details.title: Pet Pet Pet: Tidy Up!
details.short_description: 3,000 sleepy pets have taken over your shop. Scoop up kittens and puppies from 150+ adorable breeds, tuck each one into its matching bed, and watch total chaos turn into a perfectly organized pet paradise. No timers. No pressure. Just pets.

details.title: Mirrorbane
details.short_description: A tactical roguelike deckbuilder set in a dark fantasy world with atmospheric pixel art. Recruit unique heroes, combine their cards into a single deck, and develop your team in town between expeditions.

name: Staying at a Japanese Business Hotel

details.title: Staying at a Japanese Business Hotel
details.short_description: There's something exciting about staying at a business hotel. A room you've never seen, a night all to yourself. What will you do? Please relax and enjoy your stay with us.

details.title: Unknown Depths
details.short_description: Climb down a deep, dark shaft with up to three friends. A blind worm grows out of the rock and hunts you by scent: move fast and it follows your trail. Light holds it back, but not for long. Hook, swing and rappel deeper, while your friends' voices echo down the shaft.

details.title: Night Concierge
details.short_description: November 2003. Night shift at the front desk of a post-Soviet apartment block. Something is wearing your neighbors' faces. Check the resident log, question visitors over the intercom and call their apartment: if they answer from home, who's at the door? PS1-style first-person horror.

details.title: Auto Mechanic Tidy Up
details.short_description: Tidy up the auto repair shop! Sort the tools and spare parts, put everything in its place, clean off the dirt, and build a car piece by piece!

details.title: Midnight Yakiniku | 深夜焼肉
details.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a yakiniku restaurant in Japan. As the owner, you open the restaurant and welcome customers as usual. But that night, orders begin arriving from Table 7—a table that shouldn't exist...

details.title: Street Food Restaurant Owner
details.short_description: Build your own street food business! Cook delicious meals, serve hungry customers, manage ingredients, unlock new recipes, and protect your reputation as you transform a small local food stall into a legendary destination.

details.title: Hunter Road
details.short_description: Earn gold by capturing and dismantling monsters? Buy rifles at the shop? Defeated allies vanish forever? Welcome to the new standard of permadeath monster RPGs. Experience a retro, yet refreshingly addictive gaming adventure.

details.title: Fool's Trigger
details.short_description: Welcome to the table where life is the stake. Fool’s Trigger is a tense mix of Russian roulette and a card game for 6. Load your revolver, manipulate the cards, put lives on the line, and dare to find out who will be the unluckiest today.

details.title: Kick The Piñata!
details.short_description: Grab your trusty bat and smash piñatas in this colorful incremental game. Buy weapons, unlock upgrades, rebirth, and build your strangely arranged home. Everything is cute, everything is fine, and the piñatas are definitely not alive.

details.title: Vox Populi II: 2026-2029
details.short_description: Create or choose a character with a fully customizable ideology, campaign in elections across numerous countries, then take control of Parliament and the government to lead your nation as you see fit! Your own objectives will determine your victory conditions!

details.title: Attack of the Astrals
details.short_description: Heroes and villains fight the cosmos in this tactical roguelike! Every move unleashes an attack in quick battles that reward creative strategies. Combine necromancy, explosives, mimicry and more to thwart the evolving Astral threat!

details.title: Sombie
details.short_description: Sombie offers action packed PvP, and PvE in an always online MMO. loot, kill, die, repeat. Explore an endless randomly generated world with your friends. Offering a unique spin on the Zombie survival genre, built from the ground up.

details.title: Shark Mart
details.short_description: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...

details.title: Voidrush
details.short_description: Pilot your rocket through an endless 3D tunnel, from the planet's surface into space. Dodge rotating obstacles, risk a boost for extra points and beat your personal best. Play solo or challenge up to three computer opponents. German-language interface.

details.title: RUN Gor I
details.short_description: Are you capable of mastering your own body? Do you know what you need to eat? Move and build the protein your body needs before you run out of time. Face your dreams and obtain the necessary nutrients, avoid the monsters, and run. You are not alone.

details.title: Kill Loot Heal Repeat
details.short_description: Descend into an endless dungeon in this turn-based roguelike RPG! Fight monsters, collect loot, and master skills through use. Gather resources, craft weapons, brew potions, and cook food to survive. Manage hunger, overcome deadly encounters, and grow stronger. How deep can you descend?

details.title: Planet Chess
details.short_description: Six boards. Two players. One ultimate showdown. Planet Chess transforms classic chess into an intense multiplayer battle where you fight across six independent boards at once. Outsmart your opponent, master every move, and claim victory!

details.title: Gravity Switch
details.short_description: Slide, dodge, and survive! A retro-inspired arcade puzzle game where every move propels you until you literally hit a wall. Collect every dot across 50 hand-crafted stages, dodge deadly hazards, and unlock the warp crystal to escape. Features a dozen unique chiptune tracks!

details.title: Farmer's Diary
details.short_description: There is a lot of work to be done on this farm. A long-term adventure awaits you where you can take farming and orcharding to the next level with your friends.

details.title: Train Station Staff Simulator
details.short_description: First-person sim: work at a small, new one-line station in Japan. Open up at dawn, sort out trouble at the gates, announce delays, hit the emergency stop if someone falls onto the tracks: over 60 kinds of real station work. Even with a subway line, you're one person sharing the work with your crew.

details.title: Loop Minesweeper
details.short_description: Tired of traditional Minesweeper? Try Loop Minesweeper! Familiar rules, but the board never ends. Had enough of flat boards? Rotate a sphere and sweep mines in 3D. Want something stranger? Try negatively curved space on a Poincaré disk. Super cool.

details.title: TrapRush
details.short_description: TrapRush is an online party platformer for 2 to 12 players. Each round, everyone places one item on the same course: a bridge, a spring, or a saw hidden under it. Then you all race to the flag at once. Make it while your friends don't, and you score.

name: Iron Ledger: Deterrence Has A Price

details.title: Iron Ledger: Deterrence Has A Price
details.short_description: A high-pressure management sim where you build a defense contractor from nothing, secure contracts, expand production, manage staff and supply chains, and fight to stay ahead of cash flow, compliance, and collapse.

details.title: SJM - Ski Jumping Manager
details.short_description: Take charge of a ski jumping nation and build a team for seasons to come. Select your squads, plan training, develop young talent and follow your athletes in 3D competitions. Your decisions shape the future of the team.

details.title: Reshine
details.short_description: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

details.title: Eyelord Returns
details.short_description: Eyelord is an intense, fast-paced, heavy metal match-3 pop 'em up. It is a relentless massacre of innocent rolling eyeballs, using a mouse, touchscreen, or game controller. Get into the flow alone, or bring a friend to the slaughter!

details.title: Shiver Slopes
details.short_description: A fast-paced action game where you ski through dangerous slopes, dodge obstacles, and shoot enemies (in bullet time) while navigating procedurally generated mountains. Race for high scores or beat your best times.

details.title: Watch My Step!
details.short_description: Invisible traps, different perspectives, and only one way out! In this 2–4 player online co-op platformer, every player sees different traps. Warn each other, overcome the course together, and climb to the top of the leaderboards with your best time!

details.title: Ship Miner
details.short_description: Action mining game with retro aesthetics and roguelike elements. Collect minerals from procedurally generated asteroids, improve your ship and survive The Anomaly, an unknown entity threatening The Galaxy. Can a simple miner stop The Anomaly and save everyone?

details.title: TaskBound Saga
details.short_description: An idle JRPG that sits above your taskbar. Four heroes fight through 12 realms on their own while you use your computer. Open the chests they earn, equip the gear and upgrade your party.

details.title: 4th Supplementary
details.short_description: You are trapped in an endless, haunted school loop. Evade the lingering spirit, seal the anomalies, and find a way out before it's too late.

details.title: The Pogo Witch
details.short_description: A challenging hand-drawn 2D platform game. Master the pogo technique and climb to the top of the tower, where its creator awaits.

details.title: TOP STEED
details.short_description: Enter the world of high-speed horse racing! Saddle up and drift across over-the-top tracks in this multiplayer racing game with realistic riding controls. Claim victory with your TOP STEED!

details.title: Reflections at Frostkorn
details.short_description: On the early morning he comes of age, Yu begins the sacred journey to the foothill of Mountain Frostkorn.

details.title: No Mercy
details.short_description: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.

details.title: Galactic Arms
details.short_description: Command a mighty fleet of battleships. Upgrade and customise your ships with powerful modules, and traverse the cosmos to outmanoeuvre and defeat your opponents in this strategic single-player card game.

details.title: Shole Soccer
details.short_description: Shole Soccer is a chaotic online soccer game where ball obeys physics - and your friends don't obey rules. Kick, stun or tackle your way to victory over your friends.

details.title: Slop Squad
details.short_description: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Vacuum up valuable scrap from procedurally generated maps and get it back to the scrap crusher before the things lurking inside get you.

details.title: SwitcHead
details.short_description: SwitcHead is a chaotic online co-op game for 2 where you control your friend's head... and they control yours. Shout directions, search the factory, crack the safes and build each brick toy before the conveyor belt carries it away!

details.title: Near The Sun
details.short_description: Near The Sun is a 2D action-adventure game where you slice through enemy lines with sharp dashes and race across a collapsing underworld. Experience a story that changes depending on the order you explore, and discover a way to save a girl from a long-lost "previous world."

details.title: Charmosaic
details.short_description: Relax with Charmosaic, a cozy, free-to-play diamond painting game. Match colors, place thousands of tiny diamonds, and watch beautiful pictures come to life. Choose from three difficulty levels and enjoy new free paintings every month.

details.title: Slots Up!
details.short_description: A short, incremental game about rigging a slot machine to become a millionaire.

details.title: RBM Studio's Baetis Campaign
details.short_description: A historical hexagonal turn-based strategy wargame using markers to represent units designed by Dan Fournie and originally published in C3i magazine. Throwback to the great hex-based wargames of the 70's and 80's. Solo and online multiplayer modes are supported.

details.title: A Real Life Party
details.short_description: hey ill be there soon. u should go in tho my roommates are super chill.

details.title: Split Brain Samsara
details.short_description: You and your friend are locked in the same body! In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure! Communication will be key!

details.title: Tilt Siege
details.short_description: A pinball roguelite about holding a castle. An army marches down the table toward your keep: smash it with the ball, tilt the whole table to dump soldiers into the spikes, and build towers and bumpers between waves.

details.title: Slice of Fortune
details.short_description: Slice, squeeze, and sell in this juicy incremental game. Upgrade your blade to make it bigger and sharper than ever, slice every fruit in existence, and sell their juice through the Pachinko shop to grow richer and unlock powerful upgrades through the Skill Tree.

details.title: Jingle Janitor
details.short_description: Your first night as Santa's janitor, and the elves partied all night. Sort a gloriously messy workshop until every toy part sits on its shelf, learn handy magic, cheer up the elves and save Christmas. Cozy first-person tidying, alone or with a friend on the couch.

name: Age of Failon - Birth of the Hero

details.title: Age of Failon - Birth of the Hero
details.short_description: Age of Failon is a turn-based dark fantasy strategy RPG where exploration and battle drive your progression. Build your army through adventure instead of weekly creature spawns, develop your stronghold, unlock spells and lead your hero through a massive 30-chapter campaign with 6 playable realms.

details.title: ArkSeed Terraformery
details.short_description: You are the last chance for humanity, Terraform, Build, Save Humanity one pixel at a time. Arkseed Terraformery is a 2D factory and colony building and automation game with physics.

details.title: Flak Simulator
details.short_description: Crew a WWII anti aircraft gun with your friends. Spot incoming bombers, call out ranges, set fuses and load each round by hand. Flak Simulator is a firstperson coop simulation where getting a shot on target takes the whole crew.

details.title: Via Libera: Italian Train Driver
details.short_description: Drive a regional electric train from the cab on the real Florence–Empoli–Pisa line. Wake it from cold, read Italian signals, take the dispatcher's radio orders and keep 92 timetable services on time through rain, fog and night. Early Access.

details.title: Fishing Nooks: Beaver's Pond
details.short_description: A 2D painterly fishing game for people who just want to fish. Read the water, pick your lure and fight bass that fight back. No crops, no mines, no energy meter. Chill on the water. Hard on the hook.

name: Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix

details.title: Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix
details.short_description: How many times are you willing to die for revenge? Rise from the ashes to uncover a divine conspiracy in this Roguelite Strategy RPG inspired by the classics. Lead an ever-growing team on a continent-spanning quest, fight tactical turn-based battles, and synergize your skills for decisive victory.

details.title: Oops! All Mimics
details.short_description: After losing everything on a gamble, you've been saddled with a massive debt to the city. Luckily, there's a dungeon beneath the streets filled with valuable treasure just waiting to be collected. There’s only one problem: everything in it is a mimic and is trying to kill you.

details.title: GUNBOAT-8
details.short_description: Command the ultimate vessel in this 1-4 player fast-paced naval bullet-heaven roguelike! Blast through enemy fleets, collect powerful upgrades, and combine devastating synergies to create wildly overpowered builds before the waves overwhelm you.

details.title: Another Map Simulator
details.short_description: Be the architect and the audience of a living, breathing fantasy world. Generate vast procedural maps, paint your empires, and watch as autonomous AI nations wage war, forge alliances, and build deep economies. Intervene as an active god, or sit back and watch centuries of history unfold.

details.title: SoulRoad
details.short_description: Rhythm racing meets vehicular combat. Drive, drift, jump and smash to the beat across rollercoaster skies, sunset canyons and trinary star rings. Master 19 distinct rides, survive pack battles, and race your friends over LAN multiplayer.

details.title: Paid Parking Simulator
details.short_description: Old Gus has retired and left you his run-down two-space parking lot. Take tickets, collect every fare, keep the place spotless and deal with the town's worst drivers as you grow it, space by space, into a 135-space complex in this first-person management simulator.

details.title: Awake or Sleep: Anomaly
details.short_description: Awake or Sleep: Anomaly is a first-person psychological horror game where your home becomes a nightmare. Spot strange changes, blink to distinguish reality from dreams, and decide whether to sleep or escape. Survive terrifying encounters and uncover buried memories.

details.title: NinMaki
details.short_description: What do you know as a ninja? An expert in stealth? Or a powerful killing machine? NinMaki is a side-scrolling action puzzle game where you experience a ninja mission.

details.title: Build Bigger Heroes
details.short_description: Recruit, equip, fuse, and evolve your own fantasy heroes. Build an army of up to eight in this pixel art roguelite autobattler, discover powerful combinations, and test them across three acts. Choose your encounters, rescue magical Wonders, and forge heroes worth remembering.

details.title: Blank Slate
details.short_description: Blank Slate is a first-person crime sandbox — craft graded fake IDs, run shady storefronts, launder dirty cash, hire a crew — ID makers, a dealer and a store manager — train them up, pay their wages, and let them lift the work, and outrun the heat in a city that looks the other way.

details.title: The Funeral of Kay
details.short_description: The Funeral of Kay is a visual novel style adventure game. Exiled noble Jun need to launch a space burial for his guardian Kay who died for protecting him. Guide him to the launch site, and reminisce about memories with Kay.

details.title: Vibe Train
details.short_description: A cozy train-themed idle game. Build your own train at the bottom of your screen, trade goods, carry passengers, and grow crops as you enjoy a relaxing journey through a beautiful pixel-art world.

details.title: Goshiwon | 고시원
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a cramped Korean goshiwon. You and your friend make fake ghost videos for views. But something that looks exactly like his costume gets one step closer every day.

details.title: Digging In The Desert
details.short_description: You lost your hat in the middle of a vast desert and must keep digging to find it!

details.title: Survivor Town
details.short_description: Survivor Town blends colony management, autonomous survivor simulation, and tower defense in a post-apocalyptic world. Recruit unique survivors, build production chains, research technology, craft equipment, explore dangerous lands, and defend your settlement against daily raids and powerful Bosses.

details.title: 少女三国志
details.short_description: 《少女三国志》是一款融合三国历史与异世界幻想的二次元策略RPG。三国英魂因时空裂隙降临星魂大陆，以少女之身重获力量，与魔魇军团展开跨越世界的战争。收集传奇英魂，组建最强阵容，探索隐藏真相，开启属于你的全新三国篇章。

details.title: 1000 Milliarden Dollar - Kohle und Stahl
details.short_description: Essen, 1807: Grow your family business into an industrial conglomerate. Trade, manufacture, and invest in new technology. In this turn-based business and family simulation, you’ll guide your dynasty through wars and crises until 1933—and decide who will carry on your life’s work.

details.title: Point Zero: Victoria
details.short_description: One cold case, four deathbed flashbacks. Every shift in perspective overturns the "truth" you believed. Story-driven, with exploration, deduction, puzzles, and combat. Ready for a mind-bending thrill ride with twists at every turn?

details.title: Iron Dawn
details.short_description: Pilot devastating war machines as a mercenary in an tactical mech shooter. Choose your contract, customize your loadout, deploy into fully destructible battlefields, and extract with your earnings. Get paid, upgrade your arsenal, and take on increasingly dangerous missions.

details.title: 暴走拆城 (Rampage Demolition)
details.short_description: Pilot an auto-firing weapons platform through swarms of machines in this top-down action roguelite. Level up and evolve weapons, trigger chain collapses, and cut the power to industrial districts across nine maps.

details.title: The False Alice -Retold Tale-
details.short_description: This is the trash can where all failed works gather. When you awaken, you come across three false Alices. In order to become the one true Alice, they attempt to kill each other. Who will become the real Alice? This is a visual novel where your decisions, will change the ending of the story.

details.title: Just a Villager MMORPG
details.short_description: You don't need to be a hero to protect someone's tomorrow. Set out as just a villager in this 8-bit MMORPG. Cross paths with other players, help each other, and uncover the world's secrets to the end. Play with strangers, friends, or solo. Then the Trial Tower awaits. Buy once, no subscription.

details.title: Dice Tiny Town
details.short_description: A cozy dice town builder with a brainy tetromino twist. Three dice decide the shape, building, and nature you fit into your little sketchbook town — the warm yet brain-teasing joy of tetromino placement. Use stars to fine-tune the dice, and satisfy the fussy visitors and animals in town.

details.title: Pest Protocol
details.short_description: Pest Protocol is a short incremental game about a very tired exterminator, a cursor, and infested sites that refuse to stay clean. Squash some pests, buy yourself better tools, and eventually let the whole operation run itself while you make a cup of tea.

details.title: Mole & Ore
details.short_description: Become a stylish Mole armed with a three-claw grappling hook and dig your way to fortune! Snatch valuable ores, earn gold, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your mining automation, and build the ultimate underground mining empire in this satisfying incremental adventure.

details.title: Infinite Loop: Incremental
details.short_description: A purely minimalist, text-based idle incremental game! Focused on time management and strategic planning, carefully prioritize your action queue under strict time limits. Death is inevitable, but every loop makes you stronger. Build your automation routines and break the infinite loop!

details.title: Return to college
details.short_description: How do you define university? Beyond classes, will you shop, date, exercise, or work part-time? How will you treat roommates, classmates, and everyone you meet: friendly, warm, or cold? After graduation, study abroad, find a course-related job, or freelance? Return to university; find your answer.

details.title: GhostomVillage
details.short_description: Death has brought you to the Underworld. To avoid fading into oblivion, you must fight to survive. Hunt, farm, fight, build, and trade as you slowly carve out a place for yourself in Netherworld Village. Seek a way to reincarnate—or stay behind and build a life of your own.

details.title: Arcana Rift: Tactics
details.short_description: Arcana Rift: Tactics is a turn-based tactical strategy game where Swords, Wands, Cups and Pentacles become battlefield units. Recruit your forces, craft equipment, summon powerful Arcana and destroy the enemy Tower in strategic offline or online battles.

details.title: Touhou Auto Chess
details.short_description: Touhou Auto Chess is a single-player roguelite auto battler based on the Touhou Project. Recruit companions from Gensokyo and build diverse team compositions by combining equipment, treasures, and synergies. Discover fresh combos with your favorite characters!

details.title: Antiutopia
details.short_description: Antiutopia is a fast-paced, skill-based multiplayer FPS set in a fractured sci-fi world. Built from the ground up in a custom engine by a solo developer, it delivers classic arena gun-play, tight matches, and pure competitive action. No progression grind, no gimmicks, just skill.

details.title: Metal Wayfarer
details.short_description: Build your mech. Break their war machines. Metal Wayfarer is a single-player action shooter where you swap weapons, torsos and legs, boost through firefights, and bring down towering bosses. Reclaim an occupied island and turn Iron Legion salvage into your next upgrade.

details.title: Just Weeding
details.short_description: Pull 100,000 weeds! Zone out solo or chill and chat with up to 6 players in this endless weeding sim. Feed your goat to earn cash and unlock better weeding gear!

details.title: Defend The Wall
details.short_description: Choose your hero. Kill demons. Collect gold. Build your army. Upgrade Skills. Defend the wall. In this army building incremental game, you must amass the strongest army you can to survive waves of demons and defeat the Demon Lord.

details.title: Linlang's Ledger
details.short_description: Linlang's Ledger is an idle RPG game with an ancient Chinese trading theme. Starting as a penniless merchant, you will travel across vast countries, learn professional skills, and build connections with all sorts of people, writing a colorful business legend in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.

details.title: Refluff: Carpet Cleaning ASMR
details.short_description: Refluff is a first-person ASMR sim about running your own rug-washing workshop. Scrape, soak, foam, scrub and squeegee filthy carpets clean on a real fluid simulation. Get paid for every percent, upgrade your tools, take on bigger, dirtier rugs.

details.title: Desktop Island: Idle Together!
details.short_description: Desktop Island is a co-op life sim to be enjoyed through both an active or idle playstyle. Play solo, or with up to 5 friends to restore your island and create a communal hub. Meet the inhabitants, choose your profession, master deep progression, and gather resources to build your dream island.

details.title: Desktop Divinity
details.short_description: Build a cozy idle kingdom at the bottom of your desktop. Recruit female followers, collect gold and faith, and summon goddesses. Watch your pixel companions stroll, dance, and pray while you grow your realm and upgrade its facilities.

details.title: BPM Boy
details.short_description: BPM Boy is a physics-based platformer, featuring hidden secrets, leaderboards for speed-runners and a funky original soundtrack.

details.title: 2D Hates 3D
details.short_description: A short incremental game where you play as Commander, leading a squad of flat 2D shapes against an invasion of 3D ones. Clear timed waves, collect scrap. Upgrade 200+ skills in a skill tree, from squad damage to time-bending perks. Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.

details.title: Tanks & Trebuchets
details.short_description: A WW2 tank in a medieval world, fighting armies of several hundred soldiers at a time and knocking down their castles. There is an open-world campaign, a Gauntlet roguelike mode, and online co-op and PvP with friends for up to four players.

details.title: Monster Showdown
details.short_description: Survive escalating waves of monsters in a fast-paced first-person horde shooter. Earn cash, build your arsenal, upgrade your weapons, grab powerful Perk Donuts, repair defenses, defeat bosses, and unlock wild modifiers that change the way you play.

details.title: The Film Archive
details.short_description: Restore order to a film archive in this cozy first-person sorting game. Inspect films, reunite numbered reels, and shelve 400 films across three floors. Unlock useful upgrades and turn towering piles of film cans into a satisfying, organized collection.

details.title: Meow Star Archives
details.short_description: Restore the cats' damaged memory archives in this hand-drawn puzzle game. And you'll also discover the stories of these lovely cats before they returned to the stars! No timers, just enjoy the satisfaction of each piece falling into place. Come and enjoy some cozy moments with these lovely cats!

details.title: COSPECO: Greedy Bullets
details.short_description: Dodge enemy fire, shoot back, and keep getting stronger in this easygoing action shooter! Switch between 9 different costumes to completely change your playstyle and turn the tide when the battle gets tough!

details.title: KINETET
details.short_description: A falling-block puzzle driven by physics. Adjust your angle and power to launch blocks that roll, tumble, and stack. Connect same-colored blocks from wall to wall to clear them, and compete with players worldwide for the high score on the online leaderboards!

details.title: MeowFactory
details.short_description: Welcome to the MEOWFACTORY! Automate production lines and manage limited space to achieve perfection. Connect machines with conveyor lines and minimize hand (well, paw) labour! In the near and depressing future, when the world is on the verge of destruction, ONLY MEOWORKERS can revive production!

details.title: Rock Racer GOLD
details.short_description: Rock Racer GOLD, Is A (1 To 4 Player), Old-school Battle Racer Game. challenge your friends to the ultimate race circuit, and see who is the best racer. Then verify you are still the best whenever the challenge arises with infinite replay ability.

details.title: Lumanto
details.short_description: A free fantasy RPG of hooded heroes and 350+ magical creatures. Play on your own whenever you want, or join a live stream's caravan from Steam or the Twitch chat. Build your heroes, tame creatures, forge gear and trade in a player market powered by Lúmen.

details.title: Box Them Cats
details.short_description: Box Them Cats is a cozy drag-and-drop puzzle game. Grab wandering cats, sort them into the right-sized boxes, recycle the sneaky trash bags, and take on clients’ challenges to earn goddess blessings.

details.title: Paragra: Paragliding Adventure
details.short_description: Paragra is a 2D arcade paragliding game. Climb in thermals, become an XC league hero and win competitions. Read the sky and don't land in a field too early.

details.title: 1 AM MOSCOW TIME
details.short_description: A 2D adventure about rescuing magical creatures in Moscow and the role of a design bureau employee in this whole story.

details.title: Newborn
details.short_description: Newborn is a 3D online fantasy RPG for Windows where every journey begwins at the very start of a life. Create a character, step into the medieval town of Rokento, and set out across a living continent of desert dunes, frozen glaciers, misty marshlands, open seas and far-off islands.

details.title: The Endless Harvest
details.short_description: The Endless Harvest is an idle village-builder crossed with a tower defense. Build a farm that earns money on its own, invest it in towers and upgrades, and survive waves of raiders that grow stronger every round. Production continues while the game is closed — how far will you get?

details.title: Unearther
details.short_description: Explore a handcrafted-procedural world where discoveries and challenging adventures await. Gather resources, craft equipment, build your home, survive dangerous creatures, and uncover the mysteries hidden within.

details.title: webFPV
details.short_description: Learn FPV from your first hover to a pro licence. Race five inch and whoop tracks, freestyle a whole town (even upside down in 3D mode), build your own maps, then play six mini games. A manga styled drone sim that runs fully offline.

details.title: Infinite Crosswalk
details.short_description: Infinite Crosswalk is a psychedelic walking simulator and horror game in retro 3D style. You get hit on a zebra crossing and trapped in limbo. Uncover the victims' tragic stories to escape — or pay with parts of your own body.

details.title: Dragon Era: Rogue Slots
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelite JRPG where every battle begins with a slot machine SPIN! Match elemental heroes, stack relic synergies, and hire delightfully quirky crew from 800+ recruitable members as you sail through strange islands, comedic random events, and treasure-filled adventures.

details.title: Cure The Dead
details.short_description: Run a pharmacy for the infected. Stock medical supplies, diagnose zombie customers and craft cures to sell or trade. Hire customers with useful skills, assign them roles, unlock new resources and upgrade your pharmacy through a growing skill tree.

details.title: Cargo Lines
details.short_description: Build a bustling railway network and juggle cargo transport in real time. New stations appear, the flow of goods shifts constantly, deadlines loom, and trains collide if you don't keep your eyes on them. Keep your cool and master the chaos as orders pile up, and every second counts.

details.title: Empire Water Works
details.short_description: A steam engine simulator based in a water pumping station. Operate and maintain your pumping station day and night, maintain city water pressure and fulfill contracts. Interact with realistic steam, coal-firing, and audio simulation in a vintage setting.

details.title: Island Sort
details.short_description: Pirates trashed the island! Grab thousands of scattered goods and sort them into the right crates and shelves, solo or in 3-player co-op. Unlock portal doors, uncover secrets and race a friend in 1v1 sorting duels.

details.title: Carry On Together
details.short_description: Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players. Run a tiny delivery company with your friends: lift heavy furniture together, drive the truck across town and deliver everything in one piece… or don’t. Can you keep the company alive?

details.title: 狂猎世界
details.short_description: As a tactician, the player will take on the role of a demon hunter squad commander. Lead your team into the dungeon to collect resources and develop the team, confront the combat challenge known as "Flood," and ultimately succeed in passing the final trial.

details.title: MOI
details.short_description: After an embarrassing video, Mimp tries a makeover that promises a perfect face and effortless confidence. It also makes caring feel unnecessary. A short psychological horror visual novel about shame, appearance, and deciding what you can afford to lose.

details.title: Dear Gardener
details.short_description: A quiet first-person game about honest work, kind employers with secrets, and a crow who steals. Mow the lawns, trim the hedges, water the flowers and send the harvest to market. Everyone who hires you is lovely. Everyone who hires you is hiding something.

details.title: Patch Zero
details.short_description: You are a tiny security agent inside a hacked corporate network. Blast through server rooms infested with worms, botnets, trojans and ransomware, pick upgrades, and reach the Core Server in this fast top-down roguelite.

details.title: 多元幸存者 Diverse survivors
details.short_description: Diverse survivors is a 2D top-down solo ARPG horde survival game. Fight monster swarms, enchant single skills, loot random affix gear and unlock set bonuses with full armor sets. Make unique builds, explore multiverse dungeons alone and grow strong with gear enchantment systems.

details.title: Studio Sim
details.short_description: Build a film and television empire in a living entertainment industry beginning in the 1980s. Create and manage productions, cast unique talent, outmaneuver rival studios, climb the box office and grab television ratings in this immersive, old-school tycoon sim.

details.title: Our Life: Now & Forever
details.short_description: A paper airplane, two new neighbors, four autumns, and a one of a kind life. Create an experience that’s all your own in this near-fully customizable, choice-heavy story where you grow from childhood to adulthood.

name: Wave & Sort: The Magic Wand Shop

details.title: Wave & Sort: The Magic Wand Shop
details.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game in a wrecked magic wand shop. Find a home for 2,400 wands, tidy up the elemental halls and unlock handy upgrades. Play at your own pace, with no timers and no fail state.

details.title: Mammalarium
details.short_description: Relax and collect over 500 unique mammals in this cozy idle game. Watch babies grow into magnificent adults in real-time, customize warm woodland habitats across 9 themed packs, and discover rare species from tiny shrews to great whales.

details.title: Sime Returns
details.short_description: Sime Returns is a quirky, darkly comedic action-adventure about a fisherman, his cats, and the island that decided it no longer likes him. Rescue your cats from furious villagers, and unravel the mysteries lurking beneath the sunny shores of the Adriatic.

details.title: How Smart Are You
details.short_description: The year is 3518. On a faraway planet you find a pyramid built by someone very clever, and nobody is there. Inside, 30 puzzle rooms test your IQ. Every room hides one right door, every mistake costs you points, and six pictures on the walls slowly tell you what happened here.

details.title: Himekishi Survivor
details.short_description: Protect dragon eggs and fight enemy hordes with auto-attacking skills and rideable dragons. Collect and fuse gear, unlock outfits that change your starting skill, and turn defeat into Awakening powers. Conquer four stages and their mighty bosses in Himekishi Survivor.

details.title: Crash Protocol: The Wrong Directive
details.short_description: Turn robot pursuit into a collision trap. Outsmart malfunctioning machines in turn-based grid strategy with tactical bonuses and Safe Teleport. Take on 50 campaign levels, endless Survival, ASCII Classic, and a Weekly Challenge with replay-verified online rankings.

details.title: Taskbar Fishing & Aquarium
details.short_description: An idle fishing and aquarium game for the corner of your desktop. While you work, a small window quietly fishes for you. Collect 35 species across 10 rarity tiers, then decorate your tank with castles, rocks and coral to build the aquarium you want.

details.title: Tinsel Tumble
details.short_description: A cozy Holiday falling-block puzzle game. Drop pairs of elves and presents into the well, land an elf beside presents of its color to wrap the lot, and set off chain reactions. Story, Endless, 50 Challenges, Daily, an Advent calendar, and couch Versus and Battle mode for up to 4 players.

details.title: Tidy Mall Together
details.short_description: A cosy co-op tidying game. Sort + 7000 runaway things back onto the shelves of 18 shops with up to 3 friends. Grab, stack and shelve, unlock magnets, scanners and sorting robots, hunt 25 golden items, play mini games and turn the messiest mall in town into the tidiest.

details.title: Creator Tycoon
details.short_description: Run a creator company with your own studio and production team. Combine production cards, design workflows, and furnish your workspace with equipment and housing items in this management sim. Develop your staff, grow channels, and expand through sponsorships and creator contracts.

details.title: DWARRF: A Pinball Roguelike
details.short_description: Grab your balls and set sail on your 'pirate' minecart into the depths of the mines. Fight enemies in a unique blend of Pinball & Pachinko, with turn-based combat whilst collecting game altering balls, relics, & runes that ensure no two runs are alike.

details.title: pieces/渡り鳥のソムニウム
details.short_description: 不愿入睡的少女，渴望长眠的少年。 当两人的梦重叠之时，传说将再度流转。 最终，与你一同坠入浅眠之国。

details.title: Lifeguard Simulator
details.short_description: Guard the beach, react fast, and save lives using quads, jet skis and drones. Patrol the bay, help those in need and uncover a hidden criminal intrigue beneath the waves.

details.title: Bio Inc. Total Defense
details.short_description: Bio Inc. Total Defense is an incremental tower defense game set inside your body. Command your immune system against massive hordes of viruses, bacteria, and other pathogens. Upgrade your defenses, place them wisely, and fight for every inch of your body.

details.title: Starship Crafter
details.short_description: Take on the role of a starship mechanic and pay off the immense debt your father left behind. Craft components, build starships, and take contracts from factions. Follow galactic events, and pay the debt before the deadline.

details.title: Battlethorne: Reckoning
details.short_description: Fight, build, and strategize in a massive third-person action-strategy RPG with hundreds of units and large-scale tactical battles across vast battlefields.

name: Piece and Quiet: A Stained Glass Restoration

details.title: Piece and Quiet: A Stained Glass Restoration
details.short_description: A cozy first-person game about restoring stained glass. Relax and enjoy cleaning up dusty shards, as you match their shapes and colors, and rebuild six beautiful windows in a ruined mountain chapel. Unlock magical upgrades and take as long as you want, with no deadlines and no way to lose.

details.title: Taccy: TacFPS Aim Trainer
details.short_description: Taccy is a lightweight tactical FPS aim trainer built around actual in-game scenarios. Train corner clears, holds, counter-strafing and aim duels, then replay every rep to see what caused each miss.

details.title: The Eggsortist
details.short_description: A chicken possessed by the Devil has laid 4,266 colored eggs in a barn, but 666 of them are demonic eggs in disguise! Sort the eggs, find the evil impostors, and burn them before they hatch and doom the world.

details.title: Make It Cozy
details.short_description: Turn awkward spaces into welcoming homes in this relaxing interior design game inspired by Feng Shui. Arrange furniture, complete client orders, and unlock My Home — draw your own floor plan and furnish it your way.

details.title: Campaign Forge
details.short_description: Infinity grows - Your story never ends. Create worlds, heroes, and play your legends chapter by chapter. Fight, explore, and shape a world that remembers you and your Party. Generate it free and fully offline, then change it how you want. Campaign Forge - The 2D Infinite Story RPG.

details.title: MovingLog
details.short_description: A physics-based team party game for up to 12 players in four teams. One player hoists the log overhead while teammates ride on top, and where they stand decides how it tilts. Clear obstacles, ride a rival team's log to throw them off, and get your log and your whole team to the goal first.

details.title: Boardgame Nights
details.short_description: Boardgame Nights is a 3D board game collection with 16 games. Play alone or online with up to 8 players!

details.title: WRECKRUN RACING
details.short_description: Free arcade racing with competitive AI, 14 race maps, a rally stage and a sandbox. Race five rivals, beat the clock and hold the perfect line. Keyboard, gamepad and steering wheel supported. A high school graduation project.

name: Magical Rune Tower: Sort the Alchemist Tower

details.title: Magical Rune Tower: Sort the Alchemist Tower
details.short_description: Discover an abandoned alchemy tower in the forest and reorganize it at your own pace to become its new owner. Arrange more than 2,500 randomly scattered objects using a map and ancient magical runes, unlock blocked rooms, and enjoy an experience with no time limits.

details.title: LLM Tycoon
details.short_description: It's late 2022 and the AI race just started. Train models with real personalities, fill the map with datacenters, survive the scandals, and get to superintelligence before the rival CEOs who trash-talk you on social media.

details.title: Port Solano City: Gangster War
details.short_description: Come home to Port Solano as Jay Brooks and rise through its criminal underworld. Steal cars, take over gang turf, survive five-star police chases and fly helicopters and fighter jets across an open city full of side jobs, properties to buy and changing weather.

details.title: Goobies 2
details.short_description: Blow up blobs and battle bosses in co-op! Find your favorite goobie and master its abilities and evolutions. Combine mutations into unique builds and collect powerful evolving omens in this roguelite shooter.

details.title: Arkheron
details.short_description: No two runs are ever the same. New loot, new enemies, new strategies, new memories. Arkheron is a fast-paced, isometric PvP where every item you grab rewrites how you play mid-fight. Take two friends up the Tower, pull off strats that shouldn’t work, and fight your way to the next floor.

details.title: Grandpa Sam's adventures
details.short_description: A 4-player couch co-op action platformer where Grandpa Sam and his friends are starving, so they eat a few bananas, not knowing that they belong to the Monkey King. Enraged, the Monkey King sends his minions after them. To restore peace, they must defeat him.

details.title: Chaos Rune : Heroes
details.short_description: Chaos Rune: Heroes is a stat-based action game. Can you clear it in the shortest time by positioning yourself, observing enemy positions, and using attacks to one-shot enemies.

details.title: Drako: Blood Heist
details.short_description: Drako: Blood Heist is an action roguelite set in a world of vampire cats. Hack, mod, farm and fight in a fur-raising attempt to empty the city’s blood banks!

details.title: Star TD
details.short_description: Command your defense in an ever-changing roguelite TD. Harvest resources from mine nodes, explore the fog of war, and repel alien waves. With a deep branching tech tree and permanent progression, every defeat is just a step toward ultimate power. Build. Die. Research. Repeat.

details.title: Lianur: Shadows of the Divine
details.short_description: A fully voiced fantasy kinetic novel about freedom, loyalty, and the cost of peace. Follow Tharen and his companions through a world caught between demons and beings of light, brought to life with anime artwork and an unfolding, linear story.

details.title: shooter
details.short_description: SHOOTER is a pixel-art Wild West quick-draw duel. Play solo, local two-player, or online. Free download for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

details.title: Drawbacks: Draw, Guess, Sabotage
details.short_description: The draw-and-guess party game where your friends fight dirty. While you draw, they spend ink on sabotage cards that shake, flip, mirror and splatter your doodle. Guess fast, sabotage smart and laugh at the wreckage. 2–16 players online.

details.title: Sincerely, Your Diary
details.short_description: A quiet autumn evening in a small seaside town. The soft flicker of a monitor, drizzle outside, and your favorite tracks playing in your headphones. A simple "hi" from a stranger breaks the quiet. What starts as a chat to pass the time becomes a fragile thread connecting two very different worlds...

details.title: Exodus Core
details.short_description: Exodus Core is a hard turn-based tactical game with a dark sci-fi apocalyptic atmosphere. Take control of three massive mechs with the digitized personalities of soldiers and face a Swarm of thinking monsters from the dark. Can you win a hopeless battle?

details.title: Bride of Koshchei
details.short_description: Masha falls asleep over a deadline in Moscow and wakes up as Vasilisa, a young woman promised to Koshchei. Learn the rules of the living forest, protect your true name, and choose an ally in a dark fantasy visual novel inspired by Slavic folklore.

details.title: Restore The Internet
details.short_description: A cozy incremental on a retro desktop. Restore forgotten websites one block at a time, then connect them: where you place each page changes its income, traffic and repair speed. Upgrade, automate, and finish with a proper ending. No forced resets.

details.title: Paint the Town
details.short_description: One morning, every color in town is gone. Grab a brush and bring it back: paint houses, cars, trees and towers until the gray city glows again. A calm, satisfying first-person incremental game — from a single brush to a paint cannon. Almost half a million square meters are waiting.

details.title: Escape From Streamer House
details.short_description: Trapped inside a dangerous streamer's house, you must find his computer, delete a compromising private video, and escape before he catches you. Hide, solve puzzles, explore dark rooms, and survive a terrifying game of cat and mouse.

details.title: Sorcerous 2 City of Cults
details.short_description: Kick down doors, hunt sinister cults, and face bloodthirsty gods in a dark diesel-punk metropolis. Lead a group of magic-school students into turn-based battles with carefully chosen spells, talismans, and occult weapons.

details.title: ORYFT
details.short_description: Drill through underground walls, collect resources, craft powerful drills, and fight the creatures lurking beneath the surface. Restore the Lumera-01, defeat five bosses, and test your skills in the Infinite Rift.

details.title: Discharge Pending
details.short_description: Everyone was evacuated. Except you. A first-person psychological horror game set in an empty hospital. Ride down ten floors and decide on every floor whether anything has changed. One mistake sends you back to floor 10. Speak, and something in here learns your voice.

details.title: Winky!: Find the Golden Ticket
details.short_description: 1 Billion chocolate bars! One golden ticket is hidden in a mountain of Winky chocolate bars. Open them, rewrap the chocolate as your own knock-off brand, Wonko!, and sell it. Hire staff, build production lines and grow a factory big enough to find the ticket, alone or with up to three friends.

details.title: BABKA-TERROR
details.short_description: You are a real estate agent whose job is to determine which elderly woman is an ordinary seller and which one is a scammer granny.

details.title: Am I Nima
details.short_description: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

details.title: Unseen Beings
details.short_description: Unseen Beings is a short survival horror game where you avoid or confront invisible entities while exploring, solving puzzles, and overcoming horrors to pay off your debt. Use special goggles, a taser gun, and your wits to survive the night.

details.title: Botlands
details.short_description: Connect code blocks together to build bots to compete against other players in various simulated mini-games.

details.title: 2.3 Billion
details.short_description: A mesmerizing active incremental. It starts slow, with a few sparks. Then they're everywhere and you can barely keep up. Every reset, a new perk. A few hours in the flow. First goal: 2.3 billion. Of what? You'll have to play to find out.

details.title: For Our King
details.short_description: A medieval Tower Defense x Autobattler Roguelite. Defend your Keep across escalating waves, recruit different unit types, and cast spells from different Schools of Magic. Spend what you earn on a skill tree with over 300 upgrades, and place them on a Decree Bar with many unique modifiers and mults.

details.title: Mind the Clown: Reborn
details.short_description: A first-person survival horror game set in a cursed circus shaped by childhood memories. Move carefully and hide from the demonic clown stalking you. Explore dangerous attractions and burn circus posters to break the curse and save your life.

details.title: Yule Dads
details.short_description: Yule Dads is a chaotic multiplayer Christmas party game. Gather your friends and trick, grind, and race through the mall to win the last presents before closing time.

details.title: Restaurant Rush Together
details.short_description: Run a Brazilian pastel shop in first person: roll the dough, fill, fry and serve every pastel with your own hands. Hire staff, build your shop your way and grow from one kitchen to outer space, solo or with up to 10 friends online.

details.title: Royal Guard: Hive Rescue
details.short_description: Blast through robotic enemies and rescue captive bees in Royal Guard, a fast-paced arcade shoot ’em up. Fly solo or team up in two-player online co-op, power up your attacks, and take on eight unique bosses. Save all of the bees to unlock the final showdown.

details.title: The Ashen Crown
details.short_description: A roguelite tower defense where towers are empty vessels and runes are the build. March across a generated world, socket the loot you find, and play every wave with the Crown's own abilities. When you fall, only the Worldtree remembers, and it opens new ways to play, not bigger numbers.

details.title: Stalkers Strand
details.short_description: You're only here to fill your scavenging quota, sweeping the dark shoreline with your metal detector for lost trinkets. But the beach belongs to something else at night. Tread carefully, or Stalkers Strand will claim yet another victim.

details.title: EXORCISMUS: Vade Retro Satana
details.short_description: A psychological exorcism horror featuring the unique Presence System and a 3D Jumpscare effect that makes demons burst out of your screen. Every sound has a source. The demon sees you, hears you, senses your fear. Forget predictable jumpscares.

name: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive!

details.title: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive!
details.short_description: Bring order to a perfume archive of 3,240 bottles, solo or with a friend, in this relaxing first-person organizing game. Read labels, place bottles on the right shelves, develop helpful skills, and watch completed collections light up the archive.

details.title: Shellcrushers
details.short_description: Shellcrushers is a stylized horde tower defense game: tens of thousands of roaches pour in at once, and you meet them with six turrets, RPG-deep upgrade trees and procedurally generated maps, so no two fights play the same.

details.title: Screen Survivors
details.short_description: An idle survivor-like that sits in the corner of your screen.

details.title: Dreadwinter
details.short_description: Take control of Dreadwinter, your very own magical coffee shop! Explore a vibrant, fantasy world, master your craft, and turn a small café into a legend in this spooky, cozy coffee shop sim!

details.title: HOOD
details.short_description: Local gangs got you laid off your shit job. In the urban jungle of possibilities, your survival instincts kick in to keep a roof over your head, find ways to make bread alone or with your buddies.

details.title: Sort My Pigs
details.short_description: [No AI] Sort My Pigs is a 2D organizing simulator where you sort over 5,000 cute pigs into their correct pens. Pick a pig, find its pen, earn coins, and unlock upgrades as your farm grows. No timer, no pressure, just pure, cozy sorting bliss.

details.title: SUFA: Strike Fighter
details.short_description: Fly a modern strike fighter low over a real, 1:1 map of Israel. Thread the Tel Aviv towers, explore 120+ real places in Free Flight, fly six sorties from training to historic 1967 and 1981 strikes, and land it back home. Easy to learn, with a live coach.

details.title: Siberian Prison Builder
details.short_description: Build and run a Soviet prison camp in the frozen taiga. Plan cell blocks, keep the stoves lit and the prisoners fed, and hold the wire through blizzards, riots, fires and breakouts. Or grab a shiv and break out yourself.

details.title: Wrapuzzle
details.short_description: An original game of patience and relaxation where the jigsaw puzzles only have two edges! Reassemble them and wrap them around objects of your choice to display on your shelves. Human-made unique designs. Choose between 100 and 2,000 pieces, and have fun!

details.title: DEVILS : THE BORUTA REVENGE
details.short_description: DEVILS is an arcade-logic game with rpg elements created in the retro atmosphere of Commodore 64 computers. It was created using 16 colors known from Commodore 64. The game is available in two language versions: English and Polish.

details.title: Arrow Hell
details.short_description: Play as a Magical Arrow and Fight for your Survival in the Space. A fast-paced arcade game packed with relentless and sci-fi enemy waves. Dodge, Attack & Upgrade and stand until the end in this Short & Minimally Designed Action Arena.

details.title: Embodybird
details.short_description: Embodybird is a small, physics-based game with continuous bird flight controls. Decide how hard to flap, how far to spread your wings—even how wide to fan your feathers! Fly, land, hunt, and carry your catch home before dark. EMBODY THE BIRD!

details.title: Sort It Together
details.short_description: PLAY FOR FREE WITH FRIENDS! Clean, sort, and restore messy places together. Enjoy a relaxing tidy-up experience or turn up the chaos! Take on jobs, earn money, and build your own cleaning business. Just leave every place cleaner than you found it. How hard could that be?

details.title: MUKIMUKI NYANKOS
details.short_description: Online party chaos for up to 8 friends: train fluffy kittens in a neon gym until their muscles break the roof. Steal gains, suplex your friends, become a kaiju and survive laser pointers, Roombas and UFO abductions. Whoever weighs the most at 11 PM wins.

details.title: The House on Grisewood
details.short_description: A top-down survival horror shooter set in a haunted manor. Explore room by room with a failing flashlight, scavenge ammunition and batteries, and fight or evade what stalks the dark. Reach the ballroom and end what laughs there, or hold out in an endless Zombie Survival modes.

details.title: Blackest Friday
details.short_description: Black Friday night, and the shoppers turned. Drive straight into the zombie crowd: back-to-back roadkills build a RAM combo, long drifts end in a TURBO. Turn loyalty points into coupons and survive until closing time.

details.title: Escape Your Boss
details.short_description: An overworked accountant in a ninja suit takes on his entire company. Fight your way out of Megacorp Tower in a pixel-art action platformer, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

details.title: Leila's Play
details.short_description: A ghost turns the theater upside down right before the first big performance of the young theater group "ShakesPeer". Explore the winding theater, solve puzzles and earn the trust of a diverse group of friends. A heartwarming adventure about friendship, inclusion and neurodiversity.

details.title: DeathSlots
details.short_description: The Rules are Simple: You must reach 1,000,000 Cash --- If you run out of cash you die!! 💀

details.title: Metal Simulator
details.short_description: Start as a solo metal musician in 1970 and build the greatest metal band of all time! Write songs, release albums, recruit musicians, tour, grow your fanbase, and evolve with the changing sounds of metal across the decades.

details.title: Dome RPG
details.short_description: A boy named Taro once woke up in a mysterious world. Why is he here and how will he get out? Experience this world in Dome RPG and follow a text based prequel story in Dome Zero!

details.title: Necromancer: Revival of the Dead
details.short_description: Raise the fallen and build your own legion of the dead. Command the kings you defeat as elite summons, swap between 8 shot types and unleash screen-filling skills in this dark fantasy survival action game.

details.title: IDEAL DEATH GAMBLING
details.short_description: Challenge Death in a dark fantasy poker roguelike deckbuilder. Build powerful hands, combine supernatural Jokers and Soul Cards, bargain in the Black Market, and survive seven deadly contracts against cursed dealers. Risk everything, master your multipliers, and face Death itself.

details.title: Survivors
details.short_description: Survivors is a tower defense game mixed with roguelite elements. Place your survivors, test your strategy, lose, earn resources, upgrade your defenses and try again, stronger.

details.title: Construction Site: Tidy Up Together
details.short_description: The delivery truck just tipped a whole building into one giant heap. Dig out bricks, logs, steel beams and Sash Windows, check the plan and fit every part into its glowing blueprint slot. Then bin the rubbish, return the tools and watch the lights come on, solo or with your crew.

details.title: System Critical 3
details.short_description: Step into the fast-paced, high-energy world of System Critical 3, the ultimate VR platformer-shooter designed exclusively for VR.

details.title: Second Saga
details.short_description: Second Saga is an adventure RPG where you can level up, raise your stats, learn from an extensive skill tree, and make important decisions while traversing a large, expansive, and rich stylized 2D world.

details.title: Div Zero
details.short_description: A VR puzzle adventure where dimensional fractures have torn reality apart. Explore environments destabilized by the rift, solve spatial puzzles hidden across 10 distinct scenes, and follow signals, symbols, and strange objects to uncover what caused the collapse.

details.title: NEKO-NIN exHeart SPIN! 2
details.short_description: Get ready to nyan-nyan and nin-nin in the latest entry in the NEKO-NIN exHeart franchise with even more ninja catgirls than ever before.

details.title: 孤狼之春
details.short_description: This is a true-harem galgame set in a Western fantasy world.

details.title: Duck Billiards
details.short_description: Duck Billiards is a bullet heaven where your attacks are determined by billiard balls and runs are lightning quick. Play as cool duck wizards and unlock lots of items and levels!

details.title: Dusky's Nook
details.short_description: Dusky's Nook is a cozy idle desktop game about a little mushroom guy living his life on a floating island, anywhere on your screen. He gathers mushrooms and head pats, levels up, and unlocks new looks for the island — and a friend or two along the way.

details.title: lucky me
details.short_description: A live-action interactive romance. Lin Yu joins a travel dating show as its only male contestant after failing his exams. Meet four women in first person, shape relationships through dates and choices, and discover multiple endings. Is the love on camera real?

details.title: Kings of Oros
details.short_description: Kings of Oros combines deep build customization with momentum-driven marble physics. Watch your stone soldiers violently clatter, bounce, and shatter as you craft game breaking builds. Instead of grids and dice rolls, experience real physics battles. Control the chaos with endless build variety.

details.title: Love is Undead
details.short_description: In this adventure game, play as a scientist immune to a deadly virus. Scavenge for resources, develop a vaccine, and test it on Amber, a recently infected girl. Manage supplies, explore dangerous areas, and build a bond that could save humanity. Enjoy post-apocalyptic life with a zombie girl!

name: Return to Campus II: Billionaire Heir Goes to School

details.title: Return to Campus II: Billionaire Heir Goes to School
details.short_description: Return to Campus 2 brings back absurd open-world comedy, now with online multiplayer! Play as a super-rich heir exploring a modern city and a medieval world. Complete quests, meet NPCs, cruise around, pick fights, and cause chaos across two eras.

details.title: Love, in Debt!?
details.short_description: Love, In Debt!? is a romance simulation game. You once had a beautiful relationship, but overnight you were fired, cheated on, and even got yourself in a huge debt! In order to survive, all you can do is work tirelessly! But why does it seem like you became a chick magnet after you're in debt?
developers: 华东理工大学创客空间

details.title: Llama 97 OS
details.short_description: Llama 97 OS is a lightweight, cozy virtual desktop experience. Gamify focus and productivity with various tools or customize your own LlamaSpace profile and check out your friends' profiles too!

name: The Old Circle: Ecos da Masmorra

details.title: The Old Circle: Ecos da Masmorra
details.short_description: A pixel-art action RPG for 1 to 4 players. Choose one of five classes, master real-time combat, shape your build with glyphs, runes and 50 gear sets, and descend through 21 dungeons with their own deadly rules to face 21 bosses, solo or in online co-op.

details.title: I'd Choose the Bear
details.short_description: Thirty days to save your late Nana's cottage in Honeywood, a lakeside town where bears and people live side by side. Date six very different bears (one of them is technically a human), outwit a resort developer, and decide who you'd really rather meet in the woods.

details.title: ANU: Tablets of Thoth
details.short_description: ANU: Tablets of Thoth is a 3D platformer adventure where you play as Anu, a reincarnated jackal god. Sprint, scale, swim, and sail across Ancient Egypt. Use Soul Syphon to defeat undead enemies, discover hidden secrets, collect artifacts, and stop the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture.

name: Note Defender: A Sight Reading Arcade

details.title: Note Defender: A Sight Reading Arcade
details.short_description: Memorize the notes on the treble and bass staffs as well as 9 ledger lines above and below them. This covers every key of a standard 88 key piano and most instruments.

details.title: D.U.B.B.I.O
details.short_description: Become D.U.B.B.I.O, a counter-terror AI deployed to the city of Sowrat. Juggle simultaneous hacking tasks to interfere with terrorists, gather the clues they leave behind, and deduce where they will strike and how they are armed. But this mission is only the surface of the operation.

details.title: Planet Sweep Company
details.short_description: Clean up the danger zone on an undeveloped planet and find hidden landmines! Planet Sweep Company is a game that brings the familiar fun of Minesweeper into 3D space. Analyze the number hints to deduce landmines, plant flags to clear dangerous zones, and build up your achievements!

details.title: Arcane Abyss
details.short_description: A pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are swords, axes and spears, and you throw them. Thrown weapons stay on the board: hit one with another to trigger Resonance, a combo attack that chains to nearby weapons. Synthesis moves abilities between weapons.

name: Escape from the abandoned mansion haunted by spirits!!

details.title: Escape from the abandoned mansion haunted by spirits!!
details.short_description: Kanae Yamada, a reporter for an occult magazine, visits a vast Japanese mansion abandoned for over 20 years and now notorious as a haunted location. Trapped inside, she must solve mysterious puzzles, uncover the intentions of an unseen presence, and find a way to escape.

details.title: Sakura Arms ~Radiant Duels~
details.short_description: Sakura Arms is a unique on-the-spot deck-building card game. Choose two Megami, combine their martial arts, anticipate your opponent’s tactics, and build a 10-card deck after seeing both sides’ selections.

details.title: Fullower
details.short_description: Plant 100,456 flowers to decorate the Vegetable Boys' stage. A cozy first-person game about filling the empty terraced field around the stage with flowers, color by color.

details.title: Taiikooz War
details.short_description: Taiikooz War is a fast-paced, single-player zombie survival FPS. Survive hordes of the undead and plunge into a brutal where only survival matters.

details.title: Orion Blue
details.short_description: Orion Blue is a cozy fishing adventure set on a beautiful alien planet. Catch fish, gather resources, and build relationships with the locals. Play actively, or relax and let the game progress with Idle Mode.

details.title: Winx Club - Moonlight Quest
details.short_description: Fly into a brand-new Winx Club adventure! Play as Bloom, transform, take flight, and freely explore an open world inspired by the series. Unravel the mystery of the Festival of the 100 Moons.

details.title: Jester`s Anger
details.short_description: A fast deckbuilding roguelike boomer shooter where your deck is your ammo. Hurl paint cards, playing cards and tarot spells to smash marble chess pieces to rubble, heal on their shards, and take revenge on The Hands - the giant chess player who ate the Jester's cake.

details.title: Caster Crew
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op action roguelike where your voice becomes your spellbook. Speak incantations to cast magic, explore procedurally generated dungeons, collect powerful loot, visit shops, and face deadly multi-phase bosses together.

details.title: Iris's Idle Log
details.short_description: An idle RPG for the corner of your screen. Follow Iris's long adventure, battle for equipment and resources, and grow Life Skills like Mining, Logging, Fishing, Cooking, Farming, Writing, Painting, and Commerce. Play or step away—Iris's day goes on.

details.title: Pixel Sky Waystation
details.short_description: Become the new manager of the Sky Island, make warm food and cool drinks there, and help those traveling long roads rest comfortably

details.title: Raisin Universe
details.short_description: Turn your stream chat into the players. Viewers type in Twitch or TikTok chat to pop mines, race marbles and fight over property in 16 minigames and 3 party board games. Only you buy the game: your viewers play free.

details.title: Kitchen of Gods
details.short_description: Greece is starving, and even the gods have to cook! Build divine temples, gather ingredients, and feed the starving in this roguelite management adventure.

details.title: NULL VECTOR
details.short_description: Defend a central core in a neon geometric survival tower defense. Move and aim your operator, construct fortifications, research permanent upgrades, collect enemy ability modules, face evolving bosses, unlock endless mode, or cooperate online with up to four players.

details.title: Koishi’s Fishing Journal
details.short_description: A Touhou Project fan-made desktop idle fishing game starring Koishi Komeiji. Relax and fish, collect varied fish and rare merfolk, cook ordinary fish, gather precious merfolk ingredients, and sell dishes. Keep upgrading and unlocking your collection as Koishi’s fishing life unfolds on your desktop.

details.title: Zombie Day Protocol
details.short_description: Activate beacons, summon the horde, and shoot your way out! Survive a 25-day train journey in this first-person zombie shooter. Return aboard between battles to gear up and shape your build. Fulfill a mysterious company's contract and reach the survivors' camp alive.

details.title: Crystal Core
details.short_description: Incremental mining game about mining resources, digging up artifacts and upgrading your powers to obliterate everything.

details.title: LEARN CHINESE WITH 1000 PRINCES
details.short_description: Learn Chinese from scratch with 1000 princes! Choose from Chinese courses at different levels and themed courses taught by the prince teachers, ask them questions and receive their answers. Each prince teacher shares his own story while teaching you Chinese.

details.title: BE@RBRICK HEROES
details.short_description: Run, jump, and race your way to the finish together! Create your own missions, collect a variety of BE@RBRICK(BEARBRICK), and explore a growing MMORPG world filled with adventure. Play, create, and connect your way. LET'S PLAY & CONNECT!

details.title: Esper Overload
details.short_description: A roguelike with customizable skills and auto-battle!! Lead a squad of psychics and use the skills you’ve customized yourself to wipe out the monsters once and for all!

details.title: hamstyping!
details.short_description: Let's type together with this cute hamster! Don't squish it, okay?☆

details.title: PanicOperator
details.short_description: Flick weapons into your backpack and face the hordes in this action roguelite! Manage automatic attacks, swap overheated weapons, and merge gear. Arrange skill pieces before each run and spend earned gold on permanent upgrades. Build your own way to fight!

details.title: Gliding Together
details.short_description: Hang-glide from the summit to the landing field across 15 hand-crafted worlds. Lean to steer, dive for speed, thread rings to build your streak and slip past canyon walls, cable cars and laser gates. Chase your best run solo, or race up to three friends online.

details.title: Soul of Slime
details.short_description: Build your slime with cards, combine six elements and watch your strategy unfold in automatic battles. Survive 10 rounds, then take the same build into Endless mode and push on for as long as your lives last.

details.title: VITA: Observa.Momento.Adservo.
details.short_description: VITA is a third-person exploration game centered on observation, discovery, and the relationship between mother nature and human nature. You play as VITA-UNIT-05, an autonomous Ecological Observation Unit that awakens on an unfamiliar Earth.

details.title: ABLATION
details.short_description: A first person puzzle game where you carry one material at a time, and what you take from one surface, you can give to another.

details.title: HexWorldDefence
details.short_description: A hex-tile tower defense where every unit you place becomes part of the enemy's path. Build a maze, evolve your units and hold out for 51 waves.

details.title: Shadows of Hollow Creek
details.short_description: Uncover the truth. Survive the night. Hollow Creek is a narrative-driven psychological thriller game where investigative journalism leads Clara Pierce to an isolated town plagued by disappearances, buried secrets, and whispers of a witch. Some stories are better left untold.

details.title: Ricochet: Moonlit Gardens
details.short_description: One clever shot. A glorious chain of light. Ricochet: Moonlit Gardens is a cosy arcade puzzler about bouncing through jewels, unleashing magic and chasing the perfect combo. Explore eight worlds, 112 story missions and 112 challenges, plus a fresh Daily Challenge.

details.title: Collapsus
details.short_description: COLLAPSUS™ is a one-of-a-kind block-crunching puzzle game all about gravity manipulation and resource management! Join Leon the Chameleon as you twist, tilt, turn, & flip to solve your way through endless, mind-bending puzzles!

details.title: Pulp Friction
details.short_description: Fruit-on-fruit kitchen brawls! Roll, slice and parry as one of 18 living fruits, carve chunks off your rivals until their core shows and be the last fruit standing. 15 party modes for up to 8 players online or 4 on one couch, plus co-op raids against the mold.

details.title: MoltKeeper
details.short_description: Build a creature from parts and watch it fight. Each win pays samples of the parts your enemies wore, until they are yours to research; the rarest are carried only by wild creatures. Release builds into the Wilds to fight other keepers while you're away. A free creature builder and auto battler.

details.title: Decksplorers: Into the Shell
details.short_description: Dive into the world of Decksplorers: Into the Shell, where deckbuilding card combat meets real-time action in a thrilling roguelite adventure! Master the art of strategic card play, swift reflexes, and exploration as you venture into the mysterious ever-changing caves of "The shell"

details.title: RouteDom
details.short_description: Build your kingdom tile by tile! Draw, place, and connect roads, fields, and resources to your city in a strategic puzzle inspired by the great tabletop classics. Easy to learn, hard to master: every placement counts.

details.title: Anomaly Manual: Aquarium
details.short_description: Work the aquarium's night shift, escort visitors out, and follow the handbook, including its strangest rules. Watch for anomalies and get home safely in this single-player, first-person horror game with a story that gradually reveals the aquarium's past.

details.title: Find Alien
details.short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op stealth game. Copy the appearance of Earthlings, hide your true identity, avoid surveillance and traps, rescue your captured alien friends, and escape together.

details.title: Irregular Earnings
details.short_description: Irregular Earnings is a multiplayer physics crime shooter. Three crews in suits fight over cash, briefcases and secret documents across one city. Trade, steal, cuff and shoot your way to the payout in a world where every body, bullet and car is simulated.

details.title: Card: Heroes and Dispute
details.short_description: In this unique strategy RPG, you must collect resources and recruit an army by stacking cards in a fantasy world. Explore mysterious rooms, ingeniously use limited space to assemble powerful combat units, and face turn-based boss battles.

details.title: Lost in Ascension
details.short_description: Out of Orbit is a challenging vertical adventure where every jump matters. Navigate floating platforms, moving obstacles and unpredictable paths as you climb towards the unknown.

details.title: Enchantalot
details.short_description: Strike and enchant weapons on a magic workbench. Each success makes them stronger and worth more - but the higher you climb, the riskier every blow. Send your gear out on quests, collect relics that build on each other, and watch the numbers spiral out of control.

details.title: Who Am I
details.short_description: Lost in amnesia, face a horrific past rising from nightmares. Uncover the truth hidden in a diary. In this psychological horror where reality and hallucination blur, piece together memories before madness consumes you. When the truth is out, ask yourself: Who was I?

details.title: Super Money Ring
details.short_description: Roll as a ring to the goal as quickly as possible! Race ghosts worldwide for the fastest time on any of the 100+ carefully crafted levels! Find the secrets hidden in every level! Try the demo today!

details.title: Crop Dead
details.short_description: You aren’t quite dead yet, but you're slipping. Play as a ghost defending your own comatose body from endless hordes of ravenous enemies. Plant magical crops, harvest bizarre weapons, and cultivate an automated defense of undead flora to survive the tower and complete your resurrection ritual!

details.title: Ninja Kaizen
