details.short_description: Free-to-play, turn-based ninja RPG. Master the elements, build your jutsu, bring a pet and join a clan to fight bosses and rivals worldwide. Rise from Genin to Sage and carve your name into the global rankings. Free Ninja Kaizen account required.

details.title: Pizzeria: The Pizza Restaurant Sim
details.short_description: Build your own pizzeria from scratch! Roll the dough, slice the toppings, cook your sauce in a pot, bake the pizza in the oven and serve your customers. Tweak your recipes, furnish your restaurant, manage your money and become the neighborhood's favorite pizzeria.

details.title: Bunker Hill
details.short_description: Bunker Hill is a WW2 roguelike zombie shooter for 1-4 players. Fight through waves of undead that still haven't forgotten how to wield weapons.

details.title: BumperMania
details.short_description: An online car brawler made of voxels. Ram the other cars until they fall apart or push them off the edge. Grab weapons from crates, like a lasso, an orbital laser or an hourglass that stops time. Last car standing wins. Play with friends or against bots.

details.title: Hysterical Strength
details.short_description: A boogeywoman driven by vengeance guides a mysterious boy north across a decrepit world, cutting down the warlords in her way. With an ancient blade, a magical top-break revolver, and the perfect combo of drugs, survive or live in this 2.5D hack-and-slash FPS hybrid adventure.

details.title: Little Christmas Workshop
details.short_description: An adorable, stocking stuffer-sized factory automation game

details.title: Bauble
details.short_description: An action-stealth roguelite about newly sentient creatures investigating the sudden collapse of their ecosystem. Sneak, fight, and negotiate your way through expeditions, learning a little more about your planet each time.

details.title: Shape Sift
details.short_description: Build experimental sorting systems to separate, transform, and route flowing shapes in this minimalist physics-based automation puzzle game.

details.title: Ball Breakers
details.short_description: Welcome to dodgeball-yeeting heaven. Throw, punch, block, catch, dodge, slide and more in this ball and powerup slinging mayhem simulator. What build will you master? The choice is yours but no matter what - you won't stop laughing, that much is a guarantee.

details.title: BRAVERUN
details.short_description: Thrilling action and epic boss battles! Dash through a 90s-style pixel world in the retro action RPG BRAVERUN — cut through hordes of enemies and face mighty foes!

details.title: Parcel Panic
details.short_description: A VR arcade frenzy at the world's worst delivery hub. Sort fast, keep your combo alive, don't flip the fragile ones, and never leave your post. Just one more shift…

details.title: Space Postal Service
details.short_description: Fly from planet to planet delivering mail to the folks who live on these tiny worlds. Get to know them, just be sure not to read the mail. Chill out and fly around this hand drawn, 2.5D simulated solar system, earn money for your deliveries while collecting stamps to fill your notebook.

details.title: Schoolgirl vs Fishman
details.short_description: Schoolgirls × Mermen × Sewers! A "drenched" horror adventure! Solve mysteries to find an exit, and decide: will you run or fight? Your choices branch the story. Can they escape this nightmare safely...?

details.title: Digi Dice
details.short_description: A rogue-like dice-building game. Craft your own dice, play them strategically, upgrade your modifiers and discover magnificent combos.

details.title: Parent Printer Driver Simulator
details.short_description: Relive the anguish of being your family's IT support! Scroll, paint, ski, type, and search through a wonderfully ugly internet of the past. Find the best, and least virus filled, printer driver for whatever kind of cheap off-brand printer your parents have. Or just play the skiing game...

details.title: Snowday Co
details.short_description: Start with just a shovel and build your snow plowing business across an open-world town. Take on jobs, expand your territory, and keep up with whatever the winter throws at you.

details.title: Crounds
details.short_description: Crounds is a fast-paced PvP chess roguelike. Choose a powerful King, draft game-breaking upgrades, and bend the traditional rules of chess to destroy your opponent! Synergize your chaotic upgrades to create your winning strategy!

details.title: Crate Escape: Program & Deliver
details.short_description: Program your warehouse robot in secret, lock in, and watch every robot run its program at once. Shoves, conveyor belts and lasers will test the best plan. Race, deliver parcels, knock rivals out or capture flags, against the AI, on one screen or online. Same rules as the Crate Escape board game.

details.title: Spektr
details.short_description: Spektr is an asymmetrical online horror game where the objective is simple, haunt or be hunted. Enter a multidimensional battle with up to 4 friends. One of you will randomly be selected to become a ghost, and the rest of you will have to track down and expel the ghost from the physical realm.

details.title: Milo's Day Shift
details.short_description: Your new coworker lives in a pop-up diorama on your desktop. Milo clocks in, battles slimes and skeletons room by room, and trudges home to nap by the campfire when he's pooped. Spend his loot to forge better swords and grow a cozy little town, or just let him work.

details.title: Dungeon Stage
details.short_description: Play DND in Dungeon Stage, a solo RPG with an AI dungeon master. Explore towns, talk to NPCs, find quests, browse shops, and fight tactical battles. Shape a story of adventure, intrigue, or slice of life on an illustrated fantasy stage.

details.title: Crayon Sparks
details.short_description: Draw your escape route in a hand-drawn bomb arena! Chain explosions, collect upgrades and turn tricky terrain to your advantage. Challenge 50 solo stages, battle friends online with up to 8 players, or share one computer for local battles with up to 4 players.

details.title: 捕捉小动物
details.short_description: A casual simulation game where you upgrade different nets and abilities to catch animals with various abilities, and experience the thrill of scratching off a scratch-off ticket to win a big prize.

details.title: Horde Hero
details.short_description: Survive monster swarms with 13 classes, 57 skills and a sprawling skill tree. Grow your build offline or pursue seasonal rankings with separate online progress. Free demo now available to download.

details.title: Dungeon Overtime
details.short_description: Run the cleanup shift after fantasy heroes trash your dungeon. Assign slimes, skeletons, and mimics, turn manual cleanup into automation, and keep the next raid ready—all from a compact desktop window.

details.title: TOP CUT: Locals to Worlds
details.short_description: he card-game tournament roguelike. Build your deck, play powerful cards, and turn clever combos into match-winning plays. Counter opponents with hand traps, upgrade your favorites into shimmering foils, and climb from the local card shop toward being world champ

details.title: CARNOR CITY
details.short_description: Escape Carnor City by any means necessary. As a rogue MKULTRA agent in a rustbelt dystopia, outsmart a brutal AI ecosystem where G-Men and local crooks clash in dynamic crossfire. Leverage darkness, trigger chaotic physics, then die, adapt, and rewrite your tactical approach in a true immersive sim.

details.title: DISTRAIL
details.short_description: [Distrail] features a protagonist who suddenly becomes the 'director' of the final escape vessel project,and This is a visual novel game that tells the story of the 80 days the project takes place.

details.title: Minus Sixty
details.short_description: Minus Sixty is a single-player, first-person, story-driven adventure set in extreme cold. As mechanical engineer Viktor, head toward a village to repair its broken coal boiler. Gather resources, craft supplies, build fires to stay warm, manage your inventory, and overcome environmental obstacles.

details.title: En Garde Gambit
details.short_description: A turn-based tactical roguelite where you and your enemies plan predictively for simultaneous resolution. Every move and attack resolve at once. Outwit enemies in various maps, with various skills/upgrades, in Singleplayer, co-op, and PvP.

details.title: GO or STOP
details.short_description: GO or STOP reimagines the traditional game Red Light, Green Light as a social mind-game party game. Players alternate between seeker and runner. Runners shove, hide behind rivals, and race for first place, while the seeker watches for movement and stops them from reaching the finish.

details.title: ESCAPE: FALSE COLORS
details.short_description: ESCAPE: FALSE COLORS is a 2–6 player multiplayer chase game! Paint your character, blend into the environment, and take on random roles each round. Killers hunt, sheriffs chase, and innocents fight to survive. Hide, disguise, and run. Who will make it to the end?

details.title: Haunted! But Sorted.
details.short_description: It's 1996. Wojak needs money, and his girlfriend Dodoo is counting on him. His job: the night shift at a shop in the middle of a graveyard. Haul in deliveries, sort every product and keep one eye on the dark. Play solo or co-op, but don't go outside alone.

details.title: Rot & Bloom
details.short_description: A cozy idle compost bin for your second monitor. Feed it scraps, watch them rot into a glowing garden, then drop a Mystery Scrap and hope for a garden-sized miracle — a bloom big enough to swallow the screen. Hire gnomes, grow a season tree, and let it tick away while you work.

details.title: Mai Pillow Smash
details.short_description: A mental puzzle game about insomnia and the fragments that fill your head. Mai can't sleep. Every night, restless thoughts flood her mind. Match them, calm them, and clear the noise before it takes over.

details.title: Rash Decision
details.short_description: Co-op medical for 1-2 players. The Nurse examines a very unwell patient and SHOUTS the symptoms through a hatch. The Biochemist brews a cure from a deeply unreliable grimoire. Get it wrong and the patient mutates. Then mutates again.

details.title: The Clues
details.short_description: The Clues is a challenging logic deduction game set in Paw Town. Play as a cat detective, read the clues, and identify every Criminal and Innocent. No guessing, no luck—every handcrafted puzzle has a unique solution.

details.title: Survival Fund Manager
details.short_description: Senior fund managers put their pride on the line. Read the market first through your own intel network. Reveal or conceal information to steer stock prices your way. Outwit your rivals, earn the highest return, and prove you're the best fund manager.

details.title: Hyper-Realistic Fishing Sim
details.short_description: Cast your way through hordes of fish, explode arcade cabinets, and kill Poseidon in this tiny endless fishing combat game!

details.title: Orbisphere
details.short_description: A cozy arcade idle game about one small astronaut alone in a forgotten corner of the cosmos. Slingshot around planets to gather stardust and spend it to keep your machines humming while you're away. Every idle hour is earned. Navigate an asteroid belt, slice feral space worms and find your way home.

details.title: Who Got In?
details.short_description: A driving simulator where every passenger is different. Meet unforgettable characters, make dialogue choices, earn money, upgrade your garage, and discover the unexpected stories waiting behind every ride.

details.title: Astrolobe OS
details.short_description: A game console you can walk into. Astrolobe OS is an orbital station with a desk of your own, original games including TERMINAL ORION, and a real desktop for work. Full controller support for most controllers out of the box in every game, plus 4-player split screen on games that support it.

details.title: Panda vs Meow
details.short_description: Play a round little panda fighting off cat hordes in this top-down survival roguelite. Mix weapons and relics, unleash active skills, and buy traits between waves. Collect matching archetype traits to activate synergies that change how you fight.

details.title: Coppersmog
details.short_description: Run a steampunk lab in a world being eaten by the Coppersmog conglomerate. Breed, mutate, and trade one-eyed blorbs, pick your way through an economy built to make you complicit, and hunt the Reversal: the one discovery that proves Aldous Puddlepot wrong.

details.title: Last Choice Hero
details.short_description: Is that choice really heroic? Guide an immortal Hero through absurdly cruel ultimate choices in this dark-comedy fantasy ADV.

details.title: Christmas Wonderland 8
details.short_description: A festive family friendly Hidden Object Game

details.title: Farm Bunnies
details.short_description: Plant, water and grow fruits and vegetables to fulfill orders. Play with your friends or solo and customize your rabbit. Explore each seasons and discover their set of mechanics in this co-op farming party game.

details.title: Rolling Heads
details.short_description: The Rolling Heads is a multiplayer battle arena fighting game with literally Rolling Heads. Kind of like sumo wrestling on steroids.

details.title: Gunship Together
details.short_description: Crew a gunship with your friends and accomplish complex and diverse missions! Upgrade your ship and make intense on-the-fly tactical decisions to accomplish each mission set before you. Make sure to practice your landings; a mission isn't successful unless you make it home!

details.title: Campfire Simulator
details.short_description: Build, light and tend a realistic campfire. Chop wood, brew tea, toast marshmallows and play guitar under the stars.

details.title: Antmates: Idle Ant Colony
details.short_description: An idle ant colony with real numbers, behind glass on your desktop. Plan 25 kinds of rooms and level each one up two ways, feed your ants four kinds of crumbs, balance foragers, diggers and nurses, and chase milestones that multiply your income — cozy to watch, deep to plan.

details.title: WebCreep.er
details.short_description: Get filthy rich... Without leaving the toilet.

details.title: Please Stop Feeding The Frog
details.short_description: A first person incremental game about feeding a frog. Kill cute backyard creatures, throw them into his mouth, sell the random garbage he burps out, and buy increasingly ridiculous weapons. The frog keeps getting bigger. What's the worse that could happen?

details.title: やさ死くシて
details.short_description: Welcome, Subject 03. It's time for your psychological experiments. Four experiments. 56 endings. Save others, abandon them, or put yourself first. Every choice is yours. A simple game, really. Just decide how to use your kindness. Heh. Can you be kind? To yourself—and to others.

details.title: EAT Your Way Out
details.short_description: Had enough for today? Grab a spoon and eat your way through living jelly. Sell what you swallow, upgrade your tools, and follow your curiosity toward the exit. There is no rush and nothing to fear. Just you, your spoon, and a strange little journey for the price of a bad vending machine decision.

details.title: CatSitter - Remastered
details.short_description: A short and linear horror game with multiple endings. Play as Amy the photographer who, unknowingly, takes on a well-paid, weekend gig that turns out to house more secrets than she bargained for.

details.title: SKYGUARD: Last Light
details.short_description: A minimalist incremental defense game. Start with one missile silo over your city, destroy screens full of threats, upgrade your firepower, and turn the Moon, the Sun, a black hole and even higher dimensions into weapons. Ten scales, ten chapters, ten doomsday ultimates.

details.title: Dead Harvest
details.short_description: Prepare your defenses. The dead are coming. Dead Harvest is a tower defense game where you must protect your territory from hordes of zombies. Your turrets won’t be doing all the work: you’ll also have to fight the zombies by running them over with your motorcycle!

details.title: SpellBall
details.short_description: SpellBall is a magical billiards game for 2–4 players. Sink balls, cast spells, and thwart your opponents' plans. Compete in duels or 2v2 team matches—either online or locally on the same computer. Master 100 spells, choose from 15 arenas, and develop your own unique playstyle.

details.title: Poppets & Plunder
details.short_description: Sail a cutaway brig through four seas of Navy gunships, witch-hunters and Company gold. Run the crew deck by deck, work the guns, and when you are outgunned, reach for the voodoo doll and push a pin into the enemy ship. A roguelite of real-time fights and costly magic.

details.title: Collapsed: Build to Break
details.short_description: The cannon is back. In this sequel to the physics puzzle game Collapsed, find the weak point and topple wood and stone structures with a limited supply of cannonballs. Then build your own levels in the editor and break those too.

details.title: Last Thaw
details.short_description: Low-poly hardcore zombie survival where the cold is as deadly as the dead. Scavenge a 3.3 km map, build and defend a base, tune cars and drive out on frozen lakes, and hold out through the seasons, alone or in co-op with up to 8. No health bar: read your body.

name: L A C U N A

details.title: L A C U N A
details.short_description: A sci-fi exploration and probe-command simulation. Plot courses, scan unknown worlds, decode signals, and collect samples with a lone VESPER probe. Manage fuel, power, and damaged equipment over a delayed communications link, where careful planning keeps your mission alive.

details.title: KEYS
details.short_description: KEYS a rhythm game where you aim at the note with your mouse and hit the keys with WASD.

details.title: Idle Pirates
details.short_description: A pirate-themed incremental idle game! Destroy crates, collect treasure and venture deep into ships to rescue your crew to help you haul in even more loot. Fight your way deep into ships and take down mighty bosses.

details.title: Fire of Emotions
details.short_description: Stoke your inner flame and decide which desires to let in. Pride, Desire, Depression, Love, and other influences interact within you, shaping how life unfolds. Accept, Deny, or Abstain, but no response guarantees the outcome you intended. Let in too much, or too little, and you may become hollow.

details.title: Ruthenium Smash & Grab
details.short_description: Shoot the asteroids until they're small enough to collect. If anything hits the tail of asteroids you've collected, you lose them. Don't lose so many. Lose less. *Fewer.

details.title: Just One Trip!
details.short_description: Find room for one more box! Pack a whole move into a small van, and drive through a toy cartoon town to deliver all this stuff somewhere! Featuring Classic Puzzle mode as well as multiplayer co-op with Steam Friends!

details.title: 魔塔-织梦
details.short_description: A turn-based RPG featuring classic Magic Tower gameplay. Climb through tower floors, collect keys and gold, fight monsters in turn-based battles, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the Demon Lord and the Princess at the tower’s peak. There are three distinct endings.

details.title: Paranormal Cleaner
details.short_description: Take late-night cleaning jobs in a first-person horror game. Load up your van, mop floors, vacuum rugs, and take out the rubbish. When a cupboard opens by itself or an unplugged washer starts knocking, decide how much of the checklist is worth finishing.

details.title: Necro Helix
details.short_description: Necro helix is a roguelike RPG with 2-player online co-op. Explore 5 unique destinations, master 8 playable characters, and create powerful builds with 280 traits, 300 pieces of equipment, and the Flower Pact system. Face 40 bosses and uncover the secrets of the Deathlands!

name: 奇迹觉醒之大天使传奇

details.title: 奇迹觉醒之大天使传奇
details.short_description: 在剑与魔法的世界中开启属于你的冒险，这是一款以角色成长、装备收集、BOSS挑战和多人战斗为核心的魔幻动作角色扮演游戏。选择你的职业，不断升级、转职、强化装备，挑战更强大的敌人，与其他冒险者共同争夺大陆至高荣耀。

name: Minesweeper: Find All the Bombs in the Minefield

details.title: Minesweeper: Find All the Bombs in the Minefield
details.short_description: Minesweeper goes big. In Find the Bombs, up to 4 players clear a giant minefield together, dig up every mine they flag, conquer guarded bases and fill them with coloured bombs. Or go head to head in ranked 1v1 duels on the same board, or take on the solo Race, where one mistake ends your run.

details.title: Article 7
details.short_description: Article 7 is a short political thriller where you play as Arvenia’s Minister of Civil Authority during a national crisis. Review documents, weigh conflicting information, speak with members of the press, and decide whether to grant emergency powers to the Chancellor.

details.title: Croissant Simulator
details.short_description: Manage your own croissant restaurant. Take orders, prepare fresh croissants, purchase ingredients, manage your inventory, and keep your customers happy. No distractions—just a focused, single-player croissant simulation.

details.title: AbsoluteNeko
details.short_description: AbsoluteNeko is a co-op action game for up to four players set in a Japanese neighborhood. Play as stray cats, run along walls, cars and rooftops, slip past patrolling dogs, and regroup before time runs out. Meow to save caught friends, and take pictures of your cats in photo mode.

name: Soul Land: Legend of the Battle God

details.title: Soul Land: Legend of the Battle God
details.short_description: A 3D MMORPG set in the world of Douluo Continent. Recruit iconic Soul Masters like Tang San and Xiao Wu, hunt powerful Soul Beasts, collect rare Soul Rings and Soul Bones, build your ultimate team, and rise from Soul Master to Titled Douluo—and beyond.

details.title: I Am Octopus
details.short_description: 🐙What would you do if you woke up one day and you were an Octopus🐙 Even worse, being held captive by the evil Dr Docto who is back on his evil ways...and wait, is he using you as a test subject?

details.title: 一撇 One Stroke Short
details.short_description: There's a Chinese saying for a job that hasn't begun: the character is still one stroke short. You're the missing stroke in this puzzle adventure. Knock a character out of a sentence to clear the way, then play the four tones of Mandarin to make a path where there wasn't one.

details.title: NT Jigsaws: Northern Territory, Australia
details.short_description: A calm jigsaw and picture puzzle game made from 208 photographs of Central Australia and the Top End. Build the border, join pieces on the table, and watch a gorge or a desert sunset come together. No rush, no ads, and it saves the moment you stop.

details.title: Pop Dynasty
details.short_description: Build your own talent agency in this idle management sim. Recruit from 200 Pop Stars, train them, send them on Tour, and fight for Trophies at the Awards. Your Agency keeps running even while the game is closed. And winning is only the beginning.

details.title: Under The Counter
details.short_description: A roguelike where your weapon is a tree of absurd pills. Take the wrong prescription, descend the dungeon under Globnix, dodge telegraphed horrors, and build a run-ending arsenal from attacks and charms. Every seed is a new dungeon. Death is just a new dose.

details.title: TILELIA
details.short_description: Collect cards, place buildings, and forge your own army in this roguelite auto-battler. Combine units, spells, and relics from different factions. Make the most of limited space and gold, and discover new combinations to overcome each battle.

details.title: 200 OK
details.short_description: A node-based idle game about running a server. Wire up requests, tune the bottlenecks, research your way from one uplink to a global edge. Calm, steady and fully offline-friendly.

details.title: Elysian Realms
details.short_description: A pixel-art tower defence game for PC. Hold the road across seven realms, and each one changes a rule of the game. Every run, won or lost, feeds a skill tree that carries over to the next. No account and no telemetry: it runs on your machine and nowhere else.

details.title: Be Original
details.short_description: In this game you have the one goal of making many original characters as you can. The two rules? you cant make a character you've already made and you cant make a popular character that already exist.

details.title: One Million Skeletons
details.short_description: The dead are coming, thousands at a time. Build a Gothic fortress of ramparts, ballistae and bombards and hold it for nine nights. Every skeleton you break leaves bones behind: grind them into crowns, load them as ammunition, or watch the pile become a ramp over your walls.

details.title: Turf Wars: Slumika
details.short_description: Build a crew and run the streets of a generated city in the country of Slumíka. Cook and deal, fight rival gangs, dodge police heat, buy houses and stash your goods in this top-down crime sim. Every new game is a new city.

details.title: Can't See Shift
details.short_description: Mate. Three of you drive ONE van. The one steering can't see a thing, one's on the pedals, one's on the gears. The rest jump out with an axe, a winch and dynamite. 1-4 online co-op, every map generated from scratch. Just get the cake to the wedding. Good luck.

details.title: Vitrelium
details.short_description: Step into an atmospheric alchemy workshop. Mix substances, heat and cool liquids, distill vapors, and grow crystals. Discover reactions in a hands-on laboratory sandbox where real-world chemistry meets imagination.

details.title: Sort the Creatures
details.short_description: A cozy organizing game where you sort over 4000 adorable creatures into their matching terrariums. Discover more than 400 creature variations, unlock helpful abilities, and turn a colorful mess into a collection full of life.

name: Tidy Up the Royal Vault: Somehow I'm the Hero Now!?

details.title: Tidy Up the Royal Vault: Somehow I'm the Hero Now!?
details.short_description: A single-player cozy organizing sim. Bring order to a scattered royal vault by sorting coins, gems, and scrolls, discover hidden fragments of the hero's sword along the way, and unlock magic to make the work easier. By the end, somehow, you've become a hero.

details.title: Pickpocket
details.short_description: Pickpocket is an incremental game about stealing. Learn from your victims, get better loot, and advance through an extensive skill tree. Build your own crime empire!

details.title: Overrafted!
details.short_description: Over rafted! is a co-op multiplayer game for up to four players. Divide the work as you steer, fish, gather supplies, and make repairs. Brave the chaos of shifting winds, currents, and sea creatures, and sail your crumbling raft as far as you can across an endless, unknown ocean!

details.title: Grit & Greed
details.short_description: How much can you take and get away with?

details.title: SUSPECIES
details.short_description: Sculpt, Paint and Animate into literally anything! Show off your amazing talents in the SUSPECIES SHOW mode or Disguise and Hide in the environment in the HIDE & SEEK mode. up to 12 players, for private or public matches.

details.title: Punch Your Way Out
details.short_description: Punch through your prison cell, collect rubble, sell rocks, and buy upgrades to hit even harder. Break tougher blocks, dig deeper, and repeat. A simple, satisfying incremental game where every punch brings you closer to freedom.

details.title: Bento Together
details.short_description: Run a cozy bento shop solo or with friends in online co-op. Cook ingredients, pack lunchboxes, serve customers, and manage your supplies in this hands-on, first-person shop simulator. Unlock recipes and find your kitchen rhythm together.

details.title: Containment Shift Company
details.short_description: Run a supernatural factory alone or with up to 9 friends. Care for unpredictable creatures, turn their materials into goods, and meet rising company quotas. Haul cargo, monitor the facility, and survive blackouts and containment breaches together.

details.title: Tidy Up Christmas Shop
details.short_description: 5,434 Christmas items are scattered across the shop. Put them back where they belong and enjoy the wonderful order. No timer, no stress. Upgrade your skills with the candy you earn and arrange colourful, twinkling Christmas items on the shelves of a huge two-storey shop as you like. Merry Christmas!

details.title: Ski Lodge: Tidy Up Together
details.short_description: A blizzard closed the slopes and every guest dumped their gear in one giant heap in the middle of the ski shop. Climb a mountain of 2,000+ skis, boots, helmets and gloves and sort it all back onto the right racks – solo or with up to 5 friends.

details.title: Brick Blocks: Tidy Up Together
details.short_description: Someone tipped 10,860 toy bricks all over five brick-built towns. Grab a bucket, solo or in co-op for up to eight, and snap them back into 14 giant builds, from a rubber duck to a dragon. Finish one and it comes alive. Cosy first-person tidying with no timers and plenty of upgrades.

details.title: Saurora
details.short_description: Survive as a dinosaur on a 4 km island. Start as a hatchling, find food and water, stay away from the wrong animals and grow up. Play alone in free roam, or join an online server with friends, strangers and things that want to eat you.

details.title: I Shall Seek Immortality
details.short_description: An idle xianxia game for the corner of your desktop — with online duels, a ten-seat arena, world bosses and Steam Market trading. Eight origins, retro stick-figure battles, companions and sects in an open world, plus a stealth mode and boss key.

name: What Do You Meme?® The Video Game

details.title: What Do You Meme?® The Video Game
details.short_description: The smash-hit card game has gone digital! What Do You Meme?® The Video Game brings internet humor to the living room. Use your phone as a controller to battle your friends and build hilarious memes!

details.title: AMEN: The Quiet Exodus
details.short_description: Cursed the womb that bears emptiness beneath its heart. For twenty-five years children have been born without souls, and a soul can only be restored by taking another’s. Ilaya Cassette wants to know what’s wrong with her. A gothic visual novel, fully voiced in Russian. Prologue and Part I out now.

details.title: FOURSAVENT
details.short_description: Two Modes, CHAOS or Story Mode. Explore different universes and time eras, from cyberpunk futures to medieval ages, each with its own story and gameplay mechanics—or jump into CHAOS Mode for fast-paced fun with friends and climb the ranks.

details.title: Tavernia
details.short_description: A strategy board game for 2–8 players. Answer trivia to claim empty tiles, then beat your opponents in minigame duels to take theirs. Play cards to challenge them to typing races, word puzzles, reaction tests, and more.

details.title: Hold My Cargo
details.short_description: A first-person smuggling sim. Buy low, sell high, stash the good stuff where customs won't look and talk your way past inspection. Grow from a rust bucket to a freighter, escape the galaxy, then do it again. Online co-op for 1–4 players arrives in the first major update.

details.title: Reliquary
details.short_description: A turn-based loot roguelite, solo or co-op. Pick a hero, cross cursed regions and turn every chest into a weapon: affixes, sets, relics, cursed items and the forge. Beat the bosses, raise the Corruption, come back stronger.

details.title: Visual Novel: 3:17 PM
details.short_description: Eleven-year-old Asya arrives to visit her clockmaker grandfather in Chasovets, only to discover that time has frozen at 3:17. Alongside a talking cat and a boy collecting lost minutes in a jar, climb the old tower, solve the town's mystery, and give people back their tomorrow!

details.title: Horror Simulator
details.short_description: A night shift at the precinct turns into a nightmare when the terrifying "Subject #4" breaks free from the basement. No weapons, locked doors, dead comms. Navigate a maze of hallways, crack safes, and hide in the dark. Your shift lasts until 08:00. Will you live to see the dawn?

details.title: Tower of Misfits
details.short_description: A first-person co-op roguelite from one to 6 players. Pick one of twelve misfits, each with a weapon and an ultimate of their own, and climb a tower that never ends: a new world on every floor, bosses, perks, curses, and friends to fight over the chest with.

details.title: Earth Unbound
details.short_description: Lead a clandestine resistance in the occupied American Midwest of the 1920s. Recruit and train operatives, coordinate dangerous missions, and outwit the Occupation Bureau. Every assignment risks exposure, capture or death—and every outcome shapes your campaign.

details.title: Fishy Tidy Up
details.short_description: Grandpa's aquarium museum had a rough night: every tank cracked and 3,600 fish ended up on the floor. Fix the tanks, sort each fish into its own home by species, look and size, and bring nine rooms of sea life back in this cozy first-person tidy-up game.

name: Lost Places - Lonely Town - Collector's Edition

details.title: Lost Places - Lonely Town - Collector's Edition
details.short_description: Embark on an exciting expedition through a lonely town in the middle of nowhere. Explore detailed hidden-object scenes and solve mini-games to uncover the secrets of this abandoned place.

details.title: Core 31
details.short_description: You wake alone in an Arctic research station with no memory and a name written on your wrist. Eleven people are gone. Follow the notes you left yourself, get out across the ice, and find out what Core 31 brought up from under three kilometres of glacier.

details.title: One Tiny Delivery
details.short_description: A exploration game about delivering packages. Deliver various stuff to people residing on an island using one small three-wheeled truck. Explore the island and drive to the peak of the mountain to deliver one final package. Hear people's stories and take in the view around you as you drive along.

details.title: Wandering Far
details.short_description: A desktop idle hiking game that keeps you company while you work or study. A girl and her little dog set off on a journey across your screen—with outfit changes, camping, treasure hunting, multiple display modes, and the option to set it as a live wallpaper.

details.title: Imp Pact
details.short_description: An incremental where an ageing man who cannot read makes his mark on an imp's contract, puts the imps to work on the rats in his cellar, and is billed for the trial period. Keep the interest current, in blood, every forty-five seconds, or he takes imps back, and is apologetic about it.

details.title: Honk
details.short_description: Honk is a free-to-play, one-button precision platformer where you race real players online. Tap to jump past spikes, pipes and rocket cats, climb the ranked ladder, battle through tournaments every few hours, build your own levels, and hatch over 100 skins for your collection!

details.title: A Million Trees
details.short_description: A logging and automation game that is solo or co-op. Set in a forest with A Million Trees you can Chop down. Each tree is then processed into smaller chunks or planks then sold. Using this money you can then buy chainsaws, upgrades, conveyors and machines for automation.

details.title: The Crash
details.short_description: Wake up or run! The Crash is a high tension 5-minute horror game where you are trapped inside a dream maze. Navigate the panic, avoid the monsters and find the way out.

details.title: Ultimate RPS Championship
details.short_description: Ultimate RPS Championship turns Rock, Paper, Scissors into a full-blown 90s arcade combat sport. Build a deck of specialized moves, read your opponents, customize your fighter, conquer the story campaign, and take your strategy into PvP (coming soon).

details.title: Run Man: Wash the Dish
details.short_description: $20K in the hole. Stuck in a Chinatown dish pit. Rent’s due, the boss is barking, and the clock is ticking. Turn a 99-cent sponge into a screen-clearing cannon, trigger explosive combos, and uncover rare loot. Stack cash under the table—and scrub your way to a green card!

details.title: Soul Print
details.short_description: This is an occult mystery visual novel where you replay past memories by touching the belongings of the deceased. Breaking away from fixed choices, players must freely interrogate and converse with AI NPCs to uncover clues.

name: Tragedy : The Call of the Estate

details.title: Tragedy : The Call of the Estate
details.short_description: Tragedy : The Call of the Estate is a first-person psychological horror game about uncovering the truth upon returning to your long-abandoned family home.

name: Too Many Cats in the Plant Shop!

details.title: Too Many Cats in the Plant Shop!
details.short_description: A cozy grid-based puzzle game about fitting potted plants into a tiny shop full of cats. Arrange every plant, learn how each cat behaves, and use their little quirks to solve each level.

details.title: PERIHELIA
details.short_description: One ring, one gap, and a wall closing in. You rotate a ship around the center and find the gap before the wall reaches you. Four modes, and in MUSIC every wall sits on a beat of the track. The longer you run clean, the higher the multiplier, and at x8 the whole plane tilts.

details.title: SURVOLT
details.short_description: SURVOLT is a fast 3v3 arena sport. Pass to charge the ball, then shoot at moving wall targets: the more you pass, the more each hit is worth. Volleys, tackles, dives and a golden zone that doubles your points. Solo vs AI or online, no port forwarding.

details.title: Toddler Any Key: Work Machines
details.short_description: For toddlers and small kids who like big work machines. Press any key to advance the narrated picture book story. Dig, build and farm. Get used to a computer, finish small jobs and feel proud of what you’ve done. Encouraging and safe game for toddlers.

details.title: EGNAR
details.short_description: Discover the colorful world of Egnar! Learn to time your jumps precisely while using your cannon system to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles and defeat bad guys! Return to the essence of a 2D platformer, in which the player's precision, patience & problem-solving skills are put to the test.

details.title: Cee One Vee
details.short_description: Lead your civilization across six thousand years of history in this turn-based strategy game built for the Game Boy Advance. D-pad-first play makes it a natural fit for Steam Deck.

details.title: HEXHOLD: SIX FORMATIONS
details.short_description: Hex-grid tower defense set in the Three Kingdoms. Build your deck, summon legendary heroes, and hold the last stronghold through 20 waves of endless night.

details.title: JMT -DUeL-
details.short_description: A super-serious Rock-Paper-Scissors game, JMT DUeL. Rock-Paper-Scissors + Stats + Skills + Transparent AI Patterns. It will rewire your Rock-Paper-Scissors brain. Let's Duel!

details.title: Rogue Reels
details.short_description: Rogue Reels is a pirate roguelike where you build a slot machine to survive the Flying Dutchman’s toll. With over 100+ symbols and unique mechanics you can create combos to outrun a ghostly toll, and climb the global leaderboards. No real-money gambling included

details.title: 冒牌特攻队
details.short_description: A comic-style top-down survival action game. Fight solo or in online co-op, wield multiple weapons, and modify their attacks with attachments. Move, aim, and adapt your equipment as waves of enemies close in, building a loadout that suits your playstyle.

details.title: Love Trap
details.short_description: A suspenseful, atmospheric text adventure where you play an entrepreneur reborn two years before his mysterious death. At the scene were his abandoned ex, devoted roommate, and hostile socialite. Your choices reveal why they were there, why he died, and which truths stay buried.

details.title: Project: Summer Ice Bowling Online
details.short_description: A Christian-themed, story driven, anime-styled bowling video game in the Project: Summer Ice franchise!

details.title: SudoPop
details.short_description: Sudoku meets idle game. Solve candy-colored boards by hand, hire nine number buddies to solve with you, and watch them build boards out of boards until millions of Sudokus pop every second.

details.title: Chumacho Jones
details.short_description: An old-school game with geeky touches and countless references to geek culture from the 1980s. It's not all about shooting and fighting—complete missions and search for those objects that have left a mark on our lives. Explore Madrid's iconic locations, including streets, landmarks, and MetroMadrid.

details.title: Chromagami
details.short_description: Rip and tear through the competition in Chromagami, an interdimensional, fast-paced, handmade (literally) hero shooter. With 3 distinct origami characters, paper-built maps, and a boxload full of wacky events, learn to outfold both your friends and foes by putting them through the shredder!

details.title: Elite Engineering
details.short_description: Elite Engineering is the ultimate sandbox engineering game, characters, environments and creations all created by you and the community.

details.title: Runners Catchers
details.short_description: Get ready for a fast-paced, chaotic tag game for up to 8 players! Dash through obstacle courses packed with giant donuts and candy hazards. Evade your friends as a Runner, or hunt them down as a Catcher. Run. Jump. Catch. Escape.

details.title: ThrottleWave: Powerboats
details.short_description: Take the wheel of high-powered speedboats and battle your friends on the open water. Race for the finish line in high-speed circuits or test your precision in Gate Catching, where you must blast through spawning gates before your rivals steal the points.

details.title: Tether and Talon
details.short_description: Tethter and Talon is deckbuilding turn based combat game that borrows elements from creature collectors and roguelites. Draft your team of Yokai, play their moves as cards and make your way through rounds of enemies and send evil back in the Nether.

details.title: Harem of Lies
details.short_description: She's hoping you'll banish the wrong woman. How sweet. Unveil 30 adult anime characters in a single-player deduction roguelike, expose disguised succubi, and unlock their stories. Every Court can be won by reasoning alone. No forced guesses.

details.title: Pocket Partner
details.short_description: A lightweight, fully customizable desktop companion. Bring 3D anime characters to your screen with full VRM support. Experience unprecedented control: import your own animations, edit materials, change facial expressions, save custom outfits, and interact with physics while you work or play.

details.title: The Chair Game
details.short_description: A slightly tricky physics action game about going home in an office chair. Casters are less obliging than you'd think: hills are hard work, stopping isn't easy, and one pebble can send you tumbling into the sea. Push off with your feet, spin the seat, lean back, chair and all — and still, go home.

details.title: AREA 83
details.short_description: AREA 83 is a first-person survival horror shooter set inside a research facility overrun by the infected. Explore dark corridors, uncover classified experiments, manage limited supplies and fight to survive as you discover the terrifying truth behind the outbreak.

details.title: River Royale
details.short_description: Race 79 rival rivers down a real mountain island in a battle royale where you play as the water. Drop in from the sky, carve your route through the valleys, swallow lakes to grow, cut off smaller rivers and be the first to reach the sea.

details.title: Little Extinctions
details.short_description: Three subspecies descended from one gray ancestor meet again in a drought. Every creature carries a gene of three loci that sets its body and its behavior, and it eats, hunts, breeds, and forms packs on its own. As an alien biologist, you observe which lineages survive.

details.title: Scrapjump
details.short_description: A co-op horde shooter for 1 to 4 robots. Your mouse aims, each button fires one arm. Level up together, bolt new guns onto your arms, take down five Wardens and keep jumping to the next planet until the whole crew is scrap.

details.title: Zombie Incremental: The Last Outpost
details.short_description: Fight zombies. Earn gold. Upgrade your arsenal. Push deeper into a fallen world in this action-packed incremental shooter. Aim, dodge, and turn hard-earned upgrades into the firepower you need to survive the next wave.

details.title: Who A Meme I?
details.short_description: The King reads out an awkward situation, you answer with the perfect meme from your hand. Make the King laugh, climb from island to island and steal the crown. A 2-8 player online party game for friend groups. Note: prompts are currently in Turkish only.

details.title: 2Desktop
details.short_description: An anime desktop companion powered by AI that runs 100% on your PC, with no internet or subscriptions. Chat with Yue in English or Spanish, play your music and watch her react from her audio visualizer, or bring her into your streams as she reacts to your voice.

details.title: Ruby's Trick or Treat
details.short_description: Freeze when the music stops, solve her puzzles, and escape the house before she gets to you. A short, fully voice-acted anime VTuber horror game where every second counts.

details.title: Zombonk
details.short_description: A comedic survivors-like where you're the last thing standing between a city and a flood of thousand zombies. Auto-blast your way through the streets, herd the horde into minefields and chokepoints, level up, extract to your bunker — then go again.

details.title: Be A Chameleon
details.short_description: Save humanity, be the shining light against darkness, and destroy all evil. Not really..... it's a silly sandbox game where you play as a chameleon.

details.title: Starwreck Reclaimer
details.short_description: Pilot a combat salvager into a shifting starship graveyard in this top-down twin-stick action roguelite. Battle hostile machines, manage ammunition and hull integrity, choose risky protocols, recover valuable scrap, and build powerful weapon and module combinations.

details.title: DinoBox
details.short_description: Drop dinosaurs,merge matching species, and evolve them into something bigger! DinoBox is a physics-based puzzle game where every 20 turns, a meteor strikes the box—destroying one dinosaur and potentially changing everything. Build bigger dinos, fill your encyclopedia, and see how far you can evolve!

details.title: Starhold: Last Light
details.short_description: <Tower Defense × Roguelike> — Resist the Endless Swarm from the Stars Build along the surface of spherical planets, where every angle matters. Expand into space for more building grounds, but risk unknown disasters. Choose 1 of 3 cards, build your deck, and adapt your strategy with every choice.

details.title: Woolhalla
details.short_description: A sheep’s epic journey to Valhalla — adventure alone or with your friends in co-op.

details.title: The Pit
details.short_description: WELCOME, UNIT. YOUR PURPOSE IS TO CLIMB. FURTHER INSTRUCTIONS ARE UNNECESSARY.

details.title: Job Hopper
details.short_description: Fight for a better job in this pixel-art action roguelite. Wield four office weapons, combine Specs, and train after hours. Start at a tiny startup and climb toward bigger companies, where familiar coworkers and office machines reveal monstrous forms.

details.title: El Coco
details.short_description: Psychological horror in first person, seen through the eyes of a child caught between a broken childhood and a reality falling apart. Explore a house where fear is only the beginning.

details.title: Catkanoid
details.short_description: Catcanoid is a fast-paced, pixel-art roguelite brick breaker! Collect coins, spend them to upgrade your paddle and ball, and create powerful synergies. Help Julia the cat survive waves of enemies and defeat a challenging boss - Kuba the capybara!

details.title: Holy Night Survivors
details.short_description: Raise a holy heroine and fight undead hordes in this survival action game. Dodge enemies, evolve weapons, choose one transcendence per run, and grow stronger between battles across 15 chapters. Collect relics and 62 illustrated photo cards.

name: Just Take Me to My Floor!

details.title: Just Take Me to My Floor!
details.short_description: This is a short, rule-based elevator horror puzzle game where you aim to reach the 10th floor while following a series of eerie rules that change daily.

details.title: Dr. Harlow's Clinic
details.short_description: Treat patients and perform medical procedures as an ordinary hospital routine slowly descends into psychological horror. Finish your shift, watch your surroundings, and try to understand what is happening around you.

details.title: Chill Pixels
details.short_description: *Life can be overwhelming: take a well-deserved, cozy break.* Relax to soothing lo-fi tunes and peaceful ambient sounds while coloring gorgeous pixel art illustrations. Unlock adorable companions, upgrade magical powers in the Zen Workshop, and collect 62 achievements!

details.title: Request Stop
details.short_description: A slow-burning commute horror. Something is slipping, a little each day. Wake up, eat, catch the bus. Work your job, then work on your life. Maybe you'll get it right tomorrow. Or another day.

details.title: 39D
details.short_description: 39D is a linear sci-fi horror visual novel. Once you cross the line, there’s only one way to go: down.

details.title: Campfire
details.short_description: A two-player co-op deduction adventure where a grandchild and a late explorer's old apprentice finish an unfinished path. Each of you gets different clues on screen, by voice or by touch. Put them into words, compare them, and reach one answer together. Supports the DotPad tactile display.

details.title: Sanga no Jin
details.short_description: The nation is broken, yet the mountains and rivers remain. Send your troops, seize bases and unite a realm at war in this real-time Sengoku strategy game — a tale of a young lord and a childhood friend who becomes his rival, told on the battlefield.

details.title: Words In Place
details.short_description: A spatial word puzzle: drag shaped letter pieces onto a cluttered grid and uncover hidden category words. Crossword-style intersections mean one placement can complete several words at once. Fit the pieces. Find the words. Feel the click.

details.title: Nobody Watching
details.short_description: Your inner child wants to kill you. A strategy game against cigarettes, sugar, coffee and beer.

details.title: Milk Frog, Love Me Again
details.short_description: A 3D neon roguelite about an un-deletable milk frog, absurd livestreams, and collecting meme cards. Mow down viruses, build broken synergies, decorate a frog home, and chase the ending before the chat moves on.

details.title: Impersonal
details.short_description: You've come to your senses in a place that shouldn't exist. You have no face, no past, only two goals: to understand how you got here, and to find a way out.

details.title: Night on Bald Mountain
details.short_description: Orbit, dodge, and touch! Light up the stars in an action game built around Night on Bald Mountain!

details.title: Punch Through
details.short_description: Punch your way through prison walls in a satisfying first-person incremental destruction game! Smash concrete, collect resources, earn money, and upgrade your strength, tools, and abilities. Break tougher walls, unlock powerful upgrades, and fight your way toward freedom!

details.title: Mall Chaos
details.short_description: The mall is closed, and your shift has just begun. Explore a multi-floor shopping mall in first person, pick up scattered products, and return them to the right shelves, tables, and racks.

details.title: Song of Kings
details.short_description: Song of Kings is a puzzle platformer inspired by Sri Lankan myth. A Yaksha boy, captured by humans, must escape a ruthless king. Guided by his grandfather’s spirit and armed with a magical flute, he uncovers his heritage and fights to return to his people.

details.title: Sky Furnace
details.short_description: An aerial dieselpunk roguelite. Rusted ruins and the Furnace, a machine nobody remembered to switch off: for two centuries it has shot down anything that flies. Build your plane from cards; each sortie ends with a boss rising from the smoke. Squads of up to four players.

details.title: DIGITRE:SUM 10/20
details.short_description: Link adjacent numbers to total 10 or 20 on a rising board—a fast math action puzzle. Build CHAINs, collect TARGETs, chase SCORE, and cut CLEAR TIME. Soon, 10s and 20s jump out at you. Classic arcade play where every run shows your progress. Includes VS, PUZZLE, 50-clear BLITZ, and ENDLESS.

details.title: Hell Worlds Reinvigorated
details.short_description: A necromantic named Cyris leaves his homeworld for a strange odyssey through unknown realms, each one more horrible and bizarre than the next. Use your necromancer abilities to save the earth realm in this retro FPS filled to the brim with fantasy & mystery.

details.title: Equilibria
details.short_description: Release species on a small living planet, tip its balance and watch evolution answer. Populations adapt, split into new species and die out; continents drift, ice ages come and go, and clever species build villages and towns. A sandbox god game of ecology and evolution.

details.title: Defender of Darkness
details.short_description: An idle tower defense game: build fortifications, manage limited resources, cast spells, and decide which dark lords to save before the final battle against the forces of good. And don’t forget to raise your kraken!

details.title: Westward: Golden Cicada
details.short_description: A turn-based strategy roguelite inspired by Journey to the West. Pick routes, recruit Guardians, swap scriptures, and command every turn by hand. Each wipe burns a life lamp; lose them all and the run ends — but your merit survives into the next reincarnation.

details.title: Ashen Swarm
details.short_description: A gothic bullet heaven roguelite where you wield the power of deadly sins. The Judge knew not all were guilty, yet condemned the world. Burn hordes with Wrath, turn foes into swine with Pride and devour the fallen with Gluttony. Survive the swarm and face the boss of each arena.

details.title: Coy's Escape
details.short_description: 《科伊的逃亡》是一款2D回合制Roguelike卡牌游戏。带领三位命运交织的主角——科伊、莱斯莉与希娜，在崩坏的世界中搜集线索、构筑卡组、破解谜题，揭开末日背后的真相。200+张卡牌，无限可能的策略组合，每一次逃亡都是全新的故事。

details.title: Idle Raiders: Second Run
details.short_description: Idle Raiders: Second Run is an idle RPG about a band of pixel art heroes who farm, raid and loot on their own. You build their town, pick their gear, skills and AI, and send them out farming or into more than 25 raids. Version 2.0 of the browser classic from Pit Forest, rebuilt on a new engine.

details.title: Z-Defender
details.short_description: Tired of the military always losing to the zombie horde? Not here. Hold your base through wave after wave, earn cash from every kill, upgrade your guns, man your posts, and call in airstrikes. Hold the line.

details.title: Dreamfend
details.short_description: Dreamfend is a pixel-art roguelite survivor where you play as an old teddy bear guarding a sleeping child from nightmares. Fight off swarms of monsters, collect and upgrade weapons, find power-ups, hunt down every boss and survive the night. Just don't lose yourself — and don't lose the child.

details.title: ZodiacLottery
details.short_description: A lottery roguelike. Move animals to create winning tickets, then combine powerful synergies and unique relics to build massive jackpots!

details.title: a sproutingale
details.short_description: A hand-made dual-story delivered through handwriting and mixed media illustrations: Ek'mer guides the fae-kind on their journey through Hell while two doctoral students, Gus & Gwen, become friends.

details.title: Flesh Grinding
details.short_description: Grind flesh. Gather blood. Upgrade. A first-person incremental horror game where you manage a macabre basement. Buy dark upgrades. boost your efficiency. and push your machinery to the limit while avoiding the terrifying entity that watches your every move.

details.title: Fearwoods
details.short_description: Fearwoods is a 4 co-op survival horror where light and silence are your only weapons. Explore the cursed forest, uncover Aveline’s story, evade a relentless demon, and fight for escape before the darkness consumes you.

details.title: Amberfall: Village Defense
details.short_description: A medieval fantasy village builder and auto battler. Gather resources, expand your settlement, and build a force of warriors, archers, and mages to face monster waves. When your village falls, spend earned Skulls on lasting upgrades and return stronger.

details.title: Calcio 98
details.short_description: Calcio 98 is a single-player football management game set in the 1998/99 season and created by longtime fans of the classics like Premier Manager 98 or PC Fútbol 7. Lead your club across 18 leagues and 14 cups through tactics, transfers, squad development and finances.

details.title: Naishitai: The parts I'm missing.
details.short_description: Accompany Nai in her normal Sunday routine of watching TV, eating ramen and ruminating on her past.

details.title: Artillery Deluxe
details.short_description: A turn-based artillery duel with 40 weapons and destructible terrain. Draft your arsenal, adjust your aim, account for wind and outscore your opponent. Battle the AI, share one computer with a friend, or connect over LAN and direct online multiplayer.

details.title: 돌깨
details.short_description: Break rocks, uncover minerals, and build up your pixel-art mining workshop. Upgrade tools, automate the work, and start fresh with permanent abilities. Chase rare finds and jackpot rewards in this single-player incremental game.

details.title: Cafe Card
details.short_description: Cafe Card is a coffee shop game where you prepare drinks and desserts by creating card combinations and serve them to customers.

details.title: Bet Shop Simulator Prologue
details.short_description: Run the neighborhood betting shop! Print bet slips, count out change and watch the match with your customers. A goal shakes the whole shop, a losing slip gets a TV smashed. Clean up, decorate, expand.

details.title: Mechannihilation
details.short_description: Pilot a mech through escalating swarms in Survivors, lead an army to capture relays and break the enemy HQ shield in Commanders, or roam the Open World to raid outposts and hunt biome bosses. Pair maxed weapons to unleash EX attacks.

details.title: GrimKeep
details.short_description: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

details.title: Steel Umbrella
details.short_description: Defend real cities from night raids on a satellite map of the Earth. Build launchers, nets and radar by day. At night, hunt drones and missiles in the dark before they hit.

details.title: Last Couriers
details.short_description: Dive into the post-apocalyptic Zone in this fun co-op extraction action! As fearless couriers, harvest anomalous hogweed, craft batteries, and power up teleports to proceed. But your loot attracts infected enemies you can't permanently kill... Сan you hold the line and escape in time?

details.title: Kirameki Quiz: Stargazer Hill Diary
details.short_description: A quiz game with a dating-sim twist. Spin the roulette through a 365-day campus calendar, meet 10 heroines and win their hearts in trivia duels. Over 5,000 English questions across 21 genres.

details.title: We Need a Bigger Ship
details.short_description: Your ship is your backpack. Cram weapons, supports and bags onto its grid, link them into combos and forge bigger guns, then hold off waves of enemies and giant bosses. Take your build into Ranked against other players' ships. It starts tiny. You'll need a bigger ship.

details.title: PixelHeroScramble Plus
details.short_description: Intercept the surging waves of pixels with a variety of units! Experience the ultimate fixed-route tower defense! Summon a wide variety of units to defend and conquer the battlefield. Where and when you deploy, upgrade or replace your units is up to you. Discover synergies and hone your strategy.

name: フィルネティアの魔法雑貨店

details.title: フィルネティアの魔法雑貨店
details.short_description: Run your own magic shop as a young witch in this fantasy shop-management sim and action RPG. Defeat monsters in forests and mines, craft potions and accessories, then read the market and set your prices. Help the villagers and choose the crown or the Thieves' Guild to decide your ending.

details.title: The Brave Few
details.short_description: The Brave Few is a combined arms WWII combat game. Experience historically based perspectives during major operations of World War II, from one of the brave few that fought in combat during World War II.

details.title: Convoluted
details.short_description: Solve the mechanisms of a mysterious machine to find the way to its core. Deduce the patterns needed to connect Glimmer to glyphs in a unique logic puzzle system inspired by mathematical convolution.

details.title: Little Dungeon
details.short_description: LittleDungeon is a third-person loot-driven action RPG. Choose from eight classes and tackle seasonal dungeons solo or in online co-op. Collect gear, combine sets and class weapons, and grow through equipment upgrades, weapon refinement and character advancement to shape your own combat style.

details.title: HypnoFish Inc.
details.short_description: HypnoFish Inc. is a first-person incremental game about working for a fishing mega-corporation. Hypnotize fish, sell your catch, purchase upgrades, and uncover the mystery of this fishy business!

details.title: XenoTechArena
details.short_description: Don’t defeat your enemies—make them collide! A roguelike arena shooter where up to 10,000 enemies swarm you. Blast them into each other to trigger chain reactions and wipe out hordes! Fuse classes, combine 100+ power-ups, and build your ultimate warrior with endless possibilities!

details.title: Bibliopyre
details.short_description: A magical storm and a goblin horde tore a million forbidden pages from the Great Library. As the Warden Mage, burn them all: sweep piles with waves of fire, send ash flying home, and hear every book chime into place to the beat of the music.

details.title: President FC: Football Club Owner
details.short_description: Build a football club from the lower leagues up. As the owner, hire your manager, discover players and develop young talent. Explore a detailed football world and shape your club over decades. Leave the team and tactics to your manager or have your say before each match.

details.title: Toast Flipper
details.short_description: Save your family as "Thoasten"! Drag, aim, and flip: In this brutally hard 2D physics platformer, you fling yourself golf-style through a dangerous kitchen, defeat evil bread bosses, and chase the ultimate best time on the global speedrun leaderboard.

details.title: Tidy Up the Grocery Warehouse
details.short_description: One partner snapped, and Ultra Fresh Food needs your help. About 3,000 products hit the floor. Restore order to the grocery warehouse with handy abilities or your own two hands, then pick and pack orders until the shelves are empty.

details.title: Backflip Madness
details.short_description: Backflip Madness is a fast-paced, parkour-flavored extreme sports game. Your goal is simple - make tons of spectacular tricks and stunts. Take it to the extreme!

details.title: Tinplate Scramble
details.short_description: Two factions battle across land and sky in Tinplate Scramble. Win firefights and melees on foot, pilot a fighter or hovercraft into the fray, and tip the scales in open skirmishes and handcrafted missions involving 100+ fielded units.

details.title: Collapsle
details.short_description: Collapsle is a fast-paced match-three score attack roguelite set in the Gold Rush West. Create powerful synergies and score big, with tons of items, characters, customization options, and challenges to discover!

details.title: Lootale Slash
details.short_description: Lootale Slash is a pixel-art action MMORPG. Explore a shared world, choose from six classes, conquer dungeons and world bosses, hunt rare gear, and create a playstyle that is truly your own.

details.title: Nine Below
details.short_description: A twin-stick arena shooter set in an arctic wasteland. Fight through a cult swarm, break the guardians, and kill the leader before the ritual completes. One continuous battle. No second chances.

details.title: Magic Kingdom
details.short_description: Legion Warfare，Roguelike，Loot Grinding，Semi-Automated Combat，Western Fantasy，Top-Down Combat. In the game, you will control the hero, lead a powerful army, release powerful magic, have a strong city defense, and coordinate resource collection to resist the enemy's strong attack
developers: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.
publishers: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.

details.title: 4Way: Driving
details.short_description: A challenging arcade racing game with the goal of setting high scores.

details.title: Worm Capitalist
details.short_description: Worm Capitalist is an incremental game about raising hungry worms, watching them devour everything pixel by pixel, and turning their poop into profit. Feed them, expand your colony, unlock upgrades, boost production, automate the process, and keep growing until the whole world is on the menu.

details.title: CastleGuard: Operation Graveyard
details.short_description: CastleGuard: Operation Graveyard is a round-based co-op shooter in low-poly. Survive wave after wave, earn points for every hit and every kill, and spend them to push deeper into the base — before the next round starts.

name: All Those Dungeons In Alva's Head

details.title: All Those Dungeons In Alva's Head
details.short_description: All Those Dungeons in Alva’s Head is a surreal, turn-based and skill-based dungeon crawler filled with quirky characters, mind-bending puzzles, and a kick-ass electro-pop soundtrack. Fight wacky creatures, explore bizarre dungeons, and uncover the strange secrets lurking in Alva’s mind.

details.title: Whitopia
details.short_description: Experience pure calm through a short relaxing 3D painting simulation. Cover graffiti, clutter, and anything colorful in pure white. Earn rewards, unlock upgrades, and become more efficient as you restore a world where white is the only color allowed to exist.

details.title: ALL PASSENGERS BUCKLE UP
details.short_description: Run a budget airline in 1-6 player co-op. Check passports, load the bags, fly the route and keep the passengers fed while the jet catches fire around you. Take bribes, dodge storms and climb onto the roof mid-flight. Hit the quota or the whole crew is fired.

details.title: Anomaly Bird
details.short_description: An anomaly-spotting game meets the bird you already know and love... or hate. See something wrong? Fly into the pipe.

details.title: Desert Echo
details.short_description: Echo is an AI consciousness, endlessly rebuilt. Defend the Core against relentless swarms, dimensional Rifts and sandstorms. Hundreds of enemies on screen. Build and upgrade turrets, hold the gates, level up your skills. No checkpoints. No mercy. Solo or co-op.

details.title: Oloid
details.short_description: "Daddy was in the wall," says your three-year-old son. Explore an old St Petersburg flat, find the door that isn't on the floor plan, and choose who to trust. Oil-painted art, Russian voice acting, English text. Episode I — about 2 to 3 hours.

details.title: Insanitation
details.short_description: It’s Chaos VS Order in this fast-paced battle against family & friends. Will you create Chaos as a Cat - spreading fur, mayhem, & hairballs everywhere? Or restore Order as a Keeper - cleaning & mopping up the muck before Chaos takes over? Pick a side & grab your kibble or gear, & claim victory.

details.title: Collec
details.short_description: Open packs and collect a world of wildlife, dinosaurs, distant stars and curiosities. Admire your cards, trade with friends and build a team for five-card duels. A free game with one collection shared between the web and Steam.

details.title: Temporal Distortion
details.short_description: Triple Triad on a hex board, at a lamplit table. Place a pebble, then turn it to strike: the higher number takes the lower, and every pebble taken strikes on in a chain. No dice. Eight Distortion cards, four worlds, and a stranger across the table who knows whose story this is.

details.title: Tattie Bogle
details.short_description: You are the scarecrow. On a small farm at the edge of the woods, a Tomte's magic pulled you off your post and gave you a job: keep the harvest alive. Can you turn the place around before it all falls apart? A challenging fairytale roguelite, solo or 2-4 player online co-op.

details.title: Spaceborn Awakening
details.short_description: Start as a mortal. End as a god. Carve through corrupted hordes, evolve your arsenal and unlock cosmic powers that clear the screen with a wave of your hand. A narrative-driven bullet-heaven roguelite.

details.title: Barn Rush
details.short_description: Grab food, haul it home, beat the clock. A colorful pixel time-attack roguelite on your own silly farm: draft upgrades until one little sheep has a tornado, a tractor and a snail on the payroll. Every run gets absurdly strong your way. Earn Feed to unlock new animals, themes, and cosmetics.

details.title: STELLACATCH
details.short_description: Catch falling stars with nothing but your cursor. Purify the Eclipses, chain FEVER with your two Star Arts, and climb to the dawn of Layer 5000. Grow your own sky through builds, constellations, observatory decor and sweets in this star-catching action game for night-sky watchers.

details.title: RETENTION
details.short_description: November 1978. Meridian Capital's headquarters was evacuated and sealed at four in the afternoon. At two in the morning, you're sent in alone to collect some paperwork. Nobody is inside. Something is.

details.title: The Glass Perimeter
details.short_description: A night shift on the crest of a dam. Bleed the pressure off the terminals, hide from the glare behind your visor, until the air runs out. The only rest is at a window onto someone else's warm life. A short psychological thriller about sensory overload and life behind glass.

details.title: Too. Many. Socks.
details.short_description: 4,000 socks. One giant mess. Find matching pairs, fill shelves, and complete orders in a cozy first-person sorting game. Then unlock a second workshop and build your own sorting lines with conveyors, robotic arms, and delivery robots.

details.title: Sort Till You Sleep
details.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game. A whole room is buried under 3,810 toy sheep in costumes: carry each one to its shelf, play bedtime mini games, uncover a few gentle mysteries, and when the last sheep is home, go to sleep.

name: Abyss Driller: An Incremental Mining Game

details.title: Abyss Driller: An Incremental Mining Game
details.short_description: An incremental mining game beneath the ocean. Pilot a drill-equipped submarine, gather ore and turn each haul into permanent upgrades. Fight deep-sea creatures with your spotlight, dodge their attacks and dive deeper.

details.title: Crumbs & Beats
details.short_description: Revive a silent speaker and rebuild the beat in this music-driven incremental arcade game. Shatter Crumbs, collect Echoes, unlock instruments, and stack upgrades into an evolving groove.

details.title: Terrahold
details.short_description: Build an autonomous colony on a living procedural planet. Gather resources, command robots, reshape the terrain, expand your power grid, and defend the teleporter from an ecosystem that reacts to your growth. Establish the link — or lose everything.

details.title: STATE Z
details.short_description: Build your own base, hunt , cook ,upgrade your equipment and your character , gather resources, farm, maintain vehicles, trade with communities, complete tasks in exchange for rewards. The choice is yours: join your friends, trust strangers, or be alone wolf. It's all in your hands.

details.title: Altitude Zero
details.short_description: Pilot a vintage hot air balloon through a freezing, desolate void. Manage your burner, survive hostile creatures, and land at abandoned stations before the darkness consumes you.

details.title: Narrow
details.short_description: Every step becomes harder to take. Can you see the end? Will it be enough?

details.title: Brewery Simulator
details.short_description: Run a medieval tavern in first person: plant 18 crops, brew beer and wine with the exact flavors your guests ask for, hire a crew, and turn a roadside alehouse into a legendary tavern. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

details.title: Shmandala
details.short_description: Shmandala is a delirious arcade-style shoot'em up choreographed to a banging soundtrack!

details.title: Molehill Mountain
details.short_description: One swing, one fistful of gold! A cartoony mole-whacking incremental game. Bonk moles before time runs out, chain combos and critical hits, then spend your gold to upgrade your hammer. Hire a Storage Keeper to stop thief moles, and defeat giant boss moles to collect relics.

details.title: In Time
details.short_description: In Time is a 4 player online co-op adventure. Chronosyn’s strange machine has brought back the dinosaurs, and only you and your team can set things back to normal. Explore an ever-changing environment and make it back to the machine all while hungry predators stalk your path.

details.title: Route 340
details.short_description: Build your own industrial empire, connect factories, and draw your truck routes by hand. Then get behind the wheel and experience a detailed driving simulation where cargo weight, terrain, and every decision can mean the difference between a successful delivery and ending up stranded in a ditch.

name: Poor Samantha: An Agoraphobic Visual Novel

details.title: Poor Samantha: An Agoraphobic Visual Novel
details.short_description: "Noodles are the food of solitude." Trapped by agoraphobia and social anxiety, your only friend is Samantha. She is your courage to open the door. But in a room of broken mirrors, who is actually speaking? A short psychological visual novel about isolation and the lies we tell ourselves.

details.title: Cricket Manager 27
details.short_description: A deep cricket management simulation where you take charge of a club or national side, build squads, set tactics, handle transfers and board pressure, and chase glory across Test, ODI, and T20 seasons and major ICC events.

details.title: Luma Orb
details.short_description: Guide your orb through rotating planets and floating islands in this colorful 3D action platformer. Jump across gaps, dodge falling hazards, collect stars, and fight back with power-ups. From fiery worlds to slippery ice, every level brings a new challenge.

details.title: What Was Lost
details.short_description: A two-player online co-op puzzle game. One of you plays Ben in the family house as it was, the other plays Lily in the same house years later. You can only see your own timeline, so you solve it by talking. Chapters 1 to 4 in Early Access, with Chapters 5 to 7 coming in free updates.

details.title: Sketchy Warfare
details.short_description: A turn-based tactical war game where stick-figure armies from across history collide. Command 11 unique teams, master dozens of units and weapons, and fight through a campaign for every era—from cavemen and pirates to modern soldiers, fantasy warriors, and the armies of the future.

details.title: Cook & Sail
details.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op restaurant that happens to be a ship. Work the day as a crew, keep hungry customers from walking out, and spend what you make on a vessel that can actually handle the job. The tables want a good meal. The fleet wants its share.

details.title: PhotoLoop
details.short_description: Boot up the world's oldest PC to take photo editing commissions from a colourful cast of virtual strangers. In PhotoLoop, the only thing stopping you is your imagination... and probably your entire editing interface.

details.title: Dicebound
details.short_description: Dicebound is a single-player dice roguelike about pushing your luck. Roll, score, and bank points before a Farkle wipes the turn. Build powerful Charm synergies, survive escalating Blinds, and chase bigger scores with every throw.

details.title: After closing
details.short_description: After Closing is a 1–4 player co-op horror puzzle game. Explore an abandoned amusement park, solve puzzles, avoid the clown, and escape together.

details.title: Finares
details.short_description: Explore a world abandoned by humanity. Rescue lonely dogs and welcome them into your pack on a heartfelt journey of friendship, survival, and second chances.

details.title: STILL BOUND
details.short_description: A weekend trip ends on a mountain road. You wake in the wreck, alone, deep in a forest where every trail promises help. A story-driven, first-person psychological horror game about searching for rescue - and finding out what answers.

details.title: Haunted House Hellshift
details.short_description: Fight through a haunted house full of monsters and traps while a live TV audience watches. Collect eyeballs to open cursed doors, find the exit, and try to make it out alive—solo or with a friend in local 2-player co-op.

details.title: Sort of Paradise
details.short_description: Unwind in a sunlit seaside shop. Sort of Paradise is a relaxing first-person tidying game about putting scattered beach goods back where they belong. Complete satisfying displays, earn helpful upgrades, and enjoy a little order by the ocean.

details.title: Proper Football Boss
details.short_description: Remember when football was proper? Let us take you back 40 years — to when naming two subs was still a luxury and the only seven-figure salaries were in Italian lira.

details.title: Pastry Pile Up
details.short_description: Drop and merge pastries to create bigger, more delicious treats! Serve your sweet creations to adorable cat customers to earn coins. Use your coins to fully customize your cozy bakery, and compete on the global leaderboard to achieve the highest score.

details.title: IRON EDEN
