Examine over 70 eerie, hand-drawn pictures by a patient, break the seals, and reveal the supernatural truth.

details.title: Cats And Pillows
details.short_description: Run a cozy cat shelter where every whiskered guest has their own needs! Place shy cats in quiet corners, sleepy cats on soft pillows, playful cats near fun spots, and stinky cats away from sensitive noses. Each level brings a new cozy setting and a fresh puzzle full of picky little paws.

details.title: Meka Gakuen
details.short_description: Run an independent military academy above the Shigure reservoir. Get to know 100 hand-written cadets through the years, and lead them in turn-based battles against flesh demons where every loss is permanent. Build the academy. Bring them home.

details.title: AFK Throne
details.short_description: A chibi dark-fantasy squad idle looter that lives at the bottom of your desktop. Between work and study, spend your idle earnings to power up and push further, team up with other players against bosses, or duel them. With luck, you'll find rare tradable items to sell on the Steam Community Market.

details.title: Computer Manufacturer
details.short_description: Develop your computer empire, control costs, and increase profits. Decide whether to develop hardware in-house or purchase it, and whether to prioritize cost-effectiveness or pursue higher profits. The choices are all up to you.

details.title: Seabreeze Atelier
details.short_description: Seabreeze Atelier is a cozy island-building game. Shape coastlines, carve rivers, and connect gardens and cottages with paths and bridges. Cast a line from your pier, then turn the island you built into a live Windows wallpaper and watch the boats drift by.

details.title: Operation Together VR
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op military VR simulation. Complete tactical operations, neutralize terrorist threats, and rescue civilians.

details.title: Infected Zone Survival
details.short_description: "Infected Zone Survival" is an open world zombie apocalypse survival game. The game is mainly based on third person action shooting, and can be searched, disguised, built, made, cultivated, fished,hunted, recruited NPCs, simulated management, etc.

details.title: Dimension Contortion Lover!!
details.short_description: 由CRYSTALiA开发的最新力作，一款近未来风格的战斗恋爱视觉小说。 你将扮演魔术师后代的男主人公“崩月槐”潜入“学园”，探寻真相。

details.title: Ayakashi Profile
details.short_description: One button per ally. Chain four fighters’ attacks, special attacks, and spells into launches, follow-ups, and devastating ultimates in this Japanese fantasy battle RPG. Meet a cast of nine, build a party of four, and try the free First Gate demo.

details.title: DoumyakuOnline
details.short_description: DoumyakuOnline is a turn-based 1v1 game where you take turns flipping face-down cards and compete to survive or finish with more cash. The next card could turn the match in your favor or cost you your life.

details.title: Unending Watch - Dead Man's Fingers
details.short_description: A steampunk extraction survival game built on brutal melee combat and constant tension. No guns—only heavy strikes, smart counters, and raw survival. Enemies hunt, adapt, and ambush. The world shifts mid-run. Extract with loot… or be claimed by the dark.

details.title: The American Dream: Past Due
details.short_description: The American Dream: Past Due is a realistic choice-driven sim. Play as a suddenly laid-off middle-aged man keeping up appearances. Balance family finances and emotions while facing mounting bills... Can you get your life back on track before your family falls apart?

details.title: Split Drive
details.short_description: Split Drive is a roguelite arena shooter where you have to find your way home through a hostile galaxy, numerous locations and a variety of bosses, all generated procedurally.

details.title: Copter Besieged
details.short_description: Copter Besieged is a multi-copter survival arena shooter. Realistic multi-copter flight with arcade style weapons, items, powerups and escalating monster waves. Dodge incoming attacks, shoot monsters, collect coins, level up your copter. Or race against your friends ghosts on the flight courses.

details.title: Bedtime Horror Stories
details.short_description: Late night. A young man called Sam is home alone. He finds a mystical book that takes him into a world of horror stories that come alive. Start reading, but you must not break the most important rule. Once you have started the book, you must finish it!

details.title: Gowf: A Golf Adventure
details.short_description: Gowf is an arcade style golf game featuring a single player adventure mode and 8 player online multiplayer. Win tournaments, complete side quests, level up, and take on friends in a variety of courses and game modes!

details.title: Midnight Laundry
details.short_description: Midnight Laundry is a short first-person horror game where a long night at the laundromat takes an unexpected turn.

details.title: 反击战
details.short_description: Enter Counterattack, and instantly travel back to the smoke-filled southern border battlefield of 1979. Every detail here echoes the historical authenticity, immersing you in the thick of battle.

details.title: Dawn of the Zombies: Survivors
details.short_description: Face the horde in a world of shifting light and rainy nights. Choose from 4 heroes and 3 weapons to survive 2 deadly maps. Customize your run with 100+ nodes. Play solo or split-screen across 3 difficulties. Start at 6 AM. When the colors fade to gray, the real fight begins.

details.title: Blood Peace
details.short_description: Blood Peace is a fast-paced rogue-lite dungeon crawler where you embody a cybernetic warrior with extraordinary abilities. Engage in epic battles against a diverse bestiary across 7 unique biomes. Each playthrough generates a procedurally created world, ensuring infinite replayability.

details.title: Meritaton
details.short_description: The story of a pharaoh's daughter who decides to challenge her destiny. The mysterious and fragile world of Ancient Egypt hides more than meets the eye.

details.title: Toxic Crusaders
details.short_description: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville and beyond, one radioactive menace at a time!

details.title: Deaded
details.short_description: Build your defences, scavenge for loots and survive the zombie infested city saturated with a mysterious fog. Survivors will ask for help but its up to you to save them, or leave them for dead. How long will you survive before you become... Deaded...

details.title: House spirit cat
details.short_description: House spirit cat is a visual novel with interactive features. It’s a story about a kind spirit of a house in the shape of a cat who is searching for a new owner. Will it find a new home or a place of despair? You are to choose.

details.title: Knightward
details.short_description: Build towers to safeguard your crystal while you loot treasure-filled rooms and grow stronger. Knightward is a tower defense action rogue-like for 1-4 players. Will your defenses hold off enemies long enough to discover the deepest levels of the dungeon?

details.title: DESPA
details.short_description: DESPA is a fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter built for after-work warriors with more bills than free hours. Neon kill-boxes, railguns, and carbon katanas meet a five-second respawn loop, so every death flips into revenge before your coffee cools.

details.title: Evil Dungeon
details.short_description: ¡Fight the heroes trying to conquer your dungeon! Choose a class and fight along your comrades to stop invaders, level up, pick up loot, buy upgrades and become the greatest anti-hero

details.title: Unwound
details.short_description: Earthquakes are threatening idyllic Candy Island! Pull yourself together and get to the bottom of what’s troubling the island and its eccentric residents before your whole world breaks apart. UNWOUND is a rollicking yarn: a narrative RPG where people are objects and candy is currency.

details.title: Nuclear Sub
details.short_description: A realistic nuclear submarine simulator will allow you to take command of your crew and battle your fiercest enemies. Arm yourself with missiles, dive into the ocean and fight for your country

details.title: The Doll Sitter
details.short_description: This is a psychological horror game where you play as a nanny taking care of dolls in a strange house. Watch over the dolls, complete tasks, gather clues, and uncover which one is the impostor.

details.title: Gus & Stella's Stellar Adventure
details.short_description: Help Gus find out where his family is, and who was behind the attack that left his ear bitten off. Craft, Climb, Solve Puzzles, Win Battles, and Get to know the Cats at the Kitten Intergalactic Taskforce station!

details.title: Four Hundred Catapults
details.short_description: A large-scale survival strategy game with up to 3000 units on the battlefield. Build and manage your settlement, produce resources, research weapons and technologies, and recruit your army to survive in the war against the Half Dead Legions.

name: Captain Disaster and The Two Worlds of Riskara

details.title: Captain Disaster and The Two Worlds of Riskara
details.short_description: A new Captain Disaster adventure; this time he is more of a hero than a disaster! ... Or is he? A point and click adventure game with cartoony graphics, epic storyline and more bad jokes than you can possibly imagine. Wishlist this game. It is your destiny...

details.title: Kendo Warrior
details.short_description: Kendo Warrior is a realistic samurai sword fighting simulator. In the game, the player will take part in exciting duels in medieval Japan. Realistic animations of the most important moves of kendo warriors will introduce the player to the world of this martial art.

details.title: GlitchStorm
details.short_description: Fight with style, hack enemies, and chase viral fame in a dying world. Earn credits, upgrade your ship, and reach new planets. Explore a city of broken Artificials—and save the only friend you have left before it’s too late.

details.title: Hundred Battle
details.short_description: Grow like a roguelike, draft your party like an auto-battler, command like an RTS — a semi-auto-battler roguelike of a hundred battles.

details.title: Wizavior
details.short_description: 3D platformer that will pull you into a whirlwind of adventure! Step into the shoes of the powerful Zavior a retired wizard who, with humor and determination, sets out once again to save the world from evil.

details.title: Evie: The Echo Condition
details.short_description: Explore a dangerous, forgotten world to find the cure to save your best friend’s life, in Evie, an HD-2D action-adventure game that weaves a wordless fantasy tale out of the real-life battle against childhood leukemia.

details.title: Followers of Krow
details.short_description: Medieval Fantasy RPG Autobattler in a 3D Pixel Art style, where you buy and upgrade abilities to fight monsters and explore to uncover secrets about the world.

details.title: Lefka 空垣
details.short_description: 《Lefka 空垣》是一款中式赛博灵异RPG。在位于阴阳两界之间的观测站，你将扮演新上任的部长曹麟，与部员列夫卡一起调查由「桃源抛尸案」引入的诸多灵异事件。在这人鬼混杂，乱象丛生的时代下，你们能否探清名为「空垣」的怪象？

details.title: Containcorp
details.short_description: An absurd Corporate Horror & Logistical Management Sim where you contain & milk anomalies for tremendous profit. Construct your facility across multiple floors, design containment areas, employ brilliant minds to study anomalies. Contain, Research, and build a machine of Profit.

details.title: Past Visiting Hours
details.short_description: Past Visiting Hours is a 1v3 asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. Diagnose cursed patients, survive the hospital's monstrous inhabitants, or take control as The Board and turn the hospital into a living nightmare. Your shift is about to get a whole lot worse.

details.title: Life After End
details.short_description: Dive into the harsh world of post-apocalyptic Siberia. Extreme climate, limited resources, wild animals, and other players - all this is part of the daily struggle, where only the strongest survive. Are you ready to find out what life is like after the end?

details.title: BLEAK Remastered
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in the dystopian world of Pinnacle with BLEAK Remastered. Experience stunning new artwork and enhanced gameplay in this dark adventure. Can you navigate the relentless hostile world and save your sister, Asha?

details.title: One More Wipe : Raid Night
details.short_description: One More Wipe : Raid Night — Lead a 25-player raid. Alone. Nobody's late, nobody's AFK, and you will still wipe. Recruit from 10 classes, draft a new build every run and call the shots through 8 dungeons and 16 bosses. Or hand the raid to your AI agent.

details.title: Salticidae Story
details.short_description: A cosy jumping-spider keeping game. Feed them, mist them, and help them through every moult. Breed lines through a 120-trait genome and six species, catch wild jumping spiders, beetles, roaches and mantises, dress your Keeper, and play online with friends.

details.title: Project Hypnagogia
details.short_description: An experiment set up by a mad scientist called "Hypnagogia" to reveal absolute fear by revealing the subject's most terrifying images into reality. The line between dream and reality is blurred. It's not easy to find a way out when there's only one scary dream going on around you.

details.title: Rules of Alchemy
details.short_description: Defy fate as you blast your way through a procedural open world, in this spell combo roguelike with thousands of items and hundreds of spells.

details.title: Epic of Gilgamesh
details.short_description: History's first hero — Gilgamesh, who would not bow to death. Tablets fell silent; bones still speak. With wild Enkidu, cunning Ursanabi and wise healer Bau, walk from Eridu to Uruk. Take up your weapon, learn ancient spells; defy beasts, gods, and death itself.

name: Be My Mom - maternity simulator, take care of your child

details.title: Be My Mom - maternity simulator, take care of your child
details.short_description: Become a mother and experience the best of maternity. The game is for future mothers, so they know what to expect, and also for their partners, so they can experience things their women do. The adventure begins just as you see the pregnancy test is positive.

name: JUST A GUY :  Online Multiplayer Ragdoll Game

details.title: JUST A GUY :  Online Multiplayer Ragdoll Game
details.short_description: JUST A GUY is an online multiplayer ragdoll game. Play with physics, explore small open worlds, drive vehicles, use fun items and complete objectives to earn new cosmetic outfits!

details.title: Road Warriors
details.short_description: Survive on the road in this post apocalyptic world! Road Warriors is a casual game with rogue-lite elements where your goal is to create the strongest build in one run!

details.title: Cops N' Zombies
details.short_description: A multiplayer horror social deduction game where you and your friends are all police. Survive the zombies, do missions, make money, and buy fun items. But wait, there is a zombie police among you that can transform that is trying to get rid you. Do you trust your friends?

details.title: Skip Lake 2
details.short_description: “Solve beautiful puzzles and listen to the melody of crashing Pots going deeper into the story of Skip Lake!”

details.title: Game Cafe
details.short_description: Game Cafe is a casual game where you can play games like Spades, Okey, Backgammon and more with your friends or other cross platform players.

details.title: Merauders: Tides of Fate
details.short_description: Navigate family secrets and cultural divides as mysterious abilities awaken. Every choice ripples through relationships. Every conflict resolves through understanding, not violence. What you learn and the choices you make can change everything.

details.title: The Last Station
details.short_description: The Last Station is a visual novel. It's loneliness. This is the absence of a second attempt. It's the lack of happy endings.

details.title: Hexoria
details.short_description: Harness the power of magical cards and become a master strategist in Hexoria, a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder game. Explore a dangerous world, build and expand your village, gather resources, and use your cards to gain obedience. Survive the unknown and lead your cult to glory!

details.title: Zeta Wolf Chronicles
details.short_description: "Date" one of four girls on the path to enlightenment. Prom awaits. Will you be led astray by an old crush? The realistic dating-sim that "teaches" through its gameplay. Follow Rayen, a young disillusioned teen who desires a girlfriend by year's end. Is there hope in his future or endless despair?

details.title: Anseion - Fantasy MMORPG
details.short_description: Get ready for a journey to the world of Anseion, an immersive 2D MMORPG. Choose your faction: good or evil. Fight against players and monsters, explore the fascinating world, collect items and create your own. Make a unique character. Participate in events and faction battles, increase your rank.

details.title: EXODUS: Sunflower on the Horizon
details.short_description: An original sci-fi RPG like you've never experienced before...

details.title: Enfilade
details.short_description: Enfilade is a fast paced low poly multiplayer fps game with 30 levels and 18 weapons If there are not enough players there is bot support. Level up and unlock new weapons

details.title: Qubica
details.short_description: A next-generation sandbox game heavily inspired by The Blockheads. All about exploring, building, and playing together. Mine resources, craft tools, build a cozy cabin or an entire city.

details.title: 大野逐龙
details.short_description: 欢迎游玩这个步步新奇的东方大陆。在这里玩家将扮演一名刀笔吏——萧辰，在天下倾颓、诸侯割据的时代，萧辰背上行囊，游历东南西北，探索山海秘境、见识无数宝物，结识众多神奇有趣的伙伴，当然，也会遭遇强大的敌人……游戏介绍【不一样的东方大世界】狐国、密库、衣锦城、驼母宫、博望馆、龙府、人鱼岛、冰夷渡、古战场、高耳山、北境村庄等等，游历不一样的山川河流、秘境洞窟带来的别样氛围。【沉浸式体验海量剧情】丰富世界观和故事细节，希望能有大量支线填充。领略当地的风土人情，并且完成他们的委托来增加代入感，以及世界观的可信度。同时，游戏文案的整体风格会朝部分写实的方向靠拢，给玩家带真实的体验。

details.title: Pandash
details.short_description: Pandash is a rogue-lite platformer with different perks to discover and balance their powers. On your search for peace for your world, you wander through different areas, which will change every run. You need to get strong enough and unlock everything to survive and reach your destination.

details.title: DI: Debt is Inevitable
details.short_description: A wave-based arcade shooter where between waves you visit a shop with prices that increase with each purchase/rental. Keep your combo high and grab as many coins as you can, and you can delay the inevitable. Powered by GZDoom.

details.title: Predatory Islands
details.short_description: After an emergency aboard their starship, groups of settlers were evacuated to an ocean planet. Lead an island outpost in an online RTS about survival, building, trade and wars for influence across a living archipelago.

details.title: MR.E
details.short_description: A turn-based sci-fi puzzle adventure where every move costs power. Navigate a failing spaceship, solve environmental systems, and uncover the truth behind a rogue AI and your stolen human past.

details.title: VOIDRUSH
details.short_description: An action roguelite, solo or co-op with up to 10 players. Face endless hordes, combine 52 weapons and 161 items into devastating evolutions, unions and synergies, and hold on until the end as the Void awakens beyond the map.

details.title: Bullet Maidens
details.short_description: Protect a school from demon soldiers. Battle followers of the occult. Discover a chilling revelation that just might lead to doom...or salvation? A turn-based tactical shooter that doesn't rely on luck about Taiwanese schoolgirls saving their refuge in a world at war.

details.title: Family Land - Farmer Simulator
details.short_description: Family Land - Farmer Simulator. Renew an old farm. Give new life to the farmland. Take care of the animals. Convince Old Bill that together you can do more. A humorous story about the struggles of a townie who decided to become a farmer.

details.title: Adventures of Steve the Cat
details.short_description: You are a cute cat Steve, who has to go through a lot of beautiful, exciting and dangerous locations. On the way you will meet a lot of enemies created by a crazy professor.

details.title: In Stone
details.short_description: A sculptor is confined in a monastery asylum.

details.title: VISK
details.short_description: Enter the bleak world of VISK, an online co-op horror game for 1-2 players. You and your friend are sent to a desolate village. Uncover the dark secrets of this place and cautiously explore your surroundings. After all, you might not be alone…

details.title: Echoes of the Anvil
details.short_description: A simulation and management game about a blacksmith exiled for defying an empire. Gather resources, forge tools, pay taxes, and choose between helping the people or serving the power that rules the world.

details.title: DreamVision Studio
details.short_description: "DreamVision Studio" is a Studio/World maker for content creators in real time that uses the webcam to generate an avatar that can interact with the customizable world. Its the definitive content creation playground that can be used as a tool.

details.title: Tank Arena
details.short_description: Tank Arena is a chaotic top-down multiplayer tank shooter built for fast, explosive battles with friends. Jump into the arena, blast each other with shells, and see who survives the longest.

details.title: Subway Nomads
details.short_description: Survive in a post-apocalyptic metro system. Explore dark tunnels, battle zombies, and build your mobile base. Play solo or team up with friends in multiplayer co-op. Will you escape to the surface or thrive in the underground?

details.title: Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in The Neverending Check-In, a pixel RPG filled with mystery, quests, cats, humor and life universe. Rebuild a once-glorious hotel and uncover its secret past in this captivating journey of deep plots, lively characters, and abundant quests.

details.title: Checkmate MAGIC
details.short_description: Lead your King into tactical 6v6 battles alongside five loyal companions. Recruit allies, customize Runes and Gambits, forge powerful gear, and unleash coordinated attacks to deliver CHECKMATE. Defeat seven rival Kings, collect their relics, and unlock the mysterious Corrupted Gate.

details.title: Dungeon Raiders
details.short_description: Dungeon Raiders is a roguelike dungeon crawler game with cards to acquire and loot to find! Make your way through perilous dungeons, battle monsters with cards, outfit your raiders with the best gear and sell any extra loot you find in your customizable shop for profit!

details.title: Geometry TD
details.short_description: Tower defense on a starship you build and fly yourself. Explore open space, mine asteroids, trade, and lead a crew of astronauts. When pirates board your ship, place geometric towers, merge them into stronger shapes, and stop every wave.

name: Witchmarsh: Tea Party of the Damned

details.title: Witchmarsh: Tea Party of the Damned
details.short_description: Create and lead a team of four investigators in this action RPG set below Jazz Age New England.

details.title: Light Dude
details.short_description: The level hides when you move in this skill-based action game. Scan the level, then step into the dark. Dodge deadly threats, outmaneuver enemies, and defeat brutal bosses to reclaim the stolen sun. No map. No safety. Just your skill. Demo Out Now!

details.title: R.E.A.P.E.R. Corp.
details.short_description: EARTH is mutated and destroyed. You are a R.E.A.P.E.R, one of the lucky humans tasked with preparing earth for the return of humanity! Collect valuable loot and S.C.I.E.N.C.E! Travel from the REAPER space station to the infested, ancient ruins of EARTH with your fellow REAPERS.

details.title: Manipulus - A Deck Building Odyssey
details.short_description: Manipulus is a thrilling deck-building, choose-your-own-adventure game with rogue-like mechanics and perma-death. Trapped by mysterious forces, you are made to relive your past, guiding a band of survivors through perilous times. It's time to FORM THE MANIPULUS!

details.title: Bat Galaxy
details.short_description: Half on-rails shooter, half exploration-driven adventure. Zoom into a world where billions of bullets surround you and your handy punch feature can send enemies flying.

details.title: DOCTRINEERS
details.short_description: DOCTRINEERS is a turn-based strategy game where no two games are ever alike. Strategize and plan with your unique doctrinal units and adapt to new battlefields in a single-player campaign and online multiplayer.

name: Lux Leonarii - A Mechanical Puzzle Adventure

details.title: Lux Leonarii - A Mechanical Puzzle Adventure
details.short_description: Lux Leonarii is a Puzzle game revolving around guiding beams of light throughout an ancient structure using a multitude of mirrors and devices, ranging from simple A to B connection to multiple colours and complex interactions.

details.title: 万剑之残破修仙界
details.short_description: "The Broken Cultivation World of Ten Thousand Swords" is a portrait‑mode wuxia single‑player game from an indie developer. Featuring gorgeous combat visuals, its idle‑style gameplay focuses on item gathering. Every idle grind prepares for thrilling high‑damage bursts in turn‑based xianxia battles.

details.title: Sakagura Life
details.short_description: In a quiet town nestled among rice paddies, you’ve bought an old sake brewery for a bargain. Craft premium sake, build friendships with locals and friendly Yokai, and battle hostile spirits while solving puzzles in this unique blend of life sim, adventure, and brewing.

details.title: Nova Dawn: Overload
details.short_description: Take up arms and take care of robot buddies in this co-op action roguelite. Hunt giant hostile robots that have stolen the sun to harvest their mechanical parts, upgrade the machinery you can build and strengthen the bond between you and your Nova robot buddies!

details.title: Dark & Quispy
details.short_description: A Fantasy Rogue-Like game with Paper thin graphics. Cut through waves of enemies and collect their souls to increase your power! Encounter a variety of enemies and events as you make your way through the DARK.

details.title: Echo of Prypiat
details.short_description: "Echo of Prypiat" is an exciting walking simulator that immerses the player in the atmosphere of the Chernobyl exclusion zone, conveying all the horrors and fears of people left in this forgotten land. The game is created to allow the player to feel the soul of this mysterious place.

details.title: CPA:Reports Bousy
details.short_description: Experience the constant fear and loneliness surrounded by the decrepit old walls of an abandoned house with a tragic story, while feeling the true horror of being hunted by a creature created from a strong friendship. Try to survive and escape the house!

details.title: ULTRA MUSHROOM
details.short_description: Hey! Wanna rise to the top at a festival stall? "Ultra Mushroom" is a high-energy game where you run a mushroom stall at a three-day festival and see how much you can earn. Gather mushrooms in the mountains by day and sell them at night. The key? Rhythmic banter and ultra mushrooms that bring joy!

details.title: DuckTape Inc.
details.short_description: Night shift for the notoriously stingy DuckTape Inc. In 1-5 player co-op, keep an offshore oil rig and a polar research station running: tape pipes, hunt hacked drones, drill ice and reach the helicopter before the thing in the dark finds you. The pilot waits for no one.

details.title: Byte Survivor
details.short_description: Bank balance: ¥0. Shut-in gamer El, lured by her pet robot Puruya, picks up a shady part-time job inside a video game. A tinker-heavy survivors-like: runs of about 10 minutes, simple controls, screen-melting hordes. Earn, build, and uncover more of the story with every run.

details.title: Retro Rail: Japan!
details.short_description: Drive nostalgic Japanese‑style trains through busy city lines and iconic routes. Follow timetables, signals, and station rules to become a master conductor. Choose between relaxed journeys or strict professional challenges in this retro 1990s console‑aesthetic simulator.

details.title: Uphill
details.short_description: A precision platformer that allows you to alter the environment.

details.title: Mercenarian
details.short_description: In a world inhabited by monsters, seek out stronger weapons and skillstones to snatch your enemies’ abilities. Spit poison like a spider, slash through relentless foes, and level up to face stronger creatures. Sharpen your weapons, choose how you fight, and live the life of a Mercenary.

details.title: Star Child
details.short_description: Star Child is an explosive new action-adventure set on a sinister alien planet. Fight numerous aliens and formidable bosses, wield powerful explosives and destructive laser weapons, find secrets and unlock new abilities as you progress. Can you survive your dangerous mission?

details.title: Memory Adventures in the Jungle
details.short_description: A pleasant breeze of ease and casual fun ... or a satisfying challenge and strategy - you decide how you want to play the game ! Also, a lot of cute animals !

details.title: Rules of War
details.short_description: Take command in this 4X-lite strategy game with fast-paced tactical combat and missile warfare. Build your economy, deploy land, sea, and air units, expand borders, advance technology, and navigate deceitful diplomacy. In a world of collapsing nuclear powers, can you lead your nation to victory?

details.title: Sleepy Cat
details.short_description: Who says cats are just for show? Cute can be deadly! A Roguelite ARPG featuring Day/Night cycles, Elemental counters, Skill learning, and Magic evolution—all in a fresh, vibrant art style! Become Laila the "Sleepy Cat" and uncover the vast, mysterious lore behind the Seven Valleys.

details.title: Skylark 64
details.short_description: A 64-bit 3D Collect-a-thon Platformer where you play as A flying squirrel who can glide, run, jump and roll in open non-linear levels collecting Acorns, Soul Leaves and 7 pieces of armor with unique power-ups! You can even play with a friend in Split-Screen Co-op!

details.title: Shop Crush
details.short_description: Shop Crush is a shop-owner simulator and visual novel set in the early 2000s. Stock a wide variety of goods, haggle with shoppers, and manage your reputation. Get to know your regulars and peel back the illusions tied to each persona as you slowly uncover the horrifying truth.

details.title: Dungeon Baller
details.short_description: Pinball meets RPG in this fast-paced roguelike. Launch tiny heroes, battle bumper enemies, and choose your fate through mystery doors. Wield hundreds of powerful items and defeat bosses to reclaim your soul in this retro-inspired reimagining of pinball.

details.title: Match Tree
details.short_description: Match Tree is a breathtaking puzzle experience (...it's actually a match 3 game). Embark on an epic journey with pixie, gnome and witch full of adventure, mystery (huh?) and sheep. Become the master of combination and create magnificent mansions from trees, flowers and carrots (I swear, it's fun!).

details.title: Fatal Dopamine/ 致命多巴胺
details.short_description: Play as a nameless gambler who arrives at a mysterious gambling table, constantly challenging different opponents. At this table, the stakes are not money but life itself.

details.title: Eversiege
details.short_description: Eversiege is a roguelike, tower defense in which you'll defend a castle in procedurally generated terrain. Establish a production, build defending buildings and survive waves of enemies coming from everywhere! After defeat, buy new buildings, unlock new leaders and prepare to fight again.

details.title: Rebel Sector
details.short_description: RebelSector is a horizontally scrolling shoot-em-up inspired by HudsonSoft Caravan shooters.

details.title: GAMING RAIDING
details.short_description: Third-person shooter games

details.title: Nightmare in the Old Mansion
details.short_description: Dive into the first-person horror of Nightmare in the Old Mansion and follow John, a real estate agent called to inspect an old mansion. Amid dark corridors and hidden secrets, you must make crucial choices to escape alive.

details.title: The Lonely Tree
details.short_description: A serene, narrative-driven experience where you document important life events as diary entries, watching your personal tree grow and connect with others' stories. Explore the evolving environment and form connections with anonymous players based on shared experiences.

details.title: Aetherian Chronicles
details.short_description: Aetherian Chronicles is a 3D Casual SideScroller MMORPG focused on interaction with AI controlled players. Explore, train, party up, make friends and trade with real people or AI controlled players! Customize your character to your hearts content and choose your own way to experience your adventure!

details.title: Battle of Arachnidia
details.short_description: Battle of Arachnidia is a fast-paced top-down shooter in which you fight back against hordes of arachnid robots. Protect your base by destroying all enemies by coming up with different tactics, improving your robot and using different help bonuses.

details.title: 约会普拉斯 Date Plus
details.short_description: A game born from memes, featuring the “World’s Richest Person” sending you $50, a chaotic skewer vendor, and a quirky dog-shaped backpack. Dive into a whimsical yet heartfelt dating adventure full of unexpected twists and pure hilarity!

details.title: INSTALLATION 19
details.short_description: Alex Carter, part of The Abducted UFO group, acts on a tip about nighttime sightings. Unknowingly, he wanders into a top-secret military base, triggering a suspenseful journey.

details.title: THE MOST GIGACHAD SURVIVORS
details.short_description: Dive into a giga-action roguelike about GigaChad who have spent his entire lives in the gym and are stepping outside for the first time! Explore the unfamiliar world, fight the city's inhabitants, and complete wild quests. Help the GigaChad discover this complex world and understand himself!

details.title: Nuclear Apocalypse Merchant Simulator
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic single-player simulator where you sell resources to survivors to withstand internal and external threats. Work with scavengers to gather supplies, keep your shelter secure, and uncover the secrets of the bunker.

details.title: NovaLight Z
details.short_description: Novalight Z is a zombie shooter. Shoot and cut your way through an infected colony ship. Survive and explore to find the artifact and uncover the mystery behind the outbreak.

details.title: Fabled Frontier
details.short_description: An open world survival action rpg set in a procedurally generated world inspired by fairy tales. Build your hero as well as a home!

details.title: The One Who Stands Behind
details.short_description: You are a God of Destruction. Realize your strength through powerfull card combos and burn your enemies from existence in the unique deckbuilder combined with hex-grid tactics.

details.title: Paver Simulator
details.short_description: Design and craft stunning pavements with precision and style. Choose from various materials, earn money, and build your reputation as a master paver. Are you ready to pave your way to the top? Test your creativity skills and create a masterpiece in Paver Simulator!

details.title: Night Run Club
details.short_description: Feel the ultimate rush of overtaking 999 runners in a massive night marathon! Weave through dense colorful crowds, chain satisfying overtake combos, and upgrade your stats on the fly. Can you push your way from Rank #1000 all the way to #1 in this high-tempo casual runner?

details.title: Drinking Medieval
details.short_description: You are a simple peasant living in medieval times, working for your feudal lord. One day, you discover the recipe for brewing beer. This changes your life - improve your brewing skills, unlock new sales channels, and expand your product across growing territories.

details.title: Atrum
details.short_description: Atrum is a dark fantasy, third-person roguelike where you play as a powerful mage descending into darkness. Fight challenging enemies and bosses across corrupted realms and collect magical items to shape your build before the darkness consumes you.

details.title: BB ADVENTURE
details.short_description: “BB ADVENTURE” is an immersive action game where you ride a real balance ball and clear athletic stages. Using a controller with an accelerometer, your balance ball’s movements control the in-game character, making you feel as if you’re inside the game.

details.title: TheDowsing / ダウジング
details.short_description: You have entered a sealed gold mine, dreaming of a fortune. All you can rely on is your dowsing rod. Is it gold that lies beyond your reaction, or is it......?

details.title: TwinGrip
details.short_description: TwinGrip is a twin-stick physics-based puzzle-platformer video-game. That's a lot of hyphens. Control each leg of your vessel individually with a controller, or both at the same time with the mouse! Master this unique control scheme and find your way home!

details.title: The Great Hatch
details.short_description: Help goblins take down a giant floating egg

details.title: Space Revolver
details.short_description: SPACE REVOLVER is a puzzle adventure game that follows the journey of a protagonist caught in a catastrophic black hole accident. With your spaceship critically damaged, you must explore uncharted planets, solve puzzles, repair your ship, and find your way back home.

details.title: Typeria
details.short_description: In Typeria, every keystroke is an attack. Watch your weapons and followers unleash dazzling assaults to harvest foes,collect and sell a wild arsenal of bizarre weapons scattered across diverse realms——all from a compact window on your desktop.

details.title: Leaforia
details.short_description: Run your own farm, craft unique items, and battle your way to success. Pay off your debt to the city, befriend the locals, and maybe even find true love. Raise animals, train your loyal dog, and ride across the land on horseback.

details.title: Lumoryn: Whispering Worlds
details.short_description: Lumoryn: Whispering Worlds is an MMO of true rarity. Unique quests, permanent NPC deaths, unpredictable bosses, evolving worlds, and legendary items only one player can claim. Knowledge, not grind, shapes the world.

details.title: Stealer
details.short_description: Platformer with elements of metroidvania. Begin your adventure as a thief who is immersed in darkness. Use your lantern to explore eerie locations, search for clues, and interact with surrounding objects to uncover secrets and achieve your goals.

details.title: Memories Of Zattera
details.short_description: Memories of Zattera is a visual novel that merges fantasy and science fiction. Explore moral and political dilemmas from multiple viewpoints as tradition, progress and freedom collide. Will you see the world the same once all truths are revealed?

details.title: Kiki's Nightmare
details.short_description: An adventure RPG where you step in the shoes of a fearless hero. Navigate through unhospitable terrain, fierce enemies and save Kiki from her own terrifying dream!

details.title: Puppeteer: No Strings Attached
details.short_description: In a world controlled by strings, YOU are not attached. Fight your way through champions of ancient fairy tales in this action packed boss-rush game, escape the grip of The Puppeteer, and write your own ending.

details.title: DigSite: Archeology in Egypt
details.short_description: DigSite is open-world archeology sandbox game located in Egypt where you dig, clean and document artifacts you find. Donate rare artifacts to a museum and build your legacy as a legendary archeologist.

details.title: μ of the M World
details.short_description: 魔王としてこの世に生まれたのに、すでに世界は壊れていた。主人公の μ は何かを壊す事で、何もない世界の中から一つずつ大切な感情を手に入れていく。過去の正義を遡る3Dアドベンチャー『μ of the M World』は連載型のアクションゲーム。物語とアクションを同時に進めていくこのゲームは、無料アップデートで徐々に世界が広がっていきます。

details.title: Wiz Hunter
details.short_description: Wiz Hunter is a rogue-lite deckbuilding card game. Embark on a deadly quest to hunt down wizards through strategic, turn-based combat. Kill, die, learn, repeat.

details.title: Farol del Diablo (Devil's Lantern)
details.short_description: Our protagonist ventures into a dark, abandoned village in search of the treasures said to be guarded by the mysterious Luz Mala. Before long, what began as a quest for riches turns into a desperate fight for survival as she unravels a dark conspiracy that has remained hidden for years.

details.title: Imperial Bureaucracy Hero
details.short_description: IBH is a rich role playing game at the end of time. You're a mid-level official in a dying sci-fi regime, given the impossible task of fixing a faltering machine; explore a vast world, define your mind, flex your authority, and become a sinner or a savior in countless other stories.

details.title: Farming Service
details.short_description: Farming Service is a simulator of a working agency that performs assigned tasks on a farm. We start as a new owner of an agency based in Europe and our task will be to expand services worldwide. Develop skills, acquire orders and develop in three service departments: Farming, Buildings and Machines.

details.title: Service Dog
details.short_description: Unleash the chaos! Smash, bash, and crash through everything—and everyone—in sight. From wrecking houses to sabotaging dance-offs, Everyone has a favor to ask. Is he a good boy or a public menace? One thing’s for sure—this is Service Dog

details.title: Tyrofeud
details.short_description: Work! Sabotage! Smack! Do you have what it takes to be the favorite child?

details.title: Banned Together
details.short_description: A queer mystery game about book banning. Play as Ruby (they/them), a journalism major on a surreal, after-hours adventure to investigate the disappearance of books from their college library.

details.title: Ventory
details.short_description: A strange little command line puzzle game for Linux and Windows. Use the items in your inventory and outventory to solve each level and get to the exit.

details.title: SiegeBorn
details.short_description: SiegeBorn is a top-down action RTS. Lead your troops, command powerful siege engines, and defeat the enemies!

details.title: Soul Catcher: The Moon Coliseum
details.short_description: Soul Catcher: The Moon Coliseum is a fast-paced Rogue-Like First Person Arena fighter. Battle through hordes of enemies. In this cruel coliseum, it's a free-for-all. You choose where to fight and who to fight at the right moment, with the aid of Magic Crystals that give single use weapons and tools.

details.title: B-Ricky High School
details.short_description: Meet Ricky in this exciting arcade game mixing flipper, brick smashing and fight. Get ready for the challenges of Arcade or Story mode and for the tough ones, settle the score in the double 2-player mode.

details.title: Do Crimes!
details.short_description: Hey, how'd you find this game?? Do Crimes is an upcoming chaotic competitive co-op extraction game where you and your friends drop onto randomized islands and cause criminal mayhem - then try to escape before you're squashed by the law...or just give each other the finger. Do Crimes! Or Don’t!

details.title: World In The Abyss
details.short_description: The aliens have caused the oceans to rise, plunging the world into the abyss. Survive, craft, and explore this mysterious underwater world. Build your base, defend it against relentless waves of enemies, and dive deep to uncover the secret that could stop the alien invasion once and for all!

details.title: JohnJohnson: Remnant
details.short_description: They were made to entertain. But now they want to smash and kill.

details.title: Temple of Glyphs
details.short_description: No text, no tutorials—only glyphs and puzzles. Decipher the true meaning behind every enigmatic symbol, connect tiles to reshape the world, and uncover the secrets of the ancient temple.

details.title: Hexora
details.short_description: Hexora is a unique and innovative strategy puzzle game that combines the classic mine-sweeping gameplay with a godly perspective and city-building elements. Embark on an exciting adventure to unveil the unknown and guide your people to prosperity.

details.title: 02:17 AM
details.short_description: A remote forest lookout fell silent at 02:17 AM. Follow the missing keeper’s trail, restore the radio and piece together the clues in an atmospheric first-person mystery. No combat or jump scares.

details.title: Touhou Dream Duel
details.short_description: Battle your way through a beautifully drawn Gensokyo in this unique fighting game inspired by the classics from the Touhou Project franchise.

details.title: Anne & Mary's Hunt for Booty
details.short_description: Anne and Mary's Hunt for Booty is a fast-paced 2D beat 'em up. Play as historical pirates Anne Bonny and/or Mary Read, shoot and slash through the British fleet, and save the cowardly captain from a nasty privateer! Features swashbucklin' beats, local co-op, and art stylized by '90s cartoons.

details.title: Apogee
details.short_description: You wake up in a failing aircraft at 75,000 feet. No memory. No flight log. No rescue coming. Keep systems running and sweep for data to stay airborne. Explore a forgotten network of high-altitude stations and follow a signal that's been waiting forty-one years for someone to listen.

details.title: Type & Magic
details.short_description: Type words to shape your path, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of a dead wizard’s castle. Find artifacts to uncover the castle’s dark mysteries. Report everything you saw to your master. Or… don’t.

details.title: Slopeside Kings
details.short_description: Slopeside Kings is a multiplayer snowboarding combat racer for up to four players, where you shred the slopes, catch big air, and pull off tricks to build boost. Pickup and use chaotic items along the slopes to battle your way to the finish line!

details.title: Cave Trek
details.short_description: Dig passages, build footholds, and find your way past monsters and traps in CaveTrek, a single-player roguelike platformer. Explore randomized pixel caves, gather treasure, and spend it on supplies. Every shovel use counts. How much will you risk on the way to the exit?

details.title: Mulerun – Retro Bootlegger Simulator
details.short_description: Build a moonshine empire in the 1980s. Brew, bottle, deliver, and protect your cargo as you grow from a dusty village to Mulerun City. Outsmart your ankle monitor, take risky deals, and smuggle by land, sea, and air while caught between the CIA and the cartel. Solo or 4-player co-op.

details.title: COTS
details.short_description: Step into a chicken-themed tower-defense roguelike where you build and upgrade your coop, think up strategies during the day, and hope to survive when night falls. Wild predators lurk in the dark, ready to tear down your defenses! COTS is action, strategy, collectible cards…and of course, CHICKENS!

details.title: One Summer Holiday
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in a nostalgic summer vacation of rural comfort. A timeless place of natural beauty, rich conversations, quiet occurrences and indulgent detail and delight awaits you in One Summer Holiday.

details.title: Honeycomb Coins
details.short_description: Honeycomb Coins is a free-to-play, coin-fighting, 1vs1 turn-based strategy board game. Online support. Win the game to get coins and collect coins of various designs!

details.title: Snatchems
details.short_description: Dive into the pixel-packed universe of 'Snatchems️,' a roguelike first-person shooter where you infiltrate the early internet as a "Snatchems️" megafan, bent on capturing as many goofy characters as possible.

details.title: The Last Waltz
details.short_description: The Last Waltz is a full-scale visual novel about an incredible niche sport; the first visual novel to be based on Dancesport. Featuring Over 30 stunning CGs, a soundtrack of more than 35 pieces of authentic Dancesport music, and integrating real footage of professional dancers and competitions.

details.title: Shadow Dwellers – Deliverance
details.short_description: Deliver, or take it back. An observation-based horror game where you process packages while watching for subtle irregularities in the same apartment building. No correct answers are given. What remains are your decisions—and the recorded “variations.”

details.title: Mr. Cloak
details.short_description: Be the first to explore the uncharted labyrinth beneath the city of Dravaneth as Mr. Cloak. Use stealth and wit to uncover its secrets, evade deadly traps, and chart your own escape route. Every level has multiple exits, unlocking new paths, areas, and dangers in your journey to survive.

details.title: 100 Cats Philippines
details.short_description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Philippines! Can you find them all? 😺

details.title: Burning House
details.short_description: This is a game about escape: escape from the inevitable that has caught up with you in a trap of wood and fire! Explore a house that randomly reconfigures itself every time, and with cold calculation, use everything you find in the rooms—but beware of the guests... or drive them out of this world!

details.title: VERY IMPORTANT NEEDS
details.short_description: A chaotic heist game about characters with needs that are a little too “important,” repeatedly breaking into the same neighbors’ buildings and grabbing anything valuable. One goal: leave only walls and doors behind. (Walls optional.)

details.title: Voiceless
details.short_description: Voiceless is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Go live from a mysterious mansion, complete viewer challenges, and gain subscribers. Team up with your friends or sabotage them - choose your own path to popularity.

details.title: Segment In Space 1985
details.short_description: Segment In Space 1985 is a psychological horror game about a person who finds themselves in Milotropia — a strange space made of fractured reality. Using the Second Sight and various consoles, dive into a long journey driven by one goal: to return home.

name: Ruins of the Forgotten:  A Wild Survival

details.title: Ruins of the Forgotten:  A Wild Survival
details.short_description: Discover an open-world survival game that divides animals into two factions. While crafting, building, and taming animals, explore the forgotten ruins. Do whatever it takes to last another night and solve the mystery surrounding animal factions.

details.title: Kiosk Simulator
details.short_description: Kiosk Simulator is an action-packed, comedic take on the hustle of running a big-city kiosk and the nostalgia of reaching that lone open kiosk on a rainy late night.

details.title: Codename Incubus
details.short_description: Slice, dash, and parry your way through your inner demons in this fast-paced psychedelic journey! Dodge an onslaught of deadly projectiles and unleash your blade upon nightmarish foes that lurk within your subconscious. Follow a dissident dealer and a jaded philanderer on their never-ending trip.

details.title: Detective Fantasia: EXCALIMURDER
details.short_description: EXCALIMURDER is a nonlinear murder mystery game inspired by the sword in the stone legend. Explore an orphanage, meet weird people and solve logic puzzles, all in a colorful pixel art world. Bonus: Excalibur is the murder weapon.

details.title: Nevrosa: Rescape
details.short_description: Nevrosa 2025 is a meticulously crafted VR puzzle/escape room game where players must solve numerous puzzles, battle mysterious creatures, and uncover a new Misty World.

details.title: NecroTactics
details.short_description: An auto-battler roguelite where you build your own base & undead army! Draft your army, equip units and place towers to annihilate your opponent in seconds.

details.title: Mental Salvo
details.short_description: Mental Salvo is a surreal top down art game with a procedural open world. A blank sandbox where you can explode your head, talk to weird entities, and perhaps find out if androids dream of electric sheep.

details.title: Dart Career Manager
details.short_description: Rise from a pub amateur to darts world champion. Train your trebles and doubles, throw every dart yourself or simulate, earn your tour card at Q-School and battle the stars on the Pro Tour. Manage money, staff, sponsors and rivals in a deep darts career manager.

details.title: Determinant
details.short_description: Realistic physics-based open-world survival game set in the future. Survival, crafting, exploration and base building are the main focus. Hunt for food and water and survive against environmental hazards. Combat is possible, but more defensive in nature.

details.title: DROSS
details.short_description: DROSS is a procedurally Generated FPS, set in a derelict facility infested with alien bugs. Explore, collect powerful weapons and equipment, to upgrade your gear and fight the Dross.

details.title: Love In a Bottle
details.short_description: Ankora the Love Demon only has a month to prove she can make it on her own! Can she settle down and find love?!

details.title: Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story
details.short_description: "Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story" is an action-adventure platformer following the story of a failing musician named Sondro, who must seek and recover the wish-granting Mystic Orbs to repay his debt to the mysterious Masked Man. Can he find them before the many rogues of Sunova beat him to the punch?

details.title: Tales of the Realm: Arisen
details.short_description: A story rich and action packed fantasy game, that takes place in the fictional kingdom of Mythuras. Defend the kingdom against the ruthless undead in this retro-styled adventure game.

details.title: Abyss Delvers
details.short_description: Abyss Delvers is an Online Hack'n'Slash Action RPG. Adventure out alone or party up with your friends on an epic journey and fight the monstrous hordes of the Abyss. Featuring randomly generated campaigns, dungeons, items and more!

details.title: Banneret
details.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilding meets tactical auto-battling in this party building strategy game! Recruit and upgrade fighters, customize your deck, explore treacherous lands and battle fierce enemies.

details.title: Better Together
details.short_description: A 2 to 6 player co-op psychological horror. Become neighbors with your friends in an underground experiment. Complete the studies, get paid by doing tasks, while the Institute notes your routine. Betray your friends before they do. In the end you'll know exactly who your friends really are.

details.title: Mamma Mia
details.short_description: Play in co-op as the staff of Italy’s worst restaurant. Your kitchen is falling apart, customers’ safety barely makes the list, and weird things happen in the back alley.

details.title: DOLYA'
details.short_description: Atmospheric fantasy 2D-RPG. In a world where everything has a Plot, Fate, and a Name. Your role is to save Fate. To find that Name that was erased from reality.

details.title: TRYPAN
details.short_description: TRYPAN - A exploration based survival horror FPS. Return to Stagmon, the city where your father disappeared. Fight intelligent enemies. Improvise and use limited resources to defeat them.

details.title: Saveseeker
details.short_description: Embark on a quest to overwrite save points in Saveseeker, a turn-based RPG about a time-traveling girl who must save the world from her father.

details.title: Oasis the Great
details.short_description: Ever imagine you could play with your fellows in Online co-op , discover a tremendous world,find the treasures,build freely,do some farming,fight with others,party around ! also there are other mini games.And all these happen in a physics based oasis!! (￣▽￣)~❤

details.title: Cursed Night
details.short_description: Cursed Night is a multiplayer horror game for 1-5 players. Use your magic abilities to defeat the devil, or become the devil and seek revenge. Find talismans, collect power, release spirits, or choose the dark side and kill everyone.

details.title: Explory Story
details.short_description: Run around on the surface of many different stories. You can interact with the text, and the text can interact with you! There are boss battles, collectibles, a song, puzzles, and much more!

details.title: Aura Farmers
details.short_description: Outlast your rivals, lock down the zone, and farm that aura. Forget hunting for kills—it's about relentless control, crazy plays, and aura farming. Engage in intense 1v1 duels, coordinate brutal team assaults, or unleash chaos in frantic multi-team brawls. Every round is a wild, skill-testing party.

details.title: Magical Girl Critical DELUXE
details.short_description: "If magic doesn't work,then you beat with stick!" Action game in which a magical girl is transferred to another world and struggles

details.title: Drift Halls
details.short_description: Explore liminal spaces and control world lighting in real-time with the press of a button. Secrets can be revealed by the light or the dark. Search for signs of life and use your radio to catch any stray broadcasts. Learn the secrets of the Drift Halls, or simply take in the sights.

details.title: Cult: Manos
details.short_description: Rediscover true meaning of Manos. Delve into a psychological mystery where movie making mistakes the key to uncovering the true horror. The survivors are waiting for you to discover it. Jackey Raye Neyman Jones (The Original Debbie) is 'looks forward to seeing' this dark restoration.

details.title: TekRobot
details.short_description: I am happy to present TekRobot, the game about a robot who lived and worked in his home factory, but once he was marked for disposal. Our goal is to escape from the factory, which no longer home but the deadliest place in the world.

details.title: Crooklock
details.short_description: You're in a stolen ship, your turret is stuck in one position, and you have the entire Galactic Federation breathing down your neck. An 80's styled shmup that has you shooting and running from the law across fifty nail-biting stages. Can you beat the odds... and your high score?

details.title: Exo Helljumper: Descent X
details.short_description: Enter the chaotic world of Exo Helljumper: Descent X, filled with mutated foes and lurking dangers. Combine items and strategy to conquer relentless levels. Face unique foes and formidable bosses, test your cunning and skills, and feel the thrill of battle as you push beyond your limits!

details.title: Sweets'Devil
details.short_description: 《Sweets' Devil》is a Top-View action adventure game that emphasizes one shot kill and roaming. Engage in level battles and boss challenges in a humorous and entertaining fairy tale style , ‌fight against various sweets legions that treat human as the devil in their legend .

details.title: Oakley the Leafbug
details.short_description: Your best friend is going to make a horrible mistake that brings on the end of the world. Race across the Earth in this 2.5D platformer to find her, before it's too late!

details.title: Vibes TCG
details.short_description: A quirky Penguin-filled Trading Card Game.

details.title: ELISSA ：Body in the bedroom
details.short_description: Detective novelist MEL Gideon, whose career is facing difficulties, receives a strange letter claiming someone is in trouble and needs her help. Intrigued, she decides to investigate. As she digs deeper, she starts to realize that her past is far more complicated than she ever imagined...

details.title: Awen
details.short_description: Awen is a large Open world fantasy VR RPG. When creating Awen we aimed to make every aspect of the gameplay uncompromised, from movement to combat. Combat is visceral and satisfying. Exploration and progress is open-ended. Come explore the world of Awen.

details.title: B-Type: Space Builder
details.short_description: A base builder shoot'em up in Deep Space. Explore the galaxy aboard your B-Type Star Ship. Shoot down your foes to expand your territory. Build planetary facilities, collect resources and raise an Intergalactic Defense Force. Can you save the world from a robotic alien invasion across dimensions?

details.title: Outer Express
details.short_description: 500 years after Earth's destruction, humanity scours desolate planets for resources. As a Star Scavenger, lead your team on dangerous expeditions to collect valuable scrap within a limited time. Race against the clock, outwit deadly aliens, and work together to survive and complete the mission.

details.title: The Search
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic sci-fi adventure where players harness magic and advanced weaponry to battle enemies in an open world. Engage in intense combat, explore desolate landscapes, and uncover hidden secrets while mastering both supernatural powers and tactical shooting.

details.title: Rage Platformer
details.short_description: Rage Platformer (formerly Keni Adventure) is a hardcore platformer featuring difficult levels and challenging puzzles. Master timing, patience, and skill to progress, and unlock achievements to personalize your Steam profile.

details.title: Underworld
details.short_description: Underworld is a co-op roguelike FPS with waves of monsters, boss fights, and procedurally generated levels. Upgrade your gear, buy weapons, stack buffs, and go deeper into the Underworld to discover its secrets. PC & VR Cross-play.

name: My Little Sister Is an Angel

details.title: My Little Sister Is an Angel
details.short_description: "Hey, wanna try becoming a god?" After saving an angel, introvert Yuki gets pulled into divine training, and the Archangel moves in as his “little sister” to guide him. A warm supernatural romance VN where your choices lead to 4 endings.

details.title: Deadly Deals
details.short_description: You're a merchant in an antique shop. Buy, sell, develop. Easy as that. Just don't die. One little detail of a profitable location that realtors don't usually tell you...

details.title: Absorber 2
details.short_description: Every monster you defeat leaves something behind. Absorb its skills and spells, build your loadout, and watch your hero fight on their own. Fuse pieces in the Merge Laboratory and grow into something no class could ever be. A lighthearted idle auto-battler RPG, the sequel to Absorber.

details.title: Digopolis
details.short_description: Explore, dig and gather treasures to fuel your evergrowing lust for wealth.

details.title: Through Hell and Back
details.short_description: Through Hell and Back is a timeline based roguelike deckbuilding game. Place your spells on the Timeline to outsmart your enemies. Choose your power ups carefully, trade spells and upgrade the Timeline to unleash devastating combos.

details.title: Brink of Broken
details.short_description: A turn-based RPG in a world already ruined! The weapons you pick up are plentiful but fragile, you must break your foes before your weapons shatter! Explore the land in search of permanent power-ups, or win your battles with strategy alone!

details.title: High Tide
details.short_description: A story-driven adventure where Doug accidentally unleashes an ancient curse across a tropical island. Explore, solve environmental puzzles, battle corrupted creatures, help strange locals, and uncover how to bring the missing people back.

details.title: Beyond Faded Voices
details.short_description: Experience moments in a third-person story about my passed away parents and my british cat Zeus. It's a mix of adventure, cat simulator and even Tower Defence and first person bodycam. Be the cat - sleep, sharp your claws, eat, be petted by parents and misbehave in a few hours!!

details.title: Kodas Nereus
details.short_description: Don your VR headset and descend into the abyss. Kodas Nereus combines true-to-life oceanographic data with hyper-realistic diving mechanics. Navigate pitch-black wrecks, monitor living reefs, and uncover history preserved on the seafloor. No fantasy monsters—just you, your rebreather, and the deep.

details.title: SatW Guesser
details.short_description: SatW Guesser is a geography-based quiz game that challenges your knowledge of world flags and country locations. You’ll be shown a flag or a highlighted country on a world map, and your task is to pick which country it belongs to.

details.title: TohoKids
details.short_description: Shinjuku doesn't forgive. A village panda chasing neon lights. Join the legendary TohoKids, hack your enemies, and remember: here, your data is worth more than your life. How far will you go to avoid becoming just "meat for the slaughter"?

details.title: Con Clicker
details.short_description: Con Clicker is an incremental game about building your evil TV infomercial empire. Scam your way to fortune by running outrageous ads, selling ridiculous products, and automating your operation for exponential growth. It's satire, scams, and endless clicking fun!

details.title: Project Roy
details.short_description: Project Roy is a fast-paced FPS roguelike where you play as a rogue AI that survives by hijacking enemy robots. Combine abilities, adapt mid combat, and fight your way through a sci-fi facility to escape and defeat a powerful experimental war machine.

details.title: Potion in Motion
details.short_description: Brew potions, cast spells, and master alchemy in a fast-paced potion shop where magic and language intertwine. Experiment with weird ingredients, and manage quirky customers while avoiding failures! Every potion is a puzzle, but will you perfect your craft or turn your shop into a disaster zone?

details.title: CLIMB IT!
details.short_description: Take on the challenge and conquer the mountain! Test your coordination and resilience as you scale sheer cliffs and navigate through mountain caves - where every misstep can come at a high cost. Join this thrilling adventure and prove your skill!

details.title: Bunny Jump Jump
details.short_description: Journey up through the sewers, across lakes and up the tallest tree to catch the fleeting blue butterfly. Hop through challenging platforming challenges as a cute bunny and see beautifully handmade and cozy world!

details.title: ODDLI: A satisfying game
details.short_description: ODDLI is a casual puzzle game about creating satisfying loops. Solve moving puzzles where the only obstacle is your past self. Reach the goal with your character, avoid your previous movements and watch it repeat your path. Continue reaching goals, while creating mesmerizing choreographies!

details.title: Ultakia
details.short_description: Ultakia is a turn-based space 4X strategy game with distinctive resource management. Explore exotic systems and acquire powerful technologies. Exploit your planets, trade with other races and destroy those who stand in your way.

details.title: Birdoo
details.short_description: Birdoo: Feathered Fury is an indie action game were you assume the role of a bird embarking on a quest for revenge against the humans who wronged him. No longer will you tolerate being called a "flying rat" or being shooed away. It's time to exact your revenge!

details.title: Red & Blue
details.short_description: Play as two housecats causing chaos while their owners are gone! Jump on each other, get chained to each other, and help each other solve color-coded puzzles.

details.title: Agent Panda
details.short_description: You are Agent Panda - a fearless detective trying to solve the mystery of Puzzle Islands. You must solve many puzzles and interview many quirky witnesses in order to find the mastermind! Who has been setting up all the puzzles? A light-hearted detective puzzle game with character.

details.title: Mindbound
details.short_description: Mindbound is a short single-player horror game that revolves around uncovering what has happened. After a business trip, Marty returns home eagerly anticipating seeing his wife and daughter. But, things turn out differently than expected. The game emphasizes a deep atmosphere.

details.title: 悪夢祓いのアリス
details.short_description: Defeat enemies in a real-time card battle using magical energy that builds over time. Unlike turn-based games, enjoy the dynamic thrill of real-time strategy. Adapt to a constantly changing deck and discover your own optimal solutions.

details.title: Somnicore
details.short_description: When you wake up on the subway, you experience a strange sensation: you’re still asleep, and your brain is just playing tricks on your mind! Here, you’ll have to find your way out of your own dream. Observe, listen, explore, and figure things out. Perhaps you’ll manage to find yourself...

details.title: Echoes of the Outworlder
details.short_description: Explore a shattered land in this isekai Metroidvania, mastering fluid movement, battling monsters, clashing with Outworlders, and uncovering the truth behind a world on the edge of collapse.

details.title: Monster Pod Quest
details.short_description: Monster Pod Quest is an experimental creature collector with infinitely many procedurally generated monsters. Create completely unique creatures, build your party and battle through a huge variety of worlds to vanquish the bosses of the land.

details.title: UNDER WORLD
details.short_description: A deck-building roguelite game set in a devastated underground world after the war. Your choices will change your moral and soul, affecting your strategy and rewards. Venture deeper underground in search of the world's truth...

details.title: Vesper's Hunt
details.short_description: A turn-based deduction game where you play as a detective hunting vampires. Use a mirror to reveal hidden beasts and holy water to strike them down. But beware—the undead grow stronger with every attack. Outsmart the vampires… or become their next victim!

details.title: Absolute Cinema
details.short_description: Build your own movie empire! Create blockbusters by combining a huge variety of themes and genres, hire star actors at castings, and develop your studio and technologies. Crazy random events, references to real stars, and lots of humor. Prove that you are the best director! 🎬

details.title: Short Short Fictions
details.short_description: A short short mix tape of one story that connects three shorter stories. On the NewWave, a magical game console that is retro but new, enjoy DON'T SAY YES, TO:NORTH, and a secret tale nobody yet knows. Welcome to a slightly fantastical and nostalgic world of painful, toilful, and beautiful stories!

details.title: Aberrate Inc.
details.short_description: Guide N.T.R.N., a curious little maintenance robot, through cozy logic puzzles by splitting, moving, and combining red and blue boxes to power doors, platforms, and odd office machines. Winner of SXSW Sydney’s Best Student Game Award 2025.

details.title: Sci Wars
details.short_description: Sci Wars is an exploration survival shooter set in a hostile alien desert. Use your jetpack, powerful weapons, and scavenged resources to survive deadly creatures and defeat powerful bosses.

details.title: The Grand Planto Heists
details.short_description: The neighborhood will never be the same! Play as a raccoon obsessed with the front gardens of The Grand Planto Heights in this 3D digging adventure, dodging Animal Control with your woodland critter friends and stealing whatever you can scamper away with in your paws & jaws!

details.title: INNERWHY
details.short_description: You just dissociated from reality. Unfortunately, the imaginary world you've landed in is as disturbed as your mental state. Gather your courage and confront your darkest thoughts in this 8-bit psychological horror RPG.

details.title: Loot, Dungeons and Riches
details.short_description: Manage a party of adventurers and delve into the dungeon. As you progress, you will meet new enemies, new gear, a variety of dungeon systems.

details.title: Get It Up!
details.short_description: Can you make it to the top while balancing the stick on your head?ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ ㅤㅤ...probably not. It's pretty hard.

details.title: Ramen Crisis
details.short_description: It’s a wacky ramen delivery action game! Hop on your scooter and deliver towering stacks of ramen without toppling them! Hurry up before the soup gets cold!

details.title: Waddle & Rescue
details.short_description: Waddle & Rescue is a sliding puzzle logic 3D game, where you'll take control of Teo the Penguin, a cute but brave adventurer, in his mission to rescue all the lost penguins around the world. Waddle your way across different biomes, sliding and solving puzzles in order to find his lost pals.

details.title: Too Big To Fail
details.short_description: Welcome to the firm. You and your friends get the worst desks in the building and one account between you. Trade, deal, cheat, invest, gamble. The market was made to be exploited. Do well and the firm will be yours, then the world, eventually.

details.title: PhantomZone SemiDeus
details.short_description: "A dragon survivor, a rarity in these times." That's what she called herself. Mysterious, bizarre biographical tales unfold in a retro-futuristic world.

details.title: Saintless
details.short_description: Explore the halls of the underground cult of The Open Hand. Experience the test rooms setup for your initiation in this psychological horror exploration game. Never forget....they are always watching.

details.title: Feodika
details.short_description: Live your own story in a world of the early Middle Ages! Lead a dynasty, expand your domain, help your subjects, and don’t forget to leave an heir! Thy Kingdom Come!

details.title: LIMINAL CAT
details.short_description: A cat wakes up in a beautiful yet eerie world. In search of an exit, it wanders, beginning its lonely adventure. This is an adventure game featuring a cat influenced by various liminal spaces.

details.title: Mini Gears: Mayhem
details.short_description: Mini Gears: Mayhem is a single player Rogue-like where you do the aiming. Take control of a little tank on a blueprint, fighting waves of supposedly evil slimes. Gain experience, level up, and upgrade your tank in each run.

details.title: Mini Racer: Mini 4WD
details.short_description: Build, tune, and race Mini 4WD cars in this thrilling sim! Customize motors, tires, and more, design wild tracks, and manage your shop. Race in epic PVE and PVP battles. Inspired by 90s Japanese iconic hobby, it’s a gearhead’s dream. Add to your wishlist now and join the world of Mini 4WD racing!

details.title: Crystal Cub
details.short_description: Crystal Cub is a retro inspired cozy exploration game. Assume the role of Biggie the Bear who stumbles upon a magical library and discovers all of its secrets!

details.title: Ghost Sector
details.short_description: Ghost Sector is a survival horror game where you play as M-07, a prototype machine trapped in a cybernetic facility during lockdown. Outwit the automated defenses, search for answers uncovering secrets, solving puzzles, and upgrade your abilities while preserving your finite energy.

details.title: 十品芝麻官
details.short_description: Strange History Mystery is a HD2D ancient style pixel role-playing + reasoning and decryption game. Players will play the role of the newly appointed county magistrate Bao Cheng, and seek the truth in the treacherous officialdom and confusing cases, and find their own "way to be an official".

details.title: Little Woody
details.short_description: Little Woody is a 2D point-and-click puzzle adventure where you guide a small wooden soul through a mysterious world of shifting environments. Meet unusual companions along the way, solve handcrafted logic puzzles, explore atmospheric locations and uncover a forgotten past.

details.title: In Banjiha
details.short_description: It is a first-person horror game. Escape the damp, dark semi-basement. Overcome your fear and find a way out.

details.title: Hallow Maze
details.short_description: Hallow maze is a soulslike metroidvania set in a gothic world in 2D. Use transformations into different creatures to open your way, as well as incredible tools of energy. Discover the origin of the scourge that is infecting the lands of the Evernight Valley and venture into The Hallow Maze...

details.title: Dawn Girl
details.short_description: Dawn Girl is a third person 3D anime beauty girl shooting zombie survival game, which takes you into a world attacked by zombies. Players will play as a lonely girl, searching for hope and survival in this shattered world.

details.title: Can't Even See the Sky
details.short_description: Your character is a man with a troubled past who finds himself trapped in a city on the brink of civil war. Look for ways to get out of the city and make peace with the past. Will you pull yourself together or drown in the abyss of despair?

details.title: Brownie's Adventure: The Final Resolution
details.short_description: An incompetent wizard is tasked with stopping a recently awakened evil entity that just so happens to be trapped inside a (deeply suspiciously heavy) spoon. What follows is a sprawling, absurd 1990s-style point-and-click comedy adventure across bizarre fantasy realms and also North Derbyshire.

details.title: ICE on the EDGE
details.short_description: Become a coach in ICE on the EDGE, a figure skating simulation game. Train your athlete, master skills, and craft the perfect routine to win. Face fierce rivals and experience a dramatic story carved on the ice. Can your guidance lead them to the highest stage?

details.title: Flowering Void
details.short_description: Alone and newly awakened, uncover the secrets of this dark and unusual world by fighting and defending against the cruel environment.

details.title: Master Thief
details.short_description: Become the ultimate burglar in this witty 1-4 player co-op heist game. Craft your character, hone your skills, and pull off daring thefts as you rise from small-time crook to Master Thief!

details.title: Bilingual Crosswords
details.short_description: Learn languages by solving crosswords. Solve crosswords → encounter new words → review with spaced repetition → repeat → learn.

details.title: FOREX GAMING FX
details.short_description: We offer a special program that allows you to improve your skills with just 10 minutes of training per day through high-speed training using currency charts. There are three courses to choose from: one for beginners, one for advanced traders, and one for AI automated trading.

details.title: Karting of Banban
details.short_description: Grip your steering wheel and join your favorite Banban characters in the race of a lifetime! Drift around tight corners and zoom through locations both old and new. Use power-ups and boosts to dodge your opponents and claim first place!

details.title: The Last Worlds : Crossed Souls
