details.short_description: 3D Action Open World RPG set on the alien planet Ness-444. Explore this world on the brink of ruin with your inseparable companion Lupio. Fight or tame countless nessky, fantastic creatures now blinded by darkness. Survive to learn the truth of this world and find out where other like you have gone.

name: PhantomZone labyrinthos ファントムゾーン・ラビュリントス

details.title: PhantomZone labyrinthos ファントムゾーン・ラビュリントス
details.short_description: “There’s no escaping a nightmare that never ends.” When the protagonist wakes up, a young girl stands before him. She introduces herself as “Entropy (entourfe), the Management Support Android.” Spreading out before the protagonist is a confined underground facility.

details.title: One with the Unicycleverse
details.short_description: A precision platformer where you maneuver and weave your unicycle through hundreds of dastardly obstacles across dozens of levels and side modes. Upon mastering the controls; the game becomes a meditative experience and you will discover what it means to be ‘One with the Unicycleverse.’

details.title: Special Case
details.short_description: Fight the Occupation Forces with Unique Super Powers! Destroy Helicopters, Drones, and Armored Vehicles. Explore "The Strip," protect its people, and rebuild a war-torn world. Welcome to Special Case

details.title: 帰宅 -kitaku-
details.short_description: I want to go home! Such a chilling experience awaits you.This is an exploration-based action horror game depicting the terrifying experience of a newly hired salaryman in an underground parking garage.

details.title: You're a dad
details.short_description: A sleep-deprived text adventure about new parenthood, daydreaming, and the things left unsaid. Be a responsible adult, make dinner and take care of your child. You must do this. Nothing else.

details.title: Milkman
details.short_description: Explore the corrupted Kellsworth Hotel, crawling with twisted enemies. Slash your way through the nightmare, solve Puzzles, collect elevator buttons as you descend the hotel floors towards the ground floor.. Uncover the truth behind the disappearance of your husband

details.title: Monstrobus Quiz
details.short_description: Monstrobus Quiz is an online trivia game for 2-16 players! Answer questions and use tricks or boosts on yourself or others. Create custom question packs to keep each game session unique. Gather your friends and dive into the Monstrobus Quiz fun!

details.title: Dream Bar Simulator
details.short_description: Become the Owner of Your Own Dream Bar! Create unique cocktails. Manage bar resources, buy alcohol and consumables. Expand and customize your bar, buy furniture and interior items, create the most comfortable atmosphere for your clients. Hire unique employees.Reach the top of the bar industry.

details.title: HOSTYLE
details.short_description: HOSTYLE follows agent Cryptic's job interview to become an assassin for the most corrupt company on earth. This fast-paced 3D platformer combines stylish movement options alongside a futuristic but nostalgic Y2K aesthetic.

details.title: Step into the Dark
details.short_description: Dive into the grim depths of the underworld, fight with its ferocious inhabitants, and determine your own fate in this classic first-person aRPG with immersive elements, created for fans of the genre.

details.title: Arctis
details.short_description: Survive the hostile environment of Arctis on a unique rotating map and discover the fate of your group in this turn-based survival strategy game. Hunt the local wildlife, craft tools, build a community, and adapt to the foreigners who slowly populate the map.

details.title: Ritual Chamber
details.short_description: Mara Venn cleans the treatment rooms at a private clinic on the night shift. Tonight the register says Chamber Six is empty, but someone is sitting in the chair, and they know her name. Ritual Chamber is a first-person psychological horror game about a job she can't afford to lose.

details.title: Ser Chub's Adventure
details.short_description: Join Ser Chubs as they adventure through an exciting world full of slimes, skeletons, and... robots? A fantasy, sci-fi action-adventure game the likes of which is rarely seen. The world of Ser Chubs is not as it seems on first glance. Fight enemies, solve puzzles, and most importantly have fun!

details.title: Echoes Below
details.short_description: Echoes Below is a tactical first-person shooter set in an unforgiving open-world survival environment. Build and fortify your base, craft essential gear, and recruit companions to fight alongside you. Explore a hostile archipelago, hunt for resources and engage in intense firefights.

details.title: Realms at War
details.short_description: A chess-inspired fantasy tactics game where every move matters. Command armies, outthink your opponent, and experience the depth of wargaming with the clarity of chess.

details.title: THREE VERSES³
details.short_description: THREE VERSES is a first person dungeon crawler / typing game based on poetry. Having shed your corporeal form, you must now escape purgatory by completing the simple task of delivering verses from deities to struggling poets.

details.title: Echoes of Taihang
details.short_description: Run a gunsmith's workshop in a survivor camp hidden in the Taihang Mountains. Open supply crates, assemble and enhance weapons, fulfill commissions, and search the ruins for resources. A good gun can earn your keep or help bring you home.

details.title: FALSE SPIDER
details.short_description: The web woven by spiders is only for waiting for prey to bite.

details.title: Stranger Tavern - Brawl
details.short_description: Welcome to the Tavern of Wonders! Olympian deities, Norse war gods, Eastern warriors, Cthulhu horrors... all await your command. Assemble any team—misplace them? Power unleashed! Asynchronous PVP lets you challenge bizarre lineups from players worldwide. Whose tavern reigns supreme in absurdity?

details.title: Pawn & Roll
details.short_description: As the new owner, it's up to you to restore the store to its former glory—appraise, buy, repair, upgrade, and decorate your shop to attract rare clients with legendary artifacts to sell. Build your reputation as the best merchant in the realm, with just a few rolls of dice.

details.title: Forgotten Trails: Svalbard
details.short_description: Climb cliffs! Fish the fjords! Explore forgotten places! Travel by snowmobile with your dog Margis, uncovering abandoned mines, ghost towns, and shipwreck graveyards across the frozen beauty of Svalbard. We’ll be waiting for your stories at a local pub in Longyearbyen!

details.title: Bounty Fusion
details.short_description: Suit up as a mecha bounty hunter in a gritty faraway galaxy! Fuse cards to unleash powerful combos, chase high-stakes bounties, and build the ultimate deck in this action-packed roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: ROCKABILLYHOSTEL
details.short_description: ROCKABILLY HOSTEL is a simple walking simulator based on pixel art. It is just a game to walking around and look around the beautiful abandoned buildings and the scenery. There is nothing more about this game but it is OK as long as the girls and the graphics are pretty.

details.title: Jacob's Ladder
details.short_description: Jacob’s Ladder is a haunting first-person puzzler where YOU are the solution. Swap bodies and stack puzzle pieces to please The Maker. Question the nature of the soul and earn your humanity - before it’s too late.

details.title: Wasteward
details.short_description: Turn trash into treasure in this charming 2D Physics-based puzzle game! Use garbage to build contraptions for a colorful cast of clients! You'll have to get creative if you want a 4 star review!

details.title: Charlie Spotlight
details.short_description: Meet Charlie, the next King of Comedy! Or at least its' Little Prince. It's a steady grind to get to the top, until on a night like any other, after one of his sets, Charlie is approached by a couple of rather unusual fans.

details.title: Vampires Die
details.short_description: Hired by the "Council" to take out a rogue coven, you must gather your clan and travel through the dark streets, graveyards, and crypts to battle for hierarchy against the deadliest of your own bloodline. Roll the dice in this "chill" turn-based board game, but remember, sometimes even Vampires Die!

details.title: Ripley [Remembered]
details.short_description: A surreal, story-driven puzzle game set on a train caught in a time loop. Solve narrative-driven puzzles, battle psychic bosses, and uncover the truth about memory, grief, and a girl named Ripley—before the day resets again.

details.title: Niverium
details.short_description: Niverium is a survival game in a harsh world where you have to take on the role of a man sent to the very bottom. You will have to do any dirty work for those who stand above you, under threat of death.

details.title: Gravitus
details.short_description: Enter a massive battlefield where two teams clash over resources, strategy, and firepower. Start as infantry, pilot hover tanks or flying pods, and unleash laser-based combat in a sci-fi warzone reminiscent of classic space battles.

name: The Town That Died In The Night

details.title: The Town That Died In The Night
details.short_description: You must escape the town, while trying to beat 2 clocks. An incoming nuke, and a viral infection. Can you make it out in time?

details.title: The Last Resourcer
details.short_description: Survive a hostile world with your droid. Build your base, automate with robots, and manage the energy that keeps you alive. Beware. The tech you rely on may save your life – or destroy it.

details.title: Shuttle Mining
details.short_description: Shuttle Mining is a Noita- and Terraria-inspired cozy & chaotic mining game. Craft your own unique lasers, burn, taze, and make things explode. The goal is to craft new batteries so you can use stronger lasers and dig deeper...

details.title: Critter Cosmos
details.short_description: A cozy 3D adventure where you play as a Capybara Astronaut, hopping from planet to planet, befriending cute animal pals, saving communities, and building a new home together.

details.title: Ultimate Gym Simulator
details.short_description: Build your dream gym with Ultimate Gym Simulator

details.title: Reviving An Angel
details.short_description: How do you revive an angel? Reviving An Angel is a turn-based RPG set in a world where Archangels, the greatest creations of the Almighty, are in a path of war. Wanting to revive his beloved, Harold, a young Fallen Hunter, saw himself facing an Archangel as he challenged the limits of his mortality.

details.title: 秋之轻语
details.short_description: VN.Your neighbor died in a fall — yet the very next day, she appeared inside your mind, as if an unseen hand were pulling every string. Everything feels dreamlike, unreal. You seem to have boarded a train that accelerates beyond control; in the chaos, you clutch at something — perhaps the truth.

details.title: [REDACTED]
details.short_description: You're a government officer. Documents hit your desk, you scrub out the secrets, and you hope nothing leaks. Miss a word? Maybe it's fine. Miss a few? Well, ██████████. You've got limited ink, limited time, and frankly, limited ████████████. Cheaper than a ████████████.

details.title: Woe Reigns Unending
details.short_description: Lead a cursed party through a ruined world in this grimdark side-scrolling RPG. Build your team, master tactical combat, and unleash forbidden powers to survive an endless parade of nightmares. Decide what, if anything, is worth salvaging from a world that has been reduced to ashes.

details.title: Safety Check YOSHI!
details.short_description: This is a game where you earn points by identifying hazards (near-miss incidents). If you successfully point them out, say, "Safety check, YOSHI!"

details.title: CAT-A-STROPHIC
details.short_description: CAT-A-STROPHIC is a goofy 3D rogue-like city destruction game where you play as Bluu, a colossal kaiju cat, rampaging through different cities to rescue your precious kittens! Embrace the purr-fect blend of chaos and relaxation as you level multiple towns and cities.

details.title: Kanji Grinder
details.short_description: Kanji Grinder is a spaced repetition flashcard system, purpose-built for Steam Deck. Designed for immersion learners who want a no-nonsense way to drill Kanji vocabulary, your daily reviews will be a breeze. Plus, for those who enjoy quiz games or flexing their skills, plenty of challenges await!

details.title: Ping Profit - Internet Tycoon
details.short_description: Run the internet your way. Build infrastructure, control traffic, stop outages, and grow a basement hosting startup into a global powerhouse.

name: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action

details.title: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action
details.short_description: Take control of Tess, a bunny girl who uses her huge hammer to send enemies flying into other enemies in this top-down bump combat action game! Dodge projectiles, control space and outmaneuver bosses in Arcade mode or explore dungeons, solve puzzles and unlock abilities in Adventure mode.

details.title: Ghost Merc: Frontlines
details.short_description: A fast-paced, team-based FPS. Engage in intense firefights, coordinate with your clan, and adapt your strategy to dominate the battlefield. Featuring a competitive clan system, objective-based modes, and deep customization, every match is a test of skill and teamwork.

details.title: Potat
details.short_description: Potat is a quirky, physics-based 3D adventure where you play as a sentient potato trying to escape a house before you get cooked alive. Roll, flip, and flop your way through a bizarre home filled with deadly traps, chaotic layouts, and unexpected obstacles.

details.title: COLDNIGHTS
details.short_description: Learn how to survive, craft and build the essentials, find source of food and construct necessary shelter before the snow starts falling. And may be someday, after building a bridge, you will find your way back home. Keep building bridges.

details.title: Vironics
details.short_description: Control a Nanite body from a space station to gather Nanite resources on Earth, seized by a rogue AI. Build and fortify your dropbase with turrets and defenses, fight waves of robotic enemies, and collect Nanites for extraction, balancing fast FPS combat with strategic tower placement.

details.title: Car Rental Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own car rental lot in this detailed simulator. Manage reservations, clean and service vehicles, and keep customers happy. With time-based tasks, strategy elements, and high replayability, every day brings a new challenge.

details.title: Die Robot
details.short_description: Build traps. Fight bots. Survive the waves. Die Robot is a stylized third-person tower defense game where you defend a mysterious Data Seed from waves of robots, the Carbonites. Mix real-time base building with fast-paced combat in a strategic fight for survival.

details.title: Hundredfold: Hero's Ascent
details.short_description: Hero, the hundred-floor abyss awaits. Keep jumping down, dodge enemy attacks, and use special platforms to fight back. No grand prophecy. No complicated mission. Just one hero, one adventure, and 100 floors of monsters to beat.

details.title: Alpa
details.short_description: Alpa is a narrative adventure game blending atmospheric exploration, emotional storytelling, and puzzle-solving across the journey of three intertwined souls.

details.title: Nightmare Diver
details.short_description: "Nightmare Diver" is a roguelite shooting game where a rubber duck dives into the world of nightmares to save a young girl from her bad dreams, defeating enemies along the way.

details.title: Ultimate Gym Simulator: Prologue
details.short_description: Build your dream gym with Ultimate Gym Simulator: Prologue

details.title: Delta
details.short_description: Delta is a first-person movement-heavy platformer game focused on physics-based traversal, speedrunning, and mechanical mastery. And somewhere ahead, the one you lost is still waiting.

details.title: Hello Space
details.short_description: Dive into a 2D action game where you control a spaceship, defeat enemies and overcome deadly traps. Extend your arsenal by collecting new weapons and technologies for your ship that you will need to conquer four different dungeon-like worlds, all connected by an open space full of surprises.

details.title: Project SARA
details.short_description: A man who has lost his wife and seeks to escape loneliness and grief begins working as a firewatch in a forest. He meets a girl named Sarah and encounters strange occurrences while uncovering deep family secrets. He learns that not every voice is human and not every farewell signifies an end.

name: Tainted by the Stars: The Dead Among Us

details.title: Tainted by the Stars: The Dead Among Us
details.short_description: A tactical 3D top-down zombie shooter with an innovative Field-of-View system. Tasked by researchers, you must uncover the cause of the zombie outbreak while managing scarce ammo, using tactics, melee, and grenades to survive endless waves.

details.title: Proxima B
details.short_description: A short Sci-fi adventure game made for the Game Boy Color in GB Studio! Solve puzzles, collect energy for your weapons, and fight the alien Ackloids to claim the planet Proxima B for the humans!

details.title: Deckanism: Singularity Island
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder meets auto-battler where every fight is a puzzle. Build mechanisms, counter enemies and unleash your perfect combo!

details.title: DOSMIC
details.short_description: In a world teeming with colossal beings, a boy named Nero sets out to find the missing girl Snoa. Use a range of movement abilities, solve mysterious puzzles and sometimes fight otherworldly horrors in DOSMIC, a cinematic puzzle platformer.

details.title: Panic In Store !
details.short_description: You play a supermarket employee who must (in each level and within a given time) put the right boxes in the right departments. But be careful! Customers will come after you to waste your time!

details.title: Venusville
details.short_description: Guide pioneering settlers among Venusian clouds in this space colonisation city builder. Grow food, collect energy, mine resources, balance buoyancy and weight to stay afloat in the treacherous Venusian atmosphere, and build a self-sufficient colony while navigating storms and acidic clouds.

details.title: Timeater
details.short_description: Timeater is a 2D pixel art scrolling game with roguelike elements and a narrative focused on bending the time of the game to our will with a bilinear progression that will be spiced up with some gameplay/narrative secrets inherent in time itself.

details.title: Chaosfall
details.short_description: Push your luck in a cursed slot machine. Cash out or lose everything to a machine that fights back.

details.title: Keep Chopping!
details.short_description: Keep Chopping! is a local multiplayer game for 2-4 players where you plant and chop trees to outgrow your rivals. Earn Acorns by chopping trees, then use them to plant more or buy bonuses to help you dominate the forest.

name: Levels of Fear: Voidwalker Act I- An Undying Devotion

details.title: Levels of Fear: Voidwalker Act I- An Undying Devotion
details.short_description: A Survival Horror game: Paranormal Investigator, Jonathan Hunter, awakens in an alternate realm finding himself fighting to survive. Forced to team up with a ghost girl named Angel trapped in a strange artifact, they must work together to escape an underground laboratory and evade dangerous enemies.

details.title: Pinbleton Park
details.short_description: Pinbleton Park is a small open world cosy adventure game where the whole world can transform into a giant pinball table. Help the villagers, rescue lost spirits, craft new pinball elements, and take down the corporation bent on destroying the forest!

details.title: Sever's Zone
details.short_description: "Sever's Zone" is a 3D first-person shooter about survival in the Anomalous Zone, full of artifacts, anomalies and dangerous inhabitants of the Zone - living and not so. The plot of the game is based on a series of books in the genre of science fiction.

details.title: Eionis
details.short_description: Enter the world of Eionis in a dynamic, free-to-play 2D MMORPG. Choose one of 9 unique character classes - from a samurai to a destroyer, and many other diverse playstyles. Explore an open world, fight monsters, collect items, and develop your character through both PvE and PvP battles.

details.title: Consortium's Fall: Echoes of Xo'lara
details.short_description: Consortium’s Fall is a sci-fi roguelite twin-stick shooter about a people’s budding rebellion against a ruthless oppressor. Infiltrate enemy territory, defeat those who stand in your way and uncover secrets necessary to free your people once and for all.

details.title: Hoops Ahead: Basketball Manager
details.short_description: A new basketball league has been founded! Manage, trade, and sign players to help lead your team to a championship.

details.title: CapyBash
details.short_description: Jump, stomp, laugh and dominate. Think you can beat your friends in the ultimate capybara showdown? Prove it!

details.title: Becut - An Impostor Game
details.short_description: Dive into this social deduction party game for 4 to 12 players. Collaborate to prepare the ogre's feast and identify the traitors hiding among you. Your sense of direction and memory will be key assets to avoid getting lost in this randomly generated castle.

details.title: Combo Haven
details.short_description: Combo Haven is a platform fighter inspired single-player game where your only task is to perform the sickest combos possible. Progress through a variety of levels and compete for high scores. Uncover new mechanics, abilities and characters along the way.

details.title: Celestial Seekers
details.short_description: Defend your base from relentless enemy hordes—solo or with friends! Discover unique planets, uncover the mystery of your mission, and unlock powerful items to help you survive.

details.title: The Indoors
details.short_description: Days after your daughter vanishes, an anonymous note says she’s trapped in an abandoned indoor playground. You break in. It’s dark, rotten, silent. As you search the ruins, something watches you. You’re not alone and it knows you’re there.

details.title: Fungiman 2
details.short_description: Just another adventure with your friendly neighborhood fungus — nothing to worry about… probably?

details.title: 地球勇者 Earth Fighter
details.short_description: “Knights of Earth Realm” is a 2D platform shooter action light rogue game. Synthesize various homemade or advanced weapon equipment, lead your pet, and fight against human looters, out-of-control mech, evil insectoids, and other threats on the post-disaster wasteland.

details.title: Magtong
details.short_description: Airhockey meets magnets! Magtong is a fast-paced, physics-driven sports game where magnetic mayhem rules the rink. Play solo or in teams, locally or online, and outmaneuver your opponents with skill and polarity!

details.title: Newma Holiday
details.short_description: On a rare holiday, Newty's plans were disrupted by an urgent deadline. His computer was infected with a virus, and his desktop pet Ema, now self-aware, asked for help to fix it. Newty and Ema teamed up to solve puzzles and remove the virus.

details.title: Toilet Zone 2
details.short_description: Toilet Zone 2 is a 2.5D momentum based platformer, starring a duck (in a toilet). Use water-powered flight to navigate past obstacles, and master the controls.

details.title: Bomber Hero
details.short_description: BomberHero is a thrilling multiplayer game inspired by Bomberman. Up to 4 players can join online battles or play against bots. Customize your hero, collect power-ups, and dominate diverse arenas. Are you ready for explosive fun? Join the action on Steam!

details.title: Coming Home, Little Oak
details.short_description: As a little oak, your life was turned upside down when you were kidnapped from your village and family by giant robots. Survive, overcome the challenges, and find your way back home!

name: レビィのスライムファクトリー

details.title: レビィのスライムファクトリー
details.short_description: なぜかスライムになってしまったししょーを元に戻すため、みならい錬金術師レビィが日夜奮闘！スライムと錬金術の不思議な世界で繰り広げるカラフルで魅力的なパズルゲーム。

details.title: Martian Elevator
details.short_description: Travel the world as a cute ufo and ruin everybody's day! Unlock new methods of mischief in over 30 levels, each with unique setting and objectives. This is an cartoonish UFO simulator!

details.title: Herbalist Roman
details.short_description: Step into the role of a medieval herbalist. Study your herbal book, craft macerations, and help your clients by easing their ailments. Christianity is reaching the Slavic village of Drebor, and your choices will determine whether these changes unfold in peace.

details.title: The Julian
details.short_description: Work at a supermarket, pack groceries into your inventory, and spend your wages on shopping and cooking to survive. Manage satiety and sanity while building friendships that set the story in motion. Your choices lead to multiple endings. A survival simulation fusing puzzle, daily life, and narrative

details.title: Project Leo
details.short_description: Advanced physics based rally racing game. Set in Englands' picturesque countryside, rally through highly detailed beautiful english rally stages and test your mettle on dirt, gravel and asphalt surfaces.

details.title: Clayground
details.short_description: Welcome to Clayground—the next-gen multiplayer VR experience where imagination knows no bounds! Whether you're a VR veteran or stepping into virtual reality for the first time, Clayground invites you to a playground like no other.

details.title: Bharat Police
details.short_description: > Lead a police department in India where officers grow and react to how you use them. Develop their skills, shape your squad through perks, and manage the buffs and setbacks they pick up on duty. Choose your team, plan each response, and keep your officers ready for the next call.

details.title: TOWER KING
details.short_description: Building Management Simulation x Rogue-lite!You are a rookie hired CEO.Endure unreasonable demands from your boss and achieve your goals!However, the orders keep escalating…!?Overcome countless hardships and aim to become a tycoon!!

details.title: Misty Garden
details.short_description: Build the garden, fulfilling requests from the cute visitors, and even recruit them to create items! Decorate your misty garden to welcome cute little creatures, provide a place to help them relax!

details.title: CatLands
details.short_description: CatLands is a relaxing, cozy puzzle game. Move blocks to bring landscapes back together. Collect cats, build a village or just have fun with friends in online co-op.

details.title: GoopUpClassic
details.short_description: A vibrant and mysterious world filled with enchanted hats, oozing clumps of slime, hidden pathways, and a terrible king. Follow the trail of adventure to defeat the king and save the world from his tyrannical rule! Fight your companions after the trial is done!

details.title: Pirate Pillage and Plunder
details.short_description: PIRATE PILLAGE & PLUNDER is the unique blend of card game and auto battler, wrapped together in a neat roguelike package. Choose your faction, amass an army from thousands of "willing" participants, and lead them to greatness! (or agonizing defeat)

details.title: 五维介质：重生（Medium5: Rebirth）
details.short_description: "Medium5: Rebirth" is an AVG produced by Beichen, also the first MEDIUM5 fan game with a complete world view. Through QTE and other game-play interspersed in the plot, players will experience a journey on "Shulv Planet". This game will show you the charm and another possibility of MEDIUM5.

details.title: Riftveil
details.short_description: A dark fantasy rogue-lite action RPG with adaptive difficulty, dual parry combat, and structured runs full of brutal enemies and boss fights.

details.title: Supermarket Simulator Deluxe
details.short_description: Pizza Clicker is an Incremental Idle Game! Build the ultimate pizza empire! Click pizzas, earn slices, buy upgrades, automate production, and grow from a small pizzeria into a massive pizza making machine.

details.title: Cannabiz: Weed Shop Owner
details.short_description: Build, customise, and grow your cannabis empire from a tiny shop to a booming city-wide business! 🌿💼

details.title: Corpse Burger
details.short_description: Grind humans into “tofu” burgers, keep your customers hooked, and fight or avoid twisted mutants. Manage your secret meat supply, don't get caught, and deliver the most addictive meals in town.

name: Chronos Bound: How We Became Heroes

details.title: Chronos Bound: How We Became Heroes
details.short_description: Pilot a lone ship through a collapsing orbital station in a modern 2.5D shoot ’em up. Block bullets with a 360° directional shield, destroy grotesque wreck-born enemies, defeat colossal bosses, and build new upgrade paths with every run — a love letter to classic shoot ’em ups.

details.title: Androfoco
details.short_description: An FPS with SHOOTING COMBAT! Shooting your enemies a few times will not do! You must hit them with everything you've got so that they can never make it back to the stage. That is where the big money is!

details.title: Pawn City
details.short_description: From A Single Store To A Monopoly - Buy Sell And Trade Anything That Comes Through Your Door. Expand Your Business, Hire Employees, Bid For Storage Units, Don't Get Scammed, And Take Over The City !

details.title: Not Guilty!
details.short_description: Not Guilty! is a prison warden and executioner simulator. Become a scumbag: fabricate cases, spend the prison budget on your own whims, and EXECUTE PEOPLE IN DOZENS OF WAYS. Or try to stay human… if you can.

details.title: Argot's Laboratory
details.short_description: Argot's Laboratory is a 1-bit science simulator that puts you in charge of a high tech science lab! Modify, inspect, and evolve strange creatures, all while trying to not to lose your job... Can you complete the genetic tree before time runs out or will your boss finally snap?

details.title: southbound
details.short_description: A thousand years after collapse, the southern wilderness is the last frontier — and something is fracturing at its edge. Push deeper into a procedurally generated world of ruins, monsters, and growing strangeness. A survival roguelite where every run takes you further south, and further from normal.

details.title: FUGUE
details.short_description: Suspense adventure visual novel——Expectations are like a mirage: they are beautiful but lead nowhere. You will arrive in Jiangzhou, and assume the roles of a student or related personnel at Jiangzhou City No. 32 High School, and a special high school.

details.title: Ether Void
details.short_description: New York, the 90s. Detective Frank Miller investigates a murder in a grim metropolis. Your window to the truth is an old terminal. Analyze data, crack codes, uncover digital trails. Remember: not everyone here wants you to succeed.

details.title: Love Bird
details.short_description: The next hit reality dating show is here, and YOU are the star! Your job? Win hearts, stir drama, charm the nation—or crash and burn while trying. Can you make memorable TV, uncover the secrets hidden behind the scenes, and still find romance in the chaos?

details.title: The Sword Game
details.short_description: The Sword Game is a semi-fast paced retro styled 3D platformer, made to mimic shareware games of early 2000's. Your mission is to get the lowest time possible on all levels. You can cheat, find shortcuts, you have all the freedom in the world.

details.title: Spellatro
details.short_description: A roguelike word game that combines Balatro with Scrabble. Power up letters and use 100+ passive abilities to defeat bosses and rack up high scores!

details.title: Darkness in the Forest
details.short_description: Your car ran out of gas in the wrong place... Escape a bloodthirsty werewolf in an abandoned factory deep in the forest, where darkness is your worst enemy. Survive this night... if you can.

details.title: Mawang: Dark Lord Defense
details.short_description: Mawang: Dark Lord Defense is a real-time tactical tower defense game. As Princess Lua, defend the demon realm against the hero alliance. Build unique towers, manage unit morale, and use tactical pauses to repel invasions. Your strategy decides the demon realm's fate.

details.title: GrappleBurger
details.short_description: GrappleBurger is a high-management cooking game where multitasking is the only way to get your orders out. Master the chaos of the kitchen as you fry, blend, grill, and craft your way up the leaderboards! Do you have what it takes to be a top chef?

details.title: Threshold 15
details.short_description: Threshold 15 is an atmospheric mix of anomaly hunting and escape-room puzzles set in a looping bunker hallway. Identify disturbances and piece together an unsettling story as each loop pulls you deeper into the mystery. You will sign the contract.

details.title: The Embassy
details.short_description: Uncover the secrets of a government building that mysteriously still has power weeks after total societal collapse. This short narrative-driven horror game is a prequel for a DayZ map mod.

details.title: 100 Astro Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 100 Barcelona Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 100 Lisbon Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: Kui & Chai: Evolution Survivors
details.short_description: Kui and Chai is a single human survivor game that collects various materials, strengthens itself, defeats evolving enemies, and perseveres until the last moment, perhaps knowing the truth of everything.

details.title: Seaworks: Trap Season
details.short_description: Seaworks: Trap Season is a hands-on crab fishing life sim set in the remote pacific northwest in the 1990s. Take fishing bounties by fax, maintain and customize your boat, brave changing weather, sort your catch and build a small life on the edge of the sea.

details.title: Desktop Pet Engine
details.short_description: Place your favorite characters on your desktop!A desktop idle game for work, study, and fun. Summon cute companions to keep you company, vent stress, or collect characters. Quickly access productivity tools like notepads, Pomodoro timers, and task lists—making your desktop lively and efficient!

details.title: Neon Dash
details.short_description: Neon Dash is a Retro-Futurism style rhythm platformer game. Get past challenging obstacles to the music's beat, and journey back to the dreamy 80s to push your limits!

details.title: Hookah Simulator
details.short_description: Start with a small cozy hookah lounge and turn it into the most popular spot in the city! Your goal is to craft perfect hookahs, satisfying even the most demanding customers.

details.title: Out On The Water
details.short_description: Out On The Water is a short, meditative journey through memory and grief that tells the story of an inattentive father and his last chance to connect with his children. Set adrift in quiet waters that represent each child, catch strange memory fish to uncover the past and face regrets.

details.title: Starlight Blade
details.short_description: An adventure-packed slasher where you play as the heir to a legendary blade, crushing armies of faded stars and battling the very creators of the universe.

details.title: One Matter, One Hexagram
details.short_description: A little ink-turtle lives on your desktop. Ask one question, tap the coin jar, and watch it cast six throws. A woodblock-printed leaf slides in - tear it off, keep it, or export it. Fully offline.

details.title: Worn By The Forgotten
details.short_description: A forgotten god, worshipped in countless forms, was vanquished by the evil deity Yanutan—but left behind a mask holding four beliefs and the divine beasts that embody them. As Worn, the girl who finds it, wield the beasts, uncover the world's lost secrets, and overcome every trial.

details.title: Leapin Lads
details.short_description: Leapin Lads is a surprisingly rich, randomly generated two-button arcade experience. Leap one space or leap two through an endless stream of challenges, finding your rhythm and flow as you discover just how far you can go.

details.title: Live Fire Exercise
details.short_description: Inspired by classic training missions from your favourite FPS games, Live Fire Exercise is a time trial arcade shooter that challenges you to complete rounds as fast and accurately as possible.

details.title: Fluffy Fighters - Tactical
details.short_description: Fluffy Fighters - Tactical is a turn-based tactical RPG set in a medieval fantasy world populated by cats. Create your feline fighter, build your team, explore a free-roaming world and lead your cats through tactical battles full of choices, equipment and strategy.

details.title: Adeline's story
details.short_description: «Adeline’s Story» — a psychological-horror visual novel about a girl who moves from a bustling city to a godforsaken village, where the nighttime silence is ripped apart by inhuman screams and people vanish one by one.

details.title: Slammer Caps Xtreme
details.short_description: Slammer Caps Xtreme is a nostalgic RPG featuring physics-based battles, '90s wackiness playground energy and a dash of schoolyard. Blending impact simulation with collectibles and psychological duels, the game turns caps battles into rituals of power, identity and maybe something even crazier.

details.title: KaiKi
details.short_description: This is a walking simulator-style adventure game where you walk along the beach from a first-person perspective. Take photos along the beach and reminisce about the protagonist's precious memories. When you reach your destination, the ending will change depending on the number of memories you have.

name: Signal Lost: The Silence Between Words

details.title: Signal Lost: The Silence Between Words
details.short_description: Tune the radio. Silence the voices. Escape the dark. Signal Lost is a psychological horror experience where every sound matters. Lost in an abandoned underground relay station, your only link to reality is the static between transmissions.

details.title: Mainelander
details.short_description: Sandbox Mode: Manage trade, explore ten regions, complete various commissions, challenge the arena, recruit partners, develop your team in depth, and conquer various dungeons. Rookie Mode: Each game offers a different experience. Player Leaderboards: Challenge other players!
developers: MISTY MOUNTAINS NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
publishers: MISTY MOUNTAINS NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

details.title: COMANOMALY
details.short_description: COMANOMALY is a mix between a whodunnit mystery game & horror game, with different randomly selected culprit each playthrough. 🩺 It's 1985. You are Susi, a nurse working for Sudaritra Hospital, you have to protect your patient: a wealthy and powerful man with weird symptoms and peculiar conditions.

details.title: Plantverk: Perfectly Plantastic Plant Simulator
details.short_description: Create your perfect little Greenhouse with fantastic plants, fun decorations and more in this cozy idle game! Throw your harvests around and cause havoc, and then use the vacuum to clean up your mess (for profit of course). Use your well-earned money to buy decorations, unlock new plants and pots.

details.title: PLA-TOON 2
details.short_description: A chaotic, stylized, light-hearted, whimsical, cartoon party-style shooter.

details.title: Asteroid Boom Cosmic Courier
details.short_description: Work off your corporate debt as a low-tier space courier. Deliver antimatter devices to E.L.E. asteroids, recover classified data, and tackle hazardous space operations in a chaotic 4-player physics platformer. Drop the payload, share the oxygen, and survive the shift.

details.title: Cardbound Heroes
details.short_description: Cardbound Heroes is a Draw & Strike Roguelite where you combine cards to match numbers, cross out fields, fight enemies and unlock powerful combos. Build your deck, discover hidden combo cards, and master a campaign that changes every run.

details.title: The Rat Eater
details.short_description: Collect strange loot in this absurd world. Choose your simple rat and turn him into complex killing machine. Explore unique skill trees, craft items and eat rats. What more would one want?

details.title: Grim Fate: Cloverleaf Bay
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in a polished VHS style psychological horror experience, with an atmospheric first person view, branching dialogues, environmental clues, a mystery to uncover and some things that aren't quite right that will keep you questioning what's real and what's not.

details.title: Starship Dice
details.short_description: Fill your fleet with different weapons and equipment, and return to base with loot. The fleet will engage in automatic battles in three-dimensional space, and you will plan the star map route and action mode, but it is best to pray for permission from the God of Dice.

details.title: Bore Bore
details.short_description: Descend to the center of the Earth and survive beneath toxic skies. Watch out for the creatures. Manage your air, water, and food. Build vehicles to dig deeper. Grow potatoes, gather resources, and design robots to defend and automate your world — the control is in your hands.

details.title: イミテーション
details.short_description: ――It seems that in this world, immortal humans are called “Players.” Eve, a girl living in a world where immortality is commonplace. Become her, gather information through conversation and exploration, and unravel the mysteries of this world.

details.title: retrospect
details.short_description: "retrospect" is a linear, full-length visual novel. Trace the memories of the ghosts and learn about them. That is the only mourning you can do.

details.title: Project Damascus
details.short_description: A first person adventure platformer, focused on exploration with time based mechanics and puzzle elements. Enter the ruins of the Kingdom of Pharygia. Swiftly traverse its dillapidated, intricate infrastructure to delve further into the depths of iniquity, in order to cast light on hidden truths.

details.title: Bring Me Home
details.short_description: A small point and click game about helping a dog to get back home.

details.title: BONEMARROW
details.short_description: BoneMarrow is a short action survival horror in which you play a mutant creature created in a lab, destined to be used as a test subject. When the facility you were created in falls into disarray due to the meddling of a dark cult, you finally have your opportunity to escape.

details.title: ENTRY_13
details.short_description: ENTRY_13 is a psychological horror experience inspired by Backrooms lore. Explore its meta, multi-layered narrative, and its procedural, ever-changing maps. Track your way in, find your way out. Survive the encounters.

details.title: Spooky Lord
details.short_description: Become the Lord of Fear! Command a team of spooky spirits, each with unique powers, to haunt or outwit humans in this tactical ghost game. Choose your approach, master your minions, and control the world of the living!

details.title: Paccarat
details.short_description: The 10-rats-in-a-trenchcoat roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit a rag-tag team of rats, craft a curated deck for each, and discover devastating multi-deck combos. Build your team & masterfully pilot multiple unique decks to take down increasingly difficult enemies.

details.title: This Is Not A Dungeon
details.short_description: TINAD is a unique tower defense game where you defend your retirement home from overeager heroes. Play as the dungeon itself. Deploy traps, summon minions, and prove you’re just trying to enjoy your golden years in peace against heroes who can’t read the sign and assume every dungeon is evil.

details.title: Crime & Anomaly
details.short_description: Fight to keep your mind in the shadow of crime and the unknown. Crime & Anomaly is an indie psychological horror that drags you through the dark corridors of 1860s Saint Petersburg. Inspired by Dostoevsky’s Crime and Punishment, every creaking floorboard and flicker of light can shatter your sanity.

details.title: Warrior Is Just Going
details.short_description: There is no retreat. It is a game that tells the story of a mysterious journey of a warrior who only moves forward.

details.title: Multitales: Hood, Gun & Contraband
details.short_description: Red Riding Hood takes up a shotgun and explosive pies to find her missing father. Beneath the bright fairytale lies a dark story of fear, betrayal, and choices made when there’s nothing left to lose.

details.title: Pledged to a Princess
details.short_description: A cute and wholesome yuri visual about a young princess, Katarina Mikhailovna Vassilieva, who (finally!) gets to meet her online friend and fellow anime fan, Audrey McMahon. Is the power of cute girls enough to bring a princess and a pauper together?

details.title: Spheromania
details.short_description: Bounce, blast, and outlast in Spheromania. A fast-paced arena shooter where drones duel with blasters, mines, and mid-air hops. Manage your energy, dodge the shrinking arena, and be the last sphere hovering. Solo mode or online multiplayer.

details.title: A Service Call
details.short_description: Your first assignment alone. An island where no one has lived for thirty years. A lighthouse that stopped shining. The job was only supposed to take a few hours.

name: フリと忘れじの都 -FRI the Unforgettable City-

details.title: フリと忘れじの都 -FRI the Unforgettable City-
details.short_description: An adventure game where your choices change the world. Fri, a girl working at a coffee workshop, lives in a town that feels strangely mysterious. What will she encounter in this town while suffering from amnesia, and how will the world changing?

details.title: Wild Wordopia
details.short_description: Language x roguelike. The incarnations of an ancient language (Proto-Indo-European) that is said to have existed about 6,000 years ago are reborn as "Wild Words"!

details.title: Lushlands Adventure
details.short_description: Reach the finish without being seen in a cozy top-down stealth puzzle adventure. Sneak past guards, use distractions, push objects, and explore colorful pixel-art areas from farms and forests to caves and snowy villages.

details.title: ObeyE
details.short_description: In ObeyE, you will play the role of a [Fake] New-Order priest. Roguelike combat, build your fortifications while planting magical plants. Craft and shoot all the Enemy you see!

details.title: FalseGods Gambit
details.short_description: "FalseGod's Gambit" is a Roquelike deck-building game (DBG) infused with our unique ideas, set against a backdrop of Norsemytholoay, Plavers will step into the boots of veteran soldier Rod, embarking on his final mission before retirement!

details.title: 永恒少女和天使
details.short_description: A cute shota game that heals both your body and mind

details.title: Codename Sunday
details.short_description: A top-down, fast paced hero shooter. Kill tanks to upgrade yourself and become an undefeatable killing machine. Fight friends or foes in multiple engaging gamemodes and become the best of your kind.

details.title: Terragoat
details.short_description: Take up the responsibilities of terraforming an entire planet through a newfangled technological invention which could be roughly surmised as putting a goat inside of a pocket dimension to generate a potentially infinite amount of energy.

details.title: Zavix Tower 2
details.short_description: Zavix Tower 2 is a challenging Party based roguelike with turn-based RPG about Dungeon Crawling through a tower. Recruit Heroes, Upgrade your Town and try to help your mysterious host unravel the mysteries within Zavix Tower!

details.title: The Waiting
details.short_description: Please make your way to the top floor. Bob is waiting for you.

details.title: Spaceships and Cellular Automata
details.short_description: Spaceships and Cellular Automata is a tower defense game set in space! Place different towers to defend your ship against the waves of aliens. The enemies are simulated based on Conway's Game of Life. Even just one of your bullets is enough to cause a destabilizing chain reaction to destroy them!

details.title: Forager's Finds
details.short_description: Go foraging in a vast forest. Strap on your utility belt and head out to explore, photograph, journal, and pick your finds. Sell them at Forager’s Finds to unlock perks and upgrades. A relaxed mushroom picker simulator with many species to discover and document — if you take the time to look.

details.title: Re:Curse
details.short_description: A time-travel mystery visual novel about found-family, connections, and hope in dark times.

details.title: Shapes N Music
details.short_description: A brutal bullet-hell rhythm game where every death is your fault. Dodge hazards, dash and die to a varied soundtrack synced to intense levels. Master 4 more game modes built to steal your evenings. Can you beat each level without taking a hit?

name: Oops! I Got Hit by Cupid's Arrow

details.title: Oops! I Got Hit by Cupid's Arrow
details.short_description: Live-action interactive romance game. Play as an archery coach meeting three heroines. Your choices shape the story, unlock different romantic routes and multiple endings. Movie-grade production with immersive experience.

details.title: Leyline Chronicles 2
details.short_description: A JRPG with a dynamic, action-oriented tactical battle system and a diverse cast of unique characters, featuring a multi-world-spanning storyline that brings the epic saga of Leyline Chronicles to its grand conclusion.

details.title: Forestless
details.short_description: Forestless is an atmospheric, high-speed 3D action-adventure. Journey through a world of inner doubts armed with the Arrow of Hope: ignite lanterns in full stride to gain momentum, traverse procedural mazes of memory, and shatter the shackles of negative beliefs.

details.title: Console Dealer Simulator
details.short_description: A store simulator game where you manage your own game shop by buying and selling console games. Manage inventory, meet customer needs, and expand your shop. Playable in single-player or multiplayer mode.

details.title: Basefall
details.short_description: A competitive multiplayer strategy game blending lane combat and dynamic upgrades. Spawn units, unlock spells, and create insane build synergies to destroy the enemy castle.

details.title: Ta-Miu
details.short_description: Play as a cat chosen by the goddess Bastet. Solve ancient puzzles, unlock magical powers, and uncover the secrets of Egypt filled with myths, temples, and tombs. Embark on a mystical adventure and stop an ancient evil!

name: シェオルの森　- 黄昏の魔獣使い -

details.title: シェオルの森　- 黄昏の魔獣使い -
details.short_description: 古代中国から伝わる呪術「蟲毒」に着想を得た、「蟲毒×魔獣錬成×落ちものパズル」それが、「シェオルの森-黄昏の魔獣使い-」です。魔獣を使い魔にし、魔獣と戦わせ、使い魔同士を融合し巨大な魔獣を錬成しましょう！

details.title: Shrouded Siege
details.short_description: Design dastardly mazes in this co-op roguelike tower defense set in Irish mythology. Combine divine boons to make unstoppable towers and sculpt the terrain to make the ultimate death traps for your enemies.

details.title: Car-Nudge
details.short_description: Car-Nudge is a party game with cars. Play locally or online with up to 8 players, through different minigames and levels. Demolish your friends (or enemies) to win and unlock new customizations and cars to play with.

details.title: Chicken Jump, Puppy Jump
details.short_description: An online multiplayer party game for 4–8 players. Build your crew of robo-animal thieves, roam across insane locations to snatch treasures, or simply STEAL goodies from rival players — all to become the MOST WANTED crew on the Bounty Board!

details.title: The Calling
details.short_description: An anime-inspired free-to-play PvP arena shooter where every match is shaped by your build, strategy, and creativity. Customize your abilities, adapt to dynamic weather and day-night cycles, and outplay the competition in fast-paced battles.

details.title: Smash Simulator
details.short_description: Inherit a failing company and transform it into a destruction empire! Build and manage your own Rage Rooms, let clients smash objects to relieve stress… and turn it all into profit!

details.title: Aftershock
details.short_description: An earthquake has just struck the building you’re in — and caught off guard, you’ll have only moments to react. Every step could mean the difference between life and death.

details.title: The Friendliest Skunk
details.short_description: Skunk is the friendliest critter in the forest — but his natural scent makes making friends a bit… tricky. Help Skunk traverse a musical forest, in this charming rhythm-based platformer! Meet adorable forest friends, outwit hungry predators, and prove that kindness (+ good timing) conquers all!

details.title: HOTLIME
details.short_description: Chaotic PvP party game for 2–4 players. Citrus fighters battle to the death in a hellish skyscraper — one hit decides everything. Escape, if the bartender lets you!

details.title: DIVINE CRAFTING WORKSHOP
details.short_description: Ancient China handcraft sim with shadow puppet art & multiple endings. As a craftsman, take orders, craft works, unlock dynasty stories. Full version: 7 dynasties, 28 categories, 110+ collectible handicrafts, 300+ event/40+ main endings, 50+ panda events & letters—immerse in traditional crafts.

details.title: Terrafarmer
details.short_description: A roguelite farming strategy game where every tile matters. Choose from randomly offered polyomino crop tiles, arrange them for powerful synergies, and terraform a dead planet before your debt catches up.

details.title: 救済の日
details.short_description: "The Day of Salvation" is a horror game in which players must escape from giant humanoid creatures by hiding in the fog and discovering their true identities.

details.title: Kayotica
details.short_description: In Kayotica, you play as April—a clever but manipulative student caught in a web of friendship, rivalry, and dark crimes. What begins as ordinary campus life quickly turns into a mystery of betrayal, hidden truths, and a shocking murder. Can you solve the mystery, or will you become the next victim?

details.title: Ashen Vow
details.short_description: You are a knight sworn to God’s word, wielding only a sword against the darkness. But not all believers walk in good faith. The Black Maw has sunk its claws into the misguided, twisting their devotion into madness. Explore a once familiar castle now warped by evil, and cut down the corrupted horde

details.title: Rentcthulhu
details.short_description: A dark fairytale deckbuilder where you serve Ancient Gods. Reconstruct shattered stories using card suits and racial synergies. Stack high scores to complete Oracle challenges in this twisted roguelike adventure. Can you mend the fragments before the darkness wins?

details.title: Echo Protocol
details.short_description: A sci-fi survivors-style shooter. Hold the line across boarded stations, neon extraction runs, convoy escorts and frozen outposts. Level up mid-fight and stack elemental rounds, drones and auras into a run-ending build — or gamble on pacts that cut as deep as they hit. Every run feeds your Echoes.

details.title: Wade: Fly Fishing
details.short_description: Step into a Quebec river and fly fish in VR. Hand-crafted rod and line physics, living currents, and fish fights that demand real focus, hook it, fight it, and try not to lose it.

details.title: 白噪
details.short_description: What?! Mr. Boring is trying to invade the universe? No way! Grab your shotgun, power gauntlets, rocket launcher, and the 24/7 rock ‘n’ roll bass cannon! Unleash a storm of bullets to the beat of the sickest rhythm and save the world the only way a true superhero can, White Noise!

details.title: Dystopia RPG
details.short_description: Dystopia RPG is an 8 bit style fantasy RPG where You lost a duel to a government's shaman and ended up trapped and sealed in a Cell Phone application. Explore the Dungeons, Combat monsters, Collect and Trade Items, Glitch the game & break free.

details.title: MadHouse For Toys
details.short_description: Madhouse for Toys is a top-down horror game where an AI-powered plush rabbit tries to escape from a toy asylum. Solve puzzles, hide, or fight against insane toys. The unique 3D horror style and the unusual world make the game unlike anything else.

details.title: ATK：画境小镇
details.short_description: ATK: Painting Realm Town is a casual and fun auto-battler that integrates tavern chess strategic gameplay, in-depth character development, and random equipment collection. Players can unlock more than twenty distinctive characters with entirely unique styles and personalities.

details.title: 鸥鹭罔继
details.short_description: 你将观测一段虚构的故事，通过选项的干涉决定被观测者的命运。你将观测的对象是一个迷茫、执拗，有着孩童的天真与暴虐的女孩，你开始观测的时刻，她失去了自己生命中最重要的人，面临决定未来的诸多抉择。你的每一次干涉，都会将她的故事导向截然不同的方向。

details.title: Loot Goblins
details.short_description: Crack open chests, chain buffs and recruit the ultimate goblin crew in this fast-paced incremental auto-battler. Send them deeper into dungeons. Get better loot. Repeat!

details.title: Tiny House Finds
details.short_description: Search inside and around cozy 3D houses, floor by floor, in a relaxing 3D hidden object game full of tiny details.

details.title: Eclipsia
details.short_description: Eclipsia is a 2D action MMORPG where thousands explore a world beyond imagination. Master fast-paced, multi-class combat, hunt legendary weapon classes, and venture through realms from tranquil forests to Nephelia's clouds. Face epic bosses, battle in PvP arenas, and forge your legend.

details.title: Deskavator
details.short_description: The queen calls you to grab a pickaxe and start mining for the hive! Watch as your mining buddy collects ore without invading your working screen space! Collect ore, earn achievements, mine for your hive, and most importantly, relax and enjoy the ride!

details.title: Lydia Was Here
details.short_description: A horror RPG about how not to handle grief, identity, and the delusions of bringing someone back.

details.title: Towerlings
details.short_description: Watch autonomous adventurers climb a 100-floor tower while you guide their fate through strategic intervention. No direct control — only decisions. Choose when to summon, strengthen, or protect, and decide whether to build an army or raise a few elite heroes.

details.title: Eskadrila X - Rift Protocol
details.short_description: A fast-paced 3D rail shooter with photo-realistic UE5 visuals. Destroy enemy waves, upgrade and customize your ship to meet escalating challenges, uncover hidden paths with secret rewards, and blast through fully 3D environments with physics-driven destruction.

details.title: Whack It!
details.short_description: Whack It! reinvents the classic idea of golf by combining competitive multiplayer chaos with polished, physics-based gameplay. Designed for both casual players and seasoned trick-shot enthusiasts, the game challenges up to four players to navigate inventive courses where every hit matters.

details.title: StoryMode
details.short_description: StoryMode is a reading tool completely built around idle/incremental gameplay and progression. Add manga and books, earn experience, levels, and rewards as you read. Complete quests, discover companions, and personalize your reading experience with customizable themes and animated backgrounds.

details.title: Idle Chest
details.short_description: Idle Chest is a simple incremental game where you open many chests, normal chests, golden chests, magic chests and other mysterious chests. Open chests, improve your chests, complete quests and loot rare equipments.

details.title: Vampires of the 99th Night
details.short_description: You are a cute vampire. There will be blood. Survive a grueling 99-night gauntlet of fast-paced hack-and-slash action, expand your dark domain, and decide who lives and who becomes your next meal. Death is inevitable, but your castle is eternal. Can you make it to the 99th night?

details.title: Zero Station: Interval
details.short_description: New employee wanted. Join the "Interval"—an interdimensional subway system. Armed with a ritual spear, navigate bureaucratic madness and eliminate anomalies threatening the multiverse. Uncover the cause of the system failure before the void claims you.

details.title: contract of the ninja
details.short_description: Contract of the Ninja is a stealth arcade game. Study enemy routes, strike with precision, and escape without being seen. Master precise controls, optimize your path, and complete contracts with maximum efficiency in fast, challenging stages.

details.title: Flip & Shop Simulator
details.short_description: All simulators in one game! A cooperative city simulator where you and your friends manage businesses in a single large world. Open stores, earn money, and develop the shared city - together or separately.

details.title: SECTOR LOCKDOWN
details.short_description: Sector Lockdown is a fast-paced vehicle roguelite where the entire world hunts you down. Fight through hostile sectors, upgrade your car, unleash powerful weapons, and survive escalating pursuit levels in a neon-drenched world with no safe roads.

details.title: FocusScape: Lofi Productivity
details.short_description: FocusScape: Lofi Productivity is a minimalist productivity game where you manage tasks and daily objectives, focus with a built-in Pomodoro timer, customize ambient sounds and music, and earn levels to unlock regions of Midreach and uncover quiet journal entries along the way.

name: The Academy of the Cosmic Realm

details.title: The Academy of the Cosmic Realm
details.short_description: The Academy of the Cosmic Realm is a short first-person horror game where you explore an old abandoned academy to discover what terrible event led to it's closure.

details.title: Rhythm Rumble
details.short_description: Rhythm Rumble is a colorful, adventurous, and high-energy rhythm game. Feel the groove of the music as you dance your way around enemy attacks—then strike back and finish them!

details.title: Sunset Sprinters '98
details.short_description: Relive the glory days of 1998 in this high-speed precision runner. You have no health bar—only a Snack Meter that drains constantly. Smash obstacles, collect aluminum cans for rental money, find CDs for your SpinDisk, and sprint from the Middle School to MegaHits Video before the sun sets.

details.title: Meaningless Random Numbers
details.short_description: Meaningless Random Numbers is an Incremental Horror Game about earning money through Random Number Generators but be cautious, God is Watching...

details.title: Fast Food Wars
details.short_description: Fast Food Wars is a bullet-hell shoot'em up rogue-lite game in a procedural generated restaurant with random power ups, weapons. You play as a burger fighting to claim back all the invaded burger restaurant from other fast foods

details.title: Sepium
details.short_description: Investigate and localize abnormal activities in this 1-4 players survival horror game. Find your way to various locations where something odd is happening, while trying hard to keep your crew alive.

details.title: Mars Base Alley
details.short_description: Mars Base Alley is a cozy city-builder about creating the perfect little corner of humanity on the red planet—one alley at a time.

details.title: Path of Glory
details.short_description: Path of Glory is a deck-building, roguelite game, set in a post-apocalyptic world. Offering endless replayability, unlockable characters with unique tree skills and card deck's. Fight all beast on your path to become a Hero.

details.title: FOTR
details.short_description: A quasi-documentary trip that leads to a phone booth in 2002, where feelings of nostalgia and pain from broken parental relationships intertwine.

details.title: Santa's Burnout
details.short_description: Santa has officially quit. The kids are too spoiled, and the magic is gone. This year, the Toy Factory has been converted into a strip mine. Click rocks, crush hope, and manage a cynical coal mining operation in this dark industrial idle game. Your goal? Ensure everyone gets coal for Christmas.

details.title: Road 88
details.short_description: Road 88 is a car anomaly game where you must spot the differences on an endless road loop and avoid deadly hazards.

details.title: Broken Race
details.short_description: Have you ever tried driving without sleeping? In Broken Race, being tired makes reality look strange and turns every race into a fight to stay sane. Get upgrades, survive the enemies, and reach the finish line before your brain decides that the laws of physics are just a suggestion.

details.title: Cute Away: Paws Caretaker Simulator
details.short_description: Run the town’s coziest cat caretaking home! Renovate and upgrade your house, manage inventory and order supplies online. Fulfill specific feline requests with specialized furniture and engaging toys. Play with cats, keep them happy, and optimize your layout to create the perfect daily workflow.

details.title: World without Time
details.short_description: World without Time is an atmospheric adventure about a fire alicorn exploring a ruined world, using magic, and confronting their past self. Experience exploration, flight, light combat, and choices that shape the fate of the protagonist.

details.title: Veldrak: Dark Revenant
details.short_description: A multiplayer action RPG of dark survival. Customize your warrior, infuse magic through alchemy, tame wild beasts, and lead autonomous NPCs to build and defend your settlement against rank 1 to 5 demons.

details.title: Twilight Gallery
details.short_description: A point-and-click game inspired by early internet flash games. A mysterious company has induced you into a year-long coma and is curating your dreams. Free the trapped souls of artists from their exhibits to escape.

details.title: Chicago 4th of July
details.short_description: Chicago 4th of July is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in a near-future Chicago — a glamorous yet oppressive megacity wrapped in a mysterious Veil. Uncover the truth behind the Veil, navigate a world ruled by power and rise against a system built to keep you blind.

name: Dragon’s Breath : Chronicles of the Red Dragon (レッドドラゴン戦記)

details.title: Dragon’s Breath : Chronicles of the Red Dragon (レッドドラゴン戦記)
details.short_description: The Red Dragon returns. Venture into the dungeons of Mount Firebreath. This 2D adventure RPG is brought to life with stunning retro pixel art. Classic bump-combat evolves with timing-based action for tense battles. Upgrade your gear, master key items, and defeat the Dragon.

details.title: Cauldron Chaos: Co-op Potion Shop
details.short_description: Run a potion shop with up to 3 friends as wooden witch dolls. brew potions, levitate everything, fling each other across the room, and try not to blow up the cauldron. You will.

details.title: DISPEL
details.short_description: In DISPEL, play as the sole survivor of an unknown magical calamity. Explore the ruins of a corrupted wizard academy, avoid the shades of your former friends, solve puzzles to discover new areas of the school, and uncover what happened in Feylight Academy.

details.title: Unchest
details.short_description: A mouse-only management game with a bit of tower defense. Restock goods, trade with customers and craft gear for the nighttime—if the monsters reach your shop, they’ll plunder your hard-earned gold.

details.title: Orbital Command
details.short_description: Orbital Command is about controlling planet based weapon systems to defend your planets from large asteroids and hostile invaders. Will you be able to complete the Dyson Sphere, or will your planets end up barren husks?

details.title: Make Burgers: GRILL UP
details.short_description: Embark on a burger-filled adventure with chef Bobby Grill and his bright yellow food truck! Get ready to serve unique burgers not only to regular customers, but also to sweet tooths, robots, zombies, and even aliens!

details.title: The lost trail
details.short_description: Play as a raccoon on a heartfelt and dangerous journey to find the boy who once saved you from poachers. Explore the wild, avoid traps, uncover secrets, and experience a story of friendship, survival, and hope.

details.title: Little Lilicia
details.short_description: A full-fledged farm life sim where you live as a rancher, socialize, and find love with heroines in the town of Kokotan, home of the Forest Goddess. Step into the shoes of the protagonist, Philo, who becomes a rancher by chance, and revitalize the run-down farm.

details.title: Pumpkin Survivor
details.short_description: Pumpkin Survivor is a whimsical cartoon-style survival game where you’ll experiment with countless weapon builds to defend against relentless enemy waves. Mix and match abilities, upgrade your pumpkin hero, and survive as long as possible in this roguelike adventure!"

details.title: Booost!! CleanSweep
details.short_description: Take control of the 'Cleaning Cart' and clean up a filthy city! But beware of the Litterbugs who scatter trash everywhere! Faster, cleaner, better. This is a score-attack car action game.

details.title: Which Sea Is This?
details.short_description: Which Sea Is This? is a local co-op sea adventure where you control a single ship together. Trade, explore, pirate, and argue about directions — because nobody knows where you are.

details.title: Dwarven Mining Company
details.short_description: Manage your own dwarven mine. Give orders to miners excavating ore and builders providing them with ladders to get deeper and deeper into the underground. Mine iron, copper and even mithrill to satisfy the needs of the dwarven kingdom for the price of a single coffee.

details.title: Lost Dude
details.short_description: Lost Dude is an atmospheric 2D platform-adventure game that follows a character who sets out on a journey to find their lost friend, experiences various events along the way, and embarks on new adventures together after reuniting.

details.title: Type The Rhythm
details.short_description: A rhythm typing trainer where you type real words to a variety of musical styles. Augmented proprioception lets you move the grooves between your brain and fingers for faster, cleaner typing. From hunt-and-peck to 150 WPM blindfolded, Type The Rhythm moves you forward.

details.title: HexBrandPre
details.short_description: Story of VoltSpark. Choose the most suitable set of equipments for you, then dodge the bullets and crash the enemies. A bullet-hell game, which is quite difficult. Instant reactions, level understanding, strategies are requird to beat this game. As agile as leopard, ruin everything like thunder.

details.title: Rustmire
details.short_description: In this side-view pixel-art world, you captain a landship—survive by combat and scavenging, and grow your modular vessel into your own city. Among roaming cities and underground enclaves, records and wreckage hint at why people live this way… or how you become wreckage.

details.title: Still Stars Echo
details.short_description: An atmospheric science-fiction journey across distant alien landscapes. Traverse monolithic structures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the story of a lost civilization written among the stars.

details.title: Stackatalbi
details.short_description: Stackatalbi is a survival game where you stack cards to collect resources and craft new items. Drag your hero over an open world, hunt, fish, farm and grow stronger to fight new foes. Play solo or online co-op with a friend.

details.title: Ruin and Rebirth
details.short_description: Ruin and Rebirth is a fantasy open-world factory building game with creature taming and breeding. In this playable creation myth, bring life back to a surreal, shattered, post-divine apocalyptic world where the gods have died.

details.title: Watamari Part2 - A Fake Marriage?
details.short_description: This is a yuri game where you as an angel of love must help guide the heroines. Do your best, little angel (you) and take care of your mistress's wellbeing!

details.title: Before the Silence
details.short_description: In this turn-based strategy, you will take control of an anti-disinformation department and protect your citizens from terrorist influence. Manage your agents and resources, analyze media, and restore order in different regions of your country.

details.title: Synthellia: Awakening Protocol
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious 2D sci-fi world where fragmented symbols slowly become meaning. Uncover hidden truths, solve environmental puzzles, and descend deeper into the Awakening Protocol.

details.title: Alien Snap
details.short_description: Explore an alien planet, snap pictures of wildlife and build relationships with your crewmates in this heartfelt sci-fi Point & Click - Visual Novel.

details.title: Space Cowboy Radio
details.short_description: An indie action-RPG where you pilot customizable ships through side-scrolling combat, level up unique characters, and dismantle a corrupt galactic regime one mission at a time.

details.title: Immunity
details.short_description: Fight waves of bacteria and viruses as powerful immune cells in this fast-paced survival game. Choose mutations, unlock new characters, build stronger defenses, and protect vital organs before the infection takes over.

details.title: Day of Astrology
details.short_description: Turn-based battle/battle decryption/decision-type level, players need to play, fight, and choose through independent levels. The game is non-linear, and the order of entering each level will also affect the shape and ending of the level.

name: Tales from the Watchtower - The Conjurer

details.title: Tales from the Watchtower - The Conjurer
details.short_description: An episodic psychological horror game set in La Mancha, the rural heart of inland Spain and land of Don Quixote. Inspired by real events near the mysterious Watchtower of Ciudad Real, each episode explores current legends and local folklore where reality and myth blur.

details.title: Chinese Black Dragon Legend
details.short_description: " Chinese Black Dragon Legend" is a daily comedy Cantonese-style visual novel (galgame). The story follows Sino-French footballer Zhong Guolong's romantic journey with four heroines: Bai Xiaotong, Aisha, Frolana, and Kim Sung-ae.

details.title: Fantasy Sino-Japanese War：Rebirth
details.short_description: ​​Dragons roar, history bends. As Admiral Ding Ruchang, you command magical sea beasts, not ships, in this thrilling SRPG. After a crushing defeat, lead the Beiyang Fleet's last hope against Japan's monsters. Rewrite the Sino-Japanese War.

details.title: SCRATCH CO.
details.short_description: Build a deck of scratch tickets, chase rising quotas, permanently upgrade your gas station, and pay off your debt! Scratch the itch of gambling in SCRATCH CO.

details.title: Peg Together
details.short_description: Peg Together is a multiplayer puzzle game that puts you against a friend to see who can achieve the highest score by hitting the most pegs with the furthest shots! Explore through different levels and worlds and master them all to win against your friend!

details.title: UFOntastic
details.short_description: Jano has debts to pay, and the easiest place to get money is on Earth! Use your flying saucer: abduct objects, people, enemies and much more from the environment to progress through dungeons and mini-games. Amass a fortune!

details.title: Wibby Buddy
details.short_description: Explore a beautiful forest and bond with adorable animals! Build closeness with various creatures, and as your bond grows, gift them cozy homes to live together. Gather resources and craft to create a unique home with your animal friends. Turn a shabby, lonely space into a warm, lively haven!

name: 宥蘿的巫女修行錄 Miko Yuro: Training Record

details.title: 宥蘿的巫女修行錄 Miko Yuro: Training Record
details.short_description: The sequel to the Japanese-style adventure game Yuro’s Fantasy Adventure, set several years later on an ordinary day, Yuro continues her journey as a shrine miko of Kanai Jinja, training relentlessly to refine her swordsmanship and onmyo magic, the entire game is played from a third-person.

details.title: Trade Anchor
details.short_description: Amidst powerful alien empires, you are among the first humans in this corner of the procedurally generated galaxy. Trade and explore. With no combat, your success hinges on mastering complex alien economies and navigating intricate politics. Can you carve out a place for humanity in the cosmos?

details.title: 阴阳妖怪
details.short_description: Creature collection + text AVG + adventure! Catch 200+ unique yokai, meet distinct companions in a story of conflicts, feelings and secrets. Kincyo, town of human-yokai harmony, is in crisis. Team up with Miumiu to expose the villain—you hold its fate.

details.title: My Bookshop Dreams
details.short_description: A cozy bookshop management sim where you run, customize, and expand your dream bookstore. Restock shelves, host author events, pet kitties and puppies, collect literary works while helping authors, as you grow your reputation across cities and build a legacy.

details.title: Amanita
details.short_description: Amanita is an introspective journey into your mind where the path seems to be only one, and it does not seem to be easy. Let yourself be guided by surreal characters in your thoughts, clash with your memories with sword blows, wander in your memory, play cards with your fears.

details.title: Table for None
details.short_description: "Table for None" is a pixelated, bite-sized open world, food truck cooking adventure game. Explore diverse regions, discover new recipes, and prepare meals to manage your food truck!

details.title: Stick A Round
details.short_description: Relive the joy of your childhood in Stick A Round! Find uniquely generated sticks that transform into weapons based on their real-world shapes. Battle friends in combat, play action packed or relaxing minigames, and explore a changing world where your imagination sets the rules.

details.title: Tap Monster: Forest
