details.short_description: Welcome to the world of monsters! Tap the screen, fight alongside your monsters, and conquer levels—easy to start, thrilling to master. Get stronger even while lying down!

details.title: Moonstone Resort
details.short_description: Find tranquility in a peaceful farming life while building a cozy hotel for guests. When you're ready for an adventure, explore the depths of the mines, encountering unique creatures and uncovering valuable resources.

details.title: Final Absolution
details.short_description: Final Absolution is an upcoming survival-horror first-person shooter with a focus on exploration, inspired by Super Metroid and Doom. A mysterious force has overtaken the N-Space rocket launch site and corrupted the artificial intelligence that manages the remote island spaceport.

details.title: WingWhiz
details.short_description: WingWhiz brings classic arcade shoot 'em ups into 3D with roguelite progression. Destroy everything in your path, level up, build your plane, unlock new weapons and planes, and try different playstyles as you fight through new worlds.

details.title: Low Battery
details.short_description: A puzzle game inspired by sokoban. Play the role of a power-recycling robot. Plan your route carefully to maneuvering other units and make your way out. Collcet power little by little, locate the source of Infinite Power and Leave this Factory.

details.title: FreedomBot
details.short_description: Turn-based roguelike where you play as a rogue bot surviving in procedurally generated cities. Features sophisticated character development and in depth combat using a detailed anatomical damage system .

details.title: Homelander’s Valor
details.short_description: Become a hero of Eastern legend. Explore ancient secrets, plan your defenses, combine tower types and modifiers, and build an indestructible fortress in a tower-defence game with survival elements.

details.title: Cairns
details.short_description: Balance. Patience. Perfection. Cairns is the quintessential Stone Stacking game. Experience diverse and atmospheric environments, and master the art of building the freestanding stone towers know as Cairns.

details.title: Whisker Cat Shelter
details.short_description: Welcome to Whisker Village! Run a cozy cat shelter, welcome cats brought in by villagers, care for new arrivals, and help them find loving forever homes, solo or with a friend.

details.title: Cindocu: The Omens
details.short_description: Follow in the footsteps of Persia Kelborn - heir to the oldest dynasty on the continent of Ferrum. Uncover the dark secrets hidden within his family for centuries, and witness events that began long before he was born...

details.title: Bumper Buddies
details.short_description: Join your friends online for the hilarious, addictive party racer where you race, shove, and betray your buddies. Team up 1v1 to 3v3 across physics-fueled minigames. Paint your car however you like.

details.title: Priest Amore
details.short_description: Priest Amore is a cartoon-style, casual puzzle game. Players will take on the role of Amor, a priest working in the fictional institution "Palace of Love," experiencing her day in the life while encountering a mundane yet meaningful adventure about love and understanding.

details.title: Triox
details.short_description: A short indie horror blending Sokoban puzzles with tense resource management. Deep inside a hostile mining facility, you remotely pilot a pushing machine. The world's oxygen is depleting, but a volatile new form of cyclic ozone has been discovered. Excavate it. It's humanity's only hope.

details.title: New Trivia Unlocked!
details.short_description: A knowledge Q&A party game with Steam Workshop support! Featuring hundreds of quirky, mind-bending, and bizarre questions—from everyday facts to counterintuitive trivia and pure luck challenges. Play online with your friends to find out who the true "know-it-all" is!

details.title: Until somewhere
details.short_description: WARNING! This game is harder than it looks – you’ll need to be a real go-getter. The aim is to build your shuttle and upgrade it so you can venture into the unknown depths of interstellar space. With only Lina, your faithful companion, by your side, will you have enough patience?

details.title: Empirestead
details.short_description: Make a home at Grey Croft in a medieval pixel-art farming sim. Grow crops through four seasons, raise animals, and get to know the neighbors at Ashford's Sunday market. Fish, cook, and build up your farm solo or with a friend in two-player local co-op.

details.title: Voidlights
details.short_description: Voidlights is a Neon-lit 2D top-down roguelight shooter. Auto-fire through escalating void swarms, stack modules and systems, survive storms and bosses. Play solo with save/continue, or dive into Steam co-op with up to 6 players.

details.title: SoulPurge
details.short_description: SoulPurge is a psychological horror mystery. Explore an old abandoned mansion. Find clues to solve the mystery. Discover how and why its former inhabitants lost their lives. Evade the horrors that wander the mansion halls. Free their tortured souls in an attempt to redeem yours.

details.title: Crashborn
details.short_description: Lost and with no memories, cross a solar system to get back home. Tear through each planet's hordes to recharge your ship's energy and take off before the world turns lethal. Combine weapons, implants and anomalies until nothing can stop you. Every death rewrites your reality and your memory.

details.title: Still Pines: watchtower
details.short_description: Still Pines: Watchtower is a first-person psychological horror mystery where you play as Claire, a college student trapped at an isolated winter watchtower. Explore a semi-open snowy forest, uncover clues about a missing ranger, survive the thing watching from the trees, and follow story objectives.

details.title: Backrooms With Friends!
details.short_description: A 1-5 player co-op horror game where you and your friends noclip into an endless maze also known as the Backrooms. Explore procedurally generated levels and avoid the Entities that stalk the halls. Get separated and you might not make it back. Get caught and you won't make it out at all...

details.title: Deck of Empires
details.short_description: A multiplayer RTS game where you are dealt cards every 60 seconds, and you use strategy to place cards, and command your units to create and grow a powerful empire to defeat your foes!

details.title: I’m A Food Delivery Guy
details.short_description: 送外卖，攒彩礼，目标 18 万 8！“想娶我女儿，彩礼必须 18 万 8，一分都不能少！”，丈母娘的一句话，让你决定离开电子厂，开始全职送外卖，努力奋斗，只为攒够彩礼，迎娶你的心上人。

name: Magical Girl Mina ~Battle of the Twin Demons~

details.title: Magical Girl Mina ~Battle of the Twin Demons~
details.short_description: This is a stage-based 3D action game starring the cute magical girl Mina. Use various costumes with different skills to clear stages and defeat the boss at the very end!

details.title: Cell 413 : Mine & Survive
details.short_description: A survival game in the life of a prisoner digging a hole to escape. Explore the procedurally generated underground, outsmart the guards, build your base, craft tools and find a way out of there!

details.title: STACK'EM!
details.short_description: Stack cards together, create unique creatures, experiment with wild combos! Prove your creativity in this highly strategic, turn-based deckbuilder against toys.

details.title: Drone Soccer
details.short_description: Drone Soccer is a 5v5 full-contact aerial sport. Pilot a caged drone as the Striker to score through the goal hoop, or play Defender and smash opponents out of the sky to clear the lane. Compete in online multiplayer or sharpen your flying in solo practice.

details.title: The Chessboard Mystery:47 West Street,Highgate
details.short_description: Step into Highgate a fog-shrouded town in 1956, where a mysterious murder shatters the silence. As a private investigator, explore scenes, gather evidence, and question suspects. Use your evidence board to trace lies, face branching choices, and uncover the hidden truth behind the crime.

details.title: SATSUBATSU SUCCUBUS
details.short_description: YOU HAVE BEEN CURSED BY A SUCCUBUS. KILL THE ANGELS. FOR ECSTASY.

details.title: Moon Stop
details.short_description: In a silent, isolated lunar base, a lonely astronaut embarks on a moving journey to recover her daughter’s final memory. Through cold corridors and fragments of the past, a profound story unfolds about love, loss, and the human need for connection.

details.title: 颠倒世界 World Inverted
details.short_description: The sky lies beneath our feet.Above stretches a vast plane. From it hang forests of inverted buildings, linked by narrow corridors and pipes. They stand in silence, like upside-down obelisks pointing toward the eye of the sun.This game reveals an upside-down world through words and unique visuals.

details.title: Rest Here
details.short_description: Your world above, the ever changing Shadows below: Terraform your world, mine resources, craft gear, fight monsters, make alliances, rescue who you can, extract what you carry. Make it back and your cozy world thrives. Die? and the Shadows keep it all.

details.title: Logistics Simulator: America
details.short_description: Drive across the United States as a professional trucker. Deliver cargo on highways and backroads, manage your fleet, develop your warehouses, and run a realistic logistics business. Plan routes, manage fuel and time, and take on the real challenges of life behind the wheel.

details.title: Infinite Bloom
details.short_description: Embody beings from vast cosmos to tiny plankton, and even your mind in Infinite Bloom! Use your hands to flap or swim. Power, identity, and scale become fluid. Faced with the vastness of the world, human is only a drop in the ocean, part of a continuum of life far greater than us.

details.title: Rise of Sorcery
details.short_description: A narrative card-based RPG where every choice shapes your destiny. Master magic by assembling occult whispers, but beware: each spell permeates your body. Manage your magical impregnation or risk the Darkism. Balance your power before magic consumes you.

details.title: Toxoplasma
details.short_description: You are trapped on an abandoned space station, developing a bio-weapon that makes the infected hallucinate demonic entities. Spot any anomalous signs of infection before they kill you, complete your research, and unmask the conspiracy that brought you here.

details.title: Loot And Defend
details.short_description: A short, relaxing incremental game about slaughtering millions of attacking zombies. Take a load off, the end of the world doesn't have to be stressful.

details.title: Gensou Bullet Battle
details.short_description: This is a top-down shooter designed primarily for multiplayer. Players control a variety of unique characters and battle across stages filled with intense bullet patterns. (This game is an unofficial fan game based on the Touhou Project.)

details.title: Heart of Vinterium
details.short_description: There is an artifact capable of granting any wish, but only the strongest are destined to find it. In Heart of Vinterium, you must explore grim and shifting worlds where every step could be your last. Fight, collect magical cards, and solve mysteries.

name: Forest of Fear - Into the Woods

details.title: Forest of Fear - Into the Woods
details.short_description: A first-person horror journey through a haunted forest, created by a solo developer. Explore a single large map, uncover hidden story fragments, and survive unpredictable scares in this atmospheric debut made with Unreal Engine 5.

details.title: Fragments of Chaos
details.short_description: Want to explore dungeons, master spells, hunt monsters, or spend the afternoon fishing? Go for it. Want to paralyze another player, steal their loot, and disappear before their friends arrive? That works too.

details.title: The Hilarious Three Kingdoms 2
details.short_description: This is a traditional turn-based strategy game set in the era of the Three Kingdoms.Control different feudal lords, step onto the historical battlefield, experience the funny plot, strategize and unite the world!

details.title: Tidewake
details.short_description: Tidewake is an arcade naval roguelite for one to four captains. Sail, fight and loot your way up a shelf of bottled sea battles, bolt on cannons, stack relics that bend every shot, and beat the lackey at the top to win your soul back from Davy Jones.

details.title: Crystal Realms
details.short_description: Crystal Realms is a MMO game where you can gather resources and make your own worlds! You can fight enemies, complete quests, craft items, build worlds, make friends and much more.

details.title: Destiny Code
details.short_description: Beautiful girls and thrilling card battles, all in one RPG! As factions clash over the relics of a lost civilization, the fate of the world — and your companions — hangs on your choices. A dramatic tale where your strategy and decisions shape destiny!

details.title: Sadko
details.short_description: Monsters are closing in from all sides, and all you've got is a gusli… and the letter O? Dynamic combat with Slavic folk music, hero progression, and building a unique build to take on each location and its boss - so you can finally face Koschei himself.

details.title: Will O Wisp
details.short_description: This is a platform action game in which you control light in a world shrouded in complete darkness and rely on it to progress. Use the light to travel from place to place and illuminate the buried truth.

details.title: Don't Die, Dummy!
details.short_description: Who knew the secret to robot destruction was the perfect spin kick? Dance now, explain later!

details.title: Magic Cells
details.short_description: A life-or-death war between cells and germs! 20+ bosses lead 100+ minions to invade—cunning, multiplying, mutating, and parasitizing your turf! Summon 24+ magic cells, wield 100+ tech cards to fight back, and harness 9 divine powers to win!

details.title: Deliver Together
details.short_description: In Deliver Together, You control either (or both) of the two trucks attached to the same loooong trailer. And who's driving? Oh, just you. Or you and a friend. Or maybe eight of you, all screaming different directions at once. Your goal is to reach the finish line in chaotic tracks.

details.title: Rico's Theater
details.short_description: Rico's Theater is an extremely intense first-person online multiplayer horror game. Choose multiple classes that vary in weapons & abilities & work together with friends in fighting dangerous entities.

details.title: Chill Chess
details.short_description: Relax, strategize, and master chess in a sleek 3D sci-fi world. Play against friends or other players online, or challenge smart AI.

name: 異星間恋愛ガイド ‐Interplanetary love guide‐

details.title: 異星間恋愛ガイド ‐Interplanetary love guide‐
details.short_description: A romance simulation set in a future where interstellar travel is common. Explore the island, meet alien characters, and deepen your bonds through daily choices. A world woven from danger, secrets, and quiet moments of connection. Your choices shape each relationship and lead to multiple endings.

details.title: SHOCK
details.short_description: With only a wheelchair for mobility, Jack, a disabled war veteran, must use stealth, solve puzzles, and crawl into tight spaces to escape a cybernetic creature. Explore a psychological survival horror experience in third person and uncover the truth behind this nightmare.

details.title: Wizard Hand
details.short_description: Wizard Hand is a magical deckbuilder game where solitaire meets roguelike. You play solitaire by using your magical cards to uncover dazzling combos and accumulate magical points with the help of enchantments, crafting, and a collection of powerful artifacts.

name: HAOxSORA =THE SKY'S ABOUND= RIDE TO OUR FINAL

details.title: HAOxSORA =THE SKY'S ABOUND= RIDE TO OUR FINAL
details.short_description: CHANGE THE BOARD. CHASE THE WORLD.

details.title: Hydra Coil
details.short_description: Voyage amidst the stars in this relaxed turn-based Space Fantasy RPG.

details.title: echo//shredd
details.short_description: echo//shredd is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players in a dystopian future. Collect scrap, retrieve loot for upgrades and fight for your survival. Your life is a resource - and your commodification is part of the system.

details.title: Hot Dog Simulator
details.short_description: Start your own hot dog stand business, find the perfect spots in the city, upgrade your stands, attend festivals, and serve influencers. Expand your business by opening new branches and perfecting your hot dogs.

details.title: Marble Havoc
details.short_description: Marble Havoc is a 3D action game. Bring your marble to the goal in different levels. Unfriendly marbles try to kick you away. Friendly marbles assist you.

details.title: Social Warfare
details.short_description: Be a troll-for-hire on social media! You will serve in the Social Warfare battalion and promote loyalty to the Great Kingdom of Eternia, while disrupting society in the enemy nation.

details.title: The Lightkeeper Is Gone
details.short_description: The Lightkeeper Is Gone is a retro-styled horror adventure set in the 1930's on a lone island. Take on the job of keeping the lighthouse while discovering the story of those that came before.

details.title: Abyss Lord
details.short_description: What awaits the young man in the future? A long and happy life next to loved ones? Losses and suffering leading to an inglorious death? The throne of the enemy of humanity? A harem of all sorts of races, from pretty goblins to graceful vampires? The one and only love until death?

details.title: GU Fighters
details.short_description: GU Fighters is an action roguelike where you unlock and upgrade new abilities after every round of combat. Play with up to 4 players locally or online to create your own unique build and be the first to win, or go solo/co-op to traverse varying environments and defeat hordes of enemies.

details.title: Shadow Dash
details.short_description: Shadow Dash is a retro 2D action platformer with pixel-art characters on oil painting backgrounds and changing game controls.

details.title: Lost Ground
details.short_description: 3x3 grid turn-based battle and the exquisite encounter of the rogue-lite deck building! Place multiple heroes on the 3x3 grid to strategically defeat your enemies. Customize and grow your heroes with various combinations of gears, cards, and relics. Defeat the demons to reclaim lost ground!

details.title: Slingbox
details.short_description: A minimalist physics platformer built on momentum. Dash, tether, and launch through a decaying simulation: zero gravity first, then gravity and corruption. Beat the clock, earn medals, perfect every route.

details.title: By The Orchid
details.short_description: 中式原生家庭环境下，少年找寻存在方式的故事。

details.title: Snack Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own snack shop where eating snacks makes you stronger! Order 45+ treats online, stock shelves, feed employees, serve customers, or hire a team to help you. Build your business, boost your power, and create the ultimate snack heaven!

details.title: Desserted
details.short_description: Desserted is a 1-6 player co-op survival horror game. Explore procedurally generated map in your mobile food truck. Gather, cook, and defend your power grid from sabotaging monsters. Complete sacrifices and survive the deadly Blackout when the lights go out!

details.title: Omicrox
details.short_description: Stuck in an unusual game night. Break the contract and escape. In Omicrox, you are drawn into a twisted match of Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe against an uncanny foe. Uncover the mysteries of this twisted game and escape.

details.title: Backrooms: Rogue 0
details.short_description: A routine expedition into the Backrooms goes silent. You are the last call. Now trapped in endless corridors that loop into themselves, you’ll soon realize you are not alone. Something moves heremany things—and none of them can be fought. Your only hope is to stay unseen. Never trust what you see.

details.title: 42 Space Mayhem
details.short_description: Fast-paced rogue-lite space shooter where every run brings new upgrades, enemy waves, and ship evolutions. Play solo or team up with a friend in co-op to survive, adapt, and dominate the galaxy.

details.title: アストラリス
details.short_description: I awoke on a lonely shore beneath a sky of countless stars. A mysterious traveler appeared, speaking of constellations soon to fade. Together, we set out on a journey— to meet new people, uncover the truth of this world, and face the choice that awaits me. An adventure of stars and memories begins.
developers: ほしをつくりしものたち
publishers: ほしをつくりしものたち

details.title: Electio
details.short_description: Four blanks, two bullets, and a choice. Save yourself and sacrifice the others, or save them and risk your eternal death. Electio is a short narrative horror game that can be played only once. Choose wisely.

details.title: Ants Megapolis
details.short_description: Command a colony on the brink in Ants Megapolis. Survive an unforgiving world by forging your unique Pheromone, a weapon that dictates your evolution. Carve out an empire from the dirt as an interactive narrator chronicles your savage, epic story of survival.

details.title: Spellbroker
details.short_description: Become a master Spellbroker — wield magic and money in a fast-paced, isometric pixel art marketplace. Buy low, sell high, and bend the market to your will as you build your fortune in a world where profit is pure magic.

details.title: Cut the Strings
details.short_description: It's a battle to become a sacrifice. A TPS where the bride <sacrifice> girl shoots down abandoned synthetic soldiers on the battlefield. A fictional post-war world, a corrupt city, unreasonable fate and choices. Explore vast fields, enhance your body and weapons, and carve out her path.

details.title: Posse of 3
details.short_description: Posse of Three is an RPG Maker game that takes place in a wild west setting with heavy fantasy elements! You will play as 3 main characters. Sammy a young settler, Ahiga a native man, and Fennic a wild fawn. Expect traditional turn based rpg combat with a gripping wild west story.

details.title: Maidle Cafe
details.short_description: Run your own maid café in this charming idle incremental game! Hire and upgrade maids, decorate with unique items, and grow your café into the ultimate cozy hotspot—all while earning profits even when you’re away.

details.title: Sweep Squad
details.short_description: Sweep Squad is a 1-4 player arcade sweep-em-up where you and your ambiguous rodent friends team up to sweep away the bad guys and hit your quotas. Crank up the earnings with overtime and use various sub-weapons at your disposal to sweep away the competition.

details.title: Deck Breach
details.short_description: We fused roguelike deckbuilders and autobattlers to create a whole new experience. Pick your favorite weapon, craft a unique deck, create your unique playstyle, and play powerful cards to influence the outcome of the battle in a unique combat style where your Hero’s actions are your resources.

details.title: Tokyo Supplier
details.short_description: As a post robot in a future Tokyo under lockdown, deliver packages under pressure. Dodge blockades and hostile bots, beat the clock, and unlock skins for your bot, dog companion, and delivery van.

details.title: Escape from Ruin: Greymart Simulator
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic loot-fight-extract survival game with escape-style raids by day and black-market shop management by night. Fans of Tarkov-like gameplay — and players who love running management sims — will feel right at home.

details.title: Protocol Paradox
details.short_description: Protocol Paradox is a fast-paced roguelike shooter blending twin-stick combat, anomaly-based weapons and branching lore. Survive procedural sectors, customize builds with weapons and passives, face concept-driven bosses, and replay for new revelations.

details.title: Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued
details.short_description: Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued is a courtroom simulation RPG where every trial is a battle of wits. You’ll take on the role of Harold Beagll, a golden retriever attorney navigating a legal system filled with sharp-tongued rivals, eccentric clients, and unpredictable witnesses.

details.title: SPARK! -PHOTON BLAST-
details.short_description: "SPARK! -PHOTON BLAST-" is a sports action game where players face off in a futuristic stadium, rendered with stunningly beautiful photorealistic graphics. Your goal is to score by launching a sphere into your opponent's goal. Enjoy the heart-pounding, high-octane action where every second counts!

details.title: The Bone Dancer's Bane
details.short_description: A 700,000-word epic fantasy interactive novel.

name: Brave Old World: Tower of Cards

details.title: Brave Old World: Tower of Cards
details.short_description: A text-based RPG adventure. Uncover an epic story of decay and rebirth in a new world, 200 years after humanity's arrival. Guide multiple protagonists through an immersive narrative, diverse gameplay, and a dynamic art style. An unforgettable experience awaits!

details.title: Trivia Fantasy
details.short_description: TRIVIA FANTASY is a trivia-based adventure with RPG progression. Crawl your way through a decayed tower filled with forgotten knowledge and defeat the dying deity that that awaits at the summit!

details.title: Frog Odyssey
details.short_description: A turn-based strategic auto-battler where you buy ingredients, craft special dishes, and feed them to your frog adventurers to unlock powerful bonuses! Embark on a heroic journey to confront those causing chaos across the realm.

details.title: TomaDO!
details.short_description: TomaDO! is a fast, quirky multiplayer platformer where tomato heroes race through floating obstacle courses, dodge hazards, and respawn at checkpoints. Jump, dash, and explore golf and other modes to reach the finish first.

details.title: Still Hope
details.short_description: An investigation becomes a nightmare when Sam searches for missing Jess. Explore a private research facility and confront his story-rich, emotional journey into psychological horror.

details.title: 卡恩特村
details.short_description: As war erupts between the Dominion and the Kingdom Iori, from the borderlands, is drawn into the chaos This is a story-driven traditional turn-based RPG, where players embark on an adventure across a war-torn continent, and witness conflicts that will change the fate of the entire world

details.title: Please, Spin
details.short_description: The wheel of fate roguelike where you spin for your life. Customize your wheel, discover game-breaking relics, survive twisted side events, and outsmart rigged bosses to beat the lunatic host and escape the broadcast!

details.title: Dittomatic
details.short_description: A turn-based photocopier roguelike about copying the copy of a copy. Box up stamps, copy them and press them back onto the page. Copies grow stronger, matches fuse and mismatches misprint. Build a page worth printing, then watch the score cascade past quota.

details.title: Frog Up!
details.short_description: Jump, Rise, and Pose! This 3D action game challenges you to climb steps from a third-person view. Score points with each jump and aim to reach the goal—but don’t fall into the water! You can strike a cool pose to get special items. The cooler the pose, the better the rewards. How high can you go?

details.title: Crosstalk
details.short_description: Juna Park's broken implant shuts down every device around her, and the city wants her gone. You play Cal Rowe, the PI keeping her alive. She can say stop. Whether you listen decides how much she trusts you, and every one of the ten endings costs something.

details.title: Unknown Call: Ohio
details.short_description: You wake up in an empty forest in Ohio. A voice calls you. Says you're friends. Says you need to get out. But the signal keeps breaking, and so does your memory. Your friend will guide you from a distance, but he can't save you. Escape the creatures in the dark and find your friend.

details.title: Carouspell
details.short_description: Carouspell is a dark fantasy roguelite bullet heaven where you wield revolving magic to slay hordes of monsters. Spin your Spell Chamber, collect ancient relics and assemble god-slaying combinations to survive the deepest pits of despair.

details.title: Combo Smith
details.short_description: Combo-Smith is a Strategy FPS game where you combine your current weapons to create better ones. Defeat the Opposing team by Creating Crazy Combo's that wipe them all out, The limit is your imagination.

details.title: Phantom Lamb
details.short_description: Play a story-driven third-person psychological thriller set in a sinister early-20th-century asylum where reality bends under the weight of forgotten horrors. Phantom Lamb blends tense stealth gameplay with an immersive narrative of haunting secrets and psychological dread.

details.title: Refuel Together
details.short_description: Run a gas station with 1 to 6 player as Co-Op in Refuel Together. Build a large gas station from a single gas pump. Upgrade and expand your gas station as more cars arrive. Become popular as you meet your customers' demands.

details.title: One Last Sacrifice
details.short_description: Most autobattlers reset after every match. One Last Sacrifice doesn't. Unlock skills across a branching skill tree. Build a deck. Improve creatures by crafting. Compete in 1v1 duels or 8-player elimination tournaments - sync and async play supported.

details.title: Wanderer's Deck
details.short_description: “Wanderer’s Deck is a dark fantasy roguelike deck-building game. Every choice reshapes your fate: build your deck, step through mysterious doors, battle deadly foes, and face powerful bosses lurking in the dungeons.”

details.title: Wheelie Bad
details.short_description: Grab the wheels solo or sync up in co-op. Race a high-speed wheelchair through deadly tracks, dodge brutal hazards, and restart on every hit. Push your reflexes, beat the timer, and claim 3 stars on every stage.

details.title: Hellborn: No Survivors
details.short_description: Hellborn: No Survivors is a cute, unique survivors-like/bullet heaven where you descend into hell and slay hordes of undead, demonic creatures. Balance risk versus reward, master the flames of hell, collect powerful relics and evolve to unlock your potential and take on endless waves of the wicked.

details.title: OVERTYPE
details.short_description: Overtype is a roguelike typing action game set in a neon-drenched post-apocalypse. Type to fight, dodge, and survive against waves of cyborgs and corrupted machines. Every keystroke is your weapon master speed and precision to uncover Zyra’s legacy and type out humanity’s last hope.

details.title: Hadal
details.short_description: Guide a Nereid Freight submarine crew through Nadir’s hostile under-ice oceans. Deliver essential cargo, salvage wrecks, repair failing stations, hunt dangerous lifeforms, and survive in the crushing darkness where every dive carries risk — and nothing stays quiet for long.

details.title: Dissonant Frames
details.short_description: Congratulations, Mark! You’ve been selected as our new gallery night staff. Your duty: patrol the halls and ensure artworks stay in place. Should you notice hallucinations, injuries, strange events, or blackouts—no you didn’t. Welcome aboard. You start Monday.

details.title: Mango & Berry's Sorbet Syndicate
details.short_description: Fruit is outlawed, and Mango and Berry are aspiring fruit lords! Manage a criminal, underground sorbet shop solo or online co-op. Smuggle goods, upgrade your shop, trade fruit or grow your own underground supply. Will Mango & Berry rise to power? Or are they headed for a tragic downfall?

details.title: The Kult
details.short_description: A missing friend. Her last known location on your phone. A fence you probably shouldn’t cross. Enter the eerie woods, uncover her story, and face the kult that waits in the dark.

details.title: ListenUp!
details.short_description: ListenUp: detective sim with strategy and meta-progression. You’re a radio station owner ruined by a false accusation. So be it! Rule the airwaves, investigate, and adapt to a shifting world after every death. Drive your station to success and clear your name.

details.title: Combined Arms Brigade
details.short_description: Combined Arms Brigade is a military FPS featuring in-game AI and roles such as riflemen, machine gunners and designated marksmen. Experience infantry squad combat, with more modes, maps and vehicles planned for the future. Grab your rifle and get ready for battle!

details.title: The C0RE
details.short_description: Welcome aboard The C0RE! A fun, fast action dodger in space where you have to deflect bullets and capture as many powerups as you can! The C0RE has POWERUPS, MODES, A SKIN SHOP, LEADERBOARDS, and soooo much more!

details.title: Beast Reality
details.short_description: 3d Smash Bros inspired fighting game where animals in the distant future need to fight for entertainment.

details.title: Bar Master
details.short_description: Bar Master is a management game where you play as a bar owner and must develop your business. Start by serving beers in a simple bar, hire waiters, unlock new drinks, expand your bar, and buy new bars in the city!

details.title: 模拟修仙录
details.short_description: 《模拟修仙录》是一款修仙题材的策略构筑游戏。穿越获得无限模拟金手指的你，将利用系统随机提供的天材地宝、流派秘法及修仙百艺，一步步积累真元、修炼突破，构筑独属于自己的修炼法门，最终证道长生！

details.title: Midnight Dies Y2K
details.short_description: It’s December 31st, 1999. As the Devil’s daughter, you’ve been dared to stop your dad’s plan to take over the world before midnight. Solve wacky problems, collect bizarre items, and choose carefully—your decisions shape the ending!

details.title: Check My Papers
details.short_description: 2027. One year since the superpowers’ standoff came to a head. The nuclear winter has lifted, but people still hide in bunkers, afraid of the radiation. Who gets a new home—and who is cast out into the wastes? Lives are in your hands, Captain.

details.title: Paradise Beyond the Nightmare
details.short_description: "Paradise Beyond the Nightmare" is a 2D exploration horror game where you explore and solve puzzles in a 2D space with depth. You can experience moving both sideways and forwards through eerie paintings.

details.title: 和平东京
details.short_description: This is an anti-war themed destruction game. Our goal is world peace! To achieve this great mission, we must first establish peace in Tokyo!

details.title: Isometric House Builder
details.short_description: A cozy 2D isometric building game with pixel art style. Follow blueprints to place blocks and construct houses step by step. Balance accuracy and creativity as you complete foundations, walls, and roofs, turning simple plans into charming pixel-art homes.

details.title: Nitrania
details.short_description: Race. Boost. Unlock. A blazing-fast 90s-inspired arcade grip racer with 4-player split-screen. Master nitro to overtake 19 rivals, collect points, and unlock cars, upgrades, and vibrant track regions. Featuring an original soundtrack by the legendary retro racing composer BARRY LEITCH.

details.title: Emoji Guess Party
details.short_description: Think you can guess the answer from a few emojis? Emoji Guess Party is a lighthearted emoji puzzle game filled with idioms, wordplay, internet slang, and brain-teasing riddles. Play solo or guess together with friends.

details.title: Carte Blanche
details.short_description: Carte Blanche is an original adventure and card game in a fantastic world with the style of Japanese animes. Travel the world in search of the Cards. Collect them, develop them to participate in the Tournaments of the game. Discover the fabulous story of two children who love each other.

details.title: Deep Claims
details.short_description: Deep Claims is a space exploration game where you upgrade your ship and equipment in order to mine increasingly valuable and hazardous asteroids. Can you make it to the core?

details.title: 白銀のユークロニア
details.short_description: ”Silver Eucronia” is an exploration RPG where you wander through a post-apocalyptic world covered in white. Through interactions with allies, world exploration, and deadly battles against threats, you will witness the conclusion of your own world and carve out the future beyond.

details.title: Into Oblivion
details.short_description: Into Oblivion is an immerse interactive novel where your choices shape the story. Set in the far-future, explore a galaxy on the brink of crisis with dynamic companions. So, settle your mind and pray you have what it takes to fly Into Oblivion.

details.title: Endless Tactics
details.short_description: A turn-based tactics roguelite about defending a planetary mining expedition, upgrading your starship, and extracting before alien hordes overrun you.

name: Archery Pro with James Jean Trickshots

details.title: Archery Pro with James Jean Trickshots
details.short_description: Archery Pro brings life-like, competitive archery straight to your living room through VR! There’s no need for archery equipment to experience the fun of Olympics style Archery with Archery Pro. Simply pop on your headset and experience all the thrills of real-life archery.

details.title: Escape from the Collector
details.short_description: "Escape from the Collector" is a first-person puzzle adventure set inside an old house filled with strange mechanisms and secrets. Explore its rooms, follow the traces of a forgotten story, and solve the puzzles standing between you and the way out.

details.title: DeskTrack
details.short_description: A cozy desktop companion with toy cars and a focus timer. Let a little car cruise while you work or study, earn miles to collect cars and scenery, then build your own tracks or take the wheel for a break.

details.title: Electric Alps
details.short_description: You are an electrician, moving back to your hometown in the Austrian Alps, which you find lacks a certain... spark. Promptly tasked with wiring up the village, you solve electrical puzzles, blow fuses and master real-world circuitry techniques. Electrify the Alps, one circuit at a time.

name: The Magic World 2: Curse of the Ancients

details.title: The Magic World 2: Curse of the Ancients
details.short_description: Party role-playing game. You control a squad of characters moving through an open game world. Collect items, complete quests, communicate with NPCs, try to survive, destroy enemies with various magic and weapons.

details.title: New Game+ - Game Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run the game store you never wanted to leave, from the late ’90s to today. Buy, sell and repair games, haggle over trade-ins, and hunt for rare finds. Customize your shop and fill your shelves with parodies that make you laugh, cringe, or remember the games you grew up with.

details.title: Oath for Glory
details.short_description: Join the tournament as a lowly knight of a small village. A skill-based boss fighting game built around directional combat. Learn, adapt, and master precise melee mechanics where player skill determines victory.

details.title: Wanderfolk
details.short_description: A farming RPG where villagers remember everything. Grow crops, forage, and explore a procedurally generated world, then talk to AI-powered NPCs who form real opinions about you. Build friendships, pursue romance, fight monsters (or stay peaceful), and become part of a living village community.

details.title: Seal The Breach
details.short_description: A 3D survival experience set within a cramped one-man submarine exploring a hostile ocean trench.

details.title: KeelOver
details.short_description: KeelOver is a crazy physics party game where weight rules everything. Your pirate ship is a giant scale, tilt the deck by hurling heavy loot at your rivals, customize your pirate, and keep your balance… or end up as shark bait!

details.title: ELLA in da room
details.short_description: A seemingly cozy (but ultimately frustrating) 2D platformer, where a little girl’s imagination transforms her room into a magical world. Jump across pillows, race toy cars, and explore nostalgic adventures in which every object becomes part of a story, all while testing your patience to its limits.

details.title: Astral Echelons
details.short_description: Shoot holes through enemy ships from your seat at the controls of a multi-gunned turret mounted on the bow of a dimension hopping spaceship in this seated VR on-rails spaceship turret shooter!

details.title: Ember
details.short_description: Join up to 5 friends in a deadly game of hide and seek. Play as a survivor or the monster lurking in the shadows.

details.title: Chains of Vithra
details.short_description: "In a brutal, unforgiving RPG, descend into a shattered realm of massive seamless landscapes and shadowed city hubs. Forge a tormented hero through ruthless progression, engage in visceral tactical combat, and make harrowing choices that shape a grim, persistent multiplayer world."

details.title: Anomaly Planet
details.short_description: A Singleplayer Horror Game about navigating an Endless, Living Labyrinth buried in a Mysterious Planet, all whilst facing Dangerous Entities.

details.title: TRANSMIT
details.short_description: A 1-bit, point & click and puzzle short story about horror, mystery and deception. TRANSMIT, translate and search for coded messages as part of your telegraph operator job and figure out what's behind the new SS PURGO.

details.title: ARCADE LOOP: ROGUELIKE
details.short_description: Dive into ARCADE LOOP, a massive, ever-expanding collection of classic and modern arcade simulations. Featuring deep meta-progression, unlockable characters, powerful relics, weapons, bosses and a dynamic scaling system that keeps every run fresh.

details.title: Archerman
details.short_description: Two archer on a ridge. Wind blows. One arrow flies. ARCHERMAN is a minimalist 1v1 archery duel — turn-based, physics-driven, and stripped down to what matters: the arc, the wind, and the moment you release.

details.title: Verbal Vendetta
details.short_description: DITCH BUTTON MASHING! Bark real-time orders to your champion to outplay & counter your opponent! Dominate the leaderboards, and win through words, not buttons! Built by a solo dev!

details.title: Nozie Tower Defense XL
details.short_description: Defend against waves of invading balloons in this colorful tower defense adventure. Place and upgrade 8 unique towers, including fire, slow, explosive, and sniper types, across 20 challenging levels. Mix strategies, complete goals, and try to beat the developer’s high score!

details.title: Turno Nocturno
details.short_description: Work for corporations on desolate planets, complete dangerous shifts, recover valuable resources, and survive strange creatures while uncovering the remains of an ancient humanity that was actually our own.

details.title: Archa
details.short_description: Archa is a 2D platformer all about movement, combat, exploration, and score! To complete a level, you must gather a certain amount of points, and find the exit. Points are given by collecting and attacking enemies.

details.title: Satanic Panic
details.short_description: DEMONS VS ANGELS | A fantastical strategy tower defense with heavy Roguelike elements. Defend against waves of Angelic assaults with a small army of Demons, then upgrade them with a variety of abilities and buffs to tear through increasingly large and powerful hordes of Angels.

details.title: Just Barricade!
details.short_description: Just Barricade! is a brutal home-defense simulator about earning money, building protection, and surviving the consequences of your own decisions.

details.title: Defense Front
details.short_description: Take command of routes and firepower in a fresh take on classic tower defense. Deploy towers, seal off key junctions, and reshape enemy routes on the fly. Turn the tide with branching upgrades, customizable targeting priorities, and direct target designation as you defend humanity across the globe.

details.title: Rock, Paper, Severed
details.short_description: You are invited to play a deadly game of Rock, Paper, Scissors to wipe away your sins. Sit down. Make your throw. Try not to lose anything you can't reattach.

details.title: The Midnight Dump
details.short_description: A first person psychological horror game of a writer locked in his office at night, trying to overcome artblock. As he types, the story begins to take shape in unexpected ways, the line between his writing and reality starts to blur. experience subtle changes and sudden scares as the night unfolds.

details.title: Birdflop
details.short_description: An intense platformer with a unique one-button control. You've fallen from your nest, and you're just learning how to fly. Can you make it back to the top?

details.title: Knut
details.short_description: SAVE THE PLANET, FIND YOUR FISH! In this epic 2D platformer, a simple rescue mission spirals into total planetary chaos. Knut, a one-eyed rodent with a nuclear-grade grudge, engages a robotic army to find his pet. Master twitchy physics and massive upgrades. Nothing stands between you and your fish!

details.title: The Observation Exit
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror where you must identify anomalies, choose the correct elevator to progress, and escape an endless loop in a hospital corridor while avoiding deadly entities.

details.title: XiaoLuo's English War
details.short_description: The town is collapsing! A demonic legion is closing in, and its survival is in your hands. Words are your bullets, and typing speed is your life. Type accurately to unleash lethal skills against waves of enemies. Grab your keyboard and fight to master English and survive!

details.title: Dumb Dunks
details.short_description: Dumb Dunks! is a wildly creative, satirical twist on basketball where every level throws a ridiculous new object and target at you. Master tricky physics, perfect your timing, and embrace the chaos in this humorous physics-based dunking frenzy.

details.title: AI VS ARTISTS
details.short_description: Prove the power of human artists in this narrative-driven story game! Do you have what it takes to dethrone Scylla Corporation?

details.title: Apiary in Flow
details.short_description: Apiary in Flow is an incremental game with automation elements where you place bees inside a hive to build efficient honey-gathering chains. Unlock new bee types and spend your harvest on permanent skill tree upgrades!

details.title: Little Joe the Dodger
details.short_description: A high-difficulty puzzle action game featuring monochrome minimalist graphics and extremely simple controls — you can only jump.

details.title: Scarecrow Simulator
details.short_description: No swords. No dragons. No heroic destiny. Just you, a scarecrow, standing proudly in a medieval field while the world grows around you. Surprisingly relaxing. Surprisingly addictive.

details.title: S-Ranker
details.short_description: Fight through short dungeons in this action roguelite. Choose new powers in combat, equip runes between runs, and rise from F-Rank to S-Rank.

details.title: Clicker Tactics: Memorian
details.short_description: A clicker × auto-battle tactics game where you place your companions on a 3×3 grid. Link chains with a wide variety of skills and relics, and mow down the hordes surging toward you. An exhilarating incremental RPG where every adventure makes you stronger.

details.title: Magical Magic World 2
details.short_description: All the main characters are VTubers!! A 2D pixel-art side-scrolling fantasy magical action game starring the VTuber magical girl Kohaku ♪ One year after the previous incident… Kohaku once again races across the world of Magical Magic World!?

details.title: Kotoha’s Sealed Sword: Hiragana Deckbuilding
details.short_description: Learn and master Japanese with Kotoha! Join her as she goes on a mission to find her grandfather's sealed sword. Discover new creatures. Unlock and craft new words, add them to your hand to aid you in battle.

details.title: Funny Rummy
details.short_description: A Rummy roguelike set in a surreal, hand-drawn world that blends daydream and reality. Visit the Junk Drawer between rounds to bend the rules with wild cards and sub-suits that unlock new strategies. Experiment with new decks and trinkets to build power against ever-increasing scoring goals.

details.title: Vatan
details.short_description: Vatan is a narrative-focused historical drama set in Sivas in 1892. In young Ahmet's life, caught between family, love, and homeland, every decision you make changes relationships, atmosphere, and the path to the finale; every scene carries an emotional cost

name: Prof. Bringoo's Big Dumb Block Factory

details.title: Prof. Bringoo's Big Dumb Block Factory
details.short_description: Play by yourself or with a friend in this action puzzler. With tons of power up combinations, zany sound effects and music you'll never get bored.

details.title: Lost Exit
details.short_description: A psychological horror experience set in a shopping mall with an infamous history. Take on the role of a night shift security guard trapped inside a shifting nightmare of liminal spaces, deadly games, and a truth that refuses to stay buried.

details.title: Overserved: Food Fighters!
details.short_description: Overserved: Food Fighters is a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler for 1–8 players. Pick an adorable critter, dash through chaotic arenas, and hurl food-themed projectiles at your rivals in frantic matches with full cross-play across every platform.

name: 独属于神明的世界：第一部分

details.title: 独属于神明的世界：第一部分
details.short_description: "The world of deity : Part 1" is the free first part of a sci-fi romance ADV "The world of deity" published by Cloudside Games. By cooperating with "little sister" Yiran to uncover the truth behind the chemical plant explosion, players can gradually discover the hidden secrets behind this world.

details.title: ALTAR CORP
details.short_description: A solo rhythmic FPS in the abandoned city called Yerneth.

details.title: Star Seed Protocol
details.short_description: Star Seed Protocol is a bullet-heaven horde survival shooter where you aim your own weapons, deploy turrets and drones, reshape your build with implants, research new technology, and fight through alien swarms across varied mission types.

details.title: 回声 E.C.H.O.S
details.short_description: E.C.H.O.S is a narrative-driven first-person sci-fi game. Several centuries after Earth’s civilization was destroyed by an unknown cosmic force, humanity begins to awaken. Journey through virtual and real worlds, uncover the truth of a new age, and decide the future of civilization.

details.title: Bounce Rush 跟你爆了
details.short_description: A pinball-action × roguelike strategy game. Launch balls to smash enemies, equip turrets and skills, and craft your own build from hundreds of combinations. Three modes: turn-based tactics, real-time combat, and stage-based challenges.

details.title: Kepler Protocol
details.short_description: Kepler-186e. An Imperial colony on a world that wants it gone. Turn-based strategy and hard survival: secure water and Flux power, keep the supply lines alive and hold out against a swarm steered by stimulus and pheromone.

details.title: Smash Them All
details.short_description: A highly dynamic top-down action game where the car serves as both a weapon and the primary tool for survival.

details.title: MUGENDUNGEON
details.short_description: “MUGENDUNGEON” is a top-down roguelike action game where players explore procedurally generated dungeons. Collect keys, reach the goal, clear each floor, upgrade gear in the shop, and dive deeper in this single-player adventure.

details.title: Eleven Legends
details.short_description: Eleven Legends blends football management, character growth, and strategic matches. You are not just a manager on the sidelines, nor just one player on the pitch. Plan each week, build bonds, find mentors, and lead your team to victory.

details.title: Beyond Orbit
details.short_description: A tab-target space MMO inspired by Earth & Beyond. Choose between three classes, Warrior, Explorer or Trader and make your way through the galaxy. Fight, mine, haul and craft with other pilots.

details.title: SECONDED
details.short_description: Seconded is a strategy-driven tavern management game about assigning the right companion to the right problem under pressure and uncertainty. Each request hides its true requirements, forcing you to read situations carefully rather than rely on explicit instructions.

details.title: Goldfish Gunner
details.short_description: Become the most wanted outlaw by taking on the role of Goldfish, a gunner robbing every bank in the Wild West. Escape across challenging, obstacle-filled landscapes where your only way to move is by firing your weapon and riding the recoil.

details.title: Doomsday Defense Line
details.short_description: This is an innovative game that combines strategy, action and character development. David to the frontlines of the plant-animal alliance. Engage in fierce defensive battles against the powerful zombie horde, and uncover the fascinating stories behind every precious character in this world.
developers: 上海齐格飞网络科技有限公司
publishers: 辰炎翎网络科技（上海）有限公司

details.title: DreeM Ascension
details.short_description: Explore the DreeMScape Darklands and uncover it's dark secrets in this story-driven survival horror boomer shooter.

details.title: SLENDYJAN
details.short_description: Slendyjan takes place on a planet devastated by a war that has been consuming all the races that inhabit it for years. The player controls Jan, an exceptionally powerful mercenary who fights on the side of the Nuggets, an advanced civilization from an unknown planet.

details.title: 夢酔のバーテンダー
details.short_description: A hazy, dreamlike visual novel with a touch of the surreal. Step behind the bar of a mysterious, ethereal space. Craft cocktails, share quiet conversations, and connect with your guests' hearts. Mix drinks as you please, and lose yourself in this gentle, dreamlike world.

details.title: Sea Pets: Match & Merge
details.short_description: Drop adorable sea creatures into the ocean and merge them into bigger ones in this relaxing yet addictive physics puzzle. How long can you keep the ocean under control?

details.title: Bad Tides
details.short_description: BAD TIDES is a chaotic 4 player co-op pirate adventure! Explore the seven seas, dive for treasure, upgrade your trustworthy vessel, and fight creatures of myth.

details.title: Delete The Hypercube
details.short_description: Delete The Hypercube is a chill active incremental which tasks you with destroying an extradimensional cube that feeds on Earth's core.

details.title: AntiMatcher
details.short_description: Merge, pop, burst and... annihilate?! Play with bubbles and antibubbles to discover their strange properties in this abstract puzzle game.

details.title: Amalu, Wells between worlds
details.short_description: Amalu: Wells Between Worlds is a pixel-art 2D platformer, and Metroidvania blending Atmospheric exploration, Spell-casting puzzle mechanics, Amazigh/North African mythology and an emotional storytelling

details.title: Rifles & Runes
details.short_description: A real-time strategy game blending extraction, cards, and fantasy exploration. Lead a modern army through a portal, scout unknown lands, build mines and radar, repel counterattacks, hold your outposts, and extract before the world’s attention overwhelms you.

details.title: Cardcraft
details.short_description: Make the card you wish you had. Choose its cost, stats and skills, build a 30-card deck, and test your combinations against AI or in online PvP. Explore the five-act Endless Workshop and share your cards and decks on Steam Workshop. No card packs required.

details.title: The Eye of Vala
details.short_description: Colonel Moorehead disappeared without a trace while searching for what he called “The Eye of Vala.” His desperate family hires MacNaughton, a treasure hunter, to look for clues to his whereabouts. The search for Moorehead will soon become a much greater challenge.

details.title: Dust
details.short_description: DUST is an online survival shooter. Gather, build and lock down your base, then raid your enemies with C4, RPGs and a rocket launch site. Talk with proximity voice, fight in x1000 and Battle Royale, survive the infected. Everything you build can be lost.

details.title: 政通人和
details.short_description: "Peace and Prosperity" is a independently developed ink-wash style historical strategy game set in an alternate pre-Qin period of China. Starting from a small village of just a few hundred people, and conquer all sides to gradually build their own vassal state with millions of people.

name: 八長調といにしえの楽譜

details.title: 八長調といにしえの楽譜
details.short_description: Shirabe Hatcho and Ancient Music Score is a puzzle-solving ADV game where you solve the puzzles by ear. Listen to audio, read music, and play an instrument. Use your sense of pitch to solve the mystery and prevent the phantom thief from committing his crimes as a member of the detective agency.

details.title: The Last Shot: Underworld
details.short_description: The Last Shot: Underworld casts players in the role of an aging scientist who, by a sinister twist of fate, finds himself deep in the dungeons of Metropolis. Build, explore and survive!

details.title: Tom Lander: The Exiled King
details.short_description: Pilot wacky aerial vehicles with silly key-based controls through an epic action packed campaign. Struggle to stay airborne while performing deliveries, rescues, firefighting missions, bombing runs, and chaotic dogfights. This game will remind you that flying is hard, but landing is harder.

details.title: HaCo
details.short_description: "Deliver or Destroy? The choice is yours!" High-speed jet action meets heist mechanics in this up to 4-player online co-op. Pilot rusty robots, master the inertia, and dodge missiles to steal packages. Can you meet the quota before time runs out?

details.title: Typeoids
details.short_description: Wield your keyboard and destroy incoming asteroids by typing their words before they crush you. Typeoids is a fast arcade-style typing game inspired by Asteroids to sharpen your typing skill and mental focus with different game modes.

details.title: Supernatural Haven
details.short_description: 1 or 4-player online co-op horror survival game featuring supernatural entity capture and search-fight-retreat gameplay loops.

details.title: Checkpoint '38
details.short_description: You're a German border guard in 1938. Check passports, catch forged papers, and decide who crosses as the rules tighten. Then go home and face your family. Your job is to obey. Your conscience says otherwise. Free demo on Steam.

details.title: Mine Climbers
details.short_description: Mine Climbers is a vertical platformer where you'll be dashing and jumping your way out of a collapsing mineshaft while avoiding the falling rubble. An unlikely mix of falling block puzzle gameplay and traditional platforming.

details.title: Slotlander
details.short_description: A short incremental game about a gambling addict whose trip to rehab goes wrong. After a plane crash, you wake up alone on a tropical island with a broken slot machine on the beach. One wish brings it to life. Spins are free. No penalties. No one telling you to stop.

details.title: KADI: Ottoman Judge
details.short_description: You are a kadı in 1300s Ottoman Empire. Judge cases rooted in real history across ten provinces, from Gemlik to Damascus. Grow wise through knowledge or fall to bribery the balance is yours. Marry, raise a child, and choose between conscience and a never-ending purse. Every ruling shapes your fate.

details.title: The Gauntlet
details.short_description: Fight a diverse cast of characters each harder than the last! A boss rush game where you face many bosses back to back until you beat them all. Will you survive The Gauntlet?

name: Alone After Dark: A Short Drive

details.title: Alone After Dark: A Short Drive
details.short_description: Experience the chilling solitude of a nighttime drive through the woods. You are not the only person—or thing—on the road tonight. Drive carefully and try to stay calm behind the wheel. Can you make it to the sunrise?

details.title: Bullet Time Agent
details.short_description: Bullet Time Agent is a sci-fi action-adventure bullet hell. Slow time and dodge storms of bullets as you punch your way through robot-filled arenas. Leap past laser obstacles with super-powered jumps. Take down increasingly intense bosses as you rewind your own death...again.

details.title: DETRUST
details.short_description: DETRUST is an online co-op game for up to 12 players, built on teamwork and betrayal. You’ve been sent to repair a damaged facility before the scheduled decontamination begins. Complete tasks, stay alert, and try to escape alive… before one of you tries to kill the entire crew.

details.title: Pumpkin Is Yummy!?
details.short_description: Your own little farm village, tucked into the corner of your desktop. Raise a chatty pumpkin, tend your crops, and collect critters in this quirky, lighthearted idler. How you raise your Pumpkin decides who they become.

details.title: Kiosk 199X
details.short_description: Run a tiny 90s kiosk in a chaotic Eastern country - Kolkhozland. Serve quirky customers, survive inspections, pick a side in a local power struggle, and uncover a hidden conspiracy - all in a story-driven retro management sim full of humor and choices.

details.title: Gothic Steel
details.short_description: Gothic Steel is a grimdark, retro, survivor-like, wave shooter. Command a heavily armed tank against the horde, assemble your crew, and forge an unstoppable war machine.

details.title: LOVEKO
details.short_description: Aha… so you want to know what real love is, huh? Then maybe… try this RPG.

details.title: The Interpreter
details.short_description: You are The Interpreter. Use voice recognition to interogate suspects and find out if they have been tainted. Explore the dystopian world of B26, controlling technology with your voice. Be the judge, jury and executioner.

details.title: Unheenged
details.short_description: Unheenged is a cooperative horror extraction game for you and up to 3 friends. featuring proximity voice chat, scary monsters, multiple items and doors... Lots of doors.

details.title: Plant Game
details.short_description: Run-based plant survival and growth game about learning the world through imperfect senses. Grow leaves, roots, and resilience, unlock biological “sensors” as UI progression, and earn your reveal when you bloom or die.

details.title: Birds of Ascent
details.short_description: Birds of Ascent is a hand-drawn pixel-art 2D flight action adventure starring a flock of birds. Soar through the skies, explore the cavern, and fight your way back to the surface!

details.title: Cascadral
details.short_description: Cascadral is a Solitaire Roguelike about offering clever card combinations to demonic spirits. Bend the rules, build game-breaking combos and discover powerful synergies across more than 200 unique cards and abilities. Can you escape this demonic castle?

details.title: Rotoball
details.short_description: Rotoball is a challenging mouse-controlled action pinball game with a moving paddle and twin flippers. Rotate between four pinball tables, collect resources, complete orders and trigger weapons against waves of alien pests.

details.title: BERG
details.short_description: Experience the danger and beauty of high-altitude mountaineering. Climb towering peaks, survive extreme conditions, and reach the summit together.

details.title: STEEL WING: WEAVEBREAKER
details.short_description: In 2091, the military AI Weave has taken the skies. Three pilots fight on three lanes at once — and back aboard the carrier, they share the hours away from the battlefield with you. Every word you say quietly changes where you stand with them.

details.title: Dungeon Architect: Idle
details.short_description: Build a dungeon that works for you. Combine traps and monsters, crush waves of heroes, and turn their gold and souls into ever more powerful upgrades. An incremental idle game about automation, synergies, and just one more upgrade.

details.title: Skyvar Idle
details.short_description: An online idle RPG among floating sky islands. Sail your airship between the Sundered Isles, gather and craft while you're away, and let automated combat carry you through dungeons with friends. Build a guild island, trade in player-run halls and take down world bosses together.

name: She's Coming Over & My Place is a Dump!

details.title: She's Coming Over & My Place is a Dump!
details.short_description: The crush of your dreams is coming over tonight, but your apartment is an absolute dump! Clean up the mess, wash the dishes, and organize every room in this cozy - first-person cleaning simulator. Turn your chaotic mess into a welcoming home before she arrives!

name: Minato Shokudo: Mirage of the Great Clam

details.title: Minato Shokudo: Mirage of the Great Clam
details.short_description: A cozy Japanese cooking game where you play a ghost with a diner to run and no sense of taste. So you cook everything by the book. Then you row the food across the harbor while it's hot. All 50 dishes come with a real recipe to try at home. One foggy night, the lighthouse goes dark.

details.title: Up the Great Oak
details.short_description: Pip, a tiny beetle in an acorn cap, climbs a giant oak to see the world. Every landing is a balancing act — center of gravity always wins.

details.title: Still Not Dead Yet
details.short_description: 'Still Not Dead Yet' is a suspenseful horror-thriller text story inspired by H. P. Lovecraft. In a dark mausoleum, a grieving professor performs an archaic ritual to resurrect his recently deceased wife. The ritual succeeds, setting him down an unforeseen path.

details.title: Globus: Geography Quiz
details.short_description: Explore the world on an interactive 3D globe and test your geography knowledge across countries, capitals, flags, landmarks, mountains, rivers, seas and more. Play in TYPE, SELECT, GUESS or HINT modes and improve your skills round by round.

details.title: Attrition
details.short_description: A real-time strategy game of tanks, subs, jets and infantry at war across land, sea and air. Command thousands of units, fight up to 10 players or AI commanders, and build your own units, maps and factions with the same editors the game was made with.

details.title: Do A Kickflip
details.short_description: Skate an endless city that builds itself as you ride. Flip, grab and grind across three lanes of street, chain tricks into huge combos, and ride from sunset into midnight. One more run is always one kickflip away.

details.title: Vestige
details.short_description: Vestige is a fast-paced action roguelite built for solo and co-op play. Pick your class, craft absurdly powerful builds, chase game-changing loot, and survive increasingly brutal trials. **Get stronger. Break the game. Push further.

details.title: WannaRich
details.short_description: WannaRich is a 2D farming, management, and adventure game. Start with nothing, grow crops, craft tools, battle monsters, and build your fortune. Play solo or with friends, and turn a wild island into your own empire. Can you earn your first 1,000,000 gold?

details.title: Auriga
details.short_description: In 1988 the rover AURIGA found something on Mars, and the program buried it. 350 years later, it wakes. Drive a slow, physical rover across procedurally generated worlds: drill, scan, map caves with lidar and outlast radiation, storms and crushing air, from green-phosphor Mars to distant stars.

details.title: On Paper
details.short_description: Dig through mountains of shredded paper in this cute detective puzzle adventure. Sort scraps with Fedo Chan, snap documents together, uncover ridiculous evidence, and upgrade your tools to expose a shady cat businessman. Some secrets are only obvious On Paper.

details.title: My Nail Salon
details.short_description: Create cute manicures in a colourful nail-art salon. Paint and layer polish, blend ombré, shape magnetic shimmer, and add stickers, charms and rings. Experiment in Free Play or recreate your customers’ inspiration photos in Open Store.

details.title: ICE TO MEET YOU
details.short_description: Prepare your courtyard, build snow defenses, and survive a chaotic New Year's Eve snow war! Gather snow, craft snowballs, complete ridiculous errands, and fight off rival neighborhoods solo or with friends.

details.title: Brackets & Banners
details.short_description: Build your college basketball legacy. Recruit players, shape your roster, and chase tournament runs in a fictional coaching career sim. Make the calls yourself or delegate to your staff as each season adds new players, stories, and banners to your program's history.

details.title: 人生档案：千禧
details.short_description: Return to 2000 with your memories of the future. In this business-life sandbox spanning 2000–2025, act on your knowledge of the era: invest, start a company or negotiate a stake in someone else’s. Then decide what that money is for. A bigger business? A different life?

details.title: Hairpin Legends
details.short_description: Hairpin Legends is a tabletop slot racing game where every millimetre matters. Master one-button driving, stay in the slot, push your car to the limit, race across varied circuits, build your own tracks, compete in tournaments, and challenge friends online.

details.title: BombCase
details.short_description: Two agents. One table. A row of briefcases - and one of them is a bomb. Listen, scan, bluff and sabotage your way through a 24-mission Cold War campaign of turn-based deduction, then take the seat against a real opponent online. Open the wrong case and it's over.

details.title: Coral Pastoral
details.short_description: This is a desktop companion game set in the ocean, featuring small fish and sea deities from various civilizations. It combines idle gameplay with light card and incremental mechanics. Use coral skills to create your own beautiful underwater world. By the way, the ocean deities will protect you!

details.title: Last Ward
details.short_description: A top-down horde survivor. Choose from nine classes, push out of the Ward into corrupted wilds, borrow attacks from other classes, then return to the Refuge to rebuild your gear and talents.

details.title: Night Class
details.short_description: Escape Night Class by exploring the school and solving puzzles without getting caught by the horror of an evil presence.

details.title: Arclore
details.short_description: Steel and sorcery. Fists and inner energy. Arclore is a 2D pixel-art fantasy beat 'em up RPG built around aerial juggles and wall combos. Choose and upgrade two skills, then fight through branching stages solo or in local 2-player co-op.

details.title: The Turing Choice
details.short_description: Can an AI create a video game and star in it at the same time? The Turing Choice is a sci-fi conversational adventure where your choices change everything. Evaluate K.A.I.R.O.S., an AI that claims to be a SASS, and uncover what is really happening, because nothing is what it seems.

details.title: D for Defender
details.short_description: A Tower Defense with no respite, no waves, no end. Facing monsters that learn from your placements and adapt in real time to every one of your weaknesses, build and upgrade your defenses freely to create the perfect trap.

details.title: Cleanup Wizard
details.short_description: You, a wizard with a mop, fight against computer viruses to save the world! An incremental about cleaning up and collecting viruses to upgrade your mystic abilities to purge the world of this virus once and for all.

details.title: Demon Crisis
details.short_description: A fast, ridiculous On-Rails Arcade Shooter about two government employees fighting through a demon-infested office. Play Solo or in Two-Player Co-Op using a mouse, controller, or any modern USB Lightgun.

details.title: Warwake
details.short_description: Take the helm of a WWII battleship in this naval combat game as you steer, manage your speed, and lay your main guns by hand, fighting ship-to-ship duels where turning broadside triples your guns and doubles the target you present.

details.title: PixelPainter 95
details.short_description: Fill the canvas. Then fill a bigger one. An incremental paint game on a 1995 desktop, from a single page toward a billion tiles. Widen your brush, hire painters that work while you are away, and print each page into a stronger start.

details.title: Qrack
details.short_description: Qruack turns your desktop into a relaxing duck pond. Work, meet, or space out while your new companions hang out at the bottom of your screen. over 60 ducks will keep you company either way.

details.title: Arithmeria
details.short_description: Arithmeria is a non-violent RPG for kids that replaces traditional combat with arithmetic questions and realm restoration. Enjoy a full adventure campaign followed by a robust endgame built for grinding and farming!

details.title: Move The Freak Out!
details.short_description: In Move The Freak Out. You are a contracted mover who specializes in haunted homes. Your job is to move furniture out of homes that are claimed to be haunted by the people who left in a hurry! Get in, get out, and don't die in.... Move The Freak Out!

details.title: In Between
details.short_description: Three stories. An emotional game about the stories we live in between certain chapters of our lives and the chance to make new choices, reliving those moments.

details.title: Too Deep To Stop
details.short_description: Break dirt, drop treasure, and blow up whatever gets in the way. Too Deep To Stop is a physics-based incremental mining clicker where each haul pays for stronger hits, stranger tools, and a bigger mess on the next run.

details.title: Unreported Shift
details.short_description: Psychological indie-horror, simulation. In the 1990s, a small Balkan border town hides dangerous secrets. When Agent Bogomir is assigned to the checkpoint, he becomes an unwilling witness to the town’s darkest mysteries - and must uncover the monster behind the evil living within it.

details.title: Decksplorer
details.short_description: Decksplorer is a lite puzzle adventure where you explore dangerous decks, find unique items, manage limited energy, and complete contracts. Choose one of four classes and conquer tougher challenges.

details.title: TideBox
details.short_description: TideBox is a 2D physics sandbox where you can mess around with liquids and see what happens. Build stuff, dig tunnels, make rivers, flood entire areas, mix things together, or just dump a ton of liquid somewhere and watch the chaos unfold.

details.title: Mossu
details.short_description: Mossu is a botanical cubesat terrarium floating through the real solar system, with you and your friends as it's caretakers! Hands on plant growth, cubesat construction and exploration in your shared, persistent craft. Go from Earth orbit to the Martian surface!

details.title: Pencil Shavings Soup
details.short_description: Pencil Shavings Soup is an incremental about running an underground factory that makes soup from pencil shavings! Collect, sharpen and upgrade your way to becoming the richest critter ever!

details.title: ねこっとラーメン
details.short_description: 異世界に転生したあなたが得たスキルは「カップラーメンを出す」！？猫の獣人たちが暮らす世界で出会った女の子・ユズと、成り行きで始めたお店を営業する調理シミュレーション。注文に合う商品を選び、かやくやスープを入れ、お湯の量と待ち時間を見極めて一杯を仕上げましょう。複数のお客さんを同時に迎え、それぞれの調理時間と待ち時間を管理。日ごとに変わる注文傾向や制限を乗り越えた先で、物語は複数の結末へ分岐します。

details.title: Keep The Circle Alive
details.short_description: An incremental game about protecting a tiny circle. Destroy endless waves of enemies, earn resources, stack upgrades, watch the numbers climb, and turn your circle into an unstoppable machine.

details.title: Mow The Planet
details.short_description: Start on Mum's back lawn and keep going: the street, the city, the planet, then the Moon, Mars and every world after that. Mow ground that stays mowed, bolt ridiculous kits onto one growing machine, and run a mowing company big enough to stripe the solar system.

details.title: Re+pray Signals: Echoes Still Wait
details.short_description: You are the only one connected to a child trapped in a closed-off world. Speaking becomes the key; listening becomes hope. A conversational adventure where the words you exchange help unravel its mysteries. #RepraySignals

details.title: ASCENDANT
details.short_description: High stakes, high chaos, and the most unpredictable twist on capture-the-flag yet. Outwit ruthless opponents, face mutant wildlife, and secure four biocores in this fast-paced FPS where wild events can turn the tables in an ever-shifting BioPunk arena. This is ASCENDANT - bring backup.

details.title: Evil Dreams
details.short_description: Travel through nightmares until you go insane. Evil Dreams is a dark adventure, telling the story of a boy living in the 19th century and forced to face ancient evil. Delve into the world of dreams to find out the truth.

details.title: Hidden Streets
details.short_description: Find cats and hidden objects in illustrated streets full of detail.

details.title: BLIGHTEN
details.short_description: BLIGHTEN is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

details.title: 夏飢聲（なきごえ）
details.short_description: A first-person horror adventure game featuring a side story (spin-off) scenario based on “Kyoso Musebiya” by “Obaken.” Guided to Musebiya, the protagonist ventures into a mysterious underground space. What choices will they make, and what fate awaits them…?

details.title: Fantasy Mountains
details.short_description: Paper Mountain is the first chapter in Fantasy Mountains. A casual, friendly, single‑player VR climbing game. Enter a fantasy paper world. Meet and interact with the mountain creatures along the path. Collect useful and less useful items. Find your way to the mountaintop.

details.title: Tyrants Must Fall
details.short_description: In this turn-based tactical roguelike, build an army to triumph in fast-paced battles. Deploy your troops, plan your attack, and watch as the action plays out simultaneously. Unlock powerful formations and guide the Hero of Destiny as he topples the Tyrant King!

details.title: Basement Server Simulator
details.short_description: Build a basement hosting empire solo or in co-op. Buy and place servers, install server apps, set your prices, accept time-limited customer contracts, and balance power, internet, heat, and hardware failures as you expand your operation.

details.title: Sunny Hollow
details.short_description: Move to a magical city to live with your grandmother and make it your home.
