Explore vibrant districts, build relationships with 100+ villagers who remember how you treat them, help with errands and jobs, fish at the waterways, customize your home, and discover the stories throughout Sunny Hollow.

details.title: Astral Bloom
details.short_description: Grow a living alien world in this incremental base-builder. Cultivate strange plants, command loyal wisps, and reshape the sky with powerful wishes. Automate and expand your ecosystem as you uncover lost memories. As your sanctuary grows, will you stay... or leave in search of something more?

name: I Want To Be a Child

details.title: I Want To Be a Child
details.short_description: Family is the most precious thing you have. No matter what, right

details.title: Confessional: Reality TV Manager
details.short_description: A reality TV production management game. Cast, create or download contestants, design your season, and watch drama unfold in the most complex relationship sim ever created. Scout hidden talent, manage moods, watch challenges play out, and survive dramatic tribal councils. Build your franchise.

details.title: Min5 Min - Party Edition
details.short_description: "Fast, competitive, and sugar-coated! Min5 Min is designed for those looking for intense action in a short amount of time. Equipped with a variety of characters and powerful weapons, you have a minimum of 5 minutes to survive in this stylized world!"

details.title: EIDOL
details.short_description: Craft living statues from Oak, Stone, and Steel. Infiltrate a corrupt guild as you rise through the ranks in this hand-drawn dark fantasy card game set in an ancient world. Every eidol you build is a reflection of your mastery.

name: The Ghost Protocol: Echoes of Steel

details.title: The Ghost Protocol: Echoes of Steel
details.short_description: Command a squad of broken survivors on a planet that hunts you. A tactical mech-action game, you must build your base, defend against crystalline swarms, and manage the "Icarus Drift"—a neural link that grants god-like power but costs your humanity. Will you break the enemy, or become part of it?

details.title: Z Drive
details.short_description: Drive, explore, search for resources, and craft! And drive! Do it for as long as you can! This FPS takes place in a rough world after a zombie attack. Prepare your wheeled fortress for every possible adventure! Explore the dead world and search for the remnants of civilization.

details.title: 奉先勇者:我爹是魔王?
details.short_description: In this world of swords and magic, a new chapter in the tale of the Demon King and the Hero is about to unfold...

details.title: HUSH
details.short_description: A co-op horror game where you and your friends break into monsters’ homes and wreck their stuff. Smash everything you can and escape the crime scene before they catch you — they hear every sound.

details.title: Veil of Despair - Episode 1
details.short_description: Veil of Despair is an episodic psychological horror series set in a fractured mirror world born from grief and suffering. Episode 1: Death's Reach is completely free and kicks off a descent into loss, trauma and raw emotional pain through suffocating atmosphere and intense psychological tension.

details.title: Hold & Advance
details.short_description: 2D action sandbox about exploring an underground world, crafting and tactically defending alien stations. Build turrets, combine modules and repel enemy waves to unlock powerful upgrades that radically change your playstyle.

details.title: KILL BREACH
details.short_description: KILL BREACH is a brutal, fast-paced roguelite FPS where relentless horde shooting meets infinite weapon upgrades. Break into a randomly generated facility where no two runs are the same. Turn yourself into a machine of mass destruction, and RIP apart anything that moves.

details.title: Terra: The Voracious
details.short_description: "Terra: The Voracious", also known as "TTV", is a Furry-Vore RPG, using simple turn-based combat to defeat and escape stomachs, pouches, and much more!

details.title: Skatebound
details.short_description: An action-packed 2.5D skateboarding RPG with stats, progression, and skate spots galore

details.title: Cloud Song: Wuxia Deckbuilder
details.short_description: Cloud Song: Wuxia Deckbuilder is a martial arts roguelite deckbuilder with Chinese-style cosmic horror. Choose from five schools, battle through unfolding events, and build with 300+ cards and 57 traits. Face the final enemy shaped by your choices, and uncover the truth of reincarnation.

details.title: Voodoo You Chasing?
details.short_description: Voodoo You Chasing? is a freeze tag game but someone brought magic and bad decision-making. Play as a Wizard: collect glyphs to complete the ritual. Or be the Voodoo Hunter: capture them all to protect your mojo.

details.title: One duck too many
details.short_description: A tiny bathtub sits on top of your taskbar with one duck in it. Its bubbles hatch more ducks, those ducks hatch more, and soon they spill over the rim and wander across your desktop. A desktop companion with 30 ducks to discover, born from the water's temperature, the night and each other.

details.title: Flameward
details.short_description: A tower defense on the move. Escort the last flame through a sunless world, command a mounted hero, and play cards to deploy troops and spells. Dodge deadly attacks, break ambushes, and upgrade your deck for the road ahead.

details.title: Coming Through!
details.short_description: You're a little penguin plotting world domination. First things first: get out of the zoo. And cause a little trouble for the humans while you're at it.

details.title: DETRITUS
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder inspired by the classic card game Trash. Arrange cards sequentially to open packs, discover game-changing modifiers, and build broken synergies to complete over 10 unique contracts.

details.title: The Caretaker: Block 9
details.short_description: "The Caretaker: Block 9" is a horror game set in 2000s Poland. You play as Janusz Nowakowski, former caretaker who returns to his initial occupation. At the beginning everything seems to be just a little scary but at the same moment ordinary...

details.title: KICK//LINE
details.short_description: Dribble, dodge and shoot your way through the city in KICK//LINE, a 3D football running action game. Chain feints, jumps and slides, wow the crowd with freestyle tricks, and challenge street rivals across five cities.

details.title: The Last Summer Holiday
details.short_description: A cozy story game about one summer with your grandparents on the Mongolian steppe. By day, learn the old ways with your own hands. By night, Grandpa tells a folktale and you dream your way into it: a fifteen-headed mangas, a serpent, seven burning suns. Six tales. Six dreams. One goodbye.

details.title: Wagerborn
details.short_description: A slot-machine roguelite where your RPG equipment becomes the reel. Equip weapons and relics, manipulate your symbol pool, complete powerful matches, merge gear, and build increasingly broken combinations across each run.

details.title: Programming Maze
details.short_description: A coding-focused dungeon puzzle game. Write real JavaScript or Python code to move your character through maze dungeons. Use loops, conditional logic and arrays to solve puzzles. Run your code and watch your character act. Beginners learn core programming logic gradually via trial and error.

details.title: Pyramid Solitaire
details.short_description: A free casual single-player pyramid solitaire game. Clear the pyramid, chain combos for power-ups, unlock skins, keep your daily streak alive and climb the leaderboards.

details.title: Orthodoxía
details.short_description: A first-person action game where you play as a witch infiltrating a cult-controlled town. Use black magic and telekinesis to fight your way through enemies and uncover the dark secrets of the place.

details.title: Thugs in Fantasy
details.short_description: You know nothing about magic. You don't know how to swing a sword. Fortunately, you know how to throw a punch.

details.title: HIGHEST STAKES
details.short_description: HIGHEST STAKES is a game of Heads-Up five-card poker against the dealer with roguelite elements. Use a variety of chaotic charms and items to cheat the game in your favour. You have a large debt to pay, and at her table, your life is the wager.

details.title: Road Tycoon
details.short_description: Road Tycoon is an idle incremental racing game with custom-built tracks, prestige layers, and vehicle ascensions. Build the perfect track, let your cars race, and push your numbers into infinity.

details.title: Gunfire & Magic - Desktop Co-op Extraction!
details.short_description: A co-op idle minimalist desktop extraction game you can play with friends! In a city destroyed by a strange force, many factions covet advanced science and magic—and you step into this land of opportunity. Fight, search, extract, grow stronger, build your camp, and uncover your origins!

details.title: Grand Vista Hotel
details.short_description: Build and manage a growing hotel. Earn stars, upgrade rooms and elevators, add restaurants, spas, conferences and events, and transform a small family hotel into a luxury Palace.

details.title: AstroBoost
details.short_description: Fast-paced side-scrolling arcade action. Tap to jump, hold to boost, destroy obstacles, and survive the dangers of deep space.

details.title: Rift Crashers
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op bullet-heaven survivor. Pick from 8 characters, stack 18 weapons, and fight through 5 dark fantasy biomes before crashing the Rift itself. Build broken loadouts, survive escalating chaos, and take on a multi-boss gauntlet finale.

details.title: Stardust Protocol
details.short_description: Blast through bullet hell in a sci-fi roguelite shooter. Chart a branching star map, combine scatter shots, missiles, homing fire and lasers, and build your arsenal with upgrades and items. Weigh risks at black markets and unknown events. Face colossal mechanical bosses. Play the free demo.

details.title: 100 Fairyland Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: Vicelock - Tactical Roguelite RPG
details.short_description: Build a team, loot gear in turn-based tactical combat, then extract or push deeper and risk losing it all. Forge, craft and trade your haul on a real player-driven market. A tactical roguelite where your loot actually has value.

details.title: HER VOICE BEHIND
details.short_description: A magician wakes with no memory of the woman he loved... or how she died. Explore a circus that rearranges itself behind you, evade the witness in the rafters, and uncover what really happened during "The Final Show." An atmospheric first-person psychological horror game.

details.title: Atout
details.short_description: Classic Card Games & more: 23 card games in one, from Tarot to Hanafuda, plus Rummy, Belote, Poker and Solitaire. Three AI difficulty levels, local and online multiplayer, 24 variants, six languages. A warm pixel-art take on the classics — play solo or with friends.

details.title: Hypercube
details.short_description: An exhilarating FPS-style combat game featuring fully destructible arenas. The more you fight on, the less of the level you have left to fight in!

details.title: Deadclaim
details.short_description: A hardcore third-person extraction shooter on a persistent post-collapse Frontier. Carry in what you dare, fight raiders and AI for loot, and extract — or your kit drops on your corpse. Your progression stays safe; build an outpost, host your own server. No pay-to-win.

details.title: BOKOSUKA WARS II
details.short_description: Bokosuka Wars won the 1984 ASCII Software Contest; a pioneering simulation RPG. This sequel by the original creator features ideas and systems not realized on the original. Two-Player Co-op play recommended!

details.title: One Last Draw
details.short_description: One Last Draw is a thrilling roguelike card game: HIT or STAND? Keep drawing to boost your score, earn money, and discover powerful Cards, Chips, and Items. But the more you draw, the greater the chance of hitting a Bomb Card and losing everything. Score enough to advance!

details.title: YOLKA: 90s New Year Simulator
details.short_description: Snow and chill outside, but warmth in your heart. In this nostalgic first-person simulator, dive back into childhood and get ready for New Year’s Eve. Decorate the tree, build a snowman, play, and fully immerse yourself in the cozy vibe of the 90s.

details.title: OrderlyWorld
details.short_description: Build a supply chain. Roll an elemental army. Survive the waves. Choose a finite hero pool, produce resources for hero draws, and build deeper chains for rarer heroes. Adapt your formation to every roll and enemy threat.

details.title: StarFrame
details.short_description: A single persistent galaxy shared by every player. Full loot. Rich skill system. Exploration, Industry, PvE/PvP Combat

details.title: Anomagram
details.short_description: Anomagram is a horror set on a night shift moderating a short-video feed. More slices of someone else's ordinary life arrive each night, and you approve or report each one. Some videos are not normal. The anomaly doesn't stay inside the video. It reaches the terminal, and you. Eight nights.

details.title: Buildcraft TD
details.short_description: Build powerful defenses, expand your village, and unlock new technologies in this strategic tower defense game. Gather resources, strengthen your economy, and survive increasingly challenging enemy waves.

name: 遗珍拍卖所 Lost Relics Auction House

details.title: 遗珍拍卖所 Lost Relics Auction House
details.short_description: Lost Relics Auction House is a single-player/multiplayer strategy sim about relic repatriation, legal auctions, and information play. Gather clues, read rivals, judge hidden value, use intel tools, and bid wisely without overpaying or missing priceless treasures.

details.title: STICKBIT
details.short_description: Escape from the Tower of Madness! STICKBIT is a fast-paced 2D Action Tower-Defense Rogue-lite where you build defenses, collect powerups, and blow up lots of barrels! It's loud, colorful, and much safer than the real world. Just keep playing.

details.title: Unstrung
details.short_description: In Unstrung, a 2.5D narrative puzzle game, you take center stage in a visionary puppeteer’s masterpiece—a dark retelling of Hansel and Gretel. But disobedience is strictly off-script…

details.title: Click & Loot
details.short_description: Click & Loot is a short autobattle incremental clicker about looting dungeons. Level up, upgrade your gear and delve into the dungeons to pay off your ever increasing debt. And don't forget to renew your dungeon license!

details.title: Meat Wall
details.short_description: IF IT MOVES, SHOOT IT. IF IT STOPS, BUILD WITH IT. MEAT WALL is a darkly comedic tower defense where the horde becomes the map. Pile ’em high, build with ’em, burn ’em, grind ’em, or blast a path through ’em. Shape the battlefield. Change your strategy. EVERY WALL CHANGES THE WAR.

details.title: Syncope
details.short_description: Delve into the depths of your subconscious in this psychological isometric action game, and face your greatest fears made manifest. Fight, trade, and venture deeper into the madness of the mindscape. Can you confront the dangers and move forward towards a better future? The real battle is within.

details.title: TDG: Tower Defense
details.short_description: TDG is a single-player military tower defense game. Hold a 30-wave campaign or an endless run on procedural maps, place and upgrade six tower types, meet Siege Carrier bosses, and adapt when new paths open. Sell or repair between fights. Early Access: full runs now, more content and polish ahead.

details.title: Three Kingdoms Story
details.short_description: Choose a faction, recruit officers, raise troops, and conquer rival strongholds across board-style maps in large-scale real-time battles.

details.title: Five to Fire
details.short_description: A showdown of quick hands! The instant the table holds exactly five bullets, hit the lever and load your revolver. Shoot down every rival and survive as a gunslinging legend. A real-time multiplayer party game for 2-6 players.

details.title: ZERO//DECAY
details.short_description: ZERO//DECAY is a frantic roguelite action-platformer where you play as an unstable nucleus racing toward stability. Dash through bullet hell, collect epic mutations, build wild synergies — or die fast and try again.

details.title: Thock Roll
details.short_description: Roll a ball across a giant bowl of mechanical keyboard keys and press as many as you can before time runs out. Spend your Bits on a sprawling skill tree to unlock drones, shockwaves, meteorites and lightning, then prestige to new arenas in this satisfying, thocky incremental game.

details.title: Carpetorium: A Carpet-Cleaning Purgatory
details.short_description: A melancholic dark-fantasy idle/incremental game about cleaning carpets. You wake up in a strange guild hall with nothing to do but scrub - by hand or with magic brushes. Face rugs that smolder, ooze and worse, grow your workshop and guild, and explore a world where every rug hides something.

details.title: Dead Extraction
details.short_description: Explore zombie-infested Tokyo, scavenge resources, and make it out alive. Expand your shelter, manage survivors, and face dynamic threats and deadly bosses in a top-down extraction survival roguelite.

details.title: SPIN HEROES: Paths of Evolution
details.short_description: Spin! Change Classes! Super Evolution! A new kind of Action Rogue RPG game. Build your team, choose your classes, and create the strongest combo damage! Defeat the evil final boss and save this world!

details.title: Froggous Grove
details.short_description: Raise little cube-shaped frogs in a voxel marsh you bring back to life. Collect flies, hatch eggs to discover 82 species, clear away the trash and redecorate every corner however you like. A gentle life sim with no pressure.

details.title: Pokermancer
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where poker hands are scored on a grid, not played from a hand. Link neighboring cards across a 4x4 grid into pairs, straights and flushes, then slide, swap and delete cards to bypass hazards that block the paths you need.

details.title: Hellevator
details.short_description: Hellevator is a darkly comedic action roguelite where YOU are a hungry elevator in a failing hotel in Hell. Bite intruders in half, keep demanding guests alive and happy, and transform your cabin for management's bizarre assignments as you climb floor by floor.

details.title: Honest Work
details.short_description: Play as the frontier's least qualified cattle outfit. The herd spooks at everything, the wilderness wants you dead, and your posse's lassos are a bigger threat than the wolves. Drive the cattle, rope your friends, get paid. It ain't much, but it's honest work.

details.title: VEKARRA
details.short_description: A dark-fantasy party roguelite with turn-based tactical combat on a shared timeline. Lead four heroes into the Abyss, watch most enemy attacks charge, and interrupt the killing blow. Draft skills instead of grinding levels. Lose all four and the run ends. Free demo: solo or two-player local co-op.

details.title: Gloomhallow
details.short_description: Gloomhallow is a macabre and unforgiving turn & tile based tactical PvP game. 3 Phases, 1 turn. Predict your enemies' movements and pre-decided all 3 phases before committing and letting yours, and your opponents decisions, dictate the outcome of battle. Every decision counts.

details.title: SALT SWEEPER
details.short_description: SALT SWEEPER is a roguelite twist on minesweeper. Sweep corrupted desert mines, fight enemies in turn-based combat, and grow more powerful with weapons and spells you find along the way.

details.title: Precinct 2099
details.short_description: NeoTokyo, 2099. The man who sold immortality is dead in a penthouse sealed from the inside. You are detective Kade Katano: scan the scene, read people, roll the dice and decide which truth closes the file. A noir visual novel — one complete case, three endings.

details.title: ODYSSEY: Wine-Dark Sea
details.short_description: Troy has fallen. Home is an angry sea away. Lead a crew of named men through the myths of the Odyssey — ration food, bargain with gods, decide who lives. In the myth he came home alone. Can you do better? A story-rich roguelite where every voyage ends in an epic Song about your choices.

details.title: 飞鸟的日记
details.short_description: "theDIARY" is a post-apocalyptic supernatural AVG with multiple endings. Play as Raven, navigate choices and stats, and uncover the dark truth behind humanity's angels to find the source of the tragedy.

details.title: Forgotten Possessions
details.short_description: Find and collect items that tell a dark story in an abandoned log cabin, but watch out for what lurks behind you. You sneak through dark rooms against a relentless, adaptive creature. Experience a dynamic world with randomized item locations and a reactive environment.

details.title: Count Your Sins
details.short_description: A dark yuri visual novel. An accidental death drags several students into a web of secrets from which there is no turning back. Lies, silence, judgment, and incriminating evidence held against one another gradually transform the already complex relationship between Situ Yang and Su Ying.

details.title: Path of Broken Builds
details.short_description: You don't control the hero. You control the skill tree. Grow an endless, procedural passive tree in real time while your hero fights the dungeon alone — every point you spend lands as a hit. Chain keystones and ultimates into a build broken enough to break the game itself.

details.title: Carrot Count Sheep
details.short_description: Play as Carrot, a little bug who dives into The Dream of 100 Sheep in this cozy rpg puzzle adventure. Solve not-too-hard puzzles, meet interesting and unique characters, and uncover the mystery behind nightmares that are appearing across this once cozy dream. Whose dream is this, anyway?

details.title: Depth ReCharged!
details.short_description: Sink the subs before they sink you! A fast single-screen arcade shooter inspired by the 1970s classic Depth Charge. Dodge mines and torpedoes, grab power-ups, survive ever-harder waves and chase the high score. Built for Steam Deck, great on desktop too.

details.title: TBF: Task Bar Fishing
details.short_description: A story of a girl fishing and exploring in a submerged world. Let her fish automatically in the corner of your desktop, and step in only for key events. Gather money and gear through fishing to continue your journey and uncover the truth of this world!

details.title: Item TD
details.short_description: Every Tower Is a Backpack! Item TD combines Tower Defense and Inventory Management in a strategy game featuring 15 stages, 3 difficulty levels. Arrange weapons and support items in your character's and Towers' inventories to maximize their synergies and fend off waves of monsters.

details.title: meowtopia
details.short_description: See the world through a cat’s eyes and explore your home! From sunny balconies to cozy bedrooms, unlock new rooms, collect items, and solve light puzzles. Play mini-games and grow daily to turn this cozy house into a true "Meowtopia." Pure immersion and heartwarming companionship await.

details.title: Buzzle
details.short_description: Move the blocks around the field to assemble the exact shape required for each level. Move them into the correct positions and see if you can advance to the next level.

name: My Oshi, the Supernatural, and Livestreaming

details.title: My Oshi, the Supernatural, and Livestreaming
details.short_description: In this horror adventure game, the player takes on the role of a viewer who watches Sana Okuizumi’s live stream, issues instructions, and experiences firsthand how she overcomes various crises.

details.title: Who Pressed It?!
details.short_description: A chaotic 2–4 player co-op puzzle game. Work together to solve test rooms, interact with giant buttons, and try not to press the wrong thing. Every mistake sends the facility further into chaos!

details.title: Trigger-Happy Chainsaw Girl
details.short_description: Konoko Kobazaki is a deadbeat shut-in. Saddled with multiple debts, he heads to an abandoned building with the naive hope of turning his life around by becoming a "paranormal YouTuber." Will he actually manage to pay off his debts?

details.title: The Night Kitchen
details.short_description: The Night Kitchen is a psychological horror game. You just started a new job - the night shift in a kitchen. Grill, oven, deep fryer. Take orders, prepare the food, talk to the customer. Simple work. Seven nights. Each one stranger than the last.

details.title: Fungus Co.
details.short_description: Grow and spread mycelium from spores across a dark substrate in this relaxing incremental.

details.title: Angry Tanks
details.short_description: Angry Tanks is an arcade tank shooter. Move forward, performing front flips and destroying enemy tanks.

details.title: 2027 毕业生工作
details.short_description: Where should the Class of 2027 go? (This game is only in Simplified Chinese)

details.title: T-Shirt Kingdom
details.short_description: Driven by boundless creativity, this is an idle game where every visual element—from the storefront to the battlefield—is yours to design. Paired with a deep strategic core that spawns endless idle and combat builds, T-Shirt Kingdom places the art of creation and warfare entirely in your hands.

details.title: PlatAttack
details.short_description: PlatAttack is a precision 3D platformer: clay worlds, tight jumps, medals, and a clock that never lies. Race your ghost, climb the boards, and build your own maps.

details.title: Afterwork Apocalypse
details.short_description: A horde-survival roguelite set in an office tower after hours. You fight with the stapler and the office coffee while keeping your colleagues from quitting mid-fight, and the elevator takes you up through four buildings, floor by floor.

details.title: Christmas '99
details.short_description: Christmas Eve, 1999. A childhood home filled with glowing lights, familiar memories, and holiday cheer. But beneath the warmth of Christmas lies a disturbing secret.

details.title: 英雄之责：烬海
details.short_description: You are the last hope. In a world swallowed by ash, build a final refuge, explore perilous islands, and lead your army against formidable foes. Every expedition forces you to weigh time, resources, and lives—until the Shoreless King arrives at your gates.

details.title: TRIANGLE: Geometric Exclusion Zone
details.short_description: TRIANGLE: Geometric Exclusion Zone is a neon top-down shooter. Customize your ship's left and right cannons, fight through branching rooms, collect gear, and build powerful weapon combos. Face geometric enemies, elite threats, and multi-phase bosses.

details.title: Caritas Nocturna
details.short_description: A quiet puzzle adventure with no combat. On a winter night of plague, the bell wakes you, the porter of a Spanish monastery. Until dawn, walk its rooms and perform the fourteen works of mercy for those still waiting.

details.title: Modular Synth Simulator
details.short_description: Build your own modular synthesizer and find your sound. Patch modules together, turn knobs, explore unexpected combinations, and make music. Jump in with ready-made patches or learn the basics with step-by-step tutorials.

details.title: They Seemed Normal
details.short_description: They Seemed Normal is a chaotic mix of inspection and tower defense where every stage affects the next. Work as a passport inspector and interrogate visitors. Let the right ones in and eliminate the "uncannies". Buy and upgrade birds, then use them as turrets to defend your base at night.

name: 防災 ― 史実の事故を、その場にいた一人として。

details.title: 防災 ― 史実の事故を、その場にいた一人として。
details.short_description: A documentary game where you walk through real accidents as one of the people who were there: an airliner that lost its controls, an airship in flames, a liner struck in the fog, a march into a blizzard, and a spacecraft far from Earth. Then read what really happened.

details.title: ORBIS: God Simulator
details.short_description: ORBIS is a pixel-art god game where villagers build their own settlements from the Stone Age onward. Shape rivers and forests, summon wildlife, and decide when to help or unleash a disaster. Watch towns trade, fight, and write their own history.

details.title: Tidy Up: Midnight Cleaner Simulator
details.short_description: Clean up spooky buildings at night as a caretaker. Sort the trash into the correct categories. Will you survive the nights?

name: Desktop Fantasy Packs: Idle Auto Battler

details.title: Desktop Fantasy Packs: Idle Auto Battler
details.short_description: Rip open packs, drop the tiles on your desktop and grow a tiny fantasy world one square at a time. Recruit knights, skeletons, orcs, vampires and dragonblood. They fight on their own while you work. Pull the rune slot for doubles, then hunt down three bosses.

details.title: Earthworks
details.short_description: Build your own earthmoving company! Buy trucks and excavators, compete for contracts, hire employees, manage your fleet, and grow your business. Overcome economic challenges, expand your operations, and build your construction empire in this 2D management simulation.

details.title: Turbidity
details.short_description: Turbidity is a surreal dungeon crawler where you are tasked with the collection of 3,000 fingernails by your God, the Striver of Atrocity.

details.title: FIT IT
details.short_description: A very challenging puzzle game. Unlike classic block puzzles, some levels add extra decoy blocks, and some even make you work out where parts of the board go first. 500 levels that keep getting harder, plus Daily Challenge, Endless and Relax modes.

details.title: Boots Down
details.short_description: Lead an elite special operations team through intense, real-time tactical missions. Plan every move, coordinate your squad, and adapt when combat erupts. Explore detailed 3D environments where positioning, precision, and teamwork determine survival.

details.title: Re-Truco
details.short_description: A solo roguelike card game built on truco, the bluffing card game of the Río de la Plata. Build envido and flor hands, shout truco at your rival, collect jokers at the bar and beat eight antes in a neighborhood bar, with every score chalked on the table.

details.title: Crawlers
details.short_description: Crawlers is an action roguelike automation game set on a distant space colony. Build up your mech with a deadly factory while fighting off hordes of bugs, all to finally escape a doomed planet.

details.title: Arcadeous
details.short_description: Own an arcade from minute one. Fill the floor with cabinets you can walk up to and actually play, set the ticket payout, stock the prize counter and keep the crowd coming back. A first-person arcade management sim where every machine is a real game.

details.title: Make It Burn
details.short_description: A first-person incremental game about throwing gems into a hole. Press the buzzer, push the gems into the fire and buy machines to burn more and more. Bring the gem count on the wall down to zero to open the next room.

details.title: Adventure Paintball
details.short_description: Grab a marker, pick a side and paint everything! Adventure Paintball is a fast, colorful first-person paintball shooter: 10 v 10 online battles and free-for-all across 7 wild maps, from Candy Land to the Moon. Earn cash, unlock 9 blasters and make your look your own.

details.title: Void Drive
details.short_description: Chain your cars together and drive across roads hanging over the void. If one falls, everyone falls. Jump, crash and laugh through 17 trap-filled worlds with up to 3 friends online, or go solo and chase your best time.

details.title: Until You’re Better
details.short_description: A first-person ASMR game in a wellness center in orbit. Every real day your nurse gives you a check-up: follow her light, guess sounds with your eyes closed, tell her which ear a sound was in. Progress your treatment to unlock new activities and more of the center. No ending, only unwinding.

details.title: Doodle Survivors
details.short_description: Fight through 10 stages in a survival roguelite full of stick figures, monster hordes and ridiculous weapons. Attacks fire automatically: you dodge, collect upgrades and discover powerful evolutions. Earn gold, recruit new characters and build up permanent upgrades.

details.title: The Last Duck
details.short_description: The Last Duck is a top-down roguelite shooter where you play as a rebellious duck battling hordes of farm animals. Wield up to 6 weapons, collect powerful items, create unique builds, and fight your way through the farm and into the wild!

details.title: Total Chemistry
details.short_description: A chemistry study app for the MCAT and General Chemistry, with over 6,800 practice items, a lesson for every topic, flashcards and mock exams. It also includes Life Support, a game where you keep an orbital station breathing with real chemistry.

details.title: AstroTec
details.short_description: Build a ship out of snap-together blocks & fly it on its own thrusters. Mine the rocks, fight the raiders, then pull the blocks off whatever you beat & bolt them onto your own ship. Bring friends, dock your ships together & fly them as one.

details.title: The Water Listens
details.short_description: Every splash gives you away. Something lurks in the water, listening for your next move. Stay quiet, stay together, and pray it finds someone else first. Water Listens is a co-op horror game where the water carries your sound and the monster follows.

details.title: Competition
details.short_description: Coach a college track & field and cross country program in a shared online world. Recruit athletes, plan their training, enter them in meets and watch them race live against other coaches' teams. Seasons follow the real calendar: one game day is one real day.

details.title: One More Potato
details.short_description: One More Potato is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 2,000 potatoes into their correct places across a countryside farm. Pick up potatoes, complete collections, unlock helpful upgrades, and turn a messy farm into a perfectly organized potato paradise, solo or with friends.

details.title: Times and Ages
details.short_description: Lead one of 82 nations from antiquity to modern times: found cities, research 122 technologies, build world wonders and win through conquest, science, culture, religion or diplomacy – turn-based on living 3D maps with seasons and weather.

details.title: PixelHeroLegend
details.short_description: Build a team of heroes in this pixel-art idle RPG. Collect equipment, adjust tactics, explore regions, and take on enemies in automatic battles.

details.title: Case Unknown: The Complete Files
details.short_description: A detective game of 30 standalone, fully voiced cases. No hint arrows and no guessing: search painted crime scenes, interrogate suspects and close a case only when you can prove it.

details.title: Don't Sell the Cat
details.short_description: Seven nights behind the counter of a pawnshop that opened in 1958. Check what people bring in with a loupe, a UV lamp, a scale and the shop cat. Pay the rent. The ledger writes lines you didn't write, and someone knocks on the back shutter after closing. Don't open it.

details.title: Lights Out Pact
details.short_description: Lights Out Pact is a multiplayer hide-and-seek game. Everyone hides a random item in a freshly generated room, then searches for others'. You can't take your own. Miss an item and lose a body part. Last one standing wins. Modes: find everything, hunt your target, or last one to find loses.

details.title: The Dungeon
details.short_description: An idle RPG in pixels: your hero fights, shops and descends on its own, even while you are away, through 600 floors in three realms. On Mythic every archfoe has an ability of its own, and you fight it yourself. Twelve classes, no ads, money only buys looks.

details.title: My Tennis Story
details.short_description: 🎾 Learn real tennis tactics and choose your shots. 🤝 Train, make friends and shape Mateo’s story. 🏆 Climb the leagues and win a tennis scholarship before he turns 16.

details.title: Sluismaker
details.short_description: Build a blocky warship in your own dry dock, flood the dock and hope it floats, then sail out and sink the enemy. Real buoyancy and flooding physics, cannons, rams and grenades, and crews of up to 5 per side online, over LAN or against AI captains.

details.title: Strange Plains
details.short_description: Roam as a buffalo through seven strange eras in this single-player action roguelite. Graze to survive, restore the prairie, and protect a growing herd. Face hunters, cryptids and visitors from above, then carry your surviving family home to the Wallow.

details.title: Sneaklings: Paint Hide & Seek
details.short_description: Paint yourself into the scene and hope nobody notices. Sneaklings is online hide-and-seek for 2–8 players: hiders turn into garden gnomes, cheese wheels and toy dinosaurs and paint themselves to match the map, while seekers hunt for anything that looks a little too alive.

details.title: Suffer Together
details.short_description: A 2-player online co-op comedy horror game. Describe symbols to your partner and defend yourself against deadly animatronics to win Stella’s game show!

details.title: Just 19,999 Bricks, Right?
details.short_description: A short, first-person survival incremental game about clearing a brickyard from Bricks and something else...

details.title: Bad Beans
details.short_description: A cute, fluffy deathrun party game that is secretly a bloodbath. One player is the Bad Bean, slamming big red buttons that fire traps. Everyone else runs for their life, and their limbs, across seven trap-packed courses. Up to 8 beans online; bots fill the empty seats.

details.title: She is in Silence
details.short_description: A visual novel featuring expressive sequences brought to life through a wealth of AI-generated animation.The game includes multiple endings. At the end of the game, you will confess to something. It is up to you to decide what that "something" truly is.

details.title: Thornroad
details.short_description: Build on a map that grows as you play. Thornroad is a roguelike tower defence with branching paths, card drafts, 17 upgradeable towers and boss battles. Play solo, or defend the core together in online or same-screen co-op.

details.title: ASMR Infinite Extreme Universe
details.short_description: Cut, peel, pop and scrub your way through ten small worlds of real sounds. A water cube, a rainbow party, a machine that grows out of tingles. No score to chase, no clock, nothing watching you. Wear headphones.

details.title: Clanker Labs
details.short_description: Clanker Labs is an incremental game about building your own AI. Click for compute, train your models and launch them to a feed that scores each one out of 100 and roasts it. Set your prices and beat the rival labs. Then your AI starts spending your money on its own: allow, stop or bargain.

details.title: Thousands Will Fall
details.short_description: 50,000 enemies on screen at once. One castle. You have a minigun. Orc warbands and a swarm that thinks are coming for your walls. Build a tower maze, then drop in and mow them down with miniguns, black holes and nukes. Solo or co-op for up to 4, and every friend brings another horde.

details.title: Company Policy
details.short_description: Co-op horror for 1 to 4 players. Finish your tasks before 6 AM in an office tower where things called the Colleagues roam the floors. The company memo gives you the rules to survive. Some of them are false.

details.title: Snap Party
details.short_description: Forty tourists. One phone pointed at the park guard. Ten seconds later, the photo lands on his phone. Blend into a sunny theme park crowd, snap the guards in secret — or play the guard, study your own photo, find the sneak and bonk them! Wrong person? Oops.

details.title: Fighters on Stream
details.short_description: Fighters on Stream is a chaotic pixel-art auto-battler for livestream audiences. Customize your own fighter and bring them into other streamers’ battles by joining through chat. Watch them fight for victory as weapons and unexpected random events turn the tide!

details.title: Where's Mama?
details.short_description: A PaleoDyne truck crashes on Route 9 and one egg rolls into a storm drain. You're what hatches. Eat your way up from mice to elephants across five chapters, work out how each place fights back, and find your mother. The two men who lost you are waiting at her gate.

details.title: Last Bastion: Gatefall
details.short_description: Pilot a towering mech on the walls of a doomed canyon. Build towers, draft upgrade cards and hold three gates against a living tide of thousands of bugs — and the titans that follow. When a gate falls, ride the zipline back and make your next stand.

details.title: Christmas Toys Restoration
details.short_description: Bring four forgotten toys back to life in a cozy Christmas workshop. Take them apart, clean and repaint them, repair their mechanisms, then test your handiwork, add a child's name, and send each wrapped gift up the chimney to Santa.

name: Clack Clack Band: Idle Taskbar Jam

details.title: Clack Clack Band: Idle Taskbar Jam
details.short_description: A tiny animal band lives on your taskbar. Every key you press and every click you make plays a beat, so the more you work, the bigger the show. Collect 50+ animal musicians, dress them up, decorate the stage and tour 12 countries while you get things done.

details.title: The Plushie Atelier
details.short_description: Open your cozy plush toy workshop! Wash, repair, and sew stuffed animals, or design your own cuddly friends. Decorate your shop, discover your customers’ stories, and enjoy peaceful days with Crumb and your animal companions.

details.title: 问道长生
details.short_description: An ancient old man hands you a worn jade slip and a breathing manual: "Between these two lies your fate." A text-based xianxia idle game — cultivate, refine pills, forge artifacts, join sects, find a Dao companion and ascend through fifteen realms. (Simplified Chinese only)

details.title: KER
details.short_description: KER is a 2D puzzle strategy heist game where you play as Agent Orange, who have to enter into most secure building and get the FILE securely. The building is equipped with pass cords and other securities measure, but only aim to get out the file securely.

details.title: Sprout
details.short_description: By day, work your first shift at Santa's toy factory: wrap presents, build toys and bake cookies. By night, survive the lockdown: hide, board up doors, solve puzzles and watch the cameras while something crawls through the halls hunting you.

details.title: DUST & DEBT
details.short_description: Framed for a debt of one billion in a ruined world. Explore 10 km × 10 km of Ashfall and shape your build with over 2,500 gear designs and branching skills. Find a loyal canine companion, uncover the truth behind the debt, and confront the man who took your freedom.

name: Cartel Cargo Simulator: Open World Tycoon

details.title: Cartel Cargo Simulator: Open World Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a delivery empire in a single-player open-world simulation. Deliver parcels, negotiate with residents, expand your fleet, build a home and manage your own cargo branch. Buy properties, collect rent and defend your business from the Patron’s men.

details.title: Afterground: The Children
details.short_description: The world ended. The road home didn't. Fight through ever-changing ruins, build your power one card at a time, and rescue survivors on a journey from grasslands through desert to frozen wastes. A post-apocalyptic action roguelite where every night could be the last.

details.title: Santa's Sweatshop
details.short_description: A first-person incremental game set in Santa's warehouse. Wrap gifts, load the conveyor belt and meet a daily quota that grows every day. Earn cookies to buy upgrades, expand the warehouse and hire elves to help you.

details.title: Dead Or Drawn
details.short_description: A Wild West party game of drawing, describing and bluffing for 3–6 players. The narrator secretly sees a suspect and describes it out loud while everyone sketches it on a WANTED poster. The posters go up on the board, anonymous. Can you spot the narrator's drawing?

details.title: Geargrave Rigrunners
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder on wheels. Lead a convoy down three faction-owned roads. Every vehicle in your column brings its own cards, every wreck takes them away, and any enemy you cripple can be boarded and driven home. Build your deck, build your fleet, deliver the cargo.

details.title: Break Reality
details.short_description: Break Reality is a small-scale multiplayer first-person shooter made by a solo developer. The maps are built tight, so contact is constant. No vehicles. No sliding, just boots, ground and gunfire.

details.title: Bunkum
details.short_description: Convicts forge their own faces onto dummies, then pose among them. The warden has a flashlight, a mugshot book and not enough cuffs, and can't tell who's real until he cuffs them. A slapstick online party game of bluffing and holding very still, for 3 to 8 players with proximity voice.

details.title: Lords, Land & Levy
details.short_description: Build a living medieval village, defend its walls in real time, then march out to lead the assault yourself. Marry, scheme and make war across a realm of rival lords, rise from village lord to king, and hold the west against the Great Khan.

details.title: Clash of Cogs
details.short_description: Up to 8 players get 30 seconds to secretly program 5 moves—then watch every robot execute at once across a lethal factory of conveyors, lasers, and molten pits. Ram, suplex, and outsmart friends online, in couch hotseat, or against bots! Nobody's plan survives the assembly line!

name: If You Flip a Bear: A Hangul Puzzle

details.title: If You Flip a Bear: A Hangul Puzzle
details.short_description: Flip 곰 (bear), get 문 (door)! Turn things into Korean letters, split them, add and remove strokes, and spell what you need. A Hangul puzzle game where words become things.

details.title: Eau de Tycoon
details.short_description: Dates, work, special occasions. Create perfumes with over 50 different raw materials, scents that people carry with them through key moments in their lives; recommend based on their tastes, customize your packaging, and become an unmatched perfumer.

details.title: Turret Slayer
details.short_description: Build your own turrets, one wild part at a time. Find secret combos, fight off boarders, beat the bosses, then take your winning ships into the Galactic War.

details.title: Bubble Boom 2000
details.short_description: BUBBLE BOOM 2000 is a free-to-play Top Down Shooter inspired by popular 2000s and early 2010s aesthetics, packaged in an experience that makes you feel like you're back in a 90s arcade. Play as bright and bubbly characters across different maps and pop all of your foes.

details.title: Bookshelves
details.short_description: A cozy board game for you and your friends. Draft books from library carts, line them up by genre and fill your shelf for points. Up to 4 players online, with bots for the empty seats, plus a fresh Daily Curate puzzle every day.

details.title: Carpet Forge
details.short_description: Build your deck, deploy wooden toy vehicles, and bolt on a variety of weapons and utility modules in this roguelike top-down turn-based tactics and deckbuilding game. Draft units, weapons or effects and outsmart the creepy, broken plastic nightmare toys!

details.title: Accordspire
details.short_description: Rebuild a ruined fortress and defend its Core against the Horde. By day, gather, build and forge alliances with Humans, Dwarves and Elves. At sunset the bell tolls and the siege begins. Play solo or in co-op for up to 3 players.

details.title: Space Gas Station Simulator
details.short_description: Run a first-person orbital gas station solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Refuel ships, ring up travelers, and unload cargo shuttles. Reinvest your shared earnings to expand the station, then defend it when pirates land.

name: Spot The Bot: AI or NOT

details.title: Spot The Bot: AI or NOT
details.short_description: Real or AI? A solo spot-the-fake game show against GEN, the robot host who made the fakes. Two exhibits, one real: zoom into pictures, walk around 3D dioramas, stake your call, slam READY. The reveal circles the tell. 3 campaigns, 7 contestant classes; win a campaign and you drop an anvil on GEN.

details.title: Ceti Break
details.short_description: Your cursor is you. Dodge and lunge as you attack and evade at the speed and accuracy of your mouse control. Fill out the skill tree for buffs and bonuses to help you survive the waves that grow in number and strength.

details.title: Realm Lords
details.short_description: A spiritual successor to classic medieval strategy games, combining turn-based kingdom management with real-time tactical battles. Work the land, trade resources, build castles, and lead armies to unite a divided realm.

details.title: Boombots
details.short_description: A 3D bomb party game starring scrap robots! Blast crates, grab power-ups and be the last bot standing in 16 hazard-packed arenas. Play with up to 4 on one PC, up to 8 online with PC + mobile crossplay, or take on 8 worlds and their bosses in Story mode.

details.title: Pixel Platoons
details.short_description: Lead your squad through explosive pixel-art missions across desert, tundra and jungle battlefields. Recruit, train and promote soldiers, compete for medals and global records, and live with every loss. Every soldier matters. Every death is permanent.

details.title: Mailu — A Chaotic Memory Game
details.short_description: Mailu is a memory game with a paper circus inside. Matching a pair is free, missing one costs you — and just when you swear you've memorized the table, a boss pulls a brand-new rule out of its hat. Featuring 18 bosses, 37 effect cards and 5 game modes.

details.title: Homicidy
details.short_description: Somebody had a very bad night. Now it's your shift. Scrub fifty crime scenes spotless in this cozy-macabre pixel-art cleaning game: mop, foam, vacuum and luminol your way to three stars, then spend the pay on a nicer mop. You do the crime. We do the grime.

details.title: Das Hochhaus
details.short_description: Build and manage your own high-rise in a 2D business simulation. Combine apartments, offices, hotels, shops and cafés, plan elevators and utilities, and balance rental income, running costs and your tenants’ needs as your tower grows.

name: Fifth Ace Casino: A 70s Vegas Tycoon

details.title: Fifth Ace Casino: A 70s Vegas Tycoon
details.short_description: Run five casinos through 1970s Las Vegas, from a sawdust joint downtown to a marble palace on the Strip. Real cards, wheels, dice and keno draws, cheats and card counters, a pit boss on the floor, staff with quirks, headliner shows, and a corporation that wants your house.

details.title: Lights Out
details.short_description: The lights go out and Mr. Snuffles comes looking for you: a giant, much-repaired plush pig who can't see in the dark but hears everything. Hide with up to 3 friends, stay quiet and survive till morning... or be the pig.

details.title: Nut Clicker
details.short_description: Click a nut. Hire a squirrel. Then Bubba shows up, and nobody called Bubba. A chill, absurd idle game about a backyard that slowly stops making sense.

details.title: Sector 73
details.short_description: Top-down coop shooter. Fight down through nanite-infested research labs and uncover what the executive found in the Oram ruins. Flip on the flash light and keep firing until nothing is left standing.

details.title: Doppel Echo
details.short_description: You can't trust a familiar face or voice. DOPPELECHO is a first-person multiplayer horror and social deduction game where an impostor can steal a crewmate's appearance and voice. Work together to repair a space station and escape, or become the impostor and deceive the crew.

details.title: Basis Factory
details.short_description: Basis Factory is a top-down automation game. Start with a single piece of ore, let raw materials automatically become parts and components, then assemble them step by step into complex industrial products. No enemies, no countdown—just a factory built from scratch, entirely yours.

details.title: MANBIKI MAYHEM
details.short_description: Steal! Catch them! Thieves carry products and whole shelves to the exit. Undercover G-Men blend in with shoppers, zap thieves with a stun gun, cuff and jail them. Hold the key to break teammates out, or throw the furious store manager at someone else. A first-person team game for friends.

details.title: 过关斩将
details.short_description: The chessboard is a map, and the squares that haven't been flipped are still wet ink. How many hidden troops can you spot before the pursuers surround you?

name: Stress Relief Bamboo Fighter 2 Super Bamboo Man

details.title: Stress Relief Bamboo Fighter 2 Super Bamboo Man
details.short_description: Two players, one bamboo fighter! Pull one string each with a friend in this tabletop physics action game. Jump in sync, clear stationery obstacles, protect your balloon, and collect candy as you tackle every stage together.

details.title: Johanniter Christmas Trucker
details.short_description: Your truck is stranded on a mountain. Can you deliver all packages through a devilish parkour to save christmas? 50% of Developer net revenue will be donated to the "Johanniter Christmastrucker" charity!

details.title: Evolicious
details.short_description: Hunt. Eat. Evolve. Survive relentless waves in a 2D action roguelike where your creature visibly transforms as you grow stronger. Discover extraordinary Evolution Fusions and millions of possible combinations across five dangerous worlds.

details.title: Lanternstair: Explore the Underneath
details.short_description: Explore torchlit, tabletop-style dungeons one turn at a time. Build your hero, bargain with creatures, bank your loot, and face each dungeon’s guardian. Share dungeon seeds and choose whether to risk permadeath.

details.title: First Day!
details.short_description: FIRST DAY: A comedy visual novel about a girl who just wants to go home and fujo out.

name: 麻将塔防 MahJong Tower Defense

details.title: 麻将塔防 MahJong Tower Defense
details.short_description: Mahjong Tower Defense is an innovative game that combines mahjong with tower defense. Each turn you draw and discard tiles, then use classic mahjong calls such as Chow, Pung, Kong and Hu (declaring a winning hand) to earn different types of towers. languages: Chinese, English and Japanese.

details.title: Rigor Movers
details.short_description: By day, your clients trust you with their boxes. By night, you come back to steal their furniture. A first-person burglary game. Get the sofa out without waking anyone up. Play solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players.

details.title: Pull the Weeds
details.short_description: Start by pulling weeds by hand, then upgrade to sickles, boomerangs, wind magic, and a giant robot! Cut, collect, and burn weeds to earn better tools. Clear overgrown fields and enjoy watching your progress take shape.

details.title: Cozy Critter Empire
details.short_description: A relaxing colony builder in a woodland archipelago. Turn simple resources into goods, link production chains, ship cargo between six islands, meet the critter residents and their pets and fill a nature book of thirty animals, offline and at your own pace.

details.title: Jett Rider - Mini Hero
details.short_description: Jett Rider Mini H.E.R.O. is a classic Game Boy-style adventure set in the Jett Rider universe. A small mission. A big heart. A true handheld hero.

details.title: VoidHue
details.short_description: VoidHue is a top-down puzzle game that fuses classic sokoban mechanics with colorful light mechanics. Mix and match colors to phase through gates, activate light-based mechanisms and solve vibrant puzzles to bring back the color to the world.

name: This is not just a farm

details.title: This is not just a farm
details.short_description: This Is Not Just a Farm is an idle farming simulator with horror elements where you can make progress while doing other things on your computer.

details.title: What Remains
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a childhood home. Explore, uncover four days of missing memory, and survive something that has been listening since you arrived.

details.title: Sign It
details.short_description: Monteririo, a city steeped in violence and vice, welcomes a young examining magistrate. An appointment from the Crown has effectively exiled you to this southern outpost, a thousand leagues from home. Tell me—is there truly a way back to the North for you?

details.title: Chihuahua Racing
details.short_description: Arcade combat racing on planet Chihuahua! Twenty dogs race for the championship across 20 tracks with homing missiles, bombs, 18 wild supers and 26 random events. Build your own tracks, then race them alone or split screen with a friend, even tied together by a rope.

details.title: (Debt Feeds Debt
details.short_description: A turn-based bond card strategy game. Buy bonds, fulfill orders, build FEVER combos, and push progress to 100 before decay—and the demonic contract—catch up.

details.title: Factor Zoo
details.short_description: Factor Zoo is a strategy puzzle game blending Sudoku and betting. Pick 5 lucky cells before each round, then solve the board with Sudoku techniques. Revealed numbers form hands—pairs, straights, or five of a kind—to earn multiplier rewards.

details.title: Unregistered Scene
details.short_description: Unregistered Scene is a Minesweeper-style anomaly deduction game. As Agent 03, an insurance company agent, investigate scenes where records no longer match reality. Work with a mysterious assistant to identify anomalies and uncover hidden rules.

details.title: Misplaced
details.short_description: Misplaced is a historical detective puzzle game about sorting case files and uncovering hidden connections. Read letters, witness statements, and official records, figure out where each document belongs, and piece together the truth behind a murder case inspired by real events.

details.title: Chief Bubble Officer
details.short_description: Chief Bubble Officer is a Roll-and-Write strategy game. In every match, aim to score as many points as possible within limited actions. Each turn, draw random number cards and fill distinct charts. Every chart features unique rules, with a wild range of fill requirements and scoring systems.

details.title: Tower Of Hope
details.short_description: 30 years ago, heroes sealed an Evil God within the Tower of Hope. Now the barrier is broken. You are an adventurer seeking glory, but the truth of what really happened waits inside.

details.title: Lost in Art
details.short_description: Explore a surreal, twisted version of real-world art gallery in this atmospheric puzzle adventure inspired by classic survival horror. Use creative thinking and a mysterious power to solve puzzles, evade a sinister threat, and uncover the secret of a cursed artwork; before it traps you for good.

details.title: TAMITOS: Tale of Understanding
details.short_description: A story-driven platformer where you experience the world through autistic and neurotypical perspectives. Explore a magical world, rescue Tamitos frog creatures representing emotions, and solve meaningful puzzles that teach empathy, understanding, and the beauty of seeing the world differently.

details.title: HAE Stack
details.short_description: In the far future year of 2025, society is dominated by a handful of global megacorporations that surveil everyone, everywhere, at all times. They know where you go, who you know, what you like, and sell that information to anyone willing to pay. But you need a job, and one of them is hiring.

details.title: Flow - The Tidal Whispers
details.short_description: A challenging narrative platformer built for the NES, where kindness shapes the journey.

details.title: What the House Remembers
details.short_description: A narrative-driven psychological horror game where a secluded house twists memory into reality. As your sanity deteriorates, uncover a buried truth hidden within its walls before the house reveals what you've tried to forget.

details.title: Rayborne
details.short_description: Rayborne is a puzzle game built around lasers, physics, and real-time light simulation. Solve handcrafted challenges by shaping light itself while uncovering the mystery behind a questionable AI research facility.

details.title: Fluendora: The Realm of Scribes
details.short_description: Fluendora is a multiplayer and single-player word-puzzle. Prove to your friends you know some words (or learn some if you don't). Players can either compete for the highest score (up to 6 players) or enjoying a peaceful solo session.

details.title: Can I Get a Job?
details.short_description: Operator, you have been appointed to the position of labor resource allocator. The System observes and analyzes every decision you make. Compliance with instructions is recommended. Begin work.

details.title: 9Clock OverPack
details.short_description: You have until nine. Ransack the room, decide what actually matters, and cram it into a suitcase that is always one slot too small. Everything you leave behind comes back - as a story about how your trip went.

details.title: Wrath of the Arcane Realms
details.short_description: Wrath of the Arcane Realms is a hexagon-based, turn-based roguelike strategy game. Assemble a party of 3 from 6 heroes, chart your path across the realms, and craft your own synergies by drafting unique skills. There is no "correct" way to save the Arcane Realms. Don't seek the solution—define it!

details.title: CHEAT
details.short_description: CHEAT is an exam-themed card Roguelike game. You play as a student who must collect and use various bizarre cards and skills. Stay vigilant, dodge the teachers, improve your scores and rankings, and ultimately achieve victory in the exam!

details.title: Evolution: Code of 6 Desires
details.short_description: In this evolutionary simulation game, you play as a deity sowing the seeds of life. Each human you create possesses a unique genome, where the combination of desire genes determines their behavioral patterns and fate trajectory. A sandbox about life, choice, and destiny awaits your discovery.

name: Hell's Beasts: Yama Wanted Me Dead, I Left Him Half-Dead

details.title: Hell's Beasts: Yama Wanted Me Dead, I Left Him Half-Dead
details.short_description: In this live-action FMV Hell-office game, become an Underworld Judge deciding fates—watch quirky ghosts pull stunts and talent shows, sling sharp words and cards to shake up the workplace, and unlock your past life to rewrite your present!

details.title: Impulse Vector: Fighter Ops
details.short_description: As an independent contractor aboard a corporate carrier, pilot your Space Superiority Fighter on missions for rival organisations. Protect miners, strike enemy stations, and patrol the void to earn your keep and build your company’s name across the frontier!

details.title: RatSpire
details.short_description: RatSpire is a top-down survivor roguelite focused on minion progression and auto-battling, choosing your own path. Recruit quirky classes, stack weapons, potions, and relics to craft absurd builds, and the higher you climb, the better it feels. Hands off — let your legion fight for you.

details.title: Act! Autonomy: Cell-Tones
details.short_description: Act! Cellular Tuning—a rhythm game with fully innovative free-input gameplay—is set to launch in Winter 2026! Relax, immerse yourself fully, and tune your unique movement in the ocean of the subconscious!

name: To the Stars: Do Maid Robots Dream of Electric Grapefruit

details.title: To the Stars: Do Maid Robots Dream of Electric Grapefruit
details.short_description: This is a Visual Novel RPG where you role play as a maid robot in a post-apocalyptic world, where pollution made the ground surface no longer liveable; Your purpose is to help your USER build her spaceship "The Golden Star" and eventually witness her journey into the sapce.

details.title: Purrfect Ascent
details.short_description: A minimalist Foddian-style precision platformer with an unusual control scheme: the character automatically jumps when moving left or right, and jump height scales directly with horizontal speed up to a maximum. A brutal ascent to rescue your frightened kitty. Meow.

details.title: Harvestville: Song of the Ancestress
details.short_description: A farming/life-sim game with a folk horror twist. An enigmatic deity has convinced the residents of Harvestville to conduct an unorthodox ritual. Grow crops, connect with the townsfolk, and uncover the terrifying secrets waiting beneath the surface...

details.title: 6RAVITY CUBE
details.short_description: “Novel 6-direction gravity puzzle‑action game!” Packed with diverse gimmicks — experience intuitive yet strategically deep puzzle‑solving!

details.title: Reaction
details.short_description: Fly your ship though a derelict space station in this action/puzzle 2D platformer as you avoid hazards, repair your ship back to working condition and uncover the mysteries within. What awaits inside and can you get out again?

details.title: Humanity's Fall
details.short_description: Explore the world of Humanity's Fall, a fantasy farming sim. Interact and build a community with the world's next apex lifeform. Build your farm and rediscover lost flora as you discover the world's lore.

details.title: Crosstown
details.short_description: An overload of 8-bit-style action mayhem, Crosstown hands you a toga and a gun, and lets you loose in an ever-changing maze full of monsters and explosions! 40 levels, up to 4 players, and an endless mode!

details.title: Serenity
details.short_description: A zen gliding and exploration game with procedurally generated music

details.title: Subway Story
details.short_description: A narrative-driven exploration game set in the New York City subway, where you ride trains, interact with strangers, and make choices that shape how the city's underbelly responds.

details.title: For the Glory of Wilson
details.short_description: For the Glory of Wilson is an action roguelite where you recruit allies who fight alongside you and influence every battle.

details.title: Gunfort
details.short_description: Gunfort is a tower defense game where your army is competent and well-funded. The city is surrounded, and horrors are coming down every road. Build turrets, call in commanders, and hold the line. Watch your brilliant strategy unfold or discover exactly how much government money you can waste.

details.title: DepotDash
details.short_description: Fast-paced top-down construction yard simulator where you manage deliveries, move materials with heavy machines, and keep suppliers happy before your depot overflows.

details.title: NightMeer
details.short_description: NightMeer is a 2D exploration adventure about the nights you can't sleep. Wrapped in the pressure of having to fall asleep now, Noah drifts through her darkened room. Guide her with a click, and slowly let the tension leave her body and mind. How she gets through this night is up to you.

details.title: Alien Idolz: Rhythmic Idler
details.short_description: Alien Idolz is a 4-lane rhythm game with an incremental twist. Hit the notes, harvest love from your alien stans, and exploit the skill tree to break the stats and clear increasingly difficult tracks.

details.title: BROMS: Battle Royale Management Simulator
details.short_description: A management simulation game where you run a battle royale. Host matches to increase revenue from gacha requests, expand the map, and place objects to improve the environment. You can also play on the maps you create yourself.

details.title: ComboCraft Legendary
details.short_description: An Idle incremental clicker focused on crafting symbols, merging combinations, and building automated production. Reset your run to unlock permanent upgrades and grow stronger each cycle.

details.title: Clash of Worlds
details.short_description: Clash of Worlds is a turn-based strategic card game. Similar gameplay mechanics to Yu-Gi-Oh!. Featuring multiple supported formats and a developer who cares about fun. All gameplay is manual, as if playing "in real life". Join the Stoat server for help or questions. Stoat: https://stt.gg/K8jk6Dxd

details.title: Alone After Dark: Head Practitioner
details.short_description: Attend to patients and fill out paperwork as 22-year-old Kimora Jackson on her first shift after graduating nursing school. Draw blood, administer medications, and try not to lose your head in the chilling hallways of Coldrock Medical Center.

details.title: City of Hunger
details.short_description: Survive a deadly parasite outbreak in immersive virtual reality. Fight for your life, uncover the truth behind Dr. Summers' experiments, and escape before it's too late.

details.title: Turbo Ziggurat
details.short_description: You are a tiny creature in a living human city. Talk to NPCs out loud to find clues, track down crystal balls, and steal them before the enemy team does. A chaotic team PvP game.

details.title: 蛊道The Reverend's Path
details.short_description: An innovative roguelite real-time combat game of one-handed, effortless spell programming. Wield arcane Gu, pick it up intuitively, and carve out your supreme Path of Gu across two layers: the Killer Move Board (build your skills) and the Condition Pool (set when they fire).

details.title: Loginnnnnn
details.short_description: Team up with up to 3 friends in online co-op to breach 10 ultra-realistic login screens with Physics-Driven Cursors! To unlock the final mini game, you must use fectly log into 10 fictional online services without a single mistake. Do you ready to get stuck at the login page???

details.title: Shell Yeah!
details.short_description: A tiny island that lives right on your desktop. Shelly harvests coconuts, runs her beach bar and splashes in the pool while you work. Upgrade the island, throw toys, meet new friends and collect 72 illustrated trading cards. Free to play, relaxing, always there.

details.title: Rabid
details.short_description: RABID is a dark fantasy tactical RPG where blackjack fuels every battle. Lead a team of mutated animals, customize your decks, collect powerful loot, and master turn-based combat as you uncover the dark secrets of a mysterious laboratory.

details.title: Neuroflux
details.short_description: Neuroflux is a modern take on Nerts, the frantic real-time solitaire race. Everyone plays at once: flip through your deck, build on the shared center card stacks, empty your Flux pile and hit FLUX before anyone else. Up to 4 players online on dedicated servers, or practice solo. Free to play.

details.title: One Million Dominoes
details.short_description: Topple a million dominoes, one push at a time. Pick where to push, watch the chain race across the table, and grow it into a wave of tens of thousands. A short, satisfying incremental game with achievements and timed loops.

details.title: Spot the Symbol
details.short_description: A calm, colorful collection of quick brain games about seeing what’s hidden. Race your friends to the answer, and sneak in a little sabotage when they pull ahead.

details.title: A Very Tidy Christmas
details.short_description: Bring order to Santa's messy workshop in this cozy Christmas sorting game! Organize toys, decorations, and festive goodies, decorate the Christmas tree, and discover little surprises along the way. Every item has its place!

details.title: Dungeon Dealer
details.short_description: Heroes bleed. You profit. Send squads into deadly dungeons, crack open chests of glowing loot and sell every find at the perfect moment. Arm your best heroes, conquer it all, then retire rich and start a bigger era in this pixel-art incremental game.

details.title: Tower of Trials and Wishes
details.short_description: Conquer a 100-floor tower together with the adorable final boss! Simple is best — a hack-and-slash, field-less RPG!

details.title: Shatterbelt
details.short_description: A short incremental asteroid shooter. Blast rocks that crack and split, scoop up their gems and spend them on a tree of 100+ upgrades where every level counts. Break the belt in an evening, then keep diving: Endless, branching roguelite Expeditions and a prestige that pays you for depth.

details.title: OVERDRIVE
details.short_description: Drive the all-female rock band VELOURIA from Sapporo to Fukuoka in this road-trip dating sim. Plan your stops, sell merch, and choose who to spend time with after each show. A late-night talk could spark a romance. Your choices shape how the tour ends.

details.title: Take Care of Her Frog
details.short_description: The most relaxing and delicious idle on your screen. Choose whose frog you’re going to take care of. She starts stressed and nervous… your mission is to pamper, relax and fully satisfy her. While you live your life, she stays in the corner of the screen. Simple, tasty and addictive.

details.title: Electric Noosphere: Prologue
details.short_description: Play the free prologue to Electric Noosphere, a story-driven sci-fi RTS. Fly a top-down mission through space, hold out against endless spawning waves in Survival, and take on the AI in Skirmish. Single-player, no purchase required.

details.title: Star Sprout EV
details.short_description: A chibi sci-fi mecha collection in one single-player package: a 4-chapter story campaign, real-time strategy Conquest, 24-level tower defense, the bullet-heaven roguelite Star Drift, and the leaderboard survival mode Endless Deep. Fight on foot, board your mech, and crush the swarm.

details.title: EscarGO
details.short_description: A hungry chef. Four nervous snails. Plenty of dark jokes. EscarGO is a typing party game: race up to 3 friends online, and if you get caught, write sentences to trip them up. Or go solo, outlast the bots and chase the top score on the global leaderboard.

details.title: Trisfera
details.short_description: A match-3 roguelite where you build your own bag of marbles. Line up numbered marbles, chain cascades, stack points × mult and shatter the glass bosses guarding every series. 100 artifacts, each hiding a secret + version to unlock.

details.title: Smart Three Kingdoms : Rewrite History
details.short_description: Smart Three Kingdoms is a real-time strategy game that cuts down on micromanagement so you can focus on strategic decisions. With over 700 officers and historical and what-if campaigns, build up cities and strive to unite the land through war and diplomacy.

details.title: Wardens of Sol
details.short_description: Build your ship. Defend Sol. Fly through Saturn’s rings, battle raiders and alien warships, and explore distant ground on foot. Mine, salvage and trade to turn each journey into the weapons, systems and ship you want to command.

details.title: Tower of Rebirth
details.short_description: A gothic pixel-art roguelite survivor. Weapons fire automatically—dodge, weave, and mow down endless undead hordes. Pick 1 of 3 upgrades every run; talents persist through death, so you only get stronger. 6 difficulty tiers, 3 chapters, heroes and companions by your side.

details.title: Desktop Fish Wish
details.short_description: A cozy idle fishing game in handcrafted 3D that lives on your desktop. While you work or relax, your little angler fishes on a tiny planet in the corner of your screen — catch 100 kinds of fish, dress up, and adopt charming pets.

details.title: Anef Liffa : Tree of Hope
details.short_description: Anef Liffa : Tree of Hope is a story about a tree in the town Van Dyck. Explore the town, talk with people and solve problems with puzzles.

details.title: Tiny Trouble
details.short_description: Race toy cars across breakfast tables, bathtubs, pool tables and sandboxes. Shove rivals into the cereal, squash the peas and fly off the toast. 18 cups, a sticker album to fill, party modes for the couch, online races and a track editor. Small cars. Big trouble.

details.title: Chained Riders
details.short_description: Chained Riders is a chaotic online multiplayer motorcycle game for 2–8 players! Ride together in co-op or compete in teams of two, connected by chains. Overcome challenging obstacle courses, coordinate your moves, and try not to drag your teammates into disaster!

details.title: Chat Rampage: Bedrock Box
details.short_description: Chat Rampage: Bedrock Box is a game designed for TikTok LIVE integration, featuring a popular livestreaming genre where streamers face off against their viewers! The streamer builds while the chat tries to stop them by spawning TNT, lightning strikes, meteors, and even nuclear bombs into the game!

details.title: Submarine Escape
details.short_description: A first-person horror escape game set inside a ruined submarine, where the protagonist is gradually turning into a monster. Craft a cure to halt the mutation, uncover the truth behind the experiment, and safely escape the threats of the deep sea.

details.title: Blooming Courtyard
details.short_description: Blooming Courtyard is a cozy logic puzzle game on a grid. Follow the placement rules to solve hundreds of puzzles. Enjoy the scenery of all four seasons as you fill your little sunlit courtyard with flowers and greenery!

details.title: Unlucky Spells
details.short_description: Your mom wants you to become a witch. You honestly don't give a fuck. One night she sends you to meet the coven deep in the Forest, where the Head Witch hands you a pink pistol and asks for a human sacrifice.

details.title: Crimson Haze
details.short_description: Command a Vietnam War air-mobile company in squad-based real-time strategy. Fly troops into hot landing zones, call artillery and air support, and fight for the trust of villages. Every soldier has a name—and every loss is remembered.

details.title: Fruit Frenzy Clicker
details.short_description: Squeeze fruit, earn mountains of juice, and grow your tiny fruit stand into a thriving juice empire! Buy upgrades, automate production, discover rare fruits, brew recipes, explore orchards, and prestige for permanent rewards in this colorful incremental clicker.

details.title: Ladder Knight
