details.short_description: A small hero, a trusty ladder, and a world full of trouble. Explore strange lands, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and face mighty bosses in this pixel-art platformer. Put your ladder to work in ways it was never built for.

details.title: 国gal笑笑传
details.short_description: 当国产galgame占领了整个世界。吃饭、睡觉、打工、购买，这个世界的一切都围绕国产galgame发生。你将在这里体验到超过50款“有趣”的galgame游戏。努力打工然后购买更多galgame吧！

details.title: Wuchang: Three Kingdoms Survivors
details.short_description: Wuchang: Three Kingdoms Survivors is a dark Three Kingdoms roguelite survivor game. Customize your background and destiny talents, ally with deities and summon reincarnated stellar generals. Build unique builds with randomized affix gear & divine bonds, fight through endless enemy hordes.

details.title: Border Pastoral Tale
details.short_description: A relaxing, wholesome cartoon-style herding simulation game. Become a sheepdog and guide scattered flocks back to their pens across vast grasslands while fending off wolf attacks. Supports local 2-player co-op with simple controls. Experience pure fun through agile movement and precise herding!

details.title: DAYSOWN
details.short_description: Learn a trade, earn your first wages, and save for a place of your own. DAYSOWN is a single-player life sim of hands-on jobs, village crafts, growing food, and making a living one day at a time.

details.title: Splicers
details.short_description: Splicers is a party shooter with silly game modes, tough challenges, and a huge roster of characters and weapons. Bring your friends, add some bots, change the rules, and build your own maps and missions to share with the world.

details.title: BazaarBorn
details.short_description: Start with a handcart and work your way to an antique shop in BazaarBorn, a second-hand trading sim. Buy and sell, get to know customers, and back up your offers when bargaining. Take orders, trade online, bid in Storage Battles, join item auctions, invest in property, and face unexpected events.

details.title: Grey Staithe
details.short_description: Grey Staithe is a retro point-and-click puzzle game with cult-themed flair. Explore the environments, use the items you find, uncover the secrets buried here, and complete the commissioned task.

details.title: Paradise Court
details.short_description: You and up to three friends just took over the worst apartment building in town. Fix the pipes, mop the floors, deal with angry tenants and evict the ones who won’t pay, all while trying to keep the place in one piece. A chaotic co-op building-management sim for 1-4 players.

details.title: Who is the Thief?
details.short_description: Runners hide in a crowd of identical NPCs. Hunters spot the one who moves like a human. An asymmetric online party game for 2–10 players: finish your tasks without getting caught, or hunt down the runners hiding in the crowd.

details.title: Hellobnb Simulator
details.short_description: Turn a run-down house on a beautiful Greek island into a thriving vacation rental empire! Renovate, decorate, welcome guests, buy properties, and expand your businesses. Explore island life and build your dream solo or with friends in 4-player online co-op!

details.title: Blood & Ledger
details.short_description: Port Aldrich, 1920. You start as a young nobody and follow your family for eighty years. Rackets, businesses, elections or a police badge: in this city everyone plays by the same rules as you, and nobody forgets.

details.title: Night Study: Korean Ghost Stories
details.short_description: A complete first-person horror game in just 1.44MB — it fits on a single floppy disk. You fell asleep during night study and woke up alone. Learn each ghost's rule, find the keys and escape a Korean high school before dawn.

details.title: Doomsday: M.A.D.
details.short_description: Nuclear strategy on a living planet. Nations are born, build their towns, economies and railways, trade, rebel and go to war, century after century, all the way to nuclear fire. Watch the world live, or take control of one nation.

details.title: HEXPANSE
details.short_description: Hexpanse is a real-time space strategy game. Build your ships and stations block by block, mine asteroids, program the doctrine of your autonomous fleets, and conquer a procedurally generated galaxy. Play solo or in multiplayer.

details.title: Liberty Station
details.short_description: Estación Libertad is an immersive first-person psychological horror and puzzle experience. Trapped in the shadowy depths of an old, abandoned station in Santiago, Chile, you must confront the oppressive silence of the tunnels and your own fears to find a way out.

details.title: MERVARYN 2900
details.short_description: Start with a small cargo ship and build your way into an interstellar trading company. Buy and sell goods, discover profitable routes, expand your fleet, automate trade and establish your own production facilities in a retro-inspired space economy.

details.title: LOST IN MIND - Chapter 1
details.short_description: "Lost in Mind" is a single-player psychological horror game. Play as a successful and renowned psychiatrist with a secret method. Delve into your patients' nightmarish inner worlds to uncover hidden truths, traumas, and repressed emotions while surviving terrifying creatures.

details.title: Hidden Front
details.short_description: Hidden Front is a military real-time strategy game for up to 6 players. Deploy your army, scout through the fog of war and combine infantry, armor, artillery and air support. Fight other commanders or team up with friends against bots.

details.title: Octodefense
details.short_description: Commandeer the galaxy's defense in OctoDefense, a sci-fi tower defense with 10+ hours of tactical action. Master shifting tentacle paths, level up your turrets, and crush colossal cosmic bosses to an epic synth soundtrack across campaign and survival bonus modes.

details.title: Deviant District
details.short_description: Step up to the mic as a fully animated animal comic. Deviant District is a live social comedy club where your voice drives your avatar's face, the crowd reacts in real time, and the host runs the room. Book a set, work the crowd, and build a name on the District's stage.

details.title: Popwork
details.short_description: PopWork is a lightweight roguelite about popping bubbles on an endlessly regenerating bubble wrap. A tribute to the classic Ten Drops: chain-detonate with cross-shockwaves, earn coins, buy items, grab snacks, learn tips, adapt to random events and stage effects, and spend every bubble wisely.

details.title: Backrooms: Steal the Furniture
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror comedy. Noclip into the Backrooms, steal the furniture, sell it upstairs and make rent before the smiling thing finds you. Then blow the rent at the company casino. Some nights the elevator opens somewhere else. Every death is on tape.

details.title: RAT LUCK
details.short_description: Compete in precision timing rounds, choose which rat has to risk a hand, and survive a table full of dangerous cheese. Rat Luck is a chaotic 2–4 player online party game with proximity voice chat, bluffing, taunting, and terrible luck.

details.title: CLUELESS
details.short_description: Your friends secretly choose who you are. Everyone else can see it - you can’t. Ask yes/no questions, follow the clues, and figure out your character! Supports 2-8 players, and only the host needs to own the game.

details.title: Simply Padel
details.short_description: Padel is a racket sport on a glass-walled court where the ball stays live off the walls. Pick forehand or backhand, time your swing, and play doubles with friends online or four on one PC. Build a player, play ranked 1v1 and 2v2, or follow a 19-season career.

details.title: Parts Survivor
details.short_description: A top-down survival shooter roguelike built from scrap. Dodge the swarm, let your guns fire themselves, and craft gears, pipes and springs into new weapons between waves. Open crates, stack modifiers, survive 20 waves and the final boss.

details.title: MNEMOALGIA
details.short_description: An Arctic town, Dec 31, 2005. Total blackout and isolation. You’re trapped in a freezing apartment while the last light fades out. Keep warm, contact your neighbors, and survive as paranoia and "Mnemoalgia" threaten to shatter your mind.

details.title: Ricochord
details.short_description: RICOCHORD is a roguelite brick breaker.. Your balls fire on their own, the bricks shoot back, and every hit plays a note of the song. Evolve your balls, beat the bosses and climb 6 tracks. It also has some music.

details.title: Jane Doe: Cold Case Division
details.short_description: An asymmetric co-op deduction game where you solve cold cases through communication. One player investigates, while the other plays the forensic artist reconstructing the victim's face. Features lite roguelite progression.

details.title: Five Card Evolution
details.short_description: A poker roguelike deckbuilder where you construct wild combos, risk it all, and climb an endless tower of fortune.

details.title: Googlick
details.short_description: Retro arcade shoot em' up puzzler where you blast bricks, steal their color energy, and eradicate the color matching seeds nodes before the robotic army can grow! An authentic recreation of the golden age of arcade gaming with a custom built CRT cabinet experience! Come blasts some bricks!

details.title: CYBER ORBADIER BULBUS MACHINA
details.short_description: The Bulbus Machina were built to fight a long war by reusing gear taken from their enemies. Lead four of them deep into enemy factories in this roguelike mech tactics RPG. Destroy enemy gear to win fast, or disable it and take it? Choose your weapons, and replace worn-out gear with what you take.

details.title: 大赢家
details.short_description: Big Rich is a 3D cartoon-style turn-based economic strategy game. Run around and work jobs to earn gold, win licenses in secret auctions, then play cards to take a cut from your rivals. When the match ends, the richest player wins. Play online with friends, or solo against AI.

details.title: Friendly Pharmacy
details.short_description: Your next shift is probably fine. A slapstick co-op pharmacy game for 1–4 players. Decode dreadful prescriptions, operate absurd machines, and get the right medicine to the right patient. When the equipment jams and the paperwork floods in, teamwork is your best treatment.

details.title: Project 14
details.short_description: Project 14 is a short psychological puzzle game filled with bizarre tests, dark humour and unexpected twists. Explore strange environments, uncover hidden paths and decide whether to obey or defy a disturbingly polite system. Your actions shape the experience – and may lead to different outcomes.

details.title: Shapeless
details.short_description: Your enemies are your next bodies. Possess weakened monsters in this top-down action roguelite. Switch between six hosts, carry your soul build forward, and combine mutation elements. Explore ten stages, challenge bosses, and grow stronger between hunts.

details.title: HUNGRY MART: Last Pick
details.short_description: In this game, you, who are not good at socializing, will work as a picker in a night supermarket and fulfill online shopping orders to avoid face-to-face interactions with people. However, this may not seem like a good choice.

details.title: GridPi: Defense 3014
details.short_description: Dice poker × auto battler × 1–4 player co-op defense. In GridPi, you roll five dice to make poker hands, combine units, and line up synergies to hold back the incoming waves of enemies. What matters isn't luck — it's judgment. Build all kinds of combos and claim victory.

details.title: Plunder Isles
details.short_description: Plunder isles is a co-op adventure game about looting cursed ancient temples on the high seas for fun and profit.

details.title: Novus Deus
details.short_description: In a city controlled by a rising techno-religious cult called "The Church of Convergence", Kara fights her way through the corrupted districts to find her sister and save her from becoming a part of the mindless followers of Novus Deus.

details.title: Sandcastle Kingdom
details.short_description: A cozy sandbox for building sandcastles. Shape your island, castles and courtyards with dynamic sand. Dig canals, ponds and fill them with realistic water. Decorate your island. Share your home with cute animal friends, help them with their quests and gather around the campfire as the sun goes down.

details.title: Agoonis
details.short_description: Agoonis is a neon turn-based strategy game where you spend 300 gold to build a custom army, upgrade pieces into new movement patterns, fight over Soul Shrines, and capture the enemy Empress. Play Story Mode, challenge the bot, or take your questionable strategy online.

details.title: Drift Riot
details.short_description: Drift Riot is an arcade racer where style is speed. Chain drifts, jumps and near misses into huge scores, outrun the Patrols in Heat Run, conquer 150 career courses, race leaderboard ghosts, and build tracks to share.

details.title: Fishing Town
details.short_description: This is a desktop idle fishing game. Collect rare fish, upgrade your gear, and build your own pond and aquarium.

details.title: 美职篮奇迹梦之队
details.short_description: 【NBA官方授权，真实赛场共振】 本游戏内搭载拟真工资帽体系，每位球员的身价、能力值与综合战力，均依据每日NBA真实赛事表现进行实时联动。 【无界交易，市场自由流转】 除交易市场挂售、购买球员外，经理人间还可互相交易，在谈判中探寻价值匹配点，达成交易后球员即可互换东家。 【战术大师，出奇制胜】 50位教练，上百种真实战术，供经理人自由搭配。 临场还可启用自由战术，实时调配球员出手倾向，激活巨星效应。

details.title: PONK
details.short_description: Battle your way through thousands of mobs and bosses, in this modern rogue-like take on Pong. Build your run with hundreds of combinations and evolutions, unlock everything to become more powerful, and try to defeat the final boss!

details.title: Defcoon Vaulted
details.short_description: Located deep within a secret vault, you are tasked with overseeing the operations of a classified surveillance program. Play has the Overseer... from the first day to your eventual death.

details.title: TySina
details.short_description: Bring your own character to your desktop. Every time you type or move your mouse, your character moves diligently with you.

details.title: FREESTYLE FPV
details.short_description: Freestyle FPV is a realistic FPV drone simulator built in Unreal Engine 5. Fly multiple drones across varied maps, customize gravity, weight, thrust, PIDs and more, and choose from beginner-friendly modes or full Acro control for a true FPV experience.

details.title: Neonrise
details.short_description: Neonrise is a solo and co-op roguelite brick breaker. Climb from a machine-ruled city's darkest streets into scientifically mapped space. Customize your paddle, unleash wild power-ups, and keep earned cores to grow stronger between runs.

details.title: Cue Career
details.short_description: Build a career in pool and snooker. Control your stroke and spin from a first-person view, enter tournaments, climb separate rankings and practise your position play across American 8-ball, 9-ball, English 8-ball and snooker.

details.title: Rubblebound
details.short_description: Rubblebound is a minimalist idle game with roguelite elements. Unleash the balls, build skills, break bricks, upgrade, repeat. And see your power grow in this incremental game.

details.title: Dustline 2D
details.short_description: Fight through a ruined world in this post-apocalyptic top-down shooter. Gun down raiders, scavengers and mutants across 10 handcrafted levels, from wastelands to a metro and factory, and take down a final boss at the radio tower.

details.title: Let It Snow
details.short_description: Grab a shovel and dig into real, deformable snow. Clear your yard scoop by scoop, sell every load to the Snow-O-Matic, upgrade your tools and uncover what winter has buried. A cozy, satisfying snow-clearing sim.

details.title: Dungeon Wizard
details.short_description: Hover, pop, upgrade, repeat! Pop!Corn is a pixel-art incremental game about turning a handful of kernels into a popcorn frenzy. Unlock five flavors, grow a branching skill tree, and build better cooking gear until every batch bursts with rewards.

details.title: Velikopolsky Chess
details.short_description: Classic chess game is re-envisioned with Ukrainian folklore and style. Chess pieces that talk with an attitude. Many chess board styles, chess pieces sets, online, LAN play, hotseat, challenge the computer, and learn. Good for all ages, all difficulty levels, and music to relax. Build the community.

details.title: MODERN CAPITAL
details.short_description: Buy from suppliers or make it yourself? MODERN CAPITAL is a business simulation of production, retail, and investment. Run factories and stores, compete on price, quality, and brand, and expand through stocks, real estate, and company acquisitions.

details.title: SHAFT HAPPENS
details.short_description: Your shift goes down. Your quota goes up. Scavenge haunted workplaces, throw loot into the elevator and escape before the doors close. Co-op horror for 1–4 players, with upgrades, suspicious colleagues and a company that values its equipment more than you.

details.title: OVERLOADED: Tower Delivery
details.short_description: Stack your cart to the absolute limit and conquer a massive high-rise apartment! OVERLOADED: Tower Delivery is a chaotic physics-based delivery simulator. Balance fragile packages like Tetris, beat the unforgiving clock, and avoid corporate fines. Survive the daily grind solo or in co-op!

details.title: Arandu: Deck of the Amazon
details.short_description: Build a deck of ancestral power and defend the Amazon. Arandu: Deck of the Amazon is a roguelike deckbuilder where Indigenous heroes confront forest invaders to reclaim their people's sacred relics. Brew poisons, summon animal spirits, and take back what belongs to your people.

details.title: Catadel: Slot Defense
details.short_description: Command an army of cats in this slot-defense roguelite. Pull the lever, chain cascading matches and hold the castle, then push your luck on the multiplier wheel for up to ×10 damage. Damage becomes Gold, and the royal tax always comes due. No real money, just risk and reward.

details.title: sons of infinite dawn
details.short_description: A medieval grand strategy game in a living, fair world. Play in real time with pause or turn based as every nation follows the same rules and adapts to changing needs. Choose your own path, see the consequences clearly, and uncover deeper strategy with every campaign.

details.title: Seeking Immortality in the Sect
details.short_description: A seasonal multiplayer cultivation game. Join one of four sects, master unique arts, and shape your build. Fight World Bosses, explore realms, raise spirit pets, grow herbs, and brew pills. Seasons reset your progress, but pets, titles, and select rewards endure. Choose a new path each season.

details.title: Please Stay Dead
details.short_description: Please Stay Dead is an endless 2D tower defense against the undead. Build turrets, seal tunnels, burn corpses and face bosses with nasty tricks. Every run feeds a huge talent tree, so you come back stronger and hold out longer each time.

details.title: 平远县衙：从一
details.short_description: A historical mystery VN of ancient Chinese litigation. As an unranked legal advisor in Northern Song Pingyuan County, collect evidence, expose contradictory testimonies and debate in court. Every choice shapes branching endings, where written law often struggles to keep pace with human feelings.

details.title: 逃离蔡徐村
details.short_description: This is a kun-terrifying game developed by a Heizi. You play as an Ikun named Su Shan, trying to escape from Caixu Village, which is overrun by Kun Kun.

details.title: The Last Ace - Blackjack Roguelike
details.short_description: Blackjack Roguelike. 3 lives, 60 levels, 12 bosses.

details.title: DeadFront
details.short_description: DeadFront is a 1-to-4 player co-op wave-based zombie survival shooter. Fight off hordes, upgrade weapons at the bench, buy perks from the mystery box, and survive the apocalypse!

details.title: Sunrise Isles
details.short_description: Drive goods, chop wood, catch fish, cook food, design clothes, or just chill in a spacious island with your friends!

details.title: Ward Zero
details.short_description: Enter a chilling psychological horror solo or with up to 4 co-op investigators. Track a missing persons case through twisting mazes, tense puzzles, and hidden evidence. Uncover dark experiments, confront hostile entities, and fight to survive as routine turns deadly.

details.title: HOLO-KINGDOM
details.short_description: This is a 3D action game where you control Hololive members and fight your way through enemies to clear each stage.Carefully read enemy attacks and overcome challenging trials using parries and evasive maneuvers.This game requires keyboard and mouse controls.

details.title: Scuffed Stick Arena
details.short_description: Top down 2D 'stick arena' type shooter. Keyboard keys to move, get a weapon and click to aim and shoot!

details.title: Stonecall
details.short_description: Stonecall is a permadeath action roguelike where every room tests your skill. Dodge, reposition, and time your shots while building powerful synergies to survive the deadly challenges of the Stone Vault.

details.title: Pure College Football
details.short_description: Build your college football dynasty and compete for control. Master NIL recruiting, develop your coaching staff, and manage demanding boosters. Play solo or battle in online dynasties with up to 32 real players.

details.title: Wonderking WD
details.short_description: WonderKing WD is a 2D side-scrolling MMORPG featuring a unique Transformation System that lets you transform and use skills in battle. Explore a colorful fantasy world, challenge powerful bosses, and develop your character through exciting adventures.

details.title: Shadow & Steel
details.short_description: Shadow & Steel is a top-down hack-and-slash arena shooter set in a fantasy world. Battle hordes of undead, demons, and living nightmares designed to push your combat skills to the limit. Strike up close with your blade and weave arcane spells from a distance.

details.title: Singulost
details.short_description: Singulost is an exploratory interplanetary adventure. Explore forgotten worlds, pilot a spaceship, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery of the most ancient civilization that was here before you.

details.title: Postponed: Game Dev Management Roguelite
details.short_description: An addictive wave-based arcade roguelite, in which you are the manager of a game development studio. You get a project each week, that your team and you have to work on to get paid. With that money get upgrades, skill your employees and even unlock characters. Ever wanted to lead a game dev studio?

name: 郑成功传 Clash of Armadas: Koxinga

details.title: 郑成功传 Clash of Armadas: Koxinga
details.short_description: Auto Chess +Tower Defense + Naval Battle Choose from the legendary captains of the Age of Sail – Blackbeard, Francis Drake, Horatio Nelson, Zheng Chenggong… and more. Command 10+ ships. Position your fleet. Broadside fire. Enemies come in waves on fixed routes.

details.title: Incredigble
details.short_description: Uncover dinosaur fossils as you mine through rocks, earn money and upgrade your abilities! Fill your museum with your discoveries to reach the goal of becoming world renowned!

details.title: Zebulon 3D
details.short_description: Meet Zebulon once more in a new adventure now in 3D and crispy voxels! Jump, dash, explore, and gather back your siblings in this new exciting game about purpose and family.

details.title: Hey, Focus!
details.short_description: Hey, Focus! is a productivity game featuring light visual novel elements. Xiaoning, a girl who loves gaming and anime, is here to accompany you while you work and study. Complete focus timers to unlock over 200 voiced interactions, personalized outfits, and perhaps... a few hidden secrets?

details.title: Air Hockey: Magical Heroes
details.short_description: A magical roguelite twist on air hockey! Battle forest animals, collect power-ups, and survive a series of intense air hockey matches.

details.title: The Oath of Runeveil
details.short_description: An online-enabled 3D action RPG set in a vast world to explore. Centered on real-time battles and character progression, it can be enjoyed both solo and in cooperative play.

details.title: Dali's Adventure: Lost Worlds
details.short_description: A mysterious vortex pulls you out of reality. Play as Max, trapped between unknown worlds. Explore, observe, and solve puzzles to progress… but something may try to stop you. 🎮 Demo available — add it to your wishlist.

details.title: Silentia
details.short_description: In Silentia, the monster is blind. It sees only what it hears. Hunt as Krav, a creature that grows stronger with every sound, or survive as one of the many, escaping in total silence. Make a sound, and it finds you.

name: The Man of Iron: Shadows of Haensburg

details.title: The Man of Iron: Shadows of Haensburg
details.short_description: Step into the boots of a guard in the dark megapolis of Haensburg. Master first-person combat and exploration in a striking 2D-in-3D stylized world. Caught between powerful factions, your decisions will shape the city's fate. Will you uphold the law or survive the shadows?

details.title: Quackoban
details.short_description: In Quackoban you will push blocks that fuse into shapes, teleport and move in groups. A new and challenging twist on the Sokoban block-pushing classic, bringing it to new dimensions where you have to think in shapes.

details.title: VeriData Inc.
details.short_description: Solve spreadsheet-based puzzles and handle crazy coworkers in a normal day's work at VeriData Inc.

name: A Game About Launching A Ball

details.title: A Game About Launching A Ball
details.short_description: A challenging game about launching a ball to collect stars. Collect the stars as fast as you can, discover the secrets, upgrade your ball, and unlock the awards. Grab a friend to play online or split screen!

details.title: Mage On The Move
details.short_description: Mage on the Move is a rouge like game with many upgrades and things to unlock to avoid dying from the robots that will chase you through your runs. Purchase stat upgrades with skill points and physical upgrades with the legendary currency of the Vietnamese dong (in game currency only).

details.title: Lane of the Eternal Night
details.short_description: An exploratory, self-chosen experience type of light roguelike turn-based pixel indie game, currently without much storyline. Although the combat is turn-based, it’s more like a rock-paper-scissors style game mode, and it also includes skills.

details.title: Island
details.short_description: Island is a post-apocalyptic visual novel. You appear on the beach of the island, not remembering your past, and your goal is to survive. The wildlife, the other inhabitants of the island all around want you dead. Make the right choice, because it may be the last one!

details.title: Undead Apocalypse: Hellbreak
details.short_description: Fire, throw, and ride your way through a zombie-infested city. Shoot them down, blast with grenades, and escape on a motorcycle - a survival TPS built on constant action and momentum.

details.title: Whirlwind Survivor
details.short_description: Movement IS damage. A roguelite survivor with 100+ skill cards across Fire, Frost, and Lightning. One stick, total carnage. Every run builds different, every run plays different. Pure chaos and flow state.

details.title: That One Dungeon Room
details.short_description: An action-infused Idle/Incremental game that blends effortless play with satisfying combat. It combines rewarding incremental progression with action and RPG elements, creating a deep, grind-driven progression system focused on upgrades, long-term growth, and a highly addictive gameplay loop.

details.title: V.E.C.T. Impact
details.short_description: Smash through geometric hordes with your lance. Spend each run’s credits on permanent upgrades in your skill tree to unleash orbitals, sword waves and chain lightning. Keep upgrading until every enemy you smash ignites a blast. Click. Charge. Cue the fireworks.

details.title: GNOSiS
details.short_description: Lost, alone, & vulnerable, a voluntary candidate of a twisted treasure hunt attempts to survive inside someones sadistic nightmare . . Explore this Open-World Survival Horror carefully & let the guiding signals orientate your escape from this hellish reality!

details.title: Virtual Driving School: Trucks
details.short_description: Train like a professional HGV driver. Master trucks and buses, manage blind spots and long loads, avoid bridge strikes, navigate level crossings, and operate vehicle-mounted cranes. Real rules, real risks — zero real-world consequences.

details.title: Lucky Sip
details.short_description: This is a time-management restaurant simulation game with roguelike elements. Master a wide range of tasty drinks, meet all kinds of customers, and learn diverse management skills. Combine your options wisely to conquer both casual stage runs and the rent challenge!

details.title: EonDeluge
details.short_description: Welcome to EonDeluge, a turn-based bullet hell game. Two players take turns. One draws the bullet patterns in real time while the other steers through them; at the end of the round you swap, and it goes on until someone's energy runs out.

details.title: Anomalift
details.short_description: Everything is normal. Or is it? Anomalift is a cooperative anomaly-spotting game where observation is your greatest tool. Search each area, and report your findings. One mistake leads you somewhere you were never meant to be.

details.title: The One Who Returned
details.short_description: A single-player action RPG set in a fantasy world. Discover your forgotten identity while fighting enemies and completing quests. Enjoy total freedom of character development with no fixed classes—build your hero exactly how you want.

details.title: HERE AGAIN
details.short_description: You wake up in a silent underground facility with one simple instruction: REMEMBER THE BUTTON. Weird dreams and changing surroundings haunt this place. Explore, observe, and unveil the mystery that envelopes this place in this Retro Psychological Horror Game.

details.title: Void Sanction
details.short_description: A sci-fi action RPG. Battle alien hordes with fast-paced combat, evolving weapons, and a combat drone companion. Upgrade your arsenal, defeat challenging bosses, and explore a hostile alien world.

details.title: REDSTREAM DISPATCH
details.short_description: REDSTREAM: DISPATCH casts you as a police officer responding to multiple Dispatch Scenarios. Routine patrols spiral into a violent nightmare tied to a sinister streaming group. Randomized encounters and reactive gore make every run brutal. Rescue the girl. Get out alive.

details.title: Mana Reactor
details.short_description: From stone tools to modern weapons and giant mechs — survive, craft, and conquer another world.

details.title: Under Review
details.short_description: Welcome to the heart of a 1980s bureaucracy. Review applicant files, cross-check records, and make heavy moral decisions. Amidst strange rumors of an unidentified illness, will you uncover the dark truth or become an accomplice to the system?

details.title: The Havoc Channel
details.short_description: A mystery comedy visual novel game told strictly through the eyes of a news anchor. Learn about the city of Brookside, report the news as best you can, and guide the citizens toward a happy ending.

details.title: 裸辞修仙传
details.short_description: Fed up with the corporate grind? A portal to another world just appeared by your desk! Hop in! As a mere mortal, step into a strangely familiar realm, follow the legendary "First Cultivator," and explore a vibrant world of immortality in this Roguelite RPG.

details.title: 盲心：伪装的幻想
details.short_description: Blind Heart: Disguised Fantasy is an AVG game——At some point, my ordinary life stopped being ordinary… The doppelgängers I’d only read about in online horror stories had appeared in the real world. Before I could even process this, my lover, Lin Shiyu, knocked on my door.

details.title: Echoes
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in a first-person psychological horror experience where every choice matters. Confront the echoes of a forgotten past and uncover the truth behind your lost identity.

details.title: PSYCORP
details.short_description: Three siblings are given AI-Powered cybernetics by their dying CEO father to permanently bring out the worst in them. How much of your mind are you willing to lose to control your family's company, and the future of surveillance in this narrative driven AI corporate dystopia?

details.title: CTRLR.CLUB
details.short_description: The controller arcade game that hits different. Hack the board, route signals, purge the virus, and trigger cascades while your hands keep levelling up.

details.title: SeverSoul XOOKEEPER
details.short_description: Keep the entities fed, pacified and contained every night within a dark decaying facility. Can you survive each shift in this intense point & click horror?

details.title: Redneck Mayhem
details.short_description: Redneck Mayhem is a hilarious, physics-based slingshot game where small-town grit takes on the modern world. Follow three fed-up local heroes as they lock, load, and launch random junk, and eventually themselves at the professions that drive them crazy. The Mission: Unleash the Mayhem.

details.title: 小岛之门 Vaulx
details.short_description: Vaulx is a voxel-style 3D puzzle adventure game. Braving the thick mist, you finally set foot on the legendary treasure isle, where a fun and fantastic adventure begins.

name: SlidefyingBadaBoom Penguin through a Slipstream: Rise of the Penguins 3

details.title: SlidefyingBadaBoom Penguin through a Slipstream: Rise of the Penguins 3
details.short_description: Slide, trick, and throw snowballs in this fast-paced 3D platformer inspired by Ninja Gaiden and Sonic. Play solo or local co‑op as you battle enemies, discover perks, and master icy challenges in Rise of the Penguins 3.

details.title: Dig n Fight
details.short_description: Dig for treasures, build powerful backpack synergies, and defeat all enemies.

details.title: LastRoll
details.short_description: Post-apocalyptic tactical roguelike. Assemble a crew of 4, roll dice to fuel your skills and fight your way to the final boss. One lost battle means starting over. No cards. No mercy. Just dice.

details.title: Infinigama
details.short_description: Explore a universe of diverse worlds. Jump between adventures, trade, craft, and meet other players. Each world offers unique challenges, while a shared economy and evolving environments let your actions ripple across the entire connected universe.

details.title: RelicFairy
details.short_description: Abyss is a roguelike action RPG where players build powerful synergy blocks using equipment and skill items. Combine abilities, create unique builds, and fight your way deeper into a dangerous dungeon filled with unpredictable challenges.

details.title: Project OC
details.short_description: Project OC is a multiplayer online desktop idle game. Unlock 1000+ customization options through idle gameplay and freely mix appearances, outfits, expressions, and actions to create your unique OC. Invite friends to join and let their OCs live on your desktop!

details.title: Frost Muscle
details.short_description: Get good at sliding your muscle car on snow. Earth is freezing and only your driving save it.

name: That Probably Belongs in a Museum

details.title: That Probably Belongs in a Museum
details.short_description: That Probably Belongs in a Museum is a chill and cozy tidy up organizing game about cataloging and curating an enormous amount of ancient artifacts! Your job is simple: Catalog ancient artifacts, uncover bizarre stories, and help build a collection of artifacts that probably belong in a Museum!

details.title: You Are ¿Not? A Dentist
details.short_description: Brush their teeth. Accept their gifts. Pay your rent. Explore many towns in this first person brush-em-up adventure about an aspiring dentist pursuing their dreams. You can heal the world, and even support yourself, if you try!

details.title: Spatial Puzzle 3D
details.short_description: This is a casual puzzle game that combines spatial logic and brain-teasing challenges.The game features simple controls and a relaxed pace with a satisfying level of challenge. It is designed for players who enjoy Sudoku, Rubik’s Cube, and other spatial logic puzzles.

details.title: Zero Point
details.short_description: Mine ore, draw water from a spring, and harvest greens on an alien world. Craft gear, expand your outpost, and set up defenses for the night. Help three stranded friends find a way home in this single-player sci-fi survival crafting adventure.

details.title: Dark March
details.short_description: Dark March - is a casual, humorous, single-player pixel adventure game set in a fantasy setting. You are a lich! You must rid your lands of corruption, restore order, and bring peace to those in need! Summon helpers, use magic, explore the world, and defeat your enemies!

details.title: AstroFrame
details.short_description: Take a seat, engineer! AstroFrame is a 2D sci-fi roguelike that challenges your strategic planning, adaptability, and spaceship designing skills. The cosmos is hostile and your survival depends on your ingenuity in an ever-changing galaxy.

details.title: Gecko: Wall Hacker
details.short_description: A stealth action-puzzle game where you climb walls and ceilings, blend into surface materials, and hack security systems. Use full-surface movement, adaptive camouflage, and spatial positioning to infiltrate guarded environments.

details.title: 找勺子LOOKING for MYSPOON
details.short_description: A horror walking simulator play as a character searching for a lost spoon in a fantastical world You will experience a surreal world, from diverse swimming pools to strange houses. I hope you enjoy it.

details.title: Lyden Lys
details.short_description: Lyden Lys is a knowledge-based metroidvania about an existential journey through a lost homeland. Control the surroundings through music, explore a smoldering world, discover what happened to your people, decide the fate of your successors, and find yourself.

details.title: Realm's Last Stand
details.short_description: An unforgiving tower defence game focused on strategic placement, unique enemy mechanics and progressively demanding levels

details.title: Rectangle Dudes
details.short_description: Prepare to be one of the dudes! Challenge yourself in one of the best, precise yet silly, skill-based platformers. Built for co-op fun, mastery solo... or absolute chaos in party mode! Take a trip back to the age of classic platforming, with awesome secrets, arcade energy, and satisfying challenges.

details.title: Slimestronauts: Burst Strike
details.short_description: A Sci-fi Falling Block and Color Matching in Space with Slimes! Slimestronauts: Burst Strike demands you keep cool under pressure just like the good old days! Unlike the good old days; there Obstacles, Enemies, to overcome, help of Ability Enhancing PWUPS, and even Custom Game Mode!

details.title: VIGNETTE
details.short_description: A first-person point-and-click psychological horror game. Only the areas illuminated by your flashlight change in appearance. The game progresses through quiet unease and puzzle-solving, without relying on jump scares. A demo is now available (approx. 20 minutes).

details.title: Nappy Knight
details.short_description: You wake up in a strange land, you don't know who you are but you know what you must do - kill, loot, repeat.

details.title: 技能贪吃蛇 , Skill Snake
details.short_description: "Skill Snake" is an innovative casual game that adds skills and new mechanisms to the traditional Snake game and combines it with simulation management.

details.title: Clinical Memory
details.short_description: Clinical Memory is a first-person psychological horror game set in the abandoned Ward 7B hospital. Experience distorted memory cycles, explore a changing environment, and make choices that may bring you closer to the truth or send you back to the beginning.

details.title: Evidentia
details.short_description: Evidentia is a cooperative detective card game for friends. Each deck is a unique case. Analyze evidence, take risks, question everything — and find out if you can solve it before the final reveal.

details.title: CARDaCOMBS
details.short_description: A retro roguelike deckbuilder where cards cost more than just energy. Descend the CARDaCOMBS, defeat monsters, and upgrade your deck with cards that cost energy, discards, blood, and MORE!!!

details.title: STILL WATCHING: The Night Caregiver
details.short_description: Your real smartphone is your only weapon... Sync your phone with the game and pray it doesn't ring while you're hiding in the closet.

details.title: NoOneKnowsME.
details.short_description: You are not human—and no one can ever find out. NoOneKnowsME. is a psychological horror adventure set aboard a spaceship. Complete daily tasks, survive tense conversations, and hide your true identity for seven days as you make your way back to Earth.
developers: 箱詰めプロダクション

details.title: Is Gambling Bad For Business?
details.short_description: Grow a company from one tiny office into a billion dollar HQ tower, then bet it on a coin flip. Hire from CVs, survive crises, keep the board happy and don't go bankrupt. Build only with gambling winnings. Then go online: buy land from cities and conquer other players' plots at blackjack.

details.title: The Falling Skies
details.short_description: Explore a cursed forest where the past refuses to die. As a new forest ranger, uncover the truth behind a forgotten tragedy, navigate shifting paths, and face mysterious distortions that blur the line between reality and nightmare.

details.title: DRAWCERY
details.short_description: Draw your spells. Command the elements. DRAWCERY is an online PvP spell-summoning game with unique, draw-to-cast combat. Sketch elemental symbols in the heat of battle to unleash real-time magic and outplay your rivals like a true wizard.

details.title: Infiniterra
details.short_description: A voxel sandbox focused on atmosphere and contrast. Explore layered worlds, survive eerie nights, and uncover what lies beneath the surface.

details.title: Incrawler
details.short_description: An incremental dungeon crawler where you slay enemies, collect loot, and build powerful hero synergies. Master skill trees, invest in unique traits, and prestige to push deeper and defeat challenging bosses.

details.title: Three Kingdoms Stratagem
details.short_description: A retro-inspired, narrative-driven turn-based tactics RPG. Enemies telegraph their attacks before executing them, and it's up to you to disrupt them. Lead your heroes to victory to restore the Han dynasty!

details.title: DwarVein
details.short_description: Welcome to DwarVein, a world where you a trusty dwarf venture forth into inhabited caves on the search for valuable Gems. Careful though, there are creatures lurking in the dark abyss. They have stolen your trusted companions and hid them within the caves! Will you achieve the highest score!?

details.title: Math Defense Protocol
details.short_description: Deploy characters across a fractured mind, combine numbers and operators into equations, and turn every result into firepower. Build your squad, trigger bonds, and defend the last memories through story battles and endless challenges.
developers: 日食网络 Solar Eclipse studio
publishers: 日食网络 Solar Eclipse studio

details.title: Spear Dive
details.short_description: Hunt 80+ fish species in a first-person freediving sim. Learn their habits and manage oxygen and body heat. Gear up with spears, fins and wetsuits to dive deeper. Explore seas with daily changes in temperature, murkiness and waves, fill your fish encyclopedia and unlock new fishing grounds.

details.title: Arcade Together
details.short_description: Run the arcade. Play the arcade. Together. Team up with friends to run your very own arcade! From classic cabinets to extreme experiences, from a corner shop to a grand entertainment center — build your arcade empire, side by side!

details.title: Dungeon Typist
details.short_description: Dungeon Typist is a typing-driven dungeon roguelite where every word becomes an action. Type words to move, attack, and cast abilities while enemies act in real time. Dodge danger, collect gear, and build powerful combinations as you venture deeper into the dungeon.

name: Tidy & Bright: Together at the Christmas Market

details.title: Tidy & Bright: Together at the Christmas Market
details.short_description: Cozy first-person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort gifts, sweets, decorations, toys and festive treats. Tidy up the Christmas market, earn points and restore order before the holiday crowds arrive!

details.title: Arcane Circuit
details.short_description: ARCANE CIRCUIT is a dark fantasy deck-building roguelite. Socket Core Cards into Emitters, chain Modules together, and create fully automated arcane circuits. Explore the wastelands, collect powerful Relics, and build your very own spell-slinging machine gun!

details.title: Re:Red
details.short_description: Stay on the path, Little Red. Spot anomalies in an uncanny, looping forest to reach Grandma’s house with your basket of goodies intact. If safe, press forward. If not, turn back immediately. Trust your paper map, explore strange new areas, and most of all, watch out for the Big Bad Wolf.

details.title: Me VS Demonking?Seriously?
details.short_description: This is a proper auto-battler game... right? Aside from the characters being a bit odd, the equipment a bit bizarre, and the skills a bit baffling... everything else seems pretty normal.

details.title: Pickup Point Chaos
details.short_description: Run your own pickup point! Receive, scan, sort, and shelve packages. Find customer pickups, then weigh and label outgoing shipments. Carry several boxes to save time, but customers may knock them down. Handle package rain, fragile items, and explosives—and don’t blow up the place!

details.title: Fishing Spot
details.short_description: Fishing Spot is a relaxing fishing game about discovering unique fishing locations and the species that inhabit them. Generate new spots with their own ecosystems, fish populations, bite schedules and bait preferences, chase records, and build your collection — all at your own pace.

details.title: Over The Gnome!
details.short_description: Become a giant gnome-crushing boulder. Chase the treasure gnomes, shrink the giant yetis with your shrink ray, grow and improve until you crush them all. Travel through 5 unique worlds, prestige, and unlock permanent talents to become unstoppable.

details.title: Screen Nook
details.short_description: A book nook for your desktop. Tiny, lit 3D worlds that live at the edge of your screen and follow your real hours. Nothing to win, nothing to grind. Just somewhere lovely to glance at while you work or study.

details.title: MechInfection
details.short_description: Co-op survival horror for 2–4 players. By day, scavenge supplies across shifting locations; by night, defend your shelter from the things outside. Craft weapons, set traps, cook, survive together, and break out of a dead world before dawn.

details.title: Haeresis
details.short_description: Haeresis is a Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by the classic solo card game, Scoundrel, where you purposely put enemies into your deck. Climb your way up a dark, ruined cathedral to discover what truly lies behind the doorway of your religious pilgrimage.

details.title: Genius Simulator
details.short_description: **Play a god-tier genius whose subtle glance is misread as the world's salvation formula!** In this deck-building Roguelike, turn fanatical overthinking into strategy: observe your opponent's mental flaws, shatter their logic chain, or strike their blind spots for an instant kill!

details.title: Sontaku Soul: Read the Boss
details.short_description: Fail and you're fired! SONTAKU SOUL is a collection of rapid-fire microgames about Japanese business etiquette. Play as Tamako, a brand-new employee, and find the right move in every situation—bowing, business cards, seating order, toasts and more—to survive the harsh world of work.
developers: ブラック企業サークル
publishers: 株式会社セブンコード

details.title: Paceweaver
details.short_description: Backstab for double damage. Every enemy move is telegraphed in advance. Paceweaver is a turn-based deckbuilding roguelike fought on a single lane, where distance and facing decide everything. Slip between telegraphed attacks and get behind your foe.

details.title: Die Asche von Dornhain
details.short_description: A fully voiced German narrative game where choices open different scenes, relationships, and endings. Levin and his friends can die, go missing, or survive profoundly changed. No single playthrough reveals the whole story.

details.title: Roll Brighter
details.short_description: Tether up and prove your teamwork in Roll Brighter, a physics-based driving game filled with chaotic traps and fun obstacles! Coordinate with friends via a physics rope, or relax in solo mode as you navigate a vibrant, atmospheric world designed for a satisfying casual driving simulation.

details.title: Set, Bounce, Cheese!
details.short_description: Guide Squeaky, a courageous little mouse, on a physics-based quest to save his village from tyrannical cats! Instead of controlling Squeaky directly, place an unlimited supply of bouncy gadgets along his path to guide him past traps and collect every last piece of cheese.

details.title: ProutoPulsion: Fart on your friends!
details.short_description: Have you ever dreamed of farting on your friends? ProutoPulsion is a fart-ass-tic couch game where up to 4 players fly and fight each other using their ultimate weapon: large, loud, unbreathable farts. Show your friends who is the true martial fart-ist!

details.title: Hand Stretched
details.short_description: Run a wood-fired pizzeria covering three key roles, Chef, Waiter or Manager, over frantic 6 minute shifts! Can you and up to two friends keep the customers fed and the accountants happy? Or see off a rival shop in a head-to-head, best of three/five battle with up to five other players?

details.title: The Wind from the East
details.short_description: A hand-drawn school visual novel. In 2004, five students handed in a blue-cloth folder; it came back with the last page cut out. Twenty-two years later you sift the archives - race sheets, carbon copies, loan dates - to find those five and decide whose ending gets put back. Nine endings.

details.title: Hood
details.short_description: England, 1216. Experience the true story behind the Robin Hood legend as you control Williken of the Weald in this 2D pixel art stealth platformer. Explore, sneak, and fight your way through the forests, villages, and fortresses of Kent to take down the ruthless Castellan and save your family.

details.title: Squabblin Goblins
details.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer deckbuilding PvP with GOBLINS. Grab items, throw them at your friends, and craft a goblin so broken your friends will hate you.

details.title: Beyond the Rain Sound
details.short_description: You are the player, exploring a hospital that appears in your dreams while collecting fragments of memory and discovering what happened to you in this psychological horror game. As the story progresses, you will be forced to confront yourself. What awaits you beyond that...

details.title: 花散る社のハナビメ
details.short_description: Hanachiru Shrine no Hanabime is a Japanese-inspired sorting and idle game where you gather faith by discerning people's wishes and restore a once-abandoned sacred shrine. Enjoy a unique blend of peaceful, relaxing moments and fast-paced shrine duties as you rebuild the divine sanctuary.
developers: ハナビメプロジェクト
publishers: ハナビメプロジェクト

details.title: Pinball Millionaire
details.short_description: A physics pinball incremental game where every bounce earns money, triggers upgrades, and turns your board into a chaotic money-making machine.

details.title: Fetidity
details.short_description: Dive into the mysterious and terrifying world of Fetidity and help Mark solve all the puzzles and discover the secret of this place.

details.title: Diavento of Skyroar
details.short_description: The only weapon is the “Blade.” This is a bullet-hell action game that emphasizes the thrill of attacking. There are no attacks you can just fire off indiscriminately. Pilot the combat robot “Diavento,” dodge enemy attacks to build up energy, and turn the tide with a single strike.

details.title: SWIFTALE PLAYER
details.short_description: [Japanese language only] Solo TTRPG powered by your own LLM. All in-game text and player input are in Japanese; there is no English support.

details.title: Project Miasma: Prelude
details.short_description: A first-person sci-fi survival horror game. Board abandoned ships, explore their dark corridors, uncover what happened to their crews, and survive threats you cannot fight as something watches from the dark.

details.title: LIMINAL
details.short_description: You arrive skinless in an endless, fogbound world. Cross into 47 impossible realms, kill what lives there, and take gifts that mutate your body until you are worse than anything hunting you. Stay too long and the ground dissolves beneath you.

details.title: Succubus Busy Line
details.short_description: #Urban Fantasy Visual Novel Game#1v2 Demon Romance (BL)# You're a low-ranking succubus who just came of age in Demon City. All you want is to work hard and live a peaceful life, but two extraordinary demons keep stirring up trouble in your world...

details.title: Astralight: Pilgrim's Duel
details.short_description: A fantasy card game where a deck-building roguelike meets a TCG. Draft a deck, explore branching dungeon maps, collect relics and defeat hero bosses, or build your collection and duel with a 30-card deck.

details.title: Routes and Forges
details.short_description: A unique blend of RTS, Tycoon, and Tower Defense, where you are the architect, mayor, and commander of a growing village (and conurbation of villages). Your goals are simple: build a prosperous community, optimize production chains, and survive the horrors that emerge from the dark.

details.title: Arithmancy
details.short_description: Um dungeon crawler em primeira pessoa onde sua única arma é uma calculadora de bolso. Toda porta quer um número. Toda tecla que você aperta se desgasta. E quando o relógio do andar acaba, você vai ouvir passinhos.

details.title: Angel Ascension Exam: RE
details.short_description: The Angel Ascension Test. Join Marie, an apprentice angel, and take on brutal challenges with precise drag-jump controls in this hardcore platformer. Claim your place among the angels!

details.title: Kindling Wilds: Symbiotic Wasteland
details.short_description: Ember: Symbiotic Wilderness is a 2D pixel-art co-op survival game set in a living wilderness shaped by temperature, weather, seasons, and ecology. Start with a single fire, divide the work with your team, and build a camp that can endure.

details.title: Global Supremacy
details.short_description: A vast, real-time geopolitical simulation where 196 nations live and breathe at once. Economy, finance, monetary policy, trade, energy, military, diplomacy, nuclear strategy, politics, society — every lever that moves a nation is in your hands. The clock never stops — until you stop it.

details.title: Auto Empire Tycoon
details.short_description: Start in the 1950s with a small factory and a single dealership. Research new technologies, design cars, manage production, keep your dealerships stocked, and outpace your rivals to build your own automotive empire in this isometric tycoon simulation.

details.title: Neuro Cell
details.short_description: A survival horror game set in a dark, foggy city. Survive against fast, aggressive enemies whose brains are controlled by a rogue computer network. Manage your low ammo, explore dangerous streets, and stop the system before it hunts you down.

details.title: Project RESONANCE
details.short_description: Recruit AI bandmates with their own looks and stories, run a maid café together, and turn everyday moments into songs. Every album is generated live for your story—no two bands sound alike. Take music that's yours alone from a street-corner livehouse to the city's biggest stage.

details.title: Once Apond a Time
details.short_description: You crash down in a giant pond during a terrible storm. As you seek help for your broken wing, you'll meet new friends, explore the islands, and collect & craft items. Discover a heartfelt story about friendship and healing, all in a cosy 2.5D style.

details.title: Pawns into the Dark
details.short_description: Everything is visible but the Dark. Reveal tiles beside your pawns, step by step, in an 8×8 board-game-inspired tactical puzzler. Uncertain exploration meets deterministic combat. No misses, no critical hits: 3 ATK defeats a pawn with 3 HP. Read what's visible, use limited resources, and survive.

details.title: The Moth and the Moon
details.short_description: The Moth and the Moon is a rhythm platformer where each precise jump advances Clair de Lune. Guide a tiny moth across a forest lake, combining platforming skill with musical timing to complete the performance. You may even make new a friend along the way...

details.title: Rogue Space Convoy
details.short_description: Rogue Space Convoy is a roguelite space action shooter where you pilot a fighter, build a convoy, and choose branching encounters across five hostile passages. Disable enemy cruisers, salvage upgrades, and keep the Ark alive long enough to reach the gate.

details.title: Grumpy Dungeon
details.short_description: The dungeon is dying. It would rather die than say thank you. Fight through its halls with wisps living in your weapons and fighting at your side. Rescue every last spirit, grow them, evolve them, regrow its garden. It remembers everything. Collect all the wisps.

details.title: America Survival
details.short_description: You are the last Native Americans, the masters of the ancient land of the Americas, hunting, building homes, fighting off invaders, and surviving.

details.title: Muscle Kingdom
details.short_description: Grow it. Train it. Show it off. Raise mysterious creatures called "Macho" and dominate posing battles in this fresh bodybuilding brawler. Your battle cry decides the winner. Become the ultimate trainer!

details.title: Pedal Pedal Pedal
details.short_description: A chaotic physics racer where two tiny riders share one oversized BMX. Each pumps, steers and brakes, and the bike only goes where you both agree. Race a friend on one keyboard or online, or ride solo and control both riders yourself.

details.title: waga-mom
details.short_description: ――My curfew is 8 PM. Having a helicopter mom is annoying, but it's not a big deal.

details.title: Cozy Farm Life Simulator
details.short_description: Turn a quiet patch of land into a cozy farm. Grow and sell crops, raise animals, evolve helpful pets, upgrade your equipment, and expand at your own pace in a relaxing first-person farming experience.

details.title: Tavern Game Night
details.short_description: Gather 2–8 players for seven online party games in a cozy fantasy tavern. Compete in word games, trivia, dice, drawing and deduction, then put those skills to use in Tavern Race, where challenges can move several players toward victory.

details.title: BEACON 09
details.short_description: You're a prisoner sentenced to work at a crumbling lighthouse. Every night, you race against the clock, repairing whatever fails before your explosive collar decides your time is up. Repair, explore, survive in this terrifying first-person horror game.

details.title: Backrooms: Misstep
details.short_description: Backrooms: Misstep is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore unsettling liminal levels, complete unique objectives, survive deadly entities, and uncover a path through environments where every wrong turn could be your last.

details.title: New Babylon
details.short_description: A massively multiplayer voxel sandbox set in a true-scale, procedurally generated solar system. One persistent shared universe, no levels or tech-tree gates — build, mine, craft, and survive on a Darwinian frontier where every planet and moon exists at real 1:1 scale.

details.title: Interpolate
details.short_description: A Dark day follows every night. Nothing will stop the world's cycle; it's your choice to change the outcome. Some days are easier than the last, but the strong face the challenge.

name: They’ll Hang You for That Face

details.title: They’ll Hang You for That Face
details.short_description: Tomorrow, you burn at the stake as a "Werewolf". To save your family, you gladly accept a false execution. But after death, you witness them being ravaged in a living hell. Through a time loop triggered by your absolute despair, you must weave the world's kindest lie.

details.title: MURABO
details.short_description: SOLITAIRE + ROGUELIKE + 90s LATE NIGHT FEVER DREAMS = MURABO

details.title: Arvel
details.short_description: Arvel — Action RPG + hybrid RTS. Build a squad of mercenaries, clear dungeons for loot, raise an army, and fight over the Arkon. Solo, with friends, or 1v1 up to 3v3.

details.title: Golden Bay: Desktop Aquarium
details.short_description: Golden Bay: Desktop Aquarium is a cozy ocean-themed desktop idle management game. Place a transparent bay at the bottom of your screen, raise fish and corals, welcome diving visitors, and care for a changing ecosystem. Earn income, upgrade your bay, and enjoy a peaceful companion while you work.

details.title: Utaburg
details.short_description: Utaburg is an open-world MMORPG. Join a world that puts a strong emphasis on immersion. Combat is dynamic. Choose one of four unique classes, then at level 40 choose a second class that complements your first. Fight, explore, create guilds, shape the economy - you decide.

name: 洪荒修仙界 Primordial Cultivation World

details.title: 洪荒修仙界 Primordial Cultivation World
details.short_description: At the dawn of creation, demons rule and humanity faces extinction. Seize sacred mountains, claim spirit veins, carve a path to immortality — win a homeland for humankind. *Primordial Cultivation World*: a top-down 2D open-world combat RPG. Explore, slay, seize, breakthrough — reshape Honghuang.

details.title: Project TITAN
details.short_description: You start with a tiny mech factory, a pile of scrap, and one goal: make money. Manufacture parts, assemble mechs, and take on questionable contracts for clients who don't ask about ethics, just excellent margins. Grow your factory, upgrade your tech tree, and build the ultimate mech: TITAN.

details.title: Romantic Leases
details.short_description: Unsure of where life will take him, he has four very different women enter his life: Sofia, the sharp and decisive CEO; Yeseul, a faded star; Emily, his long-lost first love; and Nina, who's like a little sister to him...

details.title: Final Bulwark: Zombie Tide Defense
details.short_description: Build your final stronghold on this overrun land. Plan your defenses, unlock deadly weapons, and face the ever-evolving tide of the undead—every decision you make determines life or death both inside and outside the walls.

details.title: ODD EXIT
details.short_description: Snow outside, a TV hissing in the living room, and the same hallway waiting beyond the exit door. ODD EXIT is a first-person horror game set in an apartment from the ’90s. If everything looks normal, head for the exit. If you spot an anomaly, turn back to the entrance.

details.title: Dinosaur Apocalypse
details.short_description: Dinosaurs took over the Earth, and humans were almost wiped out. How would you survive?

details.title: CHAINSPIRE
details.short_description: CHAINSPIRE is a soul-like platformer for 1–4 players connected by a real physical chain. Your friend will become your enemy the very moment they stop listening to you.

details.title: MusicDamage
details.short_description: MusicDamage is a top-down multiplayer music shooter. Move, aim and fire to your weapon's rhythm in team battles and casual matches. Use cover and hazards, and enable optional fragment progression to collect rhythm fragments and upgrades that change how you play and build.

details.title: POLIS
details.short_description: Become mayor of a small Greek town and govern for 17 years. Citizens write you letters for years, the opposition never sleeps, and every promise is remembered. A satirical political city sim where the town never forgets.

details.title: The City Knows
details.short_description: A story-driven deduction game set in Okayama, Japan, where everyone has an answer—but you need evidence. Examine evidence and records, cross-reference witness accounts, reconstruct timelines, and separate plausible theories from provable facts across six murder investigations.

details.title: 罐头成长计划
details.short_description: 一款养成游戏，在游戏中，你将扮演妈妈，收养一只来自孤儿院的小罐头生物，前往罐头小镇抚养它，通过各种方式的培养来引导小罐成长为不同性格和职业，形成不同的人际关系 9名有感情线路的角色，游戏内包含钓鱼，换装，喂食，打工，战斗，抽卡机，五子棋，阵营选择，npc小任务等游玩方式 ·养成游戏 ·自由选择多结局

details.title: BLACKMURK: Shuffling Man
details.short_description: Fear is real. Sometimes tragedy needs nothing more than that. 💀 A short visual novel based on the story of the same name — about the silence that lets something shuffling into your home. 👁️👁️

details.title: Misguided Remastered
details.short_description: Misguided Remastered: Third-person action-horror. Silvia, high school girl trapped in otherworld nightmare. Desperately search for missing best friend & mom's cherished letter her only memory. Survive Indonesian folklore horrors with axe/knife combat, solve puzzles, uncover dark secrets!

details.title: Zombie Craft
details.short_description: Zombie Craft is an open-world survival, farming, ranching, factory-building, and trading game inspired by many beloved classics. Explore the continent freely, rebuild villages, and earn your fortune. And whatever you do—prepare for the night. They are coming.

details.title: You Can (Not) Do It!!
details.short_description: A fast-paced pixel art 2D platformer focused on high-skill parkour, where you dodge traps, clear tight gaps, and master abilities like wall sliding and double jumps across short, intense levels.

details.title: X Space
details.short_description: A sudden, devastating strike has reduced your interstellar voyage to ruins. As the sole survivor in X SPACE, you must rebuild your space base from scratch, assemble a versatile fleet, and pilot your massive mobile fortress into the depths of the universe.

details.title: Shothop
details.short_description: SHOTHOP is a violent retro boomer-shooter blending fast-paced movement mechanics with brutal combat. Utilize movement mechanics, cleanse the robot invasion, and restore the portal defense network. Reboot the grid. Survive the shift.

details.title: Gun Repair Shop
details.short_description: Become a master gunsmith. Repair, restore, customize, and test firearms in a detailed workshop simulator: buy parts, craft components, renovate classic weapons, and take them to the shooting range to prove your work

details.title: Diamond Legacy Online
details.short_description: Set in an ancient world, this MMORPG lets you develop your character, strengthen your equipment, and challenge guilds. Progress solo or with a party, take risks, and earn the rewards of your effort. In this world, power is not given; it is earned.

details.title: Snack Factory Together
details.short_description: Manage a snack factory together! Produce various treats for maximum profit. Upgrade machines, unlock new products, and deliver massive orders. Can you handle the demand?

details.title: Goblin Apocalypse: Open World Survival
details.short_description: The human king is dead, and the fragile peace of Turtek died with him. Survive as a goblin in an open world, solo or in co-op: sneak past raiders, fight with stamina-based combat, rescue goblins and peaceful humans, and build a colony that keeps working while you explore.

details.title: Yes, Your Majesty!
details.short_description: Outrageous! A century on the throne—peace and prosperity across the realm—yet my flag covers but a speck on the map? I keep an elite army, and all they do is parade for me! Guards! A grand campaign begins! — Yes! Your Majesty!

name: AI 位面旅者：无限世界

details.title: AI 位面旅者：无限世界
details.short_description: 《AI 位面旅者：无限世界》是一款由 AI 实时驱动的团队冒险 RPG。你带着队伍在位面之间穿梭：探索区域、完成任务、打怪、升级、招募同伴；也可以在信标塔手填世界观、区域、角色与部队，造一个完全属于自己的位面。剧情、敌人、事件全部由 AI 现场生成，没有两次冒险是一样的。每个角色都有自己的记忆与打算，会按自己的目标行动；你不在的时候，区域里的角色仍在自行流动。角色、装备、技能、血统分 D 到 SSS 品级，敌人与友军部队是成建制的单位；回合制战斗可手动指挥每一次出手。买断制，需自备 AI 服务商 API Key 驱动剧情。

details.title: Mightmancer
details.short_description: An old-school first-person action RPG set across a vast open world. Explore dungeons, fight hordes of enemies, master four mixable classes, recruit companions. Relive the iconic blend of 2D and 3D art unique to late-90s RPGs.

details.title: 永恒传奇之六道觉醒
details.short_description: 围绕这个奇幻大陆展开探索、战斗与角色成长，将传奇系列的装备追求、职业配合和公会对抗融入立体世界。 ⛏️ 独自深入矿洞，寻找成长所需的资源；与队友挑战首领，追寻稀有装备；或集结公会，在沙巴克城下争夺荣誉。选择你的职业与伙伴，开启属于自己的传奇征程！

details.title: Magical Angel Princess Lynn
details.short_description: Flashy action with the adorable Princess Lynn! Fight against the mysterious invaders threatening the city.

details.title: Party Rounds
details.short_description: Take a seat with your friends and survive the craziest table games! Pass the hot dynamite, fight for a chair when the music stops, pick the poisoned glass and pray when the lights go out. Every round someone is out for good — only one will stay at the table.

details.title: Desktop Xianxia
details.short_description: Desktop Xianxia is a cozy desktop companion that blends idle cultivation with farming. Set a goal and let your cultivator handle daily routines while you work or unwind. Grow your homestead, brew elixirs, craft gear, and explore new challenges at your own pace.

details.title: Next, Million Worlds
details.short_description: Expand your civilization to an empire of a million worlds. Balance production and logistics, experiment with economy mods, but don't sweat it. This is the age of expansion; growth is inevitable. This is a relaxed incremental experience where you can optimize and experiment, but you can't lose.

details.title: Ogrewhelmed
details.short_description: Get overwhelmed in this arcade-style arena bullet hell! Enter the arena with nothing but a shield and the loot you find along the way. Dodge, block, and face tank the barrage of projectiles. Will you overcome the ogre onslaught? Or will you become cannon-fodder?

details.title: Genuine Article
details.short_description: Vienna, 1901. A bureau that authenticates antiques: without your certificate the piece is worth nothing. Silver, paintings, watches, papers — each carries a truth and a lie about its history. A predecessor’s debt makes bribes tempting. And you won’t get this right every time — mistakes cost.

details.title: INNER EKO
details.short_description: A dreamlike first-person platformer about the thoughts you can't let go of. Explore a strange world, meet mysterious beings, and face yourself.

details.title: Touhou Sky Cruiser
details.short_description: Run a sky cruiser built by Tenshi. Expand it room by room with new floors and terraces, offer dining and entertainment, and carry guests from port to port as you grow your business above the clouds.

details.title: Hearth Fable
details.short_description: Hearth Fable is an ink-wash city-building management sim. Start with a blank scroll: gather wood, build trades, govern people, raise exotic beasts, and repel invaders as you paint your mountain-and-sea scroll step by step toward a paradise of your dreams.

details.title: Beach Manager Simulator
details.short_description: Clean, rent, build, and play! Run your own beach in this first-person management sim. Earn money from gear rentals, expand your facilities, hire staff, and tow banana boats full of guests. Go fishing, dig up treasure, and make the beach your own.

details.title: The Cozy Tree Co.
details.short_description: The Cozy Tree Co. is a relaxing game about chopping, decorating and selling Christmas trees. Search the winter wonderland for the perfect tree, get creative with your decorating, and sell your creations to spread holiday cheer!

details.title: Stockroom Syndrome
details.short_description: Build flatpack furniture and decorate showroom displays during the night shift in a giant Scandinavian furniture store, while demonic creatures hunt you through its ever-changing halls. HØLM. Build the room. Survive the store.

details.title: Touhou: Cirno's Snowball
details.short_description: Nobody's buying Cirno's bingsu because it's too small, so she's rolling a snowball around Gensokyo to fix it. Strawberries stick. So do crates, rocks and frogs. See what kind of bingsu you can make.

details.title: Devour & Evolve
details.short_description: Born at the bottom of the food chain in a first-person labyrinth. Devour what you weaken and keep one of its skills or traits, or bind it and breed it at home: its egg is your next body. The blood remembers. Train what you eat, fuse it into new arts, and evolve into branches your line never had.

details.title: Doctrine Strike
details.short_description: Modern real-time strategy in real cities. Pick a place on Earth, generate its real landmarks in 3D, shape the terrain, design your own units and factions, then fight combined-arms wars with superweapons on the map you built. Free to play.

details.title: The Seeker
details.short_description: The Seeker is a three-character roguelike deckbuilder with a separate furry LGBT visual novel. Combine characters and classes into one shared deck, choose your route, collect cards and Tarot Blessings, and earn rewards to unlock stories and new build options.

details.title: UNDELIVERED
details.short_description: UNDELIVERED is an exploration-based puzzle platformer in where PAR/Cel, a small, solar-powered robot must traverse an island in search of the parts required to repair the ruined boat of the islands residents.

details.title: Wish Impossible
details.short_description: Wish Impossible is a 1–4 player online co-op physics game where tiny gingerbread cookies sneak into sleeping homes to grant Christmas wishes — without waking anyone up. Move oversized objects, use ridiculous tools, and survive the chaos your friends create.

details.title: VELKOR
details.short_description: Survive a post-apocalyptic open world solo or in co-op for up to 3 players. Brave storms and emissions, build vehicles from scrap, establish your faction’s base and uncover the past. Make choices that shape lives and faction relations: every decision has consequences.

details.title: Ping & Prowl
details.short_description: Map the darkness, revealed only by movement. Play as a Ping searching for an escape or a Prowl hunting by echoes and footsteps in this asymmetric game of stealth, pursuit, and quick decisions.

details.title: 挂机魔女：星夜
details.short_description: 《挂机魔女：星夜》是一款融合桌面宠物、挂机探索、事件系统、合成制造与自动战斗的魔法养成游戏。配置技能链、研究科技、打造装备、获得伙伴，探索由骰子驱动的多重世界与事件。

details.title: Sherlock Mysteries: Victorian Investigations
details.short_description: Book-style murder investigation game set in Victorian London. Logic, Deduction and Attention to Details - use this to solve game mysteries. Unfold story chapters, investigate clues, visit London historical locations - and help to get murder into jail.

details.title: The Heroic Tale of Illumina: 0
details.short_description: The great world tree, Yggdrasil, has long stood watch over the world, providing shelter and bounty for its people. However, the arrival of Dark Lord Asmodeus has Yggdrasil and the world at large on the brink of ruin.

details.title: Menhera Maiden
details.short_description: A ‘Landmine × Yuri’ Visual Novel. To complete your master's thesis, you are forced to interact with these landmine girls—a decision that may well prove to be the most disastrous of your life. Your dialogue and choices will not only shape your relationships with the heroines, but also your thesis.

details.title: One Billion Ducks
details.short_description: An incremental journey about duck hunting with your canine companions. Shoot rare ducks, sell them, upgrade your abilities, and collect one billion ducks to combat world hunger!

details.title: 澄心大学
details.short_description: 《澄心大学》是一款校园题材剧情向视觉小说。在鲜活而平静的大学日常中，走近四位拥有不同故事的女主角，并通过选择与分支推动人物关系，走向属于你的青春结局。

details.title: God's Game
details.short_description: A young woman is reborn as a princess in a fantasy world. Haunted by memories of her past, she feels out of place and detached, but at least there is peace... until the death game begins once again.

details.title: Junkyard Stories: Rebirth
details.short_description: A dystopian sci-fi adventure where you're a broken robot carrying the consciousness of a legendary hacker. Cross landscapes shaped by war, scavenge supplies, hack systems and solve puzzles as your battery drains. Infiltrate Block-07 to find the person who can save your mind before it’s lost forever.

details.title: Kidnapped Simulator
details.short_description: Kidnapped Simulator is a first-person psychological horror game where you write your own replies to the serial killer holding you captive. Your words shape the encounter as you search for a way out.

details.title: WayBackers
details.short_description: WayBackers is a 2D puzzle game built on the core mechanics of Minesweeper. Control your character to navigate through blocks filled with hidden mines. Use your Minesweeper logic and instincts to forge ahead without stepping on a single one!

details.title: Rogue Machines
details.short_description: A roguelike building physics puzzle game. Buy blocks to build better machines to get the ball in the goal. Unlock more blocks, levels, and upgrades as you play more runs.

details.title: All Hands
details.short_description: Build walls, blast the terrain, and reroute thousands of furious customers through your own killboxes. All Hands is an incremental tower defence game about defending HQ, engineering excessive solutions, and turning corporate catastrophe into career advancement.

details.title: DoNotOpenTheBox
details.short_description: Do Not Open This Box is a 3D first-person room escape game where players solve puzzles to escape after opening a forbidden box. Find, repair, and manipulate objects among antiques such as toys, books, and wine bottles. The space subtly changes as each puzzle is solved.

details.title: Repentless DX
details.short_description: You are the imprisoned dictator. People of your country come visit. Survive as long as you can.

details.title: Frog Racing League
details.short_description: Recruit frogs, and turn them into champion racing frogs! Kit them out with hats and potions, then read the odds and bet your way to the top of the league. A pixel-art frog management sim that will satisfy your inner frog manager.

details.title: One Neck Ahead
