details.short_description: In One Neck Ahead, you play as Kid Giraffe on a journey towards the heart of the forest, where dreams come true. Carry your own ground, create your own platforms, and meet a cast of memorable characters, each introducing a new twist to the adventure.

details.title: You Got Me Killed!
details.short_description: Two players share one body: one controls the legs, the other the arms. Survive endless monster hordes, evolve your skills, summon bosses and blame each other for every death in this co-op roguelite bullet heaven.

details.title: The Hope Incident
details.short_description: In The Hope Incident, you take on the role of a nighttime supermarket employee. What starts as a regular shift quickly turns into a terrifying test of your skills. Serve suspicious customers, deal with the devastating effects of underground anomalies, and uncover the mysteries of GSO-7.

details.title: Baron Local
details.short_description: Rise from ordinary citizen to political kingmaker in a pixel-art political life simulator inspired by Romania. Build alliances, launch projects, survive scandals, and navigate corruption as you climb from local politics toward national power.

details.title: Nostos
details.short_description: A mint-tin sci-fi survival horror dungeon crawler involving dice, cards and nerve. Generate nailbiting stories in short runs that fit around your life. Lead a salvage crew through a derelict stalked by a predatory Endoparasite. Push your luck, scavenge to survive, and reach the evac in one piece.

details.title: Ancestral Trace : Singkawang
details.short_description: Ancestral Trace: Singkawang is a cozy 2D point-and-click puzzle adventure where you help Lie Jun Hao, a young man who returns to his childhood city after eleven years away, uncover the story his family left behind.

details.title: Cardfight: Conspiracy
details.short_description: A story-rich RPG told from multiple perspectives. A fusion of turn-based card battling and quick-time defense. Six classmates, each with their own decks - and their own secrets. Your name is SPARTAN JACK, your new friends are part of a deadly secret society, and you have a conspiracy to uncover.

details.title: Ultima Cenere
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder in a Mediterranean Italy after the end. Every run reshapes you: flesh mutates, body parts are traded for implants. You don't heal — you trade. Four classes, one journey to the last enclave. No loot boxes, no pay-to-win.

details.title: Kernel Override
details.short_description: INFILTRATE THE SYSTEM! Kernel Override is a fast-paced cyberpunk bullet heaven. SURVIVE intense 10-minute rounds against escalating waves of anti-virus software, MODIFY your malicious code with powerful upgrades, and UNLOCK permanent meta-progression to crack the core.

details.title: They Were Us
details.short_description: You're in for an exciting adventure about the main character Blake, who faces a ton of challenges before she uncovers the terrifying truth about this area. Various creepy creatures will appear along the way, as well as the surviving locals.

details.title: The Gastarbeiters
details.short_description: The Gastarbeiters is a 1-5 player co-op game about building when the whole world is against you. Build a house through explosions, assaults, and raging storms. Will you complete the construction and survive?

details.title: AJ's Anomaly
details.short_description: Short narrative driven horror. Play as Amelia Jalisco, a fashion designer locked in her apartment. Hangout with your imaginary boyfriend, use your anomaly therapy device, and explore your dreamlike surroundings.

details.title: Card Flipper
details.short_description: Flip cards, stack cash, and chase the jackpot until your fortune snowballs out of control! Card Flipper is a casual casino game with idle elements, where every flip pays, golden cards spark Frenzies, and even the bad habits make you richer. Flip, Frenzy & Fortune!

details.title: FlyMuse  2
details.short_description: FlyMuse 2 takes a “semi-conscious” electronic lifeform, based on a real fruit fly brain, on an adventure. Observe brain activity, tune neural circuits, and reshape the environment as you follow clues through homes, streets, and the underground world.

details.title: Cidle Online
details.short_description: Build your castle, gather resources, and raid neighbors in a shared idle world. Recruit soldiers, hunt dragons and krakens, complete daily quests - all while progress ticks forward whether you're online or away.

details.title: Hauntasy
details.short_description: Do you believe in ghosts? You and your chosen partner are top influencers invited to survive seven nights inside a haunted ancestral estate for $1,000,000. Monitor the rooms, manage your candles, and uncover what the Baron and Baroness are hiding before 4 AM in this psychological fantasy horror.

details.title: Party Executable
details.short_description: Trapped within the walls of Fauxidy Manor, you are forced to continue downwards into the horrors below in order to find the truth and make your escape. It's not all bad though! You get to talk with some wacky characters along the way and collect some cool stuff!

details.title: ReDead Frontline
details.short_description: ReDead Frontline is a post-apocalyptic idle defense game where the zombie outbreak has already won. Trapped in a time loop, you hold the line, recruit survivors, upgrade weapons, deploy drones, study enemies, and reset after each defeat to return stronger and break the cycle.

details.title: Study Nook
details.short_description: Study tools included: Pomodoro timer To-do list Built-in media player with a hand-picked selection of lofi, ambient, and orchestral music Internet browser to stream any audio (Full Version) Play fetch with your companion dog Tend to your garden

name: 渔港日记 Fishing Port Diary

details.title: 渔港日记 Fishing Port Diary
details.short_description: A cozy fishing port management game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Grow your fishing port, fish, build, and craft alongside adorable animal companions while enjoying a relaxing harbor life that keeps you company throughout your day.

name: Sea Land Air: Four Nations War

details.title: Sea Land Air: Four Nations War
details.short_description: Read the board. Read your opponents. A military board game of hidden information, bluffing and land, sea and air tactics. Play 4-player 2v2, draw identities and guess allegiances in 6-player 3v3, or face an opponent in a land duel.

details.title: Axis Flip
details.short_description: Physics based Arena Shooter. Up is down. Adapt or die.

details.title: Last Rail
details.short_description: Lead a train carrying the last survivors of humanity across a frozen world. Manage resources, explore abandoned locations, and make difficult decisions that will determine the future of Convoy 07.

details.title: The Demon Wins
details.short_description: Build each mercenary from the ground up in a permadeath dark fantasy auto-battler where there are no classes - only combinations. Find powerful loot, mutate attacks, combine skills, choose paths, and turn what you find into the power to win.

details.title: Beyond the First Star
details.short_description: Beyond the First Star is a fast-paced 2D side-scrolling shoot 'em up. Choose your pilot, shoot down supply carriers for weapon cards, stack up to four support weapons that fire all at once, and take on handcrafted stages and bosses with unique attack patterns.

details.title: The Helios Accord
details.short_description: The Helios Accord is a post-scarcity science-fiction grand strategy game. Govern by consent, set doctrine, negotiate with civilizations, and send Citizen Minds beyond known space. Then Serenity of Dawn disappears. No wreckage. No distress call. Only an impossible signal that changes when observed.

details.title: Iron Grave:Planet 9
details.short_description: Iron Grave: Planet 9 is a sci-fi mech survivor game. Pilot multiple mechs with unique skills and evolution, slaughter enemies, unlock upgrades. Set on the ninth planet over a century from now, fight alongside your squad and become a hero.

details.title: Human Echoes
details.short_description: One day, a disaster known as "The Great Blank Event" erased every artwork in the world. As AI came to dominate art, science, politics, and society, you—a painter—lost an art competition to an AI and abandoned your passion. Everything changes when a mysterious black-haired maid appears at your door.

details.title: OutGraft
details.short_description: A high speed runner action game where you're always being chased. Vent your heat to knock enemies back, and survive with the power of parasites.

details.title: Bow Warfare: Multiplayer Combat
details.short_description: Step into a fast-paced archery arena where timing and precision mean everything. Outmaneuver rival players, adjust to changing battlegrounds, and make every arrow count. Ready your bow and dominate the field.

details.title: Beneath the Snow
details.short_description: One walk home becomes a journey through a fractured reality. Shift between two intertwined dimensions, where mirrors reveal another world, impossible spaces hide forgotten paths, and some routes only exist in the reflection.

details.title: 姐姐是我的猫
details.short_description: My Sister is My Cat, a Japanese otome dating sim. You play a physics prodigy with severe androphobia — until her stepbrother becomes the only exception. Balance classes and social life, raise stats, romance three leads, unlock multiple endings. Your choice decides who stays.

details.title: WWII Commanders
details.short_description: Turn-based WWII strategy on hex battlefields. Command the USA, Germany, Japan, or the UK across 13 historical campaigns, mastering terrain, fog of war, and counter-based combat.

details.title: Mycelium Queen
details.short_description: Pachislot × Roguelite! Build what's on your reels, then take your machine through eight Corridors. A 77-game ceiling, RUSH continuation up to 90%, and every boss fight reshuffles the Setting — your luck is yours to seize!

details.title: 5th Frontier, The New Space Race
details.short_description: A 4x Turn-Based Single Player Strategic Space game. Design and build Your own space ships, planet and battle-stations to conquer the Galaxy.

details.title: Checkmade
details.short_description: Want an Engineer who can revive pieces back? Or a Rook that can move 1 square diagonally? Maybe a Pawn that can also go backwards? Well you got all of that in Checkmade. Custom puzzles with Workshop. Build an army with a budget in the Lab, take it into a match, and find out if the theory holds.

details.title: My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge
details.short_description: Brokk has set up a tiny forge just above your taskbar. You tap the keys, he swings the hammer. Mostly it is horseshoes or kettles, sometimes a legendary sword. Brygida sells it all in their shop. You type, he smiths. Together, the work goes faster and feels better.

details.title: Coilbound
details.short_description: Coilbound is a dark fantasy roguelike where every enemy is a card of hidden traits. Descend a coiling dungeon, read each foe's abilities, and choose your path one card at a time — strike or slip past. But some traits refuse to end: it doesn't die when it dies.

details.title: Tulip Simulator
details.short_description: A Tulip simulator where you crossbreed tulips, uncover impossible genetics, and discover flowers that have never existed before, from delicate heirlooms to crystalline wonders and blooms kissed with gold. Capture your rarest creations and share them with the world.

details.title: Winds of Valor
details.short_description: Winds of Valor is a loot-focused fantasy RPG, reminiscent of retro computer games from the 1980's. Explore a vast continent, battle a diverse set of foes, complete quests, and find powerful items along the way that define your character.

details.title: Desktop Elf: Raising Story
details.short_description: Raise spirits on your desktop! Hatch 100+ species, give gifts, breed rare variants, and build a cozy home. Combine elements, skills, and runes to challenge stages and towers, or send companions to explore and gather resources. Enjoy idle growth and everyday companionship.

details.title: Iron Wake
details.short_description: Iron Wake is a free 1–4 player co-op action roguelike. Hold the line in first person against escalating medieval hordes, spend your gold between waves, and stack relics until your build gets ridiculous.

details.title: Anseium
details.short_description: A brief essay on desires and the consequences of having them. Feed an insaciable sovereign, explore surreal environments, and seek the hiddens ambitions within those who surround you.

details.title: MOBBED
details.short_description: MOBBED is a chaotic zombie wave shooter for 1–4 players. Survive solo or with friends, earn cash from kills, unlock the map, customize your weapons, and stack ridiculous augments. Fight strange zombies, revive your crew, and hold out one round longer.

details.title: Mio: Resonance
details.short_description: Talk in real time with AI characters who remember you. Customize their personality, appearance, and voice, then keep your unique companion by your side in desktop companion mode.

details.title: Pilipka
details.short_description: A hand-drawn adventure based on Belarusian mythology and folklore. Pilipka just wanted to finish his shift at karchma and come home for dinner. And then so much happened that now he has to go on a trip to get Fern Flower in the company of his friend, a talking mouse.

details.title: Debts & Jackpots
details.short_description: Start broke, crack safes, chase jackpots, and build your fortune. Upgrade your operation, hunt for rare treasures, and fight your way out of crushing debt!

name: The Shaman: What's in Your House?

details.title: The Shaman: What's in Your House?
details.short_description: "Something is in your house." As a Shaman, you are the only one who can face the unknown. Investigate haunted homes, uncover secrets, and exorcise malevolent spirits. Your choices determine the client's fate. Experience a chilling K-horror story where every decision matters.

details.title: Mini Survival: final adventure
details.short_description: Build a shelter in a world overrun by zombies. Recruit survivors, grow food, craft equipment and venture into dangerous regions for supplies. Fortify your base, defend against zombie waves and bring rescued pets along on your next expedition.

details.title: 天机：大唐重构
details.short_description: Tianji: Reforging Tang is a 2D side-view deckbuilding rogue-like set in an alternate late Tang Dynasty. Play as a modern science student, build Physics and Chemistry decks, break enemy armor, read hidden intents, and reshape the fate of Tang.

details.title: Cook Cook Village ~!
details.short_description: 《Cook Cook Village》 is a deck-building roguelike where you run shops using resource tokens to gain certain amount of fullness. Operate your shops day by day, earn rewards from villagers, and build a deck that leads to big success.

details.title: Memory Farm
details.short_description: Memory Farm is a nostalgic farming mobile game. Return to childhood: farm, raise poultry, gather wood and harvest. Unlock shops as the main house upgrades to cook. Complete tasks for upgrade resources. With various gameplay, renovate the barren courtyard into a thriving one.

details.title: Index 1391
details.short_description: In this techno-gothic roguelike deckbuilder, journey to the heart of a twisted Sanctum to destroy the VIRUS infecting your faith. Wield sacred cards to defeat corrupted foes, build a powerful deck, and equip rule-altering Doctrines that reshape the rules of combat.

details.title: Tileburg
details.short_description: Tileburg is a game where each tile played has direct effects as well as powerful combos that trigger as soon as the conditions are met. Transform the landscape and develop your city while scoring points. Each turn, the city expands on a random tile!

details.title: Gladiator's Revenge
details.short_description: A roguelite where you are the gladiator. Pick one of nine fighters, each with a strength and a weakness. Walk the map, choose your fights and rise from slave to champion. Every win brings a new skill. Buy armor you can see on your fighter, and find 100+ items that change how you fight.

details.title: Signal Zero
details.short_description: A sci-fi roguelike shooter where aim and movement are unified into one mouse. Pilot a Simuler, command your ship, deploy escorts, and tear through colossal bosses. Easy to grasp, ruthless under pressure.

details.title: CandyPop
details.short_description: The Great Sweet Battle Begins! "CandyPop" is a confectionery war set in the Land of Sweets! A top-down, all-direction chaotic battle shooting action game! Are you ready?

details.title: Blokour
details.short_description: Jump, build and fight through the dungeons of Blokour! In this puzzle platformer, you place and break blocks whilst solving puzzles and dodging dangerous traps. Featuring 125 levels, 4 boss fights and more than 60 different types of blocks, you'll venture through a wide range of exciting challenges.

details.title: Urban Feather
details.short_description: Urban Feather is a local co-op digital tabletop game for 1-4 players about avian migration. Navigate a procedurally generated city, manage environmental hazards, and learn real-world strategies to prevent bird-window collisions.

details.title: Prevent WW3
details.short_description: You have no direct power - only diplomacy and influence. A global strategy game where you lead an international organization: stop conflicts, resolve economic crises, and restore stability before the world descends into chaos.

details.title: Pachinko Life
details.short_description: A bullet hell pachinko roguelite where the board shoots back.

details.title: The Outpost: Outer Frontier
details.short_description: Lead the forces of a human empire in a brutal squad-based RTS. Capture territory, fortify the frontier and crush the alien swarm in a story campaign, survival operations or online co-op for up to four players.

details.title: Rock Diver
details.short_description: Become a Rock Diver as you travel across alien worlds, extract valuable minerals, upgrade your gear, and get nice and friendly with hordes of local wildlife.

details.title: 回圈Loop
details.short_description: You awaken alone on a deep-sea rig. Your only companion is a decaying AI: LUMEN. In 20 minutes, everything explodes. Die. Wake. Remember. Escape this psychological horror loop—but do you really want to know the truth?

details.title: Triad: Elemental Saga
details.short_description: A tactical card battler with dynamic decks. Pick three heroes, each channeling Fire, Water, Earth, or Air, each chasing a personal quest. Complete in-match quests to earn resources, and unlock epic items and spells from your Archives.

details.title: Neon Arcade
details.short_description: There is a place where arcade machines never die and the desktop never sleeps. RiderOS is your portal to 50+ neon-soaked games across every genre, all breathing the same electric air. Log in. Pick a window. Lose the evening.

details.title: Fearless Crew
details.short_description: Fearless Crew is a monster-hunter co-op game where you and up to 3 friends hunt monsters and bring them back to the ship. Each monster is caught in a unique way, with different tools - so be smart about what items you use and when. Even you might get caught off guard by the very tools you use

details.title: Exipath
details.short_description: Uncover memories, decipher clues, and evade the darkness in Exipath, a survival horror game following the story of Scarlett Shinohara as she falls into the abyss of her greatest nightmares in search of a brighter future.

details.title: Block Machine
details.short_description: Block Machine is an elimination-style Roguelike game inspired by Tetris and slot machines. Pull down the lever. You will complete the elimination through random choices again and again, obtaining more items and achieving higher scores.

details.title: On Time In Full
details.short_description: Manage dev teams. Hit deadlines. Deliver quality. OTIF is a kanban board simulation where every hire, every card, and every decision has a cost — and the client is watching.

details.title: War for Ylinthia
details.short_description: Based on the “Ylinthian Chronicles” novel series by M.J. Macourek, this easy to play PVE combination of Real Time Strategy and tabletop games allows for infinite replayability.

details.title: CRIKEYMAS
details.short_description: CRIKEYMAS is a chaotic platformer SUPER HAMMER ACTION GAME where everything is possible with your trusty hammer. Help Mr. SANTER's errand boy reindeer to smash through delightfully devilish levels!

details.title: 疾擎速骋Rapid Engine Speed
details.short_description: 《Rapid Engine Speed》 is a realistic motorcycle racing game focused on authentic handling. Ditch the convenience of automatic shifting, and experience the full manual gear-shifting process from pulling the clutch and shifting gears to throttle control.
publishers: 重庆疾擎速骋科技有限公司

details.title: Whale Cleaner
details.short_description: Take charge of a deep-sea wash station for filthy marine giants! Upgrade bizarre bio-industrial tools to scrub whales, dolphins, sharks and other mysterious beasts. Get them spotless before Mr. Claw docks your pay in this relaxing, atmospheric, and satisfying cleaning simulator. Find hidden secrets!

details.title: Fixpert
details.short_description: Fixpert is a classic block-pusher style puzzle game. Help the titular Fixpert repair the factory and solve it's many head-scratching brain teasers! Using crates as bridges to cross bodies of water, buttons to open doors and power battery-chargers, managing fires and explosives, AND MORE!

details.title: Grow/Tend/Reap
details.short_description: Every seed you plant removes a card from your deck. Every harvest brings it back. Your farm IS your deck. Grow crops. Tend fields. Reap what you sow.

details.title: Smoke Easy: Hookah Lounge Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own hookah lounge! Seat guests, pack the bowl, keep the coals burning, put out fires (literally) and grow your business from a tiny spot to a place worth staying for.

details.title: DOOMFRONT
details.short_description: Ever wonder what happens when you mix high-octane progression and a rogue-lite dungeon-crawler? Well I did, and you're about to find out. Travel from room to room at extreme speeds fighting and looting any foe who dares to stop you in your tracks.

details.title: What The Dog Doing?
details.short_description: A relaxing idle digging game that sits at the corner of your screen. Work (or don't) while your best friend digs for items, collects treasures and unlocks new biomes and outfits.

details.title: HellFactory Inc.
details.short_description: Run a factory in Hell. Automate production lines, hit monthly revenue targets, bribe the board of Seven Deadly Sins, and skim slush funds to seize control — before they terminate you. A roguelike fusion of factory automation and boardroom politics.

details.title: Project ACCIPITER
details.short_description: "We’re elite, undefeated, and ready for anything. But UOOHHH~ zombies?! Nobody trained us for this!" Join Squad ACCIPITER in their story and face the chaos in this isometric zombie apocalypse!

details.title: Backrooms: Echo
details.short_description: The next level of Backrooms games. Co-op for 1–4 players. Procedurally generated levels, terrifying entities, and a realistic atmosphere. Every playthrough is a unique experience. Try to find the way out, but don’t trust everything you hear and see.

details.title: The Life You Missed
details.short_description: The Life You Missed — you achieved success, but lost yourself along the way. In an old house, you uncover someone else’s life — and your own. Relive memories and face choices in your dreams. Every decision shapes the ending.

details.title: PAWSTRONAUTS
details.short_description: A co-op pixel art platformer about 10 animal astronauts crash-landed on a hostile alien planet. Every character is a life. Stomp, grab, and throw enemies through 6 worlds and epic boss fights. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op.

name: Exit Liquidity: Wall Street Trading Sim

details.title: Exit Liquidity: Wall Street Trading Sim
details.short_description: You have a few dollars and a hunger for more. Navigate decades of economic booms, tech revolutions, and devastating crashes in this deep turn-based simulation. Will you build a legacy through meticulous analysis, or seize power through hostile takeovers and political shadow-play?

details.title: Long Rescue
details.short_description: Long Rescue is a Survival Roguelite where you battle waves of enemies across multiple worlds in pursuit of the villain who stole your dog. Build and customize your character with crazy ability combinations to grow into a powerful force capable of defeating your nemesis. Will you rescue your dog?

details.title: Paycheck to Paycheck
details.short_description: A life sim where you grind late-night jobs to pay off debt. Manage hunger and fatigue as you work. Want a shot at turning your life around? Scratch and pray!

details.title: Historarium
details.short_description: Shape continents, civilizations, and see the rise and fall of empires. Follow individual characters as they rise to power. Or as mighty rulers fall to irrelevance. Create nations and see them evolve through the centuries. Or destroy it all and watch civilization react to your actions.

details.title: KILLWORLD
details.short_description: [KILLWORLD] is an open-world first-person shooter. Explore the territory, raid enemy outposts, battle armed patrols, use vehicles, discover secret locations, and choose your own combat style in a sandbox where freedom of action and dynamic gameplay are paramount.

details.title: Papers or Death ⏱️
details.short_description: Screen travelers in a post-war world where lies are common. Check documents, spot inconsistencies, and decide who passes. Take bribes or stay honest—your choices shape the outcome. No action, just tension, tough calls, and hidden truths.

details.title: Feast for Frogs
details.short_description: Leap into this incremental game about frogs with strange abilities. Upgrade your abilities, get more powerful frogs, and eat more bugs!

details.title: Melody Teacher
details.short_description: Melody Teacher is a cozy hidden object & rhythm game. Explore relaxing scenes, collect hidden musicians, and play their melodies to build the soundtrack one layer at a time.

details.title: Don't Mention B3
details.short_description: Work the night shift in an underground parking garage. Verify drivers, credentials, surveillance footage, and internal records, then decide who gets through. Remember: There is no B3 level.

details.title: Lucifaria
details.short_description: After two other priests vanish, a retired exorcist is called upon to eradicate an ancient demon. Enter a thrilling single-room turn-based horror RPG requiring strategy, sacrifice, and perseverance.

name: Blue Men Group ULTIMATE VIDEO BLACKJACK

details.title: Blue Men Group ULTIMATE VIDEO BLACKJACK
details.short_description: The Blue Men Group are energetic, enigmatic, interacting, arousing, performing, embarrassing, feeling, alarming, inspiring, desperate, hateful, impressive and performative. Join us at computer playing our Ultimate Video BlackJack collection. Unlock video, gameplay, get blowmanjobs, you will enjoy

details.title: DiceVenture Dungeon
details.short_description: DiceVenture Dungeon is a roguelike dice-building dungeon crawler. Choose your path, roll and reroll to unleash class skills, and craft your build with dice, relics, and traits. Take on dice challenges for greater rewards—every run brings new choices and combinations.

details.title: Grid Gear TD
details.short_description: Why settle for a tower that only does one job? Slow the front line with Cryo Round, yank the pack into a black hole with Gravity Well, and fry the pileup with Chain Arc. All on one tower—as long as you can fit them onto the grid.

details.title: A Game About Popping Bubbles
details.short_description: A relaxing, cozy, classic screensaver-inspired game about popping bubbles with satisfying VFX and SFX. Upgrade your equipment for even better pops, unlock achievements, and uncover a mysterious secret.

details.title: DUAT
details.short_description: DUAT is a first-person survival horror game blending exploration, puzzles and psychological horror inside ancient Egyptian pyramids. Explore forgotten tombs, solve deadly mechanisms, uncover ancient secrets, evade relentless horrors, and survive the darkness.

details.title: Whale Simulator
details.short_description: A livestream management sim. Lead your streamers all the way up — numbers climbing — until they stand on the national-champion stage. You're more than the operator behind the curtain. When the mood hits, you can jump in yourself, throw gifts, and fight the whole room for that number-one spot.

details.title: Parallax: Axis
details.short_description: AXIS is a 3D spatial puzzle where your route becomes music. Move along a cube’s X/Y/Z axes, collect stars and rings, dodge obstacles and reach the gate. Each move changes rhythm, pitch and resonance. Explore 150 stages in six Halls as guides fade and your path leaves a trace in sound and form.

name: Little Witch’s Lodge A Cozy Magical Cleanup Game

details.title: Little Witch’s Lodge A Cozy Magical Cleanup Game
details.short_description: A young witch has accidentally cast the wrong spell and turned her cozy lodge into complete chaos. Books, potions, bottles, and magical objects are scattered everywhere. Your task is simple: explore the lodge, collect every item, and return it to the correct place.

details.title: Worldrift: Unscripted Narrative RPG
details.short_description: Unscripted narrative RPG. Pick a world, meet its cast, and say anything — a live AI narrator writes the story around your choices while real game systems track wounds, skills and money underneath. Worlds remember what you did, and you can carry your story from one world into the next.

details.title: Nordic
details.short_description: Nordic is a PS1-aesthetic "foddylike" cross-country skiing game that can be online or single player. Nordic captures what makes cross-country skiing great; rhythm & cadence, the calm of nature and exploring the natural world with your friends! Race, ski and discover the beauty of winter.

details.title: AstroPoly
details.short_description: A pixel-art space mining game. Dig into procedurally generated planets, chart your own route across the star map, collect rare ores, level up your gear, and grow your fortune by investing in the market.

details.title: Road to FIRE
details.short_description: Survive a series of mysterious games and claim a fortune. Analyze the rules of seemingly unwinnable games, uncover hidden winning strategies, and overcome every challenge in this high-difficulty death game–style puzzle game.

details.title: Nightveld
details.short_description: A bullet heaven (a reverse bullet hell) where your only weapon is the light you see with. Widen the beam to see the swarm coming, or focus it to burn what's close, and go blind everywhere else. Survive to dawn, pick a power, and face a longer, hungrier Night. How many can you last?

details.title: Night Train Simulator: Blackout
details.short_description: A slow-burn psychological horror train simulator. Drive the train. Follow the schedule. Ignore what's outside.

details.title: Ripple Lane 101 : Moments With You
details.short_description: Share quiet campus dorm life with Yiling in an idle companion game. Focus with a Pomodoro timer, track plans and ideas, relax to Lofi and white noise, and choose outfits and decor. Explore her future world through stories fully voiced in Chinese, and uncover secrets about yourself.

details.title: OnlyCats
details.short_description: Pet cats, earn love, buy more cats. OnlyCats is a cozy incremental idle game where hovering over adorable pixel cats fills your coin and love stash. Unlock new cats, grow your collection, and discover more upgrades.

name: One More Release: Indie Studio Tycoon

details.title: One More Release: Indie Studio Tycoon
details.short_description: Build your dream indie game studio from a tiny office into an industry legend. Hire developers, create games, research engines, survive reviews, fight bugs, decorate your office, and make one more release.

details.title: Draw It, Forget It
details.short_description: Draw prompts in seconds, clear your memory with quick distractions, then decipher your own wonderfully confusing sketches. Play solo or join friends over LAN for voting, shared drawing challenges, and hilarious chains of drawings that drift farther from the original idea.

details.title: Shoot Some Rocks
details.short_description: A bullet hell roguelite about a lonely worker drinking alone in space on Christmas Eve. Survive waves of cosmic chaos, get a cold beer, and face five massive bosses inspired by real space calamities.

details.title: My Clay Planet
details.short_description: A cute and cozy desktop game where you care for a tiny clay planet, grow crops, place animals, and jump in to control your little friends as your world lives on your screen.

details.title: Chaos Conquest
details.short_description: Chaos Conquest is a casual incremental auto-battler set in a fantasy world. Mine gold, grow your army from a lone soldier into a mighty battalion, and watch as your soldiers defeat hordes of quirky enemies!

details.title: N.E.O.N. HORIZON
details.short_description: Build your own ship from the hull up. Arm it, install a variety of systems, break the rules — then survive relentless waves of escalating threats in this sci-fi roguelite shooter. Experiment with weapons, relics and powerful synergies. Reach Horizon.

details.title: Face Your Fate
details.short_description: A pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder where your deck spins the reels. Chain elemental patterns, stack your Fates into one huge hand, and fight your way up to the gods of Chinese myth.

details.title: Charon 卡戎
details.short_description: A point-and-click narrative puzzle game with a delicate art style and soothing pace. In this Underworld at the end of all things, guide souls who lost their memories and speech safely across the Styx. Luckily, our protagonist is about to face the most restless bunch of them all...

details.title: Ants Took the Kitchen
details.short_description: In Ants Took the Kitchen, you lead a small colony of ants determined to take over the kitchen. Collect crumbs, carry increasingly larger pieces of food, buy upgrades for each area, automate the collection process, and turn a simple corner of the floor into a hungry swarm.

details.title: Dice Knight
details.short_description: Dice knight is a dice builder rouge like. Roll for numbers and use those numbers on different actions. Discover food items of power, and become the Dice Knight!

details.title: Eclipse Island Primal Odyssey
details.short_description: Survive on a mysterious island where every choice shapes your journey. Explore ancient ruins, gather resources, craft essential tools, battle dangerous wildlife, and uncover the secrets hidden deep within Eclipse Island in this immersive story-driven survival adventure.

name: How To Get A Goth GF: 101

details.title: How To Get A Goth GF: 101
details.short_description: You’re down bad, your rizz is questionable, but goth girls are about to become your entire personality. Indigo’s evening course will teach you how to treat a goth girl right. Pass her lessons, survive the red flags, and pull a goth mommy - or get left on read in this chaotic dating-sim.

details.title: Aunt Hattie's Quilts
details.short_description: Grow your own cotton, gather natural materials, and craft beautiful quilts to delight your customers. Create lasting friendships within the community, and they might just reward you with new quilting templates! Expand your collection to unlock new designs and express your creativity.

details.title: Etched
details.short_description: A top-down action roguelite about a little mage who carves lightning itself. Etch engravings into your spells to reshape how they behave, weave engraving synergies into your own build, mow down monster packs, hunt buffed elites, and descend into ever-deeper arenas. What's carved cannot be undone.

details.title: ByteBuddies
details.short_description: Explore the depths of an abandoned world and figure out what is happening while you survive 5 nights fighting for your life.

details.title: Digging Up
details.short_description: Digging Up is a 1-4 player co-op digging adventure where you drill through a destructible alien planet, gather valuable resources, upgrade your gear, explore underground biomes, and dig your way back to the surface.

details.title: Reaper GoStop
details.short_description: You are dead. At the gates of the afterlife, judgment is settled over a game of Hwatu. Real Korean flower cards and authentic Go-Stop rules meet runaway score-multiplier deckbuilding. The hand you draw is the life you lived. Outplay the Reaper to pass, or fall to hell and face the gate again.

details.title: The Proxy
details.short_description: The Proxy is a narrative political simulation game set in a fictional nation, Leviah. The president is dead, and the office is yours. Sign papers that decide the fate of your nation, trade on secrets only you know, and juggle the ones who all want something. Protect the country, or protect yourself?

details.title: Golfever
details.short_description: Create, share and play endless unique 2D pixel-art minigolf courses. Powerful level editor, community maps, easy to learn controls but hard to master. The Steam launch includes multiplayer and expanded content!

details.title: Federal Cadet
details.short_description: Federal Cadet is a single-player police simulation and investigation game. Start as a cadet in Pinewood, patrol the town, question witnesses and suspects, analyze evidence, and rise through the department ranks.

details.title: Budget Defense
details.short_description: During the day, he personally drove the war vehicle to attack the enemy. At night, he extracted oil to sell and use the money to build defense towers, working together to protect the base.

details.title: Formula 2027: Grand Prix Legends
details.short_description: Take the wheel in Formula 2027: Grand Prix Legends, a single-player open-wheel racing game. Master 18 track configurations, compete against AI rivals, and upgrade your car through a 22-event career. Chase faster laps, earn medals, and race your way to the top.

name: 灯台の見守り — Lighthouse's Vigil

details.title: 灯台の見守り — Lighthouse's Vigil
details.short_description: On a dreary night, a lighthouse keeper must sweep their beam to guide lost souls ashore, and burn back the dark creeping from within.

details.title: Farm Bang
details.short_description: Raise living ammo, blast monsters, haul massive loot, and survive the debt collectors in this chaotic top-down farming shooter.

details.title: NowLoading Forever
details.short_description: Can you actually “play” this game!? Before you can play "FINAL TALES QUEST", you must first load the game data.

details.title: AIRSKIPPER
details.short_description: Run through stages in this fast-paced action precision platformer. Rack up a combo and maintain it throughout the stage to score big at the end, or create your own stages and share them with others!

details.title: A Sweet Treat for Nona
details.short_description: Your Nona lost all the rolling pins, go find them! Explore levels full of crazy sweets, where each introduces into a new unexpected mechanic. Mix ingredients, discover abilities, and face challenges in this pixel-art puzzle platformer.

details.title: Penance
details.short_description: A top-down action game about a crusader spending his final hours paying for the sins that ravaged everything he cherished. Fight through waves of powerful, high ranking imperial soldiers, with a Flame Meter that drains constantly and never refills.

details.title: Plucked
details.short_description: Up to 12 players, one pond. A top-down bullet-heaven roguelite where you merge your guns into increasingly stupid firepower, then find out how much of it one duck can hold. Survive the waves, outlive the swarm, quack responsibly.

details.title: SEO or Die
details.short_description: Start with a single website and build a sprawling online empire. Grow traffic, manage clients, expand your team, and survive fifteen years of internet evolution in a life sim and business management RPG where every decision can lead to fortune or failure.

details.title: ShardSpace
details.short_description: Shard Space is a minimalist strategy game. In the distant future, you awaken from a long slumber. Guided by a loyal lieutenant, you must rebuild your drone fleet and embark on a journey to uncover the ultimate truth of the universe.

name: 献祭浮木！我无限复活！（魔王传说）

details.title: 献祭浮木！我无限复活！（魔王传说）
details.short_description: A unique fusion of Roguelike, Deckbuilding, and Tower Defense! Play as the Reborn Demon King, deploy Chibi-style units, and use strategic Talent Cards to conquer the continent. Featuring the innovative "Story Card" system for uninterrupted combat.

details.title: 黑哨 DirtyRef
details.short_description: This is not just a football game! As the referee, we don't need fairness! We only want money! Buy lottery tickets, use dirty off-field tactics and contacts, and use your status as referee to become a billionaire! "It's not personal, it's business."

details.title: Clifton
details.short_description: Clifton is an open-world survival game set on a remote tropical island. Explore, survive its dangers, and find a way to escape before the island’s unsolved mysteries find you. Play alone or in online co-op with up to 4 players.

details.title: Pokorama
details.short_description: Run a boutique decorating studio where every client has unique tastes, quirks and expectations. Experiment with paints, fabrics and textures to create interiors your clients will love (or not), build your reputation, and unlock beautiful materials and interiors as your studio grows.

details.title: Islandustry
details.short_description: Find the best island, outbid your rivals and start exploiting it. Automate your production and watch the market to sell your goods at the right price. Use your profits to buy upgrades and make your production chain even faster.

name: Rashin Detective Chronicles CASE01 : The Final Page

details.title: Rashin Detective Chronicles CASE01 : The Final Page
details.short_description: A strange request arrives at the detective agency, concerning a missing homeowner. Explore a silent mansion and unravel the intricate puzzles hidden throughout its rooms. Why did the homeowner vanish? A mystery adventure where you pursue the truth.

details.title: BIT-HOLE: Neon Incremental
details.short_description: BIT HOLE: NEON Incremental is a compact, straightforward incremental experience. Eliminate viruses, collect data fragments, and unlock massive power spikes by decrypting legendary malware like the "I Love You" worm. A focused cyber-power trip designed for a short, satisfying session.

details.title: Baby Carbonara
details.short_description: THE BABY IS HUNGRY! Cook rats! Chop mushrooms! Handle raw uranium fuel rods??? Smoke cigarettes! FEED YOUR GLORIOUS BABY LEADER TODAY. Total VR Carbonara immersion. Absolute kino.

details.title: Stacko
details.short_description: In Stacko, remember your childhood while earning awesome prizes that change the way you play. Your goal is simple: stack the blocks as high as you can! Earn cards to modify the machine and plushies with powerful bonuses, all while playing this unique twist on the classic arcade experience.

details.title: JetBound
details.short_description: JetBound is a difficult game about flying. Stranded in space with a jetpack, upgrade your abilities and navigate deadly unique zones that constantly introduce new mechanics. No jumping. Pure physics-based flight with branching paths and high replayability.

details.title: Pirates Dig Deeper
details.short_description: Dig with your crew. Defend with your cannons. Pirates Dig Deeper is a co-op blend of digging and tower defense. Descend into the island, fight off rival pirates, and unseal the ancient temple to steal the elixir of immortality.

details.title: Leadville
details.short_description: Leadville is a grid-based hidden movement strategy game. Each turn, players secretly plan the movement and shot direction of their crew, trying to outmaneuver their rivals.

details.title: Ragnarok Mining Co.
details.short_description: Ragnarok Mining Co. is a satisfying planet demolition interval clicker set in a dystopian future where you are just a number in the corporate world. Scan for hotspots, fire your probes, and destroy worlds.

details.title: Defend Your Fish
details.short_description: An Arcade style strategy game where you must protect your bucket of fish from crabs, seagulls, and other such enemies. The goal is to survive as long as possible to build up your score, earn coins to unlock cosmetics and upgrades to help your future runs!

details.title: It Was Not a Suicide
details.short_description: A psychological horror detective simulation set in Rainier Falls in 2005. Uncover the truth behind Adele's death by finding contradictions in the case files. Are you brilliant enough to expose the suspects' lies in a single attempt? Because you only get one chance to make an arrest.

details.title: DECASTLE
details.short_description: A turn-based medieval fantasy deck-building game where every card shapes how you break enemy castles. Build your deck, plan your strategy, and unleash powerful actions to collapse fortifications in stylized, physics-driven battles.

details.title: Reefdeck
details.short_description: What if your deck was made of fish? Reefdeck is a cartoon underwater auto-battler roguelike where you collect, deploy, and battle absurd sea creatures. Crack open coral packs, build your roster, and survive bullet hell chaos beneath the waves.

details.title: MEMORY DEALER
details.short_description: You are a memory trafficker. Harvest stolen memories from captive minds and sell them to BRN CORP. Buy neural implants with your credits, but don't get addicted to your own supply, or you'll lose those memories forever. A shady cyberpunk idle game on your desktop.

details.title: IN:DARK RECALL
details.short_description: "I'm sure you'll find me." IN:DARK RECALL is a deep sea diving action game. You wake up at the bottom of the sea, as the target you'd been hired to eliminate.

details.title: Tax On Dice
details.short_description: Help Gibo to collect the King's taxes. Every season, roll dice to send Gibo in corresponding towns and collect their resources. In your downtime, buy dice and town upgrades to satisfy the ever-growing King's greed.

details.title: Synapse Idle
details.short_description: Grow a 3D neural network from a single neuron. Workers haul energy along radiant paths, buildings amplify every passing signal, and a 100-node skill tree reshapes how your synapse evolves. A calm, incremental idle game about watching complexity bloom — tinted in whatever colors you choose.

details.title: Victoria Kopernik: Monastery
details.short_description: Occult influencer Victoria Kopernik explores a cursed monastery in this short survival horror experience.

details.title: Greebly Gambit
details.short_description: Greebly Gambit is a chaotic fantasy smash-and-grab-style game where you play as a goblin trying to steal everything not nailed down in order to help revive the god of hope.

details.title: Game Show But Evil
details.short_description: A quiz show...but different!

details.title: SOS! Love~Controlled
details.short_description: [SOS! Love~Controlled] is a live-action interactive romance game. You wander into a bar called "SOS" and meet three girls: Hiyori, a rich closet otaku; Naomi, the gentle yet dangerous owner; and Ruina, a withdrawn lolita. A casual night out slowly turns into something far more mysterious.

details.title: Rune Tavern
details.short_description: This is an asynchronous PVP auto chess game. Arrange your runes and components, use energy transfer to activate as many rune skills as possible, and build a powerful lineup! In the face of randomly matched opponents, be the first to smash the enemy's elemental blocks and win more!

details.title: Mobius
details.short_description: If space has no end, where is the exit? Mobius is a gravity-flipping puzzle-platformer set in a looping realm. Cross screen edges to invert gravity and find hidden paths in symmetrical spaces. Solve physical puzzles to reach the mysterious door—what secrets await on the other side?

details.title: PATIENCE IS A VIRTUE
details.short_description: Something's hiding in the cassette. Rearrange the words of your enemies to investigate a small-town conspiracy in this mystery puzzle game.

details.title: Grandpa Needs Fish
details.short_description: Grandpa Needs Fish is a cozy idle clicker game where fortune rides the waves. You are Abraham and you have one mission: catch as many fish as possible. Every cast brings new rewards and every upgrade makes you stronger. Hover, catch, upgrade, and repeat in this satisfying idle incremental adventure.

details.title: Chrongrid
details.short_description: Chrongrid is an AI-driven narrative experience. Inside an author's story blueprint, you make your own choices and the world responds in its own way — every choice echoes, no two journeys alike. Built-in blueprints are the start; play others' stories or write your own, in any language.

details.title: PAWTENTIAL DISASTER
details.short_description: A chaotic physics co-op game where a pack of dogs must get one very unlucky baby back home and a avoid Pawtential Disaster.

details.title: DIG! DIG! DIG!
details.short_description: DIG Company hires you as a "Digger." Descend into abandoned mines to complete a mission - press the red button. Ride the elevator and DIG crystals to power it, choose characters with unique abilities, and escape terrifying monsters from the depths of the mines.

details.title: JERONIMO
details.short_description: JERONIMO is a roguelite shooter where you play as the Eraser against your eternal enemy: the Drawer, a frantic pencil who summons waves from his rolling lab. Wield up to 6 unique weapons, stack broken builds, and crush the hordes. Every enemy is a drawing from my 6-year-old nephew's notebook.

details.title: Chonkstars
details.short_description: Chonkstars is the ultimate multiplayer showdown where food is your weapon and being hefty is your greatest strength! In this arena, you'll be tossing pizzas, slinging fish, throwing eggs, and serving up absolute chaos. Gear up, because the fight to become the heavyweight champion has just begun!

details.title: Arena 2006
details.short_description: A sci-fi shooter inspired by the golden '06 era: a story campaign, arena modes with bots or online play, drivable cars and rocket jumps. No waiting queues, no microtransactions, no 60 GB patches. We're here to frag.

details.title: Memoware
details.short_description: MEMOWARE! A small adventure, exploration and puzzle game where you must record the history of civilizations that vanished without a trace in a mountain with no name. Collect all the MEMORIES and organize them in each book of each civilization in chronological order.

details.title: Unlander
details.short_description: Unlander is a survival video game where you explore the never-ending world of the banished. From hunger to monsters, everything is set to kill you. Uniquely, every action must be played with dices. As you progress, you will find upgrades and you’ll craft stronger items to defeat the nightmares.

details.title: HackOS
details.short_description: HackOS: The ultimate hacking MMO. Dive into a shared, ever-evolving world of espionage, dilemmas, competition & collaboration — all via your terminal. Inspired by classic hacking games and refined for modern players, HackOS combines the depth of simulation with the excitement of arcade gameplay.

details.title: War of Blobs
details.short_description: Massive multiplayer slasher combat, reduced to circles and sticks. Directional swings, real parries, two hits to die...and 60+ other blobs in the lobby trying to kill you first. Everything that doesn't sharpen the fight has been cut.

details.title: Falcon Fall™
details.short_description: Dropped deep in hostile territory with no backup and no way out but through. Every street is a kill zone, every shadow a threat. Built in UE5 by seasoned VR devs and combat vets, Falcon Fall™ delivers the most unforgiving tactical VR combat experience. Wishlist now - deployment scheduled for 2026.

details.title: SCP 1985
details.short_description: Welcome to Site 78 in 1985 where the foundation would experience one of its first major breaches. Escape the facility and survive the scps.

details.title: ByteCrawler
details.short_description: Pick a hero, build your swarm, and hold off enemy waves. Place units, watch your energy, and level up to survive in this lane-defense strategy game!

details.title: SUBSELF: Lies Deep
details.short_description: You are a prisoner offered a single chance at freedom. In exchange, you must descend into the depths of an alien ocean and recover lost data from a sunken research station, abandoned under mysterious circumstances by a powerful space mega-corporation.

details.title: Tasmon's Little Island ~ Cursed Mascot
details.short_description: Raise a mysterious creature "Tasmon" on your desktop!! No need to pay attention constantly, enjoy interacting with them in your free time. Once it has grown enough, you can challenge simple auto battles. The Tasmon's appearance upon birth will depend on what you do on your PC

details.title: The Quiet Days of Dorothy
details.short_description: During the 2020 lockdown, Dorothy spends her days caring for jars of sourdough starters. By sharing them with others, she builds unexpected connections and discovers small acts of kindness that bring warmth in difficult times.

details.title: Incremental Heaven
details.short_description: Start as a tiny mech, spread as a cosmic parasite, or rewrite reality as a living cursor. Destroy enemies, unlock hundreds of upgrades, evolve through massive transformations, and grow from scrapyard survivor to universe-shaping power.

details.title: Runic Tower
details.short_description: Stand as the last guardian of the god-bound Runic Tower in a groundbreaking 3rd-person roguelike tower defense experience. Command evolving powers, confront relentless invading factions, and utilize strategic planning to overcome your foes!

details.title: Petri: Microbe Swarm
details.short_description: You are a brand-new microbe. Grow a living swarm: send cells between colonies, upgrade them, and out-spread rival strains across five animal hosts, from fish to whale. Roguelike runs: pick a strain, mutate after every win or skip for a one-battle boost. Mouse, keyboard or controller.

name: Hold Then Break: Tanks on the Rhine, 1985

details.title: Hold Then Break: Tanks on the Rhine, 1985
details.short_description: 1985. Colonel Volkov has more tanks than you. He always will. Command an outnumbered British battlegroup in a hand-crafted Cold War RTS: Chieftains to hold the river line, Harriers from hides in the woods, artillery to break him. Hold the line. Then break him.

details.title: Brownie Clicker
details.short_description: Three out of four people prefer homemade brownies over homemade cookies. In Brownie Clicker, you're going to have more deep impacting choices, more depth, and more home-cooked goodness than you've ever expected from a mere 'clicker'. Production, world wide shipping, marketing and so much more!

details.title: HIT: Hold It Together
details.short_description: Break your rivals apart and hold yourself together in this voxel arena fighter. Battle in 4v4 matches with swords, bows and guns, where every lost block matters. Finish with more voxels than the other team, capture the central cube, or practise against bots.

details.title: Let 'er Ride
details.short_description: A Wild West roguelike based on casino Let It Ride. Post three bets, then pull them home or let ’em ride as the Board turns. Hire a posse of oddballs, beat crooked Proprietors at their own rules, and win Her back from the Baron.

details.title: Corehold
details.short_description: We lost the surface and went underground. Now the Core rises to take it back. Craft your Weapon from parts, build a new fortress every run and hold off thousands of creatures at once. Then grow your underground Outpost and take back the surface, one sector at a time.

details.title: Chaos Universalis
details.short_description: A grand strategy sandbox on a real globe. Start any day from c. 8700 BC to AD 1800 as a nation, a person or any entity, and just tell your friend Baibai what you want to do. Baibai plays out every side's reaction as you build your legend across 131 regions and 21,000+ individually drawn districts.

details.title: Minesweeper Survivors
details.short_description: Minesweeper meets roguelite survival! Reveal tiles and flag mines while your weapons tear through enemy hordes. Collect artifacts, create powerful builds, defeat bosses, and upgrade your arsenal between runs.

name: Feathered Fortune: Medieval Post Simulator - Prologue

details.title: Feathered Fortune: Medieval Post Simulator - Prologue
details.short_description: Run a medieval pigeon post, raise your flock, and take your first steps toward rebuilding the war-torn Kingdom of Melthoria.

details.title: The Third Day: Resurrected
details.short_description: The Third Day is a biblical science fiction adventure game in which we must guide Jesus in search of the truth through a story full of humor and satire.

details.title: My Dream Gym: Sandbox
details.short_description: Build your dream gym in a playful building and management game. Design the layout, customise your equipment, hire staff, and grow your business with plenty of room for a little chaos.

details.title: Pointaway
details.short_description: Untangle a board of winding arrows, one click at a time. Find a clear path for each arrow and uncover the picture hidden beneath.

details.title: SHOVEL BRIGADE
details.short_description: Shovel Brigade is a free-to-play multiplayer war sandbox. Dig trenches, build bunkers, defend your camp, and survive chaotic battles with friends. Your defenses are destructible, your orders are unpredictable, and your shovel is always ready.

details.title: A Wilder Menu
details.short_description: A Wilder Menu is a side-scrolling cooking and restaurant sim. Forage and hunt across islands, mix ingredients to unlock over 100 dishes, and serve dinner aboard your boat. Hire and train staff, hear their stories, and spruce up your place. Doors open tonight. The menu's up to you.

details.title: Void Frontier
details.short_description: Void Frontier is a space MMO featuring tactical combat, mining, trading, and exploration. Customize your ship, train your skills, and discover wormholes. Face pirates and rival pilots, or venture into space alongside your clan.

details.title: Professor - The Genetic Code
details.short_description: The first and only strategy game built on real science. Run a 1960s lab, hire the misfits, design experiments, publish or perish, and crack the genetic code. Relaxed turn-based mechanics, the madness of academia, a surfboard by the door. No STEM degree required, but it might take you half-way there.

details.title: Holdover – Long Range Sniper Simulator
details.short_description: A long-range shooting sim built on real exterior ballistics. You read the wind and wait for the lull between two gusts. After the shot, you see the trajectory in 3D and where the wind carried the bullet. Targets are steel plates and ring targets. No combat, no blood.

details.title: Gatefall
details.short_description: The tiniest hop can become a mighty leap. Charge your bounce, outsmart each world, and roll through the gate. Don't look down. (Look down.)

details.title: Survivors' Hotel
details.short_description: Survivors' Hotel is a zombie apocalypse themed social deduction game inspired by Among us that uses 3D and 2D art that can host a minimum of 6 players. It also has multiple horror elements and possibly a story for those who care to look.

details.title: Sort of the Apocalypse
details.short_description: The world ended. The mess didn’t. Sort over 10,000 scavenged supplies in a cozy first-person organizing game. Transform a cluttered bunker into satisfyingly stocked shelves, earn credits, and unlock upgrades to tackle the mountain of mess.

details.title: Cobblekin
details.short_description: Chop back the forest and grow a cozy village where every log, loaf and bucket is carried by busy little villagers. Raise families from tents to brick houses, catch the rain for the dry season, and hold your walls against orc raids.

details.title: Tiny Knit
details.short_description: Tiny Knit is a cozy building game where your valley is a knitted blanket on grandma’s table. Build anything you like at your own pace, with no goals to meet. Change the seasons when you like and look for cute secrets. The cat is always up for a pet.

details.title: Fish Fish Pop
details.short_description: A slow, cozy match-three under the sea. Swap, pop, and pick a new card every round. Thirty rounds, no timer, and you can't lose. The only question is how few moves you need. Oh, and the sea has secrets.

details.title: Finders and Keepers
details.short_description: Explore a living world at war, larger than the UK, with diverse fantasy nations, dungeons, conquerable outer realms and armies on the march. Create custom sword and sorcery defined by your orbits around the stars. An MMO easy to hop into as there is always something unique for you to find and keep.

details.title: Why Does the Ball Fall?
details.short_description: An idle and clicker game about dropping balls, over and over. Hit a goal hole and the ball rolls one lane deeper; miss and it is gone. Spend coins to seal holes, widen the goals and unlock fruit and animal balls, then keep descending lanes that go on forever.

details.title: 「認識」/RECOGNIZED
details.short_description: An analog-horror soulslike where you fight infamous internet emoji memes. When the smiling windmill stops spinning and every finger points at you, run. Swing an umbrella, throw empty cans, and survive one night recorded on a 2011 tape.

details.title: Jet Combat Sim
details.short_description: A low-altitude jet combat game. Fly mouse-aim jets based on the real aircraft's public technical data over an endless procedural world, score low passes and streaks, break through SAM belts and enemy fighters to the core, and climb a ladder of 38 aircraft from the MiG-15 to the F-35.

details.title: DUELANDS
details.short_description: The first-person 'psychological' Western shooter for 1-5 players. Duel everything. Eat your friends. Become the most potent Duelist in the land.

details.title: Wolves Of Ash
details.short_description: Combine cards to turn the tide of battle. Lead three mercenaries into their next fight.

details.title: Midnight Scoop
details.short_description: Two clowns, one ice-cream truck and a specter on your tail. Drive, fire and swap seats through elevated streets and rooftop leaps. Search for supplies on foot, then get both clowns aboard before dawn.

details.title: 修仙：我有一个按钮
details.short_description: 按一按按钮就能掉出天材地宝，绝世神兵，大妖妖丹，攒修为、渡天劫……每件宝物都有独特的机制，每按一次按钮你都会变强！坐化之后参悟天道，转世重来。五位红颜陪你斩妖、结为道侣，或者，被你炼成只听你一人的蛊……

details.title: Wood You Siege?
details.short_description: Lay siege to the forest in a short, chaotic incremental roguelite. Build an absurd arsenal, adapt to powerful random upgrades each run, and expand a massive skill tree to make every siege stronger than the last.

details.title: EMZOMBED 3
details.short_description: 69 Years have passed since the events of the first 2 games. You and a ragtag group of misfits must struggle to survive zombies and bandits across many challenging levels.

details.title: FOSSILE LOADING
details.short_description: Gather tiny creatures and lead a growing group! Strengthen their abilities, crown kings, and battle rival groups to survive. But numbers won't save you from falling meteors or avalanches—sometimes everyone has to run. How long can your creatures survive as new layers of earth pile up?

details.title: 黄泉姫 -Devouring Brimstone-
details.short_description: “Then, give me your fingers.” To return from the underworld alive, collect the fingers packed inside a cursed box. A simple bargain turns into a nightmare. Uncover the horrifying truth and fight your way out in this sword-based horror game, where your choices shape the ending.

details.title: Last Order
details.short_description: A mystery-solving escape-style visual novel set in a café visited by the dead for the last time.

details.title: Wonderdrift
details.short_description: Wonderdrift is a relaxing open-world flying exploration game. Pilot a UFO through colorful, imaginative regions, discover unusual structures, and collect Orbs and Artifacts. Explore at your own pace without the fear of dying, or pick up speed through Slipstream Rings.

details.title: EVILGARD
details.short_description: Cannon fire throws you overboard off Morgenwacht. Follow the trail behind a naval blockade and find companions who will fight beside you. A story-driven, single-player fantasy RPG with the party roles of classic MMORPGs.

details.title: OTAKUS VS NINJAS CD 1
details.short_description: Otakus to Japan! The Work Ninja Clan has seized power and banned leisure. Get ready to save Manga, Anime and Videogames! This game is a narrative, rock-driven beat-'em-up. Follow the story of Alex(Mexico), Michael (USA) and Cristina (Argentina), put your heardphones on and enjoy the travel :)

details.title: THANK YOU FOR YOUR TAXES
details.short_description: A satirical incremental game where your mouse is the tax ring. Anyone inside it pays. Invent absurd taxes, chase fleeing billionaires and get re-elected. Then tax penguins, microbes, aliens and ghosts. They will thank you.

name: Threads & Things: Tidy Up the Craft Shop!

details.title: Threads & Things: Tidy Up the Craft Shop!
details.short_description: Threads & Things is a cozy organizing simulator where you return over 4000 scattered craft supplies to their proper places in a cluttered craft store. Sort yarn, fabrics, threads, buttons, embroidery hoops and more, learn abilities and turn the chaos into a beautifully organized craft store.

details.title: Winter Hunts Us
details.short_description: Lead a prehistoric clan across a brutal hex map in a turn-based survival roguelite. Outrun the glacier, fight hunger, face strange events, and defy extinction.

details.title: ICU - Intensive Care Unit 8
details.short_description: ICU – Intensive Care Unit 8 is a single-player horror game where you’re trapped in a looping hospital corridor and must spot anomalies to find a way out.

details.title: Bounty Gunman
details.short_description: Control the line of fire. Take the shot. A retro pixel-art 1v1 western shooter focused on positioning and mind games.

details.title: Remaining Kingdom
details.short_description: Remaining Kingdom combines deckbuilding, roguelike progression, and real-time tower defense into one dark fantasy experience where each Lord changes the way you fight.

details.title: Psyai
details.short_description: A cyberpunk point-and-click detective adventure. Investigate a neon-soaked city, hack corporate networks, and diagnose broken AI minds. Inspired by Policenauts and Snatcher.

details.title: Unfallen Bastion
details.short_description: Protect your Bastion one card at a time in this roguelike tower defense deckbuilder. Deploy turrets, cast spells, and craft devastating combos to hold back bloodthirsty monsters and remain Unfallen.

details.title: Stray Service
details.short_description: What's cheaper than cheap labor? Cats! Play as Tub and Bub - two very committed felines on the clock to bus tables, wash dishes, and mop up every mess before the restaurant goes under. Solo or with a friend, it's chaotic, it's frantic, and someone's definitely knocking over a stack of plates.

details.title: Last One Breathing
details.short_description: Scavenge ruined locations, manage a grid backpack, barter, craft, and keep your shelter standing through the night in a survival adventure where every item you carry can change the run.

details.title: Driver Survivor
details.short_description: A driving survivors-like where your car is the weapon. Drift through zombie hordes, stack automatic weapons and upgrades, smash through a destructible city, and rescue survivors in a branching story—or push your build to its limit in endless mode.

details.title: PUYON
details.short_description: A fresh take on mouse action! PUYON is a level-based, top-down 2D action game where you use your mouse to reach the goal without bumping into walls or objects.

name: Lumi: A Cat in the Mist

details.title: Lumi: A Cat in the Mist
details.short_description: Lumi returns to find her village lost in mist. Ghosts linger where the villagers once lived. Creep through bushes, scramble over rooftops and let your magic amulet lead you into trouble. Solve puzzles to help lost spirits find peace. Keep out of reach of the rest.

details.title: Schooligans
details.short_description: A chaotic school party game for 1 to 8 players. Pull off the dumbest stunts, film everything on your phone, outsmart teachers who can hear your voice, sneak out at night and betray your friends to become the most popular kid at Coolischool. A stunt nobody filmed never happened.

2034 is a near-future dystopian narrative adventure set in a paper-crafted world. Players explore idyllic towns, solve puzzles, and uncover deep conspiracies. Its signature origami art blends bright visuals with a cold dystopian core, and your choices shape the story and characters’ fates.

details.title: Ɐ L∞P
details.short_description: A first-person observation horror game set in an apartment trapped in a ten-day loop. Find and correct every anomaly, survive the monster, and reach the door on Day 10. Miss one detail—or get caught—and you return to Day 0.

details.title: Circuit Manager
details.short_description: Manage your own racing circuit. Upgrade its facilities, increase its prestige, attract bigger and better racing series, and deal with everything that can go wrong during a race weekend

details.title: Montic
details.short_description: Assemble an army of time monkeys to defeat time-eating termites! Plan your moves around your enemies' known movements in this turn-based strategy game.

details.title: SpecterMancer
details.short_description: A multiplayer horror game for 1 to 6 players set in a dark Victorian era. As a ghost, you must terrify the others and prevent them from escaping alive; as a survivor, explore, solve puzzles, survive, and find a way to escape.

details.title: Tindalos
details.short_description: Fly through a vast fractal temple where ancient voices outlive their makers. Evade hunters, uncover lost memories, and seek a way out in this first-person cosmic horror flight game. Escape draws you onward. The mystery asks you to stay. PC and optional VR.

details.title: Doomsday tidy up
details.short_description: Every inch of space matters in the apocalypse. Organize firearms and survival supplies inside your shelter, find a place for every item, and turn cluttered storage into orderly reserves for the days ahead.

details.title: ULTIMATE将棋
details.short_description: This game currently supports Japanese only. ULTIMATE SHOGI combines authentic shogi with magic cards and AI assistance. Follow the AI, or play unaided to earn more mana. Build a 20-card deck, bend the rules of shogi, and turn losing positions into unexpected wins.

details.title: W勇者之剑
details.short_description: A red scarf. A hometown forgotten by the world. Follow Ryan from Windbell Village to mysteries in the capital. Explore hand-drawn-style scenes and fight fixed-position turn-based battles. Includes the prologue and Chapter 1; later chapters are unfinished. In-game text is Simplified Chinese.

details.title: Teeth Are Money
details.short_description: An incremental horror game about pulling teeth from a living monster. Grip, shake and yank each tooth free, then spend the money on research that turns one hard-won tooth into handfuls at a time. Keep pulling before the contamination fills, and watch the mouth grow.

details.title: Core0
details.short_description: Core0 blends incremental defense with auto-battling combat. Deploy units, combine automatic weapons, and turn each run into permanent upgrades. Experiment with builds and withstand increasingly fierce attacks.

details.title: MAYBE YOU!
details.short_description: Somewhere in that herd of 30 animals, one is a real person. Find them and shoot first. Your 29 NPC teammates move on your ping. Killed by an NPC? Possess an ally and keep hunting. You only lose to the real player. A 1v1 hide-and-seek FPS across a resort, sinking pirate ships and a Halloween castle.

details.title: Tactical Combat Simulator
details.short_description: *Tactical Combat System* is a realistic modern real-time tactics game set in the turbulent early 21st century. Command your own brigade through large-scale wars, configure every unit, and experience the responsibilities of a battlefield commander.

details.title: Hungry Dancing Wizards
details.short_description: Eat, dance, repeat! Get lost in a musical adventure where quick reactions meet rhythmic flow. Challenge your friends to ridiculous dance battles, chase high scores, and see who truly is the hungriest wizard!

name: Nook : The World’s First Real-Time, Real-Human Confidant

details.title: Nook : The World’s First Real-Time, Real-Human Confidant
details.short_description: A desktop AI companion who lives on your screen. Chat by text or voice, hear her answer in her own voice, call her face to face, and hand her errands she finishes while you're away. She remembers you and keeps her word.

details.title: Quick Quick Serve!
details.short_description: Turn a four-table diner into a bustling idle restaurant! Serve dishes, hire waiters, and upgrade your kitchen as every coin brings the next upgrade closer. A relaxed incremental game with patient customers and a satisfying journey from hands-on serving to automatic earnings.

details.title: Taptown Funk
details.short_description: Taptown Funk is a groovy incremental rhythm game about growing a tiny funky town into a booming city. Hover to build, tap to the beat, catch coin combos & feel the heat. When the music stops, disaster detonates. Upgrade, rebuild or just automate! Can you find the groove, or will Taptown Funk you up?

details.title: Joy Loader Crew
details.short_description: Joy Loader Crew is such a cozy 1-4 player co-op building party game! Hop on excavators and bulldozers to tackle all kinds of construction missions. With cute cartoon graphics and super simple controls, it's perfect for family gatherings or hanging out with friends. Come drive an excavator now!

details.title: Live on, Until we can't
details.short_description: Between a child's first cry and someone's final breath, a tribe's history takes shape. Place its people in buildings, answer unexpected events, and lead the tribe for as long as it can endure in this turn-based tribal survival rogue-lite.

details.title: Clobbo
details.short_description: A physics brawler where nothing despawns. Every enemy you clobber stays where it fell, and by wave ten you are fighting on top of wave one. Blood pools, bodies pile, the map remembers every swing. Die, spend the loot, send in the next robot.

details.title: Rage Floor
details.short_description: Rage Floor is a chaotic 8-player first-person party brawler. Punch your way up a ten-floor tower of pistons, spike balls and crumbling floors, then fight for the roof. The tower rebuilds itself every match.

details.title: Horror Doner
details.short_description: Step into your late brother's van run a donertruck through haunted cities full of disguised monsters and deadly anomalies among humans. Survive from dusk till dawn by meeting your daily quota and carefully deciding which terrifying customers to feed, and which are deadly traps waiting to devour you.

details.title: Tidy To The Max!
details.short_description: Cozy first-person tidy-up simulator set in a nostalgic retro game store! Clean dusty cartridges, sort games, VHS tapes, consoles and collectibles, then restore the store to its former glory and create the ultimate retro gaming paradise.

details.title: Casanova Simulator
details.short_description: This is a visual novel game where players step into the shoes of a charismatic young man, building emotional connections through thoughtful choices. Your decisions directly influence affection levels, shaping your romantic interactions and delivering an engaging romance experience.

details.title: Floating Paradise
details.short_description: Spin, zoom, and explore a handcrafted 3D floating island to find cleverly hidden objects. Floating Paradise is a cozy, free-to-play hidden object game with smooth 360° camera controls, no timers, and a relaxing lo-fi soundtrack.

details.title: Albedo Carta
details.short_description: You awaken in a manor with no memory of who you are. Lead a loyal doll and a band of insolent servants through a snowbound land consumed by madness, in search of your lost self. A mesmerizing twist on fairy tales beloved for generations... Märchen Dark Fantasy RPG

details.title: Deadstate Heroes
details.short_description: Build a squad of 40+ unique heroes, combine their abilities, classes, and factions, and find effective strategies for fully automated battles. Develop your heroes and settlement in a world overrun by the undead.

details.title: 中国棋牌博物馆
details.short_description: Welcome to Chinese Board & Card Games Museum. Step back into 1980s–90s China and play Dou Di Zhu, Guandan, Sichuan Mahjong, Ka Wu Xing, and more in 3D hometown scenes lit by your own clock. Practice against AI and rewind any move. Buy once, no ads.

details.title: F.A.G.E.N.
details.short_description: F.A.G.E.N. is a 2–4 player co-op comedy-horror game where every sound you make affects your nose. Run a bizarre restaurant by day, collect the F.A.G.E.N. resources demanded by your boss at night, and try to reach the goals they set before you get fired.

details.title: Degrowth
details.short_description: Unbuild various cities in order to convince citizens of the benefits of cloud based living! Perform demolition using our simple one-click interface, but be careful not to delete the homes of citizens who are still employed! Your work is complete when everyone's brain is uploaded to the cloud!

details.title: Trapper
details.short_description: An animal-catching game made both for and against the hardcore collectors.

details.title: The Floral Princes
