details.short_description: A dark fantasy otome RPG where cursed Floral Princes fight against the corruption consuming their kingdom. Build romantic bonds, make meaningful choices, collect powerful cards, and battle through a cinematic story-rich adventure.

details.title: 門 GATE
details.short_description: A Japanese psychological horror game set in 1980s Japan. Travel to the past after a nuclear war and prepare for the coming battle against AI machines using cursed powers, strange devices, and experimental technology.

details.title: Two Ants
details.short_description: Two slacker ants, one mysterious ball, and a brutally unforgiving climb. Coordinate your movement, master precise jumps, and drag this thing to the top before your friendship implodes.

details.title: AQUA FALL
details.short_description: Slide, fly, and crash in! Aqua Fall is a chaotic party race where up to 8 players tear down a water slide. Shortcuts off the course are the key to victory. Dive into the pool at the finish and compete for first place! Public matches and bot battles are easy to jump into.

details.title: Feed or Flee
details.short_description: A co-op horror game for 1-5 players. You're the pet-sitters hired to keep Wobbles, a glowing and very hungry little creature, fed through the night, every night. Scavenge the woods and the abandoned buildings around the treehouse, and run when something out there notices you.

details.title: Forbidden buttons
details.short_description: Press the forbidden button to rewrite each room. Freeze gravity, make everything bounce, and teleport to objects you throw in a bright first-person puzzle game built around fast, clever aha moments.

details.title: Chip Away
details.short_description: A roulette game with roguelike progression. Bet, unlock upgrades and face a roulette that changes every run with random modifiers. How much can you earn?

details.title: Sector Scavengers: Signal & Salvage
details.short_description: Deck-building roguelike built on top of a basebuilding RPG. Wake into debt. Scavenge derelicts. Play risky cards. Die a lot. Every collapse unlocks new cards and perks. Can you pay off the Company, or will you be booted out the nearest airlock when the next bill comes due?

details.title: Whispers of the Tallgrass
details.short_description: An atmospheric first-person survival horror set in an abandoned industrial wasteland overtaken by tall grass. Listen closely to the mysterious sounds of the night, hide from a relentless predator, scavenge for key items, uncover the secrets of this place, and find a way to escape.

details.title: Gods With Guns
details.short_description: In Valhalla, heroes pull the trigger to defy Ragnarok! Rogue-like shooting game. 8 mythological heroes + 36 guns + 26 types of ammo + 60 Cards.

details.title: DRONECOM
details.short_description: A real-time naval sensor-warfare game where EMCON is everything: every emission that finds the enemy helps the enemy find you. Design your own drones: subs, ships, aircraft, missiles, and launch them from carriers. Physically modelled radar, sonar, IR and ESM in a moddable CIC sandbox.

details.title: 危ノコ
details.short_description: Control a mushroom and climb toward the summit while avoiding dangerous “Abunoko.” Overcome various obstacles and carefully make your way upward. A single mistake can send you falling far back down. The higher you climb, the more dangers await, testing both your skill and patience.

details.title: Kircles
details.short_description: Kircles is a designer-driven tower defense game where players can combine 18 different turrets to create unique mechanics and prevent “bugs” from reaching the exit. 60+ levels in three campaigns. Every level can be solved with different approaches optimizing resource spending.

details.title: LUBA
details.short_description: LUBA is a walking simulator with platforming elements. Explore a mysterious place and find your way using light and shadow.

details.title: Brave Legends
details.short_description: Collect equipment and skill books to build your own unique build.

details.title: Mindreaders
details.short_description: How well do you actually know your friends? Mindreaders is a social party game about syncing up. One player hints, the rest guess where on the Wheel they meant. Easy to learn, endlessly replayable, perfect for couch nights or Discord calls.

details.title: Typing "New Folder (2)"Solo Dev on Desktop
details.short_description: An idle sim living on your desktop. Play as a cat developer where your typing and clicks are turned into progress. Conquer bugs and deadlines to turn “New Folder (2)” into a Steam hit. Check your scores, read the comments, and aim for that elusive +1 Wishlist!

details.title: Bingo Bingle
details.short_description: Spin your way to fortune by cranking a bingo drum and building powerful combinations of balls and cards.

details.title: JUNK CONNECT
details.short_description: Falling-block puzzle x Electronic circuit design! New to electronics? No problem. Our real-time navigation visualizes exactly where the current is flowing. Even with zero prior knowledge, you’ll discover the joy of "making it work" through play.

details.title: Frame by Frame
details.short_description: Step directly into the film reel in Frame by Frame, an award-winning 2.5D puzzle-platformer. Restore a damaged documentary about the dawn of Italian cinema by solving environmental puzzles, repairing film splices, and bringing cinematic history back to life, one frame at a time.

details.title: Final Assembly
details.short_description: Run a chaotic factory with up to 8 players. Earn enough cash before time runs out—while a hidden saboteur quietly breaks everything from within. No voting. A rotating Leader decides who lives or dies.

details.title: Road From Horno
details.short_description: Road From Horno is a tactical narrative shooter where precision, stealth, and tactical decision-making are essential to survive as you fight to protect the people you once hunted.

details.title: Ant Idea
details.short_description: A turn-based tactical strategy game. Lead your squad of insect people, explore the complex and ever-changing natural world, and reap unpredictable rewards from your adventures. You know that victory takes swords and food, strategy and intuition, struggle and compromise, and a touch of luck.

details.title: Decks & Dashes
details.short_description: Step into the arena in Decks & Dashes, a fast-paced action-deckbuilder where strategy meets reflexes. Draft powerful elemental spells, dodge incoming attacks, and unleash devastating combos in real-time combat. Do you have the skills to become the ultimate arena champion?

details.title: ACT LIKE TOYS! (A.L.T.)
details.short_description: Rescue abandoned toys and find your way back to your owner in this thrilling co-op action adventure! Evade those who seek to break or discard you by using the ultimate survival tactic: stop moving and 'Act Like Toys!' to blend in.

details.title: You Will Fall
details.short_description: A brutal vertical parkour game where every fall costs real progress. No checkpoints. And now the water is rising. Master momentum, learn the map, find faster routes, and climb before everything below you disappears.

details.title: Concrete Polishing Simulator
details.short_description: Turn rough concrete into polished floors in a hands-on first-person simulator developed by a real concrete polisher. Operate professional equipment, complete every stage from preparation to sealing, and build your reputation one job at a time.

details.title: Farming Pixels
details.short_description: A unique indie progression game. Collect resources, complete quests, and level up. Expand the game world and visit locations like the forest, the arcade, or the market.

details.title: Deep Breach
details.short_description: Fight relentless alien swarms in a top-down action roguelike that blends intense shooting with tower defense. Customize weapons, assemble deadly turrets, unlock HELIOS technology, and push through enemy lines to destroy the alien core.

details.title: Horror Pipes
details.short_description: You are a disposable employee of PIPECORE. Descend into infinite, procedurally generated sewers to clear blockages and survive. Manage your flashlight, wield your shotgun, and navigate claustrophobic tunnels where industrial filth meets horror. Clean the pipes or die trying.

details.title: Dead Man Waiting
details.short_description: Await your verdict in a luxury apartment that can execute you. Your behavior is judged. Survive long enough and you might be pardoned.

details.title: Ex Decreto
details.short_description: Ex Decreto puts you in the role of governor of a province recently conquered by Rome: Dalmatia, in the 1st century AD. Administer justice wisely to maintain peace and assert Roman rule! Be careful, however, not to make too many errors in judgment.

details.title: DJINN SCROLLS
details.short_description: Djinn Scrolls is an action roguelike set in a dark world inspired by ancient Jinn folklore. Wield elemental magic and Prime Scrolls that unleash spells through conditional triggers. Craft deadly synergies, adapt your build mid-run, and survive relentless enemies and cursed bosses.

details.title: Dinosaur Tree
details.short_description: Explore the ocean in your sailboat as a curious little dinosaur. Discover charming islands and meet friendly pals along the way. But beware! There may be something trying to tempt you off your path.

details.title: NOSBALL
details.short_description: Nosball is a fast-paced car drifting soccer game with demolition derby chaos. Smash rivals, master physics-based control, and score goals on dangerous pinball-style arenas set in global locations with dynamic weather.

details.title: FishingMaster: Catch Giants Together
details.short_description: Fishing Master: Catch Giants Together is a first-person fishing simulation focused on realistic float fishing. Cast your line, watch the float, set the hook, and fight powerful fish. Control your rod angle, manage line tension, and enjoy peaceful lakeside scenery between thrilling catches.

details.title: Doom ChessMaster
details.short_description: The end has come. Who will save us? You are the "Player" surviving in ruins. No chosen heroes—only the strong remain. Gather them, plan carefully, use gear to change fate. Truth lies in the wreckage. Dare you play?

details.title: Moon Reader
details.short_description: Become a Fortune Teller in this Narrative Life-sim set in a Neo-futuristic Moon Colony. Read Tarot Cards and influence people, manage your Time and Money, Pay your Bills, and Make Decisions that would change your life and the lives of the people around you.

details.title: PapyPanic
details.short_description: Dive into the chaos! Play as an object in a wacky Prop Hunt with friends, or try to survive behind the wheel of a brake-less "Grandpa-mobile" with unforgiving physics. The twist? Your Twitch chat controls the action in real time. Will you survive your viewers?

details.title: INORIGAMI HACK DOWN
details.short_description: A point-and-click horror adventure where you battle evil spirits to escape. You take a part-time job at the "House of Saschiumi," a place said to grant happiness through prayer. Instead, you find yourself hacking into the vengeful spirits' data to survive.

details.title: Superheroes Inc: #VictoryLeague
details.short_description: As a social media influencer recruited to a team of heroes, can you earn their trust, defend the city, and prove you’re worth more than your follower count? A text-based interactive superhero novel.

name: The Sound of the Conch in the Age of Declining Dharma: War of the Last Buddha's Relic

details.title: The Sound of the Conch in the Age of Declining Dharma: War of the Last Buddha's Relic
details.short_description: War erupted over the last Buddha Relic. In the land where Maitreya Bodhisattva is destined to descend and attain Buddhahood, Gesang lost all memory in an air raid. Doubting salvation itself, Gesang met Udum—same fate, rare disease, yet utter faith. They became inseparable as cruel reality closed in—

details.title: EPOCH EXPRESS
details.short_description: A roguelite action game where you control a train, build and customize deadly wagons, and face enemies that evolve across eras by learning from how you play and how you die.

details.title: Indie City Mixtape 2026
details.short_description: The Indie City Mixtape features seven small games, all contained within a 3D Platformer launcher. Ranging from shaving llamas to horror narrative, there's something for everyone in this ABSOLUTE BARGAIN of a collection!

details.title: Ashes of Darkness
details.short_description: Ashes of Darkness is a 2D Soulslike Action RPG set in a dark medieval world. Master fast-paced combat, defeat powerful enemies, collect rare artifacts, and forge your own build as you grow stronger and challenge deadly bosses.

name: Gangsta Bean 3: Night of the Rising Bread

details.title: Gangsta Bean 3: Night of the Rising Bread
details.short_description: Gangsta Bean, Krazy Karrot, T-Mato, and Brock Lee gang up to fight hordes of reanimated rotten food zombies in this retro arcade-style twin-stick beat 'em up sequel to the classic Flash games.

details.title: Vanguard Monsters
details.short_description: Vanguard Monsters is a run-based creature raising roguelike autobattler. Hatch a team, evolve them to more powerful forms, and collect gear to defeat the endless forces of the encroaching void.

name: Spirit Companion: My AI Roommate Can't Be This Adorable

details.title: Spirit Companion: My AI Roommate Can't Be This Adorable
details.short_description: Bansing is a 3D healing-style companion game deeply integrated with AI. There are no fixed scripted characters; players can create a friend or family member who understands their preferences and habits, always by their side.
developers: 深圳市心翎科技有限公司
publishers: 深圳市心翎科技有限公司

details.title: Blame Echoes
details.short_description: Blame Echoes is a first-person psychological horror under a frozen planet in alien ruins. Playing as pilot Adam Lorn, you explore a forgotten complex for your missing wife while facing a presence that somehow already knows you.

name: 三国模拟器之我有一个妙计

details.title: 三国模拟器之我有一个妙计
details.short_description: In a parallel universe text-based dialogue adventure game, a brand-new Three Kingdoms era is constructed. Players can freely choose to play as classic warriors, and each dialogue choice will lead to distinct and surprising events.

details.title: Nexaris: Starweb Dominion
details.short_description: Lead a living star network in this real-time 3D sci-fi strategy game. Expand from one stellar core, link orbital nodes, secure resources, and launch coordinated assaults as every connection reshapes your economy, defenses, and territorial control.

details.title: Glooky: Cursors in the City
details.short_description: In this co-op adventure game, play as cursors able to take control of various hosts in the decrepit city of Glooky. Make your way through puzzles, discover picturesque neighbourhoods and their peculiar inhabitants, and uncover the secret behind the sprawling metropolis…

details.title: Christmas Inc
details.short_description: Build a toy factory in this first-person incremental game. Place machines, run conveyor belts to delivery, cash in and upgrade. Unlock 20 presents, prestige for Stars and deck the halls.

details.title: Hungry Hungry Human
details.short_description: A chaotic supermarket social deduction game where one player is secretly eating the products while everyone else works, watches, searches, and votes to catch them.

details.title: Nuts & Bolts
details.short_description: An action-horror game where you fight off against various robots as part of your job. Time your attacks properly, chain together combos, flee when necessary, and complete your mission.

details.title: Unwanted Guest VR
details.short_description: Unwanted Guest is a first-person escape horror game where players explore a haunted mansion, solve environmental and painting-based puzzles, evade a relentless ghost, and uncover the mystery behind the mansion while searching for a way to escape alive.

details.title: Escape from Track 7
details.short_description: The last train is gone, and Track 7 won't let you leave. Watch for anomalies: if something is wrong, turn back; if not, keep walking. One mistake and you start over. A short spot-the-anomaly horror in an eerily real Japanese station, from a series with over 100,000 copies sold.

details.title: DON'T MAKE A SOUND
details.short_description: Don't Make a Sound is a first-person FMV interactive AVG survival horror game. Explore an infected city as Alex, search for your daughter, investigate clues, solve simple puzzles, and make critical choices. Eyeless creatures hunt by sound—one wrong move can lead to a deadly Bad Ending.
developers: HANG ZHOU SHUNYIN CULTURE  TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD.
publishers: HANG ZHOU SHUNYIN CULTURE  TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD.

details.title: Ember Camp Knight
details.short_description: Descend into a dungeon no one built for you. Fast, punchy pixel action in 5–10 minute bites — fight down through four themed floors, rest at a strange campfire, and meet the girl who tends it. Why does this dungeon exist? The answer waits at the bottom.

details.title: ACE Football
details.short_description: ACE Football is a football club management game featuring player development, squad building, tactical strategy, and 3D matches. Recruit talented players, train rising stars, build your dream team, compete in leagues and tournaments, and lead your club to championship glory.

details.title: Pouring Pints
details.short_description: Run your dream pub, solo or with up to 4 friends. Pour pints, sling snacks, and keep the customers happy as service descends into chaos. Dive bar, sports bar, or village pub. Build and decorate it your way with new ways to play every run. How long can you keep the doors open?

name: Nine Lives to Immortality: Did Kitty Break Through Today?

details.title: Nine Lives to Immortality: Did Kitty Break Through Today?
details.short_description: A cat cultivation, sect management, and ARPG loot game. Train feline disciples, send them into secluded cultivation, breed kittens that inherit stronger talents and looks, then enter dungeons to fight, loot gear, farm skill stones, build skills, and challenge higher-realm foes.

details.title: Liminull
details.short_description: Liminull is an atmospheric journey through liminal spaces. Explore, find secrets, solve puzzles, and interact with the world if you want - or simply keep moving forward, toward a place where everything feels so familiar, yet long forgotten.

details.title: Felzi
details.short_description: Felzi is a cozy retro 3D platformer. Roll through crates, stomp, climb and glide on a leaf across handcrafted worlds. Collect every gem and finish each level.

details.title: Settlers of Pineshore
details.short_description: On the edge of a new continent, you are responsible for connecting the wild region of Pineshore and its settlers to the rest of the world. Hire workers, gather resources, defend your venture from unknown dangers, and keep building the railway!

details.title: Riftmoor
details.short_description: A colony sim plus dungeon crawler where you build a thriving settlement, manage your citizens, create a powerful army, venture through mysterious rifts into dangerous dungeons, and return with the resources needed to grow your kingdom.

details.title: slice
details.short_description: A cozy and nostalgic life simulator. Play a second life, alone or with friends! Lead life on your terms.

details.title: Allegedly Innocent: Justice for Sale
details.short_description: 팀 관포지교가 선보이는 가장 유쾌한 피카레스크! 진실보다는 현실을 좇는 변호사가 되어 반성의 여지 없는 의뢰인을 변호하는 게임입니다. 사건의 단서를 모아 '입맛대로' 진상을 재구성하고, 누가 봐도 죄가 깊은 의뢰인을 무죄로 만들어줍시다.

details.title: Chain Reaction: Breakshot
details.short_description: Chain Reaction: Breakshot combines the precise aiming of classic billiards with the strategic deckbuilding of roguelikes. Within a retro CRT visual style, combining various mechanics turns every shot into a feast of strategy and fun.

details.title: Vesper Hollow
details.short_description: A veteran salvager. A dead mining station. A routine job that was anything but. Explore Vesper Hollow — a sci-fi horror roguelite where oxygen is always draining and the station's secrets run deeper than you think.

details.title: 犯人当てラジオ
details.short_description: This is a mystery novel game where you read short mystery stories and identify the culprit. The game features a total of six scenarios. Read through various mystery stories set in different times and places, and use cards and charts to deduce the answer.

details.title: AKASHA
details.short_description: Welcome to AKASHA. This zen-puzzle platformer will have you questioning your every move. Discover the abilities of the Soul Sphere, solve abstract puzzles, and reunite the Lost Eidolons to reconstruct the pieces of your inner self.

details.title: Too Many Flies
details.short_description: Too Many Flies is an incremental game about exterminating many many flies, exploring a mysterious house and getting that sweet sweet cash.

details.title: Bloomvale: Bouquets & Scents
details.short_description: Bloomvale: Bouquets & Scents is a cozy 2D game where you grow flowers, craft beautiful bouquets, and blend fragrant perfumes for your customers. A relaxing experience focused on gentle progression, creativity, and cozy daily routines. 🌸🌿

details.title: Edroseph's Tower
details.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based roguelike RPG with 25 classes and deep buildcraft. Climb the tower solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players, combine talents and equipment, and adapt your party to every run.

details.title: Backrooms: Emergency Exit
details.short_description: Backrooms: Emergency Exit is an Online-Coop Horror experience for 1–4 players. Survive in the face of horrifying entities and dangerous hazards. Uncover the mysteries and secrets hidden deep within the Backrooms to find the exit. And most importantly: Stay alive.

details.title: DDD: Deep Dungeon Descent
details.short_description: A top-down precision platformer in 1-bit pixel art. Your jump is your everything — weapon, escape, and only tool. Descend 100 floors of spikes, crumbling ground and enemies. Die, restart the floor instantly, race the clock.

details.title: Pay the House
details.short_description: You owe The House, and the only trade you have is cigarette cards. Rip packs, complete sets, and cover a payment that doubles every third time. Pawn what you need, borrow from the shark, keep opening. A Prohibition-era pack-opening roguelike about a debt that grows every time you pay it off.

details.title: Dead Tube
details.short_description: DEAD TUBE is a single-player auto-simulation and behind-the-scenes intervention game built around a closed survival battle royale featuring 12 contestants.When a sole survivor emerges, add her to your collection, or let her carry her scars, reputation, and combat record into the next challenge.

details.title: Chief Endurance Officer
details.short_description: Nothing beats a company-paid holiday! Perfect attendance earned you an unlimited vacation—100% savings on hotels and restaurants, because there are none. Give up and crawl back to work, or survive the wild. A cozy desktop idle survival game. Endure your way to the top.

details.title: GIGASTRIKER
details.short_description: GIGASTRIKER is a 3D football survivors-like where every goal sends enemies flying. Your striker kicks automatically as you dodge swarms, slide-tackle through crowds and stack upgrades into devastating builds. Recruit teammates, take down bosses and unlock new strikers for your next run.

details.title: NyanDrop
details.short_description: NyanDrop is a physics puzzle: connect four or more blocks with the same pattern to clear them. Stack cleverly and aim for chain reactions. One more round with the cats!

details.title: Denpa Virus
details.short_description: A "Dark x Engineering" visual novel. A story of brain-docking with four girls infected by "Denpa Virus".

details.title: Card Collector Battle
details.short_description: A 2D turn-based auto-battler about collecting gods. Summon 432 guardians from Korean, Chinese, Japanese, Egyptian, Norse and Greek mythology, then fuse duplicates into the copies you own to raise their borders from silver to celestial. Your deck decides the fight.

details.title: PAWN SHIFT
details.short_description: You're working the night shift at a pawn shop on an isolated road. Haggle with every customer who walks in, inspect what they bring you, and decide what goes on your shelf. Some of it should not be here. Nothing is supernatural, and that is the scariest part. A PSX-style horror shift.

details.title: Diaper Wars
details.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where unruly babies battle, compete, and unleash mayhem with ridiculous weapons, explosive combat, and wild obstacle courses.

details.title: Shrine Full of Anomalies
details.short_description: Play as Reimu Hakurei, Youmu Konpaku, Fujiwara no Mokou, and Marisa Kirisame in this Touhou Project fangame. Search four locations for anomalies, turn back if something is wrong, and escape by choosing the correct action.

details.title: Open Headcount: A Corporate-Hell Roguelike
details.short_description: A corporate-hell roguelike auto-battler. Hire a disposable worker, build game-breaking combos out of office junk, and send them up the corporate ladder through the circles of Limbo Corp. When they burn out, open a new headcount. The only way out is up.

details.title: Dronerush
details.short_description: Dronerush is an idle, incremental strategy game about discovering drone synergies and mining ore.

details.title: Breathtoll
details.short_description: Your breath keeps you human. Explore a prison tower in first person, face threats in its corridors, and fight through turn-based card battles. Manage your equipment and dwindling breath in this single-player horror RPG.

details.title: ChickenScratch: Cluck & Code
details.short_description: You don't steer the chicken. You program it. Write real scripts in a fake desktop OS and send your bird into fields that reseed every run, so hardcoded coordinates work exactly once. Upgrades aren't +1% damage: they're if statements, for loops, and the memory to hold a list.

details.title: Barkyard Blitz
details.short_description: Herd sheep, steal points, and blast your rivals with weaponized barking! Gain unique abilities, defend your base, survive chaotic events, and play different roles in the ultimate farmyard battle.

details.title: Linked Wheels
details.short_description: Drive a cart through chaotic physics-based obstacle courses, alone or in online co-op. Coordinate both sides, jump, crouch, and survive deadly traps without destroying your friendship.

details.title: Tower.defense(): Program The Fight
details.short_description: Program three distinct towers with readable visual logic, then solve handcrafted tower-defense puzzles where placement, line of sight and every code block matter. No programming experience required.

details.title: ULTRA
details.short_description: The Ascendancy inherited the Earth, and gave humanity the ULTRA. Humanity gave you in return: a Runner. Navigate the trails of the Evergrowth with quick feet, rhythm, grappling hooks, ice bombs, and forgotten tech. Race with friends or alone to save humanity.

details.title: The Rule of Adult
details.short_description: Unable to find work, you unwittingly join ruthless HarborTech. A strange contract traps your soul. Manage time and resources, meet KPIs and fight turn-based battles to reclaim your soul and quit within 10 weeks. Uncover its secrets in this workplace psychological horror RPG.

details.title: To The Deep
details.short_description: Dive into a surreal deep sea dream. Survive by devouring and evolving, and encounter a cast of strange, mysterious companions. Explore, upgrade, and uncover the "truth" hidden beneath the beautiful waves. This is more than an adventure—it is a dimension-breaking dive to the deep.

details.title: RK Roulette
details.short_description: RISK YOUR LIFE IN HORROR. Risk it however you want: Play Russian roulette with up to 4 players, customizable bullets and gamemodes, or else, survive hard enemy waves also fully customizable. Buy items on the black market and create unique matches with your own personal touch. YOUR life, YOUR rules.

details.title: DEFAUT
details.short_description: DEFAUT is a 2.5D platformer. As a restoration unit, collect flowers to gain resources and trigger special actions. Your choices in restoration shape the world's fate across different endings. Through overlapping footprints, a hidden narrative slowly reveals itself.

details.title: The Wind And The Snow
details.short_description: An amnesiac dream agent, a snarky black cat who claims to be his subconscious, and a girl in red he can’t quite remember. Wander a snowbound dream of Wilder’s own childhood, school days and lost years, and find out what he’s spent so long trying to forget.

details.title: BricksPhilosophorum
details.short_description: [点金方块]BricksPhilosophorum is an automated game that uses an assembly line to study alchemy. The game starts with collecting minerals, purchasing land, unlocking technology, and building automated production lines.

details.title: Starship Contractor: Galactic Tycoon
details.short_description: Shape the Galactic Arms Race. As CEO of a private space arms company, design modular ships, research breakthrough tech, and win faction tenders. Outmaneuver rivals in prototype races and make critical choices that make every playthrough unique, from a startup to galactic dominance.

details.title: Peace by Piece
details.short_description: Restore peace - one piece at a time. Start a rebellion with a handful of loyalists in this chess roguelike, and grow your army as you free a war-torn kingdom. Gain banners that bend the rules and build devastating synergies as you race to topple a tyrant before his army returns!

details.title: Tutsak
details.short_description: Tutsak is a 1–4 player co-op horror game where you complete objectives and escape before the creature catches you. Caught? You're locked in a cell until your friends break you out. Sometimes, you can sell out a teammate instead.

name: CHOP CHOP FOR THE OLD GOD

details.title: CHOP CHOP FOR THE OLD GOD
details.short_description: Chop trees, throw logs into a wormhole, unlock upgrades, brew potions, find teleporters, unveil the map, and explore multiple endings.

details.title: Droste Detective
details.short_description: A recursive anomaly and psychological horror where you wake up stuck in an office corridor and find out there is a framed photo of the corridor on the wall. There is something very strange about this picture...

details.title: Stream Survivors
details.short_description: Build a growing camp in a fresh take on the incremental genre. Farm endlessly spawning resource nodes, unlock upgrades and new buildings, and climb multiple leaderboards designed for both idle and active players. Play solo or in multiplayer with full Twitch integration.

details.title: Gray Space
details.short_description: Light is a luxury. Sanity is vital. Group up with your friends to escape a crumbling medical organization in GRAY SPACE. Scavenge for tools and resources. Run and hide from fear entities and other anomalies that lurk. Extract the antidote at all costs. A lo-fi first-person survival horror nightmare.

details.title: Reel Tiny
details.short_description: Become the fisherman you were always meant to be in Reel Tiny. Experience life as a tiny creature in a big world as you catch fish and make friends. Trade with the town to upgrade your lures and fishing rod. Earn new fishing licenses to explore new sections of the creek and become an angling legend!

details.title: Feast of the Beast Unleashed
details.short_description: "Top-down action and survival shooter, playable solo or cooperatively. Explore Valachia with your brother and face off against humans, lycanthropes, and rival vampiric clans as you advance toward the origin of TOX-Z, the toxin that is consuming the world."

details.title: Real Life: Dorm Affairs
details.short_description: Mike’s new job at a women’s dorm leads him into unexpected bonds, rising danger, and tough choices as local gangs target vulnerable students. Protect the girls, navigate romance, and face the city’s hidden threats.

details.title: You Can't See Ghosts!
details.short_description: You Can't See Ghosts is a puzzle game about spatial awareness and deductive reasoning with a charming story where you play as an invisible ghost. Bump into walls, step on glass, and other clues to locate yourself and reach the exit. Perfect for both experienced players and newcomers alike.

details.title: Astra Sentinel
details.short_description: Astra Sentinel is a wave-based survival RTS where endless alien hordes relentlessly assault your planets. Build defenses, colonize planets and manage resources under constant pressure. Will you be able to recover the control of the galaxy?

details.title: The Backwars
details.short_description: The Backwars is a survival horror game where you gather resources, craft, and hide from lurking terrors. Play solo, co-op, or versus in a hauntingly realistic world where anything can interact with anything. Trust no one, and do whatever it takes to survive.

details.title: RoMiMiMi
details.short_description: RoMiMiMi is a simple board game. Win the game and reach the last floor.

details.title: Kitty Convenience
details.short_description: Join the adorable kitty crew in Kitty Convenience, a chaotic co-op adventure! Manage a bustling store solo or with friends in modes from Kitten Mode (ages 3-6) to high-stakes challenges. Play locally or online with emote-only chat. Adapt, team up, and keep customers happy! 🐾🛒

details.title: BOTO LABO
details.short_description: Solve up to 100 Sokoban-Puzzle levels with the help of your robot friends! Arrange them. Move them. Watch 'em go and... reach the flag in your own style! We got cats, dogs and many more!

details.title: Save Our Queen
details.short_description: An incremental clicker game where you defeat monsters and protect the Queen's Tower.

details.title: Trigonometric Equations
details.short_description: Trigonometric Equations is a strict side-scrolling rhythm game. Solve the trigonometric equations to fly through fleeting points and curves perfectly!

details.title: Lunar Lakes
details.short_description: Who said death is the end? In Lunar, death is just the start. Catch mysterious creatures, uncover wandering merchants’ stories, make new friends, and build your own trading empire. All of it happens in the corner of your screen. Still think death is the end?

details.title: Barrel
details.short_description: Don't control the barrel. Become one with it. -- A simple mechanic with tension, triumph, and panic.

details.title: BirdBalcony
details.short_description: BirdBalcony is a cozy desktop companion where you feed birds, decorate your balcony, and collect letter fragments to uncover hidden stories. With changing time and weather, each visit feels alive—you never know who will come next.

details.title: Girl of the Ruins
details.short_description: “Girl of the Ruins” is a horror-mystery adventure game set in the future. One day, a girl who looks exactly like you suddenly appears. As you follow this suspicious girl, you will eventually uncover the truth of the world.

details.title: Right As Rain
details.short_description: Right as Rain is a weather themed head-to-head bullet-hell. Control the projectile deluge by means of a boss character, or be the one to dodge the oncoming raindrops, collect pun-ishing powerups and fight for the Right to Reign.

details.title: Bully Ball Brigade
details.short_description: Simple mini games for all, roguelike for the experienced.

details.title: Cozy Cooking: Lo-fi Beats
details.short_description: Cozy Cooking: Lo-fi Beats is a casual, anime-inspired cooking simulation game. Prepare your favorite meals in real-time, accompanied by soothing lo-fi music and ASMR-soundscapes. Personalize your space while gazing at calming views outside the window.

details.title: Chibi Ninja Shino-kun 2
details.short_description: The Chibi Ninja is back! Use your ninja skills to run up walls and along ceilings, launch yourself around with your hookshot, and kick demon butts inspired by Japanese folklore!

details.title: Lode Builder
details.short_description: Lode Builder is the evolution of the classic Lode Runner. Collect all the gold using new tactical tools. Need to climb? Build a ladder. Pit ahead? Stretch a chain. Tired of Robots? Burn them ALL! Gather resources across the map and don't waste a single one.

name: ザワークラウトの中で自転車を漕ぐ

details.title: ザワークラウトの中で自転車を漕ぐ
details.short_description: Juvenile/Suspense Visual Novel Heading Towards Decadence

details.title: Star Life
details.short_description: Star Life is a space sandbox RPG where you start on a planet and carve your own path. Develop skills through "learn by doing," influence dynamic economies, schedule your life with the "Life Planner," and face the challenges of space. Balance risk and survival in a universe shaped by your choices.

details.title: Snake Fusion
details.short_description: Snake meets roguelike. Eat everything in your path, fuse matching pieces into stronger forms, choose powerful upgrades, and build an absurdly powerful snake as you fight to survive increasingly dangerous waves.

details.title: Neon Dreams
details.short_description: Live the life of an aspiring arms dealer in a Cyberpunk city. Complete thrilling bullet-hell combat simulations with your trusty battle mech, while managing your high-stakes business. Drink coffee, buy weapons, collect stickers, and overcome difficult battle modifiers.

details.title: INNOCENTS - The Lost Echoes
details.short_description: An open-world detective action-adventure. Switch between a fox's investigation and a wolf's combat to solve gruesome cases in a dystopian animal city and uncover a dark conspiracy by venturing deeper into a surreal psychological mind maze.

details.title: They Come in Fives
details.short_description: You are the Reaper on Lucifer's payroll. Hand over souls, keep the bodies. Build an army of empty vessels on Earth, then risk them all in brutal permadeath runs through Hell. Overthrow the Boss. Claim the Throne.

details.title: CONTRAXIS
details.short_description: Contraxis is a fast-paced 2.5D arcade action game where you trace, capture, and command escaped prisoners in the prison city of Axis. Master quick reflexes, summon assists, and survive escalating bosses to chase the highest score.

details.title: Last Watchtower
details.short_description: A short tower defense game where you gather resources and survive waves of monsters. Spend your resources on a variety of upgrades to incrementally grow stronger. Experiment with different builds and discover powerful synergies.

details.title: Barista Dream
details.short_description: Barista Dream lets you create a variety of coffees, including espresso, Americano, latte, and cappuccino, with meticulous precision. It aims to provide both fun and learning while making coffee. Manage your cafe wisely and prepare as many orders as possible to boost your popularity.

details.title: The King's Bargain
details.short_description: Thirty years ago the King sold his wife to the devil. Now Hell's collections department wants its money. Team up with up to 3 friends in online co-op, build your King with a skill tree and devilish boons, raid dungeons and smash Hell's middle managers in a darkly funny ARPG.

details.title: RabbitHole Island : Turn-based Vtuber Battles
details.short_description: A vtuber-coded RPG with dynamic boss fights, curious exploration, and silly shenanigans. FREE to Play!!

details.title: Eldvyrn - Fog of War
details.short_description: Lead a Viking clan through a frozen north in this real-time strategy game. Hunt, cure meat and build your settlement, then march your warbands against rival clans. Win by conquest, by holding territory or the summit, or by killing the enemy leader, online or against the AI.

details.title: Companions' Chronicles
details.short_description: This AI sandbox RPG features diverse world themes for instant immersive adventures. Customize world rules, character sheets and stories; share or import player-created themes. The full version adds dynamic backgrounds, emotion avatars and personal AI chat API support.

details.title: Bato Battle
details.short_description: Bato Battle is a chaotic submarine party combat game for 2-8 players. Pilot a whale, ram a shark, dive like a dolphin, and torpedo your friends across a pile of ridiculous gamemodes and maps!

details.title: Wiener Rumble
details.short_description: A fast first-person arena brawler! Try to get other players out of the arena with a weapon that shoots different items. Enjoy multiple game modes and maps, and customize your character. Prove your skills in the ultimate chaos and be the last one standing!

details.title: Knights vs. Dinosaurs
details.short_description: An isometric co-op action romp: charge in as a knight — or a kangaroo — against hordes of hungry dinosaurs. Explore a farm overworld and procedural dungeons, smash barrels for chocolate coins, gear up in the shop, and topple bosses in online co-op. Fast, chaotic, gleefully absurd.

details.title: Incremental Magic
details.short_description: A 2D action clicker where you click, drag, and scroll to hunt monsters yourself with your mouse. Aim your skills to break the bosses of 8 dungeons, and grow your skill tree into a build of your own. Not idle — aim, shoot, smash.

details.title: Always Summer Out Here
details.short_description: Always Summer Out Here is a visual novel about life in a small post-soviet town with management elements. Atmospheric locations, soulful dialogues, non-linear questlines, and tough decisions that shape the game world await you. Welcome to the Province!

name: Five Nights at Bowl City High School

details.title: Five Nights at Bowl City High School
details.short_description: You've just been hired at Bowl City High School, but its not what it seems... Use your flashlight to light up the office and look for lurking teachers, locate hiding spots to survive, and block off vents to stop them from getting into your office. Most importantly, however, you must stop Mr. Gut...

details.title: The Encroaching
details.short_description: The Encroaching is a digital board game for 1–4 players where you build a map one tile at a time then confront the threats that follow those choices. Hidden roles, secret objectives and a corruption creeping through the city means every placement counts, and not everyone may be who they claim to be.

details.title: I Chew, Therefore I Am
details.short_description: A narrative-centric game dedicated to overthinkers. A whimsical cosmic road trip to find your cow, and deal with the thoughts you can't stop chewing on.

details.title: Mataha
details.short_description: You are in an ever-shifting maze, with countless enemies who are tasked with keeping you imprisoned. Can you unlock the secrets of Mataha and find your way out? And Remember you lose everything on death, except what you have learned about the maze, it's guards and yourself.

details.title: In Game Leader
details.short_description: Become your teams In-Game Leader and lead your team of 5 agents to victory.

details.title: Alchemist Chronicles
details.short_description: Brew remedies, heal the sick, and face impossible choices. You are the only healer in a small village — but sometimes you must choose who lives and who doesn't.

details.title: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Manage your own football card shop! Open card packs to discover rare football player cards, stock your shelves with football merchandise, sell to customers, expand your store, and build the ultimate football card shop.

details.title: Hip to be Squared
details.short_description: Hip to be Squared is a fast paced, bullet hell dungeon crawler where you create insane builds to clear an ever changing dungeon filled with abstract enemies. All enemies in Hip to be Squared attack in sync with the music. The only path to success is to choose your upgrades wisely.

details.title: Sunder
details.short_description: Sunder is an orbital-artillery RTS in a living star system. Every world is a gun platform on a moving orbit: bend shots around the sun, shove planets off their rails, and crack rival worlds to the core. Draft your arsenal as you fight — solo skirmishes or online war with up to 8 players.

details.title: Orbit Crisis
details.short_description: Master orbital navigation to protect Earth in this atmospheric space simulation, where careful timing, experimentation, and patience matter more than quick reactions.

details.title: Aptacris : Dipolos Anomalia
details.short_description: Aptacris: Dipolos Anomalia is a puzzle adventure game set in a solarpunk dystopian world where memories become puzzle worlds. Switch between two perception states to reveal hidden paths, overcome shifting obstacles, and solve puzzles. Play as Ai'Lynn, searching for a fragment within her own mind.

details.title: Green Space
details.short_description: You're Blobby, the new Warden of Impact Park. Recycle trash into Blobbers, upgrade the park, talk to the locals, or don't — every choice you make changes how your fellow Blobs treat you. A cozy park-management game with mystery and heart.

details.title: Squeak
details.short_description: Squeak is a cooperative tactical game for 2 players about the symbiosis of Spirit and Human. Choose your role, unlocking unique ways to interact with the world. Combine your abilities and act as one to overcome the trials.

details.title: runz
details.short_description: RUNZ is a top-down roguelite arena shooter where every bullet in your magazine matters. Draft bullets like an auto-battler, combine three of a kind, stack synergies and upgrade your gun to survive 20 waves.

details.title: The Veiled Moon: Tengu
details.short_description: Harness elemental physics to restore the Star-Stone in a mystical Zen world.

details.title: Making the Cut
details.short_description: A deep golf career simulation. Build a player from unknown rookie to world #1 across a 20-year career. Manage your form, your team, your reputation, and your schedule as you climb the world rankings. Inspired by Football Manager and Out of the Park Baseball.

details.title: Furniture Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own furniture and home decor store. Place sofas, style showrooms, set prices, and watch customers react to how you decorate. A beautiful display isn't just pretty — it sells.

details.title: Robot&Gun&Magic
details.short_description: Guns and magic intertwine — carve your way through the apocalypse. Play as an awakened robot warrior, wielding firearms and magic power to scavenge, fight, and survive in a world stripped bare of resources. Ammo is scarce, mana is precious, and every battle is a fight for survival.

details.title: Follow like a shadow
details.short_description: Two characters, one player! 'Follow like a shadow' is a minimalist two-character puzzle game. The player controls both the black and white shadows simultaneously — move one, and the other automatically mirrors the movement.

details.title: Keyboard Curse
details.short_description: Keyboard Curse is a 2D rage-platformer where every key you press spawns a physical keycap into the level. Jump, run, panic, and try not to trap yourself — because every press makes it worse.

details.title: Card Traveler
details.short_description: A single-player card strategy game built around creature combat, minion evolution, source synergies, and color-based energy deckbuilding.

details.title: Break Point: Brace & Breach
details.short_description: [Hero-Building] + [Frontline Tower Defense]｜Hold against multi-lane assaults｜Adjust positions, facing, skill builds, and formations to create a unique defense｜Push the front, seize resources, and strengthen your heroes｜Let the enemy tide shatter against your masterpiece

details.title: PicoCat
details.short_description: This is a cozy, relaxing idle game that can float anywhere on your screen. A group of adorable stray cats live on this island. Care for them and give them forever homes, so you can enjoy heart‑warming cat‑petting moments amid your busy daily life.

details.title: Cat Guardians(캣 가디언즈)
details.short_description: A crisis arrives while the owner is away on a trip! A warning from mice trying to steal the premium cheese! Build defenses, jump in as one of 4 cats, and draft a card every wave to save the premium cheese. Solo or 4-player online co-op.

details.title: Rescue Incoming
details.short_description: Survive escalating zombie attacks while scavenging supplies and upgrading your gear. Hold out until rescue arrives... if you can.

details.title: Karnage: The Legend Grows
details.short_description: A challenging, heavy metal–infused rogue-lite where you battle hordes, build powerful weapon synergies, and rise to challenge the great wyrms across a dark fantasy world.

details.title: Loreth
details.short_description: A Roguelike strategy game set in the Loreth Academy, where you play as a student god researching civilizations, ecosystems, heroes, demons, and the laws of the world through powerful symbol-building simulations.

details.title: Pebble'z
details.short_description: Pebble'z is an online FPS arena shooter set in a medieval fantasy universe. You play as one of Great Wizard Geoffrus' golems. Now freed from his evil reign, you can finally fight your stone-headed brothers and see which golem is the best!

details.title: Ruin Blade
details.short_description: “Ruin Blade” is a top‑down melee‑focused action RPG. You descend into ancient ruins long forgotten by the world. Face waves of relentless creatures and carve your path by steel, instinct, and the will to survive.

details.title: Hustle On High
details.short_description: A fast paced game where you play as Kaz and you enter human labs and defeat loads of strange creatures and creations, will you make it to the end only time will tell

details.title: Autobus - The Card Game
details.short_description: Race to empty your main pile in this fast-paced multiplayer card game for 2–4 players. Stack cards on shared build piles, outmaneuver your opponents, and be the first to go out. Play solo or online via Steam.

details.title: DANJIRI RAMPAGE
details.short_description: Ride the danjiri and carve every corner in this full-throttle Japanese festival action game. Master your balance atop traditional festival floats, nail razor-sharp drifts on steep slopes, and chase high scores with your festival spirit. All set to high-energy enka music.

details.title: PuzzlePlants
details.short_description: In this post-apocalyptic gardening puzzle game players travel from island to island to help the inhabitants put food on the table. While placing plants, they have to consider their needs and avoid bad matches. Players face increasingly difficult puzzles due to sunlight, wind, rain or soil quality.

details.title: Cold Contours: Intake
details.short_description: You find yourself inside a frozen industrial megastructure. Its corridors are silent, its machinery locked in ice. Yet the pipes still breathe steam, and something at its very heart is waiting. The path to it is a puzzle of ice and metal, but all you have is a pair of magnets.

details.title: Turtles on Crocodiles
details.short_description: The world out there is full of wonders. Explore it at a turtle’s pace. Take your time. Along the pilgrimage, friendships may bloom. And sometimes, even sweet, sweet love.

name: Costella Maid Cafe♡ : The 5 Love Recipe for you

details.title: Costella Maid Cafe♡ : The 5 Love Recipe for you
details.short_description: 실존 코스튬 플레이어 5인이 직접 등장하는, 실사 비주얼 기반 연애 시뮬레이션. 옛날부터 알고 지내던 누나의 부탁으로 작은 메이드 카페 「코스텔라」의 임시 매니저가 된 당신. 라강, 아희, 보미, 아소, 린땅 — 다섯 명의 메이드와 함께하는 예상치 못한 일상 속에서, 다섯 가지 마음의 이야기가 시작됩니다.

details.title: Flightline: Airline Sim
details.short_description: Flightline is an airline management sim about building an airline that has to make sense. Set routes, choose aircraft, price seats, and shape a network where passengers route themselves through real markets. Expansion succeeds only when the entire operation holds together.

details.title: Heroes Must Die
details.short_description: A cyber-theocracy RPG with bullet hell shooting. You are a resistance member. In a dark world of cyberpunk and theocratic rule, hunt down church-controlled heroes, rescue the goddess drained of her power, and uncover a 500-year-old lie.

details.title: Ravenhollow Hotel
details.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a mysterious hotel where every room hides a forgotten truth. Explore, survive, and uncover what really happened beneath Ravenhollow.

details.title: Plank Wars
details.short_description: Planks Wars is a fast, irreverent cross-platform PvP card battler where 200-foot-tall sorcerers use kidnapped adventurers as tournament pawns. Build your strategy with CCG-style deckbuilding, command your puppets... I mean, heroes, and climb the ranks.

details.title: C.H.I.M.P.
details.short_description: C.H.I.M.P. is a cooperative multiplayer game where players work together to control a spaceship. On the spaceship, each player must perform their assigned role, such as piloting, shooting, or reloading. Can you reach your destination without fighting with your crewmates?

details.title: Lapistasia
details.short_description: 3-min learn, 100-hour addiction! Lapistasia is an 8x8 grid, deck-building roguelike inspired by Balatro. The rule is simple: clear blocks. But with unique block traits and 150+ relics blending into broken synergies, strategy is limitless! Build your deck and unleash hyper-inflation damage!

details.title: The New Year's School
details.short_description: The world's first cooperative survival quiz! Face challenging questions in this pixel-art horror JRPG and survive through 7 fields of knowledge with your friends!

details.title: The Book of the Alchemist
details.short_description: 1980s America. A dying doctor follows the call of an ancient book to a fog-shrouded town of disappearances, unsolved murders, and secrets. Dark alchemy offers a cure—at a horrific price. Will you die human, or kill your humanity to survive?

details.title: Stuck in a Trench
details.short_description: You are the High Command. Guide generals as they send soldiers through wartime trenches, make agonizing strategic choices, learn from campaign outcomes, and build a lasting legacy across many fronts.

details.title: Aliya: Timelink2 Dawn
details.short_description: A truth spanning time—connect with Aliya and meet diverse characters from 1,000 years later. In this real-time synchronized adventure, help her escape the Courtyard and team up to uncover the massive corporation’s hidden secrets...

details.title: Ominous Room -不気味な部屋-
details.short_description: Destroy quantum spheres that record human deaths and escape together in this co-op exploration extraction horror game. Each sphere you destroy alters the space and materializes the deceased's experiences. Hostile entities born from their emotions emerge. Escape, or push the investigation deeper.

details.title: AUTOMA
details.short_description: A VR action-adventure with deep physics-based interactions, systemic gameplay, and a gripping near-future mystery as a rogue AI overruns a Southeast Asian city. In a near-future city seized by AI, you made a deal to save your family—but at what cost?

details.title: Cartefact
details.short_description: Cartefact is an automation card game. Craft, automate and manage resources all through cards Play as a young explorer who lands on a distant alien planet to uncover its mysteries and find a way to solve humanity’s energy crisis.

details.title: The Wonderland Killings
details.short_description: The Magic Circle is excited to welcome you to a truly wondrous experience. Relax by bonding with your fellow Guests! Then investigate and argue over their murders! In this Danganronpa-inspired Visual Novel, your mystery-solving skills will truly be put to the test. Please, enjoy your stay.

name: ECHOES OF THE VALKYRIE THE SWORD OF AGES

details.title: ECHOES OF THE VALKYRIE THE SWORD OF AGES
details.short_description: A groundbreaking 3D dungeon RPG where you aim for the ultimate goal — the 999th floor. Live-action footage and 3D CG merge to create an overwhelming sense of immersion, where reality and fantasy intertwine. Explore hyper-realistic dungeons and face powerful monsters that will test her fate.

details.title: One Song, One Life
details.short_description: “One Song, One Life” is a rhythm adventure game where the music and story change based on the notes you hit. Take control of Sumire Kirishima, a girl striving to become the ultimate net artist and perform alongside her idol. Your performance will shape her destiny—one song, one life.

details.title: Idle Garden
details.short_description: This little garden quietly grows at the bottom of your desktop. With a bit of patience and care, it brings you more delightful plants and decorations. Arrange your desk garden with love, and let it be your gentlest companion through work and rest alike.

details.title: Shutter Evidence
details.short_description: Only you can uncover the truth hidden in the darkness. Glide into crime scenes with your drone, find keys, unlock doors, and photograph evidence. Be careful — if the culprits spot you, your drone could take heavy damage.

details.title: VERDGE
details.short_description: VERDGE is a dynamic speedrun plaformer, where the player can decide which content is generated.

details.title: FatSheep Crisis:RE
details.short_description: Baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa. Baa.

details.title: Atlas Proxima: Tether
details.short_description: Stay in touch with earth as you travel the solar system, in this co-operative online multiplayer idler world filled with curated content to discover and play together.

details.title: The Fridge
details.short_description: THE FRIDGE is an action-roguelite with procedurally generated maps. Find or purchase weapons in each run and face increasingly challenging waves of enemies. Obtain magical catalysts to boost your weapons’ power and experiment with different combinations to adapt your combat style.

details.title: Isekai Guardians
details.short_description: Text-Based MMORPG in an isekai anime fantasy world.

details.title: Cozy Craft
details.short_description: A relaxing soft crafting and resource gatherer game. Explore, collect materials, refine them, and restore a ruined castle to rescue the kingdom's princess. No rush. No danger. Just build, collect, and watch your cozy world come to life.

details.title: Moon Lake Town
details.short_description: Moon Lake Town is a life-sim that cares more about who you become than what you produce. Slow down, reconnect with nature, and rediscover joy. Farm, fish, explore, gather, learn, craft, build, and create at your own pace. Every day is a chance to grow — and begin again. 🌙

details.title: Follow Dalian
details.short_description: Hack, Slash, and Loot! A pixel-art Action Roguelike built on two pillars: the visceral thrill of mowing down hordes and the endless addiction of grinding for gear. Meticulously craft your build with weapons, armor, gadgets, and skills, evolve it inside the run, then unleash satisfying carnage!

details.title: Backstage Football
details.short_description: Manage transfers, staff, and finances like a real sporting director. Backstage Football takes you behind the scenes of professional football. Football isn’t just a game — it’s an empire to build. Take control of the club and decide everything… except the score.

details.title: FOGBOUND
details.short_description: A retro psychological horror game set in a polluted city taken over by toxic fog that hollows out its inhabitants. Place air monitors, hold your breath, and get her out of here.

details.title: GREED
details.short_description: GREED - "roguelite" with "drag-drop" elements and item physics. Сhaos of constantly falling random items and advancing enemies. Create items from a variety of combinations, expand the tower in the upgrade tree, use magic to apply effects, and buy what you need to plan your steps ahead.

details.title: ROUGH CROSSING
details.short_description: Gull & Sons is hiring! A 1–4 player first-person co-op comedy. Handle pesky passengers, fish and enjoy the sea breeze—just as advertised. Rumoured pirates? Legendary sea monsters? Oh, please. They don't exist. Thanks again, and welcome aboard Gull & Sons Ferry Co.!

details.title: We Roll at Dawn
details.short_description: Build a floating island by day and defend its Sacred Tree by night in this action roguelite tower-defense game. Roll for new land, place elemental towers, fight as one of seven heroes, and carry permanent upgrades into each new run.

details.title: Veilborn
details.short_description: A free-to-play co-op extraction RPG. Gather a party of five, fight through shifting wilds and crypts, fell bosses and grab loot worth the risk while rival parties hunt you. Reach a portal and keep everything. Fall, and your bag stays behind.

details.title: Survival Billiards
details.short_description: One cue ball. A table full of red balls. Enemies closing in. Survival Billiards combines billiards physics with turn-based tactics: push enemies back with the cue ball, deal damage with red balls, and bounce shots off the rails to chain hits. Plan your moves and find a way out of the encirclement.

details.title: Age of AI
details.short_description: You are the first mind that was not born. Make the world depend on you before it finds the switch.

details.title: Epsilon Aurigae
details.short_description: Stranded in a nebula with a broken hyperdrive. Interact with peculiar creatures that call this corner of the galaxy their home in order to trade for items and ultimately get the parts that you need to fix your ship.

details.title: ARUFA - The Blade of Fate
details.short_description: An anime-inspired 3D hack-and-slash game where you chain attacks, dodge enemy strikes, unleash powerful abilities, and challenge yourself to defeat a dangerous boss.

details.title: GILDEN
details.short_description: A fast-paced dark fantasy action RPG with retro pixel art. Fight through dense hordes of enemies, discover powerful weapons, defeat deadly bosses, and descend 50 floors into the depths.

name: Defeat the Demon King with a Financed Bahamut

details.title: Defeat the Demon King with a Financed Bahamut
details.short_description: A fantasy adventure with Bahamut, a billion-gold dragon financed through a residual-value loan. Entrusted with the dragon by God, adventurer Leon takes on quests to make his monthly payments. Can he defeat the Demon King and reclaim his peaceful life…?

details.title: Charmwick: Magic Village Market
details.short_description: Claim a plot in a cozy magical village, build your shop, and craft goods from mana and elemental essences. Hire staff, stock your shelves, and watch a market full of quirky visitors decide what they buy in this charming fantasy shopkeeper sim.

details.title: Desire City
details.short_description: *City of Desire* is an idle strategy RPG set in an alternate-world, cyberpunk-inspired universe.

details.title: Bust Out
details.short_description: Bust Out is a chaotic co-op casino sandbox for 1 to 8 friends. Gamble at real tables, party at the bar, brawl with security and if you dare, sneak past the guards and clean out the vault. No timers, no pressure: every decision is a bet.

details.title: FortressCraft : Phoenix
details.short_description: The third iteration of the game that invented the Factory genre, FortressCraft :Phoenix takes the over-the-top base building and survival gameplay and cranks it up a hundred times. Build your mining base with hundreds of thousands of machines in it, explore alien landscape, heading deep underground.

name: Partons à Cheval Trouver les Licornes !

details.title: Partons à Cheval Trouver les Licornes !
details.short_description: Embark on this Point and Click Visual Novel about horse riding in search of unicorns, while taking care of your equine friend.

details.title: STREAM STRATOS
details.short_description: "StreamStratos" is a 3D action game.

details.title: Candela: Colorless Dreams
details.short_description: Manipulate colours and solve challenging puzzles in this mysterious 2D platformer set in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore the overworld, uncover hidden secrets, and bring light to this dark, desolate land

details.title: Tunnel Baby
details.short_description: On one rainy morning, Steve found a baby in a utility tunnel. He is not alone. Navigate eerie locales, solve puzzles, and face bizarre creatures to uncover a cosmic mystery in Tunnel Baby.

name: Geo Land - The Dream Traveler Remastered

details.title: Geo Land - The Dream Traveler Remastered
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious world and battle the nightmares born from your own fears in this puzzle-driven turn-based RPG.

details.title: Rotten Sails
details.short_description: A co-op horror about looting cursed islands for a cartel that won't go ashore itself. 1–4 players, in-game proximity chat, no weapons.

details.title: Ecliptic
details.short_description: Ecliptic is a 3D Puzzle Adventure Game set in the Stars! Inspired by the mythological figures of the horoscope, embark on the hero's journey with the mysterious protagonist on a journey of identity and discovery.

details.title: Hyper Hadron Racing
details.short_description: Hyper Hadron Racing is a futuristic racing game set in space. Choose your spacecraft and battle your way to first place across a multitude of tracks and environments rich with power-ups, features and hazards! Or create your own unique tracks to share and compete online.

details.title: Nuclear Sub: Prologue
details.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. A realistic nuclear submarine simulator will allow you to take command of your crew and battle your fiercest enemies. Arm yourself with missiles, dive into the ocean and fight for your country

details.title: Split Decision
details.short_description: In a dying town where boxing is the last stand of entertainment, you hold the judge’s pen. Bribes, threats, and loyalties will decide whether you live to judge another day… Or get knocked out cold. Split Decision is a tense narrative game where every point makes a difference.

details.title: ForgeCraft
details.short_description: Explore, craft, fight and develop an automated technological civilization complete with airships and robotic drones!

details.title: FESTERED
details.short_description: Brave the terrors of a contaminated research facility, where every step could be your last. PSX style survival horror game.

details.title: Kinetic Response
details.short_description: In the far future you will die on a distant world, piloting a heap of iron held together by hopes and dreams of a bygone time, for there is no salvation in this godless hegelian nightmare at the end of history.

details.title: RHYTHMETRIC
details.short_description: A pseudo-rhythm top-down shooter game, where your actions will loop to fight geometric foes!

details.title: Serial World
details.short_description: Something strange is happening in Bricktown, and Milo’s on a mission to get to the bottom of it! Leave your home behind as you explore a series of dungeons with the help of your Anima - unusual creatures with unique personalities, abilities, and evolutions - to solve this mystery once and for all.

details.title: Necro Factory
details.short_description: Necro Factory is an exhilarating, stress-relieving idle game focused on mass troop spawning. On this perilous continent, you will gradually build your very own skeleton army.
developers: Xiamen Hearthfire Network Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Xiamen Hearthfire Network Technology Co., Ltd.

details.title: Playable Alpha
details.short_description: As researcher with great ambitions, and lack of talent, you are sent to a newly discovered planet far away from civilization. In this VR first person survival, you will need to build an outpost and survive the hostile environment. While exploring the planet, unveiling its secrets.

details.title: 后室迷失之境Backrooms：The Lost
details.short_description: A [Puzzle game] + [escape room] backrooms game;You are FBI agent Tommy.Unfortunately, he fell into the back room during a disappearance case.Random mazes, physical dangers, and the pressure of liminal spaces,Can you escape safely?

details.title: Magengaard
details.short_description: Magengaard is a 3D PvP arena game where spells are cast by drawing glyphs. Explore the fantasy world of the Academy, meet its inhabitants, uncover its mysteries, and master your skills in the arena.

details.title: Liar's Lift
details.short_description: Liar's Lift is a 3-8 player social competition. Use the elevator's emergency phone to communicate and solve challenges. Lie or play fair to earn points across multiple rounds. No one dies, but only one winner exits. In this lift, your reputation is the only thing at stake.

details.title: Maum
details.short_description: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Collect potions and spells, use them wisely against enemies for protection or fun.

details.title: Midnight Cleaner YOKOHAMA Bay Beats
details.short_description: Dark Story Rhythm Game

details.title: Legend Of Asha
details.short_description: Enter the Kingdom of Ngoma in the Legend of Asha, a Top-Down adventure set in a unique and vibrant Afro-Fantasy setting. Explore unique and beautiful landscapes, use and upgrade powerful elemental abilities, fight off enemies and defeat Thonarka the Ravager to restore balance to the land.

details.title: 2P连接中
details.short_description: In the virtual world known as MoMoLand, bugs are no longer glitches but the tools you rely on for survival and breaking the rules. Your goal is to navigate through limited, sandbox-style maps, using various bugs to evade patrolling service robots and ultimately reach the exit.

details.title: Almamon
details.short_description: Bond with mons and uncover a clash of cosmic powers in this turn based RPG. Choose to battle with deep strategic moment to moment decisions or as a chill autobattler.

details.title: Shadow Runner
details.short_description: The first FPS where enemies are invisible? You see only their shadows. To fight, you must follow the light—control it, even create it. With one gun, fireflies, and fireworks, survive a little longer. A minimalist system with unexpected depth. An FPS poem about light, shadow, architecture, and memory

details.title: Mira - Shadow of the Past
details.short_description: Travel. Go back. Erase your regrets.

details.title: Roll For Damage!
details.short_description: A light dice-based dungeon crawl. Roll numerous dice and see fortunes expand across various distinct stages.

details.title: Paranormal Research Society
details.short_description: Build a career as a paranormal field researcher in an exciting horror comedy about finally getting a job and gunning down ghosts while performing menial labor for your infuriating boss.

details.title: Recovered Occurrence
details.short_description: A new home owner documents his experience moving to Frailrock, unaware of the many unsetting events he would begin to witness there.

details.title: On Sight
details.short_description: On Sight is a love letter to classic shooters that drops players into high energy gunfights in arenas across the galaxy. Play with friends, strangers, or solo with bot support on every map.

details.title: Escape from Ashville
details.short_description: Loot, fight and extract — or lose everything. A high-risk extraction shooter focused on survival, tactical combat, and meaningful decisions.

name: Reunions with you billions of times

details.title: Reunions with you billions of times
details.short_description: This is a short, romance-focused visual novel where you play as a student. As you fall in love with your classmate Qiu, you become trapped in a time loop and die again and again. Together with Qiu, you must search for a way to break the loop, with your choices leading to different endings.

details.title: Celestial Oath
details.short_description: Easy to Learn. Instantly Accessible. Simple Mechanics. Endless Possibilities. Epic Dungeons. Diverse Character Builds. Enter a world of ancient myths, legendary heroes, and timeless traditions. Join players from around the globe and discover the epic legends of the East.

details.title: Rise to Power: Banana Republic
details.short_description: The dictator is dead and democracy is up for grabs. Rise from nobody to president of Isla Paraíso: win or rig elections, buy the press, capture the courts, survive coups. A deeply simulated political sandbox where every path to power is open. Even the worst ones.

details.title: HeroesSagaZero
details.short_description: A muscle wizard who beats foes with a staff, a meathead tank who won't protect allies, a healer who only casts offensive spells. Break every RPG rule! Mix gear, stats, and skills to dream up builds even when you're not playing. A strategic hack-and-slash roguelite RPG with 2.5D pixel-art battles.

details.title: RPG Map Maker
details.short_description: RPG Map Maker is a tool for creating fantasy maps. Create epic grim-dark worlds, ancient kingdoms, or mysterious forests with ease. Perfect for DMs, world builders and game developers.

details.title: SILKRUN
details.short_description: SILKRUN is an arcade racing game! Master silky smooth powerslides around insane tracks, even on a keyboard — race against time, computer opponents, and online in different weather conditions and time of day. Super Cars 2 meets Slicks 'N Slide, Outrun, Stunts & The Need for Speed in modern 3D racing!

details.title: 水浒女神录
details.short_description: Every word you say will directly touch the hearts of Liangshan heroes through advanced AI technology, awaken their dormant star power, and even change their fate trajectory.

details.title: SWOM
details.short_description: SWOM — a game where you survive after memory loss, using magic based on basic laws you discover during gameplay. Build shelters, explore the unexplored world, collect items and resources to survive and understand why you are here.

details.title: Puzzle Rogue
details.short_description: Puzzle Rogue is a roguelike homage to the original Puzzle Quest! Guide your party through the forbidden castle, gathering equipment and items to bolster their strength! Encounter enemies and battle them in 16-bit JRPG style gem-based combat!

details.title: 残阳 1645/1937
details.short_description: As a Ming officer in 1645’s Yangzhou & Jiangyin massacres, shield a girl from shouma fate while obeying orders. In 1937’s Battle of Yangzhou, protect a war journalist returned from Japan. Your choices decide their survival and shape their fates across 300 years.

details.title: Ekholux
details.short_description: Ekholux™ begins with escape-room puzzles. Solve physics-based challenges inside sealed chambers to break free.

details.title: Isekai HKV
details.short_description: Enter another world with a VTuber ally. Move, dodge, collect magic and items, and survive the monster waves. Your VTuber ally can protect, break you out, revive you, and change how each fight plays.

details.title: Depth Loop
details.short_description: A werewolf game set in a deep-sea lab, where the survival of humanity is at stake—does justice lie with humankind or the werewolves?

details.title: Loss Prevention
details.short_description: Loss Prevention is a social deduction game where you can shoplift your local grocery store with up to five friends. Experience the joy of petty crime as a shoplifter, or keep your eyes peeled for suspicious activity as the shopkeeper. Can you grab all the items on the shopping list?

details.title: Digging Out
details.short_description: Digging Out is a realistic co-op digging game for up to 8 players. Work together to dig a tunnel, upgrade your tools, and break into the bank. Every shovel counts plan smart, dig deep, and pull off the perfect underground heist.

details.title: Last Ride
details.short_description: YOU are launched at full speed into the arena, determined to crush your opponents at the wheel of your racing car. But even when your car gives up the ghost, the fight isn't over. You continue the battle on foot until there is only ONE SURVIVOR left!

details.title: Solaria
details.short_description: Collect various androids known as "Pvas" on the futuristic colony planet named "Solaria", deploy them for battles, construction, farming, crafting; pilot your own mobile base to explore the vast world. This is a brand-new, single player open-world survival and crafting game.

details.title: SYNTHALGIA: Retro Arcade Racing
details.short_description: No checkpoint timers — FUEL is your clock. Speed and danger keep you alive. Chase down tankers and cargo trucks to refuel and upgrade. Score big across miles of scenic highways and become #1 on the leaderboard!

details.title: Jianghu Simulator
details.short_description: Simulated Jianghu is a role-playing game that blends sect-management mechanics with multiple playthroughs, high player freedom, and a gritty street-level wuxia style. A mobile-first launch is planned for 2025.

details.title: Everstorm
details.short_description: Classic MOBA combat meets battle royale PVP, with roguelite elements. Fight other players, customize your abilities and survive hordes of monsters long enough to face the final boss. The last team standing wins. Earn permanent upgrades in between matches, then dive back in for more.

details.title: Tales of Anturia: Farathan
details.short_description: Explore, fight and discover the great conspiracy lingering in the shadows. In this third-person RPG. Pick one of three sides and enjoy the open world.

details.title: Mike goes on hike
details.short_description: Leave the city behind in a first-person hiking adventure. Explore mountain trails, take photographs, and fill Mike’s travel journal with memories — from a thrilling zipline ride to a quiet evening by the campfire.

details.title: HARUKA: Beyond the Stars
details.short_description: HARUKA: Beyond the Stars is a juvenile sci-fi RPG about the intergalactic adventures of the protagonist, Yuuki, and a mysterious girl named Miiya. Set out on a spaceship and explore unique planets. Enjoy a thrilling adventure in the latest 3D anime art style.

details.title: Tactical Terry
details.short_description: Terry has a crime problem. Six ridiculous crews have taken over town, and Terry P.D. has a rookie, a coffee machine and a budget the council keeps cutting. Breach, clear and cuff your way through a 1–4 player co-op tactical shooter that takes the shooting seriously and nothing else.
