details.title: Glimmerpine: A Tree-Keeper's Christmas
details.short_description: Your grandmother left you her cabin in Glimmerpine Hollow, a woodcarvers' valley where every candle has gone out. Decorate a real Christmas tree for each neighbour's wish, one chiming ornament at a time, and the carved village lights again, window by window. The flame in her lantern has opinions.

details.title: Speedway Team Manager
details.short_description: Take charge of a British speedway club in a detailed management simulation. Sign riders, negotiate contracts, tune bikes, manage finances and make tactical race-day decisions. Watch the action unfold in 2D or 2.8D as you chase league and cup glory across multiple seasons.

details.title: Sunday Socks
details.short_description: Sunday Socks is a cosy first-person tidying game. Socks are scattered all over the house: find each sock's twin, roll the pair into a ball and toss it into the Pair-O-Matic. Unlock upgrades, get help from the little Sock Bot and race for the fastest clear on the Steam leaderboards.

details.title: Twilight Park
details.short_description: Escape the amusement park before it's too late... You were invited to an amusement park, it was supposed to be fun. But soon, you realized you were trapped in the park. Can you escape the park? Investigate the environment, find useful items, solve puzzles, and escape the park before it's too late..

details.title: Jixo 7: Furry Friends Collector's Edition
details.short_description: Meet adorable animals through jigsaws, hidden-object scenes, logic challenges, and picture puzzles.

details.title: Sweets & Dragons
details.short_description: Sweets & Dragons is a simulation game of maid cafe management in another world. The player becomes the owner of a maid cafe, and while managing the shop and training beautiful maid androids, collects money and grows the shop.

details.title: BattleSail
details.short_description: Fight pirate ships in turn-based naval battles during the Golden Age of Piracy. Earn gold, hunt hidden treasures, lead your fleet through a story campaign, and challenge friends in local and online multiplayer.

details.title: Catgirl Rage: Claws of Fury
details.short_description: Demon invasion has shattered the dimensions, filling the world with corrupted souls. Cat girls with unique stories unite through friendship to restore balance by purifying souls and facing fierce bosses. An exciting and adorable side-scrolling action adventure!

details.title: NO STRAIGHT ROADS 2
details.short_description: Metronomik and Shueisha Games are thrilled to announce NSR2 – the explosive sequel to the hit action-music adventure NO STRAIGHT ROADS – coming to Steam in 2026.

details.title: Rogue's Odyssey
details.short_description: Explore, Grind, Loot, Die, and repeat! Face hordes of monsters and challenging bosses in a 2.5D co-op roguelike ARPG. Combine skills across classes, creating thousands of unique builds, such as a potion-brewing Warrior or a wizardry Cat, the choice is yours!

details.title: Interwoven Dream
details.short_description: 《Interwoven Dream》 is a Victorian-era visual novel with multiple POVs. In 1884 London, four friends reunite after a string of disappearances, each with their own motives. Together, they dive into the city's darkest secrets, where dreams and reality blur.

details.title: Whisker Works
details.short_description: Whisker Works is a chaotic 1–4 player renovation game! Clean, repair, demolish and rebuild with your cat crew, because we clean, we fix, we PURRFECT!

details.title: Buckshot Bunny
details.short_description: Buckshot Bunny is a single-player, fast-paced 2D action platformer, testing your speed and agility, navigating challenging locations as the cybernetic rabbit, Buck. Run, smash and bullet-jump through hazards and enemies to free your family and find your way back home.

details.title: Pay To Die
details.short_description: “One more room, then we’re out.” You’ve got the package. The loot next door might cover the bill. Get to the elevator and hold off the horde until the doors open. Pay To Die is a third-person survival extraction game for up to four players in online co-op.

name: Maiden Taskbar: Hardly Working — Desktop Idle RPG

details.title: Maiden Taskbar
details.short_description: A little adventure begins at the bottom of your screen. Keep this idle RPG running above your taskbar and build a squad of maidens from 100+ cards across five races.

details.title: The Gloaming Hand
details.short_description: A free one-on-one card battler where the sky decides the fight. Plant units at Dawn, let them ripen through the Day, strike before Dusk and bluff through the Night. Five lanes, four phases, one sundial: every card is worth something different at every hour.

details.title: Stress Relief Bamboo Fighter
details.short_description: Control a bamboo toy fighter and pop your rivals’ balloons with fists, guns and blades! Customize balloon images, challenge the AI, battle online with 2–4 players, or command your troops in Strategy Mode.

details.title: Hyper Arcane Mage Battle
details.short_description: A mage platform battler for up to 8 players (Local multiplayer or Online). Earn spell cards and build between rounds until the winner is crowned at the match standings.

details.title: Cat Fight
details.short_description: Scrap with other cats in a fast, chaotic multiplayer arena brawler. Swat, pounce, and use items across five competitive modes, with local, LAN, and online play plus optional bots. Cat Fight is in active development.

details.title: SagaCraft
details.short_description: Step into an untamed Slavic fantasy where no two tales are the same. SagaCraft is a dynamic action-RPG where you speak to fully adaptive characters to alter an unscripted storyline. Crush legendary beasts, scavenge for mythical loot, and explore procedural lands in a world that reacts to your words.

name: Zero Survivors: The Hero Must Die

details.title: Zero Survivors: The Hero Must Die
details.short_description: Create thousands of night creatures and ensure the Hero does not survive until dawn. Play as death in a reverse survivor-like where both sides level up as you raise armies of monsters, unlock dark powers and stop a lone Hero from becoming a legend.

details.title: VLCNP Story
details.short_description: A 2D metroidvania where you switch between Akim, a short-faced tiger, and his very long-faced friends. Punch through walls, slow foes with poison, float and fire will-o'-wisps. Recover memories to raise HP and grab rainbow seeds to power up, but hits power you down. Goofy looks, solid action!

name: The Crown of The Vermillion Devil

details.title: The Crown of The Vermillion Devil
details.short_description: Follow an Emperor's bounty to a rain-soaked island where the locals are going strange, an ancient god is waking, and you are exactly where you were meant to be. A narrative text RPG with real consequences.

details.title: Rush To Hell: Abyss
details.short_description: Rush To Hell: Abyss is a fast-paced precision platformer focused on pure gameplay. Dodge deadly traps, defeat relentless enemies, and challenge massive infernal bosses as you descend deeper into a hostile world. Descend. Die. Learn. Repeat.

details.title: Roomy
details.short_description: Make a tiny 3D room that is your link in bio. Fill it with furniture, put a link on anything in it, like your YouTube on the TV, and share it anywhere. Visits, knocks and tips show up as they happen, and new things turn up while it's open. Free.

details.title: Final Commit
details.short_description: `Final Commit` is a top-down roguelite survival action game where you swap between two characters. Combine traits, change classes, and unleash Sync Drives to complete your build and reach the ending of an unfinished game world.

details.title: The Castle of the West
details.short_description: A fast-paced, fantasy-themed boomer shooter inspired by the greats. Take down various creatures from Goblins to Skeletons with your rapid-fire crossbow through various hand crafted non-linear fps stages. What's not to love?

details.title: Towers to Be
details.short_description: Platform and zoom around a dream-like world to discover what happened to the mind of this patient.

details.title: Floodline Legion
details.short_description: A roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are a living army. Summon units onto a single lane in real time, manage your mana, and let a clean deterministic battle play out. Forge a Swarm, a blessed elite, or a spreading plague — then climb.

details.title: HANA: Neon Petals
details.short_description: This game is a Japanese card adventure game set in a cyberpunk world. Play “Hanafuda” to defeat enemies and help the girl bring the neon lights back to the city! *“Hanafuda” is a traditional Japanese card game similar to poker.

details.title: Silent Nightmare: Willow Lane
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about a young woman whose ordinary evening slowly descends into a nightmare. Uncover the truth, make the right choices, and survive the night.

details.title: Manage Town Together
details.short_description: Build your business and help a small town thrive! Run your own market, deliver orders, drive with friends, maintain your vehicle, and grow the community together in this relaxing co-op life simulation.

details.title: Flemenco
details.short_description: Become a spy-criminal and interfere in the nefarious dealings of the FLEMENCO Corporation in this spy-funk traditional roguelike! Break into corporate office buildings to leak sensitive documents, infiltrate secret research laboratories, perform elaborate acrobatic feats, and much more!

details.title: Robin Hood: Death to Tyrants
details.short_description: In this First Person Shooter, you are Robin Hood. Steal from the evil, rescue the poor and become a Legend.

details.title: cutichoria
details.short_description: This is a mystery puzzle game that blends traditional Chinese fairy tales with surrealism. Explore this unsettling yet dazzling world, spend a beautiful day here, and uncover the secrets buried deep within the Zhenyan Lake Sanatorium!

details.title: Unburied
details.short_description: Unburied is a dark-fantasy tower-defense roguelite for 1–4 players, solo or online co-op. Raise palisades and towers by day, then hold your keep by night as the dead pour in. Turn the fight with your captain's Space counter, shape your build, and survive until dawn turns them to ash.

details.title: Plonk! A 4D Puzzle
details.short_description: Plonk! A 4D Puzzle is a VR jigsaw where you piece together animated puzzles

details.title: GOD CORE
details.short_description: A hardcore shoot 'em up that takes you back to the golden age of arcades. As the rogue Martian fleet brings the chill of doomsday, the GOD CORE plunges into battle alone. One striker. One chance. Unleash everything. Hold nothing back.

details.title: Resound
details.short_description: "Echoes" is a science fiction narrative game. Players will take on the role of a member of the "Scientific Ethics Research Department", completing missions, battling enemies, and seeking out like-minded companions in a world devoid of anomalous management departments and containment organizations.

name: 你来定股价 You chart the stock price

details.title: 你来定股价 You chart the stock price
details.short_description: Want to pick up real-world financial knowledge while having fun? Driven by simulated financial data including the S&P 500, VIX, and bond yields, every decision you make ultimately draws your own one-of-a-kind stock price curve. How high will yours climb?

details.title: Gallop Diva: Ladies' Jockey Academy
details.short_description: Gallop Diva blends realistic horse racing physics with a deep story simulation. Master high-stakes horse racing and deep visual novel choices in a world where speed meets true human nature. Ride your horses, navigate choices, and outrun dark rules of the racetrack politics.

details.title: Holoplanet Architect
details.short_description: Try your hand as holoplanet architect! Place tetris-like pieces on the 3D grid of a planet hologram in a relaxed, lo-fi atmosphere to unlock new biomes and increase your highscore.

details.title: Oshi Trade Simulator
details.short_description: A simulation game about oshi merch collecting and trading culture. Pull from the gacha, trade on the board, and build your dream collection. Unlock skills for an addictive collecting rush that keeps your favs piling up!

details.title: ST UNLIMITED
details.short_description: 《ST UNLIMITED》 A free and hilarious 2D pixel exploration RPG. You are the Dream Voyager. Worlds await.

details.title: Escape from Gridlock
details.short_description: A single-player turn-based pixel-art tactical extraction game. Enter the sealed-off zone, scavenge supplies, complete tasks, fight enemies, and extract before things fall apart. Bring loot back to your base, craft gear, unlock weapon skills, and prepare for the next expedition.

details.title: Desert Survival
details.short_description: Survive 15 minutes in a desert that wants you dead. Fight swarms out of Arabian folklore, forge elemental builds and weapon evolutions, answer daily contracts, and grow stronger between runs with deep skill trees. Free to play - every run tells a different story.

details.title: Globul
details.short_description: A geography quiz and puzzle game. Assemble flags from their pieces, find a country on a blank map, link neighbours together or find the shortest route between two capitals, and more.

details.title: Slap the Curse
details.short_description: A co-op horror game about a curse you pass on with a slap. Only the marked one can see what is walking towards them. Find the cursed doll and burn it before dawn - in a town that is different every night.

details.title: Knockstep
details.short_description: Knock on anything! A cozy little rhythm game where you knock real stuff around you—mugs, desks, even your belly. Your mic listens to every beat while the town animals get to work. Drop in your own songs and they become brand-new stages.

name: Chronicles of Ellusus I: The Dark Unknown

details.title: Chronicles of Ellusus I: The Dark Unknown
details.short_description: A single player retro roleplaying game that seeks to blend the best elements of well loved games of old with modern design and gameplay sensibilities. Explore a living world, prevent a looming civil war, and learn the secrets of a growing darkness.

details.title: 弹珠之王
details.short_description: Pull the plunger, build powerful combinations, and chase your next comeback in this single-player pinball adventure. The free demo includes 4 chapters and 20 stages, ending at national training camp selection. In-game text is Simplified Chinese only.

details.title: EGO DESCENT
details.short_description: A 3D action RPG about a machine built to fight, descending a hundred floors underground. Take the weapons and parts your enemies wore, rebuild your head, body, arms and legs, and get past the GUARDIAN of each sector to see what lies behind your orders. Online co-op. 10 languages.

details.title: FPS ABILITY TEST
details.short_description: Shoot, throw, type, hide, close pop-ups. A ten-question exam where “FPS” means something new every time: sniping, grenade lineups, unarmed battle royale, forced-perspective puzzles. Your score decides what comes after. Finish the exam to unlock the Retake, a one-life roguelike 30 floors deep.

details.title: Meltwork
details.short_description: Melt a snow-buried world with fire, rescue villagers trapped in ice, and build a village where spirits mine and fairies haul for you.

details.title: Christmasing Around
details.short_description: 2-8 players running around as elves to help Santa delivery gifts while getting their hands dirty. Repair reindeers, decorate sleigh, face pirates... and form a music band while everything is on fire. Hey! Christmasing Around!!!

name: 要下海吗？（Could you be my onlyfans?）

details.title: 要下海吗？（Could you be my onlyfans?）
details.short_description: As a former corporate drone who received a severance package, you happened to make 30 million in one fell swoop through FX—and then stumbled upon a new streamer named Asuka. Faced with an invitation from this inexperienced but enthusiastic streamer, what will you choose?

details.title: In Orbita
details.short_description: At 47, Vincenzo gets sucked into the 80s cartoons of his childhood... and wakes up as an 8-year-old. A comedy point & click: think like a grown-up, talk like a kid, and try to say the things that really matter.

name: Chroma: Tidy Up The Paint Store!

details.title: Chroma: Tidy Up The Paint Store!
details.short_description: A cozy organizing simulator where you sort 4,096 paint cans by color. Dig them out of a mountain of mixed-up paint, shelve each one in its row and watch the store turn into one giant rainbow.

details.title: Hazelton Hollow
details.short_description: Welcome to Hazelton Hollow—a quiet mountain timber town with a double life. Maintain your vehicles down to the oil and spark plugs, haul legitimate timber and community deliveries by day, and run copper-distilled moonshine, botanical contraband, and encrypted syndicate drops after dark.

details.title: Sloppy Warfare
details.short_description: A loud, dumb, fast shooter. Troops raid an island full of shady old billionaires, blow up their temple and haul them to a prison boat in their bathrobes. Buy your guns, buy your strikes, call in a pufferfish. The lead mode is Capture the Pedo. Fictional rich guys, all adults, all satire.

details.title: Vanguard Armada
details.short_description: Vanguard Armada is a turn-based starship fleet based tactics game. Build and customize a fleet of frigates, carriers, and battleships. Fight solo or co-op with up to three other players, earn persistent unlocks, and find allies in the multiplayer lobby.

details.title: Ravel: Golden Thread
details.short_description: A Viking puzzle saga about untangling. Read the weave, pull only what lies on top and free the living Golden Thread across eight Norse worlds and 200+ handcrafted levels, with a Mastery Knot to close every chapter and 3 Daily Knots every day.

details.title: Sanctuary
details.short_description: Find salvation within the overgrown depths of the forgotten in Sanctuary, an atmospheric 2.5D adventure. Uncover lost secrets, overcome the dark and seek out a moment of respite amongst the thorns as you fight to carve out a place of peace in a world caught between ruin and rebirth.

details.title: Resonance Shift
details.short_description: Resonance Shift is a pixel-art action roguelite that blends survivors-like combat with strategic party management. Use the tag system to switch between party members, chain their skills to create powerful synergies, and choose the right upgrade cards to defeat relentless waves of enemies!

details.title: Zombie Recorder: Undead Divas
details.short_description: Fight the horde—or become an undead diva. Mix gunplay, melee combat, weapon customization and over 100 character looks. Between battles, gather a dance crew, put on a simulated livestream, and frame the chaos with drone cameras and cinematic filters.

details.title: Double Empty Device
details.short_description: The Double Empty Device will play a note for you to play back. It may not be in the same position or appearance as when it originally played. Play the one that originally played in its new position or appearance. Continue to do so for as long a song as your skills of perception and memory permit.

details.title: Hurlyburly
details.short_description: Throw swords. Fall. Pick a card. Come back meaner. Hurlyburly is a top-down party brawler for 2–8 players where dying is how you upgrade and 150+ stacking cards turn every match into chaos.

details.title: UB Mash 3
details.short_description: Make number go up! A cozy incremental match 3 game.

details.title: Loot & Scoot
details.short_description: Hide-and-seek tag where each thief is roped to a partner. Grab raining coins and stuff them into the Safehouse before the police sends you all to jail. Caught? Use drones and traps to knock police off the map and break out. Play with up to 10 friends online with proximity voice chat!

details.title: 罪人铁匠铺
details.short_description: 在王国里经营一家铁匠铺，将罪人与怪物统统打造成宝剑！每次打造有几率让装备身价暴涨，也有几率直接破碎，一无所有。你打造的装备还能进一步提升你的铸造效率，数十种套装效果，海量词条，熔炉系统……只等你来！

details.title: The Washing Case
details.short_description: Relax and wash years of grime off antique objects, layer by layer, until they shine. Along the way, look for the marks hidden under the dirt: together they form a code that opens the next room. The further you go, the bigger the objects get – from pocket watches to giant monuments.

details.title: MOMOKOO MERGE
details.short_description: Drop food, hatch momokoos, and merge matching ones to expel them from the gut. Six momokoos, six expel effects — see what's coming next and choose where it lands. No account needed, and one global leaderboard for every player.

name: A Game About Bees, Flowers and Vacuum

details.title: A Game About Bees, Flowers and Vacuum
details.short_description: A first-person petal-gathering game: a million flowers, hundreds of oversized bees and one vacuum. Knock petals loose with your fists, a knife and a bat, vacuum them up, and send the bees out to help. Sell the haul, upgrade your tools and bees, and climb the valley one color at a time.

details.title: Tree Wreckers
details.short_description: Best with friends. A 1–4 player online co-op physics comedy about taking trees down without wrecking what's under them. Climb it, top it, rope the limbs down piece by piece, or notch it and yell TIMBER. Every job ends on an itemized invoice with a name next to each piece of damage.

details.title: Meowside: Desktop Cats
details.short_description: Adorable pixel cats live on your screen. Watch them eat, nap, and wander through daily routines. Pet them or play with a cat wand, and enjoy their company every day.

details.title: Island Tycoon
details.short_description: Build your tropical island empire in Island Tycoon! Transport cargo, fly planes, explore oceans, build cities, and play with up to 4 friends.

details.title: 让破落宗门再次伟大
details.short_description: 《让破落宗门再次伟大》是一款融合自动战斗、Roguelite构筑与宗门放置养成的3D修仙游戏。穿越后接手破落宗门，亲自走位、闪避，搭配功法与装备，挑战山野中的精英与首领；回山修复设施、炼化战利品、突破境界，招收并培养各具资质的弟子。安排弟子自主修炼、留守生产或外出历练，下线后也能积累收益，再带上护法弟子出山迎战强敌。局内构筑不断变化，宗门与弟子的成长持续保留。从一盏残灯、一座破山门开始，让宗门再次伟大！

details.title: Anomaly Watch: House 01
details.short_description: You work a night shift as a camera operator in an ordinary house. Switch between the cameras, notice what has changed and report it. Make too many mistakes, or let too many anomalies pile up, and the shift is over.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Starship
details.short_description: You are the night operator of a starship. Watch the cameras in the ship's compartments, spot what has changed and report it before the anomalies take over the ship.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Loony Park
details.short_description: The amusement park is closed for the night, but you are still watching it. Check the cameras, find what has changed among the rides and shops, and report it before the night is over.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Ward 13
details.short_description: You work the night shift in an old hospital. Watch the cameras in the halls and wards, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies get out of hand.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Backrooms
details.short_description: You watch the Backrooms through security cameras. Move between the levels, notice what has changed in each place and report it before the anomalies pile up.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Polar Station
details.short_description: You work a night shift at a polar station. Switch between the cameras, notice what has changed and report it. Make too many mistakes, or let too many anomalies pile up, and the shift is over.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Catacombs
details.short_description: You watch the catacombs through security cameras. Check the tunnels and chambers, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies pile up.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Mine
details.short_description: You watch an old mine through security cameras. Check the tunnels and the work areas, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies pile up.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Rainy Night
details.short_description: A rainy night, an empty house and a row of security cameras. Watch the rooms, notice what has changed and report it before the anomalies pile up.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Castle
details.short_description: You are the night watch of an old castle. Look through the cameras in its halls and cellars, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies take the castle.

details.title: Gold Below
details.short_description: A pixel-art loot roguelike. Start every run with junk gear, buy and merge pieces into rarer ones, stack a set until the numbers get silly, then fight thirty floors down to the dragon at the bottom. Everyone who dies leaves their gold to his hoard.

details.title: Ruckus Squad
details.short_description: A low-poly fantasy battle royale blending melee and ranged combat. Explore with your squad, loot weapons and gear, and master dodges, parries, and weapon skills. Adapt to a shrinking safe zone and fight to be the last team standing.

details.title: How to Christmas
details.short_description: A 1-4 player Christmas co-op. Fish runaway toys out of the ice, then murder them as they flee or fight. Sell your toys for cash, buy bigger guns, beat giant plushie bosses, and drive Santa’s sleigh home. Celebrate Christmas together!

details.title: Ninja Survivors: Bloodmoon
details.short_description: A ninja survival roguelite beneath a blood moon. Cut through demon hordes, combine weapons and evolve your techniques. Escape with a decoy dash, unleash a fireball-spewing staff and defeat the bosses of eight chapters on your way to the cursed shogun.

details.title: Wheel of Growth
details.short_description: Wheel of Growth is a chance based incremental game about spinning a wheel to earn cash, and then upgrading the wheel to earn bigger.

details.title: better.game
details.short_description: A game without lag or ping advantage. Client-side customizable. Players can see and hear different things. Moving spherical zone. Build, fight, or just go to zone. Jetpack, glide, grapple, ascend, teleport or drive across the map. Lose, view an instant replay, then reboot and get back in the fight.

details.title: Idle Ascent
details.short_description: Your party fights in a corner of your desktop while you work or play something else. Pick four heroes from six classes, shape their skills and chase loot that grants new passives. Climb the Eternal Tower and claim a wish that could send you home.

details.title: Snarekin
details.short_description: A monster-collecting roguelike staged on a Victorian toy theatre. Snare 151 paper puppets, craft their moves from what they drop, and take your troupe on tour through turn-based battles before a paper crowd that cheers, jeers and throws things. Someone left the ghost light on.

details.title: 100パーセントラブペット
details.short_description: *100% Pet Love* is an aquarium survival action game where you must live as a pet after being captured by a mysterious creature. Swim, eat, breathe, and defeat enemies while seeking affection. Master the surprisingly deep mechanics and raise your love level to 100%!

details.title: The Last Summons
details.short_description: A co-op dungeon action game. A calamity has woken beneath a village, and the last summons brought you here. In parties of up to 10, descend into ever deadlier depths, slay the bosses below, and bring back stronger weapons and lost powers — if you survive.

details.title: The Thorns of War
details.short_description: The long-awaited sequel to 'The Rose of Segunda', The Thorns of War is a sweeping visual novel where your choices can change not only your own circumstances, but the fate of a nation.

name: Is It Wrong to Make a Dying Guy Woo the Seven Deadly Sins?

details.title: Is It Wrong to Make a Dying Guy Woo the Seven Deadly Sins?
details.short_description: Seven heroines. Two starting paths. Forty-two days left. In this campus romance visual novel, weigh the Sin Radar’s advice against your own judgment, build trust, uncover past-life memories, and unlock outfits and branching endings.

details.title: Children of Titan
details.short_description: Build bases on Saturn's real moons, harvest ten resources and grow a colony from a bare crater. Train troops, launch fleets and fight beside your alliance in server-wide wars against the alien Selenite Brood. A free-to-play strategy MMO in one persistent world.

details.title: Pixel Metropolis
details.short_description: Guide Paris through 10,000 years of history in a cosy city builder where your people build their own homes. Lay roads, provide services, shape society, and watch a tiny prehistoric settlement grow into a bustling modern metropolis.

details.title: FacePunch
details.short_description: Face Punch is a 2D fighting game where you create unique fighters from a photo. Customize their look, voice, and personality, then choose skills and design a signature ultimate. Create yourself, friends, or anyone you imagine—and take them into the arena.

details.title: 小小军团：合战三国
details.short_description: 《小小军团：合战三国》（也许是最讲究的战争策略游戏） 千人同屏史诗战场，开疆扩土城市经营。点燃指尖全战，智造掌上三国。

details.title: NERIS ZERO
details.short_description: A fast, hard-hitting quarter-view katana roguelite. Cut in three-hit combos, dash in and out, raise your shield. Rewrite how your blade strikes, swing found weapons or turn them into buffs, and chain burn, venom and shock into new swordplay every run. Fall, grow stronger in town, go again.

details.title: Footbik
details.short_description: Fast-paced tactical mini-football for true strategists. Plan your moves, and dominate the pitch with beautiful visuals and realistic ball physics. Every pass matters in this team-based football game.

details.title: Board Games
details.short_description: A board-game collection with dozens of different games from around the world. Create online rooms, play locally, or challenge the AI—pick a board and start.

details.title: Unmess Co.: Rewind the Wreck
details.short_description: Inspect the wrecked room, work out what's blocking what, and restore everything in the right order. Activate Rewind, piece broken things back together, and send every object home — preferably without another incident.

details.title: UNDERFED
details.short_description: An underground survival game built on proximity voice chat. Every sound in the dark is another person. The deeper you go, the harder it is to get back out.

details.title: The Wokest
details.short_description: You just want a job. Instead, you're trapped in an endless office. Solve puzzles, follow the rules, and reach the 10th floor. Don't anger the anomalies. If one snaps, run.

details.title: Space Bunny Shooter
details.short_description: Drift through a quiet corner of space. Lift cows from sleeping pastures, mine what glitters, then head home to repair your ship. Gather enough, and one by one, you can bring your kind back.

details.title: Desk Hunter
details.short_description: Desk Hunter is a desktop idle RPG that keeps battling in a compact window while you work or play. Collect loot, refine equipment through Gear Alchemy, shape builds through skills and growth nodes, fight alongside familiars, and take on higher difficulties.

details.title: The Devoltion
details.short_description: A vengeful ex-cop slices, shoots, and grapples his way through mob-controlled streets to disarm a bomb and save the mayor and city hall before the clock runs out.

details.title: Stickman & Wildland Chariot
details.short_description: This is an action‑survival game that combines highway exploration, vehicle customization and roguelike shooting. Your war chariot is your only hope. Fire up your engine and embark on this endless survival dash

details.title: Shuffle Lounge
details.short_description: Shuffle Lounge brings together 42 card games from around the world. Play solo against CPU opponents or online with friends and other players, with up to six players in supported games. Customize rules and play several games in a row with Shuffle Mode.

details.title: Edenfinity
details.short_description: Edenfinity is a relaxing incremental colony game where you guide Adam and Eve as they build a new civilization in Eden. Gather resources, sell your surplus, craft bricks, construct houses, and unlock upgrades.

details.title: Catacrawl
details.short_description: A fast action roguelike about a cat and a horde that never stops. Your skills fire where you aim, and a run is ten to fourteen minutes with two bosses. Three cats, nine skill trees, generated maps, quests, loot with uniques - and permanent progress, so every death still gets you somewhere.

details.title: Honey, Tidy the Basement
details.short_description: Honey, Tidy the Basement! is a cozy organization simulator where an earthquake has knocked over 2,880 console games all over your basement. Pick up each game case, sort them by console, and return them to their correct shelf as you unlock handy abilities to speed up your organizing.

details.title: M.A.M.M.O.N.
details.short_description: MAMMON is a co-op physics-based multiplayer action game where you and your fellow demons descend into Hell to find valuables, smash them to pieces, absorb the gold they leave behind, and bring your haul to the submission point before it's too late.

name: Ruiwen Three Kingkoms: Speakers of the Realm

details.title: Ruiwen Three Kingkoms: Speakers of the Realm
details.short_description: Powered by offline local AI, this Three Kingdoms dialogue simulator lets you roleplay as Liu Bei, Zhuge Liang and Guan Yu. Relive six classic scenes and reshape history through free, flexible conversations.

details.title: ROBOT DRAFT: LAST HUMAN
details.short_description: A first-person sci-fi escape adventure. Freeze robots, ignite fuel, and throw objects at enemies while solving escape-room puzzles. In the full game, build and playtest your own rooms, then share them as level files.

details.title: Mortal Cultivators: Idle Companions
details.short_description: The immortal path begins in Qi Refinement. In this desktop idle RPG, up to three cultivators battle on their own. Choose their techniques, forge equipment, and open the chests won along the way. Gather cultivation and prepare for the next breakthrough.

details.title: Hemolysis
details.short_description: 《Hemolysis》 is an idle game with a distinctive flair. As you awaken, a strange plague has already ravaged this crumbling land—and continues to gnaw at it still. Driven by hunger and hopelessness, you must venture again into this world, at once known and alien, to find any means of staying alive.

details.title: Aegis Vanguard
details.short_description: Lead humanity's last hope, a squad of desperate heroes, through a grim, corrupted realm in this dark fantasy strategy roguelite. Master squad combos and grid inventory management tactics. Create builds & synergies to outsmart dangerous threats in a bleak world where our fate rests on your survival.

details.title: ViRtual Mass Human
details.short_description: ViRtual Mass Human is a VR sandbox where you can interact with AI-powered characters that respond naturally and build your own worlds. Experience the feeling of characters truly being there. Freely place objects and create your own unique VR experiences.

details.title: Isle of Cards
details.short_description: Isle of Cards is a strategy deckbuilder where you build up your island by playing cards. Draw cards and place tiles to level up your island before time runs out. Create unique decks by unlocking new cards and completing challenges.

details.title: Stack & Spell
details.short_description: A cozy magical tidy-up game about collecting, identifying, and organizing enchanted cards. Learn their secrets, master the archive's classification system, and turn magical chaos into perfect order.

details.title: Offering Accepted
details.short_description: You signed her contract. Now you press the button, forever. Every press fills the bar, every full bar drops chests, every chest spills cursed relics, and every relic makes the next press worth more. Fair trade?

details.title: CartWare
details.short_description: An incremental game where you go from a single-product online store up to global e-commerce domination. Manage your inventory, fulfill and ship customer orders, deal with suppliers, and expand your storefront across a retro desktop operating system, and become the world's #1 online retailer.

name: Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game

details.title: Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game
details.short_description: Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game is an active incremental game where you cast your line, reel in the big catches, and build your fortune one fish at a time.

details.title: Zone Rush: Floating Medieval Hamlet
details.short_description: A knight robbed of her floating home, left with only a sword. Capture Zones for more time, combo through Vikings, and topple the Fire Golems guarding them. Fall, and you lose score and drop to level 1. A fast-paced single-player action game: race across a multi-level village and beat your best.

details.title: Final Armada
details.short_description: Build ships block by block, command your fleet in real-time space battles, and choose your path through a roguelike campaign. Upgrade your ships, watch them break apart in combat, and uncover what happened to the galaxy around you.

name: お洒落無限ループ　すごろくドリフター

details.title: お洒落無限ループ　すごろくドリフター
details.short_description: Stylish Infinite Loop! Sugoroku Drifter is a roguelike where you build the board itself as your deck and aim for each stage's target score. Customize pieces, collect Relics from bosses, and find powerful combinations to overcome ever-tougher goals!

name: All Pool Players Go To Hell

details.title: All Pool Players Go To Hell
details.short_description: All Pool Players Go to Hell is a physics-based combat roguelite where your pool balls are your weapons, your deck determines your options, and every shot can send a carefully laid plan completely off the rails. Build your deck, line up your shots, and use real-time physics to survive.

details.title: Fish World
details.short_description: Eat or be eaten! Survive this endless oceanic survival action game! Start as a weak fish. Devour smaller prey to grow massive, and flee bigger predators! Evolve from a mackerel to a shark or legendary deep-sea fish. Feast to your limits and top the online "Global Ocean Rankings"!

details.title: Bells Of Velmora
details.short_description: The bells of Velmora have cracked, and the dead are getting up. Pick a hero, alone or with a friend, and descend through crypts, swamp and frozen peaks. Stack elemental rituals on the same button until it becomes a war machine, fall, grow stronger, and go again.

details.title: Doodle Academy
details.short_description: Doodle Academy is a card autobattler set in a school where students settle scores with card duels. Spend gold to recruit and upgrade cards, then arrange your team for automatic battles. Uncover the academy’s secrets in the solo campaign or test your lineup against other players’ teams.

details.title: Rap Or Die
details.short_description: Nobody knows your name. Your studio is small. Your ambition isn't. Create beats, write lyrics, record tracks, start beefs, and build your underground rap empire from the ground up.

name: Cats Must Be Petted! - An Incremental Game About Petting Cats

details.title: Cats Must Be Petted! - An Incremental Game About Petting Cats
details.short_description: Cats have one simple demand. They must be petted. Step onto a little patch of grass, find a cat, and give it some attention. Tap to get a cat's attention, then keep petting when it rolls over and reveals its belly. Fill its satisfaction meter and watch it happily run off...

details.title: 2in1
details.short_description: An asymmetrical co-op parkour adventure for two players sharing a single body: one controls and interacts with the environment, while the other sees platforms and guides them through puzzles. Solve puzzles together, progress to the end and get your lives back!

details.title: Champion Trainer
details.short_description: The next level of horse racing sims. Genuine Thoroughbred lineages spanning over 300 years, 30 real UK/IRE courses featuring full race calendars, online head to heads, Mendelian and polygenic inheritance, Chef-de-Race dosage, Bruce Lowe families, nicks built from real-world race records... and more.

details.title: Tanks 2026
details.short_description: A tank battle in the spirit of old 8-bit games. Hold the base across 35 stages or in RANDOM mode, where enemies hunt you down. Clear stages clean to earn rewards you keep for good. Play solo or with a friend, in pixel art or HD.

details.title: ASHEN SEA
details.short_description: Ashen Sea is a first-person narrative experience for AXISRAY. Play as BASH, a party robot repairing arcades and tuning jukeboxes via terminal on a derelict spaceship. No combat, no time limits—explore freely. When a shuttle is the only way down, the party’s meaning blurs.

details.title: Shadows Across The Sun
details.short_description: You are one of the last to fight back — a scavenger, a soldier, a changeling — surviving run after run across the wreckage orbiting the dying star. Each attempt takes you closer to the truth buried at its core.

details.title: These Eyes
details.short_description: These Eyes is a no-text adventure game with elements of action, platforming, quests, and horror. Explore locations, solve puzzles, and interact with other characters.

details.title: SZKELETAL: Estrogen Dracul's Potato Hunger
details.short_description: Play as estrogen-fueled Dracul in this parodic roguelite 'yet another Vampire Survivors clone'. Fight off hordes of bums, haters, and similar ludolols, collect delicious potatoes, and upgrade your trashy arsenal. Survive this boring clunker, pee in the sink, and become the hobo of game scholarship!

details.title: Hide The Corpse
details.short_description: Hide Gus before the cops arrive in this chaotic VR physics sandbox. Drag, throw, and cram a fully simulated body into absurd hiding spots across unique environments while the clock ticks down. Includes the Gusimir Mansion DLC.

details.title: Gridiron Football GM
details.short_description: Take over a fictional pro football team as its head coach and turn it into a dynasty. Set the game plan, call the plays, manage the cap, make trades, sign free agents and draft from a 130-program college league simulated alongside the pros.

details.title: ユメザメの仮説
details.short_description: 『ユメザメの仮説』はあなたの力で過去を変える、マルチエンディング形式の恋愛アドベンチャーゲームです。 恋人とのデートをやり直し、振られてしまう未来を変えましょう。 デートの内容によっては恋人以外の女性との可能性も。 全てはあなたの”行動”次第。
developers: さめさめサメーション
publishers: さめさめサメーション

details.title: THREE KINGDOMS: STRATEGY SIMULATOR
details.short_description: Three Kingdoms Strategy Simulator is an AI-native historical strategy title. Every NPC possesses independent cognition and persistent long-term memory. None of the regional warlords are pre-scripted routines hardcoded into the game engine.

details.title: Affictionate
details.short_description: After a year of bad dates and failed job applications, you've nearly given up on the love story you've always written about. One night, you write your perfect man into a notebook... the next day, he becomes a reality. A romance visual novel about identity and the line between fiction and reality.
publishers: Just a single guy publishing this game

details.title: Open Skies
details.short_description: The deep Aerobiz successor. Build a turn-based airline empire across 175 real cities, painted like the 90s Koei classics: court sixty patrons, hire executives, make the Herald's front page, and outplay rivals that follow your rules and play to win.

details.title: Heatline
details.short_description: Heatline is a single-player open-world cops-and-racers game. Race as an outlaw, escape police pursuits, and unlock a police career to hunt down rivals. Customize your cars, equip pursuit tech, and decide when to push for bigger rewards or return to base to bank your earnings.

details.title: Cyber Wukong
details.short_description: Cyber Wukong is an exhilarating Roguelite action game! Here, immortal arts are black tech, and magical treasures are cybernetic creations. Enter a twisted West world of data, steel, and incense. Forge your combat style and face the mechanical Buddha, chanting scriptures and wielding a gun

details.title: Tower of Insolence
details.short_description: Grab your smithing hammer, pack your gear, and get ready to conquer the ominous Tower of Insolence in this cozy little puzzle game.

details.title: MiniCook
details.short_description: Play as a street food vendor at a night market, grilling and selling skewers. Earn enough to buy a fried rice cart and expand your business. Save more to open your own bubble tea shop. The game focuses on the experience of running a food business, with management as a secondary element.

details.title: Character House -Desktop Companion-
details.short_description: Character House: Desktop Companion is an idle collection game. Mix and match parts to create a companion that sits with you as you work, syncing with keystrokes, or watches from a corner. Earn rewards offline: pull and craft accessories,, shape its personality, and visit friends online!

details.title: Super Hole
details.short_description: Build your production area, collect goods with your Hole, and sell them at your market! Use your earnings to discover new cards, boost production, and grow your business. Enjoy a relaxing and satisfying journey of growth!

details.title: Together in Pieces: Jigsaw Puzzles
details.short_description: A cozy jigsaw puzzle game for solo play or online co-op with up to 8 players. Turn your own images into puzzles, assemble them together in real time, discover community creations, and share yours through the Steam Workshop.

details.title: The Hollowing
details.short_description: You’ve taken a maintenance job, flying between the inter-settlement comms towers in the megastructure. Land, fix, on to the next job. What could go wrong? The Hollowing is a narrative first-person horror flight sim from the creator of Lorn's Lure.

details.title: The Serena Villa Files
details.short_description: 'FMV Queen' Wang Han's First K-FMV! At your new job as a security guard in a women's only residence, feelings blossom between you and the charming residents, but strange events also haunt you from your first day. What mystery awaits you and the five ladies of Serena Villa?

details.title: On The Hook
details.short_description: You owe the casino boss a debt you can never repay—one that snowballs with compounding interest, growing heavier by the night. Several young female agents, themselves ensnared in the trap, are ready to take your orders. Make it out of the casino before the debt buries you alive.

details.title: Antopolis: The Ant Colony Simulator
details.short_description: Found a colony, dig a nest, and raise an empire of ants in a giant's back garden. A top-down colony sim of pheromone trails, brood and castes, foraging, and three-way war. Survive a whole backyard food chain of spiders, birds, frogs, and rival ant colonies.

details.title: Seikyu Let’s Go!
details.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op campervan trip through the yokai-filled wilderness. Snap photos of elusive creatures, decorate your van together, and help the locals you meet along the way. Camp, cook, and clamber across diverse biomes, from misty swamps to snowy mountains. Adventure awaits, so Let’s Go!

details.title: The Backrooms : Threshold
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op investigation horror game where you enter the Backrooms through an experimental gateway. Explore procedurally generated environments, document anomalies, recover valuable artifacts, and survive the unknown.

details.title: CASHKET
details.short_description: Make a fortune off the dead. Open stolen coffins for an evil company, sell the loot, and gamble your finds for bigger rewards. Automate the dirty work, unlock the coffins of giants and titans, and crack open rocks to uncover ancient fossils.

details.title: Loss Prevention: Prologue
details.short_description: Loss Prevention is a social deduction game where you can shoplift your local grocery store with up to five friends. Experience the joy of petty crime as a shoplifter, or keep your eyes peeled for suspicious activity as the shopkeeper. Can you grab all the items on the shopping list?

details.title: Nectar Spines
details.short_description: You encounter your handsome model neighbor in the story, but he harbors dark intentions toward you… A stormy night approaches. Evade his pursuit and struggle desperately. Yet the second you launch the game, escape is impossible.

details.title: Sort The Mart
details.short_description: Sort The Mart is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort hundreds of toys, food, cars, plushies, sports items, and more onto the correct shelves. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy mart into a perfectly organized store, one shelf at a time, at your own pace.

details.title: Kingdom Puzzles
details.short_description: A BOSS RUSH of logic puzzles—a feast for the mind. Explore a castle, tackle puzzles, collect treasures, and defeat the King! The kingdom's puzzles always put you in the toughest possible situations. Careful reasoning is your key to success. Welcome to Kingdom Puzzles!

name: Bulb Keeper: Tidy up the Night

details.title: Bulb Keeper: Tidy up the Night
details.short_description: BulbKeeper: Tidy Up the Night is a cozy single-player organizing game. Return scattered bulbs to their original places along the Bulb Street and light up the night. Complete sets of Lights to grow stronger, and use your abilities and strategy to return over 1,000 bulbs as quickly as you can.

details.title: Panic at the Pole
details.short_description: Grab up to 5 friends and try to save Christmas! Team up to build and wrap toys, feed reindeers, chase away the gift gremilins and appease a high-maintenance Santa. Work together to earn enough coins to buy your way out of an endless contract before Christmas morning!

details.title: Figure It Out! Together
details.short_description: Your cat knocked over your Anime figure collection. Sort and tidy up over 2,875 mini, life-size and giant figures. Hunt for rare finds and unlock handy gadgets in this cozy Anime organizing game. Mechas, chibis, and maids… everyone belongs on a shelf. Your cat is “helping.” What could go wrong?

details.title: Tidy Bakery
details.short_description: Your cozy bakery is a little… messy 🍰 Sort, organize, and put away about 3,000 freshly baked treats. Take your time, enjoy the cozy atmosphere, and turn bakery chaos into perfect order.

details.title: Fridge Organizer
details.short_description: Unpack grocery deliveries and place everything into organized containers where it belongs. Watch for expired goods and be sure to follow First In First Out procedures.

details.title: Shovel That Snow: Nordic Cleaner
details.short_description: Hey neighbour! You arrived just in time. A blizzard has buried our neighborhood under some seriously thick powder, and we are all completely snowed-in. Just a typical Tuesday here in Scandinavia... Could you help us out?

name: Car Rental Simulator: Prologue - Early Days

details.title: Car Rental Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
details.short_description: Free introduction to the full Car Rental Simulator game puts you behind the desk of a small-town rental office in Winston Springs. Manage customers, grow your fleet, and deal with surprises along the way

details.title: Red Rust Pioneers
details.short_description: Build a new life in the Wild West open world of Red Rust Valley, alone or with up to 4 players in co-op. Hunt, farm, raise animals and craft through the changing seasons in this survival game as your camp grows from a canvas tent to a homestead. Free land, open skies, and a world worth exploring.

details.title: Dealer Shift
details.short_description: Get your hands dirty in an immersive open-world crime simulator. Mix, grind, dissolve, and package every product yourself, build hidden labs, outsmart the police, smuggle shipments through checkpoints, and grow from a small-time dealer into an underground kingpin.

details.title: Last Survivor: Day on Earth
details.short_description: Blast through endless waves of enemies and evolve into an unstoppable force! This chaotic roguelike shooter lets you survive solo or in 2–4 player co-op, where every upgrade choice shapes your build in a battlefield swarming with monsters.

details.title: Kisaragi
details.short_description: A third-person shooter horror game inspired by the unsettling Japanese legend of the non-existent Kisaragi Station.

details.title: Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror
details.short_description: Run a cozy little soup shop haunted by unsettling stories. In Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror, uncover hidden mysteries and unlock every secret recipe. Serve the right soup from the Super Soup 2000.

details.title: Dungeon Directive
details.short_description: You’ve taken over the guild hall in the center of town near a mysterious dungeon portal. With a small roster of heroes and limited resources, it’s your job to rebuild the guild, send parties into the depths, and shape a legacy that lasts for generations. What future will your choices create?

details.title: Dungeon Manager
details.short_description: This is a PVE auto Battler! Right after graduating from the management school but before getting degree certificate, you are snatched away by a red dragon and forced to be a dungeon manager. You need to fighting against the invaders of the evil empire together with the cute creatures in the dungeon.

details.title: Elevator
details.short_description: Embark on a journey through The Elevator. This is not a simple trip to the top. Each stop will open your eyes to the mysteries of the Elevator. What floor will it stop on? What will it show? The Elevator decides your fate now!!! From the makers of Elevator: Source comes Elevator, the sequel.

details.title: In a Bleak Midwinter
details.short_description: In a Bleak Midwinter is an immersive third person grounded tactical shooter experience set in a real world inspired conflict, where you will survive alone or with others in the frontlines doing assault missions. Push your limits, your glory awaits!

details.title: Rabona
details.short_description: Rabona is an online multiplayer soccer game with physics-based gameplay. Take total ball control with precise touches. Join the real football action with your friends. Feel the game.

details.title: Rich Flavors
details.short_description: Rich Flavors is a game in which you deliver "goods" to "customers" and get paid in "coupons". Can you collect enough to buy your dream cake before your contract ends?

details.title: The Abyss Break
details.short_description: Hardcore first-person co-op horror game. Explore the worlds beyond the Abyss alone or with a team, gather what you need to survive, and discover how far consciousness can change before it is no longer your own.

details.title: Ruins of The Titan
details.short_description: A 2D Rougelike action game with pixel art style. You are a summoned "hero", in exhilarating combat, smooth action and dazzling combo, defeat and execute enemies. Build from 100+ skills! Blending adventure, action, and strategic builds, the journey offers endless possibilities in every fight.

details.title: Planet Party Time
details.short_description: "Planet Party Time" combines social sim & party games. As an alien, team with robot PADI to restore a planet via unique recruits. Become a Cube Galaxy Hero Candidate: explore space, play minigames for rewards. Build custom minigames via intuitive editor & host parties!

details.title: My Fairy Princess
details.short_description: In My Fairy Princess, you raise a daughter in a vibrant world of multiple endings. Plan her life and journey beside her through a fabled realm of humans, yaoguai, and immortals. Your choices shape not only the life she leads, but the one she comes to love.

details.title: The (mis)adventures of Magical Girl Luna
details.short_description: In another world, where magic and technology go hand in hand, lives Luna - a young but formidable magical girl. Raised by the powerful witch Solaire, Luna is about to embark on an incredible adventure, one that will put both her idealistic nature and her starry-eyed view of the world to the test.

details.title: Barely Correct
details.short_description: Barely Correct blends arithmetic duels with romance. Numbers aren't just brain teasers—they're weapons for control. Win 1v1 calculation battles to strip away your opponent’s defenses layer by layer. Reach the tipping point to reveal the truth hidden beneath their surface.

details.title: Children's Garden
details.short_description: Welcome to the Reincarnation Ethics Program "Children's Garden." This is a puzzle game where you seek eternal rest.

details.title: Adventure Paws
details.short_description: Adventure Paws is a pixel-style 2D side-scrolling adventure game where you and your friend will play as two cats, embarking on an exciting journey across a mysterious and unknown continent. Join the black and white cats and set off on this journey full of challenges and surprises!

name: 夜空色的魔法少女 - Nightsky Blue Magical Girl

details.title: 夜空色的魔法少女 - Nightsky Blue Magical Girl
details.short_description: You will play Wong YukChan, a high school student in Shenzhen. While enjoying campus life, you should investigate the monsters and seal them. In addition, you will act together with the cute girl Pak HoLing to defeat the monster, and develop a romantic relationship with her during this process.

details.title: TechStop Simulator
details.short_description: Prepare for an immersive retro arcade & game shop management experience. Take control of your very own TechStop! Stock your shelves with games and arcade classics, set prices, manage payments, hire staff, expand & design your store to attract more customers. Stay ahead in competitive local market!

details.title: Fate Trigger
details.short_description: Fate Trigger is a 3D Anime-style, hero-based tactical shooter powered by UE5, available across multiple platforms. Dive into a dynamic world of floating islands, become a sharpshooter with extraordinary special skills, and engage in thrilling, spectacular life-or-death showdowns!

details.title: Expedition: Into Darkness
details.short_description: Brave forbidden dungeons in a quest for knowledge and treasure in this medieval PvE co-op extraction looter. Craft weapons, customise gear and join forces with up to four allies. Survive the ruins together—or lose everything you carry.

details.title: Verse Project
details.short_description: In this multiplayer game you have to explore the Solar System in real scale. Control spaceships of the near future, explore planets, moons and asteroids, mine resources, fight for space domination and build the future of the universe.

name: Life of a Lonely Indie Game Developer

details.title: Life of a Lonely Indie Game Developer
details.short_description: "Create the games you want, at the time you want, and live doing only what you love." In this realistic life simulation game, an independent game developer dreams of such a life, struggling with money and time while paying taxes until death. Whether this life is happy or truly lonely, you decide.

details.title: Descending Darkness
details.short_description: Descending Darkness is a co-op PvE shooter with up to 4 players. The world has been ravaged by solar flares. You wake up inside a bunker. While initially used for WWII, it is now a hideout against the mass infected. Your goal? To defend it at all costs.

details.title: Glaciered
details.short_description: Soar the seas at the end of time. 65 million years in the future, the world has frozen over, and the oceans have been sealed under a thick layer of ice. Become a Tuai—a species that evolved from birds—and protect the Everwinter in this futuristic underwater action game.

details.title: Lost Hellden
details.short_description: Resist your Sin. Reclaim your fate. Lost Hellden is an action JRPG from a team of genre veterans, featuring a gorgeous hand-painted 3D art style, a vast world to explore, and a unique phased battle system that blends turn-based and real-time combat.

details.title: Arisen Force: Vonimir
details.short_description: Gather allies, fight the shadows, and uncover the secrets of Vonimir. In a land of pixel beauty and epic battles, your legend begins.

details.title: World of Anterra
details.short_description: The prophecy foretold your coming, Traveller, but are you here to save Anterra or yourself? Explore an expansive living world, with thriving towns, wild animals, and monster filled dungeons. Discover secrets, lore and mysteries, and uncover the truth about the Eye to become Anterra's Champion.

name: Bamboo Spring: A Story Cast in Bronze

details.title: Bamboo Spring: A Story Cast in Bronze
details.short_description: After saving an exiled prince of the fallen State of Wei, you are granted an abandoned homestead. Farm the land, raise livestock, fish and hunt, forge bonds with the townsfolk, build a militia, and defend your home against invading forces.

details.title: Handshakes: Hands On
details.short_description: Handshakes: Hands On is a wholesome puzzle game all about shaking hands. With puzzles designed to foster discovery and gently guide the player towards their own solution, you can play alone or with a friend and get your hands dirty in this simple and surprising puzzler.

details.title: Mainland
details.short_description: Enter a cooperative medieval realm, forge alliances, lead armies, and engage in epic battles. Shape history with dynamic politics, or test your mettle against others in fierce player-vs-player combat.

details.title: Melt Away
details.short_description: People end up forgetting about the dead.

details.title: Office Party
details.short_description: Office Party is a fully 3D edgy comedy adventure game inspired by classic comedies of the '90s, and also the long awaited sequel to House Party. Dive into the craziness and debauchery with all new characters, game mechanics and locations, and maybe a visit from some old party friends.

details.title: Age of Respair
details.short_description: Age of Respair is a medieval strategy castle-builder. Build massive castles with fortifications while managing resources and production chains. Assemble a large army and lay siege to enemy castles. Lead your people and bring respair to your kingdom🏰⚔️

details.title: METACRAFT: Arena
details.short_description: METACRAFT: Arena — an online action RPG with a wide selection of melee and ranged weapons, PvE and PvP raids, leveling and build customization, clan activities, base upgrades, crafting, player trading, and much more!

details.title: Dress the Duel
details.short_description: "Dress the Duel," is a roguelike deckbuilding game where your cards are your wardrobe and your outfit is your arsenal!Build a versatile wardrobe, disrobe strategically, layer outfits for powerful effects, and Dress the Duel!

name: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister

details.title: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister
details.short_description: A fully animated and voiced sister life-sim with roguelite runs. Find a cure for Mio’s illness. Share meals and quiet nights at home, then enter the Abyss each day to fight, loot, and push deeper to protect your simple life together.

details.title: Paddle Cats
details.short_description: Paddle Cats is a cozy two-player couch co-op fishing adventure where two cats share one boat. Paddle together, explore the waters, catch fish and bring your haul back to camp.

details.title: Panzer Strike
details.short_description: Authentic RTS gameplay straight out of the 2000s. Command your troops, develop strategies, and win World War II battles. Huge maps, thousands of units, long-range firepower, and no building mechanics!

details.title: Helrift
details.short_description: Helrift is a free-to-play old-school MMORPG, built around the war between Aresden and Elvine. Shape your build through stats, weapons and spells. Hunt monsters, gather materials and craft your supplies, then join your allies in open-world PvP and battle for dominance in server-wide events.

details.title: CrisisX
details.short_description: Immerse yourself into a realistic open world experience and find your way out in the ruins of a dying world. Survive the threats from the Infected, the living and most importantly, the wilderness. Fight or cooperate with others, and establish your territory. Build your own new post-apocalyptic world

details.title: Keyframes
details.short_description: After chance meetings in your second year of college, decide how you want to spend the last two years of undergrad with your friends— both old and new— in this partially customizable amare visual novel.

details.title: Underground Nomads
details.short_description: You command a drilling train, leading a dwarf clan through the underground depths toward the planetary core. Manage the crew, complete expeditions, gather resources, upgrade gear, and make tough choices to reach the abandoned city and bring your people back home.

details.title: Love Nest
details.short_description: 《爱之巢》是一场关于血肉、爱与救赎、恨与纠缠的冒险。密室逃脱也好、视觉小说也好、电子宠物也好……这些都只是这场冒险的冰山一角。唯一重要的只有……属于你的少女——『晴』，永远在你们的《爱之巢》，微笑着等着你。

details.title: Dumb Ways to Party
details.short_description: The world’s dumbest party game is here! Play as your favorite Bean, and go head-to-head with up to three other players to become the Dumbest of the Dumb. Will you use skill, sabotage or sheer dumb luck to win?

details.title: MUDANG: Two Hearts
details.short_description: In a unified Korea, masked terrorists strike at the heart of Seoul. Ji Jeongtae, a soldier sent in to stop the attacks, stumbles upon a K-Pop star named Gavi at the center of the unfolding crisis. As their stories intertwine, a chilling truth begins to take shape.

details.title: Tempus Triad
details.short_description: In Tempus Triad, dive into an ancient first-person horror scenario where a scientist is thrust into an era where huge predators dominate the land.

details.title: D-Extinction
details.short_description: D-Extinction is a first-person investigative horror game. A secret experiment went too far. Now the pre-historic predators are loose. Explore, investigate, and survive in a immersive horror experience where one mistake can kill.

details.title: Bus Terminal Simulator
details.short_description: Experience an immersive terminal management simulator. Manage passengers, organize schedules, inspect luggage, catch smugglers, and prevent illegal activities. Not every passenger is innocent — some will try to trick you or smuggle illegal items. Stay alert and run your terminal efficiently.

details.title: Cunning Stunt Racer
details.short_description: Inspired by the legendary Stunt Car Racer, Cunning Stunt Racer brings back the raw intensity of high-risk, high-reward racing — rebuilt with retro visuals with a modern twist, modern physics, and competitive gameplay.

details.title: GUILDMAKER
details.short_description: Run a guild of valiant, procedurally generated adventurers who fight, trade, craft, and do quests on their own. Do your best as their guildmaster to provide them a place to rest and thrive, and restore an old guild to its former glory.

details.title: Beyond Yardwork Simulator
details.short_description: Gardening has never been this rewarding! Use a full arsenal of tools – from lawnmowers to pressure washers – to transform properties and earn money to renovate your own home. With intuitive mechanics and beautiful visuals, it’s the perfect stress-free relaxation for everyone.

details.title: 中等生
details.short_description: 这是一部中式校园（高三）为背景的百合向视觉小说。 只要考上大学，一切都会好起来吗？手牵着手，心跳扑通扑通，我们只是朋友吗？大家说只是开个玩笑，感到不舒服是正常的吗？想要挣脱母亲的期待，这是不孝吗？您将跟随主角周语桐，探索青春期的疑惑，帮她作出选择。

details.title: Tactical Commanders R
details.short_description: Tactical Commanders R revives the classic large-scale sci-fi strategy warfare of the original Tactical Commanders. Command your forces, control the battlefield, and experience intense real-time strategic combat once again.

details.title: No Elevator
details.short_description: You as a claustrophobic guy refuse elevators and climb a massive building from the outside, using a plank gun and create your own path.

details.title: OVERCHESS
details.short_description: You are a pawn in an endless but not always fair chess world. Enslave your enemies and turn them into slaves. Build your own army. On the path to glory you will face alcoholism, alligators and ludomania. Test your luck in OVERCHESS.

details.title: 拉克夏家的女仆
details.short_description: 「The Maid of Luxia」is an otome visual novel.Rebirth. Redemption. Rewriting tragedy. Facing the truth of the heart.Experience not only the twisted love of seven masters poured upon you at once, but also a journey of self-growth.

details.title: Bad AI
details.short_description: Rapid advances in AI have sparked a wave of unemployment—and you are one of those left without a job. Your story begins at a black market, where you meet an outdated AI destined for destruction. Left behind by a changing world, humans and AIs find warmth in one another and slowly become a family.

details.title: SPLATTER KING
details.short_description: Smash through horned demons as you plunge ever downward to save the Queen. The deeper you descend, the deadlier the enemies become. Only those strong enough to survive can reclaim their throne.

details.title: Dawn's Wake
details.short_description: Awaken as a memory-stripped supreme master in a twisted jianghu. Shatter the world's cursed formations, master strategic wuxia combat where one right technique turns the tide, and reclaim your lost throne — while idle progress and a living martial world carry on even when your sword rests.

details.title: Snackrifice
details.short_description: Satisfy your ravenous appetite by slaying the Old Gods of a ruined, forsaken realm, and use their corpses as ingredients for the ultimate divine sandwich! Master your skills, timing and determination to deflect their unique and challenging attacks in this Boss Rush.

details.title: 超时空怪盗
details.short_description: 是架空世界冒险喜剧！！！你将化身一位土著人，与一位来自20年后的少女一起组成跨时空搭档，前往未来世界冒险并搜集传说中能改变一切的宝物！本作是一款搞笑游戏，目的就是逗笑你让你开心！因此在冒险过程中，你会遇到各种各样让人啼笑皆非的事。 千万不要在喝水的时候游玩本作哦！不然你就………………不渴了呢……

details.title: Chess 2
details.short_description: Chess 2 combines chess-like tactics with territory control, economy, diplomacy, and special units. Expand across the map, build your position, and outplay opponents in singleplayer or multiplayer.

details.title: VCR83
details.short_description: VCR83 is a psychological horror game where you monitor security cameras and report strange anomalies.

details.title: The Real Guest
details.short_description: Warning: Do not go outside. Keep your doors tightly shut. Pull the curtains closed. Only allow humans to enter. Eliminate all "impostors".

details.title: Autobahn Police Simulator 4
details.short_description: Experience daily police duty on Germany's Autobahn like never before and keep the peace in a living open world. From traffic stops to high-speed pursuits: every call is yours to answer.

details.title: Just a Simple Turn-Based RPG
details.short_description: A short and straightforward turn-based RPG where every action matters. Explore, cast spells through quirky enchantments, help the townsfolk, and hunt for treasure, without endless grinding or overcomplicated stories.

details.title: Liv
details.short_description: You are accused of the disappearance of a young woman. To prove your innocence, you must solve the case. Use the computer, the victim's diary, and her videos from the last months. You can use specialized software and the police datas. Make deductions, solve puzzles and find out what happened to Liv.

details.title: Atana
details.short_description: Atana is a female-led romance visual novel set in late 20th-century America, where you grow alongside your creator, Atana, as an AI.

details.title: Till & Toast
details.short_description: In this cozy organizing and management simulator, sort 3,600 freshly baked breads and pastries onto the correct shelves, open your bakery for business, earn coins, upgrade convenience abilities, and unlock adorable food-themed assistants and decorations to build your own bakery.

details.title: ALIGNMENT : An Engineering Odyssey
details.short_description: Route a road through real mountain terrain, build it with curves, earthworks, bridges and tunnels, then drive it to test the design.

details.title: Pocket Chef: Asia
details.short_description: Pocket Chef: Asia is a cozy, hand-drawn ramen shop game. Start at a little Japanese street cart, make every bowl with your own hands, crack riddle orders, count out the change and keep your quirky customers happy. In the full game, the journey continues across Asia.

details.title: SHORE
details.short_description: Stuck in the middle of the ocean, survive together on a fragile physics-based raft. Fight storms, tsunamis, sharks, and starvation as you find your way back home in SHORE, a 1-4-player co-op survival adventure.

details.title: Redast
details.short_description: Secure the area, detect the anomalies, solve the ritual, and reach the extraction point at all costs. A multiplayer operation combining tactical FPS dynamics with supernatural hunting.

details.title: Blades & Trades
details.short_description: Forge your legacy as both merchant and hero. Explore Zoldar, battle monsters for rare materials, and craft epic gear. Team up with friends to build a thriving shop in the village markets or arm yourselves to conquer the dangerous depths of the wild.

details.title: Blood Arena Path of Steel
details.short_description: Fight your way through brutal medieval arenas with physics-driven melee combat, effective armor systems, and violent consequences. Master swords, maces, and shields as you rise from fighter to champion.

details.title: 99 NIGHTS IN THE APOCALYPSE
details.short_description: A 1-5 player co-op survival game. Team up with friends to survive 99 nights in a post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, build your camp, craft weapons, explore different biomes, and fight off waves of enemies and powerful bosses.

details.title: 键盘农场 Keyboard Farm
details.short_description: "Keyboard Farm" is a desktop idle farming game. Place it on your desktop and focus on your work. Every key is a plot of land—each keystroke helps plants grow. Harvest crops to collect coins, unlock various keycaps, and create your own keyboard world.

details.title: Creatures
details.short_description: Breed, teach, and guide your Norns as they grow into independent creatures. Explore the world of Albia, develop their skills, and build new colonies by sending your strongest Norns into unexplored worlds!

details.title: Smart Train Simulator
details.short_description: Take the controls of the classic 81-717 and modern 81-765 on Moscow Metro Line 7. Master authentic cab controls, braking and safety systems, and explore stations and depots on foot. Built on professional train simulator technology.

details.title: 幻想乡毋宁
details.short_description: Grow crops, build a home, and venture into Gensokyo in this 3D Touhou Project fan game. Explore the Human Village, get to know familiar characters, and combine everyday life with journeys and action combat beyond your fields.

name: Blood Arena Path of Steel: Prologue

details.title: Blood Arena Path of Steel: Prologue
details.short_description: Fight your way through brutal medieval arenas in this free prologue featuring physics-driven melee combat, effective armor systems, and violent consequences.

details.title: 你离开之后
details.short_description: 《你离开之后》是一款文字互动类乙女向游戏，再次醒来时你发现自已似乎已经是一缕魂魄了，你的爱人在你离开后变得敏感脆弱，而你的行为将会或直接或间接的影响到他，最终走向不同的结局。 一款美味的鳏夫文学，你的冷漠与无视会让向来冷静矜持的爱人在你面前发疯变得歇斯底里，你的捉弄会让他在梦里情难自已，你的一举一动都会让他改变，你离开之后，他活成了你的样子，或是你想要的样子。

details.title: PWC Simulator
details.short_description: PWC Simulator is a jet ski simulator with online racing, freestyle, and mod support. Ride stand-up and sit-down skis with simulated water, hull and rider weight. Customize your rider and ski, race buoy courses or freeride in surf and flatwater, or flip and do tricks on flip skis.

name: DARK・PLANETARIUM~ダーク・プラネタリウム〜

details.title: DARK・PLANETARIUM~ダーク・プラネタリウム〜
details.short_description: 『DARK・PLANETARIUM』PLANETARIUM×HORROR GAME.Girl &deformed head get lost in a dark planetarium an a dying planet and travel through space. 「Don't forget. This planet」It features antique pixel art with a space theme.

details.title: Chest & Blade
details.short_description: A dark fantasy idle RPG where the fighting happens on its own. The deciding doesn't: open chests, compare gear, salvage the rest, then spend it on skills, runes and three-card augments until the wall you were stuck on breaks. Offline progress keeps it moving.

details.title: Tired of Being the Hero
details.short_description: You saved the realm. Now you just want to chop wood, but monsters won't let you retire. Train your villagers, pull them out of harm's way, unlock new abilities to outlast the next assault, and try to remember why you became a Hero. Hold the line together in this short, story-rich, fantasy action RPG

details.title: 687 Days on Mars
details.short_description: 687 Days on Mars is a survival game where you are stranded alone on Mars - your task is to manage resources, build a base from scratch, grow food, and explore the red planet in search of supplies and other hidden challenges. Every breath and decision counts - can you survive on the Red Planet?

details.title: About Fishing
details.short_description: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

details.title: Whenster
details.short_description: Who knows when what happened? Whenster is a timeline card game for friends: place movies, TV series, video games, inventions and historic events in the right order before the clock runs out. Host on Steam, and your friends join for free right in their browser.

details.title: 四季餐厅
details.short_description: Four Seasons Restaurant "is a restaurant management game that combines classic simulation management with a warm and healing art style. Whether you're reliving the classic joys of the past or experiencing the refreshing gameplay of the four seasons, this place will be your culinary sanctuary.

details.title: Let's Drive - learn driving simulator
details.short_description: There are 1.3 billion cars in the world. But how many good drivers are there? Is every one of them trained and competent? Find out while playing Let's Drive, a driving school simulator that shows you hazardous situations on the road and puts you right in them.

name: CrocApoca!! Crocodile maiden at the End of the World

details.title: CrocApoca!! Crocodile maiden at the End of the World
