details.short_description: A first-person Arctic survival game where the cold is deadlier than any enemy. Explore on skis and by boat, scavenge supplies, fight to survive, manage your warmth, food and water, uncover the secrets of the desolate North, and find your way home.

details.title: Nightbound
details.short_description: Two strangers share one house at the end of the world. Their only hope: trust each other, fix up a van, and reach a mountain too cold for the Bloom to follow. You fight as a pair with turn-based tactics. Live the days together, hold the house at night, and build a bond that outgrows the Bloom.

details.title: Keycap Keycap!
details.short_description: Enjoy the satisfying click of every keycap! Collect a variety of keycaps, upgrade your skills, and acquire powerful Relic Keycaps. Keycap Keycap! is a short and satisfying incremental ASMR game.

details.title: StowStow
details.short_description: StowStow is a first-person warehouse sim where every box is a physics object. Stop the train, unload and sort cargo, handle explosive parcels with care and load the trucks. Draft upgrade cards and build conveyor lines until the depot runs itself.

details.title: Fogreaver
details.short_description: Shoot zombies. Earn cash. Take back your Base Camp and clear the surrounding areas. Bring home supplies, upgrade your weapons and head out for more. Wake the hordes, lure them into traps or fight from horseback. Kill every last infected to keep what you earned. Then gear up for the next run.

details.title: Forgotten - Whispers of the Past
details.short_description: Something in this abandoned boarding school refuses to rest. Use your flashlight to survive what lurks in its hallways and solve the puzzles that reveal its dark past. Will you find the truth, or will you be the one forgotten tonight?

details.title: Sirin's Feather
details.short_description: The Bird of the Dead has taken your beloved. How many times will you have to die to bring her back? Gather companions, uncover their secrets, and shape the story in a world where pagan myths come alive.

details.title: Stack Out
details.short_description: Obviously, Cubes are known for their aerodynamics. Dash, slide, wall run, grind, and swing through dreamlike worlds. Play solo or with up to 5 friends. Chase every medal, then architect a world of your own and see how you stack out.

details.title: Bullet Barrage
details.short_description: Shoot. Dodge. Control the distance. Bullet Barrage is a commandless 1v1 bullet-hell action game featuring 8 unique fighters, CPU battles, local versus, and online multiplayer.

details.title: Mortal Chess
details.short_description: Every piece is living on borrowed time. In Mortal Chess, each piece's life counts down with every move. Collect the coins from expired pieces, buy extra turns, deploy reinforcements, and earn the queen you don't start with. Play vs AI or local split-screen PvP. Checkmate isn't the only way to lose.

details.title: Time Champions
details.short_description: Recruit units from different historical periods and defend the timeline against alien invaders in this action-roguelike. Mix and match units to discover game-breaking synergies and use hero powers to survive enemy hordes. Unlock new units and evolve them to wreak absolute chaos on the battlefield!

details.title: Shortcut Hero: Grid City
details.short_description: Turn real keyboard shortcuts into devastating attacks in a fast-paced arcade action game. Defend Grid City from relentless robot invasions, chain explosive combos, and master the skills that separate heroes from high-score legends.

details.title: Cat and Dog: Princess Guardians
details.short_description: Dark demons swept across the entire continent, and the princess embarked on the road of escape. Along the way, she encountered many cats and dogs that had been ostracized and abandoned by the world. In the end, these cats and dogs voluntarily transformed into guard towers to protect the princess

details.title: Sealed Gate
details.short_description: Sealed Gate is an exciting pixel 2D MMORPG with a huge world, lots of quests, crafting and social gameplay. Engage in battles with monsters, explore mysterious locations and become the hero of your own fantasy story!

name: VOID DIVER: Escape from the Abyss

details.title: VOID DIVER: Escape from the Abyss
details.short_description: Dive into a city swallowed by the Abyss. Slay aberrations, grab artifacts, and survive until the Diving Booth arrives. A 2.5D pixel art extraction action RPG with up to 3-player co-op. Run the antique shop 'BALUSHA' and uncover the city's secrets.

details.title: MAGNUM Protocol
details.short_description: Take control of the M1A5 MAGNUM. Fight mechs, drones, robots, and enemy tanks across ruined cities, frozen wastelands, and abandoned battlefields. Explore a hostile world and customize your tank with a powerful arsenal of weapons and upgrades as you uncover the secrets buried beneath the ruins.

details.title: DARK IN LIGHT
details.short_description: A man who falls asleep while working late wakes up in an unfamiliar city overrun by monsters. Survive with limited resources and explore the city by following clues through the darkness. You must press on to make it back to the son waiting for you.

details.title: Drain It All
details.short_description: Drain a 10,000-ton dam, starting with a paper cup. Sell water, buy pumps, build a filtering and bottling plant, and find out what is at the bottom of the dam. A first-person incremental game about one extremely bad plan.

details.title: Labyrinth of the Crystal Princess
details.short_description: A horror adventure that tasks you with detecting the Unseen to escape the facility's labyrinths alive.

details.title: Long Watch
details.short_description: A short incremental game about an old relay station waking up from deep hibernation. Collect signals, decode the messages they carry, and grow your station into a network across nearby sectors.

details.title: Click to Mine
details.short_description: A cozy mining incremental. Click to shatter ores in a sunlit forest clearing, sweep up the pieces for gold, and spend it by the campfire at night. Unlock 14 ores, flying magic pickaxes and powerful abilities on your way down to the legendary Fire Opal.

details.title: Cats In The Shell
details.short_description: Provoke explosive chain reactions and experiment ever-evolving combat strategies in this mech-building roguelike auto battler. Mix and match components and mech modules to discover powerful synergies, then watch each creation spring to life in satisfying combat sequences.

details.title: Rottenroots
details.short_description: You play as Salem, torn between family and forbidden love, thrown into a three-day death tournament. Can you help him survive, love, rescue and betray... while figuring out who he wants to be? 25+ endings and 300+ choices await in a hauntingly beautiful dystopia.

details.title: Medieval Frontiers
details.short_description: First-person colony simulation where strategy meets survival in a demanding, medieval wilderness. Construct gridless settlements, establish production chains, and manage the needs, desires, and work morale of your villagers to ensure their survival through the harsh realities of nature and disease.

details.title: Stip
details.short_description: Assign, undo, deduce! Solve a series of minimalist number puzzles. Use constraints to assign numbers to the correct stips. Navigate the interconnected puzzles to uncover secrets. Please ignore any odd Stip behavior.

details.title: Lost Lands
details.short_description: A minimalistic, chill city builder inspired by Nordic culture and landscape, with mysteries to uncover and a unique world to discover.

details.title: Killing Things With Your Friends
details.short_description: Rip limbs off mutants and use them as weapons in this chaotic co-op survival game about dark humour and dismemberment. Hack through mutant hordes, work as a team, and survive lethal challenges for profit!

details.title: Pocket Racer Shop Sim
details.short_description: Create the ultimate Pocket Racer hobby shop. Stock the shelves, open car packs, build miniature race cars and expand your store over time. Design custom tracks and invite your friends over to help run the shop or to throw down on the latest track setup.

details.title: Wait, They Can Climb?!
details.short_description: In this incremental Tower Defense you are alone on top of a building, surrounded by thousands of zombies. Place the turrets, grab the rifle and survive 10 days waiting for rescue. But be careful: they can climb!

details.title: You've Changed
details.short_description: You've Changed is like scary "spot the difference". Observe changes in the environment and catch enemies before they attack in this retro-inspired, anomaly horror game! You've Changed features hand-animated rotoscoped enemy graphics and finely-tuned gameplay balance.

details.title: Hexrite
details.short_description: You are a sorcerer seeking to fulfil a magical ritual to summon an ancient dead deity. Cast mystical domes, explore fantastical realms and meet a peculiar cast of characters in this stylized PS2-inspired action-platformer!

details.title: Backrooms: Impending Doom
details.short_description: The research team is gone. You're next. A first-person psychological horror in the Backrooms - explore ruined levels, keep your Synchronization steady, and uncover what destroyed your research team. Free demo: the Prologue.

details.title: PaintScape
details.short_description: PaintScape is a 3D coloring book you can step into. Every map starts as a blank line drawing. Pick any brush and paint freely, or color by numbers. As you paint, sleepy flowers wake up and little chimneys begin to puff smoke. Walk around inside your painting, where every mistake is a happy accident.

details.title: Musgro Farm
details.short_description: Start a farming empire in this incremental factory builder. Plant crops, combine them into recipes, and distribute them for sale. Optimize your layouts and reinvest in your infrastructure to maximize your output. Gain experience to unlock new technologies and expand your ever-growing automated farm.

details.title: KYC: K Stands for Killing
details.short_description: Suneil starts his new night job at a gas station on the outskirts of Highwayton, Colorado. The customers keep coming but few of them leave. Something in the dark keeps asking for them.

details.title: Clash of Melodies
details.short_description: A Visual Novel Rhythm Game that tells the story of two dorks who don't like each other going on an adventure together. Play the DDR / FNF inspired Arrow Mode and the original Circle Mode. Enjoy the story or go for a highscore in Freeplay.

details.title: SwipSwap
details.short_description: SwipSwap is a fast-paced 3D game where every hit is fatal. Fight alongside your shadow—which echoes your moves with a 2-second delay—swap positions instantly, and purge Dracoulous’ castle room by room. Sharp reflexes, positioning, and ruthless timing are your only hope.

details.title: LOVE COMPANY: A Romance Escape
details.short_description: Love leaves clues. Join LOVE COMPANY, a company that delivers feelings of love. Inspect objects, follow emotional traces, and solve puzzles to uncover the truth behind those feelings in this first-person romantic mystery escape-room game.

details.title: One More Asteroid
details.short_description: Drill voxel asteroids apart in an incremental mining game. Grow from one drill to a swarm of drones that mine where you aim. Unlock powerful tools, crack the core and watch the asteroid collapse. Then take on the next, stranger rock.

details.title: Cat Secretary
details.short_description: Welcome to DOX HQ! Manage your lobby, catfish your boss and climb that corporate ladder. But when the sun goes down, the real work begins, because there’s only one thing standing between humanity and total AI automation: one very determined cat! Who's a good Cat Secretary? You are!

details.title: Murder Meet Cute
details.short_description: Look, just because I’m paid to fix computers, doesn’t mean I’ll sit here and listen to your life story. So what there’s been murders? Do I look like a detective?

details.title: Snipers & Airdrops
details.short_description: A competitive sniper game for you and your friends, 1v1 or 2v2. Fight over airdrops falling into the middle of the map, outplay each other with agent abilities and wild movement, build a rifle that's all yours, and spend your winnings at the Black Market.

details.title: Global Plates
details.short_description: Build food factories that keep a cat café purring. Plan at your own pace, serve fresh dishes through the rush and turn your best days into upgrades. Travel through ten kitchens in a cozy cooking-automation game about tasty efficiency.

details.title: Field of Heroes
details.short_description: Swords, sorcery – and soccer. Assemble your friends and get on the Field of Heroes, the wildest, most radical online sports brawler ever. Sharpen your weapons, focus your spells, and SCORE!

details.title: Usual June
details.short_description: Fight monsters, talk to ghosts, and get to the bottom of a mystery threatening to obliterate an entire city in Usual June, a third-person action-adventure game about combat, cupcakes, and community.

details.title: Crowd of Knives
details.short_description: An online PvP stealth game where every assassin looks like an NPC. Blend into a crowded medieval marketplace, hunt your targets, and strike without being seen. Get caught killing, and the bounty is on your head. Now you're the one being hunted. Pick and use your abilities to outplay the others.

details.title: Kagenazo
details.short_description: Kagenazo is a 3D shadow puzzle game where you build cube shapes, rotate them, and match their silhouettes from multiple angles. Solve over 190 puzzles across 2x2x2, 3x3x3, and 4x4x4 cubes while chasing cleaner solutions, faster times, and higher star ratings.

details.title: Fill the Sky
details.short_description: A factory automation game where you are the mind of a self-replicating interstellar probe. Turn barren rock and ocean into sprawling industry that feeds the data centers you run on. Launch copies of yourself until they fill the sky. No enemies. Build at your own pace.

details.title: Demra: Rifts of War
details.short_description: Real-time strategy in the spirit of the 90s classics. Build your base, seize mines and lead your army with a spell-casting hero against a demon invasion – or command the demons yourself.

details.title: Portabellows
details.short_description: Explore a whimsical island to find… pie recipes?! Bake them by gathering or growing ingredients, which may be the key to helping out your new found quirky friends leave the island! In this wholesome 3D platformer collectathon, you can enjoy discovering the world freely at your own pace.

details.title: CRIMSON GATE
details.short_description: A roguelite RPG where auto battler meets tower defense! Summon and deploy 30 battle dolls. Grow your legion with gear and card combos, and take on the final boss waiting at the end of 100 waves.

details.title: Defend the Village
details.short_description: Build towers along winding waterways and Defend your Village against pirate fleets. Combine mythic powers, grow crops, research upgrades, and face powerful bosses across multiple maps in an epic single-player fantasy tower defense adventure.

details.title: I Buried Steve
details.short_description: Eight players build a lethal beach obstacle course, then all eight have to survive it. Think Ultimate Chicken Horse crossed with Fall Guys, with axes, artillery and a Sharknado. Draft the traps, rig the sand, then run for your life as the water rises.

details.title: Sweepcremental
details.short_description: minesweeper, but with a skill tree.

details.title: Illegourmet
details.short_description: From underground kitchen to culinary empire. Cook and distribute illegal food across a city obsessed with healthy eating. Expand your network of kitchens, automate production, and take over the black market for flavor.

details.title: Now With More Plunk
details.short_description: A Plinko-like incremental where your coins strum harps, hit drums, and eventually create their own master orchestra. Go Plunk it up!

details.title: ZOMBILLIONAIRE
details.short_description: Incremental FPS game where Millions of Zombies came from the dead... AND THEY ARE FULL OF OIL!!!!!! Demolish Millions of Zombies. Buy Insane Weapons. and become a Zombie Oil Billionaire

details.title: The Outer Islands
details.short_description: Explore a quarantined island chain and an automated hospital abandoned for twenty years. Investigate a returning signal, read the evidence left behind, solve mechanical systems, and evade machines that still believe they have patients.

details.title: Grid Forge TD
details.short_description: Stop continuous waves of enemies by building a maze in this free flowing tower defense game. Purchase upgrades between runs to become even more powerful and go further next time.

details.title: Idle Forgewarden
details.short_description: A cozy pixel-art blacksmith forge that lives on your desktop and keeps working while you do other things. Step in whenever you like to time the hammer, take commissions, arm adventurers for the road and grow a humble forge into a legendary smithy.

details.title: Crystals Of Irm
details.short_description: Crystals Of Irm is an old school RPG with a distinctive combat system and dungeon crawl elements. With three heroes you explore Irm, visit the different regions of the land and climb deep down into the darkest dungeons.

details.title: Special Agent: Aigis Pink
details.short_description: Aigis Pink and Blue work together under Tritonis to combat the evil organization known as Joker. A month after Aigis Blue infiltrates Joker's hideout alone and goes missing, Aigis Pink begins searching for her missing partner...

details.title: Stock Car Classics: Championship Season
details.short_description: Race door to door in a throwback stock car racing experience! Battle hard-fighting opponents, build rivalries, and chase the championship across asphalt, concrete, and dirt ovals.

details.title: NEXT OBJECTIVE
details.short_description: The objective marker IS the monster. Play as Tom, a very obedient boy, and teach him how to disobey. Leave the playable area, break the rules, and fight back against a game that wants you to stay on script.

details.title: Pigeon Gang
details.short_description: Pigeon Gang is a physics-based co-op horror game for 1–6 players. Play as thieving pigeons, grab loot with your sticky tongue, explore dangerous locations, hide from monsters, and escape together. Stealing is easy. Surviving is not.

details.title: Soulstonia
details.short_description: Recruit Summoners with minds of their own in this single-player 2.5D fantasy RPG. Control them individually, as a party, or set goals for them to gather, craft, and fight on their own. Explore five regions in a procedural world, complete quests, train 20+ skills, and summon an army. Free to play.

details.title: Crownmarked
details.short_description: Rule a fallen kingdom: manage its people, send adventurers into dangerous lands, and explore the wilds yourself to learn what broke the world.

details.title: Forge More, Mole!
details.short_description: Sell now, or try one more upgrade? Become a mole blacksmith and strike the anvil to raise your weapons' level and value. Head home after a day's trading, where unexpected events await to shake up your ordinary routine.

details.title: DOOBAK
details.short_description: While you were sleeping, a blizzard buried the entire village in snow. Now you need to evacuate alone or with a team of up to 4 players! Dig tunnels, scavenge for supplies, warm up by campfires, and try to call for rescue.

details.title: Tides of Empires
details.short_description: Two empires, one sea. Tides of Empires is the tower defense roguelite game you can finally play competitively. Command warships, aircraft and submarines in ranked 1v1 & 2v2 duels, in a challenging campaign and endless Survival. Rule the tides.

details.title: CURSOR SLASH
details.short_description: A pixel-art incremental game where your mouse cursor attacks automatically! Slaughter slimes to earn gold and collect ores such as copper, iron, and gold. Unlock a variety of skills, weapons, relics, and coins, then sweep away hordes of slimes!

details.title: Third Bloc
details.short_description: A text-based political management sandbox set in the Cold War. Balance the budget, recruit experts, bargain with rival powers, answer telegrams, and drag a poor new republic into the space age. Or bury it in a nuclear one. All in animated ASCII.

details.title: Dudo
details.short_description: How good are you at lying? Everyone cheats, and cheating is the rules in Dudo. Peek under cups, nudge your dice, lie to a table of crooks and climb through smoky back rooms to find out who is the Owner. A roguelike deckbuilder of bluffs, loaded dice and bad company.

details.title: Witch Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Step behind the counter of your very own sorcery shop. Witch Shop Simulator is a cozy first-person shop management game where you invent and brew custom potions, manage your stock, and keep your shelves full of magical wonders for customers to buy.

details.title: FIND KITTENS 14: Slavic Mythology
details.short_description: In a faraway kingdom… kittens are hiding! What are you waiting for? Explore a hand-drawn world of Slavic myths and folk tales, find hidden kittens, and fill the black-and-white scenes with different colors.

details.title: Local Game Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own local game store and rewrite the rules. Crack packs, haggle over trade-ins and chase numbered pulls with up to 8 players in co-op or rival stores. Build your own cards, packs, games and consoles and share them on Steam Workshop.

details.title: Midnight 42
details.short_description: One of you just wants to sleep. Everyone else is a mosquito. Buzz, bite and sabotage until the human snaps, or grab the swatter, finish your chores and fall asleep before 6 AM. Online asymmetric party game for 2–7 players (1 human vs up to 6 mosquitoes) with proximity voice chat.

details.title: Seaside Wash
details.short_description: Seaside Wash is a cozy job simulator where you clean, repair, and restore ships from rust and barnacles to pristine condition. Upgrade tools, grow your business, discover rare finds, build your own ship, and enjoy peaceful seaside activities.

details.title: MIXBALL: Football Basketball Volleyball Tennis
details.short_description: Mixball combines the world's most popular sports into one action packed game. Play Soccer, Basketball, Volleyball, and Tennis in the same arena. Enjoy Single Player, Local Multiplayer, or Online modes as you challenge your friends in fast paced, adrenaline filled matches.

details.title: Island Keeper
details.short_description: Island Keeper is a cozy exploration and restoration adventure. As maintenance robot Ferrum-1, clean up a polluted archipelago, recycle rubbish into gear and stations, and watch every island turn green again as wildlife returns.

details.title: Smash Arena
details.short_description: An online party game for up to 12 players: brick-built toys clash in wild, physics-driven challenges. Run, jump, shove, survive the glass bridge and Red Light… and climb onto the podium. Dress up your toy and challenge your friends!

details.title: RumBall Stadium
details.short_description: Vehicles. Arenas. Friends to crush. RumBall Stadium: the Free to Play multiplayer vehicular combat game ! Drive Tanks, 4x4s and Racers in explosive arenas ! Collect Coins, equip Super Powers and crush your friends ! Discover multiple arenas and game modes !

details.title: Brofish
details.short_description: Brofish is an autobattler roguelite with Tower Defense elements. Catch and upgrade bizarre fish, combine items, effects, and hold back waves of undead to save the village from the Sea King!

details.title: World's Worst Handyman
details.short_description: Suit up as the "World's Worst Handyman" in this comedy stealth game where every job is a chaotic adventure! Dodge disgruntled clients, bungle repairs, and save your beloved animal shelter from bankruptcy.

details.title: Net Raiders
details.short_description: Net Raiders is a strategic roguelike deck-building game where you play by performing Card Merge.To survive the dangers of a crumbling virtual world, merge the cards in your hand and find the best moves to defeat the enemies you face!

details.title: Super Galaxy Gladiator
details.short_description: Super Galaxy Gladiator is a survivor roguelite focused on buildcrafting and inventory management. Fight waves of enemies, buy and upgrade items mid-run, and arrange your gear to create insane builds and synergies in the galactic arena.

details.title: Take One Down
details.short_description: Ninety-nine bottles of beer on the wall. You know how it goes. Take one down, pass it around, and keep the Singer company at the bar. He's sung this song more times than he can count, and lately it's starting to sound a little strange.

details.title: Night Hike
details.short_description: Find your way through a dark wilderness in this puzzle roguelite where you assemble the trail. Choose your path, interact with lost souls and navigate obstacles with the spin of your compass to escape the endless night.

details.title: Matelotes
details.short_description: The Royal Hen has disappeared! Lead a group of enthusiastic (though unqualified) sailors on a quest for glory, riches, and, as fate would have it, poultry. Visit a variety of islands, resolve political conflicts, and upgrade your boat in this narrative adventure game inspired by RPGs.

details.title: One Try Only!
details.short_description: A hardcore platformer where you only get one attempt. Fall once, and the game is locked forever.

details.title: Harventure
details.short_description: Harvest, collect and upgrade! Harventure is a short incremental game about harvesting and using resources on upgrades to purify islands from corruption.

details.title: The Borderless: Cozy Island Simulator
details.short_description: A cozy floating island management sim where you build and expand your own island world from a small platform in the middle of the ocean. Welcome visitors, meet their needs, plan activities, hire staff, earn money, and grow your ocean paradise day by day.

details.title: Indoor Shrimp Farming Simulator
details.short_description: Channel your inner shrimp in this totally normal idle-clicker aquarium simulation...

details.title: Somebody's Home: The Boarding House
details.short_description: 1980. You rent a room in a quiet boarding house, eat at the landlady's table and help with the chores. She calls her lodgers family. But as the days pass, you can't shake the feeling that something in that house is wrong, and has been for a very long time. First-person psychological horror.

details.title: Lelu
details.short_description: Get your gears in motion for a captivating monochromatic adventure where you play as Lelu, a small but determined clockwork toy who has gained consciousness and found a taste for freedom!

details.title: Ashcrown Gauntlet
details.short_description: A dark-fantasy roguelite of turn-based, three-on-three battles, played out in a living book. Your mercenaries share one pool of energy. Beat challengers to keep them for good, steal their abilities, and climb a ladder of crowns where every boss plays by its own rules.

details.title: DEAD SPIN
details.short_description: Gamble your way through a deadly casino in this dark roguelite deckbuilder. Survive the campaign or challenge other players in PvP mode. Discover broken synergies and keep spinning for your freedom!

name: Crimson Realms: Relics of the Forgotten World

details.title: Crimson Realms: Relics of the Forgotten World
details.short_description: Embark on a colorful adventure set in a nighttime environment in Crimson Realms! Battle creatures and demons with eight attack styles, defeat powerful demons to claim Realms, and overcome perilous demons, creatures, and obstacles to complete epic missions in a world filled with danger and wonder.

details.title: Partial
details.short_description: Master difficult platforming, puzzles and combat with limited retries inside an unforgiving hazardous interconnected world. Partial is an intense 2D action-adventure where you play as a vulnerable and bizarre creature, seeking to uncover the mystery behind the Partial project and your own existence.

details.title: Forgery
details.short_description: Forgery is a dark medieval roguelike about counterfeiting the King’s coins. Meet each buyer’s target with a handful of punches, then arrange stamp dies that trigger and repeat one another. One good strike can be worth a king’s ransom.

details.title: Deep Digger
details.short_description: Dig down, sell what you haul up, go deeper. A pixel-art mining incremental about numbers that climb: 19+ ores, 40+ permanent talents, sealed caves, portals to other dimensions. Prestige and keep what you built. The tenth run clears in minutes what the first took an hour.

details.title: TRUMPP VS ELON TYCOON
details.short_description: Build your vehicle empire in Neo-Berlin 2157! Manufacture cars, military vehicles and orbital spacecraft in this dark humor idle tycoon. Automate factories, outsmart rivals and rise from street hustler to orbital overlord!

details.title: The Unseated
details.short_description: Reclaim your name in a mythic pixel-art action roguelite. Unlock eight divinities, fight 100+ monsters and nine unique bosses, stack powerful Offerings, rewrite each ascent with Decrees, and chase your high score in THE PIT.

details.title: CALX
details.short_description: Flow across the WARP-corrupted planet Syro. Master movement as the Seeker. Double jump, dash, levitate and grapple through atmospheric ruins. Scan, solve puzzles, and engage in measured combat in waves of stillness and frenzy.

details.title: UvsU: You vs You
details.short_description: Outsmart your past self in a battle of cause and effect. Explore an interconnected clay world, discover its hidden rules, and uncover the secrets it would rather keep buried.

details.title: Roads & Riches: Traveling Merchant Simulator
details.short_description: Hit the road and set up shop, solo or with friends! Take your caravan wherever demand leads, sell wonderful wares, and find magical treasures - all to win over the hearts, minds, and wallets of a vast, dynamic world!

details.title: Cube & Seek
details.short_description: Relax and find hidden objects in handcrafted 3D tiny cube worlds. Search for hidden treasures and enjoy fun interactive surprises along the way!

details.title: Arizona Sunshine®
details.short_description: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine® brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.

details.title: Signs Of Devourer
details.short_description: Its another night shift in the store, except this time you are trapped with monster disguised as one of the items. Keep the floor clean, shelves full, serve the customers... and try to not get devoured until the dawn.

details.title: Dead Reckoner
details.short_description: Navigate the darkness in Dead Reckoner, a stealth-action submarine game where survival depends on more than firepower alone. Slip through the shadows, elude your enemies, and exploit their weaknesses as a new recruit in a mysterious government initiative that will determine the future of humanity.

details.title: Alien Archeologist
details.short_description: Alien Archeologist is a chill incremental digging game. Use a variety of upgradeable tools to mine ore, blast through earth, and clean strange artifacts as you journey yet deeper toward the mystery hiding at the planet's core.

details.title: Football Chess
details.short_description: Every player on the pitch is a chess piece. Make the right move, disrupt your opponent's strategy, create the perfect attack, and take the shot. The excitement of football meets the strategy of chess in one unique game.

details.title: Flarebound
details.short_description: Tiny dungeon puzzle game. One flare. Ten steps. Draw a path through a forgotten dungeon before your light runs out. Avoid dangerous traps and evil creatures. 20 quests, 100 rooms.

details.title: Grizzly Cup: Tour de Mondo
details.short_description: Represent your country in a retro top-down arcade racer for up to 16 players online. Customise your car and driver, fly your flag, and race for the podium. Play solo, compete in Cups, and build your own tracks.

details.title: Shell Soldier
details.short_description: " Shell Soldier " is a high‑octane first‑person shooter set in a bleak dystopian future. Featuring frenetic firefights against a diverse range of enemy combatants, each employing unique tactics and weaponry, and offering a wide arsenal of lethal tools at your disposal.

details.title: Biden Blast
details.short_description: Brawls on the island, cigarette-butt tossing, and a stealthy hunt for lightbulbs in the stairwell—welcome to Biden Blast. Play solo or compete against friends in absurd challenges where accuracy and audacity are everything.

name: 阿宅的我被二次元女同事搭讪了！

details.title: 阿宅的我被二次元女同事搭讪了！
details.short_description: （本作根据真实事件改编）你是一名刚毕业的程序员阿宅，入职第一天就被二次元女同事七海强势搭讪，这位爱捉弄你的可爱坏女人，用各种甜蜜伎俩猛攻你的心房！游戏拥有29个HappyEnd，从嘴硬到心动，你能扛过几轮攻势？宅男与同事的恋爱日常，就这样开始啦！

name: Muscle Girl Lexy: My Personal Trainer

details.title: Muscle Girl Lexy: My Personal Trainer
details.short_description: Meet Lexy, a powerful and muscular personal trainer. Train together, face unexpected events, and grow closer as you discover the softer side hidden beneath her cool exterior in this gym-themed romance visual novel.

details.title: ARCHSCROLL
details.short_description: An indie action RPG set in a fantasy world. Experience a deep storyline and immersive action featuring beautiful characters and environments!

details.title: Trigger Range
details.short_description: A fast-paced, competitive shooting range game where speed and precision are everything. It's like Track Mania with guns.

details.title: Found it!: Lost & Found Co.
details.short_description: The mafia is forcing you to grow a lost & found business until you find their missing legendary item! Go solo or team up in co-op to unpack deliveries, decipher vague clues, and grab, carry, and throw your way through warehouse chaos.

details.title: Primary School – English Grade 1 & 2
details.short_description: A complete English learning app for Grade 1 & 2. Explore 20+ curriculum topics with guided explanations, multiple-choice quizzes, progress tracking, spaced repetition, and final year tests. Cute animated teachers make learning fun, structured, and confidence-building for kids and parents alike.

details.title: Divinuet
details.short_description: A compellingly unique deterministic musical tarot experience, which guides you through a tarot reading in two segments. In the first, each card plays its own musical theme. In the second, music and videos combine to tell the overall story of your reading. A short ritual made to be returned to often.

details.title: Zoo Life Tycoon
details.short_description: Inherit a run-down zoo at the edge of town and turn it into the pride of the city. Repair pens, care for 21 species, welcome families and juggle your own life too: eat, sleep, make friends and upgrade your home in this cozy pixel-art zoo tycoon and life sim.

details.title: GAP OR DIE
details.short_description: There’s only one rule: make the jump. Push your speed, commit to the gap, and survive as long as you can in this high-risk endless racing game. Upgrade your ride, and see how far you can go before everything goes horribly wrong.

details.title: Temple of Patience: [ 1xSCREEN//0xRNG ]
details.short_description: 1 screen, 4 coins, and 0* RNG. Yes, it's a retro style puzzle-platformer — not hard to guess. But you're probably wondering why there's an asterisk next to the zero, aren't you?

details.title: Ashfield Hollow
details.short_description: Build a life in the ruins. Ashfield Hollow combines deep survival, real-time combat, farming, crafting, and fishing in a post-apocalyptic world that nearly didn't make it. Ten years after the outbreak, Camp Ashfield is one of the last places left. Whether it stays that way is up to you.

details.title: Money Simulator
details.short_description: Hustle to the top through jobs, deliveries, street races, gambling, and risky crypto plays. Buy, upgrade, and flip cars and motorcycles for profit. Build your empire by launching businesses, managing operations, and hiring staff. Take bold risks, make big moves, and rise!

details.title: The Park Keeper
details.short_description: Become a ranger in a national park where people have doubles. Check visitors, explore the forest, and help its strange inhabitants. A copy might be better than the original. But does that give it the right to take their place?

name: Buy The Game, I Have a Gun 2: Online Open World

details.title: Buy The Game, I Have a Gun 2: Online Open World
details.short_description: Save the world from Alien Jesus in this 1-10 player online co-op sandbox game where you explore an open world, do quests, watch a HIGH-QUALITY interactive movie, and play minigames! Now that’s a mission for Sheesh-Man, his wife, his mom, and his dad!

details.title: All Haul the King
details.short_description: A co-op game where you and your friends embark on an epic journey to drag the goblin king’s dead body across the kingdom to resurrect him. Use brains, brawn and crazy goblin magic to navigate the tricky terrain and puzzles that lie in your path.

details.title: Ant Colony: Wild Forest
details.short_description: Build and automate your own ant colony – a nest that runs itself! Freely dig and shape your underground kingdom, produce different types of ants, and grow it block by block. Then it's time for conquest: scale up your swarm, crush enemy bases, and lead your colony to victory in the wild forest!

details.title: Pico Drift
details.short_description: Explore the city as your ultimate racing arena. Dodge traffic, outsmart the cops, and challenge your friends. Experience official campaign tracks and game modes, or create your own playgrounds. This is your world - drive it your way

details.title: Tiny Ramen Shop
details.short_description: 🍜 Run your own cozy Japanese ramen shop in this charming cooking simulator! 🐱 Prepare delicious ramen, serve hungry customers, and grow your restaurant with an adorable cat assistant. 🏮 But when night falls, mysterious yokai and spirits from Japanese folklore come looking for a warm meal! 👻

details.title: Cyber Planet
details.short_description: The World's Fastest Rage Game

details.title: Echograve
details.short_description: You have been appointed warden of an underground complex. Check documents and identify dangerous citizens by their behavior and sounds. Decide whom to let through the airlock and defend against threats from below. Until your shift ends, their lives — and yours — are your responsibility.

details.title: Thrice Entombed
details.short_description: Your tomb has been raided and your treasure stolen, so it's time for revenge! Push blocks to crush enemies, solve puzzles, and level up. Recover your treasure to permanently restore your ancient strength. Inspired by Pengo, solo-developed, and hand-crafted.

details.title: The Royal Restoration Society
details.short_description: Tidy up a cozy castle, solo or with 3 other friends! Queen Zoe has called upon you to clean and redecorate her family home. Put everything in its rightful place, remove dirt and rubbish, and repair banners and rugs. Go at your own speed or try to beat your best time against your friends.

details.title: Idle Mall Simulator
details.short_description: Build and expand your own shopping mall in this fun idle simulation game. Open new stores, increase your profits, keep customers happy, and turn your mall into a thriving business empire!

details.title: Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon
details.short_description: Embark on a Sci-fi Roguelike Turn-based RPG with Tactical combat. Become a Captain of a freight ship, deliver cargo through deep space, manage your crew, upgrade your ship, fight space warships, and build your reputation. Every day brings a new adventure. Space shows no mercy.

details.title: Rally King
details.short_description: Rally King is a casino-themed ping pong roguelike where every rally puts the pot on the line. Play solo or with up to 3 friends. Hit chips, collect cards, roll dice, stack multipliers, and build broken paddle combos before one bad shot wipes it all.

details.title: IronFire Idle Defense
details.short_description: Defend IronFire against endless waves of zombies in this hybrid defense game combining idle mechanics and roguelite progression. Create near-infinite builds, unlock multiple weapon types, upgrade your defenses, gain powerful bonuses, and more! How many days can you survive?

details.title: Derby Dynasty : Horse Racing RPG
details.short_description: Start with a foal, build a dynasty. Breed your horses, refine their bloodlines, and take the reins yourself or trust your jockeys. In Derby Dynasty, every victory is part of a story that spans generations.

details.title: Modoolo
details.short_description: Puzzle your way through the Modoolo factory. Your daily dose of brain tease from the brain rot.

details.title: Mountainhall
details.short_description: The dwarves have chosen you. Will you lead them? A new land, a new start, and a mountain waiting to become a home. Dig it out from the inside, lead a colony of dwarves with lives of their own, and stand with them when the goblins come. Build a settlement, a fortress, a Mountainhall.

details.title: Our Art Show
details.short_description: Open an art show with friends. Paint at the teaching easel while everyone watches the big screen. Hold up a finished canvas, find it a frame and a spot on the wall, and pass the music player to whoever brought the good songs.

details.title: Ardenfall
details.short_description: Inspired by classic The Elder Scrolls games, Ardenfall is a first-person, open-world RPG of ancient cultures and rival factions. Explore windswept plains and forgotten dungeons, forge your path with steel, magic, or persuasion, and shape the fate of those you meet.

details.title: Pup & Mole: Gold Rush
details.short_description: Join Pup & Mole on a cozy mining adventure across 7 historical areas. Hop into your minecart, build rail tracks, and dig deeper for hidden artifacts. Upgrade your gear, unlock new tools, and complete your collection while earning money by selling gold and rare treasures.

details.title: Loot List: Thief Sim
details.short_description: Rise from pauper to master thief - grab the loot list and get to work, whether it’s a roadside diner or a federal vault: slip past security and make fools of everyone, or unleash chaos and blow the place apart. Fence the haul to upgrade the hideout, gear up, and build your criminal empire.

details.title: Bossinator TD
details.short_description: Build towers. Fight beside them. Shape your build with bonus cards between waves. Bossinator TD blends classic tower defense with direct hero control, active and passive skills, and battles against hordes, elites and bosses. Spend your gold on the defense, your hero, or both.

details.title: Fish Tankfully
details.short_description: Fish Tankfully is a desktop idle aquarium sim that blends relaxing fishkeeping with a realistic ecosystem. Raise 200 ornamental fish, build tanks with plants, driftwood and gear, and manage lighting, filtration, stocking and compatibility with ease, even as a beginner.

details.title: Homemade Oxygen
details.short_description: In the right hands, a wrecked ship can be a ticket home. In Homemade Oxygen, combine cards into production chains, send colonists on expeditions, and keep your crew alive while assembling a ship to escape. On this planet, survival means finding a way out.

details.title: Supa-Market: Japanese Super-Market Simulator
details.short_description: Build your own Japanese supermarket! Stock unique products, organize shelves, serve customers, hire staff, set prices, and grow your cozy anime-inspired store into a thriving business. Every decision shapes your supermarket!

details.title: Tidy Up The Chocolate Factory
details.short_description: Tidy up a magical chocolate factory solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op. Sort hundreds of sweet varieties, unlock helpful upgrades, and complete collections to bring candy gardens into bloom. Chocolate streams, marshmallow flowers, and a delicious mess await!

details.title: Fantasy Weaponsmith Simulator
details.short_description: Become a master weaponsmith in this fantasy simulator! Combine unique parts, materials, and effects to craft countless types of weaponry. Haggle with customers, fulfill orders from across the realm, and build and decorate your dream medieval weapons shop!

details.title: Beefy Boi
details.short_description: Beefy Boi is a job-sim horror. Clock in. Take orders. Survive your BOSS who is a giant meat monster and we intentionally broke him. Reach the highest quota and become employee of the month.

details.title: Ratiator
details.short_description: Raise gladiator rats from a spoon and a bottle cap into legends in tin can armour. Write the plans they fight by, win the deadly Colosseum, then take your strongest through the door beneath it. Not all of them will make it back home ...

details.title: Warmace: Miniature Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Build the ultimate miniature hobby store! Order model kits, paint stunning miniatures, negotiate with collectors, and grow your business into every hobbyist's favorite shop.

details.title: Wheel of Death
details.short_description: Spin the wheel... or die. Wheel of Death is a dangerously addictive deck-builder where you'll spin Death's wheel, changing your fate with powerful Tarot card combos, rule-breaking chips, illegal contraband, and a wheel where the numbers go up!

details.title: Red Echoes: Berlin
details.short_description: Berlin 1918. Amidst the turmoil of the Great War, the fires of revolution burn. With the German Kaiser's reign rapidly coming to an end, lead a group of socialist revolutionaries and attempt to change the course of history. Will you succeed and bring about a better tomorrow?

details.title: The Fish Corner
details.short_description: Run your own cozy fish shop, collect unique breeds, care for your tanks, and decorate your home. Breed rare fish, manage customers, and grow your store. Build, customize, and create the aquarium life you dream of.

details.title: Bravers
details.short_description: Build your own ship, recruit a crew to man it, and fight your way through the underground caves of a world wrecked by the Great Impact. Lead your crew through a fascinating journey full of danger, mysteries, friends and foes. Are you brave enough?

details.title: Mining Guild Idle
details.short_description: Mining Guild Idle is an inventory / resource management based incremental style game featuring 15 to 20 hours of gameplay

details.title: Crack a Pack
details.short_description: An incremental collectathon. Crack packs till you complete your collection. Sacrifice cards for upgrades, hire pawns, and swim in money. One question remains: Can you crack 'em all?

details.title: Ballistic Brews
details.short_description: Drive tanks and robots in a third-person bullet-heaven roguelike. Drift, shoot, and smash through 15 waves while brewing the ultimate build to take down brutal bosses and elite enemies.

details.title: Rogue Mech
details.short_description: Take control of a rogue mech pilot in a world of ash and ruthless factions. Explore the wasteland, upgrade your arsenal and forge alliances. Create a safe haven, grow crops and scavenge for resources in this hearty, post-apocalyptic adventure.

details.title: Demon Slayer Rome
details.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based RPG. Battle demons and absorb their abilities, uncover secrets and progress in power, and save an Empire lost to sin as you go up against eight demon princes and the hordes of Hades! Demon Slayer Rome is turn-based Mega Man set in the time of the Roman Empire.

details.title: Red Tide
details.short_description: Red Tide is an EXTRACTION FISHER set in the irradiated wastelands. Radioactive fish? Heavily armed Game Wardens? Exploring a vast open world with a rod in one hand and a rifle in the other? Scavenge what's left of the former nuclear site among the Calem Islands, alone or with friends.

details.title: The Curator
details.short_description: The Curator is a roguelite gallery-management game which managing your traveling art gallery. Combine the unique artwork skills, organize your collection by day, impress the picky visitors by night, and use your earnings to prepare for the next city.

details.title: Swap Bots
details.short_description: Adapt to the needs of your ever-changing team of robots in this fast-paced, deck-building auto-battler. Combine robots to create the perfect team with the best card synergies before they wear down completely.

name: This is why, you shouln´t build hackbots Karl

details.title: This is why, you shouln´t build hackbots Karl
details.short_description: Karl just wanted free games on Vaporizor. Now his rogue hackbot is devouring digital worlds pixel by pixel! Thrown into the chaos by the Cheat Buster Authority, Karl must hack, fight, and fix his mess to save the gaming multiverse!

details.title: Protect the Pit
details.short_description: Attack with your cursor, build towers and walls to defend your pit! An incremental clicker that combines tower defense, maze building, and large upgrade trees. Earn money, upgrade your defenses, and build winding mazes to stop the hordes of the Dark Forest.

details.title: Prismfall
details.short_description: Prismfall is a strategic incremental game about defending your Prism from waves of enemies. Earn gold, wield powerful abilities, and buy upgrades from a deep and extensive upgrade tree.

details.title: Primal Survival
details.short_description: A realistic prehistoric survival game where you play as Homo habilis or Homo erectus. Craft primitive tools, build shelter, hunt massive beasts, and survive the harsh forces of nature in a vast multiplayer world.

details.title: Bazaar Below Zero
details.short_description: Don Morsa has kidnapped you and put you to work digging ice to stock his bazaar. You obey… but every tunnel you dig brings you a little closer to the way out. A co-op incremental for 1–4 players: sell to seals, upgrade your tools, hire penguins and plan the great escape.

details.title: TROPHY FLEET
details.short_description: TROPHY FLEET is a top-down shoot 'em up where every boss you kill becomes your next ship. Fly an unbroken run from world to world, shoot out each core, and steal it. A full run is about an hour, and it never pauses.

details.title: Dungeon Automata
details.short_description: Dungeon Automata「Algolemeth」is an "autologic": a JRPG dungeon crawler meets auto battler where you control your party with visual node-based programming. Program your party and conquer dungeons automatically. Master the dungeon through trial and error!

details.title: Voivod: The Nuclear Warrior
details.short_description: A brutal action game set in a collapsing sci-fi nightmare. Battle biomechanical mutants, traverse shifting landscapes, and uncover fragments of your lost mind as you descend into a twisted post-apocalyptic world.

details.title: Dino Age: Survive the Eras
details.short_description: Explore one island across three prehistoric eras in a single-player 2D survival RPG. Build your camp, craft better gear and hatch prehistoric companions. Face dangerous creatures and heal fractures in time to open the way forward.

name: Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck

details.title: Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck
details.short_description: Discover hidden truths about the world in this 3D adventure about a giraffe with an unreasonably long neck. Figure out the rules, solve strange mysteries, and stumble upon unexpected twists. Choose your own path.

details.title: Trellis
details.short_description: TRELLIS is a puzzle/adventure game featuring Fig, a robot caretaker tending to its plant. Shine the Spotlight to guide Fig and solve dozens of unique puzzles, uncovering the mysteries of an ancient alien temple long forgotten… but not abandoned.

details.title: Villion:Code
details.short_description: Cozy Okada presents a brand-new action RPG set in the near future where humanity teeters on the brink of extinction. Genome editing has ushered in a new age—but is there any hope for the future?

details.title: Phantom Beasts - Redemption
details.short_description: Phantom Beasts - Redemption is a free to play cyberpunk 2.5D shooter that has the appealing blend of story, special ability system, and an explosive, gore-filled combat.

details.title: Snow Yard
details.short_description: Dig out your yard after an overnight snowstorm in this cozy first-person snow-clearing game. Push snow into piles, sweep the steps clean, and save up for a snowblower. Your missing car keys are out there somewhere. So are ten little garden gnomes.

details.title: Sol Mates
details.short_description: Blast and laugh your way through space with up to 4 friends in this chaotic roguelike co-op. Every run is a new adventure so steer, shield, and work together to take on unpredictable challenges - or at least go out in style.

details.title: ANDREAD
details.short_description: Complete randomly assigned errands in Torpa, a strange neighborhood trapped in an endless time loop.

details.title: Frog Knight
details.short_description: A brave little frog and his talking sword climb a cursed well in this precision platformer. Jump, bounce, and master your timing to save the world. No checkpoints. No shortcuts. Just one long climb... or fall.

details.title: Ironweld
details.short_description: Ironweld is a 2D side-scrolling action RPG where every encounter feels like PvP. Survive opponents that use the same moves and parts as you. They chase, punish, launch, and pressure you back. Repair and rebuild your squad between stages as you push deeper. Lose them all and it's over.

details.title: Chess You
details.short_description: Play classic chess against girls who tease, provoke, and challenge you.

details.title: Cozy Interiors
details.short_description: Ever dreamed of becoming an interior designer? Design cozy homes and get paid for it. Build and decorate charming interiors, unlock a wide variety of furniture, and create wholesome spaces filled with personality, furry friends, and perfect little details.

details.title: Don't Stop The Pop!
details.short_description: Ready to turn a single kernel into an unstoppable popcorn machine? Build your strategy with a massive Skill Tree; discover dozens of flavors from salty to chocolatey, spicy to salted caramel, and fill the screen with pops! Earn more, pop more! Don't Stop the Pop! 🍿

details.title: Last Gnome Standing
details.short_description: You’re a gnome playing poker with friends. Lose a hand, eat a magic mushroom. Keep losing and the trip gets wild: cards shift, names swap, voices warp. Last gnome standing wins.

details.title: KAKUREONI: Hide-and-Seek Horror
details.short_description: This is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. Play a 3-minute game of hide-and-seek in an abandoned school at midnight. With only the beam of a flashlight to guide them through the darkness. Experience the thrill of a deadly hunt.

details.title: ARIA BLUE I. NATSUOTO
details.short_description: ARIA BLUE is a summer youth fantasy adventure game about nine boys and girls. Each installment focuses on one protagonist and two heroines, weaving a single story across the same span of time. This is the story of one summer, spent reclaiming a wish that had long been given up.

details.title: Fallgrade
details.short_description: Bend gravity. Twist architecture. Survive the impossible. A first-person exploration game set in an analog concrete nightmare, where reality shifts around you and Karl waits for your next mistake.

details.title: Above Water, Below Hell
details.short_description: Fight your way through a zombie-infested high-rise in flooded Chicago. Inspect survivors, track their symptoms, and lead them to safety in this first-person horror shooter. Fortify your route and protect your group. One missed infection can turn a rescue into a massacre.

details.title: Hollow Home
details.short_description: A narrative survival RPG set in a city under siege. No weapons, no combat, just the choices you make and the people you make them for. Inspired by real events. Made in Ukraine.

details.title: Drug Dealer 2049
details.short_description: Drug Dealer 2049 is about building a fully automated factory that produces ever purer drugs, in a 2D world. Design your production lines, cross plants into new strains or cook synthetic drugs, sell your production to customers, and protect yourself from every threat.

details.title: Road Diner Simulator
details.short_description: Start as a cook in Becky’s roadside diner and become her business partner. Cook dozens of dishes, keep guests happy, hire and manage staff, then expand and decorate the place your way. Play solo or in online co-op.

details.title: PRISON OF HUSKS
details.short_description: Awaken as a doll and seek your beloved. In this nostalgic souls-like set in a painted afterlife, explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts. From parries to pistols, tune your build to overcome adversity. Battle lovelorn bosses and seek your lost love.

details.title: Swordeye
details.short_description: Persistent PvPvE dungeons. Full loot extraction. 120 tick duel servers. 6-directional blocks and attacks. Master your sword or die trying.

details.title: Macaronpolis
details.short_description: Design your own 'all-in-one' macaron factory and become the CEO of your dream bakery. Decorate recipes at your own pace, or dive deep into optimizing production and adapting to ever-changing customer demand. Start from a small shop and conquer the world as a legendary CEO!

details.title: Roulettegeddon
details.short_description: Roulettegeddon is a darkly comedic roulette game where classic casino betting meets zombies, black humor and chaotic mini-games. Bet against the wheel while Rotten Bob mocks your every move, then earn more credits through a collection of bizarre zombie mini-games.

details.title: Galactic Space Guard
details.short_description: Galactic Space Guard is a turn-based tactics game. Lead your squad of elite soldiers to defend humanity’s space stations, upgrade your squad, prepare for battle, and restore peace across the galaxy!

details.title: Fate/EXTRA Record
details.short_description: Fate/EXTRA Record is the chronicle of a war fought by modern magi who stake their existence on the bonds they form and the wishes they hold. This emotional story unfolds with a sleek, reimagined art style and a new strategic battle system. The first true RPG in the Fate series is reborn!

details.title: Our Freedom: Medieval Village
details.short_description: Our Freedom is A Medieval Colony Sim with Action RPG Adventures. Build a village, lead your people, produce food and materials, forge powerful weapons, recruit an army to protect your village in epic battles and castle sieges. Stand up for your people and help them defend their freedom!

details.title: Hold Your Position
details.short_description: An incremental-style tower defense game where you face waves of orcs, undead, and demons. Recruit more troops, buy and upgrade skills, obtain powerful spells, and hold your position.

name: Closed World: Memories of a Fleeting World

details.title: Closed World: Memories of a Fleeting World
details.short_description: A long-form 3D JRPG of exploration and memory. Four hundred years out from Earth, six hundred sleepers share a single dream — and in its last chapter, Lityria sets out remembering nothing. Twelve labyrinths, 380 hand-built maps, one buried truth.

details.title: Cosmic Karma
details.short_description: Cosmic Karma is a cosmic roguelike card battler. Chain playing-card combos to build Flow, adapt to Karmic Laws, and risk tougher battles for XP to shape powerful Tarot and Combat Special builds.

details.title: Witchbrook
details.short_description: Discover magic and mystery in Witchbrook, a spellbinding witch life-sim for up to 4-players! Start your life as the newest resident witch in the bustling seaside town of Mossport. Make friends, find love, and discover a world filled with wonder and charm on the road to graduation and beyond...

details.title: Heroes Frontiers
details.short_description: A charming, bustling colony sim in retro pixel art. Carve thriving towns out of an untamed fantasy world. Recruit heroes to defend them or send them questing for fame and loot, and survive a procedurally generated continent full of danger and adventure.

details.title: Tiny Misery
details.short_description: A sick mother and her young son move into the home of a lonely old woman. A tragic story inspired by the dark puppet animations of the 80s and 90s.

details.title: Tropico 7
details.short_description: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

details.title: MR MAGEBOY
details.short_description: A cozy incremental game about an aspiring mage opening a Rescue Ranch for lost Familiars. Gather resources, upgrade your spells, explore biomes, and turn a profit to help your village thrive.

details.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
details.short_description: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.

details.title: Instruments of Power
details.short_description: Prime the battlefield with the spells you built. Consume what you laid down to summon an army of your selves, then strike the shadows before your tether to this world gives out. A turn-based tactical RPG where every spell you cast is one you built, and every summon is a choice.

details.title: WheelJumper: The Art Of Edging
details.short_description: A wheelchair ski jumping roguelite about chasing victory in the Happy Friendship Cup. You time your jump at the edge of the ramp and hope your body holds out until the last hill.

details.title: Tapis
details.short_description: Tapis is a score-chasing roguelike played on a game table. Tokens fall onto the board, each with its own effect based on its position and family. Your goal: score a huge amount of points. To help you, you'll have repositioning moves to strategically place your tokens and maximize your score.

details.title: Agama versus Bugs
details.short_description: Meet a constantly hungry bearded dragon. In pursuit of her next meal, she must watch out for various traps and obstacles lurking throughout the terrarium. Who will win this adventure? The ever-hungry lizard or the crunchy bugs?

details.title: Vorath
details.short_description: A dark action RPG in the spirit of the classics: hordes, loot and a skill tree with eight directions to mix. Defeat twelve guardians, gather their sigils and summon Vorath, the Void – solo with a mercenary or in four-player co-op. Free to play; only looks are for sale.

details.title: Silent Frequency
details.short_description: One night. A dead mountain road. An abandoned radio tower where your grandfather stopped answering. All he left behind: handwritten notes, scattered frequencies and his voice on tape. Bring the tower back to life and listen closely. Something out there is listening back.

details.title: Oshi Knockout!
details.short_description: A rhythm action game where a cat-eared idol punches overeager fans who leap at her and kicks eager photographers who slide in, all on the beat. A 30-minute story across 10 Japanese vocal songs, from a rooftop dojo to a dome graduation concert.

details.title: Overcharge
details.short_description: Overcharge is a chaotic 2-4 player co-op platformer where holding the Energy Core for too long gets your team wiped. Catch and pass the core as you run, jump, and dodge through deadly obstacle courses. Climb the Ascension spires, overcome the Gauntlet, or build your own maps in Creative mode.

details.title: Sun To Sun: Endure
details.short_description: Online co-op survivor for up to 4 players. Hold out from sun to sun against endless hordes, buy weapons from the merchant, stack power cards and bring down 16 bosses across three maps. Or take on the single-player campaign alone.

details.title: Cleaner Company
details.short_description: Star Wipers, ready your mops! Cleaner Company is a gory Cleaning Sim for 1-4 players. Clean abandoned space stations, alien outposts, and infested restaurants across the galaxy... starting with the corpses of your predecessors.

details.title: Growback
details.short_description: Grow a plant, then decide when to cut it down. Its roots and woody stems survive, and the cut earns you seeds for permanent upgrades. In this cozy pixel-art incremental game, you start by clicking a tiny sprout and end up with a whole canopy and root system working for you.

details.title: Elemental Lands
details.short_description: Build a base to support heroes in turn-based tactical card battles & defeat enemy breaches overwhelming your land! Your base-building strategy powers your spell deck, weakens foes & heals heroes. Position 3 heroes & use spell cards to seize enemy objectives for buffs. Cards are tactics, not damage.

details.title: The Wolfheaded
details.short_description: A pixel survival horror in an autumn forest. By day you chop wood, gather stones and berries and build a shelter. By night a tall creature with the head of a dog comes out of the trees. Keep the fire burning, hide, hold the walls and last until dawn. Alone or with friends.

details.title: Kingdom Isles
details.short_description: Kingdom Isles is an intense Survival City Builder with Roguelike elements. Build a mighty Kingdom, Trade resources on the market, and defend your Island against increasingly tougher Viking raids! Can you lead your people to victory?

details.title: Wheel Wills
details.short_description: A roguelike where every attack is a gamble. Spin the Wheel to decide what each day throws at you, fill your grid with Gambits that either hit or miss, and repaint the Wheel itself to bend the odds your way

details.title: Evergreen Clicker
details.short_description: Grow a thriving forest in this cozy incremental clicker. Plant trees, unlock upgrades, weather the changing seasons, trigger Forest Renewal, and build an ever-stronger woodland that keeps growing even while you’re away.

details.title: RushGirl LUCA
details.short_description: Alien drones have trashed the city. To save it, android girl LUCA fuses a weapon into a weapon into a weapon into a weapon… LUCA, how many weapons is that?! A bullet-hell roguelite you play with a mouse.

details.title: Dacan Express: Logistic manager
details.short_description: Manage a high-stakes logistics depot where the hardest route to navigate is the human one. Negotiate ruthless contracts with e-shops, handle headstrong couriers on the brink of strikes, and build a delivery empire in a gritty management sim where every personality has a price.

details.title: Estella
details.short_description: A brand-new 3D rhythm game for mouse & keyboard. Ride a golden comet through the cosmos and compose your own adventure with every song and every note.

name: Memory Dive: An 3xscape Game — Chapter One

details.title: Memory Dive: An 3xscape Game — Chapter One
details.short_description: A first-person investigation inside a rebuilt memory. You are not a man in a room — you are the scan of one. Reconstruct what happened to him object by object, link the evidence, and learn to spot the parts the machine invented to fill its gaps.

details.title: ROCKBEASTS
details.short_description: A darkly funny narrative RPG where you manage a 90s grunge band from garage obscurity to stadium glory. Book gigs, wrangle egos and navigate a cutthroat music industry. Every choice shapes your band’s story and your own. Make it big without selling out.

details.title: RUNEBLADE
details.short_description: A knight against the endless dark. Three oaths, three lands, ten minutes a run — and a King at the end of each. Your weapons strike on their own: all you choose is where to stand. Fall, and the Sanctum keeps what you carried out.

details.title: HS of Death
details.short_description: A first-person horror visual novel with point-and-click investigation. Six people are dead and you were there. Search rooms, solve puzzles that never give the answer away, and make the choices that decide whether you walk free or face execution.

details.title: Veggie Warfare - Feast of Fury
details.short_description: The veggies have snapped! Blast through endless waves of enraged carrots, onions, and mutant tomatoes in this fast-paced rogue-like FPS. Collect upgrades, unlock new arenas, and survive the Feast of Fury — where dinner fights back!

details.title: Shiverin' Shillelagh
details.short_description: it's Halloween night, strange pumpkins roam the land. In this FPS, grab your shotgun & shillelagh to do battle in 8 atmospheric levels!

details.title: Destiny Is Dice
details.short_description: A dungeon of chaos determined by a few dice rolls. The only one you can rely on here is Grin, the witch who rules the all of this place. She’ll gladly rig the dice for you. Use this to create options that never existed before and build the strongest team! Until, one day, you no longer need her help.

details.title: Unicycle Gorilla
details.short_description: Ride a motorized unicycle as a gorilla in Unicycle Gorilla! Casual 3D speedrun with global leaderboards, hilarious crashes, and wild levels. Balance with L1/R1, dodge bombs, and rule the urban jungle!

details.title: WarFront
details.short_description: Oil is the only money, and every barrel has to drive home. Take the rigs, hold your roads and cut theirs: a blown bridge starves an army faster than any tank. A pixel RTS on nine hand-built maps, against bots or online, with a map editor and a zombie survival mode.

details.title: REMOTE CONTROL
details.short_description: A missing crew triggers an investigation that you must lead. 6 human subjects are at your disposal to aid the mission. Control their every move by typing commands to explore the ship. Be wary: the deeper you go, the more dangers that will risk their lives and test how disposable a life really is.

details.title: Do Not Stop : Co-op
details.short_description: Do Not Stop is a co-op survival horror driving game. Keep your car moving on dark highways to outrun a terrifying entity. Master drifting and crank your windows closed to survive!

details.title: Heart Of Muriet
details.short_description: Your faction is in your hands in this 4X real-time strategy game. As a powerful mage, build thriving settlements and diverse armies to discover the secrets and stories at the heart of Muriet.

details.title: Gloctopus
details.short_description: Eight guns is better than one — if you have eight arms. Gloctopus is a bullet heaven roguelike where you equip, mutate, and build your tentacles into a one-octopus army. The ocean didn't stand a chance.

details.title: River Drift
details.short_description: Paddle in sync or sink together. River Drift is a chaotic co-op rafting game where you and a friend fight wildlife, repair your raft mid-river, and survive deadly branching routes. Teamwork is optional, panic is guaranteed!

details.title: Glimmerwild
details.short_description: Glimmerwild is a voxel survival RPG where you choose your next adventure. Explore mysterious islands, build a home, craft your gear, cook, fish, and face powerful bosses. Follow quests, uncover hidden places, or spend the day making this world your own.

details.title: MEMORYLEAK™
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in MEMORYLEAK, a unique FPS that blends 2D, 3D, and VR gameplay. Set in 2000s Texas with a gripping narrative, it offers stunning Unreal Engine 5 visuals and a dynamic, interactive world. Ready for an adventure that redefines gaming?

details.title: Stabjack
details.short_description: It’s just you, a deck of playing cards, and a knife that won’t shut up. Stabjack is the roguelike, blackjack deckbuilder where you cheat to win. Tuck cards up your sleeve to use later, change your deck, and invoke supernatural items as you investigate a dark, devilish, comic-noir world.

details.title: Football Survivors
details.short_description: THE FOOTBALL WAR HAS BEGUN! Thousands of crazy fans are storming the field. Defend against the fans’ attack! 70+ unique heroes, professions, and abilities 50+ upgrade items 10 different classes Strategically place your heroes, manage your team, and repel the waves of fans!

details.title: Chick'n Slide
details.short_description: An incremental arcade experience where you pull adorable chicks onto giant slides, collect resources, unlock powerful talents, and upgrade your magnet to create ever-growing, chaotic runs.

details.title: Sunset Artisan Chocolate
details.short_description: Run a cozy seaside chocolate boutique!🍫 Weigh, melt, and craft handmade treats for your colorful customers, experiment with new recipes, meet locals, grow your chocolate brand, and settle into life in Sunset Town.

details.title: Sphere Wars
details.short_description: Sphere Wars is a fast-paced, class-based fantasy multiplayer shooter where Guardians, Warriors, Scouts, Mages, and Assassins clash in intense objective-based battles. Capture the spheres, master your class, and dominate the battlefields.

details.title: Nautilus Epoch
details.short_description: On an island in the Adriatic Sea lives a girl called Lily. Her world is turned upside down when she comes into contact with a mysterious seashell and finds herself lost in an endless cosmic ocean. Help her find her way back home.

details.title: Spada
details.short_description: Enter the arena in Spada, a brutal gladiator combat game where every strike counts. Master fast reflexes and rhythm-based button sequences, survive with deteriorating armor, and win the crowd to claim your freedom. Precision, timing, and courage are your only weapons, any mistake could be fatal.

details.title: Hexmental
details.short_description: Turn-based tactics where every spell reshapes the island. Lakes freeze into roads, grass burns, lightning runs through the water, and each element feeds off the others. Both teams plan in secret and act at once. Fight CPU teams solo or in co-op, or take your friends online in 2v2 and 3v3.

details.title: Loot & Bolt
details.short_description: A dungeon strategy party game for up to 8 players online. After each room, everyone chooses at once: press on or retreat with your gold? More treasure—or more trouble—awaits. Use items to grab gold and turn the tables. Your “teammates” may be the real danger! Play with friends or solo against bots.

details.title: MOP’N SPARK
details.short_description: Try, rewind, and rebuild! MOP'N SPARK is a 2D puzzle platformer built around clever thinking, where you coordinate a cleaner and an electrician to piece together the solution.

details.title: Dylio's Adventures
details.short_description: Imagine waking up transformed into an armadillo after fleeing an indescribable trauma. Step into Dylio’s shell and venture through dimensional portals and perilous paths to recover the treasures stolen by a mysterious crow… and uncover the truth behind your transformation.

details.title: Chains of Reality
details.short_description: Chains of Reality is a survival horror game focused on a story-driven single-player narrative, where you traverse a multitude of liminal environments and alternate dimensions in search of fulfilling your end of a deal, a deal made with someone you never should have trusted.

details.title: ScrapWings
details.short_description: Fight the Consortium's armada aboard your junkyard ship in an old-school flight simulator setting. Unlock new equipment recipes as you progress and build your aircraft of legend.

details.title: Possessions
details.short_description: An award-winning puzzle game about perspective. Turn each room until its scattered things line up and settle into place. There are no timers and no dialogue, only a family's life, told through the things they kept.

details.title: Don't Mind the Robots
details.short_description: Build deadly mazes and outsmart a rogue AI in this strategic tower defense game. Adapt your defenses, use aiming parameters to your advantage, and activate powerful perks to survive increasingly complex waves of incoming robots.

details.title: 妖恋西游
details.short_description: Transmigrated into the world of Journey to the West, you find that the gods, Buddhas, and yokai have all become girls—and you're their "new master"! To return to your own world, you set out on the road west once more. A love adventure full of romance and mystery begins here......

details.title: Alchemy Duel
details.short_description: Make poker-style hands from alchemy ingredients to create monsters, then position them and stack relics to build explosive combos in this roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: Plush Rangers
details.short_description: Survive waves of wacky mutated constructs and defeat powerful bosses with your team of Plushie friends in this quirky chaotic Survivors-like. Collect loot! Acquire merit badges! Dodge and dash your way to victory!

details.title: Chaos Coin
details.short_description: Your coins are your actions in this roguelike coinbuilder. Slot sequences of coins to shove, evade, and attack in turn-based combat. Fight in pairs using coins unique to each character. Upgrade and replace individual coin faces to build complex combos. Chaos is coming, so use your heads (and tails)!

details.title: The Last Captain
details.short_description: Embark on missions across an explorable star sector in this tactical, space RPG. Directly control your ship and its arsenal of point defense and special equipment in a dynamic environment. Use your hard-earned rewards to upgrade your ship, customize its modules, and lead allies in epic fleet combat.

details.title: Isle of Finbari
details.short_description: A cozy mystery life sim where robot companions, strange visitors, conservation, and personality-driven characters shape a living seaside world. Solve riddles, uncover secrets, and experience unexpected moments across a coastal town filled with arcade games, exploration, and strange encounters.

details.title: Alien War One
details.short_description: A retro roguelite vertical space shooter! Upgrade your ship, buy powerful buffs each run, and blast through waves of enemies.
