details.short_description: This Place at the End is a tactical, turn-based RPG about moving forward at the end of the world. 30 in-game days, 30 real-time hours, and 12 ways to reach the end.

details.title: Ninkyo Dantai
details.short_description: Ninkyo Dantai is a 3D top-down, role-playing video game developed by TeamCS1. It is the first mainline title in the Ninkyo Dantai franchise developed as a turn-based RPG.

details.title: Village vs Rock
details.short_description: Village vs Rock is a physics based incremental game about crushing mountains. Raise your village of orcs to wage war against the rock that keeps popping up in your backyard. Hurl mammoths, unleash spells, and upgrade everything to DESTROY THE ROCK!

details.title: 渔乐圈
details.short_description: 工作学习时，你的鱼塘正自动运转：鱼竿挂机钓鱼，员工打理渔场，顾客岸边垂钓。 慢慢扩建渔场，从钓台到茶座，雇人管理、研究鱼饵引稀鱼。偶尔点开，或许能撞见锦鲤上钩，员工在换水。 经营越用心，渔场越热闹，成你屏幕里的悠闲小天地 —— 随时来 “摸鱼” 呀。

details.title: Miscreant
details.short_description: You're a rogue-in-training trying to break into a legendary vault under your school. Explore the danger-filled academy after curfew to find 100 keys hidden behind puzzles and traps, and even trapped puzzles.

details.title: Mannequin: Echoes of Their Minds
details.short_description: Work the night shift at a clothing store, dressing mannequins according to instructions. Your job lasts 30 days. With every mistake, the store grows stranger. Unexplained anomalies keep appearing. Can you make it through all 30 days? A job simulator horror game where quiet work meets creeping dread.

details.title: Tamabuki
details.short_description: A survival horror where your key to making it through the Depths is taking care of the Homunculus housed within your Tamabuki. Devastating abilities are powered by this dwarf within the chassis, but forget to feed them and they might just end up eating you.

details.title: FISH³: FISHTASTIC FISHING FISHSCAPES
details.short_description: FISH³ is high-octane, surreal speed-fishing adventure where your boat is powered by fish! Engage in time-attack stages, dual-rod fishing, and underwater spear-fishing in a dreamlike world teeming with bizarre aquatic creatures.

details.title: Workaholic Simulator: Leaving the Dream
details.short_description: NOT your typical simulator! A surreal and dark descent into human psyche, burnout and the horror of the working culture. Work fast while escaping the monsters roaming these eerie spaces. There are no texts or dialogs in this game, putting raw feelings, abstraction and environment storytelling first.

details.title: Halve
details.short_description: Two spirits wake up separated in a broken world, with no memory of what they once were. Control them simultaneously in an atmospheric, immersive journey about separation, memory, and the hope of becoming whole again.

details.title: Shadow Mate
details.short_description: A horror action adventure game. Cynthia awakens in a ruined secret research facility with the vicious parasite “Belial” hidden inside her body. Surrounded by grotesque creatures and maddened researchers, she must use Belial’s power to escape and uncover the horrifying truth behind the laboratory.

details.title: 3D Nuclear Reactor Simulator
details.short_description: Operate and maintain a nuclear power plant in this immersive first-person simulator. Control a pressurised water reactor, diagnose equipment failures, repair machinery, manage critical systems and respond to emergencies where every decision matters.

name: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon

details.title: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon
details.short_description: Squad-based tactical RPG, with auto turn-based combat and real-time-with-pause map movement. Build your army, defend your territory, and unite Wales against the English invaders. Inspired by classic JRPGs including Ogre Battle and Ogre Battle 64.

details.title: Trinity Archetype
details.short_description: Create busted builds and unleash crazy combos in this Skill-Crafting Roguelike RPG! Mix and match bazillions of runes, boost it up in battle, and shatter the chaos consuming your broken world.

details.title: High Elo Girls
details.short_description: High Elo Girls is a Visual Novel set in the esports scene where you play as the latest recruit for a new all-girls team. Can you help your squad achieve their true potential, or will you only squander your own?

details.title: Roof by Roof
details.short_description: Climb up, lay clay tiles row by row and watch the light change over the village. Roof by Roof is a cozy first-person roofing game: lay patterns for rewards, take on roofing orders and grow from apprentice to roofing legend, all at your own pace.

details.title: KAPICI
details.short_description: Cover your friend’s night shift as the caretaker of an old apartment building. Take out the trash, clean the halls, and handle the usual complaints. It’s only one night—until one complaint leads you inside an apartment you can’t leave.

details.title: Zorezdra
details.short_description: Zorezdra is a sci-fi platformer/metroidvania with a retro graphical aesthetic. Run, jump, fight and glide your way through a vast starport as you search for the truth about your protagonist's complex origins.

details.title: King's Escape
details.short_description: The old war game of the North, brought to life. Lead the king's last guard to freedom, or close the ring and take his crown, across seven historic rule sets of Tafl. Battle a cunning computer, a friend at your PC, or anyone online.

details.title: Carhem
details.short_description: Chaotic car brawler where you collect items, spam unique abilities, and trash talk your friends. Knock opponents off the platform or keep them out of the circle to win!

details.title: Lines Go
details.short_description: Break your mindset and solve the "impossible" puzzles! This may seem like a simple lines-connecting game at first—until phenomena emerge that defy all your past experience. Yet the fundamental rules never change!

details.title: Gunnar Malakor
details.short_description: A FULLY BLIND-ACCESSIBLE AUDIO ADVENTURE You are Gunnar Malakor: thief, failed mercenary and escape artist. Sentenced to death in the dungeons of Lysanthir castle, you'll need cunning, improvisation and a little luck to break out and leave the kingdom.

details.title: Deserter
details.short_description: An immersive isometric stealth RPG about a thief surviving in a decaying totalitarian city. Plan every move, evade traps, and pull off daring heists right under the Party's nose.

details.title: The Gambit Lost to Time
details.short_description: Become a time-travelling goddess entrusted with saving the world in this tactical RPG! With powers capable of altering time and terrain - serve one of three distinct, warring factions, and unite them over many timelines to break free from a time loop of doom.

details.title: Nocturnal Visitors: Book One
details.short_description: An interactive isekai about Aliorbis, a world where magic and science, chaos and order, are two sides of the same coin. But remember: you are not this world's hero.

details.title: SPACE WALK
details.short_description: SPACE WALK is a hands-on first-person astronaut simulation where you operate an orbital station and conduct surface expeditions across the Moon.

details.title: Danger World
details.short_description: Explore an epic fantasy world alongside three heroes on a quest to recover a stolen jewel. Guide your party to victory in turn-based battles, make decisions that will determine the events of the story, and uncover the ancient secrets of Eldora as you race to catch the mechanical thief.

details.title: D.A.D.S.
details.short_description: Use your special ops units to construct base facilities and towers to protect them from the ever-increasing threat of alien invaders in this Tower Defense game with a city-building element! Research their weaknesses and develop defenses before mankind runs out of time.

details.title: 大学物语
details.short_description: "University Story" is a college simulation game where you play as a freshman. Experience family, friendship, and love over four years in university. How will you balance studying, socializing, and daily life? What kind of person will you become ? Every choice you make shapes your future!

details.title: Revertices
details.short_description: Directed by one of Cuphead's developers, Revertices is an action combat sidescroller where you will be forced to fight the corrupted remains of your friends: your duty is to reset the cycle at all costs, but in doing so you doom yourself and your companions to repeat the same horrors.

details.title: Lemonade Apocalypse
details.short_description: Make money selling lemonade. Optimise your product. Build your workforce. Sell, sell, sell. But money is not enough. Become president! Fuel climate change! Manipulate geopolitical events! Lemonade Apocalypse is an incremental game about business decisions that are technically legal.

details.title: Kindred Ills
details.short_description: Kindred Ills is a dark, loot-focused tile-based dungeon crawler. Build a party of mercenaries, discover powerful spells and items, and fight your way through dangerous biomes where death is permanent. Find rare loot, and push your party further with increasingly brutal difficulties and modifiers.

details.title: Roadside Egg Stand
details.short_description: Bring the residents of Reine the freshest, finest eggs! Raise cute chickens, collect their eggs, and sell them at roadside egg stands scattered throughout the village. Decorate your egg stand, collect your daily earnings, restock with fresh eggs, and read the heartfelt letters from the villagers.

details.title: Easy Drive Together
details.short_description: An easy and fun drive with a friend.

details.title: Supreme Heroes
details.short_description: Highschool sophomore Jacob suddenly discovers he has super powers and must team up with his best friends to become the 'Elect Few', but convincing them to embrace their powers and save the world is all but easy. Events bring Jacob to battle villainous factions in order to bring peace to the nation.

details.title: project; VIRAI: DOOMER’s LIFE ESCAPE
details.short_description: A psychological horror RPG with visual novel elements, where you live the life of Hicha, a shut-in hikikomori trapped in an endless cycle of depression, anxiety, and routine.

details.title: Multi Deck Hero
details.short_description: Multi Deck Hero is a roguelike deckbuilder where you command three unique decks to create powerful synergies. Strategically combine cards, unlock game-changing charms, and battle against increasingly powerful enemies. Will you master the perfect deck or fall to the challenge?

details.title: Untitled 2D Isometric RPG
details.short_description: Explore a dynamic 2D isometric fantasy RPG with procedurally generated worlds, adaptive AI, deep crafting, and story-driven quests. Shape your destiny through choices, combat intelligent foes, and forge legendary gear in an ever-evolving, immersive adventure.

details.title: Ayre Battles: Heritage Academy
details.short_description: A tactical card fighter where reactions, timing, prediction, and momentum matter. Build a 30-card deck, outplay your opponent with fighting game-inspired mechanics, and master strategic battles against an adaptive CPU or other players.

details.title: Everforge Legacy
details.short_description: Single-player action RPG inspired by Final Fantasy XI. Six Jobs, weapon skills, skillchains, elemental days, and Named hunts, rebuilt for one hero, with up to two Trusts at your side. Three origin stories through a complete Chapter 1 storyline.

details.title: Hopfall
details.short_description: Build your team in this froguelite autobattler. Tame corrupted frogs, equip them with powerful items, and discover team synergies to overcome mysterious enemies.

details.title: Mermeows: Chill Cat Mermaids
details.short_description: Welcome to Mermeows: Chill Cat Mermaids – where every splash brings a smile! In this enchanting idle clicker creature collection game, traverse hand-drawn lakes, hatch unique Mermeows, and upgrade serene habitats. Collect pearls and let magical currents carry you into a world of calm strategy.

details.title: Type for Speed
details.short_description: Your keyboard is the gas pedal. Type to accelerate, chain clean words into combos and nitro, and race friends or bots on 10 tracks. Survive the endless highway or just cruise in Free Drive. 129 cars to collect, 10 languages, each typed in its own script.

details.title: Maze Maou
details.short_description: A game about the struggles of an office worker in an anachronistic medieval fantasy setting. Strategically employ monsters and cursed items to keep adventurers away from your dungeon.

details.title: Astro Architect
details.short_description: A space station city builder where your employees vote on what gets built. Play the cards they choose, keep them fed and productive, endure Void waves and roll the dice on expeditions into deep space. The CEO is watching.

details.title: Golf-Like
details.short_description: A golf roguelike where the ball never stops. Tee off onto a road over the sea that sinks behind you, steer through the air, shoot down the spiked escorts hunting you and face the Kraken. Pick your route through portals, sports arenas and hidden caves. New road, new deck, every run.

details.title: Death In Your Dice
details.short_description: Roll the dice… or cities die. Learn lethal rules, twist outcomes, accept the cost. One bad throw calls the bombs. Win to delay death. Lose to become a murderer. Every choice reshapes your ending. Fate is loaded. Your turn is encoded?

details.title: Dino Cleanup
details.short_description: Clean giant dinosaurs and save cute prehistoric friends in a world flooded with goop! Unlock vacuum overdrive abilities for new ways to play and collect tons of hats in this nostalgic 3D platformer.

details.title: Loot Goblin Inc.
details.short_description: Break into homes, steal valuables, and sell them online to make big cash money! Join the corporate goblin world in this very cool Loot Goblin Simulation!

details.title: Pinewater
details.short_description: Pinewater is a cozy first-person fishing game about restoring a run-down lakeside cabin. Catch rare and legendary fish, restore and decorate your lakeside home, plant trees, and shape the surroundings to your liking — all at your own pace.

details.title: Story of Leaves
details.short_description: Start your new life! Build your dream farm, grow crops, craft, mine, fish, and forge heartfelt connections with charming townsfolk. Explore a vibrant world, uncover mysteries, and shape your own unforgettable story in this cozy farming / life sim RPG.

details.title: 财神模拟器
details.short_description: Become a novice God of Wealth! Grant fortunes or ruin fates with a touch. Your choices build "Virtue" for ascension or lead to轮回. Uncover the truth behind your divine power.

details.title: Akryon-D
details.short_description: A Metroidvania Action Adventure with AAA Graphics and Sound. Akryon-D stems from a distant star system, his ship is stranded taken over by a Cosmic Entity attempting to take full control of the ship. Help Akryon find and neutralize the Entity and regain control of his ship.

details.title: THE BACKWORLDS
details.short_description: RUN, JUMP, ESCAPE. Endlessly high buildings of dead ruins are towering over a giant chasm of green mist. But the reality of our world is seeping in, and some familiar places are now stuck there. This is how you are invited there - against your will. Enter the hostile realm of the BACKWORLDS.

details.title: Greedspire
details.short_description: Build powerful gear combos in a push-your-luck roguelike auto-battler. Enchant your gear to +20 or watch it shatter. Move to the next floor, or risk your entire run for richer loot in deadlier rooms. 100 floors. One life. How greedy will you get?

details.title: H.A.I.N
details.short_description: H.A.I.N: Heir of the Ancient Immortal Necromancer is an asymmetrical co-op horror/thriller game for 1–4 players. Explore hostile regions, collect ancient artifacts, and begin the final ritual. But one of you will become H.A.I.N, the betrayer, and trust will collapse.

details.title: AVROPOLIS
details.short_description: VR action-adventure with fully physics-based movement. Climb ruins, fight mysterious creatures and enemies, survive deadly traps, solve ancient puzzles, and manage your gear as Leonardo uncovers the lost civilization of AVROPOLIS. Story-driven campaign with strong accessibility options.

details.title: PaceBreak
details.short_description: Pacebreak is a first-person parkour speedrunning game. Compete against yourself, your friends or the top of the leaderboard. Play official levels, community maps, or create and share your own courses using the in-game level editor.

details.title: No Gods, Only Ducks
details.short_description: No Gods, Only Ducks is a chaotic mix of boomer shooter, wave survival, and extraction shooter gameplay. Fight through increasingly dangerous waves of corrupted creatures, collect powerful weapons and equipment, and do whatever it takes to survive long enough to escape.

details.title: Underground: World War
details.short_description: A brand new game inspired by the Def Jam series. Create your own fighter or play as some of your favorite rappers in this over the top fighting game.

details.title: Detachment Crew
details.short_description: Control a crew of outcasts and try to destroy the mining tower that is corrupting the environment. Many tried before, many failed. Surely this is a good idea. A sci-fi dungeon crawling game with handmade visuals, real time combat and unique exploration options.

details.title: Ice Cream Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run a seaside ice cream shop solo or in co-op with up to 6 players. Make ice cream, serve unpredictable customers, earn money, unlock new equipment, and expand and customize your shop as each day gets more chaotic.

details.title: Laser Guy
details.short_description: A twin-stick anti-shooter where you’re maneuvering your laser around coworkers trying not to blast anyone. Just another day in the gamedev office!

details.title: Dreadmark Outlaws
details.short_description: The West is dead. You’re not. Yet. Enter a grim Wild West overrun by the undead, build deadly defenses and turn every last stand into glorious chaos — alone or with your friends. Survive the night. Become an outlaw legend.

details.title: First Age
details.short_description: A turn-based strategy card game set in the Neolithic Age. Sacrifice villagers, tame mammoths, and build powerful card synergies to lead your tribe through the threat of the Dark Ages. Will your people stand the test of time?

details.title: Battlecaster 2
details.short_description: Battlecaster 2 is an intense top-down action roguelite. Descend to the center of a hostile world where control, precision, and aggression decide every fight. Push forward and dismantle enemy pressure through skillful play. Shape powerful, expressive builds as danger rises.

details.title: Rustborn - Outland Threat
details.short_description: You’re a cowboy abducted by aliens who accidentally ends up with a biomechanical arm. Run, climb, and shoot like crazy to survive hordes of deadly robots in this third-person bullet-hell shooter. Conquer the mothership and find your way back home!

details.title: Grav My Balls
details.short_description: Grav your balls and let them fly! You are trapped and must escape with the help of the strange tech built into your hands. Launch your balls to change gravity on objects blocking your path. Use your mind and your new powers to solve gravity and mind bending puzzles.

details.title: Drudgemark
details.short_description: The dark marches on the King's Realm and you stand at its border. Forge steel, build up your keep and command your soldiers in formation. Then draw your own blade and fight beside them in first person, alone or with your friends in co-op.

details.title: Lots at Stake
details.short_description: Build a property development company from the ground up. Find undervalued land, negotiate acquisitions, design profitable estates, navigate planning and construction, finance your projects and sell into a changing property market where every decision affects your return.

details.title: BOILED
details.short_description: America, 1925. A simple errand for an old friend pulls ex-gang leader Dan into a violent smuggler war on the border. A narrative-driven, adrenaline-pumping top-down shooter, set in the 1920s Old West.

details.title: Firewheels Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Co-Op Firewheels Shop Simulator lets you manage a diecast model store. Organize shelves, assist customers, and expand your shop in a detailed, realistic world. Hunt for rare and chase cars, trade with customers, and grow your diecast empire.

details.title: Spin Power
details.short_description: A short incremental building game where everything functions with your Spin Power. Build structures, mine resources, unlock new lands, upgrade yourself inside the big skill tree, automate resource mining to increase your income and awake the mysterious water tank from eternal slumber!

name: Escape from Planet Pan: Scam Center

details.title: Escape from Planet Pan: Scam Center
details.short_description: A fake job offer traps you inside the notorious Planet Pan Scam Center. Enduring daily abuse from guards, you are forced to scam strangers into fake investments while secretly planning an escape. A unique Butterfly Effect system brings past characters into future runs so you can change their fate.

details.title: Idle Circles
details.short_description: Relax and watch your marbles fill circle after circle. Make strategic improvements then unwind in this retro futurist, idle arcade game.

details.title: Fuzz & Dizzy: Part-Time Heroes
details.short_description: Fuzz & Dizzy: Part-Time Heroes is a charismatic turn-based RPG with platforming elements where you control two characters simultaneously. Together, you’ll journey through a colorful, lively world packed with humor, secrets, and interactive combat.

details.title: Song of Maka
details.short_description: Enter the wholesome Kingdom of Birds in Song of Maka. As a newborn bird, explore beautiful sky islands through song and flight. Uncover charming stories, hatch adorable companions, or simply relax to soothing melodies and breathtaking views.

name: The Great World of Time and Space

details.title: The Great World of Time and Space
details.short_description: Chrono Realm is a 2D pixel-art open-world RPG. Explore a vast fantasy continent, command contract summons, master arcane arts and combat techniques, collect a comprehensive encyclopedia of all things, and forge your own legend across space and time.

details.title: Bannerlands
details.short_description: Build a civilization one card at a time. Bannerlands is a roguelike deckbuilder where war, culture, and economy decide your empire's fate. Nine unique leaders. Hundreds of cards. One empire to build.

details.title: Pepper the Giant Purple Dog
details.short_description: In this twist on a harmless pet simulator, take care of Pepper, who happens to be a giant purple dog. But when things go awry, you will have to decide: how many lives is one good boy worth?

details.title: Star Pulse:The War
details.short_description: Star Pulse: The War is an independent real-time strategy game that merges science fiction with fantasy. Players will command a sci-fi faction, harnessing the power of star pulse to gather resources, construct buildings, train troops, and nurture heroes in the fight against invading magical forces.

details.title: Kung Fu Addiction
details.short_description: An auto-battler RPG where anticipation is everything. Predict your enemies' moves, shape your hero's progression, and channel the souls of ancient warriors to resurrect with a new fighting style as you overcome escalating challenges across multiple combat modes.

details.title: Apprentice of Darkness
details.short_description: Play as a dark magician, gather your party of all sorts of evil, unspeakable creatures and spread darkness! A hand-drawn, turn-based rogue-like experience! Sacrifice your enemies to Evil Gods, unlock new powers and recruits, build your Tower of Darkness to spread corruption throughout the continent.

details.title: Study Abroad Simulator
details.short_description: Four years abroad. A whole new life. Take on college in near-future America! Ace your classes, earn your keep, fall in love, and play your cards right. Then start again to uncover a hidden conspiracy. Your next big decision could change more than your future—it could change the world.

name: The Big Cleanup: Hotel Palm Beach

details.title: The Big Cleanup: Hotel Palm Beach
details.short_description: A physics-driven cleanup simulator. Put 1,000+ scattered objects where they belong using physics and your trusty van. Decorate however you want. Throw it. Organize it. Clean it. Help your aunt clean up this mess! Oh, and don’t forget your aunt’s grumpy chicken. She’s not exactly in the mood to help.

details.title: MoonBurn
details.short_description: Hand drawn. Fire fueled. MoonBurn is a twin stick shooter where you carve through hostile creatures, shape your weapon to match your style, and push deeper into a strange alien world.

details.title: HAKONIWA DEFENSE
details.short_description: "HAKONIWA DEFENSE" is a tower defense game in which the protagonist, who has lost his memory, cooperates with the girls to progress. Defeat enemies to regain your memory.

details.title: Queen's Vanguard
details.short_description: Chess meets tower defense, and you're the Queen. Defend your King against waves of enemy pieces. Place your own pieces where they hit hardest, upgrade them wisely, and turn the tide with the Queen's skills. Beat all 100 levels to become the ultimate Grandmaster!

details.title: Astrocraft
details.short_description: A first-person space station tycoon. Mine asteroids, build production lines, and run a shop for the ships that land. No conveyor belts: a crew of robots does the work, and you tune the flow by what each pallet calls for. Build at your own pace, solo or in online co-op for up to four players.

details.title: Eye of Khaos
details.short_description: Slay your enemies in this sword and sorcery roguelike! Ancient dungeons, fallen ruins and cyclopean towers and their primordial denizens present a tactical and deadly challenge that can only be overcome by the most resourceful heroes.

details.title: Subjectivation
details.short_description: Subjectivation is a first person horror adventure game set in a snow-covered town frozen in time. Solve puzzles, manage your body heat, and defend yourself from the warped inhabitants of the frostbitten city. Explore the town’s past - and shape its future with your actions.

details.title: MODULE:BERSERK (모듈 버서크)
details.short_description: MODULE:BERSERK is a 2D pixel "hard-boiled" action game with steampunk-inspired world of endless desertification and corruption. Play as a butler-styled automaton. Track down the suspect that caused terrifying event to the family you serve. And protect the only survivor, 'lady' from upcoming dangers.

details.title: Dodgeball Blast
details.short_description: Dodgeball Blast is a colorful 3D action-adventure where dodgeball is your greatest weapon! Explore a wild overworld, battle 10 massive bosses, master 9 wacky minigames, unlock new abilities, discover secrets, and play solo or with friends on your quest to become the Dodgeball Master!

details.title: Golfadillo
details.short_description: Hurl yourself across vast landscapes filled with coins and obstacles in this action incremental game! Upgrade your skills and unlock abilities so you can travel even further and reach blazing speeds!

details.title: Program Penguin
details.short_description: Program Penguin is a humorous, tightly paced action-adventure game with an unforgettable cast. Think classic Zelda meets Club Penguin all rolled up in a classic retro style.

details.title: COLIVING
details.short_description: COLIVING is an interactive narrative adventure where you play as a hard-boiled detective and a relentless journalist on two distinct paths. As their cases converge on a shared apartment, your choices shape a complex, branching story. Trust no one—the real danger lives right behind the wall.
developers: Taiwan Computer Graphics Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
publishers: Taiwan Computer Graphics Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

details.title: Worlds Explorers
details.short_description: Explore alien planets with carefully designed ecosystems, weather, resources, dangers and unique phenomena. Hunt animals for food and collect resources to craft equipment and repair devices on your ship. Escape each unique planet and unlock crew members and new ships.

details.title: The Golden Horde: Survival
details.short_description: The Golden Horde: Survival takes you to the brutal and mysterious 13th century, where the mighty Golden Horde rises to power. Break free from slavery, survive, build your own settlement and lead a rebellion in a world where real history intertwines with elements of fantasy.

details.title: Desktop Legends
details.short_description: Desktop Legends is an idle desktop action game featuring fantasy character progression, incremental resource management, and visual customization. Help your hero take their legendary stand against the forces of darkness right on your desktop!

details.title: Immortal Coil
details.short_description: Build powerful decks to confront the Gods in this lane-based, strategy card game. Play the Roguelike Adventure Mode or ascend the Tower of Battle in Gauntlet Mode. Discover wild deckbuilding synergies to unleash spectacular combos against formidable foes.

details.title: SCP: Scavenger Project
details.short_description: Asymmetric co-op horror set in the SCP universe. 1-12 survivors trapped in a collapsing Foundation site, and one of you is infected. They know it, and they're hiding it. Complete objectives, trust no one, and try to escape.

details.title: Crow's Requiem
details.short_description: A narrative-heavy, comic-infused survival visual novel & puzzle game where you are a licensed body collector navigating a dystopian world of moral dilemmas and resource management; where belief, rebellion, or control will prevail through your choices.

details.title: Born Without Rights
details.short_description: Born Without Rights is a third-person, story-driven action-adventure with stealth, gunfights, and exploration. Inspired by The Last of Us and Max Payne, experience a tense linear story of survival and resistance in a world without freedom.

details.title: Shapesetter
details.short_description: An open-ended puzzle game about building machines that make modernist art. Program mechanical arms to paint, cut and weld shapes into finished pieces, then refine your machine to be faster, smaller or cheaper.

details.title: Astrobound
details.short_description: Survive and explore space in Astrobound! Visit strange planets, encounter cosmic calamities, and keep your crew alive as you journey through the stars in a retro-inspired whimsical space adventure.

name: Karakam: Call of The Dark Manor

details.title: Karakam: Call of The Dark Manor
details.short_description: Karakam: Call of the Dark Manor is a first person psychological horror game where you explore a cursed manor of a long forgotten bloodline. Solve riddles, explore the grounds and discover the horror stories hidden within the horror story. Dark Manor summons you, how will you answer it?

details.title: Hexabot Stranded: Defend Or Die
details.short_description: Action tower defense with physics & couch co-op: carry your turrets, hurl objects, and survive swarm attacks.

details.title: Aphasia
details.short_description: Have you ever wondered what happens when we fall into a coma? Why do only some make it back? Aphasia is a first-person horror where you’re trapped inside your own mind, with no memory of who you are. As you explore your fractured memories, your sense of guilt won’t let you escape...

details.title: Sven Rescues a Princess
details.short_description: Sven Rescues a Princess is a 3D co-op horde brawler for 1–10 players. Hack and slash through 30–45 minute runs to save six princesses, then live with whatever you brought home. Hordes keep time with the music. Unlock everything by playing. No microtransactions or loot boxes.

details.title: Chaos The Devil
details.short_description: Ps1 era inspired 3D platformer. Run, jump and fly your way through a new adventure, done the old way. A multi-year solo passion project, handcrafted from scratch.

details.title: Barzakh: Star Gardener
details.short_description: Survive a plane crash and enter the veil between life and death. Solve physics-bending puzzles, collect lost stars, and cultivate a garden within your mind. In this atmospheric journey inspired by The Little Prince and Sufi mysticism, the only way out is within.

details.title: Mega Hasan 2: Wallet Detective
details.short_description: Mega Hasan is back! Last time he had to find his own wallet. This time he's here to find other people's crap! Run and jump through 56 levels across 7 worlds. Battle bosses, unlock characters and team up with a friend in local co-op!

details.title: BeNormal
details.short_description: Be Normal is a comedy simulation game where you send an agent to infiltrate human society and pave the way for an alien invasion. From the cockpit of your spaceship, you can give your agent voice commands. The key is to convince the earthlings that you're a perfectly normal human.

details.title: Creep Tank
details.short_description: Build and customize your own arcane aquarium in this cozy collection/idler game. Use your magic to summon juvenile cute creepy fish. Tend to them and watch them grow. Make discoveries, expand your collection, decorate your tanks with art and plants.

details.title: Blue Book
details.short_description: Blue Book is a sci-fi detective quest with point'n'click elements, where there are no hints, there are false clues and only your conclusion. Analyze testimonies, find inconsistencies, follow the logic. Become an FBI agent and unravel a chain of mysterious disappearances in a quiet American town.

details.title: FriendOS
details.short_description: FriendOS is a 1-3 player action RPG where viruses must die! Strike and batter your opponents in Cartoon Sports Combat, and create the virtual animal avatar of your dreams. Hang out in lobbies with up to 12 friends and team up to protect the world of FriendOS from virus corruption.

details.title: Forest Keeper Lookout
details.short_description: Take a temporary job as a forest ranger deep in the mountains. Complete daily tasks, maintain equipment, and enjoy the quiet, until strange things start to happen.

details.title: Troop vs Troop
details.short_description: Tactical turn-based combat in WW2. Lead U.S. infantry, tanks, and artillery through procedurally generated battlefields. Use cover and clever tactics to outmaneuver German forces.

details.title: TEKNOKRAT
details.short_description: Enter the city of Nu-Vika as a cyborg repairman in TEKNOKRAT, a thriller romance visual novel. There's a conspiracy brewing beneath this techno-metropolis, and you find yourself an unwilling participant. You will meet three clients, cyborgs with secrets and aspirations of their own.

details.title: Where the Chips Fall
details.short_description: Balatro Meets Blackjack with a Cuphead aesthetic in this casino rogue-lite where you gamble with your abilities. Every chip you bet can turn the tide in your favor, but you could also lose it all in a bad hand. Think you can beat the house?

details.title: IsekaIdle
details.short_description: A fantasy idle progression game inspired by deep skill-based systems. Train skills through use, conquer dungeons, manage your settlement, and optimize every system at your own pace, with no prestige resets and permanent progression.

details.title: Don't Get Fired!
details.short_description: The company is going under and corporate has made YOU the office manager. Turn things around quick or everyone's doomed. Run the office, keep employees productive, and avoid disasters. Muscle through the workday or automate the grind. Play solo or with friends — just Don't Get Fired!

details.title: My Axion Shop
details.short_description: Build your own Axion shop, collect rare parts, create powerful combinations, and battle your way to becoming a Pro Axioner! My Axion Shop offers a unique gaming experience blending strategy, trading, and collection elements.

details.title: Bookie
details.short_description: The horse racing roguelike, with cards. Bookie is a fast paced deckbuilder game, in which you build your own stable of horses and try to figure out which one will win the race. Manipulate the odds by modifying the cards and buying game-changing charms that will help you get all the trophies!

details.title: Margin of Error
details.short_description: Princess Elyra is bound to a cursed grimoire. Lead her party through six monster-filled regions in this deckb-building roguelite RPG, where every attack is a numbers puzzle: play number and operation cards to hit each enemy’s exact target. Miss it, and the monster makes you pay.

details.title: Rollout Rally
details.short_description: Race solo or with friends in Rollout Rally, a physics-based marble racing party game. Play with up to 4 players in split-screen on one PC, or up to 6 online or over LAN. Team up in 3v3 races, steer, boost, shove rivals with Pulse, block hits with Shield and roll to victory!

details.title: Hunt for the Lost Folktales
details.short_description: A folklore hunting, turn-based battling, creature collector adventure where you follow trails to hunt escaped folktale beasts, engage in strategic tactical battles where fear is your strength, and capture the lost folktales so they may live on in memory. Will you be another folktale to be written?

details.title: Pinkwilds
details.short_description: A sci-fi multiplayer survival RPG with no guns - fight with weapons and magic instead. Explore an alien world, gather resources, craft gear, and build your base. Trade, form alliances, raid, or betray other players to survive.

details.title: Punch Punch!
details.short_description: 在节奏明快的夏日小镇中参与单词挑战！输入单词、连续出拳，把敌人痛快击飞！与小镇居民轻松互动，通过基于记忆曲线的复习机制，让背单词更有趣，也记得更加牢固。

details.title: Untamed Ehizia
details.short_description: Untamed Ehizia is a sandbox MMORPG with unusual game mechanics built around cooperation and social interactions. Come with friends or find new ones, and tame the world of Ehizia together.

details.title: Top Drifters
details.short_description: A minimalistic top-down racer with simple old-school arcade controls, Experience physics-based, drift-focused driving at ultra-high-speed. Master 10+ different cars with unique driving stats. Challenge your friends online in 20+ semi-destructible, chaotic races and become the world's "Top Drifter".

details.title: RUNE GUNNER
details.short_description: RUNE GUNNER is a 1-4 player co-op roguelite shooter where you combine guns and magic to create game-breaking synergies. Each room hits harder, so you must mix classes mid-run and collect runes to become overpowered.

details.title: Call Of Resistance
details.short_description: Call of Resistance is a real-time tactics game where you lead a group of resistance fighters in occupied France during World War II. Step into the shoes of shadowy heroes and discover the sacrifices and strategies needed to stand against the enemy

details.title: Crafters Heaven
details.short_description: Crafters Heaven is a lowpoly RPG sandbox where you design and build your own items piece by piece. Create unique weapons, tools and equipment, build your base, fight wild creatures, and explore an open world full of secrets! Demo coming soon!

details.title: LOVE WMC
details.short_description: "Love wmc" is a visual novel game based on music games. It tells a series of stories about the protagonist who came to a small county town to study alone due to family conflicts, and accidentally got involved with four female protagonists because of an arcade music game.

details.title: Bygoner
details.short_description: A medieval road-movie parable blending rogue-lite action and journey management, wrapped in vintage cinema aesthetics. Follow a nameless knight through the southern lands of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania (modern-day Ukraine) at the beginning of the 16th century.

details.title: Ascend and Fall
details.short_description: Ascend and Fall is a dark-fantasy multiplayer autobattler where the order of your spells decides the outcome. Build your spell loadout, fight monsters for loot, and unleash powerful arcane combos against rival players. Sequence your magic right to rise while they fall.

details.title: Liar-for-hire
details.short_description: Follow the new worker of the disinformation agency day by day. Decide how to oppose news and people through the use of fake scandals and redirections. Ensure a win for your employers - or find some conscience after all.

details.title: ExoDomia
details.short_description: Exodomia is a narrative-driven, action-adventure game set on the robotic world of Salakar V! In this fast-paced combat experience, you will encounter many dangerous creatures and enemies as you navigate a story of struggle and survival.

details.title: Veriventure
details.short_description: Combine a toolbox of enemies, hazards, items and objects to build dungeons filled with puzzles, traps, and combat. Alternatively, cartwheel into levels created by other players, or ready your weapon and explore the story mode, in this retro-inspired 3D Dungeon Maker.

details.title: Small Living World 2
details.short_description: Is a peaceful ecosystem simulator, bringing every aspect of nature to life. From the water cycle and plant growth, to animal behaviors and reproduction, observe your small living world evolve. All the tools are at your disposal to create your perfect forest.

details.title: Pay Your Space Debt
details.short_description: An incremental survivor-lite where you must earn your way out of debt by mining entire asteroid fields, upgrading your spaceship and surviving the debt collectors.

details.title: Lightbound : A Rolling Ball Game
details.short_description: A racing platformer. Take control of a ball and set off on a wildly dangerous adventure. Master your momentum, chain power-ups, outwit the enemies on your tail, and whatever you do — don't fall. Solo or split-screen for up to 4 players.

details.title: Whale Life Simulator
details.short_description: Experience the life of a whale. Hit the streets, earn cash, and pour massive amounts of money into an online game. Use your maxed-out account to crush other players!

details.title: The Facility
details.short_description: You look different today. Yesterday, you looked different too. Which one is really you? A psychological horror game about paranoia, identity, and the fear of trusting the wrong person.

details.title: Bonds of the Zodiac
details.short_description: Rei, a grieving girl, is drawn into a mystical realm where the Zodiac spirits are bound by the Jade Emperor. Mediate their inner struggles and guide them toward freedom in a first-person journey steeped in myth, conflict, and emotion.

details.title: Rookie Taoist
details.short_description: A co-op survival horror game rooted in Chinese folk traditions. Team up with 1–4 players to survive haunted locations, use ritual tools, uncover hidden truths, and escape the grip of evil. But beware—your arrival may only be the beginning of a greater nightmare...

details.title: Reng Azure Requiem
details.short_description: No jumping. Only 4-way teleportation. Travel through eras, collect Skill Gravestones, defeat bosses, explore armor sets, and choose your final act in search of resurrection in this 2D pixel art Metroidvania.

details.title: Auto Grind: Dungeons
details.short_description: AUTO GRIND: DUNGEONS is a singleplayer auto-attack dungeon crawler that fuses party management with snap decisions. Build your party, synergize skills and masteries, discover unique relics, craft items and adapt your allies' combat tactics in real time as you fight your way through enemy hordes!

details.title: THE FORMIO PROGRAM
details.short_description: Terraform the moon Io from an isolated, fully simulated outpost as an operator for the F.O.R.M.I.O program. Master interconnected devices, take your (MANDATORY) daily dose of RADOX, and ignore the robot :)

details.title: Mewts
details.short_description: Handcrafted party Clayhem! A PvP game full of chaos and innocent violence. Fight your friends or challenge bots. Play as Mewts, cute, wiggly creatures. Use your body as a slingshot and hit each other! Play a variety of game modes in handcrafted clay arenas!

details.title: Midnight Video Store
details.short_description: Midnight Video Store is an idle game where you play as Jeff, the sole employee of a retro video store. One night, the video store is attacked by a horde of monsters. Make Jeff more powerful with the help of a gigantic and monstrous talent tree !

details.title: Rogue Reigns
details.short_description: Rogue Reigns is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder about trust and sacrifice. Lead selfish antiheroes through a world where death is no more, and something still hunts them. Build synergies that bind them or rivalries that break them. Nobody dies, some are sacrificed, but everybody is condemned.

details.title: Woodland Werewolf
details.short_description: The mist came without warning. One morning, the residents of the village woke to find their lakeside settlement wrapped in an impenetrable fog—thick, cold, and utterly wrong. Within hours, people began to vanish. No screams. No signs of struggle. Just empty spaces where lives used to be.

details.title: JOIN US
details.short_description: Start a doomsday cult of your very own! Recruit followers, build your compound, customize your cult’s beliefs, and defeat enemies in this 1-4 player co-op, action-packed, open-world survival experience. Can you survive the Apocalypse?

details.title: Pip & Bones
details.short_description: Pip & Bones is a score-based deckbuilder roguelike with domino rules. Connect really long chains, score a lot of points, forge your perfect deck, enchant tiles, unlock new strategies with powerful idols and win the title of Tavern Champion!

details.title: Fireworks Incremental
details.short_description: Bad Wizard covered the land with a Magical Dome and the only way to destroy it is with fireworks! Hire units, unlock buildings, buy upgrades, discover powerful synergies, turn a few tiny explosions into a ridiculous spectacle and ultimately defeat The Bad Wizard himself!

details.title: Shadowbound
details.short_description: Shadowbound is a minimalist 3D platforming and puzzle journey where light is your enemy and shadow your only ally. Overcome short challenges, manipulate light, and recover lost colors to rebuild the memories of a lifetime.

details.title: FEARSFROMARS
details.short_description: You are a space hunter from Mars. Hunt with friends, capture bizarre aliens alive, and sell them to the highest bidder. In this galaxy, alien or not, they all share one fear... FEARSFROMARS.

details.title: Neo Bananas
details.short_description: In this sci-fi speedrun-platformer, destroy every neo bananas, get the S+ ranks, and uncover why you're the last gorilla on Earth. Go fast. Go wild. Go bananas!

details.title: A Day with Wuki
details.short_description: Wuki is a real cat, and today the whole neighborhood is his. Slip through open windows, push mugs off tables, hunt mice, complete little cat mischief in every house and collect polaroids of the real Wuki. Or just nap in the sun.

details.title: Oiran Survival: Edo Yokai Rush
details.short_description: Defeat, choose, grow, and break the battlefield. A Japanese dark fantasy survivor-style roguelite where you Limit Break 14 skills and cut down hordes of yokai. Defeat bosses, forge gear from their rewards, and face even stronger foes.

details.title: 骤雨终日
details.short_description: "Endless Rain"is a pixel plot game driven by dialogue that incorporates elements of suspense, crime, humor, and more. Players will explore the truth behind a murder case in two different time and space, gradually uncovering the true face of a small town shrouded in the haze of the past.

details.title: Humanity Echo: Cyberpunk Tactical RPG
details.short_description: Humanity Echo is a turn-based tactical RPG set in cyberpunk Odesa, 2044. Lead a squad as an engineer: prepare for every contract, fight from cover, overload transformers, set off explosive barrels, loot better gear, and make choices the people around you will remember.

details.title: PC Versus
details.short_description: The first ever competitive PC building game. Go head to head with another player on the same task and budget, pick from 800+ real components and overclock for an edge. Push too hard and your build crashes. Free to play.

details.title: Ultra Damage
details.short_description: Ultra Damage is a hand-drawn Boomer Shooter packed with humor and action, featuring hand-crafted visuals and a story blending gritty detective work with absurd comedy. Each level is a wild ride. Unravel the mystery, find hidden clues, and deal ultra damage to save humanity!

details.title: Uncivilized
details.short_description: A short-form empire building strategy game. Explore the planet and grow your colony, while attempting to negotiate with the many characterful rival factions. Make friends, break allegiances, or just drop nukes on them.

details.title: Bulgasari: Blocks & Bullets
details.short_description: Bulgasari: Blocks & Bullets is a multitasking action roguelike where combat and block puzzle happen at the same time. Devour scrap to grow stronger, create your own build, and survive against endless machine hordes.

details.title: The Missing Threads
details.short_description: [DEMO available now!] Erased memories, scattered clues. What will you uncover, and what will you leave buried?As an amnesiac detective, investigate crime scenes with limited focus. You can't analyze everything. Strategically choose your leads to shape the case and reclaim your lost past.

details.title: The Endemic : Best Mates
details.short_description: Endemic: GONGWAN is a cozy farming game inspired by a CCC comic. Taiwanese foods like Gongwan and dumplings come to life as cute creatures called Endemics. Play as a researcher, rebuild the park, farm the land, and befriend unique companions.

details.title: Reflectory
details.short_description: An idle incremental game about bouncing balls that lives in the corner of your screen.

details.title: Depono
details.short_description: Play against your friends in this fast paced, competitive card game. Bet, scheme and bluff your way to victory. Craft your deck with secret cards, change the playing field with items and become unstoppable.

details.title: Dungeon Trader
details.short_description: Become a Dungeon Trader and climb from Beginner to Legendary Trader! Buy, Sell, Negotiate risky deals, Play unique Mini-Games, Unlock strange visitors, customize your appearance, and uncover hidden secrets lurking beneath the Dungeon.

details.title: Interstitial
details.short_description: Interstitial is a first-person psychological horror game that dives into the unease of liminal spaces, blending environmental storytelling, exploration-driven gameplay, and slow-burning dread to create an experience where the world itself becomes the threat.

details.title: Please fix the mess
details.short_description: Clean up chaotic interiors, remove trash, repaint walls, and redecorate messy spaces, sometimes with a few suspiciously bodies lying around.

details.title: Catching Breaks
details.short_description: In this first-person office comedy, you fix busted microwaves and put out fires while coworkers try to stop you for a chat. Use the right tool for the job, or slap a machine and see if it holds until the end of your shift.

details.title: Blob Wars
details.short_description: Blob Wars is a turn-based tactics game where efficiency is key. Use each Blob’s unique abilities to defeat the enemy army in as few turns as possible, the fewer turns you take, the greater the reward. Traverse a branching world map and carve your own path through this replayable experience.

details.title: Qamar
details.short_description: Roll a planet through an ink-and-wash world in this physics-based precision platformer. Build momentum, ride walls, glide across gaps, and use sidespin to nail your landings. Dodge catapult fire, brave huge drops, and chase your perfect run.

details.title: Meet Mary
details.short_description: A Cinematic 1-4 Player Co-op Horror Story Adventure. One of your friends has gone missing. While experiencing strange visions, you uncover a secret bunker with suspicious intentions. Meet the people, solve puzzles, and explore the facility. Meet your host Mary. How far would you go to save a friend?

details.title: Firewall: Defend The Grid
details.short_description: Become a hacker building cyber defense systems in this retro-futuristic strategy tower defense game. Build your firewall using limited compute power and sector space, connect mods, fight along your defenses running programs and expand to new sectors to protect the Grid from ever-growing chaos.

details.title: Trial of Ember
details.short_description: Assemble a band of forest allies to defend your woodland home in this roguelike auto-battler. Level your hero, recover artifacts, upgrade allies and learn spells to build powerful synergies. Strategically deploy your forces to repel the rising flame and complete the Trial of Ember.

details.title: The Amazing Bird Miner
details.short_description: The Amazing Bird Miner is a unique incremental game where you mine ore and capture birds to live with you in your bird grotto. Equip and upgrade your gear to become a better miner. Scavenge for materials and choose your specialization as you save the planet as The Amazing Bird Miner!

details.title: Hollowbound
details.short_description: A co-op puzzle adventure for exactly two players. One of you finds the clue, the other has to act on it. Pull levers, crack rune puzzles, brew potions and outrun a collapsing mine together – every puzzle needs both of you.

details.title: The Archivist
details.short_description: A psychological horror experience set in the Backrooms. Explore a failed government facility, hack corrupted systems, and descend into a story where memory and reality collapse.

details.title: RunIn: Encounters
details.short_description: RunIn: Encounters is a competitive fantasy PvP experience focused on tactical teamplay, skill-based combat, evolving builds, and intense round-based multiplayer encounters.

name: Top of That Thing Called Mountain

details.title: Top of That Thing Called Mountain
details.short_description: Who would you go with on the toughest adventure? Team up with a friend in this 2-player, 2D co-op platformer and guide two dolphins up an impossible mountain. Shoot harpoons, blast air cannons, and swing your way up. Every climb demands perfect teamwork, and one wrong move sends you both tumbling.

details.title: interViolence
details.short_description: Help a teenage supervillain move out of his one and only home. Mop spills, pack clothes and disarm lethal machines. Think about your past, and his uncertain future. A short RPGMaker visual novel about nostalgia, grief, and the things you miss when they're gone forever.

details.title: Red Nox
details.short_description: Red Nox is a horror roguelike deckbuilder with realistic graphics and a liminal space aesthetic. Gamble, explore, and create your own synergy of cards and relics to survive against the uncanny abominations within the Forbidden Lands.

details.title: Augment Protocol
details.short_description: Enter a retro-futuristic nightmare of failed human augmentation. Fight relentless hordes, earn Bio-Credits, unlock quarantined facility sectors, and eradicate the grotesque experiments NeuraCorp left behind.

details.title: Charming Blood: Twelve days
details.short_description: Embrace darkness as an unwitting vampire in this choice-driven romance. Navigate ancient powers, brewing conflicts, and passionate relationships with four captivating vampires who could become your greatest allies – or something more. When night falls, will you surrender to its dangers?

details.title: Possums
details.short_description: Possums is an NPC-driven co-op heist game for 2-6 players where every character reacts to your actions. Distract them, use them, or stay out of their way — loot their city to pay the forest taxes.

details.title: Dithered
details.short_description: DĪȾĦɆꞦɆĐ invites you to a realm forsaken by the clock—a surreal nightmare where you must platform through the jagged shards of a protagonist's trauma. Guided by two bickering birds and hunted by a ticking horror, you must fight your way through a glitching reality…

details.title: I can offer you Flowers
details.short_description: ‘To propose to my boyfriend... what flowers would you recommend?’ Arrange bouquets in this cozy puzzly game! Discover flowers, meet new people, and become the Atrium Botanique community center florist!

details.title: Infant God
details.short_description: You are the guardian of an infant god. Guide Aistalt through the toxic ruins of the internet. Debate with random users, harvest their ideologies, and sculpt her personality matrix. Will you raise a benevolent savior or a tyrant who deletes humanity?

details.title: Pinball Realm
details.short_description: A pinball Roguelite where the board is yours to build. Fortify your defenses, stack outrageous synergies, and unleash game-breaking combos as you save the kingdom from endless waves of monsters!

details.title: Terrafactory: Idle Planet
details.short_description: The idle planet creation game that sits anywhere on your desktop. Watch the birth of a planet, upgrade the Catalyst, discover new biomes, and shape your own solar system while you work or relax.

details.title: Hauntworks
details.short_description: Run a haunted attraction where you scare guests, harvest their emotions, automate production chains, and manage a team of monsters. Hide evidence of "accidents" before the supernatural bureau comes looking.

details.title: Chronicles Meteorfall
details.short_description: A semi-open world turn based RPG with detailed class-based and skill building mechanics, deep worldbuilding and lore, and genuine LGBT+ representation.

details.title: The Bed Above My Head
details.short_description: You’re playing a game in the dark. Something in your room is not. In this Sit & Survive type psychological horror game, you're a child playing on your console, while something roams your room. Observe your surroundings, listen carefully and manage your stress to survive this nightmarish night.

details.title: Fig and Totems™
details.short_description: Capture-the-flag meets hide-and-seek in this online party game (2-4 players). In 2min30, everyone hides a totem then hunts everyone else's. Listen closely to find them, or ambush and steal from your friends before they score. Win by throwing the most totems in the box, the fastest! Bonus if unfound.

details.title: 众星入海
details.short_description: 大学毕业正在苦于找工作的平凡男生时寻，在奔波中遇到了一位穿着战术服的少女陈枫实。 陈枫实声称自己是末日时期的搜救人员，目的就是拯救世界上最后的幸存者。 时寻望着周围熙熙攘攘的街道，陈枫实望着周围残破的废墟，同时发觉了对方已经疯了的事实。两人抱着对对方的同情，开启了独属于他们的故事。
developers: 失业者联盟游戏制作组

details.title: Cursed Gas Station
details.short_description: At an isolated gas station in the 1990s, Cole takes a night-shift job that comes with a room to stay in. As you serve customers, unexplained events begin to unfold in this psychological horror game.

details.title: MILES 27: Look Like You
details.short_description: MILES27 is a psychological horror game told through self-contained stories inspired by disturbing real-life cases. Each episode presents a short but intense experience focused on atmosphere and tension. The game is designed to make players feel watched, unsafe, and uncertain about what is real.

details.title: Mine or Burn
details.short_description: Start with a basic mining ship and snowball into an asteroid-crushing powerhouse in this incremental bullet hell roguelite. Mine asteroids, battle rival miners, stack upgrades, create powerful builds, and survive escalating threats across dangerous star systems.

details.title: Bodzin
details.short_description: Step into the boots of a forgotten space legend. In this retro top-down shooter, stop a galactic villain from corrupting ancient wisdom into ultimate power. Correct your past mistake, rescue the Keepers, and rewrite destiny.

details.title: Ghost in the Cloud
details.short_description: Dive deep into the Net, build the ultimate deck, install busted plugins, and fight ever more powerful Bots and Avatars in fast-paced tactical combat that combines turn based and real time mechanics, all to realize your wish, or perish trying.

details.title: Desktop sticker
details.short_description: This is a game that allows you to freely decorate your computer desktop. Have you ever thought about setting your desktop in a unique way? Come on, let's get started and design and decorate your desktop together! Accompany you in your work and study!

details.title: The Deep Calls
details.short_description: Build every hero your way in The Deep Calls, a turn based Lovecraftian roguelite dungeon crawler. Choose distinct Disciplines, mix unlocked Skills , embrace dangerous Traits, and equip hard won relics. Forge powerful party synergies, then risk those builds in branching dungeons with no retreat.

details.title: Age of Crowns
details.short_description: Captain a free company across a medieval kingdom of four crowns. Hire swords, keep them fed and paid, and climb seven rungs from sellsword to king. Your veterans earn names, the captain who beats you may come back with one, and every fight is decided by orders you read before you commit.

details.title: Woks & Works
details.short_description: Build and automate your restaurant empire. Manage chefs, customers, supplies, and production chains in a living food economy.

details.title: BlackHole Collapse
details.short_description: You are a stationary black hole, growing more powerful with every run. Devour crystals, fend off relentless swarms and volatile anomalies, and unleash devastating gravitational blasts to survive the void in this fast-paced action roguelite.

details.title: Nest Rivals
details.short_description: Lead a slime colony through a living pixel world. Take direct control of individual creatures, grow new nests, face rival species and guide your colony through a campaign of changing worlds. Explore unfamiliar biomes and fill your illustrated bestiary with discoveries.

details.title: Hollow Orbits 4x
details.short_description: Hollow Orbits is a turn-based space 4X with the tension of a board game. Roll a die for every weapon, then choose which enemy ship takes each hit. Expand, trade, negotiate or conquer your way across a galaxy of ancient ruins and rival powers. Play solo, against AI or online with friends.

details.title: Bottopia
details.short_description: A cozy idle collecting and decorating game that lives on your desktop. Make progress while using your computer, fish up new decorations, and turn your bottle into a tiny world that's uniquely yours.

details.title: Archive of Fate
details.short_description: A single-player card RPG blending Tarot mysticism, roguelike deckbuilding, and lasting progression. Use a wide variety of cards alongside all 56 Minor Arcana, brew potions, explore randomized regions, and unleash rule-breaking Sequence skills to reshape battles, events, and fate itself.

details.title: Memory Cyphers
details.short_description: Online co-op Survivors-like for 1-4 players. Take on the memory-drained hordes with your friends. Memory chips, weapon upgrades, rule-breaking relics. Nobody clears a swarm this big alone! Fast roguelite action.

details.title: ZUNKS
details.short_description: ZUNKS is a top-down action game where you wipe out swarms of monsters and battle against powerful bosses in a ruined world. Save the world with ZUNKS, with all your might and a cheerful spirit!

details.title: Wreck & Profit
details.short_description: Swing a wrecking ball, knock down buildings, and get paid for every brick. Buy machines that do the swinging for you, sell the company, and take on a bigger city. A short incremental game with real physics & some automation with an actual ending.

details.title: Hollow Sector
details.short_description: A space logistics game that keeps running when you don't. Haul freight, mine the belts, hunt raiders, and smuggle contraband across an abandoned star system. Play full screen, or dock it to the edge of your screen while you work. You don't fly the ships. You run the fleet.

details.title: Circusar
details.short_description: Circusar is an action roguelite where you play a clown battling waves of enemies while balancing on a unicycle. Two core tensions drive the game: physical balance and crowd rating. Build item synergies, entertain the crowd, and don't fall!

details.title: Quackyard
details.short_description: A cozy incremental farming sim about helping your duck friend clean out their backyard. Dig, mine and farm your way to clearing up the space so that a tea party with friends can be hosted.

details.title: Wyrm Warrior
details.short_description: WYRM WARRIOR is a brand new JRPG in retro style. Step into the shoes of a hero fighting for justice in an unfamiliar land! Brave a world full of monsters, bosses, dungeons, NPCs, and loot! Grow stronger through fighting and exploration! Can you defeat THE WYRMLORD?

details.title: Cage Legacy
details.short_description: Build a struggling MMA gym into a title-winning empire. Scout fighters, negotiate contracts, run training camps, survive the drama, balance every dollar, and work the corner live during fully simulated fight nights. A single-player pixel-art management sim.

details.title: Deck Beasts
details.short_description: Creature-collecting auto-battler roguelike. Draft pixel-art beasts, teach them ability cards, gear them with items and relics, then watch your squad fight other players' teams. 100+ beasts, hundreds of abilities and items, billions of builds.

details.title: Slipstreak
details.short_description: A free-for-all arcade shooter where speed is your damage. Bhop, wallrun, slide and rocket-jump to fill your streak and hit harder, then beat everyone to the big guns on the map. 2–8 players over Steam or LAN, with bots and time-trial courses. The movement is the whole game.

details.title: Where's my order?
details.short_description: Deliver food across town, solo or with friends, in a chaotic world of physics-based vehicles, flying food and ragdolls. The competition is fierce and the police are watching, but customers are hungry and the money won't make itself.

details.title: Raccoon Inc.
details.short_description: Bin Dive is tired of eating from the trash! Help this enterprising raccoon build a business up from flipping junk to a sprawling mega corporation unlike the world has ever seen. Start businesses, upgrade them, hire animals to help you, sit back and watch the money flow in this idler tycoon.

details.title: Conversation Simulator
details.short_description: Conversation Simulator is the practice tool for interviews, negotiations, difficult talks, and language skills. AI characters run entirely on your computer. No internet needed during play. Open source, fairly priced.

details.title: Bandidos em Brasilia
details.short_description: Brazil has fallen. A dictatorship has seized power, and the files that could bring it down are hidden inside an abandoned mansion — with someone inside who doesn't want you to find them.

details.title: Folklore War Game
details.short_description: The folklore war. Build a deck, pick a folklore, and settle the fights the legends never had. A roguelike deckbuilder about dying, rebuilding, and one more run.

details.title: Project Poker
details.short_description: Project Poker is a single-player poker experience with smart opponents, memorable personalities, and tons of quality-of-life features. Build your bankroll in Career Mode, master four poker variants, and play your way with game speeds, fast-forward, quick betting, full controller support, and more.

details.title: Zodiac Tale
details.short_description: Zodiac Tale is a roguelite deckbuilder auto-battler where you clear dungeon after dungeon across many worlds. Stronger enemies, a shop that pays interest, side quests: every dungeon adds new rules. Shape your shop to get the zodiac animals you want, and tailor explosive synergies to fit those rules.

details.title: Bureau of Hero Affairs
details.short_description: Bureau of Hero Affairs is a simulation game about processing paperwork in an obsolete office system and digging up what it buried. As a journalist working undercover inside the Bureau, uncover the truth of a disaster twenty years ago. Follow the regulations, or report the truth.

details.title: Floors of Fury
details.short_description: Floors of Fury is a fast-paced 2.5D beat ’em up roguelite. Fight through crowds, slam enemies into walls or each other, collect upgrades, shape your build, and punch your way from the bottom of the company to the top.

details.title: Sudokucide
details.short_description: Experience a new, fast-paced game inspired by Sudoku combined with action reminiscent of late-nights spent in the arcades of the 90s. Sudokucide brings the traditional game into the 21st century with exciting new mechanics and pumps the action up to 11. Face the challenge or commit Sudokucide.

details.title: NightClub Manager Simulator
details.short_description: As the boss, evaluate the proposals that come your way. Manage your nightclub’s reputation. Beat up thieves and put out fires.

details.title: Soul Shine
details.short_description: Prohibition ruined your brewery job. So you started a moonshine business. Expand and automate your empire by harvesting souls, trafficking organs, selling to addicts, and serving strange gods.

details.title: Taskbar Chickens
details.short_description: A cozy desktop companion where chickens live on your taskbar. Breed your chickens to hatch a brand new one with its own unique look, and grow your collection while you work on other stuff on your PC! Plant crops, sell eggs and build a tiny farm that flourishes on top of your taskbar!

details.title: The Last Tenant
details.short_description: The Last Tenant is a short first-person horror game. Explore, find keys, read scattered notes to uncover what happened, and try to escape through tense, atmospheric scares. There is no combat: just you, the dark, and about two hours of dread.

details.title: Gulf Strike
details.short_description: Gulf Strike is a top-down helicopter shooter from 1991. A rogue nation is threatening the oil industry in the middle east! Complete the 6 sandbox campaigns by destroying enemy units while searching for supplies. It's time for another strike in the desert!

details.title: Pull the Lever
details.short_description: Pull the lever, send a tiny train hauling cargo. Click storms and breakdowns mid-run to protect the take. Chase jackpots, hire staff to automate the dull runs, and grow a living model railroad. You won't know the payout until it arrives.

details.title: COMETROX!
details.short_description: Nobody told the keyboard it wasn't a guitar.

details.title: Graveline
details.short_description: A first-person survival horror operation sim. Drive a steam locomotive through one night. Feed the boiler, read signals, and hold the deadman's lever while something advances car by car. Kill the light to hide and lose your gauges. Make noise to survive and it hears you. One life.

details.title: MODice
details.short_description: MODice is a dice-building roguelike. Roll five dice, then rearrange them for higher scores! Socket gems and combine sets to turn scores into board movement. Choose your landing spot, build and upgrade, and shape a stronger build to overcome changing Boss rules before your rolls run out.

details.title: Nightfreight
details.short_description: A single-player body-horror roguelite auto-battler. Draft vat-grown mutants, pay for power in flesh, arrange your squad on a train-car grid, then hit DEPART. Fights resolve automatically. Most upgrades corrupt their host; a unit pushed too far mutates, seizes up, or turns on its own squad.

details.title: Lively
details.short_description: Lively is a puzzle-platformer where two rival creatures fight for control of the planet. Use ever-changing powers to make your way through a unique world !

details.title: Doll Arena
details.short_description: A dark 2D metroidvania steeped in Slavic folklore. Play as a red motanka doll with button eyes, armed only with needles – stab, throw, parry, reclaim. Explore an interconnected hand-drawn world, then battle up to 3 friends in local or LAN PvP arenas

details.title: Song of Larithea
details.short_description: Larithea is a cute anime RPG about friendship, trust, revenge, and finding your way back from the darkness. Craft your own spells from sigils, then lead a team of five young mages through turn-based battles on a grid. Others have walked their road before. Few found their way back.

details.title: Mayhematic
details.short_description: Mayhematic is a bullet heaven where the next door is always worth the trouble behind it. Blast through cartoon hordes solo or in 4-player online co-op, spend your kills on doors that go deeper, build something ridiculous and put your name on the leaderboard.

details.title: Mercenary Guild Manager
details.short_description: Raise a banner and run a mercenary guild in a grim medieval fantasy realm. Recruit and read your blades, negotiate contracts, send them into procedural missions, and survive a living political web where every payday bites and nothing is ever certain.

details.title: DuoFall
details.short_description: Pieces fall from the top and rise from the bottom - and you play both fields at once. Can you do it? Longer than your friends? Challenge them: same seed, live duel or leaderboard - every run is proven by replay. One mind. Two fields. Many blocks.

details.title: MixUp!
details.short_description: MixUp! is a CO-OP focused, fast-paced color mixing and management roguelite. Enter the unique, black and white world of "Malben." As a Visionary Painter, your life mission is to restore color to this monochrome reality, one customer, one day, one city at a time, friends may join you on your journey.

details.title: Tiny Street: Taskbar Tycoon
details.short_description: Tiny Street: Taskbar Tycoon is a taskbar idle game where a tiny street sits right on the taskbar while you work, relax, or simply watch the people come and go. Passerbys will randomly shop in your colorful, hand-drawn stores, and slowly help grow your little economy.

details.title: Buddington
details.short_description: Buddington is a 2D life sim blending restaurant management, light action combat, and story adventure. Battle pests for ingredients by day, then plan the menu and run the canteen with friends come sundown.

details.title: MSP Mayhem
details.short_description: Run a chaotic IT service company with your friends! Answer the phones, fix the servers, calm the customers and land that big enterprise deal — all before the SLA clock runs out. Inspired by Overcooked-style couch co-op mayhem, set in the world's most stressful open-plan office.

details.title: Court of Karma: Soul Check
details.short_description: Every soul has a past. Every sin demands a price. As an underworld judge, uncover the truth behind each soul's life and decide their fate. Will you deliver justice, or condemn the innocent?

details.title: PARRUITS!
details.short_description: Swallow a watermelon, become a watermelon. A 2–6 player party brawler where parrots turn into whatever fruit they eat, then use one ridiculous ability each to knock each other into the sea. Last parrot on the island wins. Couch or online. A minute to learn, ten minutes to lose a friend.

details.title: 园区物语
details.short_description: You play as a tourist trapped in a scam compound. fight to survive, sneak around and seize escape chances. Gather hidden clues, master scam skills reluctantly to survive, meet captives stuck here for various reasons, dig out its dark secrets, and choose between escaping the den or ruling it.

details.title: AGX GP
details.short_description: AGX is a heart thumpingly fast, Anti-Gravity racing game. It's lightning‑fast action and Xtreme ability‑based gameplay, will push your reactions and skills to the limit! Welcome To AGX!

details.title: Maledictum
details.short_description: In Maledictum (1–4 co-op), you’re not a ghost hunter you’re an Investigator of Guilt. Identify the entity, uncover the victim/culprit/cause, and decide a final ritual to free or condemn a spirit that reacts to your voice.

details.title: WorldWasGray
details.short_description: A relaxing game about painting a gray world back to life.

details.title: Kwad
details.short_description: Kwad is a snappy, grid-based puzzle game where you play as a square. Jump, snap, and merge with other Kwads to morph your way through clever spatial challenges.

details.title: AI Empire Tycoon
details.short_description: Build your own AI empire in a world of business, competition, and innovation! Grow your company, cooperate with other players, sabotage your rivals, and compete for dominance. Will you rise together or crush the competition?

details.title: Pepper Patrol
details.short_description: Pests have invaded the garden! Survive 20 waves as a brave Bell Pepper whose garden tools attack on their own. Merge tools, call Corn, Onion and Tomato to help, shop at the Worm's Compost Shop and ripen all the way to Tricolor.

details.title: Woodshire Foragers
details.short_description: Gather resources, craft powerful gear, and build a thriving village where villagers automate production. Explore colorful lands, battle enemies and bosses, solve puzzles, and conquer dungeons alone or with friends in online co-op.

details.title: Capital Backstab
details.short_description: Starting with you at the bottom, the company’s cutting the fat. In this point and click adventure, you have to give your co workers the “Capital Backstab.” You had what it took to get in, are you able to stay?

details.title: Viriditasia
details.short_description: A first-person forest and garden walking tour (unguided). Explore expansive forest landscapes at your own pace, in your own way. Sow gardens and tend to them as each plant grows at its own rate. This game has an optional modal feature involving complex visual distortions.

details.title: Booster Beast
details.short_description: Booster Beasts is an incremental pack-smashing game. Equip up to six mythical beasts, and unleash all their skills with every strike. Combine elemental bonuses, evolve your beasts, and build the firepower to crack tougher packs and take on bosses.

details.title: Purrfect Circuit
