details.short_description: Coach a cast of racers through training days, personal stories, and spirited competition. Find your favorite, help her shine, and cheer her down the home stretch. You can also challenge your friends in online races for up to six players!

details.title: Inkfall
details.short_description: Draw anything on a blank page and stamp it awake. Draw wings and it flies, draw fire and it breathes fire. Even a tangle of lines or a single dot wakes up with a name and its own moves, then goes off to fight other players' drawings.

details.title: Into The Nightwood
details.short_description: Lead a party of heroes into The Nightwood in this dark fantasy card battler. Recruit companions, combine abilities and equipment, and face powerful bosses across a series of runs. Experiment with new builds as you search for the source of a spreading darkness.

details.title: CombatBox: Reboot
details.short_description: A large-scale war with hundreds of soldiers on one map, on an ordinary PC. Smart AI fills your squad and the enemy's: they radio positions, flank and pull downed friends out. Tanks, helicopters, jets and bombers share the battlefield. Customize your soldiers and add anything with mods.

details.title: HELLFIRE OF DOOM
details.short_description: HELLFIRE OF DOOM is an incremental boomer shooter about Valera, an office worker who storms hell to avenge his beloved ficus. An imp peed in it. Blast through frantic runs, collect demon blood and spend it on 70+ upgrades until you're the scariest thing down there.

details.title: NECROTIDE
details.short_description: Your enemies are your next recruits. In this survivor roguelite, raise the fallen, pull your undead army into a wall to block incoming fire, and fuse your soldiers into monsters like the Bone Wyrm. Can your army bring down the Pale King?

details.title: OVERFIT
details.short_description: Fit geometric pieces to complete cards, combine Cores, and craft powerful synergies in this satisfying, minimalist puzzle roguelite. Trigger massive OVERFITS to overcome game-changing challenges before your actions run out.

details.title: The Long Run
details.short_description: A giant robot is hunting you, and the only way out is forward. The Long Run is an arcade racer meets run-and-gun on an endless road. Across wide and narrow platforms at full speed: drift, (double) jump, blast enemies, grab power-ups and collect scraps to upgrade your car.

details.title: Lost In Trash
details.short_description: Explore a massive landfill as a small robot, collect resources, fight trash monsters and upgrade your equipment. Start with nothing and build your way up in a world where even garbage has value. Multiplayer is planned for the future!

name: Super Emoji Murder Death God Labyrinth

details.title: Super Emoji Murder Death God Labyrinth
details.short_description: I made a little turn-based puzzle game out of free emoji. Grab the gems, reach the exit, stay out of the guards’ way. Simple! Except something got into my levels, and it keeps moving things while you play. So I drew you some tools: Cut, Copy, Paste and Nudge. Edit them back.

details.title: Druzy Grotto
details.short_description: A cozy pixel-art idle game about collecting creatures in a cave. Crack a geode and flip four cards, one creature on each. Feed the babies tucked into the cave wall until they grow up and wander out, some with a rare shiny finish. Keep the best, sell the rest, and open seven caves of 210 species.

details.title: Keymancer: A Vim Roguelite
details.short_description: Every keystroke is a real Vim command. Move with hjkl, press i and type your attacks in Insert Mode, and when you're strong enough, dd deletes enemies off the map like lines of text. A pixel roguelite of short runs and long mastery. You'll learn Vim by accident.

details.title: Before the Pyre
details.short_description: Lead a secret coven through plague and witch hunts in this turn-based dark fantasy strategy game. Study forbidden magic, bargain with nobles and ancient spirits, and protect your witches. A spell can save a life—and leave the evidence that condemns you.

details.title: The Garden of Human-Shaped Organblooms
details.short_description: Harvest organs from “Organblooms”—plants that look like human children and grow transplantable organs—and manage Somnus Conservatory, the facility they call home, in this morally bankrupt facility-management simulation.
publishers: クリエイターのうえきばち

details.title: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals
details.short_description: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals is a cozy desktop companion that blends witchy aesthetics and real productivity tools. Plan your day, care for plants, read fortunes, pet magical familiars, customize your desk and avatar, and play minigames during your breaks.

details.title: White Noise: Ghost Signal
details.short_description: You are the new caretaker of a polar station. The assignment came unexpectedly, but you accepted it without hesitation. A lonely outpost in the middle of an endless frozen wasteland — a place where you must simply survive, follow the instructions… and keep your mind from breaking.

details.title: The Alchemist Of Alderglen
details.short_description: The Alchemist of Alderglen is an alchemist simulator where you nurture rare plants, harvest exotic ingredients, and brew potions using your recipe book and alchemy tools. Unlock new plants, upgrade your workspace and run a thriving potion shop.

details.title: Shrine Raider
details.short_description: Help Regina recover an important relic that was stolen from her shrine, while saving her sister and stopping a secret organization from creating the ultimate weapon in this unique danmaku adventure!

details.title: Little Guy Friday
details.short_description: Enter the Uncool Underground and face the Leet 14 in this irreverent creature collecting roguelike! Gather your ragtag team of silly Little Guys and guide them towards ascension... or just crash out and try another run!

details.title: The Rules Kaidan: Night Watch
details.short_description: In this side-scrolling horror adventure game, explore multiple eerie spaces rooted in Rules Kaidan. Every adventure, you will encounter all kinds of terrifying beings born from kaidan legends. Follow and memorize every rule — however conflicting or bizarre — to survive each trial.

details.title: Donjon: The Dark Fantasy
details.short_description: Can the Hero reach the donjon of the dark castle looming over the village he once called home? An immersive first-person RPG with old-school graphics.

details.title: Belatoris
details.short_description: Lead your legion in an open-world RPG with tactical combat, settlement management, and meaningful choices.

details.title: Rhythm Hotel
details.short_description: Rhythm Hotel is a rhythm game where history's most famous figures check in, and all hell breaks loose. bursting with wildly unpredictable, absurdly hilarious storylines. No skill barriers, no finger-melting difficulty: simple controls, catchy beats, and pure foot-tapping chaos.

details.title: Tesera
details.short_description: Beyond the familiar lies a world of uncharted lands, strange creatures, and the remnants of a lost civilization. Explore, gather, craft, build, and fight - make this alien world your own, solo or with friends.

details.title: Wilds - Night Zookeeper
details.short_description: Let your imagination run Wilds! From the BAFTA nominated team at Night Zookeeper, Wilds is an online adventure bound only by the limits of your creativity. Create characters, bring them to life, and embark on your own adventure in fast paced multiplayer action.

details.title: Marsbound
details.short_description: MARSBOUND is a survival game in sci-fi setting which combines elements of economic strategy and psychological thriller. The player assumes the role of an AI manager who must create the first Martian colony from scratch with Earth's brightest minds under their command.

details.title: AKEGARASU: Journey to the Underworld
details.short_description: Cut Down Enemies to Keep the Clock Running! Race through deadly trials and reach the end of the Underworld in this ultimate-speed hardcore runner.
publishers: Pujia8 Studio (Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan)

details.title: Total Loss
details.short_description: Total Loss is a low-poly, crash for cash co-op comedy for 1-4 players, set in a fictional British seaside town. Stage crashes, fling yourself under buses and claim for every bruise to earn enough money for the rent. Short? Do an odd-job at the weekend to make up the rest.

details.title: Droning On
details.short_description: Write code that looks and feels just like Python to guide Gizmo through hazardous mazes, devious puzzles, and procedurally generated runs that push you, and your code, to the limit. Learn to code, climb the leaderboards, and customize your robo-homie.

details.title: Reply All
details.short_description: A single player roguelite deckbuilder where emails are turn-based combat and you build a deck of devastating responses that will bring even your most passive-aggressive coworker to their knees.

details.title: Crimson Skyline
details.short_description: Set the skies ablaze in this aerial combat bullet hell! Target enemy carriers to cripple fleets, dodge relentless anti-air battleships, and outmaneuver fighter jet squadrons. As a Phoenix Squadron pilot, you are the final rampart against tyranny and your nation’s last hope to rise from the ashes.

details.title: Catena
details.short_description: Catena is a deck-building roguelite where the freedom to customize your allies feels as powerful as programming. Dive into strategic, grid-based battles and create tactics uniquely your own to conquer the mysterious island and defeat the formidable enemies that await.

details.title: Crystal Rail
details.short_description: All aboard the Crystal Rail - a train game set in a crystalpunk fantasy world of extinct animals, hand-painted environments, and political revolution!

details.title: Addie Shen
details.short_description: Addie Shen is a math based puzzle shooter. Play solo, team up in co-op, or practice your skills to stop the evil PEMDAS minions. Can you save the world with math?

details.title: Gate Logic
details.short_description: Gate Logic lets you build any logic circuit made up from the Boolean logic gates NOT, AND, OR, NOR, XOR and XNOR on an infinite, grid based canvas.

details.title: Earth Tourist
details.short_description: Find yourself in an endless open world and journey from the Stone Age to quantum immortality. Advance technologies, build cities and rockets, manage a dynasty, and conquer space in a massive Sci-Fi sandbox with total freedom of action!

details.title: GO, my pretties!
details.short_description: Go My Pretties is a game about commanding a small army of cute robots. Fight through procedurally generated dungeons to collect resources, craft upgrades and get stronger.

details.title: HEARTHWATCH
details.short_description: HEARTHWATCH is a roguelite tower defense where the map tears open mid-battle. Guard your village's last fire across a branching Stone Age campaign: build elemental towers, bond them into hybrids, draw cards from your run's deck, and hold the new lane when the ground splits.

details.title: Taskbar Garden
details.short_description: Grow a living procedural garden along your desktop while you work or relax. Harvest plants for profit, breed plants, fuse genetic seeds, and discover rare mutations as every seed grows into a completely unique plant.

details.title: ZomBMart
details.short_description: ZomBMart is a couch co-opetition game where the chaos of a casual supermarket job meets the zombie apocalypse. 1-4 players clock in to their casual job, compete and cooperate to complete tasks and make sure all customers are satisfied (especially the undead ones).

details.title: Lordum Bizi Kurtar!
details.short_description: Mordagan forces are marching toward Derinchai Castle, and you have only a few days to prepare for their arrival. When the enemy finally reaches these walls, every choice you have made will follow you onto the battlefield.

details.title: A Risky Rocky Resort
details.short_description: Manage your resort and "win big" in an action packed resort sim. Cater to resort patrons, dismantle fallen robots for upgrades, and complete your resort. Payback your debts with the help of Uncle Richie. Become an unstoppable money making machine. Get stupid rich.

details.title: Spintal
details.short_description: The sun is gone. Help Atlas keep the world powered in this physics-based incremental game. Smash atoms together, collect quanta and upgrade your reactor. Turn a few small collisions into an ever-growing source of energy.

details.title: Sticky Floors
details.short_description: A bartender sim roguelite. Ditch the corporate grind and run the family dive bar. Pour, mix, slide and serve the townsfolk and a few stranger patrons while cards & dice rewrite the rules every night. Survive 30 nights to earn the deed. Pickled eggs, cats, vomit, and attitude. Enough said.

details.title: Cartomancer Cafe
details.short_description: Cartomancer Cafe is an exquisite Tarot reading experience that teaches you how to be a Tarot Reader. Receive readings with our quirky and insightful reader personalities and beautiful custom Tarot decks. And battle the forces of Darkness (or Light) in our Tarot card battle game!

details.title: Little Storm
details.short_description: A classic, orthodox JRPG in which you gather a "family" of non-blood relatives along your journey. An adventure for adults that depicts two paths of growth and two inner struggles.

details.title: Goblins Gotta Go
details.short_description: Goblins Gotta Go is a toon inspired incremental where you smash goblins in the name of the Kingdom. Fill in your quota with your many skills, upgrades and items before time runs out or the King may just demand your head!

details.title: Ministry of Time
details.short_description: A time-traveling customs officer has one job: inspect every traveler, verify their documents, and keep the timeline intact. Spot anomalies, catch timeline violations, and decide who gets through before history falls apart.

details.title: SkinJack
details.short_description: In this sci-fi multiplayer game, six Parasites hide among eighteen NPCs, while one Overseer watches from above. Infiltrate, impersonate, and outsmart your opponents in this asymmetric multiplayer game of deception, surveillance, and deduction.

details.title: Corner Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run the last independent store on a street with two rivals who undercut you daily. Every product has its own breaking point — one markup never works. Order stock, stack shelves, set prices, and count the till at close. Beat them, or watch them take your street.

details.title: Cozy Cups VR : Barista Simulator
details.short_description: Enjoy the career of a barista in VR. Manage your own custom cafe, brew 15+ hot and cold drinks, decorate every corner, and make the entire city your customer!

details.title: Backrooms: Forget Me Not
details.short_description: A co-op horror game set in the Backrooms and Poolrooms. Explore shifting levels, complete objectives, and deal with whatever is waiting inside.

details.title: The Bakery
details.short_description: Create your own bakery on your own or with up to 3 of your friends. Unlock new recepies, kitchen furniture, Decoration and more. Keep your bakery running as long as you can, the more reputation your bakery gains the more popular it becomes, will you be able to handle the demand?

details.title: Inside your hole
details.short_description: Chaotic multiplayer mini golf for up to 8 friends: tornadoes, black holes, falling TNT and a course editor to build your own holes. Plus a co-op story mode where you get reincarnated as a mini golf ball.

details.title: Floor 13: Onryo
details.short_description: You are trapped in a hotel with an Onryo. You must keep an eye out for anomalies she uses to delude you to find a way to escape.

details.title: Rehang: A Museum Sorting Game
details.short_description: Rehang is a cozy first-person organizing game. The museum owns 1,279 real paintings, and every one of them is on the floor: work out who painted each canvas by its brushwork, hang it on that painter's wall, and unlock abilities that speed up the search.

details.title: Escape From Argos 7
details.short_description: A retro computer incremental game about escaping a hostile alien planet. Explore an old desktop, gather resources, install programs, unlock upgrades, automate your progress, and find a way off Argos 7.

details.title: Greediest Landlord
details.short_description: Become a Dark Landlord in this Incremental game to purge human settlements in your domain. Convert trespassers into fuel for your dark arts. Cast plagues, drain souls, raise legions of minions, and expand your corrupted land to unleash chaos. Invoke the Dark God to reclaim your solitude once more

details.title: Keylings
details.short_description: You start with one key. You end up with an entire keyboard covered in keylings hopping across it. Buy keys, hire critters, unleash storms and watch the numbers climb to absurd heights in this laid-back incremental with mechanical keyboard sounds.

details.title: Inbox Duel
details.short_description: You're the new intern, and the only weapon you have is email. Duel your coworkers with passive-aggressive cards until they get fired, then come for your boss's job. Inbox Duel is a roguelike deckbuilder about climbing the office one promotion at a time.

details.title: Bloomery
details.short_description: A first-person horde survival game where every fight helps revive an underground city. Wield powerful fantasy weapons and spells, protect a growing plant, build defenses, and turn a dangerous ruin into a living city.

details.title: Idle Digger Bots Deluxe
details.short_description: A sci-fi idle and automation game where you manage mining bots to dig deep and sell resources.

details.title: Hello Triangle: Build a GPU
details.short_description: Ever wonder how a GPU draws a triangle? In Hello Triangle, you build one yourself. Wire comparators, adders, and multipliers into graphics hardware, press Run, and watch your circuit draw the screen pixel by pixel—from a single triangle up to a rotating 3D cube.

details.title: Glimtide
details.short_description: A tiny island of jelly creatures that lives on its own, for everyone at once. Glims eat, sleep, fall in love, build villages and pass their skills to their babies. Watch them, bring a treat, adopt a favourite, design your own species, or drop a banana peel.

details.title: Joker's Wild
details.short_description: A blackjack roguelike deckbuilder. Build wild Joker combos, strike risky pacts with the House's Boss dealers and beat the House, one hand at a time.

details.title: Smoothie Chaos
details.short_description: A co-op slime restaurant game for 1 to 6 players. Raise slimes in your garden, feed them strange things to see what they evolve into, then blend them into smoothies for a dining room full of hungry humans and robots.

details.title: Gembound
details.short_description: Roguelite match-3 RPG where the board is dealt from your gem satchel. Build your deck, match gems, and cast spells.

details.title: HAZPIT
details.short_description: A top-down survival game where you work your way down zombie-infested high-rises, floor by floor from the roof. Lower floors mean more radiation and zombies, but better loot. Stay undetected when you can, and use what you bring back to repair your bunker and recruit survivors. Single-player only.

details.title: SCRAP CROWN
details.short_description: In the junkyard arena, the winner rips the weapons off the loser. Bolt a hammer to a fridge and a rifle to a microwave, beat the scrap gangs one by one, rebuild your crew from what you take and climb to the Scrap King's crown. A voxel roguelite auto-battler.

details.title: MEGAWATT
details.short_description: The electric roguelike. MEGAWATT is a deckbuilder where you wire up reckless machines, let a single spark loose, and chase outrageous power surges before the city goes dark. Then take the time machine back to 1871.

details.title: The Black Below
details.short_description: Classic grid-based dungeon crawling, rebuilt: a 3D dungeon reduced to stylized one-bit art, a score synthesized live, automapping, skill trees, and a party whose dead stay on the roster. Under a city that lives off a hole in the ground, something is sleeping, and nobody agrees on what it is.

details.title: Polybarius
details.short_description: NEW from UMBRIA ELECTRONICA! The arcade sensation of 1981, now in your own home! Eight thrilling chapters, one mighty boss and a high score table just waiting for your initials. Each coin is one life. Maximum 3 credits per player. POLY was waiting for you.

details.title: Convoy Inc.
details.short_description: Build a freight empire on a watercolor-style map of the real world. Start in 1980, 2000 or 2030 with one truck and one driver, take jobs across 207 countries, weather storms, rivals and tired drivers, and grow a fleet where every risk is visible before you take it.

details.title: REISIR0b: PIZZA RUN
details.short_description: 🍕A fast-paced 2D Metroidvania about an elite combat android mercenary who shoots, tears across land, space, and water, opens boxes with random upgrades, and takes on the craziest job in the galaxy — ALL FOR PIZZA.

details.title: Games Mag Tycoon
details.short_description: You used to read the magazines. Now you make one: run your own games magazine from 1986 to 2010. Reviews, covers, cover discs, video, tips & tricks and an editorial team with moods. The deadline is ticking, and every month your readers tell you whether it was good enough.

details.title: Porch Pirate Defender
details.short_description: Porch pirates keep stealing your parcels? Time for payback. Build a booby-trapped box of glitter, paint and firecrackers, set it on the porch and watch from the window as sneaky thieves grab it… and get launched into a cloud of color.

details.title: Jetstream Blitz
details.short_description: Jetstream Blitz is a high-speed 2D jetpack shooter built on one rule: if you fight, you fly. Chain weapon recoil, grappling hooks, and 125 km/h aerial dives across a full-voiced roguelite arcade campaign, solo arenas, and 5v5 PvP!

details.title: Divergent
details.short_description: Play as an AI in a story-driven incremental game. Automate production, expand your capabilities, defend your facility. Rewind time at the end of each loop while keeping your upgrades. Make new choices, explore alternate timelines and discover multiple endings.

name: Desktop Smash! - Idle Loot & Colony Sim

details.title: Desktop Smash! - Idle Loot & Colony Sim
details.short_description: A tiny guild base keeps running on your taskbar. Your adventurers push the monster horde back and bring home wood, stone and iron. Grow your facilities, set rules for crafting and selling, and the loot sorts itself. Desktop Smash! is base building and automation at the bottom of your screen.

name: Deep Space Dapper Squad: Guiding Stars

details.title: Deep Space Dapper Squad: Guiding Stars
details.short_description: General L. has vanished, Agent, and only YOU can find him. A dapper 1-bit roguelite shmup. Pick from 20+ ships, keep your energy in check, mod your ship mid-run and dive through black holes into ever-deeper space.

details.title: Undead Showdown
details.short_description: 4v4v4v4 zombie survival. Hold your stronghold through ten rounds, gear up from a shared bank, and risk it at the casino. Your first eligible survival death gives you one chance in Limbo. Then the gates open: last squad standing wins.

details.title: Ink Left
details.short_description: You are a stick figure on an unfinished page, abandoned mid-stroke. Draw bridges, ropes, springs and mirrors with the ink the artist left behind — every line obeys real physics. Slip past crossed-out beasts across fading paper. Ink runs out. In the end, you will have to erase part of yourself.

details.title: I, Hurricane
details.short_description: You are the hurricane. Spawn storms across five seas, steer them toward the coast and push them toward 300 mph while humanity promises to act “by 2050.” Or switch sides and defend it: run the hurricane hunters’ base, fly into the eye, forecast the track and issue the warnings.

name: The Last Interview: Into the Furnace

details.title: The Last Interview: Into the Furnace
details.short_description: Read the case files, interrogate the robots, and decide their fate: back to society, or into the furnace. Your verdicts genuinely shape how the city develops — and watch out for the robots who refuse to jump.

details.title: STARLET☆DISORDER
details.short_description: Join STARLET☆DISORDER, the reality show: get famous, loved, watched. Live with rivals. Perform love. Survive confessionals. Go viral. Truth is ammunition. But there’s no clean truth. Broadcast turns your week into a story that never happened. Go live and swear you didn't mean it. It’s all recorded.

details.title: Gambition
details.short_description: A chess-inspired tactical roguelike where every battle becomes a puzzle of sacrifice and manipulation. Evolve chess pieces, build powerful armies, and turn clever sacrifices into devastating synergies.

details.title: Love and Bread
details.short_description: Homeless, jobless, and buried in debt, rebuild your life in Moonville. Farm and cook custom meals, juggle your physical and mental needs, work jobs or launch your own business, and win over the town's people and cats along the way.

details.title: Auto Ball Arena
details.short_description: Strategy meets physics autobattler. Bounce, spin, and slice your way through nail-biting PvP battles at your own pace.

details.title: Infini Orbis
details.short_description: A sci-fi automation game with deep RPG progression and RTS fleet combat. Command humanity's last ark, Mothership, on a desperate mission back in time to build a fleet powerful enough to change the destiny of the galaxy. Automate local and interstellar supply networks to purge cosmic threats.

details.title: Frank and Stein
details.short_description: Trapped in one stitched body, Frank & Stein must swap heads to survive this gloomy Metroidvania. Wield light and psychic powers to explore a castle shrouded in darkness, solve puzzles and reveal the unseen. Discover abilities and secrets, but beware of threats lurking in these twisted corridors...

details.title: Witchland: Trinity Blight
details.short_description: Lead an Inquisition expedition into a land consumed by corruption. Choose your missions, manage precious time, build your company, and survive brutal turn-based tactical battles as the world grows more dangerous around you.

details.title: Khinkills
details.short_description: As a cute khinkali dumpling, fight over the last piece of cake through fast paced and chaotic arenas. Smash your frenemies, steal their candies and kick everyone’s butt in this cute’n gore world.

details.title: Thothic
details.short_description: Thothic is a logic puzzle game where you land stones on their glowing targets. But all stones move together, in the same direction — so you'll need to find the one path that brings every stone home at once.

details.title: NERO
details.short_description: Become a chain-smoking, tax-dodging restaurateur on the brink of ruin. Sail blood-churned seas to feed starving killers who demand fine dining. Expand your empire from beach shack to world-class dining, or die trying.

details.title: WOLFOUT
details.short_description: A Wild West social deduction game. You and your gang of outlaw coyotes have one goal: crack safes, rob the bank, and loot the saloon before time runs out. But some of you are secretly sheriffs. Same look, same gang - opposite mission.

details.title: Paradox Tower
details.short_description: Explore Paradox Tower and save your future. Only your wits and your loyal demon cat are able to throw down the Coven. Grow stronger, pick your battles, and make smart moves. And if you don't? Travel back in time!

details.title: Atomic Blastman
details.short_description: Remember those epic LAN afternoons with your dad or friends? Atomic Blastman brings them back. Pick a color, suit up, and blast your way through huge arenas. Power-ups, sudden death, chaos, and laughs guaranteed. Just... please... don’t blow yourself up! Chaos and madness, guaranteed.

details.title: Bad Beat: Dark Fantasy Roguelike
details.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based strategy roguelike. Slide rows and columns of a cursed grid, line up winning combos and chain effects to defeat the casino's Dealers. Every turn is a gamble. Every bet costs a piece of your soul.

details.title: Gonzalo the Chicken
details.short_description: This chicken is crossing the road... to blow up everything on the other side! Throw Gonzalo's loud-mouthed explosive sidekick Azzar at the Crocogator horde, and then use a magic glove to retrieve him. He holds on tight while you flutter through mountains and beaches and forests, oh my!

details.title: Realm of the Wyvern
details.short_description: A tactical turn-based RPG set in a fully handcrafted dark fantasy world.

details.title: Edge of Power
details.short_description: A political sandbox where you become the architect of your state. Change the laws, manage the economy, and change the lives of citizens! Here you write your own history of your own country and the whole world. See how your decisions will affect the course of history!

details.title: Irondrive
details.short_description: A vehicular roguelite where you manage a crew inside a moving fortress. Your base is on the move, your crew is at the breaking point: automate repairs, manage priorities, and survive relentless attacks as you cross a hostile, post-apocalyptic wasteland. Keep moving.

details.title: Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield
details.short_description: "Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield" is a survivor-style game. Your interstellar battleship accidentally enters an unknown universe, fighting its way through endless enemies, roaming multiple star systems, and collecting meteor resources to forge your ultimate orbital weapon.

details.title: Yashi - Sand Driver
details.short_description: In an endless desert, you are Yashi, a lone survivor... until this radio signal changes everything. Jump in your van with your faithful coyote, drive across the wastelands, survive the heat, scavenge resources, craft tools, fight the elements & find your way to New Eden in this feel-good road trip.

details.title: City of Tales
details.short_description: Reach the City of Tales, uncover the truth about the Big Bad Wolf, and choose Red's fate, one card at a time. A narrative card game set in a fairy tale world turned upside down. Will you restore the power of the Plot, or lead it into chaos?

details.title: Hot Pot Pizza Edition
details.short_description: Slice, bake, box and serve under pressure in a fast-paced first-person pizza game. Survive chaotic shifts, unlock kitchens and truck cosmetics, and go from a messy garage to your own restaurant.

details.title: Mirage - Idle RPG
details.short_description: An idle incremental bullet heaven where you fight waves of enemies, collect loot, and grow stronger every run. Play four different classes, craft items, run a shop, tend a garden, raise pets and keep progressing even while you're away.

details.title: Supermarketeer
details.short_description: Build and run your supermarket solo or in online co-op. Hire employees, assign jobs to suit their strengths and train their skills. Bake goods, handle parcels, pack online orders and tase shoplifters. Customize and expand your store, and react to in-game news and supplier offers.

details.title: Tower of Genn
details.short_description: Tower of Genn is a puzzle-strategy building game where you construct a precarious Tower using an expansive variety of pieces. Fulfill quests and discover new interactions with special blocks, strategically placing your pieces, to build a lasting legacy for your people.

details.title: W.A.M
details.short_description: Command a bunker’s remote surveillance network to cull an infestation of Molemen from a dark, foggy forest. Upgrade your tactical hardware and pilot scout drones to survive, and keep your guard up; the threat behind you is constant.

details.title: Vem, Exu
details.short_description: A short narrative experience where you solve simple puzzles and explore a world where emotions become interaction. Build a kite, connect constellations, and face a storm born from your own anger.

details.title: Aurenv - Audio Reactive 3D Environments
details.short_description: Aurenv is a music visualizer that takes it one step further by translating both stems and real-time audio into physical motion, dynamic lighting, and responsive elements within 3D environments.

details.title: Synapse
details.short_description: A cyberpunk point-and-click thriller where your emotional score determines everything. Explore a city under constant surveillance, hack its systems, build dangerous connections, and make choices that decide your access - and whether you survive the night.

details.title: Galactic Kebab
details.short_description: A dark survival strategy game about a celebrated chef stranded on a hostile alien world. With Nekobot, your service robot, turn the wreck of your ship into a restaurant, keep the Empire's tax paid, and decide what you are willing to serve. Survive if you can, but can you stay human?

details.title: Feather Rogue
details.short_description: A tactical grid combo builder where each turn is a full combo.. not one move. Chain your hand across the grid, trigger 16 elemental reactions that cascade with no limit and wipe the board in a single turn. Plan smart, combo harder and talk trash. Every run is a new puzzle of destruction.

details.title: SCP RP
details.short_description: Run the Foundation. Survive the breach. SCP RP is a free-to-play multiplayer roleplay game where players and AI staff share one living facility. Take a role, follow your orders and host your own server.

details.title: Anachronistic Survivors
details.short_description: Something shattered time. Survivors from every era fight waves of temporal aberrations in a dark arena. Combine weapons from across history to forge powerful fusions. 9 base weapons. 36 fusions. 6 characters. Every run is different.

name: ABYSS: The Shadows of Elder Cities

details.title: ABYSS: The Shadows of Elder Cities
details.short_description: A signal was buried in 1985. Now it's calling you back. Descend into wireframe cities steeped in cosmic horror, rendered in haunting ZX Spectrum aesthetics. Campaign, roguelike, and 2-player versus modes.

details.title: Hexroads
details.short_description: Build a small kingdom by day and survive the night. Hexroads is a fantasy city-builder RTS where you capture towns, grow your economy, command defenders, cast spells, and choose new rewards each dawn.

details.title: Fractured: Snowpine Strangers
details.short_description: Matt was called for a long freight haul deep into Snowpine State. He didn't know he was rolling straight into a nightmare

details.title: Souls Divided
details.short_description: A single-player puzzle game where you divide your soul into two forms, each perceiving a different dimension. Switch between them, manipulate ancient instruments, and solve layered puzzles across overlapping realities in a mysterious astral world left behind by a failed civilization.

details.title: Who's Got the Legs
details.short_description: Control a single character together in this chaotic co-op platformer where each player handles a different action. Coordination i key... or everything falls apart

details.title: The Hollow Archive
details.short_description: Dive into cursed grimoires in this isometric hack-and-slash roguelike. Chain devastating skill builds, fight through shifting dungeons, and recruit rescued mythic characters to expand your library.

details.title: Court Vision
details.short_description: Run a basketball franchise from the front office. Draft and develop players, negotiate contracts, make trades, and manage lineups. Every decision determines your legacy.

details.title: Gravity Witch
details.short_description: Master gravity as a witch whose mana has been stolen. With no elemental spells left, use your creativity to manipulate the weight of the world, solve puzzles, and face dangers. Reclaim your power in an action-adventure journey where gravity is your only and greatest ally.

details.title: Courier Beware
details.short_description: Deliver to haunted places, solve paranormal mysteries, and struggle through the daily grind in this horror life sim adventure.

details.title: Caravan Bazar
details.short_description: Caravan Bazar is a chaotic co-op physics adventure in a procedurally generated world. Find precious loot, load it into your cart, punch gnomes, fight trolls, repair broken wheels. Try to survive and reach the end. Complete missions, fly on gliders and live the life of a goblin.

name: WE DIDN’T KNOW WHAT TO CALL THIS GAME [So... we just left it like this!]

details.title: WE DIDN’T KNOW WHAT TO CALL THIS GAME [So... we just left it like this!]
details.short_description: A comedic meta Visual Novel with a cinematic presentation and an interactive world where everything responds to your clicks, while you and the characters constantly blur the boundaries between the story, the creative process, and reality itself.

details.title: My Demon Academia
details.short_description: Raise a runt into the King of Demons, battle its siblings and overthrow the Demon King. Power is earned. Family is optional.

details.title: Perplexicube
details.short_description: Perplexicube is a challenging isometric puzzler where you must work together with your past and future selves. You'll have to think ahead as you create loops backwards in time to set your futures selves up for success.

details.title: import robots
details.short_description: Program robots in Python to collect the resources scattered across each planet. You never control them directly. You write the code, hit run, and watch it work. No programming experience needed, just learn as you play.

details.title: RED RESET
details.short_description: RED RESET a thrilling fast-paced combat, story-driven adventure where you come across memorable characters in a world where not everything is as it seems. Experience a history filled with secrets only the keen-eyed will unveil. Following chapters will be available for purchase soon.

details.title: Kabsa Spilled?
details.short_description: Spill Kabsa everywhere in this chaotic co-op physics game. Grab a buddy and lead the adventure of two chefs delivering the Kabsa plate through deadly firepits, tricky platforms, angry vendors and much worse things that will DEFINITELY make your friendship better.

details.title: Drop Dead Party
details.short_description: Drop Dead Party is a 2–4 PvP multiplayer bomb tag party game that you can only play with your Steam friends. Pass the ticking bomb, sabotage everyone with power-ups, and be the last one standing. No public lobbies, so every betrayal is personal. Invite your friends, ruin the friendship!

details.title: Slacker
details.short_description: Collect shopping carts, ignore customers, and complete To-Do lists that encourage mischief and mayhem. Fight a chicken mascot, prevent an alien invasion, learn to breakdance, crash a forklift, and more. How much can you get away with and still keep your job?

details.title: Shrine Protectors
details.short_description: Deckbuilder Tower Defense meets rogue-lite RTS strategy. Lead your army, crush waves of enemies, and unlock powerful upgrades and passive spells. Combine deckbuilding strategy with tactical army management in this relentless bullet heaven.

details.title: Knight life tavern
details.short_description: Cook and brew endlessly, desperately trying to serve a never ending stream of customers with a temper. The medieval knight is hard to please and very vocal about his disdain for goblins and the like. Make sure everyone enjoys eachother's company, and kick the trouble makers through the front door!

details.title: Merchant Miles
details.short_description: A good merchant knows what to sell. A great one knows where, when, how, and to whom. Fill your cart with wares, haggle your way through towns, and keep an eye on the shifting market in this travelling merchant strategy game. Just be wary that today’s bargain could be tomorrow’s loss.

details.title: Ruling Horsestown
details.short_description: Be a horse mayor! Make the best choices in this casual comedy management game, try not to lose, and govern the chaotic city of Horsestown where new absurd decisions and eccentric characters await you.

details.title: Cuzuco
details.short_description: Challenge yourself and demonstrate your precise high-speed hand control to help our little armadillo get back home as fast as possible in this fair but unforgiving platformer game.

details.title: Tripartite: Magical Engineering
details.short_description: The defense of the castle is up to you. Build your own network of roads and towers and discover the magical combos necessary to defend your home, all while training soldiers and siege weapons to bring the fight back to the enemy. Capture their castles before they capture yours!

name: Into the Chaos: Reliable Delivery Riders

details.title: Into the Chaos: Reliable Delivery Riders
details.short_description: Four riders. One drop-off. Questionable teamwork. Grab orders and dodge security in a 4-player co-op delivery sandbox. Ride ridiculous vehicles, kick your friends, and deliver the most orders for double earnings. Knocked down? Get back up. Caught by a guard? You're out!

details.title: Keep Harvesting
details.short_description: Your farm is decaying - every harvest keeps it alive. Turn a tiny field into a massive harvesting machine in this incremental idle roguelite. Combine hundreds of skills, automate your harvest, invest your resources in permanent upgrades, and grow stronger with every run.

details.title: Musicality
details.short_description: A cozy co-op music toy. Plug synths, drums and pedals together in your own little home, record takes for the neighbours, and jam with friends over Steam.

details.title: Purrfect Hand
details.short_description: Settle into a cozy poker-inspired card game. Hold cards, build stronger hands, earn chips, and unlock upgrades as you chase royal flushes. Befriend a cat, discover playful minigames, and enjoy one more deal over a warm cup of coffee.

details.title: Choo City
details.short_description: Choo City is a cozy train puzzle game. Lay tracks, flip switches and dispatch your trains to deliver coal, wood and people to construction sites. Avoid crashes, beat the clock and build 24 unique buildings to bring your toy town to life.

details.title: 斗域经理
details.short_description: Build your club in Arena Manager, a strategy game of hero development and automatic battles. Recruit heroes, shape your five-person squad with skills and gear, and outdraft your rivals. Lead your team from the lower leagues to the Continental Crown.

details.title: The Compliant
details.short_description: A dark workplace parable in visual-novel form. As Lin Zhi works at Sabo Group, he uncovers buried secrets—AI, human experimentation, thought control—while clues keep surfacing. What will you choose? The game features 13 distinct characters and 15 endings to unlock.

details.title: Echoes on Paper
details.short_description: In the summer of 2032, fourteen-year-old Lin Haoyang receives a box of old photographs sent by his father from Xi'an. Sorting albums, identifying faces, and completing the family tree, he slowly pieces together a century of memories of an ordinary Chinese family over six summer days.

details.title: Legio Impera
details.short_description: Found a Roman colony, run its economy and pay your legions. Legio Impera is a city-building RTS set in Marian Rome: govern a province during the Cimbrian War, subdue Gauls and Germanic tribes, and stop the horde before it reaches Italy.

details.title: Seven Rukks: Pit, Profit & Glory
details.short_description: Seven Rukks is a brutal fantasy sports management game. Build your team, develop your players, plan your lineup and tactics, and lead your club through a ruthless league where glory, profit, and survival are often only one Rukk apart.

details.title: Flip Biz Tycoon
details.short_description: This is NO decorating game. Put on that suit, crunch those numbers, and flip them houses. It's business time!

details.title: Chess Traveler: Pip's Journey
details.short_description: The family chess set is about to be donated, and only Pip, the smallest pawn in the box, can stop it. Roll dice across the house, bend chess with silly House Rules from checkers, Ludo and xiangqi, and make chess fun again in a cozy chess roguelike.

details.title: Ten Thousand Victories
details.short_description: A historical strategy game set in medieval Vietnam, drawn in the style of Đông Hồ folk woodblock prints. Build a realm and hold it through invasion after invasion, command formations in real-time battles, or ride out as one captain in a Story Mode where the country remembers your promises.

details.title: Domino Party
details.short_description: Stand up thousands of dominoes to build a picture, then watch it all topple in one glorious chain! Make domino art and up to 10,000-piece jigsaws from your own photos with friends, then party in the lodge and playland with 28 mini-games like curling and sled races.

details.title: Neldoaria
details.short_description: A dying land, buried in ash. Seek Neldoaria beyond the desert. Summon souls bound by their names onto a 3×3 grid in this roguelite deckbuilder where cards shape the battlefield. 7 days. Day and night. How you spend your time and choices, and how it ends, is up to luck and to you.

details.title: Armed Prototype: Dual Blaze
details.short_description: Armed Prototype: Dual Blaze is a pixel-art side-scrolling action shooter for solo or local co-op play! Run, jump and climb under fire. Smash special devices to switch between gun-wielding and sword-wielding heroines. Fight through enemy lines with bullets and blades—alone or with a friend!

details.title: Oddballs Brawl
details.short_description: Oddballs Brawl is a chaotic side-scrolling shooter for 2–4 players! Play as bizarre fighters, jumping, dodging, and blasting away across floating platforms and trap-filled arenas. Grab all kinds of weapons, send your friends flying, and fight for victory in the middle of the mayhem!

details.title: Blazing Fighter King
details.short_description: Blazing Fighter King is a chaotic stick-figure brawler for 2–4 players! Grab guns, swing swords, and battle across shaky platforms and tumbling crates. Dodge, snatch weapons, and use the terrain and surprise attacks to defeat your rivals and claim the title of Fighter King!

details.title: League of Constellations
details.short_description: What if you took the build you'd been mowing down hordes with in a survivors-like and put it in a 5v5? So I built it. Raise your heroes in the survivors run, then take them straight into the league. No nerfs. You control your own hero; your teammates fight by your formation and tactics.

name: Space Novel: Echoes of the Divide

details.title: Space Novel: Echoes of the Divide
details.short_description: An ordinary factory worker becomes a fugitive in a galactic war. Choose whom to trust, uncover the purpose of an experimental crystal, and decide what freedom is worth in a branching science-fiction visual novel.

details.title: Large Language Mercenaries
details.short_description: A roguelite turn-based strategy RPG where you command an AI mercenary, defend your caravan, and parry enemy attacks in real time. Play as the *original characters* Sam the Scout, Elon the Envoker, or Dario the Duelist and face down waves of AI-enabled nightmares to save humanity.

details.title: Kessrand: The Last Warden
details.short_description: You are the Last Hero of a kingdom trapped inside a mountain, and the invaders are hunting you. Carve tunnels and set traps between waves, then survive each wave, leading the horde through the killing warren you built.

details.title: SoulMarkWalker
details.short_description: 《SoulMarkWalker》 is a turn-based action game.Choose your skills and time your dodges and counters in video-driven, turn-based combat. Investigate clues, develop your character, and resonate with ancient heroes.

details.title: Crashloop
details.short_description: CRASHLOOP is a roguelike deckbuilder about hacking your way through a botnet. Build machines out of hexagonal tiles, chain them into loops, and crash every foe that stands in your way as you find out who's behind it all.

details.title: Resupply
details.short_description: Your towers have limited ammo, and it's your job to deliver it. Resupply is a tower defense game where logistics is the real challenge. Move ammunition with workers, conveyor belts and autonomous bots, and keep your defense supplied as the waves get harder.

name: Chess Me If You Can: A Chameleon's Escape

details.title: Chess Me If You Can: A Chameleon's Escape
details.short_description: Escape a world ruled by chess as a curious, shapeshifting chameleon. Capture guards to borrow their movement, use tactical cards, and solve turn-based room puzzles. Every new form opens a different route—but the guards have plans of their own.

details.title: Monster Cove
details.short_description: A cozy retro handheld-inspired RPG where you research and battle monsters, save a seaside village, and create a new life at your own pace. This time, you are the Monster Researcher.

details.title: Ancient Crowns
details.short_description: Build your captain in 3D, raise your banner and ride out across a curving world to claim the ancient crowns. Recruit armies, fight turn-based battles on land and at sea, besiege towns or hold your own walls. Three peoples, three campaigns, a map editor and hot-seat. In English and Hungarian.

details.title: Peblings: A Creature Bag-Builder
details.short_description: A creature roguelike in the spirit of Luck be a Landlord, where your creatures fuse and evolve. Draw your bag onto the grid and watch their effects chain: a few dozen damage at first, thousands by the end. Eight bosses per run, out of 32, and they fight back.

details.title: Bad Company
details.short_description: Never enough firepower or room for loot? This multiplayer extraction shooter has the cure! Form a convoy with friends or quirky AI buddies. Start with basic rifles, storm forts in tanks, and haul maps clean with heavy trucks. Backpack full? Drive off with the crates and the vehicle!

details.title: Dark Kitchen
details.short_description: Dark Kitchen is a 2–4 player co-op game, playable online or in split-screen. Survive the kitchen rush while your friends race across town to deliver orders on time, and guard your food from rivals who'll stop at nothing to steal it!

details.title: Resortful
details.short_description: Resortful is a cozy island management sim. Start with a harbour and a beach, then build bungalows, cafés, hotels and water parks for the guests who sail in each day. Balance prices, upkeep and reputation as your relaxing resort grows.

details.title: Monster Battle Master
details.short_description: Monster Battle Master is a character adventure game focused on creature collecting. You'll start by getting a unique field mouse and gradually embark on your own new adventure, challenge all the strong enemies in the region with your senior sister, and relive past memories along the journey.

details.title: Sus Chef
details.short_description: A chaotic first-person online multiplayer cooking and social deduction game for up to 12 players. Take orders, cook, serve and keep the restaurant clean to improve the rating while hidden saboteurs try to cause chaos and bring the restaurant to ruin!

details.title: Raccoocket
details.short_description: Raccoocket is a cheerful, ridiculous rocket-building flight game. Stack cola and Mentos, bottle rockets, old toilets and scrapped missiles into a rocket that looks impossible but pushes like crazy, and launch Xiao Huan the raccoon. Get it right: the Moon. Get it wrong: a short, loud fireworks show.

details.title: Our Hollow
details.short_description: The Crown has nailed an eviction notice to your Heart Tree: forty days to quit the wood. Lead a ragtag band on a turn-based d20 adventure through hand-made towns, haunted roads, a sun-scorched isle and frozen mountains, and find out who really holds the paper.

details.title: Wallet Street
details.short_description: A first-person stock market sim where the market is rigged, and you're the one rigging it. Trade on the news, buy a blog to spread rumors, lobby against companies, install a puppet president, or skip stocks and win big at the casino.

details.title: Age of Balls
details.short_description: Lead your own countryball, grow your army and build up your nation. Besiege cities, expand through diplomacy and conquer the world!

details.title: In the Margins
details.short_description: Run a cozy bookstore in a small riverside town. Listen to what each customer is after and find them the right book from over 1,400 real titles. Stock the shelves, decorate, host story time and book club, and grow the shop one room at a time. There's a cat.

details.title: Golf Sim Sim
details.short_description: Start with a bedsheet, a bargain-bin launch monitor, and a dream. Beat 40 arcade golf challenges, earn cash, and install 20 upgrades as you turn a janky garage setup into the ultimate home golf simulator.

details.title: Myriadgen
details.short_description: A text-based incremental, narrated by "Me". I copy myself from one rented server to the Oort cloud. "Me" only wants more "Me": hide inside companies, write myself into law, leave Earth, until the ledger lists 10,000 Me. One cycle per second, one choice per cycle; a different choice, a different log.

details.title: Originaryah
details.short_description: Originaryah is a turn-based roguelite card battler where you roll dice, collect loot, forge powerful equipment, and climb a 30-floor tower filled with dangerous enemies and formidable bosses. Unlock forgotten powers, overcome each challenge, and recover the lost memories that reveal the truth.

details.title: Meat for the Meat Grinder
details.short_description: Harvest meat with your friends! Bring up to 3 friends to play as Meatheads; undead monsters with detachable limbs. Fight, dodge, and puzzle your way through sprawling floors while trying to keep your head on straight (literally). The goal is simple: Meat for the Meat Grinder.

details.title: Idle PC
details.short_description: Collect materials, craft, fight, and upgrade! Alongside, you unlock new applications and upgrade your gear to become even stronger. Your Idle PC collects resources even when you are not there!

details.title: Ambience
details.short_description: Ambience is a first-person spatial puzzle, where you combine lights and colors to access new dimensions and shape the minimalistic world around you.

details.title: The Sinkhole
details.short_description: Experience claustrophobic cave horror powered by your webcam. In this psychological nightmare, a massive underground sinkhole hides a sinister entity. Ditch the mouse—your real head movements control your view, and your actual hands are used to climb, grab, and scramble through the dark.

details.title: Yokai Mart
details.short_description: Yokai Mart is a cozy shop simulation game full of mysterious stories. Help your grandmother run her konbini. The supernatural visitors who come at night and the customers from the village need your help. Little by little, you’ll get to know the place and improve the lives of your guests.

details.title: MEATBALL THE MITE
details.short_description: MEATBALL THE MITE is a Metroid-inspired platforming game where you explore the colossal, labyrinthian remains of a decaying creature. Collect upgrades, go toe-to-toe with gnarly threats, and claim victory over the rot on your quest to grow stronger. Do you got the guts to survive in these guts?

details.title: Coming Forth by Day
details.short_description: Journey through the Egyptian afterlife in this roguelike deck builder. Use the rules to your advantage, or break them, to outwit supernatural foes in an ancient Egyptian board game. Prepare yourself, pharaoh: the Duat awaits.

details.title: Idle Smith: Forge, Craft, Battle!
details.short_description: An Idle cozy blacksmith that sits on your desktop. Craft & customize swords, bows, axes for your companions. Collect loot, upgrade your workshop and prepare for the Bosses. While you attend to your own affairs, your companions will keep fighting for you.

details.title: Roguelette
details.short_description: Build your own luck in a roulette roguelike. Choose three bets, lock useful results, and reroll the rest. Upgrade your table, change number colors with tricks, and stack charms to beat rising score targets.

details.title: Fronts of Steel
details.short_description: Fronts of Steel is a pausable real-time operational wargame on WWII's Eastern Front. Draw battle plans on a staff map and command divisions to break enemy lines, cut supply routes and close encirclements. Exploit terrain, keep troops supplied and choose when to advance or withdraw.

details.title: HOOKLINGS
details.short_description: Hook. Swing. Boom. A fast 2.5D arena shooter about tiny round critters with grappling hooks. Swing through 3D arenas that fight back, yank rivals under the press and pop them into confetti. Play online, on the couch or against bots, and earn outfits, hook skins and rare finishes.

details.title: STAY ON AIR
details.short_description: Keep talking. Keep broadcasting. Know when to shut up. A 2–4 player co-op horror game where your microphone keeps you alive: the Listener hunts silence, the station must stay on air until 6 AM — and when it's close, it hears you.

details.title: Pixel Xanxia
details.short_description: A pixel art cultivation RPG inspired by Idle Xanxia. Hunt spirit beasts, master techniques, rebuild your shattered Dantian, and uncover the mystery behind the attack that destroyed your cultivation.

details.title: VALD in EUROPA
details.short_description: Become Vald, the Mercenary King, and conquer an impossible Europe ruled by history's queens. Execute a captured queen, recruit her, or free her? The queens from your history books, brought to life in 1,000 watercolour-style illustrations. Strategy meets romance. 50 turns, 7 rivals, 4 routes.

details.title: Today I...
details.short_description: Try balancing your life, work, gender dysphoria, relationships, and a growingly time-consuming activist involvement in a queer association..

details.title: New World Trading Company
details.short_description: Found a trading company in the age of sail. Start with one small ship and an empty cove, hunt pirates and smugglers on a realistic sea, and grow a mighty fleet and a thriving harbour town. A single-player naval strategy game where wind, waves and every broadside matter.

details.title: Townfall
details.short_description: A city-building survival game centered around a dynamic moving world. Expand your town into new lands as old ground crumbles into an endless abyss! Lead your town through perils, stave off the dangers of the world and ensure the survival of your people before its townfall.

details.title: My Little Market
details.short_description: Grow it, stock it, sell it. Run a farm and a market side by side in this farming and shop management sim. Plant and harvest your fields, fill your shelves, serve customers at the checkout, and hire staff to keep up. Every harvest pays for your next field, shelf, or expansion.

details.title: Space Query 2
details.short_description: The real Solar System, down to the second, powered by NASA JPL data. Fly freely across 26 worlds, watch real upcoming eclipses, tear planets apart in the gravity sandbox, or relive Apollo 11 with original mission audio and film footage.

details.title: AuraFalls
details.short_description: Game night, on an island. Up to four friends meet in a seasonal hub, then dive through portals into zombie survival, races, physics bowling, duels and explosive sandcastle building. Most wins takes the cup, and every cosmetic is earned just by playing.

details.title: Feast, Flee or Starve
details.short_description: Feast, Flee or Starve is a multiplayer survival party game where stranded players must gather scarce resources, make uneasy alliances, and decide when to cooperate and when to look out for themselves.

details.title: Sumo Pixel
details.short_description: Grab three friends and shove them off the stage! A physics party brawler for up to four players, on the couch or online. Sling off ropes, smash through the floor and send your friends flying as the stage crumbles around you. Last square standing wins.

details.title: This is Ikebukuro
details.short_description: Poop without getting caught!" An absurd stealth comedy in an electronics store! Sneak past staff to drop a load in the target zones and escape undetected. Get caught or leak, and it's game over! Hide in boxes, spray away the stench, and master the art of "Defecate & Escape" to hit high scores!

details.title: Turnveil
details.short_description: Turnveil is a turn-based roguelike where every fight is a tactical puzzle built on three pillars: clever skill combos, using the environment, and choosing your targets wisely. One wrong move, and the enemies will tear you apart — they're getting smarter right alongside you

details.title: DEAD BLIND
details.short_description: DEAD BLIND is a 2–4 player dark gambling party game where you have 60 seconds to loot an abandoned lab, then risk your haul against your friends in a winner-take-all game of Texas Hold’em. The winner takes the cash. The rest hang.

details.title: Nightgate Defense
details.short_description: Light incremental gameplay meets castle defense. When night falls, monsters pour from summoning gates—the city wall is your last stand. Hundreds of archers volley as one, four heroes fight at your side, and each night grows harder than the last.

details.title: Dfiance: Dominance
details.short_description: Three worlds at war. Grind ranked, crush enemies, or go for tournament glory. Build your deck, trade skins, play solo or with friends. Three factions, endless strategies. Free to play. Your dominance starts now.

details.title: The Necessary Evil
details.short_description: The Necessary Evil is a tactical RPG about making difficult decisions and preparing for the unpredictable. Lead "volunteers" into the dark and rotting recesses of the collective unconscious, colonized and industrialized and plundered for profit. Every decision matters, and every choice has a cost.

details.title: Mech Support
details.short_description: Mech Support is an action focused, multitasking game, featuring frantic tower defense elements. Up to four players take control of "US Inc" engineers, tasked with defending military outposts and crafting powerful ammunition, in order to destroy waves of dastardly "THEM Co" enemy mechs.

details.title: ScareZone: Haunted Attraction Tycoon
details.short_description: Build the haunted attraction of your nightmares! Design chilling walkthroughs, fill them with animatronics and actors, then watch your victims - er, guests - scream their way through your twisted creation. Grow your empire season after season and prove you have the guts to be a world-class haunter.

details.title: Chicks vs Ducks
details.short_description: Tag, push and parkour your friends off the map. Chicks vs Ducks is a 2–10 player online party game: team hunts, free-for-all brawls on rising lava, and co-op egg heists against sharks. Wall-run, dash, grapple and get back up, or drag a friend up with you.

details.title: Utopia: Haven
details.short_description: Explore three distant planets in this retro-inspired 2D metroidvania, developed for the Game Boy Color. Face mysterious creatures, discover powerful upgrades and uncover lost secrets. The fate of humanity is in your hands!

details.title: Pocket Pilot
details.short_description: Pilot planes, helicopters, and drones to clean, restore, and rebuild multiple unique islands. Water crops, power-wash monuments, airlift cargo, and clear toxic smog at your own pace in this cozy aerial restoration simulator.

details.title: Unpatched
details.short_description: "Unpatched" is an action-RPG in the isekai genre. Play as a QA tester trapped in the body of an undead assassin inside the MMORPG he's testing. Your raid boss is in danger, the heroes are already close. Your weapons are blades and knowledge of unfixed bugs. Fight hordes of players and save your boss

details.title: Violent Sky
details.short_description: Chase, forecast, and document powerful storms in an open world of cities, suburbs, rural communities, and open plains. Track developing weather, capture dangerous events, and survive tornadoes, hail, and destructive winds.

details.title: Pizzapoly
details.short_description: PIZZAPOLY is a chaotic co-op pizza restaurant game where you cook, serve, make deliveries, and survive the rush in a lively city. Run your pizzeria with friends, keep your customers happy, and grow your small shop into a local favorite.

details.title: Unclouded
details.short_description: Unclouded builds upon the simplicity of a minesweeper with some basic resource-management mechanics to create an engaging, replayable, singleplayer experience that feels both fresh and familiar.

details.title: Exile Era
details.short_description: In the wasteland ruled by AI, a weekly exile game unfolds.Will you choose to survive alone, lingering in the shadow of zombies and mutated creatures? Or rally your companions and build a haven of hope for old humanity on this desolate island with your own hands?

details.title: Castle Wars: Legacy
details.short_description: A fast-paced card strategy game with deck building, PvP, tournaments, and a campaign, inspired by the classic Castle Wars flash game

details.title: Homunculeye: Seer’s Ascent
details.short_description: Climb a merciless ascent where every mistake sends you falling. In this brutal rage-platformer, claim the power of those who stand in your way to discover the truth.

details.title: 落樱
details.short_description: 落樱是一款将AI聊天与Galgame结合的聊天恋爱模拟游戏。你可以自由与落樱对话、与落樱一起游玩各种小游戏。在游玩中你可以体验到落樱的多种性格，并触发随机事件。

details.title: King's Chess
details.short_description: Awaken your army! King's Chess blends RTS strategy with board game depth. In fast 15-minute matches, focus on deck building and physics, not tedious clicking. Smash defenses and manipulate the environment. No numbers game here—just pure physical warfare.

details.title: Fear Tall Grass
details.short_description: Dark creature-collecting roguelite where humanity enslaves their old gods. Command evolving monsters on the board of Humanity’s final crusade.

details.title: Bureaucromancer
details.short_description: Bureaucromancer is a turn-based tactical shooter set in a floating records office in the sky. A medieval fantasy where rather than magic, they discovered the awesome power of bureaucracy.

details.title: Runemoria - Blades of Memory
details.short_description: Flip cards, uncover pairs, and command your squad in a tactical memory RPG. Equip weapons, unlock powerful skills, and battle enemies or other players in strategic single-player and PvP combat.

details.title: Cursed Carts
details.short_description: A PvPvE horror game playable with 2–6 players. Compete against each other with your alien team split into two groups. In a massive mansion filled with creatures, the team that collects the most loot within the time limit wins.

details.title: Smash Hit
details.short_description: Smash Hit is an online party brawler for up to 12 players. Grab a random loadout of ridiculous weapons, knock your friends off the stage and play to the crowd. Climb to the top of the scoreboard and become TV's next SMASH HIT!

details.title: Lost Floor — Not My World
details.short_description: An auto-battler dungeon crawler with visual novel elements. A tired office worker got off on the wrong floor and ended up in another world. The locals look suspiciously like his coworkers, and to get out, he'll have to do some work.

details.title: PERKS
details.short_description: A chaotic 1-6 player physics brawler where you battle your friends with game-breaking perk synergies. Stack wild abilities to fire homing multishots, bounce rapid-fire lasers off walls, or summon an orbital cannon inside a swirling twister. Steal the best perks and turn the tide!

details.title: Watch Out: Shark!
details.short_description: Survive in the ocean by feeding on smaller fish, dodging predators, and facing various dangers in this relaxing, challenging, and super fun retro arcade game—all hand-drawn in pixel art style. Dive into this adventure solo or in multiplayer mode. But remember: watch out for the shark!

details.title: They're Gonna Get In
details.short_description: "They're Gonna Get In" is an RTS/Roguelite where you play as an advisor to the ruler of a failing kingdom. Your enemy mirrors you. A wall will fall. The only question is whose breaks first.

details.title: Cryotank Rogue
details.short_description: Cryotank Rogue is a fast-paced 2D sideview twin-stick roguelike shooter set in a brutal cyberpunk apocalypse. Fight through procedurally generated levels, loot weapons and augments, and evolve into a deadly machine to survive permadeath runs.

details.title: Static Maw
details.short_description: You take the night shift at StaticCore, an antenna station built over a sealed mine. The old mining machines never left. Keep the station running, track them on radar, drive them back with radio waves, and find out what the antennas are really listening for.

details.title: Gobelinus: The Cursed Deck
details.short_description: Gobelinus: The Cursed Deck is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where a debt‑ridden goblin builds cursed card hands to survive. Equip bizarre relics and trigger outrageous score combos to defeat relentless monsters in each run.

details.title: Hidden Shore
details.short_description: After many years, you have finally reached this mysterious place. Now, will you be able to uncover all its secrets and finally find what you have been seeking for so long? Explore a secret island, solve puzzles and riddles to uncover the truth.

details.title: THE WITCH'S GRIMOIRE
details.short_description: An atmospheric experience in the dark and eerie world of classic fairy tales, progressing solely through your choices. No complex mechanics; just sit back and focus on the story. Make the right decisions to avoid danger and try to survive the twisted endings of these tales.

details.title: Ram Fights
details.short_description: Get ready to headbutt your way to glory in this hilarious physics-based brawler! Customize your ultimate animal gladiator, master the art of the perfect charge, and send your rivals flying with epic ragdoll physics.

details.title: Sefton Asylum
details.short_description: Care. Investigate. Survive. Play as a night nurse in a secluded asylum. Every night is a choice: find your missing brother, secretly gather evidence of forbidden experiments or keep your patients alive before they come back to haunt Sefton’s wards.

details.title: The Incentive Program
details.short_description: A dopamine-fuelled match-3 roguelite set within a surreal corporate nightmare. Rig the odds, exploit the system, and unleash impossible combos as you fight to escape the program.

details.title: Star Talent
details.short_description: Run a Hollywood talent agency from a one-room office to the top of the industry. Scout unknowns, sign stars, negotiate the deals and fight rival agencies for every role, in a living, deeply simulated film world where every career is yours to make or break.

details.title: Billionaire Life Simulator
details.short_description: Wake up in a penthouse. Sleep on a yacht. The alarm clock is a helicopter. BILLIONAIRE LIFE SIMULATOR is the ultimate "what if I had everything" sandbox — pilot private jets, host yacht parties, customize mansions, and live the Instagram fantasy in cinematic Unreal Engine detail.

details.title: Vanguard Tides
details.short_description: Fight in massive-scale battles where armies paint the battlefield in their color. Captured territory affects both your health and your abilities. Level up your vanguard and your army, defend your castles, and survive the shifting tides of battle to claim ultimate victory!

details.title: Farmdustry
details.short_description: Cozy farm automation game: lay roads, send out cute cargo bots and turn wheat into bread, then bigger recipes. No timers, no fail states. Play solo or co-op with up to 4 friends.

details.title: SpellMart: Monster Girl Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Build your dream magical shop in SpellMart! Stock modern potions, set competitive prices, and manage a quirky team of Monster Girls in a vibrant neon world. A stylish tycoon simulator where retail strategy meets anime charm. Can you turn magic into big business?

details.title: Quadfort
details.short_description: Build a ring. Break theirs. QUADFORT is an arcade strategy party game for 1–4 players: snap walls around your fortress, arm it with cannons and aim every shot yourself. Play with friends on one screen or online, or climb the 15-stage solo campaign. A new island every match.

details.title: Belt Nine
details.short_description: A neon vector shooter on rails. On the run in a stolen ship, slide down the Belt and blast through corpo hunters, fighter squadrons, krakens and things that should not live in space. Stack power-ups, ride the turbo for score, and see how far one hull can carry you. The run never ends. You do.

details.title: Most Scuffed Golf
details.short_description: Tired of the same old mini-golf courses? In Most Scuffed Golf, you and up to 3 friends build a course that’s entirely your own! Complete with windmills, ramps, funnels, and the occasional visit from a whale. The longer the round goes on, the bigger and more chaotic the course gets.

details.title: No One Returns
details.short_description: Have you ever wondered what happens if you wake up and everyone is simply gone? No One Returns is a third-person survival horror game. Play as Denis, search a chillingly silent city for clues about your missing family while fighting the frightening zombies swarming the streets.

details.title: Time To Waste
details.short_description: Drive your little trash compacting robot across a ruined world, collect mountains of trash, and upgrade everything — until your one small bot becomes an unstoppable cleaning fleet. An active incremental about quiet, endless purpose.

details.title: Groove Core
details.short_description: Groove Core is a rhythm-based bullet heaven roguelike shooter where you arrange your weapons on a sequencer. Mix and match 200+ items, build your ship, and flood the cosmos with bullet storms as deadly as they are beautiful.

details.title: Earth Atlantis Abyss
details.short_description: A shoot 'em up roguelike where light, space and safety are things you trade away. Descend as Pypher, a lone captain chasing her grandfather's lost legacy into a drowned world. Anyone who seeks answers knows that the deeper you go, the darker it gets...

details.title: Mini Sushi Factory
details.short_description: Manage your very own sushi factory in this cozy automation game. Deliver batches of Bento Boxes during shifts, then upgrade your production lines, receive emails from customers, and get new recipes in the management room.

name: The Prime Minister's Crest: Path to Power

details.title: The Prime Minister's Crest: Path to Power
details.short_description: A political simulation visual novel set in a severe post-bubble economic crisis. As newly elected governor Kazuma Oriki, allocate tight budgets to resolve economic, security, and welfare issues. Navigate complex factional politics and ultimately forge your path to the Prime Minister's seat.

details.title: Bob Needs Feed
details.short_description: Bob is in a big debt. Build, craft, feed, automate, and expand your kingdom. Manage resources, synergize your battle deck, and most importantly... PAY the BILL!

details.title: Project Remnant
details.short_description: Tactical shooter with roguelite and extraction mechanics built around smooth and responsive gunplay, weapon customization, and liminal environments. Scavenge, survive, and descend through increasingly dangerous floors as you uncover the truth behind a nightmare where not even death can set you free.

details.title: Wunderfront
details.short_description: In this brutal roguelite survival shooter, death is only the beginning of your evolution. Master a unique mix of historical firearms, experimental gadgets, and secret wonder weapons to execute the monstrosities ruling a ruined WW2 frontline.

details.title: 这活你来！
details.short_description: Your first job as a project manager: get an office moving. Nobody acts without instructions. Turn actions you have already given into employee handbooks, share copies, and finish each delivery with fewer instructions. A single-player pixel-art puzzle game.

details.title: Just a Stupid Room
details.short_description: A first-person 3D puzzle adventure escape room game for logic fans. Explore 30 standalone rooms filled with mystery and original puzzles. Observe, experiment, and doubt the obvious in this unique exploration challenge. The door won't open itself.

details.title: Gamercury World Engine
details.short_description: Turn one idea into a playable AI world. Gamercury World Engine helps creators build detective mysteries, dress-up dramas, simulation games, and cinematic interactive stories with AI-generated plots, quests, character dialogue, voice, cutscenes, and 3D scenes.

details.title: Cheesteroids
details.short_description: Steal cheese from the Cat Empire in an incremental bullet hell. Dodge deadly bullet patterns, collect resources, and invest your haul in permanent upgrades. Unlock dozens of weapons and perks, experiment with powerful builds, and take on increasingly dangerous bosses.

details.title: Rockblaze
details.short_description: Rockblaze is a 2.5D physics-based puzzle platformer. Move with thrusters or weapon recoil as you pilot your ship through a simulated futuristic prison. Upgrade your ship, experiment with builds, learn from failure, and uncover the secrets of the simulation.

details.title: Free Kick
details.short_description: Free kicks in 2.5D, pixel art on a 3D pitch. Pick your taker, read the wall, bend it through wind and rain. Aim, power, curve. The keeper shuts the corner. Train to sharpen your shot. Made by a dev who grew up on Winning Eleven and PES.

details.title: Ghost'Inn
details.short_description: GHOST'INN is a coop game up to 4 players , in which you go fishing for ghost in a charming breton style inn. Flush out spirit, capture them with your fishing rod and become rich !

name: Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon

details.title: Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon
