details.short_description: A survivors-like roguelite action RPG where you master the power to grow giant or shrink tiny. Build your character by collecting weapons and companions, then challenge colossal legendary monsters. Supports 2-player local co-op.

details.title: Virtus Arenae
details.short_description: Choose your tribe and step into the arena. Angels, demons, specters or sylvan folk: your creatures come to life on a 5×5 board. Move them, wield your magic to reshape the battlefield and break through enemy lines to crush your opponent.

details.title: Saving San Martino
details.short_description: A stealth adventure where you spray graffiti to reclaim Sicily from the mafia. Pick locks, tag turf, and build your base on the Mediterranean coast.

details.title: Plasma Sky
details.short_description: This week, every pilot on Earth flies the same new seeded run: identical enemies, identical drops, pure skill. Flow through alien formations, arm your wingmen, and power up when you can. Out-score your friends in Plasma Sky, an arcade shmup with over 100 handcrafted levels. Blast into the neon sky!

details.title: Astral Bounty
details.short_description: Astral Bounty is a demanding 2D arcade side-scroller straight out of the ’90s. Blast through hand-built enemy waves, hunt four bounties, earn credits and blow them on beefy upgrades in the shop. You’re going to need them. 3 difficulty levels, 4 ships, mercy optional.

details.title: Roma Eterna Sons of Mars
details.short_description: Gather your legions, build defenses, and conquer territory for ROME! Explore a doomed world, research new technologies, and uncover the legacy of Mars. "Roma Eterna: Sons of Mars" is a strategy and tower defense game. ROME WILL NEVER FALL!

details.title: WerkstattManager – Uncle Karl's Legacy
details.short_description: Take over Uncle Karl's run-down backstreet garage. Investigate symptoms, spend precious time on tests—or trust your hunch—then prepare a quote, repair the car, and rebuild your reputation in this warm, nostalgic management game.

details.title: Third Surveillance Bureau
details.short_description: Watch the monitors, spot anomalies, and protect citizens in the dead of night. The Third Surveillance Bureau is a 2D horror game centered on surveillance. Cycle through camera feeds, report irregularities in time, and uncover a reality far more terrifying than monsters.

details.title: Fifth Tier
details.short_description: Fast, readable football management. You don't just pick the XI — you own the club. Take a small side from the fourth tier of a five-tier pyramid towards the top: tactics, wages, stands, academy, shares. Then sell up and buy a bigger club. A whole season can be played in an evening.

details.title: Space Industry
details.short_description: Build and automate your own modular space fleet in this sandbox base-building game. Mine asteroids, expand your ship, fight enemies, explore new star systems, and uncover the deepest secrets of the universe.

details.title: Porcelain
details.short_description: Porcelain is a first-person stealth extraction game set in a dark steampunk city. Infiltrate guarded districts, stay hidden, recover mysterious Reveries, and escape before you are caught. No guns. No easy way out.

details.title: Mombasa Conspiracy
details.short_description: Join Connor O'Ryan and his inseparable friend Brian Moloney in a classic Point & Click thriller that will take them from the gloomy streets of Dublin to the sweltering heat of Kenya, where they will become embroiled in a conspiracy hidden in time.

details.title: SOULLOOP
details.short_description: A steampunk roguelite FPS with deckbuilding. Draft a card after every floor: your revolver chains lightning, your saw thrower freezes enemies. Combine powerful builds, bank your souls when you die, and spend them to make your next descent stronger. Free demo out now.

name: Lomiya: Do LLMs Dream of Modern Poetry?

details.title: Lomiya: Do LLMs Dream of Modern Poetry?
details.short_description: A near-future visual novel — No androids. No cyberware. Only an LLM girl, the world, and you.

details.title: HALFLIGHT
details.short_description: A survival horror roguelite about a house that erases itself behind you. Learn to read doors, solve puzzles, and survive things you cannot fight. Every step is permanent, there is no way back. Find the way out.

details.title: Mereni
details.short_description: A casual Hexcells-like puzzle game where you reveal hidden drawings among the stars.

details.title: Not Monsters
details.short_description: A medieval themed party game for 4-15 players where social deduction becomes ragdoll combat and monsters hide in plain sight.

details.title: IVORY
details.short_description: IVORY is a story-rich, cold weather survival game with cosmic-horror elements. Enjoy the twists and turns of its gripping, dark narrative and rich lore as you explore two open-world locations dripping with psychological terror. Play as a man driven toward his grim fate by cowardice and greed.

details.title: Idle Dig
details.short_description: Idle Dig is an idle mining game that sits on your desktop and plays on its own. Collect 125 unique gems and items, unlock 15 skins, complete quests, and uncover the mystery at the heart of the planet.

details.title: Family Gambling
details.short_description: A first-person narrative resource management game where you gamble with your son's organs to survive. Pay your debts, manage your home, and decide how much of your family you're willing to sacrifice.

details.title: DigiDuels
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder card game that will make you remember the classic TCGs: learn the game across a classroom desk, then ride the metro into a branching run of rivals, shops, and big choices.

details.title: Expedition Bonk
details.short_description: A short turn-based RPG where three F-tier heroines set out to defeat the Goblin King. Time your attacks and blocks, make every skill count, and power up your party through a shared incremental skill tree. Built to be beaten in about 4 hours.

details.title: Ruler of Empires
details.short_description: Command a nation through the age of steel and empire. Ruler of Empires is a turn-based grand strategy game. Seize a nation, rewrite the century, and conquer province by province across lands. Save an empire doomed to fall, or bring the whole world under a single flag.

details.title: TEKUTEKU: Discovery Notebook
details.short_description: From a corner of your screen, TEKUTEKU wanders Tokyo, finding small sparkling things for its notebook. Pack its lunchbox and the journey shifts. It scribbles along as you type, and may leave a letter if you stay a while. A hand-drawn, cozy desktop game of discovery and collection.

details.title: Gökbörü
details.short_description: Draw a line, close the loop, crush every demon caught inside. A 3D arcade action roguelite born from Turkic mythology — every open line is a gamble. Power up with divine Boons, face 10 mythic bosses and chase the high score.

details.title: Hedra
details.short_description: A scientific blunder tears open a portal, and the Hedra pour through. Build a shifting collider from six tile shapes, grow monster dice, complete patterns, battle rival Overlords, and devour physicists in this solo digital board game.

details.title: Fleeting Requests: Freya and Ray
details.short_description: Caught using magic to steal a game, Raymond Wong En is spared from arrest and recruited by Cheng Li Fang Freya into the Spell Casting Crusaders. Engage in a point and click, character driven narrative using magic to fulfill requests, each revealing deeper layers of the group’s story.

details.title: NAND²
details.short_description: Build a computer from a single NAND gate, together: online co-op for up to 4 players on one board. Wire relays into logic, memory and a 16-bit CPU with a pipeline and a cache, then program it. Robots in mazes, Nim, even a shooter on your own CPU. Level editor and Steam Workshop.

details.title: OneThought
details.short_description: One thought to ascend, one thought to fall. A cultivation roguelike deckbuilder where six disciplines light up like auto-battler synergies: stack 3/6/10/15 cards of one school and become what you build. Join a sect, collect the lore, survive the Tribulation, then reincarnate and run again.

details.title: CoreVore
details.short_description: CoreVore is a first-person voxel mining sandbox. Explore a persistent atlas of destructible planets, scan for rare ore, shape tunnels, deploy machines, and evacuate your cargo before instability turns your route into a trap. Return later—the planet remembers what you changed.

details.title: Wirehawk
details.short_description: Wirehawk is a neon vector shmup in the spirit of 80s arcade classics. Play it your way: razor-sharp mouse control, or a dedicated controller mode rebalanced for the stick. Blast asteroids and alien waves, dodge bullet storms, slow time with stasis. Autofire always on.

details.title: Sunset Painter
details.short_description: Have you ever wanted to spray an entire can of whipped cream into the sky and watch the sun's golden rays dance through your masterpiece as day melts into dusk? Craft the perfect sky - spray, sculpt, and swirl volumetric clouds with delightfully tactile tools. No pressure, just you and the sky.

details.title: Hop Slasher
details.short_description: A fast-paced arcade battler where you slice your enemies from any angle. Once you start moving your momentum never stops, use quick reflexes to dodge attacks and perform trick shots to score more points! Slash through waves of unique enemies and bosses!

details.title: BumpFlip
details.short_description: Choose and place bumpers to build your perfect pinball setup. Hit the target score before the 90-second timer runs out.

details.title: L'Eternel Retour, Death Gamble
details.short_description: A bullet heaven roguelite. Caught in a loop of death and return, hold back a surging horde, draft a build, and find a way to save what's left of civilization. Die, come back, unlock new items and weapons. Solo or online co-op.

details.title: Melodan
details.short_description: Command mythical legions to victory in a fantasy auto-battler where every placement matters. Draft your troops, unlock magical upgrades, set your formations, and let the battle begin. Pure strategy, no clickfest. Prove your brilliance in 1v1 and 2v2 matches, or survive the escalating Co-op Horde.

details.title: Touge: JDM Dealership Simulator
details.short_description: An economic simulator set in an alternative Japan. See a car that everyone has written off, read it with your bare eye, haggle with a salesman who remembers every deal, and grow from a single parking space to a corporation to keep it when the country runs out of money in 1990.

details.title: Pongcremental
details.short_description: Pongcremental is an incremental game where you play as the ball of Pong. Eliminate enemies, get stronger, unlock game changing abilities. Hit, destroy, earn, get good. And repeat.

details.title: Kingdom TD: Draft Your Demise
details.short_description: Choose the enemies. Risk a deadlier wave for more gold. Build winding defenses, upgrade your towers, and ride between them to boost their power. How much danger will you draft to defend your campfire?

details.title: Rolling Free
details.short_description: A grapple-physics 3D platformer. You're a hamster tired of the wheel—so you flee upward, from cage to an antenna that leads to the moon. Swing, accelerate, nail your landings; when you fall, start over. The higher you climb, the heavier it gets. A narrator whispers: giving up is fine, too.

details.title: Elandrake
details.short_description: Consume matter and unlock new abilities as you defend a cosmic entity from relentless waves of fleets while she emerges from another reality in this incremental twin-stick shooter.

name: GRUBSTAKE: A Post Apocalyptic Pawn Shop

details.title: GRUBSTAKE: A Post Apocalyptic Pawn Shop
details.short_description: GRUBSTAKE is a single-player, first-person, post-apocalyptic pawn shop sim. Run a barter shop in the wasteland... if you can out-haggle the survivors at your counter. No money. No price tags. Trade, craft, restock, repeat. Be on the caravan by day 30.

details.title: Asteroid Rodeo
details.short_description: Asteroids are worth trillions. They're also spinning at 200 meters per second. You are a Wrangler—harpoon tumbling rocks, wrestle them to a dead stop with your custom-built ship, and mine them for credits. The pay is good. The survival rate is a conversation people avoid.

details.title: MEATBALLS GARDEN
details.short_description: Meatballs Farm is a fast-paced first-person farming game. Farm, fish, and gather by day. Monsters come at night. You have only 30 days to pay your debt to the King. Miss the payment, and you’re dead.

details.title: Mental Break
details.short_description: Manage our AI girlfriend product as the newest engagement lead at Bigger Tech Corp. Make the tough choices for Alice as she slowly drives her user insane. A satirical choose-your-own-adventure with beautiful pixel art and widely branching narrative.

details.title: The Trial of Progress
details.short_description: A fast-paced city-building experience inspired by the concept of civilization. As you advance your technologies and attract some of the greatest historical figures, you will face the trial of progress and strive to create a lasting legacy.

details.title: Monkeys Don't Fear Hell
details.short_description: A cozy farming and building sim by day, a demon-slaying gauntlet by night - grow crops, raise a town and then descend to battle waves of demons and towering bosses. DOOM & Vampire Survivors meets Stardew Valley.

details.title: Minutes to Meltdown
details.short_description: Everything breaks on your 6 minute shift in this 1960s nuclear power plant. You and up to 3 colleagues keep the power flowing, the town lit, and the reactor from melting down. Push for one more shift, or clock out while you're ahead?

details.title: Grass
details.short_description: Turn overgrown yards into freshly cut lawns in this cozy lawn care simulator. Play solo or team up with friends to mow, trim, water, and clear debris. Finish jobs, earn rewards, and build your reputation one satisfying transformation at a time.

details.title: Fruit Auto Fighters
details.short_description: A fruit-themed async PvP auto battler. Pick a gardener, choose your fruits, and grow a team that can take down other players before your fruit starts rotting. Play at your own pace, try new team combos, and pair fertilizer effects with weapons to find synergies that break the game.

details.title: Fruit Slicer
details.short_description: Slice fruit with precision - using your mouse or real hand! Dodge bombs, master combos, and push your reflexes to the limit in this fast-paced arcade slicer.

details.title: Reverie Eclipse
details.short_description: You are the president of the student council at a high school. Six lovely girls are ready to help you! Spending time with them... is it as easy as it seems?

details.title: MonsTile
details.short_description: A groundbreaking roguelike deck-building defense game on an 8x8 board! Strategically place monsters and trigger synergies to fend off adventurers. Having fled across dimensions from an unbeatable hero, you arrive in worlds of fantasy, apocalypse, wuxia, and cyberpunk to battle their heroes.

details.title: Be Positive!
details.short_description: Move Mr Positve around the arena by converting the cubes around him to reach his goal, Ms. Negative. Play on desktop or in VR.

details.title: Your Maid
details.short_description: A desktop companion simulation featuring a charming 3D character living on your screen. Drag, rotate, and pose your companion. Collect poses across rarity tiers, unlock costumes, play 7 mini-games, and set alarms while your fantasy friend keeps you company throughout your workday.

details.title: Stellar Frontline
details.short_description: A unique tower defense game where you build and upgrade defenses by placing hex tiles. Protect your rocket from hostile spaceships to unlock new tiles after each defeated wave.

details.title: Slay the Slime
details.short_description: An incremental game where you slay thousands of slimes in an epic power fantasy. Stack upgrades, master unique classes, equip powerful relics and defeat mighty bosses on your way from rookie to the guild's top adventurer.

details.title: Gee, Tea, Eh, Seven?
details.short_description: In a single night, your family's boba tea empire AND family were taken out by rivals. Take revenge as Seven, the tragic sole survivor. Build up your power base by brewing the best drinks and retaking the town... or, you know, by *fixing* the competition through sabotage, subterfuge and violence.

details.title: Chrono Vanguard: Primal Survival - Dinosaur
details.short_description: Cut through relentless dinosaur hordes, unlock powerful heroines, and survive long enough to become unstoppable.

details.title: Lacustris - The War over Water
details.short_description: An innovative, realistic point-and-click game where you step into the shoes of a mysterious character in search of his identity and a shocking truth. Puzzles to solve, complex dialogue, and realistic graphics are the focus of this engaging game.

details.title: Asa's Ascended
details.short_description: Dodge through custom battles made by the community through the editor! Enjoy multiplayer, leaderboards, unique abilities, and a campaign!

details.title: Runeline
details.short_description: Design, build, and code a factory within the magical world of Runeline! Work on producing increasingly complex products, which will require you to write not just functional but optimized code, all within the simple instructions of the machine core.

details.title: Party Time Bowling
details.short_description: Strike up the neon-soaked fun in this competitive party sports game for up to 8 players. Bowl, roll, and battle it out in Air Hockey, unlock 100+ ball skins and custom pins with Alley Bucks, and keep the good times rolling.

details.title: Killware: Under Review
details.short_description: Adrenaline-fuelling, gory, arcade-style roguelite shooter where survival is mandatory. Outlast escalating waves, grow stronger with each run, and defy the Content Compliance Police in a dystopian future that’s watching your every move.

details.title: Thieves Guild Master
details.short_description: Run a thieves’ guild in Arathia, a medieval fantasy city of scheming nobles, hardworking people and rival gangs. Recruit thieves, take risky contracts, and expand your shadow empire in this turn-based guild management strategy game.

details.title: Forgefolk
details.short_description: Forge weapons and tools by hand, repair what others have broken, and uncover the stories buried in old steel. In Forgefolk, every scar means something — and what you find may force an old master smith to face the one thing he never managed to fix: his past.

details.title: Abyss Chamber
details.short_description: Maintain an underground research facility full of abyss entities. Fulfill their needs and survive long enough to solve all of the mysteries. Abyss Chamber is a lore-rich, first-person psychological Horror game.

details.title: Bumpers & Dragons
details.short_description: Drop balls. Slay dragons. Bumpers & Dragons is a pachinko roguelite where physics meets strategy. Engineer your luck, create wild combos, and crawl deeper into procedurally generated dungeons.

details.title: Dont Stop Walking
details.short_description: A co-op survival extraction game for 1 to 6 players. A purple storm is coming down the canyon and it never stops. Walk, scavenge, craft from grass to iron, fight what lives in five abandoned places, and get your haul home to your floating outpost before the storm takes it all.

details.title: Cafe Life Simulator
details.short_description: Manage your dream cafe, but don't stop there. In this comprehensive simulation, explore a living city! Drive cars, build relationships, work side jobs, and build your empire. From brewing coffee to becoming the most famous name in town—how will you live your cafe life?

details.title: Magic Moon
details.short_description: Welcome to Magic Moon, a cozy mystery life sim set on a peaceful island where the air is fresh, the waters sparkle, and the ground hums with forgotten magic. You play as Hana, a magical girl starting over on a remote island full of charm, curiosity, and just a little mystery.

details.title: Wilds of Lumithra
details.short_description: Explore the hand-crafted open-world of Wilds of Lumithra, where every cliff, chasm, and hidden path is yours to discover. Turn natural obstacles into shortcuts as you gather, craft, build, and fight your way to survival - solo or online with friends.

details.title: My Beautiful Aquarium
details.short_description: A fish tank that lives on your screen. Real species, and every fish is an individual you can name. In Cozy mode nothing can die, so you can leave it running all day. Challenge mode is proper fishkeeping: water types, breeding, sickness, mistakes. Play it, or just let it swim.

details.title: Steps To The Stars
details.short_description: A single player puzzle game following the journey of two stars as they climb to return to the constellation from which they have fallen.

details.title: B.O.D.E. (Beast Of Despair Exiled)
details.short_description: A crazy roguelite straight from Hell! B.O.D.E. (Beast Of Despair Exiled) is a wild 2D shooter with chaotic movement mechanics.

details.title: Destruction Brothers
details.short_description: A demolition game where every wall, plank and joint is accurately modeled. Enjoy four-player co-op sandbox chaos or progress through a solo career. An innovative, fully deterministic physics engine means when you knock out a building's supports, every brick lands in the same spot on every screen.

details.title: The Chains Of Yme
details.short_description: In this tactical roguelike you control five adventurers as you explore procedurally generated ruins to reach and conquer a Titan. Fight deadly monsters, utilize power-ups, and improvise while your knowledge of the world deepens. Persist when your adventurers are left behind, killed, or sacrificed.

details.title: Sprout's Meadow
details.short_description: Manage a team of adorable Sproutlings in this cozy farming adventure! Assign tasks, automate chores, and turn forgotten land into a lively home. Grow crops, raise animals, and craft goods, then take to the skies in your hot air balloon to trade. Watch your little farm come alive!

details.title: My Mom Says I’m Fine
details.short_description: A creepy survivors-like played on a child's tabletop. Fight swarms as a tiny toy while a giant Kid looms over the battle. Pick level-up cards, merge your powers and build a ridiculous arsenal. Mom says he's fine. You'll see.

details.title: Eatery At Ridge Station
details.short_description: A short, cozy, and heartful narrative experience with cooking elements. Play as Felix Cook, the elderly owner of an eatery, on his last week in town sponsoring the restoration of his favorite park. Cook up a new menu, say farewell to regular customers, and attend the grand reopening of Mabel’s Park.

details.title: A Trans-Siberian Tea
details.short_description: Snowbound for decades, a Trans-Siberian train holds its passengers exactly as they died. Talk to the frozen dead, uncover the identity of a legendary thief, and decide how far you're willing to go for the truth.

details.title: Eldritch Boyfriend
details.short_description: Eldritch Boyfriend is the only skill-based visual novel dating sim where your sanity—or lack thereof—turns the very act of choosing the right dialogue options into a series of challenging mini-games.

details.title: Amelia
details.short_description: In this first-person narrative experience, you step into the shoes of a young girl. Explore a rural farmhouse and witness everyday family life through her eyes. Across 13 consecutive days, you'll realize that your family is not what it seems. Will you notice what everyone else leaves unsaid?

details.title: Subsector Zero
details.short_description: A liminal space horror game inspired by the backrooms, with levels actually being infinitely long.

details.title: Minipia
details.short_description: Minipia is a cozy desktop idle game. Make a tiny island your own, right in the corner of your screen, while you work or relax. Decorate freely, collect cute animals, discover their stories, and unlock new islands.

details.title: GtFckd: Planet Survivors
details.short_description: Survive the horde on a tiny planet, alone or with up to 3 friends. Pick one of 8 ridiculous champions, stack spells that cast themselves, gamble on slot-machine chests, bargain with shrines, and slay the Rift Tyrant before the planet gets you first.

details.title: Rotten Batch: Bear Inspector
details.short_description: Inspect Fruit Patch Bears for defects, decide which category they belong to, and keep the line moving. Make sure you identify the cursed ones if you want to keep your job...and your life.

details.title: Blek and the Endless Keep
details.short_description: Guide Blek through the twisting grey halls of the Endless Keep as they work to get their memories back! Fight back the Keep's monstrous spawn, meet it's unique denizens, and make thorough use of the art of cat necromancy to find your way back home! The Keep can't truly be Endless, can it?

details.title: Puppet's Trial
details.short_description: Puppet's Trial is a horror game where you incarnate a Puppet. With decaying life and the desire to find a purpose, You will face multiple trials to try to prove your worth to your maker. And eventually meet him.

details.title: Sticky Rooms: A hopeful illusion
details.short_description: Furniture comes as stickers, so the order matters and mistakes can’t be undone. Clara has left the office to become an interior designer, with thirty jobs ahead of her and a home of her own to decorate at her pace. A new illusion to live in.

details.title: Just to Survive
details.short_description: A wasteland tactics game: explore a weathered desert, salvage what remains, and build a squad for precise, turn-based firefights.

details.title: NightGlow : Aquarium Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Light up a quiet, dimly lit shop with the glow of your aquariums. Raise and breed fish, discover new varieties, and build your own aquarium shop. Manage your tanks, sell fish, fulfill customer requests, decorate your space, and slowly grow your little shop in this cozy aquarium management sim.

details.title: Calorie Pinball
details.short_description: When can you lose weight with just a flick of a finger? Right now! Calorie Pinball turns your weight-loss plan into a pinball game. Will you bounce into a workout, a bizarre event, or that 2,000-calorie slice of cake? It all comes down to skill and luck!

details.title: Slavlands: Tribes at War
details.short_description: Build a Slavic stronghold from a few huts, feed your people and lead your warband across a great map of the early medieval Slavic lands. A 90s-style real-time strategy with a deep simulation, where wars are won with granaries, supply trains, weather and faith long before the first blow.

details.title: Skate N Chill
details.short_description: Build your own skatepark, find your line, and take it easy. Skate N Chill is a relaxed single-player skateboarding sandbox: shape bowls and rails, customize your crew, learn new tricks, or kick back and watch the park come to life.

details.title: Gridways
details.short_description: Traffic is your problem now. Draw roads, paint arrows, time the lights and stack overpasses so every vehicle reaches the right hub. Congestion costs you points - gridlock ends the round. Over 100 handmade puzzles, three difficulties, a level editor and Workshop support.

details.title: Dream Island Simulator
details.short_description: A desert-island survival sim played live by AI: every survivor is a large language model — they chat, dream, hold grudges, and get on with life while you're away. Start from firewood and thatch, and rebuild the knowledge the end of the world turned back into legend.

details.title: LUMENKEEP
details.short_description: A dark hex board. Shadow-crystal creatures march on your last lantern. Build no towers, build light. Aim emitters, bend beams with mirrors, and cross colors to unleash new effects. Every placement re-traces the whole board. A roguelite tower defense made of pure light.

details.title: Cyber Ninja: Tokyo Rumble
details.short_description: Cyber Ninja: Tokyo Rumble is a high-speed VR ninja action game set across multiple eras of Japan. Wield blades, unleash devastating energy techniques, and battle robotic armies in immersive arenas.

details.title: Pack Party
details.short_description: The drawing party game where you and your friends make a deck of absurd cards to answer ridiculous prompts. 4 to 10 players.

details.title: Grid Mage
details.short_description: A puzzle game about battling demons with magic. Figure out the rules behind enemy actions and exploit them with an expanding set of spells.

details.title: IT'S NOT A DEER
details.short_description: First-person horror game where mimicking creatures hide among ordinary wildlife. Study animal behavior and spot anomalies before you shoot. Sell meat and hides, upgrade your gear, and retreat to your cabin when you become the prey.

details.title: Airport Land: Air Traffic Control
details.short_description: An air traffic control game in the tower: sequence takeoffs and landings, call the go-around, and hear pilots answer in real ATC radio. Grow a one-runway island into a hub, then work Haneda, Heathrow, Kai Tak and Lukla by their real rules.

details.title: Plinko Squad
details.short_description: Drop balls down a plinko board to recruit your squad, arrange them on a hex grid, and send them auto-battling up a 25-floor tower. Stack augments into explosive synergies, but every unit that falls is gone for good.

details.title: Tidy Up Bukkos!
details.short_description: Hope you had fun making a mess by throwing all the Bukkos around because you're not going anywhere before putting everything back to its place! Tidy up this eccentric library and its puzzle shelves in this comedy oriented organizing game.

details.title: The Playtester
details.short_description: A first-person roguelite about being the aliens' playtester. Wake up in a cell, slot cartridges into a PC and survive their homemade minigames. Spend your pay on furniture that changes how the games play. Perform badly and you're eliminated. The next human wakes up in the room you furnished.

details.title: Sayara's Path
details.short_description: Join Sayara on a journey through the snow-covered Vad-Hidek to find a way to bring her brother back to the world of the living. Here everyone’s fate depends on the will of the Spirits, and the path to resurrection becomes a trial the result of which is unknown.

details.title: The Core: Protocol
details.short_description: A dark co-op horde shooter blending tower defense with trap building. Fight through a procedural maze whose biomes, cabins and weather are reshuffled every run. Survive the waves, collect permanent upgrades for the hub and discover what waits beyond the walls.

details.title: Shattersong
details.short_description: A story-driven tactical RPG in the spirit of the 16-bit classics. Raise a found-family army of 60 heroes, recover the lost Words that sang the world into being, and stand against the Hollow Cantor — a grieving priest unsaying the world one note at a time.

details.title: Flaparq: Home Cooking
details.short_description: Flaparq: Home Cooking is a heartwarming cooking simulator. Open up your childhood recipe book—where the dishes you create are not just a treat for the taste buds, but a journey down memory lane.

details.title: Adventurers Inc.
details.short_description: An incremental auto-battler where you build a party of adventurers and lead them through 10 dungeons. Start with one hero, recruit up to four from six classes and grow them through a big skill tree. Cast skills yourself or unlock Auto-Cast, then spend your loot at the tavern.

details.title: Typopus
details.short_description: As an Octochef, master your typing skills to manage and serve dishes in a conveyor belt restaurant. Type to cook, type to upgrade, type to automate in Typopus, an incremental cooking game. Satisfy customers, unlock new meals and optimize your restaurant.

details.title: CyberCon: Cybersecurity Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a cybersecurity firm in 1990. Recruit specialists, build an office, bid on tenders, and develop your own security products from floppy disks to AI through five eras of tech history up to 2039. Keep your staff happy and your record clean. Or don't.

details.title: Deep Trouble
details.short_description: Dive into Deep Trouble with a crew of up to 6 and your mostly trusty submarine, slipping past massive leviathans into the mysterious depths. Pilot, swim, and salvage together to reach the bottom before your oxygen runs out, a friend blows you up, or you become a tasty treat.

details.title: Refracted
details.short_description: Refracted: a 4-player co-op shooter where you build turrets and lead troops. Wield powers granted to you by a mysterious crystal against the clanker horde. Empower your hero, upgrade your army & defenses, and push through enemy lines to destroy the clanker base. Die. Refract. Push again.

details.title: Beatmaker Simulator
details.short_description: A music producer career simulator. Make beats, work with artists, grow your popularity, earn money, level up your skills, and build the studio of your dreams.

details.title: Ruins of Aloryith
details.short_description: Ruins of Aloryith is a third-person action roguelite. Fight through escalating waves with sword and shield, unleash player-controlled abilities, and shape your build with upgrades. Face corrupted bosses and uncover the source of the corruption.

details.title: The Rift Trader
details.short_description: Not good, How about half? Every deal at this counter is a conversation — with kings, inspectors, widows and street kids who all remember how you treated them. The rift brings the goods. You set the price.

details.title: V.E.L.O.
details.short_description: Abandoned by the living. Loved by the dead. Five idols return to the stage—but their new audience isn't alive. Become their sole producer, uncover supernatural mysteries, and lead their comeback in a story-driven visual novel and rhythm game.

details.title: Path Of Peecho
details.short_description: Fight the Pawtriarchy! The world has been dominated by the greediest cat the universe has ever known. Assemble your team of rebels, build their decks, customize their skill trees, and take Peecho down in this turn-based roguelite scramble to save humanity right meow.

details.title: Dungeon Contractor
details.short_description: Run a fantasy dungeon maintenance company. Hire monsters, deploy deadly traps, and prepare dungeons for the next wave of greedy heroes. Every contract is a new challenge where smart planning leads to bigger profits.

details.title: Rule By Roll
details.short_description: A tower defense game where you rank up towers, roll the dice to draw them, and pick perks as you level. Every choice compounds — stack talents, chain synergies, and build a defense that holds against hundreds of enemies across levels that only get harder.

details.title: Fallen Crowns
details.short_description: Gear up at the inn, then raid a fallen king's castle with up to eight other players. Monsters, rival parties and traps stand between you and its treasure. Grab what you can carry and reach a portal before the grave-rot rises. Fall, and whoever finds your body keeps your gear.

details.title: Dieabolic
details.short_description: A retro rogue-lite dice-builder. Roll your dice to fight. Upgrade your dice to get stronger. Battle through the 9 levels of Dante’s inferno

details.title: AI TYCOON
details.short_description: Found your AI company in the wildest gold rush of the century. Source quality training data, race to new architectures, and turn research into revenue. Balance burn rate against breakthroughs, outmaneuver rivals, and build a tech empire. A deep management sim.

details.title: YinShu
details.short_description: Played The Message? YinShu is a free online social deduction card game inspired by it, for 4–8 players. Everyone hides a faction and passes intel; read friend from foe in who accepts and who refuses. Intercept, see through and swap intel with character skills. Collect three of your color to win.

details.title: StrongGirls Tactics
details.short_description: Turn-based tactics RPG where your girls grow muscles as they get stronger. Recruit 18 girls, each with their personal stories and struggles. As your bonds deepen, they grow stronger and more muscular. Wrapped in a Norse themed world where you fight to reclaim the kingdom.

details.title: Under a Turning Sky
details.short_description: A calm, meditative celestial puzzle game where you rotate planets along orbit rings, align them, and guide a signal across the stars. Solve thoughtful, zen-like logic puzzles at your own pace, accompanied by a transporting, relaxing soundtrack.

details.title: Did a Monkey Write This?
details.short_description: A cozy incremental management game. You're a failed author with a troop of cute monkey writers. Level up and build, play the publishing slot machine, race around plot holes and ski the slopes of ever-changing trends.

details.title: Tombslayers
details.short_description: Carve through undead hordes in dark tombs. Clear waves, rebuild in the shop, and snowball into broken loadouts. A fast, dark roguelike survivor.

details.title: HASSO
details.short_description: A single-player samurai card game where you don't collect cards, you learn techniques. Each turn you build a chain of blades and decide when to stop; between duels you choose what you learn, which paths you prove and which katana you forge, until the style is yours.

details.title: Hallowed Empire
details.short_description: Hallowed Empire is a real-time strategy game of kingdoms, war, and corruption. Build your empire, upgrade your warriors, forge alliances with rival factions, and decide the fate of the undead. Will you destroy them, embrace them, or turn their power against your enemies?

details.title: Burnout Bistro
details.short_description: Run a restaurant, manage your stock, staff, recipe selection and more. Decide how much you want to sacrifice for your career, as not taking care of your personal needs will leave you completely burnt out. How long can you keep everything together?

details.title: YellowJacket
details.short_description: This is a 2D platformer adventure game set in a world that has lost its color, where you retrieve scattered jackets to color the world again. Discover the rules of color and begin your journey to restore the lost colors.

details.title: Whisker Tinkers
details.short_description: Dig through boxes filled with junk, organize them in your warehouse and fulfill client orders by crafting their desired items from your gathered materials. Protect your shiny treasures from sneaky raccoons and prepare your store for inspections. Don't forget to hide what you don't want to be seen...

details.title: Coindrop Dungeon
details.short_description: Coindrop Dungeon is a Pachinko inspired dungeon crawler. Your coins and pegs from the board are your inventory. Explore builds, create synergies and break the curse that keeps you in the ever changing dungeon.

details.title: Hendichen
details.short_description: Chaotic co-op cooking for 2 or 3 players, with real recipes and a real kitchen. THE CHEF knows every recipe but has one working hand. MUFFLES barely hears you. WOBBLES reads every order as a different dish. Talk to each other, or the kitchen burns.

details.title: Touhou: Marisa! Cook It!
details.short_description: Reimu praised Sakuya's cooking one time too many, so Marisa announced she would handle the next banquet herself. Build a deck of ingredients, pour it into her magic cauldron, and watch the collisions and danmaku chain out of control. A physics-based deckbuilding roguelike.

details.title: Anthill Wars: Ant Colony Sim
details.short_description: Grow an ant colony from a single queen into a thriving empire. Raid rival anthills, steal their brood, and strengthen your colony with captured ants. Defend your territory from giant insects and expand your nest. When the time comes, release a swarm of winged queens and begin again in distant lands.

details.title: Pupmancer
details.short_description: Pupmancer is a top-down 3D action roguelite where you fight through dangerous dungeons as a magic-wielding pup. Discover powerful spells, loot, craft potions, and build your pup’s abilities to survive each run. Adventure solo or team up online with friends to take on enemies or fight in PvP battles.

details.title: Genome Fracture
details.short_description: A fast-paced bullet heaven roguelite where reality fractures every 2 minutes. Evolve powerful mutation families, unleash devastating synergies, and create game-breaking builds as the battlefield transforms around you. Can you survive the Convergence?

details.title: Forgotten Grounds
details.short_description: Survive alone in a pixel-art wilderness where daylight can kill you. Scavenge abandoned shelters, craft essential tools, and face predators. Plan your expeditions around the sun and weather, because staying indoors won't keep you alive forever.

details.title: Machines vs Monsters
details.short_description: Machines vs Monsters is a roguelite tower defense in space. Build turrets to defeat the monsters that each wave sends at you, choose where the map grows next, and hold your Command Center. Supply drops deal rewards between waves. Every run makes the next one stronger, and each run is unique.

details.title: Meiji Oligarchy
details.short_description: Meiji Oligarchy is a historical simulation game that models the political, economic, and military systems of Meiji-era Japan. It spans the period from the assassination of Ōkubo Toshimichi through the Katsura–Saionji era (1878–1912).

details.title: OVC
details.short_description: A grid-based tower defense. Upgrade, specialize, and outfit your bases with advanced augmentations. Use weapons and research to survive the endless onslaught of enemies as they become stronger and more advanced with each level.

details.title: GridCraft
details.short_description: Shape an entire grid-based world with your mouse. Gather, craft, farm, cook, tame animals, automate production, and battle powerful bosses. Every item, machine, and creature is yours to pick up, place, and combine.

details.title: Rampartloom: PvP Tower Defense
details.short_description: Build a maze. Send an army. Win as a team. Rampartloom is a free-to-play 3v3 tower defense game where every attack grows your income. Draft a faction, defend your lane, and coordinate assaults to break the enemy team’s defenses. Play the free demo.

details.title: Magic Shop Chaos
details.short_description: A fun co-op organization simulator for 1-4 players. Team up as witches to bring order to a chaotic shop by sorting 6,000+ magical items back to their rightful places. Serve incoming customers, level up unique magical skills, and transform magical chaos into perfect order!

details.title: DOG LIVES: Space Pirates War
details.short_description: The year is 2083. As the galactic space pirate crisis reaches its breaking point, you—a "dog of the military"—must pilot a humanoid Powered Metal Frame (MF), subdue rival captains, unite them under your banner, and emerge victorious in the ultimate Pirate War!

details.title: Volleyball Sports Game
details.short_description: A sports game about Volleyball. Experience as a manager as you lead your team towards World Champion.

details.title: GyroMon: The Seekers
details.short_description: GyroMon: The Seekers is a turn-based monster-collecting RPG with a roguelite heart. Pick your starter, build your team, and push through branching maps full of trainers, events, quests, campfires, merchants, and zone bosses. Every run is different. Every team is yours.

name: Bahamut3-The Fall of the Dragon God's Child

details.title: Bahamut3-The Fall of the Dragon God's Child
details.short_description: Bahamut 3: Fall of the Dragon God's Child is a dark fantasy JRPG where every choice shapes the hero’s fate. Fight tactical battles using positioning, attack ranges, and Action Points, recruit companions tied to the Seven Deadly Sins, and manage weapons, hunger, time, and resources.

details.title: RuneEra
details.short_description: RuneEra is a fantasy colony-management RPG where you build a guild settlement, automate work and production, equip powerful runes and lead parties through a procedurally generated world of quests, factions, dangerous biomes and dungeons.

details.title: CivDle
details.short_description: A relaxing idle city-builder where a single hut grows into a sprawl of millions. Build production chains, let your civilisation expand while you're away, and Ascend to push the whole world up an order of magnitude.

details.title: The Pineapple Conspiracy
details.short_description: An impostor survival reality show for 4 to 10 players. Craft a raft in twenty minutes while impostors work against you in secret. Survive, betray, and find the Golden pineapple!

details.title: Harvesters
details.short_description: A short incremental management game where every harvester has a name and a story. Upgrade your favorites, your spaceship, buildings and explore different planets. Optimize your production to meet the Council's requirements. It's all about watching the lil people do their thing.

details.title: Dungeon's Gambit
details.short_description: Dungeon’s Gambit is a real-turn chess dungeon crawler that mixes real-time environments with turn-based combat. Customize your pawn, unlock new skills to find powerful synergies, defeat challenging bosses, and fight your way through the Black Castle to take down the Throne.

details.title: Planet INC
details.short_description: Planet-colonizing deckbuilder roguelike! Contract with galactic megacorps for blueprints, drop onto uncharted worlds, and extract maximum profit. Harvest resources from alien terrains and creatures, skyrocket planetary value, and flip the world to the highest bidder!

name: I Stole My Boss' Boy Toy

details.title: I Stole My Boss' Boy Toy
details.short_description: You find a terrified young man hiding in your apartment hallway. The twist? He just escaped from your sadistic boss. Desperate for college tuition, this brilliant art student was tricked by a shady agency. Now, hide him, protect him and plot your revenge. Your choices dictate his fate!

details.title: Color Factory
details.short_description: Connect nodes to generate, transform, and blend colors in a relaxing factory automation game. Discover new recipes, unlock powerful nodes through research, and design increasingly efficient production networks as your color factory grows.

details.title: TOWN of HIDDEN MURDERS
details.short_description: The tranquility of Peaceville was shattered by a single gunshot. In a back alley, a reporter was found shot and killed. Meanwhile, Detective Song Sun had been investigating a series of murders—but what was the truth he uncovered...?

details.title: Tactical Dungeon Slayers
details.short_description: Slay the Spire-style roguelite deckbuilding meets high-mobility tactical combat and terrain strategy. Find the perfect position to unleash powerful deck combos and AoE attacks, wiping out enemies while avoiding the enemy’s kill zones.

details.title: Filthy Fly: Horde Survivor
details.short_description: A gross-out horde-survivor where you play the pest. Buzz over picnic tables and sewer guts, stack six revolting weapons, evolve them into screen-clearing monstrosities, and outlive the entire insect kingdom. Die, mutate at The Heap, and go again.

details.title: Hotel Stardust
details.short_description: Would you like to win $1,000,000? Survive the night at the Hotel Stardust, capture every anomaly on camera, and the prize is yours. Be careful, some anomalies aren't very friendly.

details.title: A Pile of Tile
details.short_description: A Pile of Tile is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about Loki, a cute little cat who recently graduated from art school and started his first job in a tiles shop. Loki faces multiple challenges in his new job, your goal is to help him make the tiles for customers and keep his job.

details.title: Arithmetrick
details.short_description: Arithmetrick is a math-based deckbuilding roguelite. Arrange operation cards into equation chains — addition,subtraction, multiplication, division — to hit escalating target scores. Collect a permanent deck across runs and mixthree color factions to discover deep card synergies

details.title: Productive Plants
details.short_description: Productive Plants is an idle desktop game about growing and collecting house plants that rewards productivity.

details.title: RingOut
details.short_description: A 3D arena shooter inspired by Super Smash Bros.: no health bars. Every shot heats enemies up, raising their temperature in degrees (°). The hotter they are, the farther they fly: launch them off the arena to win. 23 fighters, 13 weapons, 29 arenas, 6 modes. Solo vs bots or online.

details.title: Starworks Inc.
details.short_description: Harness the riches of a star system in this incremental game. Unlock new technologies, transform raw materials, build warships and win an interstellar war !

details.title: Froginko
details.short_description: A cozy pachinko roguelike. Bounce bugs through a pond full of frogs, merge frogs into bigger frogs, and get your best score in Challenge Mode, where one drop decides your place on the leaderboard.

details.title: Obolisk
details.short_description: COSMIC COMBAT DECIDED ONE COIN AT A TIME... Obolisk is a turn-based tactical roguelike where your party of Obols use coin flips to attack, defend, and unleash unique abilities. Plan ahead, survive each encounter, and see if you can make it to the OBOLISK.

details.title: Tales of Twin Souls
details.short_description: "Tales of Two Souls" is a 2D open-world xianxia RPG. Explore, fight, and cultivate with the soul bound to you. Uncover your family's fall, rebuild your ancestral home, meet allies and rivals, and forge your own path.

details.title: No Neutral Ground
details.short_description: Master magnetic polarity in a fast-paced, physics-driven robot party game for 1-8 players. Attract, repel, dash, and outmaneuver rivals across 20+ Mini Games, Magnetic Football, and a sprawling Scrap Raid. Customize your machine and claim the arena.

details.title: War Table Arena
details.short_description: War Table Arena is a real-time collectible card battler.[/h2] Energy pours in continuously and both commanders deploy onto a three-lane tabletop, where units march, clash and lay siege to the enemy citadel while you are still deciding what to play next.

details.title: Sarco
details.short_description: Sarco is a first-person horror game built around constant tension instead of jump scares. Maintain visual contact with the sarcophagus to keep it closed and the primordial being contained. But beware: it will adapt. Explore an abandoned complex and find a way to stop the being before it breaks free.

details.title: Anispo
details.short_description: Anispo is a fast paced 2D real time strategy game set inside a digital warzone. Command streams of bytes of data, capture network nodes, reinforce your defenses, and outmaneuver computer controlled or online rivals across customizable cyber battlefields.

details.title: Bamboo Beat
details.short_description: Embark on a journey through the world of Bamboo Beat. Attack, block, and counter to the beat, and take down one formidable foe after another.

details.title: Arcanum Solitarius
details.short_description: Poker solitaire with an arcane twist. Each row and column of the 5x5 grid is a poker hand, scoring as it fills. Repeat a hand and it's worth half. Purify the cursed Arcana, corrupted tarot cards that penalize your play. Draft Jokers for unique powers and power up your deck and board for bonus chips.

details.title: SCREW IT
details.short_description: Co-op space mercenary simulator. Take on high-risk contracts, upgrade your gear, and turn a profit.

details.title: Quack Ball!
details.short_description: Defend your goal as a rubber ducky in chaotic 4-player 3D pong! Battle friends in local multiplayer across wacky arenas. Lose a round? Draw a power-up card. Stack synergizing cards into wild builds and quack your way back to victory.

details.title: Fatemender
details.short_description: A Tarot puzzle adventure where you collect cards, cast spells, and place paths to reshape an ever-shifting Labyrinth. Outsmart the Fates, collect powerful Artifacts, and attempt the impossible—escape Purgatory.

details.title: Life of a Cockroach
details.short_description: Yes, you’re a cockroach, so your top priority now is to survive. Explore an urban environment from a whole new perspective in this open-world 3D adventure filled with challenges, tasks, and dangers. Discover hidden places, master your skills, and become the ultimate survivor insect!

name: おばけなんて怖くないJK　VS　学校迷宮

details.title: おばけなんて怖くないJK　VS　学校迷宮
details.short_description: Curious about horror but bad with scary things? This is a not-so-scary horror game made by a developer who feels the same way, created for players who want to enjoy horror without being truly frightened. A pixel-art side-scrolling action adventure with puzzles and light action elements.

details.title: Mars Incremental
details.short_description: A short incremental game about terraforming Mars. Build, automate, and deploy drones to harvest power, gas and water, then watch a quiet, red planet wake into a living world, one horizon at a time. Just follow the instructions: step one, change the entire planet.

details.title: Wares & Wonders: Fantasy Shop Simulator
details.short_description: A cozy first-person fantasy shop simulator. Every customer has a profession, a budget, and a reason to stop by today. Choose what to stock, arrange your displays, take on quests, and run the shop solo or with friends. Everything is physical. Everything can be broken.

details.title: Taiyi Saga
details.short_description: Taiyi Saga is a deck-building roguelike set in Chinese mythology. Pulled into a god's private realm, you build your deck, battle rival gods' invaders, and collect relics forged from ancient beasts — fighting your way toward the truth, and a way home.

details.title: KACHIN!
details.short_description: Din Dino, the mob's top ex-hitman, runs away from their past to pursue their true passion: selling custom t-shirts. Design T-shirts, get to know your clients and confront your past!

details.title: BLOODY HELL 2
details.short_description: Pulverize demons as a small angelic birb wielding a giant demonic hammer. Explore hell's deepest layers, and uncover the truth behind the fall of heaven in this bullet-hell metroidvania. Will you succeed, or die in the chaotic depths of BLOODY HELL 2?

details.title: Evoplasm
details.short_description: Evolve and fight in this creature building Roguelike. Grow a creature by attaching new cells, add mutations to create powerful synergies, fight real-time tactical battles against weird enemies, and strategically choose a path across multiple campaign acts. Inspired by games like Spore and FTL.

details.title: Eldorion: Guardians of the Crystals
details.short_description: A pixel art exploration game where you must face various challenges and collect crystals to save Earth from its impending doom. An RPG with multiple continents that have emerged, ushering in a new era of mysticism.

details.title: Sa[meow]rai: Silverwing Stray
details.short_description: "Sa[meow]rai" is a top down action role-playing game centered around one-hit kills and rich interactivity.You play as a law-enforcer with an implant called "Gyakugawa Emergency Reboot Device," fighting for every second of your remaining time in a morally ambiguous cyberpunk city.

details.title: Impious
details.short_description: Impious is a dark turn-based RPG set in a world where human imperfection is no longer tolerated, those deemed impious are captured and dragged underground. You wake inside a system designed to break you and your only way is forward:fight, negotiate, gear up and find your way out.

details.title: Chaos Bringer
details.short_description: Outsmart foes in fast-paced tactical dungeons, then become a raid leader who stops time to command your party. Explore, craft, and conquer giant bosses single-handedly for the ultimate MMORPG-level satisfaction.

details.title: Phantom of Orion
details.short_description: A WW2 submarine sim in space. Alone in an unfinished stealth prototype, run cold and dark through alien convoy lanes, strike from cloak, then vanish before the swarm sweeps back. The cloak that hides you also blinds you.

details.title: How Much For It?
details.short_description: Run a second-hand shop. Hear out your customers, value strange items, and make your offer. Some lie, some hide important details, and some deals may bring more into your shop than you bargained for.

details.title: 时装工坊
details.short_description: You are a fashion designer and run your own fashion design room. An ordinary template can be made into anything you imagine. You can also design clothes for pets and put on your own clothes to wear after the design is completed. Match the scenes and actions and take a photo of your work.

details.title: Parcel Point Simulator
details.short_description: Sort, Scan, Deliver and Grow — Turn a corner parcel point into a fully-automized money machine, and build your logistic empire.

details.title: CatBall
details.short_description: CatBall is a physics-based roguelite builder: arm your cat, toss it into battle, watch it roll, crash, and swing on its own, and switch weapons at the right moment to send enemies flying.

details.title: Nightmare Delivery
details.short_description: Enter distorted minds and deliver packages to the darkness within. Play alone or in online co-op for up to 4 players, explore nightmarish locations, solve environmental puzzles, outsmart dangerous entities, and escape alive.

details.title: Dead Sector: Rogue
details.short_description: Pick a core, rewrite how you fight. Reload and meteors fall. Ice spikes rise, dash to shatter them. Sprint and lightning strikes. Fight in style to climb from D to S rank and make it all strike more often. A fast FPS roguelite with two guns, a combat dog and a station stuck in a time loop

details.title: Farm Hand
details.short_description: A brain-bending deckbuilder about setting up huge harvest combos! Enhance your deck, discover game-changing synergies, and plan your harvests to maximize your score. Every crop has a timer. Every harvest is a puzzle. Every combo feels incredible.

details.title: Blindstep
details.short_description: A robot with no forward vision. You can only walk backwards and the moment you turn to look where you're going, the screen goes black. Ten sectors of collapsing floors, hydraulic presses and things that patrol the dark. Every jump is taken blind.

details.title: Delphyr: The Deep Whispers
details.short_description: Dig to the last living core of a dead world. Delphyr is a 2D action roguelite where every death sends you home to the family whose bond the Deep cannot break — upgrade with them, then dig deeper. Hand-crafted spells, a grapnel, telekinetic mining magic, and titan bosses await below.

details.title: LockLine
details.short_description: LockLine is a tense turn-based tactics game. Think 3-in-a-row, but lining up your units calls down an orbital strike. Outthink an enemy trying to do the same to you. Grab jetpacks and shields, pin enemies, drop barriers and smoke screens, and face boss commanders who change the rules.

details.title: 02:17 The Trader’s Path
details.short_description: Build your path from an unknown trader to the top of the game in a story-driven trading experience. Trade simulated markets, manage risk, make choices that shape your journey, and uncover the story and mystery hidden behind 02:17.

details.title: NOYAKI — CONTROLLED BURN
details.short_description: A casual puzzle game about controlled burning! Fire obeys the land and wind: racing uphill, fading downhill, stopping at cliffs and rivers. You choose only when and where to light it. Read the slopes, read the wind, cut firebreaks, move the livestock, and burn the grassland exactly as you meant to.

details.title: Chainball
details.short_description: Chainball is a physics-driven couch sports brawler for up to four players, where animal champions swing, throw, and reel in chained flails to smash the ball into the opposing goal... and each other!

details.title: Herd League
details.short_description: Grow a small herd into a thriving ranch in this farming strategy game. Breed and exchange animals, manage your pasture, expand your land, protect your herd from wolves, and race other ranchers to reach the cow goal first. Play solo or online.

details.title: SPOTREP
details.short_description: SPOTREP features MILSIM game mechanics, each dynamically changing how you play. Spotted a stationary target? Call in a GRG based CALL FOR FIRE including method of control and number of rounds. Your AI or player teammates are down? Call in a 4 liner MEDEVAC!

details.title: Dynasty Basketball Manager
details.short_description: Win 3 titles in 5 seasons—or the run ends. A roguelite basketball GM where the right mix of player styles unlocks tactics, like TFT synergies. Draft, trade and shop between games, then call the shots when the clock stops. Pick one of 16 franchises; a full run takes about four hours.

details.title: Chef Boss Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own fast food shop in a chaotic first-person cooking simulator. Grill, fry, stack and serve every order yourself, then spend the takings on new stations, drink stands, staff and a floor you lay out and repaint yourself. You hire the crew, but you are always the chef.

details.title: Orbit Anomaly
details.short_description: Orbit Anomaly is a cooperative sci-fi horror game about robots exploring abandoned space facilities, scavenging scrap to upgrade their base, and trying not to become prey for the monsters lurking within.

details.title: Armada Ascendant
details.short_description: Command modular fleets in a top-down tactics game where every shot is aimed by hand. Build warships socket by socket, flick projectiles across drifting battlefields, and carry damage, veterans, and hard choices through a 60-mission campaign.

details.title: Grim Gambit
details.short_description: A card-puzzle roguelite where every card you place on a dungeon grid is a higher-or-lower bet. Guess wrong and part of your board explodes. Poker hands heal you, counting cards is encouraged, and the Grim Reaper runs the table. One standard 52-card deck. Fill the grid. Cheat death.

details.title: Bake It Tight
details.short_description: A cute, real-time cookie factory puzzle. Animal customers keep pouring in, but you only have a few machines. Place them, link them to the ovens with rails, and bake the cookies your customers want. Can you fill every order on time?

details.title: Cargo Tempo
details.short_description: Turn delivery chaos into a plan that works. Assign orders, optimize routes and build your fleet in this route-planning management game. Plan at your own pace, then watch your vehicles put your decisions to the test across short, multi-day runs.

details.title: The Painting War: Three Thrones
details.short_description: A grid-based formation-building autobattler set in the Three Kingdoms. Lay paper, scenery, and illustrated warriors onto a limited board, then rotate, merge, and connect them into an army. Your units fight automatically from their original tiles—study the outcome and rebuild for the next battle.

details.title: Farmer=nil
details.short_description: Farmer = nil is a programming-based automation farm right on your computer screen! Write scripts for your robots, collect resources, unlock tech, and build the most efficient farm.

details.title: Projekt Gartenzwerg
details.short_description: Projekt Gartenzwerg is a co-op horde defense FPS for 1 to 4 players. Night falls, and thousands of ceramic garden gnomes march on your position. Grab a WW2 arsenal, build your defenses and hold the line until dawn, alone or with your friends.

details.title: Strategic Command: Korea
details.short_description: Command United Nations or Communist forces in the first major conflict of the Cold War. Fight across a vast, highly detailed map of Korea, master new units and mechanics, and reshape the course of the war from the Pusan Perimeter to the Chosin Reservoir and beyond.

details.title: Seaside Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Grow your very own seaside shop! Sell products, earn profits, expand your store, plan the layout, and experience the journey of building a successful business from the ground up.

details.title: Sideways Motorways
details.short_description: Turns and corners? No thank you! In this traffic-simulation game all roads are straight and cars never brake. A smart city planner like you would do the sensible thing and move the houses around instead, to avoid intersections. Or would you rather take the thrill of a close call for a higher score?

details.title: Rush Tower
details.short_description: Rush Tower is a Tower Defense game where new paths are procedurally added over the course of the game. Can you keep up as the enemy builds more paths in this ever more hectic war?

details.title: Alchemist
details.short_description: A magic-focused action battle* RPG where research and alchemy shape your path through combat encounters, puzzles, and challenges across diverse locations.

name: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears

details.title: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears
details.short_description: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears is a story-rich, retro space shooter inspired by DOS-era space games. Blast your way through fast-paced arcade combat, build out modular, upgradable ships, and explore a galaxy torn by war.

details.title: Susia - Wolf Life Simulator
details.short_description: Live the fun life of a wolf! Find a mate, start a pack, hunt together and survive in the wild! Befriend other packs or defeat them to become the sole wolf pack. Adventure through the island and settle down or keep moving, it's all up to you!

details.title: The Unfinished Melody: Prologue
details.short_description: Some things can never be made whole, and some melodies are never meant to be played. Pursue a lost song, unspoken feelings, and precious memories as you step into a mysterious fantasy world of light, shadow, and dreamlike adventure.

details.title: 這遺虚配信
details.short_description: Photograph and repel the monsters that appear in the abandoned hotel using a mysterious camera! Uncover the mysteries surrounding the abandoned hotel by relying on comments from your viewers! Use the Super Chats you receive to buy items and gain the upper hand in battle!

details.title: ASEMA
details.short_description: Automate your factory in space. Build logistic railguns to feed the production lines of your ever growing machines. Gravity disrupts your trajectories - master it. Connect your machines over the vast void. Find resource rich moons and asteroid streams to harvest and mine, but beware of the humans.

details.title: Dynamine
details.short_description: Dynamine is an incremental mining game based on Minesweeper. Dig for ores while avoiding explosives, sell what you found, buy better tools to dig more efficiently, then rinse and repeat!

details.title: Boonies
details.short_description: A One vs. Many survival horror game with proximity chat. A group of rednecks have crashed their car in dark woods. They must search for parts to fix their car and escape. But watch out! Through his countless cameras, the Observer sees all. He controls the monster, and must "protect" his forest.

details.title: Outer Empires 2
details.short_description: A top-down space MMO where every action shapes a persistent, player-driven galaxy. Trade, fight, explore, and colonise as you build your empire. Run supply chains, wage faction wars, and customize ships in a living economy driven by real supply and demand.

details.title: Spreadsheets & Dungeons
details.short_description: A grid-based turn-based roguelike where you manage a party across a dungeon which is a spreadsheet. Explore each dungeon, level up your heroes, build synergies, scale absurd stats, and survive escalating dungeon pressure through tactical positioning and resource management.

details.title: Retire in the Fairy Mountains
details.short_description: Retire in the Fairy Mountains is a Chinese-style farming game that integrates planting, fishing,cooking, mining and free building. Players take on the role of a farmer at the foot of the Immortal Mountain, unlock various interesting items and build their own world.

details.title: Devils on the Moon Pinball
details.short_description: A classic-style Creature Collecting Pinball game based on old school masterpieces with modernized gameplay. Pixel-crafted in full monochromatic glory.

details.title: 搭搭大战（DaDa Wars）
details.short_description: Dada Dazhan is a casual real-time strategy game. No frantic micromanagement—just focus on your troop formations and city management. Grab a cup of coffee and watch these little cartoon soldiers charge into battle for you.

details.title: 26 Moves: The Queen's Plot
details.short_description: A point-and-click mystery game. Search for the truth in 26 days, playing as two different characters, in a town during 1907.

details.title: Sirius the Stargazer : Furry Idle
details.short_description: Awooo—! Follow Sirius into the starry lands! Sirius the Stargazer is a cozy desktop idle game. Start with a simple branch, defeat monsters, collect gear with random abilities, and help Sirius grow stronger. When he’s tired, let him rest by the campfire and keep you company.

details.title: Inertial
details.short_description: Inertial is a 2D arcade space racer. Race against the clock or against your friends in this reality-adjacent racing experience. No speed ceilings, no warped physics, just realistic gravity, thrust and skill.

details.title: The Final Lane
details.short_description: The Final Lane is a 3D Deckbuilding Roguelite about Bowling in Hell where the BALLS ARE THE CARDS! Draft a sinner-gistic deck of bowling balls, hone your skills, and battle other sinners as you climb through Hell for the ultimate prize: a shot at Satan and a chance at redemption.

details.title: Telenovela Simulator
details.short_description: As the head writer of the newest soap opera of a failing network, juggle a tight budget, the expectations of the audience and the chaotic world of TV production. Combine actors and locations to discover hundreds of scenes as you weave a dramatic narrative in each unique playthrough.

details.title: Tiny Drift
details.short_description: TINY DRIFT is a pixel-art drift-combat survivor. Drift, charge and ram your way through waves of enemies. Upgrade your car with unique drifting weapons and survive intense battles as you build the ultimate combat machine.

name: Hypnagogia 壊れた夢 Broken Dreams

details.title: Hypnagogia 壊れた夢 Broken Dreams
details.short_description: A protector submerged, a mirror shattered, and a dreamscape left severed. Unravel a new, surreal dream mystery as you platform, solve puzzles, meet unique characters, and much more in this first-person exploration prequel to Hypnagogia: Boundless Dreams.

details.title: Applied Shamanism
details.short_description: A cozy 3D game about a rookie rabbit shaman. Diagnose quirky illnesses with X-ray spirit vision, gather and grow elemental ingredients, and brew always-useful potions. Each patient is a bite-size mystery of folk ailments and guardian spirits, with no combat, damage, or timers.

details.title: The Old Parish
details.short_description: A cozy top-down farming and life sim in a rural Irish parish. Sow and harvest the family farm, mow and bale the hay, raise cattle and sheep and fish the lake. Then head into a town where every door opens, for Sunday Mass, a pint at O'Brien's and a hand of Twenty-Five.

details.title: Don't Wake the Queen
details.short_description: Protect the peaceful sleep of Your Meowness in this infinite incremental tower defense. Place fierce warriors, build your own path, unlock a ton of new skills and infinitely upgrade EVERYTHING.

details.title: Thousands of Chroma
details.short_description: A layered logic puzzle game, where thousands of colors come to life using only □(0) and ■(1).

details.title: Criterion
details.short_description: Criterion is a space optimisation puzzle game about designing efficient solutions under constraint. Process the color fluxes. Control their strength. Solve increasingly complex networks where every tile matters. There is always a solution, the question is how elegant yours will be.

details.title: Rows Of Earth
details.short_description: A detailed zombie-survival colony sim where you create a settlement on an infested island. Guide your workers as they build walls, grow crops, dig trenches and plant their flag in the land. Help them to fight hordes, form families, and uncover old technologies. Write their story...

details.title: Grandpa Golf
details.short_description: A golf roguelike about making really big numbers. Sink shots, buy powerful items, and build ridiculous score combos as you push deeper into Grandpa Golf’s golf course.

name: Master of Chaos: Beat or Break the Game

details.title: Master of Chaos: Beat or Break the Game
details.short_description: Pulverize your enemies for underestimating this cute little wizard by counter attacks, deflecting projectiles, unleashing face-melting ultimate abilities and building insane combos boosting your power until you are strong enough to beat the boss or break the game - Either way you win.

details.title: Beards Go Underground
details.short_description: The Mining Deckbuilder. Blow up the mountains using explosive card combos! Build your deck, prepare your strategy and BOOM! - call gold and gemstones your own.

details.title: 鱼干集团那些事：征途
details.short_description: 《Furry Journey in Other World》 IP Furry Anime 2D Role-Playing Visual Novel GameYou will take control of the protagonist — HuiYuan — and continue writing the story of Yugan Group in this sci-fi world. Embark on an epic journey together with your friends and comrades-in-arms.

details.title: KUBIKA
details.short_description: KUBIKA is a Sokoban-like puzzle adventure. Manipulate gravity and guide charming little cubes across three-dimensional, perspective-twisting puzzles. Master each world’s unique mechanics, build and share your own puzzles using the built-in Level Editor. Free Demo available today !

details.title: WarSlice
details.short_description: Take command of your army in WarSlice! Fight for the glory of your favorite faction, choose your commander, and rally your troops to victory in strategic turn-based battles. With intuitive controls and simple mechanics, even newcomers can engage in intense matches!

details.title: Antarctic Grave
details.short_description: A first-person survival horror set in an Antarctic research station. Explore the frozen complex, search for tools and weapons, keep the generator fueled, and outsmart mutants to survive the harsh conditions.

details.title: Cardmare: Descent
details.short_description: A push-your-luck roguelike deckbuilder. Ten deadly floors, ten-minute runs, nine classes, one question every turn: Will you gain enough gold to buy powerful new cards, or become too greedy and push your luck too far?

details.title: Afternoon Patient
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. As a patient tethered to a cold, mobile IV pole, you move through silent, haunting liminal spaces. Time feels frozen, and every step tests your rhythm, patience, and courage as you face isolation and psychological terror.

details.title: System Says Normal
details.short_description: You were hired to watch. Not to ask questions. Night shift. Corporate building. Cameras, reports, anomalies. Your predecessor left no final report. Now you're going to find out why. Please proceed.

details.title: Action & Automation
details.short_description: Action or automation? In this asymmetric, side-scrolling action-RTS, fight on the front line yourself, let your machines do the work, or do both at once. Each of the three species plays by its own rules.

details.title: MARBLE SOULS
details.short_description: Prepare to roll through the dense, interconnected world of MARBLE SOULS. Collect lost souls and level up your marble in the new genre-defying game from the creators of Mosa Lina & FALLSTRUKTUR.

details.title: FISH OS
details.short_description: An idle fishing game that lives inside a fake 1997 operating system. Click the water to fish, then run your catch through a desktop where every window is a mechanic: an aquarium that buffs your income, a fish market, a fleet you send out overnight. 250 species. Solitaire included.

details.title: Valley of Stability
details.short_description: Crash-land on a dying alien world and bring it back to life. Build automated factories, master real chemistry and nuclear physics, and terraform the atmosphere one gas at a time — while sandworms hunt the power signature of everything you build.

name: Ask Mom: Find Objects, Learn Words

details.title: Ask Mom: Find Objects, Learn Words
details.short_description: Learn a language by finding hidden objects 🔎 in a cozy, funny family game where everyone keeps losing things — except super‑mom, who can find anything. Search for items, learn words in context, and enjoy short family scenes. Free demo coming soon — wishlist the game.

details.title: Decommission Protocol
details.short_description: Edith station has been abandoned for a year - an unusually long time to sit derelict. You are a space station engineer sent up to decommission the station in a manual service elevator with the ability to stop between floors. Will you discover the truth or simply follow protocol?

details.title: Gamarra - Street Vendor Simulator
details.short_description: Your family is desperate for money. All you have is a stand in Gamarra, Peru's busiest market. Start small, haggle hard, dodge corrupt police, and survive gang extortion. But every coin you earn is a choice: send it home, or bet it on your business, nothing comes free.

details.title: Last Draft
details.short_description: Complete your last draft before sunrise while enduring increasing paranormal activities and relentless monster stalks. Use your typing skills to progress and your instincts to hide, surviving 7 days of pure psychological horror.

details.title: Wilderness Strike: Survivor
details.short_description: Players take on the role of a survivor trapped in an endless battlefield.
