Face massive waves of enemies swarming from all directions, gain experience by defeating foes, level up and select skills to build your unique combat build, then break through the siege and claim victory!

details.title: Tomo Cafe
details.short_description: Tomo Cafe is a Pomodoro Timer and cafe simulator game. Run a study cafe, work through your actual to-do list beside the regulars, decorate the place, and unlock the next chapter of heartwarming stories.

details.title: Train 404
details.short_description: A first-person co-op horror game where you collect coins, find the Golden Ticket, and race back to the train while monsters close in.

details.title: Ramen://protocol
details.short_description: 🍜🃏 Ramen://protocol is a cyberpunk ramen-stall roguelite deckbuilder. Push your toppings to their limits, then rev them up even further with skills. Master countless synergies and serve bowls so good they're synapse-frying. Chase the one bowl that will cut you free from your past.

details.title: Nordfolk
details.short_description: A text-based management game set in the Norse Viking Age, focused not on war, but on peaceful colony building. Assign villagers to tasks, build production chains, and stockpile food and firewood before winter sets in. Survive, found a saga, and return stronger.

details.title: Blazing Strike: R.Evolution
details.short_description: The fight continues in Blazing Strike: R.Evolution. This handcrafted HD beat 'em up brings Jake and his gang back to the streets to face a new, darker threat. Featuring fluid sprite-based combat, a deep Story Mode, and classic arcade action—handcrafted for the ultimate brawl.

details.title: Shroomanoid: breakout action roguelike
details.short_description: Forget classic breakout games. In Shroomanoid, you are the projectile. Control the frantic flight of a giant mushroom, smash enemies into a bloody pulp with precise ricochets, and stack insane combinations of abilities.

details.title: Lurking
details.short_description: Lurking is a first-person survival horror game set in a building infested by giant spiders. Search for tools and weapons to fight back and survive. Find a way out before you're eaten alive.

details.title: Sugarstar Academy
details.short_description: Read enemy landings, turn cards into a squad on a 5×5 battlefield, and use positioning and Hero Skills to rewrite the outcome of auto-combat in this story-driven magical-academy deckbuilder.

details.title: The Last Stash
details.short_description: Run the last shop in a post-apocalyptic town. Stock shelves, set prices, and complete contracts. Drive into an abandoned town at night, search for supplies, and fight mutants and raiders. Bring back what you find to sell in your shop or keep it for your own survival.

details.title: Stop Reading the Cards
details.short_description: Build a deck, define its priorities, and watch your strategy execute itself. In this satirical single-player roguelike, cards become parts of an automated combat system. Create absurd synergies, adapt your rules, and survive a tower that treats every run like a badly managed show.

details.title: HEAVY SLEEPER
details.short_description: Transport a sleeping giant Troll to Sector 35. Drive the car, keep the Troll balanced, and whatever happens, don’t wake him up.

name: ERROR: Me, Cyber Guys, and Weird Block Battles

details.title: ERROR: Me, Cyber Guys, and Weird Block Battles
details.short_description: A casual strategy game combining block-placement combat, roguelite module builds, and interactive stories for a female audience. Explore an anomalous network and conquer personalities who watch, respond to, and may even sense the real “you” as you claim your permissions.

details.title: Cthulhu's Eldritch Kitchen
details.short_description: Cthulhu's Eldritch Kitchen is a short incremental game about running your own kitchen to become the most powerful being on the planet.

details.title: NO KING IN HELL
details.short_description: Awaken as the late Demon King's children, a brother and sister with no realm of their own. Explore an HD-2D demon world, recruit monsters, and reclaim a home. Seize weakened enemies mid-battle, raise them through classes, evolution and fusion, and lead squads in a turn-based strategy RPG.

details.title: Precious nightmare
details.short_description: How do you deal with love if, every time you chase it, it ends up hurting you? That’s the question Rosa asks herself every day. One day, she works up the courage to find an answer and heads to… a police station? Dive into her worst nightmares to discover how she’s reached the situation she’s in.

details.title: Piggy Bang
details.short_description: Piggy Bang is a satisfying incremental game where you smash piggy banks to earn coins and gems, upgrade your hammer, and build your fortune. Can you expand your bank-breaking operation to infinity and beyond?

details.title: Stealthmate: A chess puzzle
details.short_description: Use chess moves to sneak past guards and plan clever escapes through handcrafted puzzles, solo or in local and online co-op. Switch to real-time chess battles, then create and share your own puzzles in the full game.

details.title: Penthouse
details.short_description: Penthouse is a Rogue-like horror game where you (and your friends) stumble into a haunted Penthouse in order to pay rent for your boat. As you do, you must find clues and use devices to discover what happened in this Penthouse. Solve the mystery of the Haunting.

details.title: All-in Tide
details.short_description: Adapt to the ever-changing weather. Learn every cave along the shore. Swing your shovel and dig up whatever the sea has hidden. But never lose sight of your own desires — they can drive you mad, or make you filthy rich.

details.title: Kalmareth: Rune Duel VR
details.short_description: A 1v1 VR magic duel fought with your hands. Draw runes in the air to cast — six strokes, no menus, no HUD. Read your opponent's motion, commit to a stroke, and strike before they finish theirs.

details.title: Idol Shell
details.short_description: Idol Shell is a retro-style FPS inspired by the classics of the 1990s. Fight relentless mechanical enemies, explore interconnected levels, uncover hidden secrets, and discover the mystery behind their creation.

details.title: Only Guns
details.short_description: It's like Only Up but with guns. Only Guns! A third person puzzle-platforming-shooter. Race against the clock! Jump, Climb and Shoot your way up through a series of realms until you reach the very top.

details.title: Warband Heroes
details.short_description: Draft a warband from 18 heroes, arm them with items and abilities between fights, then let them loose in this arena mayhem roguelike autobattler.

details.title: Astella Walker
details.short_description: Leave it to luck, or engineer the odds? Instead of cards, carve strike angles on your roulette to control probabilities. When the triple rings snap into place, your chained strikes explode. Caught between exponential loot and lethal curses, decide when to fold (STOP) and when to press on (GO).

details.title: Tetragrade
details.short_description: Embark on your own odyssey, stack hand-cut materials, watch treasures pour into the bowl and spend your rewards on the favour of ten Greek gods. Tetragrade is a compulsive block-stacking roguelite about the pleasure of a perfect fit.

details.title: Frutiverse
details.short_description: Your planet is doomed. In Frutiverse, a space game driven by orbital physics and destructible environments, you fight incoming threats, destroying asteroids or pushing them off their collision course. Gather resources and build an evacuation ship to save your fellow Fruits, alone or in local co-op.

details.title: Not a Bug: Idle Defense
details.short_description: Not a Bug is a relaxing incremental idle defense game. You can’t lose, since every bug dies the moment it reaches the glitch. Install apps, feed the bugs and watch the chaos. Remember: it’s not a bug, it’s a feature.

details.title: Domino Tinkerer
details.short_description: Become a domino tinkerer in a physics-based sandbox! Fly through rooms, deploy gadgets like cannons and funnels, and trigger chain reactions to clear every checkpoint. Build the ultimate domino machine solo or team up with up to 4 friends online!

details.title: Motor Park Architect
details.short_description: Build and manage the motorsport park of your dreams. Choose from a variety of racing categories, manage your staff, and create a world-class motorsport destination hosting a wide range of competitions. Take on the fastest drivers from different championships and beat their lap records.

details.title: CTRL Chaos
details.short_description: 15 singleplayer minigames. Different rules. Total chaos. Blast hooligans with a water cannon, fight space swarms, solve cargo puzzles, build a tower, or grow a garden. Pick your next challenge or play a series.

details.title: Floor Show
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelike on a live TV game show. You are the contestant. Push rivals into spikes, lava and barrels to earn hype, your XP. Take sponsor deals, and face returning rivals made from whatever killed you last time.

details.title: The Gigglebone Gang: Pantsylvania
details.short_description: The Gigglebone Gang returns! In Pantsylvania, everybody's pants are serious business. Join the Gigglebone Gang across ten locales and 50 activities — sing-along songs, hidden-object hunts, silly science and interactive stories — in this fully restored 1995 point-and-click edutainment classic.

details.title: Spiral Scramble
details.short_description: A co-op obstacle course for you and your friends. Work your way around a spiral of creatures, traps and hazards to reach the center together. One touch knocks you down, and only a teammate can pick you back up. If everyone goes down at once, it's back to the start.

details.title: City Safety
details.short_description: City Safety is a game about taking your city back from the mass surveillance that has infected every street corner. Join your friends in riding around the city, wreaking havoc, and challenging authority.

details.title: Cubies
details.short_description: Find and collect Cubies in this cube-sized 3D puzzle-platformer!

details.title: Residential Phenomena Hotline
details.short_description: You're the night agent at a paranormal support hotline service. Callers contact you when something goes wrong in their homes and send photos, videos, and voice notes. Question them, search the company files, find what doesn't belong, and tell them what to do. Get it wrong, and face the consequences.

details.title: That's a lot of Zombies
details.short_description: Rain hell from an AC-130 as millions of zombies climb over each other to reach your squad’s rooftop. Deploy sentry guns, flamethrowers and claymores before each night. Call in A-10s, B-52s and every bit of firepower you can get. Hold the roof until the rescue helicopter lands.

details.title: Clash Pandemic: Forest Hell
details.short_description: You’re stuck in a gigantic forest. Chop wood, explore lost buildings, upgrade your swinging weapons, and spin your way through waves of zombies to a boss. Play alone or bring friends. Lots of blood. Much gore. Try not to die.

details.title: Foilage TCG : Collectors Edition
details.short_description: Foilage TCG: Collectors Edition is a single player fantasy trading card game. Build your ultimate deck, open booster packs, trade on the market, and hunt for rare Foil Refractors to take on your opponents. Collect and build your ultimate collection to load your binder and hard cases.

details.title: MimiCreate
details.short_description: Even aliens have exams! In MimiCreate, Mimics must learn to hide among humans before earning a license to visit Earth. Build disguises, blend in, and dodge the Inspectors in chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek.

details.title: Circuit Valley
details.short_description: Grow a thriving valley with a crew of little robots. Play as Pip to tend crops and build workshops, then put your helpers to work hauling harvests and keeping production moving. Turn a handful of apples into a place that hums with life.

details.title: DUNSPIN
details.short_description: Pull the lever. Recruit whatever heroes the reels hand you. Then watch them fight. DUNSPIN is a slot-machine auto-battler roguelike with deckbuilding, where one lucky spin can turn a losing run into a winning one.

details.title: The Gigglebone Gang: AlphaBonk Farm
details.short_description: A is for AlphaBonk! Join Farmer Bonk and the Gigglebone Gang for a trip through the alphabet down on the farm — letters, rhymes, real farm photos and a barnyard full of silly games. A fully restored 1995 Headbone Interactive classic.

details.title: Idle Laps
details.short_description: An incremental racing game where you actually drive. Beat your best lap and turn it into ghosts that loop it endlessly, earning coins for you. Upgrade your ride, ascend, and master every circuit of an island racing festival.

details.title: OSAD
details.short_description: No combat, no jump scares, and no chase sequences: just you and a dying world with a mystery to uncover. Experience the end of the world in an alternate-history Poland. As a lone garbage collector, witness the final hours of reality as you know it. But don't forget to be a good citizen.

name: Fishing Company Tycoon: Harbor to Market

details.title: Fishing Company Tycoon: Harbor to Market
details.short_description: Build a fishing company from a single boat. Send your ships to the fishing grounds, truck the catch to the markets that pay the most, research better gear, and grow a fleet that works by itself. A relaxed management game on a living island.

details.title: Got More?
details.short_description: Fight monster hordes in a bullet heaven roguelite with automatic attacks, weapon evolutions and 18 bosses. Mix guns, melee weapons and skills, unlock companions, and upgrade your gear between runs to take on the next chapter.

details.title: VOXHELL
details.short_description: You are the subject. He is the experiment. Forty-eight rooms of traps designed to test not your reflexes, but your behavior, while a smug narrator comments on every mistake. And when you need a break, there's a whole other game waiting on the computer.

details.title: Diceocracy: UK
details.short_description: Win a by-election, then survive the diary. Hard choices go to a physics d20 thrown against a difficulty class. Climb from the back benches to Number Ten in a House of Commons where the seats are real and every politician is invented.

details.title: The Final Ideology
details.short_description: Lead your faction through the Third Cold War in this turn-based grand strategy. Millennia after the destruction of Earth, survivors of the Communist and Capitalist superpowers have forged enormous multi-planetary factions that have recently re-discovered one another. Which side will you take?

details.title: Fraggers
details.short_description: Fraggers is a fast-paced, chaotic first-person arena "bomber" where grenades are your only weapons! Grab your powerups and blast your way to the top of the scoreboard! Bring your friends for explosive split-screen and LAN multiplayer mayhem!

details.title: 生灵棋旅 Grid Beasts
details.short_description: Recruit unusual creatures, master their movement patterns, and build a team that changes the battlefield. Grid Beasts is a turn-based tactical roguelite where you evolve and fuse companions, brave branching routes, and bring your whole team home for your next expedition.

details.title: Dash Flash Rush
details.short_description: Move at high speed across 2D platforms, dodge attacks, and take down enemies—then join a smoking-headed guy and step into an absurd story.

details.title: Grass Planet
details.short_description: Stranded on an alien planet, you must mow endless grassy hills to uncover the materials needed to rebuild your ship. Upgrade your lawnmower and uncover the mystery of the planet in this short incremental adventure.

details.title: Far Acre
details.short_description: You leave the city for an overgrown block and an old sawmill. Read each log before the blade goes in: chalk where you think the knots and the rot are, and how deep, mark your cuts to guide the blade and plan out your orders. The saw shows how well you read, and the boards build your homestead.

details.title: The Devil Upstairs
details.short_description: Become the devil upstairs! Stomp to the beat, turn Rage into permanent upgrades, and recruit the neighbors you wake. Build a louder crew, unleash powerful combos, and descend through the building in a rhythm incremental game of short runs and lasting progress.

details.title: Gargoyle Garden
details.short_description: Grow magical plants, open enchanted seed packs, hire cute critters, and upgrade your greenhouses. Visit the local gargoyle shopkeeper and complete your plant collection in this cozy incremental gardening game.

details.title: Bloomino
details.short_description: A cozy game about running your own little flower shop 💐 Place flower tiles, create charming bouquets and brighten your customers’ day. Decorate your shop, unlock new flowers and discover a variety of beautiful combinations.

details.title: Bono
details.short_description: A calm first-person village life and survival game. Chop wood, catch fish and collect scrap, do daily jobs for the shopkeepers to win their friendship and secrets, drive the mountain road, and get through four seasons in a small village below the mountains.

details.title: Fragments
details.short_description: Your mind is shattered. Step into a first-person psychological horror where you must relive your deepest trauma, uncover fragments of your past, piece them back together and face the tormentors that haunt your mind.

details.title: Scrapfall
details.short_description: Classic falling-block gameplay pushed to the edge in a fast-paced action roguelite of escalating gravity, unstable physics, and cascading systems.

details.title: Economic Biathlon
details.short_description: Test your wits in an arcade quiz. React quickly and overcome tricky challenges. You can set new records and compete in Economic Biathlon.

details.title: Hollow Faces
details.short_description: Hollow Faces is an atmospheric narrative horror where you step into the role of creators documenting paranormal phenomena. The game blends an intense walking simulator with environmental observation, careful listening, and reacting to threats.

details.title: Tombbound
details.short_description: Welcome to the afterlife’s most dangerous internship. In this co-op extraction horror, you serve Anubis. Raid cursed tombs, dodge mythological horrors, and collect enough cursed relics to meet the God of Death's quota. Remember: The scales of justice do not tolerate lighter wallets.

details.title: Orbit to Riches
details.short_description: Orbit to Riches is a short, relaxing incremental space game where you mine asteroids, upgrade ships, and grow stronger over multiple runs - no timers, no rush.

details.title: Streaming Raptae
details.short_description: A one-button platformer about a streamer trapped inside his own livestream. Your score is your viewers, your chat throws bombs at you and every death is clip-worthy. Jump, hold to jump higher, and never let the stream get boring.

details.title: Bayani: Auto Ascent
details.short_description: A naked hero. A ten-floor tower. A Rival who drafts from the same cards you do. Build your hero piece by piece - gear, spells and fighting techniques - and watch the fights play out automatically. Take the card they need, or the card you need? At the top, you duel to the death.

details.title: Moji Snake
details.short_description: Fight to survive this snake roguelike with quick adventures or endless runs.

details.title: Earn Your Stripes
details.short_description: A single-player WWII shooter where you start as a Private, rank up, and gain command of an entire army. Fight in battles of hundreds of soldiers on procedurally generated battlefields, from the Normandy beaches to the Rhine. Lead a squad, plan attacks on the map, crew tanks and call in bombers.

details.title: Realmwake
details.short_description: Recruit and merge an everchanging roster of combatants in this roguelike autobattler. Arrange your squad, discover powerful synergies, and venture through a world shattered by the four colliding realms.

details.title: Fever
details.short_description: Experience the beautiful horror of a hostile alien planet in this co-op survival FPS. Explore, mine resources, craft weapons, and fortify outposts with turrets and traps. When the sky rains blood, fight hundreds of creatures and survive the Fever.

details.title: NEON DESCENT
details.short_description: Half human, half machine, D dives into a neon cyberspace with J, the AI who refuses to leave his side. Fuse together, outsmart 12 bosses that each demand a different strategy, and descend to the Core to learn why the children vanished.

details.title: Kill the AI
details.short_description: An action roguelike set in a dystopian future where the tech titans who built the AI are sent to kill it. Gun down swarms of glitching machines, level up, hack terminals, build your loadout and transform your weapon mid-run. No permanent upgrades: every win is pure skill.

details.title: Ladder of Numbers
details.short_description: Ladder of Numbers turns arithmetic into combat skills: charge with addition, multiply into clones, fire with subtraction, divide to split. Climb its steps through thunderclouds and imaginary-number storms to the edge of the sky.

details.title: Folkwyrd
details.short_description: A fantasy colony sim and city builder where every villager has a life of their own. Build and customize a floating island settlement, manage a living population, shape generations, and explore a persistent multiplayer world where every choice leaves a mark.

details.title: Math Combo Chain
details.short_description: A tower defense where ammo is limited and math is your reload.

details.title: Bukchon Anomaly
details.short_description: A first-person anomaly horror game on a looping street inspired by Seoul's Bukchon Hanok Village. You get one photo per passage. At the gate, report whether anything changed. Three wrong reports end your run, and some anomalies come for you before you get there.

details.title: Toque: Restaurant Tycoon
details.short_description: A restaurant tycoon where you are part of the crew. Work wherever you want, in the kitchen, at the register or on the floor, build your place yourself and pick one of four restaurant types. Grow your menu with cooks who know the dishes and rise above the city's rival restaurants.

details.title: Monster Hunting Supplies
details.short_description: A supernatural mystery game where customers bring disturbing rumors and strange encounters to your workshop. Ask questions, study your field guide, and prepare the right ammunition. Every story holds a clue, and some are connected.

details.title: Second On Ice
details.short_description: Fast, top-down ice hockey with a story-driven single-player career. Skate, pass, check, and score from snowy neighborhood rinks to pro arenas as you step out of your brother's shadow. Play quick matches, league seasons, and international tournaments in a pixel-art hockey world.

details.title: XenoTrax
details.short_description: Race powerful alien off-road vehicles across five extraordinary worlds. Choose your driver, tackle rugged tracks, compete in championships, and chase your own ghost. Take on computer rivals or race with friends in up to four-player local split-screen.

details.title: Ocean Dredgers
details.short_description: Dive solo or with up to 3 friends, dredge sunken wrecks for lost treasures, brush and rinse your finds, and display them in your shipboard museum to earn upgrades and explore deeper waters in first or third person.

details.title: Paunchy Pets TD
details.short_description: A Paunchy Pets Tower Defense game. Stop the evil veggie army from stealing your candy stash. Build Paunchy Towers, draw Upgrade Cards to bolster your defenses, and smash all of the Veggie Bosses.

details.title: Cosa Nostra – The Dark Empire
details.short_description: From errand boy to godfather: build a criminal empire of protection rackets, moonshine and smuggling in a rain-soaked city, buy officials, make deals or wage war with six families and keep the Heat down. Turn-based mafia strategy with voice-over and multiple endings.

details.title: THE LAST DELIVERY
details.short_description: The world ended. The orders didn't. Deliver food and parcels across a dark neon city in VR: drive your own car, climb balconies and radio towers, fight off zombies, and spend every hard-earned euro turning an empty flat into a home.

details.title: Turika
details.short_description: Turika is a fast top-down action game for 1-8 players. Dungeons, monsters, weapons and loot - all the good stuff and moar!. No two dungeons are the same: the layout, monsters and prizes changes every time you go in. Play with your friends online or on the couch. It's fun! It really is!

details.title: Ex Simulacris
details.short_description: Challenge the Simulation in this sci-fi autobattler. Recruit a growing roster of unique Operators, design fireteams, deploy them into increasingly difficult battle sims, gather data, upgrade, and try again. Log in, Administrator – the Simulation awaits.

details.title: Toss-Up
details.short_description: Heads or tails? It's time for a Toss Up! Welcome to the dungeon where every toss matters. Strategically distribute your numbers and flip your coins to claim victory. Sometimes, you'll have to risk everything!

details.title: Silk Road Caravan: Desktop Idle
details.short_description: A little caravan, a long Silk Road. Trade 12 goods, open routes through 13 cities, collect illustrated travel memories and return home for lasting upgrades. Open your caravan journal when you have a moment; let the journey continue while you work.

details.title: Too Many Chickens
details.short_description: Too Many Chickens is a chaotic co-op game for 1-4 players. Chase, grab and throw runaway chickens, haul them to the barn, and turn deliveries into cash. Buy better tools, build chicken-catching contraptions, and pay off the farm’s debt. Your friends might help.

details.title: Puppet War
details.short_description: Puppet auto-battler. Shop, merge and arrange puppets, arm them with items and rings, and survive the boss at the end of each stage in the haunted theater. Play solo or with a friend.

details.title: Manes in Cadentia
details.short_description: A gothic narrative rhythm mystery inspired by Edgar Allan Poe. Follow a grieving woman through five theatrical acts where music, memory, and truth become one.

details.title: Juchetopia
details.short_description: Korea, 1953. The war is over and Moscow wants its money back. Rebuild the North, pay the Soviet installment every month, play the factions against each other with secret police files and decide whether the armistice line stays where it is

details.title: Marzu
details.short_description: Something ancient lives in these ruins, and it already knows you're here. Flee through shifting halls, tunnels, and forests as unseen entities hunt your every move. Solve environmental puzzles, evade ancient horrors, and uncover a truth that unravels reality itself.

details.title: Fusil
details.short_description: An action-adventure set in a weird fantasy world. Face levels where every shot counts: move silently to backstab enemies, use spells to unlock paths, and explore non-linear environments with multiple solutions. Choose your path, manage your ammo, and survive.

details.title: Roadside Reseal
details.short_description: A roadside store where the night never feels safe. Flickering lights, endless aisles, whispers from the dark. Each task feels like research into fear—you restock, you lock, you fight to keep the seal closed.The silence breaks, the air is heavy, and every moment is research into survival.

details.title: Mysteries of Black Hollow
details.short_description: The shop is yours by day. The dark belongs to something else. Raid the abandoned houses of a cursed town, drag your loot home before your lantern gives out, and spend everything you earn on rituals that might just save it or you.

details.title: Pillow Punk
details.short_description: Fight waves of enemies and towering bosses in a third-person action roguelite. Spend the points you earn on the Patch Board to build your own fighting style. Play solo or bring up to three friends into online co-op.

details.title: Picatso
details.short_description: Play as Picatso, a calico cat painter searching for a creative spark. Navigate through underground ruins with his ability to paint the environment which allow him to advance in this platforming adventure!

details.title: The Grant Grover Anthology
details.short_description: In Neo Naarm in the 22nd century, augmentation technology has run amok. Combining deduction, visual novel and point and click gameplay, play as Grant Grover, private detective, one of the only remaining citizens without augmentations, as he solves crimes across the city.

details.title: KLITTER
details.short_description: KLITTER fuses the precision of arena combat with the chaos of glitchcore and the flow of a movement-driven brawler. Every dash, every shot, every kill defines your rhythm - stop moving and you die, flow perfectly and the system collapses. PURE FLOW. ZERO MERCY.

details.title: Ducks in Disguise 2: Mythology
details.short_description: Hidden ducks are back in a world of myths and legends! Find hundreds of rubber ducks in hand-drawn mythic scenes, from Egyptian palaces to Norse halls and Japanese temples. Watch each sketch burst into color and collect ducks dressed as heroes, monsters and gods in a relaxing hidden object game.

details.title: So Stoked
details.short_description: A chill and cozy surf game about timing, flow, and discovery. Travel between islands, ride clean waves, and enjoy a calm, skill-driven ride with light RPG-style tasks and progression.

details.title: Zoomalia
details.short_description: In a world conquered by Zealotory harvesters, Zoomalia’s survival rests in your hands. Build a team of over 100 unique creatures, then fuse, evolve, and mutate them into powerful forms. Adapt your strategy, destroy obelisks, and reclaim the planet in this strategic roguelite.

details.title: Anna's Bakery Shop
details.short_description: You’re Anna, a young woman who ditches the boring city life to open a cozy bakery in a small town. Along with your animate mannequin friend Can Doe, you will embark on a delicious journey, decorate your beautiful shop and meet locals who are curious about the new bakery in their town.

details.title: Life Balance
details.short_description: A physics ragdoll climber where life choices become literal baggage. Climb a tower in the sky alone or in 2-player split-screen co-op: give each other a leg-up, grab each other, and share the load. Can you reach the top, or will your responsibilities drag you down?

details.title: The Final Like
details.short_description: THE FINAL LIKE. A fruit machine with a mind of its own. An authentic UK AWP simulator built around the world of social media - where the machine’s AI is watching, and has no intention of letting you walk away a winner.

details.title: Little Frontier
details.short_description: A story-rich Western tactical RPG set in 1836. Lead three mountain men across the vast, untamed American frontier. Explore the wilderness, engage in tactical turn-based combat, and navigate dangerous encounters where your decisions shape the story and the fate of your companions.

details.title: DORM
details.short_description: First-person horror. An old student dormitory in a provincial Eastern European town, strange residents, brutal encounters, blood, dark humor, and explicit scenes.

details.title: Breaking News Live
details.short_description: When the truth and business are at odds, money prevails. Shape the reality of others by curating which news are worth telling and which are worth altering.

details.title: Karusel
details.short_description: 1984. Denis is trapped in a never-ending summer day in a Soviet village. The sun is frozen at its zenith, and familiar paths lead to dark secrets. Uncover the nature of this anomaly and discover: what price must you pay to finally reach tomorrow?

details.title: Fast & Fractured
details.short_description: Step into typical Spanish sun-baked places and prepare for Fast & Fractured experience, a frenetic physics-based driving shooter for up to 8 contenders— in a chaotic multiplayer battle royale. Choose from 4 colorful elderly characters and battle in stereotypical Spanish maps

details.title: Beyond Lost Planets
details.short_description: Beyond Lost Planets is an intense Roguelike Dungeon Crawler Bullet Hell. Fight through enemies and bosses across procedural worlds. Everything from weapons and bullets to powerup and companions is represented with cards. Grow absurdly powerful and create wild, unique synergies every run!

details.title: Veiled Shadows
details.short_description: Live a month in a rural mountain town, build bonds, and hunt a mystery across two worlds. Manage your days, explore dungeons, and fight turn-based battles to recover what's been lost.

details.title: Cosmic Plague
details.short_description: A plague is silencing the galaxy one world at a time. Command a small ship and a frightened crew in this roguelike about outrunning it. Trade, fight and keep your ship alive as systems go dark behind you. Reach the Ark before it leaves, and pray you pass the scan. It only takes clean ships.

details.title: One Wrong Step
details.short_description: One wrong move can change everything... Explore trapped rooms in this tactical roguelite inspired by Minesweeper. Every square is a risk. Every exit, a choice. Think carefully... or start again.

details.title: Berrus
details.short_description: Berrus is an old-school online RPG. Explore, fight in real time, gather, craft and farm.

details.title: Car World
details.short_description: Car World is a realistic 2D driving and life simulator focused on true car ownership and maintenance. Drive, repair, and tune your vehicles, take jobs or trade them for profit. Every car system is simulated down to the smallest detail. Can you prove yourself as a true car enthusiast?

details.title: RoboFarm
details.short_description: Build, automate, and decorate your dream farm! Deploy robot workers, unlock powerful upgrades, and watch your crops thrive while you relax, raising profits to your satisfaction. Save and share your creations, tune in with the music, and experience the world of RoboFarm.

details.title: Grim Path
details.short_description: A roguelike card crawler where every step is a choice. Descend into dark dungeons, battle monsters, and face various encounters. Choose your gear wisely to survive and go even deeper.

details.title: Adventurer’s Guild Manager
details.short_description: Take charge of your own adventurers' guild in a cozy low-poly world. Write contracts, craft scrolls, trade with adventurers and help your guild grow.

details.title: Undead Night Crew
details.short_description: Run an undead cleaning crew in this online co-op bullet heaven roguelite. Recruit auto attacking followers, team up with friends, and build wild synergies to wipe out zombie hordes. Sign contracts, complete missions, earn cash, get stronger, and do it again!

details.title: WotaBeats
details.short_description: 《WotaBeats: Code Aria》 is a VR rhythm experience fusing music, idols, and energy. Swing your glowsticks, fight BUGs, and keep the stage alive—feel the beat, live the light. 「Feel the rhythm. Recode the idol.」

details.title: Bones will Fly: Tower Defense
details.short_description: A cozy 3D tower defense where every hit makes the bones fly! Build and upgrade towers, give them specializations and blast marching skeletons into bouncing, physics-driven bones. Watch the skies for flying skulls and defend 25 levels across meadow, snow, desert, lava and graveyard.

details.title: Treble-Basie
details.short_description: A throwback to retro collect-a-thon platformers! Treble-Basie features a comprehensive moveset, old-school graphics, nostalgic soundtrack, and much more!

details.title: Blood of the North
details.short_description: A survival game with roguelite elements where you build, fight, and explore the northern islands to reclaim what was lost.

details.title: CardArena
details.short_description: Watch the battle unfold as you shape your deck, find new gear and create epic synergies. Climb the arena in this roguelite deckbuilding auto battler.

details.title: Epic Idlenture
details.short_description: Epic Idlenture is a pixel-art idle dungeon crawler. You play as a bear taking on endless depths. Let the fast-paced combat handle itself while you focus on building the ultimate hero: equip rare loot, level up your attributes, and unleash devastating skills to clear every floor.

details.title: Zeroth
details.short_description: Guide fallen heroes through a post-life adventure in the absurd and ever-changing 0th circle of Haell. Exploit the sandbox physics and experiment with mysterious treasure to postpone your inevitable death. Emergent chaos and exasperated heroes, only in Zeroth.

details.title: Neighborhood Video
details.short_description: Crack the case of the missing video store employee in this 3D point and click mystery game by solving escape room puzzles, combing the computer database, and scouring shelves as an undercover detective posing as a cashier during your first weekend at the suspiciously understaffed Neighborhood Video.

details.title: Only Booze: Liquor Store Simulator
details.short_description: When an alcoholic opens a liquor store… what could go wrong? Run, manage, and grow your own liquor empire in a dynamic market where prices change daily, trends shift overnight, and your reputation lives or dies on social media. This isn’t just another shop simulator. Welcome to OnlyBooze.

details.title: ACE – Tennis is Life
details.short_description: Victoria von Arndt has it all: a villa, champagne, a world ranking. Then the tax investigators ring the doorbell. Arcade tennis with diving saves and special shots, 36 wild tournaments from Monte Carlo to a motorway services, and a fully voiced comic story from riches to Germany's rust belt.

details.title: Ink Ascension
details.short_description: Ink Ascension is a turn-based roguelite where your arsenal is a board of powerful tiles. Choose an Aspect, wield different Inks, and chain attacks, transformations, and reactions into devastating turns. Gather new powers, reshape your build, and fight through a world ruled by ancient god.

details.title: Dash Hounds
details.short_description: Four paws. No brakes. DashHounds is a high-speed futuristic racing game where dogs take the place of machines. Race through sci-fi courses at blistering speeds. Winning takes sharp reflexes and nerves of steel.

details.title: Echo Walker: Tactics
details.short_description: Lead the last survivors across a broken Earth - and turn the train that carries them into a home that grows after every battle. Every attack shows its odds first, on a grid you can read in a glance. A full 5-chapter campaign; Chapter 1 is a free demo with a save that carries over.

details.title: Riftium Battles
details.short_description: The autobattler where you choose what to destroy. Target enemy buildings mid-battle to cripple their economy, weapons or defenses. Build and expand your sci-fi war machine. Unlock adjacency synergies and break the game. Become the ultimate Rift Commander in this PvE roguelite autobattler.

details.title: The Witch’s Errand
details.short_description: A cozy hidden object adventure about Myrta, a kind but absent-minded witch, and her new assistant. Explore magical locations, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and save the Whispering Forest.

details.title: Kingdom of the Sand Sea
details.short_description: Build an oasis city in a hand-painted desert. Manage resources, defend your walls, and conquer bandit kingdoms. Trade supplies with friends, capture and raise dragons, command their attacks, and soar with them above the battlefield.

details.title: Before We Sink
details.short_description: Your island is sinking and the sea rises every minute. Gather wood, patch a wrecked boat and escape before the water swallows everything. Explore cursed islands, fight pirates and skeletons, and sail a galleon through storms, alone or in co-op for up to 5 players.

details.title: Pickfall
details.short_description: Swing your pickaxe at the rock. Every cell you break charges a bar, and a full bar births a thrown pickaxe that digs beside you until it shatters. Collect what the rock dropped, buy the upgrade you can see, and dig a deeper shaft next round. A short mining incremental in ink on paper.

details.title: WE MUST DESTROY THE MOON
details.short_description: A co-op game for 1-6 players where you dig, destroy, and detonate your way to the centre of the moon to uncover what lies at it's core. Commit space crimes with your friends as you upgrade your mining equipment and unlock explosives to get the job done. Do you have what it takes to DESTROY THE MOON?

details.title: Animal Sokoban Endless
details.short_description: Four animals, four ways to move boxes: a cat, an elephant, a boar and a kangaroo. Learn their rules in handcrafted stages, then get fresh Endless puzzles every time you play, including hard ones that stump seasoned puzzlers. Go for the Master achievements.

details.title: Misconstruct
details.short_description: A 2-4 player physics co-op about building a house from a plan only one of you can see. Shout the plan across the site, throw the bricks, plaster over the mistakes, then stand back while the inspector decides what you've built. Best with 3-4 friends who don't listen

details.title: Until Broken
details.short_description: A room-by-room action roguelike where everything you carry wears out. Weapons and charms share three slots and weaken as you use them. Descend ten floors, face a boss on each, and choose what to keep along the way.

details.title: Taso Idle
details.short_description: Taso Idle is an incremental game where you flip tasos at recess and sell your stack for cash. Rip open snack packs for rare tasos, buy upgrades and leave the collecting to your little brothers. The bullies can take everything but your name. Start with a bottle cap, become the Schoolyard Legend.

details.title: LIGHTBAIT
details.short_description: Every light is a temptation. Circle it to build speed and score, then launch to the next before the heat catches you. LIGHTBAIT is a fast-paced arcade roguelite where every extra orbit is a gamble.

details.title: Ritsudo
details.short_description: Ritsudo is a minimalist 3-key rhythm game for your own music. Drop in any MP3, OGG or WAV and it builds a map of the song, with five difficulties. You can also make your own maps in the editor or download them from the community. Play with mods or open a room online with up to 8 friends.

details.title: My Crazy Stupid Pong Life
details.short_description: One summer, one paddle, and a megacorp that wants every court in the city... Life gets weird when every problem is settled over Ping Pong.

details.title: Automyth: Maze Defense
details.short_description: Automyth is an auto battler with roguelite and tower defense elements. Draft towers and buffs, deploy bronze automata, and place gates to funnel enemies into traps. Merge your towers and adapt to enemy resistances as the maze grows, with hand-drawn art inspired by Ancient Greek pottery.

details.title: The King's Command
details.short_description: Your king's life is your currency. Every soldier you summon is carved out of him, and every enemy you kill comes back as blood. No dice, no misses — you see the exact result before you commit. Four kings. One board that keeps growing.

details.title: Jamo Baduk
details.short_description: Go on boards shaped like Korean letters. Boards that bend and open like ㄹ and ㅍ make every game a new fight. Standard Go capture rules apply. New players can start with a 5-minute prologue. Chain short games into an expedition, meet 20 figures from Go history, and collect relics and cards.

details.title: Dirty Kicker - A Foosball Game
details.short_description: Fast-paced arcade table football built around razor-sharp precision, tight angles, hard shots, and split-second reactions. Master manual rod control, thread lethal bank shots, and make reflex saves. Conquer solo tournament brackets with tactical upgrades or duel head-to-head in 1v1.

details.title: Archivist
details.short_description: You are the only clerk in an underground archive. The man at the counter describes a killer, and you find their file among the shelves. Get it wrong and someone dies. Behind the back door, something hungry is waiting, and the only thing it eats is files. No one has ever retired from this archive.

details.title: motor party
details.short_description: Customize your favorite ride and tear through mountain trails and open fields. Go wild in the arena, challenge friends or ride solo across a variety of game modes!

details.title: The King's Clerk
details.short_description: The King's laws are short, vague and badly written. As his Clerk for one year, you decide what they mean, and the whole kingdom reads your rulings very closely, looking for the loopholes you didn't mean to leave.

details.title: Motorsport Dynasty Manager
details.short_description: Build your team, develop your cars and bikes, and call race strategy from the pit wall. Choose from 70 championships across seven motorsport disciplines, balancing race-day decisions with the work that shapes your next season.

details.title: Frankenstein: Awakening of Horror
details.short_description: Uncover Frankenstein’s dark secret and survive a terrifying Gothic nightmare

details.title: Circuit Ten: Idle Grand Prix
details.short_description: Merge two identical cars into a faster one. Combine cute neon race cars, send them onto the track, and earn prize money every lap to grow your team. Customize your ride with paints, wheels, underglow and nitro flames. Beat your rivals one by one and conquer every circuit in this idle merge racer.

details.title: Dice Must Work
details.short_description: One button. Infinite luck. You’re the newest Luck Operator at Fortunex Corp. Roll dice slot machines, buy and combine dice, upgrade everything, gamble every ticket and pick roguelite badges for bizarre clients. No tutorial needed: just roll.

details.title: Breachpoint
details.short_description: Plan the route, set the go-codes, kick the door. BREACHPOINT is a top-down pixel-art SWAT tactics game for PC and Mac: a 25-chapter story campaign, a roguelite Operations mode, animal-masked gangsters and a multi-storey map editor. Fully offline single player.

details.title: The Peninsula's Downfall
details.short_description: After a brutal civil war in the 2020s, the nation once called the "Republic of Korea" is finally gone. On the divided peninsula of 2030, lead a nation with a fate of its own: command your divisions, build your economy, and decide whether to return to Seoul's rule or break with the past forever.

details.title: Goblins Go North
details.short_description: A fantasy auto-battler where Goblins raid the Viking North! Recruit and customize goblins, equip them with found loot, build your formation, and watch your horde crush the enemy. Conquer settlements, collect legendary gear, and fight your way to the Jarl’s Hall!

details.title: Leeway: Lightkeeper
details.short_description: The lighthouse has reopened after years, and you are the strait's only watchman. Ships are lining up: read their papers, verify the data, talk over the radio, and decide who gets through. A quiet job in clear weather. Not once the rain starts, and you can't trust your instruments either.

details.title: Greatest President Ever
details.short_description: You are President John D. Morron, and term limits say you have to leave. You have 15 days to collect seven signatures on the amendment that lets you stay. Stamp laws, black out leaked photos, launder cash and lean on politicians while the FBI gets closer.

details.title: Souls of Avelor
details.short_description: Slay monsters as a forgotten soul, gather the Souls they carry and reawaken the silent Portals of Avelor. An idle runner RPG that keeps playing while you're away: upgrade at the Forge, Awaken to grow stronger, collect runes, raise a Skeleton Legion and explore dark-fantasy realms.

details.title: By the Coast
details.short_description: Build a coastal village, then watch it come to life. Watch neighbours settle in, children play, cats wander the streets, and seabirds circle overhead as your little village grows. No goals, no timers, just relaxing creativity.

details.title: Roomies: Co-op Life Sim
details.short_description: A co-op life sim for 1-8 players online. Each of you plays a housemate. Build the house together, pay the rent from one shared jar, cook for each other and throw parties. Someone will set the kitchen on fire.

details.title: All That Junk
details.short_description: A first-person junkyard sorting game. Lift scrap with a gravity gun, then build a factory of belts, cranes, magnets, screens, shakers and eddy separators that sorts steel, copper, aluminium, lead, plastic and rubber by what they feel: size, weight, magnetism and conductivity.

details.title: Confiscated!
details.short_description: Your phone has been confiscated. So has everyone's stuff. It's all locked in the caretaker's office, and he's still in the building. A short first-person comedy-horror chase through a British primary school: sneak, distract, and leg it before the bell.

details.title: The Graveyard Diner
details.short_description: Work the night shift at a small diner next to a cemetery. To cut costs, steal offerings from the graves to cook meals for customers, while keeping the monsters in the cemetery at bay, cleaning up the diner, and following the daily employee rules.

details.title: Tales of Twilight
details.short_description: Deploy your familiars, then fight beside them as the witch Emily in a single-player RPG blending tactical preparation with side-scrolling real-time combat. Raise your companions, study magic, and explore the story of a town under an endless night with Dark, a talking winged cat.

details.title: Ium Idle Companions Odyssey
details.short_description: Monster-collecting auto-battler desktop companion. Assemble, customize, strategize elemental synergies, craft powerful skill loadouts, and conquer regions as your squad fights autonomously in fast-paced real-time combat at the edge of your screen while you work, study, or play.

details.title: Apartment Empire
details.short_description: Build your own apartment empire, one floor at a time. Design flats, collect rent, manage tenants with very different needs, and try to keep everyone happy. Meet colourful characters, uncover their stories, and discover that some residents are not entirely from around here.
developers: I Was Supposed to Be Studying for My Exams and find an intern but Somehow I make a game and became a Game Developer and Accidentally Started My Own Studio Despite Having Absolutely No Experience, No Employees, No Budget, and No Idea How My Life Works, but Now I've Already Paid Steam $100 So I Guess I Have No Choice but to Finish This Game Before My Parents Find Out That I've Been Spending More Time Debugging Unity Than Studying for My Degree, and Even Though I Promised Myself I'd Go to Bed After Fixing Just One More Bug, It's Already 5 AM and the Bug Has Somehow Become a Feature.™
publishers: I Was Supposed to Be Studying for My Exams and find an intern but Somehow I make a game and became a Game Developer and Accidentally Started My Own Studio Despite Having Absolutely No Experience, No Employees, No Budget, and No Idea How My Life Works, but Now I've Already Paid Steam $100 So I Guess I Have No Choice but to Finish This Game Before My Parents Find Out That I've Been Spending More Time Debugging Unity Than Studying for My Degree, and Even Though I Promised Myself I'd Go to Bed After Fixing Just One More Bug, It's Already 5 AM and the Bug Has Somehow Become a Feature.™

details.title: The Hearth That Waits
details.short_description: Build your whole party around one shared dice roll. Every companion reads the same result through their own runes, then acts in turn to chain combos. Plan your team in town, then set out on a warm, light-hearted fantasy adventure.

details.title: Cursed Luck
details.short_description: The Devil owns your debt. The reels hold your fate. Cursed Luck is a dark fantasy roguelite where you build powerful symbol combinations, unleash explosive chain reactions, and bend luck in your favor. Chase massive wins, survive rising demands, and pay your debt before the Devil claims your soul.

details.title: Junk Mountain
details.short_description: Dig through mountains of junk for a hard drive holding 8,000 bitcoin. Find drives, test them on a computer and follow five clues from a backyard junkyard to orbit. Sell scrap, upgrade tools and hire workers to build a junkyard that runs itself.

details.title: Kixball
details.short_description: Kixball is top-down physics football where you are one player on the pitch. No animations, no auto-aim: just you, the ball and the walls. Train, earn transfer offers and rise from the lowest division in your career, or play with up to 3 friends on one screen.

details.title: Deep Rescue
details.short_description: Pilot a small rescue sub through a dark, glowing ocean. Gather schools of glowfish in your beam, outwit poachers, lead rare animals home and stay clear of the Gloam, the huge thing in the deep that hunts anything that glows.

details.title: Lost Subject
details.short_description: You are the result of a mysterious experiment, trapped in a dark underground facility. Solve puzzles, explore dangerous locations, unlock new characters, battle bosses, and find your way to freedom!

details.title: My Little Animal Care Center
details.short_description: Run a cozy little animal clinic in the heart of a colorful town! Treat hurt pets on the care table, pamper your boarders in their pens, welcome over a dozen species and grow your small center into a whole neighborhood of care.

details.title: Fish Gone Wild
details.short_description: Swallow smaller fish, grow into bigger ones, and chase the predator you were running from. Pick cards to change how you hunt and dive in solo or with up to three friends. Just watch who gets bigger: you can eat each other too.

details.title: Arena Shooter
details.short_description: Hop in a tank. Call in a nuke. Flatten the fortress. Battle your friends and bots in a top-down arena shooter with 20 unique maps and modes, 60+ vehicle types, 40+ perks, zombie hordes and a classic Zombie Boss, in a fully destructible world where everything goes.

details.title: Taco Truck Simulator
details.short_description: You will run your own food truck: take orders, cook fresh ingredients, and quickly assemble delicious tacos while hungry customers wait in line. But running a food truck is about more than speed: source supplies wisely, maintain steady cash flow, and win over diners with every satisfying bite

details.title: Super Doodle Mega War
details.short_description: Bring your notebook doodles to life! Build an army of scribbled soldiers, upgrade and merge your auto-battling troops, and unleash skills against overwhelming enemy hordes. A roguelite auto-battler where one little doodle becomes a mighty army.

details.title: CULET
details.short_description: Strike a glowing crystal monolith until it shatters. Every click cracks it further, shards break off and become currency, and upgrades carry you through twelve crystals, from Amethyst to Diamond. A focused, finite clicker about one beautiful object and the joy of breaking it.

details.title: SEAM VR
details.short_description: SEAM is a VR voxel survival sandbox where your hands reshape the world. Use gravity gloves to gather resources, dig into the landscape, and build a home block by block. Explore, craft, and turn the wilderness into a place of your own.

details.title: Fastfood Burger Stories
details.short_description: Manage your own fast-food restaurant: take orders, cook meals, serve customers, and hire staff. Furnish and customize your restaurant, manage supplies, upgrade equipment, and grow a small burger joint into a large restaurant.

details.title: Toad Roller
details.short_description: A timed nervous arcade platformer where a punk toad spirals his way up rotating towers. 3 worlds, 30 towers, 3 stars per tower to earn against the clock, local and world best times, and a level editor to build your own towers.

details.title: DEKABUTU
details.short_description: The giant raid boss is played by a human. DEKABUTU is an asymmetric shooter where one player becomes the boss and faces a squad of soldiers. Tanks, healers and attackers team up in first person, while the boss surveys the field and picks where and when to strike. Outwit friends, then swap roles.

details.title: We Are Bodies
details.short_description: Drag a sinner to Hell, where he belongs! In this physics-based co-op puzzle platformer for 1-2 players, you play as rookie devils who can only control one leg each. Stumble, dodge and solve your way through the chaos to drop him into the pit of Hell.

details.title: Waymark
details.short_description: Waymark blends scenic jigsaw puzzles with deckbuilding and spell combos. Build your spell deck, rotate and place puzzle pieces, and chain effects to take on monsters. Explore city landmarks, collect local souvenirs, and fill your travel journal with the places you discover.

details.title: Beneath the Pile
details.short_description: A cozy first-person organization and tidying game. Sift through piles, recover broken workstations, process materials at five hands-on stations, and build a magical production line to complete the King's shipment.

details.title: SUPRA CAELIS
details.short_description: Crash-landed on an alien world, fleeing a war you no longer believe in. You'll have to cross two planets on opposite ends of existence, guided by a dormant robot carrying secrets of its own. Explore. Scavenge. Uncover the truth behind the conflict that shaped both your fates.

details.title: Whispers
details.short_description: Whispers is a psychological horror game where you explore an abandoned hospital, investigate its dark secrets, and follow the final footage of a missing vlogger. Listen for unsettling whispers, uncover clues, and navigate a reality where you can no longer trust what you see or hear.

details.title: Railminer
details.short_description: Turn a tiny drill into a massive mining machine. Extract resources, sell your haul, and expand your train with cutters, lasers, rockets, and drones. Every run pays for your next upgrade in this incremental mining game.

details.title: How to Save the Villainess
details.short_description: You've woken up as a novel's hero—but it's the doomed villainess you want to save! Make friends at a magic academy and build your own spell deck in this roguelite RPG meets visual novel. No matter how many times you start over, you're determined to give her a happy ending!

details.title: Crimson Ocean
details.short_description: Pilot an upgradeable combat boat against swarms of alien harvesting machines in this top-down naval action game. Dodge ramming hulls, unleash guns, missiles, and torpedoes, and turn wreckage into firepower. To them, you’re raw material.

details.title: Toss It
details.short_description: Don't like long, ugly conveyor belts? Neither do we. In Toss It, the machines just throw the crates at each other! Grow the factory & keep the trucks full. Totally safe!

details.title: Flying Disc League
details.short_description: The ultimate frisbee simulator. Competitive online multiplayer from 2v2 to 7v7: pick the throw, set the power, release it and the disc flies like it does in real life. Hit the open pass, fake out your defender, lay out for the catch. Play with friends, against rivals, or train vs bots.

details.title: The Gigglebone Gang: Infinity City
details.short_description: Hop in Zack's taxicab and tour Infinity City with the Gigglebone Gang! 50 stimulating, song-filled early math activities teach kids ages 4–8 counting, shapes, time, money, and problem-solving, and it all feels like play. A Headbone Interactive classic, back for a new generation.

details.title: Asteroid Mining Corporation
details.short_description: Blast asteroids, collect resources, upgrade your mining systems, and build an increasingly absurd mining operation for the galaxy's only trillionaire. Every asteroid destroyed brings you closer to unimaginable wealth. Unfortunately, most of it belongs to the corporation.

details.title: DENIED: Zarya-9
details.short_description: Winter 1986. You work the night shift at checkpoint ZARYA-9: read the papers, query the registry, rule on every car. Every mistake is cited. At home, a family waits on your pay. Ten nights. The rulebook grows. Around the fifth night, the cars stop making sense.

details.title: The Gigglebone Gang World Tour
details.short_description: Pack your bags! Rapu and the Gigglebone Gang are off to ten countries — India, Egypt, Japan, Peru and more — for 50 fun activities, songs, stories and hidden-object hunts. See the world without leaving the couch. A restored 1996 Headbone Interative classic.

details.title: I'll Pay Tomorrow
details.short_description: A real-time management game. You're the new caretaker of a run-down hostel, on a 14-day trial: decide who gets a room from what you see at the desk, collect rent door to door at night, fix what breaks, and choose how dirty your hands get.

details.title: Pocket Orbit
details.short_description: Explore strange planets as a space cat. Choose a place to settle, deploy a habitat, gather resources and build your home by hand. Pilot your own ship, discover a Moon community, and make a life between adventures, alone or with a friend in co-op.

details.title: Balls in Windows
details.short_description: Real websites become ball contraptions. Arrange browser windows, bounce balls off buttons, and turn links into portals in a playful physics puzzle game. Find a useful edge, try another angle, and guide five balls from A to B.

name: Iz and Auggie: Escape from Dimension Q

details.title: Iz and Auggie: Escape from Dimension Q
details.short_description: Bandmates Iz and her robot Auggie wrote a killer song. Cosmo LaRue stole it. Recover the song from Dimension Q in this animated point-and-click puzzle adventure from 1996: descramble codes, outrun the Q cops, crack a musical lock, and rescue missing secret agents.

details.title: Carbon Conservatory
details.short_description: A psychedelic botanical bullet hell with the bones of a Souls-like. Parry the overgrowth's fire back into it, seed husks until they rupture, and chain their deaths into blooms. Dash, graze and run your living gun hot through a dying glasshouse refuge, and take on bosses that punish every mistake.

details.title: Jack & Snag
details.short_description: Grapple into a new angle and turn robot fights in your favour. Jack & Snag is an arena FPS for 1–6 participants, with one- and two-handed weapons, colourful arenas and bots to practise against on your own.

details.title: Room on Earth
details.short_description: A room. Probably on Earth. Somehow, it is always night, with no bearings beyond the window. Room on Earth is a 3D sandbox for building, decorating and collecting. Arrange your space, gather things you love, and make a corner into an animated wallpaper. Outside can wait.

details.title: AfterShift
details.short_description: Change the past, rewrite the present. Shift through three moments of a catastrophic accident, solve time-bending puzzles, escape a secret facility, and decide which of your coworkers you can save.

details.title: NoroiStation
details.short_description: This console is cursed. Play the cartridges one by one on an old CRT. If something is wrong, reset at once.

details.title: Crown Without a King
details.short_description: Your abilities evolve. Build a fantasy party, develop and modify its abilities, and master your weapons. Forge and enchant gear, choose where to strike in turn-based battles, and prepare Emberwatch for the coming invasion.

details.title: Velma's Costume Closet
details.short_description: Velma and Rapu are off on a twenty-country dress-up tour, and you pick the outfits. Mix and match traditional costumes and have fun with the fully animated skits. Put on a show and print your own paper dolls. A fully restored 1997 Headbone Interactive classic.

details.title: Deckwork
details.short_description: Build a six-card deck that fights for you. Draft, reorder and sacrifice cards to forge synergies, bend the rules with relics and lead three heroes through dungeons and fearsome bosses in this pixel-art fantasy auto-battler roguelite.

details.title: Strive Card
details.short_description: Strive Card is a deckbuilding roguelike won with Niu Niu poker hands. Build a five-card Niu Niu, line your Strive Cards up so additive bonuses feed the multipliers, reshape your deck with Tech Cards, and clear 24 solar terms and 8 stage bosses to push one hand into the billions.

details.title: No Pose, No Mercy
details.short_description: Paint, survive, and create your own character poses in a fast-paced multiplayer game with runtime Control Rig customization.

details.title: Clean 'Em Ocean
details.short_description: An incremental game about cleaning the ocean with a speedboat, unlocking upgrades, and cleaning more trash. Will you save the ocean?

details.title: Warbuddies
details.short_description: WarBuddies blends team building, skirmish wargaming, and card-based combat. Lead your friendly buddies creatures in a hex-based battlefield, capture objectives, and outwit your rival in tactical clashes.

details.title: Gamblemon
details.short_description: Gamblemon is a roguelike deckbuilder built around a slot machine. Place your Gamblemon and items in the lanes, spin the machine, and trigger synergies by matching elements across the lanes. Buy items, evolve your Gamblemon, and reach the target score before you run out of spins.

details.title: Forsythia
details.short_description: 1592, the Imjin War. Lead Yi Sun-sin, Gwon Yul, and other real commanders through seven years of war between Joseon, Ming, and Japan. Fight real-time encounter battles, command a fleet of panokseon warships, and craft your own equipment. A single-player campaign drawn from the historical record.

details.title: Go & Bust
details.short_description: Go-Stop, the classic Korean card game, meets poker and roguelike deckbuilding. Match cards, push your luck with GO or cash out with STOP, rig the table with 28 shady items, and bankrupt three ghost dealers, from a back-alley den to a luxury casino cruise.

details.title: NULL.REF EXODUS
details.short_description: A frenetic 1-4 player co-op roguelite TPS. Inside the ship carrying humanity's last backup, create your own weapon, scale it to absurd levels, and defend every sector from relentless swarms and colossal bosses.

details.title: Chartward
details.short_description: Rise from the slums to your own ship in an open-world pirate RPG distilled into incremental play. Sail uncharted seas, board vessels and plunder their riches. Choose your quests, dive for treasure and earn permanent keepsake upgrades across repeated lives.

details.title: Million Tiles
details.short_description: A quake shook 6,098 glazed tiles loose across an old voxel palace. Pick each one up and set it back on its chalked spot. Earn coins, buy better tools, fire cracked tiles in the kiln and open the palace one room at a time.

details.title: An Immortal's Journey
details.short_description: Begin a second life as an outer disciple in this cultivation RPG and visual novel. Choose your scripture, train, craft, take commissions, fight demon beasts, and get to know your fellow disciples as you balance daily sect life with the pursuit of immortality.

details.title: Desktop Cultivation
details.short_description: A pixel cultivation game on your taskbar: control your character to cultivate, make pills, grow spirit fields, train, forge treasures, and craft formations—no switching screens or pausing work. Collect all artifacts and advance from Qi Refining to Deity Transformation.

details.title: Samsara Hallway
details.short_description: Find the anomalies by day. Survive the night. Trapped in an endless school hallway, you must notice what has changed to move forward. But when night falls, a killer begins to hunt. Hide, run, and find three keys to escape.

details.title: Just! Yell! FireBall!
details.short_description: Turn your voice into magic in this chaotic online PvP party game! Shout spells into your microphone, collect magic scrolls, dodge incoming attacks, and blast your rivals away in colorful arenas. Challenge friends, other players, or bots!

details.title: Touhou Minesweeper Night
details.short_description: Minesweeper meets Gensokyo! Touhou Minesweeper Night blends classic Minesweeper logic with roguelite builds. Read the numbers, flag dangers, and combine the girls' abilities with random items to tackle changing boards and unravel the incident shrouding Gensokyo.

details.title: Crownkeeper
details.short_description: Ride out by day, hire villagers and give them a trade, pay for every wall and tower coin by coin. When dusk falls, portals open on four sides. Hold the line until dawn, rebuild what was lost, and push your settlement outward until the portals themselves fall.

details.title: Liquidation Inc.
details.short_description: A co-op physics horror for 1-4 friends: buy out the contents of haunted, foreclosed homes and haul everything to your van before the timer runs out. Every scratch costs money - and something still lives there.

details.title: Rainfed
details.short_description: Build and run your own farm in a pixel-art management sim. Grow crops, breed livestock and turn your harvest into products to sell. Buy land and machinery, hire workers and set plans to keep the work moving. Expand the business, shape the farm and try not to go broke.

details.title: They Are Zombies
details.short_description: Gather by day. Survive by night. Team up with friends, collect resources, and craft what you need before the zombies come. Survive 15 nights of attacks—and find out whether your brilliant plan can actually get you through to morning.

name: Curator: Tidy Up the Sleeping Gallery!

details.title: Curator: Tidy Up the Sleeping Gallery!
details.short_description: Become the curator of a vast, magical museum! In this relaxing game, find the right place for over 3,000 paintings, restore damaged works and uncover their fascinating stories. Upgrade your curator, work faster and unlock new galleries!

details.title: Just Like the Photo
details.short_description: Someone turned these homes upside down. Now it’s your job to put them back together. Play solo or with friends and use photos taken before the mess to return every item to its original spot.

details.title: Someone Else's Number
details.short_description: Your new phone number used to belong to someone else. At 2:14 AM, a stranger still writes to it. A romance played entirely on your phone in 2011: make friends, fall for someone, and decide what to do with a secret that was never meant for you.

details.title: NEW COLD WAR
details.short_description: Lead the United States or China in a turn-based strategy board game. Play cards, expand your influence, and compete across six regions while managing the technology race and a global crisis that could end the game.

details.title: Arcane Reckoning
details.short_description: Skill-shot wizard battles for up to 12 players. Aim every spell by hand, knock rivals into lava and the void, and survive arenas guarded by ancient bosses. Free-for-all or 2–4 teams, a spell shop between rounds, and bots that fill every empty slot.

details.title: Oath of the Huan
details.short_description: 100,000+ simulated soldiers on screen: Take the reins as the Son of Heaven in this massive stylized RTS with visuals inspired by Chinese traditional paintings and groundbreaking real time simulation. Titans, cataclysmic world-shattering events.

details.title: HYVE
details.short_description: HYVE is a competitive online 2v2 card game set in a cyberpunk future. Build your deck, team up with another Hacker, and combine your cards to create powerful synergies. Infiltrate the enemy network and destroy their C.O.R.E.

details.title: Hit the Anvil
details.short_description: Hammer the anvil, forge gear, sell it for gold and grow your forge. Advance to Swordmaster, Mage, Necromancer or Shadow Rogue and unleash class skills that fill the screen and reinforce all your loot at once. A pixel-art incremental crafting game with masteries, gems, charms and puzzles. Free demo.

details.title: Handful of Dice
details.short_description: Handful of Dice is a digital dice tray for tabletop RPGs and board games. Pick up your dice, shake them and throw. Only physics decides what they roll. Customise your dice however you like. Make your own dice sets and use them whenever you want.

details.title: Learn Abroad: Japanese
details.short_description: Learn Japanese through a cozy study-abroad simulation. Attend guided classes, practice with interactive activities, and complete homework to earn money. Explore Shibuya, recharge at cafés and ramen shops, and build a daily routine around learning something new.

details.title: Tiny Vessel
details.short_description: A companion idle ARPG that lives beside whatever you are doing. A tiny crew of crash-landed survivors fights along an alien walkway while you work: real loot, a Relay to grow the vessel, depths that demand better gear. Progress keeps going while you are away.

details.title: Emanet: What Was Left Behind
details.short_description: Datça, 1987. Run a seaside left-luggage counter: compare claim tickets, items and the ledger, catch the lies and decide who walks away with what. By night, chase Elif, who vanished seven years ago, through crayon-drawn dreams that regain their colour as you draw near.

details.title: Three Kingdoms: Art of Command
details.short_description: Three Kingdoms: Art of Command is a turn-based strategy game on a hanji paper map. Command paper armies, use your officers' tactics, and fight duels. Receive envoys and negotiate pacts in your audience hall. Govern cities and fight for the realm with 610 officers across 7 scenarios.

details.title: Too Angry to Clean
details.short_description: A co-op destruction game for 1-4 players where the best weapon against the undead is a falling house. Tear down walls, towers and castles with magic and bury undead hordes under the rubble. Level up and unlock new spells. Set records and find out who’s strongest in an arena you can wreck too.

details.title: Deadline Detective
details.short_description: An offbeat retrofuturistic deduction game: build your career across hundreds of investigations. For each, you have 48 hours and one accusation. Question and confront suspects, rise through the ranks, and unlock new tools. The same mysterious signature keeps appearing: the Archivist’s.

details.title: Inspector 101
details.short_description: Welcome, Inspector 101. Rest assured, you are totally not in a simulation. Step into the border security booth at District 122. Inspect documents, and keep an eye out for contraband. Remember: bribes are illegal, stealing is wrong, and exploding is highly discouraged.

details.title: Clash of Pantheons
details.short_description: The gods wage war over one continent in pursuit of faith. March armies, conquer cities, and command generals and their troops in formation battles. Capture enemy generals and bring them under your banner.

details.title: Klocky
details.short_description: The world moves too fast. Fit gears under the lamp and hear your machine’s first tick. Klocky is a calm clockwork-building game where every tooth drives the next. Follow hand-drawn plans and discover mechanical history and ingenuity through engraving-style illustrated books.

name: Restfield: Tidy Up the Pet Cemetery

details.title: Restfield: Tidy Up the Pet Cemetery
details.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game in a pet cemetery. Sort 1,093 headstones by animal and cross-reference photographs to put every stone back where it belongs. No timers, no penalties. Just you, the quiet, and a lot of pets somebody loved.

details.title: Exile: Idle ARPG
details.short_description: Diablo Rifts. Path of Exile Crafting. Epic Drops, deep crafting, leaderboards, and an Idle ARPG built for people who love ARPGs.

name: The Tidy TeaShop: Tidy Up the Tea Collection

details.title: The Tidy TeaShop: Tidy Up the Tea Collection
details.short_description: Tidy Up 2130 tea boxes with no time limits in this cosy organising game. Read the labels and study the packaging to return every blend to its proper shelf. Organise the shop and help the occasional customer find the tea they want, always at your own peaceful pace.

details.title: Elven Age
details.short_description: An old-school isometric MMORPG with no classes: the weapon in your hand decides what you can do. Train your skills by using them, hunt a hand-crafted world, and risk it all — die and you drop your entire inventory. Party up, found a guild, buy a house, and earn your place.

name: 八部寛のホームページ

details.title: 八部寛のホームページ
details.short_description: A night shift job paying 88,888 yen a day. Your task is to monitor 'Hiroshi Hachibe's Homepage' on the office PC. If you spot an anomaly, destroy the PC; if everything looks normal, just clock out. Survive all 8 days without missing a single anomaly.

details.title: Stupid Tankers
details.short_description: Play as “Ze Germans” in World War II: four friends, one tank, and a chaotic co-op adventure blasting your way to the front.

details.title: Graveheart
details.short_description: A retro FPS where William Wallace is back from the dead, Scotland is invading England, and your cursed weapons keep switching themselves at the worst possible moment.

details.title: There Is Eternal War
details.short_description: An RTS game set in a dark sci-fi fantasy universe where you command thousands of units on a huge map without breaking your PC. Dystopian humans, evil elves, greedy dwarves, or relentless undead are all playable factions in a game that has a grand campaign and two story campaigns.

details.title: TidyUp 2000
details.short_description: A cozy desktop organizing simulator where you sort thousands of scattered files into their correct folders. Upgrade your computer as you organize more files and turn a messy desktop into a perfectly sorted one.

details.title: Othercrown
details.short_description: A deck-building auto-battler roguelite where you build your own slot machine to deploy monsters and cast spells against the human kingdoms. Mutate your creatures, and maximize your slots to deploy as many creatures and spells as you can during your fights against the human kingdoms.

details.title: Chronicle of Gods
