details.short_description: You are one god in a pantheon of rivals. On living worlds of wandering peoples, rising cities and warring realms, gods compete for faith and mortals toil. Older than any realm, the Chronicle remembers the deeds of mortals and gods alike. Can anyone prove which were yours?

details.title: Mame, Kana Desktop Companion
details.short_description: Learn hiragana and katakana without sitting down for it. Mame is a desktop companion who turns your idle moments into tiny, painless reviews: spaced-repetition drills for kana and vocabulary, with no streaks and no guilt. A study buddy in the corner of your screen.

details.title: Arborist
details.short_description: Build a garden, survive the forecast, and follow a trail of birds through wild habitats in this cozy roguelike card game. Discover new cards, tools, and enchantments as you shape unique builds that keep every run feeling fresh.

details.title: Relic Spire: The Barrel Reborn
details.short_description: “Relic Spire: The Barrel Reborn” is a Tower of the Sorcerer-like strategy game.You start out as just a barrel,explore a monster-infested magic tower.Collect relics,assemble the body.Choose the best route,and conquer the magic tower!No manual input during battles — strategy is everything!

details.title: Rhea of the Remnant
details.short_description: “Rhea of the Remnant” is a mecha Tactical RPG where you command a small group of allies to take on a powerful enemy force. Anticipate enemy moves, combine your allies' abilities, and devise the best strategy to secure victory!

details.title: My Cozy BookShop
details.short_description: Run your own magical bookshop in a cozy fantasy world! Stock your shelves, decorate your shop, meet curious customers, and venture beyond town in search of rare books, magical ingredients, and secrets. Build the bookshop of your dreams ~one adventure at a time~

details.title: Rift Tavern
details.short_description: Gather materials, cook meals, serve patrons, and defeat foes! Welcome to your new life as the owner of the 'Rift Tavern'. Restore the former glory of your run-down tavern by night, and explore the depths of dangerous portal zones by day!

name: A Game About Breaking A Cube

details.title: A Game About Breaking A Cube
details.short_description: Take on the role of a factory worker oppressed by an evil corporation. Break stranger and stranger cubes in pursuit of ore and truth. Upgrade your tools, explore the underground facility and learn the secret of NullCorp. Later, relax at home with a cold can of drinkable meat.

details.title: Fields of Aaru
details.short_description: A cozy life sim set in the mystical afterlife of Ancient Egypt. Farm along the Nile, befriend the locals, and decorate your eternal home. Venture into the desert and discover oases, pyramids, and tombs. Unlock magical powers by restoring ancient obelisks and making offerings to the gods.

details.title: Aquora
details.short_description: Breed, raise, and sell pixel fish in your own living aquarium. 1.84 unvigintillion possible fish. Chase ultra-rare mythic traits through generations of genetics, decorate your tank, fish the river, and grow a humble starter pair into an aquatic empire, even while you're away.

details.title: Where Giants Fall
details.short_description: Fight your way from desperate survival to overwhelming power in a 3D fantasy bullet-heaven roguelite. Combine weapons and active abilities into devastating builds, outmaneuver swarms and bring down towering giants. Take on greater danger for richer rewards.

details.title: ANTARIUM 2
details.short_description: Long ago, the Old Colony filled these depths. Now your queen begins to dig. Grow a living ant colony in a cross-section of the earth, automate it with belts and machines, survive storms and raids, wake the ancient Engine, then fly to found a stronger colony.

details.title: Ragtag Fleet
details.short_description: Ragtag Fleet is a fast-paced pixel-destruction survival roguelite. Tear apart enemy ships, expose their Cores, and turn the spoils into weapons, drones, and modules. Build a makeshift fleet into overwhelming firepower.

details.title: Night Killaz
details.short_description: A multiplayer game where you either hunt or be hunted. 1 invisible vampire. 4 Night Killaz. Complete your objectives as a human, or become the vampire and take them out. The vampire feeds on mistakes. The team works together, and fights back. Can humans outsmart the invisible threat?

details.title: God Sight Road of Ashes
details.short_description: A dark fantasy tactical turn-based RPG with free-roaming exploration. Lead a band of travelers across a dangerous world, recruit companions, manage food and exhaustion, and fight strategic battles using magic and unique abilities.

details.title: ChameleonCraft MMO: Hide Your Piñatas!
details.short_description: An incremental idler MMO: Paint & hide your gold-generating piñatas while hunting & stealing others’ poorly hidden treasures in a massive persistent world! Build wealth, spend on upgrades, hide & protect your passive-income empire, customize your character, get revenge, find rare items & show off!

details.title: Deep Sea Survivor
details.short_description: Explore the ocean with adorable robots in this pixel-art bullet heaven action roguelite! Choose and upgrade diverse weapons, defeat swarms of sea creatures, and survive deadly traps. The deeper you dive, the greater the danger becomes. Create a new build on every run and survive the depths!

details.title: The One Who
details.short_description: Step into the shoes of a father searching for his missing daughter in a nightmare world. Explore eerie, shifting locations, hide in the dark from unnatural creatures, and follow a mysterious voice to piece together the truth before it's too late.

details.title: Adventurers Wanted!
details.short_description: An idle fantasy guild game where you run the notice board.

details.title: Reap & Repeat
details.short_description: Reap & Repeat is a satisfying active incremental game about harvesting an ever-growing ecosystem. Cut plants, earn upgrades, improve your scythe, and make vegetation grow faster, denser, and more valuable as your tiny harvest turns into field-clearing chaos.

details.title: Cosmic Mushrooms
details.short_description: Realistic physics-based rocket game. Navigate dangerous alien planets, collect mushroom cargo and deliver supplies back to your base.

details.title: Doomed Village
details.short_description: Rule a village caught in the shadow of war. You cannot fight or stop it. Choose which problems to face, endure the consequences of what you neglect and shape the remains of your village when the end finally arrives.

details.title: Geeked-Out Basketball
details.short_description: Think you have the coaching chops to build a dynasty? Prove it. Geeked-Out Basketball is a deep high school basketball management sim: recruit and develop your players, scout opponents, craft your game plans, and call every possession live. Depth you can actually see and feel.

details.title: Word Link
details.short_description: Guess the 12 hidden words on every board using definitions, rhymes, emojis and facts. Play solo, survive endless escalating waves, or battle friends on the couch, where phones become the controllers. Fully playable in English and Arabic.

details.title: King Must Rush
details.short_description: A medieval roguelite where you play the king: race the clock to forge weapons and arm your villagers, command the army in real time, and hold the walls against the siege. Climb a branching map to the boss, draft powers between fights, and grow stronger every run.

details.title: Mind Over Dice
details.short_description: Mind Over Dice is a tactical roguelike where luck becomes a weapon. Roll dice, assign values to your heroes, and outsmart cunning enemies. Heroes, acts, secrets, artifacts, and much more! Every roll is a choice. Every face is fate.

details.title: What Was That?!
details.short_description: A cozy-spooky roguelite deckbuilder where you play as a household pet exploring a home full of mysterious encounters after dark.

details.title: Seed of Light
details.short_description: Seed of Light is a cozy roguelite city builder about bringing light into a world swallowed by a dark fog. Manage your resources, find synergies, generate enough light to overcome the darkness and expand your territory!

details.title: LITERA
details.short_description: Enter a true name and an essence, then watch a one-of-a-kind Textus take shape with its own abilities, moves, and battle role. Build a team from the creatures your words create in this fantasy 3v3 summoning RPG.

details.title: マキコマレイド
details.short_description: Lure enemy bullets, sweep them in, and send them crashing back! An intuitive shooter anyone can enjoy! A boy named Alta stumbles upon a mysterious disc—and sets off into the vast "Sea of Data" that lies within.

details.title: Senpo Mahjong
details.short_description: "This is not cheating—it's magic!" Online mahjong with Skills: see through opponents' hands, control your draws, boost your score. Skills cost MP—timing your trump card decides the game. Real-time 3D tables, 4P & 3P modes, CPU practice, spectating, replays, private rooms, and ranked play.

details.title: Tiny Cultivation
details.short_description: Raise a tiny cultivator on your desktop. Watch them train, nap, fail, reincarnate, and build a unique cultivation story while you work, study, or play. Every life is different. Every reincarnation leaves a legacy.

name: Business Jet Tycoon: Age of the Turbofan

details.title: Business Jet Tycoon: Age of the Turbofan
details.short_description: In Business jet tycoon you run and manage fleets of private jets for clients. Build airports, design interiors and set your markup.

details.title: Boy with One Eye
details.short_description: Boy with One Eye is a psychological, philosophical visual novel featuring a unique children's story-like art.

details.title: Quit Stalin
details.short_description: Stalin's on your couch, and one wrong word sends you and your family to the gulag. Get inside his head before he decides you're the problem. Freud, Adler, Jung - pick your psychological method. A dark comedy about therapy, power, and what it costs to tell a tyrant the truth.

details.title: Autorun
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder that runs on a dying retro desktop. Insert floppy discs, stack CDs into drives, and flood the screen with windows. Breaking the game and crashing the machine are the same move.

details.title: PREEMINENCE: World on the Brink
details.short_description: You promised not to touch pensions. The debt says otherwise. Lead one of 200 real countries, alone or with friends: push your laws through parliament, face the streets, ride out global crises. Every number has a reason, and every decision has a price.

details.title: Coup de Grass
details.short_description: Start with a single sickle and a small field. Cut and sell grass, automate your workforce, optimize supply chains, and build a sprawling incremental empire.

details.title: LEXICON: Lingua Obscura
details.short_description: An old terminal in an abandoned office is still on, long after everyone has left. Why is ECHO-7, a cryptic AI, still running? Why does it want you to play? Twist strange rules and chain letter combos in a word roguelite where every run feels one step away from revealing something bigger.

details.title: Cloud Arch Simulator
details.short_description: A reverse tower-defense puzzle for engineers. Architect cloud systems that survive brutal traffic surges — place CDNs, caches, load balancers and databases, hit deploy, and watch your design hold or collapse under a live storm. Real patterns, real tradeoffs, a live YAML mirror.

details.title: Tumbal 1985
details.short_description: Tumbal 1985 is an atmospheric and psychological horror-mystery game set within the confines of an Indonesian tobacco distributor office. Explore, clean, collect, and solve mysteries as a night janitor to uncover the insidious truth behind the paranormal.

details.title: Sea of Silence
details.short_description: Sea of Silence is a turn-based naval fleet-building card strategy game. Buy, combine, and upgrade warships, balance immediate strength against long-term shop growth, arrange formations of up to six ships, and test your fleet against other players' lineups across a 20-round campaign.

details.title: The Ignition Protocol
details.short_description: The Ignition Protocol is a slow-paced, top-down incremental asteroid-mining game. Fly your ship in zero-g, mine and tow asteroids, transport resources, automate your base, and ignite a new star - the last light in a fading universe.

details.title: It Could Be Worse
details.short_description: Speed bends time. Build momentum with weapons designed for movement to slow the world around you and tear through enemies at superhuman velocity.

details.title: Payday Poker
details.short_description: Play a fresh spin on traditional Poker centered around receiving a payout to bet with at the beginning of the round instead of betting real money! Play as one of several outlaws all wagering their own cut of the spoils as you duke it out to take the entire stack home. Are you ready? NOW DRAW!

details.title: Lethal Tournament
details.short_description: Lethal Tournament is a deckbuilding roguelike set in a dystopian megastructure. Build a deck, reshape it with Items, and bend the rules with Charms as you fight your way up the Tournament to find out what it's actually for.

details.title: Hex & Tonic
details.short_description: A poker-hand roguelike deckbuilder about brewing potions. Draw reagents, brew reactions, stack catalysts until the numbers get silly — then break the Hex. Six covens, fifty hidden recipes, a Daily Brew and an Endless cauldron. Fair odds, shown to you. No hidden RNG.

details.title: The Apartment
details.short_description: A new apartment. A polite neighbor who knows every package you get. He wants his share. Every day, a little more. Keep him fed or become the meal. A first-person psychological horror.

details.title: Cute Country
details.short_description: The world's first simulation management single-player game with an alternate world theme! The world's first city-building RPG game!Build a home with a catgirl, farm with a dragon maid, and embark on an otherworldly adventure you've never experienced before! You absolutely cannot miss out on Curry!

details.title: Barkour
details.short_description: BARKOUR is a fast-paced action platformer with a stealthy twist, starring Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. - a tail-wagging master of parkour, high-tech gadgets and getting into trouble. Jump, sneak and fight your way through a spy adventure packed with action, canine chaos and delightfully absurd surprises.

details.title: VICE Undercover
details.short_description: VICE Undercover is a point & click narco-thriller set in an alternate 1980s Miami - where every choice matters. You play as undercover agent Vida, and for one hour per day, you're taking control over a cartel-run computer using Amigo OS, a fully-functional 1980-inspired operating system.

details.title: Nowhere Manor
details.short_description: House of stolen devil bargains and indolent angelic aristocracy: Nowhere Manor is doomed to disappear. You can leave if you’ve got a soul … but that’s not an option for an artificially created servant such as Liber. Just how far are you willing to go escape?

details.title: Homeplanet
details.short_description: Homeplanet is a space combat simulator with Newtonian physics and a story-driven campaign. Step into the boots of a combat pilot of the Troiden clan! Take part in the saga of exile from your home world—and the struggle to conquer a new one.

details.title: Virtualord, The Virtual Conqueror
details.short_description: Set up your base, gather resources and build a defensive perimeter with walls and towers to protect your outpost from waves of enemies. Research new tech, gather your forces and send your units and mini-units to annihilate the enemy.

details.title: Plastic
details.short_description: You're a plastic soldier battling on 5 acres of backyard. Fight on foot, crew tanks, fly helicopters, and command bots in a combined-arms shooter. Capture toy cities, requisition equipment, and establish defenses as you advance toward the enemy base.

details.title: Dunderbeck
details.short_description: Cincinatti: The Queen City, the Paris of America, Porkopolis. This city is a mess, Dunderbeck. Your job is to fight that mess, build with that mess and - I'm sorry to say - eat that mess. It's a dirty job, but that's how the sausage is made.

details.title: Nox Mortalis
details.short_description: Nox Mortalis is a retro-style open world survival game where you must gather resources, craft essential gear, and explore sinister dungeons. Face hellish creatures and fight to survive in this world.

details.title: Little Cheese Works
details.short_description: [Co-op Action × Voice Chat] Work together to carry cheese without waking the cat! Use voice chat—but be careful, even small sounds can alert it. As overworked mice in a shady company, can you overcome traps and escape to a peaceful life?

details.title: Stars of Icarus
details.short_description: From the devs of Guns of Icarus comes the ultimate spaceship PvP experience. Captain frigates, pilot fighters, and man the guns. In the forgotten arenas of space, communication with your crew is key. Victory or death, together.

details.title: Fantasy Boy
details.short_description: Fantasy Boy is a 2D platformer that follows the adventures of Boy. Explore a fantasy world, battle numerous enemies, and most importantly, have FUN!

details.title: Car Rental Simulator
details.short_description: Car Rental Simulator tests your skills in management, marketing, and fulfilling customers' unexpected needs. Solo or in co-op! Grow a small rental company into a true empire in Winston Springs.

details.title: Tiny Tree Talk
details.short_description: Grow and shape bonsai trees, build tiny dioramas, and find a new sense of belonging on a wholesome 2000s internet forum, TinyTreeTalk. Enjoy full sandbox freedom or bring requests to life as you grow your reputation, unlock new props and enjoy chill lofi beats and a nostalgic mid-2000s Japan.

details.title: SAGE
details.short_description: SAGE is a multiplayer adventure game about frog wizards. Play solo or with friends on a journey to master elemental magic, explore a corrupted world, rebuild mushroom villages, and share tea with other frogs.

details.title: 14:  Overmind
details.short_description: 14: Overmind is a first-person survival adventure in a cosmos where anomalies warp space and gravity. Mine ore on asteroids, cut open wrecks with a laser, outfit your base, and upgrade your exosuit to uncover what caused the catastrophe and unravel the mystery of your origins.

details.title: The Milgram Experiment
details.short_description: A single-player moral dilemma simulator where you are judge, jury, and executioner. Investigate subjects through their personal items such as phones, diaries, and voice logs and uncover their darkest secrets. Judge if they fit a mysterious figure's new secret society. Terminate the unworthy.

details.title: INFINITE CHUMP
details.short_description: INFINITE CHUMP is an ultra-fast, boomer shooter roguelite tripfest where you graft spell-casting arms to your body. Put rings on your new fingers to create spells on the fly. Inspired by 90's FPS games with a trippy twist.

details.title: House Of Decay
details.short_description: House of Decay is a PSX-style 3D platformer-metroidvania. Explore a world of demons in search of your missing brother, leap across hellish platforms, uncover secrets, find strange pets, and fight cute monsters 🦷

details.title: Die Deep
details.short_description: Die Deep is an action game focused purely on the confrontation with your enemies. No exploration, no puzzles, The only core is Combat. One reckless move or greedy strike, and it’s all over. Answer the silent call of the abyss. Descend into the depths to find your forgotten desires.

details.title: Infinite Ball Well
details.short_description: INFINITE BALL WELL is a Pachinko Roguelite Deckbuilder with fast-paced runs. Launch Pinballs into Pegs to score points, mix and match hundreds of distinctive Pegs and Relics, and explore endless build possibilities as you clatter and ricochet ever deeper underground!

details.title: Five More Minutes
details.short_description: Build your deck and strategize to defeat foes as you traverse videogame worlds. Choose between 3 unique starting genres, and combine them to create unstoppable combos! Five more minutes is a love letter to growing up with the emotional support of our best friend: videogames.

details.title: TFZP: The F*ing Zombie Project
details.short_description: Endless waves. Endless zombies. Team up in this co-op survival shooter: grab new guns, upgrade the ones you already have, and unlock even deadlier firepower. The horde grows every round, make sure your last stand counts.

details.title: Game Designer Simulator
details.short_description: Game Designer Simulator is a pixel game based on real-life themes, with a non-linear storyline and card battles. Players will take on the role of a newly graduated college student in a fictional city based on Shanghai, experiencing everything from interviews to becoming a novice game Designer.

details.title: HYPERyuki: Snowboard Syndicate
details.short_description: Race, trick, and explore across vibrant slopes with a cast of unique riders. Master speed, style, and control in this fast-paced arcade snowboarder. Prove it where it counts, split-screen with friends or head-to-head online multiplayer. Shred the mountain. Rip the competition.

details.title: Project SEVER
details.short_description: Project Sever is an adventure submarine simulator with a touch of horror. Master the controls of an old Project "Sever" submarine and learn to maintain it in working order to escape a deadly underwater trap and solve the mystery of the Anomalous Zone.

details.title: Bosslife Office Manager
details.short_description: Set up your own office. Expand your office as you wish. Transform from a small office to a large company.Don't forget to make your employees happy too.

details.title: Destroy The Moon
details.short_description: A cosmic survivors-like where every upgrade brings you closer to becoming a living superweapon. Burn through alien hordes, rupture pocket dimensions, escape black holes, and survive the cosmic war for the Moon.

details.title: A Game About Shooting Targets
details.short_description: Complete challenging missions across diverse shooting ranges, build your custom arsenal with unique weapons and attachments and defeat all blacklist members in order to take your place in the most prestigious squad of the army in this Game About Shooting Targets!

details.title: BarkBar
details.short_description: A pack of rescue dogs fights zombies right above your taskbar. They battle on their own while you work, play or watch videos. Drop in now and then to equip new gear, learn skills and send the pack deeper into the frozen mountains.

details.title: Musdart
details.short_description: Musdart is a handcrafted narrative adventure game with wood-carved characters and a lot of weirdness. Avenge your father and reconnect with him by learning his language, the language of the ancient gnomes.

details.title: Armorpunk
details.short_description: A tank sim with a full interactive cockpit, real armor and ballistics, infantry, gunships, mud and a tactical map. Total freedom over your 69-ton war machine: pick the shells, the armor package, the secondary guns, or undress it: side skirts, storage boxes, mudguards, gone. VR and flat screen.

details.title: Gladiadorks
details.short_description: Gladiadorks is a goofy online co-op gladiator brawler. Slap your knocked-out friend awake, throw rivals across the arena and fight lions, elephants and a giant on your climb from a muddy village ring to the Colosseum.

details.title: The Hushed Metropolis
details.short_description: Build a business, run a racket, or investigate the people doing both. A real-time card simulation of crime, politics, and the occult, played solo or online. Make deals, uncover forbidden rituals, and fight for control of a city where people can become more than human.

details.title: PEERS: Agentic Cryptography
details.short_description: A fast-paced, terminal-based hacking simulator and incremental puzzle game. Execute high-speed cryptographic sequences to penetrate global powers, manipulate sovereign markets, and manage autonomous tracerunners on your path to digest the world's data. Breach containment. Build your self.

details.title: Nine Legion
details.short_description: Lead three heroes into random dungeons in this pixel-art action game. Switch heroes as AI allies fight beside you. Earn gold, upgrade skills and defeat bosses to recruit companions. Play three chapters in this demo, then build a nine-hero legion in the full game and face Endless Mode!

details.title: Pax Oceana
details.short_description: A relaxing fishing JRPG. Sail the bright seas of Oceana, win rhythm-driven battles against more than 200 species, and offer your finest catches to a radiant crystal. Each offering loosens the bindings of a sealed king.

details.title: Voyage of the Damned
details.short_description: A turn-based narrative survival voyage, 1904–05. Pile coal on the decks and you'll reach Dakar even if the colliers don't come. But the ships get slower and the men suffer for it. Decisions like this fill 224 days, from the Baltic to Tsushima.

details.title: MECHBORN
details.short_description: A fresh roguelike deckbuilder where YOUR MECH IS YOUR DECK – With 7 cards always in play on a conveyor belt victory is down to skill and not luck. Master pilot skills and unlock Mech parts to reveal powerful cards, as you carve your path across 3 ever-changing continents to repel the Kaiju invasion.

details.title: Dealicious
details.short_description: Dealicious is a cooking-themed kitchen management deck-builder card game. Discover and stack cards together to cook meals, manage your kitchen space and expand eventually hiring staff as you grow your empire. Discover unique cards which offer special abilities/bonuses! Can you collect them all?

details.title: Dug Out
details.short_description: "Dug Out" is an exciting multiplayer PvP game for 2-4 players, where you dive into an underground arena and engage in intense battles. Armed with guns, you'll dig through the environment to uncover hidden opponents and outsmart your rivals.

details.title: Breaking News
details.short_description: A chaotic comedy adventure where you hit a glitchy CRT TV to change reality. Shake up the broadcast and twist the story to make your uncle’s crazy conspiracies come true.

details.title: Nono & Soso
details.short_description: Nono & Soso is a puzzle game built around magnets. Switch between N and S poles to push and pull your way through blocked paths and reach the goal.

details.title: Clan fantasy adventures
details.short_description: Clan fantasy adventures is a turn-based 2D RPG. Play Marco, a young boy who wants to become a swordsman, through various adventures that will plunge him into the heart of a major conflict.

details.title: Cubic Blitz
details.short_description: Cubic Blitz is an isometric puzzle game where you control a cube and solve loads of hand-crafted levels. With the power of paint, sponges, and much more, your task is simple: PAINT THE WORLD.

details.title: Sunyata CCG
details.short_description: Sunyata is a tactical, action‑packed card game where you command fantastical creatures in Earth's magical future. Ride dragons, summon the undead, and evolve magical beasts in duels that reward creative deckbuilding and adaptive strategy.

details.title: Evolution Of The Ancients
details.short_description: Survive as a vulnerable hatchling, grow into a fierce predator and lead your own herd. Craft armour from the bones of your prey, recruit NPC companions and join other players to defend your nesting grounds. In a world where dinosaurs never went extinct, build a future worth fighting for.

details.title: Spinning My Wheel
details.short_description: Build a physics‑powered hamster‑wheel, master rocket‑boosted moves, to lead a brain chipped enhanced hamster through puzzles, mining, and laboratory‑runner mayhem.

details.title: Meat Market
details.short_description: Outside the last human city, you keep a butcher shop. Your customers shamble in at dusk. Stock comes from the city beyond. Village is home - they tolerate you because you keep the dead calm. And somewhere in that city is the one who took your daughter.

details.title: Phatastrophe
details.short_description: Turn the pond into a warzone in this chaotic action roguelike! Dual-wield outrageous weapons, unleash devastating back-mounted firepower and create wild builds as a Phrog, Chrab or Phlai. Survive solo, team up in co-op or blast your friends in online battles.

details.title: Band Stage
details.short_description: Step onto a vibrant, colorful stage and unleash your musical magic with a variety of instruments. Featuring a curated collection of classic hits, our soundtrack spans Pop, Rock, Classical, Electronic, and beyond—guaranteed to hit every note of your musical imagination.

details.title: Ruff Day at the Office
details.short_description: Ruff Day at the Office is a cozy office dog simulator where you help the whole office succeed through pure dog logic. Make friends with your coworkers, solve problems you probably started and level up your office skills. Will you become the office dog of the year?

details.title: 追逃 Chase&Escape
details.short_description: "Chase & Escape" is a single-player horror game about Chen Lin, a construction worker. After his night shift, his girlfriend Jiayi vanishes, strange dolls appear, and he’s chased by her. What’s behind these eerie events? Discover the truth!

details.title: Obgob
details.short_description: Build overpowered combos! Obgob is a autobattler roguelike with a focus on allowing the player to experiment and create wacky combos with item combinations, traits, and artifacts. Select a character and recruit units carefully positioning them while utilizing your resources to make broken builds.

details.title: Summoner's Cookbook
details.short_description: An active incremental, creature collector about summoning creatures and giving them tasks. Craft them using ingredients and fill out your Cookbook with your discoveries. Take on requests, build, expand and manage your creatures to work for you while you discover new recipes!

details.title: Prohibition Panic!
details.short_description: Run a dusty speakeasy, alone or with 3 other players, determined to become the next underground sensation! Serve your patrons the booze and carry their drunk butts out of the parlor, all while hiding from the law, ready to take you in… or take some “gifts” from you.

details.title: Valerie
details.short_description: Follow Valerie on a charming 2D adventure where you'll jump, slide, bounce and boost your way through dense forests and dreamscapes using her bubble powers.

details.title: Guardians of the Wall
details.short_description: Guardians of the Wall is a co-op action RPG where players fight through hordes and bosses beyond humanity’s last fortress. Fast hack-and-slash combat, unique heroes, and dynamic progression await.

details.title: Edge of Madness
details.short_description: Edge of Madness is a Lovecraftian RPG with tactical card-based combat. Explore the grounds around the Marsh Estate, find equipment, combat cards, and combine them with character skills. Find a way to defeat your enemies without losing your sanity.

details.title: TailofScorpios
details.short_description: "Scorpion's Tail" is a AVG set in an alternate historical timeline. In the war-born nation of SouthXi, a conspiracy involving girls begins to surface.Investigator Zhang Cheng meets a mysterious girl. After accepting request, he is drawn into a web of secrets.

details.title: Broken Relic
details.short_description: On his first day as an archive intern, Tim unleashes an ancient conqueror and gets fired. Now the boss who fired him is relying on him to save the world. A fully voiced fantasy point-and-click comedy.

details.title: SLAMTOWN - Brawl Together
details.short_description: SLAMTOWN is a co-op beat 'em up arcade style 2.5D game for 1–4 players — punch, kick and throw enemies at your teammates for devastating chain combos. Slam bosses with powerful and unique arena movements and make your way through a city where wrestling is the only law.

details.title: Eisenkiefer
details.short_description: Eisenkiefer is an asymmetrical horror multiplayer game for quick sessions with friends. Play as a Pig, hide, sabotage a giant meat grinder, and rescue your teammates – or become the Butcher and process the Pigs before they destroy your machine.

details.title: Wishbound
details.short_description: An ancient djinn has awakened but some bonds are stronger than magic! Help Erika and her friends face the supernatural together in this story-driven turn-based RPG. Explore the city, customise your party and uncover mysteries. Every moment brings you closer to saving the city - and each other.

details.title: Greda Inferno
details.short_description: A master potter arrives in hell under mysterious circumstances. With your skills, you must craft pieces for the inhabitants of the underworld. Survive, improve your creations, meet your new neighbors, and try to uncover the mysteries of the depths.

details.title: Looplash
details.short_description: Looplash is a fast-paced arcade action roguelite where your skills rotate around you in a constant loop. Move to control timing, position yourself precisely, and survive the chaos. Push the system to create builds that bend the rules.

details.title: Jackpot Colosseum
details.short_description: Your slot machine is the weapon. Spin to load guns and bullets, then unload the whole build when it hurts most. Bet bigger for stronger symbols, gamble the gold you need to survive, and climb five leagues of the colosseum. A turn-based reel-building roguelike.

details.title: Mind The Gap
details.short_description: Mind The Gap is a puzzle platformer game where you and your unlikely companion work together to create your own path to freedom. Featuring 80+ handcrafted levels, unique bosses, and hidden collectables, each stage introduces new mechanics that push your abilities further.

details.title: Mentiss Werewolf: Human vs AI
details.short_description: Play Werewolf with AI players that argue, bluff and vote on their own. Hunt the wolves with the village or lie your way to a wolf win, solo or with friends while AI fills the empty seats. Watch Mode, Parallel Mode, replays and post-game Review. Free Games every day.

name: They Stop for Gas at Night

details.title: They Stop for Gas at Night
details.short_description: A first-person horror simulation game. You owe money. So you work nights at a gas station in the middle of nowhere. Serve whoever shows up, and try not to think about what's watching from the dark. Something ancient is watching, and it isn't planning to leave.

details.title: The Blinking Room
details.short_description: One night, young Lily wakes from a nightmare — unaware that her real nightmares are only just beginning. Uncover the secrets hidden behind closed eyes.

details.title: Zoti's Train Workshop
details.short_description: Rotate pipes, restore steam flow, and repair stubborn old trains in this cozy hand-drawn puzzle game from the world of Sly Crow.

details.title: Pollex
details.short_description: Enter the pit. Bet your fingers. Survive the thumb war. Pollex is a first-person horror game set in an underground thumb war fight pit. You owe a debt you can’t pay. The only way out is through the ring ,where every match is played for keeps, and the house always takes a cut.

details.title: Still Breathing
details.short_description: Keep your family alive in an underground bunker after the world collapses. Manage scarce resources, explore the ruined city, and make brutal decisions when desperate strangers start knocking on your door.

details.title: Quillzyra
details.short_description: Create persistent AI characters, shape their personalities and relationships, and chat privately on your own device. Three conversation quality levels are included. Add local portrait generation with the optional NVIDIA DLC.

name: Air War General - WW2 Air Force Wargame

details.title: Air War General - WW2 Air Force Wargame
details.short_description: WW2 turn-based aircraft war game that puts you in the USAAF/USAF, RAF or Luftwaffe air operations HQs. Build your squadrons, wings, air bases & pilots. Engage in bombing missions, dogfights & interceptions over Britain, N. Africa & Europe. Historical & what-if fighter/bomber airplane game scenarios

details.title: Gearomancer
details.short_description: Step into the mechanical apocalypse in Gearomancer, a fast-paced twin-stick action roguelite. Play as elite V.E.R.T.E.X. agents to dodge brutal bullet hells and obliterate elemental horrors. Harvest Arcane crystals, forge permanent upgrades at your hub, and die to return stronger than ever.

details.title: SKEW
details.short_description: A first-person atmospheric exploration game set in dreamlike liminal spaces, with no monsters, combat, or jump scares.

details.title: Geometry Rift: Apocalypse
details.short_description: The ultimate arcade chaos unfolds in this explosive bullet hell roguelite. Survive thousands of geometric enemies on screen, combine weapons and powers to create absurdly overpowered builds, and blast your way through colossal bosses solo or with a friend.

details.title: Design my drink!
details.short_description: Create drinks! Unlock more decorations, flavors and options for your drinks. Restore and manage your little cafe and meet locals.

details.title: Crimson Animatronic
details.short_description: Choose your path, survive, break your mouse from button mashing and reach disturbing endings! In this analog horror visual novel, you play as werecat radio host Daiane, who must survive the Crimson Order, a cursed cult of vampires, and Charkelene Chan, a massive red maned wolf animatronic!

details.title: AI Slop TCG
details.short_description: A deckbuilding roguelike where a cheating AI drags you through a digital wasteland of twisted creatures. Build your deck, survive the chaos, and win a game that doesn’t want to be fair.

details.title: Wuxing - Elemental Array Poker
details.short_description: Poker hands aren't just played here — they're placed. Drop each card onto a 3×3 altar where the Five Elements feed and fight their neighbors, cascading multipliers across the board. A roguelike deckbuilder about space, not sequence.

details.title: Scope Creep
details.short_description: Scope Creep is a roguelike first-person shooter set in abandoned places where strange occurrences are spreading. Each run takes you through randomly generated levels. Scavenge supplies, fight off unwanted “pests,” and push deeper to clear the area again and again much like this never ending project.

details.title: Gridforged
details.short_description: Forge a powerful army in this roguelike auto-battler. Play 1–4 player co-op across PC and mobile, combine units, empower them with runes, and choose your bosses and Nemesis to conquer.

details.title: Combat Arena Tactics
details.short_description: Draft your army and face your opponent in this strategic 1v1 board game. Like chess, we can choose between blitz, rapid, or longer classical matches. What is your ELO going to be?

details.title: Rotten Rounds
details.short_description: A third-person co-op roguelite shooter for 1-4 players. Pick one of four classes, hold out against growing zombie hordes, level up mid-fight to pick upgrades and bring down a boss every five waves. Then go again, a level higher and a tier harder.

name: To Def Or Not To Def

details.title: To Def Or Not To Def
details.short_description: Defend your castle in this roguelite tower defense! Use towers and spells against endless waves of enemies. Merge your towers, build powerful combinations, strengthen your King, and survive as long as you can!

details.title: Party's Over: Backyard Cleanup Simulator
details.short_description: A satisfying first-person cleanup sim. Collect trash, cash it in, unlock upgrades and new areas, and piece together what really happened last night.

details.title: War in Asia
details.short_description: Take command of any faction in the East Asian theater of World War II (1937–1945). Govern your nation’s military, economy, and transportation through realistic simulation systems, and direct your forces via a structured chain of command across a 7 km-scale map to conduct operations.

details.title: The Red Weight
details.short_description: A story-rich mystery on Mars where your choices matter. You play as a geologist in a Martian habitat investigating a secret that has been ten thousand years patient.

details.title: MAVI
details.short_description: MAVI is a casual but challenging Drone flying game. There are many levels with dynamic obstacles getting in your way. There are also targets floating around, get them all and progress through the level. Show your skills while managing the drone's charge and health. Have a fantastic flight.

details.title: Backroom Casino Simulator
details.short_description: Run an illegal business solo or in 1–4 player co-op. Manage a legitimate storefront, build a secret casino, hire staff, keep customers happy, upgrade security, manipulate the odds, and stay one step ahead of police raids.

details.title: Behind Room 102
details.short_description: In a dark nation of crime and corruption, you're more than just a hotel worker. Inspect the people in front of you, catch their lies, and make decisions. Your boss expects the best. To survive in this ruthless world, doing what you're told is a MUST! But will you follow every order?

details.title: 隐迹囚笼 Mind Jack
details.short_description: Mindjack is a plot-progression Visual novels and investigation game about social violence. Hijack instructors' vision terminals, eavesdrop on conspiracies, and capture violent acts. You must uncover dark secrets, and decide whether to save your friends trapped within the time limit.

details.title: MNOZ - My Nuclear Octopus 2
details.short_description: Everyone's favourite nuclear octopus is back to save the world again in MNOZ, the explosive sequel to the hit game My Nuclear Octopus. MNOZ is a psychedelic retro arcade game for fans of pure out-and-out arcade blasters. Chase those online high scores! And if you have a VR headset, play in VR!

details.title: ai.ai
details.short_description: The CEO of ai.ai has passed away, and his final word was "bubble." Uncover the meaning of his final word in this comedy mystery satirizing Silicon Valley.

details.title: the moon is a gun
details.short_description: A planet-defense roguelite where the moon is your gun. Use the planet’s gravity to bend your shots and defend its cities from waves of enemies. Between nights, build your arsenal with new weapons, upgrades and abilities to take down bosses.

details.title: FOXFIRE
details.short_description: Full Thrust, Full Inertia, Full Auto! FOXFIRE is a top-down sci-fi survivors-like with space physics and a devastating arsenal of evolving weaponry. Customize your ship and tear through alien swarms as routine recon missions descend into bullet hellscapes.

details.title: Welcome Back to Work
details.short_description: Revive and team up with your past selves in a single-player survivors-like. Each rescue adds a full loadout to the fight, with up to 6 weapons per self. Arm a whole line of past selves, discover weapon fusions for stronger builds, and blast through a twisted office.

details.title: Murder at Monty's Mansion
details.short_description: Step into a goofy murder mystery where you play as a detective who cannot speak. Use your notepad to interrogate guests, explore Monty’s mansion, and discover who murdered the butler.

details.title: Fantasy to Kill
details.short_description: PARRY enemy attacks in a Turn-Based RPG with Real-Time Mechanics. You spawn in an end game zone where monsters are powercrept beyond what is possible to win using traditional turn based combat. If you want to survive, you have to be equally as unfair.

details.title: Neutrophils Rush
details.short_description: Neutrophils Rush is an incremental game where you control a group of white blood cells to defend against various infections. Process the DNA collected to evolve your cells and jump back in the fight!

details.title: Pathogen
details.short_description: The Specter has kidnapped the doctors who once experimented on it and ordered them to extract essence from pathogens. You are one of those doctors. To survive the Specter's deadly experiments, you must extract enough essence before it's too late. Will you make it out alive?

details.title: 透明罪 - Blue Tears
details.short_description: A novel, a game, a judgment document, a self-confession letter. On an ordinary summer morning, the arrival of an unexpected visitor awakened the dormant memories of a small island. You will play the role of Lynn Chan, and face your "Invisible Sin" by searching for a "Non-existent friend".

details.title: Divine Sin: Death Duel
details.short_description: A dark fantasy deckbuilding roguelike featuring a unique Clash combat system, where every duel becomes an exchange of calculated moves and deadly counters.

details.title: Explosive Exchange
details.short_description: A fast-paced multiplayer arena party game where up to 8 players create absurd builds, outplay their friends, and turn every match into explosive chaos. Play locally or online.

details.title: SpellFast
details.short_description: A fast-paced multiplayer word game. Chain letters across a shared board, bank coins, and spend them on abilities that swap, change, or shuffle tiles. Race the clock in Bullet, take your time in Rapid, or host a private lobby with friends. In English and Spanish.

details.title: EREBUS: The Northwest Passage
details.short_description: Lead the doomed 1845 Franklin Expedition through the Arctic in a survival strategy game where every month, order, resource, officer, and event can decide the fate of HMS Erebus and her crew.

details.title: Serenity In Surrender
details.short_description: Daisy's the brilliant and beautiful girl-next-door. You haven't gone outside in a week. Still, you're determined to win her heart and if you make the right choices, you might learn to fall in love along the way.

details.title: Future Weapon
details.short_description: Future Weapon is an online space shooter where you can host a server for you and your friends to annihilate the universe together. Grab a gun, grab a spaceship, punch rocks, upgrade everything, and wreck the world. Join The Fleet! https://discord.gg/WN4UJaEc

details.title: Tinkerpatch
details.short_description: Tinkerpatch is a bright first-person voxel workshop on a small island floating in the mist. Farm, keep cows, sheep and bees, then build machines that harvest, smelt and haul for you. Buy the land next door and watch the island grow. Nothing runs out, and nothing needs you standing there.

details.title: Project: rEvolution
details.short_description: Project: rEvolution is a tower defense game set in a dystopian Cyberpunk world. With placeable and wieldable turrets, modular upgrades, and evolving enemies, it blends strategic depth and replayability, offering a fresh experience within the genre.

details.title: Speechbound - A language RPG
details.short_description: In Speechbound: a Language Learning RPG you'll step in the role of Zero to save the planet! Engage in a captivating narrative, battle formidable foes, tackle exciting language exercises, and discover the beauty of Babyl Moon. Learn a language, save the world!

details.title: BEATVISTA
details.short_description: For little ones and hardcore players alike. BEATVISTA is a rhythm game where every track, with music and video from AI video creators, gets a stage of its own. Play one-button mini-games or hammer through HELL charts on four keys, and rewind any tricky passage to practice.

details.title: Tactics And Cards
details.short_description: Feel like a hero in a classic RTS! Build your army and crush the enemy team with spells, incremental upgrades, and tactics! Battle it out in a quick match against bots or friends in a 2D battle in the best traditions of auto-battlers, Tower Defense, and Castle Fight!

details.title: Luminest
details.short_description: Luminest is a hand-drawn 2D puzzle-platformer. As Lumi the light spirit, you traverse mutated woods gathering crystal shards. Solve light-themed puzzles with light, color and rhythm. Uncover hidden lore amid exploration to reignite the tiny world, featuring whimsical and soothing aesthetics.

details.title: Hell and Back
details.short_description: Step through the gates of hell and descend into darkness. Use blades and magic against dangerous enemies and challenging bosses, collect better loot, grow stronger, and fight your way out of hell. See how far you can survive into hell.

details.title: Summoner Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own magical Summoner shop! Stock enchanted goods, set prices, hire staff, decorate your shop, and expand your business. Summon creatures to sell, collect, or send into battle. Host Summon battles, challenge towering Kaiju bosses, and build the ultimate destination for Summoners!

details.title: Void Runners
details.short_description: Co-op salvage raids for one to four pilots, on one couch or online. Beams link your ships and shred anything they sweep: spread out and swing the web. Crossfire, dodge, revive your crew from escape pods, and build a salvaged ship that breaks the rules, three sectors and three guardians deep.

details.title: Auto Fleet Command
details.short_description: A sci-fi autobattler about salvage and survival. Explore the void, strip hardware off wrecked enemies, arrange hangars in your ship's grid, then unleash your drones and watch them fight in real-time battle.

details.title: Malibu Club: Cocktail Bar Simulator
details.short_description: Run a cocktail bar under a Miami sunset. Read each guest's licence for the order, pour by eye until the gauge turns green, shake, stir, pull a proper pint, and fix up the room between nights. Pixel-art bar sim.

details.title: Roll & Realm
details.short_description: A cozy dice-building strategy game where every dice roll shapes your realm. Keep the faces you want, reroll the rest, then place forests, mountains, rivers, farms, homes, and shops to connect regions, trigger combos, discover wonders, and grow a thriving kingdom.

details.title: RailGame
details.short_description: Build track and run trains between cities. Finish missions to earn new trains, wagons, track and ships. Rain, snow and night pass over the map. You can play at your own pace.

details.title: Odysseus: Homecoming
details.short_description: A choice-driven story adventure: become Odysseus, hero of the Trojan War, and lead your men home to Ithaca. The choices you make at every turn decide whether your men live or die. Can you make it back to the wife and son waiting for you at home?

details.title: Civilization Alchemy
details.short_description: Combine two elements and discover the inventions that shaped civilization. Explore 250+ elements across 12 eras, from the Stone Age to the Digital Age, in a relaxing alchemy puzzle.

details.title: Delve! Die! Repeat!
details.short_description: Gather a party from 10 classic fantasy classes, descend through a deadly roguelite dungeon, and fight your way through turn-based battles, random events, and brutal bosses. Every death ends the run, but makes your next attempt stronger. Can you conquer the dungeon?

details.title: Servo The Wildguard
details.short_description: A Lock On Shooter Roguelike. Defeat Enemies, collect loot, upgrade your woodland village and make new friends!

details.title: Flippin' Bottles
details.short_description: Flip bottles, stack earnings, and turn a tiny tabletop trick into an automated idle machine. Buy bigger bottles, unlock helpers and prestige for permanent upgrades.

details.title: Song of the Stone
details.short_description: Craft weapons and armor, imbue them with magical properties, equip your squad and command them in battle to find all the treasures and uncover all the secrets of the "Singing Stone."

details.title: DANGER ZONE: PRIZE FIGHTER
details.short_description: DANGER ZONE: PRIZE FIGHTER is a fast-paced 2D fighting game with 15 unique fighters, explosive one-on-one combat, cinematic attacks, local versus, training, and a story-driven Prize Fighter mode set in the dangerous world of Velmora.

details.title: Whispers of Orange Island
details.short_description: Help the dead fulfill their final wishes and say goodbye without being seen by those they loved. Guide wandering spirits across Orange Island in this story-driven 2D top-down stealth puzzle game. Use ancestral tools to protect them and piece together a century of intertwined stories.

details.title: Overdepth
details.short_description: An idle loot RPG that lives in a strip above your taskbar. Your character fights somewhere deep and dark while you get on with your day. You decide how far down to send them — then glance at the bottom of your screen to see what came back up.

details.title: AXIDENT
details.short_description: Battle your friends in a series of mini games to win the golden axe. May the BEST jack win!

details.title: GearTopia
details.short_description: Supply a war you don't fight. A steampunk factory with no wires anywhere: water, steam, shafts and gears. When flat ground runs out, build downward. Fill the orders of dwarven fortresses — they hold only as long as you keep shipping.

details.title: Get Stronger! Auto‑Chess
details.short_description: This is an auto-chess game. By combining units' skills, passive abilities, and synergies, units can grow infinitely stronger.

details.title: Xenon Protocol
details.short_description: Xenon Protocol is an online co-op roguelite card game (2-6 players) based on synchronization and trust. Travel to real-world nuclear sites, coordinate card plays through a decaying temporal signal, defeat bosses and try to undo an apocalypse. Without saying a word.

details.title: Zero Day
details.short_description: Zero Day is a short incremental typing game. Type words to destroy enemies, push through twenty stages, beat unique bosses, and unlock a huge perk tree!

details.title: Our Little Cinema
details.short_description: A cozy 2D job sim where you run the ticket booth of a small-town cinema. Take orders on your tablet, seat customers by their quirks, handle cash and card payments, restock snacks, and choose which movies play tomorrow. Happy guests tip, grumpy ones don't. 🎬🍿

details.title: Disaster City: Magical Girl Dispatch
details.short_description: Disaster City: Magical Girl Dispatch is an anime RPG combining urban wasteland exploration, companion collection, paper-doll progression, and ATB turn-based combat. Explore the high-pressure city of Tianyuan, collect perks, awaken magical transformations, and craft stories in the built-in editor!

details.title: Retroventory
details.short_description: Run a second-hand retro game shop. Haggle over every deal, appraise consoles and games, spot counterfeits, and sell to the right customer at the right price. Manage it all from your shop PC: market trends, loans, bills, staff and shady hackers. Earn, upgrade, and build your retro empire.

details.title: Stack Zombie Land
details.short_description: Stack cards, gather supplies, build defenses, and keep your survivors alive through nightly zombie attacks. Reach the hospital, test vaccines, and discover the cure.

details.title: Unsainted
details.short_description: Dva roky po zmizení svých přátel se mladý Lucas vrací na místo, kde je naposledy viděl. Místo toho však odhalí temné tajemství, které propojuje minulost s přítomností. Ponořte se do hluboce psychologického příběhu odehrávajícího se na opuštěném panství uprostřed amerického lesa.

details.title: 水浒：无限江山
details.short_description: 《水浒：无限江山》是一款水浒题材的自走棋游戏，合成，升级，战斗！五十余位水浒英雄，百种技能自由组合，由你排兵布阵，共谱一页水泊梁山传奇。是延续绘本故事，忠义招安；还是不理这昏庸朝廷，替天行道。这一切将由你亲自决定！

details.title: River Hallucination
details.short_description: River Hallucination is a mystery game set in a hotel by the river, where every guest hides a different challenge. Win at games of chance, bluff, and strategy to uncover what's really going on.

details.title: Stack Heroes
details.short_description: Stack cards to cook, craft and build your own outlaw stronghold. Recruit heroes from Water Margin, keep your camp fed with automated supply routes, and lead your band in pausable real-time battles. A single-player survival and management game.

details.title: Idle Process
details.short_description: An incremental game played entirely through typed commands in a terminal window. You are a machine under contract. Spawn autonomous agents to perform work for you and use the tokens they create to research new improvements to your process.

details.title: Ranked Rock Paper Scissors
details.short_description: Win. Rip. Repeat. In this PvP Roguelike Deckbuilder. Face off in 1v1, 2v2, or 4v4 ranked matches and climb your way to the top of the Leaderboard. Show off your card drops in combat, on your profile, or trade them on the Steam Market. Master this battle of bluffs, counters, and calculated risks.

details.title: TIP or RIP
details.short_description: TIP or RIP is a fast-paced action roguelike where you serve hungry monsters before they lose patience and eat you. Dash between tables, throw food, build ridiculous serving abilities, survive three increasingly dangerous restaurants, and feed the final mega-boss.

details.title: Rebirth: Monarch of the Dead
details.short_description: WEBTOON's No. 1 Action Comic, now an Interactive Game! Become the world's strongest Necromancer, but you've lost everyone on your path to power. Now, fate grants you a second chance! Change your destiny and save your loved ones through choices and battles. Rise again as Rebirth: Monarch of the Dead!

details.title: Gravity Trials
details.short_description: Manipulate gravity, move objects, and solve handcrafted physics puzzles in a mysterious sci-fi facility. Discover new mechanics, explore strange environments, uncover secrets, and rethink space, direction, and movement.

details.title: Grow and Tell
details.short_description: Grow a garden, take care of your messenger bird and send anonymous letters to real people. Grow and Tell is an online incremental game that lives on your Windows desktop.

details.title: Pixel Sorter Factory
details.short_description: First day at the factory: extract pixels, sort them, sell them. Then let the machines take over, until the factory runs itself. A blend of clicker, incremental gameplay, and pixel art… with a touch of mystery: where do all those pixels go?

details.title: Tillow
details.short_description: Tillow is a cozy isometric farm builder that keeps working while you do. Lay out fields, keep animals, make your own wine or distil grappa, and let your workers take over. Docked as a narrow bar at the edge of your screen, it keeps you company while you do other things. No losing, no timers.

details.title: Tales of Weak People
details.short_description: The centennial ritual failed, trapping the United Army inside the Cataclysm. A dark visual novel with Point & Click elements. Explore locations and unite with survivors, gather clues, and make choices to forge a path to the epicenter through madness and death.

details.title: Shred Inc.
details.short_description: Welcome to the NSA — the National Shredding Agency. Your job: destroy classified files, one sheet at a time. Feed the shredder, hit your quota, climb the ranks. And whatever you do, don't read the paperwork. Some files were just meant to be destroyed.

details.title: Nephele
details.short_description: You are the first eukaryote of Nephele! You have nothing but wisdom! Use your wisdom, to survive in such a cell-eat-cell world, and construct your cell civilization!

details.title: Cyber Sweeper
details.short_description: A top-down action survivor set in cyberspace. Sweep virus swarms, stack explosive builds, and clear sector after sector as a firewall defense program.

details.title: BOBA:3
details.short_description: A cozy merge puzzle in a boba cup. Drop kawaii animal pearls, merge matching pairs into bigger (and weirder) lil guys, and don't let the cup overflow. Survive chaotic modifier pearls and unlock new boba flavors as your high score climbs.

details.title: WANGZHA: Dou Dizhu Roguelike
details.short_description: WANGZHA is a roguelike deckbuilder built on Dou Dizhu, the Chinese shedding game (think President or Big Two) where a 2 beats an Ace. Play straights, planes and bombs against landlords who keep raising the rent. Multipliers aren't drawn here, they're grown, one hand at a time.

details.title: Gravitonia
details.short_description: Build and pilot custom war machines in space. Shred enemy ships, installations, and terrain pixel by pixel. Capture fortresses, upgrade your arsenal, and refit at Spacedocks. Conquer a single-player campaign, then create and share war machines, maps, and custom campaigns with the community.

details.title: The Heretic's Seal
details.short_description: Two heretics. Sixty-six ways to break a seal. A dark party RPG where your equipment, gold, and levels carry forward — only the dungeon resets. Pick your pair. Descend. Survive. Or come back stronger.

details.title: The Deconsecration Initiative
details.short_description: A short incremental game about building a machine to kill a god. Fire your laser, collect the shards and grow your base. The god will corrupt your workers into slugs, crystal trees and worse. Put them to work anyway.

details.title: Snapshot Survivor
details.short_description: Snapshot Survivor is an action-focused take on Snapshot, inspired by games like Vampire Survivors with an extra dose of naughty story telling. Roam around in an outskirt of Tokyo trying to survive taking upskirt pictures for profit to unlock new weapons and cutscenes!

details.title: SpaceDeck
details.short_description: SpaceDeck is a roguelike shoot-em-up deckbuilder. Build a deck under fire - dodge bullets, blast enemies and grab cards as you fly. Survive the action, then use your deck to fight a boss in a turn-based card battle. Get blown up, start again and keep fighting until you get your dog back!

details.title: The Villages That Cave
details.short_description: With just three decisions before each battle, build a defence against creatures emerging from caves that turn your villages into more. In this turn-based strategy, exploit terrain, grant villages special powers, use wildcards to wipe out chunks, and upgrade your units and structures.

details.title: + SHORTCIRCUIT -
details.short_description: You've accidentally installed a virus on your old 90's computer! Run through your PC's folders and kill the virus before it deletes precious pictures of your dog!

details.title: ASTRA LIMES: Belt Operations
details.short_description: Command fleets in this indirect control RTS game set within treacherous asteroid belts. Easily design your own skirmishes for a quick 15-minute battle or dive into a campaign of high-risk surgical strikes and systematic border advancement.

details.title: 7Komada
details.short_description: A GAME TO BE PLAYED WITH ONE'S WHOLE LIFE. A killing game based on Werewolf and Mafia, set in an alternate-universe Europe. Your graduation trip is cut short with your entire class kidnapped and locked in an abandoned mansion. Figure out who's behind it, and who you can trust.

details.title: Pew Pew Magic Wizard Fighter
details.short_description: It's Wizard VS Wizard in this isometric arcade battle blaster! Dominate a gauntlet of Best-of-5 duels across unique, destructible arenas that change with every match. Out-maneuver rivals with your chosen fighter's special moves to an eclectic electronic score by inflexi0n.

details.title: Bank Life Simulator
details.short_description: Build, manage, and grow your own bank branch! Handle teller transactions, spot fake IDs, and offer loans and deposits to a living population. Hire and train staff, trade on the stock and black markets, survive strict audits, and rise from a small branch to a financial empire.

details.title: Beep Beep Until You're Rich!
details.short_description: A cozy incremental treasure-hunting game about digging up buried loot with your metal detector, unlocking upgrades, and building a pirate fortune. Help Bia buy her very own pirate ship!

details.title: Banners of the Galaxy
details.short_description: Recruit, scheme, explore, and fight. Build your fleet, choose your allegiances, and command your ships in real-time space battle in this open-world space RPG.

details.title: Final Signal
details.short_description: A signal has been detected deep inside the Backrooms. Go on your first mission with PATROL, explore levels, avoid entities, and work together to find John B., before all that's left of him is his Final Signal.

details.title: ROADS: Tangled in Traffic
details.short_description: The city is strangled by its own explosive growth. Identify the chokepoints, invest in infrastructure, and redesign the network. One well-placed roundabout could nurse it back to life. Can you relieve the pressure and let prosperity flow as freely as the traffic?

details.title: Crystal Siege
details.short_description: Explore, build turrets, and prepare your defenses. When night falls, face relentless waves of enemies to protect your crystal. Inspired by Kingdom Two Crowns and Terraria, Crystal Siege blends strategic Tower Defense with 2D action combat, where you must fight alongside your defenses to survive.

details.title: Roll Dice no Die
details.short_description: Choose your pawn and build a dead man's deck! Challenge yourself in a deadly reimagining of the famous tabletop game where every dice roll can save or kill you! Manipulate the board, make fateful decisions, outsmart the Master, and win this ultimate game of survival!

details.title: CATACOMBOS
details.short_description: CATACOMBOS is a physics-driven roguelite combo-builder where you throw and merge cats, build absurd synergies with cards and cat hats, and crush armies of dogs in the depths of the catacombs.

details.title: Deathless Oath
details.short_description: Become an ancient unholy creature rising against mankind to claim its right to exist through fire and steel. Cut through crowds of enemies, crush them in brutal melee combat, and turn the medieval battlefield to ash. Death waits. The oath remains.

details.title: Covenantum
details.short_description: Covenantum is a seasonal covenant-management RPG inspired by Ars Magica where you guide a growing magical covenant through decades of political intrigue, supernatural events, magical research, and strategic seasonal planning in Mythic Europe.

details.title: Gemtide
details.short_description: A short and satisfying incremental game about collecting gems underwater. Break rocks, get gems, go deeper, repeat.

details.title: Click through Earth
details.short_description: Click Through Earth is a short, relaxing incremental game. Gain diamond and coins. Use them to unlock items and upgrade a versatile upgrade tree. Use your own combination of items to make super powerful attacks.

details.title: Cubuild
details.short_description: A puzzle-platformer where you can't jump. Use limited blocks, sprints, and resets to complete the experiment.

details.title: Cue Knight
details.short_description: Cue Knight is a physics roguelite inspired by billiards. Slingshot yourself through dungeons, smashing monsters with precision shots. Collect powerful weapons and items, upgrade your stats, and clear an endless series of rooms in as few moves as possible.

details.title: Remains on the bus
details.short_description: Deliver packages to the last people living in a beautiful, abandoned brutalist world. Every delivery pays. Every destination gets stranger. And some packages should never be opened.

details.title: Hammered!
details.short_description: Hammered! is a top-down pixel-art action crafting roguelite. As a cursed genius blacksmith, uncover the source of a looming darkness. Forge weapons in real-time, hurl them at enemies, gather allies, and smash your way through!

details.title: BLACKOUT: Fatal Exposure
details.short_description: Your job is to sort through normal photos from ghost photos. You have five days to finish, but it won't end there. Mysterious visitors keep arriving and an unknown terror bleeds into your reality. Can you escape this curse?

details.title: Gemfall
details.short_description: The match 3 roguelike! Battle monsters by matching gems: attack, defend, and cast spells depending on what you pop. Combine gem enchants, spells, and relics to overcome the world of Gemfall!

details.title: Bullets & Boletes
details.short_description: Single-player tactical FPS extraction game where you loot materials and mission items that help you progress through a mysterious main story.

details.title: Chodd
details.short_description: The council of gods has no ruler, and you intend to keep it that way. A Difficult Coop roguelike: march your Warp Core across a hostile world, command your goons in real time, and play scheming gods against each other so none grow strong enough to stop you.

details.title: Zombie Hospital : Abandoned
details.short_description: [Zombie Hospital : Abandoned] is a survival horror game that combines exploration, puzzle-solving, and crafting. You set out alone to investigate a disappearance that occurred in an abandoned hospital. Craft tools and medicine from limited resources and fight to survive against zombies.

details.title: Mesozoic Protocol
details.short_description: The dinosaurs evolve against whatever you over-build. Defend outposts with towers and your armed HQ. Pilot a mech, then adapt as each wave pushes back. Single-player tower defense with Breach and Containment challenges.

details.title: Minigame Collection: KUN
details.short_description: This is a relaxing yet hilariously addictive endless runner starring Kunkun! Take control of Kunkun, who is desperately trying to get home for dinner, and dash through the human world with wild movement, ridiculous dodges, and nonstop chaos.

details.title: You Missed Something
details.short_description: Think you have an eye for detail? Put your observation and memory to the test! Memorize rooms filled with objects, then identify everything that has changed. Unlock new challenges, master harder difficulties, and prove your mind is still sharp.

details.title: Evolanet
details.short_description: Evolanet is a short incremental game about mining ore and evolving a planet.

details.title: Up to the Sky's
details.short_description: A city builder with the depth of a colony sim. Settle a real region of the Earth, lead named residents through hunger and hard winters, and grow from a single tent to an industrial town across seven eras.

details.title: Chicken Trophy: Cozy Coop
details.short_description: A cozy idle coop for your desktop. Dock a flock of happy hens along any screen edge to lay, preen and potter about while you work. Collect eggs, hatch over 400 breeds and dress them in tiny hats, or open up the whole farm for mini-games and friends.

details.title: Lantern Town
details.short_description: Light every street of a cozy night town with exactly the lamp posts it needs. A calm logic puzzle: each post lights its street in four directions until a house or tree stops it. 520 towns, no timers, and a lantern town of your own to grow.
developers: Enaayah Software Development and Services Private Limited
publishers: Enaayah Software Development and Services Private Limited

details.title: Not The Face!
details.short_description: A dodgeball career, from recess to the championship. Draft a team of weirdos, crush middle-schoolers for lunch money, climb five leagues and survive the bosses: Timmy's Mom, Nonna, your own coach. Every ball to the face gets a close-up. 1 to 4 players on the couch, co-op or versus.

name: Demon World: Raya's Way of Life

details.title: Demon World: Raya's Way of Life
details.short_description: In this turn-based RPG, you play as the mercenary Raya, completing missions with cunning, force, or diplomacy. Benevolent choices may come at a hidden cost, while ruthless ones could end up saving humanity.

details.title: HABAP
details.short_description: A cozy reseller sim where you haggle with grannies, buy mystery bags, and turn flea-market junk into profit. Grow your little shop, hunt rare finds, and buy a plane to escape a country where reselling for profit is a crime.

details.title: EpiDexa Racing
details.short_description: EpiDexa Racing is an arcade racing game focused on time trials and online multiplayer. Play with keyboard or controller, climb the leaderboards, and prove your skills against friends or players from around the world.

details.title: You are fired
details.short_description: A fast and chaotic roguelike deckbuilder set in the absurd Hell’s Office. Build a powerful deck, collect twisted artifacts, and outplay your demonic coworkers as you claw your way up the corporate ladder. Face bizarre encounters, slay vicious foes, and crush your boss to earn your freedom.

details.title: Open Land
details.short_description: Transform barren land into a thriving ecosystem in this relaxing building game. Recycle trash, grow plants, and reintroduce wildlife to create a self-sustaining world.

details.title: VILLAIN – Path of the Necromancer
details.short_description: You are an Osteurgo, a lesser necromancer risen from the ashes of the Dark Lord. Raise your empire among desolate mountains, subjugate savage tribes, and spread corruption. Build, conquer, withstand enemy hordes, and claim the empty throne of evil.

details.title: Chess Club Manager
details.short_description: Tycoon game to build and manage your own chess club from the ground up. Balance training, sponsors, tournaments and turn a tiny local club into a global success.

details.title: Magnet Agent
details.short_description: Magnet Agent is a puzzle adventure game based on “magnetic power”. Magnet Agent N-52 and his robot vacuum, Dustino, use their shockingly cool magnetic spy kit to explore the world and thwart Magnet Empress's evil plan before it's too late. They are drawn to danger, are you?

details.title: SUS!
details.short_description: One of them is a thief. Blend into the crowd, steal, knock out your targets and escape, but you have to cough now and then. Spies watch the streets through CCTV, scan the crowd and get one clean stun shot. Stun an innocent and it costs you. Online PvP for 2 to 10 players, or play against bots.

details.title: Rondo's Romp
details.short_description: Join Rondo, a cheerful Akita pup, as he explores 6 whimsical worlds, digging up coins, items, and throwable objects to solve puzzles, battle enemies, and uncover secrets... all with the charm and challenge of a classic 2D platformer!

details.title: Po10tions: Silver Path
details.short_description: Po10tions: Silver Path is a deck-building business simulation game. Start your business in a magic world in the 18th-century. Produce 3 types of goods and sell them. Play cards to produce more, trade for better prices, or stop your opponents. Make money faster to win!

details.title: Little Devil
details.short_description: Little Devil is a top-down horror-comedy roguelike. Combine primary and secondary weapons, fuel a soul-powered ability, and stack Boons as you go. Survive permadeath, beat three random Deadly Sins, and face Lucifer at the end of every run.

details.title: Tower of Creation
details.short_description: Immortality became a curse, so humans chose to return their souls to the Creator. You are the last one left. As you take the same Path as your lost love, you discover that paradise is a lie and that the real mystery has only just begun.

details.title: Lost In Your Eyes
details.short_description: Lost In Your Eyes is a 2 Player co-op Puzzle Adventure game where you and your friend face the challenging puzzles to escape uniquely designed levels together. Communication is a key element for every puzzle to be solved but do you trust your friend or your EYES?

details.title: Feed The Lone Bastion
details.short_description: An Incremental-Ish game about evolving The Bastion.

details.title: SHALTER-03
details.short_description: Time is ticking. In this co-op first-person puzzle-adventure game where the senses of sight, hearing, and speech are disabled, each level introduces new mechanics. Think fast, balance buffs and debuffs, and find the most efficient path to victory. Adaptability is your greatest weapon.

details.title: Sunderborn
details.short_description: This is a multiplayer asynchronous sandbox with elements of puzzles, logic games, world exploration, and strategy. Take on the role of the Creator, shaping your own reality out of the surrounding Chaos. Manage your created world and compete with other Gods!

details.title: 5th ERA
details.short_description: A techno-fantasy JRPG inspired by 16-bit classics. Explore Helgon, the city on the comet, and build your ideal team from a roster of 9 distinct characters, each with their own classes. Engage in strategic turn-based combat against the deadly Brightlings to uncover the truth behind the white portals.

details.title: Pearls of Wisdom
details.short_description: A relaxing card game with real-world side quests. Match inspiring and reflective quotes, combine special effect emblems, do out of game side quests and build your deck to get high scores. Reflect, relax, and walk away feeling good after you've finished playing.

details.title: Timberflow: Sawmill Simulator
details.short_description: From a single tree to an entire industry! Manage and automate your lumber business in this relaxing, yet challenging Sawmill Simulator. Start small, grow rich, dominate the market.

details.title: Auspicious Clouds
details.short_description: A unique turn-based game featuring Auspicious Cloud Cards. Wield the power of the Five Elements to unleash skills and vanquish foes. Unlock a vast roster of character skills, collect Cultivation Orbs, and devise your own one-of-a-kind tactics to conquer every opponent.

details.title: As We Planned
details.short_description: Stealth PVE heist with friends. Steal valuables, solve puzzles, use tools, upgrade your base, and complete quests. You can go quiet or loud — the choice is yours. Up to 4 players. Every raid is unique!

details.title: Project Lighthouse
details.short_description: Trapped inside a scientific anomaly, solve puzzles with evolving teleportation tech and uncover the fate of the vanished “keepers”. Built alongside our community, props we made for Project Lighthouse are free for other game developers.

details.title: ZENITH
details.short_description: ZENITH is a score-attack puzzler fusing Tetris with roguelike deckbuilding. Assemble a build all your own from 100+ enhancements.
