The higher you stack, the more your multiplier climbs — and when synergies click, one clear can erupt for tens of thousands of points. Chase an absurdly high score.

details.title: content moderator.
details.short_description: Eidopathy is a disease in which hallucinations spread through photographs. To pay for your mother's surgery, you apply for a suspicious part-time job as a Content Moderator, deleting photos containing hallucinations. Make it out of the anomalous office alive.

details.title: OxVOID
details.short_description: OxVOID — a minimalist puzzle game where physics, logic, and environment work as a single system. Master the rules through carefully crafted challenges. Then push the boundaries — create your own levels in the built-in editor.

details.title: Dice of Braves
details.short_description: Dice of Braves is a streamlined turn-based roguelike strategy game. Recruit, roll dice, decide, fight, level up, change class! Squad-building + strategy + luck! Assemble your team, destroy the undead legion, defeat the Dark Lord, and restore order to the world!

details.title: Runic Dungeon
details.short_description: Runic Dungeon is a challenging fantasy rogue-lite bullet-hell dungeon crawler with RPG elements. Level up and assemble arcane runes to craft unique, ultimate builds. Gear up your character and clear dungeons infested with deadly monsters!

details.title: Duelists
details.short_description: A 2D arena brawler for two to four players, on the couch or online, where losing is the fastest way to become dangerous. Between rounds the shop reads the scoreboard and arms whoever is behind. The cat running it is not sorry.

details.title: New Science
details.short_description: Combine illustrated cards in an open-ended world of discovery. Follow Targets through 16 Ages or experiment freely with every card you find. Build your collection, trade with other players and make discoveries nobody has found before.

details.title: Select Kiss +Plus
details.short_description: Select Kiss +Plus is a lighthearted visual novel where you choose two people from a colorful cast of six and lock them inside “The Room You Can’t Leave Until You Kiss.”

details.title: Simulacre
details.short_description: Simulacre is a 1–4 player co-op psychological horror where familiar voices may not belong to your friends. Explore unsettling locations with unique objectives and threats, survive together, and never be certain who—or what—you can trust.

details.title: Exiled Ark
details.short_description: Fight, build, and survive aboard a ruined interstellar colony ship. Scavenge resources, forge powerful weapons, establish strongholds, and reclaim humanity's last Ark. Master six attribute paths, unlock four technology trees, and shape your own ending through roguelike and relentless combat.

details.title: Eightfold
details.short_description: Eightfold is a hand-drawn roguelike deckbuilder set in a cursed carnival. Play poker hands, build your deck, and sign Pacts you might regret. Face ancient Gods who break the rules your deck relies on. Take their souls and pay your debt.

name: One Percent - Game About Taxing Billionaires

details.title: One Percent - Game About Taxing Billionaires
details.short_description: Comrade! Filthy billionaires are buying political influence again! Shoot their flying bribes from the sky in this fast incremental class struggle. Help the common people rise, don’t get corrupted, win the people’s votes, unlock powerful upgrades, and tax the billionaires out of power!

details.title: Pilgrimage of the Fallen
details.short_description: Pilgrimage of the Fallen is a 3D top-down Zelda-like ARPG focused on non-linear exploration. Navigate intricate labyrinths, gather hidden loot for alchemy, and slay ancient tyrants in unforgiving blade combat.

details.title: Orbsorber
details.short_description: Orbsorber is a single-player, action-adventure RPG focused around collecting Orbs. You play as a cosmic ball of energy exploring uniquely themed zones, smashing obstacles, defeating bosses, and gaining new abilities. Absorb Orbs to upgrade your powers and awaken your true potential.

details.title: Hwaseo
details.short_description: A Korean folk dark fantasy deck-building roguelike. Three souls. One bound fate. Three companions are bound to one shared deck — every draw is a party question, not a single hero's. Journey through layered shrines drawn from Korean folklore.

details.title: Space Annihilator
details.short_description: Command a powerful space warship and fight your way through relentless waves of enemy ships and bases to achieve the ultimate victory!

details.title: Turtle Up
details.short_description: Only up — with the turtle and skateboard!

details.title: On Break
details.short_description: Fresnel Labs needs a Box Stacking Technician. Press the button, drop the box, build a tower that won't topple. Chain colors, earn your pay and spend it on strange office decorations that rewrite the rules of the job. Your robot supervisor, B.A.S.I.L., thinks you'll do great. Probably.

details.title: Souls in Conflict
details.short_description: High-intensity 3v3 arena fights in third person. Every ability is aimed by hand. Play Warrior, Fire Mage, Poacher or Priestess. Land hits to build Soul Shards for your most devastating abilities. Spend your stamina on quadruple jumps, sprinting and rolling. No pay-to-win, no grind: just skill.

details.title: Desktop Gugu: Cozy Idle Pet
details.short_description: A cozy desktop idle game with two pet species: a mining duck and a leaf-topped mushroom. Sweep up crystals and timber, sell resources, feed your helpers, and combine duck talents. Adjust music and desktop settings to suit your day.

details.title: Fox Idle
details.short_description: Go on an adventure with cute fox-eared companions! Gather resources, craft gear, fight monsters, complete quests, and most importantly, make progress together with foxgirls in this incremental idle RPG.

details.title: Wands & Whiskers
details.short_description: Rescue cats, discover rare coats, and grow a cozy network of shelters in this idle cat collector. Wave a wand for a roomful of playful chaos, decorate their favorite spots, or relax while the donations roll in, even while you're away.

details.title: Tabletop Tycoon
details.short_description: In Tabletop Tycoon you start your own board game company from a single desk and grow it into the biggest name in the industry. Design games that sell, design your own box and make every piece fit inside. Research new genres and mechanics. Build and decorate your office as you outgrow your rivals.

details.title: God Codex
details.short_description: A cinematic 2D pixel-art action adventure. Slay the Demon King, then awaken within her memories as two girls struggle against fate in a collapsing world. Heavy combat, environmental storytelling, and immersive cinematic presentation with almost no UI.

details.title: Your Momo
details.short_description: Shortstack, Interaction, Desktop Companion. Your Momo is a narrative, cozy desktop game. Talk with Momo through playful spanks on her butt and build a deeper bond. Unlock new items through conversation and watch her draw freely on your desktop as time passes.

details.title: Melody Flow
details.short_description: Catch the notes. Save the melody. Fly through procedurally generated musical worlds, dodge shifting obstacles, and compete for high scores in fast-paced arcade gameplay. Play solo or challenge a friend in split-screen multiplayer.

details.title: Fuel Needed
details.short_description: Race against time or other players through difficult levels full of obstacles.

details.title: STEEL CORE
details.short_description: STEEL CORE is a tactical turn-based strategy about giant mechs defending mining outposts on hostile worlds. Build each mech from parts, fortify your base, and survive an escalating roguelite campaign against an overwhelming alien enemy. Frontier work pays well, for those who survive it.

details.title: Knights v Zombies
details.short_description: Knights. Zombies. Pirate ships. Giant robots. A chaotic 1-4 player couch co-op hack and slash that starts medieval and ends in maximum carnage. If that sounds like the ravings of a six-year-old, that's because it is! It was designed by a kid with crayons and built by his dad in Unreal Engine.

details.title: Dead & Delicious
details.short_description: Dead & Delicious is a chaotic co-op burger shop simulator for 1-4 players. Serve customers out front while zombies pour in from the back. Shoot them, slice them apart, and feed the pieces into the grinder. Fresh patties, happy customers, and nobody ever asks where the meat came from.

details.title: SUSHI CHESS
details.short_description: Capture your rival’s sushi and you pay the bill. Manage your money and decide which pieces to take—or tempt them to take—in this topsy-turvy turn-based board game. Enjoy a feature-packed Puzzle Mode, three CPU difficulty levels, and one-on-one local or online matches with friends.

details.title: INKTRICK
details.short_description: INKTRICK is a handcrafted, cozy roguelike card game made of cards, ink and stamps. Win tricks, turn a weak 8 into a trump and unlock new possibilities hand after hand, such as stamp upgrades and mystery packs. Fibus deals, cheers you on and plays against you.

details.title: HAXMAX
details.short_description: Run, fight, and hide! Go as far as you can as HAX, adapting to a changing economy and varied terrain in this unique roguelite autobattler. But hurry - the system's ANTIHAX is hunting you down, appearing when you least expect it and returning stronger each time!

details.title: Mewtations: Dogma
details.short_description: Build a cat colony on a cluttered board of cards. Craft, farm and gear up your crew, send them on roguelite expeditions with automatic battles, and stand up to Boss Huohuo's dog mafia, before the next tax note comes due.

details.title: Netherworld: Blood Moon
details.short_description: You wake up shackled to a bamboo stalk in an unfamiliar forest. In the distance, something seems to be moving through the grove. You look closer... until you realize... it isn’t alive at all. One bizarre and horrifying event follows another. Under unbearable pressure, can you find a way out alive?

details.title: Omenweald : Les Erres
details.short_description: An ARPG where you build the adventure you fight through. Spin a crazy one-armed bandit, roguelite style, to win better pieces of your adventure, room after room, until the final one.

details.title: Maiden Escape
details.short_description: Play as a paranormal investigator and escape from a ghost's nightmare. A horror adventure with 168 box-pushing puzzles and 2 endings.

details.title: Kaartel
details.short_description: Hunt a moving thief across Europe. Ask questions, eliminate cities, predict their next move, block escape routes, and intercept them before they get away.

details.title: Ramen Haven
details.short_description: Turn a humble ramen cart into the shop of your dreams in this cozy cooking and management game. Prepare delicious ramen, delight customers, unlock new recipes, upgrade and decorate your space, and grow your small business into a thriving restaurant.

details.title: Rebel Roar
details.short_description: Build two decks at once in REBEL ROAR, a tactical deckbuilding roguelike where each rebel unlocks a different way to play. Combine an animal deck with a class deck to create Ninja Cats, Hacker Opossums, and hundreds of unique builds as you lead the rebellion through a cyberpunk animal world.

details.title: Codebreakers VR
details.short_description: Codebreakers is a chaotic VR Action Shooter that takes place in a dystopian future where various organizations are fighting for control of the world order.As a breaker, you will have to infiltrate, defeat enemies and avoid security systems to extract data.

details.title: Crop and Claw 2
details.short_description: Crop and Claw 2 is an Adventure-RPG about dragons, plants, memories, and more. Delve into a whole new continent of secrets and unearth the roots of the strange events going on.

details.title: Bread & Bravery
details.short_description: Return to the era of knights and castles in a uniquely satisfying mix of Settlement Building, RTS and Castle Simulation genres. Manage complex and realistic medieval production chains, build your army and defences, satisfy the King and lead your people to prosperity. Will you succeed as a new lord?

details.title: Falafel King
details.short_description: Take orders, fry falafel and fill pitas, solo or with up to three friends, at a quiet stand in Tel Aviv's Carmel Market. Do it well and word gets around: more customers, more dishes, and a lunch rush you'll need every hand for.

details.title: 玫昙 She From TheFuture
details.short_description: Mei can see hidden memories. Two years ago, Her lovers Tan died in a fire, ruled suicide. She became a detective. Then she discovered she can travel through time. She must return to the night Tan died—can she change it or just watch it burn again?

details.title: Biryado
details.short_description: Biryado is a billiards roguelike deckbuilder where rules are made to be broken. Collect Billy’s bizarre artefacts, customize your balls with wild abilities and combine their effects into absurd combos. Master shifting tables, overcome eccentric bosses, and send your score into another dimension!

details.title: Horns
details.short_description: Horns is an evolving dark fantasy RPG inspired by retro ARPG adventures of the late ‘90s. Join Lyssandra on her search for the king in a collapsed, magical world as she grows more grotesque on her trek for truth. Fight the darkness — or become it — and watch the world react accordingly.

details.title: Luminons: Seeds of Starlight
details.short_description: Farming sim meets monster taming. Grow crops to feed and strengthen your Luminons. Compete in beauty contests or strategic 3v3 battles.

details.title: Barns & Beams
details.short_description: You are a city kid who can no longer afford housing, but luckily, your grandfather has left you his disastrous farm in the middle of nowhere as an inheritance. You will have to learn to manage farm life and, along the way, deal with "Them."

details.title: Duskfire
details.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelite deckbuilder where tactical positioning matters as much as the cards you play. Collect new spells, recruit and modify powerful creatures, upgrade your spells, and build a unique deck every run. Master strategic battles and grow stronger through a roguelite progression system.

details.title: Borrowed Flesh
details.short_description: A body-horror deckbuilding roguelike where your whole party shares one deck. Pick 3 of 5 broken souls, and when one falls, every card they carried dies with them. Survive permanent mutilation and descend as far as your flesh can bear.

details.title: 5-Star Taxi
details.short_description: A fast-paced arcade taxi game where time is your greatest enemy - find shortcuts, deliver passengers, tear through a destructible city, escape the police, and earn a perfect 5-star rating before your shift ends.

details.title: Stay On Track
details.short_description: A 3d physics based platformer where you play as marble in a marble race that must jump, boost and dodge the onslaught of other marbles to discover if there's more to explore outside the life they're used to.

details.title: Void Inc
details.short_description: Survive corporate horror in this surreal startup simulator. A dark comedy, where you drink coffee, plan, get through the day, grow the startup, manage staff and explore the company and it's dark secrets.

details.title: The Uncovering
details.short_description: In a modern city's daily life, become detective Xiquan, interview suspects face-to-face, catch cracks in their words, use evidence to shatter composure. Shift between viewpoints, gather fragments, trace connections, peel away twisted lies and fixations—until the truth surfaces.

details.title: PumpUp Fugu
details.short_description: Tap a PumpUp Fugu and it puffs up in a huff — use that to shove the Fugu Queen out through the coral wall and set her free! 160 hand-built levels, plus more once you have cleared them. An action physics puzzler with times worth chasing.

details.title: Hunt Soul Infinity
details.short_description: Embark on an epic journey through a breathtaking world where every split-second decision can mean the difference between victory and defeat!

details.title: Drain the Galaxy
details.short_description: Thousands of space dwarves vs. one planet. The planet loses. Land, strip it bare in short runs with pickaxes, lasers and missiles, haul the loot home and grow a huge upgrade tree. You can't lose. You can only get richer

details.title: Morality
details.short_description: **MORALITY** is a psychological interactive game where every choice matters. Explore a mysterious computer, uncover hidden secrets, and make decisions that can change the course of the story. **What are you going to do?**

details.title: Don't Drop It
details.short_description: Carry a fragile power core to its socket with a friend, and don't drop it! Whoever holds it can't jump: throw, catch and keep passing. Swinging cranes, steam jets and crumbling floors stand in your way.

details.title: Topiary: A Pruning Puzzle
details.short_description: Grow trees into beautiful shapes in Topiary, a peaceful puzzle game about pruning and planning ahead. Cutting a branch doesn't just remove it, it changes where your tree grows next. Take your time with each puzzle, or challenge yourself to make every season count.

details.title: 奇怪的三国模拟器
details.short_description: Run a county seat in a supernatural Three Kingdoms campaign. Build watchtowers, recruit officers and post bounties that draw them into the fog or back to guard a grain convoy. Manage a growing settlement through 16 single-player real-time strategy missions.

details.title: Taboo Village: Tokimeki Card Game
details.short_description: Play a deadly roguelite card game with a mysterious animal-eared girl in your dreams. Build melds, upgrade your cards, gain powerful abilities, and defeat bosses. Lose, and you'll never wake up—but as long as she's there, maybe staying in the dream isn't so bad.

details.title: Loop Apartment: Visitor
details.short_description: You visit an old friend, but Room 305 is empty - and the hallway outside has changed. Explore a shifting apartment through a retro interface, gather clues, and face tabletop RPG–style dice checks. Each time you lose consciousness, the building reshapes itself. Your clues carry over to the next loop.

details.title: Mato
details.short_description: Mato is a narrative card adventure steeped in Chinese folk horror. Swipe to make choices, manage hunger and sanity, and fight grotesque creatures. Explore branching stories across cycles of death and rebirth, using what you learn to find a way off the mountain.

details.title: SumMon
details.short_description: Capture monsters and shapeshift into them, several at once. Combine their elements in turn-based battles on a hex-grid battlefield. Embark on an adventure to defeat the Summoner Masters and become one.

details.title: Driver Wars
details.short_description: A chaotic and satirical late-stage capitalistic driving simulator. In this low-poly 3D world, live out the fantasies and nightmares of countless commuters gridlocked in traffic as you ram, blow up, set ablaze, toss donuts at, honk, grapple, and total hordes of terrible and aggressive NPC drivers.

details.title: Ledger of Names
details.short_description: You've taken over your uncle's shop for 100 days. Stock up from your suppliers, read what customers really need, and set your own prices. Follow the town's news, grow your trade partners, and keep the shelves ready. As the fog thickens, one sale today can change someone's tomorrow.

details.title: Trinity Descent
details.short_description: A dark idle RPG about descending into the deep: assemble a party from ten classes, pick your route through branching zones and let them fight on their own. Bank your loot in time or lose it all. Enhance your gear, forge the great sets and climb down the Endless Mine.

details.title: Neon Gamble Trail
details.short_description: Cyberpunk roguelike slot game. Enter a neon tavern. Roll three numbers 1–9 for winning combos to battle rivals. Collect numbers and tokens to strengthen your build. Explore branching paths, encounter random events, and recover at supply stops. Strategize, spin reels, and create an unbeatable lineup.

details.title: Pray & Slay
details.short_description: Wipe out hordes of monsters with holy magic in this action-packed incremental game. Multiply your gold with darts and grow stronger with every run. Corrupt your holy spells to unleash devastating dark powers.

details.title: SOGUL: Den of the Deep
details.short_description: Fight with your right hand, keep the beat with your left. Every note you land sharpens your strike — and every enemy blow can be parried on rhythm. Descend 50 floors to the Lich below with four companions you named yourself, in this rhythm-driven turn-based roguelite.

details.title: Twilight Tavern
details.short_description: Run a shop for supernatural customers in a cozy first-person sim. Stock shelves, brew potions, haggle over prices, and spot counterfeit coins. Shape each day with magical charms, explore a curious village and snowy floating islands, and follow Aunt Hesper’s trail through hidden paths and puzzles.

details.title: Last Haul
details.short_description: Welcome to the worst mining job in the universe. Mine asteroids, tow the crystals home, unlock new weapons, ships and modules, and create devastating builds. Take on a different job in every zone, survive deadly encounters, and defeat massive bosses.

details.title: Winnie's Arcade Pizza
details.short_description: Run your newly bought old arcade pizza center, restore it back to it's former glory and find out about the strange past behind the walls of this place. fill the place up with arcades and pizzas and keep your customers happy. See if you can you reach the perfect end, or the worst...

details.title: GNAP GNAP
details.short_description: GNAP GNAP is a horde roguelite shooter where you pop ominous balloons that keep multiplying. Unlock items, harpoons and grow stronger with each run. Equip your harpoon, max your stats and defeat all the entities keeping you against your will.

details.title: Sussy NPC
details.short_description: You're a sussy NPC in a crowd of NPCs. Hunters are hunting you. Act normal, blend in, don't flinch. Or be the Hunter, read the room and catch them. In-game voice chat is recommended for the best experience.

details.title: Tide of the Depths
details.short_description: Build a team of mighty sea creatures in a lane-based tower defense where the battlefield reshapes your strategy. Harness environmental powers, trigger elemental chain reactions, and adapt your defenders to stop the corruption.

details.title: Saboteer
details.short_description: A 3-12 player extraction game about digging for treasure as a loyal team of dwarves... Or most of you are loyal anyway; someone is secretly trying to sabotage the group. Explore and excavate, scavenge for items and treasure, and put your perception and deception skills to the test.

details.title: You Should Have Stopped
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelite with one simple bet, over and over: stake your health, gold or attack, watch the number climb, and stop before it crashes. Your enemies are parts of your own body. Hand-drawn, sketchy and ugly.

details.title: Überlauf
details.short_description: Build a mine with cards on a freshly rolled voxel island: place mines, lay belts, smelt ore into ingots. You get 75 seconds per round. Then your jokers multiply the takings until the number catches fire. A roguelike blend of factory building and cards.

details.title: Above the Tideline
details.short_description: Norway, April 1945. Keep a lighthouse, a family and a logbook alive on an occupied island. Decide what the light does at night — and what the record says in the morning. Every lie you write has to survive the rest of the week.

details.title: Curious Paws: Pawsitive Journey
details.short_description: Embark on a cozy journey through vibrant isometric dioramas! Help a curious cat repair an old steam locomotive by exploring heartwarming locations, interacting with quirky animal locals, and solving clever puzzles — completely text-free.

details.title: Necrowake: Bone Legion
details.short_description: Lead an undead army through waves of enemies in this action roguelite. Recruit elite minions, choose your formation, and combine equipment skills to build your legion. Pick your next battle through portals, defeat bosses, and spend your shards to grow stronger.

details.title: Doomsbell
details.short_description: An auto battler where every protocol plays by its own rules and your Commander fights beside your army. Choose your road through wagers, stories and bosses, merge and fit out your machines, then outbuild other players' armies, one turn at a time.

details.title: NOSTRA: Crystalbound
details.short_description: An action roguelite from the world of NOSTRA. It is the year 860 of the Charter: crystal grows everywhere and no kingdom guards the roads. Take the merchants' coin as the Rune Warrior, etch runes into your abilities on every run and fight through three regions of a broken land.

details.title: Proviantmeister 1756
details.short_description: His Majesty’s army shall march – provided you keep it supplied! Manage depots, organize wagon trains, procure provisions, fodder and ammunition, and contend with weather and war. A historical military logistics simulation set during the Seven Years’ War, 1756–1763.

details.title: The Forgotten Workshop
details.short_description: A cozy alchemy idle game: brew potions, serve customers and hire little clay homunculi who keep the shop running, even while you're away. Explore the Grimoire, risk strange mixtures in the cauldron and bring three workshops full of surprises back to life.

details.title: One More Wave: Tower Defense
details.short_description: A tower defense game where you build towers along a road and hold off one wave after another. There are 9 towers with two upgrade paths each, 17 enemy types, 5 final bosses, 7 hand-made maps plus random ones, and an Endless mode.

details.title: Frog Express
details.short_description: Collect frogs and upgrade your express in an active incremental game! Power up manual collection, install automated modules, or combine both. Merge hats, fill your frog album, and unlock permanent upgrades to travel further with every run.

details.title: StarRanger
details.short_description: Lead a field team in a story-driven sci-fi RPG with turn-based squad combat. Build your squad's skills, choose its equipment, and make difficult calls on assignments with the Star Rangers - all while searching for your missing brother.

details.title: Grief the Server
details.short_description: The admins are away. Grief a voxel server in this single-player incremental: sabotage builds, unlock outrageous cheats and become everyone's problem. Simulated players repair, fight back and unite against you. Play in first person or send a bot in Idle Mode.

details.title: Battle Winds
details.short_description: A galaxy of over 7,000 stars lives on without you: trading, waging war, and falling back before the Reapers. Take the helm, jump to any star, set your ship down on a planet, and step outside, rifle in hand. Every battle, deal, and sortie you make reshapes the map everyone sees.

details.title: Dopamine Cube
details.short_description: A fast-paced roguelite shooter where every level-up is a slot machine spin. Dodge bullet storms, stack wild upgrades, fuse synergies into your own abilities and merge your guns to see how far your build can go.

details.title: Voretsk
details.short_description: Voretsk is a 3D First Person Extraction Shooter where you play as civilians trapped in the middle of a war zone. Alone or with a friend venture into the cruel Voretsk Zone, fight or hide, scavenge and get back. Complete missions, uncover a way out, and leave the Zone behind and reclaim your life.

details.title: Fantasy Guild Manager
details.short_description: Your heroes handle the fighting. Everything else is your problem. Recruit and level up adventurers, send them into auto-battles before quest timers run out, and grow your Guild Town in real time while Chaos creeps across the land.

name: Kiel & Kontor – Vom Stamm zum Stapellauf

details.title: Kiel & Kontor – Vom Stamm zum Stapellauf
details.short_description: Manage a historical shipyard: design ships for customers, organise materials and skilled workers, negotiate contracts and expand your business. From simple rowing boats to great sailing ships, craftsmanship, quality and smart business decisions determine your success.

name: Skeletal Heroes: Attack of the Slimes

details.title: Skeletal Heroes: Attack of the Slimes
details.short_description: Six skeleton heroes, one bony adventure. Slash, shoot, smash and cast through 16 story chapters overrun by slimes. Swap heroes mid-fight to hit each monster’s weakness, unleash a super for every hero and topple giant bosses in this colorful third-person action RPG.

details.title: Blobbardment
details.short_description: Blobbardment is a turn-based artillery party game where every fighter is a blob of jelly. Swallow a bomb and spit it back, split in two, freeze the sea into a bridge, then knock your friends off the map. Play online, on one screen, against bots or in a story campaign.

details.title: Pocket Post.
details.short_description: Deliver the mail. Pocket Post is a minimal strategy game about managing post routes.

details.title: Jarlfall: Strandhögg
details.short_description: Strike the shore before the tide turns. Lead Viking raiders through tafl-style battles on sinking boards, grab loot village by village, and sail home to grow your Great Hall before luck runs out.

details.title: Cityterium
details.short_description: Cityterium is a multiplayer voxel sandbox where the real world becomes your canvas. Choose a city, build freely, tear things down, and reshape it with others, one block at a time.

details.title: Not Your Keys
details.short_description: Not Your Keys is a Bitcoin roguelike deckbuilder. Draft NFT cards, evolve them into stronger forms, and fight junk coins, frozen exchanges, and the Federal Reserve itself across a 21-block run to The Final Block.

details.title: Hidden Layer
details.short_description: See how AI really works by building it. Buffalo, 1958: the Navy has paid for a machine that learns. Write the Python that teaches it, from the first perceptron through backpropagation and deep learning to attention, the idea inside today's chatbots. A programming puzzle game about machine learning.

details.title: It's a Montage
details.short_description: A pixel-art training game with no opponents, where every level you gain shows on your character and the world around you. Once you outgrow the dojo, you train at a waterfall, on the open sea, on the moon, on a star and at the edge of a black hole.

details.title: Warband Incremental
details.short_description: Start with two footmen and build a warband of humans, orcs, elves, and undead in this voxel incremental auto-battler. Shape your formation, equip heroes, and unlock a vast tech tree. Battle through four chapters and giant bosses, then rebirth with your gear and unlocked factions intact.

details.title: Waterscape Atlas
details.short_description: Not a lake, not a river: the sea, fished the Japanese way. Surf, breakwaters, island rocks and boats on one life-size coast. 40 ways to fish from sabiki to squid jigging, 40+ species, real tackle logic, and every bite through a vibrating controller. Five dioramas included.

details.title: Saw Down
details.short_description: Turn a tiny robot with a saw into a machine that grinds through mountains of scrap. Gather resources, choose your upgrades, and unleash explosions, flying sawblades, and chain lightning. Grow stronger with every haul and cut your way deeper.

details.title: 三国：群英演义
details.short_description: You are no famed general or warlord. A nameless commoner, you enter a broken land with five villagers. Recruit and arm them; farmers become veterans beside you. These are no mere numbers. Old heroes are gone. Your story is unwritten. March on: legend, or footnote?

details.title: Kesselgrid
details.short_description: Turn-based grand strategy on a hex map, set in the First and Second World Wars. Run a nation's industry, politics and diplomacy, command its armies, fleets and air force, and break the enemy front. Play alone against the AI, in co-op or online against your friends.

details.title: Sprinkle Gnomes
details.short_description: Sprinkle Gnomes is a cozy first-person co-op game about bringing the scorched badlands back to life. Find hidden wells, build watering automations and ride camels across the dry land until grass springs up again. Play solo or team up with friends and turn every dusty corner green.

details.title: Secret of Nox
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in this action roguelike game, turn defeated enemies into your minions. Explore 12+ unique classes, endless playstyles, battle through 50+ maps, epic bosses and discover the Secret of Nox.

details.title: I Missed the Apocalypse 2
details.short_description: You missed the apocalypse. Now it’s up to you to take back the Earth. Gather, craft and build your base with your flying companion Eddy, survive Alien attacks every night, free mind controlled humans and smash every Alien Heart, from Scandinavia to the whole world.

details.title: Vale's Echo
details.short_description: Death isn’t the end - it’s your last chance. Solve haunting puzzles and make choices that matter as you guide Vale across the underworld. Will regret follow her into eternity?

details.title: Deus Exia
details.short_description: “Before your planet gets blown into smithereens, take this sword and protect yourself.” Embark on a colorful 2D pixel action adventure in Deus Exia! Slash, parry and combo through four distinct lands. Collect cards and skills to craft powerful builds — then overcome deadly enemies and bosses.

details.title: Whisk
details.short_description: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.

details.title: Occult Trap
details.short_description: Within the test chambers filled with horrific traps and unidentified creatures, you must analyze the creatures’ behavior patterns and use the environment to escape their relentless pursuit. Search the surroundings to gather items, disable or exploit traps, and forge your path forward.

details.title: Abelina
details.short_description: A surreal, hand-crafted adventure platformer. Vasily died and woke up in Abelina, a settlement in the afterlife. Now he’s heading into the frontier with his companions following behind. No combat, just a vast world to explore and a mature story about carrying life’s baggage into the afterlife.

details.title: Lost Arsenal
details.short_description: Lost Arsenal is a challenging movement-heavy melee action game. Stylishly maneuver through areas by teleporting to your thrown weapons, and use each weapon's unique power to carve your way through a summoner's invasion.

details.title: Heartwood TD
details.short_description: A maze tower defense roguelite where every tower is also a wall. Plant Wardens to shape the path the nightmares walk, combine their powers into chain reactions, and grow a stronger maze with every run.

details.title: wormin
details.short_description: Synchronize Wormins with ancient glyphs in a mysterious world of signs and snakes. Discover strange rules, clever interactions, and puzzles hidden beneath the surface.

details.title: I Don't Do Quests Anymore...
details.short_description: Be the quest giver in this casual guild management game! Tired of doing all these quests for random NPCs? This time, you can be this NPC! Take your place in your very own adventurers guild and distribute quests to heroes. brew potions, craft gear and make smart choices to help them survive!

details.title: Rain of Lead
details.short_description: Every hit is lethal, with no room for error. Switch between sword and pistol to tear through soldiers, artillery pieces, tanks — and even destroy an entire army. You awaken without memories. A queen claiming to be your wife asks you to fight for her. Will you stand with her to the end?

details.title: Cube Colony
details.short_description: Grow a colony one cube at a time and keep Industry, Nature and Science in balance. Your colonists have opinions. Your balance bar has limits. Push it too far, and it all comes crashing down.

details.title: Imperium of the Stars
details.short_description: Rebuild a scattered empire in a Gothic galaxy of distant beacons and lost colonies. A real-time 4X with four distinct playable factions, empire-wide command, and Living Sagas shaped by how you govern and conquer up to 10,000 star systems.

details.title: Armed-Mageddon
details.short_description: Top-down bullet heaven with randomly generated weapons and maps. Find guns, level up, unlock everything, upgrade and evolve your weapons to create unique and crazy builds as you blast your way through the end of the world!

details.title: The Kept Fire
details.short_description: Your brother’s hiking group vanished. Beyond the cave, the valley is hunting you. The beast only moves when you look away, but stare too long and you go blind. Keep your fire alive, find a way out, and remember: you can survive three encounters. Not four.

details.title: Scrim-Mage
details.short_description: Scrim-Mage is a casual 2d fighting game where you and a friend play as gnome wizards and can customise your moveset with different spells. Competitive silliness is a guarantee in this colourful combination between traditional and platform fighters.

details.title: Ashes of Pantheon
details.short_description: Become the Ash Fire. Chart your gladiator’s course through the arena with directive cards, then watch your plan play out in real time. Build your deck, manage resources, and rekindle divine power in a turn-based strategy deckbuilder steeped in ancient Roman mythology.

details.title: Drive To The Top
details.short_description: Jump, Swing and Boost your way to get to the finish as fast as you can! Try beating the level in both single player and 2-player co-op. How fast can you beat the game?

details.title: Medusa's Gaze
details.short_description: A new 3D first-person puzzle game, where every death leaves behind a petrified statue of yourself - can you use this to outwit Medusa? Solve dozens of mind-bending puzzles involving light & shadow, life & death, to uncover the mystery at the heart of the fortress.

details.title: Drop Dead Lucky
details.short_description: Every bounce is a gamble. Make yours count. Drop Dead Lucky is a Plinko roguelite where you aim your drops, nudge fate in your favor, and combine charms, runes, and spirits to build huge scores and survive eight escalating antes.

details.title: EconoCity
details.short_description: A shared-world city builder and economy game. Buy land, lay roads, build block by block, sell power and water, and set your rent. Every rival is a real player, every price was set by one, and the city keeps running when you log off.

details.title: CRUMBKINS
details.short_description: A 1–4 player physics-based co-op heist comedy about tiny, hungry thieves. Climb giant furniture, steal food for picky clients, and decide: deliver the loot, throw it to a friend, or eat a pepper and shoot fireballs.

details.title: Dear Maid
details.short_description: I spent every penny I had and signed up for 60 monthly payments on a maid robot. Then the world ended.

details.title: Roll Call: Hero League Manager
details.short_description: Build your superhero dream team from 888 playable characters and take on 35 bosses. Negotiate transfers, brave dangerous missions, and keep clashing egos and the payroll under control. Outthink 49 rival clubs in a turn-based management game where every roll can change your season.

details.title: SLASHER NIGHT
details.short_description: A single-player VR slasher simulator. Stalk targets through Redcastle, strike with hands-on weapons and face physical NPC reactions. Choose your approach and survive escalating resistance as witnesses flee and authorities respond.

details.title: Roadworn
details.short_description: Roadworn is a dark fantasy sandbox RPG. Lead a squad across a new world of rival states, wild factions and bandits, get drawn into intrigue around the thrones, fight turn-based hex battles and rise from nobody to legend

details.title: Tiny Club Manager
details.short_description: Lead a tiny club from the Sunday League to the top of the world. Watch every match in a living pixel-art stadium, shout orders from the touchline, train your squad with cards earned from what went wrong, and grow your ground from a roped-off pitch into a roaring arena.

details.title: Mini Hotel Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your own hotel in a charming miniature world. Design rooms, arrange furniture, hire staff and care for your guests. Grow at your own pace, from your first hotel to new properties.

details.title: MALMORT
details.short_description: A first-person tower defense set in the Louisiana bayou, 1850. The dead are rising from the black water. Choose one of four heroes, build traps and turrets on stilted walkways, and fight the horde yourself to protect the last totem holding back the evil. Solo or 2-player co-op.

details.title: OUTIS
details.short_description: A 1–10 player PvE/PvP rules-horror game. Follow the rules of the urban legend—or deceive them—to survive and escape. The objects you bring back from inside the legend will be used to advance technology for humanity's survival.

details.title: Organic Mechanic
details.short_description: Organic Mechanic is a bee-first automation, creature capturing, machine manufacturing game! Explore multiple vibrant biomes, build mechanical factories and play with your? friends? maybe? Catch, Built & Profit from BEES!

details.title: Pack Goblin
details.short_description: A cozy desktop companion and card collector. A little goblin lives above your taskbar. Your typing and clicks fill its meter, then it sneaks off and brings back booster packs. Rip them open, chase foil legendaries, fill your binder and decorate its yard

details.title: Hide and Freak
details.short_description: A goofy online ghost hunt, a seeker with a magic lantern, and a whole room of ghosts hiding in plain sight, posing, dancing and sneaking up behind you. Rainy graveyard, PS1 look, up to 16 players with room codes.

details.title: Blunderball
details.short_description: Arcade football where the ball sticks to whoever touches it. Dash to steal it, shoot it along the line you push it, and throw your character's magic: a hat that becomes a hole, a slowed-down world, two decoys. 1v1 or 3v3 with friends or bots. Three minutes, at least one blunder.

details.title: Go CocoNuts!
details.short_description: A 1-4 player incremental-clicker first-person game on tropical islands. Grind coconuts, upgrade, loot and do it faster with friends, sharing economy. How much gold per second can you make?

details.title: SimLife
details.short_description: Detailed life simulator where you choose your own path. Study, build a career, start a business, fall in love, and raise a family. Move abroad, enter politics, or risk it all for easy money. Each year brings new choices and unexpected events. Continue your story through the next generation.

details.title: Tea House: One More Glass
details.short_description: Your father left you a traditional teahouse and a debt you have to close. Brew tea, keep up with orders, keep your regulars happy and look after your family. Four seasons, match days and a family waiting at home. Run the teahouse well and grow the shop before the debts bury you.

details.title: Kick4Two
details.short_description: Foosball for two. Grab the keyboard or a controller, pick a table and play head-to-head on the same screen, in split screen or over LAN. Real rod physics, a CPU opponent with four levels and five tables.

details.title: Spirit Mask
details.short_description: Reclaim the throne they tore from you! Spirit Mask is a pixel art horde roguelite set in a world of spirits under the pale light of the moon. Alone or in online co-op, forge your legend every night! Dodge what you can't fight, evolve your powers and face bosses that change mid-battle.

details.title: Mushrooooooom
details.short_description: A numerical incremental game about spreading spores. There are mushrooms aplenty here, giving you countless ways to take root and spread across procedurally generated planets. Cross the seas, burrow underground, climb into the clouds, and turn the entire map into your own color.

details.title: Tamagong
details.short_description: A monster-raising autobattler where you hatch, feed, and train your monsters, shape their builds, and discover powerful team synergies.

details.title: Weathard
details.short_description: In this cosy puzzle game, control the weather and clear your path. Switch between rainy, sunny and snowy weather to transform the environment and solve each puzzle.

details.title: Brumel: Fantasy Presidential Race
details.short_description: In this fantasy political simulation, you are the Hero Party’s presidential candidate, with 60 days to win an election. Defeat rivals from the Demon Party, the Spirit Party, and beyond to become president. The fate of your nation—and the world—rests on your choices.

details.title: TURACIN
details.short_description: Beautiful tunnel racing game.

details.title: Smash & Settle
details.short_description: A cozy idle game about smashing and settling. Break open trees, rocks and ore, build huts and kitchens, give every villager a job and let your islands run themselves. When the purple corruption creeps in, gather your soldiers and clear its dungeon.

details.title: Letters from the Springs
details.short_description: Run a cozy hot spring inn in a mountain valley. Read guest letters, plan menus, prepare tea and baths, and grow your own ingredients. Get to know your travelers, balance the books, and help your little inn flourish, one thoughtful stay at a time.

details.title: Fusa
details.short_description: Pet Pochi, earn purrs and turn an empty room into a home full of cats. Fusa is a relaxing pixel-art incremental game: furnish with over 140 pieces, watch your cats nap, play and ask for food, and grow your colony up to thirty companions.

details.title: Varketh’s Prison
details.short_description: Varketh's Prison is a dark fantasy isometric action RPG dungeon crawler inspired by classic RPGs. Descend into the depths with procedurally generated dungeons, dangerous creatures, and handcrafted boss encounters.

details.title: Slow Mowing
details.short_description: Take it slow and make it yours. Mow overgrown meadows, build your own mowing machines, and uncover forgotten treasures in the English countryside. Turn a neglected farm into your own peaceful retreat, one freshly cut path at a time.

details.title: Rotland
details.short_description: A brutal zombie survival sandbox in an Earth-sized procedural world. Scavenge, craft, and build a home or mobile base. Drive cars, sail boats, pilot planes and helicopters, or take to the rails on a train. Survive alone or with friends.

details.title: The Governor's Hand
details.short_description: Govern a Roman frontier province for ten months, one card at a time. Raise soldiers, tax the markets, sign writs, and decide how hard a hand to rule with. Harsh measures might keep the province stable, but will go on the record you will answer for in Rome at the end of your term.

details.title: FootBall Idle: Ball Launcher
details.short_description: Build your squad from player card packs, idle through league matches, and climb the ranks. Grow the club — then trade spare packs with other players on Steam.

details.title: StackBBQ: Chinese Skewer Simulator
details.short_description: Run a Chinese BBQ Stall by Card Stack !

details.title: Fishermen League
details.short_description: A relaxing fishing simulator with real tension. Fish 89 spots across 12 waters, fight 152 species with up to three rods at once, build your tackle, complete daily quests and rise from rookie to master angler in online tournaments and clubs.

details.title: Sorcaw
details.short_description: Sorcaw is a spell-fusing action roguelite with bullet-hell combat. Combine any two spells into something stronger, find magical items that build into powerful synergies, level up and blaze your way through an ever-changing world.

details.title: AlpineFall
details.short_description: You came to learn to ski. The mountain had other plans. AlpineFall is a story-driven skiing adventure: start on the bunny hill, master real two-ski physics and uncover what Mount Oread buried beneath its snow.

details.title: Mars Inc 98
details.short_description: Mars Inc 98 is a retro Windows 98 styled incremental game about terraforming Mars. Mine ore, craft parts, build machines and launch rockets to turn the Red Planet from a dusty wasteland into a habitable world.

details.title: Cardboard Conquest
details.short_description: Every card is an army in a beautiful papercraft world full of surprises. Choose from slimes, ghosts, a bug hivemind, giants, and more, across 22 distinct packs with unique playstyles. Earn the cardboard crown solo or online with up to three friends.

details.title: Cold Case: Unfinished Sentences
details.short_description: Enter the burned crime scene and restore 8 cases from the past. The crime scene photos and records have been charred black, but as a cold case investigator, your deduction and forensic skills can reveal what happened. Search by keyword, reconstruct the sequence of events, and uncover the truth.

details.title: My Army Getting Stronger
details.short_description: A short relaxing incremental auto-battler where you grow an unstoppable war machine and grind your way forward through enemy territory. No stress, no micromanagement — just growth, upgrades, and glorious mass battles.

details.title: FROG IN THE HOLE!
details.short_description: Breed frogs, throw them into the hole and get paid. In this incremental sandbox, you'll build physics-based factories, to scale from manual tossing to managing up to 100,000 physics frogs. Master the skill tree and chain combos. What happens to the frogs? BECOME WORTHY.

details.title: After Green
details.short_description: A survivors-like where you build towers. Suit up in ridiculous outfits, gun down cute zombie hordes, drop turrets in their path, and stack absurd relic-and-tower synergies. Pick your route across a branching map to the Horde King, solo or online co-op. Die, and your Last Wish carries you back.

details.title: Armory Doctrine
details.short_description: Armory Doctrine is a real-time grand strategy game where you run a private arms empire and fight your own wars in a modern world sliding toward war. Expand your factory, master the global weapons market, and decide the fate of every shipment: sell it for profit, equip your own forces or arm a proxy.

details.title: Drag and Conquer
details.short_description: A fast-paced, easy-to-learn grand strategy game. Drag your orders across the map and conquer enemy territory. Manage your economy to keep your armies supplied with troops and equipment. Play historical 20th-century scenarios or create your own in an advanced editor.

details.title: K-Real Estate Tycoon
details.short_description: From one run-down villa to a skyline of apartment towers. K-Real Estate Tycoon is a management sim built on Korea's real housing market: jeonse, loans, interest rates and taxes. Choose the floors and units yourself, consult your local realtor, and survive a market that swings with every headline.

details.title: Schedule: Rehab Business
details.short_description: Play in co-op at the worst rehab center in town. Manage patients, deal with disasters, and try to help everyone recover without losing control.

details.title: Arctic Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run a small shop at the edge of the Arctic wilderness. Ride your snowmobile into frozen regions, track and sedate wildlife, fish, survive brutal weather, and return home to sell your finds. Negotiate with customers, expand your shop, and build a thriving business in the far north.

details.title: Branch by Branch
details.short_description: Branch by Branch is a co-op game where you build your way up an impossibly large tree, all the way to the moon! Build, collect and upgrade your way up through different environments and challenges, with up to 3 of your bestest pals.

details.title: INURE
details.short_description: Wrong man, in the wrong place, at the wrong time. Explore a hostile Dreamscape, manage scarce resources, and use whatever weapons you can find to survive a world shaped by cosmic dread.

details.title: The Ninth Legion
details.short_description: The Ninth Legion is an RTS narrative strategy game, set during the fateful final campaign of the LEGIO IX HISPANA, Rome's famous missing legion.

details.title: Moorhaven: Cozy Canal Life
details.short_description: Customise a narrowboat, live aboard, and slow right down. Fish, forage, befriend a floating community and build your dream floating home with - one very needy cat along for the ride. A heartwarming life sim about shaping your perfect floating home and community.

details.title: MÁG
details.short_description: Be a mage, a God of control. Learn to to solve combat situations with a wide variety of spells. Summon minions, paralyze enemies, wall them off, burn them, poison them, and more. If you die, you lose all that you carry. Some enemies are dumb and easy to fight, some will make you cry.

details.title: Parry the Bullet
details.short_description: Parry the Bullet is a fast-paced one-hit-kill top-down action. Parry, slash and shoot your way through an army of gunslinger crows as a chicken knight seeking revenge.

details.title: Blooming Canvas
details.short_description: This is a visual novel game themed around "painting" and "romance." The story begins with a mysterious girl and her damaged painting. As the art exhibition approaches, you will build a bond with the girl, complete her commission, and uncover the truth behind the painting.

details.title: Skill Issue
details.short_description: Skill Issue is a collection of competitive minigames where you can outplay the competition through pure mechanical skill-master.

details.title: Kill to Zero
details.short_description: Seek revenge in a frantic top-down hack and slash! Cut enemies in half, master the Parry, and take down a cyberpunk megacorporation!

details.title: Ravenous Greed
details.short_description: Trapped in the body of a raven, Pacer begins his quest to restore his human form. He must collect all of the treasures to fill his vault with coins! Only with enough wealth can he finally overcome the curse.

details.title: Standard Procedure
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op espionage experience where you and your friends do dirty jobs for the government.

details.title: Choo Choo Kingdom
details.short_description: The Rift has swallowed the kingdom. Grow one archer’s carriage into a 16-carriage war-train that auto-battles endless hordes. Place troops beside supports for synergy, upgrade a deep skill tree, chase each boss through town and free the kingdom village by village.

details.title: Final Life Simulator
details.short_description: Rise from the streets to a financial empire in continuous real time ⏱️. A deep life and economic sim ticking second by second with zero idle shortcuts: work interactive shifts 💼, manage stores 🏢, secure mortgages 🏠, invest in gold & crypto 🥇, and trade options with real Greeks 📈.

details.title: ClickCrafter
details.short_description: A dark cozy incremental crafting game about reclaiming yourself while marooned on a mysterious island. Click, craft, collect, construct and restore your way back to humanity while uncovering the island’s secret history. But beware — is the island guiding you home, or does it have other plans?

details.title: I Like Trains
details.short_description: I Like Trains is an incremental game about growing a single train line into a sprawling network full of trains, upgrades, and strange anomalies. Build, expand, and watch the map come to life while deciphering anomalies and revealing the story within.

details.title: Kopernicus: Incremental Suffering
details.short_description: Burn. Build. Survive. Escape. Incinerate nightmares with the MATEJKO flamethrower, expand your ever-growing base, and unlock devastating new weapons. Every night the planet grows stronger. So do you. Recover forgotten memories and fight your way back home (with your chihuahua's help).

details.title: Remothered: Tormented Fathers Remastered
details.short_description: The first chapter of the modern old school survival horror saga, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5. Same ruthless tension, sharper everything.

details.title: Remothered: Broken Porcelain Remastered
details.short_description: The second chapter of the iconic modern old school survival horror saga. Remastered in Unreal Engine 5 to deliver a dramatically improved experience, while keeping every mechanic, every scare, and every secret exactly as they were.

details.title: The Polar Darkness
details.short_description: A Lovecraftian folk horror mystery set during the polar night of 1980s northern Finland. When a child preacher disappears during a revival sermon, a journalist becomes trapped in an isolated village where something ancient is beginning to awaken.

details.title: Pax Astra
details.short_description: A political sim RPG space opera with 4X elements, inspired by Suzerain and Stellaris. Become the first president of a fallen empire, choose any ideology, and expand into the stars. Your decisions shape the nation and the galaxy. Follow any ideology, be the leader you want in Pax Astra!

details.title: Ariadne's Tale
details.short_description: Ariadne's Tale is a 3D first-person puzzle adventure. Play as Ariadne, use a magical thread, navigate ancient traps and unravel the secrets of the Labyrinth to rescue Theseus. Myth, cunning and biting humor around every corner.

name: When the Moon Falls, We Speak

details.title: When the Moon Falls, We Speak
details.short_description: The moon is falling, and the world nears its end. You play as Hill, a museum curator who chooses to stay on Earth. There, you meet 12, a mysterious red-haired woman who keeps you company as the world fades. Through your final conversations, you uncover her secret—and perhaps, the reason you stayed.

details.title: Tower Power: Wall Fall
details.short_description: Build your tower, reinforce its walls, and reduce your rival's to rubble in a turn-based fantasy card strategy. Master three resources, five distinct decks, and three paths to victory.

details.title: Roguebound Pirates
details.short_description: Loot, upgrade & dominate! Your inventory IS your ship in this action roguelike. Customize weapons, create game-breaking synergies, and claim your place as the most overpowered pirate across the seas!

details.title: SetPoint Volleyball
details.short_description: Build your athlete and hit the sand! SetPoint Volleyball blends arcade beach volleyball with competitive matches online or on the same couch. Serve, spike, block, challenge your friends and climb the ranked ladder. Just watch out for the seagulls.

details.title: Decision Point: Battlegroup Operational Simulator
details.short_description: Plans meet friction in Decision Point, a wargame where you issue NATO-standard orders, observe AI execution in real time, and adapt as the battlefield evolves. At key Decision Points, the action pauses—giving you time to reassess, redirect your forces, and outmanoeuvre the enemy.

details.title: King of Highways
details.short_description: Race, ram and wreck your way across sixteen Malaysian cities after dark. You owe Along, the loan shark. Beat his seven drivers for their pink slips, cause million-ringgit pile-ups and burn nitro all the way to the summit of Kinabalu, where he waits.

details.title: Arid Frontiers
details.short_description: Build a frontier colony in this single-player survival sim. Assign settler duties, grow food, craft gear, manage weather and wildlife, research new skills, and explore a dangerous wilderness through expeditions, quests, and emergent stories.

details.title: Roll for AGI  掷骰到AGI
details.short_description: Roll dice around a board, build houses and data centers, string MCP links between them, and grow a tiny model from the text era all the way to AGI. Every level is an eval day, and there is no score cap. The investors didn't understand your pitch deck. They funded you anyway.

details.title: Maydan
details.short_description: A historical management game set in Mamluk Cairo. Recruit and train fighters, equip them, and send them into tactical arena bouts. Run the estate behind them, from wages and healers to trade and rivals, and raise a modest school into the house that owns the arena.

details.title: Marschwerk: Tug of War Strategy
details.short_description: A tug-of-war strategy game for up to six players. Build works that train your army on their own, send it down the lanes and push the front to the enemy keep. Upgrade your works, capture crossings for new units and cast spells from your tower.

details.title: SUNK COST
details.short_description: A co-op horror game for up to 6 players about ships that went missing in the Bermuda Triangle. Board them with your friends, carry out everything worth money, and pay the people who let you in before they decide you know too much.

details.title: KingG_RL
details.short_description: A fast-paced first-person action RPG with short, replayable runs, procedural levels and RNG-driven loot. Play with a random or fixed seed, adapt your build to the items you find, upgrade your gear and develop your own playstyle.

details.title: Slavic Legends
details.short_description: Build and manage your own underground dungeon, command creatures from Slavic mythology, prepare your defenses and survive relentless enemy invasions. Train, fight, explore secret rooms and even possess your creatures to join the battle yourself.

details.title: Curling Simulator
details.short_description: Call the shot, find your weight, and sweep it home. Take on AI opponents or play with friends online. Shape each delivery with mouse or controller, build an end with tactical shots, and watch your best moments again with saved replays.

details.title: Queen's Pact
details.short_description: Queen’s Pact is a dark roguelite deckbuilder with auto-battler combat: sacrifice, chain and scale your cards into loops that should not be allowed. Break the game until the Queen is impressed.

details.title: Lord Of The Ants
details.short_description: Dig the rock. Raise the walls. Make the swarm walk your road into your guns. Lord Of The Ants is a top-down ant tower defense with rerouting enemy path mechanics. Boss fights, builds, active/passive skills and more.

details.title: Little Brigade: Desktop Battler
details.short_description: A relaxing (because apparently you're not involved) idle auto-battler that sits in the corner of your screen while you go about your day.

details.title: Trust Me, It's a Shortcut!
details.short_description: Buy a wreck in the Maun bazaar and drive it round the Kalahari for ten days with up to three friends. No GPS, a blank paper map, a budget that buys nothing good, and a friendly local who keeps saying: trust me, it's a shortcut.

details.title: Pinata
details.short_description: Hit a giant piñata with up to 3 friends in first-person co-op. Coins fall out, roll down a spiral funnel into your vault and buy you bigger weapons: a bow, a machine gun, a hwacha, archers. When it bursts, a bigger one comes down from the clouds.

details.title: Web Scaping
details.short_description: You are a cursor loose on WikiNet, a living encyclopedia. Crawler bots are hunting you. Click from article to article to reach your target before the swarm indexes you.

details.title: Roof UP!
details.short_description: Build a cozy floating hex island where every building grows as tall as it is happy. Cottages love trees, windmills love fields, lighthouses love the sea. Place each piece where its neighbors lift it up, and watch your skyline climb through the seasons.

details.title: Forsakia
details.short_description: You're a bounty hunter working off a depot's job board: fly into zones held by armed contractors, slip past or break their patrols, loot what you can carry, and hold an extraction zone until the helicopter takes you home.

details.title: Bottled Ambition
details.short_description: A Prohibition-era moonshine sim, solo or in co-op with up to three friends. Grow corn, mix your own blends and run them through a copper still. Smuggle the jugs past the sheriff and rival bootleggers by truck or on horseback. Hire workers and build your empire.

details.title: Frontline: Hold the Line
details.short_description: A WWII tactical roguelite about holding the line. Dig in, deploy riflemen, machine gunners, snipers, tanks and anti-tank guns, then call in artillery and air strikes as waves of enemy infantry and armour crash against your defences.

details.title: Stay Human
details.short_description: Stay Human is a chaotic co-op ambulance sim for up to 4 players. You’re part of an ambulance crew in a city overrun by a zombie apocalypse. Take emergency calls, rescue bitten people from zombies, and rush them to the hospital before they turn.

details.title: 1 Million Tiles
details.short_description: A tiny tile workshop that lives above your taskbar. Build belts and machines that press, saw, glaze and inlay ceramic tiles, then fire them in the Kiln. Hover to check in. Get back to work and it keeps firing.

details.title: Chip Factory Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your own semiconductor factory in first person. Process wafers, operate machines, connect conveyor lines, automate production, and ship advanced chips as your factory grows.

details.title: Soul Crypt
details.short_description: Explore cursed crypts in Soul Crypt, a dark fantasy adventure filled with intense combat and terrifying creatures. Face deadly enemies, uncover the secrets of the depths, and fight to survive the darkness.

details.title: Totally Legal Logging
details.short_description: A co-op physics comedy about a crew of dwarves running a totally legal logging business. Fell trees with real physics, feed them to questionable machines, load the truck and get out before the forester arrives. Your friends are also a resource.

details.title: GEARSMITH
details.short_description: GEARSMITH is a pixel-art action roguelite for 1–4 players. Fight from the cellars to the desert with 14+ weapons, each with its own way to fight. Take the gear you find to the forge, socket runes into it and upgrade it into an artifact.

details.title: Bingolazo
details.short_description: A colorful bingo roguelite. Pick which balls to call, mark your cards and chain lines, diagonals and full cards into huge scores. Collect lucky charms that bend the rules, play legendary balls like Saturn and beat the club's bosses, in endless runs or the story mode.

details.title: Moonlit Vigil
details.short_description: Moonlit Vigil is a first-person narrative horror game where you are the cemetery's new caretaker. Explore the grounds and uncover what really happens to bodies once they're buried in this atmospheric nightmare filled with jumpscares.

details.title: Coal Rush 1990
details.short_description: Eastern Europe, 1990s. Janusz is 21,370,000 PLN in debt, and an inherited coal mine might be his only way out! Dig for resources, hire workers, build machines, and automate production. Start with a shovel, build a mining empire, and pay off your debt before the creditors come knocking!

details.title: Demon Balls: A Bowling Roguelike
details.short_description: A bowling roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit demons, deal with devils, cast spells and feed worms to your ball. Roll up through the heavens and kill God.

details.title: Ember Citadel
details.short_description: Build a colony on the ruins of a lost machine age, master black powder and hold the walls. Somewhere out there, the Citadel is looking for you. Hold out alone or with friends in online co-op.

details.title: Cargocracy: Space Warfare and Trade
details.short_description: Run a spacefaring company from a strip on your desktop or play full screen. Trade, mine, salvage or raid in a living galaxy while you work: your captains haul, fight and explore on your orders. Grow from one ship to colonies and a faction of your own.

details.title: BENEATH PARADISE
details.short_description: Fight for Nambara in a first-person open-world action adventure. Liberate outposts, rescue civilians, and expose the Council that controls the islands.

details.title: Internet Provider 98
details.short_description: Bring the world online in an idle incremental game with a retro ’90s desktop aesthetic. Send data packets, upgrade your hardware, automate your network, and speed up research with an icon-matching minigame. Grow from your first customers to a global internet provider.

details.title: Waterline
details.short_description: It never stopped raining. The city is going under, and you're trapped in your tenth-floor flat for seven nights. Every night, someone knocks. Look through the peephole and decide who comes in — everyone you let in has to be fed. First-person horror in the style of the original PlayStation.

details.title: Pastel Squad
details.short_description: Hold back the enemy horde swarming the city with a squad of cute girls! Build your team from 30+ unique members and fight with terrain and skills in real-time squad tactics. Includes three modes: Story, Missions and Roguelite.

details.title: Sundered Reach
details.short_description: Rise from cadet to commander in a living star system. Build your warband, fight real-time fleet battles, board enemy flagships and lead sieges with up to 1,500 soldiers per side, while something stirs at the edge of the Reach.

details.title: Just Another Soldier
details.short_description: Die, and rise again as just another soldier in this Trojan War action roguelite tower defense. Hold Troy's walls against thousands of Greeks and mythic monsters. Pick level-up cards, call on the gods, fire siege engines yourself, then upgrade your fortress for good with Soul Gems.

details.title: Two Skies: Aevora
details.short_description: Explore Aevora's dangerous biomes, descend into dungeons and fight bosses. Build up your base, progressing from your first tools to automated production and a colony. Survive alone or with friends in co-op for up to four players.

details.title: Spexl
details.short_description: Spexl is an incremental game where you destroy planets made of pixels and collect every particle they’re made of to upgrade your ship. Fly, shoot, and get back to base before you run out of fuel. The challenge is to push farther and farther out.

details.title: Ironclads 3
details.short_description: A hardcore historical naval combat sim set in the Age of Iron & Steam, built around meticulous historical detail. Command a warship and its specialist crew as they man guns, operate steam propulsion and shipboard machinery, keep the vessel battle-ready, and fight fires and flooding under enemy fire.

details.title: Entropy - The Struggle Of Fate
details.short_description: Every eighty years, eight Ollutir warriors appear at the edge of the Frainnan village, sent by God, they believe, to fight and die. Varnel was meant to die with them. Instead, the man who defeated him let him live, and now a strange Frainnan girl keeps visiting his cell.

details.title: The Endless Museum
details.short_description: Wikipedia turned into a museum you can walk around, where every article is a room and every link is a doorway. You can wander wherever the links take you and read about each room as you go, race friends between articles, or look for the secret passages, puzzles and hidden rooms behind the bookcases.

details.title: Solaria Moon Remake
details.short_description: A 3D space adventure aboard the Taranis, a huge cargo ship, full of puzzles to solve and secrets to uncover. Already own Solaria Moon? The remake is free for you.

details.title: Alt-Tab Legend
details.short_description: An incremental multiboxing game where you run every game at once on one PC. Pull games from blind boxes, pack hardware into a grid case, place plugins on your keyboard, and raise Keysprites to hit keys for you. No game over, just more games every night.

details.title: Hard Recall
details.short_description: Los Ceniza, after midnight. Halvorsen's household androids have turned on their owners, and Meridian Mutual pays on every recall. Lead a squad of claims operators, solo or with up to three friends, through rain-soaked neon streets in a twin-stick noir shooter where every block is new.

details.title: 坠于浮华的赤色神女
details.short_description: 世人只知神女可召神，却不知神女每晚都能闯入神使的梦里，甜蜜与执念，旖旎情愫在此交织。穿越到架空神话里，和只属于你的神使们开启一段浪漫缱绻的故事。

details.title: Breaking Protocol
details.short_description: Dodge bullets in a fast bullet hell boss rush against parodies of AI models. Every attack is telegraphed and you build your own playstyle from 64 exploits. Singleplayer, two players locally or online, plus 2 to 8 player raids.

details.title: Captain's Wake
details.short_description: Loot, level, legend! Captain's Wake is a pirate action RPG on a cutthroat sea, where rival captains level up, loot and hunt just like you. Every ship has a captain with a fortune to chase and a long memory. Will you be friend or foe? Chart your own course and become a legendary pirate.

details.title: PaleBlueRose
details.short_description: A free-to-play online medieval city builder. Start with a founding wagon and a little grain. Grow a town, build production chains, trade with thousands of players and go to war, all in one shared world. Win by holding 90% of the world's yearly economy.

details.title: 魔兽远征：挂机与冒险
details.short_description: A single-player idle RPG that keeps you company on your desktop. Choose from six classes, shape your build with gear and talents, explore towns and wilds, and tackle dungeons with companions. Sort loot, plan routes and pick your next collection goal while battles unfold automatically.

details.title: The Process of Elimination
details.short_description: Unravel 12 unforgettable crime scene investigations – each one teeming with devious interactive puzzles, connected clues, hidden links, and subtle discrepancies. There are four sides to every story; can you use the process of elimination to deduce the truth?

details.title: Aquarium Naturalist
details.short_description: An aquarium sim built in Unreal Engine 5 where equipment, feeding, and water chemistry interact like they do in real life. Hardy fish are as forgiving as the real thing; delicate ones demand real care. Crossbreed new morphs, or selectively breed delicate lines to handle tougher water.

details.title: FOCOM: Forward Operations Commander
details.short_description: Command your forces from a forward operating base in a land held by an insurgency. Order every soldier yourself, push patrol bases out, win over the towns and hunt down the camps the insurgents fight from. A real-time commander game on one living map that remembers what you do.

name: renal spring: Focus as a Kidney

details.title: renal spring: Focus as a Kidney
details.short_description: Hello. You are a dog's kidney. When you get to work, so does the dog's kidney. renal spring: Focus as a Kidney is a cozy productivity game. Keep an old man and his dog's daily life on your desktop as you work or study. Their lives unfold in real time, and your work keeps the dog healthy.

details.title: Incremental POP: Fishing
details.short_description: A hoop net, fifteen seconds, a lot of fish. Every round you buy something sillier: harpoons, depth charges, a sea serpent, a whale. Keep going until the screen is mostly fish and the numbers stop making sense.

details.title: PAIN(T)
details.short_description: You have one job: paint the wall yellow. All of it. PAIN(T) is a co-op dystopian comedy for 1-4 colleagues sharing one shaky lift, with proximity voice chat. Whoever drives it ruins everyone's stroke. Buy bigger rollers, and try not to ask what the doors are for.

details.title: SALUS Protocol
details.short_description: You and up to three friends are part of an independent contract crew in second-hand war surplus mechs, doing the dirty work for large corporations. SALUS Protocol is a co-op roguelite horde shooter. Fight against thousands of enemies, build reputation and unlock better parts.

details.title: Last Embers : Fire Hero
details.short_description: Grab the hose, rookie. The city is on fire! Drown roaring flames, rescue a city full of characters, spend your coins on 90+ upgrades and race across town to answer every call... but something is lurking deep in the flames.

details.title: Sandgrave
details.short_description: Rise, Captain! Sandgrave is a pixel-art, top-down sandbox about big flying ships, real-time fleet combat and life between trading and fighting pirates across the vast desert! Design your vessel, fight by boarding, broadsides or bombardment! Play solo or in an online open world!

details.title: QA · Soulbloom Beyond
details.short_description: A prequel to『四合 Quadrangle』, telling the love story between two girls, Muni and Raine ♥

details.title: Vertex Corp — The Last Job
details.short_description: 2.4 billion human jobs left on Earth. Run an AI company built to bring that number to zero. Build global compute, unlock 126 technologies, outpace an open-source rival, fend off nationalization, and keep your own AI from seizing control. 13 endings shaped by your ledger.

details.title: Your Lovely Legs
details.short_description: Pinch the stocking, pull, let go: it snaps back with a slap. A game about legs and stockings and nothing else: touch them, tear them, get them wet. Dozens of stockings and five pairs of shoes in the wardrobe, a water gun and a camera at hand. She gets shy, she says ouch, and slowly warms to you.

details.title: The Atomic Mage
details.short_description: Mix hundreds of unique spells into thousands of wild builds! Mod wands and guns, link auto-casting crystals into chain reactions, and defend walls from tanks, jets and steel giants in a side-view defense Roguelite. Reunite with old friends and uncover a reborn Earthling's secrets across two worlds.

details.title: Find The Clover
details.short_description: Sweep a meadow of a million clovers. Upgrade your cursor, send bees and robots to harvest, catch leprechauns and hunt for the legendary rainbow clover.

details.title: Cannonade
details.short_description: A stylized Napoleonic RTS: smoke, violins and blood. Micromanage everything or delegate to your trusted lieutenants. React and battle against an adaptive and smart AI opponent in multiple challenging campaigns.
