details.title: Breach Inc.
details.short_description: 3:12 a.m. The medical practice is encrypted, the extortionists are very polite, and your admin went for coffee. Run a tiny IT security firm through the night shift: stop attacks, pay the ransom or don’t, and grow your basement office into your own SOC.

details.title: The Deep Horde
details.short_description: Blast through endless swarms of Lovecraftian horrors and grow absurdly powerful! Level up, unlock new investigators, wake the Old Gods and fight your way down to what dreams beneath the sea!

details.title: DEADSPRINT
details.short_description: A fast-paced and brutal first-person shooter set in a city under quarantine following an outbreak. Fight your way through hordes of infected, use a variety of weapons and explosives, battle monstrous bosses, and try to escape the danger zone.

details.title: Fluffy Coworkers
details.short_description: Relaxing nature sounds and a cozy little world at the bottom of your screen. Fluffy coworkers farm, cook and sell while you work, through changing seasons and weather.

details.title: The Adventure Book
details.short_description: Relive the thrill of letting the dice decide your fate. The Adventure Book is a dark roguelike RPG inspired by classic fantasy gamebooks. Explore a cursed dungeon, face the skeletons of fallen heroes, including your own, and uncover its secrets.

details.title: Company Coal
details.short_description: Have you ever yearned for the mines? No? Too bad. Welcome to the Consolidated Coal & Iron Company family! Dig coal, meet your quotas, and try to pay down a debt that grows by the day. Solo or online co-op, for your convenience.

details.title: Shadows of Chroma Tower
details.short_description: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

details.title: Starting a Village from Zero
details.short_description: “This is your own little village.”You are a familiar summoned by the apprentice witch Lily. In her place, build houses and create a thriving village.A new kind of “garden world × roguelite × turn-based strategy” game.

details.title: Ignitement
details.short_description: Shape your flame in this explosive roguelite and survivorslike inferno. Craft unique fire magic, unlock new masks and abilities, collect ancestral loot, and incinerate hordes of enemies in a never-ending battle against your inner demons.

details.title: First Layer: 3D Printing Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your own 3D printing business, from a single garage printer to a full print farm. Slice models, keep all printers running, paint your prints and fix your machines. Fill orders online and in your own store, manage filament stock, grow your business layer by layer.

details.title: Crusaders Quest : Tactics
details.short_description: Crusaders Quest: Tactics is a roguelike auto battler where you build a party of charming pixel art heroes. Recruit heroes from Shasha's shop, promote them, and craft Soulbound Weapons. Find the right hero synergies and take on bosses across five acts.

details.title: 8 More Lives
details.short_description: A challenging turn-based tactical RPG. Lead a mercenary company of outcast cats through a gritty procedural open world. Take contracts, count coin, bury the dead. Battle rival warbands and night horrors. You have 8 more lives - try not to waste them all.

details.title: Zodiac Legion
details.short_description: Zodiac Legion is a turn-based tactical RPG where you take command of an arcane chivalric order. Launch daring raids through ancient ruins and treacherous dungeons. Advance in steadfast formations to disrupt enemy ranks with cunning stratagems. Hold your ground in a world of reawakening cosmic magic.

details.title: Midnight Horde
details.short_description: Leap, slash, and soar through gothic ruins in Midnight Horde, a high-mobility auto shooter where parkour meets reverse bullet hell. Battle through swarms of monstrosities, upgrade deadly weapons, and build strongholds to push back the creeping dark.

details.title: Pirates Republic
details.short_description: Build your pirate republic from nothing. Survive, cook, trade, and plunder your way through a procedurally generated Caribbean in this open-world survival sandbox. No fantasy - just history, grit, and freedom. Play solo or with friends in co-op.

details.title: As One We Survive
details.short_description: Survive in a harsh post-apocalyptic world. Scavenge resources, build up a homestead, form a community, and defend yourself against a lawless world in a challenging survival sandbox.

details.title: Farmion
details.short_description: Build your dream farm and grow a village around it in this cozy voxel farming and life sim, solo or with friends. Grow crops, raise animals, and turn your harvest into meals, bouquets and cheese for your own café, grocery store and flower shop. Your farm keeps growing while you’re away.

details.title: Wild Wild Eden
details.short_description: Survive a primitive fantasy world in Wild Wild Eden, an open-world survival crafting game where monsters are family. Pet, feed, and protect your companions. As a tribal chief, raise your monster friends, build a thriving base, and explore a harsh yet heartwarming world together.

details.title: Moochy
details.short_description: Your coins are your health. Spend them on guns, or hold onto them and stay alive longer — your call. Dumb co-op for 1 to 4.

details.title: Vampire Rancher
details.short_description: Rancher by day, Vampire by night. Manage your time and resources to restore your sleepy little town to its former glory, all while satisfying your vampire needs for blood. Oversee shops and saloons, farm crops and humans, and explore ancient vampiric ruins in the Weird Wild West!

details.title: Anomalistic Revolution
details.short_description: You stand before a pit at the city's heart, then your gaze drifts to a deeper void, one you fear even more. Wield your invention to unravel mysteries, reclaim lost memories, strengthen your skills, and battle nightmare-born horrors in this multi-ending RPG.

details.title: Redneck Redemption
details.short_description: 100% authentic redneck alien hunting simulator. Drink, fight, stalk and piss your way through an alien invasion.

details.title: LightSup!
details.short_description: LightSup is a chaotic 1–4 player couch co-op adventure where darkness drains sanity while the Altar of Light keeps you alive. Battle monsters, gain powerful Blessings, endure dangerous Curses, and choose your path to save the world from an eternal eclipse.

details.title: BECROWNED
details.short_description: A non-linear survival horror drawing inspiration from the surrealist dark satire of VHS-era Horror and lurid atmosphere of classic Grindhouse cinema. Step into Richard Torrance's shoes and survive a complex web of relationships as you phase between industrial ruins and a tragic fantasy kingdom.

details.title: Metropolis 1998
details.short_description: A fresh, modern city builder with charming aesthetics. Detailed agent-based simulation and scheduling. See inside buildings. Design and customize almost anything. Business-specific zoning, and mixed use zones too!

details.title: Alpine Lake
details.short_description: Build, decorate, and customize every detail of your inn to welcome guests to your cozy escape in the woods. Entertain tourists, farm, cook meals, research wildlife, and ski, all while helping a colorful cast of townspeople save the struggling mountain town from a hostile takeover.

details.title: Red Dust Colony
details.short_description: The spirit of the space race lives on in this Mars based colony sim. Mine, craft and research in order to build up your initial lander into a self sustaining colony. Keep oxygen levels high and CO₂ levels low. Discover and grow a variety of plants to balance out colonist nutrition.

details.title: Sirens
details.short_description: Become a deadly Siren and hunt down the most dangerous sea creatures that have ever swim in the depths of the oceans! Experience a fascinating journey through the world as seen from the perspective of Sirens at various stages of their evolution.

details.title: RANGER COMMANDO
details.short_description: Nostalgic '80s-inspired isometric tactical shooter. Explore randomly generated missions, assassinate officers, free hostages, blow stuff up. No handholding, but easy to pick up!

details.title: Centuries
details.short_description: Grow a small camp into a thriving medieval settlement. Shape its expansion, develop its economy and care for the households that call it home. Balance your ambitions with the everyday needs of a growing community.

details.title: Croak
details.short_description: Tongue-grapple and pinball-bounce the frog prince across levels to reach the Witch’s Banquet in this hand-drawn 2D platformer. Each whimsical world has its own wacky boss, hidden collectibles, and a unique traversal ability. Grit your teeth! You're gonna CROAK. -DEMO OUT NOW!-

details.title: Death By Misstep
details.short_description: The robots can hear you breathe. Match your breathing to the music, stay out of sight and find a way off the Samos, a luxury cruise turned into a massacre. First-person horror and stealth where every breath can give you away.

details.title: Roam
details.short_description: "Roam" is a 2D Action-RPG platformer set in a procedurally generated world. Explore the surrounding lands and delve into the depths of mysterious caves that have lain hidden for centuries beneath the Azure Lake.

details.title: Tearoom of Terror
details.short_description: Congratulations on your inheritance: one tearoom, one murdered aunt, 22 regulars who know where the *ahem* bodies are buried. Brew tea, bake treats and try to solve the mystery of your aunt's murder before Halloween - or end up on the menu yourself.

details.title: Fools, Maniacs and Liars
details.short_description: A narrative-driven game of suspense, crime, and dark humor. Amid exquisitely crafted art and a gripping story, the Wushan Great Buddha's demise unfolds.

details.title: Demon Spore
details.short_description: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.

details.title: Tattered Banners
details.short_description: Lead a mercenary company in a turn-based tactics RPG set in a dynamic, simulated world shaped by your actions. Recruit, equip, and evolve your warband to survive a medieval-fantasy realm where cities rise and fall, noble houses pursue personal agendas, and the land bears the scars of your decisions.

details.title: SIM Chef: Restaurant management
details.short_description: SIM Chef is a restaurant sim that starts on an empty lot. Build the dining room and the kitchen, choose from over 200 dishes and drinks from around the world and hire a team that knows how to make your menu. Win over the judges and take home awards.

details.title: Into The Haunted Land
details.short_description: An online co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Team up with your friends to explore ruins, loot cursed items, hide from monsters and extract safely. Do whatever it takes to meet the Guild’s quota.

details.title: Plushie Party
details.short_description: Win mini-games, survive the show, and watch your friends turn into stuffing as you crush their hopes and dreams in this collection of slightly violent party games!

name: Smoke Em If You Got Em (SEIYGE)

details.title: Smoke Em If You Got Em (SEIYGE)
details.short_description: Smoke Em If You Got Em (SEIYGE) is a PvPvE tactical VR FPS shooter with vehicles, to include a functioning C130 Gunship. Up to 3 teams battle over different maps to hold a trophy for 3 minutes to win the match. SEIYGE includes weapon attachments, revives and a Zombie mode for each map.

details.title: COVR
details.short_description: COVR is a high-stakes tactical VR shooter built around next-gen visuals, grounded realism, and tense CQB. Deploy solo or in co-op, complete classic tactical objectives, adapt to unpredictable missions, and make every decision count. Coming in 2026.

details.title: Imprinted
details.short_description: An audio restoration job becomes an investigation into the occult, as an elusive musician’s damaged cassette tapes are exhumed in northern Italy. Use a fully-operational desktop to sift through files, descending into the artist’s world in this slow-burning ghost tale of creativity and obsession.

details.title: Incremental Mass Rewritten
details.short_description: Watch your mass skyrocket! Incremental Mass Rewritten lets you upgrade, prestige, and unlock cosmic layers of growth. From tiny beginnings to multiverse-scale numbers, it's perfect for anyone who loves exponential progression and optimizing every step of the journey.

details.title: True Confession
details.short_description: Henry, a religious young man, witnesses violent shootouts and fragments of his past at night in his dreams. In reality, he’s just an ordinary man, visiting his pastor while struggling with anger and guilt. Fight inside his dreams in this isometric pixel-art shooter to experience his True Confession.

details.title: Nightholme
details.short_description: Nightholme is a 12-player, third-person PvEvP extraction horror game. Hunt solo or in duos through an ever-changing city where one encounter can set off a chain reaction. Fight with abilities, not guns. Transform into a monster for devastating power, at the cost of your sanity. How far will you go?

details.title: All Ducks Must Go
details.short_description: Your shift starts with 20,000 rubber ducks. Grab, sweep, and launch them into the recycling chute to earn coins and upgrade your gear. Run out of time and the floor rises to the ceiling. Clear the pit, open the hatch, and… wait. More ducks downstairs?

details.title: Send More Squires
details.short_description: The King has been captured by another kingdom, and every letter ends the same way: "Send more squires." Train your squires, conquer region after region in an endless march, gather loot to grow your kingdom, and rescue His Majesty!

details.title: Dice chess
details.short_description: A new-age chess game combined with math. Free to play with your bro offline, your friends or any players online.

details.title: Freshly Caught
details.short_description: Catch fish, arrange your stall, and run a cozy neighborhood fish stand by the water. 🎣 Set up your stall, serve customers by finding the right fish for them, upgrade your gear, and grow your tiny seaside business one catch new and rare fish!

details.title: Tiny Patisserie
details.short_description: Run your own cozy pastry shop. 🍰 Spot what customers are craving, combine and box up sweet treats, and jump into hands-on minigames for every order. Unlock new recipes, upgrade your tools, and grow your tiny shop into a thriving neighborhood favorite.

details.title: Meow Mart
details.short_description: Experience the immersive fun of first-person restocking and cashiering. Launching with 6 distinct cat breeds—breed them freely, sell them for a profit, or keep them as collectibles in your store to boost customer traffic.

name: Before the Tee: A Golf Course Tycoon

details.title: Before the Tee: A Golf Course Tycoon
details.short_description: Before the Tee is a top-down golf course management sim. Build a course hole by hole and run it sunrise to sunset. Shape fairways and greens, hire a crew, keep the tee sheet moving, and handle whatever the day throws at you. Win the right to host tournaments and climb the rankings of local critics.

details.title: Butcher hero: hook'n'chew RPG
details.short_description: Survival RPG: fight monsters & aliens, upgrade gear, defeat bosses for survival

details.title: Heartbeat Under One Roof
details.short_description: Sakura, the protagonist’s childhood friend, gets scouted by a talent agency and begins her journey as an idol. She moves in with the protagonist, who works in Tokyo. With his support, can Sakura rise to become a top idol with one million fans?

name: Game About Botting in an MMORPG

details.title: Game About Botting in an MMORPG
details.short_description: Why grind when you can cheat? Start as a novice grinder and work your way towards total automation. Unlock Bot Modules, configure combat behavior, optimize farming routes and build the ultimate grinding machine in this incremental MMORPG simulator.

details.title: Blightmarch
details.short_description: A dark fantasy tactical RPG of war, corruption, and impossible choices. Lead a mercenary squad into an Abyss-tainted front, recruit scarred companions, and survive brutal turn-based battles with weapons, terrain, and forbidden power. Victory may save your squad, or make you accept the slaughter.

details.title: Color War
details.short_description: A simple, relaxing real-time strategy game. Play as the blue human race, summon troops mid-battle and take the continent from the Red, Yellow and Green nations.

details.title: Castle-O
details.short_description: Navigate the castle gardens, find the fastest route and compete for the best time.

details.title: Ninmarch
details.short_description: Hold the border. Seal the rift. Ninmarch is a hand-painted 3D tower defense in the spirit of classic fantasy RTS: build and branch six towers, lead a hero with four skills into battle, and stop 39 kinds of abyssal foes — 12 bosses among them — across 12 handcrafted levels.

details.title: Roots of a Kingdom
details.short_description: Lead a handful of gnomes from a hole in a hillside to a fortified kingdom. Mine 81 layers deep, farm through the seasons, craft in 30 workshops, wire up water wheels and logic-gated machinery, and hold your throne against raids, disasters and a dragon.

details.title: DEEPWARD
details.short_description: Choose three heroes from a roster of six and switch between them instantly during combat. Each has their own health, weapon and ability. DEEPWARD is a fast horror FPS roguelite set in an alternate 1920s, where keeping your squad alive means fighting through the madness. Hero death is permanent.

details.title: The Disappearance of Emily Crowe
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror built on stealth and dread. Raise your real phone to reveal what your screen can't — hidden threats, impossible paths, and the truth about a sister who vanished 15 years ago. What took Emily never left, and it remembers you.

name: A Normal Quiz Game where you try to solve questions but the questions have tricks and gimmicks and if you get them wrong you have to beat a wacky punishment but they are kinda fun so you lowkey wanna do them even if it means getting the question wrong.

details.title: A Normal Quiz Game where you try to solve questions but the questions have tricks and gimmicks and if you get them wrong you have to beat a wacky punishment but they are kinda fun so you lowkey wanna do them even if it means getting the question wrong.
details.short_description: Solve puzzles, test your reflexes, and do your taxes in this normal quiz game that is actually quite unusual.

details.title: Dude, Trust Me
details.short_description: Get hopelessly misunderstood by your two best friends. One of you goes blind, one goes deaf, one loses their voice, and no puzzle here can be solved by one person. Can the three of you work out how to understand each other?

details.title: DEADLINE: Afterlife Processing
details.short_description: The dead wait in line. You run the press. Read each soul, judge it, seal it and get paid for it. Tired of doing it yourself? The catalog has machines that'll do the work for you. Management recommends it. Management appreciates your cooperation.

details.title: 遗落者（The Lost Ones）
details.short_description: Fast-paced Souls-like action RPG. As a Forsaken warrior on a rain-scourged continent, infiltrate the Dark Moon Cult, master attacks, powerful skills, parries and rolls, defeat bosses, explore to unlock stronger weapons and combat styles, and shape the continent through key choices. 4–6 hours.

details.title: HELL-A
details.short_description: An online co-op horror action game. Enter the bureaucratic Hell and prove your worth through the Seven Deadly Sins. Master physics, combine magic, and face the trials together or turn on your friends. Maybe they hold you back?

details.title: What the K-Drama?!
details.short_description: You were a successful CEO... until you woke up inside the makjang K-drama you once dismissed! Become chaebol heir ‘Lee Segye,’ win both love and the chairman’s seat, and turn this 14-episode whirlwind of birth secrets and conspiracies into the perfect happy ending!

details.title: CRUMB Advanced
details.short_description: The follow-up to the hit circuit simulator. Build anything from an LED to an 8-bit CPU, code microcontrollers, play guitar live through your circuits and drive robot arms with real physics. Make any part in the component editor and share it on Steam Workshop. If you can build it, CRUMB can run it.

details.title: Echoes From Beyond
details.short_description: This is a desktop companion game centered around everyday companionship and time management.

name: Too Many Cards: Tidy Up Your Monster Sanctuary

details.title: Too Many Cards: Tidy Up Your Monster Sanctuary
details.short_description: Organize thousands of collectible cards in this relaxing first-person sorting simulator! Discover categories, place cards in the correct display cases, earn points, and unlock upgrades. Transform a messy sanctuary into a perfectly organized collection!

details.title: Winds of Viridia
details.short_description: Explore the valley of the towering Grantree, battle grand beasts, and find out what’s driving the creatures in these forgotten lands mad. Discover secrets, make new friends, and find powerful lost relics. Take on fearsome bosses, and uncover the truth of the wild frenzy.

details.title: Geoscape
details.short_description: Explore Earth and beyond at full scale in this cozy retro sandbox. Every city, coast, and mountain rebuilt for you to discover by car, bike, boat, plane, foot, wingsuit & more. Embark on expeditions, beat challenges, race friends, build a career, or follow the road while blasting music.

details.title: We Will Die For You
details.short_description: Destroy & defeat disease in an incremental action game where you guide a white blood cell through the human body. Fight disease, earn Protein, die, and buy permanent upgrades for the cells that follow. Unlock powerful abilities and confront disease bosses. EVERY CELL DIES. YOUR BODY REMEMBERS.

details.title: Nectarbound
details.short_description: A short, active incremental game about a bee with a vacuum. Collect nectar, turn it into coins, and buy upgrades. Hire ladybugs to plant flowers and worker bees to carry your haul. Day brings flowers. Night brings trouble.

details.title: The Infinite Shift: Backrooms
details.short_description: The Infinite Shift is a psychological horror exploration game. Trapped in an endless shift, explore liminal spaces from the Poolrooms to Level 0, solve puzzles, evade unknown entities, and find a way out before it’s too late.

details.title: SYSTEM INTRUDER
details.short_description: Explore the dark secrets of ASGARD-04 in an immersive retro-cyberpunk survival horror inspired by classic 3D games. Search for clues, solve puzzles, fight enemies, manage limited resources, and survive the horrors lurking within a mysterious research complex.

details.title: Sarmatian Heroes
details.short_description: Sarmatian Heroes is a turn-based strategy RPG where you explore the ancient world, develop heroes with unique skills, command armies, and build fortified cities your way. Fight tactical hex-based battles in the open field and defend your custom-built cities during sieges.

details.title: Houston, We Have a Spungus
details.short_description: A living space fungus is eating our colonies, and it grows back faster than you can shoot it. Build turrets, call in orbital strikes, combine flamethrowers, tiny suns and lightning, and hold the line until HQ nukes the source.

details.title: Before Dawn Bakery
details.short_description: Flour, heat, and bake away the hours before sunrise. A cozy solo baking sim where every stage — ferment, proof, bake, cool — has its own feel and timing, and one pair of hands to meet them all. Fill the morning's orders and close out before the town wakes.

details.title: Whisperborne
details.short_description: Turn-based collection JRPG on a continent the gods walked away from. Gather the lost heirs of the Sword-King, build a ten-slot weapon board for each of six elements, and raid alongside up to 30 players against the things still walking through Mira.
developers: Liufenyu Games 六分鱼游戏工作室

details.title: THE IRON GAMES
details.short_description: The Iron Games is a medieval battle royale where 24 players fight to the death. Loot armor and weapons, build unique combinations to become as strong as possible, and fight to be the last team alive.

name: 横浜機動暴走族 ROCK 'N' ROLL SUICIDE

details.title: 横浜機動暴走族 ROCK 'N' ROLL SUICIDE
details.short_description: Explore Yokohama through real-world photographs and brawl with biker gangs in giant robots! A dramatic action-adventure following a coup led by the city’s “Mobile Biker Gangs.”

details.title: MINES SET!
details.short_description: The roguelike minesweeper. MINES SET! is a satisfying puzzle game where you open an endless board, find game-changing sponsors and set off huge combos.

details.title: CARTACLYSM
details.short_description: A chaotic, physics-based party game. Compete against your friends. Sabotage your opponents with power-ups, physics and pure pettiness. Honk your way towards your rightful spot as the Top Goose.

name: What Da Font: Tidy Up the Print Shop

details.title: What Da Font: Tidy Up the Print Shop
details.short_description: A cozy first person organizing game. Thieves turned over every case in a 1920s print shop: gather 5,000 pieces of lead type from two floors, tell one typeface from another, and put them back. Every case you finish opens a job to print, and the ten printed posters keep the combination to a safe.

details.title: CARD SHOP SHUFFLE!
details.short_description: CARD SHOP SHUFFLE! is a cozy, single-player organizing sim about identifying and sorting 2,500 cards scattered across the floor of a card shop. There are no timers or game overs, so you can work at your own pace. Appraise each card, unlock skills to work more efficiently, and maximize your profits.

details.title: TrueClash
details.short_description: An emotional visual novel following the journeys of several fighters. Your choices shape their lives and dictate how the story unfolds. These characters have souls of their own—will you bring yours into the mix?

details.title: INFAZ
details.short_description: Fight your way through tense tactical firefights. Plant or defuse the bomb, take on the opposing team, or test your aim in solo matches. Use your weapons, grenades, sound awareness, and the minimap to gain the advantage

details.title: UNCUT
details.short_description: UNCUT is a tactical police raid shooter seen through a bodycam. Shout real orders into your mic and suspects react: some comply, some run, some open fire. Clear houses solo with two NPC officers or in co-op with up to 4 players. No raid plays out the same.

details.title: Greenrise
details.short_description: Greenrise is a short and cozy incremental game about chopping wood, breaking stones and mining gold to buy upgrades and grow your island.

details.title: Drone Operations
details.short_description: Pilot combat drones through diverse missions with realistic FPV flight simulation. Scout targets, drop grenades, launch explosive strikes and fire mounted weapons against enemies who flee, seek shelter or escape in vehicles. Earn stars to unlock new operations, drones and upgrades.

details.title: Goodly Trials
details.short_description: Hire a storied leader, build a crew around them, bargain for gear, and grow your company to survive your journey home in this tactical auto-battler. Play solo, face a tournament of trials in multiplayer, or team up in co-op.

details.title: Vital Decisions
details.short_description: Take charge of a emergency room up to 8 players. Examine patients’ vitals, diagnose their conditions, and choose the right treatment. Prioritize emergencies and keep the shift under control as your patients’ conditions worsen around you.

details.title: Nookmaker
details.short_description: You're the new interior designer in a small town. Read your clients' letters, decorate their rooms and discover hidden furniture combos along the way. Then spend what you earn on your own little home, where nobody asks for anything.

details.title: Dawn Of The Realm
details.short_description: Dawn Of The Realm is a medieval real-time strategy game. Build cities, manage resources and raise armies. Zoom straight out to a strategy map of the whole continent and back down to the battlefield, with no loading and no separate mode. Up to 10 players.

details.title: Pawnshop Together
details.short_description: Run your own pawn shop solo or with up to 3 friends! Buy, negotiate, inspect, repair, and sell items to build your business and find new ways to make money around town.

details.title: 动物城往事
details.short_description: 《动物城往事》是一款模拟真实经济的城市建设游戏。扮演被委派到偏远自治小镇的动物市长，规划你的城镇，发展工业，调整税收和补贴，完成上级的任务，吸引移民，聆听并解决各种可爱的小动物们的需求，将你的动物城从一无所有建设成繁华的大都会！

details.title: Conatus - Forgotten Depths
details.short_description: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler where every weapon offers a unique playstyle. Explore interconnected regions, uncover hidden secrets, craft powerful potions and descend into a world humanity chose to bury.

details.title: Don't duck with me
details.short_description: Cook with the fruit you kill in a cozy fantasy incremental. Cut down fruit monsters, blend them into delicious smoothies and grow your beach bar! Your goal: a boss with 1.5 billion HP.

details.title: Masc, Mask & Masked
details.short_description: Masc, Mask & Masked is a game that combines mini-games with a visual novel in a terrifyingly cute 2D style. Search through your mobile, chat to your potential dates and recover the powerful mask of Niarlatoted.

details.title: Laylines
details.short_description: Six challengers, one defender, the oldest trophy in sailing. Lead your syndicate from headquarters to the race course: crew, shipyard, sponsors, weather — and match race duels decided on the water, under real racing rules. History isn't bought: it's conquered.

details.title: Barista Dream - Prologue
details.short_description: Open your own cozy cafe for free. Brew every drink by hand, pour your own latte art, and read what customers post about you on an in-game social network.

details.title: Diss Diss Discussion
details.short_description: When student council president Sakurai fights to make uniforms optional, Hiyama pushes back against her (because Sakurai-senpai looks too good in them!) with nonsensical wit. Hasumi can barely look at what her crush gets himself into... A visual novel about the dumb things we say to get things done.

details.title: Theoria: A God Simulator
details.short_description: A Godsimulator without limits. Throw buildings with your bare hand, burn nations down with meteors, or possess a peasant and walk through the war you started.

details.title: Pack Ripper
details.short_description: Pack Ripper is a hands-on trading card incremental game. Rip open packs, fill your binder, and level up your packs for better pulls. Will you sell the hit or keep it?

details.title: Fleshgrinder
details.short_description: Fleshgrinder is an isometric post-apocalyptic Action-RPG. Take on the desperate mission to stop the Fleshgrinder from causing planetary extinction by harvesting the infected population. Loot, equip and level up your characters, interact with npcs in a persistent world filled with quests and danger.

details.title: Treehouse
details.short_description: An aesthetically pleasing treehouse toy. Build up and out, and the branches support your structures. Connect rooms with ladders and walkways, or carve footpaths through the grassy glen to interactable ponds. Create the ambient orchestral soundtrack with your treehouse, and set the perfect lighting.

details.title: Sails of Salt
details.short_description: Set sail and become a pirate legend in this roguelite sandbox. Every voyage, a new sea: plunder, capture ships, lead your fleet and shape your crew. Greed makes you rich. Or dead. How much will you risk?

details.title: Murder Sudoku
details.short_description: A single-player logic puzzle game. A series of mysterious murders that seem unrelated are, in fact, connected by countless threads. Use Sudoku-style logical deduction to organize suspects, evidence, and clues, and uncover the secrets behind the cases.

details.title: Highways & Co.
details.short_description: Do you hate building cities but love managing traffic? Design the perfect road network in this traffic simulator. Build interchanges, roundabouts, bridges, and tunnels with powerful road-building tools. Keep traffic flowing, solve congestion, and avoid a pile-up!

details.title: Stepwell
details.short_description: Stepwell is a puzzle game about building impossible paths. Arrange and overlap tiles to create surprising connections, discover new ways to use each piece, and guide little inhabitants as you rebuild their shattered world.

details.title: 明末：甲申年
details.short_description: Set during the fall of the Ming dynasty in 1644, this historical grand-strategy narrative game lets you rule as the Chongzhen Emperor, fight for the Shun regime, lead another faction, or survive as a commoner. Govern, wage war, manage resources, and reshape history through AI-assisted court debates.

details.title: Concerto on White: Bass Hero
details.short_description: Pick up your keyboard and play it like a real bass! Take on the role of Ostinata, the leader and bassist of the all-girl band Tutti Nova. Strengthen the bonds among the five band members while staying ever ready to fend off bassist jokes, and grow your fan base to perform in larger venues!

details.title: GnomeBoozled
details.short_description: Run an illegal gnome disposal business from your backyard. Build absurd traps and conveyor systems to maximize profit, and stop gnomes from sabotaging your shady operation before the whole neighborhood falls into chaos.

details.title: JAWED
details.short_description: Jawed is a psychological horror game where you play as Adam, a man muzzled by a life of silent torture since the disappearance of his fiancée. Presented with evidence that she may be alive, Adam must confront their strained relationship and face the only thing that can truly set him free: the truth.

details.title: Thiccfoot
details.short_description: A relaxing camping trip becomes a desperate struggle for survival. Will you survive? Will your friends?

details.title: Mecha Wars: Kitbash Rebuilt
details.short_description: One day, young Lumina accidentally witnesses a shady incident and gets dragged straight into the crossfire. From that moment on, she’s forced into a desperate war against the evil organization “Tenfold Piercing Arrow”. To crush her enemies, she must scavenge parts and forge an even stronger mecha.

details.title: Wretched Tales:Cinderella
details.short_description: A familiar Cinderella fairy tale is twisted into a grotesque puzzle adventure. Observe static 2D scenes, interpret the hidden reactions of objects, and complete the cruel procedure that leads to the ball.

name: My AI read my diary - Dating Sim

details.title: My AI read my diary - Dating Sim
details.short_description: It started as a simple tease. Yet, your devoted AI companion has crossed the line and pried into your secret diary. Your choices will dictate the final outcome of your relationship in this AI yandere romance.

details.title: Brain Bomb
details.short_description: Concepts are bombs. Association is death. An cult-like anti-utopian psychological horror puzzle game. The subject has a concept bomb implanted in brain. If a subject thinks of the [Fuse Word], their head detonates. You, as the "cognitive bomb defuser", dismantling the deadly "brain bomb".

details.title: Kingdoms Assemble
details.short_description: Kingdoms Assemble is a fantasy async PvP auto-battler. Start from a small plot: buy tiles, plan your layout, expand territory, and conquer kingdoms on the world map. Your pre-arranged lineup automatically produces and strengthens your army. Forge a unique war kingdom and conquer the continent!

details.title: Desert Sweepers
details.short_description: In this relaxing first-person cleaning sim, the Bureau has declared the desert too sandy. Start with a spoon, get paid by the kilo, and earn your way to sweeper trucks and hauling robots. Leave a clean trail through the dunes at your own pace. Play solo or in online co-op from launch.

details.title: Banana Airways
details.short_description: Feed your passengers. Or they'll eat each other. Run an airline with cannibal chickens, radioactive passengers and screaming babies you can throw off the plane. Fly, serve, repair and try to land. Play solo or with up to five friends.

details.title: Heroll: IF
details.short_description: Roll the dice, survive the chaos, and rebuild a broken world in this roguelite board-game RPG. Battle through unpredictable loops, recruit adorable pets, face wild events, and grow stronger with every roll.

details.title: Sound Agent
details.short_description: Sound Agent is a narrative puzzle game where you solve cold cases by listening. Use the sound device to rewind to crime scenes, listen to the sounds at the scene, and uncover truths hidden in plain sound.

details.title: Marriage in Withdrawal
details.short_description: A dark otome VN where you will walk a perilous tightrope between desire and morality. Will you melt the ice of your frozen husband, or fall into the gentle trap of the boy next door? Will you sink into a tangled, three-way descent, or break free from everything to claim your ultimate freedom?

details.title: Deal & Deceit
details.short_description: Ask anything. Believe nothing. Treason is brewing in a market of folk spirits. For 10 days, trade, flatter and bluff with merchants who answer whatever you type and remember how you treated them. Then name every traitor at the King's vote. One wrong name, and the King is failed.

details.title: Good Morning [Employee Name] VR
details.short_description: A seated VR mystery in an office that never moved past tape and brass. You're the new hire at Consolidated Dynamics. Play the morning cassette, work the switchboard, stamp the forms. Twelve days on the job. Try not to wonder what the work is for.

details.title: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS
details.short_description: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS is a 2D PvPvE animal extraction shooter set after humanity’s extinction. Venture into ruined cities and dangerous laboratories, search for valuable supplies, and return safely to your shelter with your loot.

details.title: ATC: Tower & Ground
details.short_description: Real Spanish air traffic control. Vector arrivals through storms and windshear, run the taxiways, and keep your nerve when an engine fails on the takeoff roll. Real procedures, real data, pilots that answer back. All of Spain, one airport at a time.

details.title: Bonsai Island
details.short_description: Grow, shape, and sell your own fully simulated bonsai trees to adorable animal customers! Turn your humble little bonsai cart into a thriving business on a cozy island.

details.title: Anomaly Cafe
details.short_description: Manage a quaint coffee shop hidden deep in an unknown forest. Brew daily cups for ordinary travelers, but be prepared to adapt your service when unusual and anomalous entities start lining up for their caffeine fix.

details.title: KICKSHIFT
details.short_description: An alternate Rocket League-like game if you are looking for a unique take on the genre, that's built with Rollback netcode.

name: Daily Life With The Herb Girl

details.title: Daily Life With The Herb Girl
details.short_description: A slice-of-life visual novel steeped in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Befriend Linglan, a girl manifested from medicinal herbs, learn herbal properties, and guide her through the modern world. Features Live2D.

details.title: Midnight Moving Crew
details.short_description: Midnight Moving Crew is a 1-4 player co-op horror sim. Clock in, pack the house, and survive the shift. Buy EMF detectors and defensive wards to repel any entities in the house before you become the next permanent resident.

details.title: MindGate CornerGet
details.short_description: A free-to-play hack-and-slash that fights on in your taskbar. Chibi heroes meet the enemy inside a thin strip at the bottom of your screen. All you do is swap the gear they picked up and respec their skills when you feel like it. No connection needed; the rest happens in the corner of your screen.

details.title: Log Drop
details.short_description: A physics sandbox with one noble goal: get more logs into the core than physically reasonable. Chop the trees, build the contraption, then unleash a wave of logs for combo-fueled cash. Kick back and let it flow, or engineer the perfect cascade. Your sandbox, your rules.

details.title: Can Collector Simulator
details.short_description: Pick up piles of scattered cans in a casual first-person collecting sim. Recycle your haul at reverse vending machines, cash out printed receipts, upgrade your pickup speed and capacity, and look for oversized prize pull tabs hidden in the mess.

details.title: Project L.U.N.A
details.short_description: Project L.U.N.A is a pixel art bartending visual novel set in cyberpunk Seoul. Run the bar Unknown as L.U.N.A, listen to your guests, and mix cocktails. Your choices and every drink you serve can change their relationships and fates.

details.title: Welcome Back to Aeris
details.short_description: Welcome back to Aeris! A point-and-click psychological horror about reviving a Frutiger Aero minigame console shutting down in 7 days. Restore its dead channels with your guide Mora — and follow the strange traces appearing beyond the screen.

details.title: My Cat Is a Maid!
details.short_description: A short, slice-of-life romance visual novel. As an anime merch shop clerk, you meet a cat-eared maid "cosplayer" while running an errand for your manager. Her request? Adopt her! Wait—she’s a real catgirl?! Your cozy life with an adorable catgirl begins!

details.title: Harmony Strike
details.short_description: A party-based survivors-like where you lead a whole party of heroes instead of a single character. Each boss you defeat adds a new hero to your team, heroes fighting side by side combine their elements, and dozens of runes and relics shape every run.

details.title: Elancia Replay Online
details.short_description: A free-to-play 2D MMORPG in development, with combat, gathering, crafting, and trading planned. Early Access is targeted for mid-to-late March 2027. Follow development and help shape the game through your feedback.

details.title: The Last Inn
details.short_description: Welcome to The Last Inn — become the innkeeper! Build a refuge on the Radiated Continent. By day, serve guests, farm and raise livestock; by night, hunt, scavenge and gather ingredients. Recruit companions as helpers or lovers. Build an oasis and unravel the mystery over three great shelters…

details.title: Dragon's Tear
details.short_description: Slay monsters, harvest their Tears and power-up your party in this idle dungeon crawler RPG. Farm cleared floors while AFK, then leap back into action to lead your party down 100 handcrafted floors. Can you find the legendary Dragon's Tear?

details.title: WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion
details.short_description: 🧸 WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion 🍯 is a mystery visual novel with point-and-click mechanics, inspired by A. A. Milne's stories. Explore the Hundred Acre Wood, unravel secrets and make decisions that can change the course of events.

details.title: Dirty Dispatch
details.short_description: Dirty Dispatch is a management game where you dispatch emergency teams across an isometric city while pulling the strings of its criminal underworld. Respond to calls, expand your operation, and face the consequences of the risks you create.

details.title: Deathand
details.short_description: Burn your cards for light. Fight with what remains. A first-person dungeon crawler with turn-based deckbuilding combat. Sacrifice cards to reveal enemy intentions, hold attacks to charge stronger hits, and build your deck as you descend through procedural dungeons.

details.title: One Million Bolts
details.short_description: Take industrial machines apart as a robot worker, solo or with up to 3 friends. Unscrew bolts, cut welds and recover valuable parts. Upgrade your tools, deploy robot helpers and bring heavy loads to dispatch in a first-person dismantling simulator with progress you can see.

details.title: Eternal Xiuzhen
details.short_description: This is a cultivation game! Play as a cultivator, hunt demon beasts, collect resources, and roam the cultivation world! With a unique battlefield size-changing mechanic, from small demons to colossal beasts, feel the thrill of hunting!

details.title: Odd Rock Out
details.short_description: You're locked out, and your spare key is inside a fake pebble somewhere among 5,000 real ones. Pick them up, shake them by your ear and listen for the one that rattles. A short, quiet game about patience: no upgrades, no countdown. Solo or with up to four friends.

details.title: KAESHI
details.short_description: A 2D beat 'em up built around Sekiro-style parrying. Attack with fast combos, parry enemy flurries to break their posture, then finish them with a Deathblow.

details.title: Prisoner Amber
details.short_description: [BL Visual Novel] Amber’s career as an agent ends in an explosion. Arrested and interrogated, he discovers a huge chunk of his memory is missing. Recover the memories, find the true culprit, and face—the final truth!

details.title: Mortis Survivors: Blood Arena
details.short_description: Dark-Fantasy Horde Survivor & Action Roguelite: Conquer 6 fortress arenas, unlock 6 champions, evolve weapons into Mythic forms and Divine or Demonic fusions, forge 64 artifacts & 6 gear sets — solo or in 1–4 player Online & Local Co-op!

details.title: Forged in Formation
details.short_description: Round up the scattered rebels of '98 on a Crown-held Caribbean island and lead them out past redcoat volleys, charging boars, alligators and one very angry gaoler. One button snaps your crowd into Column, Line or Square. Pick the right shape in time and the danger walks straight past you.

details.title: PaperKrieg
details.short_description: A real-time strategy game of paper soldiers and fantasy. Build brigades, arm them from your city, and choose formations that counter the enemy. Overwhelm them with trains, balloons, dragons, or tanks. Seize key points on the map, or hold out in endless defense against a paper horde.

details.title: Battle for Noalea
details.short_description: Battle for Noalea is a turn-based fantasy wargame for two players. Lead one of four factions and its hero, seize settlements and outmaneuver your rival in battles without dice and without hidden information. Play against real people online via Steam or in hotseat mode on one screen.

details.title: OVERPULSE
details.short_description: OVERPULSE is a fast-paced neon roguelite shooter built around intense 20-minute runs. Choose a weapon, stack upgrades, unlock its Overpulse, and survive escalating swarms, minibosses, and a final boss as your build grows from simple to screen-filling chaos.

details.title: Grocery Architect
details.short_description: Open the doors to your very own grocery store as you design, build, and grow it from a tiny corner shop into a bustling supermarket. Stock the shelves, keep impatient customers happy, and hire your crew in Grocery Architect, the cozy supermarket building and management sim!

details.title: Flipside 86
details.short_description: A coin-flicking roguelike in a neon 1986 casino. Slingshot coins into the bowl, bounce them into a JACKPOT CHAIN, stack CHIPS × MULT, then spend the winnings at Lucky's bar. 100 tables, 10 venues, one House to break. Then let it ride.

details.title: Athletics Live: Track & Field
details.short_description: A skill-based athletics game where your hands decide who wins. Mash to sprint, clear the hurdles, hit the board and release at 45°. Every men's and women's event, relays, decathlon and heptathlon, and a World Tour from club meets to the Global Games. Race your friends online.

details.title: Hedge-Wizard Cocktail
details.short_description: A not-so-cozy apothecary simulator. Explore, gather reagents, craft wicked concoctions and haggle with adventurers, alone or with friends, in a dangerous, dark fantasy world. Complete quests and expand your alchemical expertise to grow your shop before the horrors of the Hedge destroy you.

name: Silicon Life: From Bedroom to Billion

details.title: Silicon Life: From Bedroom to Billion
details.short_description: September 1981. A bedroom, a workbench, a dream: build a computer empire. Assemble, repair and sell PCs in 3D through the real hardware of 1981 to 2025 under parodied names, from the garage to the factory, and aim for a billion.

details.title: Same Day Tycoon
details.short_description: Someone just ordered a giant rubber duck, and you promised it today. Every order is a real parcel: follow it from the shelf to the box, onto the van and up to the doorstep. Build the warehouses, hire the crew and send vans, trucks and trains across North America to keep your promise.

details.title: Cuddle Puddle
details.short_description: Cuddle Puddle is a short, cozy incremental game about calling cats together. No click-spamming: your paw's love zone goes pspsps on its own, cats pounce on each other and burst into hearts. Grow a conga line, raise your cat tree and fill five places with cuddles. :3

details.title: Honed to Perfection
details.short_description: In Asterra, a young swordsman left with nothing but a debt of one million gold climbs the Ascendancy Tower to challenge the Demon King. Master Fire, Ice, Bio and Thunder in a stylized action RPG with no XP and no levels: every bit of power is earned with gold and chosen by you.

details.title: Iris: The World
details.short_description: A classic free-to-play fantasy MMORPG returns in Q1 2027. Choose Human, Elf or Hybrid, wield the power of the tarot, transform into the monsters you hunt and set out from the fortress of Terminus to recover the shattered Ipinidas Rune.

details.title: Canaanite Falls
details.short_description: Return to your roots and connect with the Levant like never before in Canaanite Falls, a brand new monster-taming RPG and decolonial journey from WaveyGaming Productions.

details.title: Pawlosseum
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelite of duo battles. Climb a 100-floor fighting tower with your elemental siblings: act by speed, boost your strikes, chain combo attacks and play to the crowd. Cheers raise your pay, boos cut it. Every run, a new path from the Pit to the Crown.

details.title: Woolfall
details.short_description: A physics sandbox about mining with sheep. Dig a mine, route your flock past glowing caves for finer wool, then flood it, burn it or blow it up. Sheep go poof and drift home. That’s normal. Solo, or co-op with up to three friends to blame.

name: 幻想灵游记 ～ The Missing Donation Box

details.title: 幻想灵游记 ～ The Missing Donation Box
details.short_description: The morning after a banquet, the Hakurei Shrine's donation box has vanished! Pick three companions from Gensokyo and team up your way: cover weaknesses or double down on strengths. Brave boss fights to find the missing box, and above all, enjoy a Roguelike deckbuilder full of dazzling danmaku!

details.title: Frontier Miner
details.short_description: Frontier Miner is a competitive sci-fi battle royale. Mine asteroids for ore, forge upgrades for your weapons and gear, then race rival players to destroy the pirate space station first. Outmine, outbuild, and outgun everyone to claim the frontier.

details.title: Depot Nine
details.short_description: Lead a squad of survivors on tactical extraction raids. Search the ruins, fight for every crate and make it to the exit, because the gear you lose out there stays lost. Build up your base, rescue the missing and find out what really happened at Depot 9.

name: Order Filled: A Trading Desk Story

details.title: Order Filled: A Trading Desk Story
details.short_description: A stock trading sim with a story mode and a free mode. Story mode: you start as a new trader on a US desk in 2010, with a tutorial week, client orders and an evening review of your fills. Free mode: open an account, pick your stake and trade a generated market, with margin and short selling.

details.title: GHOSTGRID
details.short_description: Take freelance hacking jobs in a port city. Break into fictional networks with real commands, investigate breaches, write the report, then go out and pay the rent. Everything you do leaves a record, and investigators read them. 153 real techniques, and the game checks that you did them.

details.title: Round One, Fight!
details.short_description: A laid-back incremental auto battler straight off a '90s video-store shelf. Build your fighter, let him throw the punches, and come back stronger after a beating. 25 opponents, 5 acts, a skill tree, and a little romance.

details.title: Cave Saga
details.short_description: Explore the caves in this action-adventure platformer. Jump, dash, pick up, and throw objects or creatures to help escape the various complex cave systems. Each biome you explore contains unique mechanics and aesthetics. Play solo or with up to 4 players in local co-op!

details.title: Fishly: Desktop Aquarium
details.short_description: A tiny pixel-art aquarium that lives on your desktop. Your fish swim, eat, sleep at night and earn gold while you work. Breed rare colours, fill your album, decorate your tank or let them swim across your whole wallpaper

details.title: Sharktooth Bay
details.short_description: Dig for shark teeth, sift through the sand, and stock a seaside fossil shop with what you find. Set your prices, arrange your displays, and sell to visiting beachgoers. Keep your favorite finds for your own collection.

details.title: Seoul Night Bites
details.short_description: Run a tiny Korean street-food stall after midnight. Pick ingredient cards, cook 64 real Korean dishes and chain recipes into huge combos in this cozy roguelite deckbuilder. Pay the rent, then see how long you last in Endless Nights.

details.title: SkyAceBlitz
details.short_description: Top-down roguelike aerial shooter. Engage in realistic inertia dogfights, shoot down foes with machine guns and homing missiles. Gather random upgrades every run for distinct builds. Play with friends via Remote Play Together!

name: Drink Cola. Get a Fighter Jet!

details.title: Drink Cola. Get a Fighter Jet!
details.short_description: The fighter jet prize is no joke. This cola company actually delivers. Crack open colas, rack up points, and fight with powerful prizes. The ultimate goal: a fighter jet. A top-down shooter incremental where you grow endlessly stronger and collect dangerous prizes.

details.title: Clickbait Arcade
details.short_description: You've seen the ads. Pull the pin, pick the door, run through the x3 gate. The games never existed... until now. Clickbait Arcade is 12 fake mobile-ad games made real, in a neon arcade, with no ads, no energy timers and no pay-to-win.

details.title: UNHOLY PEPPERONI
details.short_description: A tiny pizzeria. A sister you love. A tragedy you can't escape. Run a pizzeria where the nights are unsettling, and every slice comes with a side of something sinister. But no matter how hard you try to keep the business, some things refuse to stay buried.

details.title: Monsters & Banknotes
details.short_description: Open a backstreet monster shop on borrowed money. Buy, breed, raise and sell 141 species, build valuable bloodlines, prove them in the arena and trade at the grand auction. Pay the underworld tribute or defend your shop in this pixel-art management sim.

details.title: MAGICA☆REVERSI!
details.short_description: Reversi, but magical girls fire rocket launchers. Shuffle the board, flip every disc, warp in for a one-hit win. Fall behind and your comeback magic charges up. Lose the disc your character stands on and you lose on the spot. Every disc you're ahead is in-game prize money. 50 3D boards.

details.title: CANON CANON CANON
details.short_description: Stack cannons on your units, chain their effects and hold the line! Defend your garden against waves of furious animals in this roguelite lane defense.

details.title: Tower vs Zombies
details.short_description: Hold the line against relentless zombie hordes! Build and evolve industrial turrets — cannons, machine guns, missiles, flamethrowers, frost and more — grow a huge upgrade tree and defend your command post through a city under siege.

details.title: Driftworn
details.short_description: Lead a squad of drifters through a solar system still broken by a decade old war. Fight, trade, salvage and build across the planets and moons of Sol in an open-world sandbox where nobody is the chosen one, then buy a ship and start your adventure

details.title: Lost Firmament
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious world of floating islands in this 3D Action RPG. Fight strange creatures, discover forgotten secrets, and forge your path through a world falling into ruin.

details.title: Crown of Rust
details.short_description: One mech against an entire royal court. Bolt weapons onto every slot, fuse them into something far worse, and hold the throne hall against waves of knights, cultists and hounds that never stop coming. A horde-survival roguelite about building the perfect war machine.

details.title: Defender of Rome
details.short_description: A tower defense game about the steadfast defenders of Rome's cities. Build an unbeatable legion, raise veterans and use everything at hand, from shield walls to geese and burning pigs. Defeat five nations, sworn enemies of Rome, in 18 missions from foggy Britain to the sands of Parthia.

details.title: Beat Bound
details.short_description: Glowing pads explode to the beat! A rhythm dodge game on an 8×8 launchpad. 42 songs across 9 cities, from EASY all the way to PERFECT, where a single hit ends your run.

details.title: Grave Train
details.short_description: An action roguelike where your party is a train of chaos and blood. Arrange your team of monsters. Charge through waves of unwilling sacrifices. Perform a ritual summoning of the strongest beings, and kill them all.

details.title: Lancet & Linen
details.short_description: Nuremberg, 1382. Live the life of a bathkeeper: diagnose patients, perform period procedures by hand, and run a bustling bathhouse with hired staff. Travel across nine towns, raise an heir, answer to the city council, and shape your house across three careers and six endings.

details.title: Couch Potato
details.short_description: Tiny Spud is a little potato who lives on your desktop. He binge-watches TV in a panel beside your work, cooks disasters, plays his retro console, takes calls from his inventor brother and wanders out onto your taskbar for a nap. You work. He couches.

details.title: Tiny Battleground
details.short_description: Battle against 5 other players in Tiny Battleground, a fast-paced PvP auto battler where every decision matters. Build your team, combine powerful traits, upgrade your units, and master special tiles to outsmart your opponents in intense 15–20 minute matches.

details.title: 地府临时工(Underworld Temp)
details.short_description: 你是一名没有魂魄的临时鬼差。在这款卡牌构筑游戏中，用卡牌和话术与亡魂交涉、拘魂或斗法。地府的“归整”会抹去你的大部分记忆，而留住自己，或许要让别人付出代价。

details.title: Timothy: Wasteland Janitor
details.short_description: This is an incremental game in which you help Timothy, a discarded droid, defend himself against hordes of aggressive Wasteland creatures. Upgrade Timmy, pick the best builds, and enjoy the fireworks of the battlefield.

details.title: Rum & Rovers
details.short_description: A game about maritime trade and freedom. For three hundred years, ships have sailed the same ring of routes, and beyond the red buoys at its edge lies a sea that's on no map. Trade between 23 ports, fight off pirates, and collect the eight pieces of the Map of Freedom.

details.title: Architraps
details.short_description: Build the track, then race it. In ARCHITRAPS 2 to 8 friends take turns placing platforms and traps on a shared course, then sprint for the finish. Every piece you place helps you and hurts everyone else. Sabotage, laugh, rebuild.

details.title: Minicar Grand Prix
details.short_description: A cozy idle racing game played out in your room. Lay down track and your minicars race lap after lap, earning cash even while you relax. Spend it on new motors and rollers, then take the minicar you built to the cups and watch it evolve.

details.title: Monsters Eat Spores
details.short_description: Your job is simple: keep cosmic monsters fed, one spore at a time. Use your cursor to grab spores from the monsters' faces and fling them into their mouths. Each monster has its own appetite and its own quirks, so it's your job to keep everyone happy and well fed.

details.title: Nekome: Nazi Hunter
details.short_description: Hunt and kill Nazis in a stealthy single-player campaign with bloody and brutal melee combat. Study your enemies, confirm your approach, and become an unexpected assassin fueled by violent revenge.

details.title: ABISMO
details.short_description: ABISMO is a co-op deep-sea horror game set on the abyssal floor of an alien planet. Descend alone or with up to 4 players into shifting trenches, explore derelict facilities, and recover what you need to survive while uncovering an analog-horror mystery hidden in corrupted VHS tapes.

details.title: QUIET
details.short_description: Your ship crashed, your crew is stranded, and this house is somehow your best chance of survival. Search for ship parts while every movement and real-world sound risks alerting whatever lurks nearby. Stay QUIET, keep your flock together, and try not to quack under pressure.

details.title: Idle Transporter
details.short_description: Idle Transporter is a fun incremental game to have running while you work on something else. Build your own little company and watch the cars zoom around the screen while you are in a zoom call.

details.title: Lone Tower
details.short_description: Defend one tower. Face endless waves. Build synergies, unlock permanent upgrades, and survive the chaos.

details.title: The Granny Detective Society
details.short_description: Play as Madeleine, a retired granny recruited by the Granny Detective Society (basically the FBI… but add dentures). Investigate your neighbors, figure out their names and professions, and uncover all their secrets in this no-murder detective game full of white hair and mugs of tea.

details.title: DreadHaven: The Last Colony
details.short_description: Build by day. Survive by night. Each day, use a limited number of actions to expand your city, manage resources, reinforce defenses, and prepare for what’s coming. Each night, unleash the power of your towers against the ever-growing zombie hordes.

details.title: Letters Past
details.short_description: Play as a postman delivering a letter over a quiet mountain path. See the sights, journal your observations, discover secrets and piece together a story you can't experience all at once.

details.title: Picker Magnate Simulator
details.short_description: Buy junk, hunt for rare treasures, and turn it all into profit in your own resale shop. Haggle with sellers, repair antiques yourself or through hired workers, craft handmade, and level up your skills to carry and sell more. If you hate hauling heavy stuff, buy a vehicle. Build your resale empire.

details.title: We Are So Cooked
details.short_description: You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.

details.title: La Cosa Nostra
details.short_description: La Cosa Nostra is a story focused, cinematic 2.5D side-scrolling action game set in 1920s Prohibition era US. Play as Johnny, an Italian American immigrant forced into a life of crime, combining melee combat and shooter gameplay within a noir mafia themed narrative.

details.title: BattleSpinners
details.short_description: A fast-paced, spinning-tops versus game. Build your spinner, launch it into the arena, and defeat your opponents by knocking them out of the ring, or by tearing them apart. Brawl against or alongside your friends, use your skills and unleash powerful abilities to dominate the arena (1-4 players)

details.title: No Clean Start
details.short_description: No Clean Start is a first-person survival horror with roguelite elements set in a hostile underground facility. Explore dangerous sectors, scavenge for weapons and supplies, manage resources, and fight or avoid deadly enemies. Complete objectives, adapt your strategy, and survive each expedition.

details.title: Late Night Manifest
details.short_description: As Marco, you wake up to a reality where the world is shrouded in darkness, forcing you to fight for survival while seeking answers in abandoned darkness.

details.title: Sekigahara
details.short_description: The fate of Japan is in your hands! Sekigahara is a digital adaptation of the acclaimed two-player strategy board game set in 1600, during the epic campaign that unified Japan. Command hidden armies, manage loyalties, and outmaneuver your rival!

details.title: Scaredy Cats
details.short_description: Where resource management meets dungeon crawler. Collect rare loot, strategize monster encounters, and push your luck to descend to the bottom of the dungeon!

details.title: Moldborne
details.short_description: A dark fantasy co-op turn-based roguelike. The Father stopped answering prayers years ago. Then the mold came up out of the ground, and the dead started getting back up. They remember everything. So do you.

details.title: Keep It Up!
details.short_description: Keep It Up! is a 4 player co-op physics game where you and your fellow genetically [redacted] test subjects slap a balloon through a mysterious obstacle course without it touching the ground. You've gotta Keep It Up!

details.title: Inner Rooms
details.short_description: Wander through vast, unsettling liminal spaces as a quiet presence grows alongside you. Inner Rooms is a psychological atmospheric exploration game set in a world that appears calm and peaceful, yet constantly radiates unease.

details.title: False Echo
details.short_description: False Echo is a narrative cryptography thriller set in the darkest depths of the Stelantic, aboard a secret military submarine. Operate the Obscura machine, decode messages, and decide what gets through in a regime where even the smallest mistake means a huge death toll.

details.title: Barely Developers
details.short_description: Build a gaming empire in this first-person, co-op game development simulator! Start in Mom's garage, create hit games, hire chaotic employees, design your own consoles, and grow into a AAA studio. Play solo or with up to 3 friends.

details.title: The Long Mine
details.short_description: An incremental mining game with fully destructible caves. Every pickaxe strike removes an actual piece of rock. Mine ores, sell them, and buy upgrades. Upgrades are not just +10% damage. Equipment and Curses change how you mine, move and explore. Combine them to create your own build.

details.title: Worst Airline Ever
details.short_description: Build an airline from scratch in this multiplayer co-op airline management game. Fly airplanes inspired by real aircraft, design and upgrade your plane, serve passengers, and grow your airline from a small regional carrier into a world-class airline.

details.title: KAGE
details.short_description: Anime MEGABONK with friends. Unleash anime-style techniques — shout them to activate their true power! Fight hordes of enemies, hunt massive bosses, gather rare loot, and craft insane builds in a fast co-op action game for up to 4 players. Upgrade your village. Become a legend 👹

details.title: Void Hunters
details.short_description: Lead fearless rebels in a dark fantasy, turn-based RPG where tactical decisions and strategic squad-building shape every battle against the world-devouring Void.

details.title: Army of the Potomac
details.short_description: A digital version of the grand tactical wargame published by GMT Games and designed by Mark Herman. Second in the Civil War Heritage Series, this game includes scenarios for five individual battles covering the period of 1862 to 1864, and two campaign scenarios using eight maps from the boardgame.

details.title: Warband
details.short_description: Warband is a wave-crusher, boss-rusher and mystery-busting roguelite. Choose your commander, recruit for your warband and stock up at the shop to create unique combinations every run whilst fighting off waves of enemies and bosses a plenty. Can you turn the tide and get Thornhallow back on its feet?

details.title: Scream Operator: Haunted House Manager
details.short_description: Run a haunted dark ride from the control booth in this spooky horror management sim. Load guests, trigger scares, route carts, and keep the power alive as the queue surges. Earn cash and prestige to rebuild the mansion, automate the ride, and survive every shift.

details.title: Find the Ojisan
details.short_description: You must not overlook coworkers hiding to work overtime—a surreal horror clocking-out simulator where you try to leave a strange office safely, day after day.

details.title: Rescue Drone Simulator: Second Chance
details.short_description: Pilot drones into burning buildings, frozen landmarks, and collapsing tunnels. Rescue survivors, build and customize your fleet, and lead a team of specialists who never got a second chance - until now.

details.title: Green Inferno
details.short_description: A new kind of horror deduction game that allows you to investigate freely. Examine detailed scenes, collect evidence in the form of clips, and use them to reconstruct events. Connect the clues, build your own theory, and unmask the macabre truth behind a doomed expedition.

details.title: Raging Blasters 2
details.short_description: The sequel to the "Raging Blasters" is here! It's called "Raging Blasters 2". This is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shmup. Players choose from three pilots to control, and head into battle. The graphics are pixel-perfect, and the music includes chiptune versions.

details.title: Rust & Dust
details.short_description: Rust & Dust is A fast-paced 2D roguelike Shooter about two twin mice fighting through a ruined world. Instantly switch between them, combine their powers, and turn positioning into a weapon. Master the chaos or be overrun!

name: Error: Love - Human Bug Eradication Project

details.title: Error: Love - Human Bug Eradication Project
details.short_description: If love is an error you can’t fix… will you delete me—or choose to keep me? Step into the role of a censor and dive into a story of order, freedom, and love.

details.title: HELLCARD II
details.short_description: Hellcard II is a unique co-op deck-builder roguelike game. Descend into the paper dungeons on your own or invite friends to fast-paced tactical card battles against hordes of evil and dragons. Lots of dragons!

details.title: UNSEAM
details.short_description: An action platformer set in a world stitched shut. Ride the cracks your attacks leave for high-speed movement, carve terrain that falls the way you cut it, and journey to recover the memories of a girl who woke from her coffin.

details.title: Carry On
details.short_description: Carry On is a chaotic 1-4 player local co-op baggage handling game. Grab, wash, wrap and hurl colour-coded luggage down the conveyors to fill every departing flight's manifest before the clock runs out. Miss the plane and the whole terminal pays for it.

details.title: Deceptive Shadows: Final Case
details.short_description: A paranormal detective in Sin City. A missing girl, a chained demon, and a city full of lies. Sounds like a normal investigation. It isn't. Question the demon, fight with guns and magic, solve occult puzzles, and survive its tricks.

details.title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027
details.short_description: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!

details.title: Long Trip
details.short_description: Long Trip is a dark fantasy VR action RPG where you explore the shattered lands aboard the skyship The Dust, battle bosses, ride legendary mounts, summon allies, and uncover ancient secrets across a world scarred by war.

details.title: Paleokin
details.short_description: Paleokin is a brutal prehistoric survival game set in an infinite procedural world. Fight mammoths and dinosaurs, build a settlement, farm the land, breed your own dinos, and stay alive. Alone or with friends.

details.title: Unconventional Fantasy
details.short_description: I have blended card game and action game genres to create this unique deck-building game. Craft your one-of-a-kind deck, encounter quirky NPCs, discover powerful cards, make choices at every turn, uncover the secrets of this world bit by bit, and embark on an adventure in this otherworld!

details.title: Another Door
details.short_description: Another Door is a multiplayer, turn-based roguelike with monsters, despair, risk and betrayal. Hide your intentions, bluff to survive and bet on your luck. Will you back out, or venture through Another Door?

name: Path of Ambition: The Sun Rise

details.title: Path of Ambition: The Sun Rise
details.short_description: 《異麒麟：初入江湖》是一款以東漢末年為背景的高自由度武俠 CRPG。 你將扮演一位與妹妹相依為命的流民少年，在黃巾之亂尚未爆發的邊境安身立命。從一無所有開始，學武、謀生、遊歷城鎮與荒野，結交形形色色的江湖人物，也在一次次對話、事件、檢定與抉擇中，決定自己要如何在這個時代活下去！

details.title: Consume p/pixelplace
details.short_description: Hack a fully simulated pixel canvas. Build your botnet, spread the Void, and watch fictional communities fight, rebuild, and complain on Pixxit. A single-player incremental game with active and Idle modes, territorial drama, and far too many crabs.

details.title: Fishlings: A Cozy Fish Collector
details.short_description: A cozy idle aquarium where every fish comes out of a card pack. Rip packs, flip cards, chase the 1-in-1,000 Prismatic and collect 80+ odd little fish in four variants. Your tank keeps growing and earning while you're away, or swims in a tiny window on your desktop while you work.

details.title: Snow Panic
details.short_description: An online ski race for up to 8 players armed to the teeth. Blast your friends into the trees with bazookas, call in airstrikes, unleash exploding goats and beat them all to the bottom.

details.title: Celestial Golf
details.short_description: It’s 2D golf on an astronomical scale. Bite-sized missions will teach you the techniques of real space flight, without having to worry about fuel or crew. Precisely plan orbital trajectories over the moons of Mars, through the rings of Saturn, and boldly go where no golf ball has gone before.

details.title: Strawberry Milkshake: a Skate Toy!
details.short_description: A skateboarding toy. Kick, push and grind through an endless city of tiles that lock together as you skate. No score to chase, just the board, the street and the feel of discovering a great spot to skate. A sandbox to enjoy solo, or with friends on the sofa.

details.title: Tiny Routes
details.short_description: Tiny Routes is a minimalist strategy puzzle game where you grow a little public transport network into a SPRAWLING city operation. Trace routes, connect stops and keep everyone moving, or risk the wrath of angry commuters.

details.title: Family Time
details.short_description: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!

details.title: CRUSHMINO
details.short_description: Crushmino combines roguelite and falling-block gameplay. Drop blocks to crush your enemies, then claim rewards to craft your own build. Keep your balance so the stack never reaches the top. Tricky enemies and trials await.

details.title: Karanan: Gravebound
details.short_description: A dark turn-based adventure game where you explore deep dungeons, solve puzzles, and fight monsters. Find hidden secrets and rebuild a forgotten graveyard.

details.title: Gemward
details.short_description: Build a maze through overgrown jungle temples: place five gems a round, keep one, turn the rest to stone. Combine and refine them into over sixty special towers, uncover 39 recipes in a living grimoire, and hold the court across seven trials and seven difficulties, alone, with friends or in a duel.

details.title: Pinball Boss Quest
details.short_description: Pinball meets block breaker in a pixel-art fantasy quest. Bat the ball through minion waves, smash breakables and topple ten legendary bosses as a Sword, Bow, Javelin, Mage or Summoner, solo or in local co-op where you team up on the boss but compete for the top score.

details.title: ForMind
details.short_description: A horror shooter set in the ZiroTech underwater complex, where every sector is a fight for life. Battle the infected, use the environment, hack terminals, and learn from mistakes. A time anomaly gives you a second chance — don't waste it.

details.title: Boomside
details.short_description: A roguelike twist on Minesweeper. Dig up houses, signal towers and parks for points, chain power plants into huge multipliers, and read every hint to steer clear of the gas mains. Hire helpers, build your combo, and secure all eight key sites to redevelop the district.

details.title: Exclave
details.short_description: Exclave is an open-world military survival shooter set on Kepler-9. The islands’ former rulers are gone, and rival private military companies are fighting over what they left behind. Survive as a stranded contractor, build a base of operations, and fight for control of the islands’ rare resources.

details.title: Pineview Drive 2 - Rising Storm
details.short_description: For years, Lisa has been haunted by dreams of a burning mansion. When she recognizes the place from a late-night television documentary, she decides to uncover the truth behind the nightmare in this story-driven first-person horror adventure.

details.title: Age of Space
details.short_description: Evolve from being a nobody to being the center of power! Age of space combines real time resource management with tactical combat.
