name: KINGDOM OF REQUIEM-Episode One: The King, The Prince, and The Peasants

details.title: KINGDOM OF REQUIEM-Episode One: The King, The Prince, and The Peasants
details.short_description: "The truth sits under a mountain of lies and deception..." KINGDOM OF REQUIEM is a royal drama-based fantasy visual novel following the lives of various royals, their courts, and the embittered emperor who threatens to upend their lives.

details.title: Dangerline
details.short_description: An old-school real-time strategy game set in a modern war. Build a base, raise an army and fight street by street with two sides that play nothing alike. Walls and hills really block sight and bullets, so take the high ground, hold the houses and bring the town down on the enemy.

details.title: Secret of Havendor
details.short_description: Can you preserve your humanity in a world ruled by blood and gold?

details.title: Palmora
details.short_description: Palmora

name: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster

details.title: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster
details.short_description: A mysterious disease is turning people into picture books. When her sister contracts Paper Mortis, Mono must do everything she can to save her—even if that means making a deal with a veritable devil.

details.title: Heartland
details.short_description: Heartland is a meditative strategy puzzle where you shape the landscapes of new worlds by placing hexagonal tiles. As you build, your worlds come to life and react to the events that unfold. Villages grow into cities, and castles rise into kingdoms, each with its own inhabitants and chronicles.

details.title: Iron Tracer
details.short_description: Iron Tracer is a tactical shooter where you play as a spec-ops soldier sent across the globe to stop threats before they happen. Every mission demands stealth, precision, and quick decision-making, one wrong move can end the the mission.

details.title: Age of Medieval
details.short_description: Age of Medieval is a single-player medieval real-time strategy game. Found a village with four families and a wagon, build it house by house, open roads and trade routes, then raise an army for battles and sieges. When your lord dies, his heir inherits it all.

details.title: Lens Of Fear
details.short_description: Realistic, hyper-immersive, intense action-adventure horror game. Developed by PlayableGraph as their debut title. This game combines a portable camera perspective with highly detailed environments and immersive sound design to deliver an authentic horror experience.

name: Fishing in the Dark: Lake of Monsters

details.title: Fishing in the Dark: Lake of Monsters
details.short_description: Cast. Haul. Gamble. Fire back. Build a fishing village in the dark, turn your catch into gold, luck and ammunition, and defend your pile from the monster rising out of the lake.

details.title: One Command Ahead
details.short_description: Stack command blocks, press Run, and watch a very literal robot follow your plan. Jump gaps, dodge lasers, and find clever loops in a sci-fi puzzle adventure.

details.title: Anima Reaver
details.short_description: A co-op space shooter where you fly with a squad of up to four, online or on split screen, through missions, boss fights and deathmatch. Take flagships apart turret by turret, master 18 ships, and unveil the secrets of the universe.

details.title: Make The Dead Dead Again
details.short_description: Lux is dealing with a paranormal outbreak, and every loot drop could be a gun, a jacket or maybe a fresh dye job. She’ll prioritize accordingly. Clear the streets, then make her drop-dead gorgeous. Because the apocalypse is no excuse for a bad outfit.

details.title: Jamir
details.short_description: Jamir is a free-to-play fast paced sci-fi tactical shooter created by one person. Master your abilities and items to destroy creatures and enemies. Upgrade your character, guns, abilities and items to become the most powerful along the globe.

details.title: Land and Sword
details.short_description: Lead a group of survivors in a new land, build a functional settlement, manage deep production chains, and prepare defenses to face growing hordes of creatures. Balance growth, logistics, and survival in a world scarred by a creeping plague.

details.title: Age After Age
details.short_description: Age After Age. Build a thriving settlement, shape society across multiple eras, and dominate a living world economy. Choose your path - classic history, Steampunk, Gothic, and more in a deep city-building strategy with evolving logistics, citizen classes, diplomacy, and research.

details.title: Street Football: Foul Play
details.short_description: Play football with no rules, solo or with up to 4 friends in local or online co-op. Customize the weather and disasters, unleash brutal tackles and super shots on your rivals, and turn every match into total chaos!

details.title: KOTA: The Survival
details.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world abandoned by humans, control robots as they gather resources, fight enemies, and rebuild the planet using recycled materials. KOTA: The Survival lets you revive nature and craft a new future!

details.title: Bonk Universe
details.short_description: Explore an infinite universe with unlimited possibilities, Conquer the Celestials, Build civilizations, and more! This is an open universe sandbox game, and not even the sky is the limit!

details.title: Mr Bear Goes to Washington
details.short_description: A satirical hand-drawn 2D action platformer where a grizzly bear runs, jumps, and mauls his way through enemies in solo or local co-op. Blending fast-paced combat and platforming with a nostalgic, poster-inspired art style, every level feels handcrafted and full of character.

details.title: Finguedom
details.short_description: Finger everything in the sandbox. Build your dream seaside retreat on a tropical island, Fuse structures with concrete, Shape multi-story homes upon the terrain, manage resources and workers, and construct roads, overpasses, canals, and vehicles to bring your island to life.

details.title: ROOM 307
details.short_description: ROOM 307 is a first-person psychological horror game set in an abandoned hospital. Explore its decaying halls, uncover disturbing records, survive paranormal encounters, and discover what happened at 03:17. Some memories were buried for a reason.

details.title: Cursed Cards
details.short_description: Build a deck of hungry monsters in this roguelike autobattler. Position your creatures, feed their powers and turn sacrifices into devastating combos. Fight zombie swarms, collect strange relics and choose your route through a cursed world.

details.title: ZRAGG
details.short_description: Defend your home planet from hordes of creatures in this retro styled roguelite!

details.title: Shred-A-Bunch!
details.short_description: Shred zombies in slow-mo while drifting with your good old tractor?! Harvest crops, slaughter zombies, overcome epic boss fights and upgrade your vehicle. Rinse and repeat.

details.title: Luminleaf Chronicles
details.short_description: "Luminleaf Chronicles" is a local multiplayer game for 1 to 4 players that combines elements of survival, adventure, and roguelike genres. Acquire items, upgrade your skills, and defeat the continuously appearing bosses to survive tooth and nail in the game world, ultimately face the Skeleton King!

details.title: Wizard Tower Wars
details.short_description: A multiplayer fantasy RTS with deckbuilding. Choose your wizard and tower, customize your spellbook, and battle up to 3 friends. Summon armies and buildings, cast spells, and level up while your forces fight on their own, so planning beats micro. Ally, betray, or fill empty seats with AI.

details.title: Aethelon
details.short_description: Aethelon is an infinite, open world creative voxel sandbox. Build across massive procedural worlds with realistic biome systems. Share your world with reproducible seeds. Experience infinite creative freedom at impressive scale.

details.title: Golden Steam
details.short_description: Golden Steam is a thrilling arcade-puzzle adventure where you collect Golden Steams and activate machine parts to recover artifacts scattered through fractured time. Navigate 10 worlds, master geometric rotations, and control time itself in a steampunk sci-fi universe where every second counts.

details.title: BUG SQUASH
details.short_description: Defend your Command Centers against relentless waves of mutated insects! Customize powerful tanks with an arsenal of weapons and tactical modules in this action-packed tower defense game. Go solo or team up with friends in online co-op.

details.title: Echo Tide
details.short_description: Create your protagonist and inherit a house in Caelmere, a coastal village where romance, mystery, and hidden mermaids are only the beginning. Investigate your uncle's death, meet 15 unique love interests, and choose whether to become a mermaid or something far more mysterious.

details.title: Elsinore
details.short_description: Playing as Nathan, you are invited to inspect a vacant room in your friend’s share-house. When you arrive, no one seems to be home. Search Elsinore, uncover its secrets and discover what happened to your friend, if you hope to escape.

details.title: Blind Gavel
details.short_description: The auctioneer is lying, and he has secret partners hiding among the bidders. Blind Gavel is a 4 to 8 player social deduction party game: bid on items you cannot value, find the partners, and send the accused into a deadly minigame

details.title: CORE//PULSE
details.short_description: Defend a stationary Core against escalating waves of geometric enemies. Build each run with upgrade cards, satellites, orbital weapons and automated skills, defeat unique bosses, earn currency, and return stronger for the next run.

details.title: Innards
details.short_description: Innards is a deranged non-Euclidean adventure, set in the hyperbolic folds of the long-abandoned Internet, with a unique eccentric visual style.

details.title: Cherry Pick
details.short_description: Open packs to collect a variety of shrimp, then breed them to discover even rarer ones. Decorate your own aquarium and watch your shrimp slowly grow in this cozy aquarium game.

details.title: NS Drive Simulator
details.short_description: A driving simulator featuring realistic driving, diverse vehicles, and multiple driving environments.

details.title: THE MAZE WITHIN ME
details.short_description: An atmospheric psychological horror in which you explore dark, maze-like environments, evade lurking threats, and uncover fragments of a troubled past. Face the memories that shaped you and decide what your fate truly means.

details.title: Shape Fulfillment Center
details.short_description: Sublime Shape Fulfillment Experience

details.title: Routine
details.short_description: A job simulation game that tests your memory and adaptability.

details.title: The Dust of Battle
details.short_description: A lightning‑fast turn-based tactical game with explosive progression across 40‑minute campaigns, where every battle becomes a high‑stakes Strike vs Counter duel.

details.title: Cytokine Storm
details.short_description: Cytokine Storm is a retro survival horror set inside a coma patient's body. Battle parasites, viruses, and a defective immune system to wake yourself up. Explore a surreal biological world where you must use your wits, weapons, and unique costumes to survive grotesque locations and puzzles.

details.title: DELTA // SURGE
details.short_description: DELTA // SURGE is an action roguelike bullet hell shooter with deckbuilding. Draft cards mid-run, fight 30 waves of enemy fleets and bosses, and unlock new Flight Frames and permanent upgrades to push your next run further.

details.title: Mystery At Windmill Farm
details.short_description: One missing egg. A farm full of stories that don't quite add up. Play as Reed, a duck detective, in a cozy 3D mystery. Explore a colorful miniature farm, question eccentric animals, follow the clues in your notebook, and trade cheese for gossip. Can you untangle the truth?

details.title: SHOOTOSYNTHESIS
details.short_description: The plants have taken control, and the army sent you in! Farmers! Defend the Photosynthesis Core for 7 waves, alone or with your friends. A whole mutant flora ready to kill you, a multitude of weapons, and mutants you'll have to uproot before they grow back!

details.title: Sprite Garden
details.short_description: Incremental games meet Pacman in this expanding maze shoot-em-up. Move along the paths of your garden, collect flowers, kill imps, find sprites and earn tiles. What powerful sprites will you find in your garden? How big will your garden get?

details.title: Silurian Planet
details.short_description: Silurian Planet is a first-person survival horror game. Survive on a hostile and oppressive planet, seek shelter, manage resources, and make decisions to escape creatures lurking in the darkness.

details.title: Torebia Online
details.short_description: Torebia: Island Odyssey is an old-school sandbox MMORPG. No classes, no pay-to-win. Craft, fight, trade, and rise through the Adventurer's Guild ranks your way. One shared world. Pure adventure.

details.title: Counter Ducks
details.short_description: An asymmetric FPP/TPP shooter with two different game modes. In PvE, hunt ducks solo or in co-op, earn money, and upgrade your gear. In PvP, switch roles and play as a duck against hunters in chaotic 4v4 battles!

details.title: Socialiskigrad
details.short_description: Welcome to the Republic of Socialiskigrad, a budding nation to shape with bags of cement! Build working-class districts, develop national industry, and govern the metropolises of each region. Only you can become the shining President the country deserves!

details.title: Before the First Fire
details.short_description: Survive, teach, and evolve across 5.6 million years of human prehistory. Gather resources, build a tribe of companions, and guide your species through 7 eras, from the forest floor to the eve of civilization.

details.title: Haunted Paws
details.short_description: A cozy and spooky co-op adventure where two puppies rescue their owner from a haunted mansion. Customize your puppy, solve puzzles together, and defeat evil creatures. Play locally or invite a friend for free with Friend’s Pass.

details.title: Ratmageddon Underground
details.short_description: Splat your way through infested underground stations, sewers and tunnels overrun by zombified rats. Armed with improvised weapons, deadly traps and a well-aimed foot, help Alan fight his way home on a night he'll wish he could forget.

details.title: Paid in Blood
details.short_description: Bet your blood in a twisted baccarat game to pay off your mob debt.

details.title: Way to Oasis
details.short_description: Way to Oasis : a post-apocalyptic visual novel. You lead a six-member caravan after the captain’s death. Manage scarce resources, navigate moral dilemmas, and face hidden threats. Your choices decide if the group survives or perishes.

details.title: Case Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Open cases, collect rare skins, try your weapons, and run a shop where you sell, trade, and grow your arsenal.

details.title: Switch Ball Deluxe
details.short_description: Switch colors on the fly to destroy all energy bricks in sight! Bounce, boost, and race the clock through more than 160 handcrafted levels across 10 power plant themed worlds in this arcade puzzle-platformer. Chase S-ranks in Adventure Mode, or put your skills to the test in the Gauntlet!

details.title: Arcane Shores
details.short_description: Arcane Shores is a city-building strategy game infused with magic. Build, defend, and expand your settlement while casting powerful spells that bend nature, restore what’s broken, and turn the tide against your enemies.

details.title: Battle Worms
details.short_description: Get your parts, build your creature, go! Compete with your friends in a series of minigames, adding new parts along the way, to see whose custom creature is the best… or maybe just the funniest. Featuring online PVP, procedural physics and open-ended creature building, how you play is up to you!

details.title: Banana Guy Running Hard
details.short_description: A compact fast-paced platformer! Run everywhere, jump everywhere and get everything!

details.title: Depth Perception
details.short_description: It’s the 1980s. A rural cop investigates a fellow officer’s disappearance. With limited ammo and failing gear, you'll explore eerie landscapes, piece together clues, and face your own fears; no jumpscares, just tense psychological unraveling. Will you find the truth… or lose yourself?

details.title: Tiny Kitchen: Pizza Edition
details.short_description: Sauce it, top it, drop it! Build pizzas with flying ingredients and bouncy physics in this charming, low-pressure cooking sim. Tiny Kitchen: Pizza Edition is part chaos, part calm — all cozy.

details.title: Shadow Breakers
details.short_description: Play as Ultra, Apola, and Mozez as they battle shadow demons unleashed by the Cursed, a group seeking to restore balance through chaos. With their robot companions, they must split up to stop the demons and thwart the Cursed’s sinister plans.

details.title: Space Evolver
details.short_description: Space Evolver is a roguelite management and genetics game that incorporates real-time strategy game elements. Upgrade your spaceship and technologies, complete missions, and guide the evolution of species.

details.title: Baan Khok
details.short_description: If the city feels too big for you, come home to Baan Khok — a peaceful little village in the Thai countryside. Start anew: work the fields, grow vegetables, raise animals, and wander the lively temple fairs. Let life drift with the breeze, find love, and build a warm family of your own.

details.title: Click the Download
details.short_description: Click the Download upgrade your skills to multiply your speed, and conquer every game out there. Become the fastest downloader alive.

details.title: Foturians: Myth and Reality
details.short_description: Foturians: Myth and Reality is a non-linear visual novel where you change the probability of events. Your power depends on mood, character, and experience, while the universe's fate is decided by a dice roll. Every choice shapes who you become in the cosmic game's finale.

name: please have fun in the dream

details.title: please have fun in the dream
details.short_description: A card game where battles unfold in dreams — use your wits and luck to win fun, exciting duels.

details.title: The Undergrowth
details.short_description: The Undergrowth is an online multiplayer survival experience where you begin life as a tiny, vulnerable creature in a massive ecosystem filled with danger, opportunity, and other players. Hunt, scavenge, grow, evolve, and carve your place in a brutal world where survival is earned, not given.

details.title: Drone Farmer
details.short_description: First-person farming sim in the middle of a drone war. Shoot down AI drones and explore the village to find seeds and ammo. Use your farm drone to fulfill vegetable quotas faster. Will you let AI replace you, or will humanity prevail?

details.title: Shochimiki: The Eater's House
details.short_description: You are just another victim of the House — a living organism that remembers everyone who entered. Corridors change, rooms deceive, and escape is almost impossible. Listen, observe, and uncover the dark rules of a place that watches and hunts you.

details.title: Deadrise
details.short_description: Pilot a boat through fog and swell while something hunts you. Sonar is the only way to see, and every ping draws it closer. Find seven drifting bottles, reach Cape Wrath Light, then try Coast Guard rescues, hurricanes and a sandbox sea.

name: 送り火のうた ～邂逅の夜～

details.title: 送り火のうた ～邂逅の夜～
details.short_description: Escort a sacred festival float through the streets of night Kyoto during Obon. Play as Uta, fight off waves of spirits in fast action combat, and build your power with roguelite cards and weapons in this tower-defense action roguelite with a Japanese dark-fantasy mood.

details.title: No Way Back: Dark Horizon
details.short_description: Your son is counting on you, alone on an island crawling with creatures that stir in the dark. Feed him, build shelter, set snares, grow a garden and hunt to survive. The days are barely safe, but when night falls the real horror begins. Free demo available now.

details.title: Roadshift
details.short_description: Roadshift is a fast-paced arcade racing game featuring 42 handcrafted circuits, a full Career mode, challenging AI, local split-screen multiplayer, Time Attack, custom races and cups across seven distinctive environments.

details.title: Death's Legacy
details.short_description: Embark on an open-world adventure as a necromancer wielding dark magic. Explore vast landscapes, summon the monsters that were once your enemies, and uncover ancient secrets in an immersive experience.

details.title: Head Full Of Zombi
details.short_description: 1948, post‑war England. On Holy Island, a buried alien artifact known as The Eye corrupts prisoners, monks, and guards into flesh‑hungry ghouls. Technology fails, chaos reigns. You crash‑land among the wreckage—supplies scattered, hordes closing in. Survive or be consumed.

details.title: Moonsteader
details.short_description: Start a new life on a distant moon in this cosy sci-fi Western. Grow crops, mine resources, craft equipment, repair machinery and transform a rundown homestead into a thriving settlement. Meet the locals, lend a hand and become part of a frontier community.

details.title: Arcane Ligature
details.short_description: Arcane Ligature is a dark fantasy roguelite deckbuilder where you create your own spells by combining runes. Experiment with powerful fusions, master strategic turn-based combat, collect magical relics and battle through an ever-changing world where every run brings new possibilities.

details.title: Oddsmaxxing
details.short_description: The odds manipulating roguelike. Oddsmaxxing lets you flip loaded coins and try to achieve specific outcomes and combos while chasing increasingly egregious targets. Unlock and use special coins to increase your chances in this satisfying gambling roguelike. May the odds be ever in your favor.

details.title: Soul Dust
details.short_description: A third-person bullet-heaven roguelite where six factions wage war around you. Parry and brawl the horde, let your build do the killing, or mix both. Play hands-on, hands-off and break the game.

details.title: Spirit Vendor
details.short_description: I built Spirit Vendor as a solo indie dev, and I'm excited to share it with you! In this charming world, you decide how your day unfolds—run your shop, tend your fields, and care for your animals. Explore a lively village, meet unique characters, build friendships, and perhaps even find true love.

details.title: Greyskin
details.short_description: Crawl through countless dungeons, fighting hordes of monsters in this unique, fast-paced Action RPG. Class-up, mutate, and survive as you loot, shoot, upgrade, and repeat. Descend into the depths of a strange and dark world filled with mysteries and uncover its secrets.

details.title: The Main Menu
details.short_description: The Main Menu is a psychological horror thriller where you wake up trapped in a room with only a corrupted main menu to interact with. Changing the menu physically changes the room around you. Manipulate its buttons and hidden systems to solve puzzles and uncover what controls the screen.

details.title: Burning Skies
details.short_description: Burning Skies is a frantic roguelite bullet hell. Build the ultimate warjet, mix weapons and enhancements every run, take down giant bosses and overthrow the tyrants who rule the world.

details.title: Speed Golf Royale
details.short_description: Ready, set, swing! Whack the ball and dash through chaotic courses. Scored on shots taken and how fast you reach the flag. Outplay your rivals in a fast-paced, fun scramble to victory!

details.title: GearGrit
details.short_description: Tansy Geargrit, charged with some crimes she did commit, and some she didn't... Explore, platform, and blast your way through GearGrit, an Action Platformer inspired by your favorite PS2 games!

details.title: The Forgemage
details.short_description: An auto-battler roguelite of rune-forged magic. As a Forgemage, carve runes and chain their power into your spells until they break every law of magic. Walk into the horde alone and unleash what you forged.

details.title: Ship of Theseus
details.short_description: Steal your ship back from other realities, even from yourself. The Theseus is stranded, and every part it needs is held by a crew who needs it too. Rebuild it piece by piece and ask if it is still the same ship. A sci-fi roguelite FPS, solo or online co-op.

details.title: CAT Interstellar: Episode II
details.short_description: A short story inspired by Robert Heinlein's: Starship Trooper

details.title: Cafe Simulator
details.short_description: Build and decorate your shop, diversify your products through alliances, and make the right investments to expand your business.

details.title: Star Shift Freelancers
details.short_description: In a galaxy where loyalty is tested and alliances shift like stars, Captain Max Triton and his crew find themselves embroiled in a sea of treachery. When their own government betrays them, Triton and his crew must forge their own path, or lose everything.

details.title: Super Bio-Man
details.short_description: Super Bio-Man is the ultimate gunslinger and the guardian of our galaxy. Using his arsenal and metal fist, he shows the invaders from outer space - who's the boss here.

details.title: Battle Titan:RAINBOW
details.short_description: Defeat the overwhelming forces of the ASURA Cult with the Cursed Battle Titan: RAINBOW !

details.title: Catch The Train
details.short_description: Catch The Train is a chaotic co-op cooking game where the kitchen is rolling down the tracks. Chop, cook, and serve hungry passengers while your crew scrambles to shovel coal and keep the engine moving. Work together, manage the madness, and outrun the storm before it consumes you.

details.title: Cosminers
details.short_description: Cosminers is a 1-4 player co-op FPP sci-fi building and mining game with survival elements based on day/night cycle. As a space miner kill various aliens on procedurally-generated planet's undergrounds. Craft and upgrade your tools, weapons & base to get countless hours of thrilling gameplay.

name: Journey to the West(暴躁西游)

details.title: Journey to the West(暴躁西游)
details.short_description: A classic nostalgic side scroll game！
developers: 冲锋牛独立游戏工作室
publishers: 冲锋牛独立游戏工作室

details.title: ジグソーローグ
details.short_description: A deck-building roguelite where jigsaw puzzle pieces are your weapons. Master the "placement" and "combination" of pieces with unique abilities to claim victory. The game system is simpler than it looks — easy to pick up and play.

details.title: Idle Isekai - An idle RPG
details.short_description: Idle Isekai is a strategic idle RPG with roguelite elements designed for players who love managing complex growth systems. Whether you are battling fearsome monsters or meticulously managing your character's progression, the path to power is yours to define.

details.title: Heroes Of Isekai
details.short_description: An auto-battler with roguelike elements, and no unit cap. Run your camp, buy creatures, buildings, spells, gear and runes, assemble your build — then crush your enemies!

details.title: Trope Tales
details.short_description: A somewhat comical take on classic JRPGs. Take on the role of Hero, a Silent Protagonist, as you venture across the world to defeat the Main Villains with the help of your friends: The Chick, The Smart Guy, and The Childhood Friend.

details.title: Bloody Shrine
details.short_description: Bloody Shrine is a twin-stick horde survivor roguelike where you build a growing Shrine on the battlefield, forge dark pacts and shape every run through cards, tokens, and blood.

details.title: Infinite Void
details.short_description: Embark on an endless cosmic odyssey in Infinite Void! Master retro-inspired space shoot 'em up gameplay with procedurally generated universes, dynamic upgrades, & simple controls. Every run offers a unique challenge. Will you conquer the "Infinite Void" or succumb to its celestial challenges?

details.title: Chrome Carnage
details.short_description: Machines took all jobs but one - urban blood sport. Chrome Carnage is a multiplayer top down shooter set in vibrant chaotic cyberpunk cities.

details.title: Rules: Motel Horizon
details.short_description: Work the night shift at a remote motel where monsters wear human faces. Check in suspicious guests, uncover hidden rules, and survive 14 nights where every decision could be your last.

name: Scavengers of Mars - Rover Survival Simulator

details.title: Scavengers of Mars - Rover Survival Simulator
details.short_description: Drive a damaged rover across Mars, scavenging wrecks and mining ore to upgrade it. Every find has to fit a tight cargo grid, and every trip runs on sunlight, so a dust storm or a cold night can decide whether you push on or head back to an outpost.

details.title: SubDuctis
details.short_description: Traverse a puzzling metallic landscape by folding away space itself. Bypass obstacles, form conductive paths, and discover new areas by folding, unfolding, and folding again.

details.title: Jigrift
details.short_description: You crash onto the shores of a long lost island! This strange land is a gigantic jigsaw puzzle that you must assemble to explore. Earn your place among a tribe of three-eye’d voodoo frogs and put the island back together. They’ll allow you to stay if you succeed!

details.title: Hats and Guns
details.short_description: Become a cardslinger in this roguelike deckbuilder with tactical elements. Fight, gather weapons and items, face unexpected events and upgrade your cards for hundreds of possibilities. Every run is unique and so are you, the best shot of the Far West looking for your upcoming revenge.

details.title: Legacy of Ashes
details.short_description: Dive into a horror adventure where you solve puzzles, explore a mysterious island, battle vicious dinosaurs, and escape terrifying chases—all while uncovering the hidden goals of Nova Corp. Secrets await at every turn.

details.title: Arrow & Fang
details.short_description: Take on the role of Lena Morwyn. Explore, slash and shoot arrows in this action-adventure title.

details.title: Train Goes Right
details.short_description: A cozy physics based railroad simulator where you chop trees, drive trains, transport materials, and build track one rail at a time in the early steam age. The goal is simple: go right.

details.title: Shift Happens
details.short_description: Ever wanted to live out the American dream of working an abysmal 9–5 with rude management? No? Well too bad, I made a game about it anyway. Shift Happens is a first-person experience where you order stock, fill shelves, and keep the store running. The job is simple. Enjoy your shift.

details.title: The Depths of Duskraven Manor
details.short_description: First-person dungeon crawling meets turn-based horror. Lead five fugitives into the depths of a cursed manor—and survive what’s waiting below.

details.title: Dark Omen
details.short_description: Push back the encroaching darkness and the Architect's foul designs, then return to rebuild your village and reunite its people. Forge powerful artifacts and arrange mystical Omens to shape your next build as you battle relentless hordes and bosses in this low-poly Action RPG Roguelite.

details.title: Foodgitives
details.short_description: Foodgitives is a 1-4 player couch co-op physics arcade game where you're food on the run! Tilt and roll through restaurants as murderous utensils attack to the beat of 1930s big band jazz. Coordinate with friends to survive the chopping block or master the mayhem solo.

name: Alchemia Rogue: Mia and the Mystery Labyrinth

details.title: Alchemia Rogue: Mia and the Mystery Labyrinth
details.short_description: Join Mia, an apprentice alchemist, in the Alchemy Roguelike RPG. Alchemy brings new layers of strategy to traditional grid-based, turn-based roguelike gameplay. Gather materials, transmute them into powerful items, and conquer the dungeon!

details.title: Car Wash Together
details.short_description: In Car Wash Together, build your dream cleaning business - solo or in co-op! Tackle the challenge of detailing vehicles inside and out, gaining new skills and tools to satisfy even the most demanding customers.

name: Star Squadrons: Galactic Trading Card Game

details.title: Star Squadrons: Galactic Trading Card Game
details.short_description: No mana. Hidden threats. Your move—even on your opponent’s turn! Command your squadron and fight for control of five locations in a tactical sci-fi trading card game. Our planned 2027 Kickstarter will let you bring your own physical tournament decks to local events.

details.title: Harrowlands
details.short_description: Harrowlands is a medieval fantasy colony sim where you build your settlement, manage Fateborn with unique traits, shape relationships, survive raids, magical threats, and the demands of a powerful kingdom.

details.title: PIGGY ONE SUPER SPARK
details.short_description: PIGGY ONE SUPER SPARK is a single-player action game starring Xiamy, Yuez, and a lost newborn baby they happen to find. Follow the trio in their chaotic but heart-warming adventure!

details.title: Football, Tactics & Glory 2
details.short_description: XCOM meets Football Manager. Embark on the career of an unknown coach: tactically outsmart opponents in turn-based matches, earn money and experience, search for talented players, manage a club, build your reputation to get invited to lead the national team, and win the World Championship!

details.title: Nonu
details.short_description: Nonu is a hand-drawn 2D souls-like where every action draws from two interlinked resources-one born from inner strength, the other granted by a higher power. Explore a dying world, uncover artifacts that enable distinct builds, and piece together the truth behind its vanished god.

details.title: Oath of the Necromancer
details.short_description: Raise the bones of the fallen and create an army of the undead - warriors, archers, mages, monsters & beasts. Take revenge on the old tyrant, build a sanctuary, and resurrect ancient heroes to aid in your battle. All in the name of the Greek-Egyptian God of life & death: Serapis.

details.title: Arenion
details.short_description: An anime-style 3D Metroidvania adventure with fast-paced combat, varied weapon abilities, puzzle-solving, free exploration, and a mysterious journey filled with unexpected turns.

details.title: Frogspin
details.short_description: A wind-up frogventure bursting with colorful platforming and roguelike surprises. Spin the slots, master precision jumps, and rack up points. Ready to leap into action? 🐸

details.title: Marked
details.short_description: Dust, blood, and lies. Salvation’s Edge, 1899 — a dying town where you’re a killer, a thief, and a fraud — handed a dead man’s badge and told to solve a murder. Do they deserve redemption? Do you? Or will everyone forever be MARKED?

details.title: Earth Parasite: Silo
details.short_description: Post-apocalyptic, underground mining adventure, exhilarating bullet-hell shooting, mild SAN loss, mild Cthulhu, hand-painted art style, casual action sci-fi game.Escape from the underground shelter and uncover the truth behind the fall of human civilization.

details.title: Hermit Computer
details.short_description: Hermit Computer is a horror-puzzle game set in 2001. Deep within the Hermit Kingdom, you play as an outsider tasked with extracting critical intelligence using a secretive state-controlled computer operating system.

details.title: Picnic In The Zone
details.short_description: Search a ruined post-apocalyptic North America for your lost family. A story-driven survival shooter: scavenge every bullet, customize your weapons, face anomalies, mutants and armed patrols, and fight in first or third person across 10+ handcrafted levels.

details.title: We Need An Army
details.short_description: A tactical roguelike where your entire army moves as one! Shift your formation, line up powerful bonuses, and discover ridiculous combinations of units, relics, and battlefield upgrades.

details.title: Ashes & Blood
details.short_description: Ashes & Blood is a fantasy strategy RPG blending fast-paced tactical battles, 4X-inspired strategy, and roguelite progression. Break the rules, build absurd combos, uncover Varyndel's secrets, and unlock even more chaos with each expedition. Turn-based strategy has never been this unhinged.

details.title: Blotbarrow
details.short_description: Odin sacrificed the gods to thwart Ragnarök. Now you're what's left. Tear through the Nine Realms in this fast-paced, hack and slash roguelite. Wield legendary weapons. Gain the powers of the fallen gods. Die. Come back stronger. Die again. Storm the Blotbarrow and end the All-Father.

details.title: Macaron Sickness
details.short_description: Welcome to a dreamlike world where gothic elegance meets sweet delights. This macaron tower balance game is made for lovers of all things gothic. When you're feeling down or need a little sweetness, build your own fragile and beautiful macaron tower—just for you.

details.title: Desting Clash
details.short_description: "Desting Clash" is a roguelike card game similar to Monster Train, where you will control heroes from different countries and eras, build your deck and hero team, challenge numerous monster levels, and become the strongest Fatebearer!

details.title: Adventure in Hender´s Castle
details.short_description: Explore Hender’s Castle in a quest for a forbidden spell in this 3D action-adventure. Draw magic circles, brew potions, invoke spirits, bargain with ghosts and above all else: don't lose your cauldron!

details.title: SPACEROCKS
details.short_description: Mine asteroids, find rare loot, upgrade & modify your ship, build space factories, and destroy your enemies!

details.title: Elegy of St. Godhrkar
details.short_description: Elegy of St. Godhrkar is an narrative-driven game with a multi-perspective POV system. By uncovering lies hidden within the tale, you gain the power to rewrite characters’ fates and shape the story’s outcome. Where stories LIE, the answer waits for your EYE.

details.title: Kanka
details.short_description: Kanka is a 1–4 player co-op sci-fi action RPG / third-person shooter. Complete missions on SP-01, fight hostile factions and alien creatures, explore its strange regions, loot and craft, shape your character build, and work together to find a way home.

details.title: Mandated Fate
details.short_description: You are a police inspector in a totalitarian state. Follow or subvert the rules without letting the state discover what you really believe. In this dystopian alternate history thriller, navigate a technocratic empire where loyalty is survival. Make brutal moral choices, save or sacrifice lives.

details.title: Vega Chronicle
details.short_description: Lead your civilization to galactic glory in this bite-sized 4X strategy game. Build, colonize, trade, and, by tact or might, overcome all who oppose you.

details.title: FMV - Full Motion Voyeur
details.short_description: Full Motion Voyeur is a dark FMV thriller where you're trapped in a nightmare of surveillance, obedience, and sacrifice. Guided by the mysterious ADMIN, Claire is ordered to investigate targets, uncover their secrets, and feed them to a Demon or her lover Mona pays the price.

details.title: No Prospects
details.short_description: Build railways deep into monster-infested caves in this online co-op horror game. Work together to mine valuable ore, fill your minecart, and upgrade your equipment as you venture into increasingly dangerous depths.

details.title: Silent Hunt
details.short_description: Play as detective Jacques Renaud sent to a remote island in British Columbia. Investigate disappearances on Mist Island. Explore the island on foot or by car. Hide, fight and survive the threat that lurks in the forest. Protect the local population and put an end to predators that should not exist !

details.title: Dead Miles
details.short_description: Dead Miles is a 3D co-op horde shooter where your vehicle serves as a mobile base that you can equip with weapons and upgrades. Explore dangerous locations, fight massive hordes on foot and behind the wheel, and grow stronger through survivor-like character progression.

details.title: TAKE THEM DOWN
details.short_description: Combine weapons and abilities in this fast-paced, violent action game to take down necromancers, demons, and betrayers while avoiding being cleaved and crushed by blades, traps, and mines sprawled across nightmarish, macabre levels. NOT A ROGUELIKE, game features handcrafted levels.

details.title: Annalynn MD
details.short_description: Annalynn MD is a falling block puzzle game that hearkens back to similar titles of the 16-bit era. Twist, turn, and take out germs in three different game modes as you help Annalynn make the world just a little bit healthier.

details.title: IT BEGAN
details.short_description: IT BEGAN is a single-player tactical horror shooter set in a sunken world of cults, monsters, and your own fears — where escape is no longer an option.

details.title: Super Kart Blast
details.short_description: Super Kart Blast allows you to experience a unique way of kart racer with customizable karts, special combat maneuvers and powerups. Play with AI bots, friends or competitors!

details.title: Mobile Phone Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Build and manage your own mobile phone shop! Buy, sell and expand your business in this detailed simulation game. Balance profits, manage your team, and become the best shop in town.

details.title: 天工骇客 Shadow Hacker
details.short_description: Tear through cyberpunk defenses with kung fu and tech in this 3D roguelike fighter with comic-book style! Play as a skilled "cyber-ghost" employee, tearing through the Penglai Corporation's defenses with traditional kung fu, high-tech weaponry, and ancient magic.

details.title: My Name Is Vincent Pogo
details.short_description: Play as Vincent Pogo, a famous performer who is sent on an adventure upwards to the Royal Kingdom. A physics-driven platformer where every jump counts as you bounce and balance your way through a hand-crafted world full of challenges and goofy characters.

details.title: Mariole
details.short_description: MARIOLE is a narrative management game inspired by the traditional culture of the south of France. Take on the role of a young travelling merchant named Mariole, as she journeys through medieval/post-collapse landscapes in search of her friend, a missing ‘Trobairitz’ (a troubadour woman).

details.title: Sliding Dungeons
details.short_description: Slide, survive, and escape a deadly dungeon full of traps, monsters, bosses, and weird villagers.

details.title: Timber trail
details.short_description: You take over as the new ranger overseeing the infamous Timber Trail, a trail known for mysterious disappearances and the Timber Trail Murders.

details.title: Lost Hearts
details.short_description: A horror game inspired by the works of M.R. James. Explore Aswarby Hall to uncover your family’s secret history. Decide the fate of your ancestors by re-living each ghost’s last day on earth, with several endings for every story. Lift the family curse and save yourself… if you can.

details.title: World Tree Defender - Tower Defense
details.short_description: A mazing tower defense. Every tower is a tetromino-style hex piece that bends the path: rotate it, drop it on the grid, wind the swarm into a labyrinth and keep the World Tree alive. A campaign across biomes with ancient guardians, solo or with friends.

details.title: Chumaky
details.short_description: Chumaky is a game about traveling, trading, farming, and building your own homestead. Discover mysterious locations and enjoy atmospheric landscapes.

details.title: SMU News: Strange events recorded
details.short_description: In this game, play as Shenming University News Department members. Explore strange incidents—no need for truth. Write compelling reports from clues; eye-catching content excites readers. As for what really happened…do readers actually care? If you care, go find out yourself.

details.title: Blast Bebop
details.short_description: Blast Bebop is an easy-to-pick-up action-incremental game, combining dodging, shooting, collecting, and upgrades, set to retro pixel visuals and psychedelic music for a short, relaxing combat experience.

details.title: Car Crime Simulator
details.short_description: Steal cars, set up secret stashes, sell vehicles for big profits on demand, or strip them for parts. Build your criminal empire solo or team up with others in co-op mode.

details.title: Nocturnals: Cacti Coast
details.short_description: A narrative-driven, choose-your-own-adventure game where a young survivor must make difficult decisions in order to survive the foggy wasteland of Cacti Coast and find a community to call home.

details.title: Plush Time
details.short_description: Plush Time is a 1-6 player online and local multiplayer party game where cuddly meets chaos! Customize your adorable plush, then throw down with friends or AI in a wild board game packed with ridiculous minigames guaranteed to wreck friendships and spark hilarious mayhem.

details.title: Lightyears of Fervent Warfare
details.short_description: Modern old school action with explosive firepower. Rack up kills to upgrade your ship. Use your tech skills wisely. Collect the best loot. And dominate the skies with space shotguns, homing swarm missiles and chain lightning! This is a work-in-progress passion project! ETA November '26!

details.title: NTD: New Tower Defense?!
details.short_description: Active tower defense fused with a twin-stick shooter. Build your defense grid & become the death machine that exterminates the B.O.R.C infestation, one roguelike run at a time.

details.title: Stambria
details.short_description: Enter Castle Norstam as a young man searching for a cure for his sick father. Work in the stables, talk to the locals, complete favors, gather ingredients, and use alchemy to navigate a web of castle obligations and dependencies.

name: Ikigai: An Alternate Cold War Simulator

details.title: Ikigai: An Alternate Cold War Simulator
details.short_description: The history of East and West has been reversed. Take command of the United Provinces of Kinshu, the foremost superpower during a volatile Cold War. Surrounded by global conflict, corruption, and conspiracy, your decisions alone will determine the fate of the world.

details.title: The Killing Rooms
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror where hidden odds shape every procedural run. Choose between unknown doors, evade relentless horrors, and survive an endlessly re-playable challenge.

details.title: Cluck Up!
details.short_description: Climb from a farm all the way to the moon, where one missed jump can undo it all. Dodge lava floors, leap between skyscrapers, ride rockets through space, then storm Clawrence's castle. Grab the stolen eggs and try not to fall. Play solo or with 4 friends.

details.title: Tiny Queendom: An Ant Terrarium
details.short_description: A living ant colony on your desktop. Build a glass terrarium of sand, water and plants, add one queen, and watch her family dig tunnels, forage, learn from danger and raise new queens on its own. Keep it in a small window in the corner of your screen while you work.

details.title: Battlecore Robots
details.short_description: Customize your own mech: Use swords, bombs and all kind of weapons to defeat your oponents in frenetic battles with unique abilities! Play up to 4 players locally or online. Enter the Battlecore arena!

details.title: Cards n' Varmints
details.short_description: Cowboy lizard roguelike with jobs, cards, and creature management. Build a ragtag team of varmints from over 50 weird jobs such as Gunslinger, Cactus, and Hotel Manager. Your team is your deck: think hard and play cards before each round to turn the tide of battle!

name: Black Otaku 2: Taekwondo is in my Blood

details.title: Black Otaku 2: Taekwondo is in my Blood
details.short_description: Join Sahara B. Shabazz as she honours that Korean man's sacrifice by winning this martial arts tournament with the Taekwondo that flows in her veins.

details.title: Ether@Net
details.short_description: Become a Netwalker — a paranormal investigator navigating between the haunted streets of Hong Kong and a digital ghost realm. Uncover urban tragedies, forge a bond with your ghost companion, and unravel the truth that lingers beyond the Net.

details.title: Starfire Skies
details.short_description: Your fireworks are your cards in this turn-based roguelike deckbuilder. Launch fireworks now or save them for the finale to keep your audience of animals entertained. Open card and talisman packs, discover unique shops and events, and earn your stars so you can put on an unforgettable show!

details.title: Astropark
details.short_description: Astropark is a single-player VR game where you explore the Solar System through interactive, science-based missions. Adjust gravity, launch rockets, and discover real planets in a fun, educational, and non-violent space adventure.

details.title: Warfactory: Automation RTS
details.short_description: Warfactory is an automation RTS where production defines the war effort. Build assembly lines to forge an army of machines, then feed thousands of units into massive real-time battles where every loss must be replaced by your factory.

details.title: The Remains
details.short_description: The Remains is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror where an intelligent AI enemy hunts your team whilst adapting to your tactics. Stay quiet and out of sight, or get picked off one by one.

details.title: Rhythm Rat Rampage
details.short_description: Rhythm Rat Rampage is rhythm-meets-bullet-heaven. Dodge to the beat and shred your enemies in a music-driven gauntlet of chaos, speed, and style. Fight your way to the leaderboards!

details.title: PuppetOFF
details.short_description: PuppetOFF — a co-op (1–4 players) survivors-roguelite where the puppet theater stage turns into a battlefield. Play as heroes inspired by classic tales, upgrade your abilities, and mow down thousands of crazed puppets. Collect buttons and spare parts to make it through the show alive.

details.title: Cluepuff Adventures
details.short_description: A cozy puzzle adventure across floating puzzle dimensions, with Cluepuff, a curious little companion you can talk to. Flip gravity, ride arks, open gates and find every puzzle piece, then build your own levels and share them with the Community.

details.title: Misnomers by Nick Oueijan
details.short_description: A preposterous word game where you create a recursive language, one word at a time! Laugh (or cry) as you define each word from other words and your decisions snowball beyond expectations. Decipher definitions, discover drawings, then use your save file to translate the internet!

details.title: Space Arcade
details.short_description: A 3D arcade space shooter where you defend your base against endless waves of enemy ships. Earn credits, buy upgrades and perks between waves and fight Boss Waves a every few waves. Play alone, in split screen with up to 4 players on one PC, or online with friends.

details.title: Tokyo Ramen Drifter
details.short_description: A driving roguelite inspired by Japan's 90s street racing scene. Deliver ramen, upgrade your car, and challenge rivals on mountain roads across Japan.

details.title: Deep Siren
details.short_description: Deep Siren is a Lovecraftian WWII horror fairytale. When the lone survivor of the USS Siren discovers a mermaid while adrift at sea, he finds himself plunged into a world of supernatural horror fathoms beneath the surface. Utilize unique gameplay mechanics as Alex battles to hold on to his sanity.

details.title: Retromine
details.short_description: Retromine is an ultra-satisfying tough-as-nails deckbuilding roguelike. Delve into the caves, mine resources, and escape before the caverns collapse! Spend your ore to buy new cards, upgrade your deck, and discover powerful combos on your way to the bottom of the world. Dig, die, learn, repeat!

details.title: Hack Fate
details.short_description: Hack Fate is a fast-paced hack-and-slash game with Chinese cyberpunk pixel art. Manipulate the timeline, switch identities, and kill enemies in one hit. Turn traps and foes into weapons and find multiple routes through every level. Ancient myth meets cyberpunk, each choice defying fate.

details.title: Wild World: Online
details.short_description: A multiplayer third-person werewolf action game. Be the tank who guards and soaks up the damage, pull rivals in with Gravity, or vanish and strike from the shadows. Alone or with your pack, forge your own playstyle. So, how will you hunt?

details.title: SideEye High
details.short_description: A grounded detective mystery set in the most dangerous place in America: a 1997 public high school.

details.title: Valehands
details.short_description: A cozy incremental management sim about guiding dwarven crews through their daily work and bringing their valley to life.

details.title: Democracy Manifest
details.short_description: Hijack the vote in this 3-7 player social deduction brawl! Juggle with ideologies to play your cards perfectly, rig elections through deals, bribery & manipulation and backstab your closest friends to get ahead.

details.title: Oxygen Survivors
details.short_description: Oxygen Survivors is a side-scrolling roguelite where you control a spaceship supported by up to 6 drones that follow your movement. Fuse your drones together, get upgrades, and survive the final boss before the oxygen runs out.

details.title: Golem Gourmet
details.short_description: A gastronomical adventure sizzling with culinary chaos! Build a bizarre bistro from an ever-shifting array of rooms, amass heaps of treasure, and earn enough critical acclaim to became the ultimate Golem Gourmet.

details.title: Kinmen Kill
details.short_description: Kinmen Kill (金門殺) is an FPV combat drone simulator. Scout, strike, and battle PLA forces as you defend Taiwan with realistic flight controls and advanced physics built for true-to-life handling.

details.title: Anachron
details.short_description: What if Joan of Arc fought alongside Blackbeard? In Anachron, you weave a dream team of 4 historical heroes to clash in a tactical, turn-based Arena. Build a custom deck for each champion from their unique abilities and unleash history-defying combos.

details.title: Rings of Heaven
details.short_description: A multiplayer roguelike action platformer with a focus on teamwork and cooperation. Play as angel vtuber Amai Lilia and friends and take on heaven's deadliest gauntlet, the Rings of Heaven.

details.title: The Pink Robot
details.short_description: The Pink Robot is a fast-paced isometric action roguelite with deep build variety and fluid combat. Create powerful synergies through skills and mementos, and face relentless challenges that grow stronger with every run.

details.title: Limes 235
details.short_description: A historically grounded single-player point-and-click adventure that blends narrative-driven exploration, role-based perspective shifts, and puzzle solving into an emotional rollercoaster of contrasting storylines and moral choice.

details.title: Harpooner
details.short_description: Harpooner is an action-driven incremental fishing game. Dive into the ocean depths, hunt alien fish, collect stars and unlock exponential upgrades. Scale your power, stack stats, and take down massive bosses to clean up the coast!

details.title: Rushline
details.short_description: Rushline is an arcade combat racer in early development. Race friends online, take on full grids of bots offline, or play 4-player split-screen on one PC. Drift, grab power-ups and knock each other off the road. I'm planning a free demo for the end of 2026!

details.title: Over The Blackboard
details.short_description: Over the Blackboard is a fun open-world adventure game filled with quests and missions kids love to play, where exploring, solving puzzles, and completing challenges naturally helps them practice math, logic, reading, and more without noticing.

details.title: Snowboard Rogues
details.short_description: The snowboarding roguelike. Master your riding skills to survive all threats in a procedurally generated ski resort. Inspired by 90s' FreeSki and modern Roguelikes.

details.title: Poopnauts
details.short_description: Four astronauts teamed up to fix spaceships using... poop? 1-4 players co-op. Every ship is different, so you never know what you will find inside. Finish the job, sell the scrap, and stay away from whatever else is on board. Get to work, poopnaut!

details.title: School Guard
details.short_description: 💼 You took this job to save your family. Now you have to survive it. 🔍 Scan students. 🚫 Confiscate contraband. 🏗️ Build your empire. 🌙 Patrol the night. But when the sun goes down, the school reveals what it's been hiding—🧟 zombies, 🔥 fire, and 👻 a ghost that never left.

details.title: The Black Breath
details.short_description: Lead a caravan of survivors fleeing from the Black Breath. Manage your resources, explore, and choose your path carefully, as the journey will be unforgiving. When hardships arise, you will rely on a diverse group of heroes willing to give their lives to defend the caravan.

details.title: Dolls made here
details.short_description: You find yourself alone in an abandoned doll factory, assembling and inspecting dolls because you needed the money. Each order ends with the sense that they should never have been shipped, but leaving is no longer an option.

details.title: 遗物路：Relic Road
details.short_description: Relic Road is a roguelike turn-based tower-climbing game centered around equipment and relic building. As players continue to explore, they can recruit various heroes to expand their team, obtain equipment from heroes, encounter different events, and strengthen their forces.

details.title: Kundara: art of cards
details.short_description: Kundara is a frenetic and artistic elemental card roguelite game featuring combat against enemies in a theatrical kabuki adventure. Activate the power of cards, collect artifacts, and form alliances with spirits in an adventure across the five nations of Kundara.

details.title: 雨声 Rainy Days
details.short_description: Rainy Days is a short campus visual novel with 2+ original soundtracks, 10+ illustrations and a 30,000-word storyline. Play as the protagonist to encounter Yu, a mysterious girl, and start a sweet youthful campus rom-com. Make choices to alter the plot, unlock hidden stories.

details.title: Scattered
details.short_description: Scattered is a short adventure where you explore a tropical island as a cat in search of a litter of hidden kittens. Discover paths to remote locations, dig up pirate treasure, and seek out perfect sleeping spots. Upgrade your skills and show them the way back home.

details.title: Tales Of Eight
details.short_description: Tales of Eight is an action roguelite, naval battle game. As one of the last pirates you are fighting against the dreaded Feline Empire. Fight on the high seas with customizable magical canons, upgrade your ship, explore the ever-changing ocean, and trade with factions all to save Piratedom.

details.title: PERFECT SNAP: Ultimate Jigsaw Puzzles
details.short_description: Turn any image into a 3D jigsaw puzzle! Solve solo or with friends (co-op & PvP), display your masterpieces in a customizable 3D museum, and visit everyone else's. Personalize your character and take on the 100-level campaign, from easy puzzles all the way to 1000 pieces.

details.title: Shelter Prepare
details.short_description: Shelter Prepare is a post-apocalyptic placement game where you arrange various resources to create your ideal safe house. It's a low-pressure, purely placement-based, and cozy game. No combat, no death; focus on resource placement, space management, and cleaning. Gradually expand your space.

details.title: Melt Down
details.short_description: Melt Down is a slime racing game where you are on a clock to reach the finish line. You are melting: small is fast, big is slow, and you have to finish the race before you turn into a puddle. Dodge hazards, fight off your rival slimes with powerups, and finish before you perish.

details.title: Maneuver Warfare 2: BTG
details.short_description: A simulation of the 2022 Russo-Ukrainian War where the player maneuvers battalion tactical groups on a map and controls assets such as aircraft, special forces teams, satellites, field hospitals, and repair facilities to support these. The player can play single battles or a campaign game.

details.title: Eighth Pole
details.short_description: Eighth Pole is a realistic horse racing simulator where you train, race, and breed horses as you build your stable and rise through the ranks of the racing world.

details.title: Bash Moto
details.short_description: Tear up the West Coast in a 90s-themed beat'em up motorcycle racing game. Kick, punch, and bash rival bikers to claim the cash prize while dodging traffic, obstacles and hot-pursuit cops. Wreck your ride or run out of cash for bail, and it is game over.

details.title: Tic Card Toe
details.short_description: A Turn Based Strategy Roguelike with Deckbuilding elements that transforms Tic-Tac-Toe into a High-Stakes Combat Tournament!

details.title: Chaos Orbit
details.short_description: Fight through a machine-controlled orbital station in this fast-paced action roguelite. Master precision mouse-aim combat, unlock powerful mutations, and battle deadly robotic enemies as you push deeper into the chaos.

details.title: Orium
details.short_description: Aboard your ship, exterminate your enemies, exploit planets and weave your enterprise across the stars of a dying procedural galaxy. Orium is a Lovecraftian space roguelite, infused with streamlined 4X elements.

details.title: The Rift Tower Defense
details.short_description: The Rift is a tower defense game with elements of RPG gameplay that will appeal to players of all skill levels. Enemies from an alternate universe are attacking and it's up to the player to stop them by strategically building defensive towers.

details.title: Adventurers Guild Inc.
details.short_description: Run the business behind the heroics by managing your own Adventurers Guild! Turn the world's problems into appealing quest and take your cut. Support your adventurers by selling them the services they don't even know they need. Then reinvest your earnings and grow the greatest guild of them all!

details.title: Ibboran
details.short_description: The Empire is aflame! Lead your fantastical troops through a 15-battle, turn-based strategy campaign. Build your army by achieving objectives to fill your Treasury. Recruit mercenaries to tilt the battle in your favor and use your General to improve your units or blast the enemy. To war!

details.title: Collapsed Horizon
details.short_description: Travel between galaxies, dig planets, collect ores, sell them, upgrade your equipment, and earn your ticket back to Earth.

details.title: Hexamonia
details.short_description: A cozy, strategic board game where every choice matters. Place hex tiles, make the most of the options you’re dealt, and build the most valuable kingdom in the land.

details.title: Pitfalls 64
details.short_description: Take on a brutal, platforming gauntlet in Pitfalls 64! Clamber upwardly as a homesick gnome in search of his way back home, butt proceed with caution; one careless slip could spell a hard bonk back to the bottom...

details.title: Returnless
details.short_description: Eyeball Gun is your weapon. Use it to fight shadow enemies, manipulate time, and escape a city consumed by black fog - no pause, no checkpoints. Progress is saved at the end of a run.

details.title: Kingsbane
details.short_description: Raid gothic fortresses in a 2D action-platformer RPG. Choose from heroes with distinct fighting styles, hunt for rare gear, and defeat the infernal kings. Replay stages to try new routes and builds. Play solo or team up with up to three friends in local or online co-op.

name: One Nation Under the Old Gods

details.title: One Nation Under the Old Gods
details.short_description: A Rogue-lite Deckbuilder set in early 1800s United States. Play as members of a secret organization that investigates occult activity in an effort to stop various cults from summoning Eldritch Gods. Acquire cards to create combos and synergies to defeat your enemies in turn-based combat!

details.title: Strawberry Cafe
details.short_description: Build your own strawberry cafe and farm in this cozy, casual management sim. Grow strawberries for customers to pick, or harvest your homegrown strawberries to cook delicious strawberry-themed food and drinks. Complete missions and keep customers happy to unlock new furniture and recipes.

details.title: On Fighting Shadows
details.short_description: A narrative JRPG about fighting shadows outside and within.

details.title: RAIN HEART
details.short_description: Psychological horror about Alex Bow, who struggles with himself and his traumas.

details.title: BLOCK13
details.short_description: Block13 is a first-person psychological horror exploration game. On a calm afternoon, you step into a weathered Hong Kong public housing estate. Wandering its hazy corridors, unsettling secrets emerge. The deeper you go, the more it entangles you. Unravel its mystery to break free.

details.title: Cave Clicker
details.short_description: Mine rocks to collect rare ores to become the richest Mole alive, and looking good while doing it too!

name: Haedong Bisa: Secret Records of the East

details.title: Haedong Bisa: Secret Records of the East
details.short_description: On a land in flames, whose fate will fall? Set in 1597, you are a warrior caught between invaders and court intrigue. Your choices decide your path—be a blade that saves lives, or walk a road of ruin. A Joseon martial arts narrative RPG.

details.title: Space Pizza Express
details.short_description: A funny arcade space-action game about delivering pizza across the galaxy, where the perks include zero-gravity working conditions and unlimited cheese snacks, and the risks include stolen pizzas, flying hazards, and unhappy intergalactic customers.

details.title: Space Cat Digger
details.short_description: In Space Cat Digger, you will mine resources, build machines, upgrade your equipment, and try to get the highest score possible within a limited time. Play your own way, manage your resources, optimize, automate… while something strange begins to awaken

details.title: Sun Catcher
details.short_description: Restore damaged stained glass art and immerse yourself in a charming story about lost memories and community in Sun Catcher, a cozy paint-by-numbers tale.

name: B面人生：存在的重量 Life:Reboot

details.title: B面人生：存在的重量 Life:Reboot
details.short_description: Step into a narrative-driven social media simulator in a world dominated by one powerful platform. Here, followers are your currency and your life. You had it all—until someone set you up and banned your account for good. Start over. Climb. Be seen. Ultimately, the world's fate is in your hands.

details.title: Autonomous Air Combat
details.short_description: Autonomous Air Combat is an arena action roguelite missile-heaven where you pilot a fighter jet in a digital combat simulation. Create synergistic builds featuring different projectiles, modifiers, and stackable passives as you fight off difficult waves of enemy forces.

details.title: Golgothian
details.short_description: Build a three-hero party in a dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Queue actions, read enemy intent, trigger class combos, equip survivors, and choose routes through doomed dungeon runs alone or in co-op.

details.title: Cascade
details.short_description: A real-time roguelike where every move starts a chain reaction. Push enemies, manipulate tiles, combine elements, and turn status effects into opportunities.

details.title: On The Ramp
details.short_description: Your rival is right there. A ramp. Dozens of meters of air. Suspension at its limit. Touching down at 140. You started with 120 horses and a cheap frame. Race to get noticed. Build the rest.

details.title: Tutorial Hell
details.short_description: Tutorial Hell is a first-person comedy game about a tutorial that wants you dead. I'm Nigel. I'm a chicken. I'm contractually required to teach you the controls. The first lesson is PRESS W TO MOVE FORWARD. Please press W. Nothing bad will happen. Trust me.

details.title: L.L.L.Liar
details.short_description: Shi, a photographer and unforgivable sinner. After her train breaks down, she steps onto the platform and meets someone she'll never forget. This narrative-driven RPG takes you down a thorny path to save your loved one and face the real world together.

details.title: Loopy Dungeon
details.short_description: Legend has it that all who enter this dungeon are doomed to loop forever. In Loopy Dungeon, build your deck fight after fight, combine your relics and break the cycle.

details.title: Skies of Valoria
details.short_description: "Skies of Valoria" is a fantasy action Roguelite with dynamic builds and fast combat. Soar the clouds on "Aethelwhale", team up with 4 Valkyries across Valoria, and strike the Demon King's Castle! Harness War Souls for endless combos and summon monsters to sweep away all foes.

details.title: Wheeler Dealer Together
details.short_description: Turn used cars into profit! Inspect vehicles, uncover hidden problems, negotiate the best deals, and visit repair shops to get them fixed. Buy low, sell high, and grow your own used car dealership with friends in Wheeler Dealer Together!

details.title: Infinite Supermarket
details.short_description: Infinite Supermarket is an online co-op survival roguelike with physics-driven chaos, proximity voice chat and character roles. You and up to 7 friends must find the exit - and keep yourselves fed on the way.

details.title: A Growing Problem
details.short_description: Start smaller than a speck of dust in a houseplant pot. Eat anything smaller than you, grow, and turn everything that hunted you into a snack: crumbs, cats, cars, cities and, eventually, the whole planet.

details.title: Dice Dice Battles
details.short_description: Buy dice, line them up, and watch them play. Move one die and the whole line changes. A roguelike dice battler about finding absurd combos, then testing them against a cursed dungeon or other players in async PvP.

details.title: Demiurges: Land of Strife
details.short_description: A survivor-like action game: You start as a mortal and randomly obtain fragments from different factions in combat. Collect a complete set to ascend into a brand-new form—new model, more skill slots, and a deeper skill library—leading to a completely different combat path.

details.title: Midnight Bell
details.short_description: A gothic asynchronous PvP autobattler. Build a board of werewolves, vampires or monster hunters, arm them with items, then watch them fight other players saved teams of gothic monstrosities. Halfway through every fight the midnight bell tolls and the monsters transform.

details.title: Catch Succubus
details.short_description: "Catch the Succubus" is a first-person comedy horror game. The mischievous succubus has designed a variety of gameplay for you, including memory puzzles, platforming, dark navigation, and more. You win as long as you catch her.

details.title: Afterfolk
details.short_description: Renovate a Forgotten Village. Restore crumbling homes, shape the landscape, and build something new. Farm, fish, craft, and welcome new neighbours as you uncover forgotten stories and help lingering spirits find peace. Bring the village back to life, your way. Play solo or with friends.

details.title: Color Parade
details.short_description: Color Parade is a cheerful two-player co-op painting adventure! Play as a young painter and an adorable pup: spray paint, leave colorful pawprints, and bring a colorless world back to life. Explore vibrant themed maps, tackle painting challenges together, or face off in playful contests!

details.title: Nutty Mice Party
details.short_description: Nutty Mice Party is an adorable multiplayer adventure! Play as cute mice with unique abilities, explore colorful candy-filled mazes, and gobble up every last treat while dodging hungry cats. Team up with friends or face off in chaotic cat-and-mouse battles. Let the sweet chaos begin!

details.title: Star Chasers
details.short_description: Star Chasers is a 2–4 player local multiplayer party game! Roll the dice, race across the board, collect stars, and challenge your friends in wild mini-games. Dodge lasers, survive lava, and outplay your rivals with skill, strategy, and a little luck. Who will claim the party crown?

details.title: Plushie Ops
details.short_description: Plushie Ops is a local two-player 3D action platformer! Grab a friend and guide two adorable plushies through a world of traps and surprises. Jump, fight, tackle tricky mechanisms, and collect stars as you explore a toy factory and a mysterious underwater world. Can you make it to the finish?

details.title: Railsiege
details.short_description: You drive an armed war train through a ravaged Wild West, all the way to Fort Alamo. Fit the wagons with turrets, then choose as you go: floor it to outrun the monsters and risk blowing the boiler, or slow down to cut them down and pick up their loot.

name: Fine Tuning: A Radio Repair Shop

details.title: Fine Tuning: A Radio Repair Shop
details.short_description: Run a little radio repair shop in 1952, where every wireless on your bench is a working circuit, so the meter reads what's really there and the hum or the crackle you hear is the fault itself. You take each set apart by hand and fit new parts from the cabinet till it plays again for its owner.

details.title: Lords of the World
details.short_description: Develop your city, expand your armies, and send your kingdom's elite agent across the world to complete dangerous missions.

details.title: GOLF TRIP
details.short_description: YOU ARE THE DRUG. Show off your accuracy while controlling an experimental substance designed to strip away human will. High skill, instant restarts, and zero room for error. DELIVER THE DOSE. DON'T FAIL. THIS IS GOLF TRIP.

details.title: Driftbane: The Long Awaited
details.short_description: A disgraced captain, a wanted murderer, a haunted nurse: three outcasts shipwrecked on shores that shouldn't exist, changed by powers they don't understand. Driftbane is a tactical RPG of grid combat, recruited beast-folk allies, and a creeping corruption killing two worlds.

details.title: AmaTisMo
details.short_description: A visual novel about mental health, depression, and self-love. Play as Amatista, a young woman trapped in isolation, as she begins a journey she never asked for. Every choice shapes the story. Fully accessible for blind and visually impaired players.

details.title: Mushrooms vs Engineers
details.short_description: Mushrooms vs Engineers is a top-down bullet heaven/hell where you are The Engineer, armed with your trusty nail-gun battle the hordes of Mushrooms over 20 waves until you face the final boss. The enemies you face are affected by your own choice of upgrades in the shop.

details.title: GONE
details.short_description: This is a story about self-discovery, wrapped in the guise of family. You step into the shoes of Gu Huixing. Watching my life unfold as an outsider, re-examining trivial days from an omniscient perspective — what will I become? Life is never a dead end. It is always a choice.

details.title: Space Burger
details.short_description: Run a burger joint in zero gravity with your friends. Jetpack around a tiny spaceship, stack floating burgers, feed chatty aliens and keep the place in one piece while meteors, fires and hull breaches tear it apart.

details.title: Game Breaker: Divine Error
details.short_description: Game Breaker is a humorous, story-driven dark fantasy RPG where every character knows they're in a video game. Exploit glitches and cheats to rewrite the fate of a dying world. Experience a deep narrative with a massive 119-track original soundtrack.

details.title: Outspin Champions
details.short_description: Outspin Champions is a local competitive PvP / Co-op brawler where the spinning never stops. It blends party-game chaos with Souls-like precision, mastering physics-driven weapon weight to deflect foes. Outspin. Outsmart. Outlast.

details.title: For The Witch
details.short_description: For The Witch is a cute fantasy top-down tower-defense roguelite. Protect a sleeping witch from mosquito swarms, develop both the soldier and the witch, combine mechanic-changing items, and awaken them into new effects to hold out through each night.

details.title: Dyeversion
details.short_description: Dyeversion is a color-routing tower defense. Drag liquid hoses from color sources to your towers, mix colors to forge powerful COMBO towers, and route your pipes around the enemy path. Battle dozens of levels, earn tokens, and unlock a deep skill tree.

details.title: The Witch Simulator
details.short_description: Experience the life of a witch in a medieval village, co-op or solo! Gather ingredients, hunt monsters, brew potions to solve villagers' problems while keeping your magic hidden from the Inquisition. Build your reputation, earn passage into the kingdom, and overthrow the Grand Inquisitor.

details.title: Luck in the Dark
details.short_description: Luck in the Dark is a turn-based roguelike with slot machines and backpack management. Pack your bag to improve your odds, spin the reels, and find your way out of the dark.

details.title: REDHAND
details.short_description: A psychotic-horror (psychological, surreal survival horror) with dark, oppressive atmosphere, brutal action and grotesque creatures.

details.title: BlightMist Idle
details.short_description: Every drop feeds something. Ore becomes ingots becomes gear becomes power. Monster parts become permanent power. Seven classes, six life skills (just in Act 1 alone), talent trees, card collection, and much more — all compounding, while you're on and offline.

details.title: Off Tape: Welcome
details.short_description: Stock the shelves. Watch the cameras. Tell the humans from the things wearing their faces. Decide who to serve, and eliminate the rest. Off Tape: Welcome is a retro horror shop sim where you run the store for the Tobacconists, owners who don't know you exist.

details.title: Dead Relay
details.short_description: Dead Relay is a PSX-style survival horror game. As a field engineer sent to a blacked-out relay station, you must restore power, explore classified sectors, and decode encrypted logs.
