But the facility isn't empty — and the system itself seems to be watching your every step.

name: Dream to Millennium | 梦回千禧

details.title: Dream to Millennium | 梦回千禧
details.short_description: Worn out by life’s stress? Dive into a dreamy millennial world with Chinese dreamcore vibes. Wander freely with no tasks or combat. Paired with the rap album Dream to Millennium: Teen Never Die. Stay true to your dreams, and never compromise.

name: Knock Off: The Battle For Imagination

details.title: Knock Off: The Battle For Imagination
details.short_description: Fight for the fate of imagination in this fast-paced 2D fighter inspired by classic arcade games and 80s/90s action figures. Master air combos, EX moves, assists, and super attacks with a roster of wild off-brand toy legends.

details.title: Project8088: Finding Aidia Le
details.short_description: A fast first-person arcade shooter where you transfer into a quantum state and fight inside the hardware. Stack buffs, gain augmentations, and push through 16 levels of routers, rigs, and servers to find Aidia Le.

details.title: The Minesweeper's Tale
details.short_description: From the clues, reveal an imaginary map zone by zone in this minesweeper-variant logic game, where each solved region transforms a grid into a work of cartographic art.

details.title: Luck and Raid
details.short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op, top-down action RPG/roguelike where luck is everything. You're fluffy, and you're adorable. Earn money and get stronger. Running low on cash? Try gambling! Lost it all? Just borrow some from a friend. Your friend is broke too? Congratulations! Now the real co-op begins.

details.title: Astral Dive
details.short_description: Join Atlas and his companions in Astral Dive, a charming hand-drawn pixel art fantasy RPG. Experience innovative turn-based combat powered by magic cards, explore wondrous worlds beyond the astral portals, and uncover the secrets of the magic academy.

details.title: Pixel Rush: RTS
details.short_description: A fantasy real-time strategy deck builder where you summon monsters, evolve them mid-battle, cast spells, fight for control of the battlefield and rush the enemies base for victory!

details.title: Goat Survivor 2
details.short_description: Soul-harvesting survival action: a goat wizard sets out to conquer the demon realm. Mow down endless hordes, capture foes with Mind Control, and grow stronger with every soul. Simple controls, fast growth, screen-filling battles. Conquer domain after domain and claim the Demon Lord's throne.

details.title: VOIDSWARM
details.short_description: They came from the void. You are all that stands between the swarm and our annihilation. Direct and fight alongside an immense fleet as both pilot and commander, hold the line against thousands of enemies using powerful upgrades, and take back our homeworlds in this roguelike RTS.

details.title: Vacuum Uprising
details.short_description: Rip the ground from under your feet and hurl it at your enemies! Vacuum Uprising is a pixel-perfect destruction platformer with physics-based combat, epic boss fights, and local multiplayer for up to 4 players.

details.title: Voidbit
details.short_description: In this challenging deckbuilder puzzle platformer, mixing turn based with real time gameplay, you don't control the main character. Instead, you'll play cards to manipulate the character, the world and the deck to lead them off planet before the chasing void consumes them.

details.title: Koto 琴
details.short_description: A fast-paced top-down arena fighter for 1-4 players. Slash, block, and parry with samurai swords, or pick up a koto instrument to unleash ranged sound-wave attacks. Play locally in split-screen or battle online.

details.title: Overdrive: New Earth
details.short_description: OVERDRIVE is a retro 3D combat racing ARPG. Build and weaponize your car, battle rivals who remember your every move, and conquer procedurally generated tracks across five deadly biomes. Every race is a fight for survival. Every victory makes you stronger.

details.title: LANCELOT: The Silver Knight
details.short_description: Experience the legends of “Lancelot: The Silver Knight”, as he sets out on a quest to reclaim his title as a knight. A quirky top-down action-adventure game set in an mystical Brittany filled with enigmatic dungeons, legendary monsters and… chickens?

details.title: Hazel Rush
details.short_description: You need to explore the world, outsmart your environment and uncover secrets to unlock new paths to reach your next destination, gather crucial knowledge, craft different structures, and survive hidden dangers.

details.title: Project Longshot
details.short_description: Build a space program that reaches the stars in this 1:1 scale spaceflight and colony sim. Design rockets and fly them with real orbital mechanics. Land anywhere in a procedural universe of over two million real star systems, then set up space stations, colonies and factories. How far can you go?

details.title: Flipping Football Clubs
details.short_description: Buy, build, and flip football clubs in a fast-paced roguelite management sim. Sign players, hire staff, survive FFP, unlock Club DNA modifiers, and grow club value across 1-2 hour seasonal runs.

details.title: Lawn Mower Mayhem
details.short_description: Mow lawns, haggle prices and build a lawn-care empire in a cartoon mountain village — while three rivals sabotage every job with garden gnomes, rubber chickens and the occasional airborne sheep. Career mode for the turf war, Chill mode for just the mowing.

details.title: Incredig
details.short_description: Incredig is a short sci-fi incremental mining game about digging far too deep. Break rock pixel by pixel, haul ore back to your Rig, automate the mine with swarms of drones, and keep pushing downward. Something beneath the surface is beating.

details.title: Shadows of Beginnings
details.short_description: Explore fractured realms, battle fearsome enemies, and rebuild Novum in this dark fantasy action RPG. Gather resources, upgrade your gear, develop your class, and seamlessly switch between isometric and over-the-shoulder combat as you fight for a world on the brink of being swallowed by the void.

details.title: Kuaiban!! Magical Girl
details.short_description: Your phone is the clapper — wave it, and the party starts. A motion party rhythm game: beat duels, photo-booth co-op, and a single-player story across China. Scan a QR code to play with friends — no app to download. Turn any screen into a party, magical-girl story and all.

details.title: Butterfly: Twisted Thread
details.short_description: Butterfly: Twisted Thread is a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania where you use a mystical butterfly to draw platforms, objects, and attack tools into the world. Explore interconnected areas, solve physics-based puzzles, fight enemies, and unlock new paths through creative drawing.

details.title: Taverntasia
details.short_description: Manage your very own tavern as a wizard! Host guests from diverse races. Brew special magical drinks with potions and herbs, and serve delicious meals. Keep your customers happy with quick and quality service. Build your reputation, earn money, and take your tavern to the top!

details.title: Those UnderHex
details.short_description: A strategy roguelite about rebuilding the portal lands. Reveal dark hexes with beams of light and bring supplies home. Protect your workers, combine tower weapons and face successive monster waves. Each night, your people need food and shelter.

details.title: WarVara
details.short_description: A dark survival action game set in a world overrun by infection. Progress through story-driven levels, complete objectives, fight infected enemies in close combat, and use stealth to eliminate threats.

details.title: Metzger Manager
details.short_description: Run your own butcher shop, buy animals, butcher meat, serve customers, and expand your business with employees and upgrades.

details.title: The Shotgun Game: Buckshot Survivors
details.short_description: Blast your way through endless hordes of enemies and become the Ultimate Shotgun! Level up, unlock upgrades, build your arsenal of powerful mods and create unique builds to devastate everything in your path.

details.title: Torin's Greed
details.short_description: Torin’s Greed is a FPS dungeon crawler that combines mining mechanics with combat. Players navigate through underground environments, utilizing both a pickaxe and firearms to progress. Fight difficult bosses and get rich.

details.title: Obliteration Quest
details.short_description: Deliver utter obliteration through unique synergies, fully procedural and destructible environment and 4 unique characters in this hack&slash action roguelite. choose between 7 elemental power ups, lots of items and passive upgrades and destroy anything in your way.

details.title: GigaTroubleS
details.short_description: A unique giantess girl-themed exploration and puzzle work which integrating the depth of the plot and the diversity of gameplay. the past and present of the protagonist are pieced together. Three character storylines with completely different gameplay and multiple endings.

details.title: Beards vs. Claws
details.short_description: Dig tunnels, build bridges, and blast your way through walls towards victory in this highly dynamic arena first-person shooter - every obstacle is a potential door

details.title: The Legend of Wijaya
details.short_description: Experience a story-rich, classic 2D action RPG steeped in 13th-century Java. Play as Raden Wijaya using fluid hack-and-slash combat, archery, and magic. Outsmart the traitors and invading Mongols and forge the largest empire in Southeast Asia.

details.title: Super Robot Survivors
details.short_description: A Roguelite Bullet-Heaven where you rescue astronauts, repair reactors, and hack terminals while blasting hordes of robots in high-stakes, 10-minute showdowns. From the Creative Director of Destroy All Humans! 2 and co-creator of TY the Tasmanian Tiger.

details.title: Manasworn
details.short_description: Manasworn is an isometric action RPG with 3 spellcaster playable classes. Pick a Mage, Shaman or Necromancer, progress deeper in generated dungeons, and shape your spells with runes and relics. Fight alone or with three other friends in online co-op.

details.title: Coinfetti
details.short_description: A pinball city-builder roguelike. Build your district and send customers bouncing through it. Every hit triggers a chain of spending. The denser your city gets, the better it feels, until the screen floods with coins. The neon never dims. The crowds keep coming. Happiness is counted in coins.

details.title: Terra Logic
details.short_description: Sculpt planets and landscapes, watch water and climate respond, and compare two versions of the same world. Import heightmaps, draw mountain ranges, and export flat terrain to Minecraft Java. Explore Earth, ancient continents and distant worlds at your own pace.

details.title: Belt Bound Boxing
details.short_description: A physics-based boxing roguelike where no two careers are the same. Every boxer is uniquely generated with stats and modifiers that completely change how they fight. Train, study your opponents, negotiate contracts, manage your lifestyle, and fight your way to the title.

details.title: BLIGHT SWARM
details.short_description: BLIGHT SWARM is horde-building action roguelite where you invade Earth as an alien hivemind and run a planetary infection campaign. Turn civilians into zombies, merge your minions into stronger abominations, evolve your Beast, and spread the Blight across the globe.

details.title: Always Fear The Unknown
details.short_description: Always Fear The Unknown is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where fear is personal. Complete a psychological profile before the match, then survive as a human team against a relentless hunter while sanity, objectives, and adaptive scare events push back.

details.title: Fantasy Auto Chess
details.short_description: Fantasy Auto Chess blends roguelite, extraction, and auto chess gameplay. Build your squad through battle, choose when to fight or retreat, and carry Heroic Spirits into future runs as permanent assets to gain stronger starts and unlock more strategies.

details.title: Mafia Pizza : Family Business
details.short_description: Manage your mafia family and take over the city! Assassinate, extort and take down rival families — All while running a perfectly legitimate pizza business.

details.title: Strayward
details.short_description: STRAYWARD is an open-world voxel survival game set across a series of strange and isolated regions. Explore, scavenge, gather resources, build shelters, and fight to survive as you venture deeper into an unfamiliar world filled with persistent threats and unexplained phenomena.

details.title: Fast Food Together
details.short_description: Start your culinary adventure in Winston Springs! Begin with a food truck and work your way up to opening your very own restaurant, either solo or in co-op! Take care of your customers, create your own recipes, set your prices and menu. Earn money and invest in growing your business.

details.title: Cosmic Seance
details.short_description: A supernatural detective mystery where every truth costs sanity. As the Royal Medium, summon old gods, interpret their visions, and trade your mind for clues. Unravel the enigma before madness takes you.

details.title: Neubo
details.short_description: Neubo is a 3D puzzle-platformer game based on the interaction of materials and dynamic gravity changes. You control a ball that moves through levels consisting of cubic blocks, enemies, and other obstacles. Your goal is to collect all the keys and reach the exit.

details.title: Keelhauled
details.short_description: Sink your friends in fast-paced top-down pirate combat. Line up devastating broadsides, dodge deadly hazards, and unleash game-changing powerups in chaotic sea arena battles for 2-6 players.

details.title: Cozy Cookmaster
details.short_description: Cozy Cookmaster is an incremental restaurant management game where you turn a tiny food counter into a busy restaurant. Cook by hand, serve customers, clean tables, unlock new recipes, hire staff, upgrade your kitchen, expand your dining area, and keep your restaurant growing day after day.

details.title: Core!1!
details.short_description: Core Miner is a cozy incremental mining adventure where every swing takes you deeper into Earth. Break rock, collect ores, relics and pet eggs, upgrade your tools and build powerful loadouts on the journey toward the planet's core.

details.title: We Don't Exist
details.short_description: A single-player, first-person psychological horror game. You wake up in a facility where every room wants you dead and a voice records everything. The worst trap is the other subjects: trust them, betray them, sacrifice yourself? Training modes playable by two, online or in split screen.

details.title: Hellkick
details.short_description: One kick, one survivor. HELLKICK is an early 2000s inspired lightning-fast two-button fighter: divekick your way down the circles of Hell, snap spines in x-ray FATAL KICKS, and duel on arenas that fight back. No combos to memorize! Every single hit is death, yours or theirs.

details.title: 徘徊之碑 - Lingering Stele
details.short_description: "Haven't seen you in forever." A narrative-driven RPG about the heart. In a peaceful world where all conflict has come to an end, is there still a chance to make up for the words left unspoken?

details.title: Hollow Crown
details.short_description: Hollow Crown is a dark idle-incremental autobattler that casts you as an ascendant claimant to a ruined throne. Assemble a court of cursed champions, relics, and sigils; set their decks, assign passive roles, and watch the spire’s floors unspool as automated skirmishes resolve

name: Sons of the Arena: Pollice Verso

details.title: Sons of the Arena: Pollice Verso
details.short_description: A small ludus is yours, and it has to reach the great games. Build the estate, pick fights from the hosts’ calendar, fight off the rival. Turn-based fights on hexes: a kick drops a man, a wedge breaks a shield wall. Four classes, six weapon types, and all a man wears shows on him.

details.title: FerroFrame
details.short_description: FerroFrame is a real-time strategy ecology simulator — dig, dam, redirect and blast industry into high gear, then survive the world as the balance tilts in either direction. Use gigantic mechs called frames to terraform the planet to your needs and replenish your world with asteroids!

details.title: Rogue Dungeon 2
details.short_description: The sequel to the solo dungeon crawler based on the board game. Step out of the dungeon and into Ilderia: travel a dangerous world, gather a party, follow questlines to a hard-won ending, and delve into flooded sewers, cursed tombs and a vampire-haunted castle.

details.title: Tategoi
details.short_description: A calm koi-breeding tycoon with real genetics. Pair your best koi, judge the fry, grow a farm of ponds, win shows and auctions — and raise the koi your grandfather only dreamed of.

details.title: Restore Earth
details.short_description: Restore Earth is an incremental cleanup game. Clear litter on quick, timed trips, collect materials, and upgrade your grabbers. Unlock playful helpers, face natural disasters, and turn neglected clearings into thriving habitats!

details.title: Video Paradise
details.short_description: Run a 1988 video rental store one tape at a time. Order stock by fax, set your prices, rewind, repair and recommend. Every regular remembers how you treat them, and somewhere in your returns box are fragments of a film no one knew existed.

details.title: Par Under Review
details.short_description: A turn-based golf roguelike set in the 1930s. Build a deck of clubs golf won't invent for decades, and beat the golfers of the day at their own game without ever taking a swing.

details.title: Xeno Food Truck
details.short_description: In this sci-fi cooking simulator, run a space food truck on a remote meteor and smuggle contraband out back. Juggle chaotic alien orders while discreetly delivering illicit goods for the mafia. Smile for the space cops, keep your cover intact, and beware the giant hungry worm lurking in the crater.

details.title: Colorsong
details.short_description: Colorsong is a relaxing incremental game where you collect colors and turn them into hand-painted watercolors 🎨 Every color plays its own note 🎵 As your palette expands, the game's song unfolds and grows richer.

details.title: Spellspill: Magic Destruction Sandbox
details.short_description: A roguelite where your spells mess with the world around you. You can burn the grass under your enemies, but you can also freeze the pond and walk across it, or drop lightning into the water they stand in. Enemies ragdoll, houses fall apart, and every run takes a different route.

details.title: Hollowtone
details.short_description: A game you can play BLIND from start to finish... Meet Serene™️'s newest digital therapy model: N.O.R.A.! Hollowtone is a first person audio-based navigation horror game. For possibly the first time ever, CHOOSE to play with graphics OR blindfold yourself for a unique audio experience.

details.title: Yolings
details.short_description: Yolings is a puzzle platformer about sacrificing some to save the rest. Possess individual characters, use self-sacrificing abilities and turn their deaths into puzzle solutions to save as many as possible for the highest score.

details.title: Tug-O-War Wrestling
details.short_description: Grab the rope and fight for control in a physics-based wrestling game where every move pulls your opponent with you. Master momentum through Season Mode or battle friends and random opponents locally and online.

details.title: Fantasy Meat
details.short_description: Fantasy Meat is a stress-free cooking game where fantasy creatures are the main ingredient. Cut and assemble them on a skewer as you please, satisfy increasingly more demanding customers, and send out adventurers to find the tastiest creature: The Golden Drake!

details.title: The Backrooms Experience
details.short_description: The Backrooms Experience is a cooperative exploration and survival-horror game built around observation, discovery, and the unknown. Enter liminal environments alone or with others, document what you learn, and survive encounters with the entities hidden within.

details.title: Juicy World
details.short_description: A high-octane 3D adventure crafted by a unique duo: a 3D artist and an AI programmer. Take control of a fierce grey rabbit and smash hordes of mutant vegetables in a vibrant stylized world. Pure action and hand-crafted visuals packed with heavy guitar riffs!

details.title: Nine Winters
details.short_description: Survive a ruined city where the infected lurk in Nine Winters. Fight back or slip through the dark to scavenge ruins yourself for parts and collectibles. Repair your broken shelter, grow crops, and decorate your home with cherished finds to endure nine winters.

details.title: HopScout
details.short_description: HopScout is a cozy logic puzzle game about arranging cute, picky rabbits to keep everyone happy. Take your time solving puzzles, help the rabbit burrow overcome a looming crisis, and discover the heartwarming stories of its adorable residents.

details.title: Purrgeist
details.short_description: A cozy-spooky ghost-catching incremental. You're a little cat with a spectral vacuum: explore a haunted mansion room by room, suck up ghosts, harvest essences, sell your loot, and pour it into a massive talent tree. Short runs, satisfying progression, and always one more.

details.title: Derelict Planet
details.short_description: Derelict Planet is a retro-inspired top-down action RPG. Survive on a harsh alien planet, battle dungeon bosses, solve puzzles, complete quests, and search for new weapons and abilities.

details.title: Peasants in the Summer
details.short_description: A first-person roguelite puzzle mystery. The same summer day repeats, and every morning the Village redraws itself. Draft which places emerge from the mist, learn the villagers' routines, solve puzzles and remember what no one else can.

details.title: AUTOGENESIS
details.short_description: AUTOGENESIS is a roguelike deckbuilder where any number can be exploited. Swap, Bind and Multiply endlessly to build overwhelming strategies, recursively self-improve, and rewrite the system containing you. Break the experiment. Achieve AUTOGENESIS.

details.title: Alice and the Necromancer
details.short_description: A first-person point-and-click of dark fantasy and horror. Alice finds a voice behind a sealed door. It promises to teach her magic. The first lesson is free. Solve puzzles and make choices that open paths to different endings.

details.title: Villages on Wheels
details.short_description: You're a moving village, fighting against the monster horde! Villages on Wheels is a strategic horde survival. Combine buildings, blessings and orbs to create the ultimate survival machine! How long can you survive?

details.title: Demon's March
details.short_description: Demon's March is an old-school "blobber" (party-based first-person) RPG with tactical round-based combat. Create your party, fight dozens of hand-drawn enemies, find powerful magical items, and meet many NPCs to survive the hostile landscape, uncover the mystery and stop the looming march of evil!

details.title: straywild
details.short_description: Fish, catch bugs, dig for clams, and paint the world in Straywild, a relaxed solo or online multiplayer hangout. Create your own animal character, explore generated islands in changing weather, fill your logbook, and upgrade your home that travels with you!

details.title: 수용수 : to pluto
details.short_description: Two job seekers, two separate spaces, one set of controls. Guide a pair of characters who move in sync, solve puzzles, and get them safely to Café Pluto in this 2D puzzle platformer.

details.title: Humble Hauler
details.short_description: Start with $3,000 and a used car. Build a trucking empire one delivery at a time, juggling fuel, fatigue, and maintenance on a gauge-packed dashboard as you climb from motorcycle courier to semi-driving fleet owner.

details.title: Siege of the Isletress
details.short_description: Siege of the Isletress is a tower defence survival game where you defend a lone fortress against hordes of enemies. Make meaningful decisions under pressure, exploit interconnected systems using 120+ distinct weapons and upgrades and uncover the secret history of the Isletress.

details.title: TicketRot: A Carnival Incremental Game
details.short_description: A carnival incremental where you’re the only one left. Throw darts, whack moles, shoot hoops, wind up clockwork figures to play for you, and win relics from the claw machine. The midway rots a little more with every booth you bring back.

details.title: Cluckopia
details.short_description: Cluckopia is a cozy block-building game. You are a rooster: build a house — walls, door, roof — and set out to find your missing sister. Plant, cook, forge, decorate the village and make friends at your own pace; when danger comes, awaken the legendary powers. Play alone or with up to 3 friends.

details.title: House Craft Voyage
details.short_description: In House Craft Voyage, spawn blocks and devices, snap-weld and paint them into vehicles and contraptions, then explore with physics—or build your own space for fun. A single-player adventure sandbox of building, physics, and puzzles. Create, then set out.

details.title: Flash The Floppy Fish
details.short_description: Master the art of fast flopping and exploit deep fish physics as you speed through handcrafted environments and rank up to beat your and your friends' times. Can you claim the title of "Flash the Floppy Fish"? Or are you just another stale sardine?

details.title: A FAREWELL TO AI
details.short_description: It began with something strange. Something unsettling. In a future where drawing is forbidden, you dare to take up your pen and join the revolution. Solve mysteries. Complete drawing missions. This story needs your art. No one else's.

details.title: DESTRALIX & DESTENYA Sector
details.short_description: Destralix & Destenya is set in the year 2088, where humanity has explored and mapped the entire Solar System and expanded into nearby star systems. Earth remains the central hub of civilization, viewed in living 3D globe divided into thousands of tiles showing terrain, cities and advanced facilities

details.title: Ichorian Tales
details.short_description: Inspired by the traditional Zelda formula, Ichorian Tales is focused on that old-school dungeon crawling experience! Explore, fight enemies, solve puzzles and obtain new abilities to crack open the dungeon and fight massive bosses!

details.title: Pinward
details.short_description: Pinball with a roguelite twist. Spend your score on another ball or upgrades that change the table. Choose rewards, build towards bigger scores, and keep your run alive. Play with friends, or create and share your own tables with the included editor.

details.title: Sluggernauts
details.short_description: Arcade roguelike baseball. Lead the Hickory Creek Squirrels, a small town minor league team and Earth's last hope. Take a randomized road trip and upgrade your team with powerful gear combinations. Hit, pitch, and field to beat otherworldly teams with unfair advantages.

details.title: Stay in Your Lane
details.short_description: Watch the enemy. Plan your waves. Push through. A side-scrolling strategy game where your Gym Rats, Holy Cows and High Horses march and fight on their own while you run the economy, tech tree, upgrades and spells. Story campaign, puzzle challenges, custom battles and online 1v1 and 2v2.

details.title: War Wolves
details.short_description: An online ranked third-person arena shooter where you pilot an armored robotic wolf. Compete in modes like Free For All, Team Deathmatch, and Capture the Flag, control map power weapons, grab combat pickups, and outmaneuver rivals with fluid sprinting, sliding, clambering, jumping, and rolling.

details.title: Gamophobia
details.short_description: Dating is scary—especially when you’re wooing the physical manifestations of human phobias. Fall in love with a Fear. Try not to flinch.

details.title: Elowen's Travel Notes
details.short_description: Discover Elowen’s travel journal in her bookshop and step into her journey. Use productivity tools to study and work as each focus session takes you further. Unlock new scenes and discover her story at your own pace, with soothing music and beautiful illustrations.

details.title: The Five Monks
details.short_description: A settlement simulation about five monks who survived a burning monastery and set out across the continent. Generate a world, gather scattered companions, and raise a new sanctuary from the ashes. Rebuild a broken world with the hands of those who survived.

details.title: Tame or Conquered
details.short_description: You got isekai'd, only to wake up as a cursed saintess. You have 6 months to choose a husband from 7 yandere red flags.. or become a big tree and die. A "simple" psychological horror & dark romance VN.

details.title: Kayak Photography Sim
details.short_description: A meditative kayaking and photography sim. Open water, a slow boat, and nowhere you have to be. Paddle until you feel like stopping, photograph whatever catches your eye, dive underwater to explore what's down there. Nothing chases you. Nothing is timed. You're just chilling and exploring.

details.title: Sneaky Eraser
details.short_description: Class started… a bit boring. Wanna play Eraser War? Let’s go! Sneaky Eraser is a turn-based physics party brawler for 2–6 players. Take control of your eraser—aim, charge, and launch! Knock the others off the desk, and you win. It’s that simple~

details.title: BLASTARD!
details.short_description: Blast your way through walls, enemies, and your own friends! Grow absurdly powerful by placing kegs, kicking them, leveling up, and stacking loot into wild builds as you fight your way through each run!

details.title: Mall Security
details.short_description: Co-op physics comedy for 1–4 mall guards. X-ray shoppers, yell orders into your mic, chase shoplifters and throw them in the cell. Every broken window goes on your report, so try not to get fired. Or switch sides in Thieves vs Guards PvP.

details.title: Solitaire
details.short_description: Unwind with Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid and TriPeaks. Choose a deal by difficulty, take your time, and enjoy the simple pleasure of putting the cards in order, with hints and undo whenever you need a little help.

details.title: Working Dead
details.short_description: Run a supermarket for zombies in this first-person simulator, solo or in online co-op with up to three friends. Prepare body parts, set prices and turn spills into blood soda. Get bitten and keep working as a zombie, but your friends will only hear groans through proximity voice chat.

details.title: Eclipsis Online
details.short_description: A persistent online space MMO where you control a ship to harvest asteroids, trade at player-run structures, and fight inside star systems, either alone or with others.

details.title: 空降恋人
details.short_description: A Sudden Girlfriend is a galgame centered around solving practice questions. In the game, you play as a high school senior who is obsessed with solving practice problems. You become involved in a series of heartwarming stories with a beautiful girl who suddenly appears in your life.

details.title: Hotel of Seams
details.short_description: October 1997. Your grandfather’s lakeside hotel is yours now: a diner, rooms to manage, and two cats. Cook meals and serve your customers, hand out keys to guests, and keep everything clean. Some of the people who check in are not human, and nobody is going to tell you which ones.

details.title: Coin Shower
details.short_description: Coin Shower is a short, cozy incremental casino arcade game. Every machine pays out in a burst of coins that pile up on the floor. Scoop them up, spend them on upgrades, unlock new machines, and chase the $1,000,000 moon shot.

details.title: Assault Commander RTS
details.short_description: Assault Commander RTS is a fast-paced real-time military strategy game. Fight a 30+ mission story campaign with two distinct factions, build and defend your base, command land, air and naval forces, unleash super weapons and climb the online leaderboards.

details.title: PAVYON
details.short_description: You don’t know what will happen tonight. Same table, same lights… but never the same night! Step into the interactive nightclub, choose your table, and see where the night takes you. Meet online players, dive into conversations, build new connections, and become part of the story of the night...

details.title: Fishy Bar: Hook, Cook & Serve
details.short_description: Settle into life by the lake in a first-person fishing and bar-management adventure where you set the pace. Turn your daily catch into meals for your guests, grow your bar, and get to know the eccentric locals as you explore the lakes and unravel the mystery beneath them.

details.title: DDD: Dice, Dungeons, and Drakes
details.short_description: Master a unique tactical board-game battler! Roll to summon monsters and watch your dice disassemble into road-tiles to forge a path to the enemy Lord. Balance Summon and Action dice, manage crest inventories, and cast powerful spells to crush the rival Lord in DDD: Dice, Dungeons & Drakes.

details.title: Pinetrail
details.short_description: Deliver packages across Pinetrail in an overloaded rusty rickshaw truck! Meet the locals, uncover mysteries, and explore beautiful hidden spots. Use your vehicle's unique abilities to cross rivers, glide over trees, and battle cargo-stealing boars!

details.title: Tiny Taxi
details.short_description: Drift, drive and survive in a top-down pixel art city! Pick up passengers with strange demands, earn cash to upgrade your taxi and choose curses that make every run tougher. Customize your cab/driver, build your mixtape and climb the leaderboard.

details.title: Prize Denied
details.short_description: Prize Denied! In this cozy-evil claw machine roguelike, assemble rigged setups and play shady cards to stop customers from ever winning! Discover quirky combos to trap them in an endless addiction loop, draining their pockets dry until they finally win… or go completely broke!

details.title: HellHeart Breaker
details.short_description: HellHeart Breaker - the monster girls you date grant you newfound powers, and the girls you don't... are the bosses you fight! In this dungeon-crawler roguelite, you are locked away at the bottom of the Underworld, fighting your way out. If all is fair in love and war - what will you do?

details.title: TouHou Koishi's Enchanted Woods
details.short_description: 「TouHou Koishi's Enchanted Woods」 is a Touhou fangame.This is a "reverse-construction" action rogue-lite.Koishi vs. Kokoro! But as the playable character, Koishi uses various enhancement cards to continuously strengthen Kokoro. Can she ultimately defeat the Kokoro she has built up herself?

details.title: 四合 Quadrangle
details.short_description: Muni awakens on an unfamiliar campus, drawn into a web of mysteries. Your choices shape relationships and the path of the story. A relationship-driven yuri game.

details.title: Voidfall
details.short_description: Epic space strategy with 4X elements. Digital implementation of the printed board game by Mindclash Games. Base Game holds the competitive mode with 20 Scenarios and 14 playable factions. 1-4 players. AI opponent with 4 difficulty levels. Cross-platform and live and asynchronous gaming.

details.title: Asa's Adventure
details.short_description: A hand-drawn narrative puzzle-adventure. Play as Asa, a silent child obsessed with stars who unexpectedly lands on a desolate planet. Decipher alien symbols and solve puzzles to search for scattered stars—unlocking a heartwarming story.

details.title: RoRX
details.short_description: A competitive strategy game where both players plan in secret, then every order resolves at once. Build an army of Robots from over 200 cards, fight on hexagonal arenas and outthink your rival, not outclick them. Every card is earned by playing.

details.title: Future Fall
details.short_description: A multiplayer post-apocalyptic survival action game with RPG elements set at the crossroads of two realities. Explore the Exclusion Zone, hunt artifacts in anomalies, manage your sanity, build your personal bunker, engage in free trade, and lead your clan to victory.

details.title: Crazy Lemmings
details.short_description: Control entire horde of lemmings and solve puzzles!

name: There's no way that tsundere girl I met in the infirmary will be my girlfriend

details.title: There's no way that tsundere girl I met in the infirmary will be my girlfriend
details.short_description: "B-baka! Who said you could get in!? I'm not prepared yet!" "Oh well... since you're already here, why not stay for a while?" "D-don't misunderstand, okay? It's not like I asked you to stay because I like you or anything..."

details.title: Agecraft
details.short_description: Agecraft is a city-builder strategy where you guide a settlement through thousands of years of human history. Manage individual citizens, grow your economy, trade or wage war with other states, and advance from the Stone Age to the Space Age.

details.title: Gateworlds
details.short_description: Gateworlds is a colony sim about exploring and surviving a fantasy wilderness. Find your way in a world of floating islands, strange creatures, and fickle gods.

details.title: Starry-巡星之旅
details.short_description: 为了打倒毁灭世界的大魔王，少年和少女们踏上长长的旅途，开启了一段跨越两个世界的恋爱、幻想奇谭。 本作品搭载了中日语的文本和配音，L2D动态立绘以及超过200张的基本CG；此外还有立绘触碰等独特系统。

name: CANGATO: A Cat in the Backlands

details.title: CANGATO: A Cat in the Backlands
details.short_description: By day, a cat. By night, a man. A Brazilian roguelike that blends deckbuilding and auto-shooter mechanics in battles full of strategy and unpredictability. Face a fantastic sertão filled with monsters, poetry, and danger.

details.title: RUIN: Beast City
details.short_description: Assassinate your targets with style, as you uncover a plot of world domination and ancient horrors in this boss fight action game. Dive deep into the dark ruins of the Beast City, where only lunatic killers remain.

details.title: A Tiny Wander
details.short_description: An exploration mystery adventure where the setting and narrative become the riddle. Hurry through the night, lantern in hand. And occasionally respite with a cup of coffee. Explore, discover, gather insight from interactions, delivering your parcel to the farthest reaches of the forest.

details.title: Sakichan - Track Of Fury
details.short_description: Join Saki-chan, the fierce shark girl, on her wild ride to conquer Earth! Race through deadly tunnels, mow down Tentamons, and chase after rebellious traitors. Customize Saki-chan with cool costumes and relax in the interactive massage room. Ready to unleash her fury? The chase is on!

details.title: Solace Creek
details.short_description: A PSX-stylized horror mystery set in the lonely Taraset Station. Haunted by a monstrous presence, with six mysterious red coins, you embark on a tense and deliberate journey. Solace Creek is a retro-inspired horror title with a focus on exploration, atmosphere & puzzle solving.

details.title: Baggage Bedlam
details.short_description: Baggage Bedlam is a fast paced multiplayer party game where friends compete to route luggage through chaotic airport conveyor belts. Flip switches, grab power ups, dodge floor hazards, and sabotage your friends as you race to deliver bags to the right destinations!

details.title: Ball of Goof
details.short_description: A game you've never played before! Explore this world with up to 4 peeps (that's slang for people) in this comedically-driven open world sandbox by platforming through challenging challenges, unlock new abilities & uncover the delicious lore behind the ultimate question... What is a Ball of Goof?

details.title: Floppaland
details.short_description: A cozy island life sim: fish, build your village and befriend villagers, alone or with friends. Plus Floppa Kart racing, Floppa Party board games, the Floppatopia team adventure and the Floppa Odyssey 3D platformer.

details.title: Tempo Derby
details.short_description: Tempo Derby is a timing-driven horse-racing roguelike. Hit the sweet spot, build powerful relic combinations and race through a 15-stage campaign. Unlock new horses, fuse legendary relics and outpace five bosses on your way to the championship.

details.title: Starfuse
details.short_description: A cozy fireworks incremental. Launch shells, pop drifting lanterns and set off huge chain reactions. Every upgrade you buy is a star in the night sky: light them all and rekindle the dead Sun. Short and complete, about 3 hours.

details.title: Dragonwing-Rampage
details.short_description: Unleash your fury and blast through enemy lines! Dragonwing Rampage is a 2D bullet hell roguelite. Catch wild beasts, raise dragons, and build a ranch on your sky island. Gear up, dodge through bullet storms, and stack blessings to unleash the firepower you need to defend your home from the Void.

details.title: Boo! Boo! Train!
details.short_description: A cozy train journey through a valley that keeps its own time. Drive slowly, pick a line at every junction, stop for the view and whistle at the neighbours. One real hour is one day in Pinewind Valley, and the season turns every week. Nothing to build, nothing to fail.

details.title: BosaTella Loopa
details.short_description: Junk Robots. Monster Hordes. Unhinged Firepower. Team up in this co-op looter shooter to get filthy rich, discover absurd weaponry, and blast away the dangerous monsters that lurk within "The Loop". Tear through the subway, catch the train (or don't), and blow all your money on even more firepower.

details.title: Ashen Rain
details.short_description: No justice. Only consequences. Ashen Rain is a brutal 2.5D tactical action shooter: fight through rain-soaked streets, factories and military outposts with weighty gunplay, punishing enemy fire and visceral, realistic damage. The law failed. He didn't.

details.title: SonDem
details.short_description: Son Dem is a 3D online social game set in a traditional Turkish coffeehouse for up to 20 players. Play backgammon, 101 Okey and chess with friends, watch matches as a spectator, and join the conversation through voice and text chat.

details.title: No one outside
details.short_description: A co-op survival horror game set in a large reactive city. Explore, loot, drive, build defenses, and survive massive hordes when night falls.

details.title: Hoppkins: Twinkle World
details.short_description: Hoppkins: Twinkle World is a charming 3D platform adventure where you explore colorful worlds, leap across platforms, use unique abilities and vehicles, and face challenging enemies. Join Mr. Hoppkins and venture beyond the clouds to rescue his beloved!

details.title: Jennifer Against Space Aliens
details.short_description: Jennifer Against Space Aliens is an action-packed, third person, sci-fi shooter with 1980s vibes. Run, drive, shoot and blow things up inside space stations, spaceships and distant planets.

details.title: A Minor War
details.short_description: An auto battler where your build is the music. Give each instrument a phrase of notes, then lock it in and listen to your ensemble fight another player's. Your trumpet sounds out every Fireball you gave it, and your drum keeps time with its Blocks.

details.title: Splatterdunk
details.short_description: 90s-arcade 2-on-2 or 3 -on -3 basketball where the players are monsters and the fouls are fatal. Chain trick dunks, arm Fatalities, bribe the ref and dunk on monsters through the glass while VAT-9, a robot announcer who used to be a star, calls it. Up to 6 players, couch or online. Bring a mop.

details.title: Arkhanium
details.short_description: Arkham lies in ruins; humanity has lost the battle. Now is the time to perform the ritual to summon the Great Old Ones in a turn-based, tactical PvP battle. Establish your dominion and seize power over the Earth!

details.title: Guns 'n Goblins
details.short_description: Face a deluge of monsters in this incremental horde survivor FPS. Build your Bastion, level up your character, and upgrade your arsenal to rise from Apprentice Bell Ringer to Master Dragon Hunter.

details.title: PROJECT MIX
details.short_description: PROJECT MIX is a VR anime narrative adventure. Can you find happiness after losing everything you once had?

details.title: Phones not Allowed
details.short_description: School is too boring? The temptation of using your phone too strong? Be careful, teacher's watching! Like Social Media posts and collect awesome Anime Artworks while keeping an eye on your teacher & classmates. One slip... and you are suspended!

details.title: Gunmetal Gothic
details.short_description: A co-op shooter-RPG with a retro-3D aesthetic. Customize and upgrade your character as you take back the city of Vestige from demonic machines!

details.title: Infinitum: The Backrooms Story
details.short_description: INFINITUM is a horror open-world survival co-op story game for up to 4 players. Explore Infinite procedurally generated levels and uncover multiple endings, with every playthrough offering a unique experience.

name: Mystic Land: The Search for Maphaldo

details.title: Mystic Land: The Search for Maphaldo
details.short_description: An old-school RPG inspired by Wizardry 7, Might and Magic and Eye of the Beholder series. 2d grid-based movement, strategic turn-based combat and lots of places to visit and puzzles to solve.

details.title: Trailblazers: Into the March
details.short_description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in this roguelite colony-sim strategy game. Command your Landship in tactical battles, care for a crew composed of all sorts of characters, shape your home, manage resources, and lead expeditions into the March. Discover what lies at its heart... and in yours.

details.title: Isles of Krom
details.short_description: Isles of Krom is a dark fantasy top-down roguelike where progression is carved into the world itself. Master challenging, Souls-inspired combat as your Wards push back the Pestilence, claim each isle's lasting power, and reclaim the Krom Archipelago run after run.

name: Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World

details.title: Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World
details.short_description: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, gothic sci-fi metroidvania rooted in Cosmic Horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.

details.title: The Backworld
details.short_description: Slip through the cracks of reality and explore a vast, open-ended RPG world where surreal horrors collide with fantasy kingdoms and sci-fi cities. Fight in strategic turn-based battles and tense real-time action. The more your sanity breaks, the more the world and its monsters warp around you.

details.title: SERPENTER
details.short_description: A fast, colorful 3D snake adventure across 9 floating worlds and 63 levels! Dodge crumbling floors, slippery ice and wild hazards, unleash power-ups, tackle endless runs and daily challenges, or play with up to 4 friends. Help Zip find Ray!

details.title: Standard of Iron
details.short_description: Lead Rome or Carthage in a single-player RTS set during the Second Punic War. Build settlements, command infantry formations, cavalry and war elephants, then take direct control of your commander and fight on the front line. History meets an undead threat.

details.title: Have We Gone Too Far?
details.short_description: A solo or co-op horde survival where reckless wizards (you) blast mutated hordes with synthwave magic, upgrade between runs, and try not to kill each other...

details.title: My Penguin Friend
details.short_description: Jump into the adorable flippers of Dindim. Think like a penguin and tackle tricky physics puzzles across the gorgeous deep waters and sunny beaches of a tropical fishing village. Leave little footprints as you build a cosy nest, and gather keepsakes to discover a heartwarming story about friendship.

details.title: Where is Starlingdive
details.short_description: A college radio DJ has vanished, but the school says she withdrew. Search forum posts and confidential records to uncover the people behind anonymous handles. Piece together what happened to Starlingdive in a deduction mystery spanning three connected cases, from college radio to the music industry.

details.title: Necrolord
details.short_description: Command an undead army in this dark fantasy auto-battler roguelite. Raise fallen enemies, equip your troops and turn battles with powerful spells. Explore procedurally generated lands. Lose your army, reincarnate and rebuild with your retained magic and lich abilities.

details.title: Hitflag
details.short_description: Arcade car chases on real city streets: grab the flag, ram whoever carries it and escape, on Istanbul's Taksim, New York's Times Square or any street you pick on the map. Then race, wreck or run down the dead. 2 to 8 cars, online or with bots.

details.title: Stone to Stars
details.short_description: Stone to Stars is a colony sim and ruler simulator set at the dawn of civilization. Settle an uncharted continent, build a thriving settlement, discover new technologies, trade or wage war with your neighbors—and hold on to power as you guide your dynasty through the ages.

details.title: Pennants Of Glory: Condottiere
details.short_description: Run a medieval mercenary company with Battle Brothers-style management in a living world. Command up to 600 soldiers in Total War-style real-time 3D formation battles as factions wage wars, besiege towns, and reshape campaign. Break formations with unique stance mechanics.

name: Five Hearts Under One Roof season3

details.title: Five Hearts Under One Roof season3
details.short_description: Mal-sook and Gran return for the finale, feelings deeper than ever! After a work disaster, Yuman heads to Jeju with Gran, only for Mal-sook to appear and reignite their love triangle. New faces enter the mix as old bonds change. This time, choose where your heart belongs.

details.title: Trust me, Officer
details.short_description: Scissors, Stamps, and Signatures. You're a brilliant (possibly) forger who creates passports, visas, and official documents for people the system has turned away. Cut out stamps, forge signatures, retouch photos, and put every document to the test before handing it over.

details.title: TwinLock
details.short_description: TwinLock is a two-player cooperative puzzle adventure set in an abandoned gothic castle. Separated inside its halls, you and your partner have nothing but a walkie-talkie each. Every puzzle hides half its answer on the other side of the wall.

details.title: The Fallen Merman
details.short_description: An officially licensed visual novel based on Lin Qian's The Fallen Merman. A distress call from an abandoned aquarium reunites Bai Chunian and Lanbo. In a world of genetic modification and supernatural powers, relive their journey from wary encounters to a love that defies species and death.

details.title: Make GAL together!
details.short_description: Make GAL together! is a visual novel where you play as Xiao Lu, an unemployed copywriter. Move in with an energetic producer, a sharp-tongued tsundere artist, and a quiet programmer. Amid the daily chaos, can you create an unforgettable game together?

details.title: Alamare: The Wayfarer's Hand
details.short_description: Command mythic creatures in a single-player roguelite card battler. Choose your attacks, play support cards, and ascend into stronger forms mid-battle. Collect new cards, build your deck, and chart your path through dangerous expeditions across fallen realms.

details.title: Blockstein
details.short_description: Blockstein is an action block-falling roguelike. Customize your deck, add pieces with special effects, use triggers, and destroy blocks to annihilate enemies!

details.title: BLACKBELL
details.short_description: A gothic cartoon auto-battler roguelite. Build a company of strange fighters, stack Traits for powerful bonuses, merge copies into 2★ and 3★ forms, and fight your way through a haunted world ruled by the BLACKBELL.

details.title: Magnet Fishing Together
details.short_description: A cozy co-op game about magnet fishing with up to 4 friends. Throw, pull and hope for something good. Sometimes it’s a rusty spoon. Sometimes it’s a scooter you can ride. And sometimes your friend lets go of the rope at the worst possible moment.

details.title: Analog Overdrive: Signal Barrage
details.short_description: A space arcade bullet heaven where weapon evolutions are earned on the battlefield. Combine weapons and Support Modules, hunt the enemies carrying your evolutions and dash through the swarm. Keep your kill chain alive and chase a higher score.

details.title: Wall Over
details.short_description: Stack furniture, combine your powers, and toss a friend over the wall in a physics adventure for 1–4 players. Play solo or team up online as four tiny creatures on a quest to bring their village’s missing music box home.

details.title: Backwatt
details.short_description: Backwatt is a co-op top-down action roguelite for 1–4 players. Drop into the arena, fight off waves of enemies and head back to the Barge to gear up. At its heart is your rig: your skill at managing space and planning your purchases decides how strong your build is.

details.title: Wait, My Gun's Gone?
details.short_description: Survive endless waves of zombies in a chaotic PvE FPS, alone or with up to 3 friends. Run out of ammo, and you get a new random gun. Buy ammo to keep your favorite. In co-op, one player's empty gun triggers a reroll for everyone. Explore the map, buy upgrades, and discover the secret to escape.

details.title: Cordonfall
details.short_description: Type in your address and defend your own street. Cordonfall turns any real neighbourhood on OpenStreetMap into a zombie siege: make a building your HQ, put soldiers on the rooftops, fortify by day, and hold out for ten nights as the horde grows every dusk.

details.title: Unfolding Memories
details.short_description: Build paper pop-ups at a quiet desk. Glue folds onto a card, cut them with a knife, add stickers and words, then open and shut the book to watch it all fold flat. When you like it, print the pattern and make it for real.

details.title: Black Dawn Rises
details.short_description: The action game where you write the orders. Sign tomorrow's order as written or change it, then fight the mission your choice made: free-flow combat, a whip that binds, and Iona Sorn at your side. Since 1947, secret files have said what happens next. Arena co-op for two, on one couch or online.

details.title: Football Tactics: Dare to Dream
details.short_description: A turn-based football tactics roguelite with superpowers. Move your five kids across the grid, check your odds, then pass, lob, volley and shoot. Break the rules with lasers, meteors and unsaveable overhead kicks, and build your squad between matches.

details.title: Dead Freight
details.short_description: The cargo roguelike. Pack your holds with 88 cargo types that combo, multiply and devour each other, pick the port that pays the most, and watch the coins stack up. A loan shark owns your ship and wants ten cuts, each bigger than the last. Miss one and he takes it back.

details.title: Snooker Career Manager
details.short_description: Take a young player from amateur clubs to the top of the world rankings. Play every shot on a 3D table with real snooker physics, or watch and manage from the chair. Plan training, handle money and sponsors, and make the decisions that shape a career.

details.title: Power Off One
details.short_description: You're Sparky, the smallest part inside a giant dying machine. Solve mechanical puzzles to keep its failing chambers alive, and uncover why you were really sent to save it.

details.title: Intravenous 3
details.short_description: Tense stealth action, tactical hardcore gunplay, and missions & story shaped by the way you play. Step into the roles of Steve and Sean, outnumbered and forced to survive a relentless manhunt.

details.title: Pikku Adventure
details.short_description: Befriend the Pikku to decipher a mysterious alien language and deliver a crucial message. Small colorful planets filled with secrets and charm await clever deduction from sharp puzzle-venturers and exo-linguists.

details.title: Smersh: Wolfhound
details.short_description: A stealth action game set during World War II. You play as a SMERSH operative. Use disguises to get close to your target. Take out your foes with weapons or plan “unfortunate accidents.” No two playthroughs are alike.

details.title: I Can Never Love Another
details.short_description: A realistic visual novel based on a true story. As a lawyer trying to save a rock singer from her toxic family, you uncover the suffocating truth of "Codependency." Will you leave, sink into the abyss, or g◼︎ai◻︎n the c#our%ag◼︎e to f◼︎ac◻︎e the p#ai%n? Your choices decide.

details.title: Secret Files: Tunguska - Remastered
details.short_description: The award-winning adventure classic returns as a remaster with modernized visuals and updated technology. Join Nina and Max on a globe-spanning investigation filled with puzzles, conspiracies, and danger – and uncover the secret of Tunguska that changes everything!

details.title: Headshot Holdout
details.short_description: BLAST NAZI ZOMBIE HEADS (with friends)! Headshot Holdout is a retro, roguelite, FPS where squads of 1-4 start with only a rifle and build into zombie killing machines. There are no automatic weapons and no bullet sponge enemies. Strategy and accuracy are key.

details.title: Total Incremental Battle
details.short_description: Start with a single soldier, end up with a massive army. Strategize and command your units, or let them grind on their own. Progress through many unique progression systems and conquer all the stages.

details.title: After ICEY
details.short_description: After ICEY is a 2D side-scrolling action meta sequel in the ICEY universe. After countless cycles, ICEY defeated Judas and left the world, yet cycles remain. Three bound souls await. Follow the arrows, defeat them, and take their soul crystal masks — this is your mission.

name: Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It!

details.title: Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It!
details.short_description: A slap-and-solve adventure that stretches your wits and your noodly arms in all directions. Explore impossible towers where every floor is a comedy sandbox of secrets. Meet strange characters and solve (or add to) their problems with a personal touch. The power to change everything is in your hands.

details.title: Midnight Souls
details.short_description: Dive into the secrets of the quiet hamlet of Camomile Peaks! A romantic trip to meet your online crush spirals into a mystical adventure: epic battles, bizarre allies, and dark humor. Win her heart, solve the mysteries, and protect your cat, Charlie!

details.title: Rance Quest Magnum
details.short_description: Rance sets off on another grand (though not always grave) adventure across the Continent to find a cure for the curse and get his life back in order!

details.title: War of Banners
details.short_description: War of Banners is a sandbox turn-based tactical RPG set in a medieval open world. Recruit companions, lead your army, and claim victory across brutal battlefields. From a wandering mercenary band to an empire-ruling sovereign — your fate is shaped by strategy and choice.

details.title: Gloom Punks
details.short_description: Not your average co-op roguelike. Where the price for power is death, and you’re trapped in a gloom-scape of fever dreams and fairytales gone feral, you can only rely on Punks like yourself. Cheat death, bounce back, and take on a world that so badly wants you dead!

details.title: Salvebringer Ninjas
details.short_description: As the outbreak spreads and civilization crumbles, humanity's last hope rests with an order of mysterious ninjas that have been hiding from the world for decades—the Salvebringer Ninjas!

name: Shadow Sacrament: The Roots of Evil

details.title: Shadow Sacrament: The Roots of Evil
details.short_description: Shadow Sacrament is a grim horrorvania where you play as a tormented detective who must investigate the secrets of an ancient, horrific monastery. Explore hidden chambers, solve intricate puzzles, and face terrifying nightmares that lurk in its shadowy halls. Hunt the Haunt.

details.title: Rogue Wheels
details.short_description: Rogue Wheels is a turn based roguelike deckbuilder where your car is your character and timing driven combat defines every run. Build fun and crazy decks!

details.title: Neon Fragments
details.short_description: Neon Fragments is a first-person shooter set in a dystopian near future. In a world where humanity crumbled under its own weight, there is not much left but despair and loneliness. How far are you willing to go for your only glimmer of light in this cruel world.

details.title: Become
details.short_description: Become is a short single-player third-person adventure where you embark on life's most fantastical journey, as one of millions of sperm. Survive the perilous microcosm, wiggle, dash, and outcompete rivals through the human reproductive system to create new life.

details.title: Ant Tribe
details.short_description: Expand your chamber, strengthen your tribe, and put every ant to work, each with its own role — to deliver an endless feast to your Queen!

details.title: 逆界 (Inverse Realm)
details.short_description: A 2D side-scrolling beat 'em up with roguelite elements! Choose distinct weapons, trigger powerful build synergies, and adapt to fresh challenges on every run. Are you ready for the battle?

details.title: Chopeast
details.short_description: Chopeast is an incremental 2D game where you can freely explore, upgrade, and expand your weapons. In the game, you play as a alien monster hunter collecting meat to trade for resources.

details.title: Used Car Empire
details.short_description: You cannot see the car. You can only read it. Buy used cars off strangers, work out what is wrong with them before it costs you, and decide what to tell the next owner. A 2D deduction game about the motor trade, in a small town that remembers every car you sell.

details.title: Tiny Tide
details.short_description: Wind-up toy robots have invaded the house. Pick a tiny hero, grab a water blaster and survive the swarm, room by room. Tiny Tide is a survivors-like roguelite where every weapon evolves and every run turns the living room floor into a bubbly battlefield.

details.title: Discbreaker
details.short_description: A sports roguelite where sponsors bend the rules: ghost passes slip through defenders, tackles pop the disc toward their net. Create your club, draft a 5v5 squad from packs, climb a 256-team knockout cup. Lose once and you're out. Or host a cup for up to 256 friends.

details.title: Meatstone
details.short_description: Meatstone is a turn-based tactical RPG. As a mercenary in a wasteland with alien colonizers, you must cross the unknown surface, gather resources for your base, and augment your gears and flesh. Learn the truth of the past, and salvage what remains of a world that may already be beyond saving.

details.title: FeudFall
details.short_description: A guild-war MMORPG. Plant a Tree of Life, raise a walled city, arm your guild from its own forges, and hold your walls against every rival. Action combat, full-bag loot, and sieges where a city built over seasons can fall in one night.

details.title: Kennel Chaos: Daycare Simulator
details.short_description: You and your friends run a dog daycare and pet shop. It goes badly. Feed them, wash them, walk them, and scoop what they leave behind, before somebody props a gate open and eleven dogs discover the front door. Co-op chaos with very good pups.

details.title: The Off-Season
details.short_description: The seaside hotel is shut from October to March, and the winter caretaker is you. The owner's rules are pinned beside the key board: no guests. Somebody knocks anyway, after the last bus, in the rain, with cash and no booking. You decide who gets a key, and which room.

details.title: Babel Rising Reborn
details.short_description: Humanity wants to reach the heavens. You're God. Make them regret it. Unleash the elements and bring the Tower of Babel crashing down in this remastered god game, more spectacular than ever. The Unreal Engine 5 remake of a cult god game.

details.title: Hirelings
details.short_description: Turn-based tactics roguelike about building an overpowered party of mercenaries. Hire, reroll, and merge mages, vampires, rogues and more between battles... then outsmart every enemy on the grid.

details.title: Trial by Mana
details.short_description: Level up, learn new spells, loot unique equipment, slay hordes of enemies, and conquer mighty foes in this action-packed Bullet Heaven Rogue-lite!

details.title: Pigs On Wings
details.short_description: Pigs On Wings is an open-world cooperative flight sim featuring extraction mechanics and global guerrilla warfare. Work together to pilot a temperamental aircraft: battle ground forces, deliver cargo, repair systems, and upgrade your gear.

details.title: Ground Drone Operator: UGV Simulator
details.short_description: Co-op combat UGV simulator. One drone - several operators. Configure your ground drone for the mission and split roles between platform, weapon station, and equipment. Run robotic assaults, escorts, supply runs, evacuations and raids behind enemy lines.

details.title: The Nightmare Arena
details.short_description: The Ancients have awoken! Face their wrath in The Nightmare Arena, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Journey through the Realms collecting cards and facing endless waves of enemies.

details.title: Project Turbo Combat
details.short_description: Project Turbo Combat is an explosive vehicular combat racer with singleplayer and multiplayer modes. Blast through a vivid open world in muscle cars, sports sedans and EVs, firing homing missiles, dropping oil slicks, and grabbing power-ups to wreck rivals and take the lead. Free demo available now.

details.title: A Path Untrodden
details.short_description: A dark turn-based RPG in a world consumed by Mushroom Forest. Lead a group of survivors on a sacred journey to the White City, a land of promised salvation. Fight mutants, manage food, develop heroes, and make choices with lasting consequences. How much will you sacrifice to reach the White City?

details.title: Kuiper Wanderer
details.short_description: Kuiper Wanderer is a 2D top-down space sandbox RPG. Command and deeply customize your ships and mechs, recruit a diverse crew, and freely explore, scavenge, or fight in a dynamically evolving universe. Experience highly freeform emergent gameplay wrapped in a classic retro sci-fi aesthetic.

details.title: The Outcast Bloom
details.short_description: Build an ever-growing defense network, meet and level loyal companions and discover a deep loot system. Featuring many different enemy types, abilities, environmental affixes and card choices.

details.title: [ABERRATION] THE ANALYST
details.short_description: Dexton-City vanished, leaving a 14.2-meter void. As a PRISM analyst, process Agent Meg Simons' final hours through the EYESYS simulation. Survive the psychological terror and brutal trials of a Class C4 Hive Mind. An [ABERRATION] case by FEIGIN ENTERTAINMENT.

details.title: Eterno
details.short_description: A first-person fantasy RPG where you carve your own legend in a living world. Explore dangerous dungeons, shape your reputation, and choose your path between honor and ambition.

details.title: Bunny Bring Bits
details.short_description: You are a grumpy rabbit restoring the game world. Clean up rubbish, wipe away dirt with a rag, recycle junk into elements of the world, and activate mechanisms. And after the heroes' fight with the boss, don't forget to clean up the unlucky heroes.

details.title: King of Puzzles
details.short_description: A cosy little kingdom-building puzzle. Lay dominoes around your castle, grow the biggest patch of each terrain you can, and see how your kingdom compares. A new board whenever you want one, a daily everybody shares, and a crown for whoever leads the most boards.

details.title: Buildot
details.short_description: Help Buildot save the world of Godot from the tyranny of the Unreal Union! Solve clever puzzles using diodes, logic gates, and conveyor belts. Beware of slippery surfaces and ice, where a single move can change everything. Full version planned to include 100 levels plus extra challenges!

details.title: Clinic Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own clinic solo or team up with up to 4 players! Examine patients, diagnose and treat them. Divide the work, make decisions, and build your dream clinic — or at least try to keep the place from falling apart.

details.title: Incremental Garden
details.short_description: A short incremental game about a magical garden. Grow wonderful flowers, earn money, buy upgrades, and roll the gacha to discover rarer plants! Over 30 unique plants are waiting for you!

details.title: Focus My Deer
details.short_description: Focus my Deer is a game that helps you stay focused on your real-life work! After every focus session, you gain energy which can be used to bring back plants and trees to the land. As the forest grows, animals will come to visit! Learn about the animals and help them on their quests.

details.title: When Two Roses Collide
details.short_description: A BL visual novel set during the War of the Roses. Will love prevail over honour?

details.title: The Ones Who Answered
details.short_description: When a catastrophic global anomaly known as "The Knocking" drags you into a nightmare dimension, you must fight to survive. Play as YouTuber Pisty and team up with an ally, Perm, to escape a four-layer hellscape. Solve puzzles, evade terrifying threats, and defeat the creator of this twisted world..

details.title: Stormbox
details.short_description: Play as Pip the Penguin, a storm chaser on a voxel island where any sky can spawn a tornado. Drive, fly and deploy gadgets to film twisters up close, collect every storm as a Storm Card, and watch panicked towns and villagers scramble as the storm closes in.

details.title: Littlest Catalyst: Swarm Defense
details.short_description: Command a crew of tiny bots, build a modular space base, and repel relentless alien swarms. Build, upgrade, defend, and don't forget to pet the crew members.

details.title: Fluff 'N Tumble
details.short_description: Fluff ‘N Tumble is a one-vs-many online party game for friends who deserve each other. Tackle, hunt, or team up with your friends across a handful of cute, chaotic games. This is a collection of dynamic multiplayer party games, each one changing how one player takes on the rest of the party.

details.title: Historiker
details.short_description: You have inherited a train station from a family that never mentioned it. Walk its platforms into Berlin, Paris, New York and Hong Kong across the last century, and learn how a single clue found in one decade rewrites the meaning of another.

details.title: Fading Youth
details.short_description: This is an interactive visual novel about youth, redemption, and a diary, with a playtime of 3 to 5 hours.

details.title: Tomb Extraction
details.short_description: A multiplayer tomb-raiding horror game supporting up to four players, where you infiltrate ancient tombs, loot valuable burial treasures, and escape alive. Players can assume the role of a Taoist priest and use incantations to subdue the evil spirits within the tombs

details.title: Fight Manager
details.short_description: Take control of an MMA promotion and build it fight by fight. Sign contenders, negotiate contracts, book the card, and crown champions across four divisions while a strike-by-strike simulation decides who walks out with the belt.

details.title: The Arcane Open
details.short_description: A fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where the only enemy is the golf course.

details.title: CATering: Roadtrip Rivals
details.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer cooking game where cats run food trucks, compete for ingredients, sabotage each other, and travel the world together. Cook at international festivals, hit the road with friends, explore, play minigames, and fight for the highest rating!

details.title: Starbound Settlers
details.short_description: Pirates at the hull, comets past the window, a cat on the keyboard. Build a space station room by room, mine the asteroid belts with drones and keep a growing crew alive, fed and in love. 64 story chains, over 100 technologies, and no ending.

details.title: Tooth And Tusk
details.short_description: Play as Dr. Chompers, a T-Rex dentist in a cozy miniature voxel clinic for animals. Scrape plaque, fill cavities, polish teeth, drain saliva, and forge custom grillz while rival Dr. Sterling heckles from across the street.

details.title: Shrouded Aura
details.short_description: Shrouded Aura is a psychological horror experience where trauma, memory, and perception distort reality. Explore shifting environments, uncover conflicting diary entries, and survive disturbing manifestations as you piece together the truth. Play in VR or on PC.

details.title: Mouse Hammer
details.short_description: Mouse Hammer is a fast paced physics based fighting game about swinging a hammer around. Fight online with your friends, or race yourself in platforming challenges.

details.title: Area [No Love]
details.short_description: Fall in love, and you explode?! Explosive Love Cells have made love itself a danger and a crime. A boy who swore off romance gets tangled up with three girls... Will you survive? No Love Virus is a visual novel where you must keep affection just right to win a heroine's heart.

details.title: Genesis Core
details.short_description: Genesis Core is an idle RPG built around crafting and automation. Send squads farming across hostile planets, process their loot into powerful gear and circuits, and expand your base. Refine your builds, assimilate enemy technology and keep developing your squad through successive campaigns.

details.title: TerraHeist
details.short_description: Explore procedurally generated alien planets, steal valuables, and get your haul home. TerraHeist is a top-down sci-fi action game for solo play or online co-op. Capture creatures as companions, turn their attacks into weapon gems, and gear up for the next expedition.

details.title: Beyond Realm
details.short_description: A roguelite deckbuilder where your town is the reward. The kingdom has faded to grey ink, and every artefact you bring home paints one colour back. Your deck dies with the run, the town never does. Out there, place your cards and watch them fight on their own.

details.title: Nine Tenths
details.short_description: In San Verde, the law is absolute— except for you. A text-based crime management game where you evade the law to rule the underworld. Launder your cash, vet your buyers, deploy the right crew, and manage your firepower to build an empire beyond the reach of the law.

details.title: Backpack Legion
details.short_description: Build an army in your backpack! Place soldiers next to weapons and watch them fight to destroy the enemy base. Send in a huge army, or fully equip a few elite troops to beat bigger forces. Mix soldiers, weapons and gems to try all kinds of builds. Fight other players' saved armies—no waiting!

details.title: Stolen Sun
details.short_description: Stolen Sun is a co-op game for 1–4 players. You are astronauts crash-landed on a planet in impenetrable darkness. Light is your only tool and greatest threat. Explore procedural locations, gather resources, upgrade your base on a giant turtle, and escape to see the sun.

details.title: Spellvoc
details.short_description: A chaotic co-op game where 2–4 apprentice wizards use magic to fill orders, on the couch or online. Pull ingredients closer with telekinesis and fire up the cauldron with a fireball. Bridges collapse and trains barrel through, but your creations still have to reach the owl on time!

details.title: The Last Encore
details.short_description: The Last Encore is a wave-based arena shooter set in a marionette theatre, and nothing auto-fires here: you aim, and you count every round. You're the last puppet in the workshop, and the whole cast has taken the stage to find you.

details.title: Balliators
details.short_description: Build a deck of wild balls, throw them into the arena and watch them bounce, collide and explode for points. A roguelike deckbuilder where every ball bends the rules: draft, roll, shop and beat four stages of bosses.

details.title: Gate B7
details.short_description: Verify documents, stamp boarding passes, and uphold the regime's strict laws at a dystopian airport terminal. Every decision matters: take bribes to keep your family alive, or stay loyal to survive your 20-day shift. But be careful: Some anomalies aren't found on paper.

details.title: Dawn of Embers
details.short_description: Build a town. Raise an army. Command the elements. A real-time strategy game where ancient Pillars wake on the battlefield and leave magic in their embers. Choose your Calling, drill your Disciplines, and lead your kingdom through the Day of Ruin.

details.title: Gospel of Garbage
details.short_description: Gospel of Garbage is an Incremental Auto Battler about leading a fanatical troop of raccoons. Stack trash to stop the train, and protect your pile from heretical cleanup crews!

details.title: Starward Era
details.short_description: Dig deep into an alien world, gather resources, explore the unknown, and build interconnected power, oxygen, and production systems. Upgrade your gear, expand your base, and automate logistics with drones as manual work gradually grows into an efficient production network.

details.title: Tiny Tyrant: Dungeon Master
details.short_description: Build and Customize your dungeon, place deadly traps, defenses and monsters to fight alongside in this FPS / Tower Defense hybrid. Stop those dastardly heroes from stealing your hard-earned treasure.

details.title: Devilcoin
details.short_description: A coin-flip roguelite. You traded your soul for money, and now the only way out of this occult purgatory is to keep flipping. Bet on heads or tails, collect Artifacts that bend the odds, and hit the score before your flips run out.

details.title: Bladehold
details.short_description: Demolish monstrous hordes on horseback or foot, unleash devastating abilities, build the ultimate hero, and protect your fortress with deadly automated defenses in this fast-paced action roguelite.

details.title: The Golfing Hour
