A story-driven bar sim where every drink comes at a price.

details.title: Kill the Stream
details.short_description: The end of the world, streamed live. Climb a deadly tower broadcast in real time to gods, mystical creatures and demons. And you're just a pathetic guy picked at random to represent humanity and challenge the tower.

details.title: Tape Us Out
details.short_description: Tape Us Out is an asymmetric, online co-op puzzle game. Players are sucked into a VHS tape and must face challenges of logic, coordination, and communication within the universe of old movies to find their way back to reality.

details.title: Dungeon Dominator
details.short_description: Build and expand your own warm, cozy dungeon where your minions live miserable lives and do their evil things. Take part in thrilling battles against humans, angels, and powerful bosses, defending your domain. Conquer the world by commanding an army with a wave of your hand!

details.title: Valiance
details.short_description: A fast paced FPS where you create your own character by choosing your arsenal of abilities and weapons. Craft your build and chain together devastating ability & weapon combos to rip apart hordes of ravenous monsters.

details.title: Old School RPG II
details.short_description: Old School RPG II: Dawn of the Orc is a party-based RPG. Create a group of adventurers whose destiny is forged by the actions they take and their choices will matter and impact the game world. Featuring advanced class customization options, strategic turn-based combat, and trap filled dungeons.

name: Sucks To Be In The Sticks

details.title: Sucks To Be In The Sticks
details.short_description: A teenage vampire getting hooked on blood in a world that traded it for energy. See the absolute worst of what humans do to one another in every drop. It destroys you. You hate it. And yet, crawl back for more. A narrative adventure about a rather short eternity.

details.title: Life Souls
details.short_description: Life Souls is a cooperative roguelike for 1–6 players featuring dynamic arena combat, free-form skill combinations, epic bosses, and permanent progression.

details.title: Ham's Game Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own retro game shop! Stock shelves, manage customers, collect rare games, and even play the ones you sell. Upgrade your store, host launch events, and build the ultimate gaming destination in this cozy simulation game.

details.title: OEDO DEVELOPER
details.short_description: “Oedo Developer” is a city builder featuring Ieyasu Tokugawa's Edo. Story and free play modes are available, the first offering a history based city building experience, and the second allowing you to freely develop the lands. Plan, build, distribute, and learn as you make the Edo of your dreams!
developers: 株式会社ドリームスレッド
publishers: 株式会社ドリームスレッド

details.title: Gourmet Steak Odyssey
details.short_description: A resource management platformer where you play as Sweet Baby Jesus on a quest to make the perfect steak. Use your gun to propel yourself through levels and use your feet viciously to crush your foes.

details.title: Lunarift
details.short_description: DESCEND. BUILD. EXTRACT. Lunarift is a single-player roguelite FPS set inside a lunar station torn open by a dimensional rift. Fight through shifting sectors, turn salvaged technology into lethal builds, and choose when to push deeper or escape with what you found.

name: Yami Kare - His mind trying to bind me mentally

details.title: Yami Kare - His mind trying to bind me mentally
details.short_description: This game is a confinement suspense & love romance escape game in which the main character, who has lost her memory, aims to regain her memory and escape from the room she was confined in.

details.title: Drone Armada
details.short_description: Pilot and command massive drone swarms in real-time action-strategy battles. Research powerful tech, upgrade your fleet, and adapt your tactics to push back the invasion spreading across Kaelisia.

details.title: Endwell
details.short_description: One determined cat, one big backpack, and a whole lot of deliveries to make! As a Cat Courier, it's your job to deliver packages across a cozy town on the eve of the world's end. Help residents find connection, hope, and meaning before the last sunset.

name: Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift

details.title: Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift
details.short_description: Point & Click Fantasy Thriller: A burst of light - a crystal devours your little brother's life force. Desperate to save him, you must uncover the truth behind magic, while a dread mage closes in to tear the crystal from your hands - and with it, all hope.

details.title: IN SILICO
details.short_description: In a distant future humanity is enslaved in a simulation. Now that you are awake, can you escape from reality too?

details.title: Gatekeeper's Week
details.short_description: Become a guard of the glorious kingdom of Cardenia! Your task is to let only law-abiding travelers into the city, while repelling bandit attacks and sending swindlers to jail! Be attentive and vigilant! For the glory of the King!

details.title: Burger Rush Simulator
details.short_description: Burger Rush Simulator is a fast food simulator where you manage your fast food restaurant, order supplies, restock containers, take payments at checkout and drive-thru, prepare meals, hire staff, expand your kitchen and dining area, and unlock features like storage and touchscreen checkout.

details.title: Scratchcard Hero
details.short_description: Get to scratchin' in this realtime rogueli*e deckbuilder where all your cards are lottery scratch-off-micro-game tickets! Make your build of scratchcards and gadgets, and 1v1 battle other scratcher enthusiasts on your way to the source of your town's gambling problems.

details.title: Bloomcraft
details.short_description: Bloomcraft is a Garden Creation Simulator. The player's goal is to create a garden that pleases the Flower Queen. The more the Flower Queen likes the garden, the more money she pays for it every second.

details.title: UNRETURNING
details.short_description: No one is known to have reached the end of the abyss, but one thing is certain: something must be there, and it must be seen. Explore the depths of the abyss in a game that blends adventure, horror, and dark fantasy. This time, it’s not about the destination, it's about THE JOURNEY.

details.title: Little Crossroads
details.short_description: Escape the rush of your other life in this multiplayer Cozy RPG. Advance in a deep progression of skills like Fishing, Mining, and Bug Catching. Unlock cute and cool cosmetics to customize your character. Experience the "cozy chaos" of random events. All solo or with friends. Welcome home!

details.title: Last Front
details.short_description: Modern armies, unique commanders, tactical battles. In Last Front, each faction offers its own style of war and exclusive units. Build your base, lead your army, and prove your superiority on the battlefield.

details.title: Bearskull 2
details.short_description: A vast open world, ruthless Vikings, powerful bosses, and an epic co-op mode – rise to the challenge! ⚔🔥🐻💀

details.title: Imagisty Card Collection
details.short_description: You are playing a casual game “I want to spin more gachas!” “I achieved something more by collecting more things!” Have you ever wondered...? Imagisty Card Collection is a simple game that focuses on collecting cards by opening packs of cards like a trading card game!

details.title: Xplorite
details.short_description: Explore, fight, and uncover the secrets of planet Nargal in Xplorite, a hand-drawn action-exploration Metroidvania. Battle enemies, discover powerful upgrades, and explore hidden paths. The research team disappeared. Now it’s your turn to find out why.

details.title: Hexistence
details.short_description: Hexistence is a Tower Defense Roguelike Deckbuilder. Expand a procedural map, build towers, and cast spells while managing your hand in real time. Optimize your resources to survive increasingly demanding waves!

details.title: Neon Extermination
details.short_description: In this cyberpunk FPS, players navigate a dystopian city corrupted by a malevolent computer virus. You, armed with weapons and skills, unravels the secrets behind CyberCorp's experiments.

details.title: Fraudulent Idols
details.short_description: Investigate the sprawling pharmaceutical mega-facility, STRATA, where every choice matters. Uncover hidden secrets, forge alliances, solve complex puzzles, and fight your way through a cyberpunk conspiracy in a true immersive sim where no two playthroughs are ever the same.

details.title: Elementum
details.short_description: Elementum is a spell-crafting roguelike with bullet-hell elements. Fight your way out by defeating a wide range of enemies and discover a variety of spells and items to customize your build and play style!

details.title: Little Monster
details.short_description: Little Monster is a hand-painted side scroller beat ‘em up where you play as Stormy, a monster under the bed who protects us from our nightmares. Protect the dream! Explore the realms! Rescue your friends!

details.title: Arcane Arena
details.short_description: Arcane Arena is a fast-paced multiplayer action game where spellcasters clash in team-based combat. Choose your class, master powerful abilities, and dominate the arena. Manipulate time, summon creatures, wield the elements, and combine magic with your team to claim victory.

details.title: Grandma(88)
details.short_description: Of course Grandma loves you — but she loves it even more when you simply listen. Dive into her labyrinth of memories, challenge her stories and watch everything around you fall apart. Can you escape her version of the past?

details.title: Specters of the Sun
details.short_description: Specters of the Sun is a challenging 2D action platformer with action-packed levels. Take on the role of an elusive specter to reclaim your old corpse, now possessed at the heights of your former kingdom.

details.title: Nightborn
details.short_description: Fight, sneak, or charm your way through a gothic modern New Orleans as a Vampire detective of your creation. Unravel a vast centuries-old conspiracy involving Vampire factions, Werewolves, and far stranger horrors. Try to survive as a Nightborn without losing yourself to madness or damnation.

details.title: Eternal Summer
details.short_description: unmixing reality

details.title: Piece Quest Idle
details.short_description: Shape a party that keeps growing while you’re away. Gather resources, upgrade your base, craft gear, customize hero skill trees, and tune auto-battle strategies to conquer powerful bosses

details.title: My Dear Neighbor, edition 404
details.short_description: My Dear Neighbor, edition 404 is a survival horror game that tells the story of your neighbor. Go to your neighbor's house and end up in a glitchy nightmare. Fight your way out of this glitched nightmare amid bugs and nightmarish visions in this psychological horror game.

details.title: Ark Odyssey
details.short_description: Ark Odyssey is a top-down arcade shooter that lets you command an army of starships to fight against the force of void! Gather your fleet into formations, and build your team of evolving synergistic compositions. Order your army of Starforce through space and protect the cosmos!

details.title: Floralis
details.short_description: You are born from a tree in a post-human world ruled by sentient plants. Hide from predators, reawaken machines, and outwit living traps as you search for your twin and the truth of your birth in this cinematic puzzle adventure.

details.title: Heptic Arena
details.short_description: Squad up, hunt monsters, and crush the competition! Chase fame and fortune in Heptic Arena - the galaxy’s deadliest game show where infamy is power and ratings are king. Step into the spotlight and make them watch!

details.title: Suspended Animation 💽
details.short_description: A sci-fi first person exploration game about a ship in danger, and the evil AI tasked with saving it: you.

details.title: Winter of the Arbyen
details.short_description: 'Winter of the Arbyen' is a game that combines adventure and store manage simulation. In the world where the Ice Age has come, you must survive as a shopkeeper in a coal mine village. Find the missing father, chase the 'Firestone'. Various characters are waiting to help you or take advantage of you.

details.title: Apathic
details.short_description: Apathic is a first-person psychological horror game. Investigate your brother's disappearance in a mysterious facility. Shift gravity, decipher sounds, and explore underground ducts while evading a creature determined to capture you at all costs.

details.title: Peggy's Farm
details.short_description: Combine the cozy crafting of a farming sim with the satisfying physics of a pachinko game.

details.title: Rewind And Reclaim
details.short_description: REWIND and RECLAIM is a horror adventure where time moves when you move. Explore different outcomes for each movies by using your wits and your environment. Uncover their behind the scenes to unfold the story linking them all and protect your familly from the curse that took your mother's life.

details.title: Kelp Keeper
details.short_description: Take on a vital role in the ecosystem in this action-packed bullet hell. Control a charming sea otter and protect the kelp forest from an endless onslaught of devious sea critters. Skillfully dodge attacks, grab your prey, and eat them all at the surface for a huge satisfying snack.

details.title: The Hydra Experiment
details.short_description: Solve puzzles and fling flasks as a member of a mad scientist collective in this action-adventure RPG. Unlock prototypes and discover new mechanics, using them to explore deeper into 0-Laboratories. Build or burn bridges as you sculpt your persona with branching dialogue and consequences.

details.title: Dark Lessons
details.short_description: Trapped in your teacher's home, your only defense against the dark is a flickering candle. Unearth a family’s twisted history and solve puzzles in this Lovecraftian nightmare to find a way out. But be warned: Something else is lurking in the shadows ... and a voice is pleading for your help.

details.title: Teo Dove Am Skater 2
details.short_description: Skateboarding game in the spirit of THPS. Perform flip tricks, grabs, grinds. Insane lines. Level up your character and learn new tricks. Find hidden secrets. And challenge your rival to a classic game of skate HORSE!

details.title: Work In Progress
details.short_description: It’s your first day in office and half of the staff is already on burnout... Here is your gun, your contract. Now go fire some people.

details.title: 9Cat Saga
details.short_description: 9Cat is a Co-op shooter/action game. Gather your friends to forage and extract in the procedurally-generated landscape. Nourish and furnish your collection of 9Cat, refine your combat styles and overcome various missions and defeat great enemies.

details.title: The Neath
details.short_description: Beneath you go. Below the bones of the earth and lower into the darkness. Find your way through twisting passages past vile monsters. Explore, discover and conquer your way to greater depths and greater rewards.

details.title: Legend of the Corndog(s)
details.short_description: Finding yourself out of food, you decide to venture into the outdoors for the first time in an embarrassingly long time in order to satiate your growing hunger.

details.title: Race to Ruler
details.short_description: Race to Ruler is a deck-building roguelike where your cards are your army as you embark on a journey to defeat the ruler of an empire. Draft and train new units, summon epic beings, defeat your rivals, and claim the crown.

details.title: Boss Slayers
details.short_description: No game to play with a friend? Now you're a team of boss hunters. Challenge the most dangerous monsters! Dodge rains of projectiles, seize the right moment to attack and discover the weaknesses of cunning bosses.

details.title: L8R SK8R
details.short_description: L8R SK8R is a 3D platformer inspired by the classics of the fifth generation but with a unique twist that will make you feel like a speedrunner.

details.title: speak of my sin
details.short_description: Speak of My Sin is a word reasoning game - players are supposed to find the truth of the cases, restore the story in a number of interrelated cases and finally detect the identification of “me”, speaking out “my” sin.

details.title: Path to Perdition
details.short_description: Path to Perdition is a challenging roguelike auto-battler. Assemble and lead a party of adventurers through unforgiving lands. Equip them with items to unlock skills, modify those skills with relics to create unique effects, and combine those effects using tactical positioning to crush your enemies.

details.title: Savage Gears
details.short_description: Savage Gears is a violent, single-player alt-history Africa Cold War shooter. Armed with an Iron Fist and an arsenal of devastating weaponry, you play as Ero Lei'Bourne, a S.P.E.A.R. operative, in the middle of a dangerous conspiracy.

details.title: GRIDHACK
details.short_description: GRIDHACK is a sci-fi puzzle RPG where hacking = fighting nonogram battles. Chase a rogue program and chip away at the galaxy's strongest firewall to uncover the conspiracy about what happened to Earth!

details.title: Fateful Bullet
details.short_description: A third-person anime arena shooter where you can bring a sword to a gunfight. Wall-jump across the city, dash through the crossfire and win with a blade or a bullet. Build your own cute fighter and take on real players in fast online PvP.

details.title: Rat Race Ritual
details.short_description: Poison your boss with your friends. Trap him, get him fired, and make him guess your next move. Or hide in cloak mode, sneaking through pipes and covers. Clocks that speed up time, tools to block paths, and 10 player lobbies!

details.title: Wänder OutWorld - Mount Hollow
details.short_description: ~"By the whims of Yargha. Her soul, etched in Chaos." Survive and explore absurd scenarios. Switch realities. Hunt powerful monsters for loot. Encounter horrors beyond your comprehension. An open world game filled with challenges to overcome, bosses, enemy encounters, puzzles and mysteries to solve.

details.title: Keep Leapin'
details.short_description: A challenging yet satisfying parkour game about Harry, a heartbroken worm who wants to become more attractive to the ladies by mastering the art of Leapin'. Unfortunately for Harry, becoming a Leaper is tough business.

details.title: Hoptale
details.short_description: Hoptale is a Roguelite adventure that fuses hopscotch with a slot machine. Play as Tuby, a rabbit whose only weapon is his jump, against the awakened God of Chaos. In battle the tiles below spin into reels — call the stop, line up attacks, strike. Collect tiles, build your run, outsmart chaos.

details.title: Infinium: A Spaceboy's Tale
details.short_description: Follow the journey of Leo in a classical 2D platformer. Where 2 different worlds come together uncover an intriguing story. Explore diverse lands, fight unique enemies, and unlock new skills.

details.title: Warbound
details.short_description: Build a battlefield that evolves from Stone age battles into futuristic mechanised warfare. Demo is LIVE

details.title: A Totally Realistic Stealth Game
details.short_description: Become a stealth soldier fighting through enemy lines using whatever methods you see fit to stay undetected in this first-person shooter. Take a slow, methodical approach or go guns-blazing; as long as you remain undiscovered, any means to success is viable.

details.title: Recepta: Incarnation — Part I
details.short_description: A dark fantasy RPG where two rival faiths clash over humanity’s future. Experience a cinematic story inspired by comic books, with fast turn-based battles.

details.title: Farming and fighting on Island
details.short_description: When the Black Calamity falls, monsters hunt by night—devouring livestock and crops alike. Farm, fortify, hire mercenaries, and defend your remote island in Farming And Fighting On Island.

details.title: Best Laid Plans
details.short_description: An army building strategy game where you must embark on a campaign to retake The Household from an evil regime of unknown origin. As the Commander of your forces, collect units, establish bases, and deploy troops to turn back the enemy tide, exploring unique locations along the way.

details.title: Codename TCT
details.short_description: The battle for Crimson Tide has begun.

details.title: Jordi & Oslo: The Lost Tail
details.short_description: Jordi & Oslo and the Lost Tail is a humorous point and click adventure game. Explore beautiful watercolour- painted locations, interact with quirky characters, and solve witty puzzles to help Jordi and Sigrid investigate the disappearance of their missing friend Oslo.

details.title: Spells Dungeon
details.short_description: Spells Dungeon is a roguelike dungeon crawler adventure with multiple endings and a challenging adventure for those who dare to try.

details.title: Don't Get Caught!
details.short_description: A stealth platformer where you control both the hero and the cameras. Evade security systems, manipulate switches and keycards, and outsmart the surveillance to escape a high-security lab.

details.title: END: Awakening
details.short_description: END: Awakening is a greek myth-inspired, action-adventure survival game that throws you and your friends into a terrifying zombie apocalypse. Fight to survive the relentless undead by scavenging, crafting, and building in an expansive co-op experience. Can you live through the END?

details.title: Rise of Realms
details.short_description: Rise of Realms is a 4X RPG, for 1-6 players, in a medieval fantasy setting. Command an empire and recruit heroes to lead your armies. Use your tactical abilities to conquer the lands and reshape them in your image. Wishlist now.

details.title: Everise
details.short_description: Reach the top of the Tower before raiders destroy your town. Scavenge the furniture and loot monsters to collect resources along the way, then empty your inventory down balconies to upgrade and defend your town!

details.title: Garden of Ants
details.short_description: Become the architect of a thriving ant colony in this real-time simulation. Establish and evolve your ant colony, grow specialized worker castes, cultivate fungus, and explore a living world above and below ground where day and night bring shifting challenges and resources.

details.title: Dangerous Connections
details.short_description: 1987. The Soviet Union is cracking from within. As special agent Dan Morris, navigate a world of shifting loyalties, covert operations, and ideological fractures in this story-driven Cold War FPS.

details.title: Mouse Holme
details.short_description: Your precious mouse home has been destroyed! 🐭 Start from scratch, build a thriving nest... and defeat the villainous cats! 🐈

details.title: Enemy Metal
details.short_description: 2.5D Roguelite Shooter with Unique Gameplay, Powerful Weapons and a Killer Soundtrack. Battle the dangerous enemies and defend the planets of the Sunstar System! Gather crystals and destroy turrets to level up and unlock exciting new Starships on each planet!

name: Steel Runner - VR Block Craft Sandbox

details.title: Steel Runner - VR Block Craft Sandbox
details.short_description: Steel Runner is a VR vehicle crafting sandbox game using physics. Create your own unique vehicle by combining various types of blocks, then ride it to enjoy free exploration, adventure, and combat in an open-world environment. Shape your ideal vehicle and explore this vast world!

details.title: Escape From The Past
details.short_description: A scientist is stranded in the Bronze Age with a dead time machine and a pocket knife. Raid the valley for materials, survive Scythian warriors and wild animals, and work through the history of technology, from a sharpened stick to the first battery, to get back home.

details.title: Paschalis TD
details.short_description: Build and upgrade towers to defend yourself against various enemies.

details.title: Detective of the Dead
details.short_description: You are a dead detective in the Mexican afterworld trying to find your killer. Undercover you prepare unique tacos to make suspects confess. Find clues and solve puzzles. Step into the shoes of your dog, Xolo, and do magical things. Save the Día de los Muertos.

details.title: Questing
details.short_description: A satirical love-letter to classic 16-bit adventure games, about a chosen hero who never wanted to be chosen.

details.title: Retro Game Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own Video Game Store in 1984. Everyday until the end of 1989 gives you the opportunity to stock shelves, cycle your inventory, manage your prices, and analyze historical trends to make your game store profitable. Use era-relevant technology and systems to prove that gaming is not dead!

details.title: Age of Enlightenment
details.short_description: Shape the destiny of the world as an 18th century ruler. Forge alliances and prepare your armed forces to expand your domain and colonize new lands. Or focus on internal development and help your subjects thrive with prudent economic policy and lawmaking. The choice is yours in Age of Enlightenment!

details.title: Schizophrenia: R.EM. Protocol
details.short_description: Schizophrenia is a game where you have to not go crazy and get out of the bunker. Use all the items you can find to survive. Remember. The main thing is not to go crazy. And further. Don't make loud noises. They can hear you.

details.title: ISO-CORE
details.short_description: Farm, craft, build, and explore a Beautiful isometric pixel art world. Explore new places and find new biomes to expand your list of items, buildings, and recipes.

details.title: Rover's Tale
details.short_description: A creature-collecting metroidvania, in a world where dogs live on forever amongst the stars as Space Rovers! Become a LAIKA Rover! Catch & research creatures, then use their abilities to explore a new frontier! Upgrade & customize, as you help your canine companions to unravel an ancient mystery!

details.title: Critical Upload
details.short_description: Embark on a fast-paced action journey through space, discovering new weapons and abilities through acquisition and research to better each run. Invite friends to experience it with you!

details.title: Figure KnockOut
details.short_description: Prepare for an no-nonsense fighting experience in Figure KnockOut! Drawing inspiration from the Guilty Gear series and the Smash Bros series, this game combines the best of 2D fighting and platform fighting with innovative accessibility features to offer an intense, yet user-friendly combat system.

details.title: Angel
details.short_description: ANGEL imbues breakbeats with networked aesthetics in this rhythm/racing adventure. In a network devastated by digital climate change, what does it mean to be connected?

details.title: Watch Out For Goblins!
details.short_description: The world's most accurate goblin simulation! Run and jump a ragdoll goblin through this hilarious physics adventure! Gobland is in trouble! Find the lost cogs, restore power, and become goblin royalty! Alone- or with a friend in split-screen, there's no stopping the BIG GOBLIN ENERGY!

details.title: Uncursed
details.short_description: Be Uncursed like every soul, Sent to save them, that’s your goal. With a crew or on your own, Venture through dungeons unknown. On Isles and seas, adventures await, With the perils that won't abate. But when night falls, hurry back quick; While the light fades, shadows grow thick.

details.title: SOS: Forgotten Planet
details.short_description: A survival horror where Morse code is the key to everything. Tap it to open doors. Listen and decode it to crack open supply caches. Every run rebuilds the lab. And it hides a different truth to uncover. Survive it, and walk away actually knowing Morse.

details.title: Meowmentum
details.short_description: Run, young Meowcolyte - finish the elders' speed trials and become a conduit of Meowmentum! Harness your paw-kour skills, dash through magic orbs, and race against the world!

details.title: Arcade Space Survivor
details.short_description: Fight against waves of enemies to become the ultimate space survivor. Arcade Space Survivor is an arcade-styled action-roguelike. The game offers an innovative and unique experience within the survivors-like genre.

details.title: Gravitee Wars
details.short_description: Battle across the galaxy in this turn-based space artillery game. Use the gravity of destructible planets to launch your shots at the enemy until only one team remains.Unlock new gear for your team members in the single player campaign and online multiplayer modes.

details.title: Polyroll Pocket
details.short_description: An all new, Pocket-Sized adventure starring Polyroll! Kaiser Kiwi has landed on the moon with a diabolical plan to wipe out the Polyrolls. You'll need to uncover secrets, reclaim the stolen batteries from Kiwi's goons, and power up your rocket ship to blast off for the final confrontation!

details.title: Onslaught Rift
details.short_description: An arcade hack and slash where you rapidly switch between three heroes to decimate waves of enemies! Master each of the heroes' abilities as you fight your way through dangerous areas, each with unique monsters and bosses.

details.title: Elidriel
details.short_description: Elidriel is a story-driven pixel-art RPG that combines reactive turn-based combat with character customisation, a range of non-combat activities and a mystery surrounding a lost love. Explore a world of wonders, crafting, cooking, fishing, playing songs and mining gems to upgrade your weapons.

details.title: Vaunted
details.short_description: The score of a lifetime hangs in the balance – can three cut-throat criminals look past their differences to pull it off? A story of bullets, bravado, and brazen lies unfolds across a galaxy of treasure hunters and crime syndicates in this sci-fi tactical RPG.

details.title: Rocket Penguin
details.short_description: A challenging flying game controlled with just two buttons. How high you can fly is another story. Now join Peeo and dive into the world of penguins, soaring to space. Push your limits and become a true flying legend!

details.title: Reinforced Machine
details.short_description: A fast-paced mech arena shooter mixing arcade intensity with skill-based unlocks. Unleash powerful ultimate forms, mix and match skills to define your playstyle, and master each unique combat machine to unlock their signature abilities.

details.title: Ecosphere
details.short_description: A Fantasy / Steampunk Visual Novel in which you'll make hearts skip a beat! You are Arane Kross, a talented engineer capable of controlling nature with a machine: the Ecosphere! What will be your impact?

details.title: Isolation One
details.short_description: Exciting action with puzzle elements and an interesting plot, which takes place on the huge spaceship Transporter P18. In this game, players will encounter an incredible mixture of science fiction and horror. Immerse yourself in a dark world where you need to survive at any cost.

details.title: Herosbine : The Unknown Island
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious open world, battle hundreds of uniquely assembled Herosbines, and claim their Hero Parts to combine their powers and shape your own combat style. Guide Tim through a story-rich journey of grief, identity, and self-discovery.

details.title: Trivals
details.short_description: A team hero sport with one rule: no passes, no score. Pass to charge the Elderball, borrow your teammate’s power, and take down the enemy Guardian, a goal that fights back and evolves with every hit.

details.title: Jeller Fellers
details.short_description: Bounce, squish, and launch through a vibrant, stylized world in Jeller Fellers, where you *attempt* to control a wobbly jelly cube. Solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and explore diverse environments in this challenging, physics-based precision platformer

details.title: DollHouse: survive  or death
details.short_description: A stately, huge, beautiful mansion... Where is this?Opened the door of the mansion with a nervous heart, and the moment , I knew there was no turning back.

details.title: Fishing Echoes
details.short_description: Fishing Echoes is a fantasy fishing game where you catch elemental fish to save the realm from a world-devouring maelstrom.

details.title: Breach Signal
details.short_description: Breach Signal is a 1-6 player co-op cosmic horror game. As a recruit of the FNA, lead expeditions into strange places and investigate mysterious anomalies that threaten our reality.

details.title: Conquest of Eldinar
details.short_description: Conquest of Eldinar is a Action Combat / Real Time Strategy hybrid game where you choose from one of 16 different Factions to play as while you build your base, train an army, and engage in large scale battles. The game supports both single-player campaigns and online multi-player matches.

details.title: DRINKRIME
details.short_description: On the first day of a long weekend, you pick up a talking liquor bottle on a bridge. It's Jin, a demon judged by the Demon King. Cursed to stay by his side, you team up to Jinterrogate sinners hiding around town. A Fill-in-the-Crime Interrogation Adventure in retro, limited-palette pixel art.

details.title: RADMINTON
details.short_description: Become a super rad parkour vigilante and fight back against ADCO. Experience over-the-top action and comical gunfights against 'the big corpo' as you traverse through movement-based levels and puzzles. A 3D-action parkour movement shooter where you can customize, style, rebel, and keep it RAD!

details.title: Fortune and Glory
details.short_description: Fortune & Glory is a text-parser action RPG about leaving home to become a hero! Decide who you are as you explore an ailing world in a detailed retro-inspired style. Gain help from your personalities and their internal dialogue to solve puzzles and fight monsters in a realtime battle system.

details.title: Department of Gravity Management
details.short_description: Starting a new job is tough. But when your boss is a clueless AI, things get weird. Navigate your way through a seemingly abandoned space station in this gravity-defying FPS Metroidvania. Solve physics-based puzzles, interact with tools in your environment, and find out what happened.

details.title: Path For The Seeker
details.short_description: Path For The Seeker is a detective adventure in which a young nun investigates the disappearance of a famous inventor in a city on the border of two worlds.

details.title: Moons That Belong
details.short_description: Embark on a journey of strategy and domination in Moons That Belong, a 2D space strategy game that challenges your tactical prowess. Command your fleet, conquer planets, and outsmart your opponents in this visually captivating and intellectually engaging adventure.

details.title: ノウ
details.short_description: "Know" is a cute, eerie, and slightly melancholic adventure game. Explore, evade "Kaibutsu" (monsters), and uncover the secrets of this world!

details.title: Club House on Haunted Hill
details.short_description: A story driven golf game, challenge friends locally or online or experience the cinematic story. Customize your golfer with the right set of clubs and delve into a haunted golfing adventure!

details.title: 下九泉
details.short_description: 《下九泉》是一款国产剧情向解谜游戏。主角孟存真死后魂归地府，成为行走于九泉的实习判官。孟存真从一个因受诅咒而不能入轮回的亡魂展开调查，追寻亡者被诅咒的真相。游戏围绕人性中“贪、嗔、痴、慢、疑”展开5个截然不同的单元故事。不到最后一刻，你永远想不到事件背后令人细思极恐的真相…

details.title: Bagsy
details.short_description: Dive into the colorful and captivating world of Bagsy, an infiltration game where cunning and strategy are your best weapons! Take on the role of a daring thief whose goal is to steal carefully guarded treasures from a variety of shops and banks.

details.title: Neon Rush
details.short_description: Speed through a neon city in this 2D retro racing game. Outsmart cops and rivals with skillful maneuvers. Immerse yourself in illegal racing, fueled by synthwave beats, and dominate as the underworld's top racer!

details.title: LlamaRPG: Farm to Fable
details.short_description: A JRPG that brings you face to face with challenging combat, class customization, and tough choices. Trade items, create unique characters and fight other players. Bring your llama to greener pastures while never running out of things to explore or enemies to vanquish.

details.title: Chikaro
details.short_description: A boy and an android girl wake up without their memories in a world where deadly robots roam the streets. With the boy's powers, they can leave their bodies to walk through walls or possess enemies. The two follow the trail of the intentions left behind by those who once perished above the ground.

details.title: Safo and The Moon Warriors
details.short_description: In a world where the sun no longer rises, Prince Safo must rescue his sister from Argus, a mysterious one-eyed monster. Joined by diverse companions, this adventure RPG features beautiful illustrations and a novel-like story as players uncover secrets in this sunless world.

details.title: CountDown
details.short_description: CountDown is a casual, semi-idle, 2D tower-defense. Waves of enemies are advancing, it's your job to bolster your city, or rather, ammunition, and wipe them out. Will you rise to the challenge, or let your city crumble?

details.title: Icebreaker
details.short_description: Icebreaker is a co-op action roguelike for 1-3 players. Keep a watchful eye on the actions of your PROWLER units, as they deploy to complete endless missions in ever-changing and very hostile facilities.

details.title: Incline ~Railway of devil's valley~
details.short_description: An action adventure with a quirky battle system that uses an inclined railway to carry and seal devils to a sacred boundary. Robbed of his weapons, the unarmed hero must keep dodging devil attacks in the cargo bed of an inclined railway until he reaches the sacred boundary at top floor of village!

details.title: Wildforge Hero
details.short_description: Defend against waves of enemies in this minimalistic roguelite game with base building and RPG elements. Collect resources and Craft new gear! Build structures to gain bonuses and new perks!

details.title: Autofahrt
details.short_description: A storm is gathering and devouring everything. Drive for your life alone or with friends and escape the deadly storm. Repair and keep your vehicle intact, it's the only way to reach the bunker and survive.

details.title: A Short Odyssey
details.short_description: Discover a mysterious 17th century Caribbean island. Perfect your swordplay, take on giant bosses, cook tasty dishes, or take in the scenery, it's your choice in this 3rd Person RPG. Investigate the secrets of the island while you freely explore a detailed simulated world.

details.title: The Telwynium
details.short_description: A 90s fantasy adventure epic from the creator of The Drifter- It's your first night away from Willows Dene, and you have first watch.

details.title: Trivia Deal
details.short_description: Trivia Deal is the world’s first trivia roguelike. Answer fast. Play smart. Use lifelines, swap cards, and relics to survive the Rainbow Reaper. Each run is unforgiving, one wrong answer can end it all. High-stakes strategy with random questions, categories, and rewards that keep every run fresh.

name: Academia Z: The beginning of the catastrophe

details.title: Academia Z: The beginning of the catastrophe
details.short_description: A third-person action video game set in a post-apocalyptic world of zombies in an anime style. Emilia, along with other students, will try to survive in a hostile environment full of difficulties and enemies they will have to face. Will anyone survive?

details.title: Escape Alliance
details.short_description: An addictive escape game in a low poly style. You will face waves of enemies and lots of obstacles that will try to stop you from reaching the the end. As you progress the difficulty increases. Choose between several maps with different terrain and obstacles. Play alone or with up to 12 friends.

details.title: 90FX
details.short_description: Straight from the 90s, 90FX recreates the feel and experience of once revolutionary racing games of the early 90s. 90s Kids will remember this.

details.title: Weebles vs Grebals
details.short_description: Battle endless Grebals in a fast-paced isometric roguelike bullet hell. Master unique Weebles, create powerful builds, and survive solo or in online co-op.

details.title: ABSTRACTICA
details.short_description: In this fast-paced third person shooter with roguelike elements, you are tasked with recovering art that has mysteriously gone rogue. Fight abstract shapes like triangles, tangrams and even an abstract Mona Lisa to uncover the mystery of ABSTRACTICA.

details.title: Roots Of Ruin
details.short_description: Build your defenses, fight beside them, and reclaim your kingdom from the corruption. Expand your land, command powerful towers, and take direct control of one of four unique heroes to defend against relentless enemy waves and devastating bosses.

details.title: Isle of trees
details.short_description: Revive the lost forests of the Isle of Trees in this cosy open-world game. Wander around, make friends, catch worms, and restore forests back to life! Dinner’s at seven!

details.title: Curse of Dominion
details.short_description: Lead captains in grid-based battles across a conquest map where every victory expands your territory and income. Invest in regions, upgrade gear, and build class paths and loyalty bonds in a campaign focused on strategy, growth, and momentum.

details.title: Loco: Rails & Tails
details.short_description: Chaotic co-op for 1–4 players! Build rails, protect the train and deliver cargo on time. Pick your favourite animal hero and embark with your friends on wild west adventure!

details.title: Elemental Shifter
details.short_description: Elemental Shifter is a top-down 2D roguelite where you harness the power of 'Elemental Shifting' adapting your abilities based on the last damage you took. Choose your path, battle mages, grow stronger, discover new weapons and defeat powerful bosses on your way to the Mage King.

details.title: Astro Amigo
details.short_description: ASTRO AMIGO is a story-driven sci-fi adventure game where a bullied kid named Austin searches for his missing dog, Amigo. Explore a strange Wisconsin town, uncover its secrets, play nostalgic mini-games, and make story-shaping choices as the mystery unfolds.

details.title: SUPER ADVENTURE
details.short_description: Turn around to parry and block! Equipped with a shield on your back, jump your way through vivid levels, meet funny characters, and face challenging bosses. Fight using a quick-firing Alien Blaster or a melee-focused sword! Choose the path you want to go in this SUPER ADVENTURE!

details.title: Grapple Car
details.short_description: A car with a grappling hook! Twist and turn with tight driving controls around colorful tracks to complete challenges, customize your car, and race for a spot at the timed global online leaderboards.

details.title: Into the Rootforge
details.short_description: Into the Rootforge is a unique fusion of runner, roguelike and card-based action combat. Master customisable attacks to delve further with each attempt. Uncover the secrets of the Rootforge and grow your true power through the skill trees of The Garden.

details.title: Clawback: Police Corruption Simulator
details.short_description: A narrative-focused crooked cop game. Manipulate death investigations and file false evidence to reap ill-gotten gains in a dystopian future. Save yourself.

details.title: Miniature Painter Simulator
details.short_description: Take up the amazing hobby of miniature painting! Run your own online store selling your painted miniatures & handling various jobs from clients. Create the most amazing miniatures with minimal limitations and even import your own custom models! Take a seat, grab a brush and relax.

details.title: Swarm Chess
details.short_description: Chess with thousands of pieces. Place your towers then relax and watch the chaos of battle unfold in this incremental auto battler.

details.title: Hell Loop
details.short_description: A rogue-like dungeon crawler with Chinese mythic horror. Play as an ancient butcher, trapped in the cycles of the underworld. Seek redemption, gain the aid of heavenly gods, and fight for freedom—and for the wife you still love.

details.title: Full Steam Undead
details.short_description: OPEN WORLD STEAM TRAIN + ZOMBIE VR ACTION! Ride the rune train, explore Necropolis Island and slay the undead. For Queen Victoria, it's time to roll: all aboard for undead destruction!

details.title: Dreamcraft: Lumberjack
details.short_description: Chop the sick trees to purify the forests. Gather lumber, upgrade your axe, and improve stats. No rush, no stress, relax in cozy and beautiful lands, rescue animals, and unravel the secrets of the wilderness. Nature must be preserved so cut the shadow and restore the light!

details.title: SPELLOT
details.short_description: A survivors-like where your spells are written by a slot machine. Stop three reels and the spell parts you land combine into a spell. Burning swords rain down. Frozen shields circle you. Giant hammers pierce the horde. Fight off the horde and defeat the boss.

details.title: Gambit
details.short_description: A chess roguelike where every run bends the rules. Build your army, wield powerful kings, and survive deadly variants on your way to proving a human can still beat the machine. Shape your build, outlast the chaos, and choose when to command the board yourself.

details.title: Threaded Dungeons
details.short_description: A world threaded in death. Can you cultivate a party of four that defies all odds? Make every action count in tactical turn-based combat. Choose your allegiances carefully. Scour dungeons in search of loot and secrets. Resist or acquiesce to tempting whispers in the darkness.

details.title: HOLE WAR -The Abyss-
details.short_description: 「今こそ語りましょう。『もしも』の物語を……！」本作は、「職」と「食」から力を得て戦う長編RPGの体験版です。時には職業を変えて新たなスキルや能力を得て、時には料理を食べて一時的なバフを得て冒険しましょう。

details.title: Wanderdawn
details.short_description: Explore various worlds in a hack-and-slash action game - In a world ravaged by an unknown disaster, face various monsters with the diverse weapons you find.

details.title: Warmongers: Empires Reborn
details.short_description: A single player RPG inspired by oldschool MMORPGs created by a Solo dev. Play as an Orc, Saurak or Human. Explore an open world, complete quests and fight your way through dungeons and raids. Master all of your gathering and crafting skills.

details.title: Flow of Fortune
details.short_description: Build fortunes in a digital board game of economy, strategy, and no violence. Manage time, expand businesses, and shape your success.

details.title: High Mountain Abbey
details.short_description: Do you dare to meddle with the mad god? High Mountain Abbey is a stop-motion point-and-click puzzle game that throws you into a strange space. Navigate hand-crafted and photographed dioramas and solve trippy mechanical challenges to contain the forces of madness that have swallowed the abbey.

details.title: Mindbreak
details.short_description: Mindbreak is an exploration driven tile-based puzzle adventure game about the escape from a corrupted insane asylum. Play as the supernaturally gifted asylum patients as you build and combine their unique abilities to explore and master the vast interconnected asylum.

details.title: Warlocks Maze
details.short_description: A Warlock has unleashed chaos upon the World of Eld! Lead a band of heroes into his shifting labyrinth in this brutal turn-based dungeon crawler. Outsmart deadly foes, conquer traps, and adapt to ever-changing challenges. Will you emerge victorious or be lost to the maze forever?

details.title: Netcode Warriors
details.short_description: ⁤Dive into the datascape of 'Netcode Warriors', an anime-style arena fighter designed from the ground up to take competitive play to its limits. Engage in intense 1-v-1 fights, master unique characters and playstyles, then take your skills to the arena. ⁤

details.title: REVENGE CRYSTAL
details.short_description: Awaken in a fallen knight’s body, kept alive by a mysterious living crystal. Explore a ruined world with top-down Soulslike combat, elemental magic, and Metroidvania progression. You are not the knight—you are the will driving him.

details.title: Upon Dusk
details.short_description: Welcome to the world of Upon Dusk, a new PvPvE survival shooter. Set in Avalon, you were sealed in a city that was left for dead while the government finds out what went wrong outside the walls. Will you survive?

details.title: GameChanger - Episode 1
details.short_description: Take on the challenge to close the Great Five Portals in this varied 2D-Action-Adventure with Twin-Stick-Shooter Gameplay! Explore the vast Interworld, solve tricky puzzles in complex dungeons, shoot your way through hordes of mysterious entities and stop the dragon!

details.title: triMIno
details.short_description: A tile-matching roguelike. triMIno is a satisfyingly strategic tile puzzler where you crack open booster packs, draft your perfect tile set, and connect colours and shapes to unleash huge scoring chains. Every tile counts. How far can you push your next run?

details.title: Nomad: Steppeborn Saga
details.short_description: Nomad: Steppeborn Saga is an open world co-op survival crafting adventure set in a vast, ever changing world of nomadic culture. Explore, trade, forge alliances, and face threats while packing up camp, migrating, and forging your legacy.

details.title: The Whims of the Gods
details.short_description: The Whims of the Gods is a strategic, cooperative city-builder created for joint gameplay in online co-op mode. Build and protect the ancient city, face enemies, and manage resources together! 🏠

details.title: Backrooms
details.short_description: Explore an abandoned liminal space. Uncover dark secrets through eerie exploration and environmental storytelling. Evade unpredictable supernatural entities and face psychological horror. Will you reveal the truth or become another lost soul?

details.title: FLASHLOOP
details.short_description: Survive on a dreadful planet. Explore a large, interconnected world. Gain new abilities, upgrade your weapons, and uncover secrets. Defeat treacherous bosses and reveal the dark secrets of this dreadful planet.

details.title: Ashwood Conspiracy
details.short_description: Ashwood Conspiracy is a dark Slavic mystery adventure. Follow in your late uncle's footsteps to uncover the truth behind the town’s most devastating event. Find, collect, and combine items to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles. Will you dare to finish what your uncle started?

details.title: FATAL HEELZ
details.short_description: Third-person, cyberpunk-vampire brutal action game. Play as Silo, a female vampire-assassin. Kill your target and uncover the secrets behind the organization you work for.

details.title: Gatto's Pizzeria
details.short_description: Run a cozy first-person pizzeria as an adorable cat! Prepare authentic Neapolitan pizzas step by step, serve hungry human customers, and upgrade your restaurant with new recipes, ovens, and decorations while relaxing in a hand-drawn 3D kitchen.

details.title: Project TurboBlast
details.short_description: Drift, boost, and spin around corners at BLASTING SPEEDS in this stylish Singleplayer + Multiplayer Arcade Racing game, Blending the familiar drifting of Kart racers and tight responsive handling of classic Anti-Gravity racing games. With a focus on being easy to pick up but difficult to master.

details.title: Avante! Atlantis
details.short_description: Lead the world's greatest Strategists through a virtual war. Decide how humanity will approach the mysterious island of Atlantis.

details.title: BLACKOUT: Zero Point
details.short_description: Blackout is a hardcore co-op shooter for up to 4 players. Become a near-future special forces operative and eliminate infected creatures and monsters fused with machines. Complete missions through intense combat and teamwork, and escape the hellish battlefield.

details.title: Egypt
details.short_description: Command the sands of Egypt in this epic RTS! Build magnificent cities, lead mythic armies, and harness the power of the gods. Shape the Nile, forge alliances, and rise to become Pharaoh in a world of strategy, intrigue, and breathtaking battles. Your legacy awaits—rule wisely!

details.title: Univoyager
details.short_description: Experience a 1:1 scale, procedurally generated universe with seamless exploration from planets to stars. Journey across the cosmos with zero loading screens and realistic Newtonian physics. Trade, fight, and survive in a post-apocalyptic galaxy where gravity is your only boundary.

details.title: Effective Immediately
details.short_description: All intergalactic travel passes through the orbital relay checkpoint. Verify ID discrepancies, repair vehicle systems and struggle against ethical dilemmas as you negotiate a shifting political landscape. Report for duty, Effective Immediately.

details.title: Shallow Pond
details.short_description: A cozy 3d platformer full of secrets where you explore vibrant worlds across land and water. Developed by solo developer Nimso.

details.title: Middle Ages: Peasants & Knights
details.short_description: Survive in an open world inspired by 14th century Europe. Immerse yourself in crafting based on real historical methods and experience true inventory system and realistic resource management. Take control of your destiny and embrace a world full of possibilities.

details.title: Between the Lines
details.short_description: In this pre-smartphone-era text adventure, use that good ol’ T9 phone to text your way through the highs and lows of school days. Choose replies piece by piece to shape your own story. Friendships grow; feelings get complicated; secrets flicker. Every reply matters—it all happens Between the Lines.

details.title: Aerocore
details.short_description: Aerocore is a liminal walking simulator about the future they promised you and never arrived. Explore the corporation's simulation environments in this atmospheric experience. Alter the architecture by solving puzzles in impossible spaces and lose yourself in nostalgic aesthetics.

details.title: Age of Amelorn
details.short_description: Recruit unique units, cast powerful spells, and conquer your enemies in a 2D fantasy strategy adventure. Tackle a challenging campaign or dive into Skirmish Mode to create and customize your own battles.

details.title: Rasna
details.short_description: "Rasna" is an historically accurate Etruscan tale: a legend as it might have been told in ancient times when people gathered around the fire. A single-player, story-driven historical open-world game to jump 2500 years in the past.

details.title: Fear of Horror
details.short_description: In 1944, you take on the role of Jason Miles. On behalf of the OSS, you are sent to a waterworks near the Schneiden in the heart of Germany, because according to reports, a Nazi scientist is researching how to resurrect fallen soldiers as ghosts.

details.title: End the Endless
details.short_description: End the Endless is a dark fantasy Monster Collector set in the Purgatorial Realms. Harness every resource at your disposal, including your own party members to slay a variety of horrors. Explore the Afterlife, meet the ones who call this land home and seek to conquer the Seven Terraces.

details.title: Vox Manipuli
details.short_description: The king is dead! Tame chaos in this unconventional strategy with autobattler and puzzle elements, set in a fantasy setting. As the King's Regent, manage your Councilors so that they vote accordingly to your will. Manipulate, trigger synergies and win debates!

details.title: Dawn Watcher
details.short_description: Lead your army

details.title: Voyage Router
details.short_description: The further you go, the more the universe turns against you. Voyage Router is a navigation-driven roguelite strategy game where you explore dimensional oceans, chart optimal paths, and risk everything for a greater haul.

name: The Haunting of the Chea-Wilson Family

details.title: The Haunting of the Chea-Wilson Family
details.short_description: A Cambodian-American family becomes haunted by a ghost. Enjoy this story-driven narrative as the haunting unfolds. Inspired by horror movies in the late 2000s-2010s.

name: Mystic Academy: Escape Room VR Edition

details.title: Mystic Academy: Escape Room VR Edition
details.short_description: The VR version of your wizarding exam is here! Within this enchanting escape room, you'll navigate a wizardry school, unravel puzzles, master new spells, and put your magical skills to the ultimate test. Will you emerge triumphant?

details.title: Contagion Protocol
details.short_description: Survive an endless undead horde in this brutal auto-battling roguelike. Slash, upgrade, and evolve your arsenal as chaos unfolds to the pulse of an industrial metal soundtrack. Contagion Protocol is fast, bloody, and built for replayability.

details.title: Saw Counter
details.short_description: The killer is here, and now he's coming for you!!He will put you through trials, play with your emotions, your mind, and your body. Are you ready?

details.title: Fizz Flow: Factory Management
details.short_description: Fizz Flow is a strategy and management game that takes place in a setting without competition regulations. In old America, where the beverage industry is on the rise, build your own factory, make your own unique recipes, weaken your opponents and maintain your hard earned success at the market!

details.title: Tramp: Become President
details.short_description: Start from picking through trash, collecting, crafting, and trading hundreds of items. Explore sewers, hire workers, run businesses, withhold wages, dodge taxes, and buy votes on the black market. Turn trash into assets, and assets into power. One day, you too will sit atop the President's desk.

details.title: Death By Pixel
details.short_description: Death By Pixel is an action RPG shooter with exploration elements. Experiment with elemental weapon combinations, exploit enemy weaknesses and trade your defenses for devastating abilities.

details.title: One More Depth
details.short_description: A fast-paced, 4-player co-op action RPG. As an orphan, dive into twisted realms to retrieve the legendary "Precious." Don't let the cute art fool you—lethal threats await in the abyss. Dual-Class Builds: Mix and match classes with diverse loot to craft thousands of unique combat styles.

details.title: Talas
details.short_description: Shoot your way across deep space. Shred through waves of enemies, unravel the secrets hiding beneath the surface, and explore the endless synergies in this retro-inspired action roguelike.

details.title: serverBound
details.short_description: Corporate AI broke the internet, so people rebuilt it by hand. Now something is eating it. Walk their paper-and-ink web islands, read each one like a crime scene and work out the rule of whatever's attacking it. Then fight it in a turn-based duel with no dice, no levels and no excuses.

details.title: Survivors Guild
details.short_description: A survivors-like bullet heaven with 1-4 player ONLINE CO-OP. Battle across the realm and take on hordes of monsters! Strategically choose your weapons and items to craft powerful builds, challenge bosses, and complete quests. Unlock new characters and unleash their unique weapons and abilities.

details.title: 能動的ダンジョン
details.short_description: This game is a simple, high-difficulty RPG for people who are tired of the same old turn-based command-based RPGs.

details.title: EverCastle
details.short_description: Evercastle is the story of a young girl who sets out on an adventure to the mysterious castle. In this magical action RPG, you must master various spells to overcome monsters and traps, defeat powerful enemies, and reach the castle's depths to rescue beloved family.

details.title: 天罚
details.short_description: A 3D xianxia RPG of spell duels. Explore a vast world to hone your cultivation, compete with fellow cultivators in martial arts, and duel to prove your Dao.

details.title: Frontier Control : Invasion
details.short_description: Frontier Control: Invasion is a Real-Time Strategy survival game in which you play the commander of a human space colony under the attack of outer space robots. Build your base, train your colony, and fight herds of enemies and bosses.

details.title: Dr.Mememe want to sleep
details.short_description: The lazy genius scientist "Dr. Mememe," who just wants to sleep forever, has invented Kawaii Sheep that induce sleep with their mysterious healing powers. An exponentially cute sheep-carrying game with expanding production × easy 3D action for casual enjoyment.

details.title: DebugDebut
details.short_description: A debugging simulation game in which you complete debugging requests from a game generation AI that suddenly appears. Debug games of various genres and aim to win high rewards.

details.title: Don't Forget the Phone
details.short_description: Experience a point & click time management game that puts your multi-tasking to the test. Complete all of your tasks before sunrise, but watch out for anything that may have escaped the lab below.

details.title: The Shadow Beneath
details.short_description: Rescue Akhenaten, the banished pharaoh, from an eternity beneath the sands. Wield the gifts of Aten's last disciples, unleash sacred techniques and battle the relentless guardians of the forgotten tombs in a fast-paced Action Roguelike.

details.title: Word To Angel
details.short_description: Play as five human heroes in this pacifist 2D RPG taking place in a world where some friendly (and not so friendly) angels conduct balance and harmony together... and where your only instruments for fighting are words and melodies.

details.title: Bake Until Done
details.short_description: Bake Until Done is a baking-themed, turn-based roguelite. Take control of a muffin as you battle devious desserts to break the spell of a magical bakery that is endangering your town. Fight back with your muffin’s morsels, but be careful not to lose too much…

details.title: Windwalkers: Below the Storm
details.short_description: Lead high-risk surface rescue operations across a storm-scarred Earth. Power your rover, tools, and modular pack with limited energy resources as you recover survivors, salvage critical supplies, and help reclaim the world above.

details.title: Grow Wild
details.short_description: Plant trees and wildflowers, create wildlife habitats, and discover hundreds of creatures in this cozy relaxing nature game. Transform empty landscapes into living ecosystems as you bring nature back to life!

details.title: Storm Settlers
details.short_description: A survival citybuilder set in a desert afflicted by relentless sandstorms. Build, farm, research, clear sand and protect your people from the storms. Will you find water or desolation? Will your settlement thrive or be buried in sand?

details.title: AERA Flying Heroes
details.short_description: An adventure for all those who dream of conquering the skies. Choose your pilot, upgrade your ship, and make battles against waves of enemies and colossal bosses. Collect stars, unlock new missions and write your legend.

details.title: Banquet of Nausea
details.short_description: Banquet of Nausea is a dark fantasy RPG made in RPGMaker. You will play as Liya — a girl on an epic quest to find her lost kin. Explore sacred ruins, purge festering abominations, and forge bonds with survivors whose fates lie in your hands.

details.title: PARALLAXIS
details.short_description: PARALLAXIS is a hardcore, First-Person Slasher, with mind-bending GRAVITY mechanics. Be fast, relentless, optimize your path - even if that means breaking the laws of reality.

details.title: Satoyama Note: Spring Walk
details.short_description: Satoyama Note: Spring Walk is a point-and-click game where you explore the woods in the springtime. Talk with animals and observe plants as you head through the forest on your journey to enjoy a meal under the cherry blossom tree!

details.title: Fecal Freighter
details.short_description: Become a sewage truck operator and survive the foul dangers: drive your ZIL, battle sludge demons, complete tasks, explore a grim world, and uncover the mystery of an alien conspiracy.

details.title: Malloc
details.short_description: Malloc is a short atmospheric exploration game. Wander through a nostalgic city on a summer afternoon, explore on foot or in a utility mech, meet the residents, and bring the district back to life one small repair at a time.

details.title: Bloodfly Keeper
details.short_description: Breed unruly bloodflies, craft forbidden cures, and rise from outcast to underground healer in a city ruled by a corrupt medical regime.

details.title: Typewriter Monkeys
details.short_description: Infinite monkeys with infinite typewriters will eventually write Shakespeare... right? Find out in this cozy automation idler! Strategically place different kinds of monkeys with typewriters then level them up as you type longer and longer words!

details.title: Blackmail Directive
details.short_description: A gripping visual novel set in modern-day Japan, featuring cute anime-style heroines and branching storylines that lead to multiple endings. Every choice you make shapes the story—and determines Arisa's fate.

details.title: Fear Hour
details.short_description: Insane mistakes brought you to a life-or-death judgment. Fight off a terrifying Killer, or kill those who trespass on your territory in this tense (1v5) online experience. Where following your instincts might help you escape, or kill them all.

details.title: Sword of Mejor
details.short_description: A unique rpg experience where you follow the path of a sword, rather than 1 set character! Follow the Sword of Mejor as it travels the lands swapping hands through battles, trades, gifts and more! With more paths and endings to count, every playthrough is different!

details.title: With Dream
details.short_description: This is a story about two doctors who travel back in time to fulfill the last wish of a dying old man.

details.title: Battle Swap
details.short_description: Battle Swap is an auto-battler with a single player campaign and a unique twist: when you win a battle, you trade your deployed units for your enemy’s, rewarding you for using fewer units. Unlock upgrades, items, and spells as you go, and revisit past battles to improve solutions and reclaim units.

details.title: Swingin'!
details.short_description: Swingin’! is a physics-based action game where you stick a pole to your environment to control your character’s movement.

details.title: When Livia Disappeared
details.short_description: A fantasy visual novel set in the 1920s. Perform ritual magic, craft potions, and uncover the secrets of the Order that maintains the balance between worlds.

details.title: Lootspire
details.short_description: Co-op roguelite dungeon crawler for 1–4 players. Pick a class, choose abilities, gear up, and fight through a procedural spire that gets harder the higher you go. Gear and Hero Level reset every run, but Unlockables persist.

details.title: Ismene
details.short_description: The story of Ismene, floating through space with her trusted robot companion, trying to figure out where she is going, and where she came from.

details.title: Taishō Romance Theater
details.short_description: A romance-suspense visual novel set in Taishō Japan. Amnesiac actor Kotori Sakuma grapples with a dear friend's bizarre death, the awakening of his magic, and the blood ties that haunt him. As the truth unravels, shape Kotori's final choice: return to his bloodline's embrace, or pursue true freedom?

details.title: 🎧 Yellowcake - The Audio Game 🎧
details.short_description: A first-person audio game, telling the tale of a blind yet gifted hero. Make your way through a 3D environment without receiving any visual cues. Put all your faith in your ears and help our hero in his quest to uncover the sinister secrets of these twisty uranium mines, which he calls his home.

details.title: Digital Legacy of Zero
details.short_description: Battle with creatures you collect to defeat the evil Ruler of the Digital World. Hack and slash through enemy domains, upgrade your basement to achieve ultimate evolutions, and summon legendary beasts. Unlock powerful upgrades with devastating combos to conquer the Digital World.

details.title: Stellar Raven
details.short_description: On a flying laser tank, fight the armed forces of the Empire and, after overcoming several planets, meet the Empress and fight her in a mortal battle.

details.title: MARINES VS GOD
details.short_description: One of you is God. Up to four friends are Marines on a mission. Finish the objective before time runs out while your friend summons monsters, drops meteors, and ruins your plans. Can the Marines outsmart God?

details.title: Escape Velocity
details.short_description: An explosive first-person puzzler!

details.title: Crow Boss
details.short_description: Feared for countless acts of brutality, the former warrior known only as Boss returns from the depths of Limbo. Betrayed by those he once served, he now walks among the living once more, driven by a single purpose: to take revenge on those responsible for his downfall.

details.title: Morphing
details.short_description: Morphing is a 2D adventure puzzle game where you possess the ability of morphing. This power allows you to transform and acquire the traits of certain objects or creatures. Use this unique skill to overcome challenges and explore the world.

details.title: Embers Of Spiritflame
details.short_description: Embers of Spiritflame is an Emotional Point & Click detective adventure about the exploration of an old abandoned house. Inside, you go through comic book-inspired levels and begin to uncover why everyone is missing. View events and memories of the place and piece the story together.

details.title: Wretch
details.short_description: Find the violent stalker hiding inside an abandoned school. Piece together broken lore and solve a long lost mystery. What happened here and who's to blame?

details.title: Project JS
details.short_description: You are the one chosen by Nezha. This time, you will carry out justice on behalf of Heaven. The player takes on the role of the next Jishen, successor to the novel’s protagonist Jay, becoming the chosen one of Nezha and using pog card to battle demons and spirits.

details.title: Dungeon Ward
details.short_description: Dungeon Ward revives old‑school grid‑based dungeon crawlers and focuses on fast‑paced combat with flexible character progression. Level up, master powerful skills, and defeat challenging bosses in this action‑packed RPG.

details.title: Rise of Lambs : Awakening
details.short_description: 《Rise of the Lambs: Awakening》 is a 3D Roguelike where you play as a young lamb. After a brutal coyote pack invades your peaceful sheep tribe, you must protect your home, uncover the truth, and awaken your powers to stop the war and save the world from apocalypse.

details.title: Rogue Battalion
details.short_description: Command your troops in Rogue Battalion, a WW2 auto-battler blending strategy and action! Build your forces, unlock upgrades, and use powerful abilities like airstrikes and artillery to survive relentless waves. With meta progression and endless tactics, every run brings new challenges.

details.title: Blitloop
details.short_description: A fast-paced, side-scrolling retro shooter where you play as “Blit" on a mission to rescue orb pods. Blast enemy swarms and face off against bosses in this bullet-hell shoot 'em up. Earn power-ups and get ready for fluid arcade action in a stylish world with an 80s synthwave soundtrack.

details.title: THREAT VECTOR
details.short_description: Battle across the solar system as annihilation looms over mankind in this action sci-fi horror FPS. Powered by id Tech, THREAT VECTOR delivers classic FPS combat throughout a suite of concise, potent levels infested with deadly horrors… and loaded with enough firepower to destroy them all.

details.title: Dignaut
details.short_description: Take on a peaceful mining mission that leads to something far more mysterious. Dig, upgrade your tools, and slowly awaken an ancient alien temple buried beneath the surface, bringing its forgotten music and light back to life.

name: 恋爱泡馍！青春老陕：Shannxi Love Story

details.title: 恋爱泡馍！青春老陕：Shannxi Love Story
details.short_description: Shannxi Love Story is a visual novel-style game set against the backdrop of university life in Shaanxi, infused with local cultural flavors. Discover Chinese culture through a brand-new lens, explore the youthful spirit of Xi'an, and discover the myriad possibilities life has to offer.

details.title: In Another World
details.short_description: In this Isekai Anime RPG. Enjoy a more realistic skills system. Bring a race to extinction. Or live the quiet life farming in a pocket dimension. Fast paced real-time combat. Mostly medieval ecstatic. Hope you enjoy and find all and more of what you are looking for in another world.

details.title: RE:AKTOR
details.short_description: RE:AKTOR is a metroidvania about going fast and rewinding time. Race the clock, unlock new abilities and shortcuts, and solve temporal puzzles. Tear through walls and enemies with damage that scales with momentum, and punch ever deeper into a mysterious underground facility.

details.title: Rage of the Elder Gods
details.short_description: Rage of the Elder Gods is a turn-based tactical game blending board game mechanics with RPG elements. Hunt down fanatical cults across the mythical locations of H.P. Lovecraft’s universe. Face cosmic horror and survive the madness!

details.title: Appa
details.short_description: Appa is a surreal narrative-driven card battler about two siblings dealing with the death of their father. Predict, counter, and outmaneuver manifestations of grief while uncovering a heartfelt story somewhere between dreams and reality.

details.title: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess
details.short_description: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess is a 2D action with metroidvania elements set in a 16th-century fantasy world, drawn with cozy pixels. Explore a mysterious realm, battle ruthless enemies, and uncover powerful weapons and abilities. And remember: beer is the best medicine in these grim times!

details.title: Cereal Reaper
details.short_description: Cereal Reaper is a top-down turn-based RPG with a heavy focus on exploration. Talk and fight your way into finding the greatest breakfast item of all time.

details.title: Clean
details.short_description: Every room has something to hide.

details.title: Ethereal: Clash of Souls
details.short_description: Ethereal is a 6v6 third-person MOBA featuring a first-of-its-kind class system and extreme vertical lane design. Fly, climb, teleport, and destroy as you push lanes to defeat the enemy Elder. Play Early Access for exclusive skins, premium currency, monthly patches, and direct dev feedback.

details.title: WILDERLOCKE
details.short_description: WILDERLOCKE is a tactical monster-taming roguelike. Build up a team of diverse & powerful monsters. Find the perfect combinations of moves, passives & stats to create devastating synergies. Triumph in increasingly challenging 2v2 turn-based battles and become unstoppable.

name: PLEASE KNOCK: The Sloppy Researcher's Life

details.title: PLEASE KNOCK: The Sloppy Researcher's Life
details.short_description: PLEASE KNOCK: The Sloppy Researcher’s Life is a top-down story adventure game about an unusual research life between a sloppy senior student and a helpful junior.

details.title: Prism Warriors DX
details.short_description: The Prism Warriors return for another helping of retro-styled bullet hell action. Face off against the sinister Twilight Four, and fight to save more than just your friends...

details.title: Pin-Crawl
details.short_description: Pin-Crawl is a dungeon crawling pinball rogue-lite! Bop, bash and dash your way through a dungeon of weird and wacky foes as you collect abilities and upgrades on your way to defeating the Evil Sorceress!

details.title: Carcade
details.short_description: CARCADE is a fast-paced racing game with a bold art style by ICONIC GARAGE. Compete in time trials, race against ghost opponents, AI, or real players. Tune your car for different terrains, master hidden mechanics, and unlock secret achievements. Speed, strategy, and skill will define your victory!

details.title: Clawsome
details.short_description: Help Clawby find unique friends in this wholesome adventure! Collect cute figurines with the help of Clawby to create colorful dioramas in this cozy claw machine game.

details.title: Roughly Crafted
details.short_description: Roughly Crafted is a laid-back crafting shop sim with a comedy story and creative freedom. Iron makes a fine sword. So do watermelons, zombie fingers and other things never meant to be weapons. Figure out what customers need, and haggle over every coin while your uncle runs his business schemes.

details.title: Hardkill System
details.short_description: Take control of a powerful mech in this hardcore roguelite mech shooter where every projectile is simulated and hit angle makes all the difference.

details.title: Overrun Protocol
details.short_description: OVERRUN PROTOCOL is a solo survival game where you face hostile machines on a mysterious island. Explore, hack systems, craft weapons, and uncover the secrets of an out-of-control AI. Your survival will depend on your ingenuity and adaptability.

details.title: Project Enceladus
details.short_description: Fourteen scientists dead aboard a station orbiting Enceladus. One survivor: the killer, who encrypted all the data and went silent. Enter his mind, gather evidence, expose his false memories and uncover why. A first-person psychological sci-fi investigation with logic puzzles.

details.title: Vizarri
details.short_description: A monster-taming RPG set on the planet of Valaar. Capture and train mystical creatures known by the locals as Vizarri. Battle other trainers in tactical, turn-based combat on a dynamic grid. Explore islands, collect items, and outsmart a rising enemy force. These are the Adventures of Valaar.

details.title: Once Upon a Knight
details.short_description: Once Upon a Knight is a single-player adventure game with an isometric view, focused on exploration and combat. Control a hero, face enemies, overcome challenges, and master shifting perspectives as you progress using keyboard, mouse, or controller.

details.title: GAL BOCCHI
