details.short_description: GAL BOCCHI is an internet artist simulator ADV where you control the dogshit female artist “aimisu_u” and become the legendary artist she so desperately wants to become! All the time left for the not-so-young-anymore aimisu_u to escape reality for her dream is…drum roll…1 single year!

details.title: Reveniev: A Day in Nassiriyah
details.short_description: Get your revenge in REVENIEV!

details.title: Jet Birds
details.short_description: A challenging, physics-based, 3D platformer where you fly jetpack-powered birds through ring circuits suspended through nature. Not a casual flying game or a flight simulator, but a precision platformer that demands (and rewards) determination and practice.

details.title: Lecture Me Later
details.short_description: Just having a pleasant chat with one of the most popular guys in the University. Nothing weird about that, right? So why is he kinda... different than you've imagined?

details.title: The Labyrinth
details.short_description: Your brother entered the Labyrinth searching for a legendary weapon. He never returned. Follow his trail through a dark fantasy dungeon crawler filled with deadly creatures, ancient puzzles, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Nine lives. No map. No guarantee you'll make it out.

details.title: Ecosystem Architect
details.short_description: What happens when an elephant shares its habitat with a Spinosaurus? Design ecosystems with nearly 50 species of plants and animals, shape the land, and balance predators and prey in a science-inspired simulation where every creature lives, hunts, and raises a family of its own.

details.title: Aspiel: Edge Of Chaos
details.short_description: Aspiel: Edge of Chaos is a third-person fantasy Action-RPG. Explore numerous locations ravaged by the dark power of Death, face various creatures consumed by Chaos, and harness the power of Life to save the continent of Aspiel.

details.title: Salary-Mon | Hiro Versus His Demons
details.short_description: Help Japanese Salaryman Hiro overcome his inner demons by facing his fears head on, battling his worst traits, and becoming more powerful with each victory to ultimately take down his oppressive boss in this Poke-like JRPG adventure.

details.title: Surface Labyrinth KURUMABU
details.short_description: Neo-2D Action Puzzle Game !

details.title: Sato
details.short_description: Manipulate space and time in this planetary puzzle-platformer. Learn the rules to unravel more of the world and the secrets within. Do you remember? 183 15.

details.title: Bulbo's Belief System
details.short_description: Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told, letting him see, move, and interact, but he can forget! Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity and manage conflicting beliefs to solve cute mind-bending challenges.

details.title: Heretic Red
details.short_description: In this story-rich detective game, uncover clues through a card-like system to solve a series of bizarre murders. Combine pieces of evidence to build your case against the most likely culprit from within an eclectic cast of unusual characters.

details.title: Fate's Masquerade: Otome Visual Novel
details.short_description: In this animated, manhwa-inspired otome, romance the princes you were meant to hate. First, earn their affection and try not to die. Then save the empire, or burn it to the ground. Fairytale romance or villainess revenge? You decide.

details.title: Yuki-Tundra
details.short_description: Build your store empire, help the local community and keep the shelves stocked in a bid to boost your stores reputation while you rise from the ashes. Yuki-Tundra blends the casual store management genre with classic RPG adventures.

details.title: Goblin God
details.short_description: In Goblin God, you rule a tribe of chaotic goblins! Build villages, defend against evil humans, and unleash divine powers to shape the world (or cause mayhem). Each island brings new challenges—will you lead your goblins to glory or just enjoy the chaos?

details.title: Shadow of Backrooms
details.short_description: Shadow of Backrooms is a co-op horror game set in endless liminal rooms. Explore the Backrooms with up to 4 friends, solve puzzles and escape the entities before they catch you. But be warned: you are not alone.

details.title: Skippy's Grand Escape
details.short_description: Escape increasingly complex mazes as fast as possible. Select skills tactically for each level. Optimize your path. Watch out for enemies, traps, anomalies and more in this space themed top down maze runner.

details.title: Lull: Rest After Crying
details.short_description: A horror action-adventure in which a young girl carrying a baby on her back attempts to escape a mysterious facility twisted by endless renovations.

details.title: Wandering Within
details.short_description: Wandering Within is a 2d solo survival game where you have to cross a hostile desert to unravel the mysteries of a legendary chest. Gather resources, find water and build tools to increase your chance of survival

details.title: Sonic Valkyria: KANON
details.short_description: "Every time you shoot an enemy, music is born." The heartbeat of rock becomes your aim. An impulse shooting game with anime song rock and lock-on! "Sonic Valkyria: KANON"

details.title: Eight Bells
details.short_description: A pixel-art naval roguelike in the spirit of FTL. Command a Navy warship room by room, crew it with humans, merfolk and stranger things, and hunt pirate captains in real-time-with-pause broadsides on a sea where 10+ monsters lurk. Keep your crew alive. Keep the sea outside.

details.title: Last Stand Legends
details.short_description: Will you rise as a Legend or fall to the darkness? Your courage and skill will decide the fate of humanity. Step into a world overrun by the undead, where every battle is a fight for survival. Stand alone or rally your allies as you carve through hordes of zombies and deadly bosses.

details.title: KARATE ROGUE
details.short_description: A stance-driven, turn-based combo roguelike—turn defense into offense and fight your way out of the abyss.

details.title: Decay of Worlds
details.short_description: A tactical fantasy defense game with RPG elements: Deploy powerful units, wield magic, and lead a band of heroes through dark missions filled with meaningful choices.

details.title: Akiiwan: Relaxing Survival
details.short_description: Fall into a chill survival adventure, with a talking campfire as your guide. Explore, craft, fish and hunt during the day, and ask your fire three questions each night. Choose wisely: Winter isn't the only surprise in this beautiful, hand-drawn world. Playable in cosy or realistic mode.

details.title: The Darkness Delivers
details.short_description: A haunting horror story set in an isolated abbey. Jeanne, a naïve young nun, struggles to save her lover, the angelic Sister Séraphine, from a wasting disease which has ravaged their home - but what is Jeanne prepared to sacrifice for Séraphine's sake?

details.title: Stella: into the Shadow
details.short_description: Stella comes to Blackwood for a few days to write about an old case: in 1988, four teenagers drove out to the lake and never came back. Then a murder happens in town, and leaving is no longer an option. A detective visual novel about an investigation and feelings that arrive at the wrong time.

details.title: Anubria
details.short_description: Exploration. Silence. Echoes. Wander a shifting pyramid where rooms change and reality bends. No monsters, just atmosphere, isolation, and subtle unease. Uncanny, immersive, and unsettling. Solve light environmental puzzles across 8 levels. Experience the pyramid alone - empty, yet somehow present.

details.title: Torched
details.short_description: Lost and alone, a light kindles in the darkness. Brandish the torch, save the others, find the way out. Journey through an ancient gauntlet and meet those who tread it before you. Hand crafted, solo developed, a labor of love.

details.title: Flipper of Eridanus
details.short_description: A fantastical sci-fi pinball experience featuring advanced physics, unique table mechanics, mini-games, and a full pinball tutorial!

details.title: Survive: The Alien Tracing
details.short_description: A survival game where you uncover the mystery of the alien civilization "The Fallen of Elun". Navigate a dark world, solve complex puzzles, face hostile creatures, and use many weapons to survive while searching for the truth behind your missing son.

details.title: FireQuest
details.short_description: Ignite your destiny in a blazing 2D pixel platformer where every jump, dash, and strike keeps the flame alive.

details.title: Rot Together
details.short_description: A first-person co-op horror game for up to four players set in a medieval world. Explore a module map and fight a mysterious cult. Brew potions, kill monsters, chat with your friends. Survival is not guaranteed!

details.title: Their Sky
details.short_description: Their Sky is an idle deck-builder. Select cards and strategies as you build decks that can win on their own. Rather than managing moves, Their Sky all in on deck building: turn your favorite cards into self-running engines.

details.title: Tim & Harpy
details.short_description: Tim & Harpy is a revival of the classic retro 3D platforming collectathon adventures. Explore rich, unique worlds, gather many different items, and help the duo save the planet while meeting new friends along the way.

details.title: Date Survivor
details.short_description: Date survivor is a dating simulator mixed with escape room puzzles and psychological horror. Four dates, four houses, and multiple ways to either get closer — or get out before it’s too late.

details.title: Super Blood Hockey: Rogue Manager
details.short_description: A sports game where you don't control the players, instead play as a shady coach and build a deck of dirty tricks to become season champion. A hybrid of roguelike deckbuilder, auto-battler, and high action arcade hockey.

details.title: Plate And Profit
details.short_description: Can you make rent with a spicy bowl of lettuce and ketchup? Run a chaotic kitchen in this Cooking Roguelite! Manage ingredients, build your synergies and strategies with spices and decor, and serve customers before their patience runs out.

details.title: ZLEEPI
details.short_description: ZLEEPI is an exciting hyper-speedy 2D platformer, where you play as a cute alien escaping Area 51! Use your PVC pipe to bounce off of walls, floors, and ceilings to get to the exit as quickly as possible! All while eating pipin' hot pizza slices on your way!

details.title: Findosaurs
details.short_description: Casual hidden creature game featuring dinosaurs and other prehistoric life illustrated in a lumpy potato fashion living in ecosystems. Lesser known dinosaurs, non-dinosaur archosaurs, synapsids, temnospondyls are represented alongside the charismatic mega fauna.

details.title: LED Bringer
details.short_description: The sun has gone out, and darkness has consumed the planet. You ended up here by accident, but now you must become a glimmer of hope. Even if it's just… an LED. Take control of a combat drone, expand your base, navigate the darkness, and uncover the secrets of a dying world.

name: 西游肉鸽：杨戬的100种死法

details.title: 西游肉鸽：杨戬的100种死法
details.short_description: "Roguelike Journey to the West: 100 Ways to Slay Erlang Shen" is a 3D light-strategy roguelike that blends shooting, action, and tower defense into fast-paced gameplay. Gameplay:Auto-attack while equipping any 6 weapons—survive 20 waves, defeat all final bosses to win!

details.title: SCRIMBLO SCRAMBLE
details.short_description: Put it all on the line in this roulette-themed incremental game where you torment your scrimblos in order to manage and eventually escape hell.

details.title: Spider Matrix
details.short_description: Expedition is dead, but your mind woke inside a mechanical spider. Become a fatal glitch in the Machine Swarm network, which arrived for a fifth-dimension fragment. Scale walls, strip enemy weapons, and destroy the Hive Mind to save the planet.

details.title: Corban's Station
details.short_description: In this first-person puzzle exploration game, walk the liminal spaces of a long-abandoned service station. Reprogram aging computers, physically reroute damaged and fading connections and restore fragments of their waning memory.

details.title: Barge
details.short_description: Grow crops, raise animals, and harvest resources that you can sell in towns you pass as you and your barge float down an endless river in this top down, pixel art, farming sim.

details.title: Beerhouse Simulator
details.short_description: Brew beer your own way! First-person homebrewing simulator where every batch can go brilliantly wrong or surprisingly right — and clients might just notice the difference, or not. Brew, experiment or cause total beery mayhem.

details.title: Broom Broom
details.short_description: Grab your broom, fly over to people in need and brew them potions after a catastrophic snowstorm has hit your village! Talk to your lovely (but mostly grumpy) neighbours as you find your place in this short and cozy adventure.

details.title: Wall Street 1929
details.short_description: Wall Street 1929 is a business sim set in the Great Depression. Start before the crash and live through collapse and recovery. Found companies, acquire shares, buy real estate, run charities, and bid on collectibles to build your empire.

details.title: Drawing Dead
details.short_description: A grid-based roguelike deckbuilder where you swap cards to trigger cascading poker hands, or sacrifice them for power. Summon demons, strike bargains, and enchant your deck into an infernal scoring engine.

details.title: Astro Loopers
details.short_description: What if you could rewind time — and team up with your past self? Astro Loopers is a Sokoban-style puzzle game set in a cosmic universe, where every move echoes through time. Your past characters repeat their actions as time loops stack up — coordinate them to solve increasingly mind-bending stages.

details.title: Cthulhu 1920
details.short_description: Step into the eerie world of Cthulhu 1920, a strategic card game where sanity is your lifeline. Players navigate a grid-based playfield, battling enemies, collecting items, and using weapons and long forgotten artifacts to survive.

details.title: 我的灵气吸不完
details.short_description: "My Qi Is Unlimited"is a yuri-themed suspense puzzle game that combines 3D first-person exploration with 2D visual novel elements. Explore a secluded manor, solve mechanisms, and combine items. Shape relationships through choices, leading to vastly different endings.

details.title: Dive and Glide
details.short_description: Dive, glide and smash your way through colourful sky-high challenges! Explore floating islands, earn stars to unlock new worlds, and master wildly different courses filled with rings, obstacles, enemies and secrets. Race your friend, race a penguin, fight aliens, hours of fun for everyone.

details.title: Rolling Rogue
details.short_description: Explore dungeons in a stylish roguelike with turn-based combat. Use a deck of dice to give your abilities unique effects. Create your own dice and combine them with equipment, carving your way through hordes of enemies.

details.title: My Death as a Duchess
details.short_description: My Death as a Duchess is a survival game where the player embodies a duchess taking control of a cursed duchy. This game combines both narrative intrigue and strategy, alternating phases of managing the duchess's schedule and the unfolding of her day in the form of a graphic novel.

name: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon

details.title: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon
details.short_description: You'd think that after 20+ cases, there'd be no crime left in Twin Lakes - but that's not how crime works, rookie. Six new mind-melting mysteries await Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley - just as soon as they get the mustard out of Dooley's gun.

details.title: One Arrow
details.short_description: Freeze your arrow in midair and then use it as a platform in this challenging precision platformer. Carve your own paths, outsmart your enemies, and uncover the secrets of your magic arrow.

details.title: Bloomed Ghoul
details.short_description: Eat your enemies and replace your body parts. A ghoulish action roguelike where your abilities, weapons, and power come from what you choose to become.

details.title: Femboy Detective
details.short_description: Dark yaoi horror game about learning who to trust. Investigate leads, interrogate suspects, and unravel a doomsday conspiracy in the search for your missing friend.

details.title: Sweet Dreams in Midnight Kingdom
details.short_description: Sweet Dreams in Midnight Kingdom is a medieval puzzle game where the player, a king, has his divine right to rule tested when tasked with putting his own subjects to bed before the sun rises. Use logic and patience to solve each level in this grid-based, hand-drawn game.

details.title: Intersecta
details.short_description: "Intersecta" is an intense tactical top-down space combat game with a stylized sci-fi aesthetic. Devoid of humans, the game is set in another dimension where only cybernetic insects have evolved. The player takes control of an Intersecta fighter pilot hoping to survive an intergalactic invasion.

details.title: Hexborne
details.short_description: Draw one unbroken path across a hex battlefield. Tiles you cross become attack, armor, healing and gold, and how you reach each foe picks your strike. Dark fantasy roguelite RPG. Chapter 1 demo.

details.title: DUSTCROW
details.short_description: DustCrow is a space-salvaging and exploration zero-G VR game where you strip derelict wrecks for scrap, manage your tools and equipment in a zero-G environment, and play in a live, player-driven economy. It's just industrial tools, tactile physics, and the daily grind in the vast emptiness of space.

details.title: The Citadel Must Hold
details.short_description: Build and defend your Citadel in a fantasy survival RTS. Explore dangerous lands, conquer Places of Power for strategy-changing rewards, and rally your armies against the relentless Monster Tides. Every choice brings you closer to survival... or the fall of your Citadel.

details.title: Gummy Tummy
details.short_description: A co-op mining game set in a world made of candy. Bite tunnels through gummy terrain, haul loot and a bellyful of sugar back to the hub, then craft sharper teeth, bigger stomachs and soda-bottle jetpacks to dig deeper. Push past your tier and your teeth corrode go see the dentist!

details.title: 3100: Far from Earth
details.short_description: Stranded far from Earth in the year 3100, repair your ship, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover what waits beyond the stars in a hand-drawn sci-fi point-and-click adventure.

details.title: Card Shop Duelist
details.short_description: Run your own trading card shop. Rip packs chasing the big pull, price the shelves, hire staff, and duel your customers in Battleforge, a full TCG built into the game. Play solo or with up to seven friends online.

details.title: Minesweeper Maker
details.short_description: Minesweeper Maker is a grid based logic game where you can play and create countless puzzles with friends and the community.

details.title: NOEMATICA: Digital Dollhouse
details.short_description: Behold the humble Noem! Beguiling and silly-pilled, fully customizable, monstrous or adorable: with an n-dimensional vector space of fantasies and memories. An urban digital dollhouse, constructed top-to-bottom with a focus on simulation fidelity.

details.title: Fractal.OS
details.short_description: Fractal.OS insists you play tic-tac-toe. Again. And again. Build an automated board factory, earn resources, unlock rules, and bend thousands of random matches toward a single impossible task: lose 10,000 times in a row. The system appreciates your compliance.

details.title: Between Gods
details.short_description: A punishing action roguelite where your crusade is to slay every God. Master precise parries, battle relentless foes, discover powerful gear through shops and enemy drops, and grow stronger by spending skill points after every death.

details.title: Sweetheart
details.short_description: Survive the breakup with your high school sweetheart of 15 years. Escape her Hollywood mansion where fame, dysfunction, and the fantasy of everlasting love has mutated your lifelong partner into a monster.

details.title: Nekolpos — Colossal Cat Care Simulation —
details.short_description: Shrunk to just 5 cm tall, you’re now being cared for by the cat you once owned. Talk freely with a gigantic nekomata, cuddle her fluffy fur, ride on her back, and enjoy a life together with your roles completely reversed.

details.title: Blueprint Factory
details.short_description: Every machine follows your instructions. Build automated factories with intuitive visual programming, solve clever automation puzzles, and watch your factory come to life.

details.title: Little Adventurer Treasure Hunt 2
details.short_description: Little Adventurer Treasure Hunt 2 is a lighthearted and fun hidden-object adventure game. A little girl from Earth and an alien kitten embark on a brand-new adventure, solving all kinds of quirky and unusual problems for the locals in a picture-book world.

details.title: The Human Cockroach
details.short_description: Track, Hunt, and be Hunted through a series of dark tunnels. In the pitch-black depths of the caves, you can never be sure whether you are aiming down the right corridor. Think while the footsteps grow louder and louder.

details.title: Bossfall
details.short_description: Bossfall is a Sci-Fi Action RPG where you fight the galaxy's most powerful warriors and monsters to claim legendary loot. Shoot and dash through relentless incoming attacks, customize your character's build, and conquer the arena to become the ultimate coliseum champion.

details.title: Neural Spaceship Sandbox
details.short_description: Build a spaceship block by block, then watch a neural network learn to fly it. Every block can be destroyed and changes the ship's stats mid-fight. Lead your fleets across a turn-based galaxy, or battle friends online.

details.title: Domain Paradox: Growth
details.short_description: Search. Remember. Escape. Or you will never leave the domain. Explore anomalies and unravel the story of a scientist sent on an expedition, avoiding dangers and clinging to the last shred of hope: finding a way out.

details.title: Galacto
details.short_description: A cozy idle game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Run a space gas station, refuel ships, hire bots, chain combo for fat payouts, and rebuild an outpost into the busiest stop in the galaxy!

details.title: Staircore
details.short_description: The staircore has a final destination, but it is not a physical destination. The transitional phase between high and low has become thin, and I have fallen inbetween. Will I ever get out?

details.title: CardTavern
details.short_description: Everything is a card, from ingredients and dishes to customers. Drag cards to stack, combine, trade, cook and upgrade as you grow a tiny tavern into a thriving business. Fulfill customer orders, expand your tavern, and send adventurers into dangerous dungeons to gather rare materials and treasures.

details.title: Perfect·K·Night
details.short_description: Perfect·K·Night is a narrative game where you play as a pastry chef crafting parfaits. In a near-future virtual world where millions spend their sleep living a second life, your sweet, velvety creations heal weary souls and safeguard every perfect night.

name: Jay and Silent Bob's Joint Venture

details.title: Jay and Silent Bob's Joint Venture
details.short_description: Turn a rundown backyard into your own cozy cannabis farm. Crossbreed plants to discover unusual effects and grow the strains your neighbors need. Build friendships as you explore the town with Jay and Silent Bob, surrounded by the spirit of ’90s comedy.

details.title: Last Writes
details.short_description: Last Writes is a sound-based puzzle game with very sparse and cryptic instructions, reflecting on what remains of religion in a world that has long strived to overcome it. Follow the signal and confront a rogue AI that sees you as its God.

name: Specters of the Void Sea: VR Pirate Battle Royale

details.title: Specters of the Void Sea: VR Pirate Battle Royale
details.short_description: Gather your crew and sail the Void Sea in a fully physical, multicrew VR pirate adventure. Engage in brutal PvPvE with flintlock firearms, melee weapons, gesture magic, and naval combat. Sail procedural worlds, patch leaks, and do what you can to survive the entities and players hunting you.

details.title: Roll and Die
details.short_description: A push-your-luck dice roguelite. Greed gets you power. Greed gets you killed. Keep the rolls you like, push the rest, and pray you do not hit a skull. Climb the Pit to the god who runs it.

details.title: Atomic Delivery
details.short_description: The General Staff has one objective for you: build an atomic weapon aboard a nuclear bomber. Pilot through hostile skies, refine uranium, run industrial machines, assemble the bomb, keep the aircraft airborne and survive everything standing between you and the Atomic Delivery.

name: 彼女のコメント欄管理を任された！

details.title: 彼女のコメント欄管理を任された！
details.short_description: Assigned to Moderate Her Chat! is a game where you become the moderator for rookie VTuber Komeran A. Lerna. Delete toxic comments as soon as they appear! With simple click controls, protect Lerna's livestream and keep the chat safe and friendly.

details.title: Shuffle Bistro
details.short_description: Mix menus and build facilities to hit daily revenue goals. Create brand new synergy builds every run with 100+ types of facilities and 4 distinct theme perks in this restaurant deck-building roguelike.

details.title: Immortal Gambit
details.short_description: Immortal Gambit is a xianxia deckbuilding roguelike. Build your deck, seek treasures, and make trade-offs between Spirit and Bane. When Spirit runs short, Refine Bane to seize power now—and face the consequences later.

details.title: Restive Neverendings
details.short_description: A metaphysical card game about chronic insomnia and tea ceremonies. It is also a game about home.

details.title: Dinosis Zero: Quantum Island
details.short_description: Survive on a mysterious island overrun by dinosaurs. Explore abandoned research facilities, uncover the origin of a global catastrophe, craft, build, and fight your way through a dangerous prehistoric world.

details.title: Mingle
details.short_description: A multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you play as a Wolf disguised as a sheep and eat the flock from the inside!

details.title: Cryptwake
details.short_description: Cryptwake is a fast-paced first-person roguelike dungeon crawler. Fight through ever-changing floors, uncover strange secrets, wield powerful weapons, build devastating synergies, and survive the horrors that stalk the dungeon.

details.title: Dandy Rat Cricket Club
details.short_description: DANDY RAT CRICKET CLUB IS ARCADE CRICKET FOR THE UPPER CRUST. Bat, bowl and field in an easy-to-learn and impossible-to-master setting. Bamboozle your opponents with deceptively deep and engaging tactics, and magical bowling power-ups. Captain your ragtag team of posh rats from obscurity to glory.

details.title: Have Fun Exploring
details.short_description: Have Fun Exploring is a 4-player online co-op psychological horror. Urbex livestreaming is booming on the Dark Web, and the WR8 Audience pays well for thrilling content. Investigate abandoned locations to uncover who went missing and identify the ghost they became.

details.title: Spirefall
details.short_description: A single-player roguelite deckbuilder where your fortress fights back. Deploy units, cast spells, and unleash fortress weapons in turn-based card battles. Play five factions through three tavern Gauntlets, each ending with a boss who has a few tricks of their own.

details.title: Coppers & Thieves
details.short_description: Coppers & Thieves is a party hide and seek game for 3-8 players that combines strategic stealth gameplay with fast paced party action.

details.title: Me, Bitten
details.short_description: A lone survivalist, perfectly prepared for the apocalypse, just got bitten. Ridiculous? Yes. But you have zero intention of dying like this. Scavenge your surroundings for supplies to craft vaccines and weapons. Hold back the infection and wipe out the zombies. Survive. That's it.

details.title: Sodyba
details.short_description: A short psychological horror game inspired by Baltic folklore. Explore the homestead, complete everyday tasks, discover hidden places, and reveal its dark secret. When evil awakens, can you escape?

details.title: Bullet Maiden: Shoot and Strip
details.short_description: A 2D vertical bullet-hell shooter with polarity-switching and clothes destruction. Toggle Light mode to strip clothing or Dark mode to fight enemies and Bosses. 12 characters each have two stages with multi-phase Boss fights. Combo and score-based extra lives reward skilled play.

details.title: Solbound
details.short_description: Fight, salvage and trade across the moons and rings of a solar system nobody can leave. Take what you can carry. Read what the dead left behind. Everything you do is remembered.

details.title: Echoes of the Veil
details.short_description: Jack Graves has been invited to a mysterious mansion by a killer who has yet to finish their work. Investigate supernatural echoes, uncover the next victims, and stop the culprit before it’s too late.

details.title: Idle Misadventures
details.short_description: Recruit a party of classic RPG heroes and send them adventuring for levels and loot. Conquer the realm, then retire your heroes to unlock new classes, mechanics, and meta bonuses that make the next generation even stronger. Play actively to speed your progress, or idle your way to victory!

details.title: Falcons of the Red Planet
details.short_description: As part of a dedicated combat astro-fighter squadron of the Red Mars Space Force, you must defend the solar system from the oppression of the ruthless Alliance of Empires.

details.title: Boiler & Blood
details.short_description: Build and command a dieselpunk war train, manage its crew, and wield forbidden sorcery in a real-time-with-pause tactical roguelite. Destroy the enemy command train before the pursuing army catches you.

details.title: Songs of the Shoals
details.short_description: Cast a line, sail between islands, and bring your catch home in a single-player fishing adventure. Sell fish, take harbor commissions, upgrade your gear, and explore coastal villages under changing skies. Take a seaplane flight for a new view of the sea.

details.title: Night to Reticle +6
details.short_description: Nozomu follows his wife to Kyushu and meets the enigmatic KANA. Accept or refuse his nightly “invitations”? Replay the six-day story to uncover the truth. A choice-driven BL psychological adventure with a seme (top) protagonist. The complete edition of the free game Night to Reticle.

details.title: Three Kingdoms The Mainland
details.short_description: 在群雄割据的三国乱世中，从零开始建设村庄，发展势力、抵御敌军，最终统一天下。

details.title: KalshwK
details.short_description: Get aboard the Ghost Train and fight with 99 lives worth of hardship to forge your own destiny with the unnatural grasp of KalshwK Desert : Top-Down 2d Roguelite Shooter

details.title: Sceadu Eard
details.short_description: Sceadu Eard is a hardcore retro-style open-world dungeon crawler set in an eerie dark fantasy world. Craft gear at your base, gather resources, master methodical combat, unlock new paths and return safely from each expedition.

details.title: Hazardous Employment
details.short_description: Hire expendable heroes, arrange their formation, and send them into automated fantasy expeditions in this darkly comedic guild-management roguelite. Manage contracts, injuries, morale, payroll, and debt—then file the paperwork when your best employees fail to return.

details.title: Bad Ideas Game Jam Collection 2026
details.short_description: The Bad Ideas Game Jam Collection 2026 is a showcase of 50 short-form videos and single-player games that encompass a variety of genres from visual novels, platformers, rpgs shooters, rhythm, and puzzle games. Each following a theme of trying to make games that think Outside the Box!

details.title: The Dangers of Liminality
details.short_description: A first person survival horror game set in The Backrooms. Explore and survive in this liminal expanse of many levels while maintaining your sanity, with realistic yet distinct graphics. You may attempt to run or fight, but how far will that really get you?

details.title: Walls Have Eyes
details.short_description: A racket. A ball. A court that fights back. A first-person adventure built on real squash, set at night in an old mansion turned squash club, where the creatures you face are part of the courts you play in.

details.title: That Cozy Cat Game
details.short_description: A relaxing online co-op game where you and your friends explore a colorful island as customizable CATS. Go fishing, chat, find new discoveries, earn kibbles, and dress up your cat.

details.title: RIDGERUNNERS
details.short_description: RIDGERUNNERS is a first-person mountain racer. Build speed downhill and fly between checkpoints using gravity and your weapons. Find the fastest route, race ghosts and live players, and climb the global leaderboard.

details.title: HUEMON
details.short_description: A creature collector where your whole team fights at once. Field five HUEMON on a grid where one jumps over others, another anchors nearby enemies, and positioning beats raw power. Collect them across a world still learning to be colorful.

details.title: Brain Runner: Dreamcore Movement Shooter
details.short_description: Your time is running out. Kill to take it back. Sprint, wall-run, and shoot through shifting dream worlds in a fast-paced movement-shooter roguelite as Aina fights to wake humanity from the perfect dream.

details.title: World Resetter
details.short_description: World Resetter is a CRPG featuring real-time strategy controls and ARPG loot mechanics. Command a squad of up to 5 unique characters as you explore a vast world and interact with dynamic NPCs. Defeat powerful foes, craft deep attribute builds, and uncover the truth behind the world.

details.title: Sky Homestead
details.short_description: Sky Homestead is a cozy farming and automation game set on floating islands. Rebuild a shattered sky-kingdom: raise crops, chain machines into production lines, hire a crew who work while you explore, and sail cargo balloons between the isles you bring back to life.

details.title: BACKROOMS PINTEROI
details.short_description: BACKROOMS PINTEROI: Explore the endless Backrooms on your own or with your friends. Survive ‘terrifying’ entities, solve puzzles, manage your resources and find your way out. Each level features new puzzles, entities and things to discover. Two new levels are added every month :)

details.title: Ionic Drive
details.short_description: Plan your flight path, execute a perfect flip-and-burn manoeuvre and pray that your hull survives any impact in this space flight simulation/racing game. Can you avoid collision and finish your flight?

details.title: Reaching for The Star
details.short_description: Reaching For The Star is a modern entertainment industry life simulation where you play as a rising actress. Plan your weekly schedule, improve your skills, audition for new roles, build relationships, and shape your own journey from an unknown newcomer to a legendary star.

details.title: Cargo Thieves
details.short_description: In this co-op multiplayer game, you run an ordinary supermarket, but instead of honestly ordering products for sale, you steal them from the docks while disguised as dockworkers. Use crowbars, lockpicks and trucks. Expand your store, outsmart the cops, steal & sell anything from food to supercars.

details.title: Fix & Flick
details.short_description: Congratulations! You have been selected as this year's officer for the SICRED SYSTEMS Game Weeks. Your assignment is to buy, sell, and fix second-hand consoles while managing your shop. Serve customers. Uncover secrets. Complete your duties. We look forward to your outstanding service.

details.title: Night Sentinel
details.short_description: Take the night shift as a museum guard in “Night Sentinel”. Complete tasks, investigate anomalies, and survive the growing horrors within. Play solo or co-op and uncover a dark mystery with multiple endings.

details.title: 小角色
details.short_description: 这是一个增加了移动维度的类杀戮尖塔卡牌DBGrogue游戏。构筑中的移动维度将发挥重要作用，你将扮演武士，刺客，猎人，法师等角色体验一段战胜心魔的故事。

details.title: Delete the World
details.short_description: Delete the World is a completely normal visual novel… unless you decide to help her kill everyone.

details.title: Furry Defenders​​
details.short_description: In Furry Defenders, where the Demon Clan covets the Dragon Veins and incites war among all races, you will play as Cynton, the Dragon Bloodline Warrior. Rally your allies and set masterful traps at crucial passes to outsmart the looming threat of the Demon Army.

details.title: Quantum Quartz
details.short_description: Steampunk pixel-art precision platformer where you toggle platforms on and off using colored crystals. With only one active at a time, each grants a different movement ability, changing how you move and how the level works, blending high-skill platforming with spatial puzzles.

details.title: After Hours: Library
details.short_description: Survive a haunted library's overnight shift by balancing authentic librarian duties with stealth as a relentless supernatural entity hunts you. Uncover hidden secrets, survive until morning, and discover what waits between the shelves.

details.title: Stellar Mole
details.short_description: You will play a role of Agent Vanø—infiltrating an alien colonial corporation. Your mission: gather Earth intelligence for alien while weaponizing every dirty trick to torment your alien colleagues, dismantling their operations from within.

details.title: Grove Bound
details.short_description: Grove Bound is a cozy incremental woodcutting RPG where you chop, fish, cook, mine, and craft to explore a dark forest. Manage fatigue, light your way with a lantern, and upgrade tools while meeting quirky NPCs and uncovering secrets at your own pace.

details.title: Enlighted
details.short_description: Enlighted is a dark fantasy, dungeon crawler game that shows no mercy for mistakes. Explore randomly generated dungeon levels, find a legendary equipment and manage your light - it protects you quick death.

details.title: I Saw a Flying Saucer
details.short_description: An interactive fiction about a man who lost his wife and goes in search of a UFO that shouldn't exist.

details.title: Haunted Room! Urami-chan
details.short_description: In this "life-intervention watching game," you control the earthbound spirit "Urami-chan." Travel between an apartment's past and present to change the murdered resident's future. The game unfolds in semi-real time, tasking you to watch over the resident and intervene.

details.title: Math and Guns
details.short_description: Math and Guns is a top-down roguelite shooter where every right answer reloads your gun. Pick the problems you want, or bring your own flashcards, then fight through seven floors of the Necromancer’s base to rescue your captured squad.

details.title: Stroom
details.short_description: Stroom is a precision platformer built for speed. Master the dash, chain your moves and find the fastest path through 100 handcrafted levels across 5 worlds.

details.title: Follow These Steps
details.short_description: In the mood for a bit of puzzle building? Put on relaxing tunes, open the box, and start putting together things out of colorful pieces — step-by-step instructions included!

details.title: Factories in Factories in Factories
details.short_description: Build a fractal world. Automate the automation of your automation. Put Factories in Factories in Factories.

details.title: WATERTRIX ONLINE
details.short_description: A Tetris-style puzzle game where you control water to battle enemies! It's a casual game featuring cute characters and beautiful water that will soothe you. You can compete in 1v1 online matches and challenge rivals from all over the country.

details.title: Ignifugo
details.short_description: Ignifugo is a top-down action roguelike where you control a combat shell and modify it with auto-triggering units. Take advantage of class bonuses, items and abilities to create unique builds as you fight blazing battles in different biomes. Can you manage the heat or be reduced to ash?

details.title: Project Creatures
details.short_description: Project Creatures is a Multiplayer Creature Collection Game. Capture new creatures and battle your friends in a vast Open World!

name: ノナプルナイン：アシンプトート

details.title: ノナプルナイン：アシンプトート
details.short_description: "NONUPLE NINE: Asymptote" is a side-scrolling, narrative Sci-fi adventure game. Control the subject girl and solve the mystery of the building where the same floor loops. With vast scientific insights, can you find the answer for the "meaning of humanity" during this deadly journey?

details.title: Eclipsi
details.short_description: Embark on an epic 3D space shooter adventure featuring dynamic space combat and thrilling planetary exploration. Battle in single or multiplayer modes from 1v1 to 5v5, strategizing to achieve victory through base destruction, resource collection, or base capture. Dominate with our ranking system!

details.title: SketchBrawl
details.short_description: Sketchbrawl is an auto-battler: draft squads from six factions, deploy them on the grid, and watch hundreds of units clash on their own. Promote squads to ★★★, let your commander’s skill turn the tide, and survive ten rounds to clear the Arena.

details.title: Dragons Invade Scotland
details.short_description: Match-3 Tower Defense. Defend real Scottish castles from waves of dragons. Real Scottish stories and legends. Includes a full map of Scotland to scale where 1 tile is 19.5 meters.

details.title: Re:VER PROJECT -TOKYO-
details.short_description: "Re:VER PROJECT TOKYO" co-developed by Toei Animation and indie developer Nestopi, is a survival suspense adventure game set in modern Tokyo depicted in pixel art. Yukinori Amane whos falsely accused of a crime, uses his survival skills to evade the police and uncover the real culprit.

details.title: Shaft 29
details.short_description: You are alone in Shaft 29...Descend into old, pitch-black, and hazardous labyrinth to restore the failing power grid. Scavenge the dark for scrap, repair components in safe room, and brave anomalies hiding in the depths. Keep the lights on, and keep moving down...

details.title: Japanese Salaryman
details.short_description: A 1990s office-noir RPG. By day, survive office politics at METTA and protect your relationships. By night, hack into company servers in grid-based hacking puzzles, spy on people for upgrades, and sell stolen secrets to escape crushing debt.

details.title: Untold Tales: A Scarlet Way
details.short_description: Meet Devil May Cry about Little Red Riding Hood. A Scarlet Way is an isometric hack-and-slash where Scarlet wields her beloved scythe to tear through enemies in a dark Victorian fantasy world — all to the sound of heavy metal and dubstep.

details.title: Draft Fever Bowl
details.short_description: Draft Fever Bowl is a competitive multiplayer football management game focused on scouting and the draft. Study prospects, outsmart rivals on draft day, and trade with real teams. With no visible attributes, success depends entirely on your eye for talent. Enter the war room.

details.title: Starbump
details.short_description: Starbump combines fast-paced action, Third Person platforming and competitive modes in vibrants worlds. It’s designed for party nights where you and your friends battle it out for hours, packed into colorful arenas and quick-fire game modes. It's a pure cozy brawl !

details.title: Light Up the Dark
details.short_description: Light Up the Dark is a colony survival sim set in a dark world filled with unseen horrors. Collect, build, automate, research techs, and explore the procedural map. Manage three classes of colonists; keep them sane, or make use of their insanity. Solve endless interesting problems, your way.

details.title: Just A Shadow Game
details.short_description: Hear me, pitiful mortals, for I shall reveal to you the path to true power - a demonic fusion of deckbuilding, ritual duels, and roguelite! I speak of a realm shrouded in darkness, where only the most wicked may thrive. Behold my masterpiece, "Just A Shadow Game" .

details.title: Order of Renewal
details.short_description: Order of Renewal is a multiplayer fantasy indie RPG game with co-op and PvP. Detailed combat system with realistic swordsmanship, physical interaction, unusual, and fresh mechanics will require tactics and skill in every battle.

details.title: Gravepact
details.short_description: Gravepact is a survival roguelite where the goal is to destroy as many incoming enemies as possible, while collecting experience to spend on attacks, passive items and skills to build your character into a powerful conduit of destruction that lays waste to everything in your way.

details.title: The Dark Aegis
details.short_description: The Dark Aegis blends visceral third-person combat with deep base building. Build up your fortress between missions, then defend it from relentless alien hordes solo or with up to 4 players.

details.title: High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel
details.short_description: Challenge your friends to high stakes arcade puzzle action in High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel! There's something for all types of players with a variety of solo, multiplayer and online modes.

details.title: Decaying Salvage
details.short_description: A modern sci-fi survival horror built for people who miss fixed cameras, puzzles, scarce ammunition and being afraid to open the next door.

details.title: SAIGAI
details.short_description: You wake from cryosleep aboard a drifting deep-space freighter. The crew is gone. The ship is dark. Something is moving through the corridors with you. Search the vessel, uncover what happened to the crew, and learn what this ship was never meant to carry before it finds you.

details.title: Mechs and Muskets
details.short_description: Mechs and Muskets is a 2D isometric tactical RPG set in an alternate Napoleonic era where mechs rule the battlefield. Customize your squad with unique mech parts and abilities, and lead them through turn-based strategic combat in a story-driven campaign

details.title: Club Defenders
details.short_description: Club Defenders is a co-op action tower defense game where music becomes humanity’s ultimate weapon. Build towers, control enemy paths and stop alien invasions inside vibrant nightclubs with weapons and instruments. Master four powerful music genres that shape every strategy and combat ability.

details.title: Wild Shapers
details.short_description: Weaken enemies with Runes, then consume their weaknesses with a Heavy Attack to unleash chain reactions. Develop your Runes and your hero’s signature abilities to change how you fight in this fast-paced hack-and-slash action roguelite.

details.title: Dungeons & Meows: Hero Cats
details.short_description: Find hidden cats in a medieval fantasy setting. Use heroic skills to rescue kittens in a charming hand-drawn hidden object game.

details.title: Fossil Quest
details.short_description: You have always dreamt of creating your own dinosaur museum and now you finally have the space to do it! Dig for fossils, assemble your exhibits and create the museum of your dreams in this relaxing, wholesome life sim.

details.title: Pollinate or Die
details.short_description: Master a variety of abilities to attack, evade and control waves of enemies and epic bosses. Pollinate beautiful flowers to receive strong buffs. Rejuvenate Earth by cleansing pollution, unlocking many fun special abilities. Save your friends and unite the bees.

details.title: ACCURSED
details.short_description: Investigate the cursed town of Midnight Falls in a roguelike horror RPG. Scavenge powerful relics, outlast vicious foes, and cut down the awakened Ancient Deity before it devours everything. Every run is different, and the town hides secrets in every shadow.

details.title: Tarnex Warfare
details.short_description: Command modern military units along a dynamic frontline, plan operations, and fight battles on maps based on real-world terrain.

details.title: You Remembered
details.short_description: Type letters that fall and become part of the world. Use their shape and attributes to navigate the puzzles and secrets.

details.title: Masquerade: Penumbra
details.short_description: Fantasy visual novel with political intrigue, branching narratives, and romantic themes. Set in a world of underworld intrigue, where masks become identities and no one is safe. The game places an emphasis on character-driven storytelling.

details.title: Scraps Of The Machine
details.short_description: FPS Mech Action! Pilot a mass of steel through a single player campaign set in a desolate landscape. Target enemy armor or weapons to wear them down piece by piece, find upgrades to improve your mech or change its loadout, and survive in a world of rust and decay. Discover, Destroy, Scavenge.

details.title: GIGANTIC☆MAIDESTRUCTION
details.short_description: A giant maid wreaks havoc on the city under the pretext of defeating enemies! Gigantic Destruction Action Game!

details.title: Walls of Fate
details.short_description: Rule a fortress on the brink of collapse: listen to the residents’ requests, manage limited resources and time, strengthen relationships with key characters in the fortress, and move closer to solving the mystery of the ruler’s disappearance.

details.title: Scavenger Survivors
details.short_description: In this 1-4 player top-down roguelite/survivors hybrid, the machines already won. Now, you scavenge! Play as fat scavengers hauling loot from the ruins of the world. Grab and throw anything that isn't bolted down, cram it into your armored RIG, and survive the robot swarm until extraction.

details.title: Ogre Stampede
details.short_description: Ogre Stampede is a physics-based bullet heaven with incremental upgrades set in a chaotic mosh pit. Waves of hopelessly stupid trolls and ogres are running wild and pushing and shoving each other around. Level up your strength and fight to be the last one standing and become the new chieftain!

details.title: ACT OUT
details.short_description: A chaotic online party game of 3D charades. Grab a floppy puppet, act out your secret word on a live theater stage, and race your friends to guess it before the clock runs out. Push-to-talk voice, custom Workshop maps, and a winner's podium. Best with 3+ friends.

details.title: Ship Happens: Pirates Wanted
details.short_description: A co-op game for 1–4 players where you and your friends dream of becoming fearsome pirates, but for now you're sailing in a leaky tub you call a ship. Patch holes, put out fires, raid weaker ships, flee from stronger ones, and upgrade your vessel. Work together, because at sea... Ship Happens!

details.title: Cat Stack
details.short_description: Kidnapped by cats! In this frantic physics-based roguelite, your goal is to balance an endless tower of kitties on your head. Dash back and forth to keep your balance, survive chaotic events, and use special cats with unique powers to keep the stack from collapsing under its own weight.

details.title: Cyberlink Chaos
details.short_description: Cyberlink Chaos is a fast paced online multiplayer arena-slasher. Jack into your PMNCU and fight in the cybernetic forever war. Encased in metal, your soul is reborn - will you fight?

details.title: Urban Green
details.short_description: A romantic visual novel about love, life and loserdom. Take the role of Jack, a young man starting a new job at an environmental charity in search of a jumpstart to his stalled life. What he'll find, be it love, heartbreak, or just more of the same, is up to you.

details.title: DATUM: Rescue One
details.short_description: A single-player helicopter search and rescue game. Fly through storms and darkness, locate survivors with FLIR, confirm with your searchlight, and bring them home. No weapons. Only the sea, the night, and time.

details.title: Alice in BLUE
details.short_description: Alice in Blue is a deckbuilding roguelike strategy game featuring tactical roulette combat. Slot cards onto a spinning wheel, adjust their positions, and unleash powerful card synergies to overcome the dangers of a bizarre dream world.

details.title: Freeze, Dummy!
details.short_description: Freeze time, hang your bullets and grenades across a frozen world, shove enemies into each other's crossfire, then let time run and survive the chaos. A physics-driven FPS sandbox about directing explosions: chain reactions, style scoring, replays.

details.title: Mana Alchemy
details.short_description: An open-world bullet heaven RPG. Explore a cursed island, forge spells via alchemy, and arrange them in your grimoire like a puzzle. Mow down monster hordes and hunt your 7 ruling sisters. Your final choice—execute or forgive them—determines the ending of this dark fantasy.

details.title: CAPTIVE LOVE♡MELTY HOLIC
details.short_description: Ruito, a popular underground idol, is suddenly kidnapped and confined in an unfamiliar abandoned building. Blocked by tricky traps and relentlessly pursued by obsessive stans—can Ruito safely escape this building of madness...?

details.title: Anomaly Logistics
details.short_description: Entities, objects, and domains that defy the laws of physics to wield powers beyond human comprehension—these are collectively known as "Anomalies." Suppress these myriad Anomalies, strip them of their power, and harness it to descend into the deepest abyss. What truth lies waiting at the very end?

details.title: Stray Light
details.short_description: What the eye sees is a prison.” Lost in a cursed forest, ancient streetlights are your only escape. Shift seamlessly between a grim reality and beautiful memories to eliminate obstacles and solve dual-world puzzles. Remember: what blocks you here might not exist on the other side.

details.title: Coin to Crown
details.short_description: Build your adventuring career in a fantasy tactical RPG for 1–4 players. Take guild contracts, travel between towns, and master turn-based battles with timed blocks and dodges. Discover traits through your deeds, upgrade your gear, and rise through the ranks.

details.title: Observation Protocol: The Observed
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror where you wake, again and again, inside a facility that studies you. Each cycle the rooms change, the pattern deepens, and something begins to take shape. The longer you observe, the harder it becomes to tell where the simulation ends.

details.title: Slab Drifter
details.short_description: Slab Drifter is a space-based tactical physics destruction game. The Slab was fractured. The Lords were born. All that remains are corrupted machines and the drifters who scavenge among them. Pilot your drones to hunt the massive Lords and discover their weaknesses.

details.title: Virus Promoter
details.short_description: Welcome aboard, Virus Promoter! One card sparks a chain reaction. One Trinket bends the rules. One combo sends the numbers spiraling out of control! Build your outrageous deck and spread your viruses on an unprecedented scale! Your success is the world's catastrophe!

details.title: Last Drop Tavern
details.short_description: A psychological roguelite gambling game set in an oil-painted bar between this life and the next. You and a rival take turns dropping coins into a single glass; whoever makes it overflow loses their chance at the afterlife. No interface, no numbers, just the rising liquid and the coin in your hand.

details.title: FatCat Nexus
details.short_description: A challenging 2D action platformer featuring unique weapons, precise gameplay, and intense combat. Master your arsenal and defeat dangerous enemies in a world full of challenges.

details.title: Pnevmo-Capsula: Dieselnautica
details.short_description: Navigate a mail capsule to deliver a crucial letter to the Captain across a flying scrap-city. Collect lamps: the toll for passing Checkpoints - solve physics puzzles, dodge traps and fines. If you don’t have enough lamps, the hammers will crush you. A grim puzzle-platformer where every lamp counts.

details.title: The Hanging Game
details.short_description: Hangman on paper is over. Here, you are in the noose. Explore a malevolent graveyard for letters while an eerie, deceptive voice whispers in your ear—learning from your mistakes and actively lying to you. Can you solve the word before the rope snaps?

details.title: Spell Breakers
details.short_description: Build your Spell Deck, defeat your rivals, and aim for the top of the mysterious tournament, Spell Breakers! This is a new kind of auto-battle roguelike game where collecting over 300 spells is the key to victory!

details.title: Pfand Raiders
details.short_description: Dash and ride through a rock festival in this absurd, music-driven co-op runner! Dodge obstacles to the beat, loot empty cans ("Pfand"), cash them in for beer and burp everything out of your way. Will you make it to The Butcher Sisters' show in time?

details.title: Deviled Dice
details.short_description: Beat the devil at his own game by cheating harder than he does in this tabletop-style roguelite dicebuilder. Rig your dice for suspicious luck, conveniently swap the rules mid-game, and cunningly combine relics from other tabletops to set the scorepad on fire!

details.title: Wēlandes
details.short_description: Solve ancient mysteries in the ethereal world of Anglo-Saxon Britain. You are the spel-wefa, use your magical translation devices to help the gods, beasts, and gentlefolk of Old English poetry. Journey the ageless chalk hills surrounding Wayland’s Smithy; unearth the stories that wander within.

details.title: Taxistanbul: Istanbul Taxi Simulator
details.short_description: Drive a yellow cab through a faithfully recreated Istanbul. Pick up fares on the real streets of the historic peninsula, pay your daily cut to the plate owner, cover fines, fuel and repairs, and try to end every shift in profit.

name: Grandma's Guide to the Grand Outside

details.title: Grandma's Guide to the Grand Outside
details.short_description: Grandma calls for aid! Well… she wants a visit, but she lives in the middle of nowhere. Pack wisely, step into the wilderness, and see if you can reach her!

details.title: She Hunts
details.short_description: She Hunts is an exploration focused narrative action-adventure game set in a fairy tale forest. Battle corrupted creatures with your trusty crossbow and lay clever traps for your foes. But beware the night, for the setting sun heralds the coming of the Beast...

details.title: Calculusmania
details.short_description: Use a calculator to change the world around you. Solve more than 60 puzzles by adjusting variables, unlock new keys, and discover increasingly ingenious solutions in this 2D puzzle game.

details.title: Party Ships
details.short_description: Party Ships is the party brawler that's secretly a physics sandbox. Mix ridiculous items into accidental synergies and unleash them on your mates! Last one standing wins. Simple... right?

details.title: Feetball
details.short_description: A fast-paced first-person football game where precision, skill, and chaos collide. Take full control of every touch, tackle, and strike with realistic ball physics and fluid physical movement. Master the pitch with friends, or team up with others looking to dominate.

details.title: Ad Reditus
details.short_description: A hand-drawn roundtrip roguelike deckbuilder about a pilgrimage and a ring that wants to change you. Build your deck on the way out. Decide what it becomes on the way back.

details.title: Tiny Biomes
details.short_description: A build-your-own aquarium sandbox. Shape the glass, sculpt the substrate, design every plant, hang the lights, then stock the water and live with what you made.

details.title: Duco
details.short_description: A roguelike survival game where you can also interact with NPCs, encounter gangs, and build a small settlement of your own… but with cards. Loot, craft, and survive. Unlock characters and maps, and combine them with traits to create unique runs.

details.title: The Great Bitcoin (Non-)Heist
details.short_description: You paid 99 cents for a busted database full of jumbled interrogation transcripts from four people. The seller promised clues to a Bitcoin case worth over $500,000. 99 cents! What a steal! Shame this thing only lets you search, search, search. The thinking's on you.

details.title: Incinerator Inc
details.short_description: You are a pyro for hire. In Incinerator Inc, people come to you with their problems and you make their problems… unrecoverable… It’s a easy business model. Because some stains only fire can shift.

details.title: Trench Demon
details.short_description: An action-RPG set during WW1. The men in the trenches start to whisper about a figure in armor who walks through gunfire, cannot be killed, and won't stop. Clear the entire Western Front and become a demon.

details.title: Novella Oscura Reverie
details.short_description: Novella Oscura Reverie is a dark fantasy RPG set in the ruined kingdom of Albion and the mysterious Dreaming Realms of humanity. Explore a dying world, uncover its darkest secrets, and face enemies in a unique combat system that seamlessly blends real-time action with turn-based strategy.

details.title: Gniewomir
details.short_description: Open-world RPG with deck-building elements allowing you to combat weird enemies in a weird world where you play as weird characters. Go punch a dog for being ugly, or a stork for being horny. You can even punch a dinosaur!

details.title: The Book of Plagues 2
details.short_description: A steam-age city is gripped by a plague called False Death. You are a doctor once wrongly condemned, but now they need you. Every patient matters: one decision in your office can change the fate of the entire city.

details.title: AMATERASU【 天照 】
details.short_description: A dramatic bullet hell shooter where you master your Shot, Bomb, and the Yatano Kagami System, which transmutes enemy bullets into resources, as you fight to overthrow AMATERASU, the Stellar Management System that has launched its assault on humanity.

details.title: Archmage Divine
details.short_description: Archmage Divine is a 2D RPG featuring strategic card-based combat and deckbuilding. Explore vast cities and kingdoms, gather unique items and equipment, and enhance your deck as you progress on your journey. If you’re just looking to battle, our Roguelike mode is available at any time.

details.title: PLEASE EXPLAIN
details.short_description: You are a corporate internal affairs investigator. Confront suspects, sift through records, and expose lies behind fraud and harassment. Punish or pardon? Your word dictates their fate.

details.title: Bacon Cannibal
details.short_description: EVERYTHING IS GOOD IN THE PIG! Run your own pork restaurant, cook delicious pork recipes for your customers, expand your menu, manage your stock, grow your restaurant, and build your rind empire!

details.title: Nowhere Dawn
details.short_description: Nowhere Dawn is a survival action game set in a collapsed world. Move through cities and towns haunted by the infected, and follow the traces left behind by those who disappeared.

details.title: Operation Serval
details.short_description: Operation Serval is a tactical multiplayer armored warfare game where you command tanks and combat vehicles against enemy teams on realistic battlefields, where positioning and precision decide the outcome.

name: COVENANT OF GEARS The Three Musketeers

details.title: COVENANT OF GEARS The Three Musketeers
details.short_description: Lead the Musketeers in this steampunk tactical cRPG! Tactical pause combat against the English invasion. Use the powerful Campaign Editor to create and share your own adventures. And play the official campaign and those from the community.

details.title: Night Mass
details.short_description: You’re a Priest defending your Church from the horrors that come each night. Gather resources, explore the forest, and build your defenses while the sun is still shining. When darkness falls, stand your ground, survive until dawn, and let the Night Mass begin!

details.title: Canal Tycoon
details.short_description: Canal Tycoon is a unique transport builder set in the canal’s golden age, with mechanics not seen elsewhere in the genre. Move industry’s goods across period-map landscapes, manage contested water, politics and rivals, automate operations to reduce grind, then survive the railroads.

details.title: Tafl Throne Breakers
details.short_description: Play like a Viking in this cunning game of strategy - help your Jarl escape the battlefield or capture them before they do. Endlessly enjoyable with multiple variations, AI and online opponents and regular events to determine who is the grand master of Tafl!

details.title: Hardcourt Balls
details.short_description: Hardcourt Balls is a fast-paced, turn-based adaptation of the real-world game of tennis. With just a few simple rules, the roll of dice, and tactical use of skill "cards", it manages to capture some of the nuances and excitement that make tennis such a great sport.

details.title: Blood Court
details.short_description: Blood Court is a Souls-like action RPG within a dark fantasy, horrifying world. Explore PSX styled Environments, battle blood hungry monsters, and piece together a story told through environments, and voiceless cinamatics.

details.title: Praxium
details.short_description: Praxium is a 2D precision platformer that blends fast-paced movement with strategic deckbuilding. Gain movement abilities, transform scoring rules, and even modify levels themselves to achieve the highest score possible while running, jumping, and sliding across 100 levels of pure platforming fun!

details.title: Mascot Mayhem (Asymmetrical Horror)
details.short_description: Asymmetrical Mascot Horror survival game where two mascots must team up to kill ALL the survivors. Featuring crossover characters from all across the mascot horror universe (and beyond!)

details.title: Loafing Dungeon
details.short_description: Loafing Dungeon is a fully automatic desktop idle game. Build your hero team on the desktop, equip them with gear and skills, and then launch the adventure on auto-pilot. The game runs continuously in the background, ensuring your progression and rewards are always fight, whether you're busy or free

details.title: Bird Roll 64
details.short_description: This recovered copy of a lost 3D ball-rolling platformer from the 90s appears to have been created by eldritch forces from out of this world. Would you be able to find all its secrets and escape its surreal spaces?

details.title: NO PAROLE
details.short_description: Up to 16 players, one prison, friendly fire on. Raid a city where the dead get back up unless you burn them, haul the loot home and hold the walls when the government comes to bury the evidence. Then it sets the city on fire. Your crew dies for good. You don't. You just don't know why yet.

details.title: 4Born
details.short_description: A tactical roguelite RPG where every run forces you to adapt. Explore procedural dungeons under fog of war. Learn spells, gain items and forge each of your four heroes into one of many powerful classes. Build your team with what you get and break the game.

details.title: BELOW
details.short_description: BELOW is a co-op horror game about scavenging and cleaning trashed, abandoned deep sea outposts and research sites to repay your debt to a shady corporation!

details.title: Zombie Industrial Complex
details.short_description: Exterminate zombies using the might of the military industrial complex. In this active incremental game, you'll earn money by defeating zombies which can be used to buy weapons, purchase upgrades, call in airstrikes, and send in the tanks!

details.title: Ashenburrow
details.short_description: An underground survival and simulation game. Wildlife hunts, NPCs make camp, talk and fight… with or without you. Lead your expedition, alone or with up to four players, and remember: even underground, night falls.

details.title: Dung Slinger
details.short_description: An action-packed physics platformer about being chained to a giant dung ball! Master a complex movement system to move, swing and launch yourself forward. Defeat enemies, overcome obstacles and regain your freedom in a game that blends traditional platforming with a tight physics system!

details.title: Legendary Creatures 3
details.short_description: Return to the core auto-battler experience: pure recruiting and economy, faster-paced combat. Evolve both heroes and gear, with a legendary evolution for every path—then forge your own build through skills, equipment, and emblems.

details.title: Orb Orb Magi
details.short_description: Orb Orb Magi is an arcade Pinball Bulletheaven inspired by action roguelites and early Pinball videogames. Play Pinball like a Magical Girl with lots of different weapons and upgrades.

details.title: Blind Spin
details.short_description: A 1-4 player fusion of Roulette and Poker. Bet on a rigged wheel with hidden odds and bluff your opponents to steal the pot. Use items to cheat and sabotage your rivals. Who will end up the richest?

details.title: Keyboard Smash
details.short_description: Run a shop. Help weird customers. And definitely make everything worse!

details.title: Dream Travel
details.short_description: 来一场在现实与梦境中的探索与冒险吧！平淡的暑期宅家生活、奇幻的野外回合战斗、惊险的图形机关解谜、生死攸关的鱼儿推理和毛毛虫的房间逃脱……丰富的剧情和玩法等着你来体验！

details.title: Island Of Ash
details.short_description: A 3rd-person action-adventure inspired by cult classics. Explore a unique, solo-developed world and vanquish foes in intense battles. Level up your hero and reveal the secrets of a civilization that crumbled into dust five centuries ago.

details.title: Dice and Daydream
details.short_description: Roll five dice, use limited rerolls to shape the result, and play cards powered by your dice total. Combos like pairs and straights trigger bonus effects. Build your deck in a childhood-daydream roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: What's in the box?
details.short_description: OPEN CONTAINERS! Seriously, just buy a container and… OPEN IT! What’s inside? - A MYSTERY! Find a rare item, fix it, and sell it for as much as possible in this first-person incremental game!

details.title: Necroblobicon
details.short_description: Necroblobicon is a roguelike where your enemies become your army. Raise the dead, gear them up, and arrange them around positional relics on a 5x5 formation. In battle, you pick who dies first and who gets back up on your side.

details.title: GunSlaw VR
details.short_description: A flexible free-to-play online multiplayer VR shooter featuring a wide variety of voxel-based gamemodes. Build, destroy, shoot, repeat!

details.title: Herd
details.short_description: Build your set, outplay your rival, and win the Mélodus in a cute musical card battler where every match becomes a live performance.

details.title: Peak or Die
details.short_description: Peak or Die is a narrative-driven survival game about leading a team of adventurers up a deadly mountain, where every decision has lasting consequences. Manage oxygen, food, and team morale while facing moral dilemmas, random events, and an unforgiving environment. Reach the summit — or fail trying.

details.title: The Duke is Dead
details.short_description: Duke Damian has been murdered! Collect clues, solve puzzles, and deduce the killer. Follow a growing trail of crimes and unravel the conspiracy tying them all together.

details.title: Hardware Simulator
details.short_description: Build your hardware empire from scratch! Experience real business with product sourcing, dynamic pricing, online orders, and delivery management. Boost your popularity, expand your store, and become the country's most successful hardware merchant!

details.title: Confined Space
details.short_description: Pilot a customizable spaceship, battle through procedurally generated arenas, and adapt your build with modular abilities to survive escalating enemy waves in this fast-paced 2D top-down roguelike shoot ’em up

details.title: Vocal Horror Stories - Gaja
details.short_description: The first episode of a voice-sensitive episodic horror game, in which you play as Shivani, a young woman battling with phonophobia. Why did her mother go missing? Who is the elephant-headed entity she keeps seeing? Can you speak to him?

details.title: Lab Loonies
details.short_description: Lab Loonies is a physics-based descent into madness where "logic" is a suggestion the developer ignored. In this 1-4 player lab experiment, the platforms are lying, the physics are "opinionated," and the Narrator is actively rooting for your demise. Make good choices, or don't. The Lab doesn't judge

details.title: SinsKiller
details.short_description: SinsKiller is an isometric action arcade shooter set in a Dante-inspired Hell. Play as a fallen battle-mage wielding arcane power to obliterate demonic hordes and face brutal bosses. Face your sins. Kill them. Earn your redemption.

details.title: Dead 4 Now: Extraction
details.short_description: Survive the outbreak or become it in a PvPvE FPS extraction shooter. Scavenge loot, use experimental stims, and fight to extract as a survivor. Or enter a raid as a zombie, hunt other players, and evolve into a monstrous boss.

details.title: Alien Colony
details.short_description: Lead a squad of four cloned marines through an infected mining colony where every death creates a new soldier, but slowly destroys what remains of your humanity.

details.title: Auto Arcana
details.short_description: Devise the ultimate spell rotation and watch it obliterate your foes in this roguelike auto-battler. Seek forbidden knowledge to craft overpowered spells, assemble devastating combos, and break the game.

details.title: QSO7
details.short_description: A space RPG with an insanely rich story line filled with mind-bending puzzles, deep philosophical conversations and gorgeous alien species. If you are the first person to unlock the game 100% you will gain access to a hidden cash prize.

details.title: Multi Class Quest
details.short_description: Traverse a forgotten fantasy world in this classic Beat Em Up hack and slash! Fight through hordes of unique monsters as one of five different classes...then, mix the skills you learned into another class to create your unique fighter!

details.title: Bread and Iron
details.short_description: A brutal medieval survival sandbox blending crafting, base building, and combat as players struggle against harsh environments and dangerous creatures.

details.title: Helenland
details.short_description: Helen finds a mysterious video game on her doorstep and starts playing it. But as she progresses, strange events begin to happen around her...

details.title: Wisword: The Calamitous Starfall
details.short_description: A classic dungeon-crawling RPG set in the fantasy world of Eutolant. Create your own party and face deadly traps and monsters in the depths of labyrinthine dungeons. When it's all over, will your name be written into legend — or onto a headstone?

details.title: Siren's Wrath
details.short_description: A point-and-click adventure where you are trapped in a psychological loop, relive a tragic event, and return the cursed artifacts to escape the loop, before the curse claims you. But remember, she is watching.

details.title: Boing Boing Animals
details.short_description: Raise Tamagotchi-style pixel animal friends right on your desktop! Care for slimes from outer space and help them grow into bouncy 'Boing Boing' Earth animals. Feed and play with your adorable friends while completing the Codex! Your tiny companions will always be by your side.

details.title: The Other Order
details.short_description: A surreal tile-based roguelike where you build and reshape tile combinations to attack your enemies.

details.title: Gag Order
details.short_description: The Research laboratory's Guardian Unit faced with a hellish mission to exterminate invincible cephalopod creatures in this one-of-a-kind immersive co-operative Horror FPS.

details.title: Survive The Oasis
details.short_description: Survive The Oasis is a co-op open-world action RPG with survival elements, focused on exploration, combat, character progression, and a journey toward enlightenment.

details.title: REAL DEAL
details.short_description: Run your own electronics store chain. Buy phones, tablets, computers, fridges, and more in bulk, transport them with your truck, and sell them at prices you choose. Manage up to 4 stores with hired employees, but fail to plan well and you won’t be able to pay rent, bills, or salaries.

details.title: Pathways Lost: Reclaim
details.short_description: Send customised troops and your powerful mech into battle in this strategic auto battler. Spawn units, equip gear, unlock skills and reclaim lost worlds. Optimize your army and master ever increasing challenges. Fast-paced matches, endless depth.

details.title: ROGUE COLLECTOR
details.short_description: ROGUE COLLECTOR is a hex-grid tactical roguelike where you don't collect gear: you collect the Rogues. Rescue procedurally generated Rogues from dungeons, extract them in time, or lose them forever. Trade your Rogues on a live player-driven marketplace.

details.title: Fast Food Architect
details.short_description: At the dawn of American fast food, build and manage your fast-food restaurant. Create your burgers, coordinate service, and grow your establishment over the decades.

details.title: Zombies & Battery
details.short_description: Zombies hunt by the sound of your heartbeat, and only static from a government radio can hide it. Keep the battery alive, drive your camper van to the safe zone, and scavenge, sneak and revive fallen friends in casual co-op zombie survival for 1–4 players.

details.title: Godlings Unleashed
details.short_description: Godlings Unleashed is an action roguelike.Encounter all kinds of bizarre characters, defeat or recruit them, upgrade your powers, and mix and match gear and treasures to create unique builds. Fight your way through a chaotic world full of surprises, absurdity, and laughs, and make it to the end!

details.title: Monarch: The Tainted Kingdom
details.short_description: Monarch: TTK is an Action Monster Taming RPG where strategy dictates the flow of combat. Capture monsters, gather their loot to build custom skillsets, and master an engaging Timeline-based combat system.
