Uncover the secrets of the Archs and break through the corruption plaguing the Continent!

details.title: Loaded Dice
details.short_description: Wager. Survive. Profit. Throw your friends around and bet against them to show who's faster, better, and smarter in this fast action-strategy party game.

details.title: The Jotun Queen
details.short_description: Embark on a journey to a land inspired by real world mythology and meet a cast of colourful characters. Fight tactical battles and save the world from the icy hatred of The Jotun Queen

details.title: Lethal Grace
details.short_description: Order received. Target identified. Proceed with elimination. Play as Grace, a killer android, in this dynamic shooter.

details.title: King of Freshwater
details.short_description: "King of Freshwater " is a fish-themed Boss Rush action game featuring intense combat and knockback mechanics. Players control a small fish challenging dozens of larger aquatic predators in brutal battles.

details.title: Aircraft Dispatcher: Ground Operations
details.short_description: Take charge of airport operations. Manage aircraft maintenance, ground support, equipment, and taxiway movements, then leave the office to inspect aircraft, investigate damage, clear FOD, respond to emergencies, and keep flights moving safely and on schedule.

details.title: MegaGum
details.short_description: Play as Uja, an orphan searching for answers in this 3D action adventure platformer. Harness the properties of Gum to stick to walls, inflate, and make your way through the MegaGum factory. Face Mister Gum and his mysterious creations to uncover the secrets hidden behind its colorful facade.

details.title: Ghost Node
details.short_description: Play as a freelance hacker breaking into high-security facilities to steal corporate secrets in this stealth game. Use your drone to scout ahead, hack and rewire systems to slip past security, grab the data and get out unseen.

details.title: Desktopper!
details.short_description: A multiplayer game that lives right on your taskbar. In Desktopper! you can customize your character, collect items from blind boxes, chat, and hang out with friends all while multitasking. Jump into a lobby and make new friends!

details.title: The Bold Bogey
details.short_description: The Bold Bogey is a 3D golf adventure that combines open exploration with satisfying platforming. Explore a vast world filled with dungeons to dive into, bosses to fight, and new ways to upgrade your ball in a golf game unlike any other. Do you have what it takes to become the Boldest Bogey?

details.title: Crim Ludus
details.short_description: Crim Ludus is a grim-dark PvPvE arena where enslaved mages are forced to battle in underground arenas in a world ruled by demons. Fight in deadly arena matches that combine real-time grid-based movement, strategic spellcasting, and relentless monster hordes in a brutal test of positioning and survival.

details.title: First
details.short_description: First-person exploration puzzle game set in quiet, liminal spaces. Minimal environments hide unconventional logic puzzles that unfold through observation, interaction, and experimentation.

details.title: Architect Fray
details.short_description: A dramatic Deckbuilding RPG featuring artwork by Satoshi Matsuura. Carry only a few cards into the dungeon. Master preparation, time your Parries, and dive into a story where every skill holds a memory. A massive scenario awaits in this fusion of strategy and narrative.

details.title: NORMA: Story of One Platform
details.short_description: Explore the secrets of this world and discover what the local government, working alongside powerful corporations, has planned in its pursuit of complete control over the population.

details.title: UN:Me
details.short_description: UN:Me is a soul triage adventure. Four souls share one girl’s body, each certain it is the real one, yet only one can remain. Through dialogue you search a beautiful, unsettling world for its true owner, fleeing the traumas that surface as you go. When only one can stay, which will you keep?

details.title: Pale Cantons
details.short_description: A first-person sandbox RPG set in a secluded canton ringed by impassable mountains. Learn trades, fight, barter, earn the locals’ trust, and search for your missing sister but remember: the only way out leads through an ever-changing labyrinth.

details.title: RETROBOTS
details.short_description: The year is 2109, and RETROBOTS is the world's most chaotic sport. Select your Retrobot, customize and tune it to perfection, and enter the battle. Smash, slam, launch, and destroy your opponents in arenas across the world. Are you ready to KICK SOME BOT?

details.title: VeilRaun
details.short_description: Become an Explorer of fractured realities in Veil Raun, a third-person dark fantasy action RPG. Take expeditions beyond the Veil, battle Hollows, rise through the Explorer ranks, and uncover the mystery behind the Fracture.

name: Little Boy : Small Steps, Big Changes

details.title: Little Boy : Small Steps, Big Changes
details.short_description: Little Boy, a narrative game where you play as a robot assistant helping people find happiness!

details.title: Dimensional Breach
details.short_description: 4-player online co-op. The rifts are open, and every dimension hides a different threat. Dive in with your friends, tear the nightmare out by its roots and seal the breach or be lost to the dark.

details.title: Bury Us Together
details.short_description: A cooperative survival strategy game with heroes. Explore and expand by day, build your defenses, and hold the line against thousands of enemies by night. Enjoy as a solo player or with up to 3 friends!

details.title: Marrowood
details.short_description: Haunted by the suppressed memories of your childhood, you receive a letter from the town you grew up in. They need you to rebuild your family's farm. It's time to remember, welcome home.

details.title: Tenancy
details.short_description: Tenancy is a roguelike deckbuilder about managing the costs, risks, and unique effects of angry little ladies so you can live off their paychecks. While tenants may be lackluster on their own, when played together they can be extorted for maximum value!

details.title: Blood Being 2
details.short_description: Work has ended. Something told you to find the tower. You can only get in by obliterating your brain. What comes next?

details.title: Far Away Kingdom
details.short_description: A fast-paced arcade gallery shooter inspired by Wild Guns and Cabal. Play solo or in local co-op, switch between fire and ice, dodge intense bullet patterns, and take down powerful bosses. Unlock hidden routes, discover secret encounters, and chase high scores.

details.title: Crowned Games
details.short_description: A party game collection for groups of 2–8. Six wildly different minigames, one shared lobby. Bring your own images, audio, and quizzes — or just jump in and play.

details.title: Arthur’s Tale
details.short_description: Guide Arthur through a world that’s out to get him! Sprint, leap, and faceplant your way through a vibrant adventure overflowing with devious traps, oversized bosses, and enough "Try Again" screens to last a lifetime. It’s colorful, it’s chaotic, and yes—you’re probably going to fail. A lot.

details.title: Whose Story (아무개전)
details.short_description: A Korean-style action roguelike set in a dark Joseon-inspired world. Fight supernatural enemies and survive ever-changing dungeons.

details.title: Dokuro・Maguro
details.short_description: Awaken in a psychiatric hospital and become trapped in an endless loop of madness. Explore bizarre hellscapes, battle monstrous tuna creatures, and fight your way out of a surreal nightmare in this absurd escape horror FPS!

details.title: Yrdenwatch - The Dragon from Lidoriya
details.short_description: This game is about piloting a giant mech with wings that has multiple guns attached to it. It's explosive, fast-paced, skill-based, and full of gun violence. It's also a story-driven game where you explore a spaceship and talk to your fellow crew members!

details.title: Crescent County
details.short_description: Crash headfirst into this witch-tech world, drifting and driving on the back of your new motorbroom. Make deliveries, trick out your broom, and race your new friends (and crushes) as the sun sets. Get into gossip, sort your life out, and discover what it means to find home.

details.title: ZWAARD
details.short_description: Explore a post-apocalyptic world overrun by dangerous technologies and whatever is left of humanity. Scavenge for parts to upgrade your modular sword and uncover why you are here.

details.title: Fallen Symphony
details.short_description: The world of Fallen Symphony is full of heated battles, engaging puzzles, and fearsome dungeons. Prepare yourself for a unique battle system which is inspired by brawlers from late 90s and gameplay based on the JRPGs of old.

details.title: Limbo Control
details.short_description: Limbo Control is a 1v4 asymmetric horror game where a supernatural creature takes over the area in an attempt to anchor itself in our world, while four hunters fight to reclaim control before it’s too late.

details.title: Melted Time
details.short_description: Candle, your path is full of puzzles. Can you handle it? Hurry, your time is already melting away.

details.title: Desecrated Deck
details.short_description: Desecrated Deck is a first-person psychological horror card game where you face a spectral opponent in a forbidden occult ritual of Rock, Paper, Scissors, powerful Item Cards, and supernatural Perks. Win the game — or discover what happens when you don’t.

details.title: Void Soul Awakening
details.short_description: Void Soul Awakening is a hyper fast action roguelite blending hack and slash combat, third person gunplay, and sorcery. As a wandering soul trapped in an ever shifting cosmic prison, master a massive arsenal, swap between powerful classes, adapt to every run, and fight your way to the Keeper.

details.title: Beckon
details.short_description: Salvation lies deep beneath blood-soaked earth. Survive horrors born of Scottish folklore alone or with your friends - improve your camp, hunt and forge powerful weapons and find ancient, game-altering magic. From the dark, you hear her Beckon - eat a hearty meal and get ready to descend once again.

details.title: Concerto on White
details.short_description: Rhythm Action? No, this is MUSICIAN SIMULATION! Concerto on White is a musician simulation game featuring classical music. Unlike any typical rhythm games, players are required to actually play the main melody. In the main story, you will experience adventurous campus life in the academy.

details.title: Timeless Heart VR
details.short_description: Timeless Heart VR is a story-driven VR action adventure. Join Lycaena in battle, wield different weapons, and use your Chain Claw to race through four kingdoms frozen on the eve of ruin. Only by defying fate again can you reach the final answer.

details.title: Chromahertz
details.short_description: Chromahertz is a colorful and dangerous bullet hell boss rush game. It's all about weaving and warping through patterns to evade and reflect bullets. Be careful where you stop!

details.title: Red Rebellion
details.short_description: A sapphic fairy tale mashup as Robin Hood teams up with Red Riding Hood to save their town set in a historically accurate medieval England.

details.title: Legless
details.short_description: A co-op game where you have no legs. Search different maps and clear trials to appease Gods and earn your freedom - all while a giant, quirky pair of legs hunts you down.

details.title: Taste of Power: Medieval
details.short_description: Master the art of war in brutal action-RTS across an alternate medieval world. Lead Europe, China or the Timurids to supremacy through strategic brilliance and lightning-fast tactics. Expand your realm, advance powerful technologies and lead massive armies. DISCOVER NEW HORIZONS OF THE MEDIEVAL WARS

details.title: 东方药药灵-Touhou Herbalist
details.short_description: ​As a young girl from the Human Village of Gensokyo, you will enter Eientei to learn medicine-making. By fulfilling the requests of its peculiar residents, you may receive their Spell Cards as a reward. Use potions and Spell Cards to experience an extraordinary life in Gensokyo!​

details.title: Chain Shotgun
details.short_description: Chain Shotgun is a fast paced movement shooter where your only weapon is the multi-barrelled CHAIN SHOTGUN. Two barrels are way too few! With an up-to-infinite amount of barrels, it can shoot anything from sniper rounds, rockets, slime - LEGS? Why not even load it with yourself?

details.title: Be the Block
details.short_description: Be the Block is a Sokoban-inspired 2D puzzle game where you don’t just push the blocks, you ARE the blocks. Solve a collection of carefully hand-crafted puzzles that are by design simple yet challenging.

details.title: What a Wonderful Venom World
details.short_description: "What a Wonderful Venom World" is a difficult survival sim. All food is poisoned, and you must find an antidote through endless trial and error. Face countless deaths and share info with other players to speed up your research. This game is for players who enjoy a serious challenge.

details.title: Meal Quest
details.short_description: Explore the magical world inside your fridge, plan meals, and fight your way to the Dream City. Your in-game nutrition choices grant you combat bonuses that reflect each vitamin’s actual role in the body.

details.title: Deadlight Manor
details.short_description: A stylized survival horror built on community. Squad up with your team, battle endless waves of the infected, and let your stream audience fuel the chaos in real time.

details.title: Friends of a Feather
details.short_description: An absurd adventure RPG: ruin weddings, break into dinosaur mansions, and sleep with 3 or 4 opossums.

details.title: Frozen Echo
details.short_description: Venture into the endless frozen wastelands alone or with friends. Stay warm, manage and upgrade your camp, hunt, and learning your skills to survive the harsh cold and wolf attacks.

details.title: Purrfect Collars
details.short_description: Purrfect Collars is a cozy single-player shopkeeping adventure. As a witch, design collars, enchant them with potions, manage your shop and meet interesting new customers! Each collar holds meaning, every cat a story!

details.title: Caribbean Tide
details.short_description: Sail the 17th-century Caribbean as John Nelson. Smuggle or trade, upgrade your ship, manage your crew and colony, and uncover buried truths across 10+ ports, 50+ branching quests, and a vast open world shaped by shifting alliances and moral choices.

details.title: Ragga-Dagga
details.short_description: An Action Roguelite where Aggressive Play is Rewarded Handsomely! Explore a Non-Euclidean Dungeon filled with hidden mysteries in this oh so cute adventure about a catling and his sentient floating sword!

details.title: Metronome
details.short_description: Metronome is a short semi auto-biographical interactive story about the life of a British musician spanning from the early 90s to the late 2020s.

details.title: MEDIX
details.short_description: You are not here to win the war, but to save whom you can before the line breaks. A narrative real-time strategy where you lead a unit of war medics across hand-drawn battlefields and race to reach the wounded as your army retreats before an overwhelming foe. Keep hope alive amidst the chaos.

details.title: Neon Rain
details.short_description: Welcome to Vakrex, a world brimming with life but plagued by conflict. You must sift through the occupational forces and hostile wildlife to investigate the cosmic phenomena known as Neon Rain. You don't call the shots on this treacherous planet, however. Evolve or die.

details.title: Runic Prophecy
details.short_description: Runic Prophecy is a challenging third-person soulslike action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Explore Eyjusheim, unleash magic and a dragon in combat, battle supernatural creatures, and uncover the hidden lore of a shattered world.

details.title: Pair at Sea
details.short_description: Manage your own pirate crew and sail across the sea. Take care of the ship morale, drag your sailors from one room to another and raid other ships as you navigate the seas.

name: Occult Hand of the Blood Lily

details.title: Occult Hand of the Blood Lily
details.short_description: A Gothic-Punk yuri visual novel about a magician on the run and her mysterious vampiric guardian. Journey by airship across a war-torn Europe and search for a legendary flower with the power to destroy nations.

details.title: Keyboard Warriors
details.short_description: Keyboard Warriors is a bullet-heaven roguelite typing game, customise your mech and weapon loadout and type out the story of the world to cut down huge hordes of enemies and bosses, powering up with each victory and unlocking new upgrades with every run.

details.title: Glider64
details.short_description: Collect, steal and blast your way through the Glider League! Build a massive chain, fight off your rivals and race to the Gate to score big.

details.title: Eclipse
details.short_description: Three friends known as The Ghost Hunters are documenting abandoned locations. What begins as a normal episode suddenly turns into a nightmare inside The Holloway Mansion. Something terrifying happens, leaving Jack to survive alone in the mansion and face the horrors.

details.title: Insanity Path
details.short_description: A plague spreads alongside a spree of sudden disappearances... You don't need more to get on with your adventure. Step into the world of an Auto-battler/Roguelite, where each of your mistakes will send you further down the path of Insanity. Will you be able to free the forest from this tragic curse?

details.title: This Week
details.short_description: A hardcore parkour game that tells the story of Ania, a kid with mental health issues and a lot of stuff to go through in life. Meant to make you experience how someone feels in a weird, but familiar way.

details.title: Code Alone
details.short_description: A programming puzzle game where you step into the role of a gameplay programmer, write code to build the core mechanics of a wide variety of games, and solve increasingly challenging development problems.

details.title: BLACK WALLS
details.short_description: Explore a silent, impossible world of puzzles and obstacles. Make symbolic choices whose consequences may not be clear, your decisions shape your ending. Choose Chill Mode for a calm, mysterious journey with nothing hunting you, or Horror Mode for fear, danger, and something that wants you dead.

details.title: Naron
details.short_description: Co-op mining roguelite for 1-4 players. Dig into a dying moon, complete objectives and fight your way back to your drillship. Every step of progress makes the return more dangerous. Tunnels can collapse and bury you. 47 crews failed to reach the core. How deep will you go?

details.title: FLS: Fleeting Light and Shadows
details.short_description: A story-driven vertical space shooter made by young, passionate devs. Play as EOX-375, a robot born of a fallen golden age. Journey into post-apocalyptic peril, avenge humanity against its instigator, and seek one unverified truth: the future need not follow set rules. What do we exist for?

details.title: Caravanier
details.short_description: Lead a post-apocalyptic caravan through the dark wreckage of a fallen colony ship. Caravanier is a 2D top-down trade-based RPG where you exploit lucrative trade routes, barter with rival survivor factions, stave off the encroaching darkness, and shape the fate of this divided world.

details.title: Dawar: Ashes of the Snow
details.short_description: Dawar is a third-person action-adventure game. Carve your path in a punishing, UI-less world. Master the combat mechanics. Dismember your enemies. Reach your goal.

details.title: Let's make SILLY ART!
details.short_description: Time to make SILLY ART! Help Charlie rediscover the joy of making art in this cozy and creative point and click. Tidy your house, find inspirations, collect stickers and create authentic artwork to build your portfolio!

details.title: Over Package!
details.short_description: Over Package! is a chaotic, physics-based multiplayer party game. Clash with your friends in hilarious arena brawls to deliver cargo. Outsmart rivals with dynamic environmental destruction, leverage chaotic physics, and turn every delivery into absolute combat logistics madness!

details.title: Endless Night Sonata
details.short_description: Endless Night Sonata is a hand drawn metroidvania with classic style animation. Follow the quest of Nicodemos in the "Worlds-in-middle", an unforgiving and dangerous land controlled by demonic forces on a epic mission to find his purpose...

details.title: Ariki
details.short_description: A co-op colony sim for up to 10 players. Wash ashore on a Pacific archipelago, raise a village with colonists who work the land, win over rival villages in dance-offs, then sail your canoes side by side and navigate by the stars to new islands.

details.title: Sticks and Stones
details.short_description: Post-apocalyptic survival simulator set after an asteroid impact.

details.title: DesktopDaily
details.short_description: Ami Koharune and Tsukuyomi-chan live on your PC. Chat with voiced characters whose gestures match their words, or watch them cook, read and sleep in a shared home that doubles as a live wallpaper. Free to download, with trial credits for chat.

details.title: Slime Vendor
details.short_description: Raise slimes. Sell them to dungeon lords. Feed them, clean them, pet them, learn which one hates the cold — then crate them up on delivery day. Catch rare slimes in the wilds, breed new ones, and get to know your strangest clients: the dungeon lords.

details.title: A Sea of Ashen Tulips
details.short_description: A Sea of Ashen Tulips is a fantasy Text-based RPG where players control a former mercenary who searches for allies in investigating and combatting a colonial occupation.

details.title: KRUSHPIT
details.short_description: KRUSHPIT is a Real-Time Indirect PvP roguelike survival set among brutal concrete blocks and rusty garages. Obliterate mutants, evolve skills, spin slots, and create OP builds! Survive the chaos or join the PvP ladder to crush everyone and dominate the leaderboard!

details.title: Brassfang
details.short_description: Explore a castle filled with monsters and strange experiments in this steampunk action RPG metroidvania. Combine vampiric and mechanical powers, face challenging bosses, and create unique builds through randomized upgrade choices.

details.title: BULLETPROOF
details.short_description: A story-driven retro FPS set in early-2000s Seattle. Dismantle the criminal empire you built in a brutal campaign of revenge behind a bulletproof mask.

name: gumball: a rogue-like peg poppin' blast

details.title: gumball: a rogue-like peg poppin' blast
details.short_description: a rogue-like peg poppin' blast! dispense gumballs, pop pegs, and stamp your candy-coated arsenal with game-breaking modifiers on your way to mastering the pegs. built solo from from my wife's basement in utah, gumball is a vibrant peg breaking physics rogue-like where every run rewrites the rules.

details.title: My Friend, Dysentery
details.short_description: A darkly comedic "Horribly Realistic Fantasy Travel Simulator" survival adventure roguelike inspired by Oregon Trail. Journey to the Promised Land to kill a dragon! Fight monsters, manage supplies & disasters, and learn that fantasy journeys are nothing heroic like the films, but cripplingly brutal.

details.title: Benson Bones
details.short_description: A top-down pixel art action RPG. You wake in a graveyard, a dog finds you, and then a portal takes him. Learn every enemy's tell, take down bosses that punish button-mashing, and cross hand-built realms to bring him home.

details.title: Scrappers: Adhokin
details.short_description: Build your hideout with wasteland salvage, then head out again. Scrappers: Adhokin is a solo top-down extraction shooter with base building and resource management. Place structures and furniture, manage power and fuel, and return alive with gear, blueprints, and loot.

details.title: CLAM
details.short_description: Clam is an odd pet rat; googly-eyed, unpredictable and hyper-vigilant. One night Clam gets spooked and escapes the rat mansion with no way back in. Now she’s a tenant. Is the sharehouse as hospitable as home? Be a rat, be a renter, survive a sharehouse - it’s CLAM!

details.title: Legend of BAKEHIME
details.short_description: A thrilling Japanese-style action game featuring Saya, a half-yokai princess who fires spiritual arrows from her bow, and Jubei, her kind-hearted retainer who wields a spear with mastery. Together, they stand against waves of terrifying yokai through the power of their bond!

details.title: Nightmare Journey 1135
details.short_description: A horror adventure through wandering nightmares “The escape game is over.”

details.title: Insomnia Club
details.short_description: A grounded emotional visual novel about urban insomnia, moral dilemmas, and intimacy. By day, you monetize insomniacs' pain and privacy. By night, you seek help at a real Insomnia Club and meet the women treated as collateral. Are you helping them—or turning them into a better product?

name: Choice of Life: Become a Witch

details.title: Choice of Life: Become a Witch
details.short_description: Leka has always dreamed of becoming a witch. But the real magical world turned out not to be what she had imagined. Will she be able to uncover all its secrets? Including the one that connects her to magic.

details.title: Havenrail
details.short_description: “The Last Train of Humanity” is a survival strategy game. Manage your train, oversee resources, and make tough decisions that determine the fate of your passengers. Will they survive the perilous journey?

details.title: 90 Minutes Till The World Ends
details.short_description: 90 minutes remain until the world ends. Will you face the end with regret or go out with a bang?”

details.title: LineForgeBlackSmith
details.short_description: A blacksmith shop with a "line" of unique adventurers! Use your memory and timing mini-games to quickly identify each customer's preferred weapon and forge it. In the Battle Phase, your armed customers fight. Power up your regulars (MVPs) and defeat the bosses. Become the busiest blacksmith!

details.title: Daybreak Torch
details.short_description: DaybreakTorch is a pixel-art party-based RPG that combines real-time tactical combat with traditional sRPG's squad building. Assemble your own elite hero squad and embark on a heroic, classic adventure set in a mythological world.

details.title: Void Crawlers
details.short_description: Void Crawlers is a Top-down Rogue-Lite Incremental Shooter, there are 3 initial games modes, Arcade - Room to room combat, Gauntlet - 30 minute invasion, and Story - A combination of Arcade and Gauntlet mode with a story on top.

details.title: MioAquaria
details.short_description: Build and manage a cozy underwater sandbox aquarium run by cats. Discover fantasy sea creatures, research upgrades, send expeditions, and balance fish, staff, and visitor needs to become the world’s top aquarium.

details.title: Blackroots
details.short_description: Blackroots is a co-op fantasy/horror game where players work together or alone to resist a dark force known as Ul'vorran.

details.title: HIIT: Stranded on Zaruma
details.short_description: Trapped on the mysterious planet Zaruma, use tools like the Drone, Scanner, and Hookshot to explore the ruins of an ancient civilization and uncover what happened before your arrival.

details.title: Happy Village: The Broken Timeline
details.short_description: A narrative RPG of three intertwined stories, hidden secrets, and a broken timeline only the player can repair. Every ending reveals new paths, if you know where to look.

details.title: Alchemist's Arcana
details.short_description: A narrative puzzle game where you return to your hometown as an Alchemists' Guild clerk and unexpectedly become the acting alchemist. Relearn forgotten alchemy, help the townsfolk, and survive with your companions in a world slowly falling apart.

details.title: GlagStone
details.short_description: A 1-bit story-driven city builder inspired by late-80s Macintosh aesthetics. Rebuild a remote northern island settlement between warring nations and uncover the mystery at its heart.

name: BOKUKAN5 TOKYO (HND) I am an Air Traffic Controller

details.title: BOKUKAN5 TOKYO (HND) I am an Air Traffic Controller
details.short_description: The latest air traffic control puzzle is here! Set at Tokyo International Airport (HND/RJTT), experience two ways to enjoy the airport: Air Traffic Control Puzzle and the all-new Terminal Side. BOKUKAN evolves into a game where you can immerse yourself in the airport experience.

details.title: Forgotten
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. Shipwrecked on a remote island, Evelyn searches for the missing lighthouse keeper, her only way home. But the people of this island were forgotten long ago. Explore, solve puzzles and hide as you uncover who they were.

details.title: Chug It 🍺
details.short_description: Grow it. Brew it. Chug it. Run a cozy fantasy tavern, farm your own ingredients, cook food and drinks by hand, and serve a wide cast of customers. Play solo or in 4-player co-op, and let golem helpers handle the chores.

details.title: Wrongbots
details.short_description: Annihilate robot hordes and survive in this roguelite shooter. Hack or smash productive machinery. Grab resources and craft cool items. Swap body parts with glamour or extravaganza. Modify your weapons to absurdity. See how clever AI has become?

details.title: Ammo Station Simulator
details.short_description: Manage your gun shop in Ammo Station. By day, sell and repair weapons. By night, team up with friends to rob warehouses and smuggle illegal arms. Rise from a respectable shopkeeper to the city's ultimate gun baron in this first-person simulation.

details.title: Filled Up
details.short_description: Filled Up is a first-person survival horror/comedy hybrid featuring LGBT characters and themes. After a horrific accident, you awaken in the town of Hunksville, alone. An ancient and corrupt evil has taken over the town - can you save not only your friends, but the town of Hunksville itself?

details.title: Havenreach: Last Refuge
details.short_description: Fight for your people’s survival in this turn-based strategy game as you compete against other refugees for land. Expand tile by tile, defend your borders, and sustain your people through gathering or force. A streamlined 4X experience designed to finish in one sitting.

details.title: Rust Born
details.short_description: Rust Born is a neo noir top-down shooter about survival, loss of self, and a city devoured by corporations. You are Detective Gabriel, trapped in a twisted dystopian city where every shot could be your last, and every decision changes the world. Atmosphere, plot, survival.

details.title: Sova
details.short_description: Descend into a surreal sci-fantasy world in this narrative-driven action roguelite, where every run reshapes your story. Sova’s expressive combat meets deeply branching dialogue and world-shifting decisions. Compose your violence, rewrite your past, and bend a crumbling realm to your will.

details.title: 妖精牧场 - Fairy Ranch
details.short_description: Fairy Ranch is a fast-paced multiplayer co-op management simulation game. Players engage in a variety of production activities across diverse biomes—including grasslands, forests, deserts, mountains, and snowy plains—gathering products to complete orders.

details.title: ZOMBIE KEBAB VR
details.short_description: Cook kebabs and fight zombies in this fast action game. Explore streets, gather ingredients, and feed survivors. Unlock new tools and recipes as you survive each night. Fast, funny, and brutal. Known online as the “4 a.m. fast-food simulator”

details.title: 机影：夏夜梦寻
details.short_description: "A Midsummer Night's Dream with the Android Girl" — As Deputy Director of the AI Oversight Bureau, navigate the cyber metropolis alongside your robot assistant, Dill. Investigate rogue AI cases, uncover the truth behind dreams, and unlock multiple endings.

details.title: Gorecam
details.short_description: GORECAM is a hardcore co-op horror survival game, designed after found-footage horror films. Play with up to 4 friends and try to escape with your life, and maybe some of your sanity.

details.title: Arcane Mayhem
details.short_description: Master the arcane in this fast-paced action roguelike. Grow your spellbook, draft your loadout, and trigger chaotic elemental reactions as you blast through relentless waves of enemies.

details.title: Overpowered Tactics
details.short_description: The 'Nexus' stops time, giving you the power to predict every enemy move in advance. Outsmart their attacks and optimize your actions. Each turn becomes a tactical puzzle where planning and anticipation are key, rather than reaction.

details.title: Thor's Wrath
details.short_description: Embody a formidable and somewhat brute warrior, face hordes of enemies alone while protecting the city's treasures. Your goal is to climb the ranks of the best warriors ! The real challenge lies in your ability to wield yourhammer and cast spells with precision.

details.title: Umblight
details.short_description: Descend through the corrupted underworld in Umblight, a gearpunk roguelike deckbuilder about merging your cards together. Build a deck of shadow and light cards strong enough to survive, but is it enough to reach the bottom of the world?

name: Croak Crusader: the Champion of Canada

details.title: Croak Crusader: the Champion of Canada
details.short_description: Do you dare save the Land of the Maple Leaf? Croak Crusader is a fast-paced, momentum-based action platformer featuring tight controls, explosive combat, and a versatile grapple mechanic.

details.title: Founders
details.short_description: Founders is a city-building survival game for 1-10 players, where medieval robots with evolving memories and unique personalities create a truly living world. Build and defend your city against relentless threats while shaping your character’s skills.

details.title: Love's Time Cycle
details.short_description: A grand sci-fi romance healing masterpiece. Overnight, the beautiful girl around you have falling in love with you. Just as you think you can sink into this sweet trap, the one you love suddenly bids you farewell. In this endless cycle, will you be able to reclaim the love you’ve lost?

details.title: Baba Yaga
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelike game of strategic combat and sinister magic. Decimate the king’s loyalist forces, grow your powers, and discover the reimagined origin story of Baba Yaga, the most feared witch of Slavic folklore!

details.title: Mind The Trunk
details.short_description: Up to 4 friends. One abandoned station. Strip it. Launch it. Sell it. Keep breathing: your oxygen runs through a hose, and it runs out fast. Get back to the lobby or get nothing. Something else lives here. It doesn't want you dead. It wants to play.

details.title: Vagabones
details.short_description: Vagabones is a class-based roguelike action-adventure game for 1-4 players! Battle fierce foes, play minigames, solve puzzles, and collect treasures as you venture through the Shadowmoon Kingdom to defeat the Calico King!

details.title: Witchling Grove
details.short_description: Witchling Grove is an action-rpg, arena-shooting roguelike.

name: 死んで死んで強くなれ！…？

details.title: 死んで死んで強くなれ！…？
details.short_description: A deadly RPG with a new system that makes you stronger by dying and suffering.The graphics are a combination of dots and 3DCG. No matter how many times you die. No matter how many times you die. Don't give up hope.

details.title: Ravenous
details.short_description: Spin the world to control the horde, compress enemy remains into the ultimate "Scrap Bomb," and smash it down on their heads! Experience the new-sensation rolling action of Ravenous!

name: 紅茶とともに飲みこんで

details.title: 紅茶とともに飲みこんで
details.short_description: Is there something you wish to forget or remember? You are running a cafe, harboring a specific purpose within your heart. An ADV where you use tools like a pipette that extracts emotions and medicine that erases memories and feelings to select, manipulate emotions, and intervene in fate.

details.title: COMING HOME
details.short_description: A retro slasher horror game, with a focus on home defense. In the dead of night, you hear someone lurking outside - but you are not defenseless. Watch the cameras, barricade your doors, and have your gun at the ready - anything to keep the Sundown Rippers from claiming their next victim.

details.title: Fio and the Doomed City
details.short_description: A “city-building” x “tower defense” SLG by a young girl, Fio. Fio and her guardians, the Flora Bears, are building a city in the last city of humanity. Increase facilities, residents, and resources, and prepare for battle. Withstand enemy attacks and defeat the boss with your big beam cannon!

details.title: Steam & Heather
details.short_description: A cosy railway management builder set in 19th-century Scotland. Shape the land, lay track, connect industries, and watch towns grow as steam reshapes the Scottish landscape.

details.title: Tungsten Moon
details.short_description: First-person 3D spaceflight sim on a tungsten moon. Master accurate rocket physics in a vast, open world that shows no mercy, while a shadowy figure tries to help you survive. Or do they want you dead?

details.title: Seasons Turning
details.short_description: A farming sim focused on exploration instead of repetition, where you must discover every seed you plant, solve puzzles, explore dungeons, and appease the mafia cat army. No stamina bar. No combat. Save whenever and play at your own speed.

details.title: Eco: Planet Reboot
details.short_description: Imagine taking down a megacorporation with just a vacuum. Join Eco, a robot with one mission: save the world from the greedy billionaire Smogborne. Vacuum up your enemies, absorb and expel elements throughout the world to solve puzzles, and heal the corrupted biomes.

details.title: Chaotic Conundrum
details.short_description: Hit the ground running in a frantic and fast adventure through a broken world made of lost fragments of time and space. Featuring a 90s-graffiti artstyle and a headbanging dynamic soundtrack.

details.title: Mystery House
details.short_description: A first and third-person horror revival of Roberta Williams' Mystery House - the 1980 classic that invented the graphic adventure. A game night in an abandoned Victorian House turns deadly. Solve its puzzles, uncover a buried legacy, and escape before the house kills you.

details.title: ENTWINE
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror videogame. In St. Agnes’ Forest, Man bears a mark he cannot wash away. Walk the opened body of photoreal 1990s Americana as Lucas, an ex-police officer; search the estate, defenseless, in an ever-changing nightmare. “At the end of my life, I find the devil.”

details.title: Deeplands
details.short_description: Explore the Deeplands, an ancient underground world harboring the remnants of a lost civilization. Fight and parkour your way through destructible caves and dungeons, acquire mysterious powers and tools to grow stronger and recover the ancient dwarven crown in this open-cave roguelike platformer!

details.title: ZaciSa: Idle Defense!
details.short_description: A Tower Defense game mashed with Idle Clicker mechanics set inside a wonderful world of crayons. Build out your defenses, go grab a snack and watch your forces take on enemy units.

details.title: Astral Enterprises
details.short_description: As CEO, build a ruthless corporate empire! Solve spatial factory puzzles, master complex supply chains, and manipulate dynamic markets to maximise profit. Mobilise local workforces, fund high-tech R&D, and construct colossal megaprojects to satisfy your demanding Parent Company.

details.title: Nine Lives Hospital
details.short_description: You are clumsy cat doctors in a chaotic co-op hospital - a vet clinic in reverse, where the patients are human. Grab and haul ragdoll patients, X-ray, transplant and stitch against the clock, drive the claw-machine bed. For 1-4 online. Your patients don't have nine lives. meow!

details.title: The Prophecy of Horn
details.short_description: Lead your heroes through a psychedelic grimdark world in a fast-paced hybrid turn-based mode, where heroes take turns while hordes of enemies attack simultaneously. Execute devastating combos and gain extra turns through Rampage to annihilate the legions of the Demon Horn!

details.title: The Silent Fare
details.short_description: A psychological horror anomaly game where you observe your apartment, report strange changes, and uncover a disturbing story hidden in the environment.

details.title: GridLock
details.short_description: Command a 3-soldier squad against AXIOM, a rogue AI spreading across the battlefield. Every turn the Grid grows, buffing enemies and punishing your troops. Destroy every Node before 75% of the map is consumed. Fast, tight, tactical.

details.title: Me, a Robot?
details.short_description: You wake up in the body of a household robot. Explore endless rooms, uncover clues with your extendable arms and sensors, and discover why you became a robot. Look closely—everything in this mansion is a clue.
developers: ぬくもりロボット工房
publishers: ぬくもりロボット工房

details.title: Reliquance
details.short_description: Keep out a lurking monster while playing a game that seems strangely connected to reality. Open doors that hold your past hostage as you work together with a familiar face to fulfill a promise you once made.

details.title: Echo Sequence
details.short_description: An isometric, top-down roguelite shooter where your deaths are your squad. Die, and your last life fights on as an Echo, repeating every move and every shot. Die again and there are two. Plan across loops, split the work between your past selves, and clear each level together.

details.title: Master of Treasure
details.short_description: Sweep an endless procedural coastline with friends and dig up treasure no one has ever seen. Every coin, gem, relic and fossil is generated in 3D and is practically one of a kind. Level up, upgrade your gear, and see how far out you are willing to go for the rarest finds.

details.title: 离校 School's Out
details.short_description: A first-person 3D horror adventure. Trapped in a mysterious world modeled after an old school, an amnesiac hero teams up with enigmatic heroines to face looping spaces and terrifying monsters. As they seek escape and the truth, they begin to break free from the fate that binds them.

details.title: Greywake: Last Bell
details.short_description: Fight across a dark tabletop in a campaign-driven bullet heaven. Build a trio of survivors, forge persistent weapons and battle through forty stages before facing the repeatable Last Bell Vigil! Plus much, much more!!

details.title: Hex & Hunters
details.short_description: Hex & Hunters is a fast-paced action roguelite where you program your own dungeons and create complex projectiles to battle through rooms of various enemies, unlocking new biomes, items and foes.

details.title: LASTWORLD
details.short_description: LASTWORLD™ (Early Access) is an old-school inspired RTS, fast-paced, chaotic voxel fusion. Built for multiplayer and competitive play. Unlock generals, skins, and items. Build your own unique playstyle to wreak havoc on the battlefield!

details.title: Workshop Keeper
details.short_description: You bought the cheapest plot of land in town. Then the first tax bill arrived. Gather, craft, automate. Link your workshops into a trade network, ship goods across the sea, and get rich enough to show the City-State who's boss.

details.title: Echo Ridge
details.short_description: Echo Ridge is a first-person mystery set around a quiet remote forest caught in a time loop. Explore, climb, and gather what you need to find a way out before first light. If you don't make it, there's always tomorrow. OR you don't have to escape if you don't wanna. You could just hang out.

details.title: Other World
details.short_description: 异世界恋爱冒险RPG哒！想要经历冒险吗？想要和异世界的女孩子们甜甜恋爱吗？那就来吧——！！扮演主角希亚，经历冒险，与同伴邂逅，并和她们恋爱！从逐渐相遇的多名女主角中，选择自己喜欢的五位，和她们积极相处，成为恋人，度过在异世界的一生吧！（旅人啊，请你倾听，那平凡少年的一生。）

details.title: Dino Dare
details.short_description: Dino Dare is an impossible physics platformer and level maker with hours of replay value and super fun challenges. Each level may require logic, skill, and force to solve. Run, jump, and power through many challenging platformer levels.

details.title: Tropical Fishing Island
details.short_description: An incremental, relaxing, collectathon fishing game with D&B soundtrack and a PS2 visual style.

details.title: Radar Shadow
details.short_description: Somewhere on the other half of the map is the enemy's base. You don't know which hex it's on, and they don't know where yours is. No soldiers to click on: you run a country's radars, air defence and drone strikes, and design every drone and missile yourself.

details.title: Hold Morale
details.short_description: Hold Morale is a turn-based tactics game with roguelite campaigns. Master classic grid battles on land, at sea, and in the air, customize your units with retrofit kits, and combine more than 80 modules. Keep your troops' morale up: if it hits zero, your front collapses.

details.title: Oreflow
details.short_description: A calm single-player automation game set in your hometown's abandoned mine. Mine ore by hand, build drills, crushers and conveyor lines, fix bottlenecks, and restore the deep lift to uncover what happened to your father.

details.title: flingkeep
details.short_description: Grab invaders. Fling them skyward. Smash them into each other. Defend a growing castle across 150 sieges with weighty physics, strange enemies, brutal chain reactions and devastating magic. Keep the walls. Break the world.

details.title: Task Bar Maid Cafe
details.short_description: A cozy café. A hungry party RPG. Build a crew of five maids, feed demanding guests and face enormous appetites — all in a strip above your taskbar. Level up, equip your team, upgrade the kitchen and come home to your own café.

details.title: Line & Lode
details.short_description: Cast the mining claw, tune its pull, and haul ore before the chain snaps. Choose routes, upgrade your rig, and build a camp across eight regions.

details.title: Dungeon Parkour Block Puzzle Adventure 2
details.short_description: Use blocks falling from the ceiling to build a path for the adventurer. Uncover the mystery why the blocks keep falling from the ceiling. Solve the puzzles and finally the mystery. The puzzle adventure continues.

details.title: Wrong Way Buddy
details.short_description: Drive the wrong way down a packed highway. Skim bumpers for CLOSE calls, fire BOOST to smash through traffic, or FREEZE time and slip through the gaps. Runs last seconds. Most end in a fireball. Retry is one key, and the ATTEMPT counter in the sky keeps count.

details.title: Sol Mortum
details.short_description: Fight through a hand-painted world of creatures and guardians with weapons and spells you've created to find the source of its unexplained decline in this twin-class ARPG dungeon crawler from the 3-person indie studio Nightwake.

details.title: Goblin Industries
details.short_description: Ever wanted to be a hard-working goblin? Me neither, but here we are. Every goblin dreams of the easy life on the surface, and to get there you’ve got to put in your shift. This is your chance. Come underground with us: mine, smelt, and get the factory running.

details.title: Bear’s Desktop Cake Shop
details.short_description: Run a cozy cake shop in a corner of your desktop! Grow ingredients, build automated production lines, and hire little bear couriers to deliver delicious cakes to adorable animal customers. Discover recipes and grow your shop while you work, study, or unwind.

details.title: Panda Flora
details.short_description: A cozy first-person game where you run your own flower shop. Grow flowers in your garden, make bouquets by hand to match your customers' wishes, and grow your shop step by step. Unlock new flowers and complete your album.

details.title: Racing Season Manager
details.short_description: Take charge of a racing team for a full season. Plan your next move, make the big decisions, and lead your team towards success.

details.title: RATS!! - Co-op Tower Defense
details.short_description: The rats found the barn. All of them. Grab up to three friends, run out among your towers and hold the farm against hordes of thousands: build mid-wave, cable two machines into a fire lane, bowl the survivors to a hungry catfish. Solo, couch or online co-op. Then the kings arrive.

details.title: We're Gonna Die
details.short_description: A goofy co-op game where you and 1 to 4 friends play Gladiators in a wild Roman coliseum. You must survive the dangers, the crowd, and the backstabbing of your "friends". Everyone is an enemy, and everything is a weapon.

details.title: Misty and the Last Breeze
details.short_description: Platform it, then skate it. Jump, wall-run and vine-swing through bright hand-built stages, then call your air board mid-run to grind vines, ride waterfalls and kickflip across canyons. Chain it all into one fast line and chase the gold time.

details.title: World of ALPA
details.short_description: Explore a pixel-art world with magical Kaka companions. Build a cozy home, tend an ancient tree, and craft tools and weapons. Brave dungeons and protect each other in battle. With Alpa by your side, recover lost memories and uncover the mystery of a changing world.

details.title: BATTROPICA
details.short_description: Treasure at sea, pleasure by night. A single-player action adventure about Mia's 10-billion-gold debt. Hunt treasure, battle, work and invest to grow your earnings. Build fame, buy bigger ships and reach new islands, then unwind with flirty fun. No interest, no deadline. Sail on after repayment.

details.title: GunWhale
details.short_description: 2 - 4 player online experience where players cooperate to pilot a submarine through dangerous waters. Accept missions and hunt deep-sea monsters through interactive controls inside the submarine.

details.title: Heroes Never Die
details.short_description: Choose your hero, rally your troops, and carve a path through hordes of foul creatures in a fast-paced fusion of strategy and survivor gameplay. Grow your army as you march, change your tactics on the fly, and lead soldiers, goblins, minotaurs and more into glorious, chaotic battle.

details.title: All That Glitters
details.short_description: Faites vos jeux! Step into the Gombling's Lair of Sin and push your luck to earn ludicrous amount of riches in a casino themed roguelike dungeon crawler! Go bling or go home, and remember that is not gold all that glitters!

name: AI Startup Manager: Race to AGI

details.title: AI Startup Manager: Race to AGI
details.short_description: Build an AI lab in a deep management sim about the race to AGI. Recruit researchers, train models, secure funding and outmaneuver rival labs. Balance growth against safety, manage your team and face the consequences of every launch.

details.title: NEARBY: 3 LIKES
details.short_description: A photoreal cinematic gay romance adventure set in Tokyo. Three men have liked Yuto's profile. Meet them in person, talk over coffee, walk by the river — and choose how close you get. Japanese voice, written choices, and three relationships.

details.title: THREADMILL
details.short_description: Write code that controls an entire robotic workforce. Start with one worker, then scale to 128. Share jobs, feed machines, and adapt when power fails. Test your code in new facilities, then tune it to do more with less.

details.title: Everyone Expire
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you're the Dungeon Master and the party trusts you completely. Bait the room, rig the dice, and keep them alive just long enough to die at the boss. The paladin can't swim. The bard licks things. You've taken notes.

name: Doc, I Don't Want to Die! Slice the Infection

details.title: Doc, I Don't Want to Die! Slice the Infection
details.short_description: Pilot a tiny ship in this 2D shooter, upgrade your weapons and battle a variety of bacterial enemies. Blast, dash and slice your way through the infection.

details.title: Locked In: The Ward
details.short_description: Locked In: The Ward is a first-person psychological horror set inside the abandoned Ravenrock Research Facility. Explore its medical ward, solve environmental puzzles, survive the darkness, and uncover the truth behind Subject #0012 as stress distorts your perception.

details.title: Desperatea
details.short_description: A dish-pushing, liquid-pouring puzzle game all about a strange substance known as 'tea'.

details.title: GRIMLIFE
details.short_description: GRIMLIFE - An open-world survival RPG set in a world ruled by the undead. Befriend fellow survivors as you search for supplies, fight through hordes of infected, and navigate a treacherous world.

details.title: Gaucho: Subway Escape
details.short_description: The shelter is not safe anymore. You must venture into the Buenos Aires subway, defeat colossal Demon Bosses in a frenetic parry-based combat, explore branching stations, improve your equipment, level up, and claw your way to the surface to save your kitten, Gaucho.

details.title: Quarter Lie
details.short_description: A narrative adventure game where you take on a role of a fake exorcist on a demon-ridden ship in a long sea voyage. Remember; you can’t lie your way out of everything!

details.title: Home Wars: Battlefield
details.short_description: Fight in an epic first/third-person battlefield with your friends! In this cooperative PvE game, there are 3 factions, all fully playable: Army, Insects, Dinosaurs. Hundreds of allied/enemy bots on screen! Old school fun, baby!

details.title: The Time Forgotten
details.short_description: The Time Forgotten is a highly immersive hardcore Battle Royale set on a massive forgotten Island, where YOU play as a dinosaur. Discover the story and fight for survival against other dinosaurs in a struggle for victory by gathering EVO points and making your dinosaur as strong as it can be.

details.title: Soul Trader
details.short_description: Welcome to the NecronomiCon! Choose two eccentric minions, combine their unique cards, and trade souls for power as you battle rival necromancers in this colourful roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: Starlight Brigade
details.short_description: Starlight Brigade is a realistic space action-adventure game with a precise combat system and full 6DOF controls. You command the Wayfarer, an aging light cruiser centuries past her time. Plot missile salvos, hunt down your enemy, design munitions, manage your crew, and send engineers to fix damage.

details.title: THE HELMINTHS
details.short_description: The Helminths is a 2D pixel art platformer that pays homage to classic games and blending environmental puzzles, precision platforming, and fast-paced action. Confront the grim realities of exploitation in dystopian sci-fi world and embark on a dark journey of survival.

details.title: Pingbert's Snow Ride
details.short_description: Slide, soar, and deliver! Join Pingbert, the upbeat penguin mail carrier, in Pingbert’s Snow Ride—a fast-paced, endless platformer where you'll slide down snowy slopes to deliver mail at high speed!

details.title: Bloodstone Rising
details.short_description: Bloodstone Rising is a high-intensity co-op FPS roguelike. Gather your fellow space dwarves, mine resources, forge upgrades, and fight off relentless zombie hordes as you reclaim your ancestral kingdom.

name: アスクギア リブースト

details.title: アスクギア リブースト
details.short_description: A new, straightforward RPG! Hot scenarios and battles that go right to the heart of JRPGs. For those of you who still feel your youth in the RPGs of the PS1 and PS2 generations, this is the game for you.

details.title: Rendagor
details.short_description: Rendagor is a 2D Top-down Shooter starring a service bot. Just a simple machine... or something more? Uncover dark secrets in Story Mode or master the challenge of Arcade Mode. Shoot, smash, and demolish enemies and destructible environments with a devastating arsenal.

details.title: Grill'd: The Vanishing
details.short_description: [Grill'd] is a dinner party detective game played from the first-person perspective of a royal investigator. Trapped in a mansion located in the estate of a fallen aristocrat, collect clues about the cases, connect them to one another, and interrogate the suspect to uncover the truth.

details.title: Iris Dissolution
details.short_description: Iris Dissolution is a classic survival horror game where you explore increasingly surreal places, manage scarce resources, and fight for your life against horrid creatures as you struggle to come to terms with loss.

details.title: Cambrox
details.short_description: Cambrox is an online co-op or single player creature-collection adventure with over 200 unique Cambros. Battle with your Cambros against other trainers and see what the world of Hoch has in store!

details.title: ASTHENIA
details.short_description: Separated from his partner Eve, Adam is cast into a decaying world ruled by cosmic entities. To survive, he must fight distorted foes and unravel the mysteries of a brutal war and a ravaging disease, wielding a primordial gauntlet and tainted artifacts to escape before he is consumed by Asthenia.

details.title: Wish Of Hers
details.short_description: Wish of Hers is a round-based 2.5D roguelike about surviving in unstable dreams. Each run is shaped by unlocked abilities, combined aspects, and your decisions. Experiment, adapt, and break your own builds!

details.title: Epoch Reset
details.short_description: Unravel a narrative-driven 2.5D anime adventure as Hector, a dirt-poor genius and creator of the world’s first time machine. Travel between timelines, meet intriguing characters, and explore futuristic cityscapes as you seek to save reality from time-bending forces beyond imagination.

details.title: The shield of the Kingdom
details.short_description: "The Shield of The Kingdom" is a defense strategy game where player needs to protect their realm from enemies. Within the game, player controls 3 heroes and command troops in battle to repel invasions. Effective hero combinations and masterful tactical control are keys to achieving ultimate victory!

details.title: Polly's Gone
details.short_description: Polly's Gone is an action-RTS with shoot'em up elements. Lead a team of sheep through challenging levels in Story Mode to find the missing Polly. Explore diverse environments, defeat enemies, and test your skills in Survival Mode.

name: Prolegomena To a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges

details.title: Prolegomena To a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges
details.short_description: This is a collaborative experiment between you and I. We will participate in a series of interchanges, each lasting three minutes. What will be revealed across our interfaces during that limited time?

details.title: Heavenly Book
details.short_description: The Book of Heaven — Your Destiny, Your Path A regular office worker stumbles into The Book of Heaven. Explore vast lands, face trials, and uncover your destiny. Your choices shape your future — hero or villain, light or shadow. An epic journey awaits. The Book of Heaven is open — destiny awaits.

details.title: Memoria Wake
details.short_description: Parry with precision and fight through shifting, surreal landscapes in this dream-like action-adventure. When reality turns into a living nightmare, you must ascend through a shattered realm to rescue a missing friend.

details.title: VERISMO
details.short_description: A ghost and a carnival clown plot revenge on the man who ruined their lives. An operatic-tragedy visual novel set in 1920s Sicily.

details.title: Arjybeasts
details.short_description: Arjybeasts is a Turn-based RPG where colour means everything! Draw your own PNG, battle and delete other images, open chests and make space so that HE can install things. Combine creativity with strategy and uncover a mystery by viewing the computer from different perspectives.

details.title: No Way Home: BLAMMO!
details.short_description: No Way Home: BLAMMO! is a tactical arcade roguelite that's all about fast-paced twin stick space combat. Every run is a new adventure!

details.title: Diabolocracy
details.short_description: Diabolocracy is hatemail for corporate bureaucracy in roguelite turn-based tactics form. Build your team of corporate hellions, battle other Sins for supremacy, survive meetings, and choose your SIN-ergies wisely. Can you complete your hostile takeover before the boss gets back from vacation?

details.title: G Squad
details.short_description: Run the gauntlet with G Squad in this hand-crafted autobattler with roguelite and RPG elements, designed to scratch the strategy itch without the spreadsheets. 9 unique heroes, in-run rewards, permanent progression, and boss challenge modifiers to test yourself against.

details.title: Avemary Rocket -Captain Patchwork-
details.short_description: Join our brave captain on this action adventure in space! You'll be riding The Patchwork, a less than ideal spaceship, but enough to get away from pursuers. However, you'll be facing malfunctions, fires, enemies attacking... When it rains, it pours.

name: The american dream of Gunther Aims

details.title: The american dream of Gunther Aims
details.short_description: A retro puzzle shooter built around ricochets, where every shot counts. You play as Gunther, a revolver and a family man, in a constrained turn-based system: one action at a time, until it fully resolves.

details.title: < STRECT >
details.short_description: Control your ship and destroy all the enemies and bases that have appeared through teleportation! < STRECT > is a score-attack vertical shooter for 1 or 2 players. Enjoy simple shoot-and-dodge gameplay, rich destruction effects, and tons of hidden features.

details.title: Dadum The Dice
details.short_description: Plan, roll and outsmart your enemies in this turn-based tactical puzzle adventure. Show a higher number to defeat foes, discover new mechanics in every world, and face challenging bosses that twist the rules. Think ahead, take your time… and master the Great Die.

details.title: Dribble Deck
details.short_description: Dribble Deck is a basketball card game about leading your team through a tough league. Build a deck, upgrade players and trade with NPC’s. Master the game’s flow as you face ruthless coach bosses. The owner has already written you off so you’ll have to win every match or get cut before the finals.

details.title: When Voices Died
details.short_description: When Voices Died is a game of puzzles and silent emotions. Amid distant echoes and broken memories, you rebuild paths that reveal forgotten feelings — and the weight of choices that still echo.

details.title: Card Cricket Quest
details.short_description: Card Cricket Quest is a single-player roguelite deck-builder that combines deep card-matching gameplay with the ball smashing action of cricket! Complement your deck with outrageous special cards, wield powerful willows, and collect obscure trinkets to become a cricket legend. One RUN at a time.

details.title: Mt. Quack Legend
details.short_description: A single player 2D anime rogue-lite RPG. Join a new born duck girl's adventure in a aggressively cute world. Beat up cute wild creatures and level up to different bird classes as you explore this place.

details.title: Deep Hunger
details.short_description: A short incremental game about cleaning the ocean, and feeding the insatiable hunger of a deep sea creature.

details.title: WishBreaker
details.short_description: A genre-fusion ARPG. Every class plays differently, Warrior plays as Hack n' Slash, Rogue as Stealth rougelike, Cleric is decision based, Druids play creature collecting/farming, Wizards are puzzles, secrets, and code casting and many more! PVE and PVP including Bullet Hell and Soulslike areas!

details.title: GambaSim
details.short_description: Build and expand your own casino in a high-stakes gambling and manager simulator. Play classic casino games, beat rival casinos with unique playstyles, and climb through increasingly dangerous tiers where every bet can make, or break, your future.

details.title: Pizza Agent
details.short_description: Pizza Agent is a co-op simulator combining pizza shop management with undercover alien investigation. Craft delicious pizzas, manage your stock, keep customers happy. And secretly scan customers to catch shape-shifting aliens. Cook, serve and scan !

details.title: Reign & Shuffle
details.short_description: As an emperor, rule your dynasty and handle state affairs year by year. Each decision you make will shape its destiny. Will every choice today alter your dynasty's future trajectory? Classic roguelike card gameplay collides with real historical events—what sparks will fly?

details.title: Valhalla, Vikings, Ragnarok!
details.short_description: Valhalla, Vikings, Ragnarok! It's a co-op game about a band of funny Vikings who must raid villages across all nine realms to pay off their debt to Hel and carve their path to Valhalla! Grab the treasure and carry it to the ship! Fight off the weak, hide from the strong, and do it all for the loot!

details.title: TILLY'S ROLL
details.short_description: A turn-based creature dice battler where every roll counts! Capture creatures, collect dice, and battle with strategy and luck to win THE CROWN JEWELS TOURNAMENT!

details.title: Abyss of Kings
details.short_description: A Dark-Fantasy Action-Adventure inspired by the Kingsfield series. Explore the remnants of an underground civilization and battle sentient chess pieces. Discover magical rings and use them to create your own spells. Meet the last inhabitants of a dead kingdom and escape the Abyss.

details.title: Frex: Ambivalence
details.short_description: A high-speed action game blending fluid movement and stylish sword combat, as you push through intense stages and confront enemies shaped by a broken world.

details.title: Miracle Revolution
details.short_description: A fantastical Bullet Hell game where you absorb and control enemy bullets to create your own firepower! Manipulate food-infused bullets to break through any formation, and use the power of Eggs to overthrow the wicked food goddesses!

details.title: Pet.Net
details.short_description: Hatch and raise your very own PET, evolve them, train their stats, compete in competitions AND MUCH MORE! Designed for either active or passive play, sitting in the corner of your screen while you work on other things.

details.title: Bit Crusher
details.short_description: Roam an open world in your pickup truck, smash stuff into bits, then trade them in for better upgrades, vehicles, and new zones. Explore the island, discover hidden paths and carve your own adventure across the world!

details.title: Cardaver
details.short_description: Cardaver is a tower defense, deckbuilder, with roguelike looping gameplay. Using a wide variety of monsters and spells to defend each lane, help the Dragon Queen protect her Castle Kingdom against an army of fantasy do-gooders and tyrannical princesses.

details.title: Paintra
details.short_description: Leap, roll, and swing through a vibrant watercolour world under threat by the spreading Smudge! Master momentum-based platforming, launch yourself with a trusty boomerang, and chain moves together to unlock secrets in this challenging, physics-infused 2D platforming adventure.

details.title: C.C.C.: Contract Cleaning
details.short_description: You're a contract janitor in Cosmo Clean Co.'s Contract Cleaning division. Your weapons fire on their own. Your real job is vacuuming up shards, filling pods, and hitting today's quota. Then call your ride home and make it aboard alive. Solo or co-op with up to 4 players.

details.title: Super Optimal Amount of Punching
details.short_description: Punch everything. Learn nothing. Lord Evil's shining nipples await you.

details.title: Dalam Kelam: The Night Shift
details.short_description: Welcome to the night shift. Your tasks are simple: follow the nightly janitorial routine and ignore all disturbances. Last seven nights to earn your transfer to headquarters.

details.title: CANNABIS
details.short_description: Beast-themed drug novel RPG

details.title: Paws Up!
details.short_description: A challenging precision platformer where cats jump up dark, ominous and fantasy type environments. Master tight jumps and timing, customize your cat with collectible outfits, and seek out what awaits for your cat at the top!

details.title: About Bullshit
details.short_description: A STUPID 3D PLATFORMER WITH FOCUS ON WEIRD VISUALS AND HUMOURISTIC ENCOUNTERS AND A LOT OF COOL HATS TO COLLECT

details.title: Dither Cleaning World
details.short_description: Dither Cleaning World is a relaxing 1‑bit pixel cleaning game. Use different tools – brush, water gun, vacuum – to wash away dither dirt in themed worlds like City, Game World and more. Discover hidden eggs, trigger funny penalties. Just click and clean, no stress.

name: Cast of the Three Kingdoms: Rise

details.title: Cast of the Three Kingdoms: Rise
details.short_description: Cast Of The Three Kingdoms ：Rise is a Three Kingdoms-themed, diorama-style turn-based tactical RPG that blends enemy capturing, loot grinding, and equipment crafting.

details.title: Max the Unifox
details.short_description: Based on dreams from real life, adventure about a guy turning into mysteries fox with a horn. And his horn contains power of the Creator of the Universe. What will our hero use it for?

details.title: Geo Survivor
details.short_description: Explore procedural geological caverns in a 2D mining roguelite where your hammer is your only tool and weapon. Collect, combine, and exploit 200+ hammer upgrades to survive hordes of enemies and gather precious crystals.

details.title: Kotamas
details.short_description: A cozy pixel dog who lives on your desktop and runs your focus sessions. Start a pomodoro and he naps while you work, quietly clears the distractions you choose, and celebrates every block with you. Play fetch on your breaks, pick from nine breeds and counting, and never work alone again.

name: The Labyrinth At The End Of Time

details.title: The Labyrinth At The End Of Time
details.short_description: The Labyrinth At The End of Time is a retro inspired platformer. Run, jump, dash, die and repeat to get back home, all the while getting ridiculed by a fifth dimensional weirdo in control of this brutalist absurd world that's out of some deranged nightmare.

details.title: Marble Factory
details.short_description: A physics roguelite about building a machine, then losing control of it. Place machines on the board, take your shot, and let the marbles bounce. Every impact pays in Score, Gold and XP. Upgrade between waves, choose your element, and see how far your factory goes.

details.title: Bored to Depth
details.short_description: Drill against the core, against the odds, and against the bureaucracy.

details.title: The Anomaly Inspector : Hotel Anatolia
details.short_description: Congratulations, you have been hired as the new Anomaly Inspector for Hotel Anatolia. Good Luck!

details.title: Winter Batch
details.short_description: December 1988, Czechoslovakia. Your uncle ended up behind bars. Winter Batch is a first-person life simulator where you survive a brutal countryside winter, illegally make alcohol, and earn the money to get him out.

details.title: Metaversus
details.short_description: A round-based 4v4 competitive shooter. Build defenses and routes, buy weapons and gadgets, then fight for territory with one life per round. Surviving structures carry into the next build phase. Request playtest access below.

details.title: Baleful Tactics
details.short_description: You are a demon lord, using history’s famous dead to climb the ranks of Hell. Their traits determine your play style. Death leaves them with a wound. Decide who to save, star-up, gear up or sacrifice for more power. Achilles, Genghis Khan and Cleopatra, await your command!

details.title: Revenant Dusk
details.short_description: A top-down zombie survival game for solo or online co-op with up to 8 players. Scavenge a vast procedural world by day: craft, farm, fortify, build vehicles and level skills as you use them. Every Horde Night is bigger than the last. How many sunrises can you see?

details.title: Idle Wardens
details.short_description: A pixel-art fantasy idle RPG. Walk the Knight and Wizard paths as one Warden, turn your estate into a self-running production line, and push north through fog-covered lands toward the Abyssal Anchor. Progress keeps going while you are away.

details.title: Mikitti: Pirate Cats
details.short_description: Four cats, one pirate ship! Team up in 4-player co-op to steer, shoot, resupply and repair. Battle the navy and a giant Kraken. Grab more loot or sail home safe? Pick your skin, grow beautiful Cat Tower Island, and build new ships and weapons for bold adventures with friends!

details.title: 末日後書店
details.short_description: The perfect AI shut down without warning. Without its guidance, technology regressed, society crumbled, energy ran short, and the world fell into chaos. As a bookstore owner, listen to customers' stories with your android partner, offering food and the scent of books as a brief respite.

details.title: Curiopia: Fresh Finds Daily
details.short_description: Here is a tiny island on a shallow sea, where animals sail in for curious finds. Build your world and shop from voxels; fish, cook, and stock your shelves. Invite friends to build and live together. A slow, cozy island life in pen and wash.

details.title: 1999 Lockdown Unit
details.short_description: Autumn 1999: A rainy night, a sudden quarantine. As a virus mutates your neighbors, barricade your apartment, survive the lockdown routine, and outlast the nightmare.

details.title: Overflow: Roguelite Network Builder
details.short_description: A tense minimalist network roguelite. Draw Traces between Nodes, let your Runners carry Signals to your Hubs, and hold the system together as pressure escalates. One overloaded Node ends the run, instantly and permanently. Upgrade between Cycles, trigger emergency abilities, and delay the crash.

details.title: Engines of Hate
details.short_description: You're a mercenary space-ship captain. Drop war machines and infantry from orbit, call down orbital strikes, and micro every unit in slow motion. No base building, no mining, just combat. Every unit you lose costs Credits to replace.

details.title: Tiny Shaders
details.short_description: Tiny Shaders is an open-ended programming puzzle game about building image-processing algorithms. Connect simple blocks to design complex circuits, and optimise your solutions.

details.title: Medival Adventure
details.short_description: Gather resources, craft tools and build your settlement. Explore a medieval world with villages, wildlife and a day/night cycle. Medival Adventure is in early development: play solo or test experimental multiplayer with a trusted group.

details.title: Trench League
details.short_description: Punch your way to the spiked steel ball and smash it into the enemy cage. The side with the most breaches wins. Knock rivals out and the Reclaim drags them off. Face opponents from different planets of the Solar System and fight your way to the Solar Final! Test your skills against real opponents!

details.title: Hermetica
details.short_description: A world after a great war. Only one reference box survived, and you have it. The vendor sends robots in for inspection, but doesn't always tell the truth. You find where he lied and decide whether the robot goes into battle. Every shift starts at a desk. ...

details.title: Surfin' Landes
details.short_description: Welcome to Contis, a little beach in the Landes, southwest France. In this 100% co-op pixel art game, become lifeguards: one surfs, the other flies a parachute. On the menu: beer, rescues, giant fish, piranhas, dolphins, pelicans, bazookas, a dog… and ever more beer.

details.title: Thicker than Ichor
details.short_description: Blood is thicker than water. Ichor is thicker than both. Aliens spliced you by mistake, and now you're whipping, shooting and punching your way out of a mutated hotel in a totally fictional city in a first-person roguelite brawler.

details.title: Starlock Arcana
details.short_description: Explore the star-cursed world of Starlock Arcana as an undead mage on a quest to vanquish the Star of Doom. Venture into ancient dungeons, discover powerful spells and battle fierce enemies! Grow ever stronger, choose the spells that suit your playstyle, and bring an end to the star curse!

details.title: You Can't Deliver
details.short_description: All you have to do is deliver a pizza. What could possibly go wrong? In this game, the entire environment stands in your way. Dodge nasty traps, fall victim to absurd surprises, and try again. A rage game with one simple mission: Get the damn pizza to its destination.

details.title: Little Desk Farm
details.short_description: Run a pixel farm on your desktop. Grow crops, hire farmers, raise chickens and arrange buildings your way. Assign farmers to sow, water and harvest, then sell crops to expand your land. Check in on the farm now and then while you work, study or take a break.

details.title: Baseline Boss: The Basketball Manager
details.short_description: Coach a pro basketball team from the bench: pick your starting five, sign talent and make the calls live on a tactics board that cuts to comic highlights. A bold cartoon manager with story mode, trash-talk duels, voiced commentary and a real simulation underneath.

details.title: His Umbrella Is Dry
details.short_description: Hong Kong, 1999. The rain won't stop. Your uncle says he'll be away a few days and leaves you his paper offerings shop. Write names for the dead, build paper cars, take the money, count the change. Tonight's customers come in from the rain. One umbrella is dry. Uncle's rule: dry umbrella, no name.

details.title: Undaria
details.short_description: Undaria is a co-op PvE extraction RPG about exploring a kingdom that dug too deep. Ride the Great Lift into vast stylized voxel caverns, fight the Blighted, and return with loot and survivors to rebuild the town, repair the Lift, and open the way to deeper layers.

details.title: Task Bar Throne
