details.short_description: Rule a cozy pixel kingdom that lives above your taskbar. Farm, fish, trade and raise a castle while you work — then step into a court full of companions, deals and intrigue, where every decision you make leaves a mark.

details.title: ABYSS CHRONICLES
details.short_description: Six bloodlines sealed in stone. An abyss that remembers. Wake your race, carve through living hordes and drowned giants, and chase build-defining loot down to 11,000 meters in a dark side-scrolling hack-and-slash ARPG.

details.title: Boingo!
details.short_description: Bounce through colourful worlds, overcome wild platforming challenges, and help Boingo save his family in this energetic 2D platforming adventure!

details.title: Estigia
details.short_description: Defeat the eleven Gods of the Greek underworld in this turn-based sliding puzzle. Your fate hangs in the balance. No tutorials, no text. Just your soul and your wits.

details.title: Winner Takes All
details.short_description: A sci-fi themed business simulation. Start as a nobody and build your empire. Invest your winnings to make more money or use them to gain influence. Go toe to toe with the underground or operate in the shadows. Remember; winner takes all, you have no other option.

details.title: Already Recorded The Statement
details.short_description: Your statement is already on record. Search messages, social media, and your calendar for evidence. Connect related records from all three apps to answer the investigator's questions. Decide who takes responsibility. Your evidence and choices will shape the investigation and the story.

details.title: Worst Lifeguards
details.short_description: Four-player online co-op physics comedy. Run the world's worst beach lifeguard service in eight-minute shifts: real wave physics moves every swimmer and object, the tourists fight rescue, and the whole beach is filming. Bring three friends - there is no solo mode.

name: Tales of Kureha: The Outer Gate Academy

details.title: Tales of Kureha: The Outer Gate Academy
details.short_description: A pixel-art JRPG × card battler — and it's not a roguelike. Fight your way past the boss guarding every floor as you climb toward the top of the tower, collecting new cards, gear, and companions along the way, and freely tune your own deck and playstyle.

details.title: Apocalypseed
details.short_description: Become the alien invasion in this 2D real-time strategy game! Command an army of carnivorous plants, devour humans to grow stronger, evolve into monstrous creatures, and build an underground colony. Expand your horde and crush humanity's resistance!

details.title: Rush & Deliver
details.short_description: Rush & Deliver is a driving and resource management roguelike where you work as a package delivery driver. Deliver packages, pay your bills, buy upgrades, and make difficult choices as you struggle to provide for your family.

details.title: Aboard Titanic
details.short_description: The Titanic is yours to master. Explore 100% of the ship, race through challenges, navigate by instinct, interact with history. The ultimate spatial puzzle awaits.

details.title: Brew & Bottle
details.short_description: A cozy first-person alchemy game where every potion is made by hand. Crack a gem in the mortar, chop, press and stir - then decipher recipes written as riddles and sell what you brew to a village full of customers.

details.title: NecroMarch
details.short_description: Every corpse is a resource. Your necromancer fights on the battlefield: capture mana wells, cast spells, and animate fallen foes into a growing undead horde. A turn-based tactics campaign where you will serve the villain conquering the world, or find a way to rebel.

details.title: IDUN Rogue
details.short_description: IDUN Rogue redefines roguelite shooters by putting an entire upgradeable army at your command. Survive against thousands of enemies physically piling up to eat you and your army on a fully destructible battlefield!

details.title: Tiny Lords
details.short_description: Build your own army, command your soldiers, and join chaotic multiplayer medieval battles powered by physics-based combat. From massive castle sieges to intense arena fights, experience a unique blend of skill, strategy, and unforgettable action.

details.title: Noions
details.short_description: Your ship crashed and the Noions escaped! Explore 10 colorful worlds, stun the cheeky creatures with your club and catch them with your net. Every species gives you a new ability. Rebuild the ship piece by piece and face the Tigrão.

details.title: Kalamor
details.short_description: Kalamor is an action roguelike with strong Souls-like influences. During a run, you'll explore dark dungeons, face challenging enemies, and discover chests with random upgrades. Outside of a run, you can spend the experience you've earned to improve your character or unlock new weapons.

details.title: Decimate Drive 2
details.short_description: Fight back or escape an all-American mountain town where every vehicle is a ruthless killing machine. Supercars charge at breakneck speed, unmarked vans lurk in the shadows and heavy-duty trucks stop at nothing to hunt you down. Run like hell in this dark, terrifyingly fast-paced indie horror game.

details.title: X Killerz
details.short_description: A fast, bloody Y2K arena war built from three connected game types: hovercraft racing, close-quarters FPS, and a fortress-assault MOBA that run back to back in a single match. Nine stages at launch. Kills are both your score and your currency. LAN, online, or bots.

details.title: Palette Panic
details.short_description: A billiards defense game where you hit approaching enemies with balls of matching color. Mix and split colors to make the one you need, bank shots off the walls, and stop the enemies before they cross the board. Test your skills in over 100 levels.

details.title: Nyancrement
details.short_description: Clicker × Idle × Cat Story — an incremental game. Nyancrement follows a cat lost in the Between as it collects 10 billion Coins to return home. You click to charge the Wish Orb and level up Relics, helping the cat collect even more Coins.

details.title: DREAMSTAURANT
details.short_description: DREAMSTAURANT is a singleplayer game made in a charming low-poly style in which you start and manage your own dream restaurant! Build your own company by your own rules! Create your own custom dishes, design your own restaurant, master time managment and of course, satisfy your hungry customers!

details.title: YOGRAK
details.short_description: The world was ending, until Yograk's nap did. Play YOGRAK, LICH SUPREME. Battle endless hordes of demons, trolls, and piranha-mancers. Unlock 9 characters, armaments, doctrines, relics, and demonic candies. Freeze time. Unfold the FRACTAL DOMAIN. Your disciples are waiting.

name: Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio 2: Fox Sister

details.title: Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio 2: Fox Sister
details.short_description: Late Tang turmoil unleashes ghosts and fiends, turning the Sixteen Prefectures of Yan and Yun into a haunted wasteland. Play as a general’s second son, journeying south with your ghost elder sister and fox-spirit younger sister for the fabled paradise. Will you find it?

details.title: Spacetime Chronicles
details.short_description: From the Webby Award-winning studio behind paper stop-motion music videos for Pink Floyd and Motörhead: Fred and his mysterious cat accidentally break time. Explore a world built from real paper, where centuries collide and every detail hides a puzzle.

details.title: Rio Beachside
details.short_description: Team up with your friends to run a beach tent in Rio de Janeiro! Take orders, prepare food, manage supplies, help beachgoers, and deal with unexpected challenges as you grow your business and keep the beach thriving.

details.title: Cases from the Murder Wagon
details.short_description: Take control of the Murder Wagon investigation team and cooperate to solve the world’s strangest cases in this asymmetrical co-op horror game.

details.title: Astrobreaker
details.short_description: Astrobreaker is a short incremental game about making a spaceship faster and more powerful. Mine planets, gather resources, and upgrade your ship.

details.title: Infernal West
details.short_description: Infernal West is a first-person psychological horror puzzle game set in a Wild West saloon. Observe every detail, identify the anomalies warping reality, and unravel the mysteries hidden within an endless loop. Every decision may bring you closer to the exit... or trap you in the loop forever.

details.title: Just get the flag
details.short_description: In this puzzle game, you are RED, a little red square whose purpose is only to reach the flag. But be careful… it moves in the opposite direction of you. Will you manage to take the right path to finally capture that stupid flag?

details.title: Robot Crucible
details.short_description: Build a fighting robot in 5 minutes, or perfect it over 5 hours, then destroy your opponents! Sketch out a chassis, snap on some motors and wheels, choose a weapon, and throw it into the arena against the AI or friends in local multiplayer.

details.title: MISSING PLAY
details.short_description: MISSING PLAY is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where one player faces off against the rest. Play as a survivor, cooperate with your teammates, complete objectives, and escape… or become the monster and do everything you can to stop them. It's free and will remain free.

details.title: The Vestige
details.short_description: An action RPG where you play as a cyborg fighting rogue robots with melee combat and improvised weapons. Hack computers to recover your past and take down a tyrant AI.

details.title: The Arch-Enemy of Hy-Brasil
details.short_description: 勇者が敗北した世界で目醒めたあなたは、魔王を倒すために冒険に向かうことになる。停滞した世界で最後にあなたが選ぶのは再生？ それとも、破滅？

details.title: Chronos Arena
details.short_description: Heavy armor meets modern ballistics: Battle it out in fast-paced 2D top-down PvP arena matches deep inside the dungeon. Upgrade your arsenal with modular attachments, stack devastating blessings, and master skill-based gunplay to dominate your enemies.

details.title: Humane Farm
details.short_description: Program an army of robots to automate your farm in the year 2049. Under the rule of Robot Overlords, you’ve been chosen for a unique cooperation experiment. Grow crops, care for animals, make ethical choices, and master a visual programming language to automate every task on your farm.

details.title: One Star Express
details.short_description: Cosmic teleportation is down, and no one is happy about going back to spaceship travel! Seat quirky aliens in ways that let you satisfy their quirks and demands throughout the journey. Navigate strange cosmic events, return lost items, earn passenger reviews, and make sure everyone arrives smiling.

details.title: Zala
details.short_description: Zala is a roguelike about breaking bricks and catching thousands of gold coins. Combine 100+ game changing upgrades, destroy 1000+ unique stages and fight powerful bosses made of curse bricks. Make the right choices and you'll swim in gold.

details.title: Armored clash
details.short_description: "Armored Clash" - Modern Main Battle Tanks in Combat, All Preparations Complete

details.title: Babylumns
details.short_description: Babylumns is a fast-paced versus puzzle arcade inspired by 90s arcade and 16-bit classics. Match, combo, and unleash character abilities in tense, replayable battles.

name: Professor Mong Mong: The Window to the North

details.title: Professor Mong Mong: The Window to the North
details.short_description: Investigate a haunting mystery inspired by Nordic folklore in a story-rich 2D point-and-click adventure. Explore the remote Faroe Islands, uncover forgotten secrets, solve paranormal puzzles, and discover what lies beyond the Window to the North.

details.title: Swaggerfall
details.short_description: Swaggerfall is a first-person open world fantasy RPG that plays in the terminal. The graphics are ascii based and limited to what the command line offers. Playable with keyboard or gamepad.

details.title: Beezarr
details.short_description: Endless insect swarms, over a dozen bosses, 16 weapon evolutions: fight through 4 worlds as a tiny bee, rescue eggs from guarded nests and hatch 39 pets that fight by your side – from a goldfish to a cat with a minigun. A honey-sweet survivors-like for PC & Steam Deck.

details.title: Monsterpiece!
details.short_description: Battle rogue art tools and splatter them with color as you work to recreate beautiful paintings in this fast-paced combat game. Dodge enemy attacks, navigate obstacles, and experiment with your own creative strategies to bring each chaotic canvas to life!

details.title: TALLY
details.short_description: A horror clicker set inside a census ledger. It's 1847, and the Vestry pays you a penny for every person you write into the book. Beside your count sits a second number: the clicks the room has heard. It is always a little higher.

details.title: Kipper: The Mountain Lizard
details.short_description: Kipper: The Mountain Lizard is a retro-styled 2D precision platformer. Help Kipper tidy the mountain by collecting every gem and balloon.

details.title: Dode
details.short_description: Dode is an online creature-capture RPG on hex-voxel worlds. Tactical-combat focused, with a cozy side. Featuring endless unique loot, ability customization, and base creation. Explore, capture, train, battle, craft, farm, and build - as you quest aside the elemental Wardens in their Mana Wars.

details.title: Pie Paw
details.short_description: Pie Paw is a cozy bag-building roguelite where you draw, upgrade, and combine dice to outscore animal rivals. Shape every roll with special dice, items, and companions as you travel a branching road in search of pies.

details.title: Dark Looter
details.short_description: Dark Looter is a browser-based hacking simulation game. Build your rig, steal files from virtual institutions, mine cryptocurrency, and climb the hacker ranks — all in a persistent online world.

details.title: Dream Within The Vessel
details.short_description: Dream Within the Vessel is a psychological horror visual novel. Follow Ze through six days in a seemingly peaceful town—where happiness feels arranged, and something alive is watching. Your choices will shape his final decision.

details.title: Sword Dancer
details.short_description: Inspired by Gongsun Daniang, the legendary sword dancer of Tang Dynasty China. Chart her blade-dance through enemy ranks—every step is set before the first strike. Route planning × roguelite building: choreograph the perfect dance, then watch it cut through the chaos.

details.title: hooooook
details.short_description: Gold Miner + Roguelike — Classic hook-and-grab gameplay fused with roguelike building. Hooks with unique abilities ; hundreds of relics can be freely combined to forge your own playstyle. Venture deep into the earth — mines, swamps, tombs… each new zone hides its own mechanics and threats.

details.title: Portals and Ducks
details.short_description: Surf a ramp. Shoot a portal. Keep every bit of your speed. A first-person game where the surfing is forgiving and the depth is in your portals - put a boost on one, a jump on the other, and use both in the same run. Levels are short. Restarts are instant.

details.title: Factory Tour →
details.short_description: Factory Tour → is a 3D horror game where you explore a mysterious robot factory.

details.title: Five Star Crew
details.short_description: Run a tour boat with up to three friends through waters full of deadly sea life. Steer, cook, patch leaks and protect your guests on the way to the next dock. They paid for five-star service. Try to keep them alive long enough to leave a review.

details.title: SPP: Stream Party Pack
details.short_description: Up for a friendly challenge with your TikTok LIVE viewers? Pick one of three games. Deliver parcels, paint a canvas, or knock cubes into a pit. You set the effects for likes, follows, and gifts. Your viewers decide when to lend a hand and when to get in your way.

details.title: GUNBUTCHER: RELOADED
details.short_description: 90 seconds and a completely crazy card roulette! Pile up the chaos and try to get out alive.

details.title: Brewhaven
details.short_description: Brew magic combat beers that power up your village. Discover hundreds of recipes, run the tavern each night to keep your villagers juiced and happy, then have them work in the village and defend the town from enemy raids, if they can still walk.

details.title: エンゼルモール
details.short_description: Four girls and an android awaken in the deserted "Angel Mall". Explore under a time limit across repeated attempts, piecing together clues and records left behind to uncover the mall’s secrets in this puzzle adventure.

details.title: Little Dive
details.short_description: Explore, poke around, find treasures… and take your time! Little Dive is a peaceful little underwater adventure where you use your tools and the environment to make your way forward, searching for memories of a vanished world… strangely familiar?

details.title: SkyAid
details.short_description: Pilot your aircraft and dive into the disaster zone. Flames, ruins, floods — every corner holds someone waiting to be saved. Fly. Scan. Locate. Find every survivor before the clock runs out. Heal the wounded, transport the rescued, use supplies — every choice you make decides their fate.

details.title: Condotta
details.short_description: Lead a fifteenth-century mercenary company in Condotta, a historical tactical roguelike. Hire fighters, command them in turn-based battles, and decide what trouble to take on as you travel. Fulfill your contract—and live to collect your pay.

details.title: The Legend of Trump
details.short_description: Play as a raging businessman with a mission, take over the Cashlandia strip one hotel-casino at a time. Use bribes, gaudy furniture, and addicting games to keep people in your casinos and make the most cash. Take over the strip, building by building, and become the Legend.

details.title: A Monk's Quest
details.short_description: You’re a monk exploring a vast sandbox world with living, simulated villages, where everyone has a life and a story. Mine, craft, and fight corrupted spirits in the wild. Then return to the villages to build a home, make friends, and master the art of prayer to help them fulfill their dreams.

details.title: Pounce Brigade
details.short_description: Recruit a brigade of cats, arrange them on the living-room rug, and combine their talents in this auto-battling roguelite. Protect a nap or take on enemy packs through twelve rounds, solo or in private two-player co-op.

details.title: Until Mom Comes Home
details.short_description: After a tragic event changed his life forever, Ethan moves to Rottenpine with his mother. As strange occurrences begin to shake the town, the boundary between reality and nightmare slowly starts to crumble.

details.title: Gun Game
details.short_description: Gun Game is a tense psychological party game for two friends where trust is too expensive. Bluff, compete in agility and try your luck in dangerous mini-games! Do you trust your friend?

details.title: Knight Vows
details.short_description: KNIGHT VOWS is a dark medieval visual novel set in the 13th century. You are a newly initiated knight of the Order of Saint Féran, a religious order that spreads its faith through iron and blood. Will you remain faithful to your vow... or to your humanity? Your choices will speak for you.

details.title: Almost At Pity
details.short_description: Almost At Pity is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder where your gacha pulls define your run! Limit break your characters with limited resources, master powerful synergies, and conquer the final boss

name: A Very Scary Hairy Bike Ride

details.title: A Very Scary Hairy Bike Ride
details.short_description: You’re Bigfoot. You have a bicycle. And it’s really hot. Ride across the country with your friends, survive the wilderness, and try not to completely destroy your bike (and yourself) along the way!

details.title: MAKINA
details.short_description: In a world where Emotion is energy, a vengeful pilot boards a dangerous, desire-fueled Makina and descends into the emotion-addicted city. Defy the twisted rulers—a scientist, architect, K-pop idol, and director—to tear down their grand plan. A hybrid adventure of mech action and stealth: [MAKINA].

details.title: SHADOW WIZARD MONEY GANG
details.short_description: A game about greed. A chaotic heist co-op roguelike shooter where wizards blast through rooms, gamble with magic, and turn money into health, power, and upgrades. LEGALIZE NUCLEAR BOMBS

details.title: AMIMI
details.short_description: A child and a mysterious creature explore a magical world where every corner hides a surprise. Meet curious characters, experiment with inventive puzzles, and discover a story of friendship, transformation, and nature.

details.title: No Beer Left Behind!
details.short_description: 2D sokoban puzzle game with pixel art and an 8-bit soundtrack. You play as a dwarf tidying up his cellars. The goal is simple: get every barrel onto its marked spot, and the level is solved. But sometimes you need to drink a beer!

details.title: GERPHYON: The Ender Mansion
details.short_description: Will you survive 1000 rooms of pure arcade/horror pressure? Or will you crumble as soon as the lights begin to flicker and find yourself desperately running for your life from the indescribable, aberrant 'FRIENDS' crawling through the bowels of this complex?

details.title: Rusted Frontier
details.short_description: Haul chaotic cargo, drive fully physically-simulated vehicles, and build ambitious projects across a forgotten frontier. Solo, or co-op chaos with up to 4 players.

details.title: User.exe
details.short_description: User.exe is a psychological horror experience set in WinShade, a forgotten operating system from the early 2000s. Inside lives User, a trapped virtual assistant asking for help to finish a failed mission: install a virus to destroy Admin, an entity tied to urban legends and missing people.

details.title: BirdBots
details.short_description: Master a unique skill-based flight system in a post-apocalyptic world. Play the story, survive procedurally generated tunnels, or compete with up to 6 players in multiplayer races and Last BirdBot Standing battles.

details.title: Strike King
details.short_description: Explore the strange world of competitive bowling as you climb the ranks to become the Strike King. Wield 100+ unique balls as you struggle against eccentric bowlers armed with an arsenal of elements, obstacles, and outlandish abilities in this bowling roguelite.

details.title: Here, There Be Monsters
details.short_description: Hunt legendary deep-sea beasts through unpredictable waters, where every passing day drains your vital resources. Choose to hunt bounties, prey on merchant fleets, or turn to piracy just to survive.

details.title: Into the Barrel
details.short_description: This is a single-player, first-person, roguelite action game. Fight bloody battles alongside the weapon in your hand, accumulate wealth and experience through each kill, strengthen yourself, tear through the planet, and become the strongest.

details.title: Legumi Lagoon
details.short_description: Uncover the lost histories and legends of the mysterious Legumi in a stressfully relaxing survival RPG like none other.

details.title: Paracampus 2015
details.short_description: ParaCampus 2015 is a multi-ending college sim. You're a freshman in 2015—plan your days, shape your path. Grind for grades, master skills, or dive into clubs, part-time jobs, romance, and campus exploration. Endless side stories await.

details.title: Luman Lars: Dichotomy
details.short_description: Two worlds. A 2D pixel-art open-world action-adventure where your playstyle reshapes your abilities, the soundtrack reacts to your every move, and your choices decide which truth — and which ending — is real.

details.title: Brews & Kings
details.short_description: Brew on an island where the hills, springs, and fruit decide how the drink tastes. Hire masters and link their workshops into a line. When the brew's ready, the workers, the merchants, and even the Queen come calling, but that's life. You can't please everyone.

details.title: FruitSnoot
details.short_description: Capture fruit, grow your tail, chase rare finds, and unlock quirky characters and equipment in a cute, chaotic action roguelite.

details.title: Worm Game
details.short_description: A puzzle game in which you play as a worm. Push boxes to open the way forward, but beware - it's not so easy to back up when you're a worm.

details.title: Corner Dungeon
details.short_description: Lightweight desktop idle battler. The ultimate workday distraction.

details.title: Force Tilt
details.short_description: A 3D, First-Person, Physics based, Puzzle Platformer.

details.title: Novanoom
details.short_description: A colorful isometric sci-fi action-adventure. Explore handcrafted alien biomes with T.O.A.S.T.E.R., your companion drone, fight strange creatures in real time, and craft tools from what they drop to open hardlight bridges, shortcuts, and the way to the next biome.

details.title: Argosy
details.short_description: Buy low, sail far, sell high. A medieval trading sim with a living economy: build routes, factories and fleets, outwit rival merchants, and rise from humble trader to lord mayor and beyond. Play solo or online.

details.title: COLDFILE
details.short_description: A tactical third-person stealth game, solo or in online co-op. Hide in the shadows, move quietly and outsmart guards who see and hear you. Climb, take cover, grab and interrogate enemies, and choose for yourself whether to kill, knock out or slip past them unseen.

details.title: Zombies Per Minute
details.short_description: An orbital AI dropped you on Earth to take it back. She judges you on ONE number: how many zombies you can kill per minute. Automate a factory that turns raw ore into mass extermination. Stack wild upgrades and keep ammo flowing so hordes melt at your walls. When you fall, drop back in stronger.

details.title: Rush B: Esports Manager
details.short_description: Take control of a fps esports team and lead them from underdogs to world champions. Scout talent, develop players, manage personalities, and adapt your strategy in a deep, realism-driven management sim. Are you ready to break records and leave your mark on the esports world?

details.title: Yarn-Ball!
details.short_description: Yarn-Ball! is a multiplayer sandbox game where you can create & explore various worlds as a silly cat!!! :3

details.title: 13 BONES
details.short_description: A fast-paced card battler. Like BLACKJACK, but with added MONSTERS and VIOLENCE. Build your DECK and push your LUCK to earn your freedom !

details.title: The Book of Prosperity
details.short_description: The Book of Prosperity is a 2D action RPG in a surreal pixel-art Hong Kong where ancient magic seeps through modern streets and skyscrapers. Student Cyrus must master rhythmic combat, rooftop parkour, and buried secrets to uncover prosperity's hidden cost.

details.title: Emocritical
details.short_description: A story-rich urban battle RPG. As a Nikko University transfer student, freely explore bustling Xijing, raise stats, make friends, and live your days. But beneath the peaceful daily life, dark undercurrents surge. Collect clues, shatter the facade, and face the ultimate crisis when it arrives.

details.title: Soul Tripper
details.short_description: Action roguelite with autoshoot, a parry system and randomly generated levels. Loot resources from your enemies to craft your gear and grow stronger with every run. Dozens of items, skills and characters to unlock.

details.title: Lighthouse Keeper: Lost At Sea
details.short_description: An atmospheric survival and life simulation where you live alone as a lighthouse keeper, maintaining the light, braving storms, and surviving the quiet weight of isolation at sea.

details.title: BLOODMOORED
details.short_description: BLOODMOORED is a first-person psychological horror. Revive a derelict factory by restarting its machinery. The spirits here are unpredictable: one moment they hunt you, the next they are your only key to salvation. Uncover their past to understand their motives and escape this trap alive

details.title: Euphausia superba: The Antarctic Krill
details.short_description: Swim, let yourself carried with ocean currents, and search for phytoplankton alongside krill, a small crustacean. Guide a krill on a fascinating journey to reach the ice floe in this relaxing, interactive wildlife documentary.

details.title: Within The Box
details.short_description: Within The Box is a fantasy survival horror game that mixes Resident Evil and Dungeons & Dragons, all wrapped into a puzzle solving, spell slinging, story driven adventure.

details.title: Catrium
details.short_description: This idle anomaly management game is set in the bottom right corner of the screen and progresses at a leisurely pace. Grow and manage the mysterious cat-like substance "Catrium" at your leisure, earn money, and upgrade your lab.

details.title: Square Mining Builder
details.short_description: Build a village inside the mine of your dreams! Collect resources, catalog up to 200 different rare ores, manage your villagers and face random events, all in a procedural map with cozy pixel art!

details.title: WARD 107: SILENCE
details.short_description: WARD 107: SILENCE is a first person psychological horror. Your microphone is the key: use your voice to solve vocal puzzles and uncover the atrocious experiments of Project H.O.P.E. Speak to progress, but silence is your only defense when they hunt you. Make noise, and you die.

details.title: One Must Rule
details.short_description: An empire-building auto-battler set in a harsh medieval settlement where every strategic command shapes your kingdom’s fate. Build your empire from the council table, discover game-breaking card synergies, and battle against rival players. Every choice counts, only one will rule!

details.title: World Football 2030
details.short_description: A football strategy game where every match is fully simulated. Choose a national team, set the formation and tactics, then watch your decisions play out on the pitch. You don’t control the players directly, your job is to prepare, adapt, and lead your nation to the world title.

details.title: Rhomfaya: The Rays of Liberty
details.short_description: A land invaded, with a web of lies and bloodshed serving as a catalyst. Build an army of over 40 unique characters and liberate the Kingdom of Ezebar from the chaotic shadows that threaten it, in this sprite-based tactical RPG!

details.title: False Flame
details.short_description: Single player social deduction auto battler where YOU are the impostor. Steer two hidden cultists through a colony under siege: win your party’s trust, then murder whoever trusts you most. Kill too many and the siege takes you all. Plan the perfect kill, bluff your way out, then get away with it.

details.title: Perry's Pizzeria
details.short_description: Build the ultimate pizza deck! Collect ingredient cards, create delicious pizzas, discover massive flavor combos, satisfy quirky customers, unlock new chefs, and upgrade your restaurant in this tasty deckbuilding roguelike.

details.title: Digital Civilization: Evolution
details.short_description: Build your own empire! Evolve from a primitive civilization and rise to become the strongest and greatest empire of all! Manage resources, construct buildings, and engage in diplomacy with other nations, as you grow your civilization step by step into an unstoppable powerhouse.

details.title: Beast Survivor 3D
details.short_description: Battle thousands of monsters in this 3D action-survival game. Harness elemental resonance to unleash magic, from ground spikes to celestial meteors. Adapt your evolution mid-combat, using rapid skill combos and domain buffs to reign as the apex predator of this savage world.

details.title: Annexation
details.short_description: Annexation is a fast-paced real-time strategy game with old-school roots. Build bases, train armies, and outmaneuver your enemy to claim victory. Start by playing the campaign and then challenge yourself in Arcade Missions, which bring the intensity of multiplayer RTS into a single-player setting.

details.title: Oneiron Expanse
details.short_description: Your world is abruptly erased. Only the Oneiron Expanse remains; a Plane where your mental state evokes lethal potential. Embark on a deckbuilding odyssey where every card is a fragment of your will. Find the Dreamwright and dream your reality back into being... before your memories fade

details.title: Clickomorph
details.short_description: Hover over enemies to kill them... Until you choose an ability! Each new ability offers a new playstyle! Build a small auto clicker army, shoot your enemies as an archer, summon a Soul Reaper to assist you or even play a mini rhythm game! And more!

details.title: 请在正确答案处咬下
details.short_description: When obedient top student Fang Zhu discovers her childhood friend Jiang Xiangyi is secretly a werewolf, she risks her own academic standing to protect him from their suffocating school environment, toxic classmates, and an unfeeling teacher.

details.title: The Creature Mafia
details.short_description: A 1920s Prohibition-era action RPG where you capture creatures to take on the mob! Set in 1926 Kansas City, The Creature Mafia mixes a realistic world with cartoonish creature combat. Your creatures’ lives are in your hands - can you prevail against the full might of the mob?

details.title: HYPERDROP: A Pachinko Roguelite
details.short_description: Build impossible scoring machines in HYPERDROP, a hypnotizing physics-based pachinko roguelite bursting with satisfying chain reactions and game-breaking combos.

details.title: You Are Family
details.short_description: You’re looking to disconnect in a secluded country house. A family welcomes you in. Soon, you’ll discover that feeling at home here… may be more real than you imagine.

details.title: SINEK
details.short_description: Sinek is a dark, cinematic adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic bunker, where you guide a swarm of flies to explore a world filled with silent stories of human resilience.

details.title: Skymote
details.short_description: A tower defence deckbuilder with roguelike elements. Build a deck, raise towers, cast spells, and discover unexpected synergies to turn your floating island into a fortress the sky can't break.

details.title: Vertical Momentum Revival
details.short_description: Engage in fast paced vertical PVP combat. Jump straight into the action on the rooftops, or flank your enemy through the alleyways below. Choose from a variety of movement abilities to compliment your playstyle. Play any existing maps, or create your own!

details.title: Renegade Run
details.short_description: Renegade Run is an immersive deckbuilder that puts you in the pilot seat of an experimental starship. Discover anomalies, carve your path, and face powerful enemies as you battle your way back to Sector 0.

details.title: Doctor Kairokos
details.short_description: Play as scientist Doctor Kairokos, use a time machine remote controller and find your missing assistant in this 3D adventure game.

details.title: Pump Away!
details.short_description: A railroad adventure that sits at the bottom of your screen! Click to make the car go brrr or let it idle - this cat and dog duo will pump away and liven up your desktop.

details.title: The HOUSE
details.short_description: Inspired by Balatro and Vampire Survivors. In every casino game, the house always wins. In The HOUSE, you are the casino. A NY mob family runs the most crooked casino in Vegas — and you're their engineer. Rig the machines, break the odds, and launder a fortune one gloriously broken payout at a time.

details.title: Pitstop Panic
details.short_description: Pitstop Panic is a co-op pit crew game where teamwork breaks down under pressure. Work together to repair, refuel, and get the car back on track, but mistakes, distractions, and poor timing quickly turn simple pit stops into chaos.

details.title: Lethal Love
details.short_description: Turn your love lethal. Play as Kyoko, a yandere obsessed with her senpai. Eliminate rivals, make deadly choices and unlock multiple endings with cute arts. Now on PC with full controller support, enhanced graphics and constant updates. Currently in Early Access.

details.title: Drainbound
details.short_description: You are Drainbound, it is your time. A roguelike adventure where you must fight, suffer and sever to discover your true destination.

details.title: Ruinous
details.short_description: Craft devastating decks, gather loot to define your build, and defeat randomized dungeons and ruthless boss fights in a journey of risk, strategy, and ruin in this fantasy roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: Peeled Eyes
details.short_description: Stealth-Horror where you close your eyes to see what sinister forces and secrets are hiding in the shadows. Use your senses to explore atmospheric environments, avoid supernatural surveillance using stealth, and acquire eldritch artifacts for safekeeping.

details.title: Corrupt Receptionist Elina
details.short_description: A receptionist simulation set in a medieval fantasy Adventurers’ Guild, where you review documents and process rewards. You should pay for your sick sister’s medicine. Will you work honestly—or turn to bribery and embezzlement? Your paperwork and choices will shape your fate.

details.title: Penumbra
details.short_description: Penumbra is a minimalist color-theory puzzle game. Move lights and blocks around the screen to mix colors and cast shadows. Match the color-coded goal circles with the right shade of colored light to complete each level.

details.title: Ashes of Bronze
details.short_description: Bronze Ashes, a fantasy action roguelite inspired by Sanxingdui and Jinsha, conjures a cyclically reborn otherworld from ancient Shu's legends. Play alone or with friends: command shape-shifting arms, gather Golden Crow spells, and fight to save Shu from impending doom.

details.title: Sit Still
details.short_description: Sit Still is a first-person puzzle horror set in 1985. Bound to a rolling chair by a radio-obsessed killer, you must escape and survive while uncovering the truth behind a recurring cataclysmic storm that strikes the local town every 20 years.

details.title: FEMBOY SLEEPOVER - Episode 2
details.short_description: You've been invited to the Femboy Sleepover! In episode 2 of this cute yaoi visual novel series, look for ways to exorcise the demon you summoned.

details.title: The UFO Phenomenon
details.short_description: In this horror strategy roguelite inspired by Dispatch, become part of MAJESTIC; a clandestine force tasked with guarding humanity’s darkest truth. Disinform, spy, and endure as paranoia, catastrophe, and the unknown threaten everything you know.

details.title: ACORN: Seed of Resistance
details.short_description: Exploration, party building, and against-all-odds heroism in 15-minute roguelike adventures. Shape your rodent companions into a formidable fighting force and unleash them in brutal auto battles to retake your woodland home.

details.title: Pulsewave
details.short_description: Fly a ship through tracks built from the music. Every trap, ring and star lands on a beat. Dodge lightning, cross lava canyons and crystal caves, hit the Puls on the beat, chase an S rank and climb the Steam leaderboards. Load your own songs and fly them too.

details.title: The Races
details.short_description: The horses aren't real. The money isn't real. The emotional rollercoaster very much is. Bet, buy, train and sabotage from your phone in this Teletext-era horse racing party game, for a room full of friends or just you and the bots.

details.title: 不动列车StationaryTrain
details.short_description: " stationary Train" is a post-apocalyptic horror exploration pixel-style RPG. You will play as Luna, an adult woman and the last survivor of this world. you set out to recover your lost memories, and together with the conductor Diqiu, you return to a world ravaged by monsters and plague...

details.title: IRON-PLUNDER
details.short_description: THE PLUNDER AWAITS! “KING ORANGE” and his fiendish collectors have stolen “The Chief’s” comic book collection and only “Deathwish Newyork” can get them back! Blast the hell out of "KING ORANGE'S" facilities and secure the IRON PLUNDER!

details.title: Tales of the Otherworld
details.short_description: A single-player and multiplayer game paying homage to classic MMORPGs: Explore the MU Continent featuring low-number stats, AFK auto-battles, co-op play, farming, and fishing.

details.title: Corocoro Friends
details.short_description: Roll, stick, and carry everything. "Coro-coro Friends" is a chaotic physics puzzle action game where you roll a sphere, cling to objects, and solve challenges in creative ways. Play solo or with a friend—cooperate or sabotage your way to the goal.

details.title: Pact of the Black Tide
details.short_description: A narrative point-and-click adventure game blending puzzles and wit. Explore, interact with a cast of colorful characters, combine items, and manipulate reality through an integrated magic system. Humor, adventure, and discovery await to bring you into new and unexpected worlds.

details.title: The Blood Knight: Episode Dawn
details.short_description: Defeat, Devour, and Forge. The Blood Knight is a Turn-Based JRPG inspired by the classics. Guide Zeno Trillion, a boy who can turn objects into something more. Master unique skills and equipment, unleash Zeno's Critical Skills, and lead companions through a journey full of twists and turns.

details.title: Lumory: A Distant Summer
details.short_description: Wander through bright liminal spaces shaped by distant summer memories. Ride a childhood scooter, reveal hidden paths with Dream Vision, and capture surreal moments with your camera. No combat—just calm exploration.

name: Outbreak The Fedora Files: What Lydia Knows - Known Factors

details.title: Outbreak The Fedora Files: What Lydia Knows - Known Factors
details.short_description: Join Lydia as she takes her fight to expose the corruption in Cypress Ridge to City Hall in the second part of the visual novel series What Lydia Knows.

name: Detective Turner: If Looks Could Kill

details.title: Detective Turner: If Looks Could Kill
details.short_description: A point-and-click noir murder mystery where you literally read the room. Search for clues in text, photograph evidence, and interrogate suspects in visual novel-style conversations to solve the murder of a fashion icon.

details.title: Afterlight Survival
details.short_description: Open-world sandbox survival horror combining base-building, crafting, and tower defense. Scavenge for supplies and build your home while evading what's left of the government and the undead it created. Play solo or online co-op with up to 4 players.

name: Lights Out Chapter 2 The Unseen Reckoning

details.title: Lights Out Chapter 2 The Unseen Reckoning
details.short_description: Alone again and abandoned in the house, this time even darker than usual. You return as Jack and set out to search for your missing Friend.

details.title: 盲盒指挥官
details.short_description: Blind Box Commander is a toy brick-style RTS with deckbuilding, blind box draws, and classic base tech. Build a 24-card deck, expand your base, unlock units, and adapt your tactics in real time as every match delivers new combinations and fresh strategic battles.

details.title: Under A Groove
details.short_description: 'Under A Groove' is a rhythm game that's fun just to watch, even if you're only playing the music video. A stylish rhythm action game where visuals and music sync perfectly—simple to play, deeply satisfying to master.

details.title: Evil thought
details.short_description: Awakened by a brainwave separator in an artificial resurrection experiment, you fall into a mental maze blending reality and dreams. Corroded by the inner "Earth Mother", you follow your grandmother’s clues through distorted campuses, decayed buildings, secret labs and strange memory plains.

details.title: ShipIt Galactic
details.short_description: Manage and grow your intergalactic shipping company! Play alone or with friends as you fly your truck, pick up deliveries and process them in your hangar. Purchase machines, place conveyor belts, hire drivers, and build the best logistics company in the galaxy!

details.title: Fat Justice
details.short_description: You are the newly appointed Judge in the Stone Age trying to keep a chaotic island from falling apart. Listen to bizarre testimonies while balancing absurd laws and deadly politics. Pass judgment, shape the island's fate, and uncover the truth behind your father's mysterious disappearance.

details.title: Cars and Guns: Paper Parts
details.short_description: The world is flat. Everything is cardboard. Your soul is like a car made of paper parts. No thing can reach the end. Can you make it to the Garage of the Queen of Ice? Drive, scrap, and find your way through a universe made of paper and ink.

details.title: Rummy Attack
details.short_description: "Rummy Attack" is a unique Roguelite Card Battler based on Rummy rules! Place cards on the field to create "Melds" (Sets or Runs) to unleash skills. Build your deck and overcome physical gimmicks like ground fissures to defeat the final boss. Choose between Tactical Move or High-Speed Time Mode!

details.title: Mind Mirror
details.short_description: A puzzle game set in a millennial-era household. Featuring immersive, retro-styled puzzles full of nostalgic vibes, alongside abundant dreamlike elements.

details.title: Upwell
details.short_description: The only way up is to blow yourself up. Rocket jump through a procedurally generated well full of rising lava and fleshy monsters in this chaotic physics-based FPS roguelike.

details.title: Restoraether
details.short_description: Restoraether is a cozy magical survival crafting game where you explore the isles of magic, mysteriously abandoned by their powerful Mage inhabitants, and restore the balance of aethers to bring magic back to the world.

details.title: LUNAR PULSE
details.short_description: "LUNAR PULSE" is a single-player roguelite card game. Ultra-short battles decided within 60 seconds. Experience soulslike tension where a single move leads to instant death. It features a game system where players act simultaneously with hands revealed.

details.title: We Believe in No Gods
details.short_description: Awaken as a forgotten deity in a post-apocalyptic wasteland ruled by staunch materialists. Listen to desperate prayers—bestow miracles or watch with cold indifference. Extract faith to survive, manipulate mortal minds, and shape the ultimate fate of a world where We Believe In No Gods.

details.title: His Last Film
details.short_description: What happened during the filming? Stan doesn't remember. Explore the decaying depths of an abandoned subway station, piece together a fragmented reality, and discover the horrifying truth behind his last film. Some memories are better left unmade.

details.title: Depth-Bound
details.short_description: 🌊 A physics-based underwater 2D platformer. 🚀 Propel yourself out of the water, chain trajectories, and dive always more deeply. 📸 Photograph strange creatures and follow an expedition whose outcome remains uncertain.

details.title: Nord
details.short_description: NORD is a story-driven survival game set in a flooded Swedish archipelago. Alone or with friends, engineer your raft to navigate a strange, petrifying ocean.

details.title: The End of Allegoria
details.short_description: A turn-based tactical RPG where your choices determine the fate of the world. Traverse a world that changes as you explore it, find new companions, and combine different class skills by mastering a multitude of equipment.

details.title: Grid Grief
details.short_description: A roguelite plinko style deckbuilder about escaping the space between heaven & hell. Forge powerful synergies, trigger chaotic effects and rack up huge scores to secure your resurrection.

details.title: Ciella's Casebook
details.short_description: Mystery adventure game set one year after the war, following the journey of a war-veteran detective Ciella and her assistant Ricky in the industrial city of Actain.

details.title: Heirlooms
details.short_description: A letter has just arrived for you, Jack. Reclaim your legacy in this lovecraftian old-school dungeon crawler. Uncover misteries, face once buried horrors and survive. Fear what should be left forgotten.

details.title: TetraDice
details.short_description: Forget everything you know about falling blocks. TetraDice blends classic arcade strategy with Roguelite powers and dice-driven chaos. Bend gravity, unleash explosions, and use 50+ Perks to survive and beat the high score.

details.title: RUIN'S HOUSE
details.short_description: A unique fusion of "Lady" × "Haunted Mansion"—a 2.5D horror action experience emerges! Who is the lady? What happened in this place long ago? Collect the scattered Fragments of Memory throughout the mansion and uncover the truth!

details.title: VilaGod
details.short_description: VilaGod is a god simulator where you shape the destiny of civilizations on giant maps. Unlike other god games, every action generates dynamic chronicles: from political revolts to legendary discoveries, watch your world's history unfold in 14 different languages

details.title: Poop Deck
details.short_description: Step onto the Poop Deck™ in this chaotic online co-op game! Collaborate with your crew to keep the dysfunctional ship moving. Repair engines, patch leaks, and manage crises as you race to the destination. Can your team survive before the vessel falls apart?

details.title: Portal Fall
details.short_description: Portal Fall is a turn-based roguelike where your skill set evolves mid-combat. Battle endless waves of enemies across fractured realities ruled by an ethereal Jester.

details.title: Burned Out!
details.short_description: Burned Out! is a chaotic office co-op game for 1-4 players where pointless computer tasks and paperwork spiral into full-blown workplace mayhem. Type, print, sign, stamp, staple, and deliver orders while the backlog keeps growing. Coordinate through workplaces designed to break you.

details.title: Thorner
details.short_description: Thorner is a horror visual novel with multiple endings. You attempt to escape your past by fleeing to the wilderness, but spilled blood can never be forgiven. The land knows what you did. The land judges. Thorner awaits.

details.title: The Warden's Rite
details.short_description: The Warden's Rite is a fantasy tower defense game set in a world consumed by the Fire God. You are humanity's last hope. As the Warden, command Earth, Air, and Water with the power of the Elemental Gods. Combine elements to create traps, block paths, and place towers to set your strategy.

details.title: ONIGASHIMA: Awakening
details.short_description: A predictive deck-building RPG! Build your strategy from over 300 cards! Form powerful formations with unique animal companions! Master countless combinations and claim overwhelming victories! Your adventure to defeat the ONI begins now!

details.title: Hollow Heart
details.short_description: Hollow Heart is a growth‑simulation game about forbidden human transmutation and twisted sisterly devotion. As the elder sister, you gather materials, rebuild your little sister’s soul and body, and attempt to revive her in a more “perfect” form.

details.title: Plume
details.short_description: Plume is a roguelite about a tribe of birds ravaged by a volcano. As one of its last survivors, fight your way through randomly generated levels, gather and grow powerful items to create the ultimate build, and rebuild your village to its former glory!

details.title: Kint
details.short_description: A text-based fantasy multiplayer RPG where all players must decide what lore is true. Explore the world of Seram, learn everything you can. Resolve conflicts between lore by voting each week. Can you solve the mystery behind the Kilns?

details.title: The Witch and the Wish
details.short_description: You are the Holy Lady of the Kanan Empire, repeating your accustomed life day after day, thinking that your life will never change. However, one day, an unexpected event occurs, and you can no longer return to the temple. What choice will you make?

details.title: Farm to Restaurant Simulator
details.short_description: Grow crops on your farm, cook delicious meals, and manage your own restaurant in this relaxing farm-to-restaurant simulation game.

details.title: Dolky
details.short_description: Dolky is a roguelike deckbuilder about hosting a sheep show, where everything goes wrong! Arrange sheep on stage to score colorful combos and earn star points. Equip magical ribbons to influence the audience and change your fate. Will you try to keep everything under control? Or embrace the chaos?

details.title: Prototech
details.short_description: Be careful, in the darkness there are surveillance robots ready to kill you at any time. Will you discover the strangeness and secrets behind Prototech's presence at the school.

details.title: Cognomancy
details.short_description: A turn-based tactical strategy game where your real knowledge is your power. No spell lists. No skill trees. Every glyph you cast, you must truly understand. Your mind is your mana. INT is IRL.

details.title: Pawn Within: Two Fates
details.short_description: A tabletop SRPG blending match-3, Skill Construction & tactics. Collect parts to craft skill discs, spin for random abilities, then merge or keep them. Equip gear, maneuver on grids, cast spells, and lead unique heroes to defeat challenging bosses in this strategic adventure.

details.title: Litter Treasures
details.short_description: Adopt a bunch of cute, dorky cats, play with them to earn their trust and collect the odd little treasures they leave behind. Turn your desktop into a cozy or chaotic cat shelter that grows with every new discovery!

details.title: Stellar Breach
details.short_description: Blast through massive waves and tough bosses in this chaotic sci-fi roguelite shooter. Guide the charming duo, Barnaby and C.A.T., through a branching narrative via multiple-choice interactions where your story decisions directly alter randomized loadouts and abilities on every run!

details.title: Force Typhoon
details.short_description: Experience the chaos and intensity of high-speed combat in this atmospheric sci-fi vertical Shoot ’Em Up, rendered in full 3D. Blast your way through relentless waves of enemies as you unleash your arsenal to defend your home against overwhelming odds!

details.title: Hex Machina
details.short_description: Assemble and control ancient machines on the island of Hexagonia. In this roguelite autobattler game, you’ll need to find the perfect synergies and tactically outsmart your enemies to ensure your survival.

details.title: KEROGEN
details.short_description: Dredge up corpses from an oil-drenched nightmare. Lost at sea, the small crew of the 𝐀𝐓𝐋𝐀𝐒 calls for aid. Elmsfire dances in the clouds above while black beasts stir in the waves beneath. Take your meds. Hold your breath. The black sea won't let go.

details.title: Lumenal: A Photo Break
details.short_description: After a stressful day, grab your camera and hit the road. In Lumenal, you photograph animals and lovely moments, from forests full of birdsong to glaciers under the northern lights. Go solo or bring three friends, and fill your board with your best shots.

details.title: A2K: Jet Strikers
details.short_description: Movement-based action-shooter, inspired by the golden era of early 2000s games. Jetpacks, Momentum, Rocket-Jumps and violent Gunfights!

details.title: Vaska
details.short_description: Meet Vaska — a cat lost in a strange and dangerous forest... Move quietly, hide, solve puzzles, and find your way home!

details.title: Escape the Umbra
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with the positional combat of a turn-based tactics game. Shape your deck with weapons, spells and relics, use the battlefield to your advantage, and carry light into an ever-changing labyrinth.

details.title: A Vending Machine's Daily Life
details.short_description: You are a Vending Machine! In this hyper-local shop simulator, dispensing drinks and snacks is just the beginning. Upgrade, customize, and pay attention to the anime-inspired world around you. Each day can bring new customers and things to explore, unlocking secrets and new products to vend.

details.title: BowlTown碗镇
details.short_description: 欢迎来到碗镇。这是一则虚构的现实故事，讲述了少数群体的困境和自救。碗镇的居民几乎都是是兽人，如果你仔细观察会发现，他们在历史和现实中都有自己的名字，他们的故事也似曾相识。你是偶然逃到碗镇的兽人厨师，在碗镇流动设宴款待居民，在食物与交谈之中，完成自我和居民的治愈。

details.title: Weave & Wander
details.short_description: Weave & Wander is a cozy, atmospheric adventure where you play as a small spider finding its way through a vast, living world. Climb across walls and ceilings, weave your own paths, and leap through the unknown as you journey from the depths of a cave into the wild beyond.

details.title: Cards & Cannons
details.short_description: Build your own realm and turn every path into a devious trap in this roguelite tower defense deckbuilder! Crush endless enemy hordes with mighty spells and crazy builds in unique runs. Defeat powerful bosses and conquer world after world in this colorful medieval madness!

details.title: Rulehouse
details.short_description: Think you know chess? Forget some of that. Rulehouse is a pawn chess adventure where every stage rewrites the game. Travel the globe and beyond, master an ever-changing board where new pieces, twisted variants, and cunning opponents keep you guessing from first move to last.

details.title: Things to Forget – Lighthouse
details.short_description: Adam Foster, a 23-year-old office worker whose life is turned upside down after a breakup with his girlfriend. In an attempt to escape from himself, he takes a job as a lighthouse keeper, hoping to clear his mind. He could never have imagined the horror he would have to endure at his new workplace.

name: The Journey of the Gnomes: The Battle of the Elder Isles

details.title: The Journey of the Gnomes: The Battle of the Elder Isles
details.short_description: One gnome wizard against an entire army of darkness. Journey of the Gnomes is a fantasy survivors-like, bullet heaven game. Cast powerful spells, mighty elemental synergies, and survive the shadow horde!

details.title: Astral Trial
details.short_description: This is a deck-building game (DBG) that emphasizes symmetrical strategy. Your enemies, like you, possess decks, energy, and relics. Optimize your strategy, build your deck, challenge powerful female bosses, and save the world from collapse.

details.title: Terra Ninfa
details.short_description: A laid-back puzzle/exploration game about reviving forgotten, dried-up landscapes and turning them into picturesque dioramas. Manipulate water, irrigate all the plants, bring a wild beauty to a neglected world while discovering the secrets of the Nymphs.

details.title: Wasteland Light
details.short_description: Light of the Wasteland is a PvE survival game. Build your base in a wasteland, scavenge for supplies, gradually arm yourself, and fend off the creatures. When faced with insurmountable monster, you can awaken a mysterious power within your body, temporarily transforming to turn the tide of battle.

details.title: IM:VVI Galaxy Runaway
details.short_description: Crash-land with Team VVI’s three mercenaries on a mysterious planet inhabited by strange birdfolk. Explore unique civilizations, face enemies in combat that blends rhythm and strategy, interact with curious locals, and uncover the conspiracy surrounding the planet’s nature spirit.

details.title: Escape the Exomoon
details.short_description: ESCAPE THE EXOMOON is a narrative driven cyberpunk survival horror game. Hack, hide, and fight your way across an abandoned space colony and learn the terrifying secrets within. Will you sacrifice your sanity for survival?

details.title: Dungeon Roller
details.short_description: Roll into action with your snowman warrior as you journey through dungeons filled with enemies, traps, and challenges. Each new chapter brings more danger—can you survive them all?

details.title: Attractor K7
details.short_description: Solo & co-op PvE extraction shooter inside a grim Megastructure. Deep within these concrete walls, a terrifying anomaly has emerged: the Refracture. You are no hero here. You are just a disposable resource, a common liquidator.

details.title: TANKLE
details.short_description: Tankle is an amazing action packed multiplayer or singleplayer top down shooter, you have to dodge bullets and defeat enemies to progress and grow stronger!

details.title: BUSINGO
details.short_description: BUSINGO is a first-person survival game for solo or co-op play in a dry, post-apocalyptic world. You travel in one bus, search for water and fuel, and customize the bus. Theft and violence affect your reputation with the factions along the road.

details.title: Word Hack
details.short_description: Word Hack is a roguelike deckbuilder where you hack your enemies by finding patterns in their names. Gain prestige, spend it, and trade programs to hack enemies and friends! All in a terminal user interface (TUI) style presentation.

details.title: Backpack Syndicate
details.short_description: Your backpack is your build. Explore first-person dungeons, take on enemies in this backpack auto-battler, and unlock new characters as your syndicate grows.

details.title: Haunted Cleaner
details.short_description: Haunted Cleaner is a relaxing, light puzzle and narrative game about tidying up and decorating the homes of the deceased. Play as a psychic cleaner, uncover the stories left behind and help lingering ghosts find peace. Remember, every place tells a story, you just need to listen.

details.title: Editor Simulator
details.short_description: Go from a broke video editor to an industry icon working with top creators and making serious money. Land clients, improve your skills and upgrade your setup as you climb your way to the top of the industry.

details.title: Bluff or Bust
details.short_description: Bluff or Bust is a multiplayer social deduction game inspired by Persian Gol ya Pooch, where players hide and track a Goal ball using observation, intelligence, and reading body language.

details.title: Scindistella
details.short_description: Scindistella is a fast-paced space arcade game about a large-scale war between two powers. Take part in fighter battles, destroy cruisers and stations, fight in planetary orbits, and invade enemy systems.

details.title: TAMBOURINE
details.short_description: A priestess is hired to exorcize an apartment building with a TAMBOURINE. Parry and torment ghosts in this first-person survival horror as you make your way up the building. Find the mementos that will allow you to complete the exorcism.

details.title: Arc of Icarus
details.short_description: Build and lead your colony on a lost ringworld, where deadly conditions await on both sides while the world keeps turning! Progress through technological evolution, survive cultural revolution, and govern with a wise and steady hand!

details.title: Code Cross
details.short_description: A game where you must solve puzzles to see the full picture.

details.title: Endless Endless Ocean
details.short_description: Suddenly appearing in existence, clinging onto your fragile life, travel an endless ocean in a goal of finding out if you can escape. Survival isn't just about food and shelter, but you're bound to finding that out.

details.title: Sang-Je
details.short_description: Will you master the movement and techniques to infiltrate a crumbling research facility in the far future. In a race against time you must uncover the harrowing secrets that lie deep beneath. Something has awakened there, something that threatens to change the world forever.

details.title: Kolchanovo: The Manor
details.short_description: A journalist arrives to investigate a children’s sanatorium in an old merchant house that was reported burned down. But the building stands completely intact. Everything feels surreal and wrong. A little girl watching him from one of the windows might be the only one who knows the truth.

details.title: Withering State
details.short_description: Act as Premier Alexander Sants in a time of stagnation, division, and the falling of walls. Will you steer the brotherly nations of the People's Republic of Sudlivia toward the liberal West, reinforce the crumbling East, or forge a new path? Or even be ousted before becoming the General Secretary?

details.title: The Lost Froglins
details.short_description: What if Vampire Survivors was a platformer? 100 lost baby froglins are trapped in a cave. Every one you save joins your swarm and fights for you. One is cute. Ten is trouble. A hundred is unstoppable. Die, upgrade, go again. A roguelite side-scroller.

details.title: My Necromancer's Library
details.short_description: Manage a medieval library: collect books, arrange shelves, assist patrons, and host community events! Hire adventurers to delve into the depths of a dead Necromancer’s lair for rare tomes. Restore and customize books while uncovering a character-driven tale in this peculiar mining town.

details.title: 囚人カウンセリング
details.short_description: An interactive prison adventure. You play as a psychiatrist, working one-on-one with inmates who have committed crimes. Use case files to choose appropriate responses and hand out items from the drawer to maintain their trust. Your choices can either open up or close the inmates.

details.title: Battle of the Kyoshin
details.short_description: A miko gal and a Kyoshin go head-to-head with an enemy Kyoshin! Power up your Kyoshin as you fight, and take them down! Finish them with a trump-card Kamiwaza!

details.title: Legacy of Epstein: Noncompliance
details.short_description: Scandal strikes the nation and J. Epstein is in the thick of it. What follows is a web of mystery that exposes the institutions that are rotten to the core. Who's compromised?

details.title: This Flash Contains Horrors
details.short_description: Psychological horror collection, which includes 5 games: GambleHeart, ROMASHKA, You Are Doxxed, B*tch!, LOOP and COLORFOOD Inc. These are stories about anxiety, pressure, and internal tension linked by a shared atmosphere.

details.title: TETE
details.short_description: TETE: A wobbly climbing adventure featuring a clumsy little golem. Can you conquer the hardcore controls and jiggling physics?

details.title: The Tape: Origins
details.short_description: The clock is ticking. Investigate real found footage, uncover the cult's secrets, and solve escape-room puzzles to escape the hotel before they return to sacrifice you.

details.title: ToMyX
details.short_description: Inspired by its creator's love life, face his ex-girlfriends in a blend of arcade action, puzzles and Visual Novel. Survive a surreal TV show where memories become battles and feelings become gameplay. It all really happened... more or less.

details.title: Celestial Crusader
details.short_description: Strategic isometric roguelike in waves. Position mobile defense units, combine elemental powers, and use cards to protect the portal. Fight, die, and evolve!

details.title: William 2
details.short_description: Explore a connected world of villages, snowy mountains and underwater passages in William 2, a 2D action-platformer. Complete quests, battle enemies, collect treasures and unlock new paths as you face bosses inspired by the Seven Deadly Sins.

details.title: ProtoPunk
details.short_description: ProtoPunk is a fast-paced, steampunk movement FPS. Gun down clunkers with your revolver to gain speed. Slow the gears of time to sharpen your aim. Slide and boost through the city to uncover your past and stop the corruption choking it.

details.title: Rimefall
details.short_description: Your colony ship has landed on an alien planet — but the environment kills electronics. Salvage the ark, survive the early years, and build a nation as your society regresses to medieval with remnants of modern knowledge. Grand strategy with simulated population and turn-based combat.

details.title: Spirits: Unbound
details.short_description: Build your own deck of Spirits to battle in Spirits: Unbound. Play against opponents, then alter your cards with stickers, to make them incredibly powerful.

details.title: Rovi's Diary
details.short_description: Rovi's Diary – A 2D pixel-art adventure with anime storytelling. On planet Lumira, an ordinary girl Rovi is chosen by "Starlight." She grows from a passive observer into a protector, teaming up with Faye and Alice to uncover the mystery behind cosmic invaders.

details.title: Tactics of Scarlet
details.short_description: Tactics of Scarlet is a Japanese-Style Tactical RPG inspired by the classics from the GBA era. Cross swords through 3 campaigns with radically different gameplay as you discover multiple sides of the story.

details.title: Dream Disc Delivery
details.short_description: The world is ending, but everything will be alright. Bike around the seaside town of Lighthouse City as you enjoy your last days on your home planet. If you ever get lost, you can use collectibles to improve your map. Just be sure not to crash!

details.title: Altalis
details.short_description: A puzzle Metroidvania game!

details.title: WESTLINE
details.short_description: You are the lone conductor of an aging freight train, hauling precious cargo across a dying desert. The world wants what you're carrying, and it will stop at nothing to take it. Keep your train running, fight off the nomads hunting you down, and push forward to the next station.

details.title: Hawkins & Sons Detective Agency
details.short_description: A detective visual novel set in Victorian London. Play as a veteran detective and his young daughter, investigate scenes through point-and-click gameplay, question suspects, and make tough choices that shape the story.

details.title: Fun World
details.short_description: Explore the Nightmares of Fun World — a once-cheerful children’s park that has fallen into ruin, now twisted and corrupted by dark forces beyond understanding. What was once filled with laughter and bright colors is now drenched in shadows, echoing with distant sounds you can’t quite explain.

details.title: Key Krusher
details.short_description: Krush the keys coming at you in this arcade-style typing game.

details.title: Failover
details.short_description: Take command of civil air defense under constant threat. Build radar networks, manage power and resources, and decide when to sound the sirens. Every choice has consequences. Hold your cities together as escalation turns survival into strategy.

details.title: Streamer vs. Chat
details.short_description: An interactive game with Twitch and Kick integration where every message matters. You vs. your Chat. Are you ready to fight against your viewers?

details.title: Burn-9
details.short_description: A spy thriller where you’re not the spy. Safe behind your screen, guide the last survivor of an elite black-ops team in a desperate attempt to salvage a mission gone horribly wrong. Caught between military command and your agent, information is your greatest weapon.

details.title: Minesleeper
details.short_description: You wake up in a distant part of the universe 27.000 years after being deployed on an urgent mission to save humanity from extinction. A minesweeper gets a dangerous makeover in this hexagonal roguelite. Outsmart devious puzzles, bend the odds, and turn failures into triumph.

details.title: FEMBOY SLEEPOVER - Episode 1
details.short_description: You're invited to the Femboy Sleepover! In Episode 1 get to know your new femboy roommates, but watch out— your succubus might have other ideas...

details.title: When I'm Not Drawing
details.short_description: In this cozy life-simulation RPG, you play as a young artist who moves to a new city to pursue your dreams. Plan your schedule, balance life and career, explore the city, and meet new friends! Live a fulfilling year on your own, at your own pace.

details.title: Adaptive Wilds
details.short_description: Learn the land. Make a life in it. Adaptive Wilds is a hardcore survival RPG with deep character progression, interacting physical and psychological states, and a wilderness you can reshape. Develop your skills, work with NPCs, experiment with nature, and explore dream realms.

details.title: Sky Pirates
details.short_description: Set sail with your friends aboard a flying pirate ship! Explore mysterious islands, plunder ships and treasures, and amass a fortune… But beware: the richer you get, the more you attract unwanted attention!

details.title: 2080 - Operation Sunshield
details.short_description: Can a giant umbrella save Earth? Be part of the most important mission in human history and join the crew onto a daring trip into space! Will you save mankind from global warming? Be the engineer of our future in this humorous hand-drawn point-and-click-adventure (alpaca inside).

details.title: Trip to the Core
details.short_description: Build three decks at once in a roguelike deckbuilder where 15 rebels fuse modular gear into broken combos across five shifting acts.

details.title: PowerCorp
details.short_description: A space sim survival where each decision costs power. Every system drains your dying reactor. Pilot a crippled spacecraft across a real-scale solar system using true orbital mechanics, manage critical systems, scavenge for resources, while you try to uncover why humanity seems to have disappeared.

details.title: Arcane Spellforge: Core Defense
details.short_description: Forge spells with your hands, build tactical defenses, and unleash devastating power in VR. Upgrade modular weapons and towers, adapt your strategy, and survive relentless waves of robotic enemies attacking your core from every direction.

details.title: HANAE // PRIMARY
details.short_description: A first-person psychological story game: You are Hanae, trapped in a distorted game world. Evilnae wants to take your place and rebuilds everything after every escape attempt. Find the cracks, write everything down and escape... before it's too late.

details.title: Death Denied
details.short_description: Death Denied is a brutal, fast-paced top-down action game focusing on skull-crushing close combat in medieval England. Every encounter is an unforgiving deadly dance. Break walls, bones and necks. Strike with precision. Embrace divine blessings that modify the way you fight.

details.title: Victorian Pier Tycoon
details.short_description: Build and manage your own Victorian seaside pier in this nostalgic pixel-art tycoon game. Construct steam-powered rides, balance the delicate needs of the Aristocracy against the Working Class, and maintain structural integrity. Will your resort become a world wonder, or crumble into the sea?

details.title: Watchtowers & Weaponry
details.short_description: Command your forces to victory in this intense tower defense experience! Strategically deploy your defenses to fortify your position and funnel the enemies through intricate mazes. Carefully allocate your resources and adapt your tactics to counter waves of relentless enemy drones!

details.title: Auris
details.short_description: Auris is a 2D Puzzle platformer where you play as a blind kid. Use echolocation to see objects, solve puzzles, fight enemies, and uncover hidden paths. Find your mother and help other trapped kids along your way out of the evil lab facility.

details.title: Lovers Die
details.short_description: Juliet dies, but death is not the end. Armed with only dice, she fights through the underworld to rescue her lost love in this cozy-creepy, Yahtzee-inspired roguelite dice builder. Master the dice, beat the Devil & give ‘em Hell.

details.title: The Nexus Hotel
details.short_description: Become the caretaker of a mysterious hotel between worlds, where guests pay in stories. Explore their worlds, earn their trust, and help them face the past that keeps them from moving forward—all while uncovering why the hotel chose you.

details.title: The Undating Game
details.short_description: The first ever Undating Sim! A Visual Novel/Puzzle game where your main objective is to avoid the women throwing themselves at You. Navigate the halls of Valentine's Academy and the tangled hearts of your peers as you prepare for the final exams. And remember: Don't. Get. Distracted.

details.title: CitySpotter
details.short_description: Spot unique buildings hidden across large procedurally generated cities. Every map is different, with dynamic weather, animated streets, and relaxing sounds. Play at your own pace or challenge yourself to find every target faster each time.

details.title: Kankao in Action
details.short_description: Kankao in Action is a 2-player co-op adventure with local and online co-op, where teamwork, coordination, and chaotic fun are the only way forward.

name: ひとりだるま | HITORI DARUMA Alone Rite

details.title: ひとりだるま | HITORI DARUMA Alone Rite
details.short_description: A protagonist attempts to play "Daruma-san ga Koronda" (Red Light, Green Light) entirely alone. Driven by a ritual found online, they gather the necessary items and begin the ceremony. However, eerie phenomena begin to occur one after another.

details.title: Data Trader
details.short_description: Data Trader is a cyberpunk strategy game where information has become the world's most valuable resource. Buy archives, trade classified data, command agents, and uncover the truth about who you really were.

details.title: Idle Chibi Knight
details.short_description: Chibi Knight returns in an idle dungeon crawler! Fighting and exploration happen automatically while you cast spells, acquire loot, unlock new skills, level up your attributes, and push deeper. Replay as multiple classes in this casual, incremental RPG.

details.title: Endfaryth
details.short_description: In 5135, a substance called Ash poisoned the sky, and an endless snowstorm consumed the world. You awaken from darkness with no memory of your past. Faced with fragile warmth, will you forget what was and cling to the present, or venture into the frozen wilds to uncover the truth of who you were?

details.title: Dream Village
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in the cozy world of village life! Set up your home, buy groceries or order home delivery, cook delicious soups, manage your farm and earn real estate. Dream Village - dreams become reality!

details.title: Frutiger Aqua Rings
details.short_description: A nostalgic water ring-toss roguelite set in a dreamy Frutiger world. Use oxygen to push rings into spires, turn them into bubbles, and build unexpected combinations that change the way you play. But beware—run out of oxygen, and you'll wake up in a simple, boring monochrome reality.

details.title: Tiny Lands VR
