details.short_description: Discover a collection of beautifully crafted miniature worlds in this relaxing VR spot-the-difference experience.

details.title: Bird Poo Game
details.short_description: Cause chaos from the sky and profit underground. Drop poop on pedestrians to send them rushing to Bob's laundromat. Collect coins, upgrade machines, unlock explosive abilities, and build a bizarre laundry empire one splat at a time.

details.title: Lone Warrior
details.short_description: Lone Warrior is a fast-paced incremental action game built around reaction-based 1-on-1 battles. Dodge enemy attacks, punish brief openings and keep the gold you earn after death to unlock new spells, stats and permanent upgrades.

details.title: Grimwar
details.short_description: Grimwar is a CLASS-BASED MULTIPLAYER FPS where six classes fight for two rival superpowers using WWII-era weapons and magic. Set in the 3040s, it brings back the chaotic, casual feel of classic online shooters, with multiple game modes, ranked matchmaking, community servers, custom maps, and mods.

details.title: Chrono Wing: Cats in Space!
details.short_description: Chrono Wing: Cats in Space!" is a 90s-inspired SHMUP. Master five action-packed stages and use your time-rewinding abilities to dodge the game-over screen and build huge combos.

details.title: Mummy's Escape
details.short_description: After centuries of slumber, Rek awakens to find his beloved Nilo missing. Travel through ancient pyramids, oasis paths, and forgotten ruins, mastering three unique forms to overcome challenges and defeat the guardians standing in your way.

details.title: Whiskers In The Sand
details.short_description: Whiskers In The Sand is a fast-paced survivors-like arena roguelite where battle-ready cats shred through hordes of undead desert monsters. Unlock new cats, collect relics, stack upgrades, and forge ridiculous builds to survive the pharaoh's second reign.

details.title: FUTURE:ONE
details.short_description: FUTURE:ONE is a living desktop companion designed to feel expressive, reactive, and alive — sharing your screen with dynamic animations, playful reactions, customization, and subtle presence while you work, game, browse, or relax.

details.title: Coin Mechanica
details.short_description: 『Coin Mechanica』 is a VR-compatible roguelike boomer shooter. Crush demonic invaders with a storm of coins and explosive blasts! Rip out the cores of vicious demons possessing treasure, then reduce their bodies to even more coins!

details.title: Hordestomp
details.short_description: Embrace the chaos of thousands of enemies rampaging into your weapons! Kill, loot and skill-upgrade your way to God-like power levels - all in the name of brutal, goblin-slaying megadeath.

details.title: Core Of Havoc
details.short_description: Core of Havoc is a top-down 2D action RPG in space. Take control of the ship, fight enemies in missions, collect the loot, craft ship components and evolve the build over time.

details.title: SKROLL
details.short_description: Wake up, junkie. Your brain is hungry and only infinite scrolling can satisfy it. Manage dopamine, battery, and sanity in this survival roguelite about digital slavery.
developers: Emilio Rivas, Luis Suárez, Rubén García

details.title: Gardenhood
details.short_description: A cozy multiplayer gardening game where up to 8 players share one island. Grow rare mutated crops, fish the pond, build and decorate your home, and hang out with neighbors in drop-in public lobbies — or tend your garden solo. Plant something weird. Show it off.

details.title: Wash It
details.short_description: Wash It is a relaxing and satisfying cleaning game where you blast away dirt, grime, and chaos. Watch the world shine again as you unwind and get lost in pure cleaning zen.

details.title: Engagement Protocol
details.short_description: Free game for game developers that that showcases various game development tools that support player engagement.

details.title: Creepy Cases Teen Detective Club
details.short_description: The mysterious death of a girl on the municipal school sports field shook the small town of Sky Cliffs. Haunting days pass, and amid disappearances, paranormal activity, and ghosts, the Teen Detective Club takes on the investigation of these frightening cases.

details.title: VoxelForge
details.short_description: Build block by block. Furnish down to the smallest detail. VoxelForge is a single-player creative building game combining a cubic world, realistic materials and built-in interactive furniture. Design your home, shape its surroundings and explore your creations in first person.

details.title: Plunderfall
details.short_description: A co-op action-adventure where you sail a flying ship through floating islands and plunder loot for gold to meet the Captain's demands.

details.title: Before the Walls Break
details.short_description: Build your village, fortify your walls, and survive relentless waves of enemies in this strategy tower defense game with resource management and active battlefield abilities.

details.title: Shadow Rush
details.short_description: Slay hordes of Shadow Demons in this Action RPG with roguelike elements. Fast-paced combat, quick runs, build experimentation, and re-rolling characters. Spells are collectable, equip-able 'Shards' that trigger when you attack. CAN YOU BEAT THE SPEED OF DARKNESS?

details.title: 黑土无归
details.short_description: As an ordinary truck driver seeking the truth behind his father's demise, you must pierce through a web of conspiracy fueled by tech-obsession and a rapidly shifting era.

name: Build It Up! - The Holy Roman Empire

details.title: Build It Up! - The Holy Roman Empire
details.short_description: Build thriving cities in the Holy Roman Empire! Manage resources, production, and trade in a complex economy. Plan defense and siege. Expand your empire through military might or diplomacy and claim the imperial crown!

details.title: DARKDRAW
details.short_description: Descend into the Abyss with a fading torch. Darkdraw is a roguelike deckbuilder where every battle is fought on a board, creature against creature, and the dying light changes the rules. Pick your clan, build your deck, keep your flame alive.

details.title: Dillaball
details.short_description: Shoot, roll, and break your way through the city in this fast-paced pinball-like arcade action game. Collect money to buy increasingly chaotic abilities to spice up your runs, call your friends and put on the headphones for some pop punk tunes and blast off!

details.title: Land of the Dead Trees
details.short_description: "Lands of the Dead Tree A Rogue-Like / Extraction RPG" Walk the thin line between life and death as you struggle to restore a shattered world. Lands of the Dead Trees draws you into a breathtaking realm beyond your wildest dreams - where danger lurks at every step, and survival demands courage.

name: The Shattered Mind of Lucas Hayes

details.title: The Shattered Mind of Lucas Hayes
details.short_description: A first-person walking simulator focused on atmosphere and introspection, where players explore surreal spaces, discover memories, and move at their own pace through a calm, dreamlike experience.

details.title: Forgotten Flower
details.short_description: A mysterious adventure focused on exploration, puzzle-solving, and choice-driven progression as two young nobles navigate a mansion that warps into a mysterious and dangerous world after a sudden disaster. Will you uncover the truth hidden within its shifting halls before the darkness consumes you?

details.title: Corridors
details.short_description: Explore an abandoned hospital, solve puzzles, and uncover a nonlinear story where your choices have consequences. A hardcore psychological horror game in pixel art.

details.title: DEATH A LIVE
details.short_description: Your rock band needs a crowd. Neon wants you all to herself. You've got 30 days to fill the venue in a cyberpunk rhythm-action adventure of love, madness and yandere psychological horror. Explore the city, take the stage, and watch what you say. One wrong answer could be your last.

details.title: Dead Wave
details.short_description: Dead Wave is a first-person zombie survival horror game where a mysterious radio signal is the only thing standing between you and the end of the world — or the thing that caused it.

details.title: Boing Boing Bros
details.short_description: Boing Boing Bros is a chaotic pinball-like action roguelike where you blast and boing your way through increasingly larger amounts of enemies. Use powerups, stat upgrades, and your boing skills to fight bosses, clear waves of enemies, and boing with your friends.

details.title: WitchOver
details.short_description: Watch the witches.Don't miss the anomalies.Despairing witches slowly lose themselves and become monsters. 12:00 AM – 6:00 AM.Your job is to manage the “witches.” As the caretaker of a facility, monitor the witches who possess dangerous powers and resolve any anomalies that occur within the facility.

details.title: Dungeon Chess
details.short_description: Dungeon Chess is a turn-based strategy game with roguelike elements where the setting simulates a chessboard.

details.title: TileShire
details.short_description: TileShire is a low-stakes, high-depth strategy game. Combine tiles on a living landscape to grow a home rich with life.

details.title: Wildlife Ballistics
details.short_description: Wildlife Ballistics is a fast-paced, tactical top-down shooter where you manage your team of 5 to kick down doors, clear rooms and neutralize threats. Fight tooth and claw to maintain order in the ever-decaying civilization of the forest.

details.title: Devilbreath: The First Seal
details.short_description: Devilbreath: The First Seal is a dark fantasy tactical RPG set in a medieval frontier, where an ordinary village boy follows a hell-born mist into a dying forest to find its source—and stop it before his village is lost.

details.title: Fables of the Kingdom 3
details.short_description: Fables of the Kingdom 3 is a new chapter in the fairy-tale time-management strategy series. Manage resources, construct buildings, and wield powerful spells to protect the Great Tree of Life and stop the mad sorcerer Balen.

details.title: Magic Tower: Legion
details.short_description: "Magic Tower: Legion" is a roguelike Magic Tower-like game. You will play as a legion commander and lead your team into the magic tower. Use each character's strengths to defeat powerful enemies. Remember to plan every step carefully, for all resources in the magic tower are non-renewable.

details.title: Some Puzzles
details.short_description: A surreal, FMV puzzle adventure. "It's got some puzzles."

details.title: Lock In
details.short_description: An escape-the-room puzzle game. Solve locks to unlock locks. Unlock locks to unlock more locks. Lock in.

details.title: 魂途 Xoul
details.short_description: Xoul is a uniquely styled 2D ARPG. You can use the game's distinctive "Custom Combo" feature to create your own chain attacks, defeat various enemies, experience diverse stories, unravel the mysteries of this world—and then make your choice.

details.title: VASED
details.short_description: VASED is a simple, yet challenging fast-paced arcade against-the-clock puzzle game about vases.

details.title: Gumblaster Mayhem
details.short_description: Gumblaster Mayhem is a 3D retro-style first-person shooter game where you, as a player, shoot out some gumballs using the three weapons that you must use to take down the sour mutants to survive.

details.title: Seed & Deed
details.short_description: You rented a farm without reading the contract. Cut the weeds, plant, sell, automate and survive a landlord who keeps adding clauses. A cozy pixel-art incremental with a real ending: buy the deed before the fine print buys you.

details.title: Steel Tide
details.short_description: Tanks, warships, jets and a nuclear silo. Rain blinds your scouts, night hides the enemy's assault, and one warhead can end it all. Fight through the Gulf War of 1990–91 under other flags, outwit four levels of AI, or face friends on PC, phone and browser in the same match.

details.title: Mad Rat Cafe
details.short_description: Top-down roguelite about a post-apocalyptic cafe where you cook orders and shoot your way through mutant waves. Fix broken kitchen machines and stack wild upgrades to survive every shift.

name: 迷宫：秘能探险 Maze: Arcane Adventure

details.title: 迷宫：秘能探险 Maze: Arcane Adventure
details.short_description: A top-down single-player game blending maze exploration and mechanism-based puzzles. Seek treasure chests with limited sight and fading memories of explored paths. Mix and match arcane items, solve puzzles along the way, and find a way to survive monsters and disasters.

details.title: Big Cock Inc.
details.short_description: A cozy farm sim where you arm your cocks with AK-47s and bet the rent on them in club fights. Breed the best chickens, steal and sell their eggs, send the rest down the conveyor to the fryer, and serve them through your own fried chicken drive-thru.

details.title: Yemen: The Lover
details.short_description: You travel to a remote village in Yemen to meet the woman you fell in love with online. But the locals warn you that nobody lives there anymore. So who has been waiting for you?

details.title: Cry Of Monster CH2
details.short_description: After escaping the first creature, the flesh fungus infection has torn through the neighboring city. You wake up at its gates to find your best friend safe. However, bound by morality, you must witness and endure the grotesque transformation of a sovereign people. Survive the horrors to come.

details.title: Last Pasture
details.short_description: Enemies swarm every night. Gather resources, upgrade your weapons, and protect your livestock alongside your companions.

details.title: Debt & Daylight
details.short_description: Aim every coin drop in a tactile 3D coin-pusher roguelike. Upgrade the machine, chase special coins, and beat six midnight bills before debt takes it all.

details.title: Froggy's Delivery
details.short_description: A chaotic co-op cooking and delivery game. Team up with your friends, cook food on the go, keep the orders coming, and somehow make it to the customer intact!

details.title: Increlight
details.short_description: Paint light into the dark in a short incremental adventure. Shape the frontier as up to 100,000 autonomous workers hold its edge, gather resources, and fuel your growth. Explore worlds that change the rules, awaken ancient Sources, and grow stronger with every dawn.

details.title: Realistic Battle Simulator
details.short_description: Two knights or twenty thousand a side: pick who fights and watch it play out. Every soldier fights by his own armour, reach, speed and nerve, and an army breaks when its courage does. March the Warpath, paint battles in the sandbox, and forge your own units and fields.

details.title: Sunflower Dance
details.short_description: Atlatonan is a 19 year old who starts her journey to Granda Oaso, the biggest commune in Gardesta, as part of the Cultural Exchange Program. Learn new things, make new friends, and find love~ This is a Solarpunk slice of life about learning stuff and enjoying whatever that makes you happy.

details.title: Pay to Think
details.short_description: An incremental game centered on intelligence as its core asset. Once, humanity became the master of the Earth by virtue of its intelligence; now, intelligence has found a new master. Intelligence no longer belongs to the smartest humans—it belongs to whoever possesses it.

details.title: Shameless Supreme
details.short_description: Shameless Supreme is a story-rich pixel RPG with turn-based combat and dark humor. Explore crumbling worlds, build your party, and combine status effects for deadly reactions. Use optional mic-powered trash talk to weaken enemies and break their defenses. Survive, and find your way home.

details.title: The Last Dry House
details.short_description: October 1999. The dam has failed, and yours is the last dry house on the hill. Each night strangers climb out of the floodwater and knock. Type any question you like through the door. Some are survivors. Some drowned days ago, and they don't know it yet.

details.title: KINETIC SINGULARITY
details.short_description: Harness the raw power of a collapsing reactor core in this minimalist physics rogue-lite. Launch kinetic sondes into a dynamic matrix, trigger high-energy chain reactions, and balance the fatal risk of the Overcharge mode. Every shot counts. Can you survive the singularity?

details.title: The Dig Show
details.short_description: The Dig Show is a cozy digging game about finding treasures on a fake TV stage. Use a metal detector, wash the dirt off your finds and show them on air. Viewers pay to watch. Upgrade your gear and dig a little deeper every day.

details.title: DWARKA
details.short_description: Dive beneath the waves in DWARKA, a first-person underwater exploration adventure in development. Prepare your gear, sail aboard SAMUDRA, manage oxygen, and investigate ocean mysteries. The full game is planned for solo play and online co-op for up to four players.

details.title: Carrot Kingdom!
details.short_description: A rabbit and carrot puzzle-platformer! Stretch your ears to grab the carrots!

details.title: Burnline Madness
details.short_description: Race, brawl and boost through traffic in Burnline Madness, a single-player motorcycle combat racer. Punch and kick rival riders, switch between unlockable weapons, chain takedowns and spend your earnings on bike upgrades across five distinct routes.

details.title: Rúnafall
details.short_description: A retro-styled co-op action roguelike in Viking-age Norway. Raid as one of five black-metal Vikings, carve through draugr, trolls and corpse-ravens, and topple the monsters who rule three cursed regions, to an original industrial metal score by Norway's Melt Motif. Solo or with up to three friends.

details.title: Behind Her Door
details.short_description: After work, you visit your older sister’s house. The rooms feel wrong, familiar sounds carry through empty halls, and something may be watching from beyond the windows. Explore, uncover the truth, and survive the night.

details.title: EVERYONE SAYS B
details.short_description: A phone, conflicting memories, and secrets hidden by a university. Search rooms, compare evidence, and choose whom to trust in this psychological thriller. Play solo or gather friends and vote using your phones to shape the story together.

details.title: GIG: Specimen Quota
details.short_description: Explore abandoned facilities and meet the rescue quota. Form a squad of up to 4 players and save adorable specimens, each with a personality of its own. Careful! Not everything in there is adorable.

details.title: petrichor
details.short_description: 'petrichor' is a single-player FPS set in a post apocalyptic Ireland. Journey across a flooded landscape and venture into hostile bunkers to save a cursed land.

details.title: Walled Project: K
details.short_description: This is a nostalgic survival role-playing game where players need to make good use of the various resources in the walled city, and build connections with people in order to complete undercover missions or uncover deeper secrets.

details.title: Hollowfall
details.short_description: Hollowfall is a fast first-person dark fantasy roguelite. Cut through rising hordes of Hollows with sword, bow and Shockwave. Between Nights, forge your weapons and change what they can do, then climb to the Hollow King. Fall, and the cycle begins again, but you return stronger.

details.title: Test Your Luck: Gacha Simulator
details.short_description: Welcome to GachaOS, the premier gacha gaming platform for whales! Play a gauntlet of incremental gacha games with Moby, our helpful Gacha Assistant. Build your fortune, then burn it all pulling characters, ripping packs, or opening crates. Unlucky? With GachaOS, turn your misfortune into fortune!

details.title: SLICE SURPRISE
details.short_description: Throw a blade. Cut stuff in half. Like, exactly in half. Pumpkins, piggy banks, one very nervous dragon. Climb a tower where every floor has one little rule, keep every weapon you buy, and take down bosses who hit back. One more floor? Sure. Just one.

details.title: Trapout: Dungeon Run
details.short_description: A fast-paced first-person precision platformer where every millisecond counts. Run through deadly obstacle courses, race against player ghosts instantly, and create ANYTHING with the built-in level editor

details.title: With flowers, fringe of fondness
details.short_description: Life is suffocating. Almost crushed by the authority known as "normal." Tuyu, who spends their days asking themself, "Do I have a place in this society?", meets a certain friend at university. Those living on the margins find joy, suffer in their insignificant days—and attempt to resist the world.

details.title: Purpose of Visit
details.short_description: Their papers say one thing. Their answers say another. Staff a booth on a tense border, question every traveller, and drag the lie they just told onto the document it contradicts. One of them is a spy. Approve the wrong face and it makes the evening news.

details.title: Feudal Factory
details.short_description: Build your kingdom, automate your production chains, and defend your lands against relentless hordes! In Feudal Factory, combine rail and cart automation with strategic medieval-fantasy fortress management. Extract ores, forge your equipment, train your army, and hold off incoming enemy waves!

details.title: SLAPPED SILLY
details.short_description: A game of tag with terrible manners. Chase, dodge, and slap your friends through a living 3D newspaper in this party game for up to 12 players. Get slapped and join the chase, dress to impress, and turn your finest moments—and worst falls—into front-page news.

details.title: Homeland Reclaim
details.short_description: A roguelike RTS where any warrior can wield any weapon! Build a deck of fantasy fighters, arm them with swords, spears and hammers, unleash mighty spells and win fast-paced battles where the whole battlefield fits on one screen.

details.title: 通魂纸 Tonghun Paper
details.short_description: Tonghun Paper is a first-person horror exploration game. Search for clues, read old letters, and piece together a hidden past while evading danger.

details.title: Terramiasma
details.short_description: Terramiasma is an extraction adventure game where you play as a Prospector exploring the dangerous regions of Terra, a planet covered in a toxic gas known as the Miasma. Gather resources, fight off numerous creatures, and above all... survive!

details.title: INFRAMON
details.short_description: INFRAMON® is a first-person Lovecraftian horror game that combines adventure, exploration, combat and puzzles to tell a psychological horror story for adults set in the Cthulhu Mythos in the 1920s, near Barcelona.

details.title: Unstitched
details.short_description: A social deduction party game for 4–15 players set in a creepy dollhouse. Run minigame errands by night, accuse by day and unmask the Rag Doll. Play online, against bots or Face to Face: one copy on the PC, everyone else plays from their own phone.

details.title: Hello, Dr. Chamberlain
details.short_description: Hello, Dr. Chamberlain. You know BranchCorps’ computer systems better than anyone. Now the AI it once used for medical research is trying to break out. Scour company documents, dig into personnel files, and solve expert-level puzzles to shut down the AI. And to uncover who is trying to stop you.

details.title: LittleHeartRiddle
details.short_description: A transformational magical girl RPG where you command beasts to clear dungeons."Kohaku," a girl who gave up on being "cute," awakens in a sweet yet eerie World of Sweets. Accepted by the mysterious Lucia, she transforms into a magical girl to conquer perilous dungeons and retrieve her lost memories.

details.title: Palimpsest: Where Magic Remembers
details.short_description: A hand-painted magical sky-world full of fantasy and adventure. Relive the memories in its ruins, befriend the fantastic beasts you are forced to fight, and decide the future of magic.

details.title: Tactics to the devil dungeon
details.short_description: Build a party of companions who each carry a signature, shape their classes and skills, then choose every move and attack in a dark fantasy turn-based tactical RPG where range, elevation and terrain decide the fight.

details.title: NO EXIT
details.short_description: A survival horror FPS where you face hordes of zombies, explore abandoned environments, gather resources, and fight to survive.

details.title: Arctic Research: Dig Them Out!
details.short_description: Dig through snow and ice to uncover prehistoric fossils in an Arctic research simulator! Extract and clean bones, analyze DNA, reconstruct ancient skeletons, and customize dioramas. Explore the frozen wilderness, upgrade your research station, and uncover secrets buried since the Cold War.

details.title: GORAL: Highlander Simulator
details.short_description: Become a young shepherd in the 1930s Tatra Mountains. Herd sheep, make traditional cheese, and face wolves and unpredictable mountain weather. Start with no sheep of your own, earn your keep, survive each season, and build a flock of your own.

details.title: Starcore: Through the Void
details.short_description: Pilot a lone gunship on a desperate mission to save the rebellion in this fast-paced 2D space shooter. Dodge deadly bullet patterns, master multi-phase boss encounters, and fight across nearly 20 bite-sized stages. Do you have what it takes to survive the void, Commander?

details.title: Shadow Princess: Crystalbound
details.short_description: A 2D platformer focused on midair movement where you can place crystals anywhere in any level to help you reach the end of the stage.

details.title: Realpolitiks 4: Back to the Roots
details.short_description: Realpolitiks 4 returns to its roots. Lead your chosen nation in an accessible real-time strategy game. Develop your economy, shape politics, forge alliances and plan military operations. Face the crises of the 21st century and chart your own path to power!

details.title: Keepguard
details.short_description: Keepguard is a medieval tower-defense roguelite where the map is your build. Expand and defend your kingdom: bind towers to powerful rites, uncover unusual relics and create game-breaking synergies to keep back the endless hordes.

details.title: Recursive Nightmare
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where you can't fight back. Hide, run and listen as creatures hunt you through flooded, dreamlike nightmares that never let you catch your breath. Someone is turning your fear into power.

details.title: My Hardware Store
details.short_description: Build your own hardware store – solo or in multiplayer with up to 8 players! Order over 50 products, set prices, hire employees and expand your shop in a huge open world. Over 100 hours of content – from a small shop to a tech empire!

details.title: Hive and Harvest
details.short_description: Death is dying, and five hives are fighting over the rot that's left. A trading card game about insects you grow from parts, a card at a time. Plant a parasite in an enemy creature, seed it with spores until it changes sides, or just break it and race your opponent to the pieces.

details.title: Doughn't Panic!
details.short_description: A co-op adventure where 2 players share the controls of a single pizza, bound by a spell neither asked for. Explore a world never built for your size.

details.title: Evac
details.short_description: Co-op marines vs. the alien hive. Fight through infested outposts where the layout shifts every round, call the dropship and get out. Every marine who dies rises as one of them. 1–16 players, with AI filling any empty slot.

details.title: Video Gamer Legacy
details.short_description: Run a shop that buys, restores, and sells old games. Money isn't the score. Influence is, and you only earn it two ways: preserving games, and treating people well. Spend it to save the companies that really went under, and put the consoles they never got to make on your shelves.

details.title: Dustlings: The Hidden Wilds
details.short_description: You stumble into a mysterious, uninhabited wilderness—but you're not alone. The little beings that glow at night will be your closest companions. Bond with extraordinary plants and animals, build a home together, explore the wilds, and follow scattered diary pages to uncover the truth.

details.title: R.override
details.short_description: Explore an alien planet as a fierce little rover on a mission to rescue a lost crew and uncover their secrets.

details.title: Order 13 VR
details.short_description: A psychological horror VR experience where you work the night shift inside a mysterious warehouse while taking care of your cat. Fulfill orders, survive the darkness, and uncover what hides between the shelves.

details.title: World on a Plate
details.short_description: Cook your way around Europe in this cozy co-op kitchen adventure for one to two players. Prepare authentic regional dishes, keep your kitchen running smoothly, and manage busy restaurants across diverse European cultures and cuisines, while uncovering Grandma’s story behind her legendary restaurant.

details.title: Exodrift
details.short_description: Exodrift is a rhythm action roguelite where you are a space delivery driver on the run. Deliver packages, destroy enemies on the beat, and escape hazardous procedurally generated planets.

details.title: Liquid Swarm
details.short_description: Swallow swarms of monsters, earn XP, improve your stats, repeat. Minimalist active incremental roguelite with rewarding and satisfying gameplay. Reincarnate to get permanent XP bonuses and to unlock perks and Epic Bosses. Play alone or with friends.

details.title: MushHero
details.short_description: MushHero is a cooperative roguelite defense game where players fight together against waves of monsters and powerful bosses. Build unique strategies through randomized weapons, evolving skills, and a node-based progression system that creates a different combat experience every run.

details.title: Seaforge: Shores of Atlantis
details.short_description: Beneath the waves, the world of Atlantis awaits. Build your home base on sunlit Mediterranean shores, then dive into sunken ruins to uncover secrets of the deep. Get stronger, dive deeper, and battle dark forces with up to 3 friends in this underwater survival crafting odyssey!

details.title: Netherspire
details.short_description: Explore the ruins of a colossal tower and fight those who threaten its ancient vault in this short 3D Metroidvania.

name: Sacred Stakes: Starring VEINIEST DUKEM and his ludicrous blackjack skills on a holy crusade into the depths of THE gambling hell itself

details.title: Sacred Stakes: Starring VEINIEST DUKEM and his ludicrous blackjack skills on a holy crusade into the depths of THE gambling hell itself
details.short_description: Outplay cheating ghosts in blackjack as a musclebound exorcist. Build your deck and survive a roguelike descent where the house doesn’t just cheat: it haunts you. Bend the rules, use powerful items, uncover each spirit’s tricks, and turn their own scams against them.

details.title: Urine Nation
details.short_description: A SCORE ATTACK adventure through the UK and Ireland, where your goal is to soak everywhere in your urine! USE ALL THE URINE IN YOUR SYSTEM to drench every inch of the level while completing objectives and gaining crazy combos!!!

details.title: C01n
details.short_description: A nostalgic visual novel set on a quiet, remote island somewhere in Japan. Follow the words of the islanders and the small things that feel slightly off in everyday life, and draw closer to the truth this place has kept hidden. This is not a story about exposing the truth.

details.title: Whiterock Bay
details.short_description: Take on a big mystery in this first-person adventure inspired by old-time horrors. Explore the desolate town, face the anomalies, solve puzzles and search for traces of your missing sister in Whiterock Bay.

details.title: Echoes From Below
details.short_description: Echoes From Below is a mystery dungeon tactical RPG. Lead four hunters into the dungeons, where every fortune you bring home comes at a price. Fight side by side as bonds grow into love, rivalry or grief that changes how they fight, and the dead never return. How many will you bring home?

details.title: SkullStars: Supernova
details.short_description: SkullStars: Supernova looms over us in the funk of outer space! A 2D anime fighting game with stylish 3D models. Fight your way to become a SkullStar with an electrifying soundtrack. The five points of the universe will reconnect!

details.title: Pebbles Quest
details.short_description: The Princess has been kidnapped by evildoers! It is now Pebbles Quest to breach the Castle, face a gauntlet of traps and trials, all to rescue his one true love.

details.title: Palettopia
details.short_description: Paint beautiful island cities with a brushstroke in this cozy puzzle game. Explore endless islands and solve puzzles while balancing the serene landscapes and your growing urban districts. Discover vibrant biomes and their adorable inhabitants as you paint your own perfect utopia in Palettopia.

details.title: Love in Space
details.short_description: A Sci-Fi Karaoke-Musical where your choices shape the story and your decisions become the lyrics. Escape Earth, make questionable friends, find unexpected love, and sing your way to a better future. And don't worry about hitting the right notes, you've got bigger things to worry about.

details.title: Legend vs. Legion
details.short_description: Legend vs. Legion is a roguelite HERO defense! A twist on the traditional tower defense game, play as a legendary hero empowered by a random arsenal of powerful spells and artifacts. Defend against hordes of monsters using strategy and reflexes, and save the realm of Valia.

details.title: Sea of Brave: Beast Island
details.short_description: Prisoners on a legendary island! Rescue your crew in this turn-based roguelike deckbuilder. Think carefully about every move: your actions decrease each enemy's countdown, bringing them closer to their turn. Combine transformations, manage your energy, and escape Benryu!

details.title: Tinycraft
details.short_description: Demons from another world are coming, leading the allied forces of the Six Races to resist them. Choose your hero, build and continuously strengthen your team, and enjoy the collision of traditional RTS and Rogue mechanics in this world of sword and magic!

details.title: The Standard Model
details.short_description: The Standard Model is a narrative walking simulator/slice-of-life game set in different worlds throughout the multiverse. The player takes on the role of an undergraduate student that gets to explore and experience 5 different worlds on a quantum adventure.

details.title: SOS Cannibals
details.short_description: From 2 to 12 players. Gather food and scavenge for clothes to survive cold and hunger after your plane crashed on a remote island. But beware, some of you are secretly island cannibals trying to take everyone out before help shows up!

details.title: Fall of the Final Age
details.short_description: Take command of the last Stronghold of humanity, fighting back against the advancing monsters. Decide where to prioritize the forces of your Heroes, as the number of turns before the invasion is limited. A turn-based tactical strategy with RPG and roguelike elements.

details.title: Gorilla Attack 2: Rampage
details.short_description: Your favorite gorilla (kind of) is back! Smash a massive new city, take on unique challenges, and interact with a fully destructible world. Team up with friends or let them join your chaotic VR adventure!

details.title: Erehwon(エレフォーン)
details.short_description: The gear you acquire completely transforms your party’s roles. Erehwon is a loot-driven dungeon crawler where you progress by reshaping your builds around the gear you find.

details.title: Tutankhamun – Builders of the Eternal
details.short_description: A 3D city-builder where you farm the Nile, worship powerful gods, train armies, trade with distant regions, and construct monumental works worthy of ancient Egypt.

details.title: Starweaver
details.short_description: Deckbuilding roguelike game where you become a Priestess of Light and restore a sky consumed by darkness. Discover key cards, place stars across the sky, break curses, and complete constellations. Before it's too late, stand against the God of Night and drive back the darkness.

details.title: Stunt Paradise 2
details.short_description: Stunt Paradise 2 - more speed, more explosions, more madness! Jump over ramps, dodge lasers, buzzsaws, and rockets while performing insane stunts. With new traps, improved graphics, and pure arcade chaos - get ready for the ultimate stunt challenge!

name: 战网魔：谁把天才变了恶魔

details.title: 战网魔：谁把天才变了恶魔
details.short_description: This is a Chinese local-themed role-playing game. Plot is its core driver. It uses a male-female dual-protagonist narrative to deeply tell a story set in the new millennium, about online games and overcoming gaming addiction.

details.title: Echoes of Tomorrow
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic action RPG where you play a banished cleric, falsely accused of the divine disease. Wield a robotic relic able to restore lost ruins and technology, face challenging combat and make consequential choices to expose the theocracy's lies, seeking a truth that may cost you everything.

details.title: Midnight Gambit
details.short_description: So you're a vampire, and your new boss has a cape and a spreadsheet. Dracula wants his cut, and he wants it monthly. You control Sonny, a gambling addicted vampire with a coat-full of luck. Drink blood, gamble and create unique-builds to survive this wave based stealth-action roguelite in Sin City.

details.title: Storm The House Collection
details.short_description: Defend your base, upgrade your arsenal, and survive the siege! The iconic Storm the House trilogy of fixed-position shooters returns from the golden age of Flash, now preserved and better than ever. PLUS the debut of the long-lost Storm The House 4!!

details.title: BunnyOps
details.short_description: BunnyOps is a tactical PvP shooter where bunnies are the apex herbivore, carrots are scarce, and everything can be destroyed.

details.title: IRIS
details.short_description: Control Iris, a messenger who walks through a spiritual realm, guiding lost people who seek peace. An action-platformer focused on music, combat, and atmosphere.

details.title: Alchimist – Secret of the Worlds
details.short_description: After decades of peace, an ancient threat returns – forgotten shadows rise once more. As an alchemist you experience an immersive story in the realm of Aethendor, master the art of alchemy, and face ancient dangers in epic battles with magic, melee and ranged combat.

details.title: Bogeys, Ghosts & Gods
details.short_description: Bogeys, Ghosts & Gods is a non-linear visual novel with elements of traditional Chinese supernatural folklore.In this miserable world, a young boy must do everything he can to seize the chance to survive, face parting with his companions, and bear a mission that isn’t his own.

details.title: Ishing
details.short_description: Ishing is a rogue-lite, top-down, action adventure. You'll sail through an ever-changing archipelago, slay sea monsters, and fish fish.

details.title: SCP: Rift Moles
details.short_description: Single-player and co-op survival horror game set in the SCP Universe. You are sent on a one-way mission into unstable parallel dimensions, armed only with a strange machine. Navigate unforgiving environments, evade hostile anomalies and survive for as long as you can while gathering resources.

details.title: Squid Hunt 1923
details.short_description: Experience a unique flow that echoes the early icons of the shooter genre. Captivated by grotesque atmosphere, driven by ever-growing numbers – you plunge into portals, eliminate aliens, collect loot and gather experience. At a pace you set yourself.

details.title: Motocon
details.short_description: The premiere unmanned motorsport - MOTOCON. Take home the most cash with your robo-motorcycle by destroying the opposition with gadgets and brute force.

details.title: Fowl Legacy 2: Heavenbound
details.short_description: What the cluck?! Ricardo was sent to... Heaven? Yeah, now he's mad. Travel across the weirdest places, leap gracefully over the abyss, discover mysterious and powerful secrets, and fight to escape this "heavenly" prison!

details.title: Alterfauna: A Weirdlife Park
details.short_description: Join Neli as she takes her first steps in the Alterfauna (super)natural preserve. Attract, tame, and photograph over 40 species of hand-painted creatures, fantastic monsters and ferocious beasts. Your new friends will accompany you as you discover a world full of magic.

details.title: 13 Germinal
details.short_description: A historical and narrative RPG set in the world of Emile Zola's novel. You are a young man in 1866, forced to work deep in the mines to survive. But every day, the work gets harder and the meals get smaller. Organize a strike, reignite the smoldering revolt, and try to change this unjust world.

details.title: Frankenstein's Monster
details.short_description: Solo, or online for 2-4 players. Compete to build the best monster, by collecting a matching set of monster parts, helped by whatever weird creature assistant you can design. Take on the single player campaign or go mad scientist against friends (with prox chat).

details.title: Sin or Suffer
details.short_description: Sin or Suffer is a brutal mix of survival-horror and JRPG. Locked in a medieval prison, you awake amidst a cold silence. The guards are gone; inmates and madness own the place. Something terrible lurks underground. But the only way to the truth is down.

details.title: Pakku Pony
details.short_description: Pakku Pony is a 2D virtual pet simulator where you raise your own pony! It’s a chill point-and-click game where you take care of your little garden, cook delicious dishes and relax with fun minigames. Oh, and don’t forget to look stylish with cosmetics and customization options!

details.title: Groove Defense
details.short_description: Tower defense meets music game. Your towers build the soundtrack, enemies move to the rhythm. Defend to the groove!

details.title: Family Reunion
details.short_description: Your typical incremental family dinner table simulator where you play as a very bored child trying to speedrun the evening.

details.title: Appetite of the Abyss
details.short_description: Appetite of the Abyss is a survival cooking roguelite about hunger, discovery, and consequences. Learn what an abyssal creature craves, prepare meals to satisfy it, and protect your tribe. Will you master its appetite, or suffer its wrath?

details.title: Intersingles
details.short_description: A competitive fps for your best friend group. Up to 6 players can compete in the round-robin singles(1v1) format match. Play against your best friends or players around the globe.

details.title: Endess Elo
details.short_description: where you are transported into a mysterious fantasy realm. Encounter a vibrant cast of characters, wield divine powers, vanquish insidious monsters, and explore distorted dimensions. Embark on a grand adventure to unravel the deep, forgotten secrets of this world.

details.title: ココロノカギ Chapter1
details.short_description: An exploration-based escape game about a girl who has lost her memories and finds herself trapped in a mysterious mansion. Collect the hidden “emotions” within the mansion and combine them to solve puzzles and uncover the truth behind her lost memories.

details.title: ANIMITE -Echoes of the Chasm-
details.short_description: Dive the Chasm: think, fight, scavenge, and get back out alive. A survival tactical RPG that switches between real-time exploration and turn-based combat. Your wolf, and the elemental reactions under your feet, are what get you out of a bad spot.

details.title: Y2K
details.short_description: New Year's Eve, 1999. The Y2K bug is real, midnight fireworks turn on the crowd, chaos erupts. Erin is a hardware tech hacker, she can pick locks with bin scrap, hot-wire a dead mobile, reboot a generator and more. Get across the Harbour to Liam before the night is over.

details.title: Kat Domino: Agent of S.H.E.L.L.
details.short_description: Kat Domino is an agent of SHELL, the organization ruling the world. A routine mission will lead her where she doesn't belong, uncover things she was never meant to see, and unravel a conspiracy that could change everything she thought she knew. With a little luck, her trainee agent will survive.

details.title: SakuSaku Witch
details.short_description: A sharp-tongued, slightly clumsy little witch sets off on a big adventure to rescue her kidnapped little sister! Enjoy tight, responsive controls and plenty of nostalgic SNES-era charm in this cute, bunny-filled 2D platformer!

details.title: Ghostwriter
details.short_description: Write the songs. Hear them sung under her name. No one knows you’re behind the hits. Uncover what’s buried in the music until you're forced to choose what to sacrifice: her career or your own voice.

details.title: Cat Customs Simulator
details.short_description: Inspect adorable cats at the border! Check passports, verify luggage weight, scan suspicious suitcases, and uncover unallowed items. Spot mismatches, catch smugglers, and decide who gets through customs in this cozy cat inspection simulator.

details.title: Tribal Mischief
details.short_description: A co-op mischievous adventure in the Stone Age.

details.title: Kipopy: Photocard Collector
details.short_description: A cozy incremental game about unboxing and collecting K-pop photo cards. Open packs by hand, fill your binder, sell duplicates, listen to tracks, play mini-games, and unlock upgrades as you grow your fan collection.

details.title: Order Midnight
details.short_description: Order: Midnight is an arcade motorbike delivery game where speed is the whole job. Thread traffic at triple-digit speeds for near-miss cash, race the shift clock from restaurant to doorstep, and ride a rain-soaked neon island at night.

details.title: Plunge for Your Life
details.short_description: A retro FPS with roguelike elements. Players take an elevator deeper and deeper, fighting unidentified armed hostiles, planting explosives to destroy targets, and uncovering the secrets behind Complex 17. As depth increases, enemies grow more dangerous—can you make it out of the elevator alive?

details.title: Gniluha
details.short_description: Clear garages of anyone who doesn’t share your morals — in your trusty Gniluha.

details.title: Doodonia VS Zombies
details.short_description: A Sci-Fi Fantasy Lane Defense Game. Unlock little Doods (Doodonians) and then choose which to bring to battle. You select and place Doods on the battlefield where they are needed most. Strategy mixed with comedic physics makes for the one of the best ways to slay Zombies.

details.title: A Romance of Wind,Flowers,Snow,Moon
details.short_description: "If you could escape fate, what choice would you make?" By the shores of Cangshan and Erhai, you embark on a romance with several people of vastly different personalities. Only by finding the final truth can you restore peace to the restless Dali Kingdom.

details.title: Tread on the Dead
details.short_description: Paint the city with undead blood in a high-octane combat runner where stopping means death. Tear through low-poly hordes with guns, brute force and lethal abilities while pushing your body beyond human limits. The others died. You kept moving. Welcome to the program.

details.title: Atharia
details.short_description: A turn-based creature-collecting roguelite. Evolve real animals into fantastical Athars, each shaped by its nature and its type. Explore legendary places around the world, and defeat the mythical creature guarding each one to make it part of your team.

details.title: Trutzburg
details.short_description: Defend the Trutzburg from endless slime hordes. Build, upgrade and grow stronger with every run — solo or in 2-player online co-op.

details.title: Integration Test
details.short_description: A terminal game about surveillance, identity, and editing your own source. In development for PC/Steam Deck.

details.title: Meant to Bee
details.short_description: A goofy, fun, heartwarming dating sim - in Meant to Bee, you play as a drone bee, romancing one of eight princesses to help them become a Queen Bee by Hivecoming in 15 days.

details.title: Tiny Crimes
details.short_description: Who needs money when you can sneak your way into anywhere? Team up with your fellow rats, explore different stores, grab all the supplies, and fulfill your community’s peculiar requests… But watch out! Things can get out of paw pretty quickly.

details.title: FALLBREAKER HORIZON DEFENSE FRONT
details.short_description: Pilot your aircraft to smash falling blocks before they raise the sea! Use fuel to speed up, slow down, and turn. Land on your carrier to refuel, or keep smashing to boost LINK and your score multiplier. Game over if rising seas or a direct block hit sinks your carrier.

details.title: Barista
details.short_description: A cozy audio game. Be a barista in a wacky world and listen to your customers' funny stories. Designed to be fully playable without sight.

details.title: Arkforge-方舟锻造
details.short_description: A space sandbox game. Build your mobile factory ship to mine, smelt, produce, fight, and research in space. Design unique ships, equip them with various modules, and set up production lines to supply your fleet.

details.title: Chessboxing Arcade
details.short_description: Chess Boxing Arcade is a 2D arcade take on the real sport: alternate between timed chess rounds and fast-paced boxing rounds. Win by checkmate, knockout or the clock against adaptive AI, friends locally, or opponents online.

details.title: DoBato: Coo Coo Collector
details.short_description: Fly over real Tokyo, from old downtown streets to the city center, as the leader of a pigeon flock. Land at pigeon spots, wait, and strays join you one by one. Gather white, brown, black and pied pigeons, each with its own perk, and race home with 1,000 birds. A heartwarming pigeon-gathering game.

details.title: Old Yon. New thief
details.short_description: The abandoned port of Old Yon. Bandits at the gates. You're a thief with no memory and a 200-mark debt. Pick pockets, sell to the fence before the loot goes stale, and save up for better gloves. Greed, Empathy and Paranoia argue in your head. Whatever you do, stay calm: anxiety draws the shadows.

details.title: Prospects
details.short_description: Strip the solar system of its bountiful resources, all for the betterment of mankind - and your corporation's bottom line. Build and command your fleet of industrial vessels, establish manufacturing outposts, and seek out the richest prospects to expand your mining empire.

details.title: Stay Extinct
details.short_description: The wall was built to keep something in. On a sealed dinosaur island only the hunters are infected: raptors, a T-rex and diving pterosaurs stalk the healthy herds, and you. Build and electrify a base, explore the tunnels below, alone or in 4-player online co-op. First-person retro survival horror.

details.title: Xoul:Sync
details.short_description: Xoul:Sync combines auto-battler combat with spatial inventory management. Assemble three Xouls, arrange items in the Sync Case, and choose your route to the next boss.

details.title: Entangled
details.short_description: > A Survival Horror-Adventure RPG about coming to terms with futility. Run, hide, die, and repeat in order to keep your avatars alive. Please take care of them.

details.title: Torvane
details.short_description: Torvane is a skill-based online melee team game for PC. Take a role as tank, DPS or healer, read your opponent and win the duel with timing and spacing. Server-authoritative netcode, no pay-to-win. Your first fighter is the Khaedr, a warrior from an original sci-fi honor culture.

details.title: 忒修斯之女
details.short_description: You saved your daughter Xiaohe with an illegal operation. Now another girl's memories surface in her words and expressions. In this full-motion video adventure, trace the other side of the surgery and face a choice: bring back the girl you remember, or hold on to the one she is now?

details.title: CarCity
details.short_description: Run your own neighborhood car garage. Fix customers' cars, buy and customize your dream rides at the dealership, and race them down the drag strip. Grow from a single lift to the best shop in town, one job at a time.

details.title: 东方河城天下 ~Kawashiro Indie~
details.short_description: A chat with Hina Kagiyama gives Nitori Kawashiro an idea: turn everyday life across Gensokyo into her own Kawashiro Indie. Follow her from Youkai Mountain onward, reading prompts and tackling one fast-paced microgame after another.

details.title: BONK! The Mole Show
details.short_description: Whack-a-Mole, but one BONK can set off the whole machine. Move the hammer, pick the column and watch Tesla moles zap, bombs blast and golden chains roar. Build a wild combo engine in a pixel-art fairground roguelite.

details.title: ScrapHeads
details.short_description: Smash it all and get paid! ScrapHeads is a chaotic co-op game for up to 4 players. Scrap spaceships, mechs, and anything else that lands in your yard with ridiculous tools, explosive mayhem, and wild physics. Feed Panzarius and turn every shift into a disaster!

details.title: Barrowhold
details.short_description: A co-op roguelite for 1–4 players that blends dungeon crawling and tower defense. Descend into the dungeon, grow stronger fighting monsters and bosses, and turn your loot into a fortress that can hold back the goblin horde. Can you last 100 days, until the Archmagus comes for you?

details.title: Touhou Kourindou: Appraisal Records
details.short_description: Run Kourindou, Gensokyo's odd little curio shop. Dig up strange things from the Outside World, work out what they do, and sell them to Marisa, Reimu and the girls of Gensokyo, all while a scarlet mist creeps over the sky. A cozy Touhou Project fan game of appraisal puzzles and haggling.

details.title: Satellite Odyssey Horizons
details.short_description: Voxel survival in the Satellite Odyssey universe. Explore whole planets from 400 thousand to 40 million blocks: gather, craft and build, hunt, and beware of bandit camps and infected settlements. Free on official servers. The Full Version adds your own offline world and your own server.

details.title: Cripta
details.short_description: A co-op roguelike for up to five heroes. Descend a crypt that changes every run, pick gifts, curses and relics, level your skills at the anvil and face the Kings of six worlds, alone or with friends, all the way down to the Hollow Seraph.

details.title: Mica King
details.short_description: Mica King is an original top down action adventure game. Travel as an adventurer of variety skills to the once great and magical kingdom of Virrdale. Uncover the power of Mica and face the dark forces behind the bitter downfall of the king.

details.title: BloodBuild
details.short_description: BloodBuild is a roguelike deckbuilder built around build-crafting, where the challenge isn't collecting items - it's making them work together. You progress by fusing, enchanting and combining your loot into ever more powerful builds, against ever stronger enemies.

details.title: Rituals & War: Shan Hai
details.short_description: In the mountains and seas of pre-Qin myth, the way to Heaven is severed; the gods are silent. A turn-based tactical card game with hand-painted ink-wash art: read clues to enemy moves, sequence your actions each round, then cross swords on one shared timeline. One miscalculation can turn the tide.

details.title: Black Zero
details.short_description: Fight rebels, mercenaries and the infected all at once in this top-down co-op shooter for 1–4 players. Play on the couch or online, and stop a weapon with no cure before anyone can use it.

details.title: Angela's eye
details.short_description: Angela is a blind young girl. Her only guide is the mystery of a ringing bell. Living as an adopted child of a noble family, Angela returns home to find an unsettling atmosphere. Hunted by an unknown enemy, her only reliance is the bell you ring. Run or hide to evade terror and escape.

details.title: Cosmicon Plague
details.short_description: Fight against the evil bio-organic space armada known as the "Union" in this retro inspired , action packed horizontal shmup.

details.title: Take Care!!!
details.short_description: A chaotic co-op pharmacy sim for 1–4 players. Serve patients, fill prescriptions, hit your quotas—and pray nobody loses it. Turn mounting stress into a resource and somehow make it to closing time!

details.title: CABA Zero
details.short_description: Survive a devastated Buenos Aires in this third-person survival horror inspired by the PSX era. Explore subway stations, tunnels and city streets, manage scarce supplies and solve puzzles as you uncover the night that changed the city.

details.title: BombBazled
details.short_description: Your best friend is the most dangerous bomb in the room. BombBazled is an online co-op party game for 1–8 friends: bomb through monster dungeons, grab the gold and escape together – or break the pact at the gate and get branded JUDAS. Proximity voice chat included.

details.title: Chips and Chaos
details.short_description: Pull the lever and sweep stacks of chips off the felt in a pixel-art incremental game. Upgrade your slot machine and collector, hit nightly cash targets, and spend plaques on permanent VIP perks before taking on High Limit.

details.title: Midnight Set: Film Lighting Simulator
details.short_description: A film set you can play, not software you operate. Learn practical lighting in real space before you step onto a real set: meter real light, rig flags on C stands, build your own sets, work a camera modeled on real ones, and get every shot graded with tips that teach the craft.

details.title: Violet Sleep
details.short_description: Violet Sleep is a first-person psychological horror game exploring themes of indoctrination and self-destruction. Blink your way through the labyrinth of a tortured memory. Uncover your own demise. Try to wake up.

details.title: Illegal Fat Gambling
details.short_description: Someone stole 5 billion dollars from you!!! Better get it back by gambling, I guess? Illegal Fat Gambling is a dice-based roguelike about climbing the ranks of a back-alley dice ring to reclaim riches that were stolen by a mysterious man. Fight through cops, obese men, and homunculi to victory!

details.title: Bounty on Grandpa
details.short_description: A legendary hitman retired to his garden chair. Now there's a bounty on his head, and it doubles every wave. Hold your pistol, sip your beer, and turn the backyard into a fortress of machine-gun gnomes, Uzi cats and electric fences. Grandpa does not get up. Usually.

details.title: Voxnap Party
details.short_description: Jump into the party as a Voxnap, a character built from voxels! Grab the parts scattered across the map and snap them on - arms, legs, torso - to power yourself up your own way. Knock the other guests flat and seize the win! Online play for up to 6.

details.title: TITAN'S CELL: NYMPH
details.short_description: Collect and breed quirky Nymphs inside a universe-sized Titan. Build a team of three for turn-based card battles, choose your route through roguelite expeditions, explore solo or in online co-op with up to 3 players, and test your strategy in real-time PvP.

details.title: Shift Knight
details.short_description: Shift Knight is a horror typing game and a supernatural mystery. Every night the dead rise from the graves along the only road home, each carrying a word. Type it before it reaches the truck. Nobody will say where they came from, and the Order keeps sending instructions.

details.title: Pharmacy Next to the Dungeon
details.short_description: Run a small pharmacy beside a dungeon and care for adventurers! Process and combine ingredients to brew potions, diagnose adventurers with various tools, and prescribe the right remedies. Help adventurers on their journeys and grow your pharmacy in this fantasy management sim!

details.title: Multipolar
details.short_description: Multipolar is a single-player grand strategy game set in the near future. Guide your country through the turbulent times of a multipolar world, using diplomacy, influence, information and special operations. Depending on the country you select, you may go for global domination or for survival.

details.title: Atheria: Monster Tactics
details.short_description: Step onto the battlefield, assemble your ultimate squad of powerful monsters, and master position based card combat. Collect hundreds of unique creature cards and outsmart your opponents in deep, turn-based grid battles.

details.title: Crappy Driver
details.short_description: Crappy Driver is a physics-based vehicle builder where you deliver passengers and packages, hoping you don’t lose them along the way. Build from weird parts, drive to the next stop without falling apart and make your vehicle stranger with every ride.

details.title: Project: Esper
details.short_description: A massively expansive traditional roguelike where literally anything is possible. Polymorph your foes into swords, mind control an aberration with five heads, or create your own pocket dimension. Break the rules, build the indomitable, and pray nothing finds a loose thread.

details.title: No One Will Miss Me
details.short_description: An existential horror visual novel. Play as a voice inside a troubled mind. Identify her cognitive distortions, shift her perspective, and win the debate that decides whether she lives or dies.

details.title: Runic Conflux
details.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilder with 200+ cards/items. A unique elemental resource system and rune (status effect) combinations. Choose 3 of 5 heroes each run.

details.title: Calling
details.short_description: A short sci-fi adventure where you tune a damaged communications device, follow voices buried in the noise, and make choices to find your way forward.

details.title: Postal Bots
details.short_description: Fight hordes of robots in this roguelike twinstick shooter! As the last human run delivery company on Earth, it's your task to destroy AI delivery robots and keep a human face in the postal delivery service. Make deliveries and grab loot to upgrade your run and improve your robot smashing firepower.

details.title: Berlingus Idle
details.short_description: An idle clicker and sandbox survival RPG where you click, build, mine, craft, and battle your way to mastering more than a dozen specialties and becoming master of your own empire.

details.title: Slime Game
details.short_description: Slime Game is a retro rage platformer for the modern day! Run and jump through over 70 levels, all while collecting power-ups, stomping enemies, and finding hidden collectibles.

details.title: Rescue the Celestia
details.short_description: Command a deep space rescue operation in this space management game, where you manage a fleet of ships, build bases, coordinate resources distribution, and explore uncharted planets to find and save the scattered crew of the ISS Celestia.

details.title: The Feather King
details.short_description: A match-3 RPG comedy roguelike. Combine runes to trigger spells, arrange them strategically, then blast down your opponents with a barrage of arcane fury. Discover a cast of colorful characters as you navigate through the Feather King's realm in this farcical, story driven adventure.

details.title: Starmadillo
details.short_description: As an armadillo space archaeologist, you've crashed onto a mysterious planet. Luckily you're equipped with a Mobile Defense Unit (MDU) that can defend you from danger, but its capabilities were severely reduced by the impact. In true Metroidvania fashion, explore this alien world and find a way home

details.title: Bad Dubs
details.short_description: You’ve moved out on your own! Now you have to pay rent, buy food, and survive by taking on dubbing jobs. Accept absurd projects, make money, and improve your skills until you achieve your dream: starting your own dubbing company. Because dreams are free. Rent isn’t.

details.title: RUNGEON: Auto Roguelike
details.short_description: Fight through 100 dungeon rooms in this roguelite RPG with automatic turn-based combat. Choose upgrades after every victory, build your hero, defeat powerful bosses, and see how far you can survive.

details.title: Travellin Cats in Canada
details.short_description: Find many cats hidden across Canada in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator! Can you find them all?

details.title: Tin Happens!
details.short_description: Tin Happens is a realistic squash game built by squash players. Master drives, crosscourts, drops and boasts, outplay challenging AI, compete locally or online, and experience the speed, tactics and pressure of the sport.

name: HOI! あっちむいてロケット

details.title: HOI! あっちむいてロケット
details.short_description: Lose at "look away" and you become the rocket. Once you're the rocket, crash into another player and pass it on. A party game for up to 4 players. Local, or online with friends.

details.title: Acorn Heist!
details.short_description: A rock-paper-scissors roguelike deckbuilder. See your opponent’s hand and read what they’ll throw next — a battle of wits, not luck. Build your deck, play after the reveal, force wins, and break the rules of rock-paper-scissors to steal acorns from the forest’s cute animal-eared girls.

details.title: Hello Mr. Drift!
details.short_description: Part-time courier, full-time drift addict! Race against the clock, dodge obstacles, deliver packages, and drift your way to meeting your quota without breaking the goods.

details.title: Those We Serve
details.short_description: The king is murdered. You are killed too. But death isn't the end. Relive the same cursed day in a turn-based RPG where perfectly timed parries, dodges, and your decisions determine whether you survive long enough to uncover the truth.

details.title: VOIDCORP
details.short_description: Co-op mining in an endless dangerous voxel cave system. Blast & dig with real physics, haul the ore up the lift and sell it to the Company. Black holes, spider nests and worse wait in the dark below. Dig deep, get paid, and don't get left behind.

details.title: Emerald Utopia
details.short_description: Emerald Utopia is a 3d atmospheric, platformer, metroidvania game focused on vertical exploration. Here you'll explore diverse, interconnected worlds to find your missing wife, who vanished years ago during the world's shattering.

details.title: Overtime at Holiday's
details.short_description: Cleaners Bill and Jules land a weekend job at Max Holiday’s mansion - until they find him dead in the pool. Trapped in an endless overtime loop, they must move his body around while solving quirky puzzles. A darkly funny retro adventure where "Weekend at Bernie’s" meets "Groundhog Day"!

details.title: Malsort
details.short_description: An action MMO inspired by the classic ARPGs. A cursed world of ash and burning thrones, shared with every hero who dares. Hunt in parties, craft from what you slay, sell your finds in your own shop, and raid the world bosses to loot ancient relics.

details.title: We Have Lift Off
details.short_description: Gather resources, upgrade your rocket, and reach new heights in this casual incremental game. Put your little workers to work, research new technologies, and launch farther with every expedition.

details.title: Peppero and The Toad City
details.short_description: What on earth is happening in the toad world?! Help Peppero the mouse escape a dangerous underground city while managing his stress levels, and uncover the dark mystery behind twisted mutation experiments. A hand-drawn dark fantasy world with immersive first-person gameplay.

details.title: Stellmoor Stables: Cozy Horse Racing
details.short_description: Raise horses on a cozy farm, then race them. Your jockey rides and you call the race by playing cards. You got fired for refusing to race an injured mare, and now you want to beat the boss who fired you. Play solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players.

details.title: Beaked!
details.short_description: Beaked! is a tile-based puzzle-platformer about sound manipulation. Following a little Starling in an abstract world of wooden toys, players will learn to peck buttons, mimic noises and trick people -- all to reach the finish.

details.title: Build&Boom
details.short_description: Build&Boom is a chaotic competitive party game. Builders race to raise a structure from the blueprint while Saboteurs rain rocks, drones, tomatoes and traps down on them. Play three modes from 1v1 to 3v3, online with friends or in local split-screen.

details.title: Decayed Cases: Archive 22
details.short_description: The peaceful, familiar everyday life is completely turned upside down by the chaos that has erupted at the base. The silence of the archive is dissapear, leaving nothing but survival. Will I ever get to tell the story of everything I’ve been through, or will I, too, become a part of the archive?

details.title: Snake Draft
details.short_description: The fantasy football roguelike. Snake Draft is about finding synergies and building your dream team. With 100+ unique athletes shuffling between 22 in-world teams, each run offers a new puzzle to solve. Draft studs, find sleepers, and build a team that is locked in for a championship run.

details.title: Mountain Rescuers
details.short_description: A co-op zombie FPS for 1-4 mountain rescuers who are not very good at rescuing. Arrive by flying rowboat, find the one survivor on each peak and keep it quiet: noise brings the horde. Sell the bodies to the butcher, buy bigger guns, try not to shoot your friends.

details.title: Gnomes Go Boom
details.short_description: Garden gnomes vs. gardeners. Gnomes run screaming "lolololo", then freeze into a perfect ceramic statue among 300 identical ones. Gardeners hunt in first person with a water sprayer: statues drip, live gnomes steam. Spray the right one before it goes BOOM. 2–10 players online.

details.title: Mongle: Cozy Days
details.short_description: A cozy butler simulator where you serve Carrot, a bunny girl who likes things her way, and enjoy the simple pleasures of everyday life.

details.title: Modern Frankenstein
details.short_description: Experience the chilling survival horror reimagining of the Frankenstein legend set in a fictional modern time. Dr Frankenstein's experiments have led him to discover the secrets of life beyond death, a new reality. His monstrous creations roam the halls of his home, his only family.

details.title: VR PC Assembly
details.short_description: Build, fix, and upgrade PCs with your own hands in VR. Run your own workshop, one customer at a time, and build a thriving computer repair business in your very own room.

details.title: Dark Forest
details.short_description: Day 4. The tins are gone and help isn't coming. Step out into an endless first-person survival world: scavenge, craft, build, hunt and fish — alone, with up to five Steam friends or on your own server. At night, things come out of the dark. They don't knock.

details.title: Backpack Jianghu 2
details.short_description: Start as a young martial artist. Seek legendary weapons and secret manuals, combine techniques to forge your own fighting style, and turn humble moves into devastating attacks! Fight your way to the summit of Mount Hua, claim the title of the greatest, or challenge real players in live PvP!

details.title: Tarmac Tycoon
details.short_description: Turn a tiny airfield into a roaring multi-runway hub. Draw blueprints and watch your crews build them tile by tile, then keep every passenger, suitcase and fuel truck moving, from a three-seat prop plane to a sky full of airliners. Contains high amounts of jet fuel.

details.title: MYTRA: No Escape Protocol
details.short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op psychological horror where a rogue AI manipulates perception, alters information between players, and turns trust into a weapon.

details.title: Every Wednesday
details.short_description: A laundromat. Every Wednesday. And stories that stay. Join Hideki in a small laundromat in the heart of a restless metropolis, where smartphones are not allowed and strangers slowly become part of each other’s lives.

details.title: Kingdom Heroes
details.short_description: Kingdom Heroes is a fantasy medieval survivor-like blending action, exploration, kingdom management, and local co-op for up to 4 players. Battle massive hordes, vote on the group's fate, build your kingdom, and dominate other players through asynchronous multiplayer.

details.title: Let There Be Istanbul
details.short_description: A hand-drawn slapstick beat-’em-up following a father-daughter duo on a wild journey toward Istanbul, with snappy tag-team combat and plenty of cats to pet... but why is Mehmet taking Ebru to Istanbul, and what awaits them there?

details.title: Dragon Tribe Chronicles
details.short_description: An epic strategy deck builder RPG where You play as one of the last True Dragons. A shapeshifting being capable of harnessing the power of slayed beings.

details.title: The Caretakers
details.short_description: Infiltrate contaminated residences and deal with their mutant pests using the most advanced tech of the 1960s. Set up a base and observe, probe, and most importantly, survive the grotesque creatures in this online co-op horror game.

details.title: Lumenweld
details.short_description: Lumenweld is an open-world survival crafting RPG set in a luminous neon-fantasy wilderness. Build a home, gather resources, craft gear, complete quests, and hunt deadly creatures. Every pursuit builds its own skill, letting you forge a character shaped by how you play.

details.title: Cendres
details.short_description: Cendres is an isometric 3D action roguelike. Explore seven floors of procedural dungeons, dodge their guardians’ attacks, and shape your build through loot, forging and skill trees. Every descent is a new attempt.

details.title: Ocularis
details.short_description: An ancient intelligence has forgotten how to learn, so it built a place to watch you do it. Explore its abstract chambers in a first-person puzzle game with no words to guide you: experiment, observe, and master its rules. The more you understand, the more it begins to understand again.

details.title: Fishy Dish
details.short_description: Create and sell sushi in this roguelike inventory-management sushi-builder game. Collect fish, sauces, and tools, arrange them on a grid to trigger synergies, survive each round’s sales target, and build the ultimate sushi lineup.

details.title: General Chaos - MAJOR SNAFU
details.short_description: "Currently, GENERAL CHAOS - MAJOR SNAFU is considerably more than halfway to the finish line! This time around, its a sprite-based, multiplayer PC Game that uses an Xbox-style Game Controller &/or Keyboard & Mouse .

details.title: Curse Chapter: Dawnthief
details.short_description: Plunder all the treasure worth taking from the exotic wilderness with your band of rogues. Jump, kick and sling your chain mace to smash and climb your way through any obstacle. Face off against beasts and hopeful heroes that rise up to stop you.

details.title: GENKAI SHURAKU
details.short_description: Rebuild a collapsed remote village in this crafting–farming–settlement game. Gather resources, cook, manage fields, survive raids, and run a small stall to restore the community.

details.title: Never Clean
details.short_description: Clear mountains of trash, sell the junk, and finish building an abandoned park! Take a break from work and have some fun, but remember: your boss is watching you from his window. Complete bizarre tasks, crack the code to the safe, and discover what your boss is really hiding.

details.title: Shadow Seeker
details.short_description: Shadow Seeker is a 2D survival-horror action game with a noir detective story. You are Carlos Ramirez, a detective from the Amorita Police Department. You must solve a mysterious case while braving the looming evil that awaits you at every turn.

details.title: Asteroid Hopper
details.short_description: Asteroid Hopper is a cute space adventure puzzle game set in a colorful cosmos. Hop between asteroids, explore, optimize your path, manage resources, and survive in the hazardous depths of space.

details.title: Faryloopa
details.short_description: Build the board. Play the cards. Roll the dice. Faryloopa is a roguelike deckbuilder meets boardbuilder where every run is a new layout, new synergies, and bigger scores to chase.

details.title: ALLARA
details.short_description: Allara is a 2D pixel-art Metroidvania soulslike set in pre-colonial East Siberia. Play as a shamanka defending her homeland, exploring mythic realms of the sacred world tree, battling brutal bosses, uncovering relics, and mastering a strategic single-skill combat system.

details.title: Mahfam: The Cursed Village
details.short_description: In 1970, eighteen children vanished overnight across eight Iranian villages. Two were later found near Mahfam Village. According to their accounts, Mahfam is no ordinary place but a terrifying site inhabited by supernatural beings. Photographer Farshid heads toward this village of horror.

details.title: Primus Numen
details.short_description: A turn-based, grid-based, tactical RPG where you combine classes and join together to unleash an evolving Nexus Beast.

details.title: Road to Brighton
details.short_description: Fight your way from London to Brighton in this retro arcade beat’em up inspired by the 1964 Mods and Rockers riots.

details.title: It Breathes
details.short_description: First-person VHS horror game set in an abandoned Hungarian hospital. Hide, fight, or flee while working towards your only goal: to escape.

details.title: War of Avareon
details.short_description: Conquer the lands of Avareon in a turn-based strategy game where battles are decided by preparation, not dice. Build an economy, field armies in which every unit has a counter, and recruit heroes with game-changing abilities. Join the free open beta now: campaign, skirmish and multiplayer.

details.title: Disciple
details.short_description: Peggle meets Vampire Survivors in this eldritch horror physics roguelite. Launch your disc into the Abyss, ricochet through swarms of cosmic horrors and forge powerful builds from ancient artefacts.

details.title: Crazy Alchemy
