details.short_description: Crazy Alchemy is a roguelike where you take over a bankrupt alchemy workshop, draw ingredients from a bottomless bag, shake your cauldron to merge them, and combine tools to fulfill commissions and get the workshop back on its feet.

details.title: Kyrie
details.short_description: Kyrie is a first-person parkour roguelite built for speed. Sprint, slide, wall-kick and parry through procedurally generated worlds, outrun what hunts you, beat each world's boss and chase a better time, solo or in online co-op.

details.title: FUCHI's Chick: Mini Many PANIC
details.short_description: Up to 4 players hatch baby chicks and lead them to the shipping yard! A cute, chaotic party game starring the deadpan chicks of FUCHI, the illustrator behind the hugely popular LINE stickers. Lead a wobbly parade, dodge thieves and enemies, and dress up in collected outfits. Play locally or online.

details.title: Project Polaris
details.short_description: Project Polaris is an action roguelike following Eunhasu's story. Combine weapons and drones to create your own combat build, and shape her fate as Corruption changes her appearance, abilities, and how others react to her.

details.title: The Last Bookshop
details.short_description: Reopen your father's bookshop. Stock the shelves, find the right book for each reader, and make friends around town. Follow the trail of your family's missing books.

details.title: KaroKowe Jam
details.short_description: Pick a song, mute your instrument's stem, and play along with the rest of the band. Slow it down, loop the hard parts and record your take. Coming soon.

details.title: Gravity Caverns
details.short_description: Explore vast underground caverns in this physics-based spaceship adventure. Master gravity, manage your fuel, recover containers, assist scientists, and overcome hostile robots. Navigate 30 challenging levels and safely return to your starting platform!

name: Sylvia Sparrow and the Witch's Paintings

details.title: Sylvia Sparrow and the Witch's Paintings
details.short_description: A Short Hike meets a late-night Adult Swim show. A witch just set her cat on fire, and now she wants Sylvia Sparrow to hunt down her lost paintings. Adventure across Witch Isle and meet mean, creepy, ugly and brutally honest characters who’ll help you find every last one.

details.title: Rugby Playbook
details.short_description: Rugby, played with cards. Take a village club from the cow field to the World Cup, one cup at a time. Read what the other team is about to do, play your hand, win the scrum, keep the referee sweet. Between matches, fill your playbook, fight for the table and grow your club.

details.title: Brennia
details.short_description: Brennia is a fantasy RPG featuring turn-based combat and an open world. Explore biomes, solve puzzles, and craft gear for your next dungeon run! Between expeditions, grow crops and expand your island. Play solo or with up to three friends.

details.title: Mead & Embers: A Viking Tavern
details.short_description: Take over a Viking tavern in the cold North and make it shine again: build it up, furnish it and look after your guests. With a living village, a tech tree and a winter that is a real opponent. Keep the embers alive.

details.title: Quagmire
details.short_description: A co-op strategy game for 1 to 4 players. You sit in a Cold War bunker, command your branch of the army on a flickering map, and try to meet the state's quota before the money runs out. Every tank you lose comes out of your budget. Everything goes wrong anyway.

details.title: Project Galaxia
details.short_description: Earth is dying, and humanity has bet everything on its colony ships. You're in command of one. Out there, 467 million stars are waiting, and every planet and moon can be visited. How you survive is up to you: drain the worlds dry, trade with the other commanders... or take what's theirs.

details.title: Othria
details.short_description: Othria is a dark pixel-art action RPG with survivors-like autocast combat. Fight endless hordes, watch them burst into loot, craft gear with orbs and grow your passive tree. Beat each island's boss to open the next. One permanent hero, nothing resets: every level, item and point you earn stays.

details.title: THE SUNDERED AEGIS
details.short_description: A strategy and tactics simulation in which humanity, having gained routes between star systems through great Gates, has split into ten warring nations. Research technology, design warships, organise fleets and command them in battle as you seek to unite the human world under the nation you lead.

details.title: Trovador
details.short_description: A musician from the future is stranded in the Spanish Golden Age. Live the stories of the people you meet and turn each into a romance — an old Spanish ballad — piecing together its verse, composing its music through rhythm play, then performing it as a living tale. A narrative rhythm game.

details.title: Starship Salvagers
details.short_description: One last haul. Dive a dead starship deck by deck: clear sealed rooms of aliens, bolt salvaged upgrades onto your suit, keep your kill multiplier alive and bring down the boss waiting at the bottom. Six contractors, five story tiers and an Endless mode for the greedy.

details.title: Slotspire
details.short_description: A pixel-art slot-machine RPG. Spin the reels and draw one line through your heroes to attack, heal, and break enemy attacks. Rescue heroes to rebuild your camp, customize your reels with new moves and charms, and risk it all on one more floor.

name: Dean Archer Stories: Escape the Rusty Bell

details.title: Dean Archer Stories: Escape the Rusty Bell
details.short_description: Your partner, detective Dean Archer, walked into The Rusty Bell and never came back. Slip into Riverton's harbor bar on a rainy night, explore every room in first person, solve puzzles and find the evidence that can bring down the city's most powerful man. Then get out before dawn.

details.title: MENHERA RAFFLESIA -CLASSIC REMASTER-
details.short_description: Five girls, five twisted forms of love. The 2017 yandere psychological horror visual novel MENHERA RAFFLESIA returns in HD while preserving the original atmosphere. Follow five heroine routes, make your choices, and discover all 11 endings.

details.title: Ethral
details.short_description: Play as a young hero in a retro pixel top-down adventure: explore the land of Ethral, find secrets, conquer dark dungeons, and collect shards to restore the Ethral Pendant to defeat the Pirate King!

details.title: Quarantine
details.short_description: A co-op multiplayer survival game where players run a quarantine checkpoint together during an outbreak. Inspect survivors, manage shared resources, argue over decisions, and survive the consequences... or sabotage each other when panic sets in.

details.title: Crow Heist
details.short_description: The HOA have taken everything from Crowley... His nest, his ability to fly, and most important of all, his trinkets! Break into their homes as Crowley for revenge in this 2.5D Platform Comedy game. Unlock their drawers, break their belongings, and steal everything you can to rebuild the crow's home!

details.title: Please The Orb
details.short_description: Please The Orb is a roguelike puzzle deckbuilder about creating game-breaking chaos. Draft bizarre artifacts, arrange them on a grid, and trigger massive cascading chain reactions. Deceptively simple to play, but infinitely complex to master.

details.title: Nascentiar
details.short_description: A classic turn-based roguelike dungeon crawler with D20 dice combat. Three unique classes — a soul-projecting Cultivator, a monster-recruiting Mask Master, and a shadow-stalking Rogue. 117 monsters, randomized identification, and procedural dungeons make every run a new adventure.

details.title: Eternal 4 Rounds
details.short_description: A dynamic low-poly Tower Defense. Command mobile squads and repel attacks from 4 factions. Collect gold from settlements during battle to craft equipment—the currency for hiring new troops. Defeat titanic bosses, upgrade your camp, and unlock elite tiers for your army!

details.title: Mythalia
details.short_description: Build your team and challenge the tower in this turn-based roguelite monster catching game. Unlock new beasts and upgrades as you play, discover mutations and champions in the 2v2 designed system.

details.title: Settle
details.short_description: A cozy puzzle about decor and history. Explore different eras by arranging authentic items from diverse cultures. Restore harmony to interiors of the past and enjoy the meditative flow.

details.title: Belua
details.short_description: Build a team of monsters, plan your moves carefully, and escape this unjust prison. This unique mash-up of turn-based combat and auto-battlers requires strategy and wits. Every win unlocks a new cute or creepy creature to join your side.

details.title: The Last Ember
details.short_description: Fight endless hordes of enemies in a fast-paced roguelite bullet heaven while bringing life back to a dying wasteland. Capture territory, grow stronger, and discover powerful upgrades that transform you from a fragile spark into an unstoppable force.

details.title: GAS
details.short_description: A co-op road trip horror for 4 players from the fan of Spintires, MudRunner and SnowRunner. Loot by day. Survive the night. Defend your car from skeletons, monsters and bad decisions. Go GAS! Go FUN!

details.title: Project: Story about
details.short_description: An RPG where you live life after life in a constantly evolving world, and your choices and relationships influence future cycles.

details.title: In Vino Veritas
details.short_description: Explore a desecrated cathedral to find your missing wife in this psychological horror adventure. Uncover the dark truth behind the Elohim, solve ancient puzzles, and survive a chilling journey where faith and reality collide. The Bible was mistranslated; the truth is much darker

details.title: Hemlon the Grey
details.short_description: Hemlon the Grey is a deflection-based 2D Souls-like where life and death are decided by a blade. Follow the story of Hemlon, a half-demon warrior, as she uncovers the dark secrets of the Reinz Republic and the Broken Wings.

details.title: Codex Arcana: Grimoire of Monsters
details.short_description: Summon an army of Monster Girls to face your enemies in strategic battles! Defeat the Dark Lord's minions and expand your collection with cool, fierce and cute Monster Girls of all variety in this "Capsule Monsters" inspired game!

details.title: Darn Guy Adventures
details.short_description: Darn Guy Adventures is an RPG adventure following the titular Kishan "Darn Guy", Tinta and Norton as they are sent into a mission they are utterly underqualified for. Encounter verbose bushes, mathematical rocks and very loud wolfmen on the quest to save a town with an expiration date.

details.title: Revenant Maze
details.short_description: A first person, action-roguelite that centres around going fast. Enter a procedurally generated maze filled with prototypes and architects intent on defeating you. Create the strongest synergies and blitz all in sight.

details.title: Franky Psychedelic Adventure
details.short_description: Join Franky on an epic journey across breathtaking dimensions to reclaim the stolen cookies. Harness powerful psychedelic abilities to overcome challenges, master impossible obstacles, and conquer extraordinary worlds.

details.title: The Evaluation
details.short_description: A first-person horror puzzle game about solving cryptic puzzles and surviving a deadly night inside an abandoned drive-in theater.

details.title: Casse-Croute Deckbuilder
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you cook your strategy. As a Cook, manage your Hero’s Appetite and Cholesterol, and build powerful combos with food cards and kitchen tools.

details.title: Stellar Fixer
details.short_description: Step into the grease-stained boots of a debt-ridden Patcher in a gritty industrial space station. Diagnose critical failures, strip panels with your automatic vortex drill, and replace complex components to bring massive ships back to life. Restore power, clear the smoke, and pay off your debt.

details.title: My Perfect Nails
details.short_description: My Perfect Nails is a retro simulation game inspired by the 2000's web games, where you create the perfect set of nails for your customers! Choose between many options and accessories to create the nails of their dreams! ✨🌸

details.title: Desolation Arcanist
details.short_description: Craft your own magic in this Action Roguelite. "Program" your wands with varied Spell Cores (Fireballs, Flying Swords... or Watermelons?) and Runes. Raise your companion Dragon, command a Puppet army, and abuse physics to knock enemies off cliffs. Your build is your destiny.

details.title: Scriven Mage
details.short_description: The only VR game where you cast spells by actually writing them. VR spellcasting PvP/PvE. Write real glyphs in the spellbook to prepare spells. Find every combination. Master the art.

name: Yokai Batting Game in Kawagoe おまつりようかいバッティングゲーム in KAWAGOE

details.title: Yokai Batting Game in Kawagoe おまつりようかいバッティングゲーム in KAWAGOE
details.short_description: Blast yokai away with just one button! A fast and satisfying one-button casual action game set in Kawagoe! Hit the yokai. Save Kawagoe. There’s only one control. Hit! Hit! Home run! Smash them out of the park! Save the souls of the cursed yokai!! Bring peace back to Kawagoe with your bat!

details.title: Navinosuke: The Yo-kai Buster
details.short_description: The story takes place in an ancient Japan where the balance between humans and Yo-kai has begun to collapse. In this age of chaos, the Onmyo Bureau secretly creates its ultimate weapon — a karakuri Onmyoji apprentice known as “Navinosuke.”

details.title: Keep Making
details.short_description: Keep Making is a fantasy room builder fit for the creation of old-timey castles, cozy corners, and trap-filled dungeons. Design and decorate without goals, to relax or to prep for tabletop play. Then, export and share.

details.title: Iron of Dust
details.short_description: The SciFi shooter that makes you think twice.

details.title: Up'N'Up: Mountain Express
details.short_description: Join the Up'N'Up delivery crew, upgrade your vehicles and climb the mountain in this off-road driving roguelike. Look after your vehicle to overcome any challenges the mountain and delivery items can throw at you. Climb solo or tackle the mountain with friends locally or online.

details.title: Alone: far from home
details.short_description: A psychological survival horror game on Mars. After a catastrophic expedition, you are left alone on the Red Planet. Rebuild your ruined base, restore contact with Earth, and find a way home while uncovering the truth behind the disaster, before isolation and the fight for survival break your mind..

details.title: 吾之半身乃纯白恶魔
details.short_description: 黑神露娜，是一名喜欢「中二幻想」的普通高中少女。 某一天，一场意外让她的日常彻底改变。一位与她有着不可思议联系的神秘少女突然出现，原本平静的校园生活，也随之卷入了一连串难以解释的事件。 当真相逐渐浮出水面，她们将如何面对彼此、面对命运，又将做出怎样的选择？

details.title: Beyond the Bars
details.short_description: Play as a prisoner, guard, or warden. Scheme, trade, and betray, or lock everything down. In this multiplayer social game of control and escape. The prison is yours to use… or break out of.

details.title: Phone Booth
details.short_description: You are currently trapped inside a phone booth. When you pick up the receiver, the number “99” appears on the display, and a countdown begins. From among the vast number of flyers covering the walls on all four sides, find and peel off two flyers with exactly the same design that aren’t overlapping.

details.title: Core Module
details.short_description: In this cyberpunk themed Roguelike card game, you can build your own deck, connect the pathways between cards, and along those pathways cyclically trigger each card's unique abilities. This allows cards to continuously cooperate with each other and unleash powerful combined effects.

details.title: Go To Hell
details.short_description: Descend into hell, fight with mouse clicks, collect loot, die, and return stronger. A dark Incremental-RPG about permanent progression and one more attempt.

details.title: Shadows of Eldemir
details.short_description: Shadows of Eldemir is a retro-inspired, Victorian cosmic-horror, point-and-click adventure RPG, where a London schoolmaster travels to a remote Eastern European village searching for his missing fiancée, only to discover the archaeological expedition she joined may have disturbed something ancient.

details.title: Satellite Odyssey Online
details.short_description: Survive in a huge living world seen from above. Every rock and tree has real properties: gather, smelt and craft your way from a stone axe to a musket. Build a home, hunt wild animals, join a clan and claim your place on the official server.

details.title: Tiny Tenants
details.short_description: Tiny Tenants is cozy real estate management game about greed, trust and tiny lives. Bid on flawed properties, renovate homes, and keep your tenants happy while growing your business.

details.title: Sheepping
details.short_description: Sheepping is a relaxing farm simulator in which you take care of your sheep, shear fluffy wool, spin it into yarn, and weave it into cozy clothing.

details.title: Bullets and Mods
details.short_description: Bullets and Mods is a fast-paced FPS with Roguelite mechanics. Collect bullets to build your magazine, equip mods to enhance your gun, and unleash your fury on your enemies!

name: Geolocation Case Files: Road Trip to Robert's Grave

details.title: Geolocation Case Files: Road Trip to Robert's Grave
details.short_description: A decades-old family story intertwined with a modern-day road trip. By identifying dashcam photos, you will reconstruct the route, discover who Robert was, and piece together past events. A real trip, real places, real geolocation.

details.title: Panic 64
details.short_description: Panic Porcupine returns in a high-speed 3D platformer that blends classic run n' jump mechanics with racing elements!

details.title: Redline Hero
details.short_description: Redline Hero is an arcade racer inspired by classic racing games of the 90s and 2000s that can be played solo or with friends! Explore an open world, compete in races, drift events, rally stages and side activities to unlock new cars and driving abilities.

details.title: Hidden Button: Emerald
details.short_description: The third game in the Hidden Button series, a puzzle game where every level is different. Explore each stage’s unique rules and activate the clear button.

details.title: Mini Gladiators
details.short_description: Mini Gladiators is a minimalist gladiator roguelite with satisfying ragdoll physics, where your choices can turn your little fighter into an unstoppable force that gets the crowds going and enemies flying.

details.title: Crude Empire
details.short_description: Build an oil empire in boomtown Texas: find oil, drill the well yourself, lay pipelines, refine gasoline and run your own gas stations. Every stage can become the bottleneck, and rival oil companies fight you for every field and every customer.

details.title: Merge Mutants
details.short_description: Merge Mutants is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter where hostile scientists try to keep you locked up. Synthesize their remains into healing, abilities, and loyal mutants, then merge matching units into bigger and more powerful ones. Break out of the lab or die trying.

details.title: TL;DR
details.short_description: A typing incremental game where you type real novels. Work through 15+ classics, turn every word into gold, and keep upgrading until whole pages fill themselves faster than you can type. Too long; didn’t read. Type it anyway.

details.title: BAUSFIGHT
details.short_description: BAUSFIGHT is a fast-paced battleground for 2–8 players, packed with short multiplayer modes. Choose a weapon-based class, master its unique abilities, and unleash wild combos to ruin your foes’ day. Fight solo to be the last one standing, or team up with friends and conquer the lobby together.

details.title: On & Under
details.short_description: Build a fantasy settlement, guide unique villagers, reshape a fully destructible world, and lead your people in real-time battles against monsters, raiders, and rival factions. Raise a homestead, a druid's grove, a wizard's spire, a necromancer's deep lair—or something only you can imagine.

details.title: Solakrats
details.short_description: The Commandments never change: Awaken for the first time, climb down into the depths, and claim your birth halo. But the world turns, it lies to you. A full inversion twists directions, down becomes up. And after all, it's your home, and that home is the lie. So... which way is down now again...?

details.title: Stem The Tide
details.short_description: Lead the last bastion against the Swarm in this hybrid auto-battler and roguelite. Build your camp, recruit and merge units, create faction synergies, upgrade your warriors, and survive procedurally generated waves of monsters to save the world from destruction!

details.title: WireDive
details.short_description: A PS2-inspired grappling action-platformer set in a high-fantasy realm under siege by eldritch invaders from another dimension. Wield arcane technology, build momentum and swing through each level as you destroy every Blight and chase faster times.

details.title: Blade & Burgers
details.short_description: Make burgers, whale in a pay-to-win game, and simp your heart out in this parody roguelite made as a “love” letter to mobile microtransaction grindfests. It’s not the Darkest Dungeon. It’s the greediest one.

details.title: Mystery of the Sacred King
details.short_description: You are the Lawspeaker, a defender of justice. Decode local rituals. Seek the truth. Dismantle conspiracies to save the innocent from execution. Put an end to the deception by revealing the mystery of the Sacred King in this deduction puzzle game.

details.title: CORVIDTALISM: Win at Life
details.short_description: Help a lazy low life get back up on his feet. Make him work, use persuasion, ignore his cries, and make choices for him. "Don't say you don't want to win at life."

details.title: Kindred Kind
details.short_description: Kindred Kind is a hand-drawn 2D action RPG. Hunt eight powerful beasts across a branching world, master a two-weapon combat system, and save what remains of humanity. Explore, fight, and uncover ancient mysteries, in a world teetering on the edge of ruin.

details.title: Boot the Beet
details.short_description: Boot the Beet is a high-impact arcade brawler where the only thing between your harvest and a swarm of hungry aliens is a heavy steel toe. Forget guns and magic—this is about the raw stopping power of a well-placed kick.

details.title: Seedfall
details.short_description: Earth’s time is up. In this cooperative Idle RPG, secure humanity's survival by controlling alien fauna with nano-parasites. Automate complex resource chains, unlock 30+ unique skills, and team up in massive Global Missions. Your squad evolves even while you are offline.

details.title: Squid Arrives：Make Squid Great Again
details.short_description: In XXXX, deep-sea squids receive "nuclear food" from the islands. This unnatural feast triggers their awakening, reviving the lost memory of cephalopod world domination. Note: Inspired by fried calamari. Contains allegory. Don't overthink it! (laughs)

details.title: Farming & Supermarket: Clicker
details.short_description: Click, harvest, and build your own retail empire! In Farming & Supermarket: Clicker, process raw crops into valuable goods, design your store, and sell to customers. Start with a simple click and grow into a massive supermarket tycoon!

details.title: Steinvar
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious, atmospheric world and cleanse creeping corruption using the power of light. Discover secrets, restore lost places, and shape your journey in a story-driven fantasy adventure.

details.title: Heliodawn
details.short_description: You start with a coal mine, an iron mine, a well, and a farm. You end with rockets flying, colonies on the Moon and Mars, and cargo flowing between every world you've built. An idle incremental game about building humanity's space program from the ground up.

name: Mothville: A City of Hidden Things

details.title: Mothville: A City of Hidden Things
details.short_description: The residents of Mothville are always losing things and need the help of someone with eagle eyes! Explore the town’s diverse neighborhoods, talk to the animal residents, complete their quests, and find everything that’s gone missing in this wacky, story-driven hidden object game.

name: Kamiya Detective Agency: High School Girl Vanished in The Summer

details.title: Kamiya Detective Agency: High School Girl Vanished in The Summer
details.short_description: A mystery set in Fukuoka, Japan. Former cop Kengo Kamiya and assistant Hikaru tackle a high school girl's disappearance. A "Photoreal Novel" fully utilizing actual photos and AI. Enjoy snappy banter and unexpected twists in this simple, choice-driven mystery visual novel.

details.title: BaeSplit: Chaos Down Under
details.short_description: A turn-based RPG featuring Hakos Baelz and her friends from hololive! Discover a re-imagining of the Outback as you join Bae on a quest to save her homeland and herself.

details.title: Cafe Connect
details.short_description: Repair, upgrade, and build PCs for your first customers to pave your way to self-employment. Open your own internet café, build custom gaming PCs, and expand your shop step by step. Your success starts with a screwdriver.

details.title: Grot
details.short_description: Leap in and out of your mine cart hat to survive deadly, ever-changing caves in this precision platformer. Steal powerful gems and push deeper into a mysterious loop.

details.title: Dice Shepherd: Incremental
details.short_description: A small incremental game about rolling d4 to d100 dice on a grassy field. Every roll pays gold and fodder. Spend it on promotions and skills that sinergize. Play it idle or hands-on, the numbers keep climbing.

details.title: Citizen Pain II
details.short_description: Citizen Pain II is a unique old-school first-person action RPG experience featuring insane challenge, fast gameplay intensity and instantly rewarding combat. Begin a dark journey and experience secret dungeons, hidden hazards and terrifyng enemy encounters.

details.title: The Back Door: Emergence
details.short_description: It's 2015. While urban exploring an abandoned building with your friends, you lose sight of them. Suddenly, you end up in a strange place consisting only of abnormal spaces and places that seem... strangely familiar. Is this all there is? Or most importantly... are you truly alone?

details.title: Yani Again
details.short_description: Yani Again is a high-speed action game. Shift between reality and cyberspace, explore dangerous tracks hidden across the world, and overcome every challenge at extreme speed.

details.title: 薪世录
details.short_description: Xin Shi Lu is a thrilling action-adventure RPG. Meet Fan Xin and start a new life. Explore a mysterious world, grow stronger in combat, and forge bonds with companions. Expand your influence and define your own legendary story.

details.title: Money Trees
details.short_description: Punch trees, deposit coins, and buy upgrades until you're harvesting millions from this fortuitous world. But how much can you earn before your time is up...?

details.title: Clickerite
details.short_description: Clickerite is an incremental mining game where you must collect materials, craft powerful tools, and battle evil monsters in a cube-dimensional world!

details.title: Nonsense Football Club
details.short_description: Nonsense Football Club is a 3D action football game where core football fundamentals become combat mechanics! Master the timing of slide tackles, precision passing, and skill moves to defeat defeat unconventional teams like robots, fantastical creatures, and insane bosses!

details.title: Operation Paranoia
details.short_description: Operation Paranoia is a psychological survival horror in which you browse the dark corners of the deep web, uncover conspiracy theories, and hide from relentless killers. Manage your food and medicine supplies, run your vlog channel, and survive another day.

details.title: HOMUNCULCHU
details.short_description: Guide fragile homunculi with limited lifespans through humanity's final bid for survival across six hostile worlds.

details.title: Iron Dogs
details.short_description: In Iron Dogs, take the helm of 1940's inspired aircraft in a colorful retro-inspired arcade flight-sim where you will blast hordes of enemy aircraft, naval vessels and more! Engage in dogfights (literally) with hostile aircraft, while flying through beautifully hand-crafted environments.

details.title: Chaincast
details.short_description: A PvP roguelike auto battler where you build a squad and arrange their skills into escalating combos. Battle rival squads and set off a chain reaction that grows stronger with every link.

details.title: Sprig
details.short_description: Sprig is a cozy 3D exploration game about discovering real-world animals, solving gentle environmental puzzles, and filling your nature journal as a curious rabbit. Explore peaceful, no-stress levels at your own pace in a short, wholesome adventure with a clear ending.

details.title: DAMNED
details.short_description: DAMNED is a nerve-wracking survival/management experience where you are the only one who can keep a colossal dam from collapsing.

details.title: Rebel Talos
details.short_description: Pilot your TALOS mech to defend humanity’s last bastion in this high-speed action roguelite. Craft overpowered builds, crush the Automata Empire, and expand your arsenal every run.

details.title: Orbital Code: 2044
details.short_description: Become a top secret agent in VR and embark on a continent-spanning stealth action adventure. After Corp One's plan to seize New York City by force is leaked, a covert international taskforce of former special operations members sends you to infiltrate the megacorp's heavily guarded downtown HQ.

details.title: Cozy Lemonade Stand
details.short_description: Run the sweetest stand in town! 🍋 Start with harvesting produce like lemons, strawberries, and mint. Mix and serve fresh lemonade, attract happy customers, upgrade and decorate your stall, and make enough profit to turn your humble stand into the coziest spot on the block.

details.title: Cat Craft
details.short_description: A cozy first-person sim blending Gardening and Alchemy. Grow magical crops and mix ingredients to craft endless unique cats. Manage your Cat Café, find homes for your cats, and bring warmth, colors, and love back to the Gray world!

details.title: Ancient Tombs
details.short_description: Top-down 2D adventure in retro style. Explore a dangerous world filled with both living and undead enemies. Solve puzzles and search tombs & dungeons, find secrets, weapons and upgrades.

details.title: Sundae Drive
details.short_description: Hit the road in your very own ice cream truck! 🍦 Explore a cute neighborhood, park in the perfect spot, and serve adorable animal customers their dream sundaes. Scoop, drizzle, and top to perfection. Upgrade your cute truck, restock supplies, and create your own ice cream flavors!

details.title: The Everything Building
details.short_description: Press up and down, elevator goes brrr! Deliver customers to the correct floor and max your score. Serve many customers including but not limited to surfers, astronauts, cars, ghosts, cheerleaders, horses, and cheerleader horses. 1-2 players! 50 different floors! HORSE MODE included!

details.title: The Pact
details.short_description: The Pact is a story-rich psychological horror game about family secrets, where you experience a tragic tale of morality, justice, and consequence. Navigate unsettling environments, escape threats, solve puzzles, and run for your life as you slowly discover your family's dark secret and its origins.

details.title: HINO
details.short_description: Hino, a girl with a red ribbon, and the white Monimoni Skeleton journey through a world of darkness in this 2D dark fantasy game. Having lost her memory, Hino seeks a safe haven in a land overrun by monsters, uncovering the truth of the dark world as she travels.

details.title: QUANTUM HEART
details.short_description: QUANTUM HEART combines the thrill of dodging bullets in shoot 'em ups with the build variety of modern roguelikes. Graze enemy bullets to charge energy and unleash devastating powers. Take the elevator to the only city on Earth and depose the system that robbed your heart.

details.title: Witch Collage
details.short_description: A deck-cutting roguelike where you slice cards with a magic dagger and piece them together. Create your own cards and survive the witch's game.

details.title: Bad Call
details.short_description: Bad Call is a social game for 3-6 players set in an underground bunker. You're locked in separate rooms. Win challenges, trade code digits, forge alliances, and lie over the phone. Everyone needs the same exit code, but not everyone will escape.

name: Something Outside Wants You to Die

details.title: Something Outside Wants You to Die
details.short_description: Survive a paranormal home invasion caused by a case of mistaken identity. Attempt to prove you're not who it seeks as your house degrades and becomes more difficult to navigate. Something's Outside, but it's only a matter of time until it gets in.

details.title: One Last Dance Please!
details.short_description: A rhythm-driven incremental game where every beat builds a bigger party. Rally your dance crew, earn cash and go wild with upgrades. Draw your own characters and bring your favorite music. The bills can wait for one last dance... right?

details.title: The Bastion Protocol
details.short_description: The Bastion Protocol is an idle tower defense game where a lone tower faces relentless enemy waves. Earn Entropy from kills, strengthen your build, and survive until your tower falls. Turn each run’s rewards into lasting upgrades and return stronger.

details.title: Lost in the Post
details.short_description: Fly a rickety hot-air balloon with 2-4 friends and deliver the mail across a world that wants you dead. Work the burner, drop the ballast, catch the parcels, slap your crewmates, and try not to fall out. We always deliver. Mostly.

details.title: Orbit Wreck
details.short_description: Blast through waves of enemies in OrbitWreck, a fast-paced 2D space shooter! Pilot unique ships, dodge deadly attacks, collect Scrap, and unleash powerful special abilities.

details.title: Pinwick
details.short_description: Every haunted house was built by someone. You build yours one room at a time: saw, glue, velvet, patience, a photograph of everything you finish. Each room is perfect when you latch the glass at night. Some mornings, there are improvements.

details.title: The Gilded Sprig
details.short_description: Build a cozy botanical shop, craft fragrant products, gather rare ingredients, grow plants, and discover new recipes. Hire helpers, delight your customers, and turn a little shop into a flourishing business.

details.title: Spellriggers: Unification Protocol
details.short_description: Heroes of Might and Magic meets Homeworld. Five Spellriggers, six schools of magic, randomly drawn loot cards and generated battlefields: no two runs alike. Build your fleet, master cosmic-scale spells and conquer the galaxy sector by sector.

name: Degrees of Love ~ Beyond Eternal Promise ~

details.title: Degrees of Love ~ Beyond Eternal Promise ~
details.short_description: This is a story about fulfilling a promise made before birth. A guidepost for the journey home—reclaiming the time lost by fulfilling the promise the two made in the past. At the end of a journey spanning countless years, with an eternal promise in their hearts.

name: Chop or Die: Axe of War

details.title: Chop or Die: Axe of War
details.short_description: The world is overrun by wood mutants! Chop trees, gather resources, upgrade turrets, fortify your base, and enhance your Cyber Dog. Fight off nightly mutant hordes and save the planet from a forest apocalypse!

name: プライマリ・ブルーム

details.title: プライマリ・ブルーム
details.short_description: 高度なAI技術の発展により、大きく変化した世界。主人公のザニアはただ一人、人の手から生み出された植物たちを取り戻すため、研究を続けています。部屋で植物を育て、咲いた花をSNSで世界に広めていく、ドット絵・横スクロールのSF×ガーデンシミュレーションです。

details.title: Vroom Boom
details.short_description: Arcade car combat with big jumps and bigger booms. Launch off ramps, fire rockets, drop mines and set off your car's special. Fight a battle royale against 8 to 12 bots, survive waves and bosses to unlock new cars, or take on a friend in split screen or online.

name: Accrelis: A Game About Forging Planets

details.title: Accrelis: A Game About Forging Planets
details.short_description: Smash a protoplanetary disk with your cursor, choose what your new world is made of, and put it in orbit. Watch life appear, cities spread across its surface and your star system slowly fill up. A short incremental game about building planets.

details.title: Channel 666: Nightmare on Tape
details.short_description: Channel 666 is a Roguelite, Turn-Based Dungeon Crawler with endless challenges within. Choose your gang and see just how deep the horror classics go!

details.title: The Gunner’s Campaign
details.short_description: Command a Napoleonic artillery battery from Austerlitz to Waterloo. Lay your bearing, read the fall of shot, keep the gun drill going under counter-battery fire, and earn your promotions across twenty historical missions.

details.title: The End of Magic
details.short_description: Explore a world where magic is falling into wicked hands in this top-down action adventure. Cast spells to fight enemies, break barriers, and pull distant levers. Absorb magic from fallen foes, or rely on your staff when it runs dry.

details.title: NUMISMATOR
details.short_description: A cozy digging and coin-collecting game with the three felt puppets of the Balanzone Troupe. Dig to a rhythm while your companions race each coin to the bucket, or teleport it there. Every coin is real history, with a museum photo and its own story in the troupe's travel log.

name: Brick by Brick: Build and Play

details.title: Brick by Brick: Build and Play
details.short_description: Become a brick creator and bring your ideas to life, one brick at a time. Design custom models, working vehicles and moving dioramas. Build, test and play alone or with friends. Your imagination is the limit!

details.title: The Hollow Moors
details.short_description: Halloween, 1999. A camping trip on the Yorkshire moors, then the fog rolled in and your friends vanished. Chop wood, scavenge supplies and keep the fire burning through the night, because the boggarts and lampers want it out. Cozy folk horror survival, solo or with friends.

details.title: Log to Lodge: Carpentry Simulator
details.short_description: Turn a single tree into a whole house. Log to Lodge is a cozy woodworking and carpentry sim: fell trees, run your own sawmill, plane lumber into planks, build furniture for village customers and grow your workshop.

details.title: PUFF-N: Proto-Utility Flying Forager-Navigator
details.short_description: Fly around as PUFF-N, a robotic puffin designed to help restimulate a dying ecosytem. Explore a colorful, stylized open world, dive into the water to catch as many fish as you can, and learn more about the alternate future where PUFF-N lives.

details.title: Stay Tuned
details.short_description: A narrative broadcast-desk game: cut cameras, bleep swearing, and fill every second of live TV by day, then go home to your family by night. When the war starts on air, you decide what the country sees.

details.title: Shelter for Stalkers
details.short_description: Lead a community of survivors in a post-apocalyptic bunker. Overcome scarcity, grow the economy, earn money, and choose your own path in politics and governance. Make your shelter thrive: money and influence are not the goal, but the means to fulfill your ultimate mission—saving the world

details.title: Tethered Dread: The Blind Spot
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where your fear gives you away. Search for an exit from a system that harvests human terror, resist an invisible tether, and use your imagination to outwit its faceless custodians. They will not kill you. But you can break.

details.title: Shutterbug Skies: Idle Camping
details.short_description: A cozy corner idler built to be your daily desktop companion. Help Kes search for and photograph beautiful bugs while you work, study, or relax. Upgrade your camera equipment, complete your creature collection, and discover 7 unique floating islands!

name: Dankest Dungeon: Cleanup with friends and magic

details.title: Dankest Dungeon: Cleanup with friends and magic
details.short_description: Use a variety of magic and tools to tidy up millions of physics-based coins and items. Upgrade your abilities and clean up the dungeon faster with 1-4 players online!

details.title: Cupid's Bargain
details.short_description: A matchmaker summons a pair of devilishly fine deities to help save her dying club because, like, who needs a soul anyway? Go fall in love and sell your classmates’ souls in this horror romantic comedy!

details.title: Valefable
details.short_description: Start a new life in another world, alone or with up to three friends. Take guild jobs, fight with click-to-move combat, and build your abilities around the gear you wield. Gather, craft, camp beneath the stars, and turn the places you pass through into somewhere you belong.

details.title: HOLD THE DOCK
details.short_description: HOLD THE DOCK is a wave defense game with roguelite elements. Defend the dock gate. The mutants are out to smash it! Gun them down, build a loadout of weapons, modifiers and skills that activate on their own, fortify your position and keep the swarm from breaking through until the cargo arrives.

details.title: Pot-a-Boom! Offerings to the Sun
details.short_description: Smash clay pots, catch the cacao and feed a hungry Sun before dusk. A cute co-op clicker in a toy-like Aztec world: play solo or with up to three friends, grow your legacy on the Sun Stone, and let your stream's chat throw pots into the plaza.

details.title: Bones for Soup
details.short_description: Within the confines of a locked apartment, assume the perspective of young playwright Arthur Carvain as he weathers a stormy evening with Tom, his mentor and director. Delve into the creative works of both men and untangle their shared histories & influences.

details.title: Operation Knockback
details.short_description: Grapple-hook and shotgun-blast your way up a gigantic tower on a dying planet. Explore unforgiving biomes and create shortcuts by exploiting push-n'-pull physics. Mistakes are not allowed. 50% of developer profits after platform fees goes to charity.

details.title: Feuds
details.short_description: A turn-based game of feuding rulers. Take a realm one contested land at a time, and settle every claim in a compact tactical battle where each unit you place is a promise, each arrow a threat, and every tile you hold is counted when the dust settles.

details.title: Revenant of Tsushima
details.short_description: Explore haunted shrines and lantern-lit graveyards in a first-person Japanese folklore horror adventure. Collect wandering spirits, investigate strange clues, and uncover the secrets beyond the torii gates.

details.title: Holdout!
details.short_description: Holdout! is a chaotic co-op tower defense roguelite. With friends or solo, mine ore, smelt bullets, assemble ammo and haul it to your towers while bugs swarm toward the core. Between waves, buy new buildings and pick challenge cards.

details.title: Skeletons and Stuff
details.short_description: Four heroes and thousands of skeletons. Take a wizard, a huntress, a barbarian or a pirate through seven battles against a horde that keeps growing, pick a new card every time you level up, sign dark pacts you might regret, and take on the Bone King.

details.title: Moralia
details.short_description: Moralia is a lightning-fast first-person movement game where your only weapon is a shield. Slide, bash and slam through collapsing dimensions of Sparta. Come back with your shield, or on it.

details.title: Futures Fantasy
details.short_description: A caravan-management auto battler. Build your company, forge their gear, and lead them to save the world... right after you dump this shipment of spices at twice the price.

details.title: Justice Be Damned
details.short_description: A turn-based courtroom deckbuilder set in Hell. Break the prosecution’s case, strengthen your defense, and manage your standing with the court. Upgrade your deck, recruit retainers, and descend the Circuits of Hell.

details.title: Fluffy Business
details.short_description: Care for a flock of characterful sheep, turn their wool and milk into handmade goods, and run a cozy village shop. Stock and decorate your shelves, welcome customers, and grow your little business through the changing seasons.

details.title: Patient 16 – Episode 2: The Awakening
details.short_description: Face yourself, endure surreal trials, and survive an evaluation that adapts to how you think and behave. Fight your way through Patient 16’s memories to uncover more about his past and an unsettling truth he can barely comprehend.

details.title: Slash Dash
details.short_description: Fight your way through difficult levels with dangerous enemies in this fast paced 2D action bullet hell game.

name: The Casket Of The Bygone Witch

details.title: The Casket Of The Bygone Witch
details.short_description: The Casket of the Bygone Witch is a horror/ghost-story/suspense/yuri visual novel. After the abandoned old lab was sealed, student deaths occurred, spreading a witch-curse legend. Protagonist Bai Yu investigates the witch after her friend dies there from the “curse.”

details.title: Crown of Jerusalem
details.short_description: Rule a kingdom, lead its knights, and choose the turning points of the Crusades. November 1177: the Leper King, sixteen and ill, faces Saladin's army. Ride out, or wait for help? A historical strategy game of the Crusader states, 1098–1191, with 1,500+ real figures, field battles, sieges and duels.

details.title: Creative Racers
details.short_description: Race for first place using offensive and defensive items on the other players while the course booster to gain speed as well dodging hazard. Play for fun online with friends or others. Or speedrun for for glory. Have fun your way in this fun and cute racing game.

details.title: Eldritch Drift
details.short_description: A cartoon-goth kart racer where drifting wakes the gods. Forge runes into spells, blast rivals with plasma, rift bombs and walls, and race six ghoulish drivers through a haunted mansion and a temple adrift between worlds, alone or in 2-4 player split-screen.

details.title: Tinycube Tales
details.short_description: A funny, colorful 2.5D platformer for the whole family! Play as 11 unlockable cube heroes, stomp mischievous animals, dodge giant rolling boulders and face huge bosses across 7 wild worlds, with a controller or keyboard.

details.title: Worst Wizard
details.short_description: Burn 100,000 marshmallows in a single stage. A wizard, furious that someone put sugar in his coffee without asking, wipes out the cute horde with fully automatic spells. Grow your skill tree, unlock new spells, and make every run flashier and more brutal in this incremental game.

details.title: PROJECT Ω / MEG
details.short_description: A bullet hell where an android girl dodges for you. Build her dodge AI, weapons and outfit, switch her dodge AI for each barrage, and BREAK through brutal patterns from rival girls. Lose, rebuild, retry. As her researcher on PROJECT Ω, you were never told what it is really for.

details.title: Afterglow Interstate
details.short_description: A relaxing synthwave motorbike ride through neon cities, glowing seas, desert dunes, aurora skies and zero-gravity tubes, all moving to an expanding soundtrack. Just drive, or take on the beat, your echo, and your friends whenever you feel like it.

details.title: RhizoMana: Arbor Magna
details.short_description: A cozy adventure for a magic academy graduate: restore the disrupted mana flow, grow the best garden, unravel the mysteries of alchemy, and save a remote village from rampaging slimes.

details.title: Uphill Both Ways
details.short_description: Two penguins, one snowball. Lean together to roll it down a six-world mountain, grow it huge, bowl through cheering crowds and chain big-air combos, then ride it all the way back up. Co-op physics comedy for two, online or on one PC, or solo with a stick per penguin.

details.title: Bin There
details.short_description: sneak out at night, dig through the neighbours' bins for little treasures, trade them with a town of animal shopkeepers, and bring the good stuff home to make your den the coziest one on the block. a small cozy pixel game about trash critters.

details.title: Animal Chaos
details.short_description: Animal Chaos is a 2–5 player physics party game where oversized, round zoo animals run, roll, fight, race, and try to escape. Work together, panic in proximity voice chat, betray each other by accident, and survive the chaos.

details.title: Not Yet Recorded
details.short_description: A broadcast tape from 1955 is still warm. Rae Calloway, night host of a 1997 call-in show, falls asleep listening to it and wakes on the morning it was recorded. Take the calls, pin what the town says, and change what happened. Only she will remember.

details.title: YATAI: A STREET COOK'S TALE
details.short_description: Cook Japanese street food with your own hands: toss noodles in a wok, grill yakitori, fold gyoza. Start with a tiny cart by the station, feed the city through rain, snow and festivals, and work your way up from a humble stall to an elite restaurant.

name: Suddenly Meow Hidden Object: The Legendary Red Dot (Collector's Edition)

details.title: Suddenly Meow Hidden Object: The Legendary Red Dot (Collector's Edition)
details.short_description: Chasing lasers just got serious! Join Tim and Spooky on a hilarious Hidden Object adventure to catch the Legendary Red Dot and save the house from total cat-astrophe!

name: Cozy Cans: Tidy Up The Energy Drinks!

details.title: Cozy Cans: Tidy Up The Energy Drinks!
details.short_description: Cozy Cans is a single-player clean-up game. Search, sort and stack 6,911 colourful carbonated caffeine cans. Laugh at the parody drink brands as you put them back where they belong. From messy floor to neatly organised glory in one afternoon.

details.title: Formula Rogue
details.short_description: You don’t drive – you make the call. Racing manager meets roguelite deckbuilder: Command two drivers with radio cards through practice, qualifying and race. Gamble on tyres, react to rain and safety cars, and build a team dynasty across eras of new regulations.

details.title: It's Not Me
details.short_description: Become a nameless Princess inside an unfinished video game from 1986. Explore, interact and choose your responses in a narrative adventure about identity and self-determination, with nine chapters and four endings shaped by your choices.

details.title: Mulligan Mayhem
details.short_description: Golf, but the course is cursed. Tee off in peace, then fight the undead horde that wakes the moment your ball lands. Launch zombies with your driver, bowl them into each other and knock them into water hazards, with up to 4 players in couch or online co-op.

details.title: Dead Apples Dream
details.short_description: The hitchhiker who went missing playing the "Dead Apples Dare"...it turns out she recorded a second tape. Tranquil green spaces change to dark corridors...it's like she's stuck in a dream...or nightmare. Watch to the end to solve the mystery...and remember to leave room for pie.

details.title: Bloomsgrove
details.short_description: Bloomsgrove is a short incremental game about a ghost in a forgotten tomb overgrown with plants. Tend to your grave by harvesting various weeds and plants while uncovering memories of who you once were.

details.title: Puppetria
details.short_description: A slightly unusual tea party in an old mansion. As you serve tea and sweets, teapots begin to dance and little ghosts appear... Your job is to quietly smooth over the mansion's lively welcome. Keep an eye on each new surprise and make sure the tea party stays elegant until the very end.

details.title: Driving At Night
details.short_description: Et la ville Ses lumières qui défilent Comme des phares dans l'espace Et nos peurs Ont des airs d'espoir Vues à travers la glace

details.title: SilentCordon
details.short_description: SilentCordon is a 3D top-down tactical shooter. Enter a city under lockdown, alone or in 2–4 player co-op, to find your missing sister. Scout enemy positions, use cover and tactical gear, and complete rescue and escort missions. Face off against other players in deathmatch and bomb defusal.

details.title: Railmorrow
details.short_description: A first-person life and travel simulator set in an open world. Begin your journey in Tikhorechye: buy tickets, explore 20 stations, ride trains and buses, trade between cities, work, and buy cars and houses. Where will you go next?

details.title: Rush 60 Seconds
details.short_description: Innovating on the vampire survivor-like game type, instead of slowly spawning monsters endlessly, all monsters are generated at once on a large map. Within 60 seconds, the more monsters you kill, the more rewards you get.

details.title: Looooong Trip
details.short_description: Loooong trip is a physics-based co-op sandbox adventure for 1–4 players! Drive, loot, crash, upgrade your car, and cause absolute chaos on your way to Vegas.

details.title: Bloodrights
details.short_description: An unknown disease has wiped out half of the city's population. The main characters managed to survive the outbreak. However, it's not as if everything went without consequences

details.title: Márgalo
details.short_description: A first-person psychological survival horror adventure. Explore surreal liminal spaces, solve puzzles, and uncover what the true nightmare really is: your dreams or reality?

details.title: KINGDOM ROAD
details.short_description: You fall asleep after work with your bugs unfixed, and wake up inside your own game. Build a deck from the Summon Cards you created, and turn the tide of real-time battles with tower placement and well-timed hero summons.

details.title: 汉末霸业·再起
details.short_description: 《汉末霸业·再起》是《汉末霸业》制作组全新打造的2D大型三国策略游戏。玩家将扮演一方君主，在辽阔的汉末百郡大地图上纵横征伐、逐鹿天下。游戏融合战略战斗、城池建设与内政经营，并通过城内NPC互动还原汉末城镇风貌。在传承《汉末》经典的基础上，进一步拓展战略地图与玩法体系，带来更加丰富的三国历史模拟体验。

details.title: Archive Protocol
details.short_description: Fight, build and preserve what remains. VEIGLER: Archive Protocol combines top-down action roguelite combat with base building and tower defense. Expand your Signal Network, defend the Broadcast Core and recover lost Archive data before you extract.

details.title: Necrosurge
details.short_description: A roguelite reverse tower defense game. You are the necromancer, and for once the Inquisition has to defend. Before each raid you set up your horde on the battlefield. Then your undead march, and the fortress strikes back. Between raids, you cross the campaign map towards boons, events and bosses.

details.title: The Last Expedition
details.short_description: A co-op survival horror expedition through a silent 1936 countryside. Crew a colossal land crawler, scavenge fuel, food and ammunition, keep the machine alive and survive the infected as you carry a living captive north. Every noise you make draws them closer.

details.title: Kingdom's Worst Mediator
details.short_description: Win debates instead of battles! A cozy fantasy visual novel. Meet quirky characters, learn rules to craft perfect responses, turn opponents' arguments against them, and settle absurd disputes you never should have gotten involved in. Do your job right... or see the kingdom suffer the consequences.

details.title: Crytter Crawlers
details.short_description: Crytter Crawlers is a 2.5d Creature-Collecting Bullet-Heaven Deckbuilding Roguelike where YOU play as Cryptids! Find dozens of Crytters! GROW your Crytters into several stronger forms, earn new weapons, discover new upgrades, and fight back against a multitude of post-apocalyptic threats!

details.title: Ragequit Royale
details.short_description: Dice luck meets ruthless card sabotage! Choose your fantasy miniature, steal played cards and send your rivals backwards. In Ragequit Royale, reaching the finish takes more than a lucky roll.

details.title: Deadly Bloodline
details.short_description: Survive the horrors of Angel Hill as James K. Sam and his family. As they struggle to escape the city, they must face murderous demons and fight for their lives! In this pixel art survival horror adventure, will you help James and his family make it out of Angel Hill alive?

name: ロロりんご♪－オオカミさんと、おとぎのパズル－

details.title: ロロりんご♪－オオカミさんと、おとぎのパズル－
details.short_description: Make music with apples in a world of fairy tales. Connect different kinds of apples with a single stroke to create chains and complete challenges. Play puzzles like little pieces of sheet music, and wander through familiar stories. But something is strange… the characters are turning into wolves…?

details.title: Alchemist
details.short_description: Alchemist is a re-playable narrative game which puts you in the shoes of an Alchemist in a medieval fantasy world. Craft potions, earn Tarot Cards, and seek knowledge, taking what you learn into the next playthrough to unlock hidden secrets.

details.title: Islands Collide
details.short_description: Islands Collide is a bullet-heaven roguelite about ramming islands. Crash into other islands to weld them on for good, clear whoever lives there, and grow bigger with every crash, until the sea raises a living continent to swallow you.

details.title: Order Of The Jarl
details.short_description: Answer the Jarl's summons and wield magic and blades in shifting dungeons to rescue the Right Hand from the Archdruid. In this first-person dungeon crawler, delve into '90s-inspired combat, loot items, face strange creatures, and unforeseen danger in a roguelike world where death = starting over.

details.title: Fleeting Light
details.short_description: Fleeting Light is a speedrun platformer. Racing through dark and gloomy cities, cut off from the Selfish Sun's light, across 50+ short, dopamine-fueled courses. Beat levels. Then beat your best time. Then crush everyone else's.

details.title: PEAK MALE FANTASY
details.short_description: Horde-survival action RPG with 1-4 player online co-op. Thousands of monsters on screen, heavy gore, massive bosses. Collect loot, socket gems, upgrade your gear and skills. All progression is persistent: every run makes you stronger. How long can you survive?

details.title: Your Complaint Has Been Received
details.short_description: A story-driven adventure about municipal maintenance. The pipes leak, the van's broken down, and you're the new boss. Explore courtyards and offices, deal with residents and coworkers, and choose how to solve their problems.

details.title: Veilreach
details.short_description: Descend into The Lost Temples of Veilreach, a roguelike deckbuilder where OSR dungeon crawling meets tactical poker-hand synergies. Master unique abilities and talents, and build a powerful deck to survive dungeons where every choice has a brutal consequence.

details.title: Vacancy: Hotel Inspection Simulator
details.short_description: Every room needs your approval. Inspect hotel rooms and a presidential suite, uncover overlooked faults, photograph the evidence, and decide what happens next. Clear it for guests, send housekeeping, call maintenance, or close the room.

details.title: Because It's There
details.short_description: An engineering/survival game where you summit the tallest mountain in a vast, uncharted world. For the journey, carefully construct flying wooden bases with realistic structural failures. Brave thunderstorms, freezing temperatures, bears and wolves. Answer the call of the untamed wilderness.

details.title: I’m Not a Witch
details.short_description: 《I Am Not a Witch》is a narrative-driven adventure game. You play as a herbalist living under an assumed name, evading witch hunts. Every potion, piece of intelligence and favour you hold is a bargaining chip to buy another day of survival.

details.title: Gold Dredge Simulator
details.short_description: Build your own dredging operation, explore abandoned dredges, recover valuable parts, bring your machinery back to life, and expand operations in your hunt for gold rush. Play solo or team up with friends and see how far your gold rush can take you.

details.title: Grand Fantasy Empires
details.short_description: A Grand Strategy Game with Real Time Battles.

name: Medieval Farm Simulator: Co-Op Farming, Harvesting & Building

details.title: Medieval Farm Simulator: Co-Op Farming, Harvesting & Building
details.short_description: Embrace the hands-on age of farming and go from rags to riches! Alone or in up to four-player co-op, cultivate land, grow, harvest and process crops. Head to the local marketplace to sell produce and earn coin! Can you build your dream medieval farm? Farm. Harvest. Sell. Build.

details.title: Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity
details.short_description: "Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity" is a Time-loop horror RTA stealth action adventure Game, Seira steps into the school at midnight to which seven mysteries and the brutal curse of the cursed doll, Aya await her there, Break free from this inescapable loop of death and escape this night of terror.

details.title: RITZEN
details.short_description: A brutal retro horde shooter set in a ritualistic world. Fight endless undead, uncover secrets, complete objectives, and face terrifying bosses - alone or in co-op.

details.title: Blunder Construction
details.short_description: Master the occult art of block stacking in this chaotic physics blockbuilder. Discover and combine forbidden magicks to find the most brilliant and deranged build styles. Push your luck to build the tallest, grandest monuments. Impress the king... or else.

details.title: Sticky Note Battles
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you battle your coworkers with sticky notes. Collect notes and rearrange your board against the clock to outsmart your opponents. Fight your way to the top and overthrow your corporate overlords.

details.title: Tiny Car Co.
details.short_description: A cozy car-flipping and management sim with charming chibi cars. Buy bargains, repair and customize them, then negotiate the perfect sale. Upgrade your garage, decorate your showroom and grow a tiny used-car lot into a thriving dealership at your own pace.

details.title: Ranchonauts
details.short_description: A slapstick co-op game about herding alien sheep across a dangerous frontier. Work solo or with up to 5 friends to keep your flock together through physics-fueled disasters, pay off your ship-repair debt, and get home in one piece.

details.title: Autobrawl Arena
details.short_description: BUILD A TEAM of autonomous nanobots from countless parts. COMBINE DNA to arm them with hybrid bioweapons. WATCH THEM FIGHT FOR YOU against rival teams in an ever-changing microscopic arena. Sign sponsors, defend towers, place bets, and win the grand tournament!

details.title: Late Night Check-In
details.short_description: A psychological horror game where you work the night shift as a hotel receptionist. Welcome uncanny guests, prepare delicious drinks to fulfill room-service requests, and watch your peaceful night job slowly turn into a living nightmare.

details.title: Countryside Big Catch
details.short_description: Our protagonist moves to a countryside island. Here, the rent is free as long as you can fish. On this mysterious little island, a good hand with a rod is all it takes to make all his wishes come true.
developers: サークル☆フェアリーフラワー

details.title: Puddle Pond: Mouse Fishing
details.short_description: Chat, explore, and relax in a cute and colorful fishing spot with your fellow mice. Earn pumpkin seeds to buy better gear and catch more exotic fish, or unlock deeper customization for your mouse. Show off your catches to your friends, and otherwise enjoy a cozy social experience.

details.title: Under One Roof
details.short_description: Under One Roof is a pixel-art apartment management sim. Furnish rooms, welcome tenants, collect rent, and help them grow. Watch them build careers, make friends, fall in love, and start families as you create your dream apartment, grow a lively community, and follow stories across generations.

details.title: Dokapon Kingdom: Connect 2
details.short_description: An all-new entry in the Dokapon series, the RPG-style board game you can enjoy with up to four players! Take on gigantic monsters together, and create your very own hero with the Character Creation system! Friendship or betrayal? Money or power? Sacrifice your friendships and seize victory!

details.title: The Dust Remembers
details.short_description: A fallen world. On the wasteland, survival is all that matters. You walked alone—until you met them. Together or against, Trust or doubt, Closer or apart. Every choice leaves a mark, changing the story and your ending. Your decisions define this journey.

details.title: TENEGRAD
details.short_description: You have a new job. There’s only you, concrete megastructures, snow and cold. Deliver cargo, maintain the base, repair vehicles, explore. Just don't stare into the dark for too long and always lock the doors.

details.title: Marginalia
details.short_description: Read the shared action order, move one unit at a time, and bring your expedition home alive in a hex-grid tactical SRPG.

details.title: MARY - メアリ姫の奪還
details.short_description: Add a single letter to a choice in this text adventure. Follow the original path, turn the odds in your favor, or create a completely ridiculous outcome. Shape the story with just one letter. *Japanese language only.

details.title: Things Left Unsaid
details.short_description: A tiny, cozy, hand-drawn ASMR game. Every antique arrives in loose pieces: click them back together, brush away the dust, trace the cracks in gold lacquer, and press the wax seal. Then haggle with quirky collectors at your counter. Each piece holds a story left unsaid.

details.title: PIO: A Robot’s Story
details.short_description: PIO: A Robot's Story is a story-driven action-adventure with Souls-lite combat. Journey from the retrofuturistic streets of Moscow to the remote islands of the North Pacific, where every battle, discovery, and step brings you closer to a truth that could change everything.

details.title: Hatched
details.short_description: Run. Fight. Eat. Repeat. In this creature evolution roguelite. Hunt with 100+ abilities and run-altering relics, pick your element and exploit theirs, every boss you beat evolves your body. Twenty minutes, one life, a different creature every run!

details.title: 银茧 Argent Cocoon
details.short_description: Humanity has fallen, the ruins a breeding ground for the Insecta. Through the Argent Cocoon, they rewrite genes. Evolution is the unquestioned law. You, a gifted Eularva, are meant to surrender your soul to the Great Collective Consciousness. But exploring deeper, you question that destiny.

details.title: Ringwyrm
details.short_description: Ringwyrm is an immersive action horror game with survival elements. Explore a nonlinear interconnected world, meet a large cast of memorable characters, slay a huge cast of sickly monstrosities and avoid myriad diseases and ailments.

details.title: MOLTYN
details.short_description: MOLTYN: Superhero destruction sandbox where every pixel is simulated: rock, water, lava, ice and metal melt, flood, freeze and collapse for real. Every power of the earth, 18 missions, kaiju fights, free-play worlds and CREATE, a level editor with level sharing. Early Access 12 Nov 2026.

details.title: Grampage: Life at 67
details.short_description: YOUR RETIREMENT ISN’T GOING TO FUND ITSELF! Pension not cutting it? No problem. Grab up to three fellow retirees, pull off outrageous heists, and steal your way to the retirement you deserve. Work together when you have to, but remember: only one of you gets to retire!

details.title: CONQ: CROWN OF NO QUARTER
details.short_description: You were promised the heavens, but found only eternal purgatory -- unable to escape, unable to truly die. Gather your forces across sea and land, show no mercy, and give your enemies no quarter. It's time to bleed again.

details.title: Gods of Pegana
details.short_description: A single-player pixel-art CRPG that feels like an MMORPG. Party with digital "Simmy" companions who level-up, find gear, and specialize on their own. Master tactical ATB combat, quest, run your guild, respond to world events, and hunt deep loot across the cosmic-fantasy world of the Gods of Pegana.

details.title: Burger Shooter
details.short_description: Your burger was stolen. Now everyone pays. Dash through fast-paced retro-inspired levels, chain kills to survive, unlock new weapons and upgrades, battle dangerous mafia enemies, and fight your way to the final boss in this adrenaline-fueled FPS.

details.title: AROTA - Tire God
details.short_description: My friends and I grew up as simple creatures. See round object. See hill. Must roll object down hill. The first time we let it roll, we had only one thought: We need a bigger hill. If you are like us, you'll find yourself cheering for a tire to go just a little further.

details.title: Giantess Naval Defense
details.short_description: Giantess Naval Defense is a “Giant Girl vs. Kaiju Naval Artillery Defense Game” where you control Orca, the only giant beast humanity can rely on, and fight back against hordes of invading kaiju with devastating naval gunfire.

details.title: Cardboard Gladiators
details.short_description: A PvPvE inventory management autobattler with asynchronous multiplayer! Build a team of gladiators, craft and equip powerful items, discover game-breaking synergies, and outsmart opponents with clever battleplans.

details.title: Delta Neutral
details.short_description: The top-down space sim. Fly, trade, and fight in a galaxy shaped by history, where production, freight, and war reshape a living economy.

name: Chat, Should We Head Over There?

details.title: Chat, Should We Head Over There?
details.short_description: An extraction roguelite where you're not the player, you're a viewer. SIA, a rookie streamer with ten subscribers, heads into the Backrooms to grow her channel. Tell her where to go, what to grab and when to leave. Only what she carries out alive is hers. Use it to make her stronger and go deeper.

details.title: Elf Shift
details.short_description: Only 4 real time days left until Christmas. Flawlessly pack 10,000 toys, unlock new products, and improve your skills to speed up the production line. Deliver the boxes on time, don't get too curious about the weird things happening around you, and most importantly... do not anger Santa.

details.title: Tairum
details.short_description: Slash, ram and blast through waves of corporate cops, goons, drones and mechs in this top-down cyberpunk arena auto-shooter roguelite. Pick your route and cut risky deals. Hunt smuggler's caches to fill 5 ability slots. Augment your operatives and upgrade your hideout. Solo or 2-player local co-op.

details.title: Run Friend Run
details.short_description: A party game for 1–8 players where one races to the finish and everyone else tries to stop them! Hide traps where your friends least expect them, then send them flying when they get close.

details.title: Count My Coins, Coin Counter!
details.short_description: Count coins with a cast of silly characters as you add up currencies, convert their money, appraise jewels, and pick out forgeries.

details.title: Last Ditch Effort
details.short_description: Enter a grimdark world consumed by endless war and join Igor on a desperate mission in Last-Ditch Effort, a pixel-art character-action game featuring fast-paced combat, handcrafted animation and stylized comic-book storytelling.

details.title: Burn It Back
details.short_description: A survival RTS in a frozen taiga. Settle the surface for the bunker below, meet its quotas, and every night burn back a living tissue that grows, adapts and remembers.

details.title: Capital City
details.short_description: Capital City combines city, resource, and transport management within an infinite steampunk fantasy world. Mine resources, build factories and logistics networks. Transport raw and processed materials and goods to your city to ensure it keeps growing and expanding.

details.title: Spur of Life
details.short_description: You’ve woken into a world that wants you slaughtered. No weapons. No combat. Escape the oppressive, liminal space that doesn't want you, as things that shouldn’t be there hunt you from the dark.

details.title: Magna Conquest
details.short_description: Lead a kingdom in a real-time medieval fantasy grand strategy where the campaign world and battles unfold simultaneously. Command armies of up to 100,000 units while shaping your realm through diplomacy, kingdom management, research, and legendary heroes in single-player or campaign multiplayer.

details.title: Dwarven Digging Machine
details.short_description: Command dwarves as they build a huge dwarven digging machine. Harvest resources, find powerful artifacts, defend against your foes and conquer the underground in this incremental strategy game.

details.title: 灵魂甜品 Soulcake
details.short_description: Soulcake: A fantasy‑romance AVG with yuri (LGBTQ+) & female-dominant dynamics. As the female lead, you can travel into others’ minds, gather ingredients to bake desserts filled with emotions. People come to you with their secrets. Forge bonds with them and…uncover the truth behind your ability.
developers: 自己的房间  Room of One's Own
publishers: 自己的房间  Room of One's Own

details.title: Company Captain: Westashes
details.short_description: You are the captain of a free company... one among many roaming this mercenary world, growing, falling, earning and betraying just as you do. The world will not bend for you, nor wait: the other companies are already writing their stories. Yours will be decided in steel, gold and a name.

details.title: Babelled
details.short_description: Build your way back to space in BABELLED, a co-op tower-building adventure. Stranded on a strange planet, scavenge BABELBLOCKS and stack a path to your spaceship. You and your fellow BABELBOTS must leverage all of their BABELTECH to brave strange sky biomes and build a tower to the heavens.

details.title: DABA Land of Water Scar
details.short_description: Clayman, the world in your hands. God, savior, or destroyer. Choose, and pay the price.

details.title: Hunger Lane
details.short_description: A story-driven horror platformer about a boy uncovering the secrets of a quiet city where monsters hunt humans after dark. Will you discover what lies behind the disappearances before it finds you?

details.title: The Last Raccoon
details.short_description: Survive as a raccoon in an abandoned mansion filled with zombies. Solve puzzles inspired by dark fairy tales and explore to uncover whether the world is worth saving.

details.title: Fishing Girl's Fantasy
details.short_description: In an enchanting and mystical world, a healing and delightful adventure awaits! Welcome to Fishing Girl's Fantasy, a casual game that seamlessly combines exploration, fishing, and restaurant management. Immerse yourself in this fantastical experience filled with wonder and charm.

details.title: Rebounder
details.short_description: Nail the run. Deliver your line. Rebounder is a hand-crafted precision platformer about a roughneck worker recruited for a hazardous job on a distant planet. A tough-but-fair gauntlet set in a surreal comic-book world of ink, paper, and print.

details.title: Exile 2097: Space Odyssey
details.short_description: Exile 2097: Space Odyssey is a near-future hard sci-fi epic. Lead the Human Continuity Government, build solar-system colonies, upgrade space stations, shape society, uncover the AI rebellion threat, and guide humanity’s final return to Earth amid unknown dangers.

details.title: Frame of Suffering
details.short_description: Master both man and machine to escape the Ancient Temple. Customize your Hero and a modifiable Combat Frame to slay hordes and gatekeepers. Scavenge tech, uncover the Temple's history, and evolve your build in this Sci-Fi Action RPG. You're a prisoner - freedom lies at the heart of the Temple.

details.title: Tricolore: Learn French
details.short_description: Learn French at every level in a cozy, illustrated adventure. Explore 8,000 verbs, 2,000 grammar exercises and everyday conversations. Discover French classics, history and exam practice. Build your listening, speaking, reading and writing skills. Fully offline.

details.title: Buns and Poops
details.short_description: A poop-collecting sim that turns your entire desktop into a bunny playground. Over 80 pixel-art bunnies hop across your screen as you work, settle into loaves, flop over, and leave poops behind. Trade the poops you collect for furniture and treats to make life with the bunnies even cozier.

details.title: Open Daily in NYC
details.short_description: Gloria is off to mind her grandkids, so the old shop is yours. How you make each coffee and run the kitchen decides who walks in, as strangers become regulars whose New York lives you uncover. Neighborhood shop, city hotspot, or a chain? Or skip work and buy what real life never let you afford!

details.title: CENTAVO
details.short_description: A city sim where money never comes from nowhere. Tens of thousands of residents, each with a name, a job and a pocket. You lay the streets, zone and set taxes; they buy the lots, open businesses and leave if work or food runs out. Grow a camp into a metropolis.

details.title: Cursor Quest
details.short_description: Cursor Quest is an action RPG where your mouse cursor is the character. Swing weapons with your movement, dodge attacks, gather resources, train skills, craft gear, explore dungeons, and grow your cursor into a fantasy hero.

details.title: Daylight Line
details.short_description: Daylight Line is a single-player card roguelite mixing three-person deckbuilding and city life. Take agency jobs with companions, explore changing zones, learn skills, and investigate anomalies around the city. Between investigations, return to Daylight City to run your shop and share everyday life.

details.title: The Oink
details.short_description: A thriller about free will. Perform the daily livestock slaughter, find ways to escape, or try to uncover the truth. FORGET AND OBEY ███████

details.title: Survival Repacker
