details.short_description: Leave the combat and survival struggle to those outside. Inside is a stress-free sanctuary. Tactile gear repair, meditative loot sorting, and packing kits for survivors. The cozy antithesis to hardcore survival games.

details.title: 战国立志传
details.short_description: 《Warring States:Path of Power》 is a role-playing game set in ancient China’s Warring States period. Play as a historical figure and experience their story, or create your own character and begin life as an ordinary person.

details.title: Don't Give Up, Pal
details.short_description: So she won't die. So she won't break. So she can live just a little longer. I push her forward. Don't Give Up, Pal is a combat simulation where you upgrade and deploy, again and again.

details.title: Stick Desktop Expedition
details.short_description: A cozy desktop idle RPG where your stickman squad auto-battles! Train your companions, choose their weapons and skills, build your camp, and send them on adventures while you work or relax.

details.title: Totally Invited: Party Heist Simulator
details.short_description: Crash parties, blend in with guests, and escape with the valuables in this co-op stealth heist simulator. Then clean up your haul, stock your shop, and set your prices. Turn stolen goods into a growing business, fund your next heist, and watch out for thieves. Apparently, everyone has the same idea.

name: Unidentified Frying Objects: Idle Cafe Empire

details.title: Unidentified Frying Objects: Idle Cafe Empire
details.short_description: Run a cafe for hungry aliens with no taste. Invent terrible recipes, automate your kitchen, play the galactic stock market, feed a black hole, and relocate across the stars to cook the legendary Omni-Meal. A quirky idle game with a news ticker that never stops.

details.title: Driftholm
details.short_description: Explore a sandbox survival world alongside your walking home. Fight enemies, defeat bosses, and use the materials you discover to craft walker upgrades that let you reach new biomes.

details.title: Dread Omen
details.short_description: 1980. Arkham, Massachusetts. A once-peaceful town has been engulfed by an inexplicable catastrophe. Monstrous creatures roam its streets, and the familiar world is gradually giving way to something alien and incomprehensible. As Detective Arthur Sullivan, you must find your son Henry.

details.title: Dream Dwelling
details.short_description: Your aunt is gone, leaving you a cottage and a big debt. Little by little, paint it pink, add a desk by the window and pair furniture into Combos for maximum Charm. Then sell it as someone's dream home. Build houses, open shops and unwind in Dream Dwelling!

details.title: Auction Simulator
details.short_description: Build an auction career where every bid is a tell. Buy, research and sell valuable objects, read rivals in poker-inspired psychological auctions, build collections, run your own auction house, or become a dealer in the dark market. Every bid is information. Every object could be an opportunity.

details.title: Rage and Fury
details.short_description: Rage and Fury is a fast-paced 2D beat ’em up built like a lost ’90s action movie. Fight through the streets, unleash devastating combos, turn the environment into a weapon, and follow Logan Hunter through a cinematic story packed with action, attitude and humor.

details.title: Feet in Food
details.short_description: What could possibly be better than food? That’s right! Feet in food! LOTS OF FEET! Create food arrangements around the girls, then wash their feet clean of all the food and sauces afterward. You wouldn’t want them to stay dirty, would you?

details.title: Altstadt
details.short_description: A tiny old town that grows under your hands. Set down a house, then another, let a canal wander through, and stay for dusk, when the windows light up one by one. Nothing to manage. Just building.

details.title: Outblight
details.short_description: "Nothing down there is what the stories say." A turn-based clash roguelite where you operate skills against the enemy's in queue and manipulate of it's order. Between of catastrophe of the dying world, there lives Kirs, who is looking for creatures of the abyss in order to survive

name: Zombie Wrap Simulator: Grill the Dead

details.title: Zombie Wrap Simulator: Grill the Dead
details.short_description: The apocalypse continues, and survivors still need to eat. In Zombie Wrap Simulator you run a kebab shop serving fresh veggies, smooth sauces and… questionable meat. Grill meals, deliver food to shelters and defend your place at night from furious Zomboners.

details.title: CD-R Racing
details.short_description: CD-R Racing is a love letter to the racing games of the 90s - a time portal to the rave music, the aesthetics, the vibes and the joy. Conquer all corners of this PS1-inspired world as you race to collect CD-R discs with bangin hot rave tunes. BPM = MPH

details.title: The Deposition
details.short_description: The Deposition is a story-driven visual novel with fantasy elements, set in a fully fictional world inspired by the European Renaissance. You will follow Fascino, a young man of humble birth. Read the story, make your choices, and uncover the hidden side of the sacred order.
publishers: 北京皓凛科技有限公司

details.title: Dragonwynde
details.short_description: You are a dragon hatchling who can't fly in the beginning. Belly-slide down mountain slopes, stretch each glide a little further, and teach yourself the sky. Explore a cozy, handcrafted world with no combat and no death. Just mountains, water, berries, and the joy of becoming a dragon.

details.title: Traffic Check
details.short_description: An arcade racer where traffic is your weapon. Slam cars into each other, drift, boost and keep scoring even after you crash. Every map is procedurally generated, with new highways, biomes, towns and back roads to tear through, solo or up to 4-player splitscreen. Never stop burning

details.title: Raid Haven
details.short_description: Build your haven and fortify it to withstand 100 waves of increasingly dangerous raids. Strategically place walls, traps, turrets, and defences, equip your pawns with powerful weapons and armour, and adapt your base as each wave pushes you closer to the breaking point.

details.title: Category Connections
details.short_description: Category Connections is a chill puzzle game where you sort 3,000 things into 100 categories. No timers, no stress, just a big grid of things for you to organize. Perfect for a rainy afternoon.

details.title: THE GROUNDSKEEPER
details.short_description: A simulation-horror game where you power wash and restore a haunted tourist attraction by night, capture terrifying paranormal evidence and post it online for viral hype. By day, you set ticket prices for the tourists and use the profits to upgrade gear and keep the attraction running profitably.

details.title: The Stars Are Never Still
details.short_description: The Stars Are Never Still is a 2D space sandbox. Shape a galaxy and watch 16 unique races colonize, trade, ally, betray and wage war. Observe, or intervene with technology, aid, discord, disasters, new life—even black holes. Chronicle millennia of history. No set goals. No empire lasts forever.

details.title: How to Chemistry
details.short_description: How to Chemistry is a first-person co-op chemistry simulator, where you run your own lab with no safety regulations. Get an order, use your chemistry skills and deliver.

details.title: Envido
details.short_description: Grab your cards, play against wandering souls, unlock items at the pub and win all the matches to survive. Scheme your plays, perfect your bluffs and make strategic decisions based on your macumbas. Your match against Mandinga is about to begin!

details.title: Rocksowers
details.short_description: Co-op Survival Sandbox meets Bullet Hell. Explore the corrupted surface on a moving base, scavenge for resources and craft GAME-BREAKING weapons using many unique modules to defeat ever-stronger foes. Fight to reclaim what The Bloom took from humanity!

details.title: TERRORSTORM: Ground Zero
details.short_description: TERRORSTORM is a single-player FPS action-horror game with Soulslike-inspired combat. Survive brutal, high-stakes encounters against dangerous and terrifying foes, uncover dark secrets and bring down horrific underground crime ring. Resident Evil tension meets Dark Souls punishment.

details.title: Brush Burial: Bruiseland
details.short_description: You are a hunter of men, and your quarry is numerous, armed, and afraid. Bind and break them. This is a first-person immersive sim with tightly interconnected environments, sleek and sadistic melee combat, and over a hundred cosmetics to unlock.

details.title: Dubai Chewy Cookie Simulator
details.short_description: You opened a little dessert café, and now the line runs down the street! Make Dubai chewy cookies by hand, ring up every order, and run the whole place on your own in this hectic first-person management sim set in a Korean university neighborhood.

details.title: Patchland
details.short_description: Patchland is a relaxing strategy game where you create your own world by building it from scratch using tiles. Connect various biomes, earn points, complete quests, and add animals to the map to create increasingly larger and more beautiful landscapes.

details.title: Bloodfell
details.short_description: Tear through Hell with devastating weapon and spell builds in this gothic action roguelite. Hunt powerful loot across five procedural biomes, risk another floor, and rebuild Ashenhold for your next descent.

details.title: Dream Fishing
details.short_description: Explore atmospheric dream worlds and catch strange fish. Uncover secrets that have been submerged.

details.title: Mighty Tiny Railways
details.short_description: Build a steam railway where the network you build determines how it operates. Deliver cargo and passengers on time, grow towns and industries, and optimize your network. Invite a friend to build together in online co-op.

details.title: Alight
details.short_description: Photograph birds, decorate your lighthouse, and find companionable peace in Alight, a heartfelt cozy adventure about aging and absence

details.title: A-01's Voyage.Logs
details.short_description: 人类已经死去。一个在宇宙里漂流的人工智能，在无法自杀的绝对清醒中，咀嚼庞大而无处安放的算力，独自面对整个宇宙的衰亡。

details.title: Dungeon4X
details.short_description: "Dungeon4X" is a new type of game that combines 3D dungeon RPG with 4X strategy. As the guild master of an adventurer's guild, you will lead the construction of farms and workshops, build a financial base by selling products, and embark on a grand adventure to obtain the ultimate artifact!

details.title: Sovereign's Enigma
details.short_description: Explore a vast underground world in a 2D side-scrolling survival adventure. Find survivors, build a team, and battle powerful bosses in the ruins of a forgotten civilization. Uncover the truth behind the Sovereign's Enigma.

details.title: Let Us Cook
details.short_description: A chaotic physics-based co-op cooking game for up to 4 players. Scavenge ingredients, mash them together by hand, and race to feed an ever-hungry volcano before it feeds on you instead.

details.title: Battle Quads
details.short_description: Command a squad of six specialists in explosive 4v4 multiplayer battles. Make real-time tactical decisions as a commander, or take direct control of any specialist at critical moments.

details.title: Holod
details.short_description: You are an American spy. But cold and hunger don’t care who you are. Maintain a Soviet polar station, analyze samples and venture into uncharted Antarctica. Master the work of a polar researcher to survive. And keep your cover — the KGB is always watching.

details.title: Dry Jerky
details.short_description: You owe $100 in rent. You have $10. You have 5 days. Dry Jerky is a survival RPG set in Oasis, a desert city with a rat problem, a shady snack industry, and a cast of characters you probably shouldn't trust. Find work, make questionable decisions, and try not to starve before the landlord shows up.

details.title: Carbon Rain
details.short_description: Explore a beautiful yet dangerous post-apocalyptic pixel-art world. Step out of your bunker, battle mutated creatures, gather resources, upgrade your oxygen reserves and weapons, and push deeper into new, increasingly dangerous biomes.

details.title: FROM THE DUGOUT
details.short_description: Manage your team to glory in this text-based football manager. Win trophies, master the transfer market, and live the life of a real coach. Balance locker room egos, manage your personal wealth, and work your way up to buying your own club. Your life off the pitch matters!

details.title: Anvil United!
details.short_description: Anvil United! is a action-adventure for up to four players focused on crafting, management and skill. Gather materials, follow recipes, avoid hazards, optimize and manage your team. Become a legendary blacksmith and save the Kingdom!

details.title: A Simple job 2
details.short_description: 💼 One simple task. Countless choices. But what if your job was never the real objective? 😏 Experience absurd humor, discover bizarre endings, unlock achievements, and uncover what's really hiding behind it all.

details.title: Creara Select
details.short_description: Creara is a spider woman with eight distinct personalities, held captive in a military facility. Investigate her biology over seven days and choose her fate in this biological-investigation romance adventure.

details.title: Nightshift Remastered
details.short_description: Welcome to the Nightshift! Spend six nights at a totally normal office job in this branching narrative. Bond with your dayshift coworker, uncover fantastical mysteries, and experience unexpected transformations. With an optional card game and plenty of endings, what will you make of your time here?

details.title: More BrainZ
details.short_description: You lost your job and your home. All that's left is an old camper... until the zombie apocalypse turns your rock bottom into humanity's last nightmare. After isolation, depression, and anxiety, you decide to Survive. Scavenge. Fight. (¬ ´ཀ` )¬

details.title: King of the School
details.short_description: A transfer student with amnesia arrives at Myeongcheong High. Beneath its peaceful days lies a brutal night power struggle of bullies, gangsters, and corrupt elites. Uncover lost memories to unlock skills and fight the dynamic evil. Stand by, or conquer this brutal ecosystem?

details.title: Synemancy
details.short_description: Sling spells to overwhelm your opponents in card-based online duels, or immerse in a deep single-player story about the pursuit of knowledge and power, where every choice matters. Stake your very mind and become a Synemancer!

details.title: Drowned Echo
details.short_description: Drowned Echo is a narrative-driven VR horror experience in which you explore a sunken ship, using your hands to swim, interact with tools, and uncover a Lovecraftian presence that is corrupting the environment.

details.title: Boungeon
details.short_description: A block-breaker-inspired roguelite deckbuilder where you blast enemies with bouncing magical projectiles. Combine projectiles, skills, and relics to create your own strategy and conquer the dungeon.

details.title: The Obsessive Shadow: Former Residents
details.short_description: The Obsessive Shadow is lurking... In this 2D Horror Narrative, Uncover the story of what happened to the former residents of Old Diamond Drive... A once thriving community later left abandoned and in ruin. Face what's in the shadows and stay alert... You are being watched at every turn, IT IS HERE.

details.title: Schnudergoof
details.short_description: Figure out the demonic secrets of MANA – A freakish phone that has fallen into your hands. Can you make it through the Upper Echelon? Solve riddles from fallen angels, cyber with demons on GRINDAER and choose well who you are talking to. Do you believe: if I can eat god, god has to exist?

details.title: TEST 5
details.short_description: Act as AIB Test 5, operate within a surreal virtual skyscraper, wield an extensive arsenal of weapons and gear, defeat hostiles, collect loot, and complete an infinite stream of test trials.

details.title: Hoppyscotch
details.short_description: Hoppyscotch: a puzzle game about frogs, and equity. Hop into the pond, and create accessible pathways to help get all your froggy friends home together. After all, nobody deserves to be left behind!

details.title: Kharvalen
details.short_description: Survive endless waves of enemies in Kharvalen. Choose a race, switch between two weapon sets, and combine manual attacks with auto-attacking artifacts to create devastating builds. Play solo, in co-op with up to 4 players, or in 1v1 and 2v2 PvP.

details.title: One Pop Planet
details.short_description: A Tetris-like puzzle game, played with a single button, and pieces that fall from all four directions. Match colourful pixel art pieces to feed your planet and hit the leaderboard, all while dealing with escalating speed, meteor storms, black holes, and more!

details.title: Duckbound
details.short_description: Welcome to Duckbound, a light-hearted turn-based RPG where mischief meets quackery.

details.title: Carmagist
details.short_description: Civilization vs. the Demon Lord?! Carmagist is a deck-building strategy game set in a ruined world where the Demon Lord has shattered civilization. Lead a nation on the brink of extinction and build up Tech, Funds, and Population to reclaim the future — every choice shapes your nation’s fate.

details.title: Dice'n'Go
details.short_description: Dice’n’Go is a chaotic multiplayer board game where luck starts the turn - but players decide how it ends. Sabotage your opponents, pull off clever ability combos, and turn terrible rolls into game-winning plays. Expect backstabs, dramatic comebacks, and last-turn twists.

name: Hollywood Hustle: A Prop Collector Simulator

details.title: Hollywood Hustle: A Prop Collector Simulator
details.short_description: A physics-driven cleanup simulator on an abandoned Hollywood studio. Fantasy epics, sitcoms, sci-fi blockbusters: their props ended up here. Sort it all, ship boxed orders to film sets and beyond, sell the rest, and resurrect the old animatronics to help.

details.title: Dark Watching Chapter 2
details.short_description: After crossing the bunker, you reach the shopping mall, but you quickly realize that there is even more of the virus there…

details.title: DRONES
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build the enemy's deck, not your own. In this physics-based auto battler, you choose which monsters invade and discard the ones you can't counter. Buy, equip, and position autonomous drones, then watch them fight. Find the synergies that save the solar system.

details.title: Spray Days
details.short_description: Paint, restore, and customize worn-out objects in this satisfying spray painting simulator. Complete quirky commissions, upgrade your tools, expand your workshop, and grow your restoration business - solo or with friends in online co-op!

details.title: HoraitoYugi
details.short_description: In the village of Horai, where autumn lasts forever, girls clash with swords and cards in a board game-style battle for up to four players. Master positioning, mind games, and tactical maneuvers to emerge victorious in this never-ending game.

details.title: Catriarch
details.short_description: Your subjects are dumpster cats. Your kingdom is an abandoned building in a human city. Your reign is threatened by dogs, fleas, collar bells, bad valerian harvests, fish-bone fortunes — and your own terrible decisions.

details.title: Perihelion
details.short_description: Master orbital combat and bend gravity to your advantage in this space combat roguelite. Launch from your carrier, tackle tactical missions, build crew relationships, and upgrade your ship between runs as you slowly unravel the mystery of a lost sister ship.

details.title: Surging Blood
details.short_description: A dark journey shaped by blood and alchemy. A FPS inspired by retro PS1 aesthetics, and a universe blending steampunk and victorian gothic. Will you uncover the fate of Cinderval?

details.title: 永恒地牢与刹那之恋
details.short_description: 《永恒地牢与刹那之恋》是基于AI实时推演的动态叙事AVG。在这个视觉小说内，输入你独一无二的选择生成新的世界线与游戏CG。

details.title: Space Hauler
details.short_description: Space Hauler is a space flight sim set around Saturn's largest moon, Titan. Fly your spacecraft using realistic aerodynamics and orbital mechanics, take on contracts, and build your career as a pilot-for-hire.

details.title: Chrysalis: Chrome Butterfly
details.short_description: Chrysalis: Chrome Butterfly is a neo-noir cyberpunk thriller. You play Wendy, an agent with gaps in her memory, investigating a disappearance in Neo-Kyoto. Fierce firefights give way to detective work — until it turns out reality itself is an illusion. But is the truth worth knowing?

details.title: Pray To The Darkness
details.short_description: Tread the path to redemption or cling to your past. Shape destinies or submit to strangers. New society. New secrets. New path. Pray To The Darkness is a narrative psychological horror exploring the complexity of human fate and the world around us.

details.title: Down We Go
details.short_description: A roguelite horror descent across the dimensions under the whim of a supercomputer planet; you are a delver, tasked with exploring, researching, and cataloging what you can find.

details.title: The Kingdoms of Ædloran
details.short_description: The Kingdoms of Ædloran is a 2D top-down pixel RPG. Explore a living open world, encounter strange and fantastic creatures, level up and learn new abilities, battle savage beasts and monstrous foes, delve deep into perilous dungeons, and claim legendary loot.

details.title: Claw & Order
details.short_description: Claw & Order is a roguelike autobattler where you recruit, arrange, and level up adorable cats whose abilities trigger off one another. Build game-breaking combos, deal millions of damage, and defeat larger-than-life bosses on your way to the grand finale!

details.title: Knight George
details.short_description: Knight George is a top-down retro-style action-adventure game. Travel across the Kingdom of Earlyne to meet friendly characters, explore numerous dungeons and fight terrifying monsters to save the kingdom!

details.title: Stray Night
details.short_description: Experience a puzzle-build roguelite hack-and-slash adventure. As a stray cat in a nightmare, strategically combine puzzle blocks to customize skills and defeat inner trauma. Overcome the walls of loneliness and discover your true identity through fast-paced combat and permanent progression.

details.title: ZeroPrompt
details.short_description: Every NPC in this game runs on a local LLM. Ask them anything. The internet is dying. You're a internet moderator. Filter out AI impostors from humanity's last clean network. Use investigation tools to detect deception. Every verdict shapes the internet.

details.title: TrainSim: Point & Call
details.short_description: Find the sweet spot between speed and precision as you step into the driver’s seat and run trains across cities and vast landscapes. The game focuses on authentic handling and time management, delivering a tight, goal-driven, fully immersive cab experience.

details.title: ROTETRA
details.short_description: ROTETRA is a twisted tetromino stacker where you spin the whole board and juggle multiple pieces at once!

details.title: PIECES OF THE DEEP
details.short_description: An auto-run roguelite set in the deep sea where split-second decisions decide survival. Explore procedurally generated underwater dungeons, defeat bosses, and recover relics of a lost civilization. Return with materials to rebuild technology and push further into the depths.

details.title: Mistbound Silent light
details.short_description: Mistbound: Silent Light is a knowledge-based horror where your voice is your greatest power and your worst enemy. Solve intricate puzzles with your voice or master the fog's secrets in silence to survive.

details.title: Manum
details.short_description: A fast third-person 4v4 battlemage arena where you build your mage mid-match. Loot spells, combine them freely, and fight for capture points.

details.title: Unlucky
details.short_description: A bullet-heaven wave-based survival gambler roguelike where gambling-powered abilities determine your fate. Survive endless waves in an open world, level up with randomised upgrades, and master the chaos with luck on your side... hopefully.

details.title: Astrolander
details.short_description: Astrolander is an action-packed modern take on retro platformers featuring innovative 2.5D+3D gameplay and unique optional local co-op chaos! Attack enemies with your CDjector, dodge cassette launching boomboxes, and more on your quest to save the Most Valuable Programs!

details.title: DHALMAN
details.short_description: DHALMAN is a single-player action adventure featuring Metroidvania exploration and fighting gameplay across countries, with curry restaurant management between battles. Join DHALMAN on a flavorful journey to face evolving bosses, discover new worlds, and build the world’s greatest curry restaurant.

details.title: DELUCID
details.short_description: An atmospheric horror game set within an inescapable dream. Trapped in a dark forest, you must explore, forage, and uncover rare ingredients to craft the one potion capable of waking you up.

details.title: Monster Meals: Big Bite Diner
details.short_description: Cook bizarre meals for hungry monsters using ingredients you gather while exploring. Upgrade your diner through a daily loop of exploring, cooking and serving. Play solo or with friends in full co-op.

details.title: Pirate Troops
details.short_description: Follow the journey of Sammy Shortlegs in this fun yet mysterious tale! Uncover the whereabouts of powerful pirate relics lost to time, and confront the terrifying Shadowbeard.

details.title: Abyss Prowler
details.short_description: Abyss Prowler is an arcade inspired top-down arena shooter where you should always stay on the move to survive. Dash, reposition and strike. Demo is available.

details.title: Soundscapes
details.short_description: Soundscapes is an interactive music sandbox where your songs shape the world around you.

details.title: RiffHammer
details.short_description: RiffHammer is a rhythm-driven hack-and-slash where you annihilate enemies to crushing metal beats. Wield genre-infused weapons, rage through procedurally generated dungeons or handcrafted scenarios—and import your own music if metal isn’t your thing.

details.title: SCP-939: With Many Voices
details.short_description: PSX-style survival horror set in a post-Soviet SCP universe. As a Foundation Agent, investigate rumors of missing people's voices. Evade SCP-939 - a blind predator tracking sound and mimicking human speech. Gather intel to call the MTF, and choose between strict orders and saving locals.

details.title: Manifest Unknown
details.short_description: In this narratively driven train Sim, you’re the driver of a train full of mysteries. Your family is counting on you. Will you stay on schedule and follow orders, or risk stepping off duty to uncover the secrets hiding along the line? The choice is yours.

details.title: Susuki Kaidan
details.short_description: A first-person survival horror set in the dying fields of Sengoku Japan. To reach Kyoto and escape the war, a lone survivor must cross endless fields of susuki grass while the White Ghost watches from within.

details.title: Outage: Trespass
details.short_description: Trapped in a dark mansion, you must escape a violent hunter, his deadly traps, and the mutant creatures inside the mansion. Explore, loot supplies, craft weapons, hide, and fight your way out alone or with friends.

details.title: All You Can Reap
details.short_description: A short incremental game about feeding a Demonic Altar by reaping squirming field of Critters. Reap, grow, and slowly descend into hell!

details.title: Rocky Up
details.short_description: A challenging 2D platformer with mouse-only controls and only natural sounds. Jump, jump, and jump all the way to reaching the mountains top.

details.title: Time Flow
details.short_description: Take on the role of a creature exploring the surface of a living island, inheriting its powers to control the flow of time for objects, enemies, and yourself. Overcome a variety of dynamic, time-based challenges to heal the corrupted environment.

details.title: My Farm 2
details.short_description: A city family inherits an abandoned farm. Cultivate your plots, raise your animals, repair and transform a run-down estate into a thriving farm. Take part in village life, face the surprises of the seasons… and uncover the mysteries hanging in the sky.

details.title: Space Scum
details.short_description: Lead a band of mercenaries through battle after battle in this Sci-Fi, turn-based RPG. Fight your way across different planets, earning loot and equipment to outfit your team – and remember, no option is off the table when survival is on the line.

details.title: October Nightmares | Cauchemars d'octobre
details.short_description: Explore a Montréal neighborhood in the 70s, investigate a supernatural phenomenon that inflicts nightmares on its residents, and delve into the depths of the world of dreams to save their lives. October Nightmares is a point & click cosmic horror game where exploration mixes with puzzle solving.

details.title: Sunaba
details.short_description: Sunaba is a 3D First and Third Person Singleplayer and Multiplayer Sandbox game centered on User Generated Content. Inspired by games such as LittleBigPlanet, Roblox, Minecraft and Garry's Mod, with an art style inspired by cartoons, and anime.

name: The Last Hour of an Epic TO THE MOON RPG

details.title: The Last Hour of an Epic TO THE MOON RPG
details.short_description: Jump straight into the very last hour of a 1000-hour RPG. The beginning and the end of the To the Moon series.

name: Greed Realm: Hero from Another World & the Soul Tree

details.title: Greed Realm: Hero from Another World & the Soul Tree
details.short_description: Greed Realm is a Roguelike Deckbuilder fused with Monopoly elements. As Priestess Gladis, enter the "Soul Tree" to cure your mother. Master deck building, dice manipulation, and backpack management to survive the gap between desire and nightmare.

details.title: Cozy Rabbit Hole
details.short_description: Cozy Rabbit Hole is a 2D survival horror game. Explore the deep rabbit holes, fight or dodge monsters, gather resources, craft weapons and power-ups. Balance curiosity with caution, and find enough supplies to survive the harsh winter.

details.title: Shrine Labyrinth
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op Japanese horror game. Beyond the torii gate lies an otherworldly labyrinth whose layout changes randomly. Work together to escape as you run from, hide from, and sometimes confront terrifying supernatural entities!

details.title: 8-bitBot
details.short_description: 8-bitBot is a programming puzzle game where you place simple instructions in a program to make your bots transport objects in a factory environment.

details.title: Underpond
details.short_description: Delve into the depths of the amphibian afterlife, the eponymous UNDERPOND, in this procedurally generated, hand-drawn, frog-hopping roguelite.

details.title: Desouled
details.short_description: How many times have you wished you could forget and simply sleep? Desouled forces you to look at what we avoid seeing: stories that are raw, cruel, at times inhuman. But real. In a relentless fight, dodging is your only defense. You can't win, only survive.

details.title: Factomancer
details.short_description: The Order sends you on a mission. Armed with technology powered by magic, build production chains, plan, transform, optimize, and prepare for the unexpected. In this automation roguelite, the Eye of the Order watches your moves: failure is only a step toward perfection.

details.title: 无言初雪与奇迹书
details.short_description: 江城是个很少下雪的南方城市。 倘若是哪个冬天见到了，就随手纪念一下吧… 在难以成团的雪籽融化成水之前，在眼前的人尚未走远消失之前 将“白色的奇迹”封存在相片里，记录在记事本里，铭刻于脑海里……

details.title: Element TD 3 - Tower Defense
details.short_description: Element TD 3 takes the tradition of combining powerful elements for unique towers and adds heroes. Infinitely replayable and endless, this is a Tower Defense that blends classic gameplay with modern additions. Play with up to 8 players cooperatively or competitively.

details.title: Chronoscript: The Endless End
details.short_description: “Chronoscript: The Endless End” is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its end—across 2D pages and a 3D manor.

name: Before the Silence Claims: In Absentia

details.title: Before the Silence Claims: In Absentia
details.short_description: "The truth is not found in what you see… but in what you tune into." Survive a deceased scientist's memories in a strange 1930s German town. Manipulate frequencies to reveal what is hidden, face unsettling entities, and keep an impossible promise in a tactile, HUD-less psychological survival horror.

details.title: From Ruins – A Detective Adventure
details.short_description: A new-gen detective adventure combining deduction gameplay with a gripping story full of twists and turns. Gather clues, establish connections, and solve a series of increasingly challenging cases. Will you uncover the feud that began at the end of the world?

name: ナカノ人格移植研究所

details.title: ナカノ人格移植研究所
details.short_description: "The Nakano Laboratory" is a loop-based mystery 2D adventure game. Within each loop of 15 minutes, you take over researchers' bodies to gather clues around the ship, then present your evidence at the meeting.
developers: 麺屋すぱいす 東京支店
publishers: 麺屋すぱいす 東京支店

details.title: Lumen the Red Panda
details.short_description: Explore a cozy world with Lumen the Red Panda! Go through exciting platforming challenges, solve puzzles, collect apples, unlock fun cosmetics, help animals in need, and uncover hidden secrets in this family-friendly 3D adventure.

details.title: Shrouded Suns
details.short_description: In the midst of a seemingly hopeless war among the stars, take control of highly customizable spacefighters to experience classic space combat action throughout a story-driven campaign.

details.title: INFERIUS
details.short_description: Descend through nine dominions of Hell in a first-person horror roguelike deckbuilder. Wield Major Arcana tarot cards, upgrade your deck between deaths, use your lantern to survive the dark, and defeat each ruler before your sanity breaks.

details.title: Five Day Detective
details.short_description: Five Day Detective is a point and click style adventure game featuring multiple murder cases and a twisted sense of humour.

details.title: 梦之彼方-fate prologue
details.short_description: “一位名叫蓝原逸的少年，在多年之后重返家乡，转入了小镇唯一的学校。八年的时光，小镇的一切已经发生了翻天覆地的变化，那些遗失的美好，珍贵的回忆，慢慢苏醒……这就是所谓的奇迹吗？男孩显得有些疑惑。此后，他与自己的青梅竹马相逢，结识了文学部的众人，开始了一日日平凡的校园时光……”她，如此这样地说着。 片刻的沉默，少女已然整理好了头发，系上了心爱的蝴蝶结，努力挤出了一个微笑，望向窗外。 “至少现在，已经足够了哟~因为你已经很坚强的努力过了，所以，已经不用再逞强了哟~” “在这个充满着奇迹与希望的世界里，无论是快乐的事，还是欣喜的事，全部，都会再得到延续。” “所以，已经足够了哟~”

details.title: Kero Quest 64
details.short_description: Kero Quest 64 is a Collectathon 3D Platformer inspired by other games in the genre, especially those from the late 90s. You take control of Kero, a blue frog seeking to stop a prince from spreading evil Shards across the Kingdom of Bunnabaria!

details.title: INFECT½
details.short_description: 《Infect½》is a Cthulhu-themed group portrait micro-horror AVG, players can control a total of seven characters in the game to advance the story. As members of the last remaining human settlement, as you explore, you slowly uncover the truth that led to the beginning of all this catastrophe...

details.title: Evolized
details.short_description: Evolized is a fast-paced evolution roguelite where your creature changes in real time. Build your biology, push deeper into a storm that escalates the world every minute, and extract before you are wiped out.

details.title: Feral Metaverse
details.short_description: Feral Metaverse is an Online Multiplayer Game, where players are dropped naked and voiceless into a bleak environment. Their only path to survival is kindness.

details.title: Perfect Sword
details.short_description: Create Your Very Own "Perfect Sword"! Immerse yourself in the life of a medieval blacksmith. Take charge of every step in the forging process. Every detail has been meticulously recreated to provide you with a truly immersive experience.

details.title: Above Land: Rhapsody
details.short_description: A chaotic 1-3 player co-op action roguelite above the clouds. Grab a toy. Save the world.

details.title: 雨中的生命之歌
details.short_description: 《雨中的生命之歌》 是以虚拟主播社团ReliveProject其附属世界观扩展而来的一款视觉小说游戏

details.title: Ministry of Order
details.short_description: Inspect the parents’ medical record and match the newborn who can only be theirs — that is the day’s work in this 1920s dystopian puzzle. A fire burned the birth records, and the Ministry put you in charge of giving the children back. Your choice goes into the report.

details.title: Terrible Life Expectancy
details.short_description: Terrible Life Expectancy is a roguelite top-down shooter with Survivors elements. Fight absurd hordes of mutants for the amusement of an unseen bloodthirsty audience and only inherit all your upgrades as long as someone in your family is still breathing... or at least twitching.

details.title: COCOBOY
details.short_description: Rediscover the lost ‘80s platformer COCOBOY in an alternate 2005! Hack a forgotten game with bizarre mods, decorate your bedroom with rare collectibles, and scour the forums of a budding fandom for clues to deeply puzzling secrets. Demo Disc is available now!

details.title: Slain 2: The Beast Within
details.short_description: A brutal gothic hack-and-slash where old-school gameplay and heavy metal collide. As Prince Akran, wield the sentient blade Bathoryn and embrace your werewolf fury, and battle through a dying world against the forces of Vroll. The quest begins now.

details.title: Chunky JUMP!
details.short_description: Chunky JUMP! is a survival-horror platformer where you must survive through the night on your BIRD BOY. But beware... the Ghabbit is hunting, and you must restore the gas station's power before it's too late!

details.title: Taptron 1999
details.short_description: Taptron 1999 is a short roguelite clicker where you must prevent Y2K using the power of a mouse click.

details.title: FEAR BOUNDS: Amelia story
details.short_description: Through phobias to the truth. Embark on the chilling journey of the girl, Amelia. Monsters and horrors born of a child's imagination rise up, revealing the deepest secrets of her family's past. Fight or flee, hide or jump! Learn, solve puzzles, and explore these terrifying, twisted worlds.

name: Echoes of Shadows: The Last Jinyiwei

details.title: Echoes of Shadows: The Last Jinyiwei
details.short_description: A third-person stealth adventure set in the late Ming dynasty. Play as Jinyiwei agent Xie Guxian and travel with a mysterious girl. Observe patrols and connections between people. Use Threadweaving together to create openings for infiltration and rescue, and find a way through danger.

details.title: Bound Beyond
details.short_description: A dark, mystical first-person adventure. Investigate the disappearance of a renowned archaeologist. Explore locations where shadows may hide a threat, and every sound can be your final mistake. Solve immersive puzzles and use sound, physics, and tools to survive before an ancient secret consumes you

details.title: Voidwood
details.short_description: Voidwood is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game, where your voice can save your friends or give them all away. By day, you scavenge an inviting, cursed forest. By night, you survive the hunt. Push your luck, go deeper, and speak carefully. The forest is listening.

details.title: Shattered Realms
details.short_description: Battle hordes of enemies, unlock powerful abilities and new characters, and conquer unique bosses in this dark fantasy roguelite ARPG packed with loot, upgrades, and deep build customization. Traverse the Shattered Realms and reclaim the fragments of a broken world.

name: Thesis of Love 心动论证

details.title: Thesis of Love 心动论证
details.short_description: During the endless summer in Chishima, you join a graduate program hoping to become worthy of your crush. Little do you know what awaits... In this otome dating sim, experience campus life with three lab members trapped in toxic relationships. Your choices may lead them to new paths.

details.title: KVLT
details.short_description: Fight your way through armies of Nazi occultists, religious zealots, and unspeakable cosmic horrors to unveil the Eldritch secrets behind the war theatre in this 2000s-era-inspired grimdark singleplayer FPS where WW2 meets Cthulhu Mythos.

details.title: Cosmic Holidays
details.short_description: In an unknown world, help Cibo reach his vacation resort. Through a stunningly rich fauna and flora, Cibo can glide, bounce, propel himself, get stuck, absorb shocks, or roll all simply by inflating his head. Tame this unfamiliar nature and turn it into your ally

details.title: Rustwater
details.short_description: Rustwater is a cozy post-opocalyptic cleanup simulator. Pilot your boat across a flooded world, using immersive cutting mechanics to dismantle structures and rotting ships to gather resources. Sail through isolated settlements, repair homes, and trade goods to help survivors rebuild their lives.

details.title: DRIFT BOOM BOOM
details.short_description: Chase criminals, dodge missiles, upgrade your car, and smash the competition. Chaotic Combat Racing with Eurobeat. 🚗💥💥

details.title: Asbak
details.short_description: Asbak is a 2D action roguelike where you play as a corporate demon hunter in a demon-ridden urban Southeast Asia. In a dangerous world where demon hunting is a profession, your rare talent is used to slay demons and earn a living.

details.title: Crownbreakers
details.short_description: Crownbreakers is a striking and snappy turn-based card brawler where magic meets punk and demonic billionaires rule the city. Crash through their districts, build your deck, and throw every card like a punch. Be the guillotine that frees Cascade from their soul-crushing rulers.

name: In a World Full of Zombies I'm the Only One Who Doesn't Get Attacked: Road to Heaven

details.title: In a World Full of Zombies I'm the Only One Who Doesn't Get Attacked: Road to Heaven
details.short_description: A man the zombies will not attack fights to protect his allies and base as they journey toward Heaven. Prepare defenses, deploy allies, upgrade equipment, and set traps to survive the horde in this RTS and tower defense hybrid.

details.title: Black Mountain of Tlaltecuhtli
details.short_description: Third-person supernatural action-adventure in a living Aztec mountain. Climb collapsing ruins, shift dimensions to fight reality-warped enemies, and navigate Loop Zones where environments reset. The deeper you go, the closer you come to what the Aztecs sealed away.

details.title: No Mercy, No Sanctuary
details.short_description: Survive a gritty 2D apocalypse featuring realistic physics and visceral dismemberment. Fortify your sanctuary by day and defend it by night. Scrutinize every survivor seeking refuge: inspect them for symptoms, for one hidden infection will doom your entire colony.

details.title: MicroJumper
details.short_description: A tiny 2D precision platformer where you navigate the human body as a pathogen. Evade relentless white blood cells, master newfound abilities, and use power-ups while you search for a new home.

details.title: Heroic Musical Chairs
details.short_description: Face off against your friends and family in this epic take on musical chairs! Play locally or online as tiny wizard athletes ready to do anything to win. Special powers, dirty tricks, and dozens of crazy arenas: when the music stops, chaos begins!

details.title: Pizza Super Slice
details.short_description: Cartoon-exploration-platformer in which you play as an living slice of pizza. Explore a strange, cartoon town full of little secrets, dark corners and secret passages. There's something interesting in every nook and cranny!

details.title: Take Me to the Ending!
details.short_description: Huh... umm...? Meet Yuu, our hero who just can't jump high enough to escape their tiny little world. But wait—here comes YOU, the super hacker extraordinaire! 💻✨ Hack Yuu's parameters, tweak the world itself, and guide them all the way to their happy ending! Let’s get hacking!

details.title: CE-III Protocol: Last Drop
details.short_description: Dozing off in class won't kill you… unless you wake up in a strange, creepy place surrounded by monsters. On the bright side, you're not alone, nor completely defenseless. But to escape this nightmare, you'll have to do more than just survive…

details.title: The Pale Banner
details.short_description: Your Father, The king of all of Aldrain, was slain and his crown broken into five pieces by his betrayers when you were only a small child. After many years of training, you set out with your band of followers, The New Order of Light, to take back your throne.

details.title: Dustium
details.short_description: Dustium is a turn-based tactics roguelite where you analyze enemy actions and plan multiple moves for three characters in advance. You may know what the enemy will do, but predicting the outcome is up to you.

details.title: Hero Investor: Business Tycoon
details.short_description: Build an investment firm, trade fictional markets, acquire income-producing property, and create your own ETFs as you grow from a small office into a financial empire in this player-paced management simulation.

details.title: Keyb Out
details.short_description: Keyb Out is a roguelite wave defense game about defending your PC from viruses and hackers by using your keyboard as a weapon.

details.title: TreeLine
details.short_description: Grow strange trees that don't exist in the wild, chop them down swing by swing, fill the morning truck, and pay off what you owe — one day at a time. A first-person orchard sim about honest work and heavy debt.

details.title: SoulForged:Ashborn
details.short_description: Seoul has fallen to the ARCHALIS. One year later, android girl ASH rises from the ashes. An anime-style hack-and-slash action RPG across Seoul's landmarks — five weapons, parry-driven soulslike boss duels, research-based levelless growth, and a 30-day countdown to reclaim the city.

details.title: LILITH
details.short_description: Every head is a world. LILITH is a folk-art puzzle-platformer set inside nesting dolls: climb into heads, hang characters on your tree to wear their skills, and descend through an İstanbul of graveyards, malls and rooftops, until you find the man in the shower.

details.title: Edge on Truth
details.short_description: Explore the settlement, gather clues, interact with its inhabitants, and uncover a conspiracy. Your actions shape your relationships with the locals – will they help you, or deceive you? Your choices will determine whether the protagonist can escape, or if his tragic fate will repeat itself again.

details.title: Hello World
details.short_description: A colony sim with turn-based tactical combat, set in a lush, living apocalypse. Build a community of humans and robots while a bioengineered jungle devours the world around you and rogue machines fight you for what's left.

name: 嘆きの七英雄 /Seven Heroes of Sorrow

details.title: 嘆きの七英雄 /Seven Heroes of Sorrow
details.short_description: Seven heroes bound by a destiny of ruin weave a moving tale. Winner of the Freegame Mugen Grand Prize, featuring a fully-voiced main story with 120+ voice actors—an epic JRPG is born! A must-play for all RPG fans!

details.title: Starhood
details.short_description: The space station is waiting for you, Captain. Turn by turn, build modules, gather resources, and expand your station to ensure survival and prosperity in the depths of space.

details.title: The Whispering Bones
details.short_description: The Whispering Bones is a roguelike psychological horror where you gamble with a mysterious stranger in the depths of a nebulous wood. Roll dice with full physics simulation, unravel the hermit's secrets, make bets and win a chance for a better life.

details.title: Orbit Run
details.short_description: Orbit Run is an arcade sci-fi game with roguelike elements, in which orbiting asteroids are your only weapons. Catch asteroids and combine them to unlock their run-altering abilities. Skillfully manoeuvre to dodge attacks and land massive asteroid strikes to defeat the ever-increasing waves of foes.

details.title: Third Wind
details.short_description: In this turn-based roguelite where magic is commonplace, YOU get to be the lucky coach of a brand-new team of Magefencers! Your story choices will determine what your captain of choice evolves into—so choose wisely. Draft teammates, help them grow, watch them bond, and try to become Champions!

details.title: AINUR
details.short_description: AINUR is an open-world survival and building game set in a fictional fantasy wasteland. Centered on the core themes of "survival and reconstruction," it utilizes an in-game "deep construction system" to alter the state of the game world, unlock storylines, and combat natural calamities.

details.title: Night Fantasy 夜色幻想
details.short_description: Night Fantasy is a turn-based strategy RPG about building a team of three adventurers. Enter the Demon Tower, shape your party with classes, skills, talents, and relics, and forge your own strategy through randomized runs to defeat the Demon King and restore the light.

details.title: Red Moon Cafe
details.short_description: Red Moon Cafe is a story-driven barista sim set in a rough Russian neighborhood. Survive on your paycheck, manage the protagonist's well-being, and save for the essentials. The authentic city and lifelike NPCs are so detailed that the atmosphere and daily grind feel almost like real life.

details.title: Purge Phalanx
details.short_description: Unleash heavy weaponry to exterminate the demonic horde alone or up to 4 players online and/or in splitscreen

details.title: ココロトーカーズ
details.short_description: 舞台は廃校。記憶喪失の少年と、「モノ」を自身に宿すことができる「モノマネ」の力を持つ少女。 校舎内のあらゆる「モノ」と会話してモノだけが知っている情報を聞き出し、失われた記憶を取り戻そう！

details.title: Emberhold
details.short_description: An action adventure game where you explore fantastical floating islands, fight powerful enemies, and rebuild a long lost bastion of hope for a kingdom in disarray

details.title: Flashback Dream
details.short_description: "Hope leads to despair." Welcome to Lethia, a paradise where dreams are forbidden. Amnesiac Jin takes up his sword to uncover the truth hidden by the cult and find his way back home. A top-down 2D pixel art action-adventure. In this lonely world, the future is yours to choose.

details.title: CHI Project
details.short_description: Sci-fi fantasy visual novel, turn-based RPG, and murder mystery -- all in one!

details.title: Shadowbridge - The Genesis
details.short_description: Restore the balance in the dimensions! Help Ezra solve the biggest mystery of them all in this mind blowing point and click adventure.

details.title: I Need To Go
details.short_description: A naive metalhead wakes up in a strange, dreamlike cave with no idea how he got there, and no sign of his girlfriend. A fully voiced pixel art point-and-click adventure where humor meets the heart.

details.title: Leap Galaxy
details.short_description: Leap Galaxy is a 2D platformer with a minimalistic aesthetic and gameplay that puts speed and flow first. Take advantage of momentum and master the recoil of your shots to reach insane speeds and beat each level as fast as posible!

details.title: 咏唱魔女 witch's Aria
details.short_description: "Witch's Area" is an RPG game with a core gameplay mechanic centered around combining cards to create spells, featuring light strategic roguelike elements. Combine different cards to craft your unique spells and uncover the truth behind the little witch's cyclical dreams!

details.title: Faraway Galaxy
details.short_description: Faraway Galaxy is a new roguelite deckbuilder framed as a bizarre tabletop adventure narrated by a battle-hardened space wolf. Master intense tactical battles and meaningful choices between them. Fight alien pirates, collect artifacts, and uncover new encounters!

details.title: A Trivia Roguelike
details.short_description: Your actions are dictated by trivia questions and answers in this roguelike RPG with a trivia twist. Collect loot and level up to impact your chances of survival, take down dangerous foes and defeat the evil Trivia Arch Lich.

details.title: SHROT
details.short_description: Welcome to SHROT! A fast, funny, and unapologetically stupid first-person boomer shooter where a Slavic trucker gets stuck in an alien apocalypse and handles it the only way he knows how: with beer, cigarettes, and unresolved anger issues.

details.title: Monad Tachyon
details.short_description: Accelerate beyond the speed of sound! Monad Tachyon is the ultimate high-speed Metroidvania .

details.title: CactusBandido
details.short_description: Love your friends? Too bad: in Thorn City, you're going to steal their loot. Face off with up to 6 players, outsmart the sheriff, and let the richest cactus win!

details.title: Mech Log Zero
details.short_description: Take control of a mechanized pilot and its Mech. Blast through Colossal Machines and secure the last remnants of life inside a dying God.

details.title: Time Jump
details.short_description: In this adventure comedy, you are a Wrestling Champion. A Kid. A Professor. A Rock. A Ghost. An Evil Maniac. Fight yourself or save yourself. Your choice, Time Jumper!

details.title: Typing Valley
details.short_description: Typing Valley is a cozy farming game powered by typing. Type to gather, plant, harvest, and run a cozy restaurant that brings warmth and happiness to the town. Start now, and let every keystroke become visible growth.

details.title: Backtrace: Mechanisms for Forgetting
details.short_description: Backtrace is a yuri mystery and puzzle game set inside a retro computer. Log on night after night to uncover a story of internet exploits and unexpected friendships with a crew of 80s hackers. Solve 2D grid-based puzzles to piece together the mystery.

details.title: Sorcery Mastery
details.short_description: Magical duels meet roguelike builds in this fast-paced PvP arena brawler where you choose your entire skillset and other upgrades throughout the match.

details.title: Fungakas
details.short_description: Fungakas is a frantic indie "all-star" party hero shooter featuring characters from different indie games and media where you can customise any character into any niche by changing its abilities, charms and special each with roomates to get the exact variants of character you need for your playstyle

details.title: The Fancy Pants Adventures Online
details.short_description: Relive the classic Fancy Pants Adventures with your friends in an epic online arcade. Play through the story, mess around in platforming sandboxes, challenge each other to some friendly PvP, or tour through a round of Fancy Golf together.

details.title: RANOKA
details.short_description: Command the dead in hex-grid tactical battles. Climb a 40-floor soul-devouring tower as Ranoka, a child necromancer born in its grave, raising fallen heroes, recruiting rivals, and uncovering why the tower hungers.

details.title: Anti-Anti-Cheat: a musical action game
details.short_description: This is a musical action game where you need to dodge many enemy bullets appearing to the rhythm of music. Can you defeat Anti-Cheat?

details.title: Slots & Slaughter
details.short_description: You're a broke gladiator whose entire kit is locked inside a slot machine. Spin to gear up, gamble on the reroll, and win your freedom. Or die a legend who gambled it all away.

details.title: Near Nobit
details.short_description: Collision-triggered Card Combos. Near Nobit is a deckbuilding roguelike centered around an auto-activating card system. Perfect your deck’s sequence to trigger near-infinite combos, then witness the chaotic and unpredictable dance of nobits.

details.title: Cloud Infusion
details.short_description: Cloud Infusion is a casual social multiplayer game centered on free, rule-free play. With warm minimalist hand-drawn art and a unique “IV drip” recovery mechanic, it delivers a lighthearted, fun multiplayer experience that embodies gentle courage toward life, companionship, and overcoming hardship.

details.title: Out of Sync
details.short_description: Out of Sync is a classic survival horror game, inspired by the great horror hits but reimagined with a visual style inspired by the sci-fi comics of the 1960s. Guide Sara through this futuristic dystopian world on her mission to save her crew and discover the hidden truth.

details.title: StreamNet Alliance
details.short_description: A cyberpunk visual novel about chasing fame and losing yourself. 30 days. 100,000 followers. Daily choices that shape who Hoshino becomes — and what she's willing to sacrifice to get there.

details.title: Called Shot
details.short_description: Called Shot is a low-poly western battle royale inspired by Bang!. Cards pick your move, but you pull the trigger. Farm a deck, survive the plaza, duel atop a runaway train. Play dead, pass the dynamite, load silver bullets. No honest gunslingers here. Real aim meets hand-reading. Up to 8 online.

details.title: Stink Buddies
details.short_description: 4 dung beetles and one massive dung ball in this Physics based 4 player coop. Squad up and bring your turd home, get past predators and obstacles, because real buddies go through life together and just roll with it.

details.title: Deadtective Academy
details.short_description: At Mystery Academy, training detectives is routine. Dealing with a vampire? Not so much. As mysterious deaths begin to surface, questions begin to arise: is it all just pure coincidence? And who can you trust when danger might be right beside you?

details.title: The Great Beyond
details.short_description: Defeat the onslaught of aliens by building your own moon base, placing & upgrading tower defences, managing units, and mining resources!

details.title: Ivy‘s Dream Cafe
details.short_description: Run a magical cafe by day and step into surreal dreams by night. Use plant magic to uncover hidden clues, understand the emotions behind each story, and uncover the forgotten past behind Ivy’s own dreams.

details.title: Cards after Midnight
details.short_description: A dark, turn-based card roguelike where every action brings you closer to midnight. Survive with weapons by day and become a powerful werewolf by night. But beware: the beast's strength may cost you your humanity.

details.title: CENSOR
details.short_description: You can make someone tell the truth. But first, you need to know who to ask. CENSOR is a sci-fi detective game. Question the people involved, uncover contradictions and piece together the case on your evidence board. Then decide the fate of the accused.

details.title: Voxelantis
details.short_description: Voxelantis is a sandbox building and survival game set in a flat or spherical voxel world. Build anything out of your imagination, or adventure into uncharted territories to fight dangerous creatures. You can and deserve to have a small home planet of your own.

details.title: Ultra Paddle
details.short_description: A high-speed arcade roguelite where classic physics meet insane abilities. Deflect the ball, survive intense boss fights, and combine 100+ active and passive skills to break the game. Every run makes you stronger. Your goal? Become unstoppable.

details.title: The Happy Place
details.short_description: A psychological horror adventure about a small light. Keep your glow alive in the dark, explore a village that forgot how to play, talk to the people still waiting there, and make choices you can't take back, each one leading the story down a different path.

details.title: K2-18b: Legacy
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in the mysterious atmosphere of exoplanet K2-18b. Traverse its unusual labyrinths, uncover a captivating story, and reveal the world's secrets - all set to an atmospheric original soundtrack.

details.title: MONji
details.short_description: A virtual companion that lives on your desktop and shares your clock. MONjis grow in real time, from an egg to a grown-up adult shaped by time-based events and small choices. Explore new places, loot parts and craft unique visual mods for your device to show your personality. MONji grows on you !

details.title: The Lonely Golem
details.short_description: A retro style fantasy adventure combining open world exploration with turn based combat. Travel the seven realms fighting your way through elemental dungeons as you search for a way to cure the enchanted forest from a poisonous blight...

details.title: Obsidia
details.short_description: Obsidia is a 2.5D action/adventure game 2.5D inspired by Zelda and Silent Hill in which you are a hazmat technician. Explore the city of Sibodia, fight against tainted entities and solve environmental puzzles to get out of a city which remembers your actions, leading to one of many endings.

details.title: Trouble in Our Skies
details.short_description: A retro PS1-style action game set in a lo-fi cyberpunk metropolis, where fast-paced movement meets chaotic clean-up-and-combat gameplay. You are Lammy, a dormant caregiver bot revived to save a sky city from total collapse.

details.title: Dust till Dawn
details.short_description: A retro-paranormal powerwash simulator, where you're a maid restoring a quiet rural Japanese village. Dust, mop, squeegee to your heart's content...but don't stay too late!

details.title: Normandie
details.short_description: Normandie is a narrative ocean crawler set in the wake of World War II. Suit up as Charlie, a rookie salvage diver aboard the Shomesh. Work with your crew to explore the wrecks of the legendary ocean liners that once ruled the Atlantic.

details.title: Nodebreak
details.short_description: Nodebreak is a fast-paced, kinetic precision puzzle game, where you launch from node to node at breakneck speeds in an interconnected branching node network. It is an easy to understand, but hard to master test of reflexes and spatial awareness!

details.title: ChessBox
details.short_description: The match alternates between 2 minutes of chess and 2 minutes of boxing. First to KO or Checkmate the opponent wins. Brains or brawn? In ChessBox, one will win.

details.title: Pixel Vale
details.short_description: Pixel Vale is a medieval fantasy city-builder game, focused on building up your city while managing external threats. Fight or trade with other cities, explore through the fog of war, and defend against goblin raids. Research new buildings to expand and keep your citizens happy.

details.title: Entered
details.short_description: Entered ■■■■■■■... A retro-style horror visual novel branching into various horror subgenres.

details.title: Ludus Saltuum
details.short_description: A third person 3d platformer! Jump forward, unlock skills and buy upgrades! All at your own pace! Handcrafted levels procedurally presented! How far can you get? 🇧🇷

details.title: UNBIASED
details.short_description: Salvation or Damnation? Measure the worth of human souls in this psychological anime & FMV visual novel about moral dilemma! Will you allow your prejudices to call the shots? Or can you remain unbiased?

details.title: Roots n Roofs
details.short_description: Build whimsical homes within roots and wood, and transform an old stump into a little world. A relaxing sandbox with no pressure - just a quiet, peaceful place and your imagination.

details.title: GUNBUTCHER
details.short_description: 90 seconds. An alien horde, ridiculous weapons, and zero time to breathe. Exterminate them all or die trying!

details.title: Chibits: The King's Tomb
details.short_description: Collect, train, and battle Chibits in a fast-paced roguelike card game. Manage your creatures between runs, master tactical combat, and travel through a branching galaxy where every choice shapes your destiny.

name: Comfort Food: A Taste of Courage

details.title: Comfort Food: A Taste of Courage
details.short_description: Comfort Food: A Taste of Courage is a fast-paced, action-packed cooking game. Roast, fry, and sizzle a variety of dishes to complete orders and earn money before rent is due! Embark on this culinary quest of courage as Teal reheats her passion for cooking again!

details.title: CLEAVE
details.short_description: CLEAVE is a fast-paced action game where players dodge intense enemy attacks and turn the battlefield to their advantage. Master unique mechanics, overcome challenging obstacles, and push your skills to the limit in this high-intensity experience.

details.title: DiceBeasts
details.short_description: DiceBeast is a tactical dice-based autobattler with short roguelite runs. Build a team of creatures, assign elemental dice to their abilities, and upgrade them after each victory.

details.title: MeMento*fragMent
details.short_description: "Begin again. Recall all that is."

details.title: RUNLENGTH
details.short_description: You are PID_0x7F, a rogue process fighting to survive inside a dying computer. Outrun the system's daemons, solve living data-structure puzzles, and reconstruct the truth your creator tried to delete — before the machine wipes you for good.

details.title: D.I.P.
details.short_description: Rush to the bucket, dip into the paint, hook onto the ceiling, and smear your colorful body all over the walls... Oh, and you're a cute dormouse. Paint fast, grab bonuses, and become the top dormouse among your friends in D.I.P.: Dormouse Is Painting, a chaotic local party game for up to 4 players.

details.title: Fling-A-Ring
details.short_description: A retro-styled stretch-and-release physics game. Your ring will zoom about colorful procedurally generated arenas of increasing difficulty filled with whimsical obstacles and collectable sparks and powerups.

details.title: Late Stage Gambling
details.short_description: Here you don't pick up loot. You gamble for it. In this top-down shooter roguelike, you wager before every wave to get your gear. The higher the stakes, the stronger the rewards and the more it hurts when you lose. Fight through a blood-soaked casino to pay off a debt built to kill you.

details.title: Before The Meteor
details.short_description: A cinematic third-person adventure built around exploration and discovery. Travel through breathtaking landscapes, encounter dangerous creatures, and uncover the mysteries hidden across a vast and mysterious world.

details.title: My Dream Closet
details.short_description: My Dream Closet is a free retro dress up game inspired by the 2000's girl games! You'll have to create your perfect outfit for a night out! Discover the theme and follow your creativity to design the most incredible outfit! ☀️

details.title: Ruru & Lala: Wonder World Adventure!
details.short_description: Ruru & Lala is a 2D action-puzzle game where you control two characters simultaneously. After Ruru is pulled into a mysterious mirror, she meets Lala, another version of herself from the mirror world. Together, embark on a great adventure through a mysterious world!

details.title: Nostalgiallo
details.short_description: A surreal point-and-click with vote-based combat, taking place in a corrupted world based on Spanish "Tebeo" slapstick comics.

details.title: dungeons and glory
details.short_description: Dodge enemy fire alone or in online co-op as you raid 5–25 minute portal expeditions. Shape your build through equipment, skills, stats, and risky loot, defeat the boss, and bring your haul home—assuming the Directorate’s plan survives contact.

details.title: OVERQUOTA
details.short_description: Build compact machine networks, route packets, manage heat, and crush rising quotas in this factory-building roguelike. Buy new machines, stack powerful relics, and survive run-changing Boss Blinds.

details.title: Planet Gray Starlight Episode
details.short_description: An adventure game where you travel through the galaxy together in a shiny spaceship.

details.title: Alien Exterminators
details.short_description: Grab your gear, take a contract, and exterminate hostile alien infestations with up to three friends across unpredictable planets full of chaos, danger, and bad workplace conditions.

details.title: Evening, Boss.
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror about keeping a London cab firm located deep in the forest running after dark.

details.title: The Cardkov
details.short_description: Turn poker hands into weapons in this single-player, top-down extraction shooter. Collect discarded cards in the city's cold back alleys, build a hand, and use your new weapon to uncover the factory's secrets. Grab one more card, or make it back alive with the hand you've got.

name: QUIT! - The Japanese Art of Resignation

details.title: QUIT! - The Japanese Art of Resignation
details.short_description: Your boss won't let you quit. So this is a boss fight. Read the excuses, answer with strategy cards, and put the evidence on the table. A resignation-negotiation ADV.

details.title: Grumble Burger
details.short_description: Grumble Burger is a first-person cooking thriller where you take over your late Uncle Frank's food truck. Frank believed the bond between cook and customer was paramount. However, you'll soon discover that orders are handled differently here. And the customers are not your typical diner patrons...

details.title: BAKA TAO
details.short_description: What begins as an ordinary road trip slowly takes an unsettling turn when an unexpected encounter leaves you searching for answers in the surrounding wilderness.

details.title: Ember Gold Valkyrie
details.short_description: "Ember Gold Valkyrie" is a 2.5D pixel-art roguelite action game where you aim for the top of the arena with diverse skills. Saddled with a billion-gold debt, a young girl fights on for her freedom and wish in an arena where victory means gold.

details.title: Our Fleet Is In Orbit
details.short_description: A single-player space-strategy roguelite about reconquering a shattered empire across a procedurally generated galaxy. Plan fleet battles that unfold on your orders, and drive ground invasions front by front across the planet below. Every ship, crew, and army you lose is gone for good.

details.title: Human Forge
details.short_description: Human Forge is a game where you create humans and put them on air to make money. Draw a face, mix traits to create a human, then put them on the show. Every three days, God comes to collect your earnings. Fail and you're fired, but survive to the end and surpass God.

details.title: FEYFAE
details.short_description: A whimsical horror roguelite with 2D bullet hell platforming, strange companions, and lovely things hidden in unlovely places. Descend, survive, and fight your way down a collapsed research facility to uncover the truth of what was done to your family.

details.title: Gooboventure
details.short_description: A hand-pixeled platformer about a blob of goo. Ledges carry you up, ceilings don't drop you, narrow cracks are doors. Goo is both your health and your ammunition, and it comes from fighting. Find your scattered neighbours before winter.

details.title: Voluntary Consent
details.short_description: Your job is something between an autopsy and a survey. In this detective visual novel, you are an interrogation inspector who extracts information from still-living brains. Every day you analyze documents, gather evidence, and make a tough choice: to follow conscience, duty, or voices in own head.

details.title: Runechain Towers
details.short_description: In this strategic tower defense game, combine towers with different functions, make use of environmental elements, and reshape enemy paths to withstand wave after wave of attacks.

details.title: Yeet Animals Gently
details.short_description: Flick a ball at a pen full of very cute animals. Each hit drains a stamina bar, and an empty bar sends one sailing over the fence to land on its feet. Every landing pays. Spend it on a skill tree, unlock new species, and move to a new arena.

details.title: Stone Gambit
details.short_description: Stone Gambit reimagines chess in an epic fantasy world. Assemble armies of diverse pieces, create your own formations, strike from afar, and crush your enemies. Lead the weakest of the Seven Clans, challenge the mighty, and prepare for ranked online battles.

details.title: Implight
details.short_description: Type in what actions you want to take in this comedic text-adventure game inspired by choose-your-own-adventure books! Implight uses 3D visuals and absurdist humor to convey an entertaining and introspective story.

details.title: The Arena's Greatest
details.short_description: Fantasy Autobattler - Assemble a team, fight monsters to gain XP and loot, fight other players, and repeat.

name: סוד המדבר - Secret Of the Desert

details.title: סוד המדבר - Secret Of the Desert
details.short_description: A point-and-click pixel art adventure in the spirit of the old Sierra and LucasArts classics, set in the desert of southern Israel in the early 1990s.

details.title: Gnome More Work
details.short_description: A cozy incremental clicker about helping little gnomes grow a giant tree. Gather resources, recruit gnomes to do the work for you, build up their village, and bet it all on a variety of minigames!

details.title: Sorcerech
details.short_description: Sorcerech is a 2D Pixel Metroidvania where you switch between unique magic and cybernetic forms, battle enemies, solve puzzles, and make choices that shape your journey toward multiple endings.

details.title: Grench It!
details.short_description: One goblin wants to become the greenskin boss with a single stolen wrench. Hopeless, right? Well, that goblin is you now. Build walls and turrets, swing your wrench sometimes, and beat the pirate rats. Steal their ship, make it stronger, and let's go back proudly to the tribe who kicked me out!

details.title: Where The Light Stays
details.short_description: Climb a mountain lost in the night in this contemplative pixel art platformer. Carry a fragile living light that follows you as you navigate paths and meet mysterious travelers.

details.title: ECHO//NULL
details.short_description: An isometric action MMORPG of androids and erased cities. Wake in Cradle-19 as a Ninth Generation Wanderer, fight machines with blade and Drone, shape your build with Plug-in Chips, and remember the places the world was made to forget.

details.title: Abdication
details.short_description: Fight through this corrupted monarchy in order to take the king's power and the crown, and destroy it to free the kingdom, all with a yoyo. It's too powerful to let anyone else wield it, so protect it at all costs!

details.title: The Radio Tower
details.short_description: Your job is to climb the tallest towers in the world to maintain them, this time you were called urgently to fix the only tower providing cover to the small Crimsonpine city that is currently on quarantine.

details.title: Read of Mask
details.short_description: A first-person psychological puzzle game set in Eastern Europe, 1999. Explore a surreal black-and-white world, decipher an invented alphabet using a reality-altering mask, and unlock the story letter by letter.

details.title: Way of the Warrior
details.short_description: Become a samurai in Way of the Warrior, a souls-like PvP and boss rush game. Face other players in intense duels or fight a gauntlet of powerful warriors in a world inspired by feudal Japan. Parry, dodge, feint and attack until only one of you is left standing.

details.title: Click Here!!
details.short_description: You’ve installed “U,” the so-called “best” UI software. It promised maximum productivity, but in reality, it turned out to be a nightmare that throws your PC into total chaos?! Conquer the worst interface ever created and force it to uninstall!

details.title: Munchy Lair
details.short_description: Munchy Lair is a 2D strategy game fusing turn-based snake combat with roguelite tower climbing. Plan WASD paths, preview enemy moves, then resolve. Kill snakes by collision, grab items, buy buffs, advance floor by floor within a turn limit. Endless mode unlocks after three boss layers.

details.title: Exul: Beyond the Gate
details.short_description: Exul: Beyond the Gate is a top-down retro-sci-fi action RPG shooter where you play as an Exul on his journey to an unknown galaxy. Play with your friends in a Co-Op experience where you loot, shoot, pilot, explore, trade, and much more — all to stay alive.

details.title: Eilands
details.short_description: Create and explore your own islands. Sculpt the land, plant trees, draw paths, place and build houses. Inhabit your creations. There is no combat or management, just the joy of creating and experiencing your own island.

name: Breaking Up Is Hard To Do

details.title: Breaking Up Is Hard To Do
details.short_description: When you tell your girlfriend you want to break up, she refuses to accept it. Is your resolve strong enough to become single or will you cave and stay together? A 30-minute visual novel - Breaking Up Is Hard To Do

details.title: Cyber Pet'Scape : Call of Freedom
details.short_description: Cybernetically enhance small vulnerable animals in a pixel art hardcore roguelite platformer, where every jump, every mutation, and every mistake can decide their freedom… or their extinction.

name: MAD LAND: Quest of the Crystal

details.title: MAD LAND: Quest of the Crystal
details.short_description: AD LAND: Quest of the Crystal is a platforming adventure game featuring beautiful pixel art graphics. Control 3 characters with unique abilities, overcome challenges, explore diverse environments, and work together throughout an epic journey.

details.title: Veridium: Final Pulse
details.short_description: In this cyberpunk card battler, winning means taking everything: defeat enemies, steal their decks, and grow stronger, all wrapped in visual novel-style storytelling. They decided evolution had gone too far. The fusion of mankind and machine won't survive much longer. Not without a fight.

details.title: Farm Break
details.short_description: Farm Break is a 3D arcade game in which you play as Piggo the piglet. Moving from wall to wall, you need to paint every corner of the pen to advance. But be careful: some of them aren't as safe as they seem.

details.title: Lilac Prose
details.short_description: A raw, cruel story about addiction, abuse, and recovery. A young man, bound by a vial of morphine, and a world that gives him just that, so long as there's a drop of him worth taking. It has to get worse before it gets better.

details.title: Infinite Liberty
