details.short_description: A disturbing FPS survival horror game about being trapped in an alternate America. Navigate twisted realities, evade or fight aggressive enemies, and solve fast-paced environmental puzzles to survive.

details.title: NecroFlux
details.short_description: NecroFlux:A dark fantasy single-player game. 2nd-person fight view (not 1st/3rd). Combat-focused. Rhythm-based Simultaneous Turn + Tactics, Survival & Loot. Move/stance-switch, auto-attacks; combo keys to command units. Play as a resurrected soul, fight hordes to reclaim lost memories.

details.title: Project: Roaring Citadel
details.short_description: A 2.5D side-scrolling open-world wasteland survival single-player game. You fall from an ancient starship into the Sea of Ruins. Fight to survive, craft weapons, assemble vehicles, recruit allies, and build your tribe. Grow your small crew into a mighty mobile citadel, to defy the tide of evolution.

details.title: USURPATIO
details.short_description: In a world where humankind has begun to create life on its own terms, the eighth sin emerges. USURPATIO.

details.title: 雨の日に見た想月
details.short_description: A Monar RPG about a suicidal student who adventures through another world to prolong his life. Travel between a fantastical and unknown other world and the suffering-filled reality, saving him from his fate of death.

details.title: HARDcheologist
details.short_description: You are an archeologist descending through mysterious and ever-changing ruins using only your weapon's recoil to control the fall. Shoot, try not to touch the ground, reveal secrets and survive. How deep can you go? What lies hidden in the depths of this pyramid?

details.title: Terminal Reign
details.short_description: Operate a remote armoured vehicle for the glory and whims of a dying empire. Undertake tactical missions, configure your command desk with an array of devices, and remain in favour to survive.

details.title: Galaxy Pilgrim
details.short_description: High-stakes physics platformer where you can't walk so you fly! Boost a reluctant engineer through chaotic pinball levels dodging deadly traps and collecting ore for his country.

details.title: Chicken Show
details.short_description: Play as chickens in a TV show for 2 to 4 players, where you must betray your friends to win! Peck, grab, and throw your rivals to gain the upper hand throughout your adventure. Outsmart your opponents and leave them featherless!

details.title: Judicial Designer
details.short_description: A management and tycoon game where you build and manage a courthouse. From a small-town traffic court to handling high-profile criminal cases. Build your courthouse, hire and manage staff, schedule cases and balance the pressures of efficiency and reputation.

details.title: Dead Saints Parade
details.short_description: A third-person stealth immersive sim about a spy in a corrupt cathedral. Learn the patrols, put out candles to hide in the dark, pick locks and read what the clergy leave lying around. Three hits kill you, so what you know keeps you alive.

name: Pandemonium Line: Flipping on Borrowed Dime

details.title: Pandemonium Line: Flipping on Borrowed Dime
details.short_description: Your own paradise lost. You are now this trains conductor. Venture through a hellish train controlled by the Bird Eater. Fight your way to the driver’s cabin in this Action Roguelike coin-flip Deckbuilder focusing on rhythmic evasion and precise positioning.

details.title: Dronefall
details.short_description: Dronefall is a deck-building tower defense game where you defend humanity's last cities against relentless drone swarms.

details.title: YO UP!
details.short_description: YO UP! is a chaotic co-op physics building game where one wrong move can collapse everything. Build unstable towers solo or with friends, climb floating islands, and reach for space... if your tower holds.

details.title: Fractal Flyers
details.short_description: Fractal Flyers let's you fly through Real-Time 3D fractals using FPV drone controls (or traditional winged controls) — Lose yourself in the music across multiple hand-animated challenge levels and soar through the leader-boards.

details.title: The Line Must Not Stop
details.short_description: Take control of a crumbling metro line in a cyberpunk world. Transport passengers, build and upgrade your trains, enhance your systems, and complete various missions. Fight off threats, automate transit, and bring THE LINE back to life!

details.title: Loaded Dice
details.short_description: A dice-driven roguelike where you build an unpredictable deck, chain devastating charms, and roll massive Yatzy combos to hit the target score before your luck finally runs out.

details.title: Fates of Command
details.short_description: Shields up, red alert! YOU are the captain. Experience the thrill of command in this captain's chair roguelike: engage in combat, manage your crew, upgrade your ship, explore, make scientific discoveries and perform a dash of diplomacy.

details.title: THE OMEGA REACH
details.short_description: Reach for the stars, gather their instruments, and curate the best collection in the universe! THE OMEGA REACH is a point-and-click museum simulator (and dungeon crawler) where you are a musical genius.

name: Guardians of the Abyss: Rogue Protocol

details.title: Guardians of the Abyss: Rogue Protocol
details.short_description: Fast-paced roguelite where you switch combat styles mid-fight, destroy the world around you, and survive an ever-escalating challenge. Adapt, master your skills, and push your limits as each run becomes faster, deadlier, and more unforgiving.

details.title: SKY DRIFT
details.short_description: Cute but challenging roguelite platformer-inspired game where you fly through a strange oversized world with a broken rocket and limited fuel. Avoid deadly obstacles, collect gems, and upgrade after every crash. No checkpoints. Start over and fly further.

details.title: Kegs of Eternity
details.short_description: A roguelite deckbuilder starring seven stubborn dwarves. Build unique decks, slay cursed monsters, crawl procedural dungeons, drink plenty of beer, find broken synergies, and rebuild your ruined town, one keg, one combo, one dwarf at a time.

details.title: Infogrind
details.short_description: Manage a bank of supernatural artifacts and secret information in a cyberpunk future. Solve mysteries in this new reality, explore the world, navigate the balance between influential corporations that want to rule this new world!

details.title: Nothing Ever Happens Here
details.short_description: A British life sim set in a real town, with a real Grandad at its core. Can you turn your life around, save his pub, and make something of yourself?

details.title: Bazookat
details.short_description: Bazookat is a 2D Precision Platformer, where a stylish cat, freshly unemployed, uses a bazooka to "solve" problems! Enjoy blowing up your old workplace, getting into mischief, and reaching new heights!

details.title: Keeper of The Strait
details.short_description: You are the gatekeeper of a vital strait. Inspect manifests, collect fees, and block hostile ships in this hybrid of bureaucratic simulation and tower defense. When diplomacy fails, deploy tanks and bunkers to protect your base.

details.title: Drowning Dream
details.short_description: A first-person dreamcore exploration game. Wander tiled pools, empty towns and stations above the clouds. Take photos, ride the trams, play the guitar and the arcade cabinets, or just sit and listen. No enemies, no chases, no jump scares. Only you, lost in your own dream.

name: Death Line: Don’t Stop 斩杀线：极限生机

details.title: Death Line: Don’t Stop 斩杀线：极限生机
details.short_description: If life’s pressure were a physical shredder, could you outrun it? > Balance Health and Wealth on a razor’s edge in this minimalist survival-gambit. Utilize "Class-based Speed" to outsmart Death. Can you tear through the veil and reveal the truth behind the machine before your strength fails?

details.title: Veil of the Black Ark
details.short_description: A classic fixed-camera survival horror game set in a cursed medieval town. Search for your missing sister, solve puzzles, survive the roaming dead and unveil the secrets of the Black Ark.

details.title: Glitch Forest
details.short_description: A reverse bullet hell roguelite where weather reshapes the battlefield every 5 minutes! Combine active items, skills, and relics into game-breaking builds. Activate beacons, crush elites, and return to base stronger every run!

details.title: one more bottle
details.short_description: In ONE MORE BOTTLE, every cap you twist off hides a tiny puzzle, a prize, or a wish. Collect caps, build your shelf, and chase the rare one stamped 再来一瓶 — One More Bottle. A cozy solo puzzle-meets-gacha about luck, patience, and the hope that the next one will be the lucky one.

details.title: Bot.by.Bot
details.short_description: Build and program customizable robots using simple logic systems to overcome clever grid-based challenges and help Robby reunite with his friends.

details.title: Our Will
details.short_description: You are Astrid, a young girl tasked with leading a small company of warriors into an unknown and mystical land, in search of a cure to save your village. Be ready to face forces beyond human comprehension, titanic beasts and perhaps even the Gods themselves.

details.title: Raze The Realm
details.short_description: Lead massive armies in large-scale battles in this real-time tactics roguelite. Build your army, discover powerful relic synergies, and choose your path through a realm that grows more dangerous with every victory.

details.title: Floraison
details.short_description: Floraison is a cozy narrative game based on the language of flowers. Explore Heimat, meet its curious inhabitants, gather rare plants, and craft emotionally powerful bouquets to help them, shape the story, and convey the message of your choice.

details.title: 幽囚の魔法使い
details.short_description: “The Imprisoned Magician” is a fantasy BL visual novel that explores the bond between master and apprentice. Aim to become a fully-fledged magician under the tutelage of a master with a troubled past.

details.title: Aesirbard
details.short_description: Aesirbard is a fantasy Norse-inspired Metroidvania of hard steel and old magic. Sent back from the gates of Hel, fight the corrupted and the restless dead, and rewire the hidden power that underpins the world to free a village trapped by its own ward.

details.title: Shockline
details.short_description: Play as a super-speed dog in a city facing disaster. Race through streets, rescue civilians, and disarm bombs before time runs out. Slow the action to make tight turns, dodge danger, and push for a better score across three modes and three districts.

details.title: Typers Combat 2: Type Harder
details.short_description: Every correct key is a punch. Out-type your rival to land the hits, then end the match with a brutal cinematic execution, X-ray bone breaks included. A 3D typing fighter with a first-person story mode, 10 bonus stages and a fighter you build yourself.

name: MeowMeow TCG: Rip & Ship Streamer Simulator

details.title: MeowMeow TCG: Rip & Ship Streamer Simulator
details.short_description: Start your card-opening streamer career together with your cat companions! Complete pack-opening orders from viewers and grow your fanbase. Decorate your own streaming room. Get cards through various trades and events! Come and collect all the Cat Cards!!

details.title: 红尘游记
details.short_description: Hong Chen You Ji is a 2D top-down pixel wuxia action RPG. Play a village-raised youth seeking his origins among sects and officials. Real-time combat uses movement, weapons, and martial arts. Day, night, weather, and seasons change what you can do. Be a hero, doctor, or escort on your own path.

details.title: BSC: Custodial Program
details.short_description: Live and work in the backrooms as a Custodian in this first-person survival horror. Clean up after retired custodians and hunt for artifacts to earn your freedom. ▙▟▛█▜▚▞ is already in there, waiting.

details.title: AI ROBO STADIUM
details.short_description: Physical AI, on your own PC. Train legged robots with real reinforcement learning (PPO), then pilot the AI you raised in obstacle races and sumo bouts. You design the rewards; the AI figures out how to walk. Training runs on your CPU, and you can keep playing while it learns.

details.title: Reborn
details.short_description: Reborn - an atmospheric first-person survival horror. Explore a dark mansion, uncover its secrets, and survive among infected people. Use weapons, stealth, and limited resources to find your way to the truth.

details.title: Sand to Soil
details.short_description: Turn this desert planet into a lush green habitat! Find seeds, manage water, and improve the soil levels. Sadly, you were sent on this mission with woefully insufficient equipment, so you will have to harness the most potent resource on the planet: a flowery species of sheep, and their poop.

details.title: DO NOT MISS
details.short_description: DO NOT MISS is a fast-paced arena FPS where every missed shot adds an enemy to the next wave. Fight back, grab weapons and upgrades, and use bizarre vending machines. Don't let your own mistakes doom your run.

details.title: Iron Command
details.short_description: A classic base-building RTS in the spirit of Command & Conquer and Dune 2 - harvest, build, research, attack. Play it on your monitor, or put on a headset and command from inside the battlefield, with your orders on a tablet on your wrist.

details.title: Elf in Training
details.short_description: Elf in Training is a chaotic couch co-op game where Santa’s newest recruits sneak into homes to deliver presents, eat cookies, and stuff stockings. Dodge angry parents and Christmas folklore creatures as you race to finish each delivery and earn your place as one of Santa’s elves!

details.title: CHARNEL
details.short_description: Diablo, but with guns. Descend into the crypts, where darkness reigns, the dead linger, and your light only reaches so far. In this real-time ASCII roguelike you'll uncover an arsenal of weapons, battle hordes of the damned, and navigate an ever-changing labyrinth, with one life to reach the bottom.

details.title: Sogni d'Oro
details.short_description: Sogni d'Oro is a Japanese-style RPG with an Italian flavour.

details.title: A Witch's Husband
details.short_description: Scotland, the 1500s. You wake in your own blood. Your wife is gone, taken as a witch. Follow her over the Highland pass and face the men who took her, one sword duel at a time. Block and strike from three directions, parry at the last moment, and strike where their guard breaks open.

details.title: CastleWright
details.short_description: Rebuild ruined castles, manage resources and workers, raise your army, and conquer enemy outposts as you restore a fallen kingdom.

details.title: Beneath the Dying Sun
details.short_description: Beneath the Dying Sun is a cozy nautical delivery game set across the mysterious Nadir Sea. Haul cargo, take odd jobs, meet strange people, and try to make an honest living somewhere that really doesn't make it easy.

details.title: Dice Mafia
details.short_description: A debunker with two million subscribers takes a seat at the table where the fate of the world is settled with dice. 18 powers, five at the table, 12 bosses, online duels. Chance is theatre: learn to rig yours. Premium, no ads, no in-app purchases.

details.title: Regret
details.short_description: Regret is a stop-motion, top-down action roguelike where inventions from across history become your weapons. Battle through randomly generated dungeons in an entirely handmade world, craft powerful item combinations, and travel through time alone or with a friend in local co-op.

details.title: EX-Traterrestrial
details.short_description: EX-Traterrestrial is a Stealth Horror Game about sneaking into your ex's house in order to save her from her alien captor. Stay quiet, avoid the aliens hunting for noise, and hide under furniture to escape detection. Uncover the truth behind the abduction, if you dare.

details.title: Board Game Tycoon
details.short_description: Start your own board game publishing company! Combine themes and mechanics, name your games and customize their covers. Have your prototypes playtested, refine your ideas and publish your games. Invite creators, win over fans and critics, and create your first hit.

details.title: Hieroheart
details.short_description: Hieroheart is an action-adventure RPG set in an AI realm where ancient mythology meets living code. Master magical glyphs, nurture and evolve AnimAI companions, build your own camp, and uncover the mysteries of strange and beautiful worlds.

details.title: Hell In Heaven
details.short_description: It's like a shmup bullet hell but with a third dimension, and a die and retry structure. Focused on mechanics, no grinding. Play through short intense levels, firing abilities with an emphasis on positioning to aim at enemies. Are you up to the challenge ?

details.title: Popping Off
details.short_description: An evolving bubble wrap simulator made of chain reactions and upgrades. Tune in, gear up, pop off.

details.title: ANOTHER MEDIUM
details.short_description: ANOTHER MEDIUM is a non-linear adventure featuring a mix of sci-fi, horror, drama, and thriller. Explore the world, make decisions, shape your psychological profile, remain a puppet in the hands of outside forces, or break the control, even if the price turns out to be too high.

details.title: Where Sinners Sleep
details.short_description: In this card-based management game, you run a hotel owned by the Devil. Serve your guests to uncover their secrets and write your own story. But don’t forget to pay your rent. The Devil asks for flesh, mind, and soul. Will you find a way to break your infernal pact?

details.title: Feltfall
details.short_description: Fluffy felt animals. A merciless time limit. Feltfall is a roguelite deckbuilder about pulling off a harvest festival on a tiny wool-felt island. Pick your route, gather materials, craft cards on the spot, survive the storm-night showdowns, then answer a flood of animal requests at the festival.

details.title: A Wizard's Hat
details.short_description: Become Hatty the wizard's hat. Possess creatures and learn new abilities, delve into the castle's basement, travel to deep forests and lava caves. Become powerful enough to save the wizard. Adventure awaits.

details.title: Hollowreach - Wasteland
details.short_description: A cinematic third-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Dmitry Sokolov crosses ruins and hostile territories, fighting the living and the dead in search of his father. Scarce ammunition and difficult choices mark every step through a city in decay.

details.title: Boop The Snoot
details.short_description: Venture forth, to a land of seemingly endless critters. For only you can "boop" them all on their cute little noses. Gain points to unlock upgrades, cosmetics, and to aid in your endeavor of "booping" every snoot.

details.title: We Love Casting Spells
details.short_description: Magic fantasy procedural dungeon extractor. Advance solo, or with friends, in procedural dungeons with enemies, traps, and rewards! Fill your satchel, and extract to your sanctum before your magic runs out.

details.title: Solvane: The Iron Reach
details.short_description: A black hole spat your ship into a graveyard of the stranded. Build and defend a base, land on alien worlds, and follow ancient alien Solvanes toward the Iron Reach, the only rumored way home.

details.title: Project:Starfield
details.short_description: Explore an alien world in your combat vehicle. Fight hostile creatures and pirates, mine resources, craft repair supplies, and customize your loadout. With mouse-driven controls and a shared energy pool, balance firepower and endurance across wilderness, ice, and swamps.

details.title: Kigurumi Hearts
details.short_description: Interrogate the suspect. Survive the shift. Interrogation Survival Horror about exploration of inability to become, and rotting with it.

name: 供犠層 KYOGI STRATUM 操作員を募集しています

details.title: 供犠層 KYOGI STRATUM 操作員を募集しています
details.short_description: エネルギーが枯渇した日本社会。あなたは本日から操作手となる。 マウス操作で発電を行い、レバーを操作し、送電先を決める。時間制限が迫るなか、社会と自分に責任を持って供給先を判断しよう。謎の巨大装置を操作し、電力を供給するディストピア発電管理スリラー。

details.title: Asther
details.short_description: Asther is a 2D metroidvania action RPG where you play as a young witch. Explore a fantasy world, battle creatures and powerful bosses, develop your abilities, and unlock new paths in an adventure with fast-paced combat and an engaging story.

details.title: Midnight Callers
details.short_description: Spend an evening with friends in a regency-esque society with a monstrous twist! Supernatural suitors await a chance for romance, but family secrets, rumors, and your fellow players just might sabotage your prospects before the season comes to an end.

details.title: Mammoth
details.short_description: Guide a dawning civilization through the early stages of humanity in this RTS roguelite. Discover new technologies and face enemies that will try to destroy you before reaching your full potential. But every time your tribe dies, their sons grow stronger and more powerful.

details.title: Hot Human
details.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer parkour game for 2–12 players where hot potato works backwards. Pass the human before the timer runs out or explode.

details.title: Spellsanity: Wizard Survival
details.short_description: Cleanse five realms of an arcane corruption in this dark fantasy survivors roguelite. Draft a new set of spells every run, build around your playstyle and cut down hordes of corrupted foes. Hunt powerful items, forge game-breaking synergies and grow stronger with every death.

details.title: Together Forever!
details.short_description: Together Forever! is a fast-paced ricochet roguelite where pachinko physics meets backpack management. Launch bouncing balls with flipping gravity, discover crazy relic synergies, and help an angel and demon couple defend their forbidden love against the hordes of Heaven and Hell!

details.title: Empty Throne
details.short_description: Create your hero, recruit a warband and lead them across a dying kingdom. Battles unfold in real time in 3D while you play cards from your hand. If your hero falls, the run is over.

details.title: Manei Monogatari
details.short_description: 1939, Manchuria. Build a life and make films at the Man’ei studio in this historical adventure. Plan your days, assemble a crew, and navigate censorship, ambition, and survival. Your choices shape your relationships, your films, and your ending.

details.title: MindGate
details.short_description: A pool-building roguelike deckbuilder. You draw cards, but never build a deck. Line units across 3 lanes and weave 49 units into 21 synergies. Damage stacks in three layers—Base × Combo × Resonance—and the deeper you specialize, the harder it explodes. Three classes, one pool to sharpen.

details.title: Asteroid Extractors
details.short_description: Mine, upgrade and survive in deep space. Extract valuable resources from procedurally generated asteroids and turn a tiny operation into a massive extraction.

details.title: Radiant Ruins RTS
details.short_description: Experience a post-apocalyptic World War II-inspired non-linear global campaign that combines hand-crafted story missions and procedurally generated operations. Control a selection of units from squads & team weapons to super-heavy tanks & VTOL aircraft. Upgrade your army to suit your playstyle.

details.title: The Arrow
details.short_description: The Arrow is a retro wave-based horror shooter set in a world reshaped by a religious military sect. Fight alone or with friends as you push through war‑torn ruins in a crusade to spread the one true god.

details.title: Sushi Restaurant Simulator
details.short_description: Manage your own sushi restaurant, cook Japanese specialties, serve customers, manage inventory, hire staff, upgrade your equipment, and build the sushi restaurant of your dreams.

details.title: Halls of Jötunn
details.short_description: Halls of Jötunn is a first-person atmospheric dungeon crawler set in a forgotten Norse world after Ragnarök. Explore ancient ruins, survive brutal tactical combat, uncover lost True Names, and fight your way home to the family waiting beyond death.

details.title: A Lovely Day in Hell
details.short_description: A point-and-click adventure where your only verb is SUMMON, and the only things you can summon are the four dead people you still remember. Every one you spend is gone for good. Hell is a hierarchy, everything in it has a price, and nothing on screen tells you what it is costing you.

details.title: Legendary Drinking Story
details.short_description: Every neighborhood had someone like him. Relive memories that began in the alleys of 1999 through first-person brawling. Read attacks, judge the distance, and find your opening after a step or dodge.

details.title: Demon Kitty: Trials!
details.short_description: Demon Kitty: Trials! is a hidden object adventure that plays like a roguelite. Help countless kitties across multiple runs, find lost objects in mysterious ancient ruins. Gain powers, transform your kitty, find the objects and collect as many kitties as you can!

details.title: The Last Code
details.short_description: Your gun shoots, pulls and pushes. Move objects and enemies, solve puzzles and use portals in this 2D sci-fi puzzle-platformer. You are an AI awakening on a space station overrun by machines.

details.title: Neironaut
details.short_description: Solve a mysterious case of disappearance with an unexpected help from your own dreams!

details.title: Odd Shop
details.short_description: Manage a haunted pawn shop in this cozy horror game. Cursed items are your most popular wares, but keeping them all under one roof can have deadly consequences. Upgrade and maintain the shop to build a retail reputation that cannot be denied...or make your money and get out before it’s too late.

details.title: SoulGraft
details.short_description: The spell-crafting bullet heaven where you earn your god-tier endgame. Graft runic circles to your soul, then unleash your creations on the daemonic hordes. Create 10^30 possible spell combinations and ascend to godhood.

details.title: Titan Sword
details.short_description: Sword. Giant. Boom. Grab a massive sword, hunt titans, and cut through everything in your way.

details.title: Fangjie:Shattered Altars
details.short_description: Wake in a shattered voxel world and set out to restore its lost altars. Explore wilds that are different every time, shape your playstyle with a class, skill tree and styles, tame nearly forty companions, and take on bosses with NPC allies or friends on Steam.

details.title: Break Free
details.short_description: Break Free is a First person speedrunning game about breaking free of your restraints, including the level itself.

details.title: YokaiRou: Shoppe of Mystique
details.short_description: A cozy supernatural mystery about listening to your customers' stories, uncovering the yokai troubling them through divination and deduction, and finding the right ritual to set things right.

details.title: PIPELINE
details.short_description: PIPELINE is a 1-6 player online co-op, physics-based, action FPS, rogue-lite where every bullet counts. Progress levels, ride around in the shopping cart, discover game-altering upgrades, get strong, fight even stronger enemies. Death is not the end. The cycle will repeat.

details.title: Sandbox Zombies
details.short_description: An action level editor. With zombies. Carefully set up your own elaborate scenarios, or revel in causing chaos. With no innate goal, Sandbox Zombies trusts you to find fun in creativity and mischief. Explore a depth of systems and share your levels with friends.

details.title: 世界不需要败犬 - ThEeNDoFMYwOrLd -
details.short_description: 是要靠自己的双手夺回属于自己的一切，还是用自己的双手「毁灭」这一切——一切的一切，只在「她/他」一念之间。 在这一切走向终局之时，「他/她」是否会后悔遇见对方呢。 ——这是一段在「沉默的误会」中，爱与恨交织的故事。「在还能做出选择之时，不要让自己后悔。」

details.title: Peace Island
details.short_description: Twenty years ago, the paradise was revived. After the signing of the "Tide City Peace Agreement", the Atlantic United States and the Blazing Sun Empire hired desperate individuals to delve into the cursed inner islands in search of those lost angels.

details.title: Latticefall
details.short_description: Latticefall is a slow-burn colony sim. The disaster doesn't strike — it creeps: an infection seeps quietly across the land. Build your settlement, hold the line, and reclaim ground one step at a time — paused and deliberate, never twitchy. Every advance has a price; you see it before you commit.

details.title: Birth of Nation
details.short_description: Birth of Nation is an alternate‑history strategy game blending interactive movie gameplay. In cinematic experience players can make choices affecting the plot and resources to manage a refugee nation, engage in diplomacy and trade, and ultimately gather forces for tactical battles against foes.

details.title: Popcorn Idle
details.short_description: Popcorn Idle is a cozy idle automation game about the simple joy of popping corn. Earn money, buy upgrades, automate and turn up the heat to boost production. Grow bigger numbers, unlock flavors and combine effects. Fill the whole machine with colorful, tasty popcorn, one crunchy pop at a time.

details.title: Who's Calling?
details.short_description: A home invasion thriller where your phone is your main enemy. The everyday routine, office work, and chores turn into a trap when an unknown person starts tracking every step you take. You've never been able to say no. Now you'll have to.

details.title: PSyChE DiVE
details.short_description: In this 2D shoot ‘em up, you play as Caroline, a psychologist that uses her meditation powers to help people! One day she meets a strange “person”, it will make her go through challenges before her life returns to normality! How will this story end?

details.title: Sparkborn
details.short_description: An atmospheric 2D metroidvania set in a world changed by a mysterious cataclysm, where many living creatures have vanished and toys have gained consciousness. Explore interconnected locations, unlock new abilities, fight enemies, and uncover the mystery behind this new form of life.

details.title: Tavern Tussle
details.short_description: Tavern Tussle is a 2–4 player local and online multiplayer fantasy-themed party game. Entertain the tavern in frantic minigames to pay off your debt, or be turned into a frog by the maniacal wizard!

details.title: Moorfall
details.short_description: Schwarzmoor has broken into Grimmwald. Moorfall is a top-down real-time strategy game: lead your captains across the moor, call volunteers to arms out of your villages, and take the enemy's ground village by village, before he takes yours.

details.title: Monstaurant
details.short_description: A two-player co-op horror comedy. Run a roadside diner for monsters: take the orders, cook the food, clean the toilets. Most of your customers just want dinner. Some of them came for you — and there is one shotgun on the prep counter.

details.title: No Death In Wild West
details.short_description: Play as time travelers wiping out cowboys with high-tech weapons. Overcome brutal terrain against an unforgiving timer. Master unique heroes with different movement styles to conquer the Wild West.

details.title: OS95 Plus!
details.short_description: OS95 Plus! is the newest first person puzzle adventure game from Gev Creates. You're stuck in a mysterious facility and are forced to indefinitely partake in software testing. You must navigate rooms and solve puzzles to escape and uncover the truth behind the experiment.

details.title: Knightwatch
details.short_description: By DAY - Build defenses and towers. BY NIGHT - grab weapon of your choice and fight off relentless waves of zombies, undead, werewolves and other monsters. In a FPS x Tower Defense game where you defend a winter town overshadowed by the King’s castle.

details.title: Kuny-Kuny Hog
details.short_description: A porky bullet hell, as chaotic and radioactive as it gets. Go after your acorns while you blast through by shooting and using your trusty roman shield to bounce back projectiles and mutant squirrels. Grab all the power ups you can in the midst of the battle!

details.title: Die to Play
details.short_description: Die to Play — a deckbuilder with dice, set on a cozy retro computer inside a medieval English mansion filled with horrors and mysteries.

details.title: Burakku Jakku Samurai
details.short_description: A tactical pixel-art roguelite. Manage your Ki up to a lethal limit of 21. Bend the rules of the duel with special cards to alter combat conditions. Risk it all to hit exactly 21 for a Perfect Focus lethal strike. Plan your route and survive. Your strategy is your sharpest weapon.

details.title: Gabby's Odyssey
details.short_description: Embark on a journey through the fantastical world of Larion in this action-adventure inspired by timeless classics of the genre. Solve clever puzzles, overcome perilous dungeons, and unlock new abilities — while discovering that imagination is not a weakness, but a force that can change everything.

details.title: Petty Kings
details.short_description: A pixel art Survival RTS where you rebuild a fallen kingdom by day, defend against brutal night raids, and march out to crush enemy outposts. Take back your crown!

details.title: Soulscape2 Fragments of The Present
details.short_description: Dive into a dark cyber noir conspiracy in this solo developed, story rich CRPG. Set in a dystopian near future, guide Blake Turner and his squad through isometric exploration, deeply strategic turn-based combat, branching dialogue, and infinite post game progression.

details.title: JungoJam
details.short_description: JungoJam now boasts a hip downtown strip, tranquil beaches, and islands perfect for unleashing your creativity. Here, you can be anyone you dream of! Team up with friends from across the globe to explore an interactive wonderland, design your Original Characters！

name: Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo

details.title: Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo
details.short_description: Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo is the definitive animated carpark chaotic parking simulator!!! Park cars before its too late!

details.title: The Exalted Descendant
details.short_description: Rebuild a fallen species in this dark sci-fi 4X strategy game. Extract and refine real elements, command drone swarms, and make tough choices as you guide The Exalted Descendant toward resurgence—or extinction—in a procedurally generated galaxy. No diplomacy. No mercy.

details.title: Expendabots
details.short_description: Expendabots is a 1–4 player co-op horror-extraction game where expendable robots explore ever-changing islands and terrifying dungeons. Outmatched and vulnerable, you’ll need to stay quiet, hide from hostile creatures, survive the horrors, and extract with your squad before the island is lost.

details.title: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure
details.short_description: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure is a charming 3D platformer collectathon full of adventure - and a hint of nostalgia! Play as Ponchyo the platypus and journey through a variety of vibrant worlds. Collect coins and discover new furniture to decorate your home.

details.title: Evelume
details.short_description: An atmospheric 2D adventure about a schoolkid in a small town where adults are stuck in a gray, monotonous life. Explore, fight, solve puzzles, and try to uncover the something that has drained people of joy.

details.title: Meowniverse
details.short_description: Merge endless cats on your desktop! Every cat you adopt becomes a unique part in your Collection. Evolve your cats, complete the Collection, and enjoy their company. They’ll embark on adventures, bringing you coins and fish! Get ready to huff cats and let their sweet meows lift your spirits!

details.title: Yominosono
details.short_description: A first-person horror exploration where Japanese mythology meets thalassophobia. With no power to resist, observe and evade as you wander the otherworld of Yomi. Flee, or bear your karma and seek atonement—your choices shape the ending. Yomi sees all that you are.

details.title: NAIRI: Blinding Light
details.short_description: A hand-drawn adventure blending visual novel storytelling with point-and-click puzzles. Explore the lush Penguin Lagoon and descend into the ruins of ancient civilizations. Beneath the city’s foundations, a colossal beast stirs…

details.title: By the Dead
details.short_description: Explore the dark, fight the un-dead forces, gather valuable resources, craft for survival, build safe shelters, and survive the night in this eerie open world survival crafting game!

name: Three Axes Bar: Paid or Pain

details.title: Three Axes Bar: Paid or Pain
details.short_description: Three Axes Bar: Paid or Pain is a rogue-lite with elements of horror, at the center of which stands the story of a broken man. Modify your body, explore the bar, and break the rules! Your main task is to survive and remain human, whatever that may mean…

details.title: Keepers of Umbrasil
details.short_description: A cozy sanctuary-building narrative adventure about befriending ancient spirits in a magical forest. Piece together clues to uncover their stories and memories. Rebuilding the sanctuary will take more than new buildings. You must rekindle hope. May the forest find all who are wild-called.

details.title: Good Boy Good Waves
details.short_description: Set out on a relaxing paddleboard journey across scenic island waters with your faithful canine companion. Catch the rhythm of gentle waves, balance your board, explore peaceful coastlines, and uncover tranquil island secrets together.

details.title: No;Heaven
details.short_description: No;Heaven is a short, single-player FPS featuring anime-style characters and gritty visuals reminiscent of early 2000s games. A young woman who has lost everything, including those she held dear, takes up arms. Witness where her path of revenge leads.

details.title: Silentes: Cursed Children
details.short_description: Explore Brazilian cities threatened by supernatural roots in this top-down 2D RPG. Investigate the source of the calamity alongside three heroes with special abilities tied to Brazilian folklore.

details.title: Amberly Hollow
details.short_description: A Life Sim RPG set in an isolated village. Train and master a variety of skills, collecting resources and rewards as you complete quests, upgrade your home, and discover the secrets of the village of Amberly.

details.title: STICKMAN DESKTOP MALWARS
details.short_description: A physics stickman brawler on a living computer desktop. The taskbar is the floor, windows are platforms and every app opens a new arena. Brawl as eight ragdoll fighters, each with their own attacks, or be the giant mouse cursor: charge a RAM, run VirusGuard on them and open a black hole.

details.title: Look Far
details.short_description: A narrative adventure that begins inside a star. You are a carbon atom, born alongside a beam of light. Your paths part. Drift through oceans and forests, and into a human life. Six and a half billion years pass for you. For the light, not a second.

details.title: Fondaco – A Venetian Merchant's Tale
details.short_description: January 1400: you are a novice merchant, unknown and with a couple of ships. Rise to the top of the Mediterranean markets, where events and rival companies can sink your trading house. Open Fondaco abroad, produce, trade and fight when you must: shape the future of the Mediterranean.

details.title: Kazu the Cassowary
details.short_description: Run, leap and claw-kick through an Australian-inspired world in this colorful single-player 3D platforming adventure. Help Kazu rescue his captured parents, explore varied landscapes and discover secrets along the way.

details.title: Beakwood
details.short_description: As a stork, deliver packages across Beakwood, a cozy town that changes with every season, while a gang of jealous, gadget-crazed hawks glide, hover and rocket in to sabotage your route.

details.title: ルルイエの子守唄
details.short_description: A Cthulhu Mythos mystery played like a tabletop RPG, with no Keeper required. In a snowbound city, uncover the truth about the girl you found in a park by linking the evidence you collect and rolling the dice. Japanese text only.

details.title: Mop & Plot
details.short_description: Clock in, clean up, and watch your back: in this chaotic online social deduction game for up to 12 players, paint walls, scrub floors, and finish the job while hidden Saboteurs wreak havoc. Use proximity voice chat to spot the culprits and vote them out!

details.title: Corrupted Seal
details.short_description: A dark action RPG in pixel art. The seal that held back the Corruption has been broken. Fight with sword, bow, staff or wand, hunt for loot, grow your seal trees and close the Rifts before the Abyss swallows the world.

details.title: Broom - The Card Game
details.short_description: A solitaire inspired by the italian game "Scopa". Complete the challenges before you run out of cards! Empower your Cups, collect Coins, transmute with Clubs, and cut through with Swords. And don’t forget the Brooms!

name: Tonald Dump: Make News Fake Again

details.title: Tonald Dump: Make News Fake Again
details.short_description: Lead Tonald Dump through a satirical, turn-based presidential campaign! Manipulate the media, influence voter groups, build political connections and navigate 600+ events across four campaign stages. Control the headlines. Win the election!

details.title: Touhou Chihaya Battle Festival
details.short_description: A fan-made Touhou Project 5v5 and 3v3 multiplayer battle game. Most of the Touhou cast is here, with free choice of items, lanes and skill loadout. Even leaving mid-match is free: something came up? No problem, your teammates take over your character. Oh, and a rabbit delivers your items.

details.title: Spellthief: The Borrowed Galaxy
details.short_description: Steal the powers of every enemy you defeat. Combine them into your own constellation, dodge bullet-hell patterns, and take down towering guardians in a top-down sci-fi roguelike. Bring back the dawn.

details.title: Soul Gear
details.short_description: A retro-evolved 3D Metroidvania that fuses the fast-paced third-person shooter gameplay with strategic RPG spellcasting! Play as Auruma, a soldier from the steampunk town of Iron Junction, and uncover the mystery surrounding her people as they realize their reality is a lie.

details.title: Moenie Kyk Nie
details.short_description: Inherit your late oupa's farm in the South African Karoo and clean it out to sell. Rebuild childhood memories you lost through old portraits, Afrikaans tapes and flashbacks that turn the house new again. Follow his handwritten rules. Above all: moenie kyk nie. Don't look.

details.title: Hide & Prey
details.short_description: Night falls on the orphanage, and the nun has awakened. In this 1 to 5 player cooperative horror game, hide, run, and unite to escape before she catches you. The slightest noise can betray you. Play as the orphans, or embody the nun and hunt your friends.

details.title: Ashenreach
details.short_description: Home lies in ashes. Follow a fallen star into Ashenreach, an old-school online RPG for small groups: tab-target combat, 4 classes, 260 voiced quests, dungeons, a raid, 14 crafts, your own home. Closed playtest: December 2026, dates to be announced.

details.title: Midnight Debt
details.short_description: A first-person night shop sim set in a town swallowed by fog. Read the news, stock up, haggle with strangers and serve shady buyers to pay off your debt. At 04:30 the street lamps begin to die. At 05:00 the fog takes anyone still outside.

details.title: POKUS
details.short_description: Sling spells and shatter friendships in a chaotic wizard tavern. In this online card battler for 2-6 player, play as petty mages whose hexes hilariously backfire. Break fragile alliances and haunt your friends from the grave in frantic 15-minute bouts of magical mayhem.

details.title: BRAZUELA
details.short_description: Start from scratch and build your own path in Brazuela, a political and life simulation game set in Brazil. Work, study, join a political party, run for office, build relationships, earn positions of power, and take part in the decisions that shape the world around you. Which path will you choose?

details.title: Alura Quest
details.short_description: A top-down action adventure in the spirit of the classic 8- and 16-bit quests: one big overworld, dungeons, caves and secrets everywhere. Unravel the mystery of the world of Gildilox and overcome the darkness that overtakes it.

details.title: BookBuster
details.short_description: The bookies ban winners. Become their worst nightmare in this incremental management game: find the odds they got wrong, hide your winnings across a network of accounts, and let your models and bots do the work until every bookmaker is bankrupt.

details.title: Card Thunder
details.short_description: Select cards from a 5x5 grid, stack powerful boosters and perks, and outscore escalating target scores in this spatial poker roguelike.

details.title: かみひより ～弓張り編～
details.short_description: Command four humans and four spirits in real-time tactical battles. Transfer spirits, manage spiritual energy, and analyze the lunar army to uncover its weaknesses. Combine careful planning with quick decisions to turn a desperate defense into a counteroffensive.

details.title: Gravewell
details.short_description: Defend the last Beacons in a first-person tower defense where you build on the battlefield and fight alongside your towers. Place defenses freely, wield weapons and powerful abilities, and battle through 24 handcrafted levels with over 150 tower variants.

details.title: Blackthorn: The Unquiet
details.short_description: Build a life in a town with something rotten beneath it. Work, steal, farm, craft, and romance its inhabitants—or venture into the wilds for loot and turn-based battles. Blackthorn is a text-based dark fantasy RPG where your choices can earn you a home, a fortune, or a grave.

details.title: One More Shift
details.short_description: Welcome to the family! Our company turns yesterday's waste into everything you use today. In this factory roguelite you build the line behind a giant recycler, turn scrap into anything from toasters to salvage robots and meet the quota. Mr. Quota is watching. Fondly.

details.title: Rails of Fortune
details.short_description: Build your transport company across Europe from 1850. Connect cities with trains, ships and airships, carry passengers and supply factories. Plan profitable supply chains, research new technology and compete with rival companies.

details.title: Barely a Village
details.short_description: Grow a tiny village on floating tiles,. Every day you only have a few actions, so use them wisely. Enemies hunt your villagers, smash your buildings and infect your land. When your village falls, unlock new research and try again.

details.title: PixelOffice
details.short_description: A tiny pixel office sits in a corner of your desktop and keeps you company while you work. Start the focus timer and its coworkers get to work; take a break and they wander off to the lounge for pool and small talk. Level up to grow the team, dress them up, and yes, you can pet the dog.

details.title: Insertion Burn
details.short_description: A real-time tactical space fleet simulation. Plan orbital maneuvers and intercept windows, track contacts across multiple sensors, coordinate your weapons and defenses, and defeat the enemy within the physical limits of propellant, power, and heat.

details.title: Run away from BLEB
details.short_description: You are a young female streamer trapped in a terrifying house by a maniac named Bleb. Outsmart him and escape... If you can.

details.title: HADAL: Into the Mariana Trench
details.short_description: Pilot real research submersibles from a ship off Guam to the floor of Challenger Deep, 11 km down. No monsters and no timers: your battery, your hull and how deep you dare to go decide every dive. More than 50 real species to find, each with a scientific source.

details.title: Campaign Season
details.short_description: A turn-based tactical board game that sees the player take on the role of an Officer in the Empire's army, recruit Soldiers, lead them on Campaign, and command them in battle.

details.title: Blind Dial
details.short_description: A pixel-art co-op action RPG for 1-4 players, online or on one screen. Dial a Gate to worlds nobody has charted, fight your way down, and decide when to turn back. What you bring home rebuilds the base. What you lose stays out there.

details.title: Waffles' Cranked Stories
details.short_description: Waffles' Cranked Stories is a selection of mini-games set in the same universe as Inspector Waffles, originally released exclusively on the Playdate console. This time, follow the adventures of Chance and Spike and discover new stories that expand on the previous ones!

details.title: Pixel Frenzy
details.short_description: Pixel Frenzy is a fast-paced first-person shooter game where you create your own combat style in fully destructible environments. Defeat the pixel monsters invading the real world. Grab your weapon and save the world by destroying everything in your path!

details.title: Rodent Company
details.short_description: Battle enemy pests using randomly generated toy guns, powerful perks and unique abilities! Join with friends in up to 4-player couch co-op and gather the best arsenal to win!

details.title: Ninja JaJaMaru: Yokai Night Parade
details.short_description: Ninja JaJaMaru-kun returns in a yokai-filled hack-and-slash action game! Stray into a dungeon party, defeat dancing yokai, master flashy Ninpo, and amass an arsenal of ninja gear! Clear special "Yokai Night Parade" rules for loot, decorate your base for stat boosts and save Princess Sakura!

details.title: Guardians Planetfall
details.short_description: From the creators of Guardians Frontline, Guardians Planetfall drops you into a galaxy-wide war for the fate of humanity. Fight assembled into squads of up to 4 soldiers in fast, tactical VR combat across space and dangerous planets filled with aliens, Void soldiers, and massive war machines.

details.title: ARES
details.short_description: ARES is a VR Milsim platform with interactive features, simulated combat scenarios, and customization options. Play solo or online with other players in different gamemodes across an open milsim sandbox experience rooted deep in player-driven campaigns missions, & scenarios. Gear up and embark!

details.title: KEMURI
details.short_description: KEMURI is a Yokai-Possession Action Adventure set in KEMURI CITY, where the everyday and paranormal cross paths. Explore as a Yokai Hunter, uncover the unseen with the FOXWINDOW, and wear their powers. Run the streets, race across walls, and cut through the air to dive into the supernatural!

details.title: Hack '95
details.short_description: Return to 1995, become a hacker, save the Internet. Take down an evil tech startup and shadowy government agency with a deck of illicit scripts and compromised servers. Meet freaks, geeks, and a virtual pug with a split personality and lack of bowel control.

details.title: Send Forth the Brave
details.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilder where you run an Adventurers’ Guild. Combine heroes, weapons, and items into teams, fulfill quirky commissions, deal with difficult clients, and build the most powerful guild in the realm.

details.title: Nascor Descent
details.short_description: Awaken in a tower beyond death, where five realms conceal unspeakable horrors. Fight your way through a labyrinth of deadly traps and monstrous foes, and let your morality shape your path to salvation. Will you reclaim your life, or be lost to the depths forever?

name: Last Wail of the Sea King

details.title: Last Wail of the Sea King
details.short_description: Explore the body of a dying sea beast in this first-person RPG with JRPG-inspired turn-based combat. Recruit bizarre companions, battle mutated creatures and uncover the secrets of the Sea King.

details.title: Polygrounds
details.short_description: Master rally-car physics in a neon 2D roguelite physics shooter. Navigate procedural vector dungeons, survive claustrophobic ambushes, face interesting foes, pick new guns, and draft run-defining cards. Will you build a game breaking deck or face an untimely end?

details.title: Unhex
details.short_description: Unhex is a replayable co-op survival-horror game. Your goal is to figure out which demon has possessed the victim, and to exorcise it once you know it. You do this by searching for occult items and observing the possessed’s behavior and interactions with the environment - all without being caught.

details.title: Shard Squad: Onyx Rising
details.short_description: Build a squad of elemental Shards in this roguelike auto-battler. Draft, position and level up your team, collect Relics, and chart a branching path through events, shops and bosses, or face other players’ squads in asynchronous multiplayer.

details.title: Something Really Evil Inc.
details.short_description: Take down an evil corporation by spreading memes and chaos with cute characters! Each week brings a new project, and each project is a chance to annoy and ragebait the CEO as you get projects delayed and cancelled.

details.title: Magic Link
details.short_description: Magic Link is a roguelike magic bullet-hell game. Play as a variety of fantasy characters, harness the power of magic, and defeat your enemies!

details.title: Demiourgos
details.short_description: A psychological horror game where you see and command the fate of living beings. Everything has an inevitable end, but who truly breaks the thread? What if your attempts to alter destiny are merely serving a far more terrifying design?

details.title: Mandragora Shinju
details.short_description: ある高校のスクールカウンセラーである主人公は、二人の少女が起こした心中事件に巻き込まれていく……。画面を二分割し、二人の少女を見比べながら進める「二画面同時進行」システムを採用。食い違う証言から事件の全体像が浮かび上がる。「rhizome village」が送るファナティックガールズトークADV。

details.title: Another 2D Platformer
details.short_description: A 2D platformer that starts simple, then keeps changing the rules with new mechanics, strange level gimmicks, and plenty of fourth-wall-breaking nonsense.

details.title: Rock Wager Scissors
details.short_description: Rock Wager Scissors is a logic & gambling game, where you get rich by adapting to your opponent's playstyle in Rock Paper Scissors. Make bets, use perks, study past moves, figure out your opponent's playstyle, and go all in!

details.title: Mega Sokofox World
details.short_description: Help Sara, the fox, overcome anxiety and leave her comfy labyrinth, to visit her beloved vampire girlfriend in this 16-bit Sokoban Adventure for the Mega Drive!

details.title: Duo Escape: Eden Protocol
details.short_description: Play a cooperative puzzle adventure for two. The future is here, and it ain’t pretty. The Earth is wrecked, and humankind has retreated to cryo stasis. The good news? You just thawed, and you’re not alone! Team up with a friend to explore the biofacility, solve puzzles together, and save humanity.

details.title: Nodus Attrition
details.short_description: Expand your base to reach the enemy threat. This is tower offense

details.title: The Final Showdown with AI!
details.short_description: A forum-battle game with bullet-hell combat. Su Shihe loves settling online disputes—until he finds himself against everyone. Caught between progress and salvation, what will he choose?

details.title: Eccentric Wander
details.short_description: Despite the genuinely horror-like atmosphere, the main characters are lighthearted, making it a stealth comedy horror!

details.title: Duskmont Files
details.short_description: The disappearance of a crooked politician with a taste for the bottle doesn't seem like much of a concern to private detective Ray Hardigan at first. But what appears to be a routine investigation in the perpetually overcast city of Duskmont quickly spirals into something far more dangerous...

details.title: Snakesweeper - minesweeper survival
details.short_description: A classic minesweeper variant, with some minimalist survival mechanisms. Reveal tiles to find resources to keep your thirst and hunger down, while avoiding the snake tiles. Game sessions take approx 10minutes to 1hour.

details.title: Terminal Swarm
details.short_description: A real-time space roguelite where your deck builds your warship mid-battle. Draw weapon blueprints, bolt railguns and missile racks onto your hull while the shots fly, then slow time to swat down the salvo. Every ship is built tile by tile and torn apart tile by tile. Yours too.

details.title: La Casa
details.short_description: A dice-rolling deckbuilding roguelike set in the Weird West of 1848. Fourteen days. One town. A warlock riding home to burn it down. Every card you play and every die you roll decides whether you survive the showdown. Go roll some dice.

details.title: Fury Drive
details.short_description: A lone traveler fights to survive a post-apocalyptic wasteland crawling with undead, mutants, and cultists. Drift, loot, and slaughter your way across the desert while building out your vehicle's arsenal.

details.title: HEAD FIRST, ROLL OUT!
details.short_description: Don’t control the head—control the floor. Dent the ground to create slopes, build momentum, and roll a disembodied head through obstacle-packed stages in this physics-driven 3D action game.

details.title: Clown Hole
details.short_description: There are clowns down there, in the hole. An incremental mining game where you mine clowns for profit.

details.title: Bloody Horror Plant
details.short_description: Bloody Horror Plant – probably the bloodiest casual point and click adventure game ever! Help Horror Plant solve interesting and funny point and click puzzles, kill evil dwarfs, save the forest and its creatures!

details.title: BLIGHTWRECK
details.short_description: Stuck at the bottom of the sea floor, escape a sunken ocean liner in this handcrafted 2D METROIDvania! Find powerful upgrades, and fight strange bosses. You may be isolated from your shipmates, but you're not alone...

details.title: Good Luck, Little Truck!
details.short_description: Good Luck, Little Truck! Is a genre-bending cozy navigation puzzler/narrative delivery sim. Set in a recovering post-collapse world where robots and humans coexist, help North Pacifica Island bounce back one delivery at a time!

details.title: Long Gone
details.short_description: Explore an abandoned suburban neighborhood decades after the outbreak. Solve environmental puzzles with your cat companion and uncover the secret lives of the people long gone through the belongings they left behind in this atmospheric 3D pixel narrative adventure. Oh, and watch out for the zombies.

details.title: Firearms Factory
details.short_description: A strategy-management game centered on weapons production and wartime logistics. Your candy factory is forced, by government order, to arm the military throughout both world wars. Set up production lines, supply the front lines, keep your workers alive, and determine the outcome of the war.

details.title: Bunker Builder Simulator
details.short_description: Plan your work, dig a hole and build a bunker, that will survive anything! Manage safety, needs and moods of your clients, so you can become the best architect and earn a fortune. Will you be able to meet the expectations?

details.title: Beasts of Steel
details.short_description: Beasts of Steel is a WWII combined-arms game. Fight as a rifleman, tank crew or pilot in the same battle, on maps generated from real landscapes, or command the whole war in a turn-based campaign. Play online with up to 64 players, or offline with bots in battles of up to 128 soldiers.

details.title: Badger Tactics
details.short_description: You stole and lost your sister's favorite figurines. Get them back or face her wrath! Fight, collect, and track down the missing figures before SHE finds you. In this retro turn-based tactical RPG, your fate is decided by the roll of the dice!

details.title: Food Industry
details.short_description: Build and expand in agriculture, industry and commerce. Evolve in the food industry sector, and weather the storms by helping your people build the new world.

details.title: Octopus City Blues
details.short_description: In a world of ice, the last human city is tearing itself apart. Explore the underbelly of a monstrous metropolis in a surreal adventure about everything and nothing.

details.title: ARIDA 2: Rise of the Brave
details.short_description: Journey through the 19th-century Brazilian backlands in this narrative, culturally rich adventure. Face the drought to explore arid biomes, craft and manage resources, complete quests, and guide Cícera to Canudos - the mythical village promising to change the story forever.

details.title: Mars Tactics
details.short_description: The Red Planet is at war. Lead either Capital’s corporate army or Labor’s worker revolutionaries and wage war across a vast strategic map, then assume direct control in turn-based tactical battles featuring artillery, vehicles, and fully-destructible environments.

details.title: Junxions
details.short_description: Answer your true calling as a traffic engineer in Junxions! Featuring comprehensive simulation, construction, and management tools, use careful planning to build roadways, railways, and walkways, and the complex interactions between them.

details.title: Proto Trigger
details.short_description: An arcade shoot'em up with unique power-infusion gameplay. Face down an unknown army alone or with a friend in online or local co-op. Navigate the cosmos to save the remants of humanity, or join them in extinction!

details.title: Restora: A Poster Restoration Game
details.short_description: Step into your workshop and give vintage movie posters a second chance. In this calming restoration sim, restore as many posters as you can before the day ends. Inspect each poster, repair damage through mini games, and bring it back to glory. How many posters can you save in time?

details.title: FoldLoop
details.short_description: FoldLoop is a detective game that emphasizes logical reasoning. To escape the curse of endless cycles, you'll observe the sandbox from a higher dimension, analyze the rulebook, and deduce the secrets of the real world.

details.title: Scourge of the Reptiles
details.short_description: Command dinosaurs. Master tactical combat. Shape your fate. Scourge of the Reptiles is a party-based tactical RPG set in a prehistoric low-fantasy world, where a devastating meteor grants magical powers to humans, elves… and dinosaurs. The result? War. Chaos. And something far worse.

details.title: Lost Zone: Survival
details.short_description: You wake on a barren island with no memory - the newest contestant of a survival TV show. Feed the Pit to bring the island back to life, build a raft and row out to strange islands rising from the sea. Loot fast: every island has its own way of ending.

details.title: Celestial of Dolls
details.short_description: Lead a humanoid squad from a roaming settlement base into a Dyson megastructure built by runaway AI under a binary star system. Fight the AI Guards, the Empire, and the Humanoid Cult, use Scarlet Particles and terrain tricks, and escort Io to rewrite civilization’s fate.

details.title: Conversations with My Imaginary Friends
details.short_description: A free collection of explorable scenes capturing conversations spanning two decades between the creator of To the Moon and the fictional characters they've created. About life, making games, and everything in between.

details.title: MESS
details.short_description: MESS is a multiplayer first-person jailbreak game where strategy, deception, and survival collide in a prison environment. Experience yourself in a role of Warden to maintain order, or Prisoner to try to break free and escape the prison.

details.title: Simulario
details.short_description: 2D physics based game. Particle physics, soft bodies, rigid bodies, motors, jet engines, forces, vehicles and space ships, explosions and realisic destructability - all kinds of physics stuff. The game contains very different levels, that utilize various aspects of physically simulated world.

details.title: Cozy
details.short_description: Build your dream farm, make lifelong friends, and experience the joys of small-town living in Cozy Town. Plant crops, raise animals, fish, craft, and enjoy seasonal festivals. Escape the hustle and bustle—relax and live your best life in a charming countryside adventure.

details.title: Katakamuna Idle
details.short_description: Experience cosmic harmony in this Katakamuna-inspired idle game. Gather "Ka," the essence of all existence, and weave the 80 verses of the Katakamuna Utahi. As an idle game, actions automate as you progress, allowing you to create harmony through color and sound, even when offline.

details.title: Pacific Fire
details.short_description: Pacific Fire is a turn-based strategic wargame set in the Pacific Theater of World War II using a node-based map, rather than hexes. Take command of US, Japanese, British, Australian, New Zealand, Chinese and Dutch forces in the Pacific and Southeast Asia from 1941-1945.

details.title: RABAUKEN - Spirit Resort
details.short_description: Build a spirit resort. Research. Expand. Idle. Crowd-control spirits. Repeat. An automation game designed to be played on the side.

details.title: Slaughter of Luminance
details.short_description: Search for your love in this devastating, unforgiving world of SOL. Face the burnt dystopia in search of what you had but lost. Get lost in the desert, encounter, help and eliminate characters.

details.title: Deck of Memories
details.short_description: Deck of Memories is a nostalgic deckbuilding adventure about the stories your grandfather left behind. Explore fragments of his life as a lighthouse keeper, manifested inside atmospheric dioramas. Craft and combine cards to restore these memories and discover the secrets they hold.

details.title: LIVING HELL
details.short_description: A co-op horror where you must escape a city in ruins, as solar radiation twists animals and humans into terrifying mutations. From the creator of DEVOUR.

details.title: Gang of Frogs
details.short_description: Sail through the galaxy as a fearless outlaw frog. Plunder loot, upgrade weapons, eat flies and fight through hordes of monstrous bugs in an intense 1-4 player co-op shooter.

details.title: Roleplay Passion
details.short_description: Step into a universe where every word matters and every choice opens unexpected paths. This is not your typical dating sim: here, the characters don’t follow fixed scripts they listen, react, and evolve with you.

details.title: Burnout Inferno Office Girl
details.short_description: Tokyo, 1992. Office worker Satomi endures one absurd day after another. When she hits her breaking point, she can download alternate versions of herself from other worlds. Borrow their unique personalities and abilities to fight back against work, relationships, and life's everyday nonsense.

details.title: Madness Afloat
details.short_description: Pilot customizable steamships through a Lovecraftian Polynesian archipelago. Explore and survive handcrafted missions, manage cursed cargo, and balance sanity against power. Face the deep alone or in optional co-op expeditions.

details.title: Tiny Track Labs
details.short_description: Build a tiny toy race track piece by piece: loops, wall rides, barrel rolls, jumps, a 3-lane viaduct and portals. Then sit back. Little toy cars race, flip and crash on their own, and a tiny mechanic runs out to fix them. A relaxing idle racer you watch grow.

details.title: Ink And Table
details.short_description: A cute action roguelike where you play a tiny doll defending a girl’s possessed home, one tabletop at a time. Dodge bullet-hell barrages with simple left-right movement as you command flying swords and fire ink bullets at haunted teacups, ink paintings, and even braised pork.

details.title: Double Trouble Delivery
details.short_description: A two-player online coop physics game. One of you drives, the other keeps the packages balanced. Solve mini-games, dodge obstacles, and find the right house before the dogs steal your cargo.

details.title: Manga Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Sales by day, loot hunting by night. Stock the shelves of your shop with fresh manga volumes and serve your customers. By night, open your eyes in a dungeon spilling off the page, defeat monsters and collect your loot. What will you find to display in your shop?

name: Circuit Depot - Retro Computer Shop Simulator

details.title: Circuit Depot - Retro Computer Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run a small-town computer shop in 1999. Buy broken PCs for a few dollars, open them up, find the fault and repair them, build custom machines for customers, stock the shelves and grow the store. Then close up shop and play the games on the computers you saved.

details.title: ACID DROP DOWNHILL: WITH UZI
details.short_description: Downhill as far away as you can from a nuclear explosion on your skateboard // snowboard or surf while shooting it with uzi to do tricks. Hope you are faster than the nuke. ACID DROP DOWNHILL IS THE BEST YOU EVER FEEL

details.title: Sunderkin
details.short_description: Venture into a broken land and forge a hero strong enough to overthrow its tyrant. Loot gear, collect spells, and combine them into a build of your own. Then put it to the test in brutal turn-based duels where every blow counts.

details.title: Gnolf
details.short_description: Gnolf is an incremental mini-golf automation game, in which you play as a gnome building a golfing rube goldberg machine in an attempt to win a goddess's favor.

details.title: The Last Bureau
details.short_description: In this pessimistic and atmospheric grid-based horror game, you wonder if still being alive really is a blessing, or a fate much worse than death.

details.title: Porta Patrol
details.short_description: A co-op comedy game for 1-4 players running a porta-potty service at music festivals. Drive the tanker, pump out full toilets, pressure-wash the mess, crane-lift cabins with someone still inside and hose down gatecrashers. Keep the festival clean to win bigger contracts. It's just another shift.

details.title: The Somnus Fracture
details.short_description: First-person psychological horror. Alex Reed signed up for Project Somnus to finally sleep. Every session drops him into a dream built from his own past, and something that knows his name is waiting there. Hide, run, and put back the life he can’t remember.

details.title: 塑时者Derealization
details.short_description: "Derealization" is a visual novel that combines Japanese campus youth, suspenseful loops, and supernatural combat. The main characters in this work are voiced by professional Japanese actors. Inserting original animation clips into the climactic scenes greatly enhances the impact of the plot.

details.title: Humbuggest
details.short_description: Ziggy wants the crown and will do anything to steal it, even if it means breaking the law by breaking the laws of physics. Manipulate time and solve fourth-wall-breaking riddles in this comedic 2D puzzle-platformer filled with classic pixel art.

details.title: Zorehrai: Space Formations
details.short_description: Start with your own character and a small ship in a world that lives independently of the player. Develop your skills, explore space, trade, build industry, and grow your fleet to survive real-time battles against hostile fleets—and something far more terrifying lurking in the darkness.

details.title: Catino Town
details.short_description: Raise cute creatures that can transform into over 150 unique evolutions! Play games, decorate their home, and explore their world!

details.title: Beyond the Noise: Radio Observatory
details.short_description: Beyond The Noise: Radio Observatory is an indie project created by a radio astronomy enthusiast. Build and manage your own radio observatory. Operate powerful radio telescopes, explore the universe, detect realistic cosmic signals and uncover mysteries hidden beyond the noise.

details.title: Across Crime
details.short_description: A deduction game where every case challenges you to uncover who committed the murder, with what, and where. Step into the shoes of Leah Sharp, a detective working for an agency that uses neural synchronization to send its investigators into reconstructed crime scenes across time and space.

details.title: Sneak Souls
details.short_description: A familiar cubic aesthetic, an extinct ancient underground civilization, and a living plant. Check out what awaits you!

details.title: Ode to War
details.short_description: A civilization MMO: from a single town to a galactic empire. The server ticks once an hour and keeps running while you sleep. You administer towns, not a nation, so each one holds its own stores and anything you need from a neighbor has to be traded for.

details.title: Ruminate: The First Oath
details.short_description: This is a dark fantasy where the world has been divided and cursed. Your party will go on adventures and have the chance to remove the curses from the kingdoms and unite them! The world depends on you. Will you be their saviour or their downfall?

name: Heroic Hop: The Colorful World of Blocks and the ChromaLords

details.title: Heroic Hop: The Colorful World of Blocks and the ChromaLords
details.short_description: Jump into a vibrant retro platforming adventure! Defeat the five Color Lords, conquer deadly traps, collect Enemy Badges, uncover hidden secrets, and restore the colorful Block Kingdom. Includes a playable demo!

details.title: Yuoh　～Escape from the Empire～
details.short_description: A sleek, fast-paced vertical bullet-hell shooter. Harness a vast arsenal of gear and shatter the tactics of the relentless enemies closing in.

details.title: Her Milk, My Coffee
details.short_description: The tastiest coffee is made with milk. Or, more precisely, with her milk... Brew coffee, add all kinds of ingredients, serve it to cats, and make money. And you are going to need a lot of money, because you will be spending it all on gifts to take the cow girl on dates.

details.title: Misohagi Crossing
details.short_description: On his first visit to his father's rural hometown in seven years, Hotaru reunites with his first love—only to learn that she died three years ago. Explore Yokomizo, uncover the truth behind a family tragedy, and escape supernatural otherworlds in this Japanese horror mystery adventure.

details.title: Dicey Darlings
details.short_description: Dicey Darlings is a tabletop-style, turn-based tactical roguelike. Lead standees across hex battlefields as physical dice tumble into play. Choose your route, combine skills and items, and use positioning and terrain to beat tough foes. The dice bring chance. You choose your next move.

details.title: One More Planet
details.short_description: Mine asteroids, build defenses, and conquer planets across distant galaxies. Explore open space, complete missions, unlock new technologies, and defend your settlements against attackers. One More Planet is an action & exploration game set in a physics-driven 2D space sandbox.

details.title: Echo Era
details.short_description: Build a party, explore a kingdom under tyranny, and choose your battles in this classic-style JRPG. Recruit adventurers by class, uncover side quests and secrets, and face enemies in turn-based combat. The goddess has called, now lead your journey to where ever it may end.

details.title: Make Them Mine
details.short_description: An incremental game where you build slime-shooting cannons to mine gold... wait, what? That's right: build cannons on a grid and shoot slimes to mine gold, smash enemies and activate mysterious mechanisms. Complete the skill tree to unlock new cannons, slime upgrades, and new mechanics.

details.title: Holon
details.short_description: Build factories inside factories. Extract shapes, automate production, and deliver increasingly complex designs to the Hub. Enter a Nest to build its machinery, reuse it as a single building, then fit smaller Nests inside larger ones to take your factory further. About this game

details.title: Juicicora
details.short_description: Explore Elyndor in a colorful cozy co-op adventure for up to five players! Discover 25 magical fruits, press powerful juices, master playful movement, meet quirky Souls, make a home, and sail into exciting challenges. Adventure together, chase best times, or challenge friends to duels!

details.title: Peep
details.short_description: Peep is a psychological horror game that mixes the retro PSX-style 3D perspective with 2D point-and-click. You awaken trapped in an ever-changing room with peepholes looking into different realities. Use your wits to solve twisted puzzles to help strange individuals and you may just escape alive.

details.title: Rokujo Hitoma
details.short_description: A 1-bit action-adventure, a shy shut-in descending from his tiny six-tatami room into the underground. Top-down exploration, enemy battles, key hunting, and the power of true friendship. (There is no friendship.)

details.title: Mindvale
details.short_description: Master frantic bullet-hell runs, turn hard-won knowledge into game-breaking builds and bring resources back to the surface. Craft, expand your base against the ever-enclosing corruption, produce more to heal your land’s mysterious affliction and defeat the Death Core.

details.title: Camedieo
details.short_description: A score chase roguelike deckbuilder played with dice. Every hand splits in two: the dice you Cast and the ones you Outcast. The points from each are multiplied together to produce your score. Collect cameos, upgrade your deck using cups and try to break the scoreboard!

details.title: Sizzling
details.short_description: Play a small rolling ball in a relaxing adventure incremental game. Enhance your ball and your world as you progress, discover its mysteries and push back its frontiers to learn why this world went blank !

details.title: Flailbo
details.short_description: Soar and dive through the world of Flailbo! Meet curious characters and restore happiness to the Frends by returning their missing belongings! Platform and explore colorful areas to help all thirty Frends!

details.title: Oaks vs Orcs
details.short_description: A roguelike kingdom builder with fast runs & crazy builds. Draft cards to grow a stronghold of deadly plants. Route the river to chain powerful bonuses across your tiles. Survive the orc siege and watch your army crush the horde.

details.title: The Night Archive - Sable's
details.short_description: One night alone at the campground he loved as a kid. Closed for years, chained at the gate, rotting. A friend arrives at sunrise. Episode 2 of The Night Archive.

details.title: Tomb Zombies
