details.short_description: Chaotic Republican-era China shrouded in dark fog. Play as a wandering Taoist with peachwood tools and cinnabar talismans, defeat ghosts and flying jiangshi to calm evil spirits.

details.title: I Think I Killed Someone
details.short_description: A non-linear psychological horror puzzle mystery where you suffer from dementia and wake up next to a dead body in your apartment. Piece together the seven days of your life in chronological order to uncover what really happened over the past week.

details.title: Temp Agency
details.short_description: Temp Agency is a chaotic office co-op game where you and a friend race against the clock to survive increasingly ridiculous office jobs through different levels and offices. Answer phones, deliver packages, brew coffee, and work together to keep the office running. Or at least try to.

details.title: Monochrome Rainbow
details.short_description: Monochrome Rainbow is a surrealist card game

details.title: Gacha The Frog
details.short_description: Collect and play with cute frogs in a cozy physics simulation. Use the machine to get new frogs, play mini-games to improve the odds of getting legendary frogs and manage your space so you can keep playing. Can you complete the album?

name: Riggin Farm: Raw Land to Riches

details.title: Riggin Farm: Raw Land to Riches
details.short_description: A long-form farming and business management RPG where you transform raw land into a thriving farm. Grow crops, raise livestock, sell at markets, hire employees, expand your operation, manage finances, and survive the unpredictable realities of farming.

details.title: TALES UNFOLD
details.short_description: Explore different worlds, share clues, and change each other’s surroundings as you restore tangled tales. TALES UNFOLD is a two-player online co-op puzzle adventure inspired by Korean folklore.

details.title: War Mart
details.short_description: The apocalypse is here and the shelves are emptying fast. You and your friends must get that last toilet paper roll in this co-op mayhem. Steal carts, sabotage your rivals, and fight dirty to reach the checkout first. Get what you need by any means necessary.

details.title: Deadship Protocol
details.short_description: Co-op action for 1 to 4 players, online or on one screen. Fight through four areas of a dead ship full of monsters. Your guns fire on their own: you move, dash and use your skill. Pick an upgrade after every room and beat a boss in each area.

details.title: Looking for a Property?
details.short_description: Listen to your customers, find out what they really want, and search for the right property to recommend in this real estate simulation and story-driven adventure. Work alongside your boss, Hisui Odate, at a small neighborhood agency and help each customer find a place they can truly call home.

details.title: Cairnforge
details.short_description: A sandbox based fantasy survival game. Invent. Craft. Use. Flourish.

details.title: HIVEROT
details.short_description: HIVEROT is a hardcore round-based zombie FPS. Fight evolving hordes across 10 maps, build powerful loadouts, discover secrets, and stand your ground against a wide variety of enemy types that stumble, burn, break, and fly as you cut your way through them.

details.title: Pingorile 2
details.short_description: Pingorile is back! In this 2D platformer, explore new and bigger levels, overcome obstacles and discover new environments. Can you build a rocket and fly to the Moon?

details.title: Slasher Manager
details.short_description: Become the slasher in a darkly comic horror clicker set inside a killer’s hand-drawn notebook. Turn Screams into ridiculous upgrades, chain combos, and automate the hunt—then take on bosses that change the rules. Nine locations. One very questionable career.

name: There is no HERO: Desktop Quest

details.title: There is no HERO: Desktop Quest
details.short_description: In this comedic desktop companion RPG, let the villagers worship your woolly savior, gather resources, build and defend your town, all while you are being productive!

details.title: DeadStuck
details.short_description: Take on the role of a sinner fighting for absolution against hordes of the damned. Inspired by arcade light gun shooters and boomer shooters, use your quick reflexes tools of divine condemnation to come out victorious!

details.title: Risk & Responsibility
details.short_description: A corporate crisis management simulation where every decision has a cost, every audit has a deadline, and one wrong call can cost careers, compliance, and lives.

details.title: Comet Isle, July 6
details.short_description: Experience the chaos of 50 visual novels running in parallel over a single day! Immerse yourself in the daily lives of the townsfolk, swap freely between each unique protagonist, and navigate a domino-web of storylines and consequences to save the island from its cometary fate.

details.title: Spy Diner
details.short_description: "Spy Diner" is a click-and-run adventure game combining restaurant management and spy infiltration. Players run a diner by day next to the century-old "Old Chiang's Braised Pork Rice" as a good neighbor, and execute takedown plans by night under handler orders.

details.title: THE SHOW
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror extraction gameshow. Enter deadly labyrinths, solve puzzles, steal valuable loot, and build a fortune for the masses' entertainment. Push your luck, go deeper, and extract before you lose everything...

details.title: Gravitten VR
details.short_description: Grab, climb, and turn your world upside down! Become Gravitten, the gravity-defying kitten, and master the environment's shifting physics. Experience 5 distinct biomes where up is down and left is right.

details.title: SIDEROS
details.short_description: Iron, the fundamental element of the world, was cursed by the magic lords of earth, water, air and fire to rust. In this high fantasy turn-based RPG you take the role of the iron knight in his quest to stop rust from destroying the world.

details.title: PODER
details.short_description: Run a district in a 12-million Latin American megacity in a political strategy about power, compromise, and dirty deals. 100+ starting combos, 75 population groups, and no decision without consequences. Can you do better than those you love to hate?

details.title: Travel the Backrooms
details.short_description: "Travel the Backrooms" is a horror puzzle game that supports 1-4 players! Explore a variety of levels, solve the unique puzzles of each level, and be careful not to get caught by the "Entities"...

details.title: Cyber Demon Protocol
details.short_description: An antique computer has granted you the ability to summon cyber demons. Seeking power from demons is like dancing on a tightrope, from Lawful Good to Chaotic Evil, how will you choose? Will you collude with the wealthy, politicians, stars, and artists, or change this decadent society?

details.title: Plesiotopia
details.short_description: A wholesome marine sanctuary sim, where you take care of giant sea reptiles from the dinosaur era. Nurse ichtyosaurs, plesiosaurs and mosasaurs, train them for the wild, then search the Pacific Ocean for a suitable marine ecosystem where you can release them.

details.title: ESCAPE: Orphanage
details.short_description: A psychological thriller set in Scarlet Orphanage, where every choice shapes the fate of the residents. Nothing is as it seems. Are you facing ghosts… or something far worse?

details.title: Backpack Roguelike
details.short_description: Arrange, merge, and synergize gear inside a growing backpack, then survive real-time waves and brutal bosses. Every slot shapes your build in this strategic action roguelite with persistent progression. Experiment, adapt, and turn limited space into your strongest weapon.

details.title: One Coin Museum
details.short_description: Explore, collect, and build your very own cozy museum! In One Coin Museum, travel across the seas and use your claw to grab hidden treasures. Display your finds to attract visitors, grow your reputation, and upgrade your boat to reach even more distant wonders.

details.title: Grey Heritage: Counter Gambit
details.short_description: Grey Heritage: Counter Gambit is the grand finale to the tactical RPG trilogy. Command a massive cast of returning heroes in the series’ most strategic entry yet. Master evolved turn-based combat, guide your army through tactical challenges, and witness the conclusion to every character's story.

name: 三位一体！超異常混沌賭博遊戯～アルティメットカオスギャンブルバトル～

details.title: 三位一体！超異常混沌賭博遊戯～アルティメットカオスギャンブルバトル～
details.short_description: Welcome to ULTIMATE CHAOS GAMBLING BATTLE! Playing cards, mahjong, and hanafuda—all mixed together! Behold an unprecedented incremental gambling roguelike! In three completely different modes, watch your bankroll skyrocket at a breakneck pace!
developers: キザミレモントースト

details.title: Fluffy Spider
details.short_description: A fluffy spider. Tricky jumps. A web to call home. Explore a colourful 2D platformer, find secret worlds, then build a network of insect traps in your idle hub. Collect silk, unlock talents and characters, and fill your radio with original songs.

details.title: ワタシがVtuberデス
details.short_description: Genre: VTuber × Comedy × Despair × Exploration Adventure

details.title: BODY COUNT
details.short_description: Drive to catch bodies, crash to rewind time. Road rage at your past selves in this physics-driven, arcade-style game!

details.title: TOKENS: Rogue Club
details.short_description: Launch explosive combos and master your luck in TOKENS: Rogue Club, a tic-tac-toe deckbuilder roguelike. Every flip counts while you forge synergies with Arcanes, Effigies, and Harmonies. Paris's nightlife in the 1920s with its artists, magicians, and exciting challenges awaits! Welcome to the club!

details.title: Mineral Zone
details.short_description: Build a factory by day, defend it by night. Mine ore, automate it over belts and keep the grid alive, then hold the line with towers your factory feeds and your own ship in the fight. Solo or online co-op for up to 4 players.

details.title: BUS: Bro u Survived
details.short_description: Ride through the apocalypse with your friends! BUS: Bro U Survived is a co-op story-driven adventure featuring your very own bus! Fight zombies, gather resources, help other survivors, and solve puzzles. Can you uncover the truth about the beginning of the epidemic and decide the fate of the island?

details.title: Record Studio Tycoon
details.short_description: Run a record label from one room in 1950 through seven decades of changing taste. You decide who gets signed, what they’re paid, and how their record sounds. When the reviews come in, there’s no one else to blame.

details.title: The Lost Wild
details.short_description: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.

details.title: Mayfly
details.short_description: Mayfly is a first-person psychological horror game set aboard a narrowboat in Northern England. You wake alone to find your husband is missing as you weave through a shifting, unstable reality. Search your confined surroundings to unravel the mystery in this focused narrative horror game.

details.title: SuperWEIRD: Automation Roguelite
details.short_description: An automation roguelite for 1–4 players. Set worker bots to craft and deliver supplies while fighting bots battle the Goofy Goo. Piece a broken planet back together, strengthen your production network and try new strategies on each run.

details.title: Descent Of Lunaris
details.short_description: Assemble your squad and explore a lunar base where cosmic horrors warp your reality, challenge your strategy, and break your sanity. Descent of Lunaris is a grid-based dungeon crawling RPG inspired by Wizardry and Shin Megami Tensei.

details.title: Starshard Brigands
details.short_description: Starshard Brigands is a first-person dungeon crawler with grid-based movement, where shifting loyalties and hard choices shape your fate. As a nameless mercenary in a fractured world, decide where you stand—or stand alone.

details.title: Lead The Dragon
details.short_description: Join your crew and conquer the narrow roads of America. Explore the open world, earn respect and money by competing in street races, but breaking the law will bring you serious trouble with the police.

details.title: POSTAL 2 Redux
details.short_description: POSTAL 2 Redux lets you loose in the most chaotic sandbox shooter ever, fully reimagined for a new generation. Survive a week in Paradise, Arizona - buy milk, return books, or go completely POSTAL with an arsenal of weapons. The choice is yours…but good luck staying out of trouble.

details.title: Rise & Reign
details.short_description: Washed ashore on a strange medieval land, it's up to you to choose your destiny. Harvest resources, craft weapons, and build your kingdom. Raid other players or form alliances. Serve the king or take the throne for yourself. This land is harsh, can you survive?

details.title: Militsioner
details.short_description: Every move you make is being followed by a Colossal Policeman. Anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive or even romance him to escape in this kafkaesque immersive sim.

details.title: Capital Command
details.short_description: Take the helm of a state-of-the-art warship as you fight epic space battles in a sandbox campaign. Upgrade and customize your ship, master the art of maneuvering, and use a blend of tactical prowess and heavy firepower to overcome deadly threats.

details.title: Bosslords
details.short_description: Gather an army of monsters and misfits to march on the Imperial Capital in this fantasy roguelite auto battler. Explore procedurally generated worlds filled with powerful weapons and artifacts as you gather new recruits to take to battle and show them who's boss!

details.title: BLACKFROST: The Long Dark 2
details.short_description: A year after the Aurora’s appearance & the world went dark, the people of Harmont & its vast wild environs struggle to survive the Quiet Apocalypse. Survive alone or with others against a host of new hazards & a fresh new survival sandbox from a pioneer of the genre. Live together. Die alone.

details.title: Generation Ship
details.short_description: Humanity's last hope is you. As its AI, build a generation ship, until the rotating ring can leave a dying Earth behind. Recycle everything your crew needs, keep them alive and fly supply missions in a realistic real-time colony and space simulation.

details.title: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 3
details.short_description: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 3 is a wholly-new Dragon Ball experience, where you decide the hero you want to be in an unexplored Dragon Ball world: AGE 1000.

details.title: The Walker
details.short_description: The Walker is a single player survival horror game. Peaceful days have passed, you no longer work to eat, but try to survive. Find out what's behind all this, hope you make it out alive.

details.title: Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement
details.short_description: Unravel the dark history of the Bloodstained universe and explore a hauntingly immersive 16th-century England steeped in a 2.5D gothic atmosphere, enthralling players in strategic battles, crafting, and exploration across a sprawling, cursed land.

details.title: Everbloom
details.short_description: Everbloom is a cute and cozy social farming sim set in a world of whimsy - grow buckets of popcorn right on the plant and make chocolate milk by feeding your cows candy bars. Grow, care, build, decorate, and explore the world of Everbloom solo or with your friends.

details.title: Rooted
details.short_description: In this solo and multiplayer survival game, explore an ancient overgrown world full of dangers. Salvage, build, craft, hunt,.. and try to survive alone or with your friends in an evolving and fascinating post-apocalyptic environment. Powered by Unreal Engine 5.

name: Water Margin: Rise of the Outlaws

details.title: Water Margin: Rise of the Outlaws
details.short_description: A story-driven grid tactics RPG set in China's classic Water Margin. Fight beside Shi Jin, Lu Zhishen and Lin Chong through the novel's famous scenes and choose how they end. Walk the Righteous, Pragmatic or Ruthless path: heroes join or leave you for it, and the fallen stay dead.

details.title: Singing Attorney: Verdict by Midnight
details.short_description: Expose the contradictions. Deduce the lyrics to the truth. Find the holes in the testimony. Tear it apart with evidence. Amnesiac rookie lawyer Kanade must defend a star streamer accused of murder. Why was the dead man clutching an old handheld? A courtroom mystery where deductions become lyrics.

name: 敲敲小镇：桌面锻造物语

details.title: 敲敲小镇：桌面锻造物语
details.short_description: Type to mine, smelt, and forge gear with random affixes. Welcome residents, battle monsters and village trials. Stronger residents mean faster automated production. Start with one blacksmith shop and grow your town!

details.title: Forgotten Tactics
details.short_description: Fantasy grand strategy on the map, turn-based tactics on the field. Govern 71 counties, strike treaties and break them, while 17 rival houses and roaming fiends move at once. When armies meet, lead your champions into skill-card battles where one careless push can cost a whole company.

details.title: The Monsters' Child
details.short_description: This is a daughter-raising game set in a world of monsters. As a monster chosen to be her guardian, you’ll raise the only human girl in the world, helping her learn, make friends, and explore a world that is both unfamiliar and welcoming.

details.title: Abyss at Hand
details.short_description: Form an adventuring party on your own or with friends, and set out to defeat this world’s Demon Lord! Abyss at Hand is a multiplayer action-adventure game for 1–4 players. Experience thrilling, adrenaline-pumping battles in a vast fantasy world!

details.title: True Cult
details.short_description: True Cult is a 2D auto-scrolling shooter blending roguelite progression with shoot 'em up action. Lead a procession escorting the Pretender to the site of their sacrifice: the Holy Hole. Enrich the Cult, obtain powerful relics, upgrade your cultists, and sacrifice every Pretender!

name: Onka: Echoes of the Spirit Prison

details.title: Onka: Echoes of the Spirit Prison
details.short_description: Even those you fear once had lives of their own… Explore a Japanese manor in another realm, solve puzzles, and escape vengeful spirits as you uncover a family's past in this story-driven 3D Japanese horror adventure.

details.title: Yonder Shores
details.short_description: Yonder Shores is a relaxing island diorama builder. Sculpt land from the sea, place cozy coastal cottages, and design charming harbours that adapt to the terrain. Featuring dynamic wildlife, weather, and zero timers or failure states, craft your peaceful seaside sanctuary at your own pace.

details.title: Curse of Beauty
details.short_description: Beauty demands sacrifice. Here, it's literal. Clock in at a factory that makes cosmetics out of people. Mix the ingredients, follow instructions, and try not to dwell on what you're doing. By the end of your shift, your hands will still be dirty.

details.title: Pull Over!
details.short_description: A co-op detective horror game set at a roadside militia checkpoint in 1991. Check papers, search cars and make quota by morning. Some of the drivers aren't human. Spot them and shoot first

details.title: Tavern of Tells
details.short_description: A social deduction game where you uncover the lucky number of each hero gathered at the tavern! Read their clues, work out who is lying, and place enchanted coins across 100 levels. Correct matches stay put, so every deduction brings you closer.

details.title: Dead North
details.short_description: A hardcore survival game set in the north, solo or in co-op for up to 4 players. Built as an immersive sim, it has no scripted encounters. Fire a gun and everything in earshot hears it. Steal from a village and they remember your face. Light a fire at night and something will come to see it.

details.title: Semaphore
details.short_description: A train simulator with systemic horror. You are the driver and the conductor of a night train in the People's Republic of Ordovia. Drive the train, meet the passengers, check their papers and look after them. Solve the mysteries of Ordovia's railways and fulfil the state's plan.

details.title: Dark Gothic Doll Party
details.short_description: Before her mainspring stops, a wind-up doll girl climbs a gothic clock-tower theatre to meet its master. A bullet-hell shooter across five acts and an extra stage: gather screws to buy time, face six doll bosses, and reach one of four endings that change with difficulty. Relief Mode included.

details.title: FATHOM
details.short_description: Send your crew deep into an alien ocean in this pixel-art desktop companion idler. Research strange creatures, harvest and refine resources, expand your deep-sea research platform, and discover the secrets lurking beneath the waves.

details.title: Scrambled Ships
details.short_description: A Yacht Dice Roguelike set on a ship with a mysterious figure, trapped in an endless game night atop a sunset cruise. Think outside the box, buy items, and progress through the rounds, or fall to the ever-increasing score targets.

details.title: VOTUM
details.short_description: Votum is a turn-based roguelite inspired by Ancient Rome. In the ruins of Aeterna, champions chosen by the Sibyl face tactical battles and harsh choices as they venture into the temple to uncover the source of the Soul Affliction.

details.title: Documancy
details.short_description: An incremental management game where you use magical documents to empower an auto-battling warrior. Every victory unlocks a new document, introducing a new way to improve your warrior. What will the next one do?

details.title: Midwatch Engineer
details.short_description: You are a ship engineer, keep watch at night, build and repair stuff on a lathe and a milling machine by day. In this Game you will machine parts from raw metal instead of just combining items to craft. You directly control the axis of the lathe.

details.title: Tea by the Sea
details.short_description: A cozy tea shop by the sea in a strange digital world. Grow tea, make drinks, get to know the locals, and decorate your shop. Enjoy quiet days in this seaside town while discovering the unusual things happening around you.

details.title: 野生机
details.short_description: Step into BIO: Wild Machine—a hand-drawn biopunk world created by the author, and explore the perilous "New Tower of Babel," a city once a milestone in human life technology, now in decline. You must reinvent yourself, battling powerful enemies and unknown fears in harsh turn-based combat.

details.title: Songkran Hazard: 4Lom
details.short_description: Lock, load, and stay dry! Step into the soaked slippers of Rookie Cop “Lee” in this high-octane survival “horror?”. Armed with water guns and wet powder, escort Anchan through Bangkok's chaotic Silom Road during the wildest Songkran outbreak ever. Can you survive the Songkran hazard?

details.title: The Grander
details.short_description: Settle a 10,000 year war in this comedic Top Down Action RPG where God is just a guy in jeans. Gather powerful weapons and even more powerful allies as you dash, slice, shoot, and bomb your way through a war-torn world.

details.title: Padlova Street
details.short_description: Guide Kapo through an acid-soaked apocalypse of deadly traps, crawling foes and flying enemies. Padlova Street is a hardcore 2D platformer: time your jumps, risk it for stars and beat your best time. Learn the route with checkpoints in Light or climb the leaderboard in Hardcore.

details.title: MAGEKIN
details.short_description: Battle rival mages, collect spells, and build ridiculous combos in a third-person multiplayer arena. Grow stronger as you fight players and waves of monsters, grab powerful loot, and finish with the highest score to win.

details.title: House of 21
details.short_description: Fight cursed enemies in a blackjack roguelike deckbuilder set inside a phantom casino purgatory. Push your luck, upgrade your cards with unique badges, collect relics, and uncover strange events as you battle your way out of the House. If the House lets you…

details.title: Underground Sweeper
details.short_description: A side-scrolling exploration game with light looting and incremental progression. Explore underground ruins, defeat monsters, collect and sell loot, upgrade your gear and abilities, venture deeper, and pay off your debt.

details.title: KANKERI: Can Kick Clash
details.short_description: Kick the can to start. Spotted? Race the Oni (the seeker) to the can and kick it first. That's kick-the-can, but this time it's a fight. Kick the can, level up for weapons and gadgets, take down rivals, and kick it again. Online asymmetric multiplayer: 2 Oni vs. 6 hiders, 5-minute rounds.

details.title: Yellow Noise
details.short_description: Dungeon Crawler Survival Horror where exploration is your greatest weapon. Explore a warping city, where reality is slowly unraveling. Survive terrifying creatures, manage your physical and mental condition, and find a way out of the maddening cosmic truth about the world around you.

details.title: ACCURSED
details.short_description: Bear your vows in ACCURSED, a 2D narrative-driven soulslike, hand-drawn in worn fantasy and shades of burning autumn. Bequeathed upon a fading world as a herald of Death, may you find your peace within what remains.

details.title: Somnium: Hypnagogia
details.short_description: Somnium: Hypnagogia is a psychological horror visual novel set on a night where dreams, nightmares, memories and reality bleed into one another. As you drift from dream to dream, your whispers will decide where the night ends up.

details.title: Wasteland Bites 2
details.short_description: Wasteland Bites is a horror-based food truck sim. You've expanded your operation with a decked-out caravan! Explore deeper into the wasteland in search of new delicacies. But be warned. The freaks only get more dangerous the further out you wander.

details.title: Burgerama Anomaly
details.short_description: Serve or die in a late-night pedestrian underpass kiosk. Prepare different burgers, fry ingredients, and manage your supplies - all while inspecting your customers for inhuman traits. Follow the night's rules, survive various hazards, and uncover the truth behind the mutations.

details.title: Bad Magpie
details.short_description: You are a magpie with one wing, a missing flock, and an unhealthy obsession with a fallen star. Steal shiny trinkets, cause chaos, and stick your beak where it doesn’t belong.

details.title: Where is my sword
details.short_description: A mismatched duo—a wicked demon god and a kind-hearted fox girl—is gathering followers!? Travel across many lands and survive hectic yet strategic real-time battles by rummaging through your bag for just the right item! Fight your foes or turn them into followers... What awaits at journey's end?

details.title: Screams of the Abyss
details.short_description: Descend into the abyss, following the trail of a vanished expedition. Piece together their story through the recordings they left behind and uncover why none of them ever returned to the surface.

details.title: Bloom Control
details.short_description: Eradicate the Bloom in this high-energy active incremental. Hack into powerful security weaponry at infested target sites as the only AI fast enough to outpace the spread. Control and destroy the hostile growth before your transmission window closes.

details.title: Carbon Compliance
details.short_description: A simulation game about experiencing the very mundane job of a government official, rummaging through paperwork. Make sure all the paperwork is free of any errors. Deny applications that are not up to the specified requirements. Bored of working, play mini-games to relieve stress.

details.title: Sinful Testament
details.short_description: A dark historical otome visual novel. Houston, Texas, 1925. A heroine from 2025 is reborn as the daughter of a murdered mafia boss and becomes “compensation” for the Devil’s Six gang. Six dangerous men, seven deadly sins, and a choice between Redemption and Fall.

details.title: Godless Dawn
details.short_description: Godless Dawn is a ruthless action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Descend into cursed dungeons, uncover the stories behind fallen souls, and reveal the truth hidden behind the silence of the gods.

details.title: Iron Bramble
details.short_description: Momentum-based platforming built around expressive movement and tight gunplay. Master your elastic grappling hook to explore a vast, cyber-gothic megastructure, where robots piloted by the souls of the dead do penance for their sins.

details.title: Midnight Train: New Moon
details.short_description: A 2D exploration-based horror adventure game set in a creepy train and mysterious buildings.

details.title: Stack Order
details.short_description: Stack Order is an enigmatic deckbuilding adventure. Engage in tense one-on-one card duels, use strategy to stack up synergies, and uncover the source of the corruption spreading over this mysterious, handcrafted world.

details.title: Castle Away
details.short_description: Build and command your own flying fortress. Battle your way through a hand-drawn realm and craft the strongest keep imaginable. Will your castle hold up against the Archdemon?

details.title: Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare
details.short_description: The heir to the legendary "Muv-Luv Alternative" series, "Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare" is a tactical simulation RPG devoted to pure gameplay excellence.

details.title: Tidy Up
details.short_description: A peaceful cleaning and organizing game where you explore different locations, collect trash, clean stains, and arrange items to turn mess into perfection.

name: Castaway Diary: Portal to the Unknown Isles

details.title: Castaway Diary: Portal to the Unknown Isles
details.short_description: Castaway Diary is a bright and charming anime-style survival adventure. Are you ready to escape to a relaxing island life with a group of lovely girls?

details.title: GraveDiggers
details.short_description: Online co-op horror for 1 to 6 undertaker cats. Every day, find the body, drag its coffin across a cursed Louisiana swamp and bury it before sunrise. Skeletons, Lazarites and the midnight mist will try to stop you. Eat cheese whenever you can.

details.title: Line of Contact
details.short_description: A linear, story-driven first-person shooter focused on intense combat and a dark military narrative.

details.title: Elderfeast
details.short_description: Hunt. Carve. Cook. Elderfeast is a co-op action game where the monsters are the menu. Hunt Lovecraftian horrors across the galaxy and slice them apart for ingredients to make your next meal. The better you cook, the stronger you become, but there's always something more terrifying to hunt next.

details.title: The Pactmaker
details.short_description: You are a professor who forged pacts with otherworldly entities to save your daughter. Dive into the memories of others, alter reality, and use your new supernatural abilities to uncover the truth in this dark point-and-click thriller.

details.title: Creepy Horrors: Blood Cult 2
details.short_description: Build your roster of Creepy Horrors in this spooky occult creature-collector RPG. Crawl through crypts collecting cursed curios and ingredients, combining them to summon adorable Horrors, wielding them in strategic 3v3 battles against rival sects. The Crypts are calling. Will you answer?

details.title: DARK MACHINE THE GAME
details.short_description: DARK MACHINE THE GAME is a team-based mecha action shooter where your custom machine evolves through three combat classes. Clash in up to 7v7 PvP or battle overwhelming hordes in PvE across destructible, ever-changing arenas.

details.title: Money Under the Bed
details.short_description: You complained to a strange roadside statue about being broke—and the next day, a jar of money appeared under your bed. How do you plan to spend this windfall? Of course, you’re free to squander every cent... as long as you can survive until tomorrow.

details.title: SaviorS : Oath of the Blade
details.short_description: SaviorS: Oath of the Blade is a roguelite action RPG with flexible party building and deep, beat 'em up–style combat. Choose your path on the world map and combine companions, sword skills, spells, and gear to face powerful foes. Grow your favorite party and see the journey through together.

details.title: DEADRIFT
details.short_description: A fast-paced sci-fi shooter where a failed experiment unleashes mutated horrors inside a secret research facility. Armed with experimental weapons, you must fight through swarms of twisted enemies, and survive the collapse of a world-breaking project.

details.title: Battlespace Command
details.short_description: Take command of modern warfare across land, air, and sea in a real-time strategy sandbox. Direct every unit, from infantry to aircraft carriers, across vast, real-world scale battlefields where sensors, strategy, and coordination decide the outcome.

details.title: WATERFUL: a tiny oasis builder
details.short_description: A relaxing puzzle game inspired by nature. Dig riverbeds to guide water through desert valleys and grow a variety of plants, then zoom in to discover hidden animals drawn to new habitats. Earn points for your discoveries and unlock new contraptions to transform the dry landscape into a lush oasis!

details.title: Mauled Horde
details.short_description: Mauled Horde is a free-to-play 1–3 player PvE horde shooter. Survive waves solo or in co-op, spend points at Citadels, and choose upgrades that change how your weapons, perks, and gadgets behave. Combine equipment to unlock build synergies and survive tougher enemies and bosses.

details.title: Spellogger
details.short_description: A slow-paced, cozy fantasy RPG where you play as a Wizard Lumberjack. Take on daily tasks and upgrade your character in a relaxing work cycle similar to Stardew Valley, while setting out on Elder Scrolls-style quests and exploration.

details.title: Barbie™ Horse Ride & Rescue
details.short_description: Start your Western horse riding adventure with Barbie at Roaming Hearts Rescue Ranch. Rescue and rehabilitate charming horses, test your riding skills and customize your style as you uncover the mysteries of Moonrise Valley!

details.title: Call It a Day
details.short_description: A physics-based online co-op game where you and your friends play as the world's worst renovation crew. Drag the couch up the stairs, water down the paint and throw the trash out the window - but don't work too hard. Cracking open a cold one with the boys is also part of the job.

details.title: ESTELLA - The Sin of Time -
details.short_description: Switch between multiple protagonists in this suspense visual novel and follow the event of the three days leading up to Halloween. Piece together clues from each perspective to uncover the truth, as your choices reshape the fates of the others.

details.title: Skydeck Swords
details.short_description: Bring a sword to a ship fight! Become a pirate and command a fleet of ships armed with massive, hull-mounted swords in this unique roguelike deckbuilder. Navigate across the stars to rescue your crew and steal all the riches!

details.title: Dr. Oops!
details.short_description: Treat bizarre patients, solve outrageous medical mysteries, and pay off your crushing debt in this dark comedy deduction adventure! Every diagnosis relies on your observation, deduction, and some real-world knowledge. Pay off your debt, or skip a payment if needed, and fight for your freedom.

details.title: Stargazer Simulator
details.short_description: Go from zero to a real amateur astronomer. Join the astronomy club, set up your own telescope, start with your first bright star, and go on to find the Moon’s craters and distant galaxies in the real night sky. Every star you learn in the game is really up there tonight.

details.title: Victor's Video Vault
details.short_description: Survive a '90s video store where movies come to life after closing. Work the night shift as an ordinary job spirals into a reality-bending nightmare.

details.title: HOSHiN ENGi Re:surrection
details.short_description: Wield mythic treasures, ride spirit beasts, and hack and slash through ever-shifting dungeons in an all-new roguelite steeped in Chinese myth, based on Ryu Fujisaki's Weekly Shonen Jump manga. A new hero, a new story, thirty years on.

details.title: Dream Hackers VR
details.short_description: Join Dream Hackers team in this VR action-adventure. Infiltrate surreal collective dreams, where danger and discovery intertwine. Create your own builds from various weapons and artifacts to battle living nightmares, defeat their ancient bosses, and uncover the truth of the dreamworld.

details.title: Last Float
details.short_description: Explore and survive in this shattered world. Build, defend, and repair your raft. Search for secrets and uncover information about what happened - and most importantly, don't drown!

details.title: For Tarnow Eternal
details.short_description: The end of time has come - alas, the emperor of the faraway city of Tarnow has managed to avert the natural flow of time, causing the time space continuum to break, slowly decaying into nothingness. Explore the forgotten lands of Tarnow, defeat mighty foes and give the universe a proper death.

details.title: Don't Return to Wonderland
details.short_description: A dark fairy-tale horror adventure inspired by Alice in Wonderland. Use mysterious powers to forge your path and confront the horrors lurking within a world that is both adorable and cruel.

details.title: Fall of the Days
details.short_description: Fall of the Days is a systemic isometric immersive sim where the world reacts to how you play — not just what you choose. A 3D action and stealth experience amplified by social interaction systems, where systems collide and every action has consequences.

details.title: Generations: Utopia
details.short_description: A secret Soviet research institute is conducting an experiment to create a utopian city. Develop your city, resolve generational conflicts, and overcome the challenges prepared by the institute.

details.title: Infamous Keepers
details.short_description: Defend your dungeon—and your job! Tower Defense meets Roguelite in Infamous Keepers. Use strategy and some clever trickery to defeat waves of enemies: set up deadly traps, send your employees into the line of fire, and slaughter any intruders left standing yourself.

details.title: Daxi King: Seven Kills Reincarnation
details.short_description: Daxi King: Seven Kills Reincarnation is a Chinese Dark Fantasy Roguelite RPG. You will play as Zhang Xianzhong, the Daxi King and peasant rebellion leader of the late Ming Dynasty. Sacrificing to evil gods to gain overwhelming power, you will unleash endless slaughter!
developers: 骷髅猫工作室 (Skull Cat Studio)

details.title: Legendum
details.short_description: Start as a nobody and become a legend before old age claims you in this incremental RPG. Fight hordes in idle combat, plan your days, and train your skills. Grow your soul and unravel a dark plot across generations. Every life reshapes the world, and one will finish what the rest began.

details.title: Barely Breathing
details.short_description: Spill and splash away, make your own path! Go on an adventure in this 3D Platformer with fun physics interactions and smooth controls!

name: Wisps & Wares: A Spirit of the North Idler

details.title: Wisps & Wares: A Spirit of the North Idler
details.short_description: Return to the enchanting world of Spirit of the North in a cozy shopkeeping idler. Send your Fox Guardian exploring, gather treasures, stock the Raccoon’s traveling shop, and journey across the Northern Isles in charming pixel art.

details.title: SanararaR
details.short_description: It was something that could’ve happened to anyone… A somewhat mysterious story… One day, I was approached by a girl I didn’t recognize. She told me that she could grant any wish I desired but… While I stood in disbelief, she began to explain how it worked. A classic visual novel from NekoNeko Soft!

name: Sayagatari - Promise of the Cursed Blade -

details.title: Sayagatari - Promise of the Cursed Blade -
details.short_description: "My love for you began with that kiss." Ex-Kendo practitioner Kanemori Tōya, comes across Saya who seals demonic blades. Saving him from his murderous impulse curse is a kiss from Saya!? The two begin living together, battling with demonic blade in hand. Break the curse with a kiss from this beauty!

details.title: Horu
details.short_description: Command hundreds of thousands of units across land and space in a galaxy-spanning RTS and 4X hybrid.

details.title: Truck World: Australia
details.short_description: A trucking simulator set in Australia. Haul cargo on highways and off-road, step out of the cab, hitch trailers, connect hoses, refuel, and service your truck by hand. You don't just drive a truck - you work as a trucker.

details.title: Dead Broke
details.short_description: Wanna run a cursed graveyard with your friends? You’ll regret it. Probably. An online co-op (up to 4) physics-based game about you, definitely not ending up Dead Broke.

details.title: HOPENOTHING
details.short_description: Tactics RPG × Cross-Species Bonds. You play a human who can wield every weapon type. Torch enemies on the grasslands, call down lightning in the rain. Every choice leads toward one of many endings. A story of joining hands with the companions you hold dear, in search of hope.

details.title: Volcaris: Ashen Secrets
details.short_description: A card-based roguelike strategy game set on a volcanic island. Each cycle is a race against time: gather resources, craft equipment, collect artifacts, and build up your settlement for the inevitable eruption.

details.title: Moving Pieces
details.short_description: Moving Pieces is a first-person psychological horror puzzle adventure game. Explore a convoluted mansion, collect key items, and solve physical puzzles without combat or death. Assemble tactile jigsaw puzzles, decode ciphers, and break reality in this atmospheric puzzle-based narrative mystery.

details.title: Nibble Ville
details.short_description: A cozy farming adventure where you befriend adorable Nibbles, discover new seeds, and begin a new life on a mysterious island.

details.title: yttrium X
details.short_description: Zellia Mots goes awol and steals yttrium X the Plutocracy of Yeoman's secret Mech in this PvE mech brawler!

details.title: PuPuPoPu Company
details.short_description: A cute, wacky top-down PvE extraction shooter. The world's fading, so a duckling with flashy feet and flawless blush starts a paint-spraying company. Blast away pollution in a hail of paint and give this black-and-white world its color back. Rescue critters, pack 'em to go—extract. Clock out!

details.title: Bound Together
details.short_description: Bound Together is a roguelike deckbuilder about Stitch, a crochet doll hero, battling sticker foes and toy bosses throughout an ominous attic. Aid Stitch by drafting cards and sewing them together for use in battle. Powerful enemies force you to make clever choices to craft a strong deck to survive.

details.title: MAT-O
details.short_description: Humanity is gone. As an organic being, explore an abandoned research facility, uncover traces of the past, and discover the mystery of your existence.

details.title: Gold Digger
details.short_description: An incredibly exciting incremental game about hovering your mouse over shovels and moles.

details.title: Frontworks
details.short_description: Build a war factory on a hostile alien world. Extract raw ore and refine it into complex components. Automate logistics, manufacturing and army recruitment. Defend against huge waves of native robots and alien wildlife, then send your army to raze enemy bases for planetary domination.

details.title: Lock 87
details.short_description: Work the night shift at Lock 87, a canal checkpoint in a brutalist dystopian 1992. Inspect vessels, authorise passage, and earn enough to escape the district - while strange transmissions and security footage suggest you may not be alone.

details.title: Darkness Requiem
details.short_description: Fear not only what the darkness hides, but the power that draws you toward it. Darkness is a top-down dark fantasy action game where light is your only refuge.

details.title: IllumaNet
details.short_description: Build a living network across the dark. In this strategic incremental game, connect distant stations with pulse bridges, turn every cycle into Data, and manage limited Grid Power as you scan the unknown and expand into strange new biomes.

details.title: Absurdocracy
details.short_description: Satirical strategy card game with a single-player Campaign and PvP Multiplayer. Absurdocracy is nothing like real life. Your strategy will most certainly make sense, and the best one will indeed win. Discover cards, build tactics and embark on a very serious quest with these totally fake characters.

details.title: Eldritch Wildlife Tours
details.short_description: Eldritch Wildlife Tours is a cozy, Lovecraftian 2-player co-op / solo exploration and adventure game where one role charts a course to cosmic sea creatures based on collective sightings and takes promotional photos while the other safely steers a tour boat full of paying passengers.

details.title: Ardeo Chronicles
details.short_description: Recruit legendary heroes and lead them into brutal turn-based encounters. Draft abilities, gather loot, sacrifice powerful spells to invoke godlike powers and forge your ultimate party in this roguelike fusion of turn-based tactics and RPG.

details.title: Hit The Floor
details.short_description: Eight legs, three guns, bullet heaven chaos. Play as a mobster spider in this top-down roguelike shooter, where you tri-wield weapons and stack incremental upgrades to annihilate endless enemy waves.

name: Catch A Pack: Incremental Card Game

details.title: Catch A Pack: Incremental Card Game
details.short_description: Open large packs of cards in this 90s nostalgia-steeped incremental game. Build your dream board with super duper rare cards, click frenetically and chain massive combos. Can you catch them all?

details.title: Nordic Sprint
details.short_description: A classic-style cross-country skiing game where technique, stamina and drafting decide the race. Climb the World Cup with 20 abilities, race sprint, biathlon and relay in changing weather and wind – solo or in online multiplayer with up to 12 players.

details.title: The Sundered Anvil
details.short_description: A party of greenhorn adventurers acquires a contract to retrieve an anvil stolen from a remote village, only to discover the job is more than they bargained for.

details.title: Soulstone
details.short_description: Be anyone, go anywhere, do anything. Live a new life in a fantasy world.

details.title: Crawlbound
details.short_description: Survive a grid-based roguelite by selecting game altering bugs to endure each level. Dodge traps, battle bosses, and draft upgrades to build your run. Spend your loot on permanent upgrades to push deeper into the dungeon.

details.title: Video Game Store Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your own video game store in this first-person retail management simulator. Order new titles, unpack deliveries, stock shelves, set prices, serve customers at the register, and reinvest your profits to customize and expand your growing business.

details.title: ワカレタナビ
details.short_description: This is an action-adventure game where you navigate an unfinished title riddled with bugs, relying on guidance from a navigator. However, interacting with certain stage gimmicks apparently causes my personality to switch...

details.title: BoneHeads
details.short_description: BoneHeads is a physics-based sword-fighting party game where every swing is under your direct control. Fight locally or online with up to 4 players, and keep battling as every bone you lose becomes a weapon.

details.title: Immortal Loop: Doom Cycle
details.short_description: Transported to a cultivation world, you face apocalypse in one year. Every world‑ending catastrophe sends you back to the start. Keep resources and boost your aptitude across loops. Explore, uncover secrets, seek treasures, and survive doom in this real‑time action cultivation RPG.

details.title: Blue Blood Love Song
details.short_description: A multi-ending visual novel blending romance, sci-fi, and mystery. A perfect reunion gradually gives way to unsettling inconsistencies. As your relationship with him deepens, you must choose between trust and doubt—and every decision may change your bond and the ending that awaits you.

details.title: The Old Forge
details.short_description: Explore a open world inspired by 1990s Poland. Scavenge, build, craft and dig your way through forests, villages and industrial ruins surviving the zombies, harsh weather and the constant fight for food, warmth and safety.

details.title: Claim the Gods
details.short_description: Would you dare to defy the gods? Claim their power? Then battle in this roguelike deckbuilder where you can win new cards, power up and Claim the Gods! But be warned mortal, if you fail, there will be consequences!

details.title: Hollow Ones
details.short_description: Hide away from the end of the world in Hollow Ones, a mid-apocalypse narrative horror game.

details.title: Water's Bounty
details.short_description: Set across a vast global map, Water's Bounty thrusts you into a sea full of nonstop dangers. You'll navigate a world dominated by the ruthless Ronek Trading Company; a commercial empire branding all independent merchants as pirates to protect their monopoly.
publishers: Not Allowed to Die Gaming Studios

details.title: Chronicles of the Six Sages
details.short_description: This game is a Turn Based JRPG with real time mechanics in order to overcome the enemies attacks. The game features a fully unique gear system, allowing for the player to fully customize their party to their choosing

details.title: Tide and Crown
details.short_description: Command a ship in an open-world pirate trading RPG. Exploit a living economy, run dangerous cargo, fight tactical turn-based naval battles, capture vessels, build a fleet, and choose a life of commerce, piracy, or power.

details.title: Hope Delivery
details.short_description: Fly an eVTOL aircraft and deliver humanitarian aid to isolated villages, watching the world change beneath your wings. Hope Delivery is a cozy, contemplative adventure with no danger and no pressure, where every mission leaves its mark.

details.title: Night Drives
details.short_description: An adventure game about spending one night in the passenger seat of a friend's car, enjoying the conversation, the music, and the view outside the window. For anyone who has ever stayed out late with friends for no reason at all.

details.title: Catfight
details.short_description: Team up with a catgirl companion in 2v2 deathmatch tournaments, then head back to the apartment you share. Talk through your microphone and hear her reply, coordinate in combat, and spend your winnings on guns, outfits, and home decorations. Her AI runs locally on your PC.

details.title: Afterlife Dreams: Anna - Part I
details.short_description: With no idea what's going on—or where she came from—Anna meets the friendly citizens of Sweet Harbor and Woody Cabins, colorful vacation spots being attacked by horrible creatures that... are looking for her.

details.title: Incrementalism
details.short_description: A free to play collection of incremental games, all in one. Every game is a short run where the weapons fire by themselves and the payout buys the next upgrade. Ant Colony, Paper Space and Pirate Seas are in, with more on the way.

details.title: Second Reign: Reclaim
details.short_description: Reclaim a fallen kingdom solo or in online co-op in a dark fantasy roguelite tower defense. Fight beside your defenders, heal and command them, survive escalating undead assaults and Surge Waves, shape each run with powerful cards, and grow stronger between battles.

details.title: Mezanine
details.short_description: Mezanine is both a literal and figurative small scale sandbox builder where you can construct and recolor your own creations to compliment its gigantic environment.

details.title: Concorrenza
details.short_description: An offensively inaccurate depiction of the competition between Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo Buonarroti told with cartoonish sensibilities. | Ah! To be "vuomo eccellentissimo e singhularissimo"...

details.title: Zynthex
details.short_description: Build an alien-drug business from your inherited shop. Hunt creatures, harvest organs and turn them into products. Stock shelves, set prices and serve customers. Explore a hostile planet for supplies, expand your lab and automate production with robots. Play solo or with up to three friends.

details.title: Marrowsteel
details.short_description: Assemble every turret from parts — barrel, ammo, magazine, a second gun on the mount — and hold the last line against a biomechanical swarm hundreds strong. Swap modules mid-battle as the swarm changes. Roguelite runs, bosses, a research tree.

details.title: Orb Ball
details.short_description: A dark fantasy PVP auto-battler… with a ball. Be a reckless wizard: summon monsters, cast spells, get lucky, and destroy your foe. Or be a cunning coach: draw up tactical plays like sweeps and passes to finesse your way to the goal.

details.title: Barely Outnumbered
details.short_description: Incremental tower defense, but there are hundreds of thousands of them and your fortress never resets.

details.title: Tower Maintenance Simulator
details.short_description: Climb hundreds of meters above the ground to maintain and repair communication towers. Choose your tools, secure your harness, diagnose faults and complete dangerous maintenance jobs where one mistake can send you — or your tools — falling.

details.title: Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino
details.short_description: "Where will their light lead them?" Kitsune is a fox girl who finds herself on Adashino Island and starts travelling with her Frog friend. Neon signs give light and color to the island with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. Something is lurking in the shadows, inching ever closer...

details.title: UNDEFEATED: Genesis
details.short_description: Become the hero Voltissia needs. Fly freely across a vast alien planet, master extraordinary superpowers, and battle ferocious mutants in an expansive superhero action RPG.

details.title: Threads of Time
details.short_description: Threads of Time is an era-spanning, turn-based RPG inspired by the timeless classics. Embark on a journey through time, gather a party of charismatic heroes from across ages, and uncover a plot that threatens to unravel the past, present and future.

details.title: NO LAW
details.short_description: Welcome to Port Desire, a city that doesn't belong to anyone, but where everyone wants a piece. You’re Grey Harker, an ex-military attempting to live a quiet life after near fatal injuries in the field. All you want now is peace - but in a city of no laws, what you want isn’t always what you get.

details.title: Sunkissed City
details.short_description: Sunkissed City is a life-sim set in an upbeat, sun-kissed seaside metropolis full of funky vibes and quirky characters. Stake out your new life in the city, tending to DIY gardens, learning new skills, and making life-long friends and help bring life back to its once-vibrant streets!

details.title: Ardem
details.short_description: The zombies ended the world. You're going to switch it back on. Ardem is an open-world zombie survival game in an immersive handcrafted world. Restore electricity, rebuild vehicles, construct your base, and permanently reshape the world. Solo, co-op, or on up-to-64-player PvE, PvP, and RP servers.

details.title: Thorny Times
details.short_description: Lead a mercenary company through story-driven fantasy scenarios. Capture castles, manage scarce resources, evolve your fighters, and solve puzzle-like turn-based battles where positioning matters more than brute force.

details.title: Gilded Destiny
details.short_description: Forge empires, incite revolutions, and reshape society in Gilded Destiny, the definitive grand strategy game of the Industrial Age. Take command of your chosen nation and lead it to glory through masterful diplomacy, sweeping industrialization, and decisive warfare.

details.title: Elysium
details.short_description: Wake up on a paradise-like abandoned island with your friends. Explore the lands of an ancient civilization and uncover the mysteries behind their collapse as you build, craft, and tame corrupted machines. Most importantly, survive the unwelcome lands of Elysium!

details.title: Tempus Vitae
details.short_description: You are Alex, a time-displaced astronaut unraveling the space station Theia doomed in both the war-torn 2185 and the post-apocalyptic 2385 to find your lost brother. Master an arsenal of time travel abilities and weapons in this sci-fi metroidvania FPS: Tempus Vitae.

details.title: Dr. Emmerson's Nocturnes
details.short_description: Dive into the worlds of the best classic weird fiction and cosmic horror writers. Try out our original approach to bringing literature into the interactive medium. Relax and let Dr. Emmerson guide you through all the colors of dread.

details.title: Dungeons of Edera 2
details.short_description: Return to the land of Edera, where you play as a sword-for-hire, exploring environments, competing for contracts, and waging guerrilla warfare to become a legendary mercenary, alone or with friends.

details.title: LogiGolf
details.short_description: LogiGolf is a relaxing golf puzzle game where you place walls to guide the ball. Journey between islands to uncover new challenges and surprising discoveries.

details.title: Phantom Line
details.short_description: Join the paranormal SWAT. PHANTOM LINE is a co-op (1-4) shooter set in the post-nuclear European continent. Your mission is to search and contain paranormal events and activities (anomalies) hidden from the public eye, in an open world map full of dynamic events.

details.title: Wardens of Avalon
details.short_description: Restore the former glory of a corrupt Camelot in Wardens of Avalon, an Action RPG set in a Dark Arthurian world. As a new member of the Twilight Knights, establish your fiefdom, explore, craft and gear up for thrilling adventures against the fallen Knights of the Round Table, alone or with friends.

details.title: The Bornless
details.short_description: Welcome to The Bornless, an action horror FPS. Face off against other players, summon demons, and build factions in a Lovecraftian world. Use Black Magick, acquire powerful weapons, upgrade your Safehouse, and strategize to survive.

details.title: Enginefall
details.short_description: Session based survival where players upgrade and live aboard their own personal trains. Team up with friends, make new ones or go solo. Board colossal Titan Trains to fight, build, craft, gather and steal much needed resources. Fortify and stock your personal train fortress. Will you survive?

details.title: Clockwork Revolution
details.short_description: CHANGE THE PAST. CONTROL THE FUTURE. Alter the course of history and rewrite the future in this steampunk first-person RPG.

details.title: Surviving Deponia
details.short_description: Explore, craft, build and fight your way through the harsh landscape of Deponia. Meet allies and make enemies while surviving the perils of the junk planet. It might be garbage - but it’s your garbage!

details.title: The Chronos Event
details.short_description: Bend time to your will in The Chronos Event, a fast-paced third-person roguelite shooter. Rewind the clock, team up with your past selves, and battle hordes of enemies. Master time-looping, gain game-changing upgrades, and face down a hostile future in this time-bending sci-fi adventure.

details.title: Dōbumon
details.short_description: Dōbumon is an RPG monster collecting/battling game. Experience tactical battles as you choose 4 Dōbumon to fight with on the battlefield. Grow, evolve, and customize your attacks while developing different strategies in order to win, as you fight and explore your way to become the Dōbumon champion.

details.title: At Fate's End
details.short_description: At Fate’s End is an action-adventure game where you fight the ones you love and your skill tree is your family tree. Explore a lush fantasy world, defeat the foul creatures of the realm, and face your estranged siblings in intense, emotional duels to decide your family’s fate.

details.title: Cartomantic
details.short_description: A tactical Tarot roguelite deckbuilder, where positioning matters just as much as the cards themselves. Craft decks of Minor and Major Arcana, create powerful combos, make your power reach the millions, and overcome the formidable Arcana Trials to see what lies within.

details.title: Chronicles: Medieval
details.short_description: Step into a vast, dynamic medieval sandbox set in the age of the Hundred Years' War. Explore a brutal but beautiful, historically grounded Europe, command armies in massive battles, leave a mark the chroniclers can't ignore as you make your name one fight at a time. What story will you write?

details.title: Locus Equation
details.short_description: You are an anthropod, a synthetically crafted life form. Your objective is to save the ones who are stuck on an uninhabited planet. Persuade, charm, manipulate: use your ultimate power—freedom of choice—in sci-fi role playing hyper variative game LOCUS EQUATION.

details.title: BoosterWare
details.short_description: A deckbuilding autobattler incremental where you cheat at your favorite card game. Crack packs, build decks, and install shady tools to automate the grind. Just when you think you’ve seen everything, something new arrives. All running on an early-2000s desktop that feels a little too real.

details.title: Neverway
details.short_description: After quitting her dead-end job, Fiona starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Make friends, fight through horrors and pay your debt in this nightmarish life sim RPG.

details.title: The Last Exam
details.short_description: Dylan hasn't left his home since the pandemic. As he struggles to move forward, his dreams pull him back to one day from his youth: the day of his final exam. Explore his memories in a hand-painted watercolor point-and-click adventure, solve puzzles, and uncover why he can’t let that day go.

details.title: Starship Colony
details.short_description: A deep starship colony sim. Build your starship, manage air, water, food, fuel, energy, temperature and psychology to keep your crew alive across vast distances. Closed-loop system in space. Mining, wiring, plumbing, in-ship factory, (alien?) radio signals & translation, diplomacy, combat, and more.

details.title: WTF - Waifu Tactical Force
details.short_description: Multiplayer Anime Movement FPS. Wall-run, slide, pilot your mech, and run the map in PvP and PvE. Win matches, earn loot, build your Mother Base. Customize your guns and squad of anime operators. No sweats, just vibes.

details.title: Espiocracy
details.short_description: Espiocracy is an espionage grand strategy game where you lead the intelligence agency of one of 74 playable countries. Rewrite history from the shadows as you influence ideologies, stage coups, and wage proxy wars. Subterfuge takes center stage as you establish a new world order.

details.title: Fragile Existence
details.short_description: Save humanity from the brink of extinction in this sci-fi strategy game of survival. Travel among the stars to seek out resources, establish and develop colonies to sustain civilization, and grow your military might to push back against an overwhelming threat.

details.title: IKUMA - The Frozen Compass
details.short_description: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

details.title: SPINE - This is Gun Fu
details.short_description: SPINE is a single-player action game about close-quarters gunfights with aesthetics of Gun Fu movies. Step into the stunning cyberpunk world with rebellious street artist Redline and her sentient combat implant Spine as they defy the autocratic AI regime in search of Redline's captured brother.

name: Lair Land Story 2: Mist of Sea

details.title: Lair Land Story 2: Mist of Sea
details.short_description: After traveling far to the southern end of Lair Land, seven knights have reached Chainch Bay. Settled in a small tropical fishing village surrounded by ruins, they will spend the next few years building a new life here while facing the most challenging quest they will ever meet.

details.title: ILL
details.short_description: A realistic first-person action horror game that takes you into a dark fort overtaken by a mysterious entity. Unpredictable monsters, a visceral dismemberment system, and realistic physics create an atmosphere of relentless terror.

details.title: Dungeons of the Amber Griffin
details.short_description: Play as a group of daredevils who explore the world of dark fantasy in search of fame, amber and gold. Experience the classic mechanics of the iconic ‘90s Dungeon Crawlers with a new twist. Solve the mystery of the ghost that haunted the ruins and discover a bestiary based on Kashubian beliefs.

details.title: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades
details.short_description: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades is a turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenaries in a medieval fantasy world. Try your hand at mercenary work, trading, or exploring, and keep your crew well stocked for brutal combat in a procedurally-generated open-world campaign.

details.title: Atomic Hockey
details.short_description: Every hockey player is strapped to their own rail. So what now? You pass... and you pass before the bomb goes off under your stick. Atomic Hockey is a wild couch game for up to 12 people. Each of you controls hockey players on rails, trying to beat the other team. Usually not the way you’d expect.

details.title: WIRED TOKYO 2007
details.short_description: — Dive into Tokyo. Dive into the past. — WIRED TOKYO is a vertical 3D action game where you climb toward the vast skies above Tokyo. To unlock new abilities, you may have to deliberately “dive” from above. A climbing game where falling has meaning — that’s WIRED TOKYO.

details.title: Mega Man: Dual Override
details.short_description: Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series! Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

name: Black Sailors: Bay Of All Saints

details.title: Black Sailors: Bay Of All Saints
details.short_description: Command a fleet of formerly enslaved people who became pirates in Brazil’s Bay of All Saints. Challenge colonial oppression, fight for freedom, and rewrite Atlantic history in turn-based tactical naval battles.

details.title: Sealbreakers
details.short_description: A top-down 3D roguelite brawler where a disgraced warrior fights immortal tyrants in a collapsing reality. Break the world back with nothing but fists.

details.title: Overbit
details.short_description: A 4th-Wall-Breaking Pixel Art Horror/Comedy RPG with Rhythm based Bullet Battles happening inside a Retro Operating System

details.title: Pilot 6174: Orbital Survival
details.short_description: Navigate star systems using real orbital mechanics. Pilot a cockpit with controls inspired by the Apollo command module. Manage heat, energy, and trajectory.

details.title: Beat Weaver
details.short_description: 3D multi-track rhythm action with space-time bending mechanics that reward your style as much as your precision. Hit notes and switch tracks to add instruments to the mix. Become a remix machine, enter the flow state and uniquely approach each song of a highly replayable, genre-defying soundtrack.

details.title: Murderplanet
details.short_description: Fight to the death in the arena-based action game show, Murderplanet. Make a loadout of ridiculous and broken synergies to weave and cleave through hordes of enemies. Survive each wave, stake out Capture Points, earn heaps of cash and further customize your runs for maximum arcade chaos.

details.title: The Orphaned House
details.short_description: Step into the mystery of The Orphaned House. Explore its rooms, manipulate the environment to solve puzzles, and follow your intuition to uncover every hidden secret in this atmospheric adventure game.

details.title: The Pines
details.short_description: A psychological horror RPG where every choice has consequences. After a failed case, former detective Edward Walker arrives at The Pines, a secluded retreat with therapists on site and the promise of peace. But beneath its carefully constructed calm, something is deeply wrong.

details.title: One Iced Latte: Milk Song
details.short_description: Idol baristas, Samurai baristas, VTubers baristas, Robot baristas! The Coffee War has taken over Tokyo! You are Ken Katsuki, a young master and the new manager of Milk Milk Coffee. Help sweet Moka win the Barista Cup! ☆

details.title: Marked For Mayhem
details.short_description: Enter a shattered world where dimensions collide in this competitive 4-player action dungeon runner. Defeat and leverage diverse bosses, win chaotic challenges, master your build around unique weapons, and sabotage your rivals to take the top spot. The mission is shared. The glory isn’t.

details.title: We Die Standing
details.short_description: Arcs, Rings, Power, Annihilation, Courage, Comradeship, Worlds, Earth, Humans, Creatures, Flood, Scourge, Starvation, Crisis. Through All, One Must Fight Unless He Dies Standing.

details.title: Hero of the Kingdom IV
details.short_description: A lovely adventuring RPG. Journey across a picturesque tropical island and shape your own destiny for the first time in the series. Enjoy complete freedom in solving quests. Use thoughtful logic, master the art of bartering, and explore peacefully at your own pace.

details.title: Finding Frankie 2
details.short_description: Trapped inside a deadly televised game show, you must parkour through a massive obstacle complex. Wall run, rail grind, and vault past twisted traps in the final season. Win the $10 million prize, or die trying. Frankie is waiting for you and he’s not holding back.

details.title: ROBOSCAV
details.short_description: ROBOSCAV is a turn-based extraction RPG where you command fully customizable robots into raids. Explore the planet, Scavenge for loot, Fight robots and aliens, Extract. After crash landing on a hostile planet, you must rebuild your spaceship from scratch, to escape.

details.title: Plumber Simulator
details.short_description: Become a plumber and restore water flow in suburban homes. Unclog toilets, replace sink traps, renovate bathrooms - the residents can only count on you during an emergency.

name: Co-Ed Casualty: A Chandler Chase Case

details.title: Co-Ed Casualty: A Chandler Chase Case
details.short_description: Spring break at Briarwood College turns lethal when a student is found dead on campus. Journalism major Chandler Chase finds himself caught in a murder investigation he never asked to be part of. Interrogate suspects, solve puzzles, and unravel a conspiracy someone is desperate to keep hidden.

details.title: Varren's Expanse
details.short_description: Explore the wilderness using mice and badger legionnaires, rabbit scouts, and squirrel skirmishers. Every round builds your strength, every round brings new challenges, every round is a fresh expanse!

details.title: Polyzonia
details.short_description: An ecosystem sim set in the Amazon rainforest. Grow plants, create habitats for animals, and click to hunt prey, pollinate flowers, eat fruit, and poop to spread seeds. Unlock automation and make the rainforest grow and thrive on its own.

details.title: Idol Manager: Virtual Venture
details.short_description: The management simulation game Idol Manager depicted the good and bad sides of the idol industry... another entry in the series is here! This time, the focus is on virtual streamers! Manage a new streaming agency and raise your staff to become the best agency in the industry.

details.title: Idle Squares
details.short_description: Claim tiles one by one in this cozy idle fantasy strategy game. Harvest resources, unlock upgrades, and prestige to grow stronger, then automate it all. No single path to victory. Click your way across each map or play hands-free. Clear every tile, complete every map, and conquer the whole Atlas.

details.title: Resurgis: Rise of the Dead
details.short_description: Resurgis is a 3D dark fantasy action game blending souls-like combat with rogue-lite dungeon crawling. Dismember your enemies with brutal finishers, draft cards in every room to build your unique playstyle, and master a relentless loop where death is only the beginning.

details.title: Hamster Time
details.short_description: Your desktop hamsters run on their wheels in response to your keyboard and mouse input. Get things done with friends while collecting cute hamsters and stylish wheels. Enjoy a variety of multiplayer modes, plus a timer and to-do list.

details.title: SMILEC++
details.short_description: This is an app, that allows you to program in C++, in a much more simple, and fast way. You can build your own apps, and games. Program by typing or with visual tools. You can choose how you program, and can choose among any IDE design you like the most. Export your app or game for commercial use.

details.title: Scholar Adventure: Lost Night
details.short_description: An ancient prophecy is about to awaken. Guided by a mysterious artifact, William ventures into Azig, where a secret society, ancient temples, and opposing forces await, trapped beneath the eternal sun. Uncover the truth that could change the fate of these lands.

details.title: Heroes of the Underworld
details.short_description: An open world party-based RPG with turn-based combat. Heroes of the Underworld is a comfy yet challenging mid-sized adventure in a vast fantasy world, inspired by 90s games and comic books.

details.title: RAT CITY: Ratocracy
details.short_description: Build and Manage a Rat City. Run it into the ground. Literally. Keep your Rats happy and productive. Create for them a glorious colony in the dirt! The never ending demand for the production of products to consume is all consuming. Wait, is this real life? No, it's RAT CITY!

details.title: DRIVE IN THE RAIN
details.short_description: A newly licensed boy drives a highway on a torrential night. In the back seat, his girlfriend is consumed by a "Paranormal Phenomenon" born of a social media firestorm. Beside him, a self-proclaimed expert in modern Paranormal Phenomena. A horror road-movie adventure by playwright Keisuke Tagawa.

details.title: What Remains Of Me
details.short_description: After an injury shatters the future he had planned, Jake Turner returns to the small town he thought he'd left behind. With old feelings resurfacing and unexpected attractions becoming harder to ignore, he must confront who he was, who he's expected to be, and who he actually wants to become.

details.title: JOB
details.short_description: JOB is a bleak and surreal corporate mystery that incorporates and subverts incremental/idle, rogue-lite, and traditional puzzle mechanics. The Company is looking for new Contractors and they ask, "Would you sign away three years of your life for the possibility of unimaginable wealth?"

details.title: Nymble 2
details.short_description: Jack returns in Nymble 2, a turn-based puzzle-platformer where every step and jump matters. Solve 100+ handcrafted levels filled with new enemies, traps, and hazards that react when you move. Find the seedling, plant it, and climb the beanstalk to reach the next level above.

details.title: I'M YOUR HOST
details.short_description: An audio deduction game where you have one task: restore a series of lost podcast episodes.

details.title: Toziuha Night: Nosferatu's Curse
details.short_description: Eight years have passed since the battle against Dracula, the hero of Transylvania who succumbed to the power of darkness. However, peace is once again in danger. A pair of young alchemists will fight against the curse of the demon who goes by the name Nosferatu.

details.title: Monger Drop
details.short_description: Throw dwarves, unleash rats, and toss bombs as you dig ever deeper in this chaotic incremental mining adventure.

details.title: Survindust
details.short_description: Pirates raid your tiny island for its riches. Hold them off, capture them and put them to work in your factory. Grow your land tile by tile, automate production and build a ship to escape with your captured crew.

details.title: Quiet Express: Cabin 909
details.short_description: “Do you know anything about Cabin 909?” In Quiet Express: Cabin 909, you spend seven days on the titular train, journeying from one side of the continent to the other.

details.title: MMORPG NPC Simulator
details.short_description: Play as an NPC in a living MMORPG world. Run your shop, trade with players, give quests, and send raid parties after rare loot. Build your reputation, unlock Game Master abilities, and take control of the server from within.

details.title: BrokenLore: MIKI-CHAN
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a Japanese high school. Meet Miki-chan, your personal virtual assistant, and survive a nightmare where jealousy and obsession distort reality.

details.title: MonstrousPark+
details.short_description: A workplace ensemble visual novel about sixteen cast members — monsters — working at a small amusement park that opens only at night.

details.title: AZUR
details.short_description: AZUR is a fast-paced PvP survival FPS on the French island of Belmas. No crafting, no extraction: drop into persistent servers, complete missions, and secure rare gear via Black Drip drops, with the risk of losing everything.

details.title: Burdenfall
details.short_description: Burdenfall is a story-rich roguelike deckbuilder about personal growth and inner struggle. Ascend a mysterious castle with your shapeshifting companion, whose transformations shape and evolve your deck. Survive the climb and uncover the truth behind the Weeping Crown’s message.

details.title: King's Courier
