details.short_description: King’s Courier is a free roam, party-based RPG. Carry out perilous quests for the King while exploring dungeons, enchanted forests, deadly swamps, and monster-filled caves. Build your party, learn magic, battle in real-time or turn-based, solve puzzles, and uncover the kingdom’s secrets.

name: Lufia I & II The Sinistrals Saga

details.title: Lufia I & II The Sinistrals Saga
details.short_description: Lufia and its sequel, Lufia II, return! In a love letter to JRPG fans, these two dramatic tales of love and loss, which moved countless players to tears, are back!

name: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart

details.title: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart
details.short_description: Fighting is hard, right? Let your party do it for you! Romance Monster Girls and traverse the Dungeon! Hopefully they'll all get along... right?

details.title: White Crow Castle: Loop
details.short_description: A fantasy mystery otome RPG with time loop mechanics. Explore a cursed castle, collect clues, solve puzzles, make critical choices, and experience branching storylines, emotional bonds, and life-or-death survival in an inescapable cycle.

details.title: Sweatpants Savior: Worlds Beyond
details.short_description: Shipwrecked in Antarctica, survivors cross the frozen glaciers and step beyond an ice wall into the boundless Great Thousand Worlds. A sandbox RPG centered on exploration and experimentation, featuring deeper systems, a vastly expanded world, and long-term progression shaped by player choice.

details.title: Laica
details.short_description: Live with Laica, a mysterious girl alone aboard a drifting space station, and explore the nightmare spreading beneath your quiet days together. A first-person sci-fi adventure that fuses survival horror with a slow-burn relationship. Is what waits ahead love, or despair?

details.title: GUNGRAVE G.O.R.E: BLOOD HEAT
details.short_description: Full Rebuild with Unreal Engine 5, GUNGRAVE G.O.R.E BLOOD HEAT delivers stunning visuals and an evolved action system. Experience the explosive fusion of stylish Bullet Ballet and Gunkata in an immersive, adrenaline-pumping action spectacle!

details.title: Model Kit Studio
details.short_description: A rich and relaxing model-building simulator. Enjoy the meditative flow, meet fellow builders, and unwind to a soothing soundtrack as you build, pose, paint, and display your collection.

details.title: L'Agence - The Hearts of Paris
details.short_description: Paris, 1888. In debt after taking over her grandmother's marriage agency, Marie has 7 days to find a wife for her creditor's nephew. But everyone in this case is lying! In this Ace Attorney-style detective visual novel, unmask the client and the suitors, and let love triumph!

details.title: Jiří Kára Simulátor
details.short_description: Jiří Kára Simulátor is a retro FPS inspired by the 90s Czech legend. Explore various districts of post-communist Prague in a fast boomer shooter. Fight your way through pubs, dirty streets and defeat bosses. No common weapons, only street scrap, crowbar and gloomy wild atmosphere.

details.title: Rift Fishing
details.short_description: Rift Fishing is a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game. Fish through rifts into other worlds to catch mysterious creatures and artifacts. Make friends worldwide, paint together, and jam by the cozy campfire.

details.title: Mirrors Castle
details.short_description: Mirror Castle is a 3D puzzle-platformer with a unique mechanic: step into reflections to change reality and solve tasks. 4 trial corridors, 128 achievements, multiple endings, and humor parodying horror. The castle evolves as you play. For parkour, puzzles, and self-irony lovers!

details.title: Prospice: Anomalous Logistics
details.short_description: Haul cursed cargo across a haunted island, where the terrain can take your life and every road bears the scars of the past.

details.title: Chill Planet
details.short_description: A deck-building adventure game about a group of girls traveling across Japan in a world doomed by an incoming meteor. Collect items, craft powerful builds, and play your cards wisely as you journey toward Hokkaido!

details.title: Musicasa
details.short_description: Unbox tiny instruments, arrange them on your desk, and connect them to bring your space to life with sound. A story unfolds through the strangers who write to you: read their letters, answer with songs, and watch every reply shape what comes next. Get closer to the truth, one letter at a time.

details.title: Summer Syndrome
details.short_description: "Summer Syndrome" is a sci-fi mystery visual novel set in the near future. Eerie plane crashes, shadowy organizations operating in the dark, and the increasingly prevalent "Summer Syndrome"... Players will experience a non-linear narrative through chapter-based choices and uncover the truth.

details.title: Eldritch Horror: Digital Edition
details.short_description: Uncover ancient cults, battle horrific monsters and thwart the rise of unfathomable Ancient Ones in a 1920s-themed adventure. In this faithful adaptation of the classic board game, you must race against time to save humanity from ancient powers and dark secrets before all is lost.

details.title: Gate Guard Simulator
details.short_description: Step into the boots of the castle guard. Inspect seals, expose smugglers and reveal witches. You decide who enters and who’s turned away. Will you uphold the law, or break it for your own gain?

details.title: Inkblood
details.short_description: You're an Inquisitor following a trail of death. A cult is at work, your predecessor has vanished, and the region teeters on the edge of chaos. Find the truth. Uphold the Inquisition. Do not fail.

details.title: Your Painting, Sir
details.short_description: A puzzle game about forging paintings using newspaper cutouts. Fool your legally blind boss or lose your job!

details.title: Road to Jukai
details.short_description: You work the night shift as a taxi driver in a remote region of Japan. Not all of the odd passengers you pick up after sunset are what they seem. Sometimes it's safer to just keep your eyes on the road, especially when a fare leads to the strange, massive forest the locals whisper about.

details.title: Perceptum
details.short_description: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.

details.title: All Army Attack
details.short_description: Hold onto your clucks! All Army Attack is a chaotic large-scale roguelike auto-battler. Unite animals and plants, build an army that spills off the screen, gamble it all with every battle, and fight your way toward a formidable cosmic threat!

details.title: Dungeon Treaders
details.short_description: A classic-style 3D dungeon crawler that blends nostalgic challenge with modern comfort. Enjoy flexible character creation and a classic world, now with streamlined, trial-and-error gameplay.

details.title: PANLINE
details.short_description: Welcome to post-scarcity! But you’re not on the list. Deliver to make a living off-grid while PANLINE, the abundance engine that keeps the city endlessly supplied, begins to change. Earn currency, favors, kit upgrades and work the runner scene to unlock new contacts and fixers.

name: The Recipe for Life: A Horror About (not) Saving Lives

details.title: The Recipe for Life: A Horror About (not) Saving Lives
details.short_description: Travel across a quietly dying world in your RV, helping people with suicidal thoughts. Dive into the icebergs of their trauma and decide whether each of them deserves salvation — and whether you deserve it too.

details.title: RadCity: A Post-Apocalyptic Adventure
details.short_description: RadCity is a narrative-heavy, top-down journey through a dark, irradiated city. In a post-apocalyptic world, environmental storytelling and meaningful decisions shape your survival. Supplies are running out, the undead are everywhere, and it's hard to trust people anymore. Find a way out.

details.title: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons
details.short_description: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons is a dungeon-crawler RPG where classic literature meets anime Girls! Assemble a party inspired by legendary characters such as Alice, Juliet, Dante, and Raven, then lead them into treacherous dungeons crawling with monsters, traps, treasure, and otherworldly horrors.

details.title: Cutting Edge: Roots Of Mutation
details.short_description: Perform life-saving operations in this fast-paced surgery sim. As lizard surgeon Dr. Peri Maddock, you'll treat injuries, excise tumors, and hack corporate organs with speedy, surgical precision. The patient's life is in your claws!

details.title: CHTHON
details.short_description: CHTHON is a visual novel about pain, memory, and the darkness within us.

details.title: Crop
details.short_description: A gritty farming thriller where your safety depends on the yield. Bound to a dying farm, you must dig, plant, irrigate, and cut your way through the decay. Uncover buried secrets, both in the soil and quietly brewing within the village. The only way out is through the harvest.

details.title: Frostpunk: 1886
details.short_description: A full reimagining of Frostpunk, the groundbreaking survival city builder, packed with new content. In a world ravaged by endless frost, become the Captain of the last city on Earth. Manage its people and infrastructure while facing cruel weather and even crueler choices.

details.title: DRUG Schedule
details.short_description: Build your empire! Cook and make illegal drugs, expand your cartel, and outsmart rivals and law enforcement. Play solo or team up in co-op to dominate the underworld! Your empire, your rules. Rise to power! Don't get high on your own dope!

details.title: Out Fishing
details.short_description: Fish, sell, upgrade your gear, and build your camp in this first-person horror fishing game. Explore a haunted forest and uncover clues about a forgotten disappearance near the lake, but return before nightfall, as danger lurks beneath the water.

details.title: Compress(space)
details.short_description: A mind and space-bending puzzle game where you fold space to cheat your way through puzzles. Master space manipulation and reach beyond the stars to uncover the mystery at the end of the universe.

details.title: AlcheMice
details.short_description: A tarot roguelite deckbuilder. Play a card to move like a chess piece: the knight's jump clears traps and reaches high ground. Strike with action cards and brew alchemy into your deck. Three days, then the loop resets at dawn and you keep only your deck and whatever you locked in the chest.

name: The Wondrous Wedding of Ivan the Bard

details.title: The Wondrous Wedding of Ivan the Bard
details.short_description: A romantic fairy tale set in a fantasy medieval Rus'. Play as Ivan, a young bard with a gusli in hand, on a quest to win the love of the elusive Novgorod princess. Learn tunes, make choices!

details.title: Road Valkyries
details.short_description: Rider Valkyries is an adventure game blending open-world riding, romance, life together, and motorcycle racing and combat. The neon never fades, and the engines are roaring. Welcome to a vertical city where every road climbs and every turn leads somewhere new — Cyber Chongqing.

details.title: Illusive Domain
details.short_description: Deflect, parry, and defeat your opponents through intense boss rush action. Fight for you and your allies’ freedom, lest you remain entombed forever more.

details.title: The Secret of Weepstone
details.short_description: In a hand-drawn black and white dungeon crawler RPG inspired by classic D&D of the 80’s - Roll Dice, Fight Monsters, Loot Dungeons, Embrace Death, and unravel The Secret of Weepstone.

details.title: SOS Recordings
details.short_description: A lone mountain in northern Japan. Two hikers rescued alive from its silent maw. In their wake, a perfect SOS made of tree trunks, built years before anyone was lost. Based on the real unsolved 1989 SOS Incident. The recordings are waiting.

details.title: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons
details.short_description: Play as Kaatri in Warlock, a single-player, third-person action-adventure set in a D&D-inspired open world. Wield forbidden magic to bend the rules around you. Across exploration and combat, every challenge is a test of creativity, preparation, and cunning.

details.title: Economic Miracle
details.short_description: Take charge of any nation and lead it to greatness in the most ambitious geopolitical simulator of the modern era. Manage economy, laws, military, and diplomacy. Build the future without compromise!

details.title: Into The Unwell
details.short_description: Whack-and-slash your inner demons in this third-person roguelite, set in a rubber hose fuelled fever dream! Play 1-3 players as one of several flawed and heavily medicated misfits.
developers: She Was Such A Good Horse

details.title: Port Control
details.short_description: Build the port, on the water and on land. Run its traffic, from the open sea to the warehouse gate. Ships can't stop and the port never sleeps. You are Port Control. Automation management game from the author of Rail Route.

details.title: Bloody Hell Hotel
details.short_description: Renovate, upgrade and expand your hotel! Oh, by the way, you're a vampire, so hospitality isn't your strong suit.

details.title: CODE EXIT
details.short_description: Enter Pantheon, a futuristic city swallowed by darkness and ruled by a rogue AI. Team up with up to 4 players and survive an adaptive pursuer that learns from every mistake. Complete the mission, uncover Minerva’s secrets, and find a way out before the city consumes you.

details.title: Psychotic Bathtub
details.short_description: Have a psychotic episode in your bathtub. Argue with a rubber duck, flood your bathroom and drown Jesus. Find your very own ending – or all of them.

details.title: The Hearth and Harbour
details.short_description: Transform a run-down restaurant and build a new life for yourself in this management RPG. Decide what kind of restaurant you want to create and what kind of person you want to be. As a storm brews outside, every choice you make has consequences.

details.title: MOONSHIRE
details.short_description: Embark on a journey to save MOONSHIRE as you navigate through a mysterious world filled with dungeons, weapons, upgrades, and fast-paced combat!

details.title: Sternly Worded Adventures
details.short_description: Sternly Worded Adventures is a roguelite word puzzle RPG inspired by Bookworm Adventures where you travel through a forested peninsula with Yorkshire-sounding place names fighting monsters with the power of words to uncover whatever dark secrets may be lurking beyond.

details.title: The Last General
details.short_description: Lead thousands of units in this large scale modern war RTS as you manage economy and logistics, build your war machine, and fight across millions of procedurally generated scenarios, or jump into the battlefield controlling any unit in first or third person at any time.

details.title: HUMANKIND™ 2
details.short_description: Build a civilization that spans the ages in this historical turn-based strategy game. Combine evolving cultures, raise cities, command armies and expand your empire as a changing climate reshapes the world and your path through history.

details.title: The Wake of the Wyrm
details.short_description: A crown upon your head, danger all around. Rule, marry, scheme, raise heirs, wage wars, fulfill prophecies, and survive the waking Wyrm. An interactive text-based dark fantasy novel, 850,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

details.title: MEAT-GRINDER
details.short_description: Have a human MEATGRINDER with Obi the freelance hitman! Fulfill contracts all over the planet, open a beer, turn off your brain: it's time to kill and solve the financial problems of Obi and her peculiar family!

details.title: The Plague Lords: Black Death
details.short_description: A turn-based tactical party RPG with base building, set during the Black Death. Assemble peasants, craftsmen, and warriors, investigate the plague's mysterious origin, develop your settlement, and fight the infected as disease consumes medieval Europe.

details.title: Arcane Eats
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a delicious twist. Think like a master chef, balancing resources as you strategically combo ingredients to subdue hungry hordes. Recruit a legendary kitchen crew, and rise through the heroic cooking guilds—before The Hunger consumes us all!

details.title: Beyond Astra
details.short_description: Lead your civilization in a galaxy brimming with life and intrigue. Seamlessly explore and expand across uncharted worlds, from their surfaces to the stars. Forge your destiny in this sci-fi 4X offering a unique blend of grand strategy, planetary city-building, and RTS combat.

details.title: Decrepit
details.short_description: Decrepit is a first-person action game with souls-like combat where every death drags you back into the depths. Learn the dungeon, master the combat, and find your way out of the forsaken castle.

details.title: Windwoven
details.short_description: You inherit forest edge land. Daily, till soil with your hoe grow radishes, rear chicks, bond with oddball neighbors. Spring seeds yield summer gardens; autumn's firelit pumpkins reveal woodland mysteries. Nighttime under trees, fireflies dance like starlit constellations, this is your idyllic life.

details.title: Gravity Circuit 2
details.short_description: A new Ark has emerged. Play as one of two adept fighters, Gravity and Power Circuit, in this action-packed 2D platformer inspired by console classics. Gravity Circuit 2 is the sequel to the critically acclaimed Gravity Circuit.

details.title: Gretel's Honesty
details.short_description: A comic-like visual novel, expressing a new story based on the fairy tale “Hansel and Gretel”.

name: Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator

details.title: Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator
details.short_description: Step into the role of a technomaster in Valkyrie Iteration, a sci-fi visual novel. Train and guide Lana, a young pilot, and her sentient mech, the Valkyrie, as they prepare for high-stakes battles against otherworldly foes.

details.title: Biofactory
details.short_description: Build your living factory using organs and fleshy biomachines. Combine your pulsating machines to automate and scale up production. Mine, harvest, produce and assemble weird materials in a grimdark biopunk setting. You are an evolving hive-mind brain, driven by one instinct: The factory must grow.

details.title: City of None
details.short_description: A metropolis crumbles into ruin as powerful Barons satisfy their greed upon souls lost in time. You are but one spirit, with a wooden body left to rot in the wild…

details.title: My Time at Evershine
details.short_description: Be the Governor of a brand-new settlement on the fringes of the Free Cities, facing the almighty Duvos Empire. Recruit settlers, build infrastructure, tame the wilds, and lead your people to become a new cornerstone for the Alliance in this adventure-packed simulation RPG!

details.title: SACRATA
details.short_description: SACRATA is a Diablo-like roguelite looter with horde-survival combat. Fight through relentless hordes, create skill builds, unlock a roster of heroes, challenge formidable bosses, and claim ancient Relics. Experience the thrill of intense combat and ultimate destruction!

details.title: KINGDOM HEARTS IV
details.short_description: Our hero Sora awakes in the unfamiliar world of Quadratum. As he looks for a way to return to his world, his friends Donald and Goofy head for the Underworld to try to find him. Wield the Keyblade in fast-paced battles that match to your own play style.

details.title: 2 FAST 4 YOU
details.short_description: Race through challenging levels and annihilate killer bots. Master your movement to create your own fastest paths to the finish line. Use unique abilities to speedrun your way to the top of the leaderboards. Catch and banish the evil folder - your cat’s life depends on it!

details.title: Zozo and the Lost Dreams
details.short_description: Help Zozo find his way home in this cartoon-inspired casual Metroidvania platformer. Pillow-fight sentient pastries, train under an octopus master, and brave a cybernetic jungle as you explore the vibrant landscapes of Zozo's dreams.

details.title: Starball Pachinko
details.short_description: Spend the night in a back-alley izakaya where a fox-masked owner pours the drinks and the regulars wear festival masks. Play the old pachinko machine in the corner, build your board, and win prizes that help them. A cozy pachinko roguelike.

details.title: The Subminer
details.short_description: An atmospheric underwater drilling roguelite beneath the icy crust of Enceladus. Pilot your submarine, explore the depths, mine resources through procedural caves and upgrade your base. Each dive is darker and more dangerous, and you must face the terrors lurking in the shadows. Live. Dive. Repeat.

details.title: 异世轮回录：If
details.short_description: 诸君！这个世界很无趣。生为牛马，我只是一个行走的NPC。谁不想当主角？ 在地球OL已经不可能办到了。但至少在异世轮回录中，我们可以！《异世轮回录：If》是一款多结局多周目轮回式人生模拟团队卡牌肉鸽游戏。你被女神召唤来到剑与魔法的异世界，新的人生你要选择怎么样的天赋？本以为是一次王道转生，但没想到这个世界危机重重，选错一步就只能迎接死亡。无数次轮回，你一点点探寻这个世界的隐秘，在最后的世界线，或许就是所有人都能幸福的Happy End?

details.title: MAW
details.short_description: What's it like to be queer in a totalitarian regime? Explore your identity as a wolf detective working for the state. Sniff for clues. Interrogate or date other characters. Make lasting choices. Will you fight your instincts or embrace who you really are and face the consequences?

details.title: Precinct IX
details.short_description: Precinct IX is a cyberpunk police management and turn-based combat game. Receive visitors, manage cases and resources, dispatch unique officers to unstable scenes, and change case outcomes—and your relationships—through dialogue, command, and battle.

details.title: Worms: Galactic Tactics
details.short_description: Worms makes an explosive leap into tactical roguelike combat! Battle across destructible arenas, mod classic weapons and unleash devastating strategic combos as you fight for survival, riches and glory!

details.title: THE LIFT: Supernatural Handyman Simulator
details.short_description: You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and the SCP Foundation.

details.title: The Vow: Vampire's Curse
details.short_description: You are Sir Richard in a tactical card battler set in a dark fantasy roguelike. Master your cards, execute deadly combos, and survive cursed nights to rescue your fiancée from the vampire’s grasp.

details.title: Häxeri
details.short_description: Häxeri is a grid-based first-person dungeon crawler DRPG with turn-based combat. Form your own party, explore and map the sprawling corridors of the dungeon, and battle the monsters therein. Gain extra turns by exploiting their weaknesses, but be careful or they will exploit yours!

details.title: Magicians: The Devil's Deal
details.short_description: Magicians: The Devil’s Deal is a narrative driven FPS where stage magic becomes real. You play as Jacob Menteuro, a fallen illusionist bound by a pact with The Devil and cast into Hell. Master deadly tricks, steal the powers of rival magicians, and escape the infernal world of Theatreland.

details.title: Calame
details.short_description: In this turn-based tactical RPG, renown can change the course of a war. Lead Kenmare and the Panthers against the King of Light, shape the Chronicle through your choices, and wield the Legend to turn battles around.

details.title: Liminal Point
details.short_description: Classic Survival Horror. Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

details.title: Wild Terrain
details.short_description: You're a wild pig on a quest to find all of your missing piglets. Smash obstacles, forage through trash for food, discover special mushrooms, and poop flowers to restore balance as you grow closer to your piglet family and the wild around you.

details.title: Underground Security Inc
details.short_description: Defend your dungeon against relentless waves of “heroes”. Manage your minions, mine ores, construct traps and cast spells to strengthen your defenses. Each run brings new challenges in this roguelite dungeon defense game.

details.title: Hell Operators
details.short_description: Command a squad of military operators in a satirical hellscape. Enemy hordes don't come in waves, they fuse and evolve into emergent ecosystems. Each operator has their own class, gear progression, and permanent upgrades in the form of cybernetic implants, DNA extensions, and paranormal abilities.

details.title: Monster Cuisine
details.short_description: Best a beast and serve a feast in Monster Cuisine, an action-RPG where you're a tavern keeper hunting fabled creatures in a forbidden forest to cook mythical meals and grow your business. Craft unique weapons and armor sets to take on stronger monsters that are as delicious as they are dangerous.

details.title: GRIDLANDS
details.short_description: GRIDLANDS is a PvE extraction shooter set in a fallen world where sentient machines hunt what remains of humanity. Scavenge, survive, and extract through hostile industrial dead zones where every run could be your last.

details.title: Carnholt
details.short_description: Build your victory upon the corpses you leave behind. Carnholt is a roguelike deckbuilder in which death is not the end, it’s just another card to play. Craft a deck of wild creatures and powerful spells, fight in tactical battles, and slay a God that refused death.

details.title: Respect The Horde
details.short_description: You're outnumbered. Outsmart them. Lure hordes of zombies into deadly traps, shape their path with obstacles, and grow stronger with every kill. But know when to walk away before overconfidence and greed turn your strategy into uncontrollable chaos.

details.title: Intercept Course
details.short_description: Intercept Course is a tactical space auto battler where you command a starship caught in a temporal rift while chasing a tech thief. Recruit a crew, survive with limited resources, and modify your starship to face rival factions stuck in their own conflicts across every corner of the multiverse.

details.title: In Perfection
details.short_description: A writer is trying to finish his "perfect work," but things keep getting in his way. He is poor and full of anxiety. In this retro lo-fi visual novel, fix the problems with point-and-click, explore the depths of consciousness. Forgive yourself? or stare into the dark and fall deeper? It's up to you.

details.title: Rotten Chamber
details.short_description: A single-player logic puzzle disguised as social deduction. Read the claims of a corrupt city council, catch the liars and arrest them, but every wrong call brings you closer to losing it all.

details.title: Girlfailure Art Club
details.short_description: Fall in love again with the cringey otaku girls who spent their school days drawing in the corner. Packed with 2010s otaku culture, memes, and second-hand embarrassment, this visual novel lets you relive a painfully cute youth with the oddballs of a Japanese art club!

details.title: World Railway
details.short_description: World Railway is a sim management game and you're a conductor reviving an old train. Produce and gather resources in stations via loops, process and manage onboard. A new world unfolds with the wheel's rumble. On your journey, forge bonds and witness the seasons.

details.title: Shipolis
details.short_description: Shipolis is a cozy naval city builder and resource management game. Explore archipelagos with your ship. Build cities and expand in several regions. Manage production lines and automate with trading routes. Play at your own pace to build great wonders and uncover all the mysteries of the world.

details.title: Falling Apart
details.short_description: Falling Apart is a disturbing point-and-click puzzle adventure about a man descending into his own fractured mind through hypnosis.

details.title: Orbital Maintenance Technician
details.short_description: The stations in orbit need maintenance! A handful of specialized tools and zero gravity. Drift, dismantle, clean, restore. Just you, your tools, and a job well done. Suit up and get to work!

details.title: Papaya Plaza
details.short_description: Rebuild a faded tourist town as its new mayor! Place shops and decorations, staff them with quirky villagers to earn cash each day, and help out with their favours. Every night the judges score your town, so rank up, unlock new buildings, and get that coveted 5-star rating. Peep peep!

details.title: Where Dolls Hang
details.short_description: Where Dolls Hang is a psychological survival horror game inspired by Mexican folklore, set in 1998. Investigate an island filled with hanging dolls, eerie mannequins, and horrifying rituals. Explore the forests and interiors with your camcorder, find VHS tapes, and uncover what happened.

details.title: Dendrophobia
details.short_description: A twisted pixel-art horror thriller about death, ancient gods, and a persistent waiter. Explore The Willow’s Embrace hotel, solve puzzles, and gather paranormal evidence. Challenge the madness to find a way out and avoid becoming part of an eternal nightmare.

details.title: Dice Crawler
details.short_description: At the bottom of the dungeon lies the rotting corpse of a dead god, festering and devouring the land above. Descend into the depths. Slay the monsters. Resurrect the god. Dice Crawler is a dice-based roguelite game.

details.title: Blightrole
details.short_description: Blightrole is a dice-based game, a role-playing campaign you won’t escape from. Face an original dark fantasy world with a touch of black humor. Will you uncover the Master’s secrets, or will your campaign end before its time?

details.title: Torizon Telecom
details.short_description: Torizon Telecom is a text-based FPS game set in a vast world composed entirely of text. “Telecom”—a world where everything is text. “Telecom”... But does any other world exist beyond “Telecom”...? Or is “Telecom” the only one that exists...?

details.title: Gorilla Tag Contagion
details.short_description: Join your fellow Monke to smash, climb, and roll your way through hordes of enemies! Unlock new characters, powerful weapons, endless gadgets, and crazy parkour skills as you fight through twisted monstrosities with your unique build. Will you survive the Contagion?

details.title: Flight Date
details.short_description: Getting everyone in the same place should be easy… right? Flight Date is a logic puzzle that turns seemingly simple meetups into absurdly complicated travel plans. Untangle the logistical chaos, find the right routes, and share in the little moments each meetup leaves behind.

details.title: C.A.G.E.
details.short_description: C.A.G.E. is a satirical first-person narrative adventure where your choices influence the story. Guided by an entity with questionable morals, you must navigate through corporate gaslighting and environmental oddities to complete your tasks. Your empathy is a glitch, compliance is your currency.

details.title: BRO GHOST
details.short_description: When you die, you don't leave the game. You become one of the deadliest things in it. A co-op horror for 4 players — return as a spirit, help your friends, or haunt them until they break.

details.title: Haunted Uni Love
details.short_description: Romance × Mystery × Ghost Story The heroine, who has just stepped into university life, never imagined she would soon find herself in a bizarre yet sweet campus life. With a series of haunting events happening, the heroine holds the key to solving everything.

details.title: Foxwood Adventure
details.short_description: A cozy survival game designed to be relaxing and approachable. Explore, craft, and learn the basics of survival alone or with someone new to the genre.

name: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros

details.title: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros
details.short_description: Classic real-time strategy in the world of Westeros. Conquer the Seven Kingdoms solo, or dominate your enemies to claim the Iron Throne in multiplayer skirmish. Command the Great Houses, rally iconic heroes, and rewrite the fate of the realm.

details.title: Acre of Aces
details.short_description: Click a patch, harvest a patch. Build patterns and chains and watch the numbers roll from hundreds to hundreds of millions. Power up your seed cards each night, pick relics that amplify your strategy, and grow one small field into an ever-faster harvest machine. A farming deckbuilder roguelite.

details.title: Fear Tide
details.short_description: Fear Tide is a single-player zombie extraction survival game where you and your dog brave infected zones for the supplies keeping your bunker alive. Fight together, track valuable resources, carry what you can, rescue survivors, and extract before the horde closes in.

details.title: Resident Evil Veronica
details.short_description: Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica. In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.

details.title: Westlanders
details.short_description: Survive a wild-west open world alone or with friends. Travel the land with your wagon, build settlements, fend off foes, and weave a powerful economic network across the wilderness. Forge your legacy in the Westlands.

details.title: My Cannibal Family
details.short_description: You are the lurking terror in My Cannibal Family, a multiplayer monster sim where you get to build your own deadly fairground of horror.

name: The War of the Worlds: Siberia

details.title: The War of the Worlds: Siberia
details.short_description: The War of the Worlds: Siberia tells a story of one young Student, running from law and martian invaders whose Incursion into Europe in 1896 threatens the entire civilisation and all that makes us human.

details.title: Changer Seven
details.short_description: 3D Single-Player Action-Adventure! Explore a Vibrant World, Recruit Colorful Teammates, and Swap them during Combo-Driven Battles! ❤️ A Love Letter to the Toku-Sentai, Shounen Anime, Mahou Shoujo, and Classic Morning Cartoon Shows of our Childhood!

details.title: Eternity
details.short_description: Lead the last fleet of mankind across an abandoned star system. Ration life-support, weigh research against survival, and shape society through Fleet Council decisions you cannot undo. Every choice tightens the path to the next jump.

details.title: Amalga
details.short_description: You wake in a ring of purple light with no memory of who you are, and a voice that says you were chosen. A dark dungeon crawler with a hidden-intent card battler at its core: every blow aimed at a body part, every body a choice, and the strongest cards are what will change you.

details.title: Super Vecter Elite Turbo
details.short_description: Explore, fight and race across the real world in the sequel to one of the best runner games out there. Real cities, real mountains, real scale, all waiting for you to discover and unlock. Customize your ship, unlock new ones, and fight enemies at crazy speeds.

details.title: ONTOS
details.short_description: A sci-fi mystery set on the repurposed moon hotel Samsara. Uncover cryptic experiments, face unsettling encounters, and piece together a mind-bending narrative. The deeper you go, the more the truth unravels as you confront the ultimate question: What is reality?

details.title: No Signal: Chornobyl
details.short_description: No Signal is a strictly online co-op psychological horror game set in the abandoned Chornobyl Exclusion Zone. Explore decaying towns, solve tasks together, and question everything—because you and your partner may not be seeing the same reality.

details.title: Crimson Crisis
details.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelike where skill beats firepower. Outmaneuver swarms, harness Poison/Inflame/Traumatize, and expand the game with mods & co-op.

details.title: Telluris
details.short_description: Become a waymaker on the frontier of Antaris. Fly a second-hand ship past the edge of the charted stars, dive from orbit through the clouds of a world nobody has named and land anywhere. Chart its rivers and species, name it, claim it… or go too far to ever come back.

details.title: Rasterfall
details.short_description: A falling-sand survival crafting game where every pixel is physically simulated and chemically reactive. Explore the world using a wide variety of materials, synthesize new substances, and build automated production lines. Multiplayer supported.

details.title: Cthulhu's Cleanup Crew
details.short_description: You’re Employee #1 at Cthulhu’s new reality repair business. In this relaxing restoration game, clean up impossible disasters with a cosmic paint gun and upgrade your gear and workspace. Just try to ignore whatever’s screaming behind the walls.

details.title: Beyond The Plastic Wall
details.short_description: Set off on an adventure set in a sprawling world that blends satisfying, mechanical puzzles with a rich narrative. Explore a stunning pixel-art world, repair intricate machines & meet unforgettable characters in a story about connection, resilience, and life that clings on in a world left to ruin.

details.title: The Last Of Morvein
details.short_description: You are an aristocrat, the last survivor of Morvein. Explore a dark metropolis of Gothic architecture and Victorian elegance. Battle hellish creatures and uncover the mystery behind the fall of a city where death was only the beginning of the nightmare.

details.title: Super Cucumber
details.short_description: Super Cucumber mixes Saturday morning cartoon charm with fast-paced action platforming. Play as Cucumber, an aardvark superhero, dashing, leaping, and comboing through 100+ handcrafted levels filled with new abilities, hidden secrets, and delightfully devious foes.

details.title: EREBUS
details.short_description: EREBUS is a third person element focused fighter, where players can face off in a free for all fight. Players will choose an element and utilize one of the four abilities specific to that element, each win is cataloged and the winning element will have the map change to showcase that change!

details.title: 魔王3：新秩序
details.short_description: Falsemen 3 is a fantastic adventure game based on an independent world view. In the game, players will play a group of non-positive characters and experience the magnificent epic of the times in the story of struggling with the empire.

details.title: Panic in Puzzle World
details.short_description: Panic in Puzzle World is an action-packed 2D platformer in the spirit of console classics. Play as Tide and breathe fire, slash with your claws, bounce on bad guys and glide with your wings to put a stop to the robot menace taking over the land, block by block!

details.title: Feudums
details.short_description: Lead your noble house through brutal wars, shifting allegiances and economic strife in an asynchronous multiplayer 4X strategy. Shape the narrative with or against real players in a medieval world where diplomacy isn't binding, there is NO pay-to-win, and only strategy determines your legacy.

details.title: Mayhem À La Carte
details.short_description: Cook, fight, and serve under pressure in this chaotic 4-player co-op first-person cooking shooter. Prepare delicious meals, defend your kitchen from relentless enemies, and keep the orders flowing before everything falls apart.

details.title: Abysses: Meridian
details.short_description: Your pod came down crippled on Meridian, a world where the sea has risen sixty metres in six years. Swim out on a minute of air, wake a silent station, build a real submarine and dive ever deeper, alone or with a friend, toward the vast ring that made the sea rise.

details.title: Pelagia
details.short_description: Build a colony on the floor of a shoreless ocean while an ark of sleeping colonists waits in orbit. By day, lower your modules and keep air, power and food flowing. By night, your lights draw creatures up from the deep.

details.title: Deadstick - Bush Pilot Simulator
details.short_description: A career-driven bush flight simulator where judgement, skill and reading the terrain determine whether you make a profit. Take on flying jobs across unforgiving wilderness, build crucial infrastructure and earn a reputation among the island's scattered communities.

details.title: Usurpator
details.short_description: USURPATOR is an EXTRACTION MELEE SLASHER. Rally your allies, clash with rival players, and battle the forces of evil. Master powerful weapons, unlock new talents, and carve your path to glory—then fight to make it out alive.

details.title: Scratch The Cat
details.short_description: Grab your headphones and step up to the turntable in Scratch The Cat - a vibrant action-adventure 3D platformer. Play as DJ Scratch, explore a sprawling musical world, fight bosses, and reclaim your stolen records. Turn up the volume and set the stage for the purr-fect comeback.

details.title: Seclusion: Islesbury
details.short_description: Seclusion: Islesbury is a new horror point-and-click adventure in the vein of genre classics such as Scratches and Dark Fall. Can a decade-old murder case be solved? Is it safe to wander on these streets? Will anyone help you in this town? Find it out in this tale of personal tragedy.

details.title: Sin Hunter
details.short_description: An innovative roguelike deckbuilder with a fresh card combat system and character-driven relationship stories. Become a Sin Hunter, slay the Original Sins, meet four demon girls, uncover the secrets of Hell City, and become their salvation—you are this world’s “Hope.”

details.title: Still Above: Orbital Refuge
details.short_description: A 3D space-station survival builder. The Earth below is gone; your station is still falling. Salvage the orbital graveyard, fit out empty hulls rack by rack, and keep air, water, power and fuel flowing long enough to turn one fragile module into humanity's last refuge.

details.title: The Free Shepherd
details.short_description: Run fast and free as a sheepdog in a beautiful but troubled world. Herd masses of lost sheep to a secret refuge. Discover a mysterious calamity that only you can stop.

details.title: WRAITH OPS
details.short_description: WRAITH OPS delivers snappy gunplay, fast movement, and objective-based combat with a focus on teamwork and skill. No grind, no gimmicks. Just pure infantry action where every fight matters. Get in, squad up, and take control.

details.title: ARTIFICIAL
details.short_description: ARTIFICIAL is a physics based first-person puzzle platformer inspired by Portal & Half-Life series. Interact with the environment, pick up and throw objects, sneak around enemies, control intricate physics-based mechanisms and learn how to survive in the underground colony of the Asteroid 2031 XT

details.title: Forgery Craft
details.short_description: Master the art of forgery in this story-driven simulation game. Start with altering documents by changing single signatures and dates. End up forging entire art pieces that could fool any museum expert.

details.title: Unsung Warriors
details.short_description: Unsung Warriors is a 2D action-adventure game. The game can be played solo or in couch co-op mode. Enjoy beautiful handcrafted levels. Fight against ferocious enemies and discover the many secrets of this ancient world.

details.title: Islands
details.short_description: Island Island Island is a low-poly cartoon-style sandbox survival crafting game. Set in an infinitely dynamically generated world of floating islands, all terrain unfolds in real time as you move—the map has no boundaries.

name: MoonLit Journey: The Age of Deth

details.title: MoonLit Journey: The Age of Deth
details.short_description: Join us on an Epic Journey into the warped minds of life long gamers who are creating a nostalgic game, setting the player deep into a fantasy realm with a rich story line and many interactive features.

details.title: Jump Frog
details.short_description: A determined frog leaps ever higher, risking its life in a perilous climb where every slip could send it tumbling back to the start. driven by the call to find the perfect mate. Will this frog have what it takes?

details.title: TreeTale
details.short_description: TreeTale is a HACK&SLASH ARPG that combines limitless customization with strategic combat. Players can freely build their characters using an extensive Passive Tree, while the Skill Customization System allows them to refine their combat style to perfection.

details.title: Spells and Sploobies
details.short_description: A tactical hex-grid card game for 2–4 players where wizards clash in strategic PvP duels. Build your deck, summon units, build structures, cast abilities, and issue commands to fight for control of the board.

details.title: Crystals
details.short_description: Crystals is a RPG game where you travel to another Dimension and have to fight multiple enemies using a turn-based combat system and avoid attacks like a platformer.

details.title: 轮回江湖
details.short_description: 2D挂机沙盒武侠网游无货币纯材料交易
Space flight arcade focused on maneuvering.

details.title: Robust Island
details.short_description: A relationship-driven farming sim with time pressure and consequences. Grow crops, raise animals, manage stamina, and build relationships while racing against daily deadlines that shape your success—or force you off the island.

details.title: Atmospheric Labyrinth
details.short_description: Search for unusual events inside a labyrinth of usual rooms. Walk through it, and see daily life differently.

details.title: Irredeemable
details.short_description: Irredeemable is an Open World First Person Shooter where you can explore the war and the criminal world directly on the hood.

details.title: DAUGHTER OF PAIN
details.short_description: "DAUGHTER OF PAIN" is a top-down action game with Roguelike elements. You will explore in dreams and create after waking up... provided that you can defeat the powerful enemies who are the incarnations of pain. Don't be afraid of nightmares - sleep, wake up, create, and repeat this cycle.

details.title: 2 Etoiles sont nées
details.short_description: Two children journey through worlds shaped by emotions to save their parents. Work together, solve puzzles, face strange creatures, and reverse gravity to transform the rules, gameplay, and music, either solo or in local co-op.

details.title: Mazino
details.short_description: A neon-soaked casino twist on classic maze-chase action. Navigate glowing mazes as "Chip," dodge cunning Dealers, ride hot streaks, hit jackpots, and let the music-reactive visuals pull you into one more run. The house always wins... unless you're on a Blazing Streak.

name: Miners and Moyu-spheres in a field of citadels

details.title: Miners and Moyu-spheres in a field of citadels
details.short_description: A colorful RTS with rainbow skills.

details.title: Adept
details.short_description: Conquer the world with fire and sword in a world where chaos reigns.

details.title: GODBOX
details.short_description: GODBOX is a coding god-sim where you program life, grow your power by unlocking divine domains, and compete against rival deities. Help your devoted Folk survive while you harness their faith to fuel your divine ascension.

details.title: Battle Tanks Online
details.short_description: Retro tank battles with live opponents. Destroy, break through, and outsmart other players in fast-paced, dynamic matches. Destructible environments, arcade-style gameplay, and tactical elements await you.

details.title: Finnish middleschool simulator
details.short_description: In this simulation, you can live the life of dreams. The game is completely open world, and besides attending school, you can also customize your moped, drink alcohol, and enjoy the sauna. If you’re not in the mood for school, you can tell the teacher to fuck off and come to school drunk.

details.title: Trust Me Bro, I Trade
details.short_description: A minimalist incremental clicker about trading stocks and coins in rapid-fire rounds. Watch prices move, trade bulk orders, square off for profit or loss, and unlock upgrades & sectors to further maximize earnings.

details.title: Furniture Market
details.short_description: Manage every step of your furniture business. Unload containers with cranes, drive forklifts to organize stock, and design your store for customers. Handle logistics alone or with friends in co-op. A realistic simulation focused on deep mechanics, from port shipments to in-store sales.

name: VIOLENCE DOLL バイオレンスドール

details.title: VIOLENCE DOLL バイオレンスドール
details.short_description: Become V.D, a cybernetic investigator pursuing a global conspiracy in this sci-fi action RPG. Hack enemies at close range to freeze them, then unleash devastating combos. Explore 2.5D stages and engage in real-time 3D battles.

details.title: 思安α.1.0
details.short_description: 游戏类型：日常休闲轻解谜

details.title: Arraywrap
details.short_description: A strange world filled with mystery. Bend space to go through impossible passages and explore the Sky Archipelago. Discover its secrets and rules. What does it all mean?

details.title: Brutal Magic
details.short_description: Master devastating elemental magic in this fast-paced third-person fighting game. Chain explosive spells, outplay your opponent, and unleash spectacular magical combat in a visually stunning fantasy world. 1v1 duels where one hit ends the round.

details.title: Gunlands
details.short_description: Gunlands is an FPS action roguelike about crafting weapons and fighting an evil cult ready to overthrow the world with an army of ascended, mind-controlled soldiers. Find gun parts, assemble them into weapons of mass destruction, and let the chaos rain down upon your enemies.

details.title: Delta x Dungeon Breaker
details.short_description: Guide "Kaiza", your main character, through a treacherous high fantasy world grappling with the looming threat of Dungeon Breaks that grows each day. Gather adventurers, train, fight, and die while traversing a deep narrative puzzle on your quest to stop the dungeon breaks!

name: くろねこ・ぷれい・ろーる！

details.title: くろねこ・ぷれい・ろーる！
details.short_description: 「くろねこ・ぷれい・ろーる！」は、3D空間で主人公のねこを操作し、会話でストーリーが進行するRPGです。VR・PC（Windows）の両方でプレイ可能です。プレイヤーであるあなたは、不思議な本に閉じ込められてしまった主人公の「ゆかいなくろもふねこちゃん」になり、問題を解決しながら本から脱出しましょう。

details.title: Soap Soup Tycoon
details.short_description: Inherit Grandma's restaurant in Kesselbach and make it your own: a schnitzel house, a trattoria, a wok kitchen or wild fusion. In a town where every guest really lives somewhere. Only the big pot in the cellar, Grandma couldn't get out.

details.title: 悠久教室 - Perpetual Classroom -
details.short_description: A horror adventure where you confront supernatural phenomena and unravel mysteries in a school transformed into another world, all to save your childhood friend. Exploration, combat, and psychological terror await you.

details.title: Parkdens
details.short_description: Parkdens is a minimalistic and relaxing nature park building game where you can place tiles and choose variety of objects ranging from statues, sitting areas, shelters to bushes, playgrounds, trees etc. to populate the placed tiles.

details.title: 龙之塔
details.short_description: Dragon Tower is a light ROGUE game set in a different world, where players take on the role of a brave adventurer exploring inside the Dragon Tower. They will assemble their own team to create unique strategies and defeat the monsters within the Dragon Tower.

details.title: Diehexegy
details.short_description: Diehexegy is a hex grid turn-based 4x game with a unique twist: your armies are composed of dice. It has multiple victory conditions and straightforward gameplay.

details.title: Looping Art Museum
details.short_description: "Looping Art Museum" is a single-player adventure game where you wander through an infinitely-looping art museum, finding changes in the paintings to progress. Interact with a talking "Mr.Cat" and uncover the mysteries of the strange art museum.

details.title: Hateful Days
details.short_description: George Prinkerton, expecting nothing terrible about the new day, finds himself caught in a time loop. Shocking events unfold one after another, and what seemed to be a completely ordinary young man becomes trapped in a terrifying whirlwind of events.

details.title: A Story About Forever: Transience
details.short_description: A Story About Forever is a space exploration action RPG game with heavy emphasis on story and character interaction, (inspired by Star Control II). Features Asteroids-style dogfights, an upgradable ship, a deep conversation system, and hundreds of characters with novels' worth of dialog to discover.

details.title: Land of Manifestations: Sanctuary
details.short_description: A fantasy RPG blending romance, roguelite shooting, and city building. Awakening in the Tianwen Temple with no memory of the past, you discover that an unknown force is corrupting the Land of Manifestations, twisting Xiangling into monsters. To save the world, you must build a Sanctuary.

details.title: Emotion Hunter
details.short_description: A 2D anime-style action game. Dive into the unconscious mind world to hunt negative emotion monsters!

details.title: Build or be sniped
details.short_description: A chaotic physics-based party game built to test friendships. Every match switches things up: build a staircase to steal a sniper’s rifle, shoot rivals off giant jenga blocks over open water, climb a wall covered in knives, throw chairs off a ledge, draw shapes to cast spells and much more...

details.title: Ram and Hedgehog
details.short_description: Set off on a crazy adventure with the Ram and the Hedgehog, filled with unexpected dangers and fun challenges. They prank each other and annoy everyone around them. But one day, a great goal unites them — food. What could possibly go wrong?

details.title: こもれびの丘
details.short_description: I accidentally overslept on the train and ended up in some kind of mysterious towns. This is a relaxing, slow-life game where you wander around the streets freely, meet the locals, and feel the changing seasons together with the main character, Rifa, who unexpectedly became the town's representative

details.title: VIVID
details.short_description: Be a plant in this cozy, narrative-driven plant survival simulation about nature, responsibility, and interconnected systems. You will grow procedurally over time, explore evolving environments, and shape a fragile ecosystem through meaningful choices.

details.title: Wrathbreaker
details.short_description: Wrathbreaker is single-player 3rd person combat game where you protect your kingdom from an invading evil empire while growing your personal keep and commanding your troops in battle. Manage resources to grow your fortress, train new troops, create and upgrade your arsenal to defend the realm.

details.title: SolBound
details.short_description: A 4X turn-based strategy game where energy is everything. Build a power network, grow your forces, and fight your rivals for the best ground on a planet where day and night are always on the move.

details.title: SURANGAMA
details.short_description: Unravel the truth and secrets which bind Tse Li Li to her forgotten past. Battle through hordes of relentless malformed souls and solve intricate puzzles in this Survival Horror X Character Action mashup set in a neon soaked Diyu, the Chinese-Buddhist vision of Hell, inspired by Kowloon Walled City.

details.title: Retired
details.short_description: RETRO HYPER TIRE RACING! Cruise down hills through 5 different developer created worlds competing for the best track time, or race through a nearly infinite supply of User created levels through the steam workshop!

details.title: Terror of the Titans
details.short_description: Terror of the titans is a 3D arena brawler pitting kaiju against one another. Featuring 10 playable monsters, 10 maps, a movie inspired story mode, and many game modes. Smash, crush, and rampage across the globe!

details.title: Phase Nexus
details.short_description: Blitz enemies in slow motion as an energy-based speedster and stop time then fire off with precision as a warp speed teleporter in this space-time action! Phase Nexus is a cartoony character action game that stars a quarter alien and a cyborg vigilante fighting against reality-breaking anomalies.

details.title: Hypocrisy
details.short_description: Hunt a tyrant, liberate oppressed worlds, face the monster within — in a sci-fantasy action roguelike RPG.

details.title: Dawn Herald: Purple Fox
details.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelite built around teleportation, symmetry, and runic combos, where movement, positioning, and mastery of space decide every fight.

details.title: Arbiters Dream
details.short_description: Face the God of Chaos in a cosmic tower-defense board game for the balance of the universe. Each run craft a unique deck from tower and unit cards and upgrade them with modular ability runes.

details.title: Bloody Moon - First Fear
details.short_description: First-person horror with no HUD. Nostradamus and Catherine de’ Medici shared a secret that history buried on purpose. Underground, on nights the Moon turns blood red, something still hunts. Every piece of this story really existed. That’s the terrifying part.

details.title: Weekend Racer
details.short_description: Race your way up from weekend wannabe to hired pro driver. Every pixel of the track is simulated live: rain washes it clean, rubber and dirt build up, and the dry line forms as the cars warm it up. Full weather and day/night cycle. It looks cute but it won’t be easy.

details.title: LENG
details.short_description: A bass-drenched FPS set in a vertical megastructure built on pirate radio and UKF rave culture.

details.title: Cerulean Climb
details.short_description: Play as Lark in a story-driven 2.5D RPG about climbing an endless tower to become God. Explore its wildly different floors, solve puzzle-box dungeons, and break enemy shields in turn-based battles. The higher Lark climbs, the easier it gets to justify what he does to keep going.

details.title: XiSiTeLing with Infinite Winding
details.short_description: Xisiteling and the Infinite Winding A pixel-art deck-building RPG Roguelike. Black fire traps worlds in cycles. Play amnesiac Xisiteling, sword in hand, in the Infinite Corridor. Fight, learn skills, meet others, unlock cards. Choices forge your power. Recover memories; face the truth

details.title: 4000 Later
details.short_description: After doing something foolish, you slip into Headspace, whereupon you meet Phil. Will you escape, or will you remain a doofus?

details.title: KONBOYS
details.short_description: Co-op for up to 4 players. Drive through a dark and mysterious island filled with mutations created by Mycel Corp, navigate using your vehicle’s analog controls, search for the lost complex, and recover the forgotten cargo to sell it and upgrade your gear.

details.title: Voltform
details.short_description: Become more than a line of text in Voltform, a two-player online co-op puzzle adventure. Share clues, restore power, and rebuild your digital bodies from 2D to 3D. Solve puzzles together and uncover the secrets of a silent city.

details.title: Rotten!
details.short_description: Grow vegetables! Burn the rot!

details.title: Amaterasu in Hell
details.short_description: You are Amaterasu, the Japanese sun goddess, and circumstances force you to explore the realms of shadow to retrieve the former pets you once mistreated and cast into the Buddhist underworld. Between descents into the underworld, players can unwind in a cavern hub and converse with their animals.

details.title: Australia: Federation 1901
details.short_description: Lead Australia from Federation in 1901 and shape the nation's future. Manage the economy, politics, immigration, infrastructure, defence, education, healthcare, and welfare in a deep historical nation-building simulation where every decision changes history.

details.title: Path to Transcendence（追境）
details.short_description: Path to Transcendence : a Chinese story driven auditory puzzle game. The story takes place in the Northern Song Dynasty, spanning 30 years from Qinling Mountains to Bianjing. The narrative mainly revolves around light puzzles. Make an appointment to follow and wait for good news.

details.title: Knights of Jikan
details.short_description: Six heroes must travel back in time to defeat a powerful enemy and save the kingdom of Jikan!

details.title: Immania
details.short_description: Immania is a large-scale real-time strategy game. Command armies of Immanians to capture territory, build interconnected Energy networks, and overwhelm opponents using specialized units, upgrades and powerups.

details.title: Fallen Dungeons
details.short_description: Fallen Dungeons is a grid-based dungeon crawler which melds modern aesthetics and mechanics with old school game design.

details.title: Chi Chi's Magic Wash
details.short_description: Help Chi Chi clean grime and master her magical cleaning prowess. Make her parents proud in this cozy witchy cleaning sim. Clean with a spell-powered wand, explore charming locations, find potions, and bring sparkle back to every corner of the enchanted world.

details.title: Pain-Hatching
details.short_description: Game about a rooster, friendship, family, a cult, WOMAN, and chthonic horrors.

details.title: Kiss Magic Curse:the accursed child
details.short_description: One sneeze turns you—a young noble heir—into a stunning woman?! Now, a loyal knight, an elegant fiancée, a sharp-tongued tutor, and a mysterious wizard are turning your life upside down! Uncover secrets, find love, and shape your destiny in this gender-bending rom-com VN with BL & BG routes!

details.title: This Little World
details.short_description: Britain has fallen silent. In a vast 1:1 recreation of the entire island, built from real-world data, begin on foot and bring harmony back to the land: restoring every road, valley, field, town, and tree. Unlock vehicles, reconnect regions, and explore all 200,000 km² of England, Wales and Scotland.

details.title: The Energy Case
details.short_description: Explore the world of the dieselpunk society of robot-bugs in The Energy Case. Follow Detective "Dec" in solving the murder of a scientist, who was working on cleaner energy sources, and maybe join the energy transition for a cleaner, greener future!

details.title: Let Them Breathe
details.short_description: Let Them Breathe is a cozy, collectathon, adventure game that takes place decades in the future after a zombie apocalypse. Seoul, South Korea is in the mist of rebuilding, join 5 as you navigate this new dystopian yet modern side of Seoul.

details.title: Coding Day
details.short_description: In "Coding Day", you are a videogame developer whose project is about to be released, but a sinister entity threatens its publication, and you must survive it throughout the night in a dark office building full of mysteries and dangers.

details.title: Triad
details.short_description: Embark on an epic journey across the realm of Lyria in this real time fantasy RPG paying homage to classic games. Assemble your Triad from 15 unique classes, engage in strategic tab-targeting combat, and uncover ancient secrets in a world of danger and mystery.

details.title: Ball Bots
details.short_description: Kick, punch, and steal your way to victory in this frantic online and local sports-brawler. Knock off your opponent’s head and throw it to the goal in chaotic arenas. Grab a teammate for 2v2 or play 1v1 in 5-minute match where losing your head is part of the game!

details.title: EXONAUTIS
details.short_description: Crashlanded on Calliope 4348A, your objective is to navigate the vast oceanic biomes, survive and construct your vehicles and bases to dive deeper and uncover the mysteries behind the disappearance of the Kappa crew.

details.title: Monster Forest 怪物森林
details.short_description: The ancient forest has been corrupted by void energy into a fleshy spawning ground of mutated beasts. Choose two exiles from different factions to form a pact, and wield two distinct card builds to fight your way out of the suffocating woodland depths!

details.title: Smash 'N Grab
details.short_description: Smash obstacles, fight guards and zip through the environment as you grab the loot and race against the clock for the perfect heist in this jazzy, noir speedrunning beat ’em up!

details.title: Presto!
details.short_description: Jump into an N64-style 3D collectathon! Explore surreal worlds as Presto with classic platforming action and a physics-based Rolling Globe for bouncing and rolling around! Collect Stars and Memory Cores to restore the magic of the past, with optional rankings for skilled players.

details.title: The Mire of Miss Audacity
details.short_description: After waking up in a world without her sister, Miss Alexandra Audacity believes she's been left out of a conspiracy between her flaky friends and secretive husband. Guide her through five timelines mired by false memories while trying to keep her sanity, and yours.

details.title: Frog Telephone
details.short_description: Frog Telephone (蛙电话 / 蛙電話) is a folklore mystery adventure game rooted in computer science concepts. You play as an amnesiac phone operator at a Tokyo travel agency, reconstructing shattered reality through the spin of a dial, exploring the terrifying truth hidden behind Gero City's mystery.

details.title: Tempered Heart: Pilgrim's Mark
details.short_description: Play as Esther, a retired knight journeying through a world of monsters and hidden truths. Master skill-based combat against fast and unique enemies using precisely timed blocks. Uncover the past and confront the question that has kept the world in stagnation: When will we be ready?

name: All AI Must Die (Read Only Memories ii)

details.title: All AI Must Die (Read Only Memories ii)
details.short_description: All AI Must Die (Read Only Memories II) follows Turing in 2066 as they confront a world that fears or seeks to control them. Explore Neo SF, shape relationships, and face urgent questions about AI, identity, and the future we are racing toward.

details.title: Fifth Sun: Coop racing
details.short_description: Run solo or share the ship's cockpit with a friend. Use the ship's unique abilities to outmaneuver or outlast your opponents in cylinders, flight sections, and other crazy hazards. A player shoots while the other one runs, and if you're fast enough or aggressive enough, you might win the Grand Prix!

details.title: Modforsaken
details.short_description: Explore and modify your way through a fictitious RPG as you unearth its sinister secrets.

details.title: Mushroom Day
details.short_description: A cozy exploration game about mushroom foraging. You uncover leaves to search for mushrooms, delicious, poisonous or hallucinogenic. You cook meals, upgrade your gear, explore forests for clues to finally find the mushroom paradise.

details.title: Legacy Of The Depths
details.short_description: A dark narrative adventure in the spirit of Northern Noir, set in an alternate Russia of 1929. Explore forgotten places, uncover fragments of lost coordinates, and follow a family mystery beyond the Barents Sea.

details.title: Villein
details.short_description: In this, the prequel to "Annum Crossroads," navigate a vast, open-world dystopia while battling countless enemies, and the sorcerers who command them. Non-Woke | Non-AI GRX

name: Purge Of Evil: Age of the Fallen Spirits

details.title: Purge Of Evil: Age of the Fallen Spirits
details.short_description: A dark action RPG inspired by Vietnamese mythology, where ancient legends, restless spirits, and forgotten sins shape a land on the brink of collapse.

details.title: Purrfect Galaxies
details.short_description: Purrfect Galaxies is a text-based strategy game. As the ruler of the planet Cataris, hungry cats await your decisions. Will you let your meowpurrlation bask in catnip bliss, or will they unsheathe their claws and seal your doom?

details.title: 斗虎INDOMITABLE  SPIRIT
details.short_description: The player will play the role of an anti-Japanese soldier. In the icy and snowy forest wilderness, relying on secret camps, villages and deep mountains, they will carry out a series of dangerous tasks and ultimately expose the conspiracy of the Kwantung Army.
developers: 哈尔滨智云科技开发有限公司
publishers: 哈尔滨智云科技开发有限公司

name: Lonely Coast: Echo of the Deep

details.title: Lonely Coast: Echo of the Deep
details.short_description: You wake up on the Lonely Coast, your treasure ship wrecked, it's seven relic cores stolen by deep-sea pirates, and the island has nothing—not even a bird turd. No engineering, no botany, not even bloody magic (oh, my word). Well, well. At least you know a little Alchemy!

details.title: Space Dash
details.short_description: In Space Dash, every move is an explosion. Click to dash into swarms of rock enemies, unleash devastating area damage, and spend gold to unlock upgrades, gravity pulls, turrets, and missiles for nonstop action

details.title: INKARO
details.short_description: INKARO is a brutal Parkour FPS that crosses flow-state platforming and push forward combat against anomalous enemies - doling out punishment with a toybox of weapons. Roam megastructures of plastic and concrete in a desolate journey of revenge and violence, clad in armor of ink and bone.

details.title: Withering Age
details.short_description: Withering Age is a real-time strategy roguelike set in a dark fantasy, medieval world brimming with magic, danger, and decay. Build and expand your kingdom, train loyal troops and mighty champions, and defend your lands against relentless hordes.

details.title: Traces of Ink
details.short_description: Wu Zhou Dynasty Visual Novel Synopsis During Wu Zetian’s reign, a destitute orphan, you are saved by a mysterious maiden. She brings you into the noble Chi Manor, offering you a new life. Yet behind her kindness lies hidden danger. Unfold her secrets and fight to survive.

details.title: RELICTUM
details.short_description: Become the Messenger of God and descend into the endless abyss to defeat powerful enemies and bosses while fulfilling the divine command in this 2D Metroidvania action adventure.

details.title: Daomei Village: Prologue
details.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version. In order to return to the Emperor's favor, you must make an effort. Repair, build, cultivate fields and fight various adversities. Meet new friends and learn their stories. Do whatever it takes not to be banished forever!

details.title: A Forest Tale: Porasy
details.short_description: Embark on a journey through a new mythological realm as Porasy, an Indigenous warrior. Explore uncharted landscapes, unleash the power of Muiraquitãs, unravel your story, and vanquish the Seven Legendary Beasts to carve your own legend. Are you ready to dive into this epic adventure?

details.title: READ: 3AM
details.short_description: READ: 3AM tells the story of two lonely souls, the need to be seen, and something that should not be able to message you. Told through a mix of visual novel storytelling and chat-sim interactions, you'll navigate friendships, make choices, and get to know someone who shouldn't exist.

details.title: POLYSTRIKE
details.short_description: POLYSTRIKE is a competitive top-down tactical shooter where every angle, every utility and every decision can change the outcome of the round. Coordinate with your team, master tactical combat and outplay your opponents in intense 5v5 objective-based battles.

details.title: She Tells Her Story
details.short_description: She Tells Her Story is your narrative-driven visual novel and educational project about bullying and its long-term impact on mental health, identity, and personal growth.

details.title: Between Two Lights
details.short_description: Between Two Lights, an adventure shooter that explores the importance of awareness and the value of choice: give in to love and escape, or sacrifice everything for the truth.

details.title: AS ABOVE SO BELOW
details.short_description: AS ABOVE, SO BELOW is a Survival Horror Open World Action/RPG. You play as a recent college graduate offered a job in a small town, but upon arrival things are not what they seem. Face a series of unexplained events that unravel history, and ultimately change the future. Explore, Fight, Survive.

details.title: The Sewers
details.short_description: As you are having a rest in your humble abode you have the urge that something is present, something dangerous. Now you trust the urge and decide it's time to leave. You've been pushing your luck for too long down here. As you walk to exit this place you once called home, your urge becomes a reality.

details.title: Bloodsalt
details.short_description: Bloodsalt is a dark 2D Action RPG with deceptively beautiful visuals. Step into the shoes of a warrior defending his village against an orc invasion and the dark magic of Bloodsalt. Explore a ruthless world, develop your character, and make tough choices in a story woven with intrigue and betrayal.

details.title: Veil : Black Blood
details.short_description: Veil : Black Blood is a game about a witch named Dalia on her journey to the Witches' Sabbath. Perform arcane rituals and uncover the symbolic language of magic. Draw and combine shapes to craft powerful spells on the fly. Explore the world in search of clues and secrets.​
developers: State of the Art Game Studio
publishers: State of the Art Game Studio

details.title: Motherheart
details.short_description: An unexpected call pulls you into the world of a secluded writing circle following a tragedy. In this first-person point and click detective RPG, play as Carmen Voss, investigate, dream, and survive the killer hunting you down.

details.title: Blue Fog
details.short_description: Blue Fog is a turn based JRPG with the pinch of the perfect timing for certain battle skills. The game's focus is the linear story, the characters and the cruel, racist world.

details.title: Principal Panic
details.short_description: Principal Panic is a multiplayer school party game filled with chaotic humor. Each round, one player becomes the principal, while the others try to create chaos by completing mischievous tasks, dancing, and managing energy. Distinguish real students from bots and survive.

details.title: Lucky Newt
details.short_description: Join Lucky Newt, Amelia Axolotl, and Murphy Mudpuppy on a vibrant, platforming adventure to stop the evil Salazar from stealing the legendary 5 Leaf Clover and taking over their home.

details.title: No Man's Land
details.short_description: A First World War turn-based strategy game. It's you versus them, versus No Man's Land.

details.title: Precursors: Reach for the Stars
details.short_description: In the game, players play the role of one of the corporations that fights with other corporations for influence over planets in the future in the Precursors universe. The game will combine idle and turn-based gameplay.

details.title: Orbit Or Beat Extended Edition
details.short_description: Get ready for new type of rhythm action game you may have never experienced before. Listen to various awesome music, control your ball, and dodge all the obstacles to get through all the levels. But be prepared to any unexpected and "unfair" gimmicks designed throughout the levels.

details.title: Art Gallery Simulator
details.short_description: Enjoy a side of art with a serving of business building! Go rags to riches! Start by fixing up an art gallery in the slums and work your way up in the world. Sell thousands of unique pieces of art and eventually open up your very own art museum in the high class downtown commercial district!

details.title: Constellations: Beyond the edges
details.short_description: After an accident at a space station, you lose all communication with the earth and are no longer able to locate yourself in space, your best chance of returning is to use the space monitoring system to identify known constellations and configure the route back home.

details.title: GNOMONIC
details.short_description: GNOMONIC – An ART-PG! Walk through watercolor paintings, fight in real-time projectile battles, solve puzzles with shadows, meet friends with creative talents in worlds themed by artistic mediums, and discover a story about how we experience art... and how art experiences us.

details.title: Red Memory
details.short_description: Honoring history and preserving the spirit of heroes, "Red Memories" invites you to immerse yourself in this historical journey. Get ready to delve into this chapter of "Red Memories" and feel the historic moments of struggle for peace.

name: 最弱骸骨兵 The Weakest Skeleton

details.title: 最弱骸骨兵 The Weakest Skeleton
details.short_description: You wake up from the Evil Skeleton Legion as a skeleton soldier. Take control of female minions to help you fight, obtain human skins, blend into towns, and get resources. Explore dungeons, collect materials, expand your team, and become the sole master of this world in this land of danger!

details.title: Horse Reality
details.short_description: Join a thriving community in this realistic horse breeding sim! Collect 30+ breeds, breed unique foals, train champions, manage your estate, and compete or trade with real players. Discover over 500 billion possible genetic combos with our realistic genetics system!

details.title: Ink Shapes: Book One
details.short_description: Rotate stamps to create beautiful watercolor paintings in this relaxing hand-drawn puzzle.

details.title: Space gold rush TD
details.short_description: Join in on the next gold rush and become a prospector in space. In this unique tower defense you can set up and reposition towers for maximum efficiency and adapt to the environment.

details.title: All the King's Men
details.short_description: Join Topher in this classic-styled JRPG as he traverses the country to figure out how his family is linked to the disappearance of the King. Fight & explore this open-world adventure, as you team up with others along this path of self-discovery and defining what an individual's life is truly worth.

details.title: Clock Overwhelmed
details.short_description: Organize tasks within your routine, but be careful not to overlap activities and get overwhelmed!

details.title: God Of This World
details.short_description: What if classic RPGs were modern day 3D top-down shooters?
