You'll collect health, jewels, keys, bullets, shield bombs, unlock doors, destroy enemy portals, all while shooting down non-stop seeker robot enemies with regular and tactical guns, enemies who are all set to fire back.

details.title: Deathly Reprieve
details.short_description: Strategize, adapt, and shoot your way through enemy lines. In this ruthless, story-driven tactical shooter, precision is the difference between life and death. Lead a mercenary organization through a blood-soaked, near-futuristic world, as you uncover a global conspiracy. Do you have what it takes?

details.title: FreeCat
details.short_description: ［Features］Girl + 10 cats with unique skills. ［Action］Blocking, aerial combos,bosses trained with real kung fu fighter. ［Puzzle］Chinese puzzles. ［Art］Maps: Sky, Underground, Ocean, Jungle, Snow. ［Metroidvania］64+ achievements/quests. ［Fun］Funny enemies. ［Story］Plot twists

details.title: Miuma
details.short_description: Miuma is a cozy game about a little, modest bakery with unexpected twists. The game features the significant feat of Kevin, the bakery’s new owner, and his venture within the middle of nowhere of which he calls his home.

details.title: Non-Euclidean Design
details.short_description: Design your home in the non-Euclidean world.

details.title: Villainville
details.short_description: Join the outcasts of Villainville in this cozy farming sim adventure where Stardew Valley meets Shrek. Grow magic crops, tame the tiny unicorns, sneak into the night market, and befriend misfit fairy tale characters. Bonus? Find the misery mushroom plague saboteur and redeem the irredeemable.

details.title: Wish for Eternity
details.short_description: Wish for Eternity is a cozy-spooky 2-player co-op adventure across 7 Deadly Sin domains, each with unique mechanics, enemies, and an epic boss battle. Combine asymmetric spirit powers to fight and solve puzzles, then retreat to your warm, magical Lantern to rest, decorate, and recharge together.

details.title: The Blackout Project
details.short_description: Manage your contry energy requirements, avoid blackouts, sustain industrial developpement, avoid civilization collapsing.

details.title: Guardian Order
details.short_description: 1-4 co-op action roguelite where you explore ever-changing dungeons with your allies. Choose from various weapons and talents, and defeat enemies through strategic combat using environmental elements like water, fire, and electricity. Develop the Order’s base to unlock new abilities

details.title: Many Ducks
details.short_description: Many Ducks is a cozy creature-collecting life sim where you win wild ducks over with music. Explore the woods, grow your flock, make your ranch your own, and raise a flock worthy of leading the Duck Parade.

details.title: Forgebound
details.short_description: Rebuild a fallen medieval kingdom. Gather, craft and fortify a settlement that has to last through harsh seasons, hunger and raids. Lead your survivors in a story campaign, or build and survive with friends online. Your people, your walls, your legacy.

details.title: Dining Deck
details.short_description: We fused co-op strategy, deckbuilding, and restaurant chaos into the ultimate roguelike dining experience! Build your deck, serve customers, master the kitchen, and secure your place amongst the Hall of Taste!

details.title: Project: Shinova
details.short_description: The young boy, Quill, finds himself accidentally travelling through different worlds to prevent a total restart of the universe while fighting corrupted fallen angels. And while doing so, he discovers a dark and hidden history of humanity.

details.title: StellarFighter: Galactica
details.short_description: Lead your starfighter as a bounty hunter, complete contracts and fight your way to free your home system from a criminal empire full of conspiracies and underworld secrets, in this hard boiled action old school arcade shooter.

details.title: Shellbound
details.short_description: Shellbound is a 2D metroidvania set on a gigantic snail. You’re a parasite exploring a living world, battling and controlling enemies that will cause the ecosystem to evolve around you. Platform through diverse biomes, solve puzzles, and unravel your role in the giant creature’s life cycle.

details.title: Financial Freedom
details.short_description: Why can't games teach as much as books? I read 50 business books and trainings and made a short funny game about a businessman's journey. Follow the story from a factory worker 🧑🏻‍🏭🏭 to a millionaire! 💸💸

details.title: Far Dawn
details.short_description: A classic dark fantasy real-time strategy game, set in a state engulfed in an internal ethnic conflict. Witness centuries-old hatreds and newly reignited distrust fuel the flames of war, and be forced to pick your side: will you fight for the integrity of the realm, or the freedom of your nation?

details.title: RATKING
details.short_description: Become The Salary Man. Unleash ZA BLADE. Save Your Boss. Experience a life OFF ZA CLOCK. a Uniquely Surreal Action Combat, Player Choice Fueled, Point & Click Adventure.

details.title: ASMR Food Experience: Prologue
details.short_description: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full game. If you are looking for tones that will put you in an amazing mood, you've come to the right place! In the game, we have connected the game with the tones of the world around us. Open, manage, and listen to your own restaurant!

details.title: Digital Artmaster: Volume 8
details.short_description: Explore the artistry behind stunning digital worlds with this exclusive visual artbook. Featuring high-resolution artwork, intricate designs, and breathtaking environments, it offers a glimpse into the creative process, perfect for fans of imaginative storytelling and digital art.

details.title: Zoe's Game
details.short_description: Escape from a mansion full of puzzles, traps and characters who may not be what they seem! Can you survive to this deadly birthday party?

details.title: Aether Wizard Life
details.short_description: Aether Wizard Life is a cozy wizard life sim where you apprentice as a young mage in a haunted town. Grow your skills, craft magical items, explore mysterious dungeons, build relationships, and restore a forgotten corner of the world.

details.title: Jeff and Crackhead
details.short_description: Explore a quirky top-down RPG/platformer as Jeff and Crackhead! Solve puzzles, dodge traps, and uncover secrets in the overworld. Battles mix turn-based strategy with real-time action—dodge, parry, and unleash powerful combos. Fast-paced, simple, and packed with nonsensical fun!

details.title: LastDitch
details.short_description: "LastDitch" combines 2D tower defense and auto-chess, immersing players in a futuristic clash against void creatures. Strategically choose pieces barricades for defense, barracks for minions, fortresses for high damage. Experience intense battles, unique pixel art style, profound strategic depth.

details.title: The Goddess's Will
details.short_description: Dive into a 2.5D isometric action RPG adventure inspired by late-90s and early-00s classics. Face cunning enemy factions, explore a layered world filled with vivid characters, mythic stories, and handcrafted environments. Immerse yourself in a dangerous and unforgiving golden age of power fantasy.

details.title: The Seventh Screening
details.short_description: ESCAPE THE LIMELIGHT. Outsmart, outwit or outrun your demons in this cinematic first person survival horror.

details.title: Snowbound: Steam Voyage
details.short_description: You drive your steam-powered truck across the snowbound wastelands left by the Great Frostfall. Ice has claimed the world, but not your resolve. Scavenge, rebuild, and cultivate what life remains. Somewhere in the endless white, the past still breathes

details.title: Bound City
details.short_description: An action-packed and bittersweet adventure in a city of endless night. Explore the dying city and try to find your way to the tower that seems to be at the heart of it all. Nothing is quite as it appears to be, and only by facing death can you hope to understand the mysteries of Bound City.

details.title: 星と塔と冒険者
details.short_description: A 2D × 3D fantasy RPG where you investigate a mysterious tower that suddenly appeared. Fight, explore, and uncover the truth of the world.

details.title: 无生之荣
details.short_description: Murder in a back room? Headless corpses? Disappearing murder weapon? Deadly messages?Murder? Suicide? You want it, it's all here. Let's start from the bloodshed in the Imperial City that shook the nation, pull them out of their cocoons, and get a glimpse of the truth behind them.

details.title: Nightmare Loop
details.short_description: Traverse the unsettling Gdańsk of the early digital era. Immerse yourself in a dark vision of a real city. Explore the Falowiec and other real-world locations as you search for answers to the mysteries. Try to stop the approaching nightmare in this unique horror game.

details.title: Solis
details.short_description: Join Nina and RAM with a friend to explore the puzzles and challenges of Solis. Discover the mysteries and the natural and technological wonders of Tortuga Island as you embark on a journey toward the abandoned factory. Play in local split-screen co-op or online using the Friend Pass.

details.title: Chess Peace
details.short_description: Find your way back to the surface by learning new movement patterns, out-maneuvring enemies, and helping stray figures in a surreal chess-inspired metroidbrainia.

details.title: Final Boss
details.short_description: Fight through a pixel-art beat ’em up, then face off in a cinematic 3D boss battle! Based on Tyler Kirkham's hit Image Comics series, Final Boss blends side-scrolling action, fighting game precision, and animated comic storytelling into a nostalgic co-op adventure.

details.title: The Blade
details.short_description: 2.5D Action Roguelite that fuses Hong Kong-style Action Cinema environmental interaction with hardcore martial arts combat.physics is as deadly as your blade. Kick&Launch: From small tea bowls to heavy mahogany tables—one well-placed kick turns mundane furniture into lethal projectiles.

details.title: The Flowership
details.short_description: The Flowership calls to you. To have a heart pure is what we all desire. Though a long journey, the flowers of pure soil believe in you.

details.title: Invariant
details.short_description: An atmospheric, story-driven sci-fi FPS set in Antarctica in the 1990s. Explore an isolated facility, solve environmental puzzles, uncover secrets and fight through increasingly intense encounters using a diverse range of weapons and powerful combat abilities.

details.title: Echoes of the Broken
details.short_description: A creature-collector RPG set in today’s France. After a breakup, you become a spirit hunter for all the wrong reasons. Capture 200 spirits, master energy-based tactical combat and face your toughest rival: yourself. Become the best, or realize it was never the point.

details.title: Barobellum
details.short_description: Barobellum is an amphibious, story-driven extraction FPS. Gear up, salvage, and get out - or lose it all.

details.title: Shalvatian - The Witches of Renewal
details.short_description: Shalvatian is a first person, story driven, Dark Fantasy RPG in the style of 2000s era rpgs. Exploration, leveling up by collecting experience points, following elaborate questlines, discovering items in hard to get to places. A strong narrative in an immersive game world awaits you!

details.title: Sins of the Broken
details.short_description: Your teammate just went down in the open. He's bleeding out, your cover is coming apart, and the other squad is waiting for you to move. A squad-based tactical FPS where getting your people home alive wins the fight.

name: 穢れ憑きの少女　鳴海龍也の回奇録

details.title: 穢れ憑きの少女　鳴海龍也の回奇録
details.short_description: A point-and-click horror adventure game in which you and your partner investigate incidents caused by cursed objects and unravel mysteries and curses.

details.title: Nescient
details.short_description: A hardcore turn-based traditional roguelike where you explore a surreal city. Fight tactically, manage wounds, shape your own magic, and leave lasting consequences across every run.

details.title: The Beyond
details.short_description: A sci-fi co-op shooter in space with two modes! Whether you want to see how long you and your teammates can last while protecting your base or you all want to go hunt down bosses together and collect cool stuff, The Beyond has a little of everything! Character customization, gun upgrades, and more!

details.title: いるかの絵本
details.short_description: The protagonist of "Iruka's Picture Book" is Iruka, a young girl who dreams of becoming a picture book author. In this adventure game, you'll discover picture books hidden throughout her room and immerse yourself in the stories and worlds within their pages.

details.title: Stonebloom
details.short_description: In a far future where people are gone, little dolls called Poppets wake with threads of life inside. Rebuild your body from parts others teach you, untangle worlds woven from memory, and bring sound and flowers back to a silent land, in an action adventure where your body is your instrument.

details.title: Bolero: The Shifting Isle
details.short_description: In a genre defying blend of Tactics-Adventure gameplay, unravel the story of the four adventurers who braved the unknown and solved the mystery of The Shifting Isle.

details.title: Residuum
details.short_description: Defend your base on Mars from invaders in Residuum. A thrilling mix of tower defense and shooter gameplay, upgrade weapons and choose your crew for a unique experience each time. Play with a friend for even more excitement!

details.title: Hanoi Puzzles: Magnetrix
details.short_description: Assemble magnetic towers by stacking pieces from opposite poles, to enlighten a electrifying hexagonal board.

details.title: Daomei Village
details.short_description: You have been banished to Daomei Village for your offense. In order to return to the Emperor's favor, you must make an effort. Repair, build, cultivate fields and fight various adversities. Meet new friends and learn their stories. Do whatever it takes not to be banished forever!

details.title: Chaoslands
details.short_description: This game is a pixel-styled, turn-based sandbox game. Collect around 50 items and build or find 100 obstacles accross the world. Build ships to cross water and enter the caves to collect advanced resources. Fight 2 bosses and level up.

details.title: Westins World
details.short_description: Westins World is a turn-based RPG where sci-fi meets fantasy. After a supernova scatters civilizations across the galaxy, lead Westin and his party through a story-driven adventure: explore, swap heroes on the fly, gear up your party and face the bosses standing in your way.

details.title: Warboard
details.short_description: Command history on a chessboard. Unique piece stats shape your strategy, while dynamic Board Effects can turn the battle in an instant. Create custom matches, challenge your friends, and experiment with different piece sets to fight your way.

details.title: Dragon & Alice
details.short_description: "Will your choices save her?" A dark fantasy adventure of Alice, an apprentice mage, and her talking crow. In a kingdom haunted by the "Dragon," your decisions will corrode Alice's mind and rewrite fate. Experience 8 endings and a world brought to life through radiant, hand-drawn art.

details.title: Lemy
details.short_description: Condemned to Hell for a forgotten sin, Lemy receives an offer: "Hunt down the monsters that have occupied the afterlife, and I will reduce the weight of your sins." Experience a unique, mouse-driven action-adventure. Help Lemy atone and reclaim her past.

details.title: 迷宫：囚笼 Maze : Captivity
details.short_description: A relaxing puzzle game. Combine spells and items to better traverse the maze. Through the maze trial, we shall select mages who possess both wisdom and talent. Come, contribute your strength to the nation! Seek the final exit and solve the mystery!

details.title: SCP: Distorted Spacetime
details.short_description: SCP: Distorted Spacetime is a thrilling horror game based on the SCP Wiki. In this game, you work in the dangerous world of Site-DE2 and can choose from various jobs such as Class D Personnel, Mobile Task Force Alpha 1, Omega 7, Epsilon 11, as well as O5 and Scientists.

details.title: Forum Mortuorum
details.short_description: Take the reins of a Roman gladiator school. Hire and equip your team, freely combining powerful gear effects to create overpowered panoplies. Accept challenges wisely: once in the arena, your gladiators must fend for themselves until they find glory or death!

details.title: Guild of Slayers
details.short_description: Survivors-like in full 3D with ragdoll physics. Enemies throw themselves at you as projectiles, crash into allies, and damage each other. Bodies fly. Chaos reigns. Survive waves of undead in the most satisfying horde-slaughter you've ever seen. 🔥💀

details.title: Haunted Lakes of Austin
details.short_description: Explore the real Haunted Lakes of Austin, boat and fish for hidden treasures, and survive the darkness in this eerie adventure where every cast could awaken something beneath the surface. BOAT, FISH, SURVIVE

details.title: KAELIS: Seraph Protocol
details.short_description: Become an Executor of Serenos Academy in KAELIS, an academy sci-fantasy JRPG where you investigate Noise incidents, fight turn-based Lumina battles, and build bonds with the Guardians who stand beside you.

details.title: MindCleaver
details.short_description: Manipulate the minds of fully simulated NPCs as you and a rival sorcerer twist emotion, factions, and armies in a dark, emergent fantasy world.

details.title: 研究生病院
details.short_description: A visual novel set in the modern or near-future era. You play as a male protagonist struggling with psychological trauma after graduate school, as he reconnects with three heroines. Through player choices, you will develop relationships, and uncover the past of each character.

details.title: About Thieves
details.short_description: About Thieves is an old-school first-person dungeon crawler with real-time combat. The character progression system rewards exploration and secret hunting, and that’s where the main focus lies.

details.title: Theorycraft: Raiding Guild Simulator
details.short_description: Theorycraft is a single-player raiding guild simulator. Recruit raiders, tune gear and spell priorities, and command authentic MMO-style boss fights with encounter replays, win rate prediction, deep strategy, and rich combat data.

details.title: Farmastrophy With Friends
details.short_description: Farm. Cook. Deliver. Survive the cows. A chaotic co-op race against the clock - solo or with up to 4 friends!

name: オブジェクト・ハッピーエンディング

details.title: オブジェクト・ハッピーエンディング
details.short_description: “You” are the only human to have arrived in a world inhabited by non-human beings with the characteristics of objects, commonly known as “Objects.” A visual novel game in which you grant the Objects—who can only end their lives through human hands—the endings they desire.

details.title: Unstable Table
details.short_description: Survive the lunch rush in Unstable Table, a physics-based chaos-sim. Battle Boss Karens with rule-breaking mechanics, reassemble modular burgers after purse hits, and manage a shared Rage Meter in co-op. Use XP to balance your character and cash to buy "Karen Counters." Serve or be served...

details.title: Bravely Doomed
details.short_description: A deck-builder roguelike where you draft cards, explore fog-of-war dungeons, and fight in turn-based combat. Meet NPCs with dynamic dialogue, uncover deep lore, and conquer a mysterious dungeon floor by floor.

details.title: Dinobreak: The Hatching
details.short_description: Race against time and teeth to save the city of Cypress Ridge from a dinosaur invasion in this 4-player online co-op remake of the 2023 game.

details.title: Devoris
details.short_description: Formerly known as Devora,now changed name to Devoris. You become a bird living in the sewers, killing and eating other inhabitants to fill your stomach. Of course, as an adventurer, you can choose to explore the underground world to obtain new weapons, new delicacies, discover the stories here.

details.title: Patchwork Home
details.short_description: Patchwork Home is a dating action game where you help a colorful cast of characters build a home in a world that has broken more times than they can count. But, for some reason, these goofballs think this time it'll be different. Make sure that it is. Currently in Alpha.

details.title: Enemies Within
details.short_description: Battle corrupted enemies, liberate afflicted allies, and explore a modernly medieval world on the verge of self-destruction in this action-packed 2D side scrolling adventure.

name: Reficia: The WonderLog ~3 Days of Whirling Whimsy~

details.title: Reficia: The WonderLog ~3 Days of Whirling Whimsy~
details.short_description: Adapt your strategy to every drop and evolve your mastery. A nostalgic 2.5D action RPG where skills — not levels — define your power. Train weapons and magic to forge unique builds and discover lethal synergies, all while facing the ultimate trial at the end of a 3-day journey.

details.title: Asylum 1966
details.short_description: A forgotten asylum. A missing daughter. A man with nothing left to lose. In Asylum 1966, descend into a decaying institution where reality bends and shadows whisper secrets. What you uncover will test your sanity and your choices will shape your fate.

details.title: Impound Rumble
details.short_description: Impound Rumble is an upcoming indie platform fighter bursting with personality! Rumble online with rollback or offline in a co-op story mode or duke it out PvP-style. Pop-off and go crazy with Turbo Mode and send friends and foes flying through stages that adapt to the chaos you create!

details.title: They Fear The Mist
details.short_description: They Fear The Mist is a real-time strategy game, where you command your Troops, build your Settlement, fight off thousands of Enemies and explore the Unknowns of the Mist. Take command of your people and defend them from the incoming hordes… Can you survive?

details.title: Untitled Project
details.short_description: Unravel the secrets of a sprawling metropolis in this gripping third-person adventure. Explore a vast cityscape, engage with intriguing characters, and unravel mysteries and crimes. But beware—the shadows hold danger, and thugs lurk around every corner.

details.title: Bradamante
details.short_description: Become one of the wandering knights of legend. Live the adventures of Bradamante, the strongest paladin in Charlemagne's court, push back against the invading Saracen Army and go on quests with allies and rivals in this action packed epic RPG about honor, duty and the sense of self.

details.title: 1 CAT LEFT
details.short_description: Look, I didn’t ask to be humanity’s last hope. Some scientist started a zombie outbreak, blew up my home, and ruined dinner. Now I’ve got claws, illegal weapons, and a grudge—and I’m only saving humans because tuna cans don’t open themselves

details.title: Ibru
details.short_description: Born yesterday, you are a detective in a Sumerpunk city ruled by gods. Navigate shifting allegiances, make impossible choices, and decide who survives as the divine order fractures. Will you remain a pawn or shape your own fate?

details.title: DEVIL GATE
details.short_description: DEVIL GATE® is a dark Action RPG in the Hack & Slash genre. Slay hordes of monsters, hunt for rare loot, and conquer Asartarion. Combine two classes, blend their abilities, and create unique builds. Challenge the darkness alone or team up with friends in co-op for up to 4 players!

details.title: I'm a Human
details.short_description: Forget defense. This is Reverse Tower Defense where you are the threat. Lead the AI, build robots and destroy human bases.Your goal is invasion. Your weapon is the swarm.

details.title: DUALITY
details.short_description: DUALITY is a 2.5D Action RPG that blends intense, skill-based combat with a rich story set in a high-fantasy world. Players engage in thrilling battles and unravel deep, intricate mysteries in the role of an amnesiac warrior searching for meaning and self-understanding.

details.title: PRECOGNITION
details.short_description: After receiving an experimental implant, Diana gains the ability to see her own future. Use her ability to navigate kaleidoscopic possibilities and change the world for the better… or for the worse. PRECOGNITION is the new sci-fi horror game from Sam Barlow and Brandon Cronenberg.

details.title: World Turned Stone
details.short_description: Civilization has turned STONE. Revive the people, terraform the world, defend against the apocalypse, and rebuild civilization from the stone age to advanced technology! Prologue link below.

details.title: Akos
details.short_description: A co-op open-world dark fantasy RPG. Bond with a dragon whose personality is shaped by your actions. Explore, hunt, and fight alongside it as it grows, then fly it into battle. Play solo or with a friend, each raising your own.

details.title: Astropods: Dreamlayer Dragon
details.short_description: “A magical Cave has just been found! We need explorers... now!” Team up in co-op, or play solo as Hemi & Acro! Adventure into a new world full of friends, mysteries & treasure! After all, no one knows what lies within this Cave... yet!

details.title: Ebon Age Tactics
details.short_description: Turn-based tactics in a world without magic, at the moment magic arrives. Resources are shared between units — spend the party's movement and mana where the fighting is, and make every action worthwhile.

name: Scott Whiskers: The Search for the Bad Twin

details.title: Scott Whiskers: The Search for the Bad Twin
details.short_description: Scott Whiskers is back! The cat-loving, sci-fi-obsessed hero trades his couch for outer space in a brand-new humorous point & click adventure – with hand-painted backgrounds, expressive 3D characters and full voice-over, packed with puzzles, quirky aliens and one very unwelcome lookalike.

details.title: Starfell
details.short_description: Classic JRPG exploration meets modern beat ’em up combat. Explore a stylized fantasy world, unlock powerful abilities and battle the armies of Varkhaul to save Eldoria.

details.title: Calamity County
details.short_description: Calamity County is a first-person survival horror game set in an abandoned theme park. The player’s main weapon is an unreliable toy gun that forces the player to control it like a classic rail-shooter game. The player must survive as they slowly discover the unnerving past behind Calamity County.

details.title: RabbitConquest
details.short_description: In a world ruled by rabbits instead of humans, this is an adventure story about labyrinth appraisers who get caught up in a conspiracy surrounding a "magic fruit." It's a traditional 3D command RPG that anyone can play through to the ending in about 4 hours.

details.title: SUPER DEBT
details.short_description: Money is your life in SUPER DEBT! Fight to survive with an arsenal of wildly different weapons and upgrades. In this intense and challenging Twin-Stick Bullet-Hell Roguelike everything costs money, and we mean everything!

details.title: Thimbleweed Park 2
details.short_description: Agents Ray and Reyes are investigating a murder at the Mansion. In a spoof of a classic whodunit, everyone is a suspect and the murderer will be confronted…... If you can find them. Not really a sequel. Not really a prequel. It’s more Thimbleweed Park and just as weird.

details.title: Minotaur Hotel
details.short_description: A mythology-inspired gay visual novel about the legendary Minotaur. Manage a magical hotel, explore the stories of mythical beings from around the world, and uncover the realm's dark history.

details.title: Malk
details.short_description: You are Malk. You survived where you were meant to die. And now you are paying for it. Fanatics are hunting you. Aristocrats are playing with your life. And power is your only chance not to become dirt beneath someone else’s boots. Allies betray you. Patrons use you. No one gets a second chance.

details.title: Sky On Fire : 1940
details.short_description: Fight in the skies of WWII Europe in an accessible, single-player flight sim. Control every crew member, from pilots to defensive gunners. Realistic airfoil physics, modular damage model, full HOTAS/TrackIR support, and 20+ authentic aircraft across the 1940 and 1944 European theaters.

details.title: SeverLink
details.short_description: SeverLink is a retro stealth action, inspired by the console classics of the early 2000s like Splinter Cell, MGS2-3 and Hitman Contracts. With the art direction emulating the distinct look of the Playstation 2 library of games.

details.title: NEO BERLIN 2087
details.short_description: Uncover the truth as Nolan, a troubled detective chasing a conspiracy shaking the foundation of Neo Berlin: a cyberpunk city split in two by technology, wealth, and class.

details.title: Under Mythos
details.short_description: Comfort and madness — each gives the other meaning. Run a cozy inn for otherworldly guests by day; descend into an abyss where one wrong step costs everything. A dark fantasy JRPG from Yoichi Miyaji, creator of Grandia and Lunar, steeped in the Cthulhu Mythos.

details.title: Gemini X
details.short_description: The Heretechs have seized Gemini Colony! Explore, upgrade, and blast your way to victory in Gemini X: a Metroidvania built for fans of classic 32-bit run-and-gun platformers.

details.title: Heart of Ural
details.short_description: Heart of Ural is a pixel rhythm RPG based on the ancient epic Ural-Batyr and Bashkir myths. This is a deep story with many difficult decisions and unexpected twists, humor and drama. In this game, EVERYONE remembers what you did before.

details.title: REDLINE — Strings of Fate
details.short_description: A sci-fi otome game where your choices shape love — and the future of society.

details.title: HEX Defense
details.short_description: HEX Defense is a tower-based strategy game set in a hexagonal world where you have to fight enemy forces by combining simple blocks into complex tower patterns.

details.title: Kids of Karendow
details.short_description: Kids of Karendow is a pixel-art fantasy sci-fi JRPG about a war built on lies. Play both sides: join Elmo, a resistance fighter who can't look away from injustice, and Kommander Krewl, the Daughter of Death, as the truth forces former enemies together against something far worse.

details.title: 祓ノ狐
details.short_description: Purifying Fox is a Japanese-style action adventure inspired by a book found in an old shrine storehouse. The story shifts between two phases: Escape, where you cannot fight and must survive, and Purification, where you seal the spirits and restore balance.

details.title: The Guardians Realm
details.short_description: Open-world Fantasy Action-RPG with a focus on combat, crafting and gathering.

details.title: Sneak Pit
details.short_description: Sneak Pit is the working title for an EXTREMELY alpha stealth / immersive sim experience. Use a variety of weapons and items to outsmart the enemy and access restricted areas crucial to your mission. More details and features to come.

details.title: Plague hunter
details.short_description: Plague hunter is an indie platformer game in the dark fantasy vein. In the game you’ll be using sword and gun to cut your way through hordes of zombies and other terrible monsters, avoiding deadly traps.

details.title: PlayLife: Life Deck Simulator
details.short_description: A card-based life simulation where every choice is a card. Build your deck, shape your destiny, and explore multiple paths with 21 skills and 22 careers. Marry, stay single, get rich, or start over—every run tells a new life story.

details.title: Waste Of Life
details.short_description: You crashed on Garb'aaj, a planet made of trash, and you owe money for the ship. Scavenge, swap your body parts one finger at a time, fight drones built from garbage, and recycle the whole planet into a real one. Solo or co-op.

details.title: The Legend of Zen Town
details.short_description: The Legend of Zen Town is a classic turn-based RPG driven by a rich narrative. Explore a world where Chinese folklore blends with vibrant street culture, hidden beneath a modern city. Uncover supernatural mysteries and ancient secrets through striking art and storytelling.

details.title: Tidespawn
details.short_description: Dive into a magical underwater world in this pixel art action-adventure RPG for 1–2 players in local couch co-op. Explore sunken ruins, battle fearsome sea creatures, uncover lost memories, and shape your destiny beneath the tides.

details.title: LoopCraft
details.short_description: Loop Craft is a game about economics. There is an item trading system within the game. This game has a variety of item mix systems. And have a reservation system to set up a factory to produce products for sale in the game.

details.title: Goojeegoop
details.short_description: Click ClIcK CLICK your way through endless rounds of enemies in an exciting new point and click roguelike and become insanely strong! Click on enemies to unlock new slots, increase your level and create crazy and spectacular builds!

details.title: Jasper's Dream
details.short_description: Jasper's Dream is a first person puzzle game set in a techno mystic Egyptian world. Help Jasper, a robot programmed to create games, by solving his mind-bending puzzles. You will also explore an abandonned futuristic pyramid and unravel its many mysteries.

details.title: Bring Me Hope
details.short_description: Bring Me Hope is a bittersweet adventure RPG about love, loss, and family (and boss fights!)

details.title: Vampire vs Devil
details.short_description: Control Vampire, use corpses of your enemies as weapons. Run through 666 levels to hell.

details.title: Dawn of Demons
details.short_description: Become a medieval monk and confront the demon that has haunted the Boar Lake village.

details.title: ANAMNESIS: memoria war
details.short_description: Will you die and be free of pain? Or live and break the shackles of fate? Can two souls, bound by fate itself, sever the never-ending cycle of death? "ANAMESIS: memoria war" is a gorgeous 2D jRPG rich in story, heavy on action and steeped in deep characterization.

details.title: Mister Gato Idle - The Meowsiah
details.short_description: Mister Gato Idle is an idle and incremental game where you can play minigames for rewards. There are no red dots, no ads, no P2W, no daily tasks, no MTX! Find unique items that change your gameplay, choose what randomly generated skills you use. Play the minigames Banjo Hero and Grand Theft Meowto!

details.title: Villages™
details.short_description: Villages™ is an Open-World Sandbox game that has rules to encourage People to make a complex society and economy.

details.title: Onlympic Up!
details.short_description: A lightning strike, a torch in your hands, and a voice echoes: “Your fates are now bound.” Tied together by a fragile rope — if it snaps, the fall is inevitable. Jump, climb, solve, slide… but never lose your rhythm. Only the patient will glimpse the summit.

details.title: Formula Team
details.short_description: Formula team management. The Formula Team will allow you to play the role of a team director, the success of the entire team will depend on you. If you are a huge Formula fan and have always been excited about the racing atmosphere? This game is made just for you.

details.title: MOKI - The Escape
details.short_description: Awaken without memory in a seemingly peaceful world. In this 2.5D puzzle-platformer, use the gift of the Streak (short-range teleportation), whose potential unfolds over time. Encounter fascinating creatures and uncover the truth that waits in hiding.

details.title: Timberquest
details.short_description: Embark on an adventure in our RPG game! Explore a new, wild continent and fight to survive against environmental factors and monsters. With a heavy focus on cooperative play. Customize your character's stat-driven abilities to suit your preferred playstyle.

details.title: Colors Assemble
details.short_description: Help Brad reunite with his family and complete all hand-crafted 2D platform challenges in a colorful twisted world.

details.title: The Road 66
details.short_description: The Road 66 is a 2D pixel art adventure where Kai and childhood friends Sue and Nile hit the road to find the brothers' missing mother. Along Route 66, they’ll encounter talking cats, dancing fire gods, and eerie folklore. Start the engine—adventure awaits!

details.title: GrimmVale
details.short_description: GrimmVale is a story-rich RPG set in a dark world of twisted fairy tales. Chased from her home, separated from her parents, and pursued by Wolves and Witches, Jill must gather allies and seek out the sources of magic to bring down the dreaded Wolf King, and regain the peace and family she has lost.

details.title: Fish Market
details.short_description: A cosy fish market simulator where you cut fresh fish, turn them into products like sushi, and collect rare species. Build a peaceful market, master satisfying preparation mechanics, and grow your seafood business at your own pace.

details.title: ZEROSEGI
details.short_description: A TRPG × Visual Novel led by the roll of the dice. You arrive at Seiria Magic Academy just one week before the centennial 'Violet Eclipse.' Immerse yourself in campus life, romance seven heroines, and uncover the world's hidden secrets. Your choices alone will reshape the fate of this world.

details.title: Nyaukimoe
details.short_description: Nyaukimoe is an anime and pixel art style catgirl Metroidvania platformer. Play as Nyaukimoe, fighting and exploring dark areas with a Cat Scratcher and glowsticks, searching for her lost sister.

details.title: Pozionista
details.short_description: Creates potions with plants gathered in the woods, discover new ways to make potions and sell those potions to stores

details.title: Destination Empire
details.short_description: Destination Empire is a 3D platformer hack-and-slash with fast tactical RPG elements. Fight large enemy groups, stop time with Kairos, quickly reskill to adapt your tactics, and switch to first person to uncover alternative solutions.

details.title: Same End
details.short_description: Discover Dienna, a young reaper tired of having to deal with troubled souls, who prefers to challenge them with trials where their lives are at stake. A platformer and Die and Retry runner game featuring multiple branching paths and alternative endings, hand-drawn in the style of a lightly animated.

details.title: Beasts of Ephesus
details.short_description: Lead Dawn from Division 5. Scout prospects, negotiate transfers and personal terms. Train 21 attributes; manage condition, injuries, and wages. Build 5v5, 3v3, and 2v2 plans, make live calls and lead 5- or 10-person raids for gear and mastery. Turn winnings into freedom, then reinvest in the squad.

details.title: Dynasty Rush
details.short_description: "Dynasty Rush" is an official Chinese-themed TD game. Command legendary heroes and unique towers across iconic Chinese landscapes. Experience deep strategy infused with rich culture as you defend the realm. The vast empire awaits your command!

details.title: In The Valley of Gods
details.short_description: From the creators of Firewatch, In the Valley of Gods is a single-player first-person adventure. Explore a remote and ancient valley in the Egyptian desert, uncovering treasure and treachery in pursuit of a discovery that could bring you fame and fortune—or leave you for dead, buried beneath the sands.

details.title: Hakimi's Ocean Drift
details.short_description: A survival shooter game set at sea, where players must gather supplies, locate hidden shelters, and build rafts to survive. On the ocean surface, you'll need to fish with a rod, diligently collect drifting supplies with hooks, construct rafts, and grow food to stay alive.

details.title: Beautiful in Death
details.short_description: A first-person game with a focus on dialogue and historical accuracy, set in the Victorian Era. You will step into the shoes of a photographer with a stern mustache who specializes in post-mortem photography. The game is emotionally heavy, melancholic, and full of skeletons in the closet.

details.title: Raven Gold
details.short_description: Raven Gold is a classic-style RPG featuring a handcrafted world. Explore unique dungeons, defeat powerful enemies, and conquer challenging puzzles to find rewarding treasure! Manage your resources carefully, especially your money, to achieve long term success as a fledgling adventurers guild.

details.title: Fault & Fragment
details.short_description: Fault & Fragment is a game about exploring the ghost of a world, searching for a way to lay it to rest. Travel far, contend with terrible foes, and reignite the leylines that once powered your kingdom.

details.title: Blightfall : The Last Year
details.short_description: Survive a deadly infection in a decaying world. Absorb your enemies to create powerful ability decks in this fully hand-drawn, turn-based RPG.

details.title: The Floor is Lava
details.short_description: The Floor is Lava is a parkour and adventure game with mountains, rocks and even floating objects that defy the law of physics! But remember, if you fall in the lava. You'll have to do it all again!

details.title: Bleaklands
details.short_description: Bleaklands is an action roguelite that combines exploration, gear-building, and horde survival. Venture from a safe zone into dangerous wilds, gather treasure, defeat bosses, and shape different builds through equipment and random upgrades.

details.title: Secrets For Taking
details.short_description: Take the others' deepest secrets--including your own. Find out where you belong in this decaying world.

details.title: BLOOD ENGINE 血焰引擎
details.short_description: 《BLOOD ENGINE》是一款Metroidvania类的横板ACT游戏。我们在平台跳跃和动作游戏的基础上尝试融入我们设计的“瞬杀”系统。尝试增幅击败敌人时带给玩家的打击感和爽快感。玩家需要随时面临由怪物，机关组成的各种各样的危机，并灵活做出反应，化解危机，击败敌人。

details.title: 幻蝶：双生对立的少女
details.short_description: “当幻蝶振翅，灵魂的共鸣将改写命运——是选择沉溺于过去的阴霾，还是握住那双伸出的手？” 《幻蝶：双生对立的少女》是一款以 Unity 引擎开发的美少女视觉小说游戏，在宁静的海滨岌川市，体验日常与奇幻交织的故事。在游戏中，体验主角与每一个少女之间的故事，感受彼此友谊与情感的回响，如蝴蝶振翅般，故事的齿轮开始转动。形形色色的人物如生命中的旅人，伴随在身边，他们拥有他们自己不为人知的故事，而这一切，都可以在游戏的探索中逐步发掘。在各自背负着自己过往的人之间，相互理解，互相认知，在陪伴与爱中，度过着似乎与昨天不同的今天。

details.title: HELLEVATOR
details.short_description: `·.¸¸.·´´¯`··._.·Welcome to the Hellevator·._.··`¯´´·.¸¸.·` Hellevator is a ballet hell (with an “a”) RPG. Your job is to deliver food to our most valued guest. How hard can that be?

details.title: SeArena
details.short_description: Hoist the sails and prove who rules the waves! Pirate Arena is a fast-paced naval PvP brawler inspired by the chaotic fun of Sea of Thieves. One player becomes the Host, setting rules and map hazards, while rival captains trade broadsides, boarding actions, and daring maneuvers until only.

details.title: 天藻のモズクヒメ
details.short_description: In 20xx Japan, 200+ vacant mosques became mozuku farms! Play as Mozuku Hime, breed super strains with genetic algorithms, and turn every mosque into a glowing seaweed paradise!

details.title: Incident 24
details.short_description: （This game does not use AI.）A hand-drawn 2D action platformer set in a sci-fi world. Explore the perilous Ancient Ruins No. 24, master fluid movement to dodge deadly traps, and utilize precise combat mechanics to fight mutated monsters for survival.

details.title: Slimes & Dusters TO
details.short_description: Lead an army of slimes on the offensive against the dusters that have invaded your planet and restore your home to its former glory in this Tower Offense game!

details.title: Doge Simulator
details.short_description: Doge wants to destroy! Doge wants this whole damn city to be destroyed! Smash the shops, cafes and even the damn palm trees! In our game you play as Doge, and you have to destroy, smash and break!

name: Mion and the Cursed Killer Hamster

details.title: Mion and the Cursed Killer Hamster
details.short_description: The Magnificent Mion is a warrior queen from Wharevarland. She battles a malignant verse-making kraken, tries to win the love of Count De Loboda, studies at an ordinary magical school, and she's also... crazy! Absurdism. Ridiculousness. Idiocy.

details.title: Drawn into Darkness
details.short_description: Drawn into Darkness will have you Descend the Depths in this Deckbuilding, Dungeoncrawler, Roguelite with over 200 Cards, 200 Enemies, and 100 Floors of pure RNG Goodness. What path will you take, hmm, Hero?

details.title: Javelin
details.short_description: Strategic roguelike with party-combat.

details.title: 奥丁为什么没胡子
details.short_description: Creating a horizontal version to explore RPG

details.title: Cartoon Killers
details.short_description: Play as 10 distinct and customizable classes where you shoot, punch, and blow each other up in a causally competitive sandbox shooter!

details.title: PilotXross（パイロットクロス）
details.short_description: VR flight game developed for VR devices.The player becomes a [Pilot] flying in the sky with a VRM model, wearing an equipment called [Xross], you can enjoy various ways of flying. The fastest time is to take a commemorative photo and share it on SNS!

details.title: Ever Fallen Empire
details.short_description: A Strategic Empire Collapser. As The Authority. Manage a living galaxy, and plan large-scale actions according to your needs. Collapse governments, inflame rebellions, seed new factions, and sacrifice your own. All for purposes grander than any Empire could hold.

details.title: Wagrrr
details.short_description: Give your viewers more FUN and INTERACTIVITY with your broadcasts! Let your viewers respond live on-screen to your gameplay, send text and questions, and make FUN wagers on your Battle Royale Games! ADD AN EXTRA LAYER OF FUN TO YOUR BROADCASTS!

details.title: Samuda Interval
details.short_description: Samuda Interval is a visual novel, slice-of-life, murder mystery & supernatural game. You play the daily life of Park Haewon or Park Sae-il, a college freshman attending classes, working part-time jobs, and meeting new people. Solving the serial kidnapping & murder case is your highest priority.

details.title: The Electric Odyssey
details.short_description: We are all familiar with the apocalypse. The end of the world, beginning of a new age. It isn't over for everyone though, some resist. There is a way out, but it won't be easy. Androids were predictable, but it still seemed too sudden. Could someone else be pulling the strings?

details.title: Abstract Dwelling
details.short_description: 《Abstract Dwelling》 is a game that’s “just about building houses.” There’s no complicated currency system, no complex menus, and no intricate storylines.

details.title: LabyrinTheam
details.short_description: Welcome to the Labyrintheam Tavern! Where we serve riddles that will test your wit and ingenuity. In this game, you will team up to escape from rooms filled with mysteries. Use your brains to open the door that will help you escape. Good luck to you!

details.title: Claria's Great Maze
details.short_description: Behind the Claria's Great Maze is the last village of humanity, and the maze is also the last barrier for humans to block enemies. And you are the last guardian of magic, the last hope of humanity.

details.title: Bullet Blasters
details.short_description: 💥 Bullet Blasters – An action-packed roguelike where elemental chaos reigns! Blast through 30+ procedurally generated levels alone or with up to 4 players in local co-op as you fight from Hell’s tower base to Heaven’s gate!

details.title: OMAPELI
details.short_description: OMAPELI is an action RPG setting in a medieval fantasy world. Explore different biomes and enter underworld dungeons. Meet friendly NPCs, hear their quests and trade. Fully customize your character. Craft your weapons - swords, bows and magic.

details.title: Shadowless
details.short_description: Shadowless is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a creepy house marked by tragedy, where dark entities and the past haunt you. Defenseless, you face a nightmare that consumes you before you can escape.

details.title: Uncharted Sectors
details.short_description: A grand strategy game built on a deep economic simulation and orchestrated by an intelligent AI storyteller. Ensure the survival of your domain at the edge of the galaxy: colonize worlds, manage populations, navigate politics, design custom goods, and master dynamic markets.

details.title: BoxSim
details.short_description: In BoxSim, think outside the box while inside of a box that's inside of a box. Find creative solutions to puzzles. Navigate platforming challenges. Pick up and put down boxes. Will you escape, or will you spend the rest of your life inside the box?

details.title: Protovolkers
details.short_description: Winding tracks at high speed with the wildest cast of characters in the most forgotten galaxy. What started as a morbid competition will become a fight for survival behind the wheel. An adventure with visual novel elements, all wrapped in a retro-inspired addiction for old-looking visuals and music.

details.title: 十元怎么买下世界
details.short_description: 一款笑点密集的沙雕休闲游戏，主要玩法是经营+放置+AVG+收集，风格轻松愉快，有大量有趣的剧情和插图。沙雕画风加上脑洞大开的爽文剧情，玩法简单易懂，经营你的商业帝国，探寻世界未解之谜，名利双收，走上人生巅峰。

details.title: Hasteventure
details.short_description: Become a beginner adventurer in this co-op RPG. Select and complete one of the many quests to earn promotions. Choose your playstyle to defeat enemies and help those in need. Enjoy quick gameplay sessions, either solo or with friends.

details.title: Exoplanet Outpost
details.short_description: Establish a base on a distant planet. In this immersive sci-fi colony building sim, you'll balance economic growth, tourism, and defense against hostile alien forces. Your decisions shape the fate of your settlement and its inhabitants. Are you ready to thrive on the frontier of space?

details.title: Micro Macro Farm: Enchanted Fields
details.short_description: Grow magical crops, care for mystical creatures, and uncover the secrets of the enchanted valley in this cozy pixel farming adventure. Expand your land, craft potions, and let your helpers keep the farm alive while you shape your own spellbound homestead.

details.title: Greeblings
details.short_description: Greeblings is a chaotic multiplayer platformer where silly creatures use abilites and crafty builds to escape the hunters who use traps and sharpshooting to stop them

details.title: Gokutoshi (獄闘士)
details.short_description: Gokutoshi is a 2D side-scrolling hack-and-slash action game focused on intense battles against powerful enemies.

details.title: Ghostorio
details.short_description: Build automated factories in a bright afterlife. Mine, belt, power, and produce at massive scale, then defend your work from the spirits it attracts. A third-person factory game of automation, base building, and tower defense.

details.title: Internal Affairs: Love Parliament!
details.short_description: A lighthearted romantic-comedy visual novel set in the depths of bureaucratic hell! Meet four remarkable women—and dive into the absurd daily grind of a government office.

details.title: Welcome to Graymount
details.short_description: WELCOME TO GRAYMOUNT is a narrative VR action-adventure game using advanced locomotion mechanics set on the bleak island of Graymount, featuring "push-forward" combat, wall-running, jumping, and magic.

details.title: Dark Gun
details.short_description: Dark Gun is a modern roguelite survivor where guns clash with dark magic. Survive endless waves, build unstoppable power, and fight the abyss in stylish, fast-paced chaos.

details.title: Deal With Destiny 2
details.short_description: A fan made, story-driven sequel for a legendary mod "Deal with Destiny", where you step into the shoes of Oscar Wilson again, but in a new story which continues after leaving the city on the train with hopes for a peaceful life after what happened.

details.title: Defensia
details.short_description: Defensia is a turn-based strategy game. Build structures, Grow carrots, Recruit bunnians, Kill enemies, Keep your castle safe!

details.title: HeHe Remake
details.short_description: When the crimson moon rose, the HeHe were forced to abandon the surface and descend into the depths. Now, hunted by ReRe’s spawn, survival is no longer about mining — it’s about defying extinction.

details.title: Demonarch
details.short_description: Demonarch is the First-Person Real-Time Strategy game about summoning uncontrollable demons and keeping them happy enough that they eat all of your enemies before they eat you too! Emphasis on chaos, language, and information flow across the battlefield. Last exhibited at PAX West 2019

details.title: The Psychic
details.short_description: Be a Psychic to experience a larruping adventure. Living in the foggy place and exploring the unknown. Collecting resources and discovering magic treasures. Build and expand your own castle.

details.title: Chante: Fortress of Spores
details.short_description: In this third-person, tower defense/ puzzle game, you play as the adventurous little fungus, Chante! Explore, gather, and craft to uncover resources that will fortify your defenses, while surviving waves of enemy attacks. Join us in discovering the oddities of Chante: Fortress of Spores.

details.title: ЭОН
details.short_description: Welcome to "Volga" summer camp! Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a summer camp and find out what it's like to start living anew in such an amazing place. Shift 2032 is declared open!

name: 东方时裂空 ~ Numerology of Artifacts

details.title: 东方时裂空 ~ Numerology of Artifacts
details.short_description: 在一个本应该无事发生的冬季，幻想乡内各处发生了时空错乱的异变；不同区域的时间流动速度不一样，甚至还有其他时空的事物出现在幻想乡……但异变产生的原因和源头都不得而知，一切都是突如其来的。 不论如何都要解决掉黑幕，让这场异变停下来，要不然幻想乡就乱套了！

details.title: AI Peace Protocol
details.short_description: Pilot the anti gravity glider, explore world, transports goods, repairs infrastructure and decide the true mission of AI life on the new planet.

details.title: Portal of Nightmares Chapter 1
details.short_description: Upcoming Horror Game

details.title: see you: a brief exile
details.short_description: may this swordless adventure leads you to a peaceful new world

details.title: At the Bottom
details.short_description: You’re nobody. Until you become someone. Build a street empire from dirt, pain, and rage.

details.title: Fay Keeper
details.short_description: Battle, catch, and morph hundreds of Fays in this new turn-based creature collector RPG! Traverse the vast realm of The Faylands, filled with bustling cities, challenging dungeons and arenas, hidden routes and unpredictable weather. Ascend ranks to become the ultimate Fay Keeper!

details.title: SCP: Overrun
details.short_description: SCP: Overrun is a tower defense game where you secure a shelter while being overrun by hordes of dangerous SCPs. While things may seem hopeless at first, there is always a certain strategy or hidden mechanic that may be enough to save yourself.

details.title: MiniTank: Desert Strike
details.short_description: This is a twin-stick shooter in the style of The Binding of Isaac. A MiniTank, was sent on a mission to destroy an Enemy Base producing zombies was found in the Desert and Arctic.

details.title: 时空传说2黑暗之路
details.short_description: This is an RPG game set against the backdrop of swords and magic, paying tribute to the gameplay of the Golden Sun, DQ series, and Heavy Armor series. The storyline continues from generation to generation, In the depths of the quicksand lies another kingdom, a ghost wandering in the depths of the Sea of Death, hatred towards the Blood...

details.title: Ukrainians: Our battle
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of military events, become one of the volunteers of the country, where your every decision can become critical. Explore locations, make decisions, complete challenging missions. Everything is in your hands. Good luck!

details.title: Christmas Heist
details.short_description: A online co-op/PvP Christmas horror game. One player becomes Santa and hunts down the naughty kids trying to steal his gifts and escape the workshop.

details.title: Star Fighters
details.short_description: Star Fighters is a fully cross-platform shooter RPG where you can hunt down other players' spaceships or AI bots, either by yourself or as a team with your friends.

details.title: SYNCO PATH: AUTOMATON PRISON
details.short_description: Trapped in a surreal prison cell, Avery Stardust, a rogue automaton, has only 17 days to enter his reset code and accept a new life as determined by the Stagnation Protocol. But when the mystery of the SYNCO PATH program unravels, Avery will question everything he believes to be true.

details.title: Project: Bits
details.short_description: Project: Bits (Pronounced Beats) is a complimentary music and rhythm game. It's primary goal functions as a distribution platform for various songs and steps. Listen to the music. Feel the groove. Hit the arrows.

details.title: BuzzKill
details.short_description: Squash waves of nasty bugs! Swat them, kill them with fire, or pull out the Orbital Death Laser. Your mouse is your weapon in this EPIC Bullet Heaven Roguelike loaded with crazy weapons, items and upgrades! Now go spank some bugs 🎾 🐝

details.title: Win the Date
details.short_description: A deckbuilder roguelite about gay dating. The dating world can be cruel. Don’t let those guys crush your self-esteem. Crush theirs first!

details.title: Nosher
details.short_description: Nosher serves up the perfect platforming meal. Nosh on a variety of 'enemy treats' to possess their powers and movement, opening up more of the stages to find those hidden secrets you remember from classic '90s platformers.

details.title: GOD PLEASE HELP ME
details.short_description: Horror roguelike highly inspired by the 00s and 10s. BOO

details.title: The Wonderful Adventures Of Sip
details.short_description: Follow a journey of discovery, thunder, and destiny. Guide Sip through a world that judges, fears and misunderstands him. Uncover the ultimate purpose behind his existence. Your actions will shape the future. Choose wisely.

details.title: Donuts in Space
details.short_description: A space donut platformer

details.title: Biomes: Survival Era
details.short_description: Your last memory is a bright, glistening light in the water ... then you woke up in a world in which primates never existed and you are fighting for your life.

details.title: Wteruna
details.short_description: It's been a long day, without you my friend. And I'll tell you all about when I see you again.

details.title: Dragon Spirits 0
details.short_description: A skeleton from my childhood, the original edition of Dragon Spirits, which I developed in middle school, is a creature collector RPG that serves as the origin of the Dragon Spirits series. I still keep it as a memento. (Almost) no one can make a good game from the very beginning.

details.title: Trigger Spree
details.short_description: Putting the FUN back in FPS

details.title: B-17 Squadron
details.short_description: Take control of a B-17 in a realistic bomber simulator. Destroy key targets by dropping tons of bombs on them. Command each member of the crew and feel their stress and tension. Take part in the historical campaign across occupied Europe.

details.title: Aeronesia
details.short_description: Aeronesia is a non-linear platform RPG with emphasis on exploration, combat, dialogue and quest-based progression. After an accident transports you and hundreds of other people into an alien world, it's up to you to find a way to survive and discover some means of getting back home.

details.title: Schoolmare
details.short_description: Schoolmare is a survival horror game where you fall in love with a teacher. But it was a trap… You need to get out of the school and not be killed by a horrible monster.

details.title: WhyTaoism
details.short_description: Why Taoism Is an adventure game that explores spirituality and transcendence. In this game, players will take on the role of a group of beings who follow the legends of the ancient immortals and hope to ascend in order to transcend.

details.title: World of Yggdrasil
details.short_description: Become an emperor, a criminal, or a merchant in the ruthless world of Yggdrasil... Choose your own path, or carve it in blood.

details.title: Virnap
details.short_description: Virnap is a 3D horror game planned to release in 2023 made primarily for VR that will get you into a nightmare especially chosen for you from your fears.

details.title: Sunny Side Down, by Muno!
details.short_description: Sunny Side Down is a frantic arcade puzzle-platformer where you're a tiny mouse working at a breakfast diner, guiding eggs toward a frying pan while a line of angry customers looms over your head. How long can you last in this hectic work environment without getting fired?

details.title: Path of Life
details.short_description: Fantasy RPG with large world exploration, turn based combat strategy, custom character development through character attribute distribution and skill development. You Choose to play on the evil side or the good side.

details.title: Fishing Nightmares
details.short_description: A co-op horror fishing sim for 1–4 players. Play as SWAT operatives to retrieve a lost item deep in the Amazon jungle. Fish, sell, buy, and upgrade to achieve your mission.

details.title: DECONSTRUCTION
details.short_description: DECONSTRUCTION is a fast-paced, hardcore, shooting game.

details.title: Aletheia: Return of Odysseus
details.short_description: Embark on an accurate retelling of Homer’s Odyssey. A classic-inspired CRPG that puts you in control of Odysseus during his return home from the Trojan War. The game features turn-based combat, detailed character creation, choices and consequences, and a faithful depiction of Homer's Greece.

details.title: Aletheia: Prophecy of Perseus
details.short_description: A story-rich, turn-based RPG where you play as Perseus on his quest to slay the gorgon Medusa. Inspired by classic cRPGs like Baldur's Gate and Fallout 1 and 2. The game features choices and consequences, multiple quest solutions, and a faithful portrayal of Greek mythology.

details.title: TYRONE vs COPS 2
details.short_description: Awaken the latent power of your melanin and kill cops in this thought-provoking game on police brutality in America... Again!

details.title: Smol Adventure
details.short_description: A short 3D exploration role-playing game with a click-to-move movement system.
